comments:
Amazing place!

Location: short walk to all the bars and shops in Palermo soho and hollywood, plus also the subway

Apartment: v modern and with all you could want. Living room was perfect for relaxing in with a large sofa, massive TV and amazing view through the floor to ceiling windows. Bedroom hits the spot with a big windows, wardrobe and comfy bed. Bathroom also of the same standard

Building: has an amazing gym set-up on the 31 floor - always seemed to be empty and a real pleasure to use.

Fueron pocos días, pero alcancé a notar la excelente atención de Sandra. Estuvo siempre muy atenta para garantizarme una estadia muy confortable.
La casa es muy cómoda, agradable y bien ubicada.
Anhelo volver en un verano y disfrutar de la piscina.!!

La casa es hermosa y muy cómoda. Me he manejado como en mi propia casa. La calidad y calidez de la atención es INSUPERABLE. Sandra y su familia me han hecho sentir como un miembro mas de la familia. EXCELENTE.

encantadora casa y encantadora familia. mas que espacio suficiente para cualquier persona. la comodidad y la hospitalidad ponen en peligro las ganas de salir a conocer la ciudad!!! gracias por todo Sandra!!!
Really enjoyed Candela's recommendations and quick communication! Had a wonderful time in BsAs, enjoy this apartment!

Great location! Hosts are very helpful and welcoming. I stayed here for a week while I looked for a longer term apartment, and enjoyed my time. Big spacious room in a wonderful spot in Palermo Hollywood.

Excellent place, very comfortable (like a good size bachelor apartment), safe and a 10 minute walk from the subway and train to Retiro.  The owners are friendly, very helpful and interested in their guests.  The neighborhood is full of good restaurants, cafes and bars.  Feels like having your own place for your stay in BA!

This accommodation was superb.  For a busy and bustling Buenos Aires this Palermo Hollywood (Hollywood is a misnomer here) location was a breath of fresh air.  The room itself is nestled away at the back of the house far from the street (which, itself, is quiet) and made for a peaceful and relaxing stay.  The room is quite large, about the size of a king-sized Manhattan studio apartment, and it is detached from the main house where the hosts live.  If you want privacy, this is a great place to be.  However, if you want interaction with the hosts, their door is always open to you.  They are delightful and thoughtful people and very considerate of their guests' needs.  It is near the subway (el subte) and also near many local bus (el colectivo) stops to get you in the heart of downtown Buenos Aires.  If you're looking for an equivalent to a neighborhood, one suggestion is the residential Upper West Side of Manhattan -- great architecture, not commercial, and removed from the well-trodden touristy areas.  Like the UWS, it has access to great dining and cafés.  It is also no too far from trendy club spots, but you get to come home at night to undisturbed sleep (unlike many other areas of Buenos Aires).  Enjoy the space, enjoy the hosts, and enjoy Buenos Aires!

It was a pleasure to stay at Aikes place, the room is spotless clean, big and quiet what is a huge advantage in Buenos Aires. Beside this the host Aike is a lovely, welcoming host which makes you feel at home the minute you arrive. He provides you with good tips especially when you go to Patagonia what is his expertise. I can only advise everybody to stay at and with Aike in Buenos Aires.

We have stayed in a number of airbnb places and had a lot of great experiences, but we both agreed this was our favorite.  Perfect location in the heart of Palermo Hollywood, walking distance to Palermo Soho, in a very comfortable suite of rooms that feels very much like a private apartment.  Great bed, AC that worked well in the heat of the Buenos Aires summer and extremely quiet.  Most of all we enjoyed the company of our hosts!  This is a highly recommended stop for anyone looking for a taste of life in bohemian Palermo.  We stayed 9 days.
Guillermo and Christina were wonderful hosts and treated me like family. Guillermo is a fascinating person–ask to see the films he made about Patagonia!
Wonderful hosts and a great place to stay. Highly recommended!
Wonderfull stay. Best entry to buenos Aires and Argentina.

Candela and her colleague were very attentive and quick to respond, absolutely wonderful. The apartment is beautiful, well equipped and conveniently located close to the historic part of Palermo, bars and excellent restaurants. I highly recommend this place.

How to start living as a local in Buenos Aires? Just book this apartment..!

A fantastic place with lots of quiet and peace amidst the energy of Pallermo. Busses around the corner to visit the best parts of town, or if you don't want to, just walk 5 minutes to discover the best and cosiest restaurants, lunch places, breakfast cafes or designer shops.

The hosts are very warm people who really do care about you and make sure that you will have a great time.

Will visit again!!!

My experience in Vivi's house couldn't be better. Her house is really good, confortable, clean. The neighboorhood is very nice too. There are parks, cafes, supermakets, subways...

But the best of everything is Viviana. If you want to know the life of the porteños, this is the best place to stay. She took me to places I could never go as a normal tourist. She is incredibly sweet, inteligent, helpful... Very, very nice person. I'm really happy to know her.

Gracias por todo, Vivi! Besos

Stop looking - you have found the perfect place for your stay in Buenos Aires! Vivi is the most welcoming host you could imagine and staying at her appartment is like finding a home in a foreign city.

The room and appartment are bright and colourful and it is lovely to have a living room and kitchen to use whenever you like. The appartment is in a brilliant area with little tango bars, cafes and parks on the doorstep - Vivi will tell you about local places that aren't in the guidebook. If tango is your thing, Vivi runs milongas (group workshops) a few times a week, which are super friendly and end in wine and pizza.

Seriously, stay here - we've had an amazing few weeks!

My stay at DONDE VIVI was great! From the moment I got there Viviana made me feel at home, she is a cool host. The room was large and had everything I needed and the location is next to a nice plaza with good public transportation near by too.

Estuve casi dos semanas en el departamento de Vivi y me gustó mucho, me sentí como en mi casa, y Vivi era muy amable. Bien, nos hemos visto no mucho, he estado muy preocopado con tareas afuera. También el barrio está bien y muy cercano a mi barrio favorito de Buenos Aires, Once.
Vivi is a beautiful person, very friendly and the place is very nice and well situated.
Excelente lugar, muy bien ubicado y la casa es super tranquila. Vivi es muy agradable y atenta, demasiado! Sumamente recomendada :)
Muy bien. Amabilidad y una casa llena de gente interesante.

location is great - 2 metro lines close by.
area safe and pretty (bars, restaurants, shops ... )
internet (wifi) works great.
rooms are spacious, luminous and welcoming. feels like home the second you step foot into the apartment. beautiful pieces of art all over the place.

perfect place to dive deep into the tango scene!!

defenitely a place that makes you want to stay there for as long as you can!

and vivi ... what can i say?!? a perfect host!!!
Recommended!!!!!!!!!

Vivi was so nice, so helpful and so understanding with everything. I loved her apartment, the neighborhood, and have no complaints. I would recommend staying at Vivi's place! She's an excellent tango teacher, taboot.

For the price, this place was good. Close to one of the subway lines, Medrano station (B or red line), clean bathroom, and a comfortable bed (soft mattress, may not be good for those with a bad back, but fine for me). It was a secure location with private entry. 2nd floor, street level locked entry, up a private staircase, another locking thick glass apartment door, and a locking bedroom door (good for those who may feel nervous about sleeping soundly in a foreign country). Karina provided a clean towel for showering. WiFi was available. It worked about 85% of the time during my 16 night stay. It would stop working sometimes throughout the day and evening for periods of time. Not a router issue, but an ISP issue. I was told this could be common throughout Buenos Aires. Internet access was very important to me during this trip because I was travelling for school and writing a research paper which required an extensive use of Internet, but when it didn't work I resolved the issue by using free WiFi available at the McDonald's 3 blocks away at Avenida Corrientes or at Grotto on the same block, a nicer restaurant. Many restaurants/business throughout Buenos Aires have free WiFi, which helped. The kitchen has a medium sized fridge, sink, toaster oven, and twin hot plates. It's a bit small but nothing you can't get used to. I didn't do any heavy cooking. Mostly cold foods, drinks, take-out, and restaurants. The neighborhood is mostly locals as far as I could tell. Not many tourists. English was not widely spoken in the shops I entered. If your Spanish is not good, it may be difficult. I speak enough Spanish to get by. Didn't have any problems making purchases for basic items and food. Try to speak the local language where ever you travel. It's respectful!!! The pizza shop 1 block to the left when exiting the building "Pizza de Antes" was good and the staff friendly. It's not at all like pizza in the States, which I expected, but good. Gelato shops are everywhere and really good! Like other reviews mentioned...yes, the street is very noisy. I knew this going in. I'm from NYC and used to the noise, but if you're a light sleeper, it may be a problem. Also on some evenings you could hear loud drumming from a neighborhood band playing from the park down the block "Plaza Almagro." It's a good beat and entertaining, but it does go on for an hour or so. Overall, it wasn't a flawless stay, but for the price, very good. Also, Karina was very accommodating when I was arriving. I had some difficulties travelling (delayed flights and exiting the airport). I kept in contact with her frequently to update her regarding my whereabouts so she still knew I was coming. She waited for me patiently until I arrived to give me the keys and to show me around the apartment. I'd stay here...

The room is very nice and there are 2 rooms and its private, in other words her apartment is separate(but same entrance). the bed is a double and its very large. The room and the apartment are very nice, very well decorated with modern paintings. Karina is very cool person with an amazing life, but the problem was that she is so busy that I never got to see her. All together I saw her only 5 minutes. thats too bad because i was hoping to spend a little time with her, but no. But she was helpful and answered any questions i had by leaving a notes. Also she had some travel books available. also i like the neighborhood even though its funky. there are some nice tango clubs near by with live music very closeby. thats nice. also plaza almargo is very interesting. there are hundreds of people there at night. its about 3 blocks from the subway station medrano on line b. i like karinas attitude. its like we are sharing an apartment, share food, share things. the bathroom and shower are just ok. She put a big fan in my room which was nice and also there was a balcony also. there is a lot of noise from the street but the fan drowned out the noise.

El barrio es bastante céntrico, a 10 minutos andando del mercado Abastos, por donde está el museo Carlos Gardel. Es cierto que el barrio de Almagro no viene en los mapas de las guías turísticas, pero, insisto, es bastante céntrico y viene muy bien para visitar toda la ciudad.
La casa es amplia y hay todo para preparar la comida.
Puede haber ruido de los vecinos entre 10 y 12 de la noche y ruido de los coches de la calle Salguero. Este es el único inconveniente.
Por lo demás, tanto Viviana como Karin son muy serviciales y amables, aunque no las haya conocido personalmente.

Viviana is a wonderful person and a great human being, she has deep knowledge about argentina's music, art, politics, culture, food and geography that will share with you if you want, she is also a Tango dance teacher (wow). She speaks English and has toured Europe and USA ensuring hours of enjoyable conversation. On the other hand if you just want your own space, silence and quiet you do not notice that she is around. The house is an old house in a very good shape, the room has a lot of space and it is nice, maybe you will have some trouble if you have too much clothes, but Viviana will help with that. The room is front a big avenue with lines of buses and you will hear some noise but in the night is quiet. The neighborhood is safe, beauty and is close to a big mall, few restaurants, pubs, markets and a metro station. I walk late night on the streets and i think is a safe place. If you want spend good time in Buenos Aires in a beauty and safe place i sincerely recommend Vivi's home, once you're there you do not want to leave. Deseo agradecer a Viviana la hospitalidad que me brindó en el momento en que un extranjero como yo mas la necesité. Viviana es una persona maravillosa y una gran hospedera y tiene conocimientos en todo lo relacionado con Argentina y Buenos Aires (comida, cultura, musica y geografia) y te puede sacar de las dudas que tengas sobre la ciudad si así lo deseas (también es una de las mejores profesoras de Tango, asi que aprovecha!). Vivi es una gran conversadora y habla bien el inglés, ha viajado mucho por Europa y Norte America por lo que tiene mucho que enseñar y compartir. Por otro lado si lo que deseas es quietud y silencio no te va a molestar para nada. La habitación es espaciosa con una cama grande en la segunda planta de una casa antigua pero bien conservada, hay espacio para todo y dentro de tu habitación tienes tu mesa y un par de sillas con un closet pequeño y percheros para tu ropa, si tienes demasiada ropa puedes tener problemas con el espacio pero nada grave que Vivi no te ayude a solucionar. La habitación esta frente a una calle principal con muchas rutas de buses por lo que hay bastante ruido en el día, en la noche es bastante calmado. El barrio es antiguo, bonito y bastante seguro (caminé varias veces por las calles en la noche y la madrugada sin ningún problema), esta rodeado de varios restaurantes, bares, ventas de alimentos y esta cerca a un Shopping (Abasto, que es grande y muy bonito) a la vez que tienes varias rutas de buses y una estación del metro. Si deseas pasar un buen rato en buenos aires en un sitio bonito y seguro te recomiendo 100% la casa de Vivi. Una vez que estas ahí...

We enjoyed an amazing stay at Vivi´s for 2 and a half weeks. The bedrooms are spacious and there is a lovely and light dining room to use as well. The kitchen is small but has everything you need. As described on the listing there is quite a lot of noise from the road outside, but we never found it to be a problem.

The apartment is in a great position to explore the city and local Almagro highlights such as the Catedral tango hall, El Boliche di Roberto historic bar, and Las Violetas cafe.

Vivi is a wonderful person and a perfect host! Her partner Tommy was there at the time too and they both gave us loads of advice about where to go and lots of knowledge about Buenos Aires and Argentinian culture :) Not to mention some invaluable tango training! We really hope to see them again :)

Muchos gracias Vivi y Tommy!!

Vivi's place is the definition of BUENA ONDA. I wish I had had more time there, in fact. The place is taken care of with amor, and you can really tell. Vivi and her roomate Vanessa are the best company to sit around with and drink a couple of mates. Vivi, you're always welcome in New York (or wherever I may be)!

Solamente decir que fue una excelente experiencia en Buenos Aires!... Vivi es una excelente anfitriona y su casa es muy acogedora, cómoda y bien ubicada para desplazarse por todo Buenos Aires. Almagro es un barrio seguro y agradable, con buena disponibilidad de comercio (restaurantes, kioskos, supermercados, etc). Definitivamente muy recomendable para alojarse en Buenos Aires.
My holidays in Vivi's flat and in Buenos Aires were splendid. Vivi is that kind of person that simplifies your life and brings things in the right prospectives. Thanks Vivi!
Viv was great!  Very accommodating, personable, friendly, helpful.  A very attentive and cool host.

Foi uma experiênca interessante e agradável para mim. Pois, nunca havia feito aluguel de quarto de imóvel com o proprietário morando na casa. Quanto ao espaço alugado, ficou dentro do que planejei para o período em que estive estudando em Buenos Aires. O único incoveniente que me incomodou foi o ruído contínuo de veículos passando pela rua. Abs.

Nem sei direito como começar mas vamos lá. A minha experiência na casa de Vivi foi maravilhosa! Desde a recepção até a minha saída. Vivi é uma anfitriã excepcional o que fez minha estadia em Buenos Aires ser melhor do que o esperado. A casa de Vivi é aconchegante, bem localizada e em um bairro muito gostoso. Pude fazer vários passeios por Buenos Aires a pé e nas visitas a outros bairros o taxi ficou em conta. Tem um quarto limpo e gostoso de se ficar, e aquecido para dias de inverno. Recomendo 100%.

I don't know how to start but, let's go. My experience on the house of Vivi was amazing! Since the reception till the check out. Vivi is a exceptional hostess, what made my days in Buenos Aires better then I was think it. The house of Vivi is so comfortable and it is in a neighbor very well located. I could do many optional tours simple walking and going to others neighborhoods the cab was cheap. Vivi have a room clean and comfortable to stay, heated with cooled air to the winter days. I recommend 100%, and it was good to meet you Vivi. Take care! :)

Viviana is a lovely person! She takes care that her guests are good in every aspect of their stay. She is an excellent guide on the uses and customs of the Argentine people.
This welcoming house is in the center of one of the most beautiful neighborhoods in the city. Within walking distance there are many nice and typical bars, along with all the services that you may require.
For me a perfect experience, I felt welcomed by Viviana as a friend.

Viviana is an amazing host more like an old friend. We chatted about travels and life in Buenos Aires, she always made sure everything was fine.
Viviana even arranged for an airport pickup with her friend Leandro who is a super cool guy, for a good price.
Highly recommend staying with her :-)
Nos fue súper bien en la casa de Vivi. Ella tiene la mejor onda y es súper amable. La casa esta en un barrio genial, cerca del centro. La casa esta muy bien. Recomiendo este sitio para quedarse.

Viviana is such a great host and personifies the life and vibe of Tango and Buenos Aires!
The Flat is in Almagro wich is very central so getting around to the other Barrios is short and easy.
Your Room is super nice, Spacious, Clean, Friendly and Light.
DondeVivi is a great place to stay and if you have questions about Buenos Aires Vivi will give you some great pointers and tips!

Vivi was wonderful! I just wish we had more time to spend with her. She gave us a quick tour of the neighborhood and showed us what's around for food and entertainment as soon as we got there. This is a great location - park nearby and lots of little shops, restaurants, groceries, etc. Subway is not a far walk and buses are right outside the door. The street noise is LOUD at night but we still enjoyed our stay once we started sleeping with earplugs. This is one of two guest rooms that are rented out, so be aware that there may be multiple guests. The kitchen is very tiny but we still managed to make some good meals there. This place is very cozy and homey. We enjoyed the patio a lot. This was a wonderful place to spend a week in Buenos Aires!

The flat is located in a central neighborhood and there are plenty of shops and cafes nearby. I liked Almagro barrio. Viviana was travelling at the time when I was in the flat, but she had organized everything, so that I felt welcomed. The street is a bit noisy at night, but it was not a problem for me.

Passei momentos adoráveis no bairro do meu coração em pleno coração de Buenos Aires. Depois de haver morado algum tempo na vizinhança, na casa de Vivi me senti "como en mi casa". Além de uma anfitriã maravilhosa, se tornou uma querida amiga. A casa é tão receptiva quanto ela, os cômodos são limpos e a decoração simples e aconchegante. Almagro é um surpreendente convite a conhecer um tradicional bairro portenho que se encontra muito perto da estação de metrô, de vários pontos de ônibus que te levam rapidamente até Palermo, Recoleta e ao centro e à muitos outros lugares interessantes. Padarias e supermercados também estão por ali. E Vivi fará questão de ajudar com qualquer dúvida ou orientação necessárias. Gracias, Vivi.

Nice place to stay, close to the metro station. In a real local, argentina neighborhood. The place is quite, clean and the lady is verry friendly. I realy enjoyed my time in this place. A nice way to be introduce to Argentina....

In a former travel hotel, the appartment has the dated charm and atmosphere of Buenos Aires, we really enjoyed it.
The location is pretty central to discover the city and you can find everything you need within one block.
(-) Internet was quite slow because of the distance from the antena but we dealt with it and Eleonora offers to use her own flat if needed.

The apartment was in a beautiful, modern building, was wonderfully decorated and equip with all of the modern amenities. We not only loved the apartment, but the location was ideal. We were walking distance to the Subte and to my job in Palermo Soho. We were surrounded by lots of restaurants and boutiques. The only issue with this apartment is the noise. The neighbors on our floor had a dog that barked constantly and often times woke us up at night. We spoke with Candela who tried to help us solve the issue and it seems as though many neighbors have complained about dogs in the building and that they might be more selective in the future. We hope that's the case because it's a beautiful place to live otherwise.

Muchas gracias a Eleonora y Milagros, por la hospitalidad, pasamos días muy tranquilos y confortables en su casa.
Pequeña y acogedora con todos los servicios necesarios y céntrica.
Lovely self-contained apartment- everything is clean, tidy and quiet.. easy to get around the city. Elenora is very helpful and easy to get hold of.. Will go back, if in Buenos Aires..

Nice place to stay in Buenos Aires, close to everything and very quiet. Very kind and very friendly peoples to. Perfect. No surprise. I recommend !
Thanks for everything:)

The apartment was great- the bathroom was very spacious, there was reliable Internet, and lots of room. Although located close to Once, the neighborhood was very calm and has lots of restaurants and grocery stores. A great stay!
La casa es muy acogedora, cómoda, y tiene todo lo necesario. La casa es muy silenciosa. Milagros es un amor. Eleonora responde todos mis mensajes, es una chica muy atenta. ¡Recomendable!

Adoramos nossos dias em Buenos Aires! O apartamento é muito aconchegante e tem tudo que precisa depois de um dia de muitas caminhadas por BsAs. Milagros foi atenciosa quando precisamos, tivemos um pequeno problema para acessar a internet mas foi logo resolvido.

No bairro há muito comercio mas é bem sossegado a noite.
Há metro próximo e muitas linhas de transporte coletivo e levam a todos os pontos da cidade.
All was really good - lovely place in a great location. Eleonora's a great communicator and very nice!

My stay at Ele's place went great!  It is a very spacious studio with great light during the day.  The building itself is also kind of neat and has a very BA feel.  Ele was not around while I was in town, but the woman who manages the building lived down the hall, was extremely friendly and was always a help when I needed something.  Ele herself was very flexible when I had a friend in town that wanted to crash for a few nights.  The internet was occasionally a bit spotty, but not usually for long.  I definitely recommend this comfy space!

My girlfriend and I booked Eles place for 9 nights and we have to say that our stay was just perfect. Not only are Ele and Milagros super nice but the apartment is beautiful. It is located just in the heart of BA and the connection to public transport is amazing. It's the perfect home to discover this incredible city, so we recommend to anyone who's thinking about going to Buenos Aires, to stay at Eles place! Thanks so much. We will come back :-)

Einfache kleine Wohnung, trotz des großen Geräuschpegels von BA sehr ruhig. Gut zentral gelegen, wir haben vieles zu Fuß gemacht oder sind mit der U-Bahn gefahren, Station gleich um die Ecke. Geschäfte, alles was man braucht in griffnaähe. Betreuung von Milagros richtig lieb. Wir würden gern wieder herkommen.
Uta&Jürgen

Quelle hôte ! sourire, sympathie, bonne humeur ... Ce fût un plaisir de partager durant plus d'une semaine l'appartement de Vivi. Fine aiguilleuse que ce soit pour les restaurants, musées , parc ou autre, elle a pu répondre à toutes nos questions ! L'appartement est très bien situé dans le sympathique quartier de Almagro!
Nous avons partagés de très bon moment, n'hésitez pas!

Viviana me recibió con muchísimo cariño y atención. La habitación es fabulosa y los ambientes comunes de la casa un sueño. Vivi me enseñó  los secretos del barrio con una educación, cercanía y amabilidad increíbles. La ubicación es inmejorable y el barrio ofrece lo mejor de un Buenos Aires eléctrico. Viviana es una anfitriona magnífica.

Beautiful Person, Soul and Tango.. .
Very comfortable home .

Thank you :)

My stay at Candela's apartment was very enjoyable. The apartment looks exactly like the photos.  Candela is very hospitable and does everything to make the stay enjoyable. I would recommend this place to anyone wishing to visit Buenos Aires. The location is also an added bonus, very close to the D line Subte and bus connections from Plaza Italia. The parks are very close by as are many great restaurants and coffee shops.
Very nice place, just as shown in the pictures.  Close to everything - stores, Palermo Viejo, botanical garden, and the subte station.  Candela made everything easy.  Thanks!

El lugar es muy acogedor y muy bonito además de su excelente ubicación en almagro, además Vivi es una persona tan buena onda y cálida que no hay el más mínimo problema en sentirse como en casa, la atención excelente siempre. Lástima que no estaba por vacaciones u ocio, sino me imagino que hubiera podido conocer toda la onda del Tango que Vivi te la transmite con tanta pasión que uno queda con muchas ganas de conocer.

Durante 2semanas en DONDEVIVI fue un placer. El barrio es muy tanquilo y facil para andar sitios iteresantes. El ambiente de casa fue muy comodo, la habitacion fue amplia y limpia. Vivi era una persona muy buena..y sabe mucho historia de argentina..para mi ella fue muy buena guia para conocer mas de Argentina.

The description of the rooms was very accurate. It was noisy from the buses passing, but I already knew that, so it didn't bother me. On the first day, my host greeted me, oriented me to the house, walked me around a few blocks of the neighborhood to show me where a natural food store was (I am celiac), and gave me keys. She is warm, friendly, helpful and very funny. I really enjoyed staying with her, and would do so again.
Un apartamento muy bonito con una anfitriona muy amable y un perrito, pompi, adorable! Bien situado, un poquito de ruido en la habitacion por la noche pero recomendaria la estancia a cualquiera!
La casa es acogedora y Viviana es muy amable!!! Un poco de ruido por el tráfico pero nada que no te permita descansar...ojalá pueda quedarme más!!!
Fantastica! Una casa linda con buena gente. Gracias viviana ☺️
Excelente lugar, ubicación y amabilidad.. 100% recomendado

A estadia foi super tranquila. A comunicação com Viviana é fluida e sempre que precisei fui bem orientada por ela. O gatinho se tornou um grande amigo, assim como Ariel, e sentirei saudades! A localização é muito boa também.

Meu único adendo é para pessoas que têm o sono leve: por ser uma casa de frente para a rua há muito barulho no quarto. Mas, se isso não é um problema para você, todo o resto é perfeito e exatamente como descrito no anúncio.

Mi estadía en la casa de Vivi fue súper. Pude sentirme realmente cómodo y a gusto. La casa es muy linda, y viene con la compañía de Fisu, un gato que está diseñado para enamorar. La zona es genial, es lindo y cerca de todo. Me da mucha lástima no haberme podido quedar más días, pero sin dudas volvería en el futuro. Gracias Vivi!!

Whats-App ist für BsAs sicher Pflicht. Hierüber war es sehr einfach mit Vivi in Kontakt zu treten. Sie hat immer schnell reagiert und eine gute Lösung gefunden.

Der Zugang ist etwas schmal, was bei großem Gepäck schwierig sein kann.

Das Zimmer ist exakt wie in der Beschreibung. Ausreichend groß und mit offenen Regalen.

Die Küche ist funktional und eher klein.

Das Bad is sauber und wenn es Wasser gibt, dann ist es auch heiß.

BsAs ist eine laute Stadt und die Busse tragen ihren Teil dazu bei. Leider ist genau vor dem Fenster eine Bushaltestelle und die haltenden Busse erreichen dann bei offenen Fenster 75dB (gemessen mit dem iPhone im Bett liegend).
Wer kein Problem mit Lärm oder Ohrstöpseln hat, findet hier eine hervorragende Herberge.

Ein gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis!

Very nice place to stay in Buenos Aires.
People in the residence are very kind.
Very good

Thank you for everything, Candela. Die Wohnung und die Anlage ist genauso wie versprochen. Meine Sonderwünsche konnten alle berücksichtigt werden. Beim Check-in und Check-out war Candela sehr flexibel!

I booked Eleonora's unit on short notice and she was completely accommodating and responded in a timely manner. She was not in BA during my stay but her assistant Milagros was, and was of great assistance. The apartment was located in the Congreso area, and was easy to find. I walked from the bus station, but realized the subway is very close by. The neighborhood is residential and quieter at night than other areas. The apartment itself was spacious and comfortable. It's an older house with high ceilings and windows with tiled kitchen and wood floors. It had an old boutique hotel feel. The wifi was good and bed was comfy. Milagros was available any time but was also respectful of my time and space and was very considerate. It turned out she was from my parents home country so it was good to have a familiar presence. The bathroom had a bidet,. The hot water worked and pressure was good. Overall the place was comfortable and accessible to all public transportation. You can also call a taxi or have Milagros call one for you as she did when i had to fly out of Ezeiza.  I had a great stay and Eleonora and Milagros made me feel welcomed. Most importantly they didn't stress check in and check out times and accomodated me according to my arrival and departure.  Highly recommended for the great price.

Eu e o meu marido ficamos no apartamento durante nossa lua de mel, foi ótimo! O apartamento é muito aconchegante e está tudo muito em ordem. Alguns problemas que tivemos com a internet e o chuveiro a Milagros, pessoa responsável pela chave, ajudou-nos prontamente!

A quaint old building, with rooms converted into apartments. A nice big main room with cool fittings and a high ceiling. Eleonara was most helpful when we needed to arrive quite late.

Having stayed in a few other places in BA, though, there are some other neighbourhoods that I preferred:
- The location is a little far out for what I paid, though access to the Subte is pretty good.
- The surrounding area isn't brilliant: passable restaurants and cafés, and it can get a little seedy late at night.

Eleonora's studio was for me fantastic: romantic, rustic with style,  very quiet, 20 foot high ceilings and 10 foot high doors, a cozy kitchen and all safe and sound. Milagros, the on site caretaker/manager, is a true delight. The next time I return I want to marry her. John from switzerland
Exatamente como está na foto, da pra economizar uma grana e passar bem. Não é chique, não é apertado. Bem ok.

The apartment was great and bright, and since it is facing inwards it is also very quiet. We got all the help we needed, and the arrival and departure was easy.
There is not much happening in the area, but we felt safe in the street and it was easy to take public transportation or walk to other neighbourhoods.

Eleonora helped us book this apartment at the last minute. She was out of town but Milagros the caretaker was available all the time, really sweet and helpful with advice about the neighborhood. The apartment is a few blocks from the subway and it is about 20 minutes to downtown and 30 to Palermo and San Telmo. We used the subway during the day and took taxis home at night. Overall the apartment is a good deal!

I had an excellent stay in Buenos Aires and at the Urban Escape Studio. This was my first time using AirBnb so I had my reservations. Things turned out great. Ralf met me at the unit (even though I made him wait an hour and a half due to a delayed flight). He was very helpful, showed me all around the room, and gave me some tips about the area. The apartment itself was in great shape; beautifully decorated, and equipped with anything you could ever need - from kitchen utensils to bath supplies. I would highly recommend Ralf and his services, and will try and use him again when I likely return towards the end of the year.

Thanks again.

Erik

I loved this place!  It is like a hotel yet way better.  We went with some friends and we stayed here and they stayed in a hotel and we all wanted to hang out here because there was more room, there is a balcony where you can watch the sun set, a fridge, and so many more things.  One of my favorite parts was the roof top pool.  I would go up around 9:30 am and there were very few people there.  Amazing place, very clean and the cleaner came by twice a week.  Could not have asked for a better host or a better place to stay.  It was in the heart of all the action!  I cannot say enough about Ralf.  He has people to help if he is not available so someone always get back to you, they let us keep our bags in the office until we needed to leave for the airport, etc.  Amazing place, amazing experience, amazing host!  Highly reccommended.

We had admired the Palermo Uno building on previous visits to Buenos Aires and it did not disappoint.  The location is prime, and the apartment, furnishings, building amenities and security are all first-rate.  Candela is a friendly, gracious host, and her onsite manager could not have been more helpful.  The view from the gym on the 31st floor is the visual definition of awesome.  Thanks for a great experience!

Candela did a great job accommodating us. While she was not there personally, she had a friend meet us at the unit and let us in and get us situated. Any issues we had were quickly fixed.

The unit itself is in an excellent location. Close to the parks and attractions in and around the park (zoo, planetarium, Japanese gardens, MALBA) as well as all of the great restaurants in Palermo SOHO. We could not have asked for a better location.

The unit was also clean and had some good books on BA to review. The bed was very comfortable!The unit had a decent gym and good security.

The only negative was noise. The sounds of dogs and babies was so loud they sounded like they were in the unit. There is also a water pipe in the wall that is poorly insulated so you constant hear water flushing through the pipes. If you're a light sleeper, this apartment isn't for you. Otherwise it is fantastic and in a great location.

The service we received was excellent! Everything went without a hitch; we were picked up from the airport and delivered back exactly when we were told we would. The apartment looks just like in the pictures and it is very conveniently located in the center of town with a grocery store right across from it. I would definitely recommend this apartment as well as Ralph's company to my friends.

Ralf took time to welcome us and to give us basic information about the flat and the city. We also had access to a really useful document with useful addresses and important phone numbers. Ralf was available if we needed some help. We spent five nights in this nice studio located in Recoleta. It is a central location from which it is easy to commute to other interesting neighbourhoods of BsAs. We enjoyed the roof top swimming pool during hot summer days!

Ralf an his team were great, they provided a tone of information on arrival - which was late in the evening - and were incredibly helpful.
The apartment was the perfect location and had everything you could ask for.
Thanks for a great holiday and we'll definitely be back!

We stayed one week in this apartment. The location was excellent. It's very close to a Subte station, taxi drivers knew the area and the building has a 24/7 doorman.

The apartment itself was exactly as promised. There was wifi that worked very well and cable tv with lots of channels - both in Spanish and a few in English. The apartment was well decorated and very comfortable and included a nice kitchen area fully stocked with dishes and pans. The rooftop pool was great.

Ralf and his team were very helpful when we wanted information about booking tours, etc. They also provide a book of information in your apartment with answers to common questions, recommended restaurants, etc. Read it before you go out. It has tons of useful information that will make your trip better.

Ralf could not have been more welcoming or helpful when we arrived at Urban Escapes. He gave us so much useful information about the area and places to visit in BA and the apartment was just beautifully set up with everything we needed- good coffee and even a beer in the fridge. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

The studio is very well located to discover the city, closed to all shops and to the metro. The little swimming poool on the roof is fantastic to have rest after walking all the day in Buenos Aires. The building os very  secured .The studio is well decorated with wifi and TV. The kitchen is equiped with all that you need. Marcello and Ralf heplped us during our stay and duirng our difficult check out because of climatic and "toxic" conditions on B.A

Our stay in this apartment went very smoothly thanks to the attentive BA4U team. It's a compact space but perfect for one or two people. They had coffee for the coffee machine, a variety of fresh fruit and a bottle of water waiting for us which was much appreciated! In general, we preferred staying in Palermo because of the restaurants and neighborhood atmosphere but Recoleta has much to offer if you want to easily explore the museums, shopping areas, and famous cemetery.

Netter und unkomplizierter Empfang.Hatten schöne 15 Tage in diesem "old Fashion Stil" Zimmer und haben uns sehr sehr wohl gefühlt. Eine kleine ruhige Oase zum ausspannen nach einem anstrengenden Tag. Super Matratze und viel heißes Wasser ;) Danke Ernan!Sehr günstig gelegen. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Busse und Metro gleich in der Naehe. Auf ein Wiedersehen!!!!!

Candela was a very good host. Although I did not meet her in person she was quick to respond to any questions or concerns. The apartment itself is just as described.  I was very comfortable for the two months that I lived there, the bed was wonderful, and everything worked perfectly in the apartment. In terms of the location, it was also very convenient, near the metro (Plaza Italia) and Santa Fe, which has all the bus connections you could ever need. My one caveat would be that the neighbors have a very annoying dog that barks all the time. It didn't really bother me much because I sleep very deep and I was out of the house most of the day, but if you are a light sleeper this might be an issue. Sadly this is out of Candela's control, but it would only be fair to mention it. Beyond that, I would recommend this apartment and great building.

Candela's apartment listing description was accurate. She was very responsive. It is a lovely space, great location and wonderful amenities. An amazing view from the gym on the 31st floor. Lovely sauna and jacuzzi on the 32nd floor, and great pool and sunbathing area. All the staff in the building was very friendly and responsive to any needs. They made me feel very welcome.

The building is two books away from the Subte (public transportation - subway), walking distance to great coffee shops, retail stores, ice-cream parlours and restaurants. The building is located in Palermo Soho and walking distance to Palermo Hollywood and Recoleta. It is couple of books away from "Bosques de Palermo", the planetarium, the Botanical Garden and the Japanese Garden. All fantastic outdoor green areas for safe walks or to practice outdoor sports.

I have been visiting Argentina for over 20 years now. I have been coming at least twice a year for work during the last 3 years, and this was the best accommodation I have had.

I stayed in this apartment this time for 6 months and loved it!!! If available, I am planing to stay here again when coming back to BsAs for work or vacation. I highly recommend it!

Thanks Candela for providing me with a great living space that was key for a fantastic 6 month in BsAs!!!

El apartamento es muy cómodo, tiene mucha luz y está muy bien distribuido. El edificio es bastante nuevo y los amenities como gimnasio y piscina están muy bien. El apartamento incluye equipamiento suficiente como platos, vasos, toallas. He estado muy a gusto en mi estancia de 2 meses. Repetiría sin dudar. El contacto con Candela ha sido fluido tanto a la entrada como en la salida.
The Palermo neighborhood is great for guests with easy access to the subway and many restaurants! Candela is very responsive and helpful. It was very easy and convenient to stay here.

Candela was a wonderful host and gave us lots of information about the neighborhood and checked in several times to make sure everything was satisfactory. Although we did not meet in person, the check in process was easy and everyone in the building was very nice.  I am very happy we spent our month in Buenos Aires here and would highly recommend it to other guests!

Como lo exprese en una reseña de mi estadía en este apartamento en el 2015, el apartamento es moderno, con lindos acabados y muy bien mantenido, en un edificio como n excelente gimnasio y piscina, en una zona linda de la ciudad y de fácil acceso por transporte público. Candela ha siempre sido muy amable. La comunicación siempre fue fácil y efectiva. Es mi segundo semestre como huésped en este apartamento, lo recomiendo y de estar disponible, espero sea nuevamente mi casa en BsAs.
Excelente departamento tanto en ubicacion (2 cuadras del metrobus y subte) como confort (amenities del edificio).  Candela y Gaston siempre muy atentos en todo! Sin duda volveria a hospedarme!
Excelente departamento. Estuve casi 2 meses. Lo recomiendo 100%. Candela y Gaston estuvieron siempre predispuestos. Gracias por todo!
perfect location, looks exactly like the pictures, very safe and secure, best views in the city from rooftop gym.

I love this place.

The internet works well, which is extremely important for me because I work from the apartment where I run my business.

The apartment is spacious, in a nice part of Palermo. I LOVE the exterior wall windows so I always have a view of outside. And the view from the gym on the top floor is spectacular.

The apartment is as shown in the pictures, and Candela is always helpful whenever I need anything.

Repeat business is the best compliment you can give. I stayed in Candela's apartment, and then promptly booked it again for a longer stay.

And I wholeheartedly look forward to booking it a 3rd time for an extended stay.

The apartment is wonderful. The building g is great. And Candela is a fabulous host.

It was a wonderful experience all around.

Another amazing semester at this fantastic apartment. Great location, easy/close to public transportation and outdoor green spaces. Great amenities and Candela has always been the best hostess, prompt to respond and always helpful. Highly recommended!

I loved my time at this apartment. This was my secret and stay and i loved it so much the last time, i was delighted to come back.

It felt like home. The apartment, the building, the staff - everyone was wonderful and I was thankful to be in this space for almost a full year on this trip.

Candela is a fantastic host, she communicated well with me, and went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed for an enjoyable stay.

I can't recommend this space enough.

The location and views are tough to beat!
Great place and hospitality!

Eleanora's apartment was everything we could have hoped for - a quiet oasis right of calm right in the centre of buenos aires. Though we didn't meet Eleanora, her brother Hernan was around to welcome us and provide us with some much needed local advice. The apartment itself was well equipped and very pretty indeed. Thoroughly recommended!!
Highly recommended. The apartment looks exactly how it shows in the pictures and Tomas, Andres and Ralf are very helpful whenever you need. Will definetely stay there next time!
Had a great stay at Candela's place. Candela and Marcelo were very accommodating during my stay - would recommend!
El lugar muy bien ubicado, el edificio seguro, el gimnasio tiene una vista impresionante! Candela y Marcelo muy atentos. Pase excelente. Muy recomendado.
Fantastic apartment, perfect location, pool and gym are a huge bonus too!

I LOVED this apartment. It has so much natural light with really modern features and nice furniture. The building is really nice with an amazing gym and a nice pool. The location is absolutely perfect, right by Plaza Italia and not too far from the park. The shops, restaurants and bars in Soho are within 10 minutes walking, and Hollywood is not too far either. This place felt like a home 100%. Can't recommend it enough!

Gostaria de agradecer muito a atenção e o cuidado que Candela e Marcelo tiveram conosco, sempre muito prestativos e atenciosos. O local é ótimo, muito bem localizado, o apartamento também é excelente, com ar condicionado e calefação em nenhum momento passamos frio ou calor, a banheira é uma delícia. A única coisa não perfeita são as cortinas da sala translúcidas que não bloqueiam todo sol, tirando esse detalhe todo resto foi perfeito! Obrigada, Candela e Marcelo! Foi inesquecível!
Increíble departamento e increíble atención de Candela.
Candela es muy amable y la comunicación y atención fue excelente. El departamento es bello y está ubicado en una excelente zona.

We loved Candela’s apartment! It was perfect for a 2 week stay in Buenos Aires. Awesome location, and nice to have a gym and pool access. The host was very proactive in checking us in and helping us get settled for our stay. The building is nice and close to many restaurants and parks. Would stay again!
Candela y Marcelo fueron muy amables, atentos, flexibles y cumplidores en absolutamente todo. Sin duda intentaremos repetir cuando volvamos a alojarnos en Buenos Aires!

Candela and her staff were are great and nice they were responsive and flexible. The apartment was clean and just like the photos. Great building with a pool and really good location. I would definitely come back. Thanks for a great stay.

Great stay- the apartment itself is clean, modern and secure. There is 24/7 security and it's in a great neighborhood.

Also, located near everything you need- grocery stores, a gym, and restaurants. A quick walk to the area that is full of bars and restaurants but two of my favorite restaurants in BA are within two blocks (La Carniceria and Las Pizarras)

What really made the stay great were the apartment managers. Whatever you needed they were so helpful.

I would definitely stay here again.
Gorgeous apartment and amazing location! Staff was super friendly and the weekly cleaning service was great! Would definitely stay again!

Happy House was an amazing experience ! The apartment is well located in Palermo, super cosy and nice !
And Manuel is the nicest person that you can meet in Buenos Aires for sure, he was always ready to help us, give us some advice !

Happy House is THE place to stay for sure!

The Urban Escape apartment on Avenida  Santa Fe is aptly described.  What a great location on the 13th floor facing away from the busy Avenida.  If you like bustling cities you love the vibe as you exit your apartment building.  The unit is exactly as described and quite comfortable.  Herr Ralf has trained his team to be responsive and professional.  Our shuttle ride from the international arrival terminal, arranged by Tomas, was smooth and efficient and while slightly more expensive than other options I would still recommend it.  For shuttles to the domestic airport we would suggest a regular taxi - both less expensive and not subject to any snafus with private drivers.  Marcello met us at our apartment and gave us a very thorough introduction to all the details relating to the unit and other amenities.  He is a great resource for any of your questions about safely visiting the city.  All in all just a great place and should problems arise Ralf and his team always respond.  We would recommend Ralf and his team for your stay in BsAs.

Choosing the Urban Scape from BA4U apartments was the best thing we could be done. The apartment is exactly the one showed in the pictures. The bed is perfect to give you an invigorating sleep to wake up well next day. The kitchen appliances are very usefull and totally clean. The apartment as well as the bathroom were very clean, exactly as we were looking for. Also, the building is very good and the localization is excellent. We strongly recommend this apartment for you stay in Buenos Aires. Another facility offered by BA4U was the transfer from/to the airport. I had booked it and I had no problem. Besides all the aforementioned, the BA4U staff is very attentive, lovely, lively. Half and Tomas was very attentive while we were booking the apartment by meas of Airbnb. Marcelo and Andres were very attentive and welcoming when we got at the apartment. I have no negative point about Urban Scape or BA4U personal. We really recomend. Thank you guys!
April/2013

Escolher o Urban Scape da BA4U foi a melhor coisa que poderíamos ter feito. O apartamento é exatamente como mostrado nas fotos. A cama é perfeita para dar-lhe um sono revigorante para acordar bem no dia seguinte. Os utensílios de cozinha são muito útil e totalmente limpo. O apartamento, bem como o banheiro são muito limpos, exatamente como nós estávamos procurando. Além disso, o prédio é muito bom e a localização é excelente. Recomendamos este apartamento para a sua estadia em Buenos Aires. Outra facilidade oferecida pelo BA4U foi a transferência de/para o aeroporto. Eu reservei esse serviço e não tive nenhum problema. A equipe do BA4U é muito atenciosa, amável e alegre. Half e Tomas foram muito atenciosos, enquanto estávamos reservando o apartamento pelos site Airbnb. Marcelo e Andrés foram muito atenciosos e acolhedores quando chegamos no apartamento. Eu não tenho nenhum ponto negativo sobre Urban Scape ou sobre o pessoal do BA4U. Altamente recomendável. Valeu pessoal.

abril/2013

Excellent from the minute we first enquired to the moment we left. The apartment was accurately described and more. The bed was super comfortable and had a bonus of memory foam pillow. The small kitchenette was well appointed and the coffee machine and kettle used a lot. Great amount of storage for our 3 night stay. We loved the view from the balcony and whiled away a few hours watching the birds, stars, city, thunderstorms and sunsets.

The only thing that could possibly be a criticism would be the bathroom. The towels are not up to standard - very bedraggled. Only one bathrobe and just two tiny bars of soap. Would have liked some shampoo and shower gel. But I guess it's not sold as a hotel.

We liked the location between the edge of Recoleta and Palermo, which was what we were expecting as we've visited BA before. Very easy to get shopping, visit bars and restaurants, or popping out for a late night ice cream. We didn't find the noise of the city disturbing but our apartment was at the back of the building.

The pool had just been cleaned and was being refilled so we didn't use it, or the gym, but they both looked ok. Liked having a doorman to let us in and out of the building.

I think this is a great find and would have no hesitation in recommending this apartment, and others owned by BA4U. They've put a lot of thought into what people need during their stay. This apartment comes with a useful landline where calls are free to local numbers (great for booking taxis or take outs), iPod docks and speakers, ac, extension cables so you don't need to hunt for a socket, tv, clock radio, good supply of tea bags and coffee, hair dryer, iron and board, safe and plenty of hangers. In the basement of the block there are washers and driers too.

All the staff we met were exceptionally helpful and friendly. Don't take my word for it though - book to stay here and you won't be disappointed. We weren't and we are looking forward to going back there next week!

Second visit to Urban Escapes and super impressed that Ralf had read my last review and changed things to ensure my very minor criticism was overcome. For those of you that don't know, I commented that the towels and lack of toiletries weren't up to the same standard as the rest of the apartment. Can't say that any longer! Very impressed Ralf and team.
For us it was like returning home after a trip away. Love the location, the facilities and the service. These guys know how to run a good business and pay attention to their clients needs. The apartment is very well equipped and we are considering a third visit in a few months time. We are so glad we found Ralf and team and will be recommending that all our Uk and Chilean friends and family give them a try when they visit Buenos Aires. Thank you for making our stay so enjoyable.

This apartment was perfect. In a great location, with views of the city from the balcony.

Ralf kept the apartment in pristine condition, even equipped with a fruit plate, coffee, and tea.

Highly recommend.

Ralf lists a few excellent apartments on here and represents a premier apartment rental company in Buenos Aries. Every apartment is in excellent condition and the level of service and the entire experience working with him and his company is top notch. I would not hesitiate to rent any apartment Ralf is listing. His staff were multi-lingual and provided many recommendations on things to do and see in Buenos Aries. His company even arranged airport transfers for us and helped us book reservations for tango shows. Check In was smooth and the whole process was a pleasure.

The place was exceptional. A small cozy studio, very well located, has a nice balcony, very well decorated. Good quality furniture, comfortable bed, hot shower, etc. Everything perfect. The location is also great, close to the subway. The Santa Fe Avenue is a bit busy and ugly, but is still worth it. I'd highly recommend staying there.
When we got there, Marcelo was waiting for us and showed the apartment, gave a few tips, etc. They even left us some fruits, water and cereal bars. Very nice reception! :)

We had a great experience staying in this apartment.  Marcelo was very welcoming and provided us a very helpful and thorough overview of the city and do's and don'ts as a tourist.  Very comfortable and clean - just like the photos.  We got great recommendations for local tango places to visit as well.  Highly recommend staying here!

This is a fantastic apartment and everything you need when staying in Buenos Aires.  It has spectacular views.  And there is a gym and pool just two floors above you.  Your host Ralf is a pleasure.  From the fresh fruit that is waiting for you on arrival to recommendations for restaurants around the city, he and his staff make sure that you have everything you need.  I've stayed in a few different apartments in this same building and they are all wonderful.  I recommend that you look at all of his properties and find the one that is just right for you.   Enjoy!

I rented this apartment for a month.  It was bright, clean, and looked exactly like the photos.  Importantly, the kitchen was a decent size and well-stocked.  Everyone at ba4u was very friendly and responsive.  Andres was particularly helpful, spending a good 30 minutes during check-in explaining the map of Buenos Aires, pointing out interesting things to do, and giving tips about transportation.  Additionally, the apartment was stocked with fruit and a few snacks upon arrival -- a nice touch.  The one time I had an issue -- the bidet was leaking water -- it was fixed promptly.  The apartment is housed in a nice building, and is well located in Recoleta.  I highly recommend it!

Rented two different rooms on two different days. The rooms were very clean and bright with full sliding windows to a terrace which was very nice for breakfast. Bathrooms also very clean. Both rooms were studios with very well stocked kitchens. Andreas and Marcelo were very accommodating to our odd check in times and we especially appreciate their support holding our bags. I would definitely stay with these guys again and I would recommend them if you want to stay in recoleta.

Hola, la estadia estuvo muy placentera, perfecto para un viaje de negocios.

Walter

Everything was as represented, no unpleasant surprise. The place is quiet, and has a lot of air. The gas stove and the hot water worked very well, not a given in Buenos Aires. The public transportation close by is excellent. There are lots of good inexpensive food joints in the neighborhood, and a "supermercado chino" right in front. Allows you to forgo the big supermarkets ( also present in abundance nearby) that often have long waiting in lines. Also, I appreciated the possibility of later check out, since my flight usually leaves the late afternoon.
A few things to consider:
The internet worked, but was quite slow;
You will have to outsource all of your laundry;
The water tastes badly, so, if you like to have coffee/tea/mate inside, like I do, you will probably need to buy bottled water;
I stayed more than a week, and asked for cleaning, the charge was $10 USD. Factor all that into your expenses if you plan a longer stay.
All in all, positive experience!

Our stay at eleonora's flat was great. The place is cozy, the bed is super comfortable, it is located in a central area ( walkable distance to congreso ). So everything was perfect!  A good choice for enjoying buenos aires!

Fue perfecto para nosotros, estaba muy limpio el departamento, tiene mucha luz natural. La casa está linda y es muy tranquila. Está en el centro mismo de Buenos Aires asi es muy fácil de ver todos los sitios
Hay unos vagos en la calle abajo pero no hacen nada, es lo mismo en todas las grandes cidades!

Sehr gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis! Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, in der Umgebung ist alles zu finden was man im Alltag benötigt (Restaurants, Supermärkte, Banken etc.). Außerdem ist sie nett eingerichtet, bietet ausreichend Platz und alles was man zum Wohnen, Kochen etc. braucht ist schon da. Bei fragen hilft die sehr nette Nachbarin gerne aus!

Absolut empfehlenswert! Vielen Dank für alles!

For this cheap price, you have a place which is: clean, quiet, confortable, convenient (kitchen), in thé very center of thé city, just next to métro And bus line 8 which is direct to thé airport (for 8 pesos).

More over Eleonora answer quickly to all mails And message so u always can get thé assistance u may need. I recommand this place.

Nossa viagem à Buenos Aires foi excelente, da combinação via AirBnb até a o último dia na cidade.

A Eleonora foi muito atenciosa e combinou tudo conosco com bastante antecedência. Ao chegar no apartamento, a Milagros nos recebeu muito bem, sempre solicita e com o um sorriso no rosto.

O apartamento é um quarto com uma sala/cozinha, dentro de um casarão antigo que foi dividido em vários pequenos apartamentos. O quarto é antigo e com um pé direito altíssimo. A cama era confortável. O chuveiro e as torneiras tinham água quente e funcionavam bem. O fogão deu um pouco de trabalho até se acostumar com ele, mas depois tinha que ficar de olho na comida, pois ele é bem potente.

Achei o bairro ótimo tb, muito bem localizado, e à uma pequena caminhada dos metros Once e Alberti. Tem opções de comida (padarias, cafés, pizzaria kentucky) por perto, e o mercado "chino" bem em frente à casa é uma verdadeira mão na roda.

Essa foi minha primeira experiência com o AirBnb, e meus dias em Buenos Aires na casa da Eleonora só me deram vontade de repetir essa maneira de viajar muitas e muitas vezez.

¡Gracias, Eleonora! ¡Gracias Milagros! Ojalá nos quedemos en Buenos Aires otra vez para visitar-las.

um forte abraço,

Filipe
Todo muy bien, muy auténtico. Muy entrañable la hospitalidad. Nos hubiésemos quedado más tiempo.
O apartamento condiz com o que foi anunciado, a Sra Milagros é muito atenciosa e no geral nossa estadia foi muito boa.

El departamento es tal cual las fotos! no es muy grande pero esta bien.
Buena cocina, comodo, edificio tranquilo.
Recomendable

Foi uma experiência muito agradável, o quarto é uma adaptação de comodo que fica num prédio antigo mas bem conservado, o quarto é amplo, espaçoso, claro, silencioso e a localização do prédio é muito boa, próximo de uma das principais avenidas e a 1 quarteirão de uma estação do metrô (Sube)
Super Aufenthalt! Alles wie Beschrieben. Schöne, gemütliche Wohnung. Perfekte Lage, zwei Minuten von der Metrostation entfernt.   Ruhig, sauber! Vielen Dank für diese tolle Möglichkeit!
Very nice location, near the subway; lovely apartment and building. We had a nice time!

The apartment is quite good for the price that we have paid, it is very calm (because it is not facing the main street) and it's got a double bed, TV, Bathroom and kitchen.
The location is near a metro stop (Subte Alberti) so very easy to get almost everywhere. It is also in walking distance from microcentro (30 minutes). We have not faced any troubles in that district but I heard from some Porteños (locals from Buenos Aires) that we should be careful because the district is dangerous. But I must say that besides a couple drunkards and homeless people everything else looked quite normal and ok to me.
The apartment could be better if it would have a fan because it is really hot in BA's summer. We also found that the bathroom could be much cleaner, in particular the tiles (for instance, there was quite a big handful of hairs in the shower, on the other hand Milagros has cleaned the hairs as soon as we told her).
They give you one roll of toilet paper independently of the length of your stay, we have stayed one week and we needed to buy more toilet paper ourselves. In another apartments we have stayed (e.g. In Cordoba, Argentina) they gave us 3 rolls for only 3 days.
Overall, we were happy in the apartment and we think it is a cheap nice option to stay in expensive Buenos Aires.

We had a good stay in the appartement of Eleonora. We never met her, which was a pity, but the lady that showed us around and who we stayed in contact with was very nice. The room had everything we needed and was charming. The appartement is pretty close to a subwaystation, which leads you right into the citycenter. The only thing we liked a bit less was the neighbourhood. It wasn't bad, but it didn't really offer nice lunchrooms, restaurants or bars. Not a place to stroll around at night. That wasn't a problem though, because taxi's are not expensive in BA. So if you want to go out for the night, just grab a cab;)

This is by far the worst experience I've had on airbnb. Eleonora (the host), is far from being a warm person. Bad attitude all day every day. She doesn't have anything under control and I was thrown out of the place with less than 24 hours notice, because she was upset that the gas company had cut the gas. I didn't mind, but she did. The was numerous misunderstandings about the availability of the apartment, which is very inconvenient when traveling and not knowing what to plan. Also I was bossed around the place, being told where I could stand talking on my phone, which needed wifi that almost didn't reach the room and frequently lost connection. I would describe the atmosphere as arrogant and stuck up. In my opinion people like this are spoiling the  airbnb experience and only looking for money to gain - and not the experience of exchanging homes. This is the first time I ever write a bad review of anything, but my recent experience made a big impression on me, which has led me to share my honest thoughts on this woman and her business. Sincerely
The reservation was canceled 3 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Eleonora hat uns freundlich in ihrem ruhigem Apartment empfangen. Während unseres einmonatigen Aufenthaltes kümmerte sich vor Ort Milagros engagiert und herzlich um unsere Bedürfnisse. Das Apartment entspricht der Beschreibung in der Anzeige und überzeugt durch das angemesse Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.
We had an great Stay. The appartment is well located and we could reach everything by walk. We would stay here at any Time again.
nos sentimos muy cómodos con la recepción, que fue cálida y atenta. El barrio está ubicado muy cerca del centro y con variadas opciones de transporte. El depto. es amplio, cómodo y silencioso.
la recepción de Milagros fue muy buena  como así Eleonora para responder todas las preguntas por msj.  El dto es tal cual las fotos.
En un punto estrategico, sin ningun lujo pero 100 por 100 pulcro y acogedor. Muy buena relacion precio calidad.
El departamento es cómodo, completo, cumple con todo lo indicado en el anuncio! La atención de Milagros es muy buena, la ubicación también, con muchos medios de transporte alrededor.
O apartamento, bem localizado em Palermo, a duas quadras do metrô Bulnes, é uma ótima opção de estadia em Buenos Aires. Manuel foi muito atencioso e acolhedor com minha família e eu.

This apartment was the perfect spot for us to get away from the hustle and bustle and relax. The place is decorated with beautiful antique furniture and feels like stepping back in time and getting a true Buenos Aires neighborhood. Milagros, the neighbor that assists to care for the apartment was extremely helpful and kind. I would recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a quiet get away in a fun city.

Un super petit appartement, très agréable à vivre, avec tout ce que vous avez besoin pour etre bien. On s'y sent vite comme chez soit. Le métro tout près, plein de bus qui vont un peu partout. Pour un couple c'est parfait. Apres le quartier reste un quartier pauvre et seule, je ne me serais pas sentie rassurée de rentrer le soir. Mais le quartier reste très sympa dès que vous vous promener, vous êtes près d'avenue importantes, de lieux de visites intéressants. Je conseil vivement !
We had a great stay in Ralf's apartment. It looked in reality just as good as on the pictures. We received an excellent and extensive introduction to Buenos Aires from his team. Recommended!

Fiquei 6 noites no apartamento e foi uma experiência excelente!! Ele é muito bem localizado, perto de tudo, numa região maravilhosa. A mobilia do apartamento é linda e tem tudo na cozinha para funcionar muito bem. Sugiro apenas uma revisão nas toalhas de banho que estão muito gastas. Mas valeu a pena a hospedagem e o Manuel é muito educado e simpático !

El apto Happy Hose en Palermo estuvo excelente, tal cual como lo vimos en esta pagina, esta super bien ubicado con todo bien  accesible, supermercado, restaurantes, cafes etc, a una cuadra de la v Sta Fe que es bien conveniente y a una cuadra del Shopping Alto Palermo, pero el plus del apto es Manuel, quien es un chico super amable y educado, nos dio unos tips bien buenos, no  encanto compartir con el .

This was the first time we rented a apartment through Airbnb, but its not going to be the last!

Manuel has been the most amazing host, he is allways there to help you with whatever you need. Here you really feel at home and welcome! He has taken us with him to meet his friends and to barbecues, wich has really been great! He had prepared everything so nice when we got here..he even has a tin of joy ( La lata de la alegria)..that we actually manage to empty!

The Happy House is better than you can imagine, and if we could choose, we'll stay here forever! Mercedes has done a incredible job with the decorating, colors and style. Its beautiful, has lots of space and everything works as it should. The apartment is light and clean.

The location is amazing, close to everything and really easy to get around. There are super markets, cafes, parks, subways and buses, shopping and a cinema just around the corner. Its also a reasonably quiet street, so trafic and noise wont bother you. The neighborhood is great.

Thank you soooo much Manu, Mercedes and Happy House!

juste parfait.
just perfect

nice and sweet people, very helpful.
l'attention mise à l'accueil, à tout ce qui peut aider l'installation dans l'appartement : des choses simples comme du savon dans la salle de bains et de l'huile dans la cuisine, Mercedes et Manuel nous avaient mis de l'eau au frais, acheté une bière... bref. assez rare, comme accueil.
Great location, very clean house, Mercedes is a great host, absolutely recommended for any duration.

Manuel and Mercedes were perfect hosts: quick to respond to any inquiry before and during my stay, flexible, friendly and very welcoming, and offering plenty of advice. The apartment is well located, very comfortable, and fitted with all conveniences. For a hassle-free stay in BA, I couldn't recommend Happy House more highly. Thanks Mercedes!

Spent two weeks at Happy House. The house was well appointed and well situated next to a subway, several grocery stores and a variety of restaurants, bars and cafes. It is also quite central and close to Palermo Soho and Hollywood. Check in and check out was easy. The owner really took care in making my stay a pleasant one.  Since she knew I was going to be working from the apartment, she even took the time to rearrange the living room ahead of my arrival - without me having to ask - so that my work desk would be well positioned next to a window. My flight out of Buenos Aires was at night, and there was absolutely no problems when I asked to check out at 6pm. The Internet is a bit slow, but still works well for sending emails and surfing the Web.  I'd have no problems recommending the apartment to anyone going to Buenos Aires.

I was at the Mercedes home 4 days and I felt at home.
The apartment is very comfortable, the location is great for exploring the city and Mercedes is available for any information.
I would recommend staying in the apartment of Mercedes at all.

Ralf and his team run a top-notch operation. Was given a very complete "orientation" on the apartment and advice/suggestions on everything from security precautions to suggestions about which streets/sites to explore. They were very helpful and responsive if I needed suggestions, but gave me the space I wanted as someone renting an entire place.

As for the apartment, it was immaculate, in great condition, true to the photos, and centrally located. Was very easy for me to get downtown for my classes as well as other places worth visiting (the Cemetery (15 min walk), Palermo (10 min subway ride), etc.). Liked that there was a pool, but it was not quite big enough for a semi-serious swimmer to do laps. That said, the roof deck provided a nice break from the city bustle where you can read or hang out with friends.

El departamento es tal cual como muestran las fotos. Es pequeño, sencillo pero cuenta con todo lo necesario para vivir cómodamente, los muebles se encuentran en buenas condiciones, hay buena presión de agua y siempre todo muy limpio. Al llegar me recibió Milagros, la encargada de la casa y una persona maravillosa, ella es la que se encarga de la limpieza y siempre esta bien predispuesta para ayudar a los huéspedes. La casa se ubica en un barrio tradicional de Buenos Aires a una cuadra de una Avenida comercial muy importante que cuenta con todo tipo de negocios (comida, vestimenta, farmacias, etc). El transporte público es accesible desde la zona, hay un subte y muchas líneas de colectivos.
Recomiendo este departamento para quien busca un lugar tranquilo, sencillo y limpio para descansar. Excelente relación precio/calidad. Para los turistas la zona no es de lo mas linda para pasear. Hay que tomar precauciones mas que nada por la noche pero el transporte público es variado y pueden llegar rápido a cualquier punto turístico de la ciudad.

I had a lovely week at Happy House! Manuel and Mercedes were perfect hosts: attentive, quick to respond to any inquiry before and during my stay, flexible, friendly, honest, very welcoming, and offering plenty of advice. The apartment is beautifully, great location (near shops, Sta Fe, Alto Palermo shopping and tube station), very comfortable, and fitted with all conveniences. I warmly and highly recommend Happy House and I Iook forward to my next stay. Thanks Manuel and Mercedes!

Nuestra estadía en la “Happy House” fue estupenda. Nos atendieron de maravilla y se mostraron muy flexibles ante nuestro repentino cambio de planes. Tanto Mercedes como Manuel estuvieron siempre atentos y dispuestos a ayudarnos. La casa es muy cómoda y posee todo lo necesario para ser acogedora y a la vez práctica. Muy recomendable.

Both Mercedes and Manuel were very welcoming guests.

The happy house is a peaceful place in the middle of BA - Palermo and a great base for exploring the city.

Thanks a lot,
Stijn & Katrien

Manuel was truly an awesome guest.
The apartment is super cute and very nicely located of off Santa Fe Avenue. Eventhough the internet connection was spotty at times Manuel was very responsive in promising to take care of it soon for future guests. Still, the overall experience was magnificent. I actually forgot my wallet and camera at the appartment and after I notified him, Manuel found it and Fedexed it to me the next day.
Highly reccomended!

Mercedes is the perfect host ! We were very happy in the Happy House ! The appartement is very nice, quiet (well, as quiet as possible in this huge Buenos Aires querido), clean, warmful, cheerful, decorated with a lot of delicate attention, the floor (parquet) in the living was perfect for practice and private tango classes. A lot of milongas in the neighbourhood, Palermo is a tango barrio ... Gracias por todo !  Keep in touch for next time, un abrazo enorme to Mercedes and Manuel ! Laura y Bruno

Ha sido un verdadero placer estar en este departamento. Unos anfitriones maravillosos y la casa cuidada al detalle para que la estadia sea una experiencia maravillosa.
Yo ya tengo piso preferido para estar en Buenos Aires.
Muy recomendable.

Happy House was clean, cozy, and cute with all the amenities we needed. It was also well situated and a great base from which to explore the city. The hosts were very friendly and made themselves readily available to address questions. Overall, a great place to stay!

We had a lovely stay at this apartment in Buenos Aires. It had everything we needed and was conveniently located. As two women traveling alone, it was a safe neighborhood. Mercedes and Manuel were extremely accommodating. When our outgoing flight was cancelled, they quickly responded to my email and enabled us to stay another night. We so appreciated their kindness after a terrible day at the airport!  Muchas gracias, amigos!  I can recommend this apartment without hesitation.

The happy house was the perfect place to spend my visit in Buenos Aires. The decor really did make me feel happy and comfortable. Manuel was an excellent host. He was flexible when it came to checking me in and out and was always available and helpful with any other requests. I will always remember my stay in the happy house and strongly recommend it to anyone who is interested!

Mi novia y yo pasamos genial en el apartamento de Ralf. Marcelo (un miembro de su equipo) nos recibió de maravillas y no sólo nos explicó muy bien absolutamente todos los pormenores del lugar, sino que lo hizo con muy buena onda y hasta con alguna grata sorpresa. Fue una experiencia divertida y súper cómoda, la piscina es un gran diferencial y el barrio es muy lindo, accesible y lleno de lugares para comprar o comer. Sin dudas me encantaría volver y lo más probable es que lo haga. Gracias por todo chicos.
Apartamento muito bem localizado, em condições impecáveis, tal como descrito. O staff foi sempre muito prestável e atencioso.A nossa estadia correu muito bem!

Happy House is a fabulous place to stay:  perfectly located in Palermo near parks and public transport lines, a cozy and beautifully decorated apartment, and a wonderfully helpful host in Manuel.  We had a marvelous time in Buenos Aires and Happy House made our stay all the better.
Very nice small apartment in a very good location and a very nice and helpful host.

A Happy House é muito aconchegante e limpa. O prédio quieto e reservado -  mesmo com um restaurante embaixo não chega a ser barulhento. Hospedes viciados em wi fi podem ficar impacientes, mas existem 2 conecções disponíveis. Manuel foi um excelente host, estando sempre pronto para nos ajudar no que fosse preciso. A casa é super bem localizada, com fácil acesso à metro, parques, supermercados,shoppings e restaurantes. Mercedes tem super bom gosto e um astral incrível no seu charmoso apartamento. Mimos como a A lata da Alegria nos faz sentir super benvindos. Happy house tem uma energia maravilhosa, e Manuel foi um excelente amigo. Recomendo muitíssimo! Habla-se Portunhol e Inglês! ;P

I had a great experience at Happy House! The location is awesome. It was easy to get to the subte and taxis drive past the apartment regularly. There is a grocery store at the corner. Manuel provided me with lots of helpful information about places to visit and recommended great restaurants! I'll go back to happy house the next time I travel to BA!

We had a wonderful week at Happy House and in Buenos Aires. The apartment is very cosy, bright, comfortable and spacious. Located in a fantastic area close to everything and very safe. Manuel was a great host and very helpful and responsive to any of our questions. Highly recommend :)

We had a great stay at the Happy House. The apartment itself is spacious, charmingly decorated and well situated (close to a number of tourist attractions, the subway, buses and supermarkets). The hosts were very friendly and responsive - and flexible with check-in and check-out.

We loved our stay at Happy House. Manuel and Mercedes were very responsive to any questions and flexible with check-in and check-out. We had to leave at 6am in the morning, and this was no problem.
