The apartment is well-furnished and has all that you need. The location is excellent - minutes to a supermarket and the subte station and the Palermo parks. Plenty of taxis in the street. A lovely local neighbourhood and felt safe for two women travellers. Highly recommend.

A really cosy appartment in the cool neighbourhood of cool Palermo. The appartment provides everything you need for some Buenos Aires days and the host, Mercedes, was absolutely great, helpful and made us feel at home from the very first minute of our stay. We would highly recommend this place!
Everything was perfect
Nice apartment in a great location. On a Main Street but facing the quiet side of the neighborhood, nice setup and comfortable furniture. Would stay here again for sure.

Everything was exactly as pictured. Very safe, very clean, very comfortable. We didn't actually meet ralf, but we were met on arrival and shown around. The guy who orientated us was very informative, not only about the apartment and the building, but lots of good BA tips too. The transport from the airport was effortless. Highly recommend.

Amazing apartments, have now stayed twice at Ralf and his team.
Very careful in-check of the apartments, so you are sure that you know the area, apartment and property.

Overall very good experience

Urban Escape is exactly as described, inviting, comfortable and very well-maintained. Marcelo and Andreas were responsive and it was clear that all of Ralf's team wanted everything to go well.

The kitchen was well-supplied with cooking items, dishes, glassware and the like. The bed was very comfortable, and wifi and tv reception were always perfect. The pool area is a great asset, the security guards and building maintenance men reliable.

The area has many shopping possibilities, for groceries, books, clothing, wine, including small fruit and vegetable shops. Pharmacies and restaurants abound. The location is great for sight seeing, on foot or by subte or taxi.

A very well-run property.

Minha estada em Buenos Aires foi perfeita desde a chegada no aeroporto de Ezeiza. A recepção no apartamento como sempre é muito calorosa, de forma a nos sentirmos bem acolhidos e seguros. As dúvidas são respondidas de forma eficiente e nos são dadas informações e sugestões ecelentes, como por exemplo, onde trocar moedas com segurança, haja vista a existência de cotações bastante variadas. O apartamento é como demonstram as fotos e até melhor. A localização esplêndida, de onde temos acesso à muitos restaurantes, compras e meios de transporte.

The location was great and the check-in process was very smooth.  We were provided with great recommendations and there were very good travel materials inside the apartment.  Please note that the washer and dryer are not inside the apartment itself, but you are granted access to it.

Great apartment, as described - well furnished and maintained, everything worked out well. Check In was smooth and worked just fine. Location is central and a good base to reach most parts of the city from.

Will consider this again the next time we go.

Staying at Urban Escape was a very pleasant experience. The place was very neat and the room is overall super comfortable and cozy. The kitchen was well set with good quality items for indoor meals; the balcony with the 13th floor view of the city was a nice place for an intimate dinner (I totally recommend doing that); the bed was big, clean and very comfortable; internet and cable worked very well, and the bathroom had everything we needed. Ralf and the rest of the BA4U team was willing and thoughtful, provided us all the information we needed and made the communication very easy. The building itself has a good structure, was very safe, has very kind and polite personnel, counts with a lovely top floor deck (with sauna, gym and pool) and I'd like to stay there again and work with BA4U in future visits to Buenos Aires.

It's all about location and this was a great location, just a few blocks from the metro station with plenty of shops and restaurants on the doorstep. Perfect for visiting all the attractions of Buenos Aires, in particular around Recoleta.

We were warmly welcomed by Marcello, one of the BA4U team, who gave us excellent detailed instructions about the property. The apartment is on the 13th floor and faces the rear of the building making it very peaceful. We made use of the gym a few times with its view over the city, and loved stretching out on the balcony after our workout. The pool looked great but was a little chilly for us to use at this time of year.

Our hosts were really flexible about check out time and we were able to make use of the apartment until 4pm on our day of departure. Communication before and during our stay was perfect.

We would highly recommend BA4U and this apartment and if we return to Buenos Aires we would definitely stay here again.

Estadia perfeita! O apartamento está igual nas fotos, muito bem localizado e tudo muito limpo.

A equipe é sensacional, nos ajudou em todos os problemas e dúvidas. Fomos recebidos pelo Marcelo, que nos deu excelentes instruções detalhadas sobre o apartamento e sobre a região.

Muita flexibilidade com checkin e checkout. Recomendo a todos!!
Fantastic apartment in every sense. Room clean and modern with good facilities. Location convenient and apartment staff also helpful. Would recommend.

Perfeito! Tudo como descrito no site. Chegamos no apartamento e tudo estava a nossa espera. Como fazia frio no dia (8 graus), o apartamento já estava climatizado, limpo e perfumado. Detalhes como ter água mineral, frutas e alguns biscoitos mostraram a atenção aos detalhes para fazer com que tudo ficasse mais confortável. A localização ajuda muito, tem tudo perto, tudo mesmo. Você poderá andar poucas quadras para ir a lojas, cafeterias e supermercados. O Cemitério da Recoleta fica a uma caminhada de alguns minutos (vale a pena caminhar pela cidade). A equipe de Ralf é muito atenciosa. Recebemos dicas práticas do que fazer e cuidados que deveríamos ter. Podem ir sem medo!

The place was absolutely amazing! Very clean, spacious, and well-lit. Beautiful views from the 13th floor balcony. 24/7 guards on premises. The location could not be better; easy walk or a quick ride on the Subte to ALL of Buenos Aires' best sites, restaurants, bars, and clubs. When I come back to Buenos Aires, I will be staying here again.
It was so good. There was no specific checkout time so we could stay until our next flight which was at night. The room is cozy kitchen is well sorted. Highly recommended!

A estadia no apartamento da Eleonora foi muito boa. Ficamos 30 dias e o monoambiente atendeu as expectativas. A Milagros, senhora que cuida de tudo por lá, estava sempre prestativa para que tirássemos quaisquer dúvidas.

Morei por meses no apartamento e adorei. O apartamento é muito aconchegante, tem uma cozinha separada com uma mesa onde eu podia trabalhar, além de comer. O banheiro é muito adequado, o quarto com um bom tamanho. O edifício e o apartamento são antigos, mas bem cuidados. Uma pessoa muito solícita do edifício (Milagros) ajuda muito nas dúvidas e solução de situações que aparecem.
A localização no centro é um ponto a ser avaliado segundo as intenções da viagem: para mim foi excelente, pois estava perto dos meus lugares favoritos (região do Congreso), tinha muito transporte público disponível (metrô na esquina e ônibus - que funcionam 24h), muitos serviços próximos (como lavanderias), bastante comércio popular e não fica muito longe de nenhum lugar para quem gosta de caminhar pela cidade. Todavia, à noite e nos domingos é uma região menos movimentada, e é um pouco escura à noite (como outros centros). Não é uma região turística ou badalada.
Para quem busca um local nessas condições, recomendo muito a estadia nesse local e agradeço muito à hospitalidade!
A única dificuldade que tive foi com a instabilidade da internet wi-fi: a rede estava lenta e o sinal chegava muito fraco ao apartamento; para alguns dias e uso de comunicação estava ok, mas para quem precisa trabalhar estava muito difícil. Acredito que será resolvido.
Minha estadia não poderia ser melhor, eu e meus filhos simplesmente adoramos a Milagros e o Ivan, cozinha bem limpa e equipada,quarto com roupa de cama trocada semanalmente,tudo perfeito parabens
Nice host and nice arpartement. The location is not the best but i had still a great time there!

Very good value place. Central city location, close to buses and subway. So wasn't an issue getting to the big sights in Buenos Aires. Plenty of restaurants and kiosks/supermarkets nearby. Felt safe in the apartment. Had all the amenities we needed. Highly recommend. Would return.

El depto de Eleonora es una excelente opción!! Está ubicado cerca de estaciones de colectivo, subte y tren. La zona tiene todo lo que necesitas para tu estadía: teatros comerciales e independientes, cine, bares y zonas comerciales. El lugar también es tranquilo, limpio y si tienes cualquier duda o problema, Milagros siempre está lista para ayudarte. Un excelente lugar!!
Todo ok. Milagros un sol y atentísima para que la estadia sea muy buena.

El departamento es una belleza, tiene techos muy altos, ventanales gigantes y en general el estilo es antiguo con encanto. El baño también estuvo muy bien, la regadera exquisita, y la cocina con todo lo que necesitas para una estancia larga. Nosotras estuvimos dos meses y definitivamente lo mejor fue Milagros, la señora que cuida los departamentos y que nos daba la ropa de cama y baño muy limpios cada semana. Eso sí, el WIFI nos fallaba mucho, parece que el modem está lejos pues el departamento es el último del pasillo así que era difícil que llegara la señal. Lo reportamos varias veces pero no lo solucionaron. Así que si para ti es importante el internet en tu viaje tienes que pensarlo muy bien.
Con respecto a la zona, es súper céntrica, no tendrás problema para ir a cualquier parte de la ciudad que quieras, con la plaza Miserere cerca con paradas de autobuses y subterráneo. Y si quieres caminar, al Congreso son 15 minutos o menos y a la Plaza de Mayo 30 minutos. Lo único malo de la zona es que es muy popular, así que seguramente la encontrarás muy sucia, con muchas heces de mascota en las calles y muy frecuentemente verás tipos tomando alcohol en las banquetas lo que no te hace sentir tan segura.
Con excepción de estos dos detalles, nosotras recomendamos ampliamente este departamento. Saludos!!

Lovely little apartment in a great location, with good amenities and cleanliness. We had good communication with Eleonora in the lead up to our stay and Milagros was also very helpful. Would highly recommend this airbnb and we didn't want to leave after a great 4 nights here.

Schön eingerichtete Wohnung.
Gute Lage mit Bus und Ubahn Anbindung wenige Minuten entfernt.
Bequemes Bett
Leider keine Klimaanlage, dennoch erträglich.
Very nice place, it was a beautiful week in a magic house! Really original and nice atmosphere!

The room was exactly as described. The bed was just amazing to sleep and relax after a walk through the city. Eleonora answered fast and could give us tips e.g. where we could do our laundry. We enjoyed our stay in Buenos Aires very much. If you avoid the area around the nearby station its a very safe and central area of the city to live in. Unfortunately the wifi is very moody and not reliable (bookings and check ins for our trip had to be done in cafés with free wifi). Overall we were still content with Eleonora and Milagros.

O apartamento não é ruim mas está precisando de uma reforma, melhorar o wi-fi,melhorar a cozinha, colocar um forno elétrico ou micro-ondas,um aquecedor bom e forte, uma televisão mais moderna com controle-remoto.Neste momento indico para ficar poucos dias mas estadias longas não recomendo.

Die Unterkunft von Eleonora ist wirklich sehr zu empfehlen! Das Bett ist groß und sehr bequem, zum Duschen hat man jederzeit warmes Wasser zur Verfügung,es ist alles sehr sauber und die Küche ist mit allem ausgestattet,was man so braucht zum Zubereiten von Mahlzeiten. Das Apartment liegt sehr ruhig und trotzdem zentral,man ist in 2 Minuten Fußweg an der Metro-Haltestelle "Alberti" (Linie A) und in 5 Min. am Kongress und  im Zentrum, zusätzlich fahren Busse vor der Haustüre vorbei und es gibt zahlreiche gute Cafés, Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten direkt um die Ecke,unter anderem das empfehlenswerte Café "Havanna" und "Martinez". Ich wurde sehr lieb begrüßt und empfangen von der Nachbarin Milagros,die die Schlüsselübergabe macht und sich um alles kümmert. Besonders toll fand ich,dass sogar ein kleiner Heizofen zur Verfügung stand und ich so nicht gefroren habe. Man fühlt sich sehr willkommen und wohl,ich würde wieder kommen! Vielen Dank für alles! :)
Eleonora siempre tuvo respuestas muy rápidas, milagros un amor, la zona tiene medios de transporte con fácil acceso a cualquier parte de la ciudad, el lugar muy muy lindo. 100% recomendable ❤️

Plusieurs petits appartements dans une maison ancienne . Très belle belle maison, j'ai été reçu par Eleonora, très bon accueil, j'ai changé d'appartement en cours de séjour avec Airbnb. Tous c'est bien passé. Merci!
Lovely flat, good hosts, great shower, and comfy bed. Poor wifi and local area is pretty run down.

Me senti muy a gusto en el departamento de Eleonora !! Me recibieron Milagros y Hernan con mucho carino, siempre atentos y disponibles para cualquier cosita. Eleonora igual, muy reactiva por Airbnb. El depa esta hermoso, el Wifi ya funciona MUY bien (lo usé para mi trabajo), ya tiene todo para cocinar. Cuando llegué, el refri no funcionaba, me lo cambiaron muy rapido. El lugar queda a dos minutos del metro Alberti y tiene todo alrededor. El unico inconveniente puede ser el olor de cigarrillo que entra por la ventana cuando el vecino esta fumando. :( Gracias Eleonora, Milagros y Hernan, que les vaya muy bien !
Abitazione comoda,accogliente e silenziosa.
El departamento es un encanto. Está bien equipado y ubicado. No le faltaba nada. Eleonora respondía cualquier pregunta con rapidez, y Milagros siempre estaba dispuesta a ayudar.

El depto. es cálido, acogedor, tranquilo, silencioso y con buena luz natural, especialmente en la habitación. Está ubicado en un primer piso por escalera. Sin grandes lujos, posee todo lo necesario para que puedas pasar una estadía cómoda y agradable. El barrio, sin ser de los más lindos de Buenos Aires, está muy bien comunicado. Milagros es una persona muy amable, simpática y agradable, que estará dispuesta a solucionar cualquier inconveniente que puedas tener. Una buena opción para alojase en esta ciudad.

Un lugar muy pintoresco, agradable, y con todo lo necesario para que no precises nada durante tú estadía, Milagros la administradora es una persona muy agradable y predispuesta, la ubicación del lugar es buena, saliendo un poco de la locura de Microcentro pero con muchos medios de transporte cercanos para llegar a cualquier sitio de la ciudad en minutos, de noche se pone un poco feo pero nada fuera de lo normal, probablemente el mejor lugar calidad precio de los alrededores pero no recomendado para personas con movilidad reducida ya que cuenta con escaleras en la entrada.
Todo muy agradable. Mili e Iván hacen que te sientas como en casa.  Es un espacio tranquilo y cómodo. Volvería definitivamente.

A nice cosy apartment in a great area!!!
Everything, from supermarkets to metro station is so close, and if you are into shopping just a minute away there is one of the nicest BA's shopping mall.
The apartment was clean and equipped with everything you might need (even all kind of international power plugs). The wifi connection was a bit unstable (still working though) but that same week (beginning of november '13) the telco company was going to install the new line, so should be all solved now.

Mercedes&Manuel were of great help, from simple information about the city to arranging a taxi and helping out with the Spanish.

Overall feedback is very positive, I would choose the same place.

A haven for a deep, good night's sleep, which is exactly what I was needing. I also like that it doesn't have all the modern commodities an airbnb place usually has, and yet it doesn't lack for decent living.
Milagros, who cares for the place, is a complete gem... and she makes your day with her sweet smile! Same for Eleonora, the host —despite the distance and time difference, she is always quick to respond and help.
Location is central and a couple of blocks away from the metro, which is great, but the overall neighbourhood has known better times… I would recommend being careful and alert at night!

Eleonora e Milagros são muito gentis e atenciosas. O apartamento fica numa localização ótima para quem quer conhecer a Buenos Aires dos argentinos (e não a dos turistas). Mas considere o tempo de estadia. O apartamento vale a pena para estadias curtas. Falta estrutura (internet boa para trabalho, utensílios de cozinha e roupas de cama) para períodos mais longos.
perfect stay! you feel like at home in buenos aires!

Great experience!! Manuel and Mercedes were super helpful, awesome hosts. Easy to get in contact with before and during our stay, and as locals, had great recommendations on restaurants and activities nearby.
The apartment is beautiful, lots of natural light, comfy bed and living room furniture, functional, well-stocked kitchen, and modern, clean bathroom. We really felt at home during our stay.
Good location, grocery store less than a block away, a Subte (metro) stop 2 blocks away, in a nice quiet neighborhood, but close to lots of restaurants.
Really, so glad we stayed at Happy House. =)

Staying in the Happy House was our first experience with airbnb and we could not be happier. The house was comfortable and had everything we needed for our 5 days in Buenos Aires. It is so much better than staying in a hotel where often there is little space to spread out. The air conditioning is a bonus when it was hot outside. The location is perfect for exploring the city on foot and is close to the subte (metro) for those who chose to use it.

We stayed for a little over a month at the happy house and it was a fantastic experience.



The neighborhood is great. We became regulars at Faricci, La Payuca, Bella Italia, (all in walking distance), Local in Palermo Hollywood (short ride on the D line) and bblue in Palermo soho. There is also a large grocery store (disco) within 2 minutes walking. There is even a big mall a couple blocks away that's called Alto Palermo with many anchoring restaurants and fun shops. It's also a block to the D line (subway). We got a sube card there, which allows you to get on buses as well as the subway.



The apartment is really cute and cozy, decorated with lots of loving details. It was also clean and comfy. There are many interesting books, DVDs and music CDs for you to enjoy too. All the appliances and amenities (washing machine, hot water, AC, high speed wifi, DVD player, TV, etc) worked perfectly. There's plenty of closet space. The small balcony and cute pink courtyard are filled with plants. The crystal wind chime sparkled under the sun every afternoon.



Manuel and Mercedes were such welcoming and responsive hosts. Our check in and check out were smooth and efficient. They gave wonderful suggestions on places to visit, how to get around, money exchange and learning Spanish. We were even invited to join them in a happy hour and got to meet Manuel's wife and sister. We traded stories on how we met our respective spouses and had many laughs over hamburger and pizza. They are such a happy family and the beer tasting was super fun too!



We were lucky to have had the opportunity to stay at the happy house. It surely made our first trip and first month in buenos aires an unforgettably pleasant experience.

We stayed at the Happy House for 5 nights and it was an excelent experience. It's the perfect appartment for a couple! There's a very big room and another one with a small bed, both of them were confortable. The location is great and the apartment is super cozy and spacious. We had everything we need and both Manuel and Mercedes are very friendly and kind. Thanks! We'll repeat for sure if we come back to BA!

3 friends and I spent 10 days at Happy House as we were studying Spanish at a school in buenos aires.
The house is in immaculate condition and close to shops, restaurants, cafes and public transport.
We had a great time and experience in this house and the owners went out of there way to make us feel welcome and settle in.
All in all a great 10 days was had by all and I firmly recommended this accommodation.

Manuel's place is extraordinary. It's cosy and stylish and very well located. Apart from that he's just the best host you could imagine, extremely helpful, friendly and funny. We just felt like we had a friend at the very moment we arrived in Buenos Aires.

Happy House was excellent. I was in BA for a conference and the apartment was perfect to set up base, close to the conference centre and close to all the nightlife of Palermo. The apartment was as described and Manuel went the extra mile to make me feel welcome. All the guidebooks and maps at the apartment were incredibly useful! At the time of being there there was an issue with the gas supply in the entire apartment block. However, I was fully aware of this beforehand and it didn't deter me from booking. An electric shower was installed before I arrived and Manuel dropped in an electric kettle the day after I arrived.

When I come back, I'd love to stay again.

We received a warm welcome from Manuel and his wife. After a late arrival, they took the time to help us get settled over some Argentinian parrilla at a nearby restaurant. Happy House was clean, bright and nicely presented. We found it a tranquil escape from the bustling grind of BA. Happy House is situated in a safe neighborhood with a supermarket, shopping complex and subway within a short walk. We recommend it.

Ein wirklich tolles Appartment mitten in Buenos Aires. Alles hat super geklappt und Ralf hat uns hervorragend mit den wichtigsten Infos versorgt. Wir haben die Zeit sehr genossen und koennen jedem das Appartment nur waermstens empfehlen. Die Aussicht aus dem 13. Stock ist auch nicht zu verachten ;-)

Pasamos bárbaro!
Todo muy completo, limpio y bien decorado.
Cocina muy completa, incluso nos dejaron algunos alimentos básicos para que no tengamos que salir de compras recién llegados de viajar!
Nos recibió Andrés en la puerta del Apto para mostrarnos el lugar y explicarnos todo sobre la zona en las que nos quedabamos y los mejores lugares para visitar.
La zona es excelente! Cerca del subte, a 10 cuadras de Recoleta y de Palermo Soho.
Sin dudas volveríamos.
Gracias por todo!

I highly recommend renting from Ralf and his BA4U crew. Our "urban escape" apartment was clean and well appointed for our week long stay. The only thing we missed was a full freezer (the mini fridge has a small ice box though), but it's not like our helado made it home before we ate it anyways! There was also a hairdryer which was a big save for me.

As for convenience, I'll give it an A+. The building is only a short block and a half from a subway stop, there's a small grocery store across the street and a big one a few blocks away.

We came as tourists and felt very safe staying in the immediate area. I was concerned about noise after reading reviews, but it really wasn't bad since it's high up and this unit doesn't face the street. Either way, you're staying in a huge city; there is no silence!

Ralf was a great help with getting us set up to see the city and accommodating us even with our crazy departure schedule. The team went above and beyond our expectations to help us have a comfortable and safe trip. Thanks!!!

I had a great experience in this fabulous apartment in Buenos Aires.  The apartment was clean, well decorated, extremely well located (close to the subway, restaurants, and a great coffee spot on the corner).  Check in was easy and thorough.  I would stay hear again in a heartbeat.

Listing was exactly as described and looked like the photos. The kitchen was well stocked and we made use of the laundry (thanks to Ralf for the coins which turn out to be quite hard to get). Ralf and team were extremely friendly and helpful throughout the stay. Ralf's office is located in the same building which was useful eg they allowed us to print tickets for the BA hop on hop off bus with their printer.
Wonderful and safe place, great location with easy access to subway, pictures are accurate, host was very helpful with additional information.  Would stay again.
Eine sehr nette Unterkunft. Die Lage ist super. Man hat es nirgends weit hin und die Ubahn -Station ist gleich um die Ecke. die Ankunft war unproblematisch.  Ich kann die Unterkunft empfehlen.

Wir wurden sehr herzlich von unserem Gastgeber empfangen; alles in der Wohnung wurde genauestens erklärt; weiterhin hatten wir sehr gute Hilfestellungen bei allen unseren Fragen, auch bzgl. Buenos Aires (z.b. Buchung Tango-Show).
Der vom Gastgeber organisierte Transport vom und zum Flughafen war perfekt, können wir nur weiter empfehlen.
Das Apartment selbst ist perfekt modern eingerichtet; alles, was man braucht, ist vorhanden; ideal ist der Balkan mit herrlichem Blick über B.A.
Zusammengefasst können wir nur sagen, dass wir das Apartment von Ralf Hobeck ohne irgendwelche Einschränkungen weiter empfehlen können.

Great location, room was just as we hoped. Clean and comfortable with a nice view from the balcony. Marcelo was an excellent host who met us on arrival and made sure we were settled in. Gave great tips on how best to enjoy the city both in terms of things to do and how to stay street smart. We had a great time thanks! The only let down were the common areas: the pool appeared dirty so we did not swim, the laundry smelled unhygienic, the gym was not in the best working order.

Fruit was left as a welcome was a nice touch, and we had constant communication from our hosts which was most helpful. We would definitely stay here again.

Manuel est un hôte tres sympathique et agréable, il a tout fait pour que nous nous sentions chez nous .
L appartement est très bien situé dans un quartier vivant et commerçant, le métro est tout proche.
Une base parfaite pour découvrir buenos aires
Merci manuel

It was pleasant to stay at The happy house. Location was perfect and the appartment very nice. The only thing which we didn't like was that there was no gas in The appartment. Fortunately there was an electric shower but still...
Very nice apartment in a great neighborhood. We really enjoyed our 2 weeks stay in the Happy House. We warmly recommend it!

Mercedes was very welcoming and helpful. Her directions to the apartment were accurate, and everything went quite smoothly. The only criticism would be that there was a problem with the hot water. The shower was not that hot, and there was no hot water in either the kitchen or bathroom sink. Not a major problem, but slightly inconvenient.

The happy house was perfect for our 4 day visit in Buenos Aires. Manuel was an amazing host and helped tremendously when we had some travel changes arise. He was super responsive and helpful with things to do, getting taxis, etc. The place itself is great... good location to get to a lot of places and we were comfortable. The energy in the house is positive and it made our stay enjoyable. Highly recommend.

Nous avons apprécié l'accueil de Manuel,son sourire et son attention pour nous rendre service.L'appartement était très propre et agréable. A proximité de Santa Fé où on trouve tout et dans un quartier très calme le soir. Nous recommandons cette Happy House qui porte bien son nom.

Manuel is a great host and totally trustable. The apt has a perfect location to explore BA. Absolutely recomendable place. The apt is furnished with great style and taste. Everything was very clean and Manuel always available in case you need him.

Happy House was OK. The best part was Manuel, who welcomed us, always smiling and ready to help. We had a nice conversation. Now, regarding the condo, is well decorated creating a cozy ambient, a lot of book to read and information for the traveler. The area is great! The bad part is that is an old building that smell a little. The hot water in the shower and vanity was connected in the oposite side and took me the first time 3 trips to the kitchen to check if the Water heater was turning on since is On Demand. Also the TV isn't connected to cable or antena and since the router for the WiFi is in the bedroom, the signal was poor in the living room. The kitchen need to be upgrade with new pan & pots and the dish-ware. Most of the cups and plates are cracked. Still, I had a good time in Happy House but it can be much better. Luigi

I had a wonderful experience staying in Mar's apartment in Palermo Hollywood. Mar is very accommodating, friendly, speaks great English and made some wonderful suggestions about things to do in Buenos Aires. She even recommended a really nice Tango/dinner show that she booked for us with a discount. The apartment was nice and in a great location... only a few blocks from the Subway and we were able to walk to all the trendy shops and restaurants throughout Palermo. The building was very safe and the neighbors within were extremely friendly. If I were to return to Palermo I would stay in Mar's apartment again. She even welcomed us with fruit, fresh flowers and a bottle of wine.

We stayed at Mar's apartment for one month in Feb/March 1012. The apartment is exactly as described on Airbnb - great location and outlook, new, clean and comfortable - and Mar is a fantastic host. We would highly recommend......... David and Carolyn

Mar is a fantastic host. She helped us plan our short stay and made some great recommendations. The Tango show we saw was excellent and Mar called the place to get us a discount even after we had already reserved! On top of that she was very accomodating to our schedules.

The place was very clean and had everything you need. The location was a short walk from some great restaurants and cafes, not too far from shopping and bars, and quite close to one of the main metro lines. Buenos Aires is a beautiful city and we would love to stay there again. Thanks Mar!
Mar is a fantastic host. The apartment is in a great location and perfect for a couple (or a silo traveler). If I were to come back to BA I would definitely stay with her again.

Mar is really cool! And, she's got a great apartment in a really cool part of Buenos Aires, modern, clean, all facilities you'd need! Checkin is easy, heaps of helpful friendly advice, definitely highly reccomend the place!

It was my first time at Airbnb, and the experience couldn’t be better. Mar’s was a great host. The booking was smooth, and so was check in and out. The place is just like pictured at the site. Thanks a lot! I recommend it.
Petit space in a great location with everything you need.  Mar lives up to her reputation.  She was friendly, helpful, and eminently prompt.  Would staying here again if I was in Palermo.

It was a great location and Mar was beyond helpful. Everything was really clean and It was in the center of cozy Palermo. I also got lift to my next location nearby by lovely Mar. I would strongly recommend everyone Mar and her apartment if you are visiting BA.

We stayed in Mars place for two nights and it was absolutely perfect! Bright, clean and comfortable. It had a great view and is in the middle of a really nice, quiet neighborhood with plenty of good restaurants and shops. Mar was very friendly and helpful and even left us snacks and fresh bars of soap with clean towels. It's the little things that made this place so great!

Mar is a very warm and sympathic person. The communication with her was very easy and pleasant.
Her apartment is very clean and exactly as shown in the pictures. The only thing i could say is that we can hear the noise from the street but we have slept very weel thanks to earplugs. The rooftop is great, there is a beautiful view, a pleasant little pool and a "parilla"!! The building itself is secure, clean and modern.
Palermo is a great "barrio". Mar's studio is surrounded by many restaurants and is at walking distance from Palermo SoHo and its nightlife and all its boutiques.
I recommend Mar and her studio.

Manuel and his wife are wonderful people and made me feel extremely welcome. Everything went flawless from check in to check out. They could not have been more helpful and available. The apartment feels very safe and comfortable. For me it was the perfect spot to wind down and enjoy Buenos Aires - a city I love. The location is very convenient to explore all central parts of the city. I will try and book again for sure...if it is available ;). I can highly recommend staying in Happy House.

Manuel and his sister made us feel very welcome, and they were very accommodating concerning picking up the keys and the leaving time at the end of our stay. The apartment is in a great location, one block from Santa Fe and the Alto Palermo shopping mall. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos and is well equipped. Moreover, Manuel was always easy to contact and helpful. We enjoyed our stay in the lovely 'Happy House' and recommend the apartment if you are planning on visiting Buenos Aires.

Very good apartment. Great location with easy access to supermarket and malls nearby. The apartment has 1 master bedroom with bath and the living room is decorated nicely with couple of sofas. The 2nd room is very small with a twin bed and has no door as per the description. Kitchen is furnished with basic utensils. When we arrived (late night), Manuel was ready to welcome us and showed us the apartment. He was kind enough to answer any questions over whatsapp. Very nice host and easy to work with. Highly recommend it to anyone with a group of 2 or 3.

Nous venons de passer 2 semaines superbes dans cette Happy House si bien nommée.
On a l'impression d'être chez reçu chez des amis. L'appartement est cosy, super bien situé dans BA ce qui est extrêmement important compte tenu de la taille de la ville.Proche du métro, très bien desservi par les bus et les taxis sont très nombreux et très abordables.
Nous avons été reçus par Manuel qui est vraiment charmant .
Bref, c'est le coeur serré que nous avons quitté L'appartement et Buenos Aires!

Mar, muchas gracias por todo!
Las recomendaciones que nos diste nos fueron de gran utilidad.
Todo estuvo excelente y disfrutamos mucho.
El apartamento estaba excelente. Equipado con todo lo que necesitabamos. La internet funcionaba muy rapido y bien.
Saludos!
Victoria

We had the most memorable stay at the apartment. Mar was such an amazing host, providing us with a great list of things to do, restaurants & ways to get around the city, she really couldn't have been more helpful. We sent a lot of emails asking for advice & she always got back to us. The apartment was great, in a good location & very safe. It had everything we needed to make our stay comfortable, was very much a home away from home. We planned to stay for 7 days but in the end stayed for 10 days & had fresh linen & towels provided too which was a bonus.

Would most definitely stay here again if back in BA & can't recommend it enough .

The stay in this apartment was great. The place is totally funcional with kitchen tools, great cabe and delicious shower. You can enjoy a good breakfast at the balcony, cook a dinner for two, or even have some drinks with friends you have in town. The terrace is another plus. It has a great view and a swimming pool for relaxing houres.There are a lot of restaurants around.
The apartment was new and clean- very nice place in a nice neighborhood. I would certainly recommend this to place to anyone looking for a place in Buenos Aires.

We stayed two times in Mar's appartment. 2 nights at the beginning of our trip and 3 nights at the end of our holiday. It was wonderful. The appartment is just like it is described and like in the picutres. The pool was even bigger than we had epected... Mar was a great host. She was there when we checked in and alsways gave us good adivices on what to see and do in Buenos Aires. She was also very helpful before the trip when she replied to my questions whithin a few hours. All in all: I can very muh recommend this appertment and Mar as a host! We had a wonderful time at her place and would/will book it again when we are back in BA ! Thanks Mar!

Great apartment in Buenos Aires. The apartment had everything we needed and was just as described and in the photos. We spent 4 days in BA and reckon this was the best area to stay in. There were plenty of restaurants near by, a small supermarket on the corner, as well as fruit and veg shops a short walk away.
We were near lots of lovely parks and from the balcony you could sit and watch the sunset.
The number 39 bus goes from outside the apartment straight in to the centre of town near the Obelisk. Exact change only. It only cost 3 pesos.
Mar was very nice, she was very helpful when my luggage when missing and she phoned the airport for me when I was struggling to find out what was happening with my luggage.

Amazing apartament expecially for a couple !!! The neighborhood is very save and the apartament is near to the subway M. Carranza line D ! In few minut's you can go in the centre with only 2,50 pesos and also there many bus around ! From the balcony you can enjoy with a special view on the city and inside the apartament equipped with every comfort .
Mar is very nice , ever present ...if you have some problem she always try to help and always answer to your mail or on the phone !!
We spent 5 weeks in this apartament and was very nice !

We stayed at Mar's place on two separate occasions.  It was a really nice apartment in a good area with plenty of restaurants nearby.  There is also a Metro station about 5 minutes walk away.  Mar was great in terms of communication and how welcoming she was.  She was also very understanding of our disjointed travel arrangements and was very accommodating on check in/out times.  I would recommend anyone to stay here.

We had a great experience in this amazing apartment in BsAs. It's very well located (close to the subway, restaurants and a grocery store). It's also very clean and comfortable and has a fabulous view from the balcony. Check in was easy and thorough. Ralf and the team were excellent hosts who met us on arrival and made sure we were settled in. We had a wonderful time thanks!

We got a great welcome from Ralf and got access to the apartment already at nine o´clock in the morning. The apartment is exactly as in pictures, with a great view over the rooftops of Recoleta.  We enjoyed the rooftop pool and sundeck very much, since it was really hot days. The subte is close by even though we didn´t use it, taxi is really cheap so we made it our mode of transportation. Several supermarkets are close by. From the apartment we explored the Recoleta area and made some detours to the center and to Palermo Soho. I would higly recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to be "in the middle" of the center, it´s close either to the center or to Palermo, so a perfect base for exploring the city. Big thanxs to Ralf, Marcelo and rest of the crew who took really good care of us during our stay in beautiful Buenos Aires!

Room was great, view was great, and location was great. However, the main reason we wanted the apartment was for the rooftop pool, and they had it closed on days due to "weather conditions" when it merely drizzled outside. Kindof a bummer. There was also a pipe that needed to be fixed above our bathroom and we had to leave our room when they had to come and repair it. Just little inconveniences. Ralf and Marcelo were great though and were always trying to help. Great apartment for any couple.

The Urban Escape Studio was absolutely perfect. Beautiful design, very well equiped, fantastic views over Recoleta and perfectly located in the heart of the city. Our hosts Ralf and Alejandro are really knowladgable about Buenos Aires, and they gave us a lot of helpful and interesting tips. We are very grateful for all they did for us to make our stay unforgettable. We will definitively come back from Switzerland next year, and stay in the same great place.
great little apartment over looking the south west side of BA

Muy bueno! La atención muy buena y muy lindo el lugar!
Super limpio

I think that the studio is a great place and right by the Subway. I found the building clean, but thought the door men could have been a little nicer although that has nothing to do with the actual apt.
I was very appreciative of them accommodating my last minute booking and letting me check out late.

This apartament is in a terrific location if you want to be close to the green line subway.   The bed is comfortable, the shower works well and there is a gym and laundry facility in the building. The only difficult think with this apartment is because it is small, there is not a full size table to eat at, only a coffee table. Other than that The apartment was great.

My wife and I stayed at Ralf's apartment and everything was perfect, from check in to check out, everything happened according as agreed. Ralf provided the shuttle service to the airport / apartment. The driver arrived at the scheduled time, on time. It was all very easy, both on arrival and on departure. The apartment is very cozy, nicely decorated, clean and tidy, very comfortable bed, kitchen with everything the guest needs to prepare coffee and small meals, the location is very good with easy access to public transportation. The person who received us in the name of Ralf (can not remember her name) was very helpful and kind, gave us useful directions and even lent us a card that is required to use the subway or bus. Anyway, our experience of staying at the apartment Ralf was excellent. I recommend 100%.

Ralf war sehr zuvorkommend, pünktlich und gab alle wichtigen Informationen, die für einen reibungslosen Aufenthalt in Buenos Aires notwendig sind! Zusätzlich war noch eine SUBTE (Metro) Karte vor Ort, mit der man sich in BaAs sehr preiswert und sicher bewegen kann, toller Service! Das Appartement ist super, sehr zentral in Palermo in ruhiger Nachbarschaft, was bei argentinischer Bauweise auch durchaus von Vorteil ist. Die Sicherheit in der Appartement-Anlage wird groß geschrieben, alles zusammen ergibt hier 5 von 5 Sternen.
Great apartment and great location. Host was very flexible and helpful. Would definitely stay again.

Es hat alles sehr gut geklappt, auch im Vorfeld. Wir wurden bestens in alle Besonderheitej der Wohnung eingeführt. Es war ein sehr netter Kontakt. Wir können die Wohnung nur weiter empfehlen. Den Fitnessbereich fand ich absolut ausreichend um ein paar Tage zwischendurch nicht ganz unfit zu werden. Ganz toll: Sauna und Swimmingpool ( habe ich zwar nicht genutzt, aber inspiziert,
Great flat! Great location! Great people who checked us in and helped us with our trip! Loved this flat!

Todo tal cual lo promocionado.
El departamento (13 F) es luminoso, sin ruido y funcional.
La cercanía al transporte público es muy buena teniendo acceso a todas las líneas de subte con la combinación de la línea H que se ubica a 150 metros.
La cercanía a Recoleta abre un abanico de posibilidades gastronómicas y de entretenimiento del mismo modo que la zona de Corrientes/Abasto.
La atención por parte de Ralf y su gente es muy buena.
En definitiva una excelente opción de alojamiento en CABA.

Totalmente recomendable el departamento de Ralf!
La ubicación es muy buena, pasan todas las líneas de colectivos por la puerta y en la esquina hay una estación de subte. Además de estar rodeado de negocios de todo tipo!
El horario de check in fue a las 13 hs porque cuando llegamos estaban limpiando el depto, pero el check out fue flexible y nos fuimos a la tarde.
La limpieza fue muy buena y el depto cuenta con heladera, anafe, horno electrico, cafetera, tostadora, secador de pelo, toallas, toallones, planchador, plancha, WiFi, teléfono, televisor con cable, tarjeta SUBE y todo para estar realmente cómodos.
El edificio cuenta con pileta en la terraza y también pudimos usarla!
La descripción del depto y las fotos son totalmente veraces.

The apartment is in a great location where there are many restaurants and stores nearby.  The space was perfect for two people and the amenities they offered were great.  We were able to make use of the gym and the pool.  We had a great time in BA and would recommend this place to stay.

I had a great time with my boyfriend at Ralf's place, except for a few minor issues. The place was clean, beautiful and just as depicted in the pictures. Mathias gave us a great introduction to Buenos Aires in the beginning of the trip, and Ralf was kind enough to let us stay way past normal check-out (almost 10 hours past!) because we had a late flight out of Buenos Aires for free. The pool on the roof has great views, but be warned that it is NOT heated - so though it was great to lounge, it is not fun to get into. My boyfriend used the sauna and said it was not very hot, so I would caution against choosing this Airbnb based on building amenities, since you likely will not use them. However, it was really nice to have a landline in the apartment - we made lots of restaurant reservations with it!

The location is convenient to the supermarket, La Cocina empanadas, and lots of cafes. Most of the restaurants we wanted to go to in Palermo were about a 30 minute walk or 10 minute metro ride. We did cook one night during our stay, and though we (and I believe Mathias) thought there was olive oil in the apartment, we realized that the two nice italian bottles in the kitchen were both filled with balsamic vinegar. Not a big deal, but wish I had known before we cooked pasta! Other thing was that the wifi stopped working the last day, because the internet and phone bill wasn't paid. This happened literally in the last hour of our stay, so it didn't affect us for the most part. The internet was also quite slow, but it might have been because the internet company was gradually shutting off service... The BA4U team seem very responsive, so I'm hopeful they got the internet sorted out for guests to come.
Great apartment and amenities.  VERY trough check in process made things easy :)

Excelente ubicación
Debo destacar la excelente antencion de cada uno!!!
Súper cómodo, impecable
Sin dudas es el lugar ideal !!!

Everything happened exactly as we had thought. Communication with all staff was always very easy and efficient. The apartment itself is very comfortable and we were not lacking anything during the time we were there (hair dryer, kitchen items, ...). The location is very good, one block from a metro station where two different lines pass and a wide choice of supermarkets, shops, bakeries .... by the region.
Excelente APTO. Limpieza, servicio a la llegada y muy buena ubicación!
Ótima localização e o Ralf foi excelente.

Place was great for my wife and I.  We loved the location.  Doormen were kind. Elevators were efficient.  The host was always gracious, helpful and responded quickly.  We stayed for 12 nights and only had a problem one night with what sounded like a Clydesdale horse walking back and forth in the apartment above for several hours starting at around 2:30am.  However, we will definitely stay here again someday, hopefully.

O flat é extremamente bem localizado, equipado, limpo, bonito e agradável. A recepção e atenção em todos os momentos foi incrível! É bem próximo ao metrô e em uma rua que tem fácil acesso a todos os locais! Super indicado!

The happy home is so happy!!  I loved waking up daily to my sunny balcony.  The hosts were great, any questions I had were answered quickly.  The neighborhood is good, save, & convenient.  I plan to stay there again if they'll have me!

Our host, Manuel, was very thoughtful, responsive & kind. If we had any issues- such as not knowing how to turn on the heating, or how to use the video- he would explain via whatsapp or come around as soon as possible to show us. He always responded immediately to any questions or problems. He also suggested places to eat & things to do. His English was very good.
The apartment was very cozy, & decorated beautifully. It had a small outdoor courtyard & balcony off the bedroom, which we loved as you could have plenty of fresh air.
The washing machine was great to have, as staying for around 7 weeks, we used it frequently.
The location was incredibly convenient, 2 minute walk to Alto Palermo Shopping Centre( very modern), 2 minute walk to Bulnes subway train station, very close to Avenue Santa Fe for buses. Palermo Soho was only a 20 minute walk away & the Botanical Gardens a 10 minute walk. Fruit & vegies shops & mercados(supermarkets) less than 1 minute away.
Although the apartment was situated on Avenue Arenales, a fairly busy street, it was pretty quiet inside the apartment. The building was quite old but well maintained & there was plenty of natural light. The interior was bright & cheerful so can understand why it's called 'Happy House'

Manuel war ein sehr netter Gastgeber! Er gab uns eine Menge nützlicher Tipps und antwortete auf unsere Emails immer sofort. Das Apartment war sehr sauber und mit viel Liebe und stilsicher eingerichtet. Wir fühlten uns dort sehr wohl. Es war direkt im Herzen von Palermo gelegen und sehr zentral.
Manuel was a very nice host! He gave us a lot of usefull Information and answers our questions immediately. The Apartment was very clean and furnished with much style and love. It was amazing! It was located directly in the heart of Palermo and very central.

I cannot recommend this airbnb enough. It was a perfect experience from start to finish. 100% accurate description, good communication, great host. The area is safe within good walking distance to Palermo, the cemetery, and San Telmo. Subway is next door if you don't want to walk. The security guard, Sebastian, was very friendly. Our host, Marcello, was fantastic.
Thank you

Mar was a fantastic host. She was very kind of giving us some recommendation and made sure we felt at ease. The place is in a superb location, close to nice cafes, restaurants and bars. The flat is clean, confortable and modern. I absolutely recommend it!

Regards
Miguel

Manuel is a exceptional host. He provided helpful information like places to visit and restaurants before our arrival. Happy House is a cute old classic Buenos Aires home. We are so thankful for the resources provided. We used the maps, made mate, and enjoyed the open space.
Precioso apartamento, muy buena ubicacion, la gente muy atenta. Todo bárbaro

Ralf's apartment is quite the same of pictures and staff Marcelo was lovely and very professional during our time in Buenos Aires. We had some small problems with the bathroom and they fixed in time, also gave us a wine + chocolate as a message of apologizes. I would stay again when return to Buenos Aires and recommend it. :)
Excelente ubicación,cerca de todo , depto muy bien decorado,volveremos seguro,muy cómodo tener el parking en el edificio

muito bom! Otima localização.
Otima equipe. Marcelo muito atencioso. Obrigado por tudo.

El apartamento es tal como se ve en las fotos. Es cómodo,limpio, muy bien ubicado. Las instrucciones para llegar fueron claras y nos estaban esperando cuando llegamos. Derlis, que fue quien me recibió, fue muy amable y me explicó en detalle el funcionamiento del apartamento y me orientó acerca del barrio. Había varios detalles agradables, que son los que realmente hacen la diferencia entre anfitriones. Por ejemplo, nos habían dejado frutas frescas, café, té y agua mineral. También está el hecho de que prestan una tarjeta SUBE para el transporte público en Buenos Aires. Altamente recomendable.

The whole team was very helpful and friendly. They were very responsive to any questions or requests we had. We stayed at several different apartments in the same building as we were traveling around Argentina and were using Buenos Aires as our "base".
Really liked the fruits and water that they left in the room. Also, the location was excellent for going anywhere in the city. Just beware that depending on which apartment you get, you may or may not hear the nose. This particular one was facing the inner courtyard so it was very quiet.

We had a wonderful holiday in Happy House. Manuel is a perfect host, very communicative, always helpful and has lots of local's tips. Happy House is a really cozy decorated and well equipped apartment in a great location.
Thank you Manuel for hosting our family.

Eclectic and clean apartment with a lovely feel. Great air con, plenty of towels and bedding. Tiny but good kitchen! Safe and friendly area, super close to supermarkets and Alto Palermo mall. Subte (underground)  a couple of minutes away. Plenty of taxis around and we used Uber easily too. Stay there you'll feel at home straight away!

This was a perfect place for us.  I more private street so not  so much city noise (though we always travel with a sound machine and have it on at night when in cities).  The apartment is spacious and very comfortable.  Good bed and pillows.  Large plants at the windows give a protected feeling and nice filtered light.  If we ever travel to BA again, we will definitely ask to stay again.

Me encantó poder hospedarme en happy house, sentí que estaba en casa. El departamento es hermoso, amplio, muy limpio, al entrar se sienten las buenas energías, la ubicación esta excelente. Manuel siempre estuvo pendiente de cualquier detalle, es muy atento y muy amable.
Very nice apartment in Palermo,with personal touch,and practical location for discovering the city.We stayded there almost a month and felt at home....we made the perfect choice!

Manuel is a great host, very helpful and accommodating, made our stay easy from start to finish. The apartment is charming and well located. You have everything you need for your stay.

There was a general strike across the city and he let us stay all day there after our checkout so we didn't have to stay on the streets with out luggage for hours, top host!

Totally recommend!

Pasamos muy lindo en Happy House!
Todo fue tal cual como la descripción. Manuel estuvo atento a todo en toda la estadía.
Fuimos con Antonio que tiene 5 años y pasó muy bien, tenía su dormitorio y una casa linda para llegar después de los paseos.
La recomendamos y volveremos!

Maravillosa Happy House!! Nos quedamos para semana santa con mi familia: mi marido una bebé y una pequeña de 6 años, el departamento está amorosamente decorado con agradables espacios libres y muy bien equipada, en una calle bastante céntrica y nosotros que amamos caminar encontramos que todos los lugares turísticos estaban bastante cerca, como por ejemplo el jardín japonés, planetario, malva, museo de Bellas artes, plaza francia, centro cultural, millones de cosas por hacer y visitar.
Manuel es un excelente y preocupado anfitrión, se enfermó una de mis peques y hasta dato de clínica por si necesitaba me envio.
Muchas gracias por tu hospitalidad Manuel, te volveremos a visitar muy pronto!!! Hasta luego!

This apartment was great.  The location is perfect; centrally located in Palermo, close to the subway and the main city avenue (Avenida Santa Fe), restaurants, bars, grocery stores.  The apartment itself is clean, well-equipped with all necessities, and perfect for both shorter and longer vacations.  The host was extremely friendly and always responded in a timely manner.  Highly recommend!
I stayed at Happy House for two months and it was a wonderful experience. The owners were very responsive and even left us a bottle of wine and some sweets. Great for a short or long term stay!

Me ha gustado la ubicación, pese a estar muy céntrico no se escuchan ruidos molestos. Para ir en pleno invierno deberían equiparlo mucho más según mis necesidades, el resto es muy recomendable, María y Manuel son discretos y muy agradables, hacen que te sientas en casa! muy agradecida
Appartement recommandé

Amazing flat in a great location!
The communication for check in and check out was very good and helpful. I would definitely stay there again.

We stayed at the Happy House for over a week. We were recieved  by the lovely Maria, who is the most amazing host. She was friendly and easy to reach when needed, always trying to help. We had a great time! The apartment is spacious. The internet works well. There are basic things in the kitchen to cook. There is an ac both in the living room and bedroom which was good because we had some hot days. The location is excellent. There is everything within 2 blocks range- groceries, atm, cinema, metro line, pharmacy etc. The happy house is a good place to stay in Buenos Aires.

Muy lindo apartamento, aunque pequeño, muy confortable para una o dos personas, silencioso por la noche.
Volvería a bookearlo sin dudas!

Excellent Condo in a great area. If you are Business Traveller, I would recommend Ralf's Condo instead of a hotel. Ralf and his team provide a 'Turn Key' service from picking you up at the Airport, to reviewing all the amenities/services that the Condo provides and finally getting you back to the Airport for your return flight. Any/all texts, emails or voicemails were answered within 20mins by a professional & competent Staff.

cannot recommend highly enough - great to book and really convenient location for buses and underground - close to most attractions - lovely apartment as well.  The best part was the magnificent backup assisting us with a 4.30 am arrival - arranging transfers and allowing us to stay late until connecting with the transfer to the airport for our mid night flight when we left- best Air BnB   experience we have enjoyed

Ralf and his apartment were fantastic! Clean, beautiful building, amazing location, great amenities, super fast internet, and fruit/water waiting for me upon arrival. Rooftop pool deck is lovely. On a main street but super quiet because unit is on a high floor and faces the back. Even has bluetooth speakers! A/C worked like a charm. Balcony beautiful. And I was allowed to stay until 6PM on my check out date because nobody was checking in that day. Great communication and service! Couldn't recommend enough. FANTASTICO!

Ralf’s place is perfect for two people wishing to explore BA. It is near the Subte ( Subway) green line and close to anything you need to enjoy the city. We went to the Colon Theatre and were there in less then 20 minutes. Near the studio, there are small grocery stores, laundry service, pharmacies and coffee shops. (If you want peanut butter you can purchase it at the liquor stores!) The studio has a great balcony overlooking the city with lovely plants. We could easily Bluetooth our music to two very nice speakers. The bed is very comfortable! We made good use of the rooftop pool due to the hot weather. It is really nice just to lay by the pool and get away from the city bustle. In all,  the studio is just as described and we would stay there again!

I stayed 14th floor of the same apartment, but it was already taken so I chose 13th floor this year. Honestly speaking, both rooms are super clean, neat and lots of amenities such as welcome fruits, freshly ground coffee, huge bottle of mineral water, soaps, etc. so I never been disappointed by Ralf and the Team's job. Also, veranda is a bonus. I always enjoy outside fresh air on the veranda with a cup of cappuccino which is bought from the next door from this building.
Location is seriously superb too. Several steps away from subway stations (2 lines) and the entrance is facing to busy traffic Santa Fe avenue so catching a taxi is super easy (always within 30 sec.) and taxi fare in B.A. is very affordable. Oh, the room is facing the other side of the street and high floor, so it was quiet, no problem of the noises at all.
I will definitely back to one of their room next year for sure. This is 'my home' in B.A.!!
Excelente, sin dudas volvería.
Muy buena experiencia, el dpto. es lo que parece en la descripción.

Location: The apartment is located on the main road (Sante fe), where you will find many restaurants, cafes and book stores. I felt safe in this neighbourhood.
Note, the famous bookstore in a monastery is a five minute walk from the apartment.
Amenities: A fruit bowl is provided, several number of plates, wine glasses and cutlery. Detergent is also provided.
There is a washing machine located in the lower level. To use this, you will need to either get a token from Ralph or use coins. You will also need to bring your own washing powder.
Apartment: It's spacious and perfect for two people.
Great experience.  We arrived 3:00AM and Marcelo came to receive us with no problem. Location is perfect. For sure a place to consider next time . Thanks for everything.

El departamento de Ralf es un muy buen alojamiento. Es cómodo, esta bien ubicado, es seguro, limpio. Ellos muy atentos y con detalles que te hacen sentir a gusto. Lo recomiendo 100%. Seguro volveremos !

The flat was super nice. Stylish deco, great location, easy to check in, check out, easy communication... The flat had everything I need to spend some time comfortably, including a balcony with a nice view of the city

Ralf and his crew were very accommodating! was our first time and gave us a map of the area and pointed out places that made our short stay much more enjoyable. Great guy! place was very nice and  clean and served our needs just perfect. Bed was very comfortable too. We will choose this unit again on our next trip for sure.
It's is a very good place! Comfortable, clean, safe and complete for travelers.
Loved staying at Ralf's place. We had a great introduction and were provided with many local tips. would stay here again.

Great flat - modern, open space concept with all you need as a traveler. Probably only fit for two people due to the overall square footage, but has all you need. It is a bit noisy with people walking above you or dogs barking in the ally. However this apartment does not face the main road so you can't complain too much...after all it is a busy city! Martin was an amazing host. Very kind and readily available before and during your stay. Would recommend working with him on any of the spaces they have in Buenos Aires!

Cheers and happy travels!
Excelente ubicación y hospitalidad. Gracias por todo. Volveremos pronto.

Great place to stay! I loved the view the apartment had!
I stayed there one month and found the neighborhood very safe with great restaurants nearby, besides Mar is a great! I once got locked outside and she was kind enough to wait for me around 12am to pick up the extra keys!!!

I stayed in this apartment for five weeks and would have extended my stay even longer if it hadn't already been booked after this. The apartment is spacious and well located, close to bars, cafes, supermarkets, laundry, etc. Mar was extremely helpful with information about BA before I arrived and very responsive when I contacted her while in BA. Overall it was a great stay - the only minor issue was the loss of water one day, but this was a building wide issue and soon fixed. mar was very helpful and followed up the issue with the building manager.

One tip for future guests: be careful leaving the balcony door open during and after it rains as you will get a multitude of bugs in the apartment.

Overall, I highly recommend staying here.

The apartment was great--clean, comfortable and well appointed with everything we needed. The location is also great--super central to all three areas of Palermo, subway and a number of bus lines. Moreover, Maria could not have been a more helpful, friendly, accessible and welcoming host. Every request she tried to help with, she was super quick with responses via email or phone and she was always ready to answer questions or give local advice/recommendations. Was a great stay!

Nice clean studio and Mar was really kind!
Good location , really enjoyed our weekend!

This sunny studio is fantastic and perfectly located in one of the best areas in Buenos Aires. It is very functional, modern, tastefully furnished and cozy. We enjoyed the nice balcony and a small swimming pool on the roof, from where one may watch the spectacular sunsets. Mar is a very helpful and nice host, always ready with advise and a friendly hand.
The whole apartment building is new and elegant with several safety features for your peace of mind only, because the neighbourhood is probably the safest in Buenos Aires, so you don't really need these locks that much.
We definitely recommend it and if we're back in BA then we are renting the same place for sure. Thank you Mar!
Muy lindo departamento

El departamento de Mar es espectacular. En primer lugar, la ubicación es ideal. Queda en Palermo, un barrio muy lindo, con lugares cerca para ir a comer, tomar algo o hacer alguna compra. Es seguro para caminar de noche, volvimos caminando de madrugada y nunca nos sentimos inseguros. El edificio es nuevo. El departamento está impecable, lo recibimos muy prolijo y limpio. Es sumamente luminoso, entra luz natural por todos lados. Mar es una excelente anfitriona, muy considerada, dispuesta a ayudar y con mucha experiencia. En el departamento encontramos cosas muy útiles para los viajeros, hay mapas, la tarjeta 'sube' para usar colectivos y trenes en la ciudad. También tiene una cocina muy completa, plancha, secador de pelo, aire acondicionado y mucho más, perfecto para una estadía más larga. Tiene una terraza muy linda que está sobre la calle Soler que es ideal para sentarse ahí a cualquier hora. Nosotros estuvimos tres días en total y el lugar nos resultó muy cómodo. Se lo vamos a recomendar a nuestros amigos ya que nuestra experiencia fue muy buena. Muchas gracias por todo Mar! Fue un gusto! Elisa y Alfonso
The apartment is sweet and cozy, clean and comfortable and in a nice location. Mar was very nice, helpful and caring and I felt that if I needed something, I could turn to her. I recommend it !

Mar is an amazing host. She is helpful and very receptive to whatever you could need during your stay. Moreover, the flat is nice, clean and very cosy. It is located in a very quiet place, with everything you can need around.
Thank you for everything, i will definitely come back to stay in Mar's studio !!! 100% recommended !!!

Tuvimos una sola noche en el departamento de Mar. Nos iniciabamos con el sistema de Airbnb. La primera experiencia fue excelente. Mar estuvo pendiente todo el tiempo de nuestra llegaday nos estuvo esperando en Sunny Studio. El lugar muy comodo, elegante a mas de organizado. Cerca de todo lo importante en Buenos Aires. Altamente recomendable.
Staying at Mar's place in Palermo Hollywood was awesome! She is super nice, and her apartment is great. The view from the balcony is awesome!
We had a great time. The location is perfect and the apartment is comfy.  Mar helped get us organized so we could take advantage of all the great things to do in Buenos Aires.

I had a pleasure to stay at Mar's apartment for over a week. Mar is a great host and a very warm and kind person! She greeted me very warmly and gave some tips on the area. She was always responsive to any of my questions. I felt really at home at Mar's flat!! The best thing of the flat is a huge window with the city views! A sunset over the city is just beautiful! The apartment is very cosy, comfortable and clean. Thanks so much, Mar, for hosting me at your place!
Everything was just great! The apartment is really beautiful and the view is amazing! it is really cosy and in a great part of Buenos Aires! We felt like home!
Mar was a very gracious host and the apartment is beautiful. Great neighborhood to explore and grab a bite to eat. Fantastic balcony and view.

O apartamento é ótimo! Tem uma localização excelente principalmente para quem gosta de restaurantes e pubs. A anfitriã Mar nos recebeu muito bem e foi muito simpática e atenciosa! Gracias Mar! Super recomendo!

Excelente mi estadía en el departamento de Mar, me espero a la hora acordada en el lugar, me oriento para poder movilizarme en la ciudad y me brindo su apoyo en caso de necesitar ayuda para algo.
Muy lindo el departamento, la vista a la ciudad es hermosa, muy cómodo, cerca de todos los lugares turísticos de palermos y con muy buena movilización, además cuenta con mapas y lugares de referencia para solicitar información.

Recomiendo a todos este lugar, es tal cual como se ve en las fotografías y ella es muy amorosa, espero volver pronto.

Great Place, Amazing Location and a Very Friendly Host!  We stayed here almost two weeks and were so comfortable that we didn't want to leave.  The apartment is sunny, very nicely decorated and has everything one might need.  It's located in a very safe negibirhood of Palermo Holywood just a short walk away to the trendiest restaurants,b bars and clubs in the Buenos Aires and only three blocks from the green line subte station and Avenida Santa-Fe where you can catch many buses that will take you towards the center.  Mar was a great host checking up on us everyday and responding immediately to any questions or concerns.  Book this place, you won't regret it!

La ubicación del departamento es excelente y el mismo es tal cual las fotos, perfecto para 2 personas !
Mar fue sumamente atenta, dispuesta a nuestra necesidades y flexible con nuestros horarios.
La verdad que recomendable 100% !!

Excelente ubicación y cerca de medios de transporte. Equipado con lo necesario para una tranquila estadía en Buenos Aires... Mar fue muy amable y se adaptó a nuestros horarios de check in & out. Posiblemente volveré en mis próximas visitas a la ciudad.

Mar made me more than welcome. Al correspondence was answered promptly, the flat is exactly as described. I did not have any problems whatsoever....... only help .  which made my stay so much more enjoyable.

This is a lovely little spot, close to everything, but still quiet. Modern, secure building with 360 degree view of BA from rooftop terrace. Plus Mar went to extraordinary measures to return some cash that I inadvertently left in the flat, so bonus points for being a righteous person.

Hermosa experiencia! Una anfitriona de lujo, todas las comodidades, muy amable mar, hizo que la estadía sea perfecta. El departamento es hermoso, la ubicación perfecta. Todo impecable y súper recomendado

Que bien Mar, fue muy satisfactorio ocupar tu casa, de lo mejor en cuanto a la calidad, la veracidad de lo ofrecido, al principio dudé del Barrio y después me resultó casi familiar y muy seguro. En el aspecto personal no puedo creer tu calidad humana y solidaridad. No podía conseguir taxi, era un día difícil y Mar me llevó en su automóvil hasta un lugar donde conseguí movilidad para el Aeropuerto. Sinceramente agradecido!!!

Great apartment in the wonderful location of Palermo Hollywood. Apartment is exactly as described, and was clean and comfortable. Mar is lovely, and we knew if there were any problems we could get in touch. Really handy for bars / restaurants. Highly recommend!
Great apartment and perfect location! Mar was so friendly and accommodating!

Mar is a warm and friendly host. Communication with her was easy and fast. She also allowed us a late check out which was much appreciated. The apartment is a value for the cost. Great neighborhood with restaurants and small stores. Tree lined street with a balcony that is actually big enough to sit on! The apt is s studio and fairly small but there is so much light it didn't seem cramped. Good wifi, lots of hot water, a.c. Decent , very secure building . I recommend it.

The stay in Mar's apartment was really lovely! The apartment was exactly as described and looked as per the pictures. We especially liked the great view from the balcony and from the rooftop pool. The area of Palermo is one of the best in Buenos Aires, the vibe in the neighbourhood was really unique. We would gladly be back again!
Gracias Mar por todo!. La estadía fue magnífica.

Me encanto el lugar, comodo,accesible, un barrio perfectamente ubicado, cerca de todos los medios de transporte y lugares para comer. Seguro, la vista del departamento genial. Mar es una genia, me dejo hacer check in y check out de acuerdo a los horarios de mis vuelos. Y es muy amable. Me encanto y volvere sin dudas.

excelente depto, es tal como lo muestran las fotos
muy buen barrio, tranquilo, seguro y con múltiples alternativas
Mar es una genia y se adaptó a mis horarios de vuelos
Todo fue como en la descripcion, el departamento es muy comodo, en la zona hay varios lugares para salir es una zona segura y Mar fue muy amable, gracias!

La casa es tal cual se ve en las fotos, un mono ambiente muy acogedor, con mucha luz y situado en pleno Palermo Hollywood. Se entregó muy limpio y bien equipado, con pequeños detalles que demuestran cuando las cosas están hechas con cariño (desde guías y planos hasta un DVD con cientos de películas por si prefieres quedarte en casa). La cama, bien cómoda.

Mar hizo todo lo posible porque nos sintiéramos a gusto, cuidando detalles para nada necesarios e incluso ayudándonos con algún problema que tuvimos que iba más allá del propio alojamiento y que ni tan sólo le atañía. Todo siempre por voluntad propia. Ante cualquier petición, su respuesta es inmediata y siempre positiva.

De verdad, es imposible decir nada malo de esta experiencia.

Great experience. Mar and her friend were very accommodating. The check-in and check-out process was very smooth and communication was fast throughout the stay. When there was a problem, they tried their best to fix it.

Excelente atención y disponibilidad de Mar para hacer cómoda nuestra estadía.   Su departamento es cómodo, cálido y acogedor. Todo tal cual lo ofrecido, muy buena ubicación. Agradecemos mucho y seguramente será un lugar para regresar y recomendar. Gracias Mar!

Minha estadia em Buenos Aires foi perfeita! O apartamento de Mar está no melhor bairro de Buenos Aires, com varias coisas para fazer por perto... Baladas, bares, cafés deliciosos, supermercado, farmacia, metro, trem enfim, ótima localização. O apartamento está em boas condições, a vizinhança é tranquila e silenciosa, não tive problema algum. Mar é uma ótima anfitriã, está sempre presente para resolver qualquer problema que te aconteça com o apartamento, para te indicar lugares, é muito simpatica e prestativa. O apartamento é bem equipado, pode cozinhar e guardar alimentos. Quando voltar a Buenos Aires penso em ficar novamente neste apartamento.

Excelente todo!

Muchas gracias

Mar, our host, is friendly, accommodating and responsive. We were in touch with her on several occasions and she made herself always available.
She provided us with an invaluable knowledge of the neigbourhood and the city. It is difficult to imagine more charming airbnb host :-)

This was a great place to stay in Buenos Aires. Mar was very flexible in our check in time and was even more flexible to let us check out a day early when our plans changed. The location was perfect, near many cafes and the subway. Amenities were great: AC, hot water, towels, etc. Our only complaint was that it looked like someone hadn't been there in a while so there were a few dead flies around and the place was a little dusty but other than that, everything else was great! Mar also have great suggestions about places to see and eat at near the area!!! She even left a subway card for us to use.
Mar was an amazing host and handled my last minute travels plans very well! Loved the apartment as well. Highly recommend!

Alquile el departamento de Mar para un miembro de la empresa que viajaba a Buenos Aires por trabajo. Todo resulto muy fácil. Comunicarse con Mar fue un placer, estaba siempre disponible y muy atenta. El departamento era lo esperado!
El departamento estaba en buenas condiciones, pero con algunos detalles, especialmente en el baño. Mar, es muy atenta y gentil. Está en un buen barrio y tiene una adecuada relación precio calidad.

Mar's place was perfect for my 33 days in BA!

It's in an excellent location that's safe.

If you need to work while staying here, it won't be an issue as the wifi was solid all the time.
The apartment is exactly as billed. Mar was an incredibly accommodating hostess.
Ape super bacana, região agradável, proximo a varias lojas, mercado, shopping (mt perto). Tranquilo os combinados com Maria, que foi sempre atenciosa.

A Maria, que foi quem nos recebeu, foi muito atenciosa em todos os momentos e estava no apartamento exatamente no horário combinado. Quando precisamos falar com ela, respondeu as mensagens em seguida. O apartamento é lindo, muito bem decorado, as acomodações muito aconchegantes e limpo. A localização do apartamento é ótima! Fica próxima a shopping, mercado e estações de metrô. Super recomendo a estadia no apartamento Happy House!

Magnifique appartement dans Palermo, à un bloc du métro Buelnes. La deco de l’appartement est vraiment tres sympa, dans un logement bien fonctionnel. Le quartier est tranquille avec un grand super marcado a 200m, restaurant de grillade au pied de l’immeuble.

Really well located apartment, with subway and supermarket on the same block. Also three parks close by with playgrounds, which was important for us while travelling with a kid. Maria was very responsive and easy to contact for the duration of our one month stay.

This clean, bright, warm and safe apartment was a wonderful home for two traveling artist/friends. I stayed in the small room which is quite cozy but plenty big for one small or average sized person. If you are bothered by not having a door or need more storage space, this might not work for you, but I slept great.  The main room is huge with plenty of closet space.  Everything we needed was provided, and we loved our time here. Within walking distance to great sights (see the rose garden nearby) and many trains and busses.  If I can return to BA, I would be thrilled to stay here again.
Atención perfecta, muy buena ubicación, decoración y limpieza muy buena lo recomiendo altamente!

Happy House is truly a home away from home! It's well provisioned for a couple friends and/or a family, designed to be comfortable and cozy, has TONS of storage space in the master bedroom, and at a prime location to the train/metro for easy city access. María was our main contact and was absolutely delightful -- thank you for helping make our stay so positive and comfortable.
Apartamento é bem localizado, mas barulhento e indico apenas para casais, pois o segundo quarto  não é confortável ...
très beau séjour. Merci !

Muy lindo departamento, ubicado en pleno palermo, en una zona muy tranquila, el lugar esta muy bien ambientado y te hace sentir como en casa de amigos. El único detalle que tengo para decir, es que la segunda habitación es muy chica, no tiene placard, y no tiene puerta.
Awesome! Thanks for the stay!

It was our first Airbnb experience and it was very positive. The apartment is situated in a bit less trafficked street but still If you like to walk then both Palermo Soho or Hollywood are within walking distance and so is Ricoleta. We enjoyed our stay and Maria was helpful both with check-in (our flight was several hours delayed) and check out.

Piso bien situado, cerca del metro, a unos 20 min a pie de los parques de Palermo. Supermercado al lado de casa. Zona muy segura y poco ruidosa, muy buen lugar para vivir en Buenos Aires. Del piso las únicas salvedades, una habitación no tiene puerta y es muy pequeña y la cocina también es pequeña, no hay una mesa comedor al uso.
