La decoración es muy bonita y tiene el resto de servicios que se pueden esperar: lavadora, microondas, tostadora, aire acondicionado. En definitiva, estuve muy bien.

I had a wonderful experience at Happy House. The apartment is full of good energy - the building is older, and not sterile like many apartments are nowadays - it has soul and personality. It was clean, very comfortable, and well equipped with everything I needed in the kitchen (including a blender and espresso maker!), extra blankets and towels, washing machine.. everything. I loved the mornings with the sun streaming through the crystal in the patio, and the afternoons with the light coming through the trees on the bedroom balcony. Since I was there for work, I also appreciated the desk and the proximity of the large supermarket. María was wonderful and met me in person to deliver the keys at a time that was very convenient for me. Overall, fantastic value! I hope to return!

The apartment was as communicated and the stay was fine.
The disappointment was that a message had been sent asking when we were arriving. I was traveling and missed this message and also didn’t get a notification from Airbnb.

This miss resulted in us not being able to check in until 6pm after arriving at 1pm.
The expectation of the host that the result of missing one message caused this inconvenience.
I’d have hoped that the info on the Airbnb page stating that check in in from 11 would mean that a key is available from 11.
No attempt was made to communicate the impact of missing one message or to try to check if we had received the initial message... and this resulted in a poor experience.
Nice place!
The location is superbly convenient and safe!  We enjoy the daily walk around the neighborhood.  Good restaurants are nearby.  All in all, the stay is satisfactory!
Muy buena ubicación del depto para hacer base y dirigirse a muchos lugares de interés. El depto no cuenta con canales de aire ni de cable para ver en la televisión.

This is a really cosy gem of a place in Palermo. We had a wonderful 3-week stay there. The flat is like home from home and is very well equipped with everything you might need. It has very effective heating for the cooler winter days. It is very well located in the city. The neighbourhood has everything. It is also convenient for travelling to other neighbourhoods in the city. Check in and out were very smooth and flexible to fit our flight times. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend this as a wonderful and comfortable place to stay in Buenos Aires and would definitely stay there again. A big thank you!
Wonderful stay! Thank you so much for the hospitality!!
Hermoso departamento, muy cómodo y en una excelente ubicación.

O apartamento é agradável e a localização muito boa. O apartamento é bem silencioso e tem ar condicionado no quarto (o da sala não segura o calor). Na parte de baixo do prédio tem um restaurante (churrascaria) e o exaustor da quase que na janela de dentro do apartamento, assim, o apartamento fica no horário de almoço e de jantar com cheiro de churrasco. Não me incomodou, mas fiquei pensando em como isso seria para um vegano. O apartamento não tem nenhum luxo, não tem nem taças de vinho e também não tem elevador (ele é no segundo andar). Mas é bem aconchegante, com cara de casinha e ao lado do metro. A Maria foi atenciosa mas atrasou na nossa entrada, um acidente ao qual se desculpou. Ela até nos deixou ficar a mais do que o horário de check out. Muito real ao que apresenta nas fotos.

El departamento es perfecto. Muy bien ubicado, más amplio de lo que parece en las fotos.  Excelente ubicación y la atención de María y los chicos fue fantástica, siempre atentos a que todo estuviera bien. Volveremos !!!

I enjoyed my 5-day stay at “Happy House”.
I appreciated that the host accommodated my late check-in (my international flight arrived after 9PM).

The owner left the apartment with many details that makes it eclectic and cozy, and gives this AirBnB a unique personality.
The place was comfortable and well equipped. The kitchen had enough utensils for a short stay. There is a small table for eating (the only place in the apartment) and also a washing machine. The living room area was nicely decorated exactly as the pictures show, and the large sofa was comfortable for reading or working with a laptop. There’s a desk that I also used for when I needed to do some work. The apartment receives most of the light in the morning, and it gets dark in the afternoon.

The AC in the living room area worked fine (I was lucky that my stay was during cooler days) and just opening the window to the small internal patio was enough for me. The issue with doing that is that the apartment is located next to La Payuca — a high-end parrilla. As an Argentinean expat, I miss asado a lot, but smelling that BBQ grilling all the time is a bit distracting borderline annoying (it did entice me to buy food there twice, which is delicious). The window doesn’t have mosquito netting so that could be an annoyance, too, as I was bitten one night.

The bedroom had a small flat TV (I would personally preferred it in the living room area), a small AC unit, large closets with drawers, and a double bed. The mattress was decent but not the most comfortable. At night I was hot, so I had the AC on, and it was quite loud. The street outside had normal traffic, mostly the noise came from the restaurant, since it stays open until 1:00AM. It is a very popular place.

I didn’t like that the linens (towels, bed sheets) were very old and stained, especially considering the cost of the stay.

The WIFI was lightning fast, and let me do remote work smoothly.

The location was great, one block from Disco supermarket, two blocks from Alto Palermo Shopping Mall, and the Bulnes subway station. This is my favorite area to stay in Palermo and it’s like my neighborhood every time I return to Buenos Aires.

As the listing states, the place does not have elevator, so future guests must keep that in mind if mobility is affected as the apartment is located on a second floor.

All in all, I would stay again here, it felt like a nice private place centrally located.

El departamento de Mar es bonito y muy iluminado, el barrio hermoso y la ubicacion perfecta, cerca de todo (transporte, restaurantes, etc) y tiene un balcon con una vista hermosa, Mar estuvo siempre pendiente y fue una anfitriona excelente, lo unico negativo fue el baño que no nos parecio muy limpio, y la cama que esta hundida al medio, lo que me dejo con dolor de espalda, pero esto utimo no se si fue a causa del anterior inquilino ya que no vi queja alguna sobre la cama en las reseñas, lo demas todo excelente.
Great location, lovely appartment & fantastic host. We loved staying here. Thank you Mar !

El departamento es todo lo que uno espera y más. Bien ubicado, limpio, iluminado y con una agradable vista. Llegué con poco equipaje porque hice un viaje corto y no me faltó nada gracias a las comodidades provistas por Mar. Como anfitriona estuvo atenta a todos los detalles y comunicada desde el primer momento. ¡Una excelente experiencia que espero repetir!
Todo bárbaro

Great location in Palermo neighborhood, Buenos Aires.
Close to restaurants, bars, and public transportation.
Very good WiFi, AC and pool in the top floor.
Very responsive host and useful tips sharing.
Muy buena ubicación, departamento moderno, bien arreglado, muy buena atención de Mar. Todo bien..

This apartment is simply fantastic! Great rooftop, comfy bed, nice balcony, host is always accessible via whatsapp. The kitchen is small but otherwise, is the most amazing spot to stay in Buenos Aires, close to bars and restaurants. Definitely recommend.
Muy buena estadia, Mar muy atenta.

Mar's place is very convenient and comfortable. Everything is as pictures in the profile, easy to use, and makes for a great stay. Mar was quick to respond for arranging check in/out and everything went as planned. Highly recommended!

The place is very nice and cozy. Lots of light and good view. The flat inside is like on the pictures. Good location. Friendly host.

The only minus was that some things needed maintenance, like doors to the wardrobe or thing to hang towels on that was falling apart. But that didn't bother us at all.

I loved staying at Mar's apartment! It really is a super sunny and light apartment and the view from the balcony is incredible. I loved having dinner and breakfast on the balcony. Mar is an excellent host, she communicates perfectly and she is very sweet and helpful. I would definitely stay again :-)
Ótimo apartamento. Ideal para viajantes e estudantes. Bem localizado. A anfitriã é muito gente boa!!
Perfect place to explore BsAs

This is a great apartment in a good location between Recoleta and Palermo. Despite being on the busy Santa Fe, the space is quiet because it is at the back of the building and high up with great views.

That flat is kitted out with everything you could possibly need and is very clean.

Ralf's team were responsive and checkin was really easy.

This was our second stay in two weeks at one of Ralf's places and the quality of service and accommodation is really very high. We will definitely be looking them up again when we return to the wonderful city of BA.

Ralf place is excellent.  The apartment is very comfortable, nice and quite.  The place is also very clean and organized.  The location is perfect.  Just a block away from subway, easy to get on taxi and with plenty of shops, restaurant, bank and supermarket close by.  Ralf and his team are very friendly and helpful, they help us arrange transportation from the airport and response fast to our request.  Would love to stay at Ralf's place again.

Wow, what a gem! Stylish apartment is a peaceful respite in a super central location at the heart of bustling Buenos Aires. The apartment is located on busy Avenida Santa Fe with numerous shops, cafes, restaurants, and Alto Palermo shopping mall up the street and  direct access to the Subte (metro). Despite being in such a busy area, the apartment faces the back of the building and is near the top floor so it's relatively quiet. We also enjoyed the rooftop pool after walking around on a hot day. What a treat!

We had a great time in Ralf’s apartment and enjoyed our stay. The arrival was uncomplicated and easy.
We can definetly recommend the apt. for a city trip to BA!

O apartamento tem um ótimo espaço, bem equipado e estava bem limpo, exatamente como nas fotos, inclusive a cesta com frutas, que foi muito bem vindo pois fomos com nossa filha de 1 ano. O processo de Check-in e Check-out foi super simples e fomos muito bem recebidos pelo nosso anfitrião. A localização é outro ponto forte, ficava a pouco metros do metrô e no apartamento já tinha um cartão Sube (cartão do metrô) precisando apenas carregar, dava pra ir a pé até o Cemitério da Recoleta, Museu Nacional de Belas Artes, Shopping Alto Palermo, Jardim Botânico e outros lugares de destaque, o bairro é bem tranquilo e nos sentimos seguros o tempo todo. A equipe do prédio foi muito cortês, sempre prestativos e muito simpáticos, o prédio também tem piscina e lavanderia. Foi uma estadia bem tranquila. Certamente ficaríamos de novo nesse apartamento.

Das Appartament hat uns sehr gefallen.  Es ist modern und chic eingerichtet. Dort gibt es alles was man braucht. Die Lage ist sehr zentral: viel Cafés, Restaurants in der Nähe. Man  fühlt sich immer sicher. Es gibt Sicherheit 24 Stunden. Ganz Nah befindet sich eine U- Bahn Station und zahlreiche Busse um die Stadt zu erkunden
Muy bien situado, colchón muy cómodo, bien equipado.
Everything is perfect in this appartment.

Eu e meu marido amamos ficar no apartamento era exatamente como a foto e superou nossas expectativas. Fomos em lua de mel e amamos a cidade. O apartamento é bem localizado do lado do metrô. O Marcelo nos apresentou tudo e como funciona. Tinha uma cesta cheia de frutas frescas e um cartão sub que usamos bastantes. O apartamento tem uma vista linda, a piscina é maravilhosa ( tiramos fotos lindas) e estava sempre vazia ( isso era bom). Usamos a academia tambem. Marcelo foi bem fléxivel quando ao check out. Usamos a lavanderia, e a cozinha é bem completa e  tem restaurantes e mercados pertos.  Andamos a santa fe inteira, tem muitas lojas de decorações. Enfim, amamos a estadia.  Ah tinha um home theather bem legal, minha unica sugestão é colocar uma smart tv para poder assistir netflix ( depois de um dia de caminhada é bom relaxar).  Excelente estadia voltaremos com certeza!!
Espectacular! Vale la pena!

J’ai séjourné 4 jours dans ce magnifique appartement extrêmement bien placé à 2 mn du métro ce qui est très pratique
L’appartement est très bien équipé : lit très comfortable, petit salon sympa et jolie terrasse avec une vue imprenable
Il y a aussi une piscine avec transat sur le toit avec une jolie vue sur la ville mais je n’ai pas eu le temps d’y aller
Ralph nous a gentiment accueilli avec un plateau de fruit et a pensé à tout pour nous rendre le séjour très agréable :café, sélection de thé, bouteille d’eau ... et même une rallonge pour charger nos téléphones et un séchoir à cheveux
Je reviendrai avec plaisir dans cet appartement
Nice place

Great people, great hospitality, very accurate and quick to respond.
The place itself is very modern with thoughtful amenities, clean and one block from bus stop and underground tubes station. There are enough cafe shops and restaurants to go to within 1 to 3 blocks.

I will definitely come back here.
Nice place, well located, quiet (for city centre) , and much as described. I would stay again.
Un espacio, confortable, acogedor, con muy buena asistencia por parte de los anfitriones  y con una  ubicación  estratégica
Amazing location! Everyone was very helpful. I would highly recommend this apartment. Thanks for a great stay!

El departamento es muy lindo, bien iluminado, la ubicación es muy comoda.
El Anfitrión esta siempre a disposición ante cualquier duda o consulta.
Sin dudas volveria al departamento.

5 estrellas es poco. Me quede poco más de dos meses en Urban-escape, alojamiento de Ralph y fue la mejor decisión.
Mi estancia fue excelente. Viaje de UK a visitar a mis padres y me aloje cerca de ellos. Comenzando por todo el staff de Ralph, Marcelo, Andrés y Jonathan y el equipo de mantenimiento. Siempre disponibles, resolutivos y encantadores. Gracias a cada un@ de ell@s.
Las instalaciones son impecables. La casa está súper equipada con limpieza asistida cada quincena. Disfrute de la piscina cada día, hay gimnasio y sauna recién habilitado post-pandemia. Los encargados del edificio Ismael y Juan, tienen todo al día, piscina limpia y gimnasio sanitizado.
El depto está a metros de buses y subte. Buenisima ubicación, céntrica y segura con infinitos negocios, bancos, farmacias y dieteticas a la mano. Ademas de la terraza con piscina, el depto Urban tiene un balcón donde disfrutar una tarde tranquila. Además dispone de un SUM que se puede alquilar para uso de hasta 10 personas. Alojarme allí fue un sueño, volveré el año que viene. Para mi fue perfecto. Gracias nuevamente a todo el equipo. Abrazos y hasta la próxima Clara
Ideal location .

Apartment is well-located in Recoleta and, although central, is not bothered by traffic noise. It was perfectly equipped for my tourist needs, that includes refrigerator, microwave, toaster, oven, ironing equipment. Very useful were the washing machines y dryers in the basement.
Other provided facilities, like pool and fitness, I did not use, due to the winter and due to laziness.

I prefer to use public traffic in BsAs, for that the location of the apartment is ideal in all directions.
I felt welcomed from the first moment. Check in was possible before normal schedule, so I did not lose time after arrival from flight.
I felt well during my stay. Checkout went smoothly.
The host was helpful and answered quick.
I would recommend the place.

Apartamento muito bom, impecável e em uma localização maravilhosa! Indico, recomendo. Anfitrião sempre atento à qualquer necessidade e sempre disponível para a comunicação durante a estadia. Local seguro a qualquer hora, próximos às principais atrações, metrô ao lado.
Excelente todo, y la atención muy buena. La ubicación es sobretodo absolutamente genial.
Ótima estadia. O checkin foi super tranquilo. O prédio está bem localizado e a acomodação é idêntica às fotos. Muito bom!
Todo excelente. Piensaron en los minimos detalles para que uno se sienta en casa.
Very clean, very good location, no road noise, and very safe. Host is helpful and makes your stay easy to enjoy.

The place is very nice, clean and comfortable, A  perfect studio , they are very helpful with check in and checking out . Perfect location with a lot of restaurants and things to do around , I will recommend this place any time and looking forward to stay there again.

Wonderful apartment for two people. Nice neighborhood with shops and restaurants. Ralf's assistant, Emanuel waited for us at the apartment until quite late and we paid an agreed upon $20 late check in fee but it was well worth it. Emanuel was great with recommendations and directions and responses were quick when we had questions. On our final day, our flight wasn't until 9pm, but Ralf didn't have anyone else checking in that day so he told us to stay as late as we like and we didn't end up leaving until 5:30pm. Would stay here again.

Happy House was the perfect spot for my stay in BA. Maria is a great host. She is quick to respond and solved any problem I had within that day if possible. One of the AC units broke while I was there and it was during one of the worst heat waves in BA history. She had someone come quickly and fix it. The apartment is very comfortable and roomy. I was alone but 2 or 3 people could easily stay here. The location is fantastic as its close to everything. There are markets and grocery stores within a block or two. If you like asado, then there is a parrilla right outside the front door. In fact, I could smell the cooking steaks sometimes. The restaurant also has a playground upstairs which is great if you have kids. However you can also hear the kids playing and screaming so that was a bit noisy. Not terrible, occasional.  The shower was hot with great water pressure. The bed was firm but not hard. Perfect for me. The kitchen is small but has everything you need. Even a washing machine to do your own laundry. And the dedicated work space has a beautiful antique desk. I stayed there for a month. I would definitely come back.
The pictures tell the story. A lovely place for one or two.Tree line streets, three food shops within two blocks and a steak restaurant next door. I liked it so much I extended my stay for week.

Es un departamento muy cómodo y acogedor, uno se siente como en casa. Muy bien iluminado y ventilado. El rincón del escritorio es muy agradable para trabajar por la luz natural que tiene.
La ubicación es excelente. La anfitriona fue muy amable y flexible para colaboranos en lo que pudo. Volvería sin dudarlo.
Everything good. As shown in the pictures. Location is great. The apartment is old but has all the basics. There’s a tv but no cable provider so you’d need to plug your laptop. Wifi worked well!
Maria, excelente!!! responde a la brevedad los mensajes. El lugar está muy bien ubicado y es muy acogedor
The location is perfect and the apartment is real perfect when you are working or traveling.
The place was great and Maria very responsive, would recommend for sure

Muy lindo departamento, amplio y con una ubicación perfecta. Ideal para estadías largas como la mia de dos semanas. Tiene absolutamente de todo. Sentí como si estuviera en el departamento de una amiga. María es super amable, responde cualquier necesidad rapidamente. Creo que también funciona muy bien para una pareja con un niño, ya que tiene un segundo cuarto muy pequeño agradable. Algo que no molesta, pero es para considerar es segundo piso por escalera. No hay ascensor. En sintesis, muy recomendable. Sin dudas, volveré

Great location. Coffee shop and restaurant literally downstairs. Sade area. Close to good supermarket, shopping mall, subway and transport. The host is very nice and helpful. It is close to the street so bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper.
excelente lugar para pasar unos días en BA

This flat is absolutely perfect!
I felt at home the moment I walked in. The location cannot be better, there's a nice restaurant right next door and lots of great places to visit only a few blocks away, If you are a runner like me, you'll appreciate the big parks nearby.
It's a lot more spacious than it looks in the pictures, and both the balcony and the small private yard let in beautiful light and fresh air during the entire day.
Wi-fi signal was good all over the flat, the bedroom is big and comfortable and the kitchen has everything you might need, and more!
Next time I'm in Buenos Aires, I hope to stay there again.
As a frequent Airbnb user, it's hard to find a place like this. I highly recommend it.
Todo perfecto!
Spacious and cozy! Great location.
Incroyable appartement, proche de toutes commodités et extrêmement bien équipé ! Rien à redire, communication parfaite et très très bon rapport qualité-prix. Je recommande vivement.

Es la segunda vez que me quedo en este departamento. Lo volví a elegir por la buena onda de María, la ubicación y la calidez del lugar.
El departamento es súper cómodo y lleno de detalles que te hacen sentir en casa.
Lo súper recomiendo!

I just got back from Buenos Aires - and Mariano's delightful apartments were a highlight. Not only is San Telmo the epitome of what we were hoping to find in BA, the lofts themselves are light, airy and beautifully kept.

Mariano is always helpful, always smiling, and always someone we'd happily recommend!
Me encantó el departamento.  Todo estaba perfecto.  Y como esperaba.
Easy to check in, very flexible and all was as it was advertised. Great first experience with Air BNB

My husband and I really enjoyed our stay in Luciano's apartment. It is a lovely apartment!  It looks exactly as in the picture and was clean and ready to occupy when we arrived.  We found it to be quiet and tranquil. We appreciated the flexibility on the check-in and check-out times.  All went very smoothly and staff in the building were also friendly and helpful. The neighborhood was excellent!  It was close to the Subte and many stores. We would choose to stay here again.

We stayed in Luciano's studio on Larrea for a week just after Christmas. The booking and PayPal payment could not have been simpler. Normally, we'd be reluctant to opt for a studio because we like to dine in some nights and sometimes studio or lofts can leave you believing that you are living in the kitchen. The layout makes good use of the space and the sleeping area is invisible to any visitor. Overall, well equipped kitchen. Although it does not have a full oven, the counter top one works well and we cooked a couple of scrumptious dinners with it.

The location is really convenient for Recoleta and Barrio Norte. 24 hour security.

Facundo met us upon arrival and reviewed everything with us . We stayed at this apartment for one month .. Just like you see in the pictures! It was clean. The lock was broken on slider to deck which we told them about but never fixed .. Kitchen was sufficient . Didn't really get into cooking any great meals . The oven is hardly what I would call an oven . The sheets have out lived  their usefulness as well as the pillows . A very comfortable bed though..   Plenty of closet space and drawers for clothing. We thought the neighborhood was great . Nearby supermarket , coffee shop , church , subway , parks, museums and great restaurants . Location for us was ideal..Always felt very comfortable being out .. Our doorman was so helpful too. We don't speak any Spanish and people were helpful , kind and patient. We would recommend this apartment without hesitation . We had a wonderful time in BA.

Simply an amazing apartment and a very courteous host. I called this place my home for four months. I come to Buenos Aires twice a year, and I will always try to book this same apartment, and if it's unavailable I will try booking Luciano's other listings. The apartment is conveniently located near major bus lines and subways, in a very safe neighborhood (there is a police booth right up front). The doormen were polite, the neighbors were very warm, and the apartment had everything I needed.

Luciano and his cousin were able to get my wife and I checked in on very short same-day notice. The apartment was clean, quiet, and comfortable for our 3 night stay. It was also conveniently located in a safe part of town, as well as being only a few blocks away from the D (green) line metro and walking distance to the Recoleta cemetery. Highly recommended.

We were disappointed. The location is good if you want to shop on Santa Fe Avenue. The room did not loom like the pictures. The air conditioner didn't work for three of the five days stay. The safe didn't work for two days. The balcony was very dirty and its a terrible view from the balcony. We couldn't use the swimming pool as it was always locked.

Great flat for exploring the city. We stayed for 6 weeks and felt like home all the time. Subte station is very close, bus stops are abundant. Unfortunately, the air conditioning started to malfunction during our stay but one call to Luciano was enough to get someone to get it fixed very quickly. Contact with our host was always very prompt and friendly.

El departamento está muy bien ubicado. Cuenta con personal de seguridad las 24 hs, siendo el mismo muy amable y servicial. Tiene las necesidades mínimas cubiertas para cualquier viajero. El dueño sólo debe realizar un par de mantenimientos mínimos que el inmueble está necesitando. Lo volvería a elegir.
The apartment is very clean and all in working order. It is very safe and they have very friendly doorman. I was very comfortable and suggest this apartment for future guests
Great apartment, great attention, great zone.... I would definitely recommend it!

Luciano was a very gracious host regarding my early arrival, he had the keys waiting for me with the friendly front doorman, after letting myself in Luciano's friend Diego came over to greet me and show me the internet connection etc, in all fairness it's in a convenient location, the subway, buses, supermarket and la panderia´s are all very close, the bed was very comfortable as was the studio in itself, it does need a couple of minor maintenance issues taken care of and a new couch, for example there's dirty grout in the shower and the kettle never worked, another example was the pool, I didn't have any keys for entry to it and it appeared to be unmaintained as the water was dirty and it didn't have any chlorine, in my option this is of no fault Luciano's, maybe a lazy maintenance man.

My major concern was the very popular young lady in the adjacent studio (7d), the day of my arrival (a Thursday) a note was pushed under my door informing me that it was her birthday and that she was going to have a party that I should expect some noise, her party went on till 5am, these partition walls are very thin therefore a sleepless night ensued! Then 2 days later she had another party this time till 6.30am, needless to say I got no sleep again, there were other nights when it was very noisy when she was entertaining her very loud girlfriends, she also goes onto her balcony with friends in the wee hours of the morning for a cigarette and a chat, she's literally 8 feet from the bottom of the bed talking loudly, once you're been woken at 3.30am it's difficult getting back to sleep, in fairness to Luciano I didn't call and complain about it, perhaps I should have as I was there for over 5 weeks, it wasn't much fun listing to their very loud conversations, I'm truly sorry that I'm adding a bit of negativity about this studio, but in fairness to others visitors coming behind me, they should know about your noisy neighbor.

Yet the noise continued until I screamed at her and her boyfriend, which resulted in a fist fight, and me a man of 62 years and her twenty something year old friend, it stopped after that security had a word with her, again in fairness to Luciano, I didn't call you to inform you of your noisy neighbor in the event I was asked to leave, but she is a very big problem!
The host canceled this reservation 4 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Hermoso dpto, balcón contrafrente, cama y ropa blanca impecables. Buena ubicación cerca de Av. Santa Fé, seguridad 24hs. Lo volvería a elegir.
Loved the place, one of the best apartments we ever stayed in.
Excelente departamento, 100% recomendable
Excelente depto. Muy buena ubicación. Excelente atención de Luciano y Ricardo
Really nice place to stay, has all the equipment you need, the host is really kind and you can ask him anything about the facilities in the area. Very neat and quiet building.
Excelente. Volveré

Excelente lugar, muy bien ubicado en Recoleta. Luciano y Ricardo son 2 hosts / coordinadores muy disponibles y buena onda, siempre disponibles para alguna consulta o algun arreglo que sea necesario! 10 puntos todo; un gusto!

This place is fabulous. Super clean and conveniently located just a few blocks from the Subte. Egle is kind, polite, and always available if you have questions or need anything. I will definitely stay here again. 5 stars+++ easily.
Simply fabulous!

I enjoy staying there for two weeks, an apartment is located in a very typical Argentinian neighbor, in this case, is at the Boedo area, just a few minutes walk to the subway station and almost across the street from the supermarket. The first few nights was a bit difficult as I don't use to the traffic noise. It has a good breeze from the balcony door. It is a bit far from the central. If you don't mind taking subway and be among the local then it might suit your need especially anyone planing to be there for more than a few days. Egle is helpful. I would return if opportunity arrives.
Nikom

Egle is such a lovely person!
And my aunt and I simply loved her apartment. It was exactly the way we see on the pics. I highly recommend them! Boedo is a very nice neighborhood, and the subway is very close to the building. I can't wait to travel to Buenos Aires and rent it again. :)

The flat is extremely well located in the lovely neighborhood of Palermo Hollywood and has a very cute small balcony! Plenty of great restaurants and bars walking distance. Mar was also very communicative during check-in and check-out and very nice.  It was however unfortunate that there was a lot of loud constructions (during week days) all day long and the glass sliding door is not thick enough to block the noise. Also, the sliding door did not lock, which wasn't a problem in itself but should probably be fixed for safety. Overall, although the place provided for minimum comfort and great location, we thought it was a bit worn out since the pictures were taken.
a lovely place to stay with great hospitality

Nossa estadia no apartamento de Mar foi muito boa. Apartamento muito bem localizado e aconchegante. Além disso, a Mar foi solicita pelo WhatsApp e nos ajudou a chegar no apartamento e explicou muito bem as coisas. Obrigado, Mar!
Todo bien! Es tal cual lo anunciado, la ubicación es perfecta!
Muy buen lugar
Great Host. Really attentive, pay attention to every detail and take good care of guests.

Muy buena ubicación, estación de metro a solo unas cuadras, muy buenos restaurantes, supermercados, lavandería. El apartamento da hacia la calle, así que puede entrar un poco de ruido común de la ciudad. El edificio sí es silencioso, no se sienten a las vecinos. El apartamento cuenta con todos los utensilios y aparatos de cocina básicos. La cama es cómoda. El agua caliente tiene una duración limitada, como en muchos apartamentos de Buenos Aires. La anfitriona es muy buena y muy atenta.
El departamente esta ubicado en una zona espectacular, cerca de todo
Genial el apto y la zona.. Recomiendo, Mar una Genia

El dpto de Mar es muy cálido, luminoso y acogedor, está muy bien hubicado, en proximidad de todos los medios de transporte y de muchas opciones gatronómicas.
Y ella muy cordial, encontró solución a nuestros imprevistos, incluído el chec-out de madrugada. Una genia!
La pasamos hermoso en Buenos Aires, el lugar céntrico para salir a comer, pasear y divertirnos.
muy lindo depto, con balcon a la calle , y juegos de mesa!!!
Clean, centrally located apartment. The host was super communicative and helpful. Only downside was slightly uncomfortable beds. Great price though.
Dirección perfecta, acomodación limpia y aconchegante. Contacto muy fácil con el anfitrión
It's a very secure and safe location.
Exelente. Mar es una gran anfitriona y el depto todo tal cual se ve.
you can't find a better place to stay in Buenos Aires. Mar is a tier 1 host, highly recommendable for her hospitality and beautiful apartment in a great area.

El lugar es tal como se ve en las imágenes, ubicado muy cerca del Subte y de locales comerciales diversos, emplazado en un agradable barrio. Por su parte, Mar es muy amable y preocupada de apoyar en las necesidades que uno pueda llegar a tener. Volvería sin duda.
Excelente departamento, muy buena ubicación, súper cómodo y tranquilo, 10/10 . Recomendado !!!
Conforme en general con el depto.
Muy buen alojamiento. Mar excelente anfitriona.

El departamento es tal cual las fotos, muy lindo. La ubicación es excelente,  es una zona tranquila, linda vista, a cuadras de av. Santa Fe/Cabildo y de la estación Carranza de trenes y subtes. Y Mar fue una excelente anfitriona, se ajustó a mis necesidades para el check-in y eso lo valoro muchísimo.
Departamento ubicado en una zona linda y accesible.

Recomiendo este lugar totalmente por encontrarse cerca de muchos bares cafes y supermercados. Facil llegar por subte si van por Arevalo porque por Dorrego hay que cruzar un puente. la zona en general es mucho mas tranquila que muchas otras en Buenos Aires.
Departamento con falta de mantenimiento y fotos del momento del estreno.
Muy buena experiencia !!! Recomendable en todo sentido !! Gracias Mar !!!
Departamento muy comodo. Limpio. Bien ubicado, en una zona muy linda de palermo. Con balcon y buena vista. Y Mar, encantadora. Lo recomiendo!

El departamento de Mar es perfecto. La ubicación es inmejorable. Todo tal cual las fotos y mejor. Sin dudas volvería a hospedarme con ella. Muy atenta y muy amable. La pileta en la terraza es perfecta.
The apartment has a really good location (close to public transport and bars/restaurants). Good communication with the host. We loved the balcony with streetview.

I stayed at Mar’s apartment for two months. The apartment was clean and stylish. It looks exactly as the pictures do! The terrace was my favorite part of the apartment. You can watch a beautiful sunset everyday. The AC and WiFi were flawless. The apartment is located in Palermo. Many restaurants, bars, etc within walking distance. I will miss my Buenos Aires home! It was amazing.
Great place

Mar is incredible, helpfully, responsive, and gave us all support needed.

The place is like the photos but better!!

Near from the subway, from many places to hang out or buy food, the place is awesome, and very quiet too.

Obviously I will return to this place again!
El departamento muy lindo y comodo para moverse en transporte publico.
Very nice, well equipped apartment in the loveliest area in Buenos Aires that provides everything you need for a few days in the city. Excellent communication with Mar as well 😊
We had a lovely time at this apartment - Mar was an excellent host and made our stay a breeze :) Also be sure to try out her local tips!

Mar's place was great! An amazing location in Palermo Hollywood close to lots of bars and restaurants, but still really peaceful barrio. Mar's communication was great and she was always available when I needed her and the apartment was cute and had everything I needed. I particularly liked having coffee or wine on the balcony - you can catch some really amazing sunsets up there! Thanks for everything Mar.
Todo maravilloso. Recomendable 100%
Espaço Incrivel!
Todo excelente.

My stay was perfect!!! The apartment is beautiful, exactly as described and shown in the pictures. Easy communication for check-in/check-out. Everything very clean in the apartment. Convenient area with many restaurants and nightlife. Would definitely return next time I am in Buenos Aires!
El espacio esta acorde en las imagenes, mar fue hiper amable y atento en todo, si vas a necesitar un espacio comodo y ser bien atendido, no dudes con este departamento!
Muy buen servicio!
El derpartamento es lindo, comodo y seguro. Tiene todo lo necesario para que puedas pasar los días en el. Cerca de subtes y colectivos para que puedas transportarte.

Muy simpática y a disposición de ayudarnos en lo posible para hacernos la estancia más amena.

Totalmente recomendable
Es lo que presenta, cómodo y muy iluminado. Zona tranquila y bien iluminada, todo muy recomendable.
Excelente el Dpto y la ubicación inmejorable para usar el transporte que se quiera utilizar. Subte linea D, Tren, etc. Mar muy atenta y coordinamos perfecto la entrada y salida.
muy recomendable, buena ubicación( a pocas cuadras del metro) y limpieza. Mar es una persona muy cordial.

Good value,  but you get what you pay for,  a deep clean needs to be done to the whole apartment as well as fixing the kitchen sink, sliding door of closet and curtains. Good and easy communication with host and easy check in and check out. Host was very responsive amd aplogized for areas that needed to be cleaned. Promised to have a more thorough deep clean for future guests. Location was fine,  but would stay in Palermo SOHO if I stayed in BA again.  Overall,  the apartment had all the basics you need for your stay.

Lugar confortable y cálido, ubicado en una buena zona de palermo con negocios cercas a cuadras de la avenida santa fe.la anfitriona muy atenta y predispuesta a responder cualquiier respuesta y super accesible en cuanto al ingreso/ egreso.Recomendable!!!
Muy bien ubicado
Pretty central to all the main entertainment spots.
Very nice apartment in one of Palermo's prime locations. Mar is an absolutely amazing and thoughtful host!

This place is fantastic for short or longterm stays. The Studio is very clean and even though being in the middle of everything, it is not loud thanks to the very good windows. The internet is very fast (50Mb downl./10Mb upl.). Balcony with a great view. Mar is extremely responsive and truly a great host. She makes you feel at home in this new city. Thanks for everything, Mar, and see you again, sometime soon!

Muy cómodo el dpto.
buen colchón y sábanas.
Si falta limpieza en cocina.
Mar fue muy amable.  El departamento está muy bien y la ubicación genial

Excelente ubicación, cerca de todo
Ideal para un fin de semana

Para los que viajan con bebé, muy cómodo tener practicuna disponible!

O apartamento está de acordo com o anúncio. O apartamento é bem localizado, tem cafés, restaurantes e mercado próximo. A anfitriã nos recebeu muito bem, foi atenciosa e comunicativa, estando sempre a disposição em caso de dúvidas. Tivemos uma estadia boa, deixamos como sugestão a melhoria da área de banho, o restante atendeu nossas expectativas.

We hired 3 rooms from Mariano and we had a very good experience in San Telmo. It was nice and tidy and felt safe.
I can really recommend Mariano for other travellers to Buenos Aires.

Joakim S - Stockholm / Sweden

We loved staying at Mariano's apartments on Calle Mexico. The location is fabulous. Great restaurants, bakeries nearby and easy to walk anywhere.

The bed was really comfortable. The unit was really quiet and so cozy. We had all the kitchen equipment that we needed and there was a grocery store nearby for coffee and food.

The only thing to be aware of is that the air conditioning is either all on or all off for all the apartments on one floor at the same time.

We would highly recommend staying here. Mariano is a great guy with a great attitude and his apartments are really a quiet and wonderful refuge in fabulous Buenos Aires!

The neighborhood made us a little nervous at night, but we gradually got used to it. It was great to be near the San Telmo fair on Sundays. The space itself was nice, although a little older and darker than expected. Overall our stay was good.

Had a fine time in BA!  Did not get to meet Mariano (he was working & out of town), but the loft was comfy and conveniently located for walking & public transport.  The San Telmo district is probably  best for younger folks, with it's broken sidewalks and doggy droppings all around, but it is a very interesting area with great tango, good food & fun people watching.  I would  definitely consider returning!

Muy conveniente, muy cómodo. A pesar que había algunas cositas que merecen la atención (luces que no andan, el piso del dormitorio tenía baldosas rotas presentando riesgo de cortarse los pies si andabas descalzo), yo creo que se arreglan eso, el lugar es bárbaro. Nos trajeron toallas por demás, y es muy lindo el patio que se comparte con otros huéspedes. No obstante esto, las fotos son mejores que en persona.
Me inquietó un poco que si bien el precio cuando lo contraté estaba en dólares, el aviso de la reserva vino en EUROS, espero no tener problemas cuando vea mi resumen de la tarjeta.... creo que eso es un problema de AirBnB y no de Mariano.

Silvia is an adorable host. The studio is perfect and located in the heart of the arty, trendy and modern neighborhood of Palermo Viejo (nice for creators shopping too) ! I had a wonderful stay there ! If you go to Buenos Aires, you have to stay there a few days !!

The apartment was the perfect stop to feel "at home" in BA. The neighborhood is fantastic, and Silvia was incredibly kind, helpful, and easy to work with. You won't be disappointed. (Plus there are the most precious little cacti in the window, and if they don't warm your heart, well, you have my pity.)

The apartment is really nice. The patio and the roof terrace make it a very special place.
Many thanks
Stefan

PS: Excellent Peruvian / Japanese fusion restaurant nearby: http://www.mbuenosaires.com.ar/

El piso es muy lindo y muy practico, la cama es comoda, esta muy bien equipado y limpio. lo unico punto defavorable es la falta de luz de dia.
Ademas esta muy bien ubicuado para los que quieren disfrutar del barrio e san Telmo, para nosotros el mas encantador de Buenos Aires. Es un lugar que aconsejaria a quien viene a pasar un tiempito en bs As!

The communication with Mariano was great. He was helpful with everything that i asked and he always replied within a few minutes or hours. The place is a great option for a couple or 3 people. It is located in San Telmo, blocks away from great restaurants and clubs (Gran Parilla Del Plata on Peru and Club One on Adolfo Alsina are my top choices). The subway (Subte) is just around the corner.

Fue una muy buena experiencia para nosotros la estadía en ese departamento. Se notó mucha preocupación por hacemos sentir bien y todo lo prometido se cumplió. Lo pasamos increíble. Gracias por todo. Fue una agradable y placentera estadía. Lo recomiendo de todas maneras.

Really well situated apartment in Monserrat (i.e. just north of San Telmo) close to the subtle and only a short walk from all of San Telmo, Plaza de Mayo and Calle Florida. The shared areas are fantastic, giving you extra space beyond the loft apartment and providing the place with a real sense of tranquility, while Elbio is a very enthusiastic and obliging host. It's worth pointing out that the apartment is a part of complex rented out to travellers - which meant someone came in and cleaned the room one day (which was great!) but we didn't know about it beforehand and left a whole bunch of stuff out (not so great). And while the kitchen is functional, it is really small, which might be difficult if you are keen to eat in, but there's so many good cheap restaurants nearby that you really wouldn't need (i.e. want) to!

The apartment is good for few days, but it's more like a hotel than just an apartment.
The whole building is dedicate for rental with tourist. That's not a problem as there is enough space (you'll not see your neighbor a lot), but if you prefer a stay in a flat surrounding by Argentinian, prefer an other place in other parts of the city.

The area is quite safe and you'll be able to find many restaurants and bars. Plus you'll be in the heart of the administrative commercial and financial city and close to the subway.

The building has a great "jardin d'hiver" and a superb terrace.
The apartment is good with no special charm.

Perfect place to be in downtown Buenos Aires, and yet, enjoy the tranquility needed. The host is very helpful and friendly, and the loft is very spacious. I will definitely will go back again! PS: Check the roof.. ;^)

El duplex no. 6 es tal cual como la descripción, y una muy cómoda y buena base para una estadía en BA. Aunque no lo conocí personalmente, Elbio fue muy atento a todas mis inquietudes, respondió rápido a los mensajes y ante un cambio de planes imprevisto que tuve yo, fue flexible con las respuestas. Muy recomendable.

O apartamento da Silvia é excelente para pessoas que querem conhecer bares, restaurantes e o lado bohêmio de Buenos Aires!
Altamente recomendado, ficamos 2 dias em Novembro.
A região é muito segura e movimentada até altas horas da noite!
---
The Silvia's apartment is excellent for those want to see the Buenos Aires nightlife with good restaurants and bars.
We stayed two days in November.
The area is safe and busy all the time.
Small apt but perfectly equipped, perfectly situated, perfectly clean. Silvia is very nice and very reactive. We really enjoy our stay in her apt. Highly recommended.

If you are looking for a studio-type apartment right in the heart of BA's favorite Palermo neighborhood, don't look further.
Silvia's apartment, only one block from the popular Plaza Serrano (Plazoleta Julio Cortázar), is what you want.
Silvia gave very valuable advice on money changing, public transport, nearby services, and, and, and
Unless I purchase my own BA apartment one day, I will definitely try to book that Palermo studio next time I go to Buenos Aires.
Ein sehr angenehmes Appartment. Habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt.
Nice little loft, everything was clean and the common out door space was very good as well. Enjoyed my stay there.

I didn't stay at this listing, but booked it for a photographer that works for my company - Elbio was very easy to communicate with and Manuel (our photographer) had no trouble with checking into the apartment. He said everything was clean and convenient. The only issue he had was that the heat in the apartment wasn't working, although Elbio provided him with a space heater.

Very nice and good location~

I make a good memories in buenos aires!

Staying at Egle's apartment made our first week in BsAs very easy and nice. The apartment is brand new, everything works perfectly, it really is close to banks, supermarkets, restaurants and the subway. Egle and her husband made us comfortable and helped us whenever we needed. If you're looking for a place to stay in Buenos Aires, you should talk to them first.

We had a really nice time in the apartment. Its clean, cosy... a really comfortable apartment. Boedo is a authentic barrio in BsAs, subte is located in the same street. We would definitly stay there again!

I had a wonderful time in a great space. The apartment has everything you need for a short, or extended stay. One of the highlights for myself was the weekly cleaning. This was a great addition to my time in the "Dreamy apartment". Egle was a great host and I had the feeling that she really cared about my experience while staying here as well as being very accommodating when my flight was delayed.

This flat has all the necessities a traveler needs. It is close to subway and several bus lines. They are many restaurants and take away places nearby and for those who want to cook (there is big supermarket 50 meters away). The apartment and all the furniture is new and clean. Wireless internet is fast. There many laundry shops nearby. The neighbourhood is safe and fun to walk around. If I have to write one downside, the flat is next to a busy road and so there is traffic noise.

This is one of the few places on airbnb that looks better in person than in the pics! The apartment is large, comfortable, and modern; everything works well; and the walls are decorated with Egle's painting.

Egle was the perfect host, meeting up with us almost immediately after we had a problem (and solving it just as quickly). She also provided a slew of great tips to help us enjoy the neighborhood and Buenos Aires in general.

I can't recommend this place enough -- a great deal on a great flat.

Everything was as it was said to be, very clean, comfortable and perfect for what we needed. Good selection of kitchen wares and a small balcony to watch any street action. Close to cute cafe's, bar's and even a traditional Tango show all just down the road. There is also a supermarket if want to use the kitchen. The subway or subte as its called is close by and easy to use, and Egle gave us bus numbers and stops for anywhere we needed to go and once we got coins we had no trouble using this service either. We went out to meet friends in more popular areas at night like Palermo and the cab fare was not too much and easy. I was traveling with my sixteen yr old daughter and we felt happy and safe in Boedo. Although my spanish was quite limited the locals in cafes etc where helpful and friendly. Many spoke english or helped us with our emerging spanish.
Egle was a pleasure to deal with as was the doorman/ caretaker. Both always friendly and willing to help with any queries or directions etc. Also was willing and able to let us stay for an extra night short notice when our flights were changed.... thank you Egle !!!
Totally recommended by us!!
Kind host and a nice and comfortable appartment! thank you

Wonderful stay in Buenos Aires. We loved the apartment. Was great to have a nice safe place for a week. Neighborhood is great and offers everything you need, Was a little quieter than other areas we saw, which we liked, but close to the Subte and also great access by bus. Egle gave us great information on getting around, where to eat, and things to do. Oscar, the doorman was kind and always there when we needed him. Perfect Place for a week in BA. My only suggestion is if your light sleeper bring ear plugs, your in a lively city and can hear the liveliness well into the night! I used my earplugs the first 2 nights and after that just got use to the city sounds.

Egle's apartment is really good, comfortable and quiet. Even though we stayed in one of the front units (in front of a busy avenue), we didn't hear a lot of noise. The location is great: close to the subway station (Boedo - purple line) and buses that go to many parts of the city. The neighborhood has lots of things: restaurants, supermarkets, bakeries, banks, etc. When we had a few problems with the apartment, we got in touch with Egle and the guy who takes care of the building readily helped us. In order to improve the apartment, I just think that it should have some small kitchen things, like a can opener, an ice tray, etc. But I highly reccommend it. When I go back to BsAs I'll stay there again, if possible!

Pasé ocho noches en el apartamento de Egle y amado. Fui con mi padre para conocer la ciudad y nos sirvió perfectamente. El apartamento es exactamente como se describe, tiene todas las comodidades necesarias para un viaje como este. Cocine por unos días, comemos otras cafeterías en la zona. Locomotion fue tranquila, utilizamos el metro y parada de autobús a pocas cuadras de hacerlo todo. Cuando se utiliza el servicio de taxi fue también por un buen precio. El apartamento dispone de calefacción, buena ropa de cama, que era algo que me preocupaba un poco cuando yo estaba buscando un lugar ya que la temperatura era baja para nosotros. La Egle tomó todas mis dudas siempre con cuidado y nos envía consejos sobre la ciudad antes de nuestra llegada. Recomendar el apartamento está muy bien!

It's a very nice apartment, very clean and well maintained. Everything is in the right measure. Egle is very helpful and really cares so that your Buenos Aires experience is the best possible.
It is located in a quiet and cozy neighborhood perfect for those who really want to see the city and feel as a local in a few days.

A estadia foi muito boa. O local é de fácil acesso, à poucos quarteirões do metrô. O edifício é novo, moderno e muito limpo. O apartamento fica bem próximo a um supermercado e quase ao lado de uma padaria/cafeteria excelente. A região é bastante segura tanto de dia quanto à noite e, apesar de estar localizado em uma avenida bastante movimentada, o barulho não chegou realmente a me incomodar. O apartamento é condizente com as fotos. Tudo é novo e funciona perfeitamente. Não tive contato pessoal com a proprietária, mas ela respondeu rapidamente aos meus e-mails. Oscar, o encarregado, foi muito simpático e prestativo.
Havia apartamentos excelentes em outros locais, mas optei por este porque já havia ficado anteriormente em Palermo e Recoleta e desta vez gostaria de ficar em um bairro mais residencial, menos turístico, para ver como é realmente a vida dos portenhos. Não me decepcionei, a estadia em Boedo/Almagro foi excelente! Recomendo não só o apartamento, mas também o bairro.Você convive com as pessoas da cidade, com seu dia-a-dia, com as escolas, universidades, trabalho. Os cafés próximos são lindos, mas frequentados pelos moradores e não por multidões de turistas, o que era exatamente o que queria. Em resumo: encontrei o que fui procurar.

Los departamentos están limpios y son agradables. El barrio de Boedo tiene lugares para cenar y ver teatro cerca, es un lugar muy agradable. No conocí personalmente a mi anfitriona pero no nos faltó nada, una estancia muy cómoda y ella siempre respondió a todas mis preguntas e inquietudes. Quizá sería ideal que hubiera un lugar dónde tender las toallas mojadas y quizá una pava. Pero fuera de eso el departamento está muy bien equipado.
Alguien antes había señalado lo de la ducha muy chica y me parecía que era un comentario raro pero sí me parece importante señalarlo porque una persona un poquito grande difícilmente entra. Sí es muy chica la ducha, pero eso pasa hasta en hoteles. Son detalles. La cama es cómoda y hay poco ruido. El arte en los departamentos y la vista al cielo desde el balcón decoran los departamentos y le dan un aire muy lindo. Definitivamente recomiendo el departamento para alguien que busque tranquilidad, buena ubicación y limpieza. Cinco estrellas.

I stayed 2 1/2 weeks in Egle's studio. It was a very pleasant place to say. Everything you need for a comfortable stay is there. The location is fine for visiting the city during the day. At night you need a taxi, which is cheap in BA. In the neighbourhood are nice bars and restaurants.
If you need anything, Egle is only an email away and very quick in responding. You won't regret staying here while exploring this great city!

Um excelente apartamento!!!
Completamente mobiliado, com todo conforto e suporte (há aquecedor/ calefação, ar-condicionado, água quente, wi-fi, tv a cabo e roupas de cama).
A localização é muito boa, perto do metro (estação Boedo - linha E) que dá acesso a toda a cidade pelas outras linhas e combinações; nas proximidades há inúmeras linhas de ônibus.
No entorno há locais para refeições a qualquer hora (seja um cafézinho com pão à uma pasta italiana), além da segurança de andar nas ruas a qualquer hora sem nenhum problema.

A Egle é extremamente atenciosa, tira todas as dúvidas, e acompanha (quando possível) tudo, com todo o suporte por mensagens ou e-mail (com um guia muito bom sobre as redondezas e pontos interessantes de Buenos Aires). O Oscar (encarregado) é muito gentil e muito solicito, nos ajudando a qualquer hora ou situação.

Foi uma experiência incrível!

El departamento es igual a lo que se ve en las fotos, muy lindo y cómodo. Lamentablemente no pudimos ver a la anfitriona pero salió todo bien. Por error nos quedamos con unas toallas que mañana vamos a estar devolviendo. Muchas Gracias !!!!!!

El departamento es tal cual las fotografías, mantuve una buena comunicación con Egle,   muy bien hubicado, todos los servicios,  cómodo y confortable. Lo recomiendo. 😊😉

Hermoso lugar! Tiene todo lo becesario para una comoda estancia, Egle muy amablr al igual que el encargado del edificio, todo queda cerca. Muy buenos restaurantes a solo pasos del alojamiento. Super recomendado.
Very nice place. Metro station was close. Walkable.
Não vale o custo benefício.

Nice place, easy access, great communication with Egle who answers quickly. The neighbourhood is nice and feels safe. The subway is not too far, lots of buses. Supermarket nearby. The flat is clean and convenient. Thanks Egle for everything.
LA RELACION PRECIO-VALOR ES EXELENTE

Tuvimos muy buena comunicación con Egle, la ubicación bonita y tranquila y todo coincidía con lo del anuncio hasta puedo decir que en persona todo era más bonito y acogedor.
Teníamos aire acondicionado, toallas y sábanas limpias, el wifi siempre funcionó al 100% al igual que el agua caliente, tiene restaurante, kiosko (minimarket) súper cerca. Sin duda alguna volvería arrendar con Egle.
We loved this apartment - great location, well-presented and Sergio responded quickly to my emails. Fantastic experience!
Loved Sergios Penthouse. great location, well described and the phots are accurate. Very clean and comfortable. Loved my stay in BA and this was def in part to this airbnb. Thanks Sergio!

Hemos pasado 3 días estupendos en Buenos Aires. El piso de Sergio, además de ser muy agradable, se encuentra en una de las mejores zonas de BA; zona tranquila pero a la vez con mucha vida (restaurantes de diseño y de variedad culinaria, bares de diversos tipos, tiendas y boutiques...). Cómodamente se puede llegar a los principales puntos de interés de la ciudad. Por otro lado, el piso es muy bonito y limpio con una vista increíble sobre BA. Por otro lado, la atención y ayuda de Sergio antes de nuestra llagada así como su rápida respuesta a cuestiones varias, ha sido de gran ayuda.

we spent 5 weeks in this amazing flat ! location is just perfect. Sergio and friends help you for everything. the building is safe, doorman is cool... for my next journey in BA, i will go there for sure !
thank you sergio ;)

We had a wonderful time in Sergio's delightful apartment.  The location was excellent with plenty of restaurants and bars near by and a fantastic panaderia next door.  The apartment was extremely clean, equipped with everything we could have needed, and a perfect base for the four of us to spend a few days in Buenos Aires.  We would recommend it highly and could not fault it.  Thank you Sergio.

This was our first time using Airbnb, and it was fantastic.  The apartment was exactly as described, and very clean and comfortable.  We were met by Sergio's wife when we arrived from the airport, and we were provided with a huge binder of information on what to see and do.  We didn't need much from Sergio, but the two times I contacted him, we heard back from him quickly. It was plenty of space for my husband and two children, and I don't think you could beat the view for the fireworks displays all over the city on New Year's Eve.  We were here for a wedding, and my dad and aunts and uncles were able to rent two other apartments in the building, which was very helpful.  The neighborhood is very safe and comfortable-- a little bit away from the hot, noisy downtown area, but very reachable to things by taxi or subway.  Great restaurants and cafes all over the neighborhood, too!
Friendly couple, who hosted us. The apartment ist great located, new cool designed, clean, safe and has a fantastic view over Palermo. Sundowner is amazing! Would always recommend it.

This is an excellent location right in the heart of trendy Palermo Hollywood. The apartment is clean, modern and nicely furnished. It's a professional operation so everything is taken care of with efficiency and ease. Highly recommend.
Yes, the neighborhood was great and the apartment pictures were very accurate.

Vi kunne ikke ha vært mer fornøyd med leiligheten vår og med oppfølging fra Sergio. Bilder og tekst fra nettsiden lyver ikke, utsikten var enda flottere en bildene viser. Vi var to voksne og et barn på 9 år som storkoste oss i tre uker. Vi benyttet bassenget på taket mye, og hadde bassenget nesten alltid for oss selv. Hyggelig folk som jobbet i huset og hyggelige naboer. Etter besøk mer sentralt i Buenos Aires var det alltid like deilig å komme hjem til det rolige og fredlige Pallermo Hollywood. Vil anbefale leiligheten på det varmeste og vil veldig gjerne leie den igjen.

Couldn't have been better.  Pictures can't even do this apartment justice - the view of Buenos Aires is incredible, we had a great time hanging out on the upper and lower patios, opening up the sliding door to the kitchen and living area, and watching the sunset from the pool on the roof.  Check in was easy, and Sergio and his wife were happy to help in any way.  Perfect location, surrounded by Palermo's shops, bars and restaurants (check out the bakery right downstairs for bread and pastries in the morning).  I'd recommend this to any of my friends and would absolutely stay again next time I'm in BA.

Great apartment with a wonderful view in a very good location, with restaurants, cafes and shops nearby. Sergio was very helpful - we even could leave our luggage before check in and after check out with the doorman.

Excellent experience throughout.  Sergio was a great host and made our stay very comfortable.  Great walking neighborhood, ample dining options a few minutes away.  Subte (subway) options 10-15 minutes away.  The flat is just as described... excellent views and very nice architectural details.  Will definitely look forward to staying again next time I'm in B.A.
The apartment is perfectly located and has a incredible view. Everything was clean and ready when we arrived. Sergio was very kind to us. Would definitely stay here again. Perfect.

The place is amazing: great view, great neighborhood, and very comfortable.
Sergio is very solicit and the neighbors too!
I will definitely get back some time.

Sergio's place was perfect and exactly as advertised!!  Sergio and his English-speaking friend met us upon checkin and were very helpful and informative.   The place had an amazing view and was very clean...the location was perfect as there are so many restaurants and bars nearby to explore.   Sergio was very friendly and responsive to any questions we had.   Thank you so much Sergio!

El departamento es MUY lindo, funcional y por sobre todo cómodo. La ubicación es excelente, muchos bares y restaurantes buenos cerca. La panadería que esta al lado es altamente recomendable!! . Sergio fue un anfitrión genial, nos dio toda la información que necesitábamos y estuvo a disposición. Recomiendo el departamento sin dudar, y lo elegiría para mi próxima estadía en Buenos Aires!

Muy buenas recepcion y explicacion del uso y servicio disponible.
Muy recomendable, lugar muy bonito y acogedor.

Sergio a été d'une disponibilité incomparable. IL a été très serviable et réactif.
Le logement est spacieux, très propre et très bien situé. Parfait pour une famille ou deux couples. Il est situé dans un quartier très sur, entouré de nombreux bars et restaurants.
Great apartment and location - highly recommended!

Fantastic modern spacious apartment with awesome views. Bowl of fruits, milk and even a deserved beer in the fridge on arrival. Handy to Santa Fe and subway plus easy walk to many attractions. Night life only 10 to 15 minutes walk to either Plaza Serrano or Palmero Hollywood. Ralf is a fantastic host, greets you and is on the end of the phone if you need him. Total 5 star.

Ralf was travelling when I stayed there but Marcello did an AMAZING job - really friendly and helpful in showing us the apartment and answering questions. The apartment is really lovely and in a good location. Would stay there again =)

The apartment was even better than I expected, more like a luxury hotel. When I arrived at the II was warmly greeted and given a full tour of apartment and given information on BA including maps. The local knowledge came in very handy. I can't recommend this enough, I definately will be returning.

Wonderful experience at Buena Vista.  The location in Palermo was perfect - close to shopping, restaurants, and the metro.  The apartment was clean, comfortable, and spacious.  Ralf and his team were flexible and extremely helpful - a perfect stay in an amazing city!

My friend and I rented this apt for one week in Buenos Aires and it was great! Looks just like the pictures. Very clean and good amount of space and light from all the windows. The apt is also gated so you feel safe. Ralf was really friendly and especially helpful in securing cabs to the airport so we were ensured the fairest rate through a local. Overall, a great stay. Definitely would recommend it to a friend and/or family.

This was my third time to BA in 4 years. I have stayed in Palermo all three times. This condo was the best place I have stayed in.

I normally rent through a different vacation website. I decided to try Airbnb and could not be happier. The communication with Ralf was great and he was very prompt. Payment was fast and there was follow up emails right up until I left.

The condo was large, clean and fantastic to stay in. It was close to Santa Fe for the subway and just north of the heart of Palermo for all the night life. The security guards were friendly and the gym was pretty cool to work out in. I arranged transport from the airport through them. It just makes it easier.

Ralf had maps of the area and I think the best part of all of this. There was a bottle of water in the fridge and a HUGE bowl of fruit waiting for me when I arrived. I can't recommend this place, or any of Ralf's other places enough.
The apartment is beautiful and very well located, very comfortable a great choice to feel at home in Buenos Aires! Marcelo was very helpful, thank you!

We had a great stay at Ralf´s apartment. The view of the city is amazing from the windows. We stayed there for one month and this apartment was perfect for us, comfortable, beautiful and super well located. Ralf is a great host. We hope we can come back soon and will defenetly want to stay at this appartment for sure. We totally recommend it! Thanks so much for such a great stay!
Great apartment, fantastic views and excellent location. Highly recommended.

We had a perfect stay in the Buena Vista apartment. The location is great. It's not the exact heart of the 'restaurant/bar' zone in Palermo, but it's got its fair share of good places to eat within a block or two. It also feels more like a real 'neighborhood' than a tourist zone (which is only about a 10-15 min walk anyhow).

The apartment was very clean (it is just like the pics), has great views and also has a gym/spa. We didn't use the spa (jacuzzi/massage), but I did try the gym which has incredible views as it is on the top floor of a 32 story building.

Ralf was an excellent host. Marcelo met us on day 1 and gave us a thorough tour and the housekeeper who comes weekly was nice and trustworthy.

We had no problems during our stay and would recommend the apartment to anyone wanting a good Palermo location with quick access to subway (2 blks) and calle Santa Fe.

Oh, there was also a nice basket of fresh fruit in the apartment when we arrived which was very kind of Ralf.

The Buena Vista apartment was the perfect rental for me, during my three week stay in Buenos Aires.

The entire reservation process was very smooth, with all my questions answered within 24 hours, in addition to the very comprehensive information already provided. From the first exchange of mails with Ralf and his team mates, I felt like being in good hands. Everything was very clear and straightforward, which made me at ease from the beginning.

Transfer from the airport was definitely worth it after the long flight, followed by a friendly welcome to the flat, including a fruit bowl and tea & coffee.

Everything matched perfectly the description & photos of the listing, and the view was simply impressive. I was very pleased to notice that even the wifi internet connection was working perfectly, something not guaranteed everywhere.

The location in Palermo Soho was the best choice for me, with easy access to everywhere with local buses, subte or by cab. Above all, I loved making long walks in the residential surroundings or in the huge parks nearby. There are lots of grocery shops and supermarkets around, as well as bakers, butchers and even a fishmonger, and the kitchen is totally equipped for cooking at home, to make a change from the countless choice of restaurants around.

On my arrival at the flat, Ralf greeted me and explained all you need to know, to enjoy your stay at his flat. In addition, he showed me around to a nearby gym (larger than the one in the building) with a personal trainer, and on the way there, he gave me more hints about nearby shops and restaurants.

Being up on the 13th floor, the flat was surprisingly quiet, even with the window open at night. The entire building and the flat are very well maintained and felt very secure.

Ralf and his team mates are very professional in anticipating and taking care of a traveller’s needs and at the same time, very warm and welcoming, making you feel at home at their place. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone wishing to stay at a contemporary flat where everything works, in a charming part of Buenos Aires.
Ralf and his team were great in all aspects and the apartment was great.  This type of apartment experience beats the hotel experience hands down.
Ralf and his team was excellent to communicate with. The appartment was perfect with a great view.

This was the best place I've stayed at in over 10 airbnb stays. Ralf and his team are exceptional at what they do - they welcome you at the apartment, leave detailed instructions on the appliances, recommendations for restaurants etc. and are available on the phone should you have any other questions or require assistance during your stay. They went above and beyond to make our stay in BA fabulous.

The apartment is spacious and well laid out, it has a stunning view from most rooms and all the equipment you need to cook up a storm including a coffee machine which I loved! There are supermarkets within 5 mins walk and you are within 5 mins of plaza Italia, a transport hub in BA. We also really enjoyed running around the parks in the neighbourhood and the gym on the 31st floor has amazing views too! Some of the best in BA.

A million thanks Ralf, good luck and we will stay again if we come back.

Cheers
Kate and nick
El barrio de Palermo es perfecto, tiene de todo cerca y el apartamento de Silvia se encuentra muy bien ubicado. Silvia fue muy rapida en su respuesta y muy amable.

This was our second time staying here and we really love this apartment - it is great value for money! The location is unbeatable - in a great neighbourhood, within walking distance to nice restaurants, a supermarket and public transport etc. The apartment is well equipped, the sofa bed is really comfortable. Fan and air con are perfect for hot nights. Everything else went smoothly and communication with Silvia was easy and prompt. We can highly recommend - don't look any further.
Silvia is a very kind and flexible host. Her apartment is modest, but the location is great! Thank you for the experience!
Silvia went out of his way to accommodate my last minute request. The location is simply the best in Palermo Soho. In case you're wondering: yes, it's a sofa-bed. But a very good one indeed.

Silvia, my host, was amazing!!! I had a bit of a travel emergency and not only was she very quick at responding to my emails, but she also picked me up and took me to the apartment! The apartment was very clean and well furnished. The kitchen was also well stocked with all necessary utensils. The neighborhood was very vibrant with lots of restaurants and boutiques. I stayed with my 18 month old son so having an enclosed park less than a block away was a huge treat. I had a small issue with the hot water heater, which Silvia had fixed within 30 minuets. She also contacted several car services and helped me find the cheapest option to get to the airport. She went far out of her way to be accommodating and helpful without being intrusive.

I had a great 5 day stay in Silvia's Palermo flat this past March! The flat was clean, well taken care of, equipped with good wifi and air-conditioning, and set up for me to do my own cooking! The location was incredible, secure, and surrounded by restaurants, cafes, and shops. Silvia was additionally always available for support, checking in at various times, and helped me figure out my transportation out of Buenos Aires!

Muchas gracias a Silvia por todo! I cannot wait to return to Buenos Aires!
I've had amazing stay in the apartment. Silvia is welcoming and friendly, and always willing to help! And the location is just right.

El apartamento está muy bien situado, en pleno corazón de Palermo. Es una muy buena opción para una persona. Silvia fue siempre muy educada y contestó a mis mensajes con rapidez, amabilidad y eficacia.

Silvia is fantastic - always prompt to communicate and easily available for all queries and issues. At the beginning of the stay, she left welcome empanadas and other snacks and at the end of my stay she actually found time in her busy schedule to drive me to the airport! This is the second time I've stayed here and I would definitely stay again.

The apartment is indeed cozy and clean in a perfect location right in the heart of Palermo Soho, next to good restaurants and cafes and a quick 10-15 minute walk from the subway. I also give high marks as well for the general stability of the WiFi connection and hot water in the bathroom. Light sleepers should be aware that it is a lively neighborhood, particularly on the weekends, but this is not something that would deter me staying here again. Thanks, Silvia!

Great location - you cannot get a better location than this, right in the heart of Palermo soho. Great little place. The only negative is it can be noisy at night to sleep, easily fixed with ear plugs and worth it for the location

Silvia was an amazing host.
Would stay again with her any time :)

Sylvia is a gracious, informative, and amazing host. She went through the trouble of helping me secure a phone SIM on the first day -- something that turned out to take much longer than expected -- acting as translator as well as neighborhood guide. I was incredibly touched by this gesture, very few Airbnb hosts have shown me this level of hospitality. The apartment is modest -- a sofa bed, AC, ceiling fan, table with four chairs, work desk, simple kitchen and bathroom, sparsely decorated, and with mild wear and tear. I was satisfied with this listing as I was paying for location (which is truly UNBEATABLE, very close to the shops, bars, and eateries I frequented), and a no-frills place to rest at the end of each day. An amazing place for an easy-going, adventurous, outgoing guest, but perhaps not recommended for someone looking for glamour and luxuries.
An ideal Palermo location and Sylvia is an excellent and helpful host. While good value the apartment is spare and the hot water heater is barely functioning.

Silvia is amazing person and host!!
The apartment is small, cozy and comfortable. RECOMMENDED!!!!

I stayed two months in the winter (Aug/Sep) and Silvia's place was perfect. Not much to add to all the previous excellent reviews. The location could not be better. Silvia was helpful and accommodating, and she was very responsive to my texts.

The place is small as noted but it has a fully equipped kitchen and a large dining table to eat or do work. I never felt like I lacked space (to be fair, I came from NYC where all apartments are tiny). The supermarket is 1.5 blocks away and laundry 1 block away. Wifi was fast and never failed.

Highly recommended - a great, cute and very clean apartment with very good Wifi that is in one of the nicest neighborhoods in Buenos Aires. Silvia was once again a fantastic hostess - warm and friendly and prompt to respond. She also took the time out of her busy schedule to drive me to the airport as well, which I really appreciated. These are some of the reasons I've come back here after my first stay and plan too again in the future. As it is a lively neighborhood, particularly on weekend nights when there is a bit more street noise, it is ideal for those who don't mind that and who like being in the middle of things.  Thanks as always, Silvia!

Silvia estuvo siempre pendiente de que todo funcionara correctamente en el departamento. Es rápida resolviendo cualquier tipo de imprevisto, siempre me facilitó muchísimo las cosas.
El departamento es perfecto para una persona, ubicado en una zona excelente que tiene de todo. Para una estancia temporal lo recomendaría 100%. Yo estuve 4 meses pero me hubiera quedado otros 4.

Me recibieron muy bien y fueron flexibles con los horarios de llegada y salida lo cuál fue muy útil. Silvia es muy atenta y responde rápido en cada contacto. El lugar tenía todo lo necesario para cocinar y pasar una buena estadía. Con varios juegos de sábanas, toallas, etc. Muy bien equipado y con buenos detalles como por ejemplo paraguas, 2 llaves, tarjetas Sube, etc.
La cama es cómoda y se puede descansar sin problema. La zona tiene mucho movimiento de gente por lo que es un poco ruidosa de noche pero se entiende por la ubicación. En mi caso con tapones para los oídos pude descansar sin problema. Muchas gracias por todo!

Silvia is a great host! Very communicative and nice person! :)
She helped us with ALL questions - where to go, what to eat, what to see (even gave us her SUBE card for public transport).
The apartment has perfect location - 2 blocks from the heart of Palermo Soho (Plazoleta Julio Cortázar). All popular Palermo's cafes, restaurants, bars are in 1-5 minutes walk.
Also you'll have straight bus to the city center, in 50 meters from the house (bus number is 39).
About the apartment: as on photos - simple, but with all you need. As for me - great value for the money. The big table and fast wi-fi are very nice bonus for digital nomads)
Definitely recommend!
Silvia estuvo muy atenta a nuestras necesidades e inquietudes todo el tiempo, incluso consultándonos si teníamos algún “requisito extra” o alguna necesidad en especial. Además responde súper rápido!

El apartamento está ubicado en una zona privilegiada dentro de Palermo, a dos cuadras de Plaza Serrano y está rodeado de distintas opciones de comercios y servicios gastronómicos que enriquecen la experiencia en Buenos Aires.
El apartamento está en excelente estado y te espera con las cosas necesarias para llegar y salir a recorrer.

Silvia, por otro lado, es una gran huésped.
Durante toda nuestra estadía estuvimos en contacto y se mostró muy receptiva a nuestras consultas, siempre dando respuesta a las dudas planteadas.
