El proceso de check in y check out fue muy cómodo y conveniente, considerando que llegamos tarde en la noche y nos fuimos muy temprano en la mañana.

Es un apartamento al que volvería, sin dudas, en futuras oportunidades.
You’ll be very happy with this rental!

Silvia is an amazing host! Apartment is exactly as listed, she was super flexible and very communicative -- even provided us with many recommendations for activities, restaurants and museums around Buenos Aires, as well as gave us breakfast food that lasted during our stay. The location could not be better -- as two females,  we felt very safe, even late at night. The bathroom itself is amazing, especially the lighting for doing your makeup. We recommend this place to anyone coming to BA! Thank you so much Silvia :)

El lugar tiene una muy buena ubicación. Es muy acogedor, está muy lindo y tiene todo lo que puedes llegar a necesitar! Sumado a eso, Silvia es una persona muy atenta y muy linda, volvería a quedarme acá si regreso, gracias Silvia!
lugar céntrico, pequeño pero bien equipado, ideal para una o 2 personas, la anfitriona es muy amable y esta presta a ayudar altamente recomendado.
Perfect location, spacious and clean room, and a great host that’s very helpful. Highly recommended.

Excelente localização, apartamento muito confortável, muita gentileza da Silvia em nos ajudar com check in antecipado e check out tardio (nos ajudou muito, somos muito gratos).
Única coisa que pode melhorar é o controle da temperatura do chuveiro, ou é muito quente ou muito frio, tivemos dificuldade de tomar banho pois não conseguíamos encontrar uma temperatura morna/mediana. Mas isso não atrapalhou em nada a experiência. Amamos nossos dias em buenos aires, Obrigada Silvia!!
The location is incredible, right in the heart of Palermo SoHo. Walking distance to all the bars and great restaurants. Host was kind and communicative.

Silvia is a lovely host who went over and beyond what I could expect to accommodate me and make me feel at home. The location is perfect with a great mixture of restaurants, cafes, bars and boutiques within a very short walk. Upon hearing of something unfortunate happening to me, Silvia was so generous in assisting me in the way she could. Will be back again when I return

Great location and walking distance to many bars and restaurants. Also, there is an excellent gym within a block where you can play tennis, paddle tennis, and work out - pay daily, weekly or monthly.  Silvia is an amazing host and treats you like family - we even played tennis twice!

Myself and a friend stayed at Luba's for 10 days and we couldn't have asked for a nicer host. Luba is welcoming, funny and treated us very well. We even got to try some of her home made cake on New Years' Eve. Whenever we were looking for a steak house or a milonga Luba always had good suggestions. The breakfast was a nice way to start the day, especially with the dulce de leche! I would recommend anyone to stay here.
This was a great place and it looks exactly as the photos. Wonderful location. I would absolutely stay here again!
Great apartment! Exactly like the photos. We stayed for a week and would definitely recommend Sergio's place

Very Accommodating host. Apartment is beautiful with amazing views and located in an excellent neighborhood. Plenty of restaurants/bars located within walking distance.
Great Bakery and bar located on the first level. This unit is on the 4th floor (top level)

My mother, her friend and I all stayed at his beautiful condo. The place was in a great location, we felt extremely safe and nearby great bars and food!
Sergio was by far an excellent and experienced host, from detailed information on restaurant recommendations, to taxis to money exchanges -he was accommodating, very helpful and friendly. We all enjoyed the condo and would definitely stay here again and recommend him to anyone coming to Buenos Aires. Gracias por todo!
O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos. A vista é maravilhosa. O chuveiro funciona bem. Tudo perfeito. O Sergio e a esposa são super atenciosos. Com certeza recomendo.
La estadía fue impecable, el departamento supero las expectativas, es más fácil cuando se trata con gente seria y confiable como Sergio. La ubicación es inmejorable y el departamento espectacular
Great place. Great help from Sergio. Highly recommended.

Localização perfeita, excelentes condições de habitação com tecnologia e bom Wi-Fi.
Uma excelente Padaria no r/C e uma série de bons e excelentes restaurantes, bares e galerias.
Um excelente Anfitrião porque ausente, mas presente, sempre...
Absolutamente a repetir .

I had such a great time staying at Sergio's place in Palermo. It's the perfect location for an American tourist to live in while visiting BA. The apartment was great, clean, and has spectacular views.

We stayed for three nights in August. The apartment is very nice and Sergio was very accommodating of our late check in and early check out. There is also a binder full of restaurant/bar suggestions for Buenos Aires and a number of guide books scattered around the apartment which were helpful. We would definitely recommend staying here.

The apartment was fantastic! Beautiful views, an amazing location and neighborhood. Located on top of a great beer bar and an awesome cafe & bakery. We had a great time in Sergio's beautiful apartment.

When we arrived Mariano gave us a great tour and explained the area to us in great detail. (Very Helpful!)

Had a great time in Palermo thanks in part to this amazing apartment.

Cheers!

Sergio was great! The place was beautiful and he was super helpful whenever we needed help with something. He helped us exchange our US dollars into pesos and made our stay very welcoming. The photos are very accurate as to the look of the apartment. I definitely recommend the apartment and Sergio!

Exceptional apartment that elevated my experience of B.A. It was very clean, comfortable and well equipt. The only bad thing about it was my friend and I had to leave it each day to go exploring the city :)

Sergio was very professional ensuring no delays for key handover meaning a seamless arrival with minimal disruption after long travel. Lots of local info provided, and always in contact if needed/reliable.

The positioning of the apartment is second to none- very very close to 3 top recommended bars in town, lots of cafes and restaurants meaning it was a great base to explore but also feel part of the area for local experience.

The best place I could ever pick the location is blocks away from plaza Serrano on your way to it you have a lot of very cute restaurants also clubs are around the corner too and next door is a bakery also a beer pub !! Can't go wrong Sergio was very nice and helpful too he recommended a couple of places and in his apartment he have a folder with all the things that you may need including 24 hours pharmacy hospitals Togo restaurants we love the place we definitely going back !!!!!

reviewer_name: Hugo M. Pesa Y Cia S.R.L.
comments: La experiencia fue excelente . Muy buen dpto y muy buena la atención . Totalmente recomendable . Gracias

We loved this apartment and the Palermo area it is in. The apartment is modern with all of the mod-cons. Beautifully appointed with a full kitchen and beautiful bath, living area, and balconies (incl hot tub) overlooking the city.
Palermo is full of cool cafes and shops - you'd have to spend weeks or months just to try them all. Beyond Palermo we tended to walk everywhere, though we did catch Subte some days (beware that Subte stops at 11pm which is weird for a city where people don't eat dinner till 10 or 11 pm). Sergio was super helpful - emailing beforehand and answering all emails promptly. Although he wasn't in BA when we stayed, he arranged for a friend (Mariano) to meet us - he too was super helpful. They helped with exchanging USD both when we arrived as well as later in our stay. The apartment also has a laundry (if you don't want to use a service in the neighbourhood) - which was also great.. there is a mini-market a block away for necessities.

We can't recommend this apartment more highly!

Sergio's penthouse was amazing! From the views to the neighborhood. I couldn't of chosen a better property. Everything you need to know about the area and building is written down for you. Sergio was out of town but his friend Mariano checked me in and showed me everything I needed to know. Everything went very smooth and communication with Sergio couldn't of been better. I hope to return. Friendly doorman too!

I had a terrific stay at Sergio's place. It's great apartment in a perfect location. Sergio was a fantastic host who made sure that everything went smooth with our stay. Thanks again! I can definitely recommend this place for your stay in Buenos Aires.
Luba was an amazing host! Comfortable beds, and she couldn't have been more accomodating
Todo perfecto segun descripto! El departamento es amplio y comodo. Bien amoblado y equipado. La ubicacion es muy buena. La atencion de ralph y su equipo perfecta. Altamente recomendado.

From the moment we booked our reservation, to being greeted at the airport, to the walk through of our honeymoon abode; we were treated with hospitality, efficiency and given helpful tips.  Our flat, was immaculate, lovely views and amenities, convenient location and a celebratory bottle of champagne!  Marcel answered all of our questions happily and with the knowledge of a bonafide Porteńo, he made himself on call for anything we need.  Our building had 24hr security and quickly became our happy home for the week!   Muchas Muchas Gracías for helping to create the happiest honeymoon.

A minha experiência com o apartamento Bella Vista foi simplesmente maravilhosa. O apartamento é grande, lindo, novo. A área de lazer do condomínio é ótima (um plus a vista da academia e do SPA). A localização não poderia ser melhor: a uma quadra da Av. Santa Fé, pertissimo da Plaza Itália, do Jardim Zoológico, Jardim Japonês, Rosedal. A 15mins a pé do Alto Palermo Shopping. Tem metro perto, mercado, farmácia, padaria. Enfim, foi tudo muito melhor do que a gente esperava... Sinto saudades da minha casa porteña.

This apartment was the high point of our journey to Buenos Aires. The place is well-appointed, spacious, filled with generous extras, and has tons of light; the bed is comfortable, everything is clean, and the bowl of fruit that welcomed us was delightful.  With floor-to-ceiling windows and a small but fabulous terrace for morning coffee and evening cocktails, the views are great and the location is perfect... Ralf and his team run a really professional operation -- they started us off with great tips for touring and were available at every turn to answer questions or help as needed (while being totally respectful of our privacy).  They are just generous, well-organized folks with an amazing space to offer. This is definitely the place to stay if you're coming to town.

Our rental in Buenos Aires was extremely pleasant and a great location.  Ralf, and the rest of BA4U's staff, made a real effort to make our stay go smoothly, including providing us with a great city map, suggestions for things to see, and transfer to the airport.  The apartment was well furnished, with pots - pans - coffee maker (and coffee) - dishes - everything we needed.  There was even a bowl of fruit, juice and bottled water for us!  The apartment has lots of windows and light and separate air conditioning units in the living room and bedroom.  The television has several channels in English (and German) - which was pretty rare in our experience in Argentina.  We especially appreciated the handbook provided.  In addition to information about the apartment and building, the handbook recommended restaurants (which proved to be excellent recommendations), and told us where to find ATM's, grocery stores, and places to recharge our telephones.  We got the best parts of staying in a hotel and in an apartment in one place and we recommend it highly to anyone staying in Buenos Aires.

Sergio made my group feel very welcome. We had an easy and smooth check-in process once we arrived in Buenos Aires. The apartment has fantastic views of the city from its terrace. The inside was spacious and comfortable for our group of 4!

I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Buenos Aires.

This was the first time I have booked accommodation through Airbnb and to be honest I was a little nervous. However dealing with Sergio and being welcomed to his amazing Penthouse put all my concerns to rest.
The apartment if possible was even better than it looked in the pictures, everything was spotless and very well set up for everything we needed for our stay.
The location was outstanding and walking distance to numerous bars and restaurants. The boutique beer bar downstairs was a hit with my husband and we became big fans of pastries from the corner cafe.
Sergio made us feel very welcome and was on hand when needed to help us with any questions we had.
Don't hesitate to book if you are looking for a stunning place to stay with breathtaking views of the city. You won't be disappointed.
Rebecca - Sydney

Sergio's picture reflects his personality exactly: friendly and fun, but serious about providing excellent accommodation. He spent a good deal of time with us right from the start, orienting us to the unit and the neighbourhood.  We stayed for two months and would be hard-pressed to find a more comfortable unit, a better view, or a better Buenos Airean neighbourhood.  Everything fell into place for us.  Even the porter/building manager Julio is the kindest guy around.  Any issue we had, he dealt with asap.  The best panaderia in town is next door.

We loved the apartment and neighborhood. Sergio was a great host. Even though we did not meet him in person , he responded graciously to our questions and was always available and prompt. I would recommend this apartment to anyone wanting to be in the Palermo district.

Beautifully-furnished apartment with absolutely stunning views across Buenos Aires.  Although Sergio couldn't receive us personally, we were received by the lovely Silvia who was waiting in the apartment when we arrived.  Excellent boutique cafés and restaurants below the apartment and plenty others within a couple of blocks.  We will definitely be in touch again next time we visit the city!

We loved this beautiful apartment! You can find everything what is needed to make your stay comfortable. The area around the apartment is fantastic. A lot of restaurants, bars and shops. It is the best place to stay in Buenos Aires. The apartment has wonderful views around the city. It was hot (close to 40 degrees) during our stay in BA but the air condition makes it feels good and relaxed. The doorman from the apartment building was very friendly. The kitchen is very well equipt, the balconies are amazing. You can enjoy the souround views over the city while your are lying in bed. We defenitly would book this apartment again! Thank you, Sergio :-)

It was a great privilege to stay at Sergio's amazing apartment. The reception was perfect, the city view and stylish environment exceptional. We loved the neighbourhood and will miss Buenos Aires.  If we ever return we would love to stay there again.

We loved to stay at Sergio's place, we had an amazig time.
The appartment wes extremely clean, nice and looked like in the pictures.
We will stay again at his place in a week from now and can only recommend it.
Sergio was welcoming. Everything on the description was accurate. My friends and I loved Sergio's apartment. The neighborhood was quiet and friendly. Everything was within walking distance.

My wife and I have just returned from our trip to Argentina and we already miss BA and this wonderful duplex apartment. The space is exactly as pictured in Sergio's AirBnB listing. The main floor has the living space, a terrace which overlooks a view of Palermo Hollywood, a half bath, and a small but workable kitchen. The bedrooms are on the upper floor. The master bedroom shares the same view as the main floor. It opens out onto a terrace with an outdoor shower. The second bedroom is smaller and doesn't have a view or a terrace. Since it was just the 2 of us, we used the second bedroom to store our luggage and cold weather gear for a brief trip to Patagonia. The space suited us perfectly. Throughout our month-long stay, we continually talked about how lucky we were to have rented the apartment.

We love the neighborhood. The building's location is in the heart of Palermo Hollywood, and it's a short walk to Palermo Soho. There is a wonderful bakery/coffee bar downstairs, and no shortage of good restaurants within a few blocks.

Be advised that there is also a very lively artisanal beer bar immediately next door to the entrance to building. The entrance to the apartment is on the 5th floor (4th floor on the elevator button but the ground floor is counted as zero), so the bar's late night revelry was never a problem for us, but we could hear it. (Bedrooms are on what would be considered the 6th floor.)

Sergio was a great host, and we would rent from him again without hesitation.
Gostamos muito. Lugar extremamente agradável, bairro muito gostoso com vários restaurantes perto e o atendimento do Sérgio impecável
Outstanding location and amazing place

We found ba4u and Ralf to be great to deal with, and Buena Vista was a lovely modern apartment with truly breath taking views. We found it spotless and extremely well equipped, and the tower block's excellent security was much appreciated.

Ralf and his team exchanged many emails with us prior to our arrival, giving us invaluable help and advice, and answering our many questions. We didn't call on the ba4u staff too often after arriving, but when we did they couldn't have been more helpful. We were touched when we were each given a small Easter egg!

The block is very well located, near to many supermarkets, a huge variety of lovely restaurants, and very near to Plaza Italia and the Subte (Underground)with its direct line straight into the heart of the city. We used the Subte, buses and trains, as well as taxis, and found them all to be very reasonably priced, safe and efficient. It's just a short walk to the lovely Botanic Gardens (free) and the equally lovely Japanese Gardens- a small charge but well worth a visit.

BA is a vibrant, sophisticated and lively city, and the food was very impressive, varied and plentiful. There are very many sights to see, and the museums rival any we have seen elsewhere in the world.

We found BA to be very safe and secure, and the people were very helpful. The only small downside was that we were caught out by a scam perpetrated on us by a (non Radio cab) taxi driver. We had been warned only to travel in Radio Cabs, and about this scam which involved switching 100 peso notes for forged ones, but we were a bit slow. Another non Radio cab driver was great, and went out of his way at no extra charge to get us to our destination.

Ralf, Marcelo, Andres y Luis fueron excelentes en todo. El depto es increíble, muy bién ubicado con todas comodidades y muy lindo. Ralf y su team son muy muy organizados y atentos. En el primer dia de mi llegada el inmueble presentó un pequeño problema electrico pero en el correr del dia (feriado) Marcelo providenció todo el cambio y arreglo de todo. Además todo el team es muy amable, con muy alto nível y hacen de todo para que te sientas en casa y sobretodo muy comodo. Regresaria totalmente al inmueble o a otro coordinado por la equipa.

Goregeous apartment in wonderful location close to Subte, and walkable to Palermo Soho. Beautiful new building and impeccable apartment! Ralf and his team made the process very easy and care free thanks for being so on top of everything! The view from the apartment and top floor (gym/sauna) were amazing! Great sound system, comfortable bed, and all amenities! Wonderful experience from start to finish!!! Highly recommended and we hope to be back to Buenos Aires again soon!

Ralf and his team (I mostly spoke with Tomas) were quick to respond to any questions I had before arriving, regarding the apt and the neighborhood. When I arrived Sunday morning, I was met by a member of the team, who explained how things worked in the apt and the building, and gave me some great advice regarding restaurants, setting up a local cell phone, etc. I was also given a handy map of the city and a nice fruit basket. I felt like I was in good hands!

Great modern apartment in a wonderful and very walkable part of Buenos Aires. Apartment has beautiful views and modern amenities and is perfect for a stay in Buenos Aires for a couple (my wife and I stayed there). Building is a high rise in the neighborhood of Palermo Soho, only a few short blocks from the Subte at Plaza Italia. It's very safe, with 24 hour security guards at the gate. Overall my wife and I truly enjoyed the space and spent a good 5 days there, and even used the nice little dry sauna in the SPA room. Ralf, the owner was great and provided us with booklets about Buenos Aires as well as guides and suggestions of what to do in and around the city.

Only three small things I would suggest to improve the stay would be:

1) faster and more wide ranging WIFI (it didn't work for us in our iphones in the bedroom, only in the living room)
2) the private massages advertised as a possible service for renters via the building's spa are no longer available (which we only found out after checking in - we were hoping to get a massage)
3) SPA room's jacuzzi on the woman's side was not working.

Other than these small things (which are minor anyway) we had an excellent stay and already recommended the place to some of our friends.

The apartment was spacious, clean and well-appointed, located on the 13th floor which provided a panoramic view of the city. The kitchen was fully-equipped, the king-sized bed was very comfortable and there's a modest balcony along one side.

It's in a secure building in Palermo Soho, a lovely neighborhood. It's a short walk to the Plaza Italia subway station, so it's easy and inexpensive to get around the city, and Palermo Soho has lots of shops and restaurants, as well.

One of Mr. Hobeck's associates met us at the apartment to give us the key and an introduction to the apartment, building and neighborhood.

I would stay in the apartment again and can recommend it wholeheartedly.
El departamento es excelente. Muy buena vista y tal cual se ve en las fotos. Un lugar genial para estar.
Otra vez me me aloje en este dto. Todo 10 puntos como las anteriores veces?!
Una vez mas me quede en buena vista. Y todo fue increíble. Ralph y su equipo son altamente profesionales, serviciales y atentos a todos los detalles. Todo 10 puntos.
One of the nicest apartments Ralf has.  Really enjoyed
Beautiful apartment, great location and impeccable service all round. I would recommend this to my friends

Appartement très bien situé à proximité de la station de métro Plaza Italia. Tout est tel que présenté sur les photos et la piscine est définitivement un plus. Un excellent séjour, je le recommanderais sans hésiter.

The hosts were absolutely wonderful to deal with and the apartment was fantastic. The accommodation is spacious and had everything we needed for our stay in Buenos Aires. I was also very happy with the security and building facilities including the pool, sauna, rooftop gym (with an excellent view). I highly recommend this accommodation for anyone who plans to spend time in Palermo!

Once again we were surprised about he views and the neighborhood, goodly surprised. Palermo has secrets about every corner. and the apartment is very good. just like the pictures. See you all again next year.

Super appartement , qui correspond aux photos. Très propre, très bon accueil et de bons conseils. Tout a été mit à notre disposition pour passé un bon séjour à Buenos aires, le quartier palermo est top ! (métro à deux cuadras, restos, bars .... ) Nous reviendrons !
Wonderful experience. Great apartment. Convenient location. Ralf and his team are very considerate and patient. We will definitely stay here again.
Excellent apartment in a fantastic location. Incredible views, clean apartment in a secure building. I highly recommend this unit!

la verdad es que Luba fue muy atenta inclusive desde antes que llegara. Muy amable y atenta, muy dispuesta. La habitación es tal cual se describe y como se muestra en las fotos, el departamento muy lindo y cómodo. La ubicación es excelente, muy sencillo tomar transporte público o conseguir taxis. Ha sido una experiencia muy grata. Muy agradecida con Luba.

Luba was a very warm and helpful host. Our flights out of Buenos Aries were late and she allowed us to keep our luggage at the apartment until we had to head to the airport. It was very nice of her!
The room and apartment was exactly as described. It was great for two friends traveling on a budget. Having breakfast available each morning is a bonus! The location is great - near transportation (buses and not far from subway), close to shopping, near lots of bars/restaurants. We enjoyed our stay!
The host canceled this reservation 3 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Hermosa la habitacion, camas muy comodas, y gran hospitalidad.  Recomendable!

Palermo/Soho ist eine sehr gute Gegend zum Wohnen. Luba ist offen und sehr hilfsbereit, wir haben uns mit ihr sehr gut unterhalten können, in Englisch und auch in (halb) Spanisch. Luba ist flexibel und hilfsbereit. Boris hat sich über uns gefreut, nachdem er uns kennengelernt hat; er ist sehr lustig.
Good location, comfortable bed, fast wifi. But beware that you are not allowed to use the kitchen.

Luba was such a kind and great host!!! This stay is more like a group home, which makes it really fun to meet others who are traveling or living there for a few months! I made some great new friends, and Luba (and her small dog) were so fun to hang out with :)

We had a short stay here, but we really enjoyed it. Luba is so friendly and knowledgeable. Her place was clean and very cute. We also really enjoyed interacting with Boris, her very cute Pomeranian! We also had the chance to meet some travelers from other countries, and I'm sure if we had been able to stay longer, we would have had great conversations or hung out more.

Luba is also in a really great location in the heart of Palermo Soho; tons of great restaurants, markets, craft breweries, and shopping are all just a stroll away from her.

Communication was easy, and we were comfortable. I highly recommend Luba's AirBnb to anyone who is interested!
muy recomendable.

Luba ist phänomenal. Ich wollte erst nur ein paar Nächte bleiben und bin am Ende zwei Wochen bei ihr gewesen. Sie hat einen kleinen Hund, der aber nur gestreichelt werden will und sehr süß ist (ich bin normal keine Hundeperson, aber habe mich total verliebt). Die Wohnung ist sehr groß und es wohnen noch andere Airbnbgäste dort, was ich super fand, weil man gleich Anschluss finden kann wenn man möchte. Luba ist immer für einen Plausch zu haben, wenn man seine Ruhe möchte, ist das aber auch kein Problem. Sie ist sehr herzlich (sie hat mich auch zum Kaffee mit ihrer Familie eingeladen), gebildet, interessiert an spannenden, nicht oberflächlichem Unterhaltungen und liebenswürdig. Ich fühlte mich ein wenig wie bei einer Gastfamilie, was ich sehr genossen habe. Die Lage der Wohnung ist auch perfekt. Man ist direkt in Palermo, es sind viele Restaurants, Bars, Cafés um die Ecke und Supermärkte gibt es direkt vor Ort. Außerdem ist die Gegend sicher, weil die Straßen hell und immer Menschen unterwegs sind

excelente lugar, súper gentil y flexible con entrada y salida.
lo.jnomcontra es q no se puede cocinar

La casa de Luba es un lugar fantástico. Está muy bien ubicado, es muy seguro y tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia perfecta. Su perrito Boris nos hizo muy felices!!!! Es el perrito más lindo de toda Argentina ❤️🇦🇷

Luba est une personne formidable, qui est à l'écoute de ce dont vous avez besoin. C'est une femme au grand cœur qui est toujours là pour passer un moment avec vous.
En se concerne le logement rien à dire. La chambre est spacieuse et bien aménagée, la chambre comme le reste du logement étaient impeccable et nettoyés plusieurs fois par semaine les draps et les serviettes de bain aussi!!
Le logement dans sa globalité est plus que fonctionnels.
Le petit bonus est le deuxième hôte de l'appartement, Boris le chien de Luba qui est une boule d'amour, à l'affût de toutes caresses.
Luba et Boris ont été de merveilleuses rencontres et feront partie des meilleures de notre voyage.
Mi experiencia fue excelente. Luba es una persona amable y te hace sentir como en casa. Sin duda volvería a elegir este lugar para hospedarme.

Very nice condo in a great part of town with everything very easy to access! would definitely stay again. One bedroom is clearly superior to the other however with views, patio, etc. Something to consider if staying with friends but does not mean the place isn't very nice anyways!
Sergio nos recebeu muito bem e nos deu dicas muito legais! Foi muito atencioso. O bairro é um dos melhores que tem em Buenos Aires. Com muitos restaurantes e bares.
Excelente!
Very clean apartment, just a short taxi ride away from tourist spots! Two gluten free restaurants within walking distance. Lovely place to stay!
Nice apartment with great location, clean and modern design. The restaurant Sergio recommended is fantastic!

Nossa estadia no apartamento foi incrível. Ele é simplesmente idêntico ao a foto, ou seja, lindo, extremamente bem decorado, dono de uma vista incrível, com todos os itens de cozinha/cama/banho necessários. Acredito que seja o melhor bairro de Buenos Aires, com muitos restaurantes e bares.  Além disso, o Sergio e sua esposa são gentis e prepararam uma pasta com muitas referências de cada bairro, dicas de locais e passeios. Foi excelente! Recomendo

Stunning apartment in a great neighborhood. Loved the views from all rooms and you must check out the rooftop as well. Super clean and with all the amenities you need. Sergio was excellent in his communication too and assisted us with any questions we had. Definitely would stay there again.

El apartamento esta muy bien ubicado,muchos restaurantes alrededor, un supermercado,cerca de la estacion del subte, este te ayudara a acercarte a los lugares turisticos para conocer buenos aires.
El apartamento cumplio mi expectativa, un lugar muy comodo,agradable,es muy limpio y seguro. Cuando vuelva a buenos aires no dudare en contactar a sergio. El apto y la ciudad de buenos aires la recomiendo 100%.
Great house in awesome location with panoramic views of the city from pretty much every room. This is where you want to stay when in Buenos Aires. Thank you Sergio for being a great host!

Sergio was a great host and made himself available whenever we needed him. The place was great and located in one of the best and most hip areas of Buenos Aires (Palermo Hollywood). Most bars and clubs worth going out to are in this area, just a couple of blocks away from the apartment. Greatly recommend!
Excellent apartment in a great location. Sergio was extremely responsive and welcoming. The apartment was gorgeous. Highly recommended!

A great apartment in a good location. It is very clean & modern, everything you need for a comfortable stay away from home. More bath towels would have been nice, we had 4 towels between 3 adults for 6 days. Be careful with the washing machine too, it doesn't dissolve the washing powder.
Thanks for accommodating us Sergio, next time we are in your area we will definitely be staying here again.
Perfect place, host and location. Everything ran like clockwork. Such a professional operation and enjoyable place to stay. Gracias!!
EXCELLENT localization and apartament!
Sergio was a great host! My stay was comfortable and pleasant. I would highly recommend.

Sergio was an excellent host, he communicated very well and even had someone at the apartment to show us everything at check in.  He even allowed us a late check out given our flight was later in the day.  I would absolutely stay here again.
Sergio's Penthouse is an amazing apartment in a fantastic location. Sergio was great to deal with and I would highly recommend staying here

Foi Excelente a estadia! Uma localização privilegiada dentro do Palermo! O apartamento em si até supera as expectativas quando se comparado as fotos e descrição!!! Recomendo a todos!!!Tudo exatamente como combinado! Obrigado Sergio!

Easy to book. Sergio was very accommodating and responsive to questions. The apartment is in a great location with loads of bars a restaurants and a great bakery downstairs. The layout of the apartment is ideal and it has good views. I would recommend if staying in the city.

Flor was wonderful and very friendly! The apartment is in a great location and very accessible to subte D and buses.  We scheduled our arrival the day-of and Flor was able to accommodate us!! Very helpful!!!  Definitley recommend!

This is one of the best AirBnb experiences I've had overall. Besides being affordable and in a good part of BA, the apartment itself was really great. It almost felt like you were in a hotel. Florencia was great at check-in - very prompt and made sure I knew how everything worked. The check-out process was just as smooth. Highly recommended!

Florencia is a very enthusiastic and helpful host.
The appartment could not be better; very clean, very comfortable matress, new sanitary and centrally located between Palermo, Recoleta and the center.

Very well located apartment, very close to subway, supermarkets, shopping mall, restaurants.. Everything you need from a walking distance! Flor was very helpful, solved the only problem I had(getting locked outside the apartment with no keys) superfast! Thanks for the stay, Flor!
This apartment was great! Very secure building and the views are amazing. Ralf is a great host and took time explaining all the info you need about the apartment, the building and the neighborhood.

Ralf's place is amazing! The apartment is completely laid out with everything; wall-to-wall windows, heated floors, a fantastic rooftop gym, and it's only a few blocks from one of the main subway terminals. We didn't meet Ralf personally, but we met his employee, Marcellos, who could quite possibly be the nicest guy in the world. He met us at the door and gave us a full tour of the apartment, and a detailed rundown on all of the amenities. We stayed at Ralf's place for 3 days, and we were bummed to leave. I highly recommend Ralf and his entire crew.

My boyfriend and I had a most fantastic stay in Palermo. We met Marcellos who showed us around the beautiful apartment. He gave us great tips and advice. The welcome pack is full of great restaurant recommendations that used. Everything about the stay was fantastic, we would stay here again in a heartbeat. Also we were silly enough to lock ourselves out of the apartment and the response was incredible. The security man rang Ralf and we were back in the apartment within an hour even though it was a Saturday evening! Really lovely people to deal with. Thanks for making our trip to BA so great!

Beautiful, immaculate, safe apartment with all amenities and great location as everyone else has mentioned.

I never met Ralf but he runs an accommodation business with quite a few properties, and his employee Marcelo took good care of me with the check-in and any questions I had during the stay. For example, I couldn't figure out where to turn on the kitchen light and the TV had a problem with CNN reception, so he came over promptly to sort these out.

Even though there is no one right there physically as with a more intimate hosted accommodation, please do not hesitate to ask any questions as I sense there is nothing they won't handle. I texted Ralf asking if he could arrange an early AM taxi to the airport for me, and Marcelo took care of that seamlessly.

As I tend to be more independent, I also would have liked the "Information Folder" that was mentioned in my introductory confirmation email, which stated this would contain information about the local area (things like the nearest grocery store are useful). However, once again Marcelo proved very helpful to overcome this slight matter -- I just had to ask him and he was delighted to help. So just don't be shy; simply send a text and you'll be handled as if you have a personal concierge.

I could not recommend this place more highly if you're looking for a fairly independent stay with the full amenities and privacy of your own gorgeous apartment.

Ralph and his team (Sandra, Andres and Marcelo) are excellent hosts. Everything went very smooth and professional. The apartment turned out to be as great as shown in the advertisement and was the perfect spot for my one week business trip. Although I had limited sparetime I really enjoyed the city, especially the Palermo Soho area, famous for its trendy and divers shops, galeries, bars and restaurants.

Met by the delightful Marcelo, who was most thorough with his (English language) welcome and introduction to this apartment.  The standard of the property is excellent and clean, the location is handy to Palermo's best shops, boutiques, cafes, and the Subte (metro) at Plaza Italia, there's 24-hour security, and the pool was a treat. BA4U manages this apartment most professionally, and there was welcoming fruit and coffee when I arrived.  Easy liaison for cleaning and any enquiries.  I also highly recommend the airport transfers arranged by BA4U.  And Marcelo - I did finally learn to operate the laundry!  Sincere thanks for a great first-time visit to Buenos Aires.  The view from this apartment is splendid too!

I have stayed at several of Ralf's apartments. This one was just as wonderful as the others. Gorgeous views, immaculate apartment, and friendly staff with an easy check in and check out. Every time that I return to Buenos Aires, I don't even think twice about booking with Ralf.

Everything about this property was fantastic — from the condition and quality of the physical space to Ralf's informative introduction and welcome. Immaculate, spacious, convenient to the subway, surrounded by eateries and shops, safe/secure AND affordable. Ralf is responsive, accommodating and thorough. A lively neighborhood that affords you the experience of living in — not just visiting — Buenos Aires.

One word: magnifico! Ralf met me upon arrival, thoroughly explained every detail in the apartment and the amenities in the building, provided all the necessary contact numbers, and added a wonderful personal touch by providing a map and recommendations of restaurants, coffee shops, etc., in the Palermo neighborhood.

The apartment and building are wonderful. The highrise view adds a wonderful element, in getting to see sunrise and sunset over the city. The amenities in the building are superb, the rooftop gym and outdoor pool are wonderful to have on site, and especially nice to relax by the pool after a full day of work/touring. The location near Plaza Italia and Subte/transportation makes it very easy to get all across BA from this location... and the immediate neighborhood (especially just north into Palermo Hollywood) is a treasure of local dining, shopping and cafes...with beautiful tree-lined streets.

One additional added benefit is the round-trip airport transportation Ralf and his team can provide. I used it, and very glad I am, as EZE is quite a ways out of the city and it was nice to be greeted by the driver in the terminal and have no concerns in getting to the apartment.

I will be back (many times) and would highly recommend BA4U and felt very welcomed by Ralf and his team.

Sergio helped us organise a driver from the airport and the doorman was there to greet us and show is around.
The apartment is in a great area with heaps of bars and restaurants. It has a nice balcony to hang out in and is very nice.
Sergio leaves a folder with recommendations and services around the area.
Lovely place and great host. Recommended!

We loved this apartment!!!!
The area is beautiful and safe. Restaurants are at walking distance and the view from the deck is beautiful. The host, sergio, thought of everything and had everything available for us when we got there. I can't wait to go back!!! Argentina is beautiful!!

This apartment is fantastic! We had a great time staying here and the description of the apartment is very accurate. The views from the windows are amazing and they're only beat by the views from the Gym. Ralf and his crew were very accommodating to our late-check out needs and this made our last day in BA much easier. There was some nice personal touches like fresh fruit and flowers as well as a description of the neighborhood with places to eat, order out from, and visit.

We were kindly welcomed. Everything was clearly explained. Great suggestions for dinner and breakfast. A nice bowl of fruit awaited us as a bonus!! Everything was clean and as indicated on the website.
The gym was well appointed and had a spectacular view.
Location was great for our purposes. Excellent view and it was really great to have a small but usable balcony.

The place is stunning, just like in pictures, and the views are amazing. Conveniently located to all the great restaurants in the area, and the park nearby is beautiful. Ralf is a fantastic host, who made our stay very pleasant and comfortable. We'll definitely be coming back to this place next time we're in Buenos Aires!

From the moment we arrived at the apartment, we felt at home. Ralf was there to greet us and show us around the beautiful apartment. We stayed for a month and enjoyed every day! Rolf was available 24 hours a day and was very generous with his time and his knowledge of the area. He provided a fabulous binder (in English) with everything we could want to know about the building as well as a long list of excellent restaurants and things to do. He even offered to secure tickets to a Tango Show, etc. if we were interested. It was exceptionally helpful as we settled in. Note: Our very favorite restaurant was Don Julio and we highly recommend it! The side of mushrooms, the pasta dishes and the steaks are all just exceptional! It is very reasonably priced and we became regulars!
The apartment is amazing. It is super clean (as is the whole building) and very secure. The view is incredible and the amenities (pool and fitness center) were perfect! The cleaning service came each week and made our place sparkle. The location of the apartment is absolutely perfect. It is in a very safe neighborhood in walking distance to the restaurant Mecca of Buenos Aires! We loved our neighborhood fruit/veggie stands and our local grocery market (all who got to know us and would smile or make suggestions when we visited.). Ralf arranged our shuttle to the airport at the end of the trip and it was perfect. ($50 USD to be picked up at 2AM at our front door and dropped us off right at our gate.) The driver arrived early, was very kind and was an excellent driver. We were so happy that we chose that option rather than a cab or bus shuttle. Buenos Aires is a wonderful city to explore and enjoy and Ralf's apartment is a fabulous place to stay. Each night, when coming home from a busy day, we felt as though we were coming home.
Great place and beautiful views!  Very convenient location in the city and we loved it!  Ralf was very accommodating and very organized.

Fantastic stay in a most safe, well appointed apartment.  The check in process was easy and everything in the apartment was impeccable and no detail was overlooked. The view sells this place....you won't be disappointed
Fantastic views, lovely apartment and great location. We were made to feel very welcome and given lots of tips about the area. Thanks!

There is not a single thing I can fault about this apartment - it is perfect for your trip to BA. The apartment is beautiful, great views, quality fit outs (incl a well stocked kitchen!), secure building with great facilities, super clean.
Service was also superb - We used the airport transfer & appreciated it after a delayed flight. Marcelo welcomed us and was so friendly and detailed in his introduction.
We also appreciated the information folder left in the apartment and enjoyed dining at Don Julio, La Carniceria, Nininia and trying out all the coffee suggestions on the Pickupthefork blog.

Bom apartamento, localizado próximo ao metrô e com todos os equipamentos necessários para uma boa estadia. Quando chegamos fomos muito bem recepcionados pelo Marcelo que nos explicou detalhadamente todo o funcionamento do apartamento. Reclamamos do conforto do colchão da cama e Marcelo nos atendeu prontamente, substituindo por outro novinho e muito confortável. Como ficamos 8 noites, ganhamos uma limpeza, com troca de toalhas e lençóis, o que tornou nossa estadia muito mais agradável. A nossa única sugestão, seria para que Ralf disponibilizasse melhores taças de vinho para utilizarmos, afinal estamos na terra do vinho e uma boa taça faria toda a diferença no sabor dos vinhos que compramos para tomar no apartamento. Recomendamos fortemente esse apartamento e parabenizamos o profissionalismo e atenção do Ralf e staff!

As a fellow airbnb host and frequent airbnb user, this was far and away the best airbnb experience I've ever had. Located on the 13th floor of a luxury residence high rise in beautiful Palermo (best place to stay in my opinion), the apartment itself is incredible. It features floor to ceiling windows and a nice balcony with unobstructed views of Buenos Aires all the way down to the river. The apartment is very modern and well appointed with a very comfortable bed. Everything you could possibly need was provided (soap, shampoo, towels, guide books, metro card, wifi, tv, safe, etc.). Transportation was offered to and from the airport and Ralf was very flexible with check in and check out times. There is also a gym as well as a spa (saunas and private jacuzzis) on the top two floors of the building that you can taken advantage of. I honestly can't say enough great things about this place. Way better than any 5 star hotel.

We had a wonderful stay in Palermo in Ralf's Buena Vista apartment.  We had wanted to stay somewhere that had a view of the city and this apartment did not disappoint! The apartment had everything we required and more.  We highly recommend this apartment.  Ralf was great to work with - I would certainly be happy to stay at any of his listings based on our experience here.  Quick tip if staying here, when out of the apartment keep the shades drawn to keep the temperature in the apartment cool - the floor to ceiling windows offer an incredible view, but they do heat up the place even when open.  Thanks again Ralf for the great home during our stay in Buenos Aires
Everything is what it is supposed to be

Florencia fue una anfitriona amable y muy generosa, que no tuvo problemas en hacer concesiones para adaptarse a mis horarios. El departamento es cómodo, agradable y funcional, y la ubicación es muy buena. ¡Muy recomendable!

Muy buena experiencia! El departamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos, la ubicacion es muy buena tambien. Encontramos el departamento muy limpio y Flor dispuesta a acomodarse a nuestro horario de llegada sin ningun problema, no tuvimos que esperar nada.
Flor muy simpatica y atenta, gracias por todo ;)

el depto es muy lindo, muy bien ubicado, a dos cudras de la calle santa fe y tres del shoping alto palermo y de la estacion de subte.
Flor fue muy amable con su atencion
Muy recomendable
La verdad que la pasamos excelente, la ubicación es genial y el depto impecable, ni hablar de Flor nos trató re bien...

Flor was an excellent host. The apartment is beautiful and exactly as pictured. It's in a nice location and she even gave us some recommendations on what sites to see and good places to eat. On our departure she even helped us flag down a radio taxi. She's a sweetheart. Whenever we go back to Buenos Aires I'm sure we'll stay here again. We would highly recommend staying here.

A cozy apartment that is conveniently located near the bus station and the subway.  Florencia was great, an extremely punctual and helpful host. She was always accessible and promptly responded to any questions we had. Being first timers to Air BnB and Buenos Aires, it was a pleasure staying there.

Great apartment and great host!  In a perfect spot to know Recoleta and Palermo, two great/modern areas of Buenos Aires. The apartment is nice and spacious, and had everything I needed. Flor and her husband were very nice and helped with anything I needed. Definitely recommended, would rent here again.

Florencia is a wonderful guest. The apartment is super nice. It`s clean, the bathroom is very goos and the water of the shower is hot, there is cable TV, a comfortable couch and the bed is very comfortable too. The kitchen has everything you need such as stove/oven, microwave, fridge (with freezer) and cuttlery utensils. Also, the apartment is next to Subtes (metros) and bus stops. You can really know all Palermo and Recoleta on foot. Great location.

100% recommend!

Cheers,

Jean and Cinthia

Flor foi uma excelente anfitriã. Cheguei bem mais cedo da previsão do check-in, mas ela se adequou aos meus horários e foi de uma gentileza impressionante. O apartamento é também muito arrumado, perto de Palermo, onde você sente um pouco do cotidiano da cidade. Recomendo a todos!
Muy comodo el departamento, todo lo necesario para sentirse en casa, impecable y silencioso, excelente ubicacion. Muy amables Florencia y su esposo. Recomendable.

Simplesmente fantástico. Flor é sensacional e uma ótima host! A localização é ótima, segura, acessível e perto de tudo. Recomendo a todos que desejam conhecer Buenos Aires.

Gorgeous! Flor is fantastic! The apt. is great, near Palermo and Recoleta!
Could not be better!!!!!

Florencia's apartment is a very cozy and well located one, with all essencial equipment for a nice staying in Buenos Aires.
I truly recommend it!
Florencia has a nice place in a good location.  It was clean and cosy.  I had a small issue with the hot water system, but Florencia was very responsive. Thanks Flor!

Flor was right on time when we arrived at the apartment.  She was super friendly and helpful with getting us settled.  The apartment was very comfortable and clean, and the kitchen had everything we needed to cook our meals.  The location is great, only a few blocks from the main strip in Palermo where you can easily catch the Subte (subway) to the center of downtown.  We walked to the Recoletta, the Museo de Bellas Artes, and many of the parks.  Also, the bed was SO comfortable, it was sometimes hard to get out of in the mornings :)  We would definitely stay here again and recommend it!

Lovely place,centrally located to 2 Subte Lin D stations. Palermo's activities close by. As the apartment is located off the street it is very quiet at night. Very comfy bed and bedding. Thank you Flor for your always prompt responses. I had a very pleasant stay.

I highly recommend this posting, Florencia is amazing host, the apartment is in a perfect location the neighborhood is lovely is close to everything, major bus stops and underground train. Palermo is the place to be. The apartment was impeccably clean and the decoration is super cute. if I were to return to Argentina i would definitely return to this apartment. Also we loved Argentina!!

My husbond and I have just visited Buenos Aires and stayed in Flor's appartment. It is a very cosy appartment, excellent for two persons and located within reach of everything one could want to visit and see. Flor is a wonderful host, the most helpfull, trustworthy, and sweetest person. We will gladly recommend other visitors to visit Flor's appartment, you are bound to be very satisfied. Helle and Sven from Denmark.

The studio was *amazing*. Even though the city is noisy, Florencia's place is very quiet and peaceful. The place is close to the metro (although they were on strike when we visited) and also close to restaurants and attractions.

Flo was a great and attentive host, and I'm sure you will enjoy being hosted by her.
Great cozy apartment in an excellent location! Absolutely loved our stay, Florencia was very attentive and gracious, I highly recommend choosing her apartment for your stay in BA.

My mom and I can only echo the many other glowing reviews of time spent in Florencia's apartment in Recoleta. She and her husband Damien were warm, welcoming, accessible, and responsive to any need. The apartment is cozy, charming, and well-maintained. Wifi is a major plus and we loved the thoughtful jar of cookies set out on the coffee table. It's a completely different experience when traveling abroad to stay in a private residence as opposed to a hotel and we're so glad we could call Florencia's place our home away from home in Buenos Aires.

Se o apartamento parece bonito nas fotos, ele é ainda mais em pessoa. Perto de restaurantes, mercados, do metrô e de uma padaria com sanduíches de presunto maravilhosos, esse apartamento é altamente recomendável. Sem falar na simpatia de Florência.
Was a comfortable stay located in a great location. Sergio's assistant was there for our arrival and walked us through explaining the features...very helpful. Good value in Palermo Hollywood.
Ce duplex est très agréable et situé dans un quartier vivant et à la mode, Palermo Hollywood. Il est parfait pour 4 personnes, et Sergio est très disponible pour conseiller.
Sergio was a fantastic host and the condo/apt is absolutely wonderful in all aspects such as location, security, cleanliness, views, etc. I would highly recommend staying here.

We had a great time in Palermo staying at Sergio's place. The panaderia and the cafe across the street were both excellent as was the brewery. Really appreciated the air conditioning and blackout curtains because the sun was quite hot blasting in the morning. Took a lovely bath in the tub on the balcony after walking around all day while the family went for a dip in the small rooftop pool.
Nice quiet safe neighbourhood

Sergio's place is in a great location. The view from the balcony is unbelievable. Everything as described. The only thing we missed was a better equipped kitchen, it was difficult to cook dinner as only basics were available and we had to buy all spices etc. However, we left some of it there, so maybe the next renters can use it :)
Very nice. Located near lots of bars and restaurants.  Just like the pictures.  Was clean and great for the price. Would recommend place to anyone!

Sergio's flat was wonderful. Clean, comfortable and well equipped. Sergio left a lot of details to aid our stay. We met him on our arrival and he very kindly treated us to breakfast in the lovely cafe next door!  A great few days to finish our S.American experience.

Tive minha primeira experiência no airbnb com o apartamento do Sergio. Gostei muito da estadia, amei o apartamento e a localização, com ótimos restaurantes e padarias próximos. A internet funcionou super bem e o ar-condicionado foi fundamental para o calorão que encontramos em Buenos Aires. Valeu super à pena!

The apartment is in a very nice modern building in a great part of the city. The subway is about 7 minute walk. Many wonderful bars and restaurants within a short walking distance. For those like us that enjoy working out even while on vacation there is a great modern gym nearby within a couple of blocks.
Sergios place is great. Very nice views and lots of restaraunts nearby.

Ideal location in a great neighborhood.
The bakery downstairs one door over is stellar. Highly recommend the empanadas for breakfast.
Can't imagine a better place to stay. Unbelievable duplex with great views and easy check in, check out.

Dear Mr. Sergio,                                                   I greatly appreciate your kindness and everything you have done to help my trip more comfortable and more interesting.I really like your apartment that close to restaurant, bakery shop, grocery store,... and the most important thing is the safety. I greatly appreciate the guy who you sent to your apartment to show us how to operate everything in your place. Once again I want to to say thank you very much for your help.                                                              Loan Nguyen.
Great place to stay! Me and my 2 girlfriends thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Sergio's place in BA. The neighborhood is hip and fun with many restaurants and bars. Would highly recommend staying here!

The apartment was very comfortable and seemed even bigger since it is two stories. It is well stocked and nicely decorated. The view from the balconies is great. Sergio was very easy to work with and check in and check out were a snap. The neighborhood is full of great restaurants and bars. It is an easy 10 or 15 minute walk to the subway station or hop on hop off bus.

Sergio's apartment was really beautiful. We were two young girls travelling round South America alone so safety was a key issue for us and of course some luxury after we had just come from the Amazon in Peru! In terms of location and comfort, you really won't get any better than this and there are so many shops and bars around to keep you occupied at any time of day.
We had a slight issue with taxi money on the way from the airport as all of the case machines were empty and we couldn't pay the driver (we understand that Argentinians withdraw cash on Fridays and the ATMs run out so with our arrival on a Sunday we were pretty stuck) but fortunately Sergio's friend Mariano came to the rescue and very kindly paid our taxi on arrival. This was of course not expected or required but was a kind gesture, for which we were so grateful. If you are coming to BA, you must stay here. The check in and check out process was also very straightforward and the views from the balcony....well there were absolutely incredible.
thanks Sergio!
Lisa and Rebecca
What an awesome stay, central, clean with great views of the city. Trying sleeping with the curtains open in the main bedroom.
Excellent unit with amazing views. Very contemporary, in a high secure building.. In one of the best neighborhoods in the city!! I felt taken care of the entire time that I was there.

Ralf and his team were wonderful hosts. Even before we visited, they assisted with our travel plans, helped us book a city tour and answered all of our questions. Upon arrival, they even greeted us with Champagne to celebrate our anniversary. The apartment was clean, well stocked and just as described. The WiFi worked extremely well and the kitchen had everything we needed for morning coffee and tea and was equipped with cups, plates and silverware for snacks and meals throughout our stay. The view is amazing and even better than the photos! Waking up to the sunrise was truly wonderful. Not only was the apartment (and view) great, but located in a great area of the city. It was close to the Subway station and near lots of shops, cafes and restaurants. We always felt safe walking the streets and coming to/from the building. We highly recommend this apartment and would not hesitate to book it again. Ralf and his team certainly excel at making things perfect for their guests.

Grat location in Palermo, walking distance to the best cafes, restaurants, bars, shops, markets etc. in the palermo area, really safe, secure and comfortable apartment. Easy access to the city. Next time I'm in BA I'll be checking availability for sure. Thanks Ralf.

This place was perfect. It's beautiful, safe, clean. I felt at home. Ralf's team were so helpful. Marcelo greeting me at the apartment and was always available. It got whatever I needed. It was wonderful!

It's a lovely apartment in a smart and secure building as described. Check in was great. Marcello couldn't have been more helpful. The view is stunning and  I enjoyed making fresh coffee (a jar of grounds were left) and sunning myself on the small balcony first thing in the morning. The view from the gym is even more fantastic (31st floor) though a couple of the machines weren't working. The electricity went off for nearly a whole day because of repairs made by the electric company which was inconvenient and annoying. Ralf was in regular contact however and as helpful as he could be. Overall my best AirBnB experience so far and good value.

The apartment exactly as in the description and pictures... super cozy, very well located and with everything you need. This, in combination with a great attentive host that makes everything easy for you gives a perfect experience as result! :-) Thank you so much Ralf and hope to return to this apartment in my next visit!

"Buena Vista" is an understatement for the quality of view from Ralph's apartment.  Very clean and exactly as described.  Marcelo did an outstanding job of explaining and giving us a tour of the house, including the upstairs gym and sauna(which have even more amazing views).  He was also very helpful with tips for getting to know not just Palermo, but Buenos Aires in general.  Loved my first stay through AirBnB and would definitely recommend to friends and family.  The whole process was seemless.  Keep up the good work, Ralph and friends!

El departamento espectacular, más lindo que en las fotos. Muy linda vista y buena ubicación. Cuando llegamos nos estaban esperando. Muy amables. Lo recomiendo y seguramente en un próximo viaje lo vuelvo a elegir

Beautiful space, very convenient location, helpful host - stayed for 1 week and loved it. Amazing view of the city every night, great extra amenities such as hot tub with even more views of the city, heated wood floors, many channels on TV including HBO in Spanish and English. Super close to subway station, even include subway card for you to fill as you please, and to Aeroparque airport (20-min taxi). Palermo is probably best neighborhood for tourists given safety and plethora of nearby restaurants/shops/things to do. Host was wonderfully helpful - gave us advice on where locals eat, how to keep safe from taxi scams, how to ride the subway.

Sin palabras, EXCELENTE en todo, es la 1era vez que alquilo en BsAs y me he llevado una grata sorpresa.
El dpto era tal cual se mostraba en la pagina. Limpio, confortable, cómodo, luminoso y con una vista panorámica de la ciudad que no daban ganas de irse. ¡Nada que objetar!
La ubicación es muy practica y de fácil acceso desde diferentes arterias de la ciudad ya sea que uno vaya en auto o quiera moverse en transporte publico.
Quedo muy agradecido por la recepción y la predisposición de Ralf y la atención de Marcelo con quien estuve en contacto telefónico un domingo (si un domingo!) evacuando mis dudas al instante y a Andres quien estando en Brasil respondio mis Whatsapp!!
Ralf y su equipo son totalmente recomendable y confiable, nuevamente gracias.

Beautiful apartment, comfortable and clean. Great view! The location is convenient to the subway and a short walk from the main attractions of Palermo Soho. It's also close to the Botanical Garden and the Palermo Nuevo area. The building has a  great gym and excellent security. Andres, Marcello, and the team that manage this apartment were easy to work with. Since there wasn't a guest departing the same day, I was able to arrive early, direct from my flight.

We very much enjoyed our time at Ralf's place. Overall we would recommend to stay here. There are few comments about this specific listing - but my overall feedback would be absolutely stay at any located hosted by BA4U. These guys are professionals - do a great job and have fair and reasonable prices and policies.

Pros:
- I was quite happy with the responsiveness and professionalism of the hosts.
- The check in process was perfect. Marcelo took the right amount of time to explain all of the key points of the apartment which helped us navigate it perfectly.
- The apartment security is also great - not onerous, but appropriate to have guests come in and out (they take a photo of you, tie it to your key and then they only let you in when your key matches your photo).
- They pre-stock with exactly what you need so you just need to make a quick grocery trip for specifics (comes with a water, toilet paper, coffee, tea, fresh fruit on the table etc).
- There are nice touches like fresh flowers in the bedroom and books to read
- It is exactly as pictured and (in general - see comment below) clean
- The view is absolutely stunning - the view was one of the reasons I chose this place, and was happy it was even better than expected
- One thing they don't advertise too much is you have access to a jacuzzi tub with beautiful views of the city on the top floor. We very much enjoyed it.
- The Skygym has amazing 270 views of the city and has enough equipment to get in a solid workout. I was most pleased with the pilates reformer.


Things to think about:
- There are floor to ceiling windows in the bedroom. Which is great. But then the window coverings are not sufficient to block out the light so you wake up with the full strength of the sun in the room which impeded our sleep until we got eye masks. If you stay here BRING AN EYEMASK.
- There are some things that show the wear and tear on the place. Specifically holes in the bathroom ceiling, other holes, dents etc.
- The bathroom always smelled like a urinal to me.
- Its very noisy. As in, I was woken up by my fiance washing dishes because any water running makes a lot of noise. You can hear your neighbors taking showers...pretty much everything makes noise. Not a big deal...just something to keep in mind.

All in all, we enjoyed it and would quite happily stay again at a BA4U property.
Excellent stay. Attentive host. Incredible place.
Very comfortable condo with amazing views. Worth the $$, would stay again.
El apartamento es realmente hermoso. Muy cómodo y el entorno es ideal. Excelente en todo sentido lo recomiendo al 100 por 100.
Great location, beautiful apartment, and accommodating host. Highly recommend.

Sergio was great and really easy to deal with. The apartment is in a good area. It was handy to have the bakery and bar just downstairs. The master bedroom has awesome views although second bedroom is quite small and dark. The water pressure in the shower is very low and the toilets didn't flush well. Otherwise we really enjoyed our stay.

Un posto bellissimo nel quartiere modaiolo di Palermo, con tanta vita sia di giorno che di notte. L'appartamento su due piani, arredato modernamente e con due camere al piano superiore, offre una vista incantevole su Buenos Aires senza essere rumoroso. Al piano superiore anche una piccola piscina, sicuramente piacevolissima d'estate. Tutto intorno all'edifico c'é tutto quello che puó servire in vacanza, dal panificio, al supermercato, al fruttivendolo ed alla birreria appena sotto casa, fino a locali e negozi di tutti i generi nelle immediate vicinanze. A pochi minuti ci sono Plaza Italia e i favolosi giardini di Buenos Aires, con il metro o con il taxi si raggiunge velocemente il centro.
Consigliatissimo!
Vale la pena 100%

Sergio's place is the nicest Airbnb apartment I have stayed in. Phenomenal view of the city. Walking distance from a bunch of good restaurants and cafes. Communication with Sergio was easy before hand. Would definitely recommend.
Very nice place to stay, in a safe location in Buenos Aires.
Nice place, good location.
Really good host.
Lovely place.   Will stay again.
Sergio's place is great.  It was spacious, clean and well appointed.  The location is great and makes a perfect base to explore the city.
Very nice place.

Our stay was very enjoyable, we loved the views out over the city especially at night time.
Sergio was very pleasant and easy to deal with.
We loved that there were plenty of restaurants nearby that offered a good choice of different cuisines.
The property itself was perfect for our requirements, very secure with a police presence in the area.
I would be more than happy to return in the future.

Sergio was fantastic.   I had flight cancellations arriving and departing, and he was extremely flexible and patient with my constantly changing travel plans.  On top of that, the apartment was beautiful, super clean, and in a great neighbourhood for walking to restaurants, bars, and shops.  I'd highly recommend staying here and with Sergio as your host.

Apartamento fantástico como anunciado. Camas confortáveis, limpo e vista espetacular. Localização perfeita, restaurantes deliciosos, padarias na mesma rua. Comunicação com o Sérgio foi muito boa e tranquila. Adoramos. Obrigada por tudo Sérgio!
Very good location, great apartment, excellent host.
Fantastic location and fabulous apartment. Perfect for 2 couples or a family.
Great place in an amazing location. I felt very safe in Sergio's place and we were very close to a bunch of great restaurants.

Schönes Appartment in schönem und sicheren Stadtteil von BA. Perfekt geeignet um von dort aus ein paar Tage die Stadt zu genießen. Super Ausblick auf die Stadt, sogar direkt vom Bett aus. Absolut sicher durch Hauswart. Gepäckaufbewahrung am Abflugtag hat problemlos geklappt. Sehr zu empfehlen.
100% recomendable para 2 parejas
As the pictures...great neighborhood...recommend this place to others for sure

I would come back to this apartment on a future visit to BA in a heartbeat. The location was great: just stroll down Goritti street for a huge number of bars/restaurants/cool stores, etc. There is also a great bakery right next door—and a gelato store across the street.

The apartment itself was absolutely wonderful. The view is great. There is a second shower and tub on the balcony (and still private, as there are no nearby buildings tall enough to see in) which is a nice touch.

Internet is reliable, but at 3MBPS down, 0.3 up, it will be slow if you need to upload any non-text based content.

The building is very safe and in a calm residential neighborhood. There is also a grocery store half a block away.

Serge was great and stayed in touch for the duration of the visit. We fell in love with BA, and will be back—and this is where we will stay again.
Located in Palermo Hollywood, it has great views of the city as well as nice vibe! The apartment is modern, spacious and well lit!

Sergio's place was really great, clean and in a fantastic part of town. He met me exactly when I arrived, was very communicative and helpful. There is more around here than you can probably check out in a few days, but it really is a fun neighborhood. Only good things to say!
El apartamento está excelentemente ubicado tiene mucho estilo y comodidad!
Un departamento muy recomendable.

Sergio's residence is in a really wonderful location, and it is both stylish and comfortable.  We loved the balconies for a glass of wine at night and the pool on the roof to cool down on a hot day.    Sergio was wonderful at communicating with us and ensuring everything was perfect.   Would definitely recommend!

Would highly recommend Ralf's apartment. It's a safe and secure building and has the most beautiful views of the city. We wish we could have stayed longer in this airbnb!

Plenty of towels and space for my boyfriend and I. And the location was ideal for walking.

Ralf and his team were magnificent with no details left unturned. Marcelo met with us at check in and walked us through EVERYTHING to the TEE!!! The rules, the building amenities, the process, security IDs, keys, the inner workings of the apartment, the wifi, the cable, identifying key points around the neighborhood including where to get the best FACTURAS, laundry recommendations...EVERYTHING!!!! They even provided a transportation card that made it EXTREMELY easy to ride the busses and subways/trains! I cannot wait to return to Buenos Aires and use these guys again! Thank you for the great experience!!!

La estancia en el departamento de Flor fue excelnte, ella muy amable y el lugar muy lindo, limpio y una ubicacion excelente, cerca de todos los puntos interesantes y de principal acceso hacia las atracciones de la Ciudad e Buenos Aires.-

Great host and great place. Very nice neighborhood. We walked for hours discovering new restaurants stores and buildings. Fashionable people and great architecture. Found our favorite coffee place nearby and they had amazing pastries. Would love to stay again.....also, the house is beautiful and clean. Very modern. Nice design touch. Great view of the neighborhood. A treat.
If you like nice design and a clean stylish apartment then this place is for you.

A great place to stay. An easy walk to Plaza Serrano and the underground tube is 7 minutes walk down the sane street. You can get anywhere in the city so easily!
Sergio is an incredible host. Attentive and organised and everything went absolutely smoothly. Not a glitch with any aspect. The place is great. We used the pool on rooftop and used the balcony bath daily. Loved Buenos Aires. One of the highlights was contacting Delta Unplugged ( check out their Facebook page or website or through TripAdvisor) who offer Parana Delta private tours on their boat. We got a private Taxi from the apartment all the way to Tigre and then had an amazing day in the delta. Other highlights was Plaza De Mayo on Thursday when the mothers of The Disappeared meet and march. Get out to San Telmo market too. All in all we had a fantastic time at this apartment and gave it and Sergio a full 5 stars. Thank you Sergio!

The condo is beautiful , amazing view. Great space, it is in the middle of dozens of bars, great restaurants and close to major attractions. We found 3 great restaurants so for those looking for steak houses, we found Las cabreras, Don Julio and Las Cabras, all within walking distance...about 10-15 mins. Sergio responded quickly to our whatsapp messages withour any issues. I highly recommend this place !
Melhor lugar para se estar em Buenos Aires: próximo dos melhores restaurantes e bares! O charme do apartamento do Sérgio faz juz ao de Palermo. Super recomendado!

Sergio's appartement is prima. Het ligt centraal in Palermo, op loopafstand van metro en bussen. Veel raturants etc in de buurt.

Appartement ligt op de 7e verdieping, met prachtig uitzicht. Is redelijk goed uitgerust.
Amazing flat with brilliant views of the city.  Very smartly decorated, lovely pool on the roof, 2 big bedrooms and the host was very nice and easy to communicate with.  Highly recommended

I would trade my apartment in NYC for Sergio's anytime. The rooms were very comfortable, airy and sunny.  It has a great unobstructed views from the living room and bedroom balconies of downtown Bs Ar. The building was very safe, lobby and individual floors very clean.  It was also very close to the Subte, centrally located to Palermo Soho, Palermo Viejo.  Many restaurants within walking distance.  I would give it 10 stars, if I could.  I highly recommend it.

Sergios apartment was in a wonderful location.  Great restaurants and bars within walking distance of the apartment.  Also a ten minute walk to the train station that gave us easy access to the city.  The apartment was very clean, safe and secure.  Sergio was very helpful and responsive to  every need.
Super recomendado en todo sentido el lugar es excelente, la zona la mejor que conocimos en buenos aires, cerca de bares restaurants y fiesta, el departamento esta increíble todo fuciona al 100%
We loved our stay here!

Sergio's gorgeous condo is the perfect spot to stay if you're visiting Buenos Aires and want to stay in Palermo. Tons of restaurants nearby, the Subte D Line is just a 10-15 minute walk away, and the condo is absolutely beautiful. Fantastic views from both decks were the perfect backdrop while we just read books and had Malbec before a night out. Sergio is very timely with responses, and he made us feel right at home. He even had a great guidebook with stellar recommendations for where to go out to shop, eat, and drink. We hope to visit again in the future!

O apartamento é muito bom: na parte superior são dois quartos com cama de casal e um banheiro que atende aos 2 quartos. Na parte inferior uma sala confortável e cozinha bem equipada. O Sérgio é muito atencioso, suas respostas são rápidas e o Júlio, vigia do prédio, é mais um apoio para quem está hospedado. Em relação a Palermo a localização é ótima, uma excelente padaria em frente ao prédio, bons restaurantes e supermercados próximos. Fica um pouco distante dos principais pontos turísticos de Buenos Aires como: Praça de Maio, Florida, Porto Madero, Caminito etc mas  a região é bem servida de serviço de taxi e Uber.

Flor was very kind on being there at the right time, waiting for us with the keys, orange juice and cookies =)
The house was clean, organized and had a very good smell (smell of home).
She really takes care of details, and although the place is not very big, has just everything you need for a good and comfy stay.
More than hosting us, she helped us since the beginning on gettin to the city in the cheapest and easiest way possible. She also speaks very good English, what helped a lot.
I tottally recommend the place and the host =)

Florencia is super helpful and her apartment is super clean and well located. The apartment has supermarkets, banks and other facilities nearby. Florence is a great host, we loved her :)

thanks for everything, Flor!
Clean and nicely equipped apartment.  Also very well located.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

I stayed 2 days in Florencia's apartment in Recoleta. The location is fantastic and the apartment is perfect. Small but very comfortable, it was Impeccably clean and fully equipped for a short stay. Flor is lovely and a very friendly and helpful host.

Fue un sueño, realmente maravilloso.Flor es un amor, un encanto, muy amable, el studio limpio, comodo, con muchos detalles, con todo lo necesario para sentirte en casa,muy bien ubicado tienes todo cerca.la ciudad es bellisima..

Flor is the model airbnb host.

She was there waiting at the time of my arrival. She explained everything about the apartment quickly & efficiently. She helped me book a taxi to the airport. She was there to collect the key at 5.30am in the morning, right on time, when we were leaving for the airport. She was exteremly pleasant, friendly & helpful. When I struggled a little with the wifi connection her husband came in within 20 minutes to help sort the issue out. When there was glitch late night with an electrical connection, her husband was at the doorstep first thing in the morning & the issues was resolved very quickly. In short, Flor & her husband are the perfect host & will be there, as soon as you need them.

The apartment itself is perfect for 2 people. Tastefully done up. The location is very convenient. The tea / coffee & the cookies were a great touch.

I would whole heartedly reccommend this place for anyone wanting to stay in Buenos Aires.

Florencia is a gem. Her apartment is unique and stylish. Not the kind of stylish that slaps you in the face but the kind that evolves as you see a clever vase for flowers, interesting pictures on the walls and the personal touch of someone that truly cares about her guests experience.

The apartment location is terrific. A few doors down is a small market. Restaurants are within walking distance and transportation. When we arrived, Florencia was waiting for us with keys and an infectious smile. She easily explained how things worked and then left us to our travels.
