We cooked in a kitchen that was well stocked and very efficient. It as a terrific experience.

We left in the midst of a torrential and unusually strong tropical storm but Florencia arrived at 5:30am to see us off. She walked the rain soaked streets with us to find a taxi and made sure the driver knew where to go and how much time we had.

Mi estancia en Buenos Aires, en el departamento de Florencia fue muy buena. Es super comodo y acojedor. Tiene todo lo que uno necesita cuando va de turista a pasear unos dias por la Capital.
La ubicacion es fantastica!!
Se los recomiendo!!!
Flor was the ideal host: Waiting for us to arrive late, always contactable and nice. Highly recommendable. thanks flor!

Florencia was a great host! She was able to accomodate our needs and provided a very clean and comfortable place to stay. She even stopped by half way through out stay to show us how to use the oven!

Her place is located between Recoleta and Palermo and is about a 20 minute walk to either one. I would recommend Florencia's apartment!

We had a wonderfull experience staying at Florence's apartment. She was there to greet us and showed us around very quickly. We found the apartment exactly as described and it was roomy with plenty of space for our 2 week stay.
It is decorated very nicely and the bed is comfortable. The area is great as you can walk every where and find lovely restaurants and grocery and fruit and vegetable places.
It was great to stay in one place when we took a 2 night stay to Aguazu Falls and day trips to Uruguay.
Florence was very helpful in booking car service to the airport when we had trouble with our phone and Spanish language.

We enjoyed our trip to Buenes Aires and staying in the apartment was so nice. Thank you Florencia for a great stay.
Accueil excellent lors de notre arrivée!

Foi tudo perfeito. Melhor lugar que já me hospedei em Buenos Aires.
O Ralf é um ótimo anfitrião, nos explicou absolutamente tudo com muita calma.
O prédio extremamente seguro e na melhor região de palermo.
O apartamento lindo e limpo. A vista é maravilhosa.
Recomendo muito!! Saudades da minha casa de Buenos. :)

We had a great time in Palermo. The flat has a brilliant location - right in Palermo - a great neighbourhood for walks, jogging, eating and obviously paying tribute to Evita. Our host Ralf left us a metro-card, so we immediately started to explore other parts of Buenos Aires. Ralf was a great host (from Hannover). Not only were we allowed to arrive earlier and leave later from the flat (compared to the normal terms); he also gave us good advice on restaurants in the neighbourhood. Everything we needed was in the flat, including good WIFI and a nice pool area. We will always cherish our memories of Christmas eve on the balcony, enjoying the Buenos Aires’ fireworks.
A wonderful place to stay! Palermo is a great neighborhood and we loved exploring. The place was impeccable and the host was very helpful. Would highly recommend!
El depto está super bien ubicado, la pileta es increíble, la climatización marcha genial. Lo recomiendo mucho
Excelente ubicación, excelentes instalaciones, muy cálida la recepción, realmente era lo que esperaba y está a la altura de la relación precio producto.

The apartment is amazing with a gorgeous view.  Interactions were friendly,  thorough, and professional. Everyone was so helpful.  The apartment is close to restaurants and night life,  but not too close!  Great amenities; they even have a transfer service to take you from the airport to the apartment.  I highly recommend this listing.
Super recomendable, tal cual aparece en las fotos.
Great Place

A escolha foi perfeita ! O apartamento é incrível, absolutamente limpo. bem localizado e equipado.
Lençóis e toalhas limpas e perfumadas. A vizinhança é cheia de opções para o dia e para a noite. Check in feito com pontualidade , segurança pelo simpático e competente Derlis . Recomendo e quero voltar nas minhas próximas férias em Buenos Aires para esse mesmo apartamento.

This is a great apartment.  On previous trips to BA I have stayed at apartments in the downtown area because of easy proximity to my work location, but on this occasion decided to stay in the cool/hip Palermo neighbourhood so that I could get to know it a little better.  I was not disappointed!
Great apartment in an awesome neighborhood. Ralf was really helpful pointing out the best restaurants and even set us up with a taxi to/from the airport. Definitely recommend.
Buena ubicación, barrio tranquilo. Buena conectividad con la ciudad y hermosa vista.

The host were absolutely incredible! They went above and beyond; were very responsive to questions, recommendations requests and made sure we had a wonderful time. Great location, close to the subtle, local bars and restaurants. I would 100% recommend this place, es la posta!

Sergio was Extremely Amazing as was His beautiful apartment ! I will definitely be returning to Argentina to his Location because he was very helpful and extremely accommodating! Thank You Sergio for everything Your Place was Amazing

Close to everything in walking distance Nightlife super cheap Uber’s and supermarkets
A great place in a great location. Would happily stay there again.

This place is amazing the views especially during sunset are incredible. I am in BA often and this have been my favorite spot! Sergio was a great host, my schedule was crazy with meetings and he accommodated me for check in and out etc. The apartment is chic, relaxing and comfortable. The neighbor is great I can’t wait to stay here next time I am back in BA!

Sergio's apartment is breath taking and very safe! The view is even more lovely in person than it looks in the pictures. The entire building is clean and centrally located. Sergio is kind and informative. He was always there to help when my family and I needed him. I would recommend his place to anyone!

Sergio’s place is very hip and modern right in the heart of Palermo. Lots of shops, restaurants, and bars within a short walk. The apartment was immaculately clean and included tremendous views of the city from the terraces. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to stay in Palermo!
Very stylish pad. Nice view too. All items in house in excellent condition.

We loved the apartment - clean and fresh, with great views. It is certainly well positioned, with easy access to transport, restaurants and some of BA's special parks.
We especially enjoyed Marcelo's informative - and very entertaining - introduction to the apartment's facilities and the whys and wherefores of the city!
One minor hiccup - we had arranged for a late checkout, but early afternoon received a call that the apartment was needed for a last-minute booking and we had to vacate. That spoiled our last few hours in town a little bit and we suggest that a more appropriate system is put in place.
But that aside, we would highly recommend Ralf's place.
Excelente departamento, ningún punto en contra. Muy amable atención de Ralf pese a haber alquilado con pocas horas de anticipación, siempre buena predisposición. Muy recomendable!

O apartamento é perfeito para um casal. Super limpo e bem decorado, com uma vista linda. O prédio é novo e tem porteiro 24h.
A localização é ótima! Dá para ir andando a qualquer lugar em Palermo Soho e Palermo Hollywood. Eu diria que o ideal seria se fosse um pouco mais próximo da Plaza Serrano, que é onde tudo acontece em Palermo Soho. Mas mesmo assim, a localização é incrível.
Tem metro (subte) perto, o que também facilita bastante. Ah, no apartamento tem um cartão do SUBE para os hóspedes usarem, assim não é preciso comprar um.
Fomos super bem recebidos pelo Marcelo, que ficou nos esperando até tarde e nos deu todas as dicas de como nos virar na cidade. O Ralf fez o nosso check out e também foi muito solicito.
Enfim, eu super recomendo e voltaria a esse apartamento.
Ralph est un hôte exceptionnel. Il est très sympathique et arrangeant. Je recommande grandement ses appartements
Great unit and well located. Sergio is a great host.
Great apartment, good location

We stayed at Sergio's amazing home for a month and absolutely loved it.  The views are better than pictured and it has everything you will need to be blissed out in Buenos Aires.  The location is incredible and Palermo Hollywood is full of outstanding bars and restaurants just waiting to be explored.  The double balcony, views, and modern touches of this apartment were very hard to part with.  I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

The apartment 's location is very good, there is a lot of restaurants around. This is a rent apartment with a modern still. The description is correct. We had a problem with the air conditioner and the toilet and sergio helped us very quickly. Maybe the cleaning could be done more.
Todo excelente y conforme lo mostrado y convenido .
Amazing apartment as we were expecting - modern and comfy. Stunning view and well located. Would definitely stay there again!
Excelente departamente, ubicado dentro de una gama amplia de restaurant y muy cerca de Palermo soho. Muy recomendable.
tudo ótimo, mega bem decorado e com comodidades incríveis pelo bairro.

For our first visit to Buenos Aires we could not have chosen a more ideal location. An amazing apartment with awesome city views. Early check-in went very smoothly and the apartment facilities were second to none. Would highly Recommended.

O apartamento do Sergio é de muito bom gosto, tanto o projeto, quanto a decoração. A localização é muito boa, com excelentes opções de restaurantes, padarias e de lazer no entorno próximo. O anfitrião é extremamente simpático e solícito!! Altamente recomendado!

Lovely 2 bedroom penthouse in a quiet neighborhood of Palermo. Walking distance to cafes, restaurants and bars.
However if you are looking to be near the tourist spots then this is a bit far (20-25 can ride), although we love walking so it was not an issue and it was always nice to come back to a quiet part of the city!
Amenities are very basic so plan on doing some basic shopping if you plan to have coffee/tea or cook at home.

We loved this apartment. It was spotlessly clean, very well equipped and in a great location. We are a family of four - with two teenage girls - and it worked very well for us.

And the view of the sunrise over the city from the bedroom window is spectacular!

If you like being in a neighbourhood with great coffee shops, bars and restaurants in walking distance, you will love this place. It is not a noisy area though and the apartment was very quiet and secure.

It’s within a few blocks walk of the Subte station which was easy to use and gets you straight into the centre of town.

We will definitely book again if we come back to Buenos Aires. Highly recommended.
Fantastic location, wonderful property. Would highly recommend

We loved our 2 weeks stay at Sergios wonderful holiday home. The 2 private terraces with an outdoor shower on one of them and the view made for a really nice stay. Commnication with Sergio made it very easy, his housekeeper met us there with the key and he followed up to make sure everything was ok. The location in Palermo Hollywood was perfect, close to lots of resutrants and a great bakery for fresh bread every morning is in the same building at the corner. it is located between 2 subte lines and there are busses a few blocks away to take you anywhere in the city you want to go. One of our favorite things were the black out blinds in the master bedroom. The apartment faces east for beautiful sunrises but not being a morning person, i really appreciated that there were black out blinds and that they even had velcro on them so that you could close them completely - a nice touch! We would absolutely stay here again.
Place with beautiful view. I felt safe. Loved the bakery downstairs for delicious breakfast.
Sergio’s home is perfection. Not only perfectly clean, the views from all balconies are a sight to see. Centrally located to all things you’d want to do/see in Palermo. Highly recommend.

Great location! great view of the city!
The apartment is in a great location, sparking clean with great views. Sergio went out of his way to help us get Pesos as the banks refused to cash our money and ATM had long lines.
Highly recommend it.
Great place! Thank you Sergio!

A very pretty and neat place, the location was in very great place not very touristy but still have a lot of walking distance restaurants and bars. Close to some cool stuff in the neighborhood. Definitely recommended if you ever staying in Buenos Aires. Sergio is very responsive and checks in almost every day.

Great place to stay while in BA! Amazing location in Palermo. Right next to many cool bars and restaurants. The terrace and deck have amazing views of the city. We really enjoyed our time at Sergio’s apartment. I would 100% recommend staying here.

It was the second time that I stayed in this apartment and it was as perfect as the first one. Ralf and team are no-doubt super hosts and the apartment is cozy, perfectly equipped and in optimum location. Recommended in every possible aspect. I have in fact made a new booking with Ralf already!

Ralf's place will make you fall in love with Buenos Aires if you were not already. Awesome views from a perfectly styled boutique apartment that looks better in person than the images.
Attention to detail and help for anything at your fingertips
You cannot go wrong with a Ralf apartment

Buena Vista is a perfect retreat for your stay in Palermo Hollywood of Buenos Aires. The property is beautiful and is perfectly represented exactly as pictured. The views are incredible and the apartment is nicely furnished with everything you will need for your stay.

We spent almost 2 weeks here and were even able to cook a beautiful Christmas dinner for ourselves and a friend traveling with us.

Ralph is the perfect host and greets you with a big smile and all the information you will need to be comfortable in Palermo. He produces a multipage list of great shops, restaurants, and coffee shops in the area with an accurate description of what to expect. To make you visit even more enjoyable he left a SUBE (mass transit) card with some funds on it to get you started.

Great location and SUBE Underground Station just a couple blocks away. The Buenos Aires people are the friendliest and most helpful you will ever find. Even if you don't speak Spanish everyone will bend over to work out communications.

An excellent choice for staying in Buenos Aires’ Palermo District. A stylish flat on the 13th floor offering great views of the city, with all amneties, good WiFi and access to pool and gym (on 31st floor!) included. Close to great restaurants (Pizarro, Carneceria etc.), just a couple minutes from the metro and a short walk into Palermo’s shopping and entertainment areas. All comes with a great host who’s been extremely efficient and helpful in all communications and interactions. Yes, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay here.
Todo perfecto!. Nos recibió Marcelo, muy atento y ocupándose para que tengamos una muy buena estadia. El departamento y los servicios son de primera. Lo recomendamos totalmente.

El departamento está en una gran ubicación y la seguridad es muy buena.  El A/C de la sala no funcionaba cuando llegamos y lo repararon al día siguiente.  Sentimos que al departamento le falta un poquito de mantenimiento, no obstante, estaba bastante limpio y sus anfitriones fueron muy muy amables con nosotros.

Ralfs apartement was great. We stayed for 10 days and loved it. The location is perfectly set in palermo (hip neighborhood with lots of cafes bars and restaurants). The accommodation with its "over -the- roofs- of buenos- aires- gym" and the beautiful pool left us speechless. Also ralph left us a guide with the best restaurants and cafe tips which kind of ended up as our itinerary for the stay.

This stylish apartment is ideally located in the Palermo neighborhood walking distance to hip bars, cafes, and lounges. Ralf was very hospitable and easy to communicate with. We needed to do laundry the last few days, and instead he recommended a reasonable 'wash, dry, fold' place just a few steps away, giving us time to further explore the city. The Plaza Italia subway station is just a block and a half away, and just 3 blocks to the Distrito Arcos shopping mall. We would definitely stay here again.

I have stayed at Ralf's apartments many times. He and his staff are by far the best in Buenos Aires and the apartments always top quality with incredible attention. A 5 plus star rating!!  Thank you Ralf!
Great safe location amazing views.

I stayed at Palermo Uno for one week and it was great for everything.
Location is close to Subway station and supermarket as well. And Ralf’s team prepare SUBE card for transportation. That is great kind for tourist.
I really appreciated Ralf’s team. I highly recommend this apartment!

What a wonderful place! The apartment is beautiful, clean, and big! As a solo traveler, Marcelo was VERY helpful when I missed my first flight. Not only did he go over every detail of the apartment, but he explained so much about Buenos Aires — how to get around, safety, where to explore, and what to watch out for. From the bus card, to an umbrella, this apartment also has every little detail down! I’d recommend for anyone, but especially for first time travelers to Buenos Aires. The high rise apartment and gated building is so great!

This apartment is right in the heart of Palermo, close to both the main thoroughfare and to the excitement of Palermo SoHo. The building itself is extraordinarily secure and has an excellent gym and spa. We were greeted by Marcelo, who gave us a wonderful and complete introduction to all of the amenities and practical aspects of the apartment. Views are spectacular and the kitchen was well equipped. Ralf and his team were very accommodating with check-out and arranging for transfers. All-in-all, a great experience.

The flat is small (enough for 2 people), nice and comfortable. And the owners are very helpful and nice!

The flat is 5 minutes walking to the metro and there are a lot of buses next to the flat going to the turistic spots (Boca, San Telmo, Puerto Madero, etc). There are also supermarkets, restaurants and bars at the area of the flat which is colliding Recoleta and Palermo.

The AC works perfect and the bed is comfortable! Kitchen is well-equipped :)

What a wonderful place to stay!  Checking in was very convenient and Flor was waiting to show us the ins and outs of the apartment upon our arrival. I would recommend staying with here if you want to be within walking / metro distance from all the action in BA but still want a quiet place to make a relaxing meal and just have a quiet night.  Thanks Flor!

Florencia's place was lovely as is her kind assistance.  We arrived in on Christmas eve and she was kind enough to meet us, we were greeted with a friendly smile, mini Christmas tree and homemade cookies- the perfect start to our stay.  All our questions leading up to and during our trip were answered promptly.  The apartment itself is located in a great neighborhood, close to everything!  I highly recommend making this apartment your base during your trip to Buenos Aires.

Just had a four night stay at Sergio’s apartment. It was exactly as described and has stunning views of the city. Hollywood Palermo is such a beautiful neighbourhood with a truly amazing selection of good quality restaurants selling excellent food at reasonable prices.  It is not a tourist area and that makes it all the more enjoyable. The locals are really friendly and welcoming. Sergio was super responsive with ALL communication and also went out of his way to help us out with some local currency as all of the ATMs were empty due to the long public holiday weekend.  This was really kind and was truly appreciated. If you are travelling to Buenos Aires, take some US$ (preferably crisp notes) which are exchanged in most places. Credit card is accepted in the majority of larger restaurants. THANK YOU SERGIO

We loved Sergio’s place. It is very well located and our host had great restaurant recommendations. Highly recommend it.

Sinceramente el lugar es fantástico, moderno, llena de detalles delicados, todo funciona, Sergio es un anfitrión muy espectacular, tienes todo a mano cafés, mini Market, restaurantes, y mucho más, lo recomendamos sinceramente!! el barrio es espectacular, la gente es cordial muchas gracias Sergio por recibirnos en tu casa!! VOLVEREMOS TOTALMENTE RECOMENDADO!!
Great place in the heart of Palermo Hollywood!   Sergio is a great host and very accommodating to our schedules.   The apartment was perfect!

Buena comunicación, una ubicación muy buena con fácil acceso a la movilidad pública, a pesar de tener un auto rentado, preferimos utilizar el servicio público por lo fácil y cómodo que nos quedó debido a la ubicación, lugar bastante seguro, todo estuvo perfecto.

Sergio's apartment was very nice and in a great location. He was very helpful with local tips and also helped me out when I left my sunglasses at his place. The apartment has great views over Palermo and so does the communal rooftop which would be very nice in summer. Adequate amount of towels too.

Perfect location in the middle of many great dining and night life options (walking and Uber)!

Sergio did an outstanding job of communicating with me and even made sure I was able to get to the listing even though I had lost my phone in the previous country I was visiting and was unable to confirm anything while in my trip.

The home was clean and perfect to sit have a glass of wine on the patio!

Thank you Sergio!

I highly recommend Sergio's apartment in BA!  The building is located on a quiet street in Palermo Hollywood that is just a couple of blocks from all of the action. The apartment itself is gorgeous - tons of space and has a stunning view of the BA skyline.  The unit is also very secure with key fob access into and out of the building.  We had an amazing stay with Sergio!
Fantastic place to stay in. Sergio has a book full of many recommendations. The location is perfect and communication was great. Highly recommend!
Excellent location ! Sergio was great , awesome time in Buenos Aires , definitely I would recommend this apartment 👍

This was my 1st AirBnb, and because of Sergio’s place, the bar has been set high.

The penthouse is So immaculate, I don’t believe the pics do it justice. The balcony views at night continued to remind me and my friends , “We Live a Great Life, and We are in Buenos Aires!”

Sergio’s place is located in a prime area in Palermo Hollywood. It’s literally blocks away from all of the happening bars as well as some great shopping.

Easily my best airbnb experience! Great location, the place is clean and well maintained, just enough natural lighting and Flor was such a great host. I was there during summertime and hardly turned the air-conditioner on. Highly recommend this place.

Florencia nous a très bien accueillis à Buenos Aires. Souriante et accueillante, elle parle parfaitement anglais pour les novices en espagnol. Son petit appartement est soigné, décoré avec goût et dans un quartier vivant et charmant. On recommande fortement !!

This apartment exceeded all our expectations and we loved the Palermo vibe. And the excellent fitness centre at the 31st floor gave us a chance to work off the Argentinian menu...

We hope to return soon!

Great location! Amazing apartment view, very clean and safe. Marcelo was detailed and quick at check in. All the recommendations you could want, there is a pool open on the warmer months. I will book again on our next trip!!

This is a fabulous apartment in BA because it has tremendous views of the city and water.   The location is ideal as you are so close to the bus and subway stops, taxis run right down the street plus near so many great restaurants. We liked exploring the many BA parks especially the rose garden in full bloom.  Palermo SOHO has a neighborhood feel.  The host was very responsive and the building very safe.
highly recommend!

This is a truly great place to stay in the best part of BA. Marcelo checked us in with excellent tips to make our stay very special. The apartment itself is beautiful and the building quite glamorous. The views are spectacular. We were very comfortable and couldn’t wish for anything more.

Staying at this apartment will certainly make anyone’s experience of the incredible city of Buenos Aires even better.

Light, spacious and secure, the apartment is the perfect place to come back to after a long day. It has all the amenities that you would expect and all are in good working order. We had a slight problem with some of the television channels and whilst it couldn’t be fixed in time before our departure, Ralf was extremely responsive and helpful in trying to sort it out. Overall, the whole team went above and beyond to help us and make sure we had a comfortable and easy stay.

I wouldn’t say it is the quietest place given we could occasionally hear people talking in the apartment above and next door so make sure you bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper. I must stress however that I am pretty sensitive to noise and it didn’t bother me significantly enough to make a complaint.

The gym is excellent and having it on the 31st floor made for a very memorable few workouts during our stay - the views are insane.

The location is absolutely perfect, with Palermo Soho and Hollywood a short walk away but also by being by Plaza Italia, there are fantastic bus and subte links (for which a card is provided for).

I lived in Buenos Aires ten years ago and didn’t think I could love the city any more but staying at this place proved me wrong.

Thank you Ralf and team, we are looking forward to staying in another property of yours when we return to BA in a week!

Ralf’s apartment is the perfect place to stay in Buenos Aires. The location is great with lots of bars and restaurants nearby and Ralf has lots of great recommendations too. The apartment is just as it looks in the pictures and the pool area offers a great place to relax. I would highly recommend to anyone looking to visit this wonderful city.

fantastic host, location and service.  I highly recommend staying in this apartment.  The communication was excellent and there were so many thoughtful touches.  THE VIEW and location were the best of my stay in Bs As.  Make sure to see the view from the gym and call to reserve a jacuzzi on the top floor.  Thank you so much for the hospitality!

This place is great! It's about a 10-15 minute walk (depending on how fast you are) to some of the main bar / restaurant areas within Palermo Soho, but still has a couple places just a block or two away. Ralf was a great host, very responsive, gave great recommendations, and was very accommodating with our check in and check out times. We would definitely stay again!

This place is absolutely perfect. Very safe, will everything you could dream of (gym with a view, swimming-pool, very modern flat). Communication with Ralf and Marcelo has always been fast and good. The flat is located in Palermo, which is convenient when you want to go out at night or discover the city in daylight. The place is very clean and these even a basket full of fruits and drinks to welcome you as if you were staying at friends. Great great place !

Fantastic apartment within a very stylish and well maintained building. Ralf is a great host, it’s the 3rd time we’ve stayed in his apartments. This is the best location and the apartment is comfortable and a great base for exploring the city. It has super air conditioning, comfortable bed, great views from the balcony etc. We had a wonderful stay and will certainly be back for a 4th visit sometime!
the apt is very comfortable. great view. very safe. the location is very good the rrstaurants and public trans. The hosts Raif and Marcelo werr excellent. Responsive and caring. i revommend.

This was a beautiful space and very proximate to many bars and restaurants. Check in was super easy and our host was very helpful in explaining everything about the apartment. The space itself was gorgeous — floor to ceiling windows throughout. Highly recommended!

Host was very helpful.  Accommodated to flight changes when my flight was delayed to the following day and was very quick to respond.  The apartment was beautiful, very clean and had an amazing view of Buenos Aires.  I would certainly recommend anyone thinking of visiting Buenos Aires to rent this apartment out.
Un departamento bien ubicado en Palermo, con facilities y seguridad y muy biena atencion del equipo de Ralf. Muchas gracias!

Verry nice place. Near subway and all transports. The view is awsome ! The perfect place to visit BA. Don't hesitate to take contact with Ralf. He's always kind and reactive. That was a pleasure for us !
Great place, convenient location, great views, nice gym in the building - I would stay again, highly recommended
Muy buen apto

We had a great stay at the flat. Everything went flawlessly : starting with the communication prior to arrival.
The apartment is well located with stunning views and excellent security.
Marcelo is a wonderful guy and welcomed us with details about the flat and neighborhood. Highly recommended and would stay there again
Ralf's place is amazing. Full of light, great view. Very comfortable. Very good building and amenities. Great host, paid attention to every detail and made us feel at home.

This place was amazing! This was my first solo trip, and as a woman that can be very nerve-wracking. I felt very safe here and had an amazing time in BA! The 24 hr security is awesome. If I went out at night, I would call a cab via Cabify and just wait behind the gate until they arrived. You can do laundry in the building, but according to Marcelo, it is a bit of a process. He recommended just using the laundry service around the corner. It was painless! I dropped off my laundry and picked it up the next day clean, folded, and wrinkle-free for around $3 USD. Amazing. Also, one of the best bistros in Palermo Soho is a block and a half away! Las Pizarras Bistro is AMAZING. I ate dinner there so many times. I would 100% stay here again. It is in a quiet/more residential part of the neighborhood and less than 10 blocks from all of the action of Palermo Soho.

This was our second time at one of Ralf’s apartments. The experience was perfect, again! Everything clean, the place is exactly as the photos show. Excellent reception. Perfect location. We will be back next time we travel to BsAs, for sure.

Ralf's apartment is truly gorgeous and well-located. Marcelo met me during check-in and was very thorough with his walkthrough of the place; he even sent someone over within minutes when we had a small issue that we could not figure out. Breakfast (get medialunas and facturas from Bellas Artes) on the balcony is a must.
El departamento es muy completo en todo sentido, y Ralph y Marcelo súper eficientes y serviciales, muy buena experiencia.
Excellent host and an amazing location. Host provided excellent recommendations about the local area.

Great location for proximity to the subte and Palermo soho and Hollywood without being in the middle of the craziness. Also great having security gate, good gym upstairs. Pool opened after my stay unfortunately and quite a bit of noise from the upstairs tenant. But Ralf did his best to address that quickly, took it seriously and took steps over and above what others may have done in same situation. Good amount of space in the unit, comfortable bed and great location and a pretty great view!!
Great location and really easy to communicate with Ralf.
Excelente departamento. Solo lleven tapa ojos para dormir

We had a wonderful stay in this apartment. First of all, the view is spectacular from every room, and it was great sitting on the the balcony overlooking the city on the 13th floor. It was beautiful day and night.

The apartment itself is centrally located in Palermo, close to Jardín Botánico, and lots of shopping. Palermo in general is very picturesque. It was also very well-equipped, and had very nice touches like live plants and fresh flowers. And MOST importantly, the bed and the pillows were very comfortable!

We were met at our arrival by Marcelo, who took time and care in explaining every relevant detail of the apartment, as well as providing us with many helpful tips about the neighborhood. He was awesome. :)

It was a great stay overall, and we enjoyed coming home every night to our beautiful apartment!

El departamento de Ralph es el segundo que conozco de los que ofrece en AIRBNB. El primero fue simplemente SENSACIONAL, pero en mi nuevo viaje estaba ocupado. Motivo por el cual elegí otro departamento, con otro Host. La experiencia fue desagradable (el departamento no era tal cual las fotos) y cancelé mi reserva (Airbnb nos reintegro el total de la reserva) y en ese  momento decido comunicarme con Marcelo (quien maneja los departamentos de Ralph) para saber si habría algún dpto disponible donde alojarnos con urgencia (ya que nos quedábamos sin hospedaje). No sólo el departamento era de verdad ESPECTACULAR, sino que Marcelo hizo que todo fuera maravilloso!! Desde el ingreso inmediato al depto, hasta los detalles y su predisposición. Realmente vuelvo a elegir mil veces mas a este equipazo de personas impecables y resolutivas!! MUCHAS GRACIAS POR TODO!!!
Lugar muy recomendable. Buena ubicación, muy lindo departamento y excelente atención por parte del anfitrión
Buena ubicacion, Lindo apartamento, limpio y exelente ateción ! Todo funcionó bién, muchas gracias Ralf !
Amazing place, amazing host ! 100% recommended, beautiful, clean and full equipped apartment, definitely I will come back.
A perfect view for a perfect time. Apartment is spacious for 2 or 3 people. Right amount of space too to work remotely.

Ralf and his team were giving everything to make my stay perfect. Very friendly and easy communication!

The apartment was very clean and equipped with every necessaries reaching from iron boards to a hair dryer. The view from the apartment and the gym at the top of the building was definitely the highlight.

I will for sure come back - thank you!

Excelente apartamento y excelente trato personal y distendido.
Pasamos un tiempo agradable en este hermoso apartamento en Buenos Aires.

WOW - our stay gets a 15 on a scale of 1-10. The physical place is better than the photos (if that is possible). When we were not in the city or at the pool - we spent many hours on the incredible breezy and beautiful terrace. The apartment has the perfect location. It is centrally located and walking distance to every possible shop, restaurant and night club (even post office and grocery store!). It is also close to the best parks and Japanese gardens. However, Ralf's service is really A+. In matters both large and small - he and his staff were incredibly responsive and helpful from arrival to departure.  We thoroughly enjoyed our entire stay and hope to book a longer stay next time to spend more time in Palermo - a vibrant, friendly and welcoming neighborhood.
Beautiful apartment, bright, well equipped and in a very secure building.  The Palermo area is perfect for exploring Buenos Aires.  The welcome from the Ralf team was impeccable. Thanks!

Even more beautiful than the pictures! I absolutely adored this place, and hope to have the opportunity to stay again in the future. The views are unparalleled, the sunshine in the morning is simply intoxicating, and Marcelo and Ralf are incredible hosts!!! Extra special thanks to them too for accommodating my specific check-in and checkout needs.

Staff was receptive and always available to answer concerns. Bedroom AC was broken the first two nights, but was resolved and complementary fare to the airport was offered. The view is also wonderful.

I stayed in this place for 4 weeks. Its a beautiful apartment in Palermo. It has amazing view of the city from all windows with a cute balcony you can enjoy sitting on .  The apartment is very nice and clean with a big tv, Netflix and etc. The bathroom is all nice and clean . The manager’s office is in the same building which makes things much easier if you need something. The whole management team were very nice and helpful and always available. I loved my stay there and for  sure will stay there again on my next trip.  I totally recommend this place if  you are one or two people.

O apartamento é num prédio bem novo e a vista da sala faz toda a diferença na estadia. É bem equipado, limpinho e silencioso, com cama confortável e chuveiro ótimo. Ao redor tem vários restaurantes, cafés e supermercados que facilitam muito. Adoramos tudo!
Great place on the edge of Palermo, walking distance to everything and a great view!

Sergio's apartment is in a great location and quite safe. Sergio and his team were super easy to communicate with and very helpful. The balcony is a special treat to take in BA, a glass of wine, and a beautiful sunset. Definitely recommend staying at Sergio's place.

We absolutely loved this apartment!! I’ve stayed all over the city of Buenos Aires and this is by far one of my favorites. The combination of a beautiful apartment, incredible cleanliness, my favorite neighborhood in the whole city, and a balcony with gorgeous views is just unbeatable. It’s so nice and bright inside and the bakery downstairs has great empanadas. Plus Sergio has a fantastic list of local recommendations and was incredibly helpful when we had to change our plans last minute. 100% recommend!

Stylish and modern apartment in a beautiful neighborhood. Everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Sergio was accommodating and responsive, and offered great insider tips for places to explore around the city. Would definitely choose again on future trips!

We had a very pleasant stay in the wonderful flat of Sergio. The view, from the balcony of the living, and the terrace in the main room, is just amazing. Having showers in the bathtub outside was just fun and exceptional. My parents were here for the first time, and it was a great way for them to discover the city and have a vision of Buenos Aires. The location is perfect in Palermo, next to one of our favorite italien restaurant, "Cocina Paradiso". The flat is very luminous, clean, functional and convenient, even if the second room is a bit small, and you have to share the bathroom, which is pretty. Sergio is very reactive and nice, even if we didn't meet. He left a cradle in the flat for our 4 months Baby, and we felt at home. Thank you again Sergio!

A perfect place with a gorgeous view and well equipped with all things necessary. Situated in Palermo, a very comfortable neighborhood. Good communication and even help with booking a taxi for three o’clock in the morning.

This space is it. Modern and elegant. Smack dab in the middle of Hollywood Palermo. You can’t walk twenty steps without coming upon a funky bar or an amazing restaurant or a cool cafe. Two stories, two terraces, an outdoor tub and shower and to die for views. A large modern bathroom as well as a ground floor powder room. Why would anyone choose anywhere else? Thank you, Sergio, for sharing your spectacular home. See you next year!
Amazing place to stay in Buenos Aires.
Muy buen depto, con todas las comodidades en una muy buena zoe de Palermo. Sergio fue un anfitrión excelente. Gracias
Amazing stay! Perfect location and very impressive views. Definitely recommend!
Vista increíble, departamento cómodo, edificio en buen estado y con amenities que suman. La atención de Sergio, excelente.
El departamento está impecable; mejor aún que en las fotos. La zona es de lo mejor de Bsas y la atención del anfitrión fue de lujo. SÚPER RECOMENDABLE!!!
¡Excelente atención de Sergio! Logra responder de inmediato y está atento para brindar un gran servicio. Super cordial y amable para coordinar ingreso/egreso, y muy atento a que todo esté en orden.
Great place to stay
Sergio es un anfitrión excelente
Tiene excelente ubicación, varias opciones de restaurantes alrededor. La vista es extraordinaria. El departamento es muy lindo, bien decorado y tiene todo lo necesario.
Excelente todo, súper recomendable !
Sergio was a great communicator throughout the stay. His place was clean and as described. We really enjoyed the space & views. Got a few Instagram posts out of it :)

sergio’s apartment was perfect! it was just like in the pictures and the neighborhood was awesome! in walking distance to so many bars and restaurants and a cool, hip neighborhood! he was very responsive with all our questions and accommodated us with all our needs. so helpful and generous!
Beautiful apartment, Sergio was very helpful! Perfect location!

An awesome penthouse will everything you need to visit Buenos Aires!  The beds are real comfortable, the water pressure is excellent.  The view Is incredible.  The rooftop pool is great to take a dip and even though its shared, we were able to enjoy all to ourselves.  Sergio is a great guy, so easy to communicate with.  We enjoyed reserving and our time spent here.  Ty for sharing! We will return!

Olá! Nossa experiência no apartamento de Florencia foi excelente. Flor é uma pessoa muitoooooo simpática, agradável e atenciosa. Antes de embarcamos entramos em contato com ela, que nos passou muitas informações uteis sobre a cidade, passeios, clima e dicas.
O apartamento é exatamente como está na fotos, muito limpo, aconchegante e tinha tudoooooo a nossa disposição: ferro de passar, secador de cabelo, toda a louça, microondas, cafeteira, toalhas, adaptadores de tomada, mapas da cidade, enfim...
A região onde está localizado o apartamento é seguro, não houve qualquer problema e andávamos até tarde. Perto há uma padaria, frutaria e há uma quadra vários restaurantes.O shopping Alto Palermo está muito perto há duas ruas atras do apartamento.
Não me arrependo, se voltar a Buenos Aires certamente irei novamente.

The apartment was exactly as described. It is nicely furnished and very clean.  The location is perfect for exploring the city and upscale and safe. Our hosts were great. We were late on our arrival and had to check out very early in the morning, our host were so nice and accomodating. I had a great stay and highly recommend the apartment. Florencia and Damien are a pleasure to deal with.

Fantastic 2 bed apartment in Palermo with 2 balconies with views over Buenos Aires (including a plunge pool/outdoor bath off the main bedroom) and a rooftop pool to cool off in. Sergio was a great host, excellent with communication before, during and after our stay with an easy check in (thanks Julia) and a friendly doorman. The apartment is in a safe and fantastic location with many bars, restaurants, supermarkets and site-seeing activities in the immediate vicinity or within a short taxi ride. Complimentary washing machine (just need to bring your own washing powder) in the upstairs communal area  - note there isn't a dryer but we used the clothes horse in the apartment (can also hang clothes on the terrace by the washing machines) and our clothes dried in no time. We just wished our stay was longer and will definitely be back!
Lovely flat in a great area. Good check in process and timely communication from the host. Highly recommend.
Great spot, the balconies are amazing and the outdoor space has a great view!
todo correcto, muy buena ubicación y vistas increíbles, repetiría

The location of this place is very central and most things are within 10-15 minute walking distance. The views are fantastic both during the day and at night (there are balconies on both floors)
There is an outdoor bathtub, which was great for late night soaking while watching the moon and the stars. The wind can get a little crazy, but as long as you keep the doors locked, you'd be ok. Everything in the apartment was very clean and organized. Sergio made sure to communicate on time both via AirBNB & WhatsApp and even let us check in a bit early. Overall we had a great experience.

amazing stay
recommend 100%
Great place to stay in Palermo Hollywood, Sergio is a perfect host

Sergio’s place is well appointed and located in a quiet part of Palermo. I come to Argentina every year on business and typically stay in Recoleta. I really enjoyed changing it up this year and staying in Sergio’s apartment. Everything was exactly as advertised and he was exceptionally communicative and helpful every step of the way. I highly recommend staying at his apartment.

We traveled to Buenos Aires for 4 days - I had been there before and knew I wanted to stay in Palermo.

This apartment from Sergio was 5 stars across the board.. location, value, the balcony, amenities, everything. We had an absolute blast and really enjoyed our stay. He was very responsive and we stayed in contact the whole way.

If I'm going back to BA then I'm staying at Sergio's place again.
Sergio’s apartment was lovely and exactly as pictured. Very clean with great views and a cool vibe. Prime neighbourhood. I would live there myself!

The apartment was in a great location with amazing restaurants within walking distance.   It was very clean and we liked the two levels for living and a second for sleeping making the space very appealing.  Sergio was a great host!
Genial todo! El departamento es increíble! La pasamos bárbaro! Muchas Gracias
Sergio was a great host and made sure we had everything we needed. The apartment was amazing! Great views of the city and close to tons of restaurants and bars. 10/10 recommend.
Excellent stay in Buenos Aires, the apartment was beautiful with a lovely view of the city. Check in was very smooth and Sergio was easy to get in touch with at all times

Ok, first, the description of the neighborhood doesn't do it justice. It is so unbelievably full of places to eat, drink, shop and explore it is better than a lot of the trendier area's, think Recoleta, as it is quieter and easier to walk around. Sergio was in non stop contact and check in was a breeze. I am so happy we stayed here and am trying to figure out when I can return and stay for an extended period of time. The place is quiet, clean, and has everything you could want. Don't hesitate to stay here as it is one of my all time favorite AirBnB stays ever!

Spectacular place! Spectacular location! Sergio a wonderful guy… Went out of his way to help us with a late check in of 2 am because of a cancelled flight…. The neighborhood is just fantastic! Will be back soon!! Gracias mi hermano Sergio…

This was a fantastic place to stay. Sergio was so friendly and helpful. The apartment is just as it appears in the photos with a gorgeous view.

The location is also fantastic with many cafés, coffee shops, and restaurants all within a short walk.

I would absolutely stay here again.

El lugar es cómodo y tranquilo, tiene una vista muy linda, está bien equipado, no nos faltó nada. Es como en las fotos de la descripción y tal vez mejor. Está cerca de muy buenos cafés y restaurantes. La atención de Sergio fue excelente. Sin duda volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí.
The apartment had wonderful views and Sergio was very helpful and responsive. Great location!
Todo excelente!

My stay in Palermo was a fantastic experience. The location was amazing, you are walking distances away from  great restaurants and bars. And the condo in itself was very quaint, confortable with amazing views of Buenos Aires. Very much recommended!

Sergio is a fine host and the apartment is excellent. The location in Palermo makes one reluctant to leave the convenient neighborhood. The apartment is attractive with a fabulous view,  and met our every expectation.
Es la segunda vez que nos hospedamos en el lugar y volveríamos nuevamente.

Buena ubicación y bonito lugar.

La atención de Sergio es excelente.

Saludos

Awesome location super close to very popular bars and restaurants, and a quick Uber ride to some of the best steakhouses in Argentina. Sergio was a great host who was super responsive / made the check in process smooth, and the building and apartment itself felt very secure. Several grocery stores and coffee shops nearby too, you won’t regret the location!

Lots of well thought out details throughout the place ideal for travelers, like several outlets that accommodated US style plugs and European style plugs in addition to Argentina plugs. Comfortable furniture and beds, 10/10 Sergio gracias!
Pretty hard to beat. Located in a great neighborhood for finding an exceptional morning coffee or good drink, stunning view, wonderful doorman, very professionally handled. Highly recommended!

Absolutely fantastic host. The apartment was beautiful and clean. Sergio was very responsive, always available to help answer questions, provide what we needed, and he provided great guidance for getting around.

Sergio’s home is wonderful and exactly as described. The view from the balcony is spectacular. I wish we could have spent more time on the balcony but it was still a bit chilly. However, if you come when the weather is warmer it would be perfect for coffee or wine. The washing machine was a little finicky (it’s for the whole building) but that’s the only issue we had. We did not use the kitchen to cook because there are SO many great places to eat nearby. There is a bakery next door and a vegetarian restaurant across the street. Communication was great. Sergio was very helpful with all my questions. I would absolutely stay here again. There’s so much to do in Buenos Aires—you’ll love it. Tip: if you like antiques, be sure to visit the Mercado de Pulgas. It’s 7 minutes walk and has sooo many interesting, strange, one of a kind finds. And not many tourists either!

We had the best time at Sergio’s place, we were greeted by a lovely young man the answer all our questions and the book the explained everything you need to know about were to eat .. etc, etc .. awesome! loved the surroundings lots of restaurant’s, very safe, nice atmosphere. We recommend Sergio’s place absolutely!

Great stay with my friends in Buenos Aires. Sergio’s apartment was just as pictured and he has an excellent guidebook to the city. He was very accommodating and held our bags for us. The views of the city were amazing. Very close to many nice restaurants and shops. Would definitely recommend to any visitors.
