A perfect home base to explore the city. Amazing balcony view and close to the great restaurants and bars of Palermo. I hope to be back someday...Muchas Gracias!
El mejor ap de bs as, sin mas que decir. Sergio un genio !. Iré nuevamente siempre al mismo ap.
Loved the view!

Sergio was a great host, the place is fantastically located. There was a little hair on the pillows but no real problems.

Unfortunately the security for the apartment block isn’t great, there is no emergency exit or fire escape. On checkout we closed the door behind us (as instructed) and were stuck in the lobby for >1 hour trying to get out. None of the emergency numbers work and there is no way to exit from inside. I dread to think what would happen in a fire… we managed to get out eventually by dismantling a lock box and fishing out a key but nearly missed our flight. Not a problem and no hard feelings but a stressful experience!
The 3 of us stayed at Sergio’s place. We had a great view of Buenos Aires in a central location, close to many restaurants!
Amazing stay - the apartment was beautiful and well situated in Palermo Hollywood. We loved the views and the tranquility of the place!
Great apartment and great host) Thank you very much for the hospitality)
Great location and very clean

Overall our stay in the San Telmo apartment was really enjoyable, the location is fantastic full of life and activity, great places to eat and loads of interesting antique shops and the market on sunday along Bolivar was really interesting.

the apartment was for the most part just what i was looking for, it had plenty of charm and character (this may not suit everyone) there was loads of natural light and air flow. One should bear in mind that the apartment is in the heart of San Telmo which is quite different to the posher areas like Palermo and Recoleta.

there were a few issues with the water during our stay that were beyond anyone's control, Nicky was quick to respond to the situation, even though she was overseas herself. At the time it was stressful but looking back it was just part of the big Buenos Aires experience, and certainly didn't ruin my trip by any means.

Nicky was very friendly to deal with in all stages of the process - from the initial inquiry through to the few hiccups we had along the way, i have no hesitation in recommending her apartment as a place to stay.

Perfect for our stay in Buenos Aires!  Florencia is a truly wonderful host and one of the nicest people we've met during our travels. The apartment is exactly as pictured, very clean and well maintained.  Wifi and air conditioning both worked great. The location was ideal for us, safe neighborhood and an easy walk to Palermo or Recoleta.  Stay with Florencia for your trip to BA!

This place is beautiful.  The view is spectacular, and it is VERY quiet!  :-) It's in Palermo near lots of great shops and restaurants.  Super safe in a gated condo tower.  Highly, highly recommended.  Wifi signal strong, which is also very helpful.

All of the conveniences of home, super clean apartment, and a location that can't be beat!  My recent 10 day visit to Buenos Aires was my first.  I had a great time and this apartment played a big part in that.  Ralf and his team were excellent to work with.  Communications with them were timely, professional, and friendly.  I will stay here again on my next visit!
Very nice appartment, well mantained and wonderfull view. The pictures reflect well the present state and dimensions of the appartement  (this is far not the case in other advertisements).
Great host! Great view of the river. Safe area.

Absolute Top-Empfehlung. Sobald ich das nächste Mal wieder in Buenos Aires bin, werde ich das Apartment erneut buchen. Der Service seitens Ralf und seinem Team war rund um die Uhr optimal, sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das habe ich in dieser Qualität noch nie erlebt. Die Lage ist perfekt. Meine Freundin und ich hatten eine unvergessliche Zeit.

AMAZING.....This apartment is exactly as described.  Absolutely beautiful with views from every room and a relaxing balcony.  It is in a great neighborhood near shops and restaurants and walking distance to so many things to see and do.  We felt very safe walking and getting around and knowing the building had security was a plus. Our host (Ralf) was superior and went above and beyond to help in anyway he could.  He took care of us from check-in to check-out.  This felt like home and next time in BA will definitely stay here.  The best Airbnb stay I have ever had.
I keep going back to Ralph's places because he has  the best places with the best service.
Wonderful location and amazing views. Exceptionally clean and safe
Hermoso apartamento cómodo y bien situado.
These guys are so timely with everything! The apartment is in the perfect location, lots of restaurants nearby as well as the metro
Estupendo apartamento, limpio, moderno y bien situado.

Absolutely phenomenal appartment with a great location and an unparalleled view of the BsAs skyline - not to mention the gym, sauna & jacuzzi are fantastic!

The host is sweet and always available at a moment’s notice to either book the sauna or jacuzzi, or answer any questions. The building security is fantastic, and all of it made our stay in BSAs magical. Would absolutely recommend, and look forward to returning someday soon!

Nossa estadia no apartamento do Ralf foi maravilhosa! O apartamento é uma graça, exatamente como nas fotos, e tem tudo o que é necessário pra uma estadia, com o plus de ainda ter ferro de passar e secador de cabelo! Ralf é muito simpático e nos recebeu com alegria e dicas locais, além de pequenos mimos no apartamento como biscoitos, itens para fazer drinks e cápsulas de café. A localização em Palermo Soho é perfeita, da pra fazer muita coisa a pé e ainda fica bem perto  de uma  estação de metrô! Nós com certeza voltaremos! Obrigada por tudo, Ralf!

The apartment is a great base for exploring Palermo and beyond, and the city views are special. But it was also a lovely place just to hang out in (and watch the World Cup!) Will certainly book it again on our next visit.

Ralf, Marcelo, Andres and the team were incredible over the course of our stay. The apartment is beautifully appointed, with plenty of clean, bright open space. We were offered extremely clear instructions for check-in and check-out, that kept us as the guests at the absolute forefront of consideration. The bed - importantly - is plush and soft and the views over BA are awesome. We couldn't fault the place, or the experience, and it made our time in Argentina far more memorable. Thank you!

The place looks nice when you walk in.  There is a problem with a cloudy window that affects the view but they said it’s complicated to fix.  I chose the location because Palermo is walkable and that is true in this case.  Not the prettiest area of Palermo but walkable.  I also chose the unit because of access to a washing machine in the building but using it is complicated and they should explain that.  You have to walk to a grocery store and buy tokens to use the washer/dryer and then if the washing machine or dryer eats your token, you’re  out of luck and no one in the building can help you. Lastly, I found a roach when I was looking for pots to cook and informed Marcelo.  He said someone would come to investigate the next day.  Someone did come so that I could point out where I saw it but said they were scheduled to fumigate when I left.  The man who came (not Marcelo) said you will see roaches in the summer.  They came back later that evening with a roach motel. I won’t be back.

My husband and I are visiting from New York. We had an amazing time! Ralf went above and beyond for our stay. We enjoyed everything in the apartment. It was fully stocked with everything we needed and more. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!

ralfs team are truly exceptional...Marcelo is so lovely, welcomed us at the entrance and showed us around the whole building, helping us to get acquainted after our super long and 2 day delayed flight...we wished we had booked it for our whole trip...pool is sweet, views wonderful and everyone just so helpful...thanks so much, tj
Victor and Andres were were always attentive during my stay. Awsome apartment with spectacular views!
Amazing! The loft was perfect and the host very helpful. Don't hesitate to book it :))
Excellent flat in San Telmo steps away from great dining, entertainment and public transport. Her place is very sunny, spacious and clean! I would highly recommend staying at Nicola's place.

This loft was really, really, really chic! We really enjoyed to stay in Nicky`s flat. It actually looks more pretty as it looks on the pictures already. As long you are a fan of antique furniture. Everything worked fine, but it can get a little bid cold as we noticed. The contact via her manager, Eva was very easy. We were able to check in at 8am, because we reached the city by bus overnight. Also we got the chance to stay until 6pm before our departure in the evening. So we had two full days for sightseeing. Its nice located in the center of San Telmo.  Its a pity that we haven't booked this apartment already on our first stay. Thank you a lot!

We really enjoyed our stay at Nickys apartement, the location is great, the flat beautifuly decorated and the comunication with Nicky was quite easy and friendly! Nos gustó mucho nuestra estancia, el apartamento esta bien situado, lindo decorado y la comunicación con Nicky ha sido facil y amable!
Great place and nice staff! I totally recommend it.

We spent 5 days visiting Buenos Aires, our experience with BA4U was great.  Timely in picking us up and the apartment was just like the pictures, super cute!  Great building amenities and security, easy walking distance to all of Palermo Soho.   We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

I had a great time in this apartment.

It includes everything you're looking for in a place in a foreign country; great location, great condition, great amenities and great host!


Before I even arrived in Buenos Aires, Ralf's BA4U team offered to arrange a transfer from the airport to the apartment (for an reasonable fee). I would suggest to take the opportunity, as the arrival can be quite hectic at Ezeiza Airport. Once there I was greeted by the funny Marcelo, who took the time to explain the details of the apartment and even provided very useful informations about Buenos Aires, wich was very helpful for my stay. Andres from BA4U also helped to arrange a great tango show at El Viejo Almacen. They even left a few fresh fruits and candy bars for my arrival, which is great after the long trip to Buenos Aires ;-)

From there, it was a pleasure to stay here, as it's situated in a new building with modern design in a quiet neighbourhood. The apartment was clean, well furnished and well maintained. It has ton of amenities including a nice balcony (15th floor), WiFi, LCD TV with cable, well stocked kitchen, a safe and even a cleaning service once during my 5 days stay. There's a gym at the top floor with an amazing panoramic view of the city, laundry services in the basement (bring coins) and good security with metal gates and a 24h security gard at the entrance.

It is well positioned, close to a subway station and to tons of great restaurants in Palermo, like the superb La Cabrera. You're not in the center of town, but that's good as you're away from the hustle and bustle while just a few metro stations away from everything.

I can't said enough great things about my experience in this apartment. If you want to stay in Palermo, it is the place to choose. I would recommend it to all my friends!
El depto muy comodo y super completo. limpio y ordenado. Es mas lindo que lo que se ve por fotos. Gracias Nicola y Eva!!

Ralf is the man!  And his apartment was great.  The staff at BA4U Apartments was really helpful and responsive too.  The Marilyn apartment is in a wonderful location in a very cool high-rise building - right in the heart of Palermo, but also close to the subway and a couple blocks from Sante Fe Ave.  The views from the apartment are wonderful and the apartment is beautifully decorated.  We enjoyed the balcony very much, the bed was comfortable, and overall the apartment had plenty of space despite being just a studio.  We stayed for 5 nights in October and the apartment was cleaned once during our stay.  We used the kitchen quite often as well.  Thanks Ralf and BA4U!

Ralf was an excellent host:  he was very responsive to us in prepping for the trip (even offered to have a car pick us up at the airport - while we took a cab, we appreciated the offer), he had fresh fruit and coffee stocked for us when we arrived, provided us with great info on the area, and accommodated a special request.  The condo is exactly as represented on the website:  it's spotless, well maintained, and in a secure new building (24-hour gated security around the building).  The location is excellent - about 2 blocks from the subway (IMHO the best way to get around B.A.), in Palermo SoHo.  I know the ultimate question is, "would you stay here again if returning to Buenos Aires?" and the answer is a definite "Yes".  Thanks, Ralf, for a wonderful stay!
Excellent apartment in great area surrounder by cafes, bars and restaurants.  peaceful ares.

The Marilyn apartment is an excellent place to stay in Buenos Aires.  The apartment is ultra modern, clean and well located less than a two minute walk from the intersection of Av Santa Fe and Uriarte near the Botanical Gardens.  Taxis to downtown, Recoleta, San Telmo and other parts of Palermo are readily available and cheap.  Great restaurants are walkable as well as simple conveniences for travelers including a supermarket, bank and laundry facility.  The apartment has a beautiful balcony overlooking the city and the gym on 31st floor is modern and has amazing panoramic views of BA.  Ralf is an excellent host, we took an overnight flight and were pretty tired when we arrived, he met us at the apartment and gave us a brief update about the surrounding area.  We had to take a 5 am flight to Patagonia at the end of our stay and he arranged a car for us which showed up on time and was reasonably priced.  Residents in the building are very friendly too.  If you want a great place to stay in Palermo for a good price, you cannot beat Hotel Marilyn.

I spent 10 days at the Marilyn apartment in March. It was just as it looks in the photos, only felt bigger than I was expecting. Everything was well designed, spotlessly clean and it was generally a very comfortable place to stay (including most importantly the bed). The balcony was great in the late afternoons as it caught the sun. The building was good and modern, with friendly security staff and a small but useful gym on the 31st floor with amazing views. Also, jacuzzis, saunas and a decent sized pool on the ground level which was often empty, particularly in the evenings.  I requested a car to collect me at the airport and then Ralf met me on my arrival at the building, all very smooth. We then spent 20 minutes or so chatting and he went through some recommended restaurants / bars / and events happening that week. He was a very friendly and approachable host.  Fruit, a beer and bottle of water in the fridge on arrival was also a nice touch.

Ralf was a fantastic host who has thought of everything down to the most minute detail. We were more than comfortable in this lovely flat and he was very helpful with any request we could dream of. Was really able to enjoy the city thanks to Ralf and all his efforts.

We soooo appreciated being able to stay until we went to the airport!!   We also appreciated their response when we asked for towels even tho that wasn't their policy. Nice security guards. Bed was comfortable and place was fun! We didn't use the gym but the 20m pool was great!

My girlfriend and I stayed here for 8 days and loved it.  It is just as nice in person as it is in the pictures.  The views and the sunset are spectacular as well.  It's a short walk to all the great restaurants in the Palermo Soho area and a few blocks from the subway.  Ralf is a great host and we would definitely stay here again.

My wife and I planned to stay at Ralf's Marilyn apartment for a month but because of change  in our plan could stay only for 25 days.  We enjoyed are stay very much.  The apartment is a good size studio on the 15th floor of a 33 modern building.  The security in the building is excellent is is immaculately clean. The apartment comes with fully equipped kitchen.  It has a balcony with a very good view of the city.  Once a week the apartment is cleaned and the linens are changed.  Location is excellent.  Very close to underground subte and many buses.   Within few  blocks of the apartment there at four supermarkets and bakeries.  Palermo Soho is gastronomic center of Buenos Aires and you will find many of best restaurants in the city.  But best of all the service we received from Ralf and his associates.  Despited 13 hours flight delay, they met us at the air at midnight and showed us the apartment with throughly.  The two times that we had minor problem with working of television a staff member came to the apartment with 30 minutes of our call.  I short, we recommend the apartment highly and would stay there if we revisit Buenos Aires.

Amazing apartment! Ralf and his team are great. They organised an airport pick up straight to the apartment. Ralf met us there and gave us suggestions for restaurants and bars in the area, just a shame we couldn't try them all!

The building is nice and safe with security guards 24 hours to buzz you in. We didn't manage to use the pool, as it was still a bit chilly when we were there, the gym is great though and has an amazing view.

There was a maid service too which cleaned up and changed the towels, an added bonus.

There's a laundry service around the corner, supermarkets and bakeries, so a great location all in all. Would definitely use one of ralfs apartments in BA again when we're next there.
Excelente departamento. Muy bien ubicado y con todas las comodidades que se requieren. La atención de Ralf fue sobresaliente, preocupado del más mínimo detalle.

Ralf was a perfect host. The apartment was clean and totally in order. Ralf was good to make a short briefing about does and donts in the neighborhood and in BA for general. I will highly recommend a stay with Ralf.

What an AMAZING apartment and host! I had been in Buenos Aires, staying in two pther parts of town prior, and wanted to spend my last 5 days in this amazing room w/ an amazing view. When I arrived I was greeted by friendly Ralf, who was on time, kind, and very helpful when it came to detailing the neighborhood and the building itself -- which was stunning. The entire process was so easy, and I loved everything about my stay. Ralf will definitely be the first contact I book through when I return to BA!
Beautiful apartment and great building. Definitely would stay there again.

Ralf and his team were absolutely amazing!  They helped us navigate through the local restaurant, shopping and entertainment scene in Buenos Aires.  He was even so helpful to provide us a local pay as you go cell phone while we were there.  The unit and building are very modern and stylish, extremely safe, clean and centrally located.I look forward tostaying with him again when he gets his new properties opened in Brazil!!

The apartment, location and amenities were better then we could have hoped for! The apartment was beautifully decorated and had everything we need! The pool was an amazing bonus for super hot and long Buenos Aires days! This apartment is a just. Ralf was also very accommodating and helpful! A 10 on 10!

Ralf is the best! He was helpful, informative, friendly and a great resource to us. The apartment is gorgeous!!  We had a wonderful time in the Marilyn apartment. The neighborhood is awesome and  close to shops and restaurants. We didn't want to leave. I highly recommend Ralf and his apartments in Palermo SoHo.

Me and my wife had a great week in Marilyn apartment The service that Ralf and his team provided was exelent, taking care of all important details. Nice and clean apartment in a very good building. I would love to come back. Goran

Ralf was a great host and the apartment was amazing - perfect location and great amenities.  The apartment was even better than it looked in the pictures.  The view was beautiful and the deck allowed us to watch the sunsets with a bottle of wine.  The pool was another added bonus and something you definitely appreciate in the hot B. A. summer.  The apartment was also very secure and felt very safe.
Superb flat, great location.  Florencia was an absolute pleasure to deal with - would highly recommend to friends.

Cozy and comfortable this apartment Is! We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The apt and building are clean and safe. The apt is in a great area close to recoleta and Palermo. Florencio and her husband are amazing hosts- they are nice, flexible and most importantly accommodating. It was a pleasure to deal with their flexibility and understanding when our flight was delayed and our luggage was lost. Flo was nice enough to give the airline her cell phone # and she kept us updated when it was arriving since we did not have a local phone. Overall it was a great comfortable stay. My favorite part was opening the back door and taking in the sounds and amazing aromas from the neighbors nearby in highly recommend staying this apartment and dealing with Flor! Hope to come back and visit and stay here!!

This apartment is in a really central location in a nice neighbourhood, easy to walk to most areas and there is a bus down to La Boca from the main road nearby. Flor and her husband were very nice and welcoming, and really flexible with check in and out times which was kind. The apartment is well equipped, has a hairdryer, iron, telephone for local calls, nice towels, some basic kitchen equipment pots and pans etc. The block is very well maintained and clean. Wifi works perfectly. The photos are what you should expect - nicely furnished and clean.
We really enjoyed our stay here and wouldn't hesitate to book again if we returned to BA (I hope we do!). Recommend that if you want a picnic to take to the park on a nice day, don't bother buying sandwich stuff from the grocery store which isn't that cheap - turn right out of the block and one street over is a Panaderia where you can buy good sandwiches, omelettes and pastries for very little peso.
Thanks Flor!

When you arrive in this appartment, you feel good immediatly and that's perfect after 13h hours of flight!
Florencia was very nice with us and very welcomed.
The district is cool and the appartment is close to the subway so not farway from the "city center"

Nicola's place is a great unique place located at a very special lively, old neighbourhood. The apartment is tastefully restored with an admirable effort to preserve the original. I loved the personal touches and the original details; the beautiful glass and iron work, the high ceiling, concrete kitchen counter, original fire-brick wall, original bath and sink etc...
Nicola is an excellent host, she always answered our messages instantly ; when we had the slightest problem , she made sure that it was solved right away.
We loved to stay in that apartment at a special time for us, we spent the first days of our honey- moon here.
Thanks Nicola, we love you.
Ps. We love our neighbour too!

First the location was great, close to restaurants and cafes, was able to walk to everywhere around the area. Communication was efficient and easy with Nicola, she even let us check in way early due to my early flight and sent a nice lady to show us around. I would definitely stay here again and enjoy this unique and cozy place.

The apartment fitted perfectly to our needs and expectations. Everything was clean and in very good condition. The apartment is centrally localized, with Subte-connection, restaurants and shops nearby. Ralf and his very friendly staff gave us excellent support during our one-week stay in BA. Always again.
Helen and Elmar

The Marilyn apartment was so perfect for our week long vacation. The studio was decorated really stylishly and had everything we needed. The terrace was so nice and had an incredible view of all of Buenos Aires. The location was also perfect for us...lots of cute boutiques, bars and restaurants very near. Lastly, Ralph was a pleasure to deal with. He made us feel right at home in the apartment and provided lots of recommendations for things to do while in BA. We would absolutely recommend this apartment and we hope to stay there again ourselves soon. Thanks again Ralf!!

The Marilyn apartment was the perfect place to stay. Close to all the best bars, shopping and restaurants in Palermo and also close to the train line. The facilities in the complex were 5 star, our only regret is that we didn't stay longer. We will be back!

Ralf was an awesome host! He was there to greet us when we arrived and gave us a tour of the unit along with introducing us to the city. We forgot our pesos at home and Ralf was able to help us with the exchange as well. He was very accessible and we were able to contact him when we needed.

Great unit, awesome host, lovely city - what more could you ask for?

Will definitely stay again when we visit BA next time!
This place is great! Perfect location, really cute design, and a beautifully classic BA building.

We stayed at Nicola's flat for a week in October. The flat is lovely, airy, calm and well equipped. Its location makes it very convenient to visit San Telmo, the ecological reserve of Puerto Maduro or the shopping district on foot, and other areas of Buenos Aires can be reached by bus or subte. The flat is well equipped, and has plenty of little homey touches. Being able to do some laundry was also very convenient.

The main problem during our stay was that there was no wi-fi for the whole duration. We never managed to solve the problem and lost quite a lot of time trying to figure out alternatives. Despite this, we had very good communication with our host, who did all she could do from a distance. Also, Nicola's wonderful neighbour and friend Jenny opened her wifi to us to partly mitigate the issue, and she was also a mine of information and good spirits.

If you get the opportunity to book this place, snap it up! What a gem!
It's in a perfect location, right in an interesting and fun part of town! The flat is on the top floor of a building, which makes it a surprisingly quiet location considering you're in the center of BA. The flat itself is beautiful, with wood, tiles and stain glass windows creating a lovely environment to be in. It comes equipped with anything you might need! Nicola is a wonderful host and very quick in responding to emails. She is also very generous with her knowledge and made our transition from the UK to South America very easy. If we have the opportunity in the future to come back to Buenos Aires we will certainly be staying here!

If you’re looking for a stay in Buenos Aires this is the place! The apartment is amazing; beautiful high ceilings, wooden flooring, incredible location, and wonderfully decorated throughout. We really enjoyed coming back after a day of exploring and relaxing in the hammock! Unfortunately we didn’t get to meet Nicola, but communication with her was prompt. Her neighbour was extremely helpful in showing us around making us feel welcome. I would definitely come to stay again!

Nicky is a great host, along with Jenny, who received us. Both very attentive and helpful. The apartment is really nice, charming and cozy. It is quite silent, though only a couple of blocks from one of Buenos Aires’s busiest night spots. Many details, like electricity adaptors, transportstion cards and city guides show Nicky’s careful attention. I’ll certainly stay here again in future trips to Buenos Aires.

We really enjoyed our stay! The apartment is very stylish and comfortable with beautiful high brick ceilings. It was only about a 10 minute walk to public transit which is cheap. Guillermo was extremely helpful during check-in, throughout our stay and at check out. He had wonderful restaurant recommendations that included some of the best food of the entire trip. The apartment had all of the amenities that we needed. It was really hot while we were there so having air conditioning in the main bedroom was a life saver.
Would highly recommend staying here! Enjoyed my time spent here and would stay here again!

Nicola and Guille are very welcoming caring hosts. They make one feel very welcome & maintain personal contact with their guests throughout their stay always ready to provide tips and assistance. They really do provide customer centric caring service! Nicola’s artistic flair make this loft apartment a very warm and inviting space. Thanks Nicole and Guille for your hospitality.
Superbe appartement, tres propre, accueil tres agreable, nous recommandons chaleureusement !
Wir hatten eine super Zeit in dieser charmanten Wohnung. Nicola und Guille sind nette und aufmerksame Gastgeber. Die Lage in San Telmo ist perfekt. Wir würden wieder kommen! Vielen Dank.

Nicola's place is a quirky loft conversion.  We liked it very much.  Although its in the middle of a noisy city area its surprisingly quiet.  She did warn us - it is up three flights of stairs which are a real killer!

L'appartement de Nicola est très beau, original et confortable, et Guille est un hôte très attentionné, qui s'est assuré plusieurs fois pendant notre séjour que tout se passait pour le mieux !L'emplacement  de l'appartement est idéal, à 2 pas du coeur de San Telmo et 2 pas de la place de Mai et des boutiques du micro-centro. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir !

Nicola's place is enchanting! Full of charm and beautifully decorated, it is close to everything in San Telmo and has all the amenities and comfort we needed. Our local host Guille was amazing! He was very accommodating and went out of his way to arrange an early check in for my husband. Always attentive and immediately responding to any requests, he is the perfect host.
Thank you Guille for your hospitality, we will definitely be back in our next trip to Buenos Aires!
Analía and Daniel

My friend and I received an amazing welcome from Guille, along with some lovely, unexpected touches, such as: a bottle of wine, fruit and water in the fridge! Guille was very responsive before we arrived and during our stay and took care to ensure we felt comfortable. The place is exactly like the photos, so we were not disappointed. I would like to have given a 4.5 (not possible on here) only because of the noise from a small dog downstairs and the second, smaller bedroom room was noisy because it was near the entrance. However this is not the host's fault, more because of the older building. Turning the fan on at night helped to drown out the noise. Overall we were very happy and recommend the place.

Idéalement placé dans SAN TELMO, le quartier historique et vivant de BUENOS AIRE, vous vous sentirez chez vous dans cet appartement spacieux, coloré et chaleureux. Accueil des plus sympathique ! Un séjour très très plaisant !

We spent 10 days in this beautiful apartment right after Easter break and totally recommend it. Right by the "mercado Santelmo", close to many cute bars and restaurants, and near the street fair that takes place every Sunday - it is perfectly located. The apartment is a lot more spacious than it appears to be on the pictures, it is cosy, functional and tastefully decorated. We enjoyed cooking meals at home and planning the rest of our trip from there. My girlfriend felt so inspired, she actually managed to get back into her yoga routine (it's not always easy to be consistent when you are on the road). Last but not least, Guillermo made us feel very much at home and was always ready to provide feedback or assist us whenever we needed.

This place is a perfect base for exploring San Telmo and Buenos Aires. It’s comfortable, stylish and within metres of markets, bars and restaurants. Nicola was very helpful and communicative from the moment we booked. A great spot in great part of town.
Great place to stay, location was great and room was clean and as appeared in pictures.   Would stay there again.

I like my interior so can be a fussy bird when it comes where I live. And corporate traveling in cool hotels around the world did not help either… BUT I have to admit, this is the first time an airbnb booking exceeded my expectations. Both in terms of the venue ( flat is just as shown on screen) and the service (host’s sense of welcoming, communication, check-in and touring advisory). Think no more, just go there and find out by yourself.

What an amazing privilege it was to stay at Ralf's Marylin Apartment. Every attention to details is taken care of to ensure a wonderful stay. The apartment is beautifully furnished, very conveniently located and extremely stylish. Ralf and BA4U were very friendly and accommodating and  a pleasure to deal with. Many thanks for providing such a lovely apartment.

The Marilyn apartment is a great launching point for any stay in Buenos Aires: super clean and modern, well-furnished and an extraordinary view of the city (especially at night). It's also in a vibrant neighborhood, close to the Subte (subway) and to restaurants in Palermo Viejo. Ralf and his team are outstanding hosts and were incredibly responsive and welcoming. Thanks especially to Marcelo for all of his help during our trip!

Sem palavras!!!! o apartamento é fantástico, de muito bom gosto, moderno, equipado, limpo, seguro, confortável e possuiu uma vista privilegiada da cidade!! a localização é ótima... próximo ao zoo, próximo a restaurante, bares, mercados... ao lado do metrô!! fiquei impressionado com a cordialidade do anfitrião!!! realmente, foi uma experiência única!! Pretendemos voltar!!!
The apartment was fantastic, and Ralf makes sure that guests are set up well with fun things to do.  Would recommend to anyone wishing to stay in Palermo.

It was a really very nice, comfortable and clean appartement with a beautiful view over the City of BA!
Ralf and his staff (special Marcello) were very friendly and helpful.

Thank's, it was a very great stay we had hear. We love to come back hear.

Nice apartment and carefull people!
Also very well located. We realy enjoyed.
Thanks for Ralph and team
The apartment is beautifully designed, has an amazing view (that you can even enjoy from the bed) and is in a great location. One of the best places I've ever stayed at!
We had a great time on Marilyn apartment! It's very well located, clean, bright and the view is beautiful. Andres was very kind with us! I recommend!!

What an awesome place to stay. Ralf greeted us and went through all of the aspects of the apartment and the Palermo area. The view from the balcony was amazing to wake up to. The Palermo area itself is safe and has many options for eating and shopping. We would definitely stay in one of Ralf's apartments again.

Ralf is a delightful host with a good sense of humor who was very attentive and helpful during our 10 day stay. He gave us suggestions for places within the local area, and suggested things to do in the city. We had frequent contact with him and his staff, and all were helpful.

The apartment is in a luxury building, relatively new, maybe 10-15 years old, and is well and completely furnished., and we would highly recommend it. It is in Palermo Soho and it is an interesting area. Subway and bus stops within two blocks and taxis everywhere..

This apartment is fantastic. We loved it so much that we stayed there twice on a recent trip to Argentina.  Stay here, you won't regret it.  Ralf and his team are amazing, you'll be well taken care of.

Awesome place, stay here and enjoy BsAs. Flor's studio is fantastic, even for a long stay. We spent 6 nights and loved it. The studio is bright and airy, and has all the amenities including a small but well stocked kitchen, a living and dining space, a comfortable bed with good linens, and a nice bathroom with thick towels. It's centrally located in a nice part of Recoleta, just a few blocks from the Subte and various bus lines.

Finally, Flor is amazing. She was very helpful in answering all of our practical questions and left us all her contact information. She also emailed us useful maps and transportation tips.

El departamento es amplio, acogedor y lindo.  Guille, quién nos recibió, es muy atento y preocupado. La ubicación es bien clara y céntrica y hay supermercados y almacenes a metros de distancia, eso hace que se haga muy ideal la estadia.

We had a lovely stay in Nicola's apartment, what a beautiful place with a great atmosphere (even better than the pictures)! I would totally recommend this place in San Telmo. Guille, who welcomed me, was a great host who gave lots of local tips for San Telmo and more and was really fast in answering and staying in contact. Muchas gracias!

Flor has a wonderful apartment very close to public transport and also within walking distance (a healthy walking distance!!) of Recoletta.

Flor met me on time as arranged and showed me around the apartment, which is a perfect size, has a great kitchen, lounge room and a cofortable bathroom. She also brought bottled water with her, and has tea and coffee facilities as well as cooking facilities.

On the day that I left, Flor met me again for the return of the keys, then walked (carrying one of my backpacks) to a nearby private taxi company (literally around the corner) where she negotiated the fare to the airport. Earlier that morning she had rung to confirm that I could leave my packs at the apartment during the day, while I crammed in some last minute sight seeing.

A really lovely person - I cannot recommend staying at Flor´s highly enough.

My girlfriend and I visited BA for the first time, and decided to stay at Florencia's place near the Palermo neighborhood.  First of all, Florencia and her husband were excellent hosts, accommodating our early arrival and late departure from BA.  The apartment was very clean and comfortable, and had everything we needed to call the place home during our trip.  The apartment was also in a nice quiet neighborhood only a few blocks from the BA subway system, and only a 25-30 ARS taxi ride from all of the popular tourist areas and bus station.  Since the building is in a residential neighborhood, there are a few nice restaurants and cafes nearby, but not quite as many as in other popular areas nearby.  This does not diminish the apartment's quality or charm; it just means that you should be up for doing some exploring on your BA trip!

The flat was clean and the bed was super comfy.  It was a perfect hideaway in the city and had everything I needed. Florencia was very welcoming and a very good host.  I am sorry it has taken me over a year to leave this feedback, but I still remember what a pleasant experience I had!

We stayed at Flor's place twice; first for one week then later (after a trip to Brazil) for two nights. Everything is as described by other reviews, ie, great. Flor and her her husband were most helpful with all  things, including our sad lack of Spanish, and truly went beyond normal expectations to assist us. The apartment was very accommodating, spotlessly clean and ideally located.

I loved my stay at Flor`s place!! It was my first AirBnB experience and everything went perfectly. Flor was the ultimate host - very warm & friendly & always responded quickly to any questions. The flat is as pictured & meticulous. You can see the attention & effort Flor and her husband have put into the place. There was a hairdryer and iron provided as well as all the basics for the kitchen & more. The flat is conveniently located between Bulnes & Aguero stations & on every block there is a small supermarket or fruit store. The wi-fi was very reliable and Flor gave me a lot of great info on nearby restaurants and tourists locations. I couldn`t have had a better experience & one day I would love to return & stay again. It really felt like a second home. Buenos Aires was very safe & easy to get around - it`s really the "Paris of South America". Muchas Gracias Flor & Demian :)

Flor fue una excelente host, nos recibió a la hora que llego nuestro vuelo a pesar de ser en la madrugada y nos explico las cosas necesarias para nuestra estadía tanto en Buenos Aires como en el departamento.

Su apartamento es exactamente lo que se describe y es muy acogedor, queda cerca de una principal avenida y es de muy fácil acceso por transporte público.

Se lo recomiendo a cualquier persona que visite buenos aires !
Beautiful place that has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Very helpful host. Highly recommended!

Ralf and his team are super helpful and amazing - from meeting us, to giving us tips, to storing our luggage in between stays at the apartment.  The apartment itself is lovely and centrally located.  The deck is gorgeous for watching the sunset, and the apartment is within walking distance to all the hotspots in Palermo.  Great apartment in a great city, we will definitely stay here next time we're in BA!

Great apartment! I was greeted by Marcelo, who was incredibly friendly and helpful when showing me the room. He gave me lots of very valuable information about the city and how to stay safe. The place was incredibly clean and exactly as described. The check-in and check-out process was a breeze.. TV, WiFi and A/C worked perfectly. I would highly, highly recommend booking your next stay with Ralf and his team, you won't regret it!

The APT was in a great location, the View was everything it is cracked up to be. Ralf's staff was awesome when showing us the room and the transportation from the international airport (1 hour drive) was super easy and recommended. the APT was just like the pictures and very clean and wonderful to stay. IT is also about a 4 min walk to the subway, and 15 min to many great restaurants. Recommended
Great apartment in a fantastic area. Very easy check in process and Ralf was extremely helpful with all aspects of our stay. I thoroughly recommend you stay here!

This is a beautiful apartment in the perfect location in Buenos Aires.  Accessible to anything in the city you might want to visit.  The management team is organized and efficient.  Highly recommended.

Não pense duas vezes e reserve logo este lugar! Uma das experiências mais incríveis que já tive. O apê é um luxo! E tem a vista mais incrível da cidade. Conforto. Perto de tudo o que você precisa: mercados, restaurantes, parques, metrô, ônibus, enfim. Ideal para uma hospedagem de casal. O Marcelo, que nos recepcionou, é uma das pessoas mais atenciosas que já conheci. Nos tirou todas as dúvidas, nos orientou a respeito de todo o funcionamento do apê e ainda nos deu diversas dicas.

I didn't have the chance to meet Ralf personally but his staff took great care of me.

The apartment was perfectly located, clean and with everything you could ask for.

I can recommend staying there to anyone interested in having a good time in BA.

Perfectly located in Palermo Soho I enjoyed the stay at this apartment very much. Everything was very well organized, the flat was clean and well furnished. Lots of cool bars, restaurants and cafes in walking distance. Subway station just 5 minutes from the apartment. Ralf and his team were extremely helpful and even organized luggage storage for us during our short trip to Uruguay. I can recommend this place to everyone who wants to explore Palermo and the rest of BA. Perfect Airbnb experience!

Great apartment, stylish decorated and with an amazing view of Buenos Aires. Nothing you would need is missing here.
Ralf and his team at BA4U apartments were very helpful and service minded both before and during our stay, easily available for questions and advice through both phone and email (and in english too, which I appreciated since my spanish is still very basic).
Higly recommendable!

This was a fabulous apartment in an excellent location. Everything was spotless and adorable; we felt at home immediately. Ralf was extremely helpful and gracious. As someone who travels to Buenos Aires regularly, I will most definitely be booking this again and recommending it to all of my friends. The gym on the top floor has a view of the entire city and is a must-see. Thanks for everything Ralf, we'll definitely be back again!

It was a great pleasure to discover Airbnb through the Marylin apartment. It was just perfect, everything is perfectly thought. Ralf's team is efficient and kind.
If we come back one day in BA, we will choose, for sure, one of Ralf'apartment.
See you soon!
Great stay, great apartment, feedback and exceptional RECEPTION

Ralf's place in Palermo was superb, great location and very clean with a great view from the balcony.
The staff were so nice and helpful, I really recommend this place very highly, thank you!

Fantastic apartment, fantastic Buenos Aires. Excellent communication prior to and throughout our stay. Apartment is located in a great place, with easy access to transport and other parts of this huge city. Apartment exactly as it looks in photos except views of city more stunning. It's well equipped and everything has been thought about to make ones stay comfortable. The onsite gym has very good equipment and the perfect environment to watch the sunrise and sunset.

Ralph and his staff were extremely helpful, the transport organised by them to and from airport made it so much easier. Tips on where to eat, proved very good and the friendliness in our dealings was second to none.

The area Palermo Soho and it's neighbour Palermo Hollywood are the best areas, I believe, and it felt safe walking around at anytime of day. Good abundance of places to eat and drink to cater for most needs, including some nice quirky cafés e.g. Oui oui.

Would definitely recommend ralf and his team and apartments to others and if we ever come back to this part of the world again, we will definitely be looking to stay with ralf again.

My wife, daughter and I stayed in two of Ralf's apartments (Sunset and Marylin). We were all very impressed by the condition of the apartments and by the attention to detail Ralf, Marcelo and Tomas had to make our stay memorable. I would definitely recommend the units and them. The units were exactly as shown, in a very safe and central building, and nicely appointed. If you are in Buenos Aires, this is the place to stay. Walter

The apartment is very comfortable, clean, organized, well located and have a wonderful view of Buenos Aires. Since the moment we arrived, Ralf and his staff were very kind and helpful making our trip even better.
We wouldn't think twice to come back and stay in Marilyn Studio or any of others Ralf's places.
Thanks for everything.
Hasta Luego!

A estadia no Marilyn Studio foi sensacional! Eu e minha esposa estávamos em lua de mel e Ralf nos recebeu no apartamento com champagne, existem ótimos restaurantes por perto, bem como muitas atrações turísticas, cafés e o metrô (subte). A equipe de Ralf, muito receptiva, nos ajudou em tudo que precisávamos.
Enfim, ótimo apartamento, ótima localização e ótima cidade... Ficamos até triste na hora de voltar para casa. Com toda certeza iremos voltar para BA e com certeza ficaremos em um local da equipe do Ralf!

The stay at Marilyn Studio was sensational! My wife and I were on honeymoon and Ralf received at the apartment with champagne, there are great restaurants close by as well as many tourist attractions, cafes, and the subway (subte). A team of Ralf, very responsive, helped us in everything we needed.
Anyway, great apartment, great location and great city ... We were so sad when getting back home. Surely we will return to BA and for sure we will be in a place of Ralf team!

Ralf and his team were more than professional. Not only were they professional enough to have an apartment that was even better than the pictures on airbnb, they went above and beyond making us feel welcome and safe in Buenos Aires. The transfer from/to the airport was great, they had no problem with us checking in late and didn't feel like they had to check us in in a hurry because it was late.

The apartment itself was perfect. Great location, close to the Subte, close to all the great parks in Palermo and a short walk from awesome restaurants/coffee shops. The bed was comfortable, the apartment was very clean and cozy. Couldn't have been better. They had some fruit/coffee/water and a few other things waiting for us upon our arrival to make our first night/day in buenos aires more pleasant, and it definitely made a difference.

Would/will definitely book an apartment with Ralf again.

Ralf and his team were more than accommodating. The apt looks even better in person than pictures and is in a very nice neighborhood. The gym on the top floor was an added bonus and provided an exceptional view of the city. I would definitely recommend this place

Ralf was SUCH a great host. He met us in the lobby at 5am when our flight got in and gave us plenty of great information and was always very responsive. The apartment was PERFECT. Great little space, well decorated, awesome views on the sprawling city from the deck, we enjoyed many bottles of wine and charcutterie out there! Great location close to all the parks in Palermo area, close to the best neighborhoods in BA, plenty of cute shops, bars and restaurants. The only thing I wished we had done was spend time in the gym or the huge jacuzzis on the top floor of the building- talk about amazzzzzzing views!

This studio apartment has great views of the Buenos Aires skyline. It's in walking distance of excellent cafes, bars and restaurants in Palermo Soho (one of the best neighborhoods in BA) and metro locations. Raif and the BA4U team were excellent hosts - they accommodated our change in arrival time with ease, made us feel very welcome, provided us a very comprehensive overview of the apartment and also helped us with tours in and around BA. I would definitely recommend this place to other travelers looking for a centrally-located apartment in Buenos Aires.

Definitivamente recomiendo hospedarse aquí a todas las personas que quieren visitar Buenos Aires. Ralf y su equipo son sumamente amables y comprensivos con todo, desde los tiempos de respuesta durante la comunicación, hasta las comodidades, detalles y explicaciones precisas sobre el funcionamiento del departamento para que la estadía sea sumamente agradable. Lo más remarcable del departamente es sin duda su vista, desde el piso 15 que se encuentra el departamento y también desde el piso 31. Está muy bien ubicado y hay lugares muy cerca para todo, desde salir a tener una cena rápida hasta darte un clavado en una librería o tienda de ropa.

We stayed in the Marilyn apartment for our honeymoon recently and loved our experience. The place looks just like the pictures and the BA4U team was incredibly helpful during our time in Buenos Aires. From giving us pointers on where to go, getting us set up to see a tango show in San Telmo and even letting us print our Colonia ferry tickets at the office, we felt 100% taken care of. We would recommend the Marilyn apartment or any other BA4U listing to anyone!

FANTASTISCH, SUPERTOLLES APPARTMENT, SUPER ORGANISIERTES TEAM!!!!
Unsere Erfahrungen sind durchweg positiv. Das Appartment ist super, tolle Lage, geschmackvolle Einrichtung, Wahnsinnsausblick mit Sonnenuntergang auf dem Balkon und Sonne ab Nachmittag.
Das Team von Ralf ist perfekt organisiert und hilfsbereit in jeder Situation. Neben der Organisation des Shuttles vom Flughafen, übrigens sehr zu empfehlen, war das Team jederzeit ansprechbar und erleichterte uns die Ankunft mit einer tollen Einführung (speziellen Dank an Marcello!!!) in das Appartment und das Apartmentgebäude und tollen Tips für unsere Zeit in BA.
Über das Appartment muss nicht viel gesagt werden. Die Bilder sprechen schliesslich für sich. Kleinigkeiten wie ein voller Obstteller, sowie Kaffee und Tee, ein vorhandener Fön und eine Mehrfachsteckdose kompatibel mit gängigen Steckertypen und andere Details sollen hier aber doch nicht unerwähnt bleiben.
Der Apartmentkomplex ist ebenfalls sehr gepflegt und in tiptop Zustand, was auch auf den Fitnessbereich und den Pool zutrifft. Palermo ist ein schickes modernes und angesagtes Viertel mit einer Vielzahl an Kaffees, Bars, Restaurants und Boutiquen. Ein idealer Ort, also für eine tolle Zeit in BA.
Danke an das Team ba4u, Ihr seid SPITZE!!!

Buenos Aires is an amazing city and Ralf's Marilyn Studio in Palermo Soho is a fantastic base to explore this fantastic city.

Ralf and his team were brilliant to deal were brilliant to deal with before and during our stay. They were always very prompt to answer questions and provide excellent and very useful advise and tips. Ralf met us at check-in and really made us feel welcome. He also left some fruit, water and biscuits in the apartment which was very kind.

The apartment itself is really modern and finished to a very high standard. The pictures on Airbnb are very accurate and the view across the city is really great. There are loads of amenities in close proximity to the apartment and lots of great restaurants. I highly recommend Las Pizarras on Thames (recommended by Ralf).

I would highly recommend Ralf's Marilyn Studio in Palermo Soho to anyone visiting this amazing city and I would not hesitate to stay here again.

Ralf's associate, Marcelo, promptly met us at the apartment and we were blown away with how welcoming, energetic, and helpful he was! He took the time to show us everything about the apartment and the building amenities. In addition to all the wonderful tips Marcelo provided (not just about the apartment but also the neighborhood and Buenos Aires in general), the apartment included a binder and local magazine filled with really helpful information (which would have made a world of difference our first go around in BA when we stayed at a different apt). The apartment itself was very nice and had an amazing view! We enjoyed the gym, which was nice and also boasted an impressive view.

We were nervous about having a late departure out of Buenos Aires but Marcelo went above and beyond to accommodate us and ensure that we could leave our luggage in the building until it was time to depart (well after our scheduled check-out). All in all, this was probably our best stay in all of Argentina - not only for the apartment itself but for the tremendous customer service we experienced. Thanks Ralf and Marcelo!

arrived tired after long-haul flight.  Ralf's transfer worked and he was there to greet me.  Apartment great, everything I needed, comfortable, stylish, nice balcony with sunset, a pleasure to return to each day to my home away from home.  Beats a hotel room hands down.  Local provisioning easy so was able to enjoy home-cooked meals.    Security good.  Ralf's team very professional and efficient.  I would return without hesitation.

Breathtaking views over Buenos Aires. This place feels like a mix between a hotel and and apartment, because you also get access to the gym on the 31st floor and the pool in the gardens.

Ralf was very approachable and helpful and the location is great close to public transportation in Plaza Italia and to all the restaurants in Palermo.

We loved this place! Ralf is great, and was very welcoming and gave us plenty of good advices for the area. The view is amazing (and even much better from the nice gym on the top), and there where drinks, fruits, flowers and shampoo etc, a nice extra touch.

The heated pool was great too.

This house was perfect!!! It was exactly like the photos posted online. One of Ralfs associates met us at the gates right on time and led my boyfriend and I to the apartment, he brought us fresh water and there was a bowl of fruit waiting for us as well. It was a great apartment to explore Bunenos Aires from, located to tons of great supermarkets and restaurants and even a bar with specialty microbrewer beer on tap. Overall fantastic experience, we ended up spending an extra night because we loved it so much. The view from the balcony can't be beat. I would definitely recommend staying here

Everything was perfect. Location is a plus being very close to the Metro (subte).
The apartment is nice and I would recommend for everybody

We absolutely loved staying at the Marilyn Studio in Palermo for 2 nights in December 2014.  We arrived after 4 nights staying in the Recoleta where we focused on sight seeing in those surrounding areas.  When we arrived at the Marilyn it felt like a heavenly Oasis...the view, the pool, all the comforts of home...it was easy to hole up, enjoy and fully relax.  The neighbourhood is great too.  The service provided by the host was also very efficient and professional.  I wish we could have stayed a bit longer actually, and if we ever do, I would definitely try to return to this apartment.
Ralf and co. were all super nice and the apartment was amazing! Balcony was awesome!

If you are coming to stay in Buenos Aires and want to experience the city as an Argentinian then look no further. Ralf was a fantastic host with loads of great information , tips and advice. Nothing was to much trouble and he went out of his way to ensure our stay was perfect. The apartment was better than we expected with everything you need as well as stunning views, use of swimming pool and the perfect location. The metro is minutes away for access to the rest of BA while the apartment is in soho palermo which has more than enough to keep you occupied wherther you are eating, drinking, shopping or just going with the flow. Ralf recommended restaurant las pizarras just around the corner and it was so good that we ate there 3 times in 6 nights - also just further up the road towards the centre of soho is burger joint (voted third best burger bar in the world) where you can have a burger chips and a beer for just 80 pesos - fantastic. In fact the combination of apartment , location , the magic of BA and of course our host meant we did not want to leave. When we return to BA we will not consider staying anywhere else and will be telling all our friends to do the same.

I've had many great Airbnb experiences but this was the best so far. The apartment is gorgeous and in an ideal location between Palermo Viejo's shopping and dining and the subway. The apartment is every bit as nice in person as in the photos and extremely clean. The little touches made a big difference - liquid soap dispenser in the bathroom, fresh fruit in the kitchen, a small bar with liquor to make drinks. Ralf arranged a car to pick me up at the airport and drop me off, and it was less expensive that a typical taxi to the airport. Ralf is a total class act and a gentleman. I didn't leave to the airport until 7pm on my last day, and unfortunately the apartment had been booked for that night so I couldn't extend my stay. Ralf took care of my bag all day, and let me hang out in another apartment in the building he manages to freshen up and have a glass of beer before heading to the airport.

We were met by Andreas of Ralf Hobeck's team. We were late in arriving due to travel delays and Andreas was able to adapt to our revised schedule. He gave us a rundown of the apartment and the neighborhood. Andreas also left us a contact number should there be any questions or problems.

Lots of cafes, bars and restaurants in the neighborhood. The apartment is about two blocks from the metro which came in handy when visiting some tourist sites. It is also close to the zoo and the botanical garden.

The apartment had nice touches which we haven't seen in other apartments. There was a fresh fruit basket on the counter and a large bottle of water in the refrigerator.

Great view from the balcony of the apartment. Bed was comfortable and the air condition was welcome in the hot days of Buenos Aires.
We loved this apartment and are sorry to be leaving it.  Would recommend it highly

We have been very well attended, our host was caring and reactive. The place is wonderful, tastefully decorated, well equipped and perfectly located in the nice neighborhood of San Telmo. We strongly recommend this place, and we'll not hesitate to come back here the next time we visit Buenos Aires.

great place.
short walk to the start of Florida, pedestrian street, where I was working.
close to many bars and restaurants in San telmo.

washing machine was useful for my week's stay.

the team was very responsive to any communication.

Pour un voyage à Buenos Aires, cet appartement est un véritable bijoux. Parfaitement conforme aux attentes, dans un quartier authentique et populaire, vous vous sentirez à la maison. Nicola est très agréable et Guille est toujours disponible pour aider, avec une grande gentillesse.
Je le recommande très fortement, vous ne serez pas deçus.

Encore merci Nicola, gracias,
Abrazos

I can confidently say that this is a wonderful apartment! we felt at home from the first day. Guille is very fast and responsive to any request. met us in the morning, before the official check-in time. it's great to take a shower and sleep on a soft bed after a long flight. a special surprise was a bottle of wine as a gift) thank you! the apartment is fully equipped with everything necessary for a long stay. in the morning you can prepare orange juice, toast, brew coffee and go for a walk. in the evening, cook a steak at home from the beautiful local beef and drink a glass of Malbec, relaxing in a hammock. we enjoyed it for a month. the apartment is located in the center. 5 minutes walk to the presidential Palace. many shops, bars, pubs and cafes, shopping centers near several metro stations. walking distance to all attractions. two milongas very close, and on Sundays a big market. highly recommend. answer on all questions

Die Wohnung ist super gelegen und wirklich schön eingerichtet und groß. Die Klimaanlage im Schlafzimmer lässt einen gut schlafen, in den anderen Räumen war es zwischenzeitlich etwas warm. Es war alles da, was wir brauchten und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Gastfreundschaft war wirklich ausgesprochen toll!
A tremendous place on every level.
Eine Wohnung toll und absolut ausreichend eingerichtet. Liegt super in San Telmo, alles was man braucht erreicht man Schnell. Die Kommunikation war super und hilfreich. Wir kommen gern wieder.

Que dire à part conseiller cet appartement qui offre une ambiance extrêmement relaxante dans une décoration zen  au milieu d'une ville vivante. L'accueil a été parfait plein d'attention et d'aide. L'équipement de cet appartement est parfait, il y a tout ce dont nous avions besoin. L'emplacement à côté du marché de San Telmo , de restaurants , de cafés , de la place Dorrego où le Tango se danse à toute heure nous a rendu la vie très agréable.
Appartement exceptionnel. Je recommande vivement. Accueil et disponibilité incroyable. Je reviendrai !!

Really a great spot and a quick walk to Mercado San Telmo. Coffee Town became a favorite there because they roast their own beans on site.

Just around the corner there was a market with all the essentials. Better than the kioscos you typically end up settling for on your way home.

The apartment itself has Bohemian vibe. Exposed brick, high ceilings in the living room, and the decor has lots of character. Definitely felt at home and comfortable.

Private and because it doesn't face the street it's pretty quiet except for the occasional sound of construction, which seems somewhat ubiquitous here in BA.

The hosts were great and very helpful.

It is a third floor walk up, so if you are not used to taking the stairs you might feel like you're getting a bit of a workout.

That turned out to be a great warm up for all the hiking we did at our next stop in Mendoza.

I would definitely recommend this place to friends visiting the area.

This place is an absolute gem and I would gladly stay again. The decor is stunning, the hosts are extremely nice and helpful and respinsive and you get everything you need. The loft is fairly quiet despite being in the heart of San Telmo yet you get everything you coukd wish for in terms if nightlife and entertainment just a few blocks away. Thanks a lot for an unforgettable stay!
Todo fenomenal. Muy amable y mucho jabón 😉

Very good apartment, a lot of place, very good location
The hosts are very welcoming

Ralf's apartment is beautiful, spacious, clean, safe, with scenic views,  and in a wonderful neighborhood.  He also provides a car service to and from the airport - which was amazingly helpful and convenient. It takes all the stress out of getting your stay started. When we arrived we made our way up to the floor and were greeted by one of the friendliest and most helpful staff members (I'm sorry I can't remember his name!). He had a map of the city for us, showed us where to change our money, where some great restaurants and bars were located, and gave us a general layout of Buenos Aires. His English was perfect and he answered every question we had thoughtfully and carefully. The apartment had coffee, tea, and fruit ready for us from the get go and the views from the balcony we spectacular. We had a really fabulous stay and slept wonderfully in the ever comfortable bed. Thank you Ralf for everything!  It was perfect!

Ralf and Marcelo were incredibly helpful. We had a late arrival time and Marcelo was there waiting with a big smile to greet us and spent a lot of time making sure we knew where everything was in the apartment and how to get a hold of him if we needed anything. They really went above and beyond any Airbnb experience I've had and they have all been good. They had city maps in the apartment, towels for the pool, coffee, tea, fruit, snack bars, water... it was really nice when we didn't want to try to find anything that late at night. Additionally, we were enjoying our time so much, they let us stay later than originally planned at very short notice. They store our luggage for us and made sure we had safe and reliable airport transfers.

The apartment photos are completely accurate, they place is absolutely stunning and the view is spectacular. The floor to ceiling windows made the space feel so open and enjoyable.

It is in a great location, very safe and you can easily walk to the metro or to some of Buenos Aires best neighborhoods. It was always easy to find a taxi if we needed and there are great restaurants and coffee shops nearby.

When I go back I will definitely stay here and I would recommend both the apartment and Ralf/Marcelo to anyone looking for a seamless experience in Buenos Aires. Thank you both so very much.

Ralf and his team were VERY responsive to my needs. Excellent service. The apartment was clean and pleasant. The neighborhood was wonderful... great restaurants in the area and a subway station just a few blocks away.

Just a little warning... the apartment was quiet EXCEPT for the small dog that lives in the apartment above. You could hear it's click, click, click of little toenails on the bare floors all hours of the day and night. It wasn't loud, but if you tend to be annoyed by such things, be aware! I live in a bottom floor condo and have become very "zen" about the noises upstairs, but even so... there were times that it was annoying!
The host canceled this reservation 283 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Marcelo met us at the apartment after our trip from EZE airport.  The ride from the airport was fast and efficient and Marcelo was warm, friendly, and full of information.  The apartment was pristine and lovely.  The location was perfect.

Muy lindo todo!!
Bastante central xra seguir escurciones x buenos aires

We had a great time at the Marilyn studio! It was high standard for the price and a good location. We didn't see Ralf but Marcello gave us a good introduction! Everything was very clean and it felt like home.

Every moment spent in this apartment and on the grounds was delightful. The building itself is impeccably maintained, perfectly situated, and operates with 24 hour friendly and professional security staff; but it is the apartment, especially, that is a little jewel, with its harmonious decor, very comfortable furnishings, and outstanding vista over the city!
Ralf and his assistant, Marcelo, were attentive to every need and detail and responded in a most genuine and amiable manner.
My husband and I are anxious to return to this space and duplicate the wonderful experience we had there.

Very comfortable and well furnished. Every detail in Ralf's properties has been well thought out and the check-in process is as smooth and efficient as possible. Really enjoyed my stay... and the view.

The apartment was fantastic, exactly as described, and the service was great! The host was available for anything we needed and spent over an hour with us at check-in introduce us to BsAs. Would definitely stay here again!

My favorite thing in life is when expectations meet reality. During my stay at Florencia's lovely apartment, my expectations were far exceeded. Not only was the space exactly as pictured, but it was in the back of the building, over-looking lovely neighboring gardens, so I woke to the sound of birds singing every morning. Hard to believe in a bustling city such as Buenos Aires.

Besides the wonderful, comfortable, very clean accommodations, Flor and her husband were very helpful and kind. From giving me advice on transportation options from the airport to recommending local restaurants to helping me get a taxi at the end of my stay, they were truly the consummate hosts.

I chose this particular airbnb apt. because of the overwhelming number of wonderful reviews as well as the beautiful photos. I only needed to look at one listing to know that I was making the right choice. Hopefully you will make the same choice, and enjoy this little gem in the heart of Buenos Aires.

Apartamento ótimo e realmente aconchegante! Adoramos os dias que passamos ali. Além da Flor ser um doce de pessoa nos ajudou com mapas e até com o catão do transporte público, o que foi extremamente útil. Nas proximidades encontramos restaurantes, cafés e mercados. O bairro é tranquilo com muitas pessoas passeando pelas ruas até tarde da noite. Tivemos uma experiencia muito boa!

Florencia's place was absolutely adorable and everything we wanted in Buenos Aires! Located in trendy Recoleta, we were close to everything and felt safe. It was clean and very thoughtfully decorated. Perfect for short or long stays. Highly recommend.

Florencia and her husband were really good hosts!
The apartment is close to subway stations and bus stops.
Me and my fiancée walked to restaurants and markets. Great location.
The decoration is super cute and I had a really good time at Florencia's apartment.

Flor is an excellent host and the accommodation was perfect. Flor let us leave our backpacks at her place (a few blocks from the apartment) until check-in time. During check-in, she showed us how everything worked, gave us a metro/bus ticket and SIM card to borrow and then left us alone until checkout. Location is perfect, great shower and everything you need - felt like home. Free local telephone calls too! Would definitely recommend Flor and her apartment.

Adoramos nossa estadia em Buenos Aires! A Flor foi realmente uma excelente anfitriã! Ela já estava nos esperando quando chegamos ao apartamento e nos recebeu muito bem, deu várias dicas sobre a cidade, nos orientou com um mapa turístico, informações sobre ônibus, táxi e metrô, além de deixar um cartão recarregável para utilizar nos meios de transporte. Foi bastante útil!! O apartamento é muito agradável, tudo bem limpo e uma cama confortável para descansar no final de um dia de passeios. A localização é muito boa, fica num bairro agradável, cheio de cafés, restaurantes, supermercado (ao lado) e lojas. O metrô também fica há próximo, bastando uma pequena caminhada.

Um dia antes de irmos embora tivemos um pequeno problema no banheiro, mas prontamente o marido da Flor resolveu, com muita presteza e atenção, em pleno sábado de manhã (feriado)! Nada que atrapalhasse nossa estadia, mas mesmo assim, eles fizeram questão de resolver. Nós atrasamos uns 20 minutos do horário combinado para deixar o apartamento, mas eles foram ótimos e pacientes. Foi tudo muito bom, nós recomendamos!!

We enjoyed so much staying in Florenzia's flats that we spent more time than planned. The flats are lovely decorated, very clean and well furnished (one of the best bed we had during our 6 months trip) We felt like being home. They are both well situated in Recola, with a lot of small stores and restaurants by a small walking distance. Florenzia and her husband were really welcoming and arranging concerning chek in and out. We would defenitly go there again.

I loved my stay at Flor's apartment! It was my first Airbnb experience and it was flawless! The apartment is very well located, in the heart of a nice and safe neighbourhood. It is very close to the subway, markets, drugstore and a lot of nice places to eat. The double bed is very comfortable and the apartment is cozy and nicely equiped! Flor is very kind and sweet and she helped us with everything. She left us a map, a bus/metro card and a cellphone chip that was very helpful! The free local telephone calls were also very handy! I would definitely recommend staying in Flor's place. =)

100% recomendable, muy bien ubicado entre Recoleta y Palermo con Subte y diferentes líneas de bus para ir a centro, la boca... O para caminar por los alrededores. Zona segura tanto de dia como de noche, con comercio de todo tipo.
Y muy buena atención por parte de Flor.
