We highly recommend staying at Florencia's apartment in Beunos Aires. She is a fantastic host!  Even before we arrived, Florencia was sending us recommendations of what to see and do in her beautiful city. The apartment was well appointed. It was very comfortable, clean and was located in a great neighborhood in the coveted Recoleta area.  She provided great maps, guide books and a subway card which became extremely helpful. Florencia's thoughtful touches, restaurant recommendations and overall responsiveness was refreshing and much appreciated. The perfect place to stay whether you are first time visitors to BA or savvy travelers! Can't recommend this place more highly!

Flor es una anfiltriona muy amable y nos ha ayudado con todo que nececitábamos: transfer del aeropuerto al departamento, recomendaciones a dónde ir y comer, transfer al terminal de ómnibus etc... Su departamento es muy lindo, bien equipado (sobre todo la tarjeta del subte era muy práctico!) - en pocas palabras: una estadía perfecta en un lugar bonito en Buenos Aires. Muy recomendable! Gracias Flor!

El departamento de Florencia está excelentemente ubicado, en un muy buen barrio y con buena locomoción justo afuera. Todo estaba muy limpio y bien cuidado, y hasta nos recibió con café y alfajores. Fue una gratísima estadía en Buenos Aires. Volvemos de todas maneras!

An attractive, cosy well-contained apartment; comfy bed, well furnished, clean.  Small kitchen but okay for two. Fantastic location - walking distance to museums, parks, shops, restaurants, easy access to the subte. Apartment building feels very safe/secure too. Flor allowed me a super early check-in because the apartment was free that day, which meant i could enjoy the place for longer and was much appreciated! Thanks for the stay, we had a lovely time :-)

This flat looks exactly like the pictures show. All is clean and it's very comfortable! Although the kitchen may seem a bit tiny, it's fully-equipped and very practice for those who enjoy cooking. Flor and her husband are really kind and helpful, they gave us precious tips from the pre-arrival to our departure time. The location is great, with loads of shops, super/mini markets within a walking distance and also a short walk to the tube and main bus stations. We have taken a bus from Santa Fé Ave. which drove us straight to Caminito in 20 minutes - on a Saturday morning - and we've paid as little as 2.85 pesos p/p!!! Should you prefer, it's also easy to get a taxi around (it's a short ride to Palermo's main bars and clubs). I strongly recommend it and the cost was real fair!

Tudo estava de acordo com o anunciado, melhor, iam muito além.
Localização excelente, com acessos a metrô e ônibus além da proximidade de duas grandes avenidas, Córdoba e Santa Fé. A anfitriã nos deu todas as informações sobre a cidade, seus pontos turísticos, e do funcionamento do apartamento. Aconchegante, seguro, funcional e bem equipado.
Florência nos ambientou e deixou tranquilos para aproveitar nosso passeio.
Simpatia, presteza e solicitude são suas características.
Agradecemos pelo que pudemos viver a partir desse local e certamente voltaremos.

Great location and well appointed apartment. Florencia was a great host and provided us with maps and public transport cards to make our trip around Buenos Aires most enjoyable, a big thank you for helping organise the early morning transfer to the airport.  We would highly recommend and will return.

The apartment looked exactly like the pictures... it is absolutely well located... and on top of that Florencia and her husband were both down-to-earth in terms of providing us hints and sorting out questions we've made prior to our arrival. Really well spent cost benefit rental.

My stay at Flor's apartment was lovely - the apartment is just as nice as the photos, and the neighborhood is great, it's a pretty quiet street that's a short walk from some great restaurants and shopping. She was a great host, very flexible about check in and check out times, and it made my stay in Recoleta very comfortable. Highly recommend this for a short OR long stay in Buenos Aires.

We had a wonderful experience here. Flo and her husband were very responsive to our needs from the start.

The place itself was warm and welcoming after a long day of travel. It was the perfect size for two travelers. We arrived late in the evening. Alfajores, an Argentinan delicacy and bottled water were provided, a very nice welcoming touch.

The location was ideal for walking to various venues throughout Buenos Aires and exploring the city. Subway cards were provided which we did not use, but we have a idea once we return to Buenos Aires.

This place and the hosts know how to create a comfortable experience for world travellers. We would have liked to stay a few days longer.

Everything was perfect! Me and my partner stayed at Flor's apartment for four days and since we booked, she went very attentive, giving us tips about money exchange, what to do and where to go. She also booked our transfer from the airport to the apartment, with a very kind driver called Armando, for a great price.
When we arrived in the apartment, at 3am, her husband was there to give us the keys and explain everything we needed about the neighborhood, with various guides and maps.
The apartment is cute and comfortable, perfect for a couple, just like it looks in the photos. The location is great, also, only two blocks to the subway, and about 10 minutes walking to the Palermo Viejo area. I would definitely come back! Thanks Flor!

O apartamento da flor é incrível tanto na localização tanto quanto no conforto! O lugar é exatamente como nas fotos, muito arejado, limpo e com um cheirinho ótimo! Nas redondezas se encontram diversos cafés, restaurantes e bem do lado do apartamento há um supermercado. Para quem deseja cozinhar a cozinha é equipada com tudo que é necessário, a cama é extremamente confortável s e o banheiro tem uma banheira bem aconchegante. Quando a flor nos recebeu foi bem simpática e nos deu indicações de onde estávamos localizados e como poderíamos explorar buenos aires, além disso ela nos ofereceu o cartão SUBTE que é bem prático na hora de pegar transporte público sem a necessidade de moedas, há também diversos guias turísticos pela casa que nos ajudaram bastante. Ela também foi muito gentil na hora do check out e nos deixou ficar um pouco mais já que não tinha hóspedes para dar check in. Enfim, buenos aires na casa da flor foi uma experiencia ótima recomendo a todos!

Con mi marido hemos estado muy bien en el apto., muy cómodo y arreglado, con todo lo necesario y funcionando, una buena ubicación céntrica en la ciudad, a doscientos metros del obelisco. El edificio es seguro, con vigilancia las 24 hs. Griselda, la anfitriona, ha sido muy servicial, pendiente de cualquier necesidad que pudiéramos tener. Hemos estado durante 15 días y consideramos que es una opción muy recomendable.

El apartamento de Griselda es perfecto para dos o tres personas (una de ellas durmiendo en el sofá-cama del salón) durante unos cuantos días para descubrir Buenos Aires. Es muy céntrico, enfrente del teatro Maipu, y perfectamente comunicado. Hay vigilancia en el edificio. Griselda y su hijo estuvieron muy atentos a todo lo que pudiéramos necesitar, y no tuvimos que pagar ningún extra por la tercera persona.
El único detalle es que el aire acondicionado no es muy potente, y como estuvimos en diciembre durante unos días en que la temperatura era muy alta, pasamos un poco de calor por las noches.
Por lo demás, una buena relación calidad/precio.

El departamento está muy bién ubicado, a pocas cuadras del Obelisco e de la Calle Florida. El edifício tiene seguridad 24 horas y el personal es muy amable. Además, está justo sobre una estación del Subte! Adicionalmente, el departamento es limpio, organizado, la cocina tiene todos los aparatos y el aire condicionado es nuevo y funciona muy bién. Viajé con mi madre y hermana e lo pasamos muchísimo bién. La señora Griselda fue muy atenciosa e nos recibió muy bién. Lo recomiendo fortemente.

Nossa Anfitriã, Florencia, foi muito simpática e solícita. Nos recebeu muito bem, com chá e alfajores! Deu dicas de como chegar ao apartamento e muitas outras sobre o bairro e área próximas. O bairro do apartamento é muito bom, bastante residencial, mas com comércio próximo. É perfeito para quem quer experimentar a vida de um morador de Buenos Aires. Ficamos encantados. O apartamento é exatamente como se vê nas fotografias do anúncio, bem aconchegante, bem decorado, bem limpo e bem equipado. Foi uma experiência excelente!

Ralf’s flat was excellent and I would certainly come back. It is modern and well-maintained, impeccably clean, nicely located and comfortable. Not big, but smartly arranged so that you have everything you need. Ralf is very well organised (there’s a folder full of information in the flat) and will give you great tips for your stay in Palermo.

This was an amazing apartment at a great area of the city and an even better host. Ralf was exceptionally accommodating, gave us good advice and responded quickly to any of our questions. I think that it will be tough to find a better place in BA.

This was my first time in Buenos Aires and as a solo traveller I enjoyed the apartment. It's really close to a lot of places, shops and restaurants (and if you're planning to use an uber -which is super cheap- this apartment has a superb pick up location).

The pool was really enjoyable in the morning and afternoon. The balcony has THE BEST sunset view ever and the aircon was always working.

The first day a guy called Marcelo did my check-in and took the time to explain how to navigate the city - I appreciated this a lot.

5* experience in this apartment. It worth every penny.

If you're pondering options, go and get this one!

This place is a great unit with an amazing view. Ralf is very accommodating and flexible with check in and out and arranged car service to and from the airport for us. The neighborhood is great and Ralf gives great recommendations. The balcony is perfect for watching the sunset and relaxing with a bottle of wine. We would definitely stay here again.

Ralf was great - everything from the initial booking, pre-arrival information to the arrival walkthrough and tips on venues in the area. I would highly recommend staying - the unit is beautiful, in a great location and has top notch security.

Denne lejlighed ligger perfekt placeret i Palermo, udsigten er fantastisk, og solnedgangen på altanen skal opleves. Meget flotte faciliteter som fitness center og  pool. Meget grundig og gæstfri modtagelse. En perfekt lejlighed for to voksne gæster...... rækværket på altanen er lavt, hvis man skulle have børn derude uden  100% opsyn. Sikkerheden er i top ved indgangen til området. Vores højeste anbefalinger.

Really great condo! We couldn't believe the amazing view of the city from this condo!! Great location too. Close walking distance to restaurants, bars, small shops, and subway. Ralf provided a subway card, which made it easy to load money and use. The gym was nice and with an amazing view. The security was on point, they remembered us.

I highly recommend visiting La Carnicería which is on the other side of the block! Make sure to make reservations for this place.
Cumplió con las expectativas!

es un monoambiente muy amplio y bien decorado. equipado a full y con unas vistas hermosas de BsAs.
muy recomendable.
Marcelo el anfitrion es muy atento y pendiente de todo.

In Lindo departamento en in buen barrio
Con mucho que hacer

Great apartment with very good security. Lovely balcony to enjoy breakfast on. Good location. Nothing negative to say about the actual apartment. Walls very thin so could clearly hear neighbours, especially the apartment above who were noisy until the early hours for three nights. But this is not Ralfs fault and in no way distracts from the lovely accommodation.

A estadia no apartamento foi muito boa. Todas nossas expectativas foram satisfeitas.
Indicamos positivamente a locação do apartamento!

Pasamos muy lindo. Fue la primera vez que usábamos Airbnb y todo salió perfecto, era lo que buscábamos. El lugar ideal, el apto muy bien puesto, cómodo, linda vista. Ralf muy buen anfitrión, nos indicó todo lo que necesitábamos. Es para volver y recomendar. Muchas gracias!

The apartment is clean and well-maintained. It is very conveniently located in a great neighborhood. The subway is in walking distance and there are a ton of cafes, bars, and restaurants close to the apartment. Ralf gave us many great suggestions on places to visit and restaurants to eat at. He was extremely helpful and responsive. Highly recommend!
Perfect for a couple with the best sunset we saw in a long time.

This Soho apartment was lovely, with beautiful views and everything you need to enjoy the surrounding neighborhoods. Hosts were extremely hospitable and friendly. Great place to stay near restaruants and the park.

Ralf and Marcelo are great Airbnb hosts! Not only the apartment was very clean when I arrived, Marcelo was very warm during the check-in and explained to me every detail so I could feel like home. All main transportation is very nearby to the apartment and Palermo counts with lots of options from restaurants, to local cafes, supermarkets and entertainment. The view from the apt is also astonishing - don't miss going to the rooftop to exercise or take some panoramic pics of Buenos Aires. Very well recommended!

This place is amazing! Great location, the room is beautiful and stylish, and has everything you could need. The bed is SUPER comfy with great pillows! The view is awesome, plus there is a gym, pool, and sauna. Highly recommend! Plus they have check in down to a science and are so helpful

La posizione dell’appartamento molto comoda vicina a mezzi di trasporto, vicina a ristoranti e bar, edificio molto elegante strepitosa la palestra al 33 piano, appartamento molto bello con una vista pazzesca, arredo ricercato, lo consiglio vivamente, Ralf molto efficiente e preciso .
We had a wonderful stay here! Ralf and his friend went above and beyond to make sure we had a comfortable stay. The view from the balcony was incredible. Would highly recommend this place to others.

Perfect location in Palermo Soho, beautiful apartment and building, and the amazing balcony even nicer than in the pictures ; ) Host was  extremely attentive and communicative, and made our stay a pleasure. Highly, highly recommended.

O apartamento é ótimo, limpo, tudo muito funcional, wi-fi, tv a cabo, ar condicionado perfeitos. A localização central e proxima de tudo é muito comoda pra passear a pé, metro ou ônibus. Griselda é extremamente atenciosa e simpática. Com certeza recomendo!

C'était notre première expérience avec airbnb et nous avons été enchanté. Griselda nous a réservé un accueil chaleureux et familier. Tout était prêt dans la chambre, le téléphone et les adresses en cas de besoin. Aucun problème pour accéder à la chambre ni à la rendre. La chambre se situe au dessus d'un arrêt de métro (très pratique!) et très bien situé dans le centre. Nous recommandons cette adresse.
Excelente departamento, bien ubicado, Griselda una persona muy amable y siempre estuvo pendiente durante nuestro hospedaje.
El apartamento está súper bien ubicado, es cómodo y seguro. La atención de Griselda fue de lo mejor, cálida y apoyándonos en todo lo que necesitamos. Recomiendo al 100% esta experiencia!!

Hey everyone! I am very thankful to Grizelda, she is very nice, intelligent and accurate host. We had a very nice time in buenos aires.
Apartment was very good, clean and simple, with great central location, right above metro station (which we didn't use hahahah)
Rooms and everything was very very small, really. If you are a little bit fatty, you will suffer :))) Anyway, we were lucky to be quite slim )))
Also we were lucky to have local friend with us, who translated everything, because Grizelda is very nice and friendly but not speaking English person.

Hola Griselda,Muchas gracias por tu atenciòn durante estos dias !Nos sentimos como en casa y muy a gusto en el departamento.
Cuenta todo lo necesario para pasar muy bien!
Gracias por todo!
Alfonso

hola! mi familia y yo estuvimos desde el jueves hasta el Domingo de semana de Turismo en el apartamento. el mismo esta ubicado en pleno microcentro, a pasos de la peatonal de Lavalle y de la Calle Corrientes.
es un lugar cómodo para pasar las vacaciones
Griselda muy buena anfitriona, muy atenta y dispuesta a orientarnos respecto a los diversos recursos disponibles para movilizarnos en esa hermosa ciudad.
hasta pronto!!!

griselda quiero agradecer tus atenciones nos sentimos muy a gusto en el departamento, ya que cuenta con todas las comodidades, el departamento es lindo buena ubicacion, seguro y vos nos brindaste toda la atencion para poder disfrutar y conocer la ciudad. Muchas gracias y esperamos regresar pronto. saludos.
Roxana Martinez.

Griselda is a warm lady that takes care of her guests. She doesn't speak English but it didn't matter as she still managed to communicate with a big smile. Apartment is very, very clean, safe, ideal located and good value for money. Highly recommend!! We will absolutely stay here on our next Buenos Aires visit!

We had a great time, the apartment was clean, neat, it had everything, the wifi worked perfectly, the shower and the bed were very nice too!
Griselda is very friendly.The location was good and the people guarding the building were also friendly.
I definitely recommend it :)

Griselda es una anfitriona muy acogedora, llena de información local y dispuesto a ayudar en lo posible. El apartamento es muy agradable y espacioso. La ubicación es excelente muy cerca del metro, lo que te permite movilizarte por todo Buenos Aires. Cerca del muchos lugares turisticos, definitivamente una excelente ubicación Lo recomiendo

Excelente, el departamento en verdad muy limpio, céntrico, lamentablemente sólo estuve un día en buenos aires pero con gusto regresaría! Griselda una muy buena anfitriona siempre al pendiente de nuestra llega y que no nos faltará nada!

A acomodação é excelente, me atendeu muito bem. Quando cheguei o apartamento estava muito limpo e com todas as informações (controle da tv, ar condicionado, wi-fi) disponível. Griselda foi ao apartamento no dia seguinte, pois cheguei de madrugada. Foi muito atenciosa comigo, nos explicou tudo e combinamos o horário que ela iria pegar as chaves de volta.
A única coisa que deixa a desejar no apartamento, é o banheiro, tem duas lampadas e ambas estão em cima da pia o que torna o banheiro escuro e uma das lampadas estava queimada, o que deixou o banheiro mais escuro ainda.
Sobre a localização, o prédio fica literalmente ao lado do metro (Lavalle), uns 300 metros do Obelisco e bem próximo também ao café Tortoni. De noite não é um lugar muito bonito, porém tem acesso a tudo que você precisa durante o dia.

Griselda, agradezco sus comentarios y alojamiento. Fuiste días muy útiles y buenos allí y pasó su apartamento. Gracias.
Cecilia

Ratings below out of 10.
Cleanliness: 10
Closeness to theatres, centre of the city and public transport: 10
Information and help provided by the hostess, Griselda: 10
Ammenities within the accommodation for guests, i.e. tourist information, closet space, storage: 10
Highly recommended to all. Even at night the location felt more than safe to walk around, made all the more with a receptionist on ground floor to keep track of entrants to the building.

Disfrutamos de una bienvenida muy cálida y punctual. Es un alojamiento cuidado, muy limpio y central en Buenos Aires. Puedes ubicarte facilmente a pie en el barrio, posibilidades para comer y desayunar cercanas, entrada vigilada, estación de metro al lado. Perfecto para ir de turismo por el país teniendo un apartamento para las maletas. Gracias por todo Griselda.
All was good. Griselda is a fine lady and everything went well with our stay.

Griselda was accommodating with our early morning arrival and helpful in showing us her place. The pictures were accurate and the neighbourhood was central. The kitchen was a bit small for a family of four if we were staying long term but a very nice short term place for us.
We had a great time, Griselda it is a great hostess and we felt in love with the apartment. The security personel was wonderful, very kind and respectful. Griselda you were awesome with everything.

Gracias Griselda por toda su ayuda y apoyo. Nuestra estadia fue muy confortable y el apartament muy bien cuidado y limpio. El personal de vigilancia muy amable y atento. La pasamos muy bien y esperamos volver pronto!

Desde el primer momento Griselda nos hizo sentir como si estuviéramos en casa, su amabilidad y su opiniones sobre que visitar, por donde pasear o donde comer fueron excelentes.

La ubicación de 10 y el apartamento limpio y coqueto.

Muy recomendable !!
Griselda fue muy atenta. El apartamento esta super bien localizado ,muy limpio y ordenado

Griselda es una persona muy amable, atenciosa y preocupada con sus hospedes. Nos ha presentado toda la habitación y además de eso, nos ha dejado todas las informaciones de las líneas de subter y autobús de la ciudad. Ella nos informó acerca de todos los teléfonos importantes y nos dejó una lista de lugares que deberíamos visitar en nuestra estadía.
El piso es lindo y todo funciona perfectamente.
Puedo hablar con seguridad que cuándo vuelva a Buenos Aires buscaré este mismo piso.
Muchas Gracias por toda atención y cariño. Eres una señora muy amable.
Besos de sus hermanos Brasileños
Andressa Porto
Marta Porto
Marcio Xavier y
Yo, Angéllica .

Griselda is the sweetest person I have ever met! She waited us in the lobby of the apartment first day and showed the house. She does not speak English but she has written all the instructions in a piece of paper in English. She was always available to answer the airbnb messages during our stay. She also helped us arrange an airport transport (4 am in the morning) in our last day. Apartment is very well located, close to everything. There is a simple market and a subway station just under the apartment. Apartment is simple, but she has everything that you may think of. I recommend this place!

Só tenho a elogiar a receptividade da Griselda. O apartamento é exatamente o que se vê nas fotos. Acomoda 4 pessoas perfeitamente. Perto de tudo, farmácia, conveniencia 24 horas, metro, Obelisco, Galeria Pacífico, enfim, melhor impossível. Encontrei o apartamento limpíssimo e muito completo, com tudo o que se pode precisar. Griselda é uma pessoa muito agradável, preocupada com o nosso bem estar nos ensina a usar desde a TV, split, fogão, até microondas, ela é ótima e de uma pontualidade britanica. RECOMENDO.

El lugar muy ameno,  muy a mano de todo, Griselda una persona muy amable y hospitalaria.  Griselda nos permitio dejar nuestras pertenencias muy temprano, porque  teniamos que ir al medico. Muchisimas gracias por todo.. !!

El departamento está estratégicamente ubicado pudiendo acceder a cualquier punto de la cuidas a través de los distintos medios de transporte. Todo en perfectas condiciones. Griselda fue muy amable con nosotros y nos brindó información para facilitar nuestra estadía en Buenos Aires. El check in y check out fue muy sencillo. Asimismo, la seguridad del edificio fue muy amable con nosotros y nos asesoro para llegar a los distintos lugares que teníamos que visitar.

Griselda una excelente anfitriona, muy atenta y amable, nos ayudo y estuvo pendiente de nuestra llegada y estadía, proporcionando tips para conocer la ciudad. El departamento muy acogedor, todo esta y funciona perfectamente, muy bien ubicado en la ciudad, cerca las diferentes vías de transporte, centro, restaurantes y mas, el edificio es muy seguro.
La pasamos muy bien. Gracias..

Passamos o fim de ano em Buenos Aires, que cidade maravilhosa!!! O apartamentos que ficamos estava perfeito, perto de tudo, ótima localização ( a 2 quadras do obelisco e da rua Florida, e em cima de um metro).
O apartamento é muito agradavel, aconchegante, do tamanho ideal, com ar, frigobar, wi-fi...não faltou nada !!! tudo que estava mencionado estava correto, e a Griselda é muito gentil, nos ajudou em tudo.
Tem porteiros, segurança 24 horas.
Adoramos e com certeza vou usar o site de novo em outra viagem!!!!

Muito bom o apartamento, muito arrumado, limpo, espaçoso, organizado, e muito bem planejado. Foi excelente a estadia, dá perfeitamente para 4 pessoas. Griselda não pode nos receber mas deixou na portaria as chaves, e foi tudo tranquilo, depois ela nos telefonou e deu tudo certo. Enfim, foi muito bom a localização. Recomendo muito.
Good value and very. Central location. Griselda was lovely.
This was a great apartment in the heart of Palermo Soho with amazing views! Ralf and his team were very helpful and responsive throughout the stay. Highly recommended, would stay again!

I had a wonderful stay in this beautiful apartment!  I used the car service to and from the airport and the driver was very prompt.  Ralf was at the building when I arrived.  He showed me how to work everything in the apartment and gave me great tips on where to get groceries and lunch.  The apartment itself is very nice - it has a beautiful view of the city and the sunset.  I was there over NYE and had a fantastic view of the fireworks over the city from the balcony.  There is plenty of shopping and restaurants nearby.  There is also a very large and beautiful park nearby that I enjoyed walking around. Ralf very helpful and was easy to reach when I need some help with a window shade.  I used the gym on the top floor everyday - the views are great.  I never made it to the pool, but I saw people enjoying it every day. I will stay here again if I get back to Buenos Aires in the future!  I highly recommend this apartment!
Wonderful location.......responsive host.....lovely apartment

This unit is everything that is advertised and more. The location is really terrific for walking,  or taking transit or catching a cab. All of the daily amenities such as great cafes,  banks, small grocers and a variety of other shops and restaurants are nearby. The building and facilities surrounding the apartment are top notch and the unit itself is well outfitted and very neat. Excellent value proposition.

Great place, great location, great hosts.  They even had a fruit basket for us upon arrival.  Marcelo showed us around and made us feel comfortable.  The neighborhood is wonderful.  Highly recommended.

Great location, clean, beautiful skyline view from the terrace. The stylish apartment has everything we need to stay comfortable besides. Palermo is a cool neighborhood, with lots of bars, restaurants, cafes, park, cozy and nice places around. Ralf is a great host, easy to communicate with. Recommend to anyone.

This apartment is exactly as advertised.  Great apt, great building with pool and gym, fantastic location.   The host Ralf is a pro, super responsive.  Can’t ask for anything more.  You should book this place.

Ralf was a nice host. He welcomed us at the place with fresh fruits and water. The apartment is really beautiful, like in the pictures. The location is amazing, just a few block from the subway station and it's a nice and safe neighborhood with many restaurants to go to. The only issue we had was with the bathroom that had a bad smell (like sewer smell) that was very uncomfortable.

Without a doubt,Ralf's studio was the best Airbnb that we have ever stayed at!
Everything about it was first class. The place is in a beautiful building, in a terrific area! Fantastic restaurants within one block. Communication was excellent, the local tips very helpful and the view lovely! To top it off, he even was able to provide a Nespresso machine for us. Which we had asked for. Wow!
We can't recommend it enough!!

Ralf and his team are great. The apartment is in a fantastic location with excellent security, and provides a view that even locals were impressed by.
The comprehensive ‘orientation’/welcome where we were shown in detail all the facilities of the building and apartment, as well as information about the local area and subway was unparalleled. The provision of two keys, a Sube (subway travel) card, contact details in case of an emergency, and cookies and a bottle of wine were exceptionally thoughtful.
I would absolutely stay in one of Ralf’s properties again.

The apartment is excellent. Brilliant location, amazing view with a sunset. We especially enjoyed the check in with Marcello... He was great. Amazing sense of humour and knows the city well. He put us on some brilliant restaurants. Thank you!!

The apt and the views were unbelievable. The location was perfect and walking distance from restaurants/bars in Palermo. The building amenities were just too good....the gym, sauna and jacuzzi in the 32nd floor are perfect.
Best airbnb in Buenos Aires! I hope to stay there again during future visits.
The balcony view is incredible. Location amazing and thank Ralf for making me really feel at home. Will be back here for sure next year :)
Localização excelente, fomos muito bem recebidos, apartamento confortável para um casal.
AAAAA

Great space with a very hospitable host. Clean and easy to use. Great view. I asked by chance if I could get some salt because I was cooking something and realized there was no salt, and I was delivered salt within minutes! Haha - random but incredibly prompt service. The location is great as well, super close to public transit, nightlife, etc.
Great experience, exactly what I expected.
comodo buena ubicacion y el anfitrion sumamente amable

This apartment is absolutely wonderful. It is clean, comfortable, and in an excellent location. Flor and her husband were fantastic hosts. They were very welcoming and helpful. When we checked in a map of the city, subway card, and tea were all ready for us. I highly recommend this apartment - you will be very happy with your decision to stay here!

Excellent option in Buenos Aires.  Clean.  Quiet.  Comfortable.  And very friendly host (Griselda).  Near the theater district and walking streets with many restaurants and small cafes.  Highly recommended!

Clean and comfortable apartment. Construction on the street below so taxis can't go directly to/from building. Take taxis to/from nearby Rochester Hotel. Friendly and helpful host. Doesn't speak English, but uses technology like Google translate so communication isn't a problem. Has a thorough manual with lots of info like WiFi password. Recommend!

Ótimo apartamento, muito bem localizado. Andamos os principais pontos turísticos a pé, além de ser uma rua movimentada e tranquila de se andar durante a noite. Existe supermercado e padaria na mesma rua. O apartamento é muito arrumado e cheiroso. Não nos faltou nada. Não conseguimos conhecer a Griselda pessoalmente, mas o tempo todo ela se mostrou dedicada e interessada com a gente, entrando sempre em contato, excelente anfitriã, uma fofa! Além disso, ela se preocupou em fazer um catálogo com os principais pontos turísticos e possibilidades de se chegar até lá, o que nos ajudou bastante.
Adorei ficar nesse apartamento. Recomendo!

房主非常熱情且親切，我們詢問的問題她都會盡可能地回答我們，房間跟照片一樣，沒有任何的落差感。地點非常的好，公寓樓下就是地鐵站，非常的方便，離AEP機場搭計程車約一小時，搭地鐵到公車總站約30分鐘，走路到送洗衣服的地方約三分鐘。
但晚上出入若是女生自己一個人來旅行的話，要早點回家喲。BA的晚上跟大多的大城市首都一樣，出入的人比較複雜，要注意安全。
非常感謝屋主！很喜歡這個家！Muchas gracias ！
O apartamento é igual ao descrito. Extremamente limpo, organizado e muito bonito! Recomendo a todos alugar, não irão se arrepender! A anfitriã estava a nossa espera e nos orientou pacientemente :)

El departamento está muy bien ubicado, muy céntrico. Por supuesto hay el típico ruido del centro, pero la gran ventana de estar muy bien ubicado. Griselda dejó mucha información útil y el departamento estaba limpio. Tuvimos un problema con las llaves y ella fue muy amable! Muchas Gracias Griselda!

Griselda was very friendly and helpful, she even came back to the apartment to see us off when we checked out. The apartment is in a busy area but feels safe with the doorman. The ac works really well. It may have been from the previous tenants but the apartment had a funky smell to it. Other than that, great place to stay.

Excelente atención de parte de la Sra Griselda, nos gustó su manual de sugerencias, la ubicación es ideal, estaba limpio con sus respectivas toallas y sabanas.muy acogedor, horario flexible al entrar y salir del apartamento. lo recomiendo ampliamente.
Very clean and welcoming. Amazing location over the Lavalle metro stop.
Todo en orden en el depto y muy buena onda de griselda. Muy buena experiencia

Flor's apartment is as described. The apartment is located in a great area with shops, restaurants and cafés. You have access to the bus and train to easily access other areas in Buenos Aires.  Flor was a great host and helped us with tango reservations and organizing cab ride to the airport.

The apartment was extremely clean and had some nice 'extras' like travel adapters and guide books/maps.  Location was conveniently near train stations and felt very safe.  Flor was an amazing hostess who responded quickly to any questions and accommodated our early arrival and late departure schedules.  Thanks for making our stay in Buenos Aires so comfortable!

Florencia and her husband were wonderful hosts! They made us feel welcome and answered all of our questions as well as helped us get transportation to the airport. The apartment was absolutely perfect, in an awesome and safe location, and even better than the photos! We would absolutely recommend you to stay here!

It was a pleasure staying at Flors apartment. The apartment is great, in the perfect location and looks exactly like the pictures.
Flor was a great host, very informative and accommodating. She spent time with us upon check-in to show us everything in the apartment and gave us very handy tips about Buenos Aires.

Highly recommended and will definitely stay again on our next trip to Buenos Aires.

THANKS!!

El apartamento se encuentra en muy buenas condiciones. La cama es muy comoda, la cocina bien equipada, el wi fi funciona perfecto. Esta limpio. Florencia y su esposo son muy amables y estan atentos a todas las necesidades. Me estaban esperando el dia que llegue y cuando me tenia que ir alli estuvieron inmediatamente para recibir la llave.
La ubicacion es muy buena, cerca hay lugares para comer, tomar un café, tambien hay un mercadito y lugar de venta de furtas y verduras.

Great location and everything you need for a stay in the area.
Flor and Demian were very accessible and they made us feel welcome in BA.
We had a great stay with them!

The apartment is just as gorgeous as in the photos! We loved our stay here, in a very safe area, lots of restaurants, cafes and supermarkets close by. Flor was absolutely lovely and responded to emails quickly. Thank you for making our stay in Buenos Aires so fantastic!

El apartamento está impecable y tal cual las fotos. Uno se siente como en su casa. La ubicación es muy céntrica con varias cosas para visitar cerca y sino se tiene el subte y muchas líneas de colectivo a pocas cuadras. Ojalá pueda volver a hospedarme ahí! Agradezco mucho la hospitalidad recibida.

Florencia was a wonderful host! When we arrived at the apartment she took the time to walk through everything with us, she provide us with a map of the city and recommendations of where to eat and places to go. The apartment was just like photos, very clean and in a great neighborhood.

My daughter and I stayed in Florencia's flat for a week in November and our experience could be summarised in one word; fantastic.
The flat is large enough for two persons and well furnished. The kitchen is small but very well equipped making it easy to prepare meals. The bath room is large and hot water is available all the time.
The flat is in a large block of flats with a locked front door making you feel very secure. It's situated in a very nice part of Buenos Aires with plenty of shops, cafes and restaurants near by.
Florencia and her husband were very wellcomming and gave us plenty of advice on how to find our way around the city as well as lots of good recommendations.
If I ever return to Buenos Aires I would certainly try to stay there again.
I can highly recommend this flat

As soon as we stepped into the apartment, Flor made us feel at home.  She provided us with a map of the city, a subte card, and recommendation of places to visit and eat.  She even was nice enough to book a Tango show for us since the people at the place couldn't understand my broken Spanish.  The apartment was exactly as the pictures and had everything that we needed.  It was located in a great area, only a few blocks from metro.  I don't think I could have asked for a better host and experience from my first time using Airbnb.  I would definitely stay at Flor's place the next time I'm in Buenos Aires.
We had a great Time in Buenos Aires. Florencia is very nice and helpful. The apartment is very close to the coolest place!

Florencia and her husband were excellent hosts. We loved the apartment and location. The neighborhood was safe and getting to all the main attractions in Buenos Aires was simple by foot, Subte, or a cheap taxi.

Wonderful! Very cozy, well decorated and well-outfitted studio in a nice neighborhood. We loved the feeling of 'home' that we felt from the moment we walked in. Tea is on the table waiting for you to brew as soon as you arrive!

Florencia is fantastic. She's just down the block from the apartment and was a great communicator in advance and very responsive to our needs while in BA. She let us leave our stuff with her while we waited for a bus ride out of town.

My only wish was for a better view from the window, but for the quality of the place (especially the good feeling), the neighborhood and Florencia, this is the best you can do in BA.

We had a great time at Florencia's!  Both her and Demian were very helpful and allowed us to stay till 6pm the day of our check out which was very helpful.  The building where the flat is situated is not in a very good condition, but the apartment is clean, cosy, and nicely decorated.  The couple have put a lot of thought and care so as to have in the flat everything that the guests might need.  The location is good, central, safe, and close to many cafes and restaurants.

The apartment is very clean, located in a good area, and management was very responsive and forthright. We came to BA twice within a week and ended up just staying here both times because it was a good value and exactly what we were looking for.

Wow! This place is just as pictured! The view was amazing, the building security, gym, facilities were amazing, the checkin/out process was easy, the location was great. Ralf was amazing - quick responses, helpful tips, etc. Overall just an absolutely amazing place to stay! We loved Cafe Martinez and Las Horas, both a very short walk away. We had a fun day at the horse races, taxi there was 107 pesos.
great apartment in palermo soho. walking distance to bars and restaurants and close to tourist attractions

Wow, we loved this place! This was our first trip to BA. We landed in the morning and had arranged a car. Upon arriving, Ralf greeted us and was able to check us in a little early. He’s wonderfully accommodating Av and shared tips about the city. The apartment is perfect size, well decorated and very clean. Ralf provides everything you need to enjoy a meal for breakfast or a night in. The neighborhood is safe and lovely. Grocery, deli, coffee and laundry all very close. The sunsets are as amazing as described. Ralf has fruit, coffee, tea and little  cookies to welcome you - a welcome treat after an overnight flight! We loved staying here and when back to BA some day, would stay again. Choose this place!
This apt is perfectly located, extremely clean and as advertised. Host was exceptional too making life easy for us... all outstanding sr Ralf’s place

This apartment has it all! Never get tired of that view. Palermo Soho neighborhood, the food, shopping....amenities of this condo....the transit options. Ralf is very professional. Can’t wait to come back.....

GREAT PLACE TO STAY, every little detail was nice, good mattress and bedding, clean new white towels, well stocked place. Views are amazing as well as the building.
Great downstairs pool and don't miss the gym even if you don't exercise go upstairs to enjoy the view, you can't miss the panoramic city view all the way around in the 32 floor.
Neighborhood is very good ,full of reaturans and a few blocks for Palermo Soho center.
Thanks for the perfect condo and the welcoming fresh fruits.
also the contact people got back to us quickly and are really friendly
Awesome place close to town and wonderful amenities esp the pool and gym.  Loved the sunset nights!
Great location, secure and good facilities

Stayed here for New Years, this place is next-level for Buenos Aires and a phenomenal value. Beautiful views in Palermo SoHo with a balcony and the apartment is styled nicely. The pool is unbelievable!  Ralf is a pretty fun guy with some funny jokes, amazing hospitality. Everything about this place I recommend.

Excelente loft, estadia maravilhosa, todo o espaço do prédio é surpreendente... incrível como nas fotos. A vista da sacada é alucinante! Localização privilegiada, restaurantes maravilhosos e bem pertinho. Ótima indicação de restaurantes pela equipe, que nos recebeu com muita atenção... deixando conosco até o seu cartão de transporte público. Sendo assim pudemos passear de metrô muito mais fácil. Ótima experiência! Quando voltar para Buenos Aires com toda certeza ficarei no mesmo lugar.  Obrigada

We had a great stay. The apartment is very stylish and offers all the comforts of home plus fab pool. Perfectly located - lots of places to eat, shop etc and close to parks and easy access to buses and subway. Transfers to and from airport worked brilliantly and very reasonable. Thank you!
Would highly recommend this place! Great host and great location!
Great city apartment and views! I wasn't able to take advantage of the amenities like the fitness center on the 31st floor but recommend it.

This place is amazing! You can’t beat the view. The place is stylish, clean, and perfect for a couple. Marcelo was so helpful and accommodating. We were unfortunately there when the coronavirus news hit and restrictions were put in place for travelers, but Marcelo made us feel safe and comfortable. We ended up having a blast our few days in Buenos Aires and will definitely book again when we replan our trip!
Increíble vista con los mejores sunset o tormentas de Buenos Aires. Súper recomendado.

One of the best AirBnB's I've stayed at. Perfect location, beautiful building with great amenities and staff making sure everything was always clean.

Ralf and his team were exceptionally professional. Spoke Spanish and English, and were available any time I needed. Cleaning services were extremely thorough and polite.

Apartment is exactly how it looks. Really nice design touches, and high quality furniture (great comfy bed) and furnishings. Even little things, like full soap dispenser, full salt and pepper shakers, etc, were great quality.

The view is amazing and I will seriously miss it. The internet worked great for all of my remote-working needs, including video meetings.

Apartment is quiet with polite neighbors. Shower was excellent with great hot water and great pressure.

Seriously, everything rocked. Beautiful plants in the apartment (just like the picture).

The price was definitely fair, especially considering the location and amenities and professional service that Ralf's team provides.

I would tell you if there were any cons, but I can't really think of any. Thanks for a great stay Ralf!

Me sentí muy a gusto en el apto en todo sentido. Bien equipado, los servicios accesorios del predio, la ubicación, etc. La atención de Ralf y su equipo fue rapida y eficiente en todo momento. Volveré sin dudas.

Realmente Griselda nos recibió muy bien, una persona muy cordial. Nos brindo todos los detalles para pasar una buena estadía.
Muchas gracias!

Hello !!!
Nous avons posé nos valises avec plaisir dans cet appartement petit certes mais vraiment bien agencé et très fonctionnel.
Par ailleurs, il est bien situé car en plein dans le micro-centre.
Donc, nous avons pu découvrir plusieurs parties de Buenos Aires en nous promenant sans avoir besoin d'utiliser énormément les transports en commun.
Rien ne manque dans cet appartement car Griselda a pensé à tous les petits détails dont nous pouvons avoir besoin : sèche-cheveux, fer à repasser, plans, de la ville et infos sur les choses à voir et même à un double de clés (honnêtement, non négligeable si vous venez à plusieurs). La kitchenette a suffisamment d'ustensiles, de couverts, etc... Désodorisant dans la salle d'eau (et oui, pour moi ce n'est pas qu'un détail).
En un mot, appartement à conseiller :-)
Besos Griselda !

Griselda es una dama muy amable, responsable y serena, que ha convertido el departamento en un lugar muy acogedor, pulcro y funcional, cuyo aspecto es tal cual aparece en las fotografías. Además cuenta con la simpatía de los conserjes del edificio, quienes se suman a colaborar en hacer una estadía muy agradable.

Apto mto bem localizado e próximo à rua Florida. Todos os equipamentos do apto são novos. A Sra Griselda nos recebeu com muito carinho e é uma pessoa muito atenciosa. Com certeza voltaremos numa próxima viagem! ;)

Griselda was there to meet us when we arrived and although we didn't speak any Spanish or her any English, she had some information prepared in English and we were just about able to understand each other as she showed us around the flat and how to work the appliances etc.. The flat although small was exactly as it looks in the photos. The kitchen did feel a bit smaller than it looked in the photos, and I think you would struggle to cook a meal there, although we were on holidays and eating out every night so this was not an issue. The neighbourhood was fine; extremely central which was great, the subway C is right alongside the building. There was building work going on outside the flat at the time but this was not the hosts fault. The lights in the bathroom failed when we were there but Griselda came over within the day to fix up a light while we waited for an electrician to come. Overall the apartment was exactly as described, small but very centrally located. Great place to stay if you're going to be out and about sightseeing and just want a place to rest for the night.
Griselda was super helpful. The apartment is located in a very central area of Buenos Aires. It was just what we wanted.
Una estancia corta pero magnífica, Grosella siempre estuvo muy atenta y amable.

Todo excelente! El departamento es tal cual se muestra en las fotos: ordenado, prolijo, funcional, muy bien ubicado y accesible a todo. Griselda es una persona muy amable y siempre pendiente. Excelente atención por parte de ella y los conserjes y seguridad del edificio! Realmente un lujo! Recomendable 100% y más!
Excellent location and secure place. Host was very informative. Highly recommendable.

La ubicación del apto. es sumamente cómoda, se puede recorrero el microcentro caminando, además hay una estación de subte al lado del apto.
La información que aparece en la página es exacta.
Griselda fue muy amable y cuidó todos los detalles para hacernos sentir muy bien.
Quedamos muy contentos y con ganas de volver pronto!!!

Todo estuvo perfecto, el departamento es igual a las fotos y esta cerca a todo los puntos principales de la ciudad. Griselda es una anfitriona excelente, nos dio información  muy valiosa para disfrutar la ciudad al máximo. Definitivamente volvería

The apartment was comfortable and the location was great.  The subway (Subte) is right next to the building and lots of sightseeing within walking distance.  Griselda was very helpful and met us at the check-in.  She was easy to get in touch with and the wifi worked great in the apartment.

Es la segunda vez que voy a un apto de Griselda, y la verdad que es super recomendable. No solo por la ubicación y por las comodidades del apto sino por la amabilidad de Griselda. Este apto tiene el beneficio de tener doble vidrio, entonces si sos una persona que le molestan los ruidos (por más que es un sexto piso y casi no se sienten) este es un plus muy importante. Algo que es muy bueno es que la conexión wifi es fabulosa, algo que sabemos que no es en todos lados así.
Recomiendo nuevamente a Griselda y el apto.

Nous avons été très contents de notre séjour. L'appartement est idéalement placé, dans un quartier de rues piétonnes avec tous les commerces à côté.
Griselda nous a donné des tas de conseils de visites et de lieux pour aller avec nos enfants.
Merci à elle pour son accueil et ses attentions.
Merci aussi aux gardiens de l'immeuble très sympathiques.
Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement.
Clément
Foi tudo ótimo, ela se mostrou muito amável, o local é muito bom, faltando apenas ducha de higienização e box maior, fechado em blindex, o que é perfeitamente simples de fazer.

Griselda é uma pessoa muito receptiva e agradável. Nos explicou todo o funcionamento do apartamento detalhadamente. Sempre manteve contato para ajudar. O apartamento é bem prático e funcional. O box é um pouco pequeno, mas no geral valeu a pena. A localização é excelente. Recomendamos.

El apartamento es tal cual la descripción. Muy bien ubicado, limpio, con un colchón comodo y todo lo que se precisa para una estadía corta.
No conocimos a griselda, pero la comunicacion por mail fue muy fluida y buena y no hubo ningun inconveniente para ingresar al apartamento.
Alli hay una carpeta con información general, código de wifi, e infos varias que son muy utiles.

Nos hospedamos de 17 a 22/07/2015 nos dois Apartamento da Sra. Griselda pois eramos 07 pessoas. Os apartamentos são super bem localizados, limpinhos e possuíam tudo que precisamos. Alem disto a Sra Griselda é super atenciosa e fez excelentes indicações e dicas para o nosso conforto e segurança. Quando eu voltar a BsAs com certeza me hospedarei la novamente. Muito Obrigado!
Maria (Cida)
Fortaleza, Ceará, Brasil
Griselda é uma ótima pessoa. Disposta a ajudar quando necessitamos, nos passando informações muito boas.

In short one of the best studios I have stayed, everything as described and over, really great studio, building, cleanliness, hosts !! amazing view on top. Highly recommended, I’ll go to that same place if back to B.A.
Excelente depto. Muchas gracias Ralf y equipo

Wonderful host. Punctual, communicative and trustworthy. Thank you for being on top of everything for me and available by text at all times. You made my travels here much easier and i am grateful. Thank you.

If this place is available for your dates, book now. It's a great value for the best building in Palermo (one of the best neighborhoods in Buenos Aires).

Marcelo is like a dedicated guest manager and was always available for anything I needed. The place has an amazing sunset-facing view, which is worth it alone. I spent a week here working remotely and the internet was fine. The room is clear, well-designed, well-equipped and stocked (international power converters, etc.). I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here and hope to be again soon.

This is our second time in Buenos Aires. Palermo is a beautiful neighborhood.
Soho Sunset Studio was incredibly nice and neat. Having security at the apartment, added an extra comfort. We stayed there nine nights.
Every evening coming to the flat was as we were coming home. Kitchen was very well equipped. Ralf and his team is very professional. If we come to Buenos Aires again, we would stay here without any hesitation. Thank you Ralf…

If your hip, generous uncle lent you his place in Palermo, this would be it.  Decor was personal and tasteful.  Uncluttered.  Apartment has everything you need for a great stay.  The building is a big plus- lap pool, gym on 31st floor, nice outdoor spaces.  Neighborhood is loaded with restaurants and bars of every price point and type.  Team Ralf is very responsive. If we go back to BA I will be renting this place again.
Great place, great location
Wonderful view, very safe and secure. Close to so many great restaurants and activities.
The studio is clean, modern, and has all the amenities.  Felt like a hotel suite.  The area is walkable and decent.  Good security too.
This a a great apartment.  Great location in Palermo, great view, almost all the niceties and accoutrements a person could want.  Very clean with a comfy bed.  Well done.

Absolutely gorgeous apartment in a great area. The bed was the most comfortable we’ve ever had in an Airbnb, the views were unbeatable, the shower had amazing water pressure and plenty of hot water, the air conditioner worked well, and the building felt very safe. The check in and out processes were great and everyone we interacted with was lovely. The neighborhood is adorable and the apartment is very close to plenty of restaurants and the Subte.

If you are planning on doing laundry, the machines take tokens that are sold in a grocery store off site- Marcelo was very clear in explaining where to go and how the laundry system works. There are also lots of laundry service shops nearby to have clothes washed for you.

All in all, an absolutely fabulous stay- we will absolutely stay here again next time we are in town.

Great apartment.  I was a solo traveler who stayed at this apartment for a full week.  The guys are well organized with the apartments they have:  communication was great.  I did book the the round-trip airport car through them and security had form with name waiting for me when arrived.  They were good enough to store my luggage when arrived and departed and internet worked great.  Highly recommend.

Ralf and his team have a clear understanding of all the things that make a stay great - from a warm welcome and thorough briefing by Ralf's colleague Marcelo, to the little condiments and equipments that made the apartment feel like home (a power board for charging all your devices!), to picking the perfect locations with such tasteful furnishings. Hands down, the best place we stayed at during our two-week visit to Argentina - highly recommended. Thank you for having us!

Ralf’s place is perfect for visiting Buenos Aires. Located in one of the best neighborhoods, Palermo, the Airbnb is located within walking distance to several restaurants, bars and parks.

The Airbnb itself is comfortable with an amazing view. The apartment has great 24/7 security and has all the amenities one could need during their stay.

I would absolutely recommend this Airbnb for anyone looking to visit Buenos Aires!

We had the best time in Buenos Aires. The apartment is just like the photos - very clean, adorable decor and spacious. The apartment is located in a safe and quite building with elevator and the location is very central. It has everything you need for a stay in BA.

Flor was a wonderful host. She is welcoming and accommodating and thinks of everything her guests might need. She had everything prepared for us on arrival, including a subway card, guide books and maps. She was also very helpful with restaurant recommendations and reservations.

The neighborhood is located near tons of shops and restaurants and a somewhat easy 15-20 minute walk to the best parts of Palermo. There is a grocery store downstairs and a very commercial road a few blocks away with a mall and subway. Taxis are also very easy to come by.

I would highly recommend staying at this apartment and hope to visit again!

Florencia was an amazing host. She was so kind and even let my boyfriend and I keep our large bags with her at her place while we went on a trip to Patagonia. The apartment was really clean and very cozy for two people, and you're a five dollar cab from nearly everywhere in the city. I would highly recommend staying with Florencia!!!

The host is an adorable couple who are very welcoming. They are quick to reply with anything you need and make you feel right at home. The place is just as pictured and very clean and nice. The building and neighborhood feel very safe and centrally located in the city. The only downside is it's located on the border of a few neighborhoods. If you are hoping to stay in the heart of Recoleta, just know that this will be a 30 minute walk or 5 minute taxi trip.
A lovely apartment in a great location.  Clean and comfortable.  Flor was a lovely, attentive, host.

Flor was a great hostess. She met us at the apnt, ordered a taxi and gave us info on local restaurants and buses etc. The apnt was meticulously clean, comfortable, well equipped and conviently situated. We would definitely stay there again if we are in BA.

Our 5 night stay at Florencia's apartment in Palermo was splendid. Her apartment was a studio, simple and clean and cosy. About 10 minutes walking distance to Recoletta and Palermo Soho. We enjoyed our stay here and would not hesitate to stay here again if we ever got the chance to be in Buenos Aires again.

Florencia was very sweet, helpful and lovely. Before our arrival she promptly responded and gave us directions to her place and when we arrived, she was so kind to provide us with maps, guide books and gave us recommendations to where to eat and see, she even printed our boarding passes for us! Thank you Florencia for sharing your home with us =)

Florecía y su esposo fueron muy amables al recibirme y también al despedirme explicando todos los detalles del departamento. Son los mejores anfitriones que he conocido porque tienen un manual con toda la información y me ofrecieron mapas de la ciudad, tarjeta del subte y hasta adaptadores para diferentes tipos de enchufes, todo esto es muy útil cuando estas viajando y se agradecen tantas atenciones y lindos detalles!

We had a wonderful stay in this cute apartment! Nice cozy studio in a secure building. The neighborhood is conveniently located between Palermo and Recoleta with much to do and see. It is also very close to Santa Fe and the Subte (metro). Flor was very accommodating, even with our early departure on the final day. Would stay here again!
Florencia was amazing! She was super helpful with restaurant suggestions and how to navigate the city. The bus card, though we didn't use it, is extremely generous. We would easily stay here again.

Lägenheten stämde helt med det utlovade . Var mycket välstädad och trevlig. Låg dessutom i ett lugnt område med inte så mycket trafik. Dock ganska lyhört från grannarna.
Florencia var en trevlig värd och hon fanns till hands när man behövde hjälp. Hjälpt e bl a till med restaurangbokning när inte skolspanskan räckte till.
Kan mycket väl bo där igen.

Great hosts and a great little place to stay in BA!
My boyfriend and I stayed in Florencia's apartment for 4 days just last week. We met her husband on arrival and Florencia on departure, and they could not have been more lovely and helpful. We were given a map of the city along with heaps of good advice, a subway card with instructions for use and a list of restaurants to try. Our Spanish is atrocious so Florencia was nice enough to help us book a remise when the time came for us to leave. The apartment itself was bright, clean and well stocked. We were very grateful for the air conditioner on a couple steamy nights. The bed is comfy too. We also liked the fact that we were on the fourth floor of the building and could use the stairs instead of the elevator. In terms of location, the apartment is within walking distance of the Recoleta tourist attractions (eg Cemetery) and there is a subway stop nearby to help you access other parts of the city. The neighbourhood felt very safe even during our nocturnal wanderings.
All in all, I strongly recommend you stay here, especially if you're first-timers to the city like we were :-)

This is a very sweet and nicely stocked studio that is clean and perfect for two people. Flor kindly left bottled water, coffee and a Subte card, and her husband was so nice to suggest favorite neighborhood spots. Extra points for a very comfortable bed and a fabulous hot shower! Thank you for hosting us!

A Griselda foi excelente anfitriã. Ela nos recebeu no horário combinado e foi muito simpática, apresentou o apartamento detalhadamente, deu dicas de turismo em Buenos Aires e se colocou à disposição. O apartamento é bastante fiel às imagens apresentadas, não é muito grande, mas é aconchegante e recebeu confortavelmente nosso grupo de 3 pessoas. A localização é boa e dá acesso a pé aos principais pontos turísticos de Buenos Aires bem como a rede metroviária da cidade, o acesso à estação Lavalle da Linha C fica no térreo do edifício. Os porteiros do edifício são simpáticos e estão acostumados a lidar com o movimento dos turistas no prédio. Para quem gosta de teatro o apartamento está próximo da Av Corrientes, região que concentra diversas grandes casas de espetáculo. Outro ponto favorável é que o ponto do Arbus está a 2 quarteirões, o que facilita muito o acesso ao Aeroparque.

El apto cuenta con todas las comodidades de casa, la ubicacion del lugar es perfecta para quienes quieran ahorrar, es muy centrica, aparte la seguridad es muy buena. La recomiendo 1000% y espero tener la posibilidad de volver a ser su huesped.. saludos y muchas gracias

Séjour très agréable, Griselda nous a accueilli avec une grande gentillesse.
L'appartement est petit mais très bien agencé, ce qui le rend fonctionnel.
De plus, il est très bien situé dans le microcentre.
A recommander vivement.

A anfitriã foi muito educada e solícita. Explicou detalhadamente tudo o que eu precisava saber. Organizada e simpática.
O apartamento é muito bem localizado, um pouco menor do que imaginava, mas bastante funcional. Tudo transcorreu bem.
Todo muy bien conforme a lo esperado. Griselda es muy atenta y estuvo todo impecable.
Excelente atencion de Griselda y muy lindo el apartamento. Nuestras hijas jovenes disfrutaron mucho del lugar.
Location was perfect. Griselda was so kind.

Griselda é uma excelente anfitriã!!  Não só nos deixou super tranquilos, como o apartamento é exatamente como descrito aqui.  Chuveiro com água quente perfeita, elevador funcionando, segurança na portaria e talvez o principal, super bem localizado - ele fica simplesmente "grudado" no metrô, no micro centro de B.A., próximo a praticamente tudo, seja para comer, comprar, passear.  Super indicado e recomendado.  Voltaríamos com certeza!!

Maravilloso sitio.
Muy bien ubicado, de fácil acceso.
Todo lo que se muestra en la página y fotos es verdadero.
Griselda es muy cumplida y clara con sus cosas y su casa.

Apartamento limpo com ótima localização. Porteiros atenciosos e desejosos de ajudar. Excelente custo benefício.
Griselda é muito atenciosa e minuciosa. Teve a delicadeza de traduzir as regras para o português. Muito bom.
Fue muy buena. el apartamento es impecable y tiene todo lo necesario. Está bien ubicado y tiene fácil acceso

Muy lindo apartamento, cuidado limpio y funcional. La ubicación es excelente, a muy pocas cuadras de las líneas de subte lo que permite ir en minutos a cualquier parte de la ciudad. El trato fue excelente en todo momento, siempre a disposición para lo que fuera necesario.
si es correcta y muy bien el lugar, muy seguro

Griselda una excelente anfitriona! Fue muy amable y accesible con nuestros horarios, muy amable y da buenos consejos! Ademas el lugar se ve como en las fotos! Agradable y todo super cerca, muy fácil ubicarse! Muchas gracias Griselda esperamos regresar! Un abrazo!!

Excelente anfitriona . Atenta siempre de nosotros . El apartamento impecable . Súper cómodo y súper bien ubicado. El edificio muy lindo y seguro. De verdad quedamos encantados y con ganas de quedarnos más días. Esperamos que se pueda repetir . 100% recomendada.

We had a great trip in Buenos Aires in large part to Griselda's great apartment. Everything was as described. It is right in the heart of town in an excellent location. Griselda is very kind and the security staff are very kind and welcoming as well. We are quite happy with our selection and gratefull to Griselda for opening her apartment to us!
Griselda era una anfitriona buenisma, todo era como lo describió y ella era muy disponible para ayudarnos con cualquier duda.

Griselda fue una excelente anfitriona. Todo fue como lo descripto en el aviso. Además nos asesoró en todo lo necesario para una muy buena estadía. Zona bien céntrica y segura. El Subte al lado del dpto.

What a well-located place and with all the especial attention of Griselda. Unfortunatelly I got an allergy in the begining of my trip and she was so dedicated to help me. Thank you and of course I indicate this place, which is close of the microcenter and the Obelisco. All the furnitures and structure inside was pergect!
El departamento era tal cual lo prometido, con todos los accesorios necesarios para sentirte como en tu propia casa. El barrio espectacular, en pleno centro turístico de Buenos Aires.

Fomos recebidos pela Griselda, muito simpática e atenciosa, prestando muitas informações que nos ajudou muito.
O apartamento é igual as fotos, tem localização privilegiada.
Wi-Fi excelente.

My experience at Flors apartment was wonderful. She is a gracious and made herself available to us and answered questions. She also supplied us with a subte card, maps and tour books. I appreciated so much that she called a Taxi for us to arrive at 3 am and came to the apt to close out our stay and ensure the car arrived as scheduled. The apt is clean, cute and the bed comfortable. I would definitely stay again.

We had a wonderful stay at Flor's apartment! It was beautiful and in such an amazing location - right between Recoleta and Palermo and walking distance to so many little cafe's, sights, and shops. Flor and her husband were also very welcoming, meeting us very late at night when we arrived and giving us a bunch of tips on where to eat and where to visit. We also felt like locals staying in Florencia's apartment, which was a much cooler experience than staying in a hotel. Hope to be able to come back soon!

Excellent location in Recoleta, close to Sube stations on D line. The apartment is very quiet and the bed is in a small alcove away from the window which gives a good feeling of privacy. Damien (Florencia's husband) welcomed us to the apartment and gave us a complete run down on the apartment, neighbouring attractions, favourite restaurants, and lots of other information which we greatly appreciated. We enjoyed our stay very much and would recommend Florencia's apartment to any AirBnB travellers.

Florencia was great! As soon as we arrived, my husband realized he left his bag in the taxi! Flor swiftly and graciously called the company and had our bag back within minutes:)
Her apartment is a good location. Fun walkable area and tourist attractions are a very short, very cheap cab ride away.
Overall it was a great experience! Loved Buenos Aires!

We loved this air bnb! The flat was great and the pictures represent the apartment and neighborhood perfectly! Florencia and her husband were kind and accommodating and made sure that we had everything we needed to make our stay great. We would definitely stay here again!

Florencia is lovely. Communicative and well organised. The flat is great. Clean. Central and inviting.
I recommend everyone who arrived in BA to use this place.

Flor and her husband were so helpful and very friendly hosts! They gave us a list of their favorite restaurants and told us stuff to do in the city which was really helpful. The apartment is centrally located and it is easy to get around to other parts of town. The apartment is quaint and clean.  When calbuco volcano erupted her husband emailed me to let me know because it affected my travel plans. Definitely stay here!!!

We had a great stay at Flor's apartment.  I was very impressed with Flor's communication and the check in documents she provided after our booking was confirmed.  She provided lots of helpful information on transportation options and popular sights.  The apartment was very clean and exactly as pictured.  Both Flor and her husband were very accommodating of our travel plans, meeting us late at night and at 5:15 in the morning to check out before our international flight.  Flor was even nice enough to arrange for a taxi to pick us up and take us to the airport.  We would definitely stay here again!

Florencia's Listing was the perfect location for our brief stay at BA. Florencia and her husband were great hosts, helping us with all the necessary basics to navigate in a new city. from early check in to late departure she accommodated all our needs. She kept in constant touch, arranged for transportation back to the airport, etc. Florencia and her husband are great hosts and we would love to go back for a longer stay! Thank you!

The Amazing Apartment in Recoleta is truly amazing. The location very good, few blocks from two subway stops, only one blog from a grocery store. Few minutes from very good restaurants (some of them were suggested by Florencia), shops, bars etc.
The unit was very clean, comfortable. The owners paid a lot of attention to details and for the wellbeing of their guests. I highly recommend this place for your next stay in BA.

Florencia is lovely! She is super friendly and extremely efficient with her communications. She made us feel extremely welcome. And the flat is as gorgeous as you can see in the pictures. It overlooks the back of the street, so it is extremely peaceful. You will have everything you need, and more!, in the flat. The location is superb! I cannot recommend this flat more emphatically. Great place to stay. We will be back! Gracias, Flor!

Buenos Aires was beautiful, fun and awesome!! We played tourist while in the city. Flor was such a gracious host. She provided maps, tips and even her personal number in case we needed anything while we were out and about. Her apartment was clean and had just the perfect amenities for the 8 days we were there. When I come back, I will definitely try to stay at Flor's apartment again!!! Gracias por todo Flor!!
Florencia is the sweetest host ever! She explained everything clearly and made us feel really welcome in Buenos Aires! Definitely will come back and stay at her studio next time! Thanks Flor!

My experience at Flor's apartment was absolutely wonderful! From the beginning to the end, Flor was exceptional with communicating. She was always quick to respond, and provided me with very detailed information prior to arriving. Flor's husband met me at the apartment and went over all the details of the place, and really took the time to explain the area. Speaking of the area, it is the perfect location! Right in the center of it all. You're in a great neighborhood, which gives you the "local" feel, but super close to the sights downtown. Highly recommend this apartment!! Thank you, Flor!

Very cute and clean apartment with a comfortable bed. The building is older, but well maintained. As a result, the walls may be a bit thinner so you can hear the neighbours and elevator at times (but it really wasn't a big deal!)

Good location, close to D subte line and walking distance of many shops and attractions. It is listed as being in Recoleta, but on a map it is perhaps more on the border of Recoleta and Palermo.

Flor and Demian were excellent hosts. They provided a recommendation for where to exchange currency, helped book transportation to the airport and even came by with more toilet paper when we ran low! Always easily accessible by phone and email; we felt comfortable asking them any questions we had and they were always more than happy to help in any way.

The area felt safe to walk at night, and there was usually police presence (a good thing I think?) There were supermarkets close by as well. Highly recommend staying here!

Excelente, lo que muestran las fotos es lo que tienes. Edificio muy tranquilo y en buena ubicación, todo tipo de servicios cercanos.
Recibí el departamento en perfecta limpieza y orden, la ducha del baño tiene una presión y temperatura reconfortantes.
Florencia fué muy amable en todo momento, hasta nos ayudó a conseguir un taxi a la salida :)
Awesome apartment in an amazing location. Florencia was a great host!

Flor e Demian, muito obrigado por tudo. Vocês são ótimos Anfitriões.

O apartamento é muito bem localizado e muito bem equipado.Tem de tudo pelas redondezas. Desde fruteiras, mercados e estações de Metrô. Eu e minha esposa recomendamos e com certeza voltaremos.
Mais uma vez, muito obrigado por tudo e até a volta !!!

El apartamento era tal cual como se presentaba en las fotografías y tenía todo lo necesario para sentirte como en casa. La ubicación del apartamento es excelente, estas cerca de todo.

El departamento de Florencia es excelente, es exactamente como se ve en las fotos, en medio de todo. Todo muy limpio y ordenado. Florencia muy puntual y atenta, 100% recomendable.

Florencia é uma anfitriã maravilhosa! Muito atenciosa e simpática.

Le logement était totalement conforme à sa description, très propre, très lumineux, pratique et décoré avec gout. Le quartier est très agréable et central dans Buenos Aires. Quant à Florencia, l'hôte, elle nous a accueillies avec beaucoup de générosité, de disponibilité et d'attention. Elle a pris le temps de nous expliquer comment nous déplacer dans la ville, nous a mis a disposition une carte de métro/bus nous a indiqué un restaurant, et s'est toujours montrée disponible quant nous avions une question! Elle a été très coopérative et arrangeante pour le check-in et check-out qui sont toujours des moments sensibles du voyage. En deux mots, je la recommande totalement!!!!!!!

We had a great time this apartment! Both hosts are extremely nice and responsible. Location of the apartment is great, it's central and walking distance to everything. There are convenient stores, laundry place right around the corner. One of the best parts was the Apple TV, which making watching the stuff we want so much easier. Overall, we had an awesome experience and would highly recommend this apartment!

Our stay with Flor as our host was absolutely amazing!  The apartment was small but perfect for my wife and I for a few days in BA! Our start got off to a rough start as our flight was cancelled to BA so we got there a day later. I sent Flor our updated flight info and her husband was there at the apartment the next day waiting for us. He gave us the tour and answered any questions we had (where to exchange money, etc). There is a sube card at the apartment waiting for you which came in handy and you can load it pretty much anywhere. Flor would check in on us thru email every few days. She offered to book us restaurant reservations and she booked us a remi for when we left. Can't describe how amazing her and her husband were as hosts. Can't wait to come back to BA and will stay in their apartment in a heartbeat!
Los días que pasamos en Buenos Aires fueran muy agradables. El departamento de Florencia es muy acogedor, muy bien ubicado. Estamos muy agradecidos por toda la atención dispensada.

We have nothing but outstanding reviews about the apartment "Central to Everything".  The pictures were a most accurate presentation of the place.  Everything was perfect with extra amenities.  Florencia and her husband were delightful... such wonderful people!!... both service oriented and always available if we had any questions.  What an awesome experience in every sense of the word.  We also have to mention that the location was amazing and "Central to Everything" is exactly right.  With no hesitation we will recommend this to anybody and everybody... and we will return.  thank you Flor and thank you Airbnb for an impeccable service.

una excelente anfitriona, muy amable ,servicial , ademas colabora con el asesoramiento de como movilizarse en la ciudad y en el en apartamento existe una guia de lugares telefonos e incluso mapa .el apartamentocondise con las fotos aportadas es confortable para una pareja , ademas de muy bien ubicado a poquitos metros de importantes avenidas,cines ,teatros bares restaurantes y servicios de locomocion,edificio muy tranquilo que ademas cuenta con servicio de porteria las 24 hs.equipado para satisfacer las necesidades de cualquier persona, en suma muy recomendable

Muchas gracias a Griselda para su bienvenida,sus informations y su simpatia . El departamento muy bien ubicado cerca de todo (subte, comercios, spectaculos, museos, centro historico...) es como las fotos, limpio y muy practico. Lo recomendamos. Es securisado con gente muy Linda. Gracias a todos.

Apartment is good, clean and well situated. I'd recomend it to anyone and if I'm back to BAires, I'll defenetely stay at this place.

Thank you, Florencia and Demian!

Very friendly welcome. Demian and Flor were very accomodating of our early check in and early morning check out. They were also very helpful throughout our stay. The apartment is well equipped and nicely decorated.

El departamento es muy lindo, muy cómodo, en una excelente ubicación y Griselda como anfitriona es muy buena. Excelente experiencia. Es nuestra segunda vez en ser hospedados por Griselda y nos encantará volver cada vez que visitemos Buenos Aires

Griselda's apartment is so great!
The apartment is just the right size for 2 travellers and is warm, cozy, and excellently located.
And we couldn't meet Griselda because of our short stay,but she is very kindness. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in Buenos Aires.
Amei vc Griselda que foi muito gentil e dedicada, o apto é ótimo e está bem localizado.
The apartment was perfect for us.  It's in a safe but busy location.  Plenty to see within blocks of the apartment.  The bathroom living areas were clean and comfortable.

Griselda est tres attentionnee, et amicale. Elle nous attendait a l'appartement comme prevu. Le logement est tres bien situe au centre de Buenos Aires, et donc pratique pour tout faire a pieds en quelques minutes.
La chambre ressemble a celle de la photo, mais le reste de l'appartement est assez sombre et la cuisine est minimale.
pratique mais assez sommaire.

Griselda foi uma pessoa muito amável e presente desde o início da nossa estadia, mostrando todo o apartamento e nos dando dicas da cidade. Apartamento bem localizado no centro de Buenos Aires, o que o torna muito fácil de chegar a qualquer ponto da cidade. Silencioso em relação ao barulho da rua. Bastante funcional.

El departamento un lugar acogedor con lo justo y preciso para el turista, su ubicación excelente todo a la mano comercio y todo tipo de restaurant para todo los gustos.

en cuanto a la anfitriona una persona maravillosa, encantadora no tengo nada negativo que decir, de volver repetiría todo. Gracias Griselda por tu hospitalidad y encanto.

Griselda greeted us when we arrived and was extremely welcoming. Communication with her was excellent and she was flexible with our flight arrival and departure times. The apartment was clean and comfortable and in a convenient location. We felt safe having security at the entrance of the building.
