Very nice room, excellent location, the apartment is very well set out, comfortable, and a really pleasant place to stay. Flor and her husband Demian were extremely helpful and kind, and gave me lots of advice and recommendations. It was a great experience, and I would stay again.

El departamento es hermoso!!! todo muy limpio y tal cual las fotos. Es muy cómodo y se encuentra muy bien ubicado. Florencia fue muy amable, respondía rápidamente nuestras consultas y se mostró preocupada por nuestro bienestar.
Conclusión: 100% recomendable.
Todo muy bien. El dpto es muy cómodo, limpio, y tranquilo. Florencia y Demián fueron muy atentos. La ubicacion es muy buena. 100% recomendable.

La pasamos muy bien en dpto de Florencia, todo re lindo, limpio, cuidado y bien pensado para que no te falte nada. Florencia siempre a disposicion. Muy silencioso para dormir y muy comoda la cama ! Gracias !

El apartamento de Flor reúne todas las condiciones para hacerte sentir como en casa: muy limpio, decorado con esmero y con todo lo necesario para hacer tu estancia agradable. Está muy bien ubicado, cerca de todo en una ciudad enorme.
Además, Flor es encantadora. La comunicación con ella fue excelente, tanto antes como durante la estancia. Se preocupa de que le saques el máximo partido a tu viaje. Te proporciona información sobre cómo llegar, cómo cambiar, dónde ir...etc.
La experiencia ha sido tan positiva que repetiremos cuando volvamos a tomar el vuelo a Buenos Aires de vuelta a Madrid.

Some friends who live in BA recommended this neighborhood, and they were right! Awesome place, location and communication!  Ralf’s team was super communicative and gave tons of great rec! The location is close to tons of great restaurants and bars! Neighborhood was safe and clean with a live security guard.

Fantastic location and the apartment and amenities exactly as described.
Ralf and team were professional, friendly, approachable, and accommodating. Building security and cleaning on point too.
Happy to recommend. 😀

My husband and I have a comfortable and enjoyable stay at Ralf’s apartment. It was well located walking distance from tons of great restaurants, cafes, and parks. Perfect location to many restaurants, Cafés and bars.  The communication was quick and responsive.  Will definately recommend to fellow travelers!

Rich and I had a lovely stay at Ralf’s. His apartment is in a great area with lots of amazing restaurants and bars close by and the sunset was stunning. We arrived early and they were very flexible in allowing us check in early. We’d definitely stay again.

We had an amazing stay at Ralf’s apartment. It was very clean, there was some fruit, water and coffee for us, the view is amazing and Ralf and his team were super friendly and helpful. Highly recommend a stay at this unique place.
Perfeita a estadia! Ótimo apartamento, ótima região de Buenos Aires, perto de muitos restaurantes e fácilacesso ao metrô. Agradeço ao Ralph pela hospitalidade.

Nuestra experiencia en el departamento de Ralf fue excelente. La unidad estaba impecable, tal como en las fotos, y ofrece una vista muy buena de la ciudad desde el balcón. Aún mejor, podés acceder al gimnasio en el piso 32 con una vista panoramica tremenda. La ubicación del departamento es excelente, a dos cuadras del subte D sobre Av. Santa Fé y rodeados de restaurantes y bares. Especial mención a Marcelo, quién estuvo siempre presente con la mejor predisposición durante el check-in, el check-out y toda la estadía.

Saludos, Javier y Joyce.

Great studio with all things you need to survive.  Ralf gave us an arrival present of wine, fruit and and a small cake.  Nice touch.  Great location in Palermo with fantastic restaurants and bars in about 15 minutes walk from the apartment.  We would definitely stay there again.  Thanks Ralf for your hospitality.

We loved this place! Great, safe, and walkable location near restaurants and shops. We spent our afternoons and evenings on the balcony enjoying the sunset views. Comfortable bed and space. We liked the smart TV functions and reliable internet. Overall great stay and would highly recommend.

Great place, good view. Loved the plants made it feel very homey. Quite comfy bed and pillows as well.

Host and host team were incredible, always going out of their way to help out, would highly recommend this place and/or host.

Great appartment that has everything to make you feel at home and having a comfortable stay.
I can't think of anything that the place did not have, and I missed. O maybe one thing: the scale did not work because of the low batteries, but with one of the best parillas so closeby i didn't mind a lot ;-)
Anyway, when considering staying in Palermo, surely consider this appartement. You'll love it a lot.
PS. the view from the terras is great and enjoyed the sunrise and sunset many times.
Loved this apartment! Super chic and clean. Amazing sunset view!!! Feels expensive and very safe. Stay here.
Great stay! I was there for a week for work. Easy and flexible check-in/check-out, lovely building, perfect location. Would def stay again
would recommend this place to anyone! we loved the apartment, the amenities and location was perfect.
El departamento está muy bien ubicado, y Griselda ha sido una buena anfitriona, muy amable y atenta.

Griselda was very helpful, she received us very well and showed carefully the apartment. The flat is very well located, its really close to the main avenue. It was clean and organized! I recommend it!

Tivemos um ótimo estadia no apartamento. Muito bem organizado, confortável e bem localizado. A senhora Griselda foi uma excelente anfitriã, nos recepcionou muito bem e deu várias dicas de Buenos Aires. Super recomendo.
Todo perfecto. buena ubicaciòn.

Excelente experiencia para comenzar a utilizar Airbnb. Griselda es muy agradable y preocupada que la estadía sea positiva.
El departamento es tal como se ve en las fotos, cómodo para dos personas y su ubicación es muy buena en pleno centro de la ciudad.
Griselda, muchas gracias por tu buena disposición. Espero regresar en una próxima oportunidad.

El apartamento es ta muy cómodo para una estadía de 3 a 4 días.
La ubicación es super excelente.
100% recomendado.

Somos de Fortaleza CE... Acabamos de chegar de Buenos Aires onde eu e meu marido nos hospedados no apartamento de dona Griselda. Ela é super simpática e atenciosa e o apartamento dela é bem aconchegante é tem tudo que o hóspede precisa... Ao lado tem um subte ou metrô que se torna mais prático quando for conhecer lugares, porém muitos dos pontos turísticos estão bem próx. Então preferimos ir andando... Lugares como obelisco, casa rosada, catedral, praça de maio, rua Flórida etc. Super recomendo. Obrigada mais uma vez pela estádia dona Griselda. Até a próxima.

Todo muy bien , el dpto es como lo describen , funciona muy bien WiFi,la ubicación muy buena con conexión a muchos lugares y a pasos  de cines y teatros.Muy amable Griselda ,muy útiles sus explicaciones para una placentera estadía.Volveremos sin duda.

El apto mejor ubicado imposible , con entrada de subte en la puerta a 2 cuadras del obelisco en el centro porteño fácil acceso a las atracciones. Griselda siempre estuvo a disposición nuestra escribiendo constantemente. Seguramente volveremos a repetir

A Sra Grizelda é muito simpática e organizada. Ela não se preocupa apenas com a estádia. Ele se preocupa com a experiência da sua viagem. Ela deixa uma pasta com várias dicas da cidade e quando chegamos nos mostrou item a item. O apartamento é super bem localizado, limpo, bonitinho e aconchegante. Tem um quarto, uma mini salinha com sofá cama e uma cozinha pequena. Se voltarmos a Buenos Aires ficaremos lá novamente com certeza.

El departamento es muy acogedor, la ubicación es perfecta porque está en el mismo centro de Buenos Aires.
Griselda siempre estuvo al pendiente de nosotros, estoy muy contento con la elección.

Excelente, todo impecable muy buena ubicación, cerca de todo, edificio muy tranquilo, el apto excelente, la atención de Griselda simplemente espectacular!!!.
Volveremos sin duda!!
Muy recomendable
La descripción del anuncio es la correcta y todo funciona muy bien en el dpto , muy servicial el personal de la recepción .

Es un departamento , que tiene solo una ventana , en el dormitorio principal,en el otro dormitorio y cocina hay que prender luz en el día ,es oscuro
Como tiene dos dormitorios y ningún espacio cómodo para compartir , lo aconsejo solo para dos personas y en especial su uso solo para dormir
Bem localizado e com um serviço de portaria bem prático.

Fomos muito bem recebidos pela Griselda! O apartamento fica numa localização maravilhosa, bem no centro da cidade e ao lado de uma estação de metro. Há muitos restaurantes por perto e é fácil ir a pé para muitos lugares. A Griselda é uma anfitriã muito atenciosa e foi muito solícita! Ficamos muito satisfeitos.

We had a wonderful stay in Buenos Aires. Gresilda was a great host who met us & showed us around the apartment with tips of sight seeing & map. With us not being Spanish speakers & broken English from Gresilda we still communicated well.  The apartment is a good size for 2 people & is in a excellent location with underground train next door, restaurants, shopping all around you. Security doorman very nice & we felt very safe walking around. Everything was clean & we loved that there was good heating for the cooler nights. An amazing experience & stay.
Muy buena. El departamento es como se lo ve. Es cómodo. Esta bien preparado.  Excelente precio. Y la ubicación me resultó comoda. La anfitriona muy atenta.

El depto es muy lindo. Limpio, ordenado,  luminoso, cálido, justo lo que buscábamos para pasar los 3 días. El  lugar inmejorable en cuanto a la ubicación, cerca de todo, tranquilo,  seguro. Cerca de medios de transporte, gastronomía, etc.y en cuanto a Griselda, nada más que palabras de agradecimiento por el recibimiento y la atención y predisposición siempre. Nuevamente gracias!!y esperamos volver pronto. Slds Gonzalo.

Somos una pareja de esposos Colombianos, llegamos a Buenos Aires y Fabiana estuvo muy pendiente de nosotros, nos espero en el Apartamento y tenemos que aclarar que reservamos a ultima hora pero aun así ella y su esposo estuvieron al tanto de nuestra llegada.

El apartamento estaba dispuesto tal como se ve en la fotografía y es perfecto para dos personas, tiene todo lo necesario.

Nuestra estadía fue muy gratificante. Las indicaciones y sugerencias de nuestros anfitriones muy buenas, la pasamos muy bien y conocimos lo mejor de la ciudad y sus alrededores, el paseo por tigre y Colonias Uruguay fue increíble. . incluso el día de nuestra partida nos dejaron en el taxi que nos llevo rumbo al aeropuerto... Gracias Fabiana y Gerardo son unos excelentes anfitriones.

Seguramente cuando volvamos a Buenos Aires esta sera nuestra casa.

Hasta pronto

Alex y Luisa.

Florencia es una anfitriona estupenda. La comunicación con ella fue fácil y expedita. Se preocupó por brindarnos información sobre transporte, cambio de moneda y sitios para comer alrededor del apartamento. Este, por otra parte, está muy bien ubicado. Es un lugar limpio y muy agradable. Realmente pasamos unos días muy agradables!! Volveremos!!
Excelente la atencion y predisposicion de Griselda. Muy buen lugar donde se encuentra el departamente. Justo lo necesario para pasar 3 o 4 dias.

Es la segunda vez que nos quedamos en casa de Flor. Si la primera vez te sientes como en casa, en esta segunda ocasión realmente parece que llegas a tu hogar. Flor y su marido son encantadores y están ahí para resolver todas tus dudas. El departamento está impecablemente limpio, decorado con gusto y no se escucha ni un ruido. Además hay detalles de calidad como la tarjeta subte (que no utilizamos), apple tv, y sobre todo el teléfono para llamadas locales, que nos resultó muy útil para reservas a restaurantes, remises o encargar una pizza. Un lujo. Gracias por hacer nuestra estancia tan agradable.

Flor and her husband graciously and kindly welcomed us to Buenos Aires.  Their friendly hospitality and helpful tips made us feel comfortable in a big city.  The apartment exactly matches the characteristics described in airbnb.  It is a cute, little apartment located conveniently to many stores and restaurants.  We easily walked to Palermo Soho and Rocoleta nighborhoods.  The subway is nearby to go to the historic center of Buenos Aires.  Overall, we enjoyed our time at this charming, comfortable apartment.

Flor and her husband were an amazing hosts. They were extremely kind and generous to me and my friend. Throughout the weeks leading up to my stay and during, they were very responsive to emails and provided detailed information to my several questions I had about the city, activities, recommendations, etc...They definitely made my trip easier and made me feel welcomed. Their apartment is adorable and in a great location.They were kind to provide maps, tourist books, a subway card and local recommendations. They were also extremely accommodating to my travel schedule and worked with me through my early arrival and late departure. Should I find myself back in BA, I will definitely return to their apt.

We had a great experience. Flor and her husband are very friendly and helpful. The apt building is in a safe and convenient location. The apt itself is clean, tastefully decorated, well-equipped, and just like the photos on the website.

I will definitely stay here again if I have a chance to visit Buenos Aries in the near future.

Fomos muito bem recebidos por Fabiana e seu namorado Gerard.. O apartamento é muito bem localizado e o prédio tem tudo para que você se sinta seguro durante a estadia. O único problema é que o vizinho da porta em frente que não é muito delicado na hora de abrir ou fechar a porta dando um susto em quem estiver em casa. Nada que comprometa. Recomendamos o apartamento para estadia!

Pasamos unos excelentes dias en el departamento. Griselda muy amable al recibirnos, muy clara y con mucha disposición a ayudarnos en lo que necesitaremos.
El departamentos es exactamente lo que muestran las fotos, muy cómodo y especialmente muy bien ubicado!! En el centro de todo!
Realmente muy recomendable alojar ahi cuando estén en Buenos Aires, tanto por el departamento como por la buenísima onda de la dueña. gracias!!!

We are a family with two teenagers. We enjoyed our stay here, and Griselda was very warm and informative about what we could do to get the most out of our four days in the city.
We talked Spanish with her.
The WiFi in the apartement was good. Medium bandwidth (guess is 5 Mbit) with a strong connection.
Only downside was that the apartement is rather small. Two sleeping rooms with room for two in each, a small kitchen and bathroom.
Very clean apartement.
It is located extremely good in the city centre with lots of shopping and eating options nearby, and withing walking distance to some of the tourist attractions.
Griselda es genial. Super amable y considerada. Nuestra estadía fue impecable.

La ubicación es muy buena y el lugar seguro, muy cómodo acceso a los medios de transporte y cerca de lo básico que se necesita día a día. El departamento es tal cual se los ve en la página, ideal para parejas solas o con niños pequeños, Griselda muy amable y atenta a todo.
Lo volvería a alquilar.

El departamento es tal como lo muestran las fotos. Griselda me estaba esperando puntual y dejo una serie de indicaciones y direcciones para visitar la ciudad.  Todo muy bien. Sobre todo la ubicacion.  Nos vemos!
Very central and good price as within easy reach of everything. OK for a one night stay but a bit too small for us otherwise. Surprisingly quiet at night, which is good.
Uma ótima localização, um apto ideal para até 4 hóspedes! Limpo, organizado e confortável! Ótimo preço e com uma anfitriã, que te deixa a vontade e lhe dá tudo que necessita!

¡La pasamos muy bien en el dpto de Griselda! La ubicacion es excelente, el dpto super limpio y ordenada. Griselda es muy amable, atendío el horario de llegada y salida que necesitabamos. Seguramente volveremos. Super recomendable! :)
El departamento esta bueno
Amable y servicial. Excelente amfitriona.

Ha sido muy amable. Ha estado comunicada por cualquier eventualidad.
Exelente anfitriona.

A localização é perfeita, bem próxima da Av. 9 de Julho. Apesar de pequeno, o apartamento é confortável, estávamos em 3 mulheres. A rua tem muitos cafés e é bem movimentada, mas no apartamento tem janela anti-ruído. Infelizmente, não conseguimos ligar o ar condicionado quente, provavelmente estava com mal contato na tomada. Ao chegarmos, a Griselda já estava lá e foi muito hospitaleira, mostrou tudo com calma e deixou um livrinho com dicas de Buenos Aires.
Departamento muy bien ubicado, cómodo y tranquilo. Mil gracias Griselda por tu buena predisposición.

Our stay at Griselda's place was nice. She is very nice person, she showed us the map with the most important places in Buenos Aires and where to go sightseeing. The appartment is cosy and with everything you need. There is a small kitchenette and bathroom. The place is very well located, close to the Obelisk and you can get a bus easily from there to go around. I recommend to everyone.

A sra. Griselda foi muito atenciosa e hospitaleira.
Apartamento em ótima localização.

Excelente atención. Griselda un sol. El departamento está en una ubicación perfecta a 3 cuadras del obelisco y frente al teatro Maipo. A un paso de la peatonal Lavalle y al lado del Subte. Griselda fue una gran anfitriona y nos tuvo mucha paciencia. Volvería sin dudas. Gracia Griselda x todo!!
El departamento muy lindo. Algo pequeño para 4 personas pero muy bien equipado. Lo único es que el baño es muy pequeño. Por lo demás muy recomendable.

Griselda super simpática, prestativa e atenciosa. Nos explicou tudo nos mínimos detalhes. Apartamento super bem localizado e confortável, nos deu várias dicas de locais onde irmos. Tudo próximo, estação lavalle linha c subte fica embaixo do prédio onde está seu apartamento , se tornando fácil a locomoção. Obrigado por toda compreensão e atenção, Griselda

Griselda es sumamente atenta y amable. Estuvo muy disponible para cualquier información y apoyo que necesitaramos. Apartamento muito bem localizado, próximo a mercados, farmácias, estações de metrô e pontos turísticos. Gostamos muito e certamente voltaríamos. Griselda foi bastante atenciosa e não nos deixou faltar nada.
Excelente ubicación en zona céntrica y segura. Todo tal cual se ve en las fotos. Altamente recomendable. Volveré
The apartment was much smaller and darker than presented in the pictures. However, it was ok.

Die Gastgeberin ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung ist ordentlich und sauber und ausreichend gut ausgestattet. Die Lage ist sehr zentral mit schneller Anbindung an verschiedene Verkehrsmittel. Die Küche ist leider etwas klein und nur mit den nötigsten Kochutensilien ausgestattet, weshalb man nur sehr einfache, schnelle Gerichte kochen kann. Die Gastgeberin weisst auch darauf hin, dass keine zu stark dampfenden und riechenden Speisen zubereitet werden sollten, was allerdings den Zweck einer Küche in einer Ferienwohnung verfehlt. Bei 4 Personen wird es außerdem sehr eng.

Nice host and central apartment - clean and tidy. The Kitchen is a little bit small (especially for 4 guests!) and it could be better equipped for an apropriate use.

This studio apartment is adorable with all of the amenities that I needed. It's also in a convenient location in Recoleta. The whole apartment was very clean and the bathroom and kitchen are very nice and the bed is very comfortable. The hosts are very helpful also with helping with check-in, check-out, providing fruit, etc. I loved staying here!!
Fabiana and Gerard were great! The apartment was very nice and had everything we needed. They were great hosts and a great help to us.

La verdad que haber encontrado el depa de Fabiana y Gerardo fue maravilloso no solo porque está buenísimo y rebien ubicado sino porque ellos son unos anfitriones fabulosos!! Estuvieron siempre pendientes de que no nos falte nada y que todo funcione correctamente.
El depa es muy lindo, limpio y completo! No te falta nada!.
Se lo super recomendamos para que pasen unos días increíbles en Bs As en la mejor ubicación!!

Fomos muito bem recebidas por Fabiana e Gerardo. Anfitriões muito atenciosos, sempre preocupados com a nossa estadia. O apartamento está muito bem localizado próximo a Av. Santa Fe e há algumas quadras do metrô. Definitivamente quando retornar a B As. me hospedarei novamente com eles!!
Lo recomendamos sin dudas!

The studio was wonderful. Everything we needed to enjoy Buenos Aires. Fabiana and her husband, Gerardo, were both really helpful and friendly. The studio is really close to Recoleta Cemetery, which was great. We would recommend this place to anyone.

My husband and I stayed in this studio for a month and had such a wonderful time. The apartment has absolutely everything a person would need, with lots of extra towels and blankets to a fully equipped kitchen. It's a cheerful, clean and bright space with a fantastic view of the street. The large windows all pull back, opening the entire wall up to the outside. It's such a nice place to sit and enjoy dinner. The location is also perfect for those new to the city. We were able to find everything we needed within a couple of blocks of the place and found that it was a great central spot from which to explore the city by foot. It's also near to tons of public transportation options. The best part was Fabiana and Gerardo. They are wonderful hosts. Gerardo walked us through the whole apartment, getting us familiar with everything and even had a map on the door labeled with recommended food options, laundry services, and other helpful suggestions. Fabiana was quick to respond to questions and offered several suggestions for sites to see in and around the city. We had the perfect stay there and would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

For the price, the studio apartment was perfect for our week in Buenos Aires.  It's ideally located in the center of Recoleta and in walking distance to the main streets if you need bus/metro access.  We loved the little kitchenette that allowed us to cook when needed.  The hosts were very welcoming and met us at the apartment when we arrived, and gave us a tour of the apartment as well as some neighborhood tips.  Also, if we ever had any small problem with the place (burner not working, etc) the hosts would be over quickly to fix the situation.  Thanks again for allowing us into your home, we had a great experience!

We loved staying in Recoleta. There little apartment is in a great spot in a fancy neighbourhood. The hosts were most accommodating of us and helped us get the most out of Buenos Aires.Highly recommended. An  easy place and people that helped our stay be even better .

Mi pareja y yo nos quedamos dos veces en el apartamento de Fabiana y Gerardo. El apartamento estuvo fantastico en ambas ocasiones, super limpio y con todo lo necesario. La localizacion es excelente con supermercado y cajero automatico a una cuadra y una parada de subte a pocas cuadras. Fabiana y Gerardo fueron muy amables, que aunque estuvieron fuera durante nuestra estadia siempre estuvieron en comunicacion y al tanto de todo. Definitivamente que recomiendo este apartamento!

Fabiana y Gerardo fueron muy amables, que aunque estuvieron fuera durante nuestra estadia siempre estuvieron en comunicacion y al tanto de todo. Definitivamente que recomiendo este apartamento!

Somos do Brasil, ficamos 1 semana hospedados no Studio de Fabiana e Gerardo. Fomos muito bem recebidos por eles, foram muito receptivos conosco. O Studio fica numa ótima localização. Voltaremos com certeza, e recomendamos. Ótima escolha!

We had a very pleasant time in Buenos Aires & the apartment in Recoleta, which is located very central in BA. We easily reached any attraction in the city from that nice, clean, little place. Fabiana and Gerardo were very helpful with suggestions what to do or any kind of questions. We felt like home far away. We definitely recommend this place to anybody!

Gerardo and Fabiana were awesome. The space is small but very well located and everything I needed for the five nights I was there. They have a neat map of all the amenities nearby. Gerado was suoer nice and incredilbly helpful. Definitivamente lo recomiendo!

espectacularmente genial! de verdad que muy agradecido el departamento es identico a las fotos osea increible, la ubicacion es inmejorable y la atencion de gerardo y fabiana  insuperable, muy amables, pendientes de todo, la verdad es que me senti como en casa jamas pense que me encariñaria tanto con una ciudad por medio de mi alojamiento! de ahora en adelante sera nuestro hogar cada vez que visitemos ese pais!
Muy buen lugar, el departamento tiene lo justo y necesario muy bien ubicado y Fabiana hasta nos envió panoramas al mail.
Departamento muy luminoso, zona muy bonita y a mano de todo. Atención muy buena y personalizada por parte de los anfitriones. Sin lugar a dudas volvería a alojarme en este lugar.

Fabiana and Gerardo were great from the start.  Not only is the studio on a quiet street very close to Recoleta Cemetary (3 blocks) where all the action is; but Fabiana sent me plenty of activities, discounts, etc along the way.  Gerardo was there to welcome us in and give us some great hot spots to check out as well.  The place is just what I would expect out of a studio...small but comfortable.  The street is quiet at night, the bed was comfortable, the kitchen was big enough to cook breakfast, the shower was hot, and they even have A/C!  We ended up extending our trip and the first thing I did was call to see if we could extend our reservation!  Would definitely stay again.

The place is very well located and just 15m by cab from the Aeroparque.
Gerardo was on time to welcome me and my wife.
The studio is organize and with two heaters, which helps a lot for the cold nights.
The bed is very comfortable and the bathroom very clean!

Perfect location, safe building, wonderful hospitality in fashionable Recoleta!  If you'd like to live among the wealthiest portenos at an affordable price this is the place.  You can easily walk to Cementerio de la Recoleta (find Evita's tomb), exclusive shopping on Av Alvear, and fun street fair shopping and music at Feria Artesanal, Plaza Intendente Alvear (where I bought virtually all of my gifts) all in one day.  Don't miss the stunning El Ateneo bookstore.  You can even walk to all the wonderful BA museums and parks from the apartment, including my favorite, Miuseo de Arte Latinoamericano de Buenos Aires (Malba).  The pizza restaurant 3 doors down is also excellent easy dinner if you need a quick bite.  Also, a quick cab ride to the trendy Palermo neighborhood, a little further to San Telmo for tango.  All in all, a perfect location to see all of BA, my only regret is that we only had 3 days in Recoleta.  Fabiana and Gerardo were wonderful hosts and were able to point us in the right direction for all the things we wanted to do.  I recommend the Lonely Planet BA guide book too.
We loved our stay in Buenos Aires ! The city is amazing, and Fabiana & Gerardo's appartment is warm & perfectly located !

ESTIVE COM MEU MARIDO, POR UMA SEMANA, HOSPEDADA NA CASA DE FABIANA E GERARDO. ADOREI O APARTAMENTO, QUE É PEQUENO, MAS MUITO FUNCIONAL E LIMPO. É IGUAL COMO NAS FOTOS. ESTÁ NA MELHOR PARTE DE BUENOS AIRES, NA RECOLETA. PERTO DA RUA SANTA FÉ, COM ÓTIMAS LOJAS PARA COMPRAS, PERTO DO METRO E COM CONDUÇÃO PRA QUALQUER LUGAR QUE SE QUEIRA VISITAR. É MUITO PERTO DO AEROPARQUE (15 MINUTOS, MAIS OU MENOS 35 PESOS DE TAXI). FOMOS MUITO BEM RECEBIDOS POR GERARDO QUE NOS DEU TODAS AS DICAS E FEZ NOSSOS CHECK-IN E CHECK-OUT SUPER PONTUAIS. VOLTAREMOS COM CERTEZA E RECOMENDO.

Great location, really safe and really convenient. Apartment exactly as described. Really clean. I would have stayed longer and will probably return. Host very helpful and very quick to respond. Great start if your new to the city- totally tourist ready

El depa está super bien ubicado, todo equipado con todo lo que es necesario. Recoleta é un lugar increíble lleno de cosas que ver y hacer!
Gerardo nos recibió muy bien y Fabiana nos indicó cosas que hacer!!
Seguro que volveria a quedarme allá, me encató el depa, la ciudad y nuestros hosts!
Muchas gracias por todo!

Me pareció que todo estuvo bien, lo suficiente para estar tranquilo.
Deberían inforrmar acerca del ascensor, es MUY pequeño.

We loved our stay at Florencia's. She and her husband were wonderful hosts going above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed our stay. The apartment was very pleasant and clean and located in a lovely part of town. They also made arrangements for our taxi to the airport. Would definitely recommend them.

This is a fantastic Airbnb - definitely one of the best we have experienced. The location is fantastic, only 5 mins walk to the metro which is handy. The area around has everything you need - really big supermarket, bars, restaurants, shopping mall, cinema. The area is really safe and we felt totally comfortable walking around at night.
The flat itself is brilliant. There is a separate kitchen and bathroom, large bed and a cute little dining area - all great quality and very clean. The little touches throughout make it feel very homely - Apple TV and Netflix for example! The building is well kept and no issues from neighbours.
Flor and Demien are fantastic hosts and only live 5 mins away so are always close if you need anything. They were always really quick to respond to any questions and they did so with much enthusiasm! A truly lovely couple :)
Would definitely return here - don't hesitate to book!

Florencia was a very thoughtful and gracious host. She and her husband went out of their way to make sure everything was just right. Additionally, they provided great restaurant recommendations and good insight into the local neighborhoods.

Florencia was a breeze to work with. Her husband, Damian, met us at the apartment when we arrived late at night and was very helpful in getting us oriented to the city with a free map. The apartment is the perfect size for the needs of two people. We appreciated the hot shower, cold air conditioner, apple tv, and comfortable bed after a long day of exploring Buenos Aires. It's a big city, and this apartment is in a good location to walk, take the metro, or catch cabs. Florencia and Damian were also hugely helpful with making local calls to restaurants and taxi companies on our behalf since we only speak a little Spanish. We would gladly stay here again!

Staying in Florencia's apartment was a pleasure. We enjoyed it very much. The neighborhood is very nice with many shops, cafes and restaurants close by. The apartment was very clean and cozy and has everything you need (we loved the Apple TV ;-)). But the best thing about this place is the host: Florencia is just great. She provided us with so many recommendations for places of interest, transportation and restaurants and is very flexible with check-in and check-out times. Highly recommended place.

Florencia is a wonderful host - very helpful and attentive. The apartment is very nice and as advertised with air conditioning, netflix and good wifi. It's a 5 to 10 minute walk to several nice cafes, and 15 to 25 minutes to several places like the Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes, Parilla Don Julio and La Choza. It's the perfect size for a couple. We would certainly stay here again.

Place is perfect for a couple who want to taste BA local life, yet just steps away from downtown.

Florencia was so nice. She sent us tips for our arrival, and could accommodate early check in. She took the time to explain our neighborhood, cafes, stores, safety, provided a few books etc.

The place is small, with plenty of light. It is clean, and we'll appointed. You just feel at home immediately. She even provided a subway card for our use.

Classic great Airbnb host that keeps us using the service. Thx Florencia!

Flor is a perfect host. She is on time, helps where she can and if there is any problem she just offers to call. The apartment itself was very clean and perfectly situated in case you want to be near downtown (The Subte just 5 min away) or especially if you want to explore Palermo Soho with its lovely shops and restaurants. For those who liked running Palermo Woods and all parks around Libertador are reached in 10 minutes...and there you will be definately not the only one running around! The aircondition helped a lot during these extremely hot days. The area is safe and you feel secure all the time.
Flor... Muchissima gracias! I really would come a next time!

Florencia and her husband were so accommodating! They were there to answer all our questions and were perfect hosts. The apartment was clean and well kept and close to many great cafes and groceries that made meal time easy. We were very comfortable during our stay and would recommend it to anyone!

Griselda fue muy amable y atenta y 100% servicial,estuvo muy pendiente Y   disponible para cualquier información  que necesitabamos . El departamento estuvo bien equipado como decía en el anuncio ,el edificio era muy seguro ya que contaba con portero la 24 hs y muy  amable los  mismos. Ubicación excelente!!!!! cerca de la peatonal florida y a tres cuadras del obelisco .Mucha seguridad y movimiento en la zona, muy buen acceso a transporte publico.  SUPER RECOMENDABLE.!!!
que lindo departamento y Griselda es una mujer tan simpática!! nos sentimos en nuestra casa.

No tuve oportunidad de conocer a Griselda personalmente, sin embargo, resulto muy amable y bien predispuesta en la comunicación. El departamento en excelente estado, bien ubicado y muy limpio. Sin dudas lo recomiendo!
El alojamiento era tal cual aparece en las imágenes. Griselda fue encantadora y estuvimos muy bien durante la estancia
The place was clean, acceptable but extremely noisy.  Not only the noise coming from the street but the internal noise coming from inside the building was unbearable.

A anfitriã foi muito gentil e prestativa. O apartamento estava exatamente como as fotos e é próximo a vários pontos turísticos (Obelisco, Casa Rosada, Galeria Pacifico,..) e com saida ao lado do metrô. Embora seja no Centro e próximo a teatros e restaurantes, a rua não é muito barulhenta e os vidros da janela são duplos, evitando barulho. A portaria é 24horas e os porteiros são muito gentis e animados, principalmente o Daniel! O bairro também é bastante seguro e andamos tranquilamente na parte da noite, inclusive voltando do show de tango no café tortoni (que vale muito a pena!)



The hostess was very kind and helpful. The apartment was exactly as the pictures and it was near a lot of attractions (Obelisco, Casa Rosada, Pacific Galleries, ..) . The exit to the subway was beside the apartment and really convenient. Although it was in the Center and near Theatres and restaurants, the street was not very noisy. The lobby had somebody 24hours and the doormen are very gentle and lively, especially Daniel! The neighborhood was also very safe and we walked quietly in the night, even returning from show Tango at Café Tortoni (which worth it!)

Very well located for San Telmo and Puerto Madero and near some famous landmarks (the obelisk and the world's widest avenue). Griselda was very welcoming and extremely accommodating to help make my stay a good one. I really enjoyed my few days in Buenos Aires.

Griselda was very quick to reply to messages and arranged for her friend to pick us up from the airport ($40.00 USD) and drop us off at her apartment.

The cozy apartment is very clean and orderly.

Everything you would need - bus, subway, grocery store, shopping, café, bakery, and restaurants are all within 5-10 minute walk and the ferry terminal is about a 20 minute walk.

Many of Buenos Aires top sights are also within walking distance.

I would definitely recommend this location and Griselda is lovely!

Para quem não se preocupa com espaço, o local é ideal. Apartamento muito pequeno, mas muito bem localizado, bem em cima de uma estação do metrô (subte), próximo ao obelisco, dá para ir a pé ao porto madero... Enfim, recomendo muito.
A anfitriã é muitíssimo atenciosa, está de parabéns.
Muy bien todo , el lugar, la amabilidad de Griselda , muy buena ubicación.

The place was good, the kitchen has a hot plate and microwave. The bed was comfortable. The location was amazing as it is close to the main area of the city. Griselda was really friendly and amazing with her communication.

I would recommend this place for a city exploration trip for sure!

Danke, liebe Florencia, für Dein wunderbares Appartement, welches für acht Tage unser Zuhause in BA war. Die Lage ist perfekt, mitten im städtischen Leben und ideal für touristische Erkundungen. Die Subte gleich um die Ecke, die kleinen Läden für den täglichen Bedarf, der nette Gemüsehändler, der das Pfannengemüse schon geschnitten verkaufte, die flotte Reinigung, die sogar meine alten Flecken aus der Wäsche beseitigte, die tollen Cafés und Parillas - also wärmszens zu empfehlen, Mein Mann war begeistert von Eurer schnellen WLAN Verbindung!! Danke auch für Eure guten Tipps und Eure herzliche Gastfreundschaft. Alles Gute für Eure Familie!

Florencia and her husband arranged a very warm welcome amd made me feel at home immediately. The apartment is beautiful, stylish, absolutely clean with lots of light and with a very comfortable and cozy bed. There are no wishes left open and it won't be easy find a better place in Buenos Aires. I wish I could have stayed longer! Thank you fot your lovely hospitality!

We absolutely loved staying in this charming and cozy apartment! Fabiana and Gerardo were great hosts, and we stayed in touch through the whole stay. They showed us amazing hospitality, always willing to help us with whatever we needed, giving us amazing tips.
We stayed during winter and it was really cold outdoors(about -2 celcius) but the apartment was VERY warm (it had 2 heaters) and the shower was extremely good too. The bed is high and very confortable to sleep in after a very runny day. Definitly the best location in Buenos Aires. Just in our street we had a little market, a farmacy, restaurants and cafes and it was 1 minute away from the huge Callao avenue, wich we would catch a cab in 3 seconds. At the market we bought coffee powder and milk, so we could make coffee in the mornings in the apartment. The kitchen is fully equiped in case if you don´t want to eat out plus hundreds of useful phone numbers of delivery restaurants, taxis, emergencies...it had absolutely everything! Whatever we needed we had it. The towels are great and didnt had to bring them my own, plus a hair dryer and a ironing board and iron for out shirts was available. I would (and already planning to very soon) to stay again in this amazing apartment (with an AMAZING VIEW)!!!!!!!!!!
Thank you Fabiana and Gerardo for making our dream come true, it was perfect!!!
The stay was great! I was a bit skeptical of airbnb at first, but everything worked out perfectly. Check in and Check out were smooth and easy and the apartment was wonderful.

Perfeita localização. Gerardo e Fabiana foram simpaticos e pacientes, já que tivemos problemas na viagem de ida e chegamos muito apos o marcado. O apartamento tem tudo que é necessario e a localização é perfeita.

O apartamento de Fabiana e Gerardo é bem como parece nas fotos: aconchegante, charmoso, cheio de vida! Uma graça!!! É compacto, mas super bem equipado; tem tudo o que precisamos, além de ser super bem localizado! Além disto, me senti super bem recebida e acolhida pelos nossos "anfitriões", desde os emails que trocamos, antes de minha ida, nos quais eles me deram todas as informações de que eu necessitava sobre as acomodações, além de dicas ótimas de restaurantes e lugares para conhecer em BsAs! Recomendo muito, para quem quer sentir-se "morando" em BsAs, mesmo que por poucos dias!

O apartamento é ótimo, muito bem localizado, perto de restaurantes, museu, do cemitério, cafés e muito mais. As fotos que estão no site mostram exatamente como ele é. Fabiana e Gerardo são ótimos anfitriões, nos receberam muito bem e foram bastante atenciosos (inclusive, nos levaram mais um cobertor para os dias mais frios!). Se formos outra vez a Buenos Aires, com certeza tentaremos nos hospedar no mesmo lugar.

Estuve junto con una amiga seis días alojada en el departamento de Fabiana y Gerardo, este tiempo fue un agrado. Ellos como anfitriones son excelentes, siempre están preocupados  y pendientes de que nuestra estadía fuese placentera. El departamento es tal cual se ve en las imágenes, muy bien equipado, y lleno de detalles que hacen más agradable la estadia. Absolutamente recomendable.

A estadia no studio de Fabiana foi ótimo. É um local muito bem localizado, próximo ao metrô, supermercados, restaurantes e os diversos pontos turísticos da Recoleta. É um local muito seguro pra circular em qualquer horário.

O studio é exatamente como descrito e como está nas fotos. Tudo bem dividido, com armário, cozinha completa e bem funcional. Adoramos a experiência.

Fabiana e Gerardo sempre foram solícitos a nos ajudarem e sugerir passeios, se precisássemos.

Fábio e Dana
Griselda's place is great!  Close to everything and really cozy.
Griselda es muy buena.

The host was very warm and friendly.  She went over everything in the manual, including all the tourist attractions, money changing, the apartment, the supplies in the apartment, the TV, and the air conditioner.  On Saturday, we got clean set of towels and sheets.  The apartment looks like what the picture portrays.  We liked the apartment.  It is quite efficient.  It has a bedroom, a living room, and a kitchen.  It is at a very convent location. It's next to a subte (subway)  Line C.  It's within walking distance to Teatro Colón, Obelisco, Casa Rosada, Café Tortoni, Feria San Telmo (every Sunday), many restaurants, including a vegetarian restaurant.
Great location with a great price!
Griselda es muy amable. Todo muy bien.

O apartamento é muito agradável, bem localizado, quente e sem umidade. Os anfitriões são muito atenciosos e preocupados com a qualidade na estadia. Eu, minha esposa e filha de 1 ano gostamos muito dos seis dias que passamos em Buenos Aires e o apartamento foi um dos fatores importantes para isso.

Tudo ótimo no apartamento! Exatamento como descrito no perfil! Passamos 9 dias com total conforto, privacidade e segurança. Fabiana e Gerardo se mostraram do início ao fim disponíveis para nos ajudar ou tornar mais agradável nossa estadia, desde as questões burocráticas do aluguel até sugestões de passeios na cidade.

O apartamento é perto de tudo. Não tivemos problema algum para nos locomover de ônibus pela cidade. Sempre tínhamos uma parada perto para sair ou chegar em casa.

Perto de uma infinidade de cafés e confiterias, ótimas sorveterias, kioskos, pontos turísticos, locutórios (onde podíamos fazer ligações telefônicas para o nosso país), bons restaurantes, mercados, centros de compras (em especial, a Santa Fe) e, por uma grande sorte, de uma casa de câmbio na Posadas, onde conseguimos uma ótima cotação na troca do real por pesos (recomendo fortemente: Posadas 1564).

A cozinha do apartamento tem tudo que é preciso para preparar sua refeição - seja ela qual for. As refeições com vista para Ayacucho foram ótimas. Existem dois aquecedores no apartamento. Na maior parte do tempo usamos apenas um. Dá conta demais. O segundo só utilizamos por algumas horas. Existe um armário de duas portas no qual podemos guardar nossos pertences sem deixar o apartamento tão bagunçado. Assim que chegamos já encontramos uma série de adaptadores de tomada, então não precisamos correr para comprá-los e conseguir utilizar nossos aparelhos eletrônicos. O apartamento está todo decorado, com painéis e artesanatos em madeira. A cama é confortável e todas as noites dormi como uma pedra. O aquecimento da água funciona perfeitamente, não tivemos qualquer problema com isso. Os vizinhos são pessoas agradáveis, educadas. Não tivemos incômodo algum com barulhos.

Nos dias que lá estivemos não sentimos falta de absolutamente nada. Agora que voltamos para casa, estamos sentindo falta de morar na Ayacucho 1523.
This was a great apartment - clean, perfectly located in the heart of Recoleta. Gerardo was very helpful and suggested several neighborhood spots to check out. Highly recommend!

Fomos muito bem recebidos tanto por Fabiana quanto por Gerardo, mesmo antes de chegarmos a Buenos Aires. Fabiana respondeu prontamente todos os questionamentos via mensagens, e sugeriu lugares maravilhosos para curtir a cidade! Além disso atenderam nosso pedido para realizar o check-in um pouco mais cedo do que o combinado, pois nosso transporte do aeroporto até o apartamento foi mais rápido do que imaginava. O apartamento fica muito bem localizado na Recoleta, perto de tudo, numa região muito charmosa, com bons cafés, diversas delicatessen e opções de mercado. Além disso, nos forneceram mapas, e diversas informações para tornar nossa estadia ainda mais agradável. O apto é pequeno, porém bem iluminado, e com todos os itens necessários para estes 5 dias que passei com minha irmã na cidade. Recomendo!

O local é exatamente do jeito que Fabiana e Gerardo descrevem. Eles são muito simpáticos e atenciosos. Apartamento confortável, chuveiro excelente e bom estado. A localização é ótima! Existe mercado, ponto de ônibus, lan house, boas lojas de ruas, e está a 15min do Centro - Av 9 de Julho. O bairro é calma, requintado e vale a pena um passeio pela região a pé. Recomendo a estada e que andem bastante pela cidade, tem muitos lugares incríveis, fora do trecho para turistas. Fabiana e Gerardo, parabéns pela hospitalidade!

I had a beautiful 8 nights at the lovely apartment in Recoleta. Excellent location for walking to many cool places like the Cemetary, Design, shopping mall, Facultad de Derecho, Museo de Bellas Artes, Floralis Generica, and of course the countless exquisite cafes. In addition there are several mercados, pharmacies, laundry mats, internet cafes, all the essentials, literally right around the corner. The bus system was confusing for me but they were also close by and easily accessible, as were taxis. I was travelling alone and felt very comfortable roaming the streets both in Recoleta and beyond.

The apartment was just like in the pictures. Cozy, clean, plenty of light with the option of extra shades at night if you like it quite dark like I do for sleeping. It was also overall very quiet at night for sleeping. The window looking out onto the street below opens if you need a little breeze. Plenty of extra blankets and a heating device for the nights that were a little cooler. Shower had plenty of hot water. TV and stereo working, as was Wifi. Elevator came in quite handy for going up and down the 7 floors and was always working. Concierge also very friendly and helpful. Overall a very comfortable experience and I was sad to leave.

Fabiana and Gerardo are terrific hosts and really went the extra mile to make sure I was happy, without being obtrusive or overbearing. Easy to contact via email using the Wifi in the apt. Fabiana was extremely quick to help resolve an appliance issue. She was also very sweet and called to check on me one day when I was not feeling well. She even recommended places for me to look for a wedding dress!

Highly recommend Fabiana and Gerardo, as well as their beautiful apartment and city. You should definitely stay with them. I hope to return soon one day!

Passamos, eu e meu marido, uma semana muito agradável no studio. Ele tem uma ótima localização, pequeno mas com cozinha independente e um chuveiro ótimo (a banheira é pequena). Fica perto de restaurantes, cafés, kioscos, supermercado, pontos turísticos, shopping etc Muitos taxis passando bem na porta. Bairro bem seguro mesmo à noite.A Recoleta é linda, convidativa para caminhadas. Quanto aos anfitriões, Fabiana atendeu-nos muito bem, via e-mail, tirando nossas dúvidas; quem nos recebeu foi Gerardo também muito simpático e prestativo.
Emfim, recomendamos com certeza!

Fabiana and Gerardo were the perfect hosts and I was glad to find their studio in Recoleta. It was perfect for me because it was affordable and only a few blocks walk from the ECELA language school on Ayachucho Avenue.  All the shops you could want were nearby and they had a map on the wall with the locations marked to help you find them the first time.  Ahora estoy aprendiendo español.

Fabiana and Gerardo are great hosts and very amiable people. They are helpful and easy to contact by e-mail or phone. It was big pleasure to stay at their apartment which is clean, cozy and sunny. Apartment is perfectly located in very safe district, a lot of interesting places are within walking distance from here, 24-hour shop (kiosco) is only 1 minute away so you can buy some snack even at night.
We highly recommend this place! And hope to come back here some day

Gerardo e Fabiana são bastante atenciosos. Estão à disposição de seus hóspedes com boas dicas de passeio por Buenos Aires. O apartamento está bem situado e oferece ao visitante locais bons e próximos  para visitar.

Very cute and well located apartment! We stayed here our first few nights in Argentina and loved the location and the sunny space. Definitely small, but the bed is comfy and the table and big windows were great. We didn't use the kitchen but it looked well equipped.

Everything was super smooth with check in (they even let us in early!) and communication, this was my first airbnb stay and it left a great impression.

This was the perfect location to begin our visit to Buenos Aires. The apartment was comfortable, clean, and welcoming after 20 hours of travel from San Francisco. The neighborhood is charming and convenient to literally dozens of sights and attractions. Fabiana and Gerardo were friendly and attentive. Highly recommended!

Plus: great location in Recoleta, excellent (quiet) air conditioner, good bed, good shower head, wi-fi available, and cable TV.

Neg.: kitchenware needs updating, towels are getting old, shower rod is sagging, apartment needs general updating.

Geraldo & Fabiana were so nice!

Fabiana and Gerardo were awesome hosts. Gerardo was waiting for us when we arrived and helped us bringing the luggage upstairs. The apartment is just like portrayed in the pics: a cosy and sunny studio.

The AC is very silent, the shower is excellent and we had cable TV, DVD, wifi (though not very fast - 1mbit), a landline phone to receive calls and a stereo system. The kitchen is ok. There's a small fridge and other appliances. Nearby there's a bunch of coffee shops, grocery stores, drugstores and restaurants. It's MUCH better than a hostel and arguably better than staying at hotels if you consider the price.

The street is not noisy but the same cannot be said about the next door neighbor. We were woken up two or three nights by loud talk and banging when the said person was arriving home late at night with friends. Maybe it was bad luck.

One day the internet stopped working. We sent an email to Fabiana and later on everything was sorted out. We were positively surprised to find an umbrella in the apartment on a rainy day. It really saved our lives.

This studio is very well located. It's within walking distance from Recoleta's Cemetery (where Evita Peron is buried) and a 15 minute walk from a subway station. It's generally better to take the subway in Buenos Aires because cabs are expensive and busses only accept coins (and nobody has change!).

Also, if you're looking for bikes you won't be able to rent the convenient yellow bikes (they have stations all over the city, one very close to the studio) unless you're a Buenos Aires resident. Nevertheless, you can rent bikes in parks and other places, like "The Orange Bike".

We had a good time there and we're probably staying over again if we come back.

Gerardo and Fabiana were great hosts. In the days leading up to our trip, they responded to emails quickly and answered all our questions. We arrived earlier than their normal check-in time and the apartment had to be cleaned after the previous guests - but that was no problem, Gerardo met us at the apartment so we could drop off our luggage and explore the city while the apartment was being cleaned.

The location is great - the street is not too noisy and very close to public transit. Most attractions are a cheap cab ride away. We felt very safe in the neighborhood. Gerardo and Fabiana gave great recommendations and called to check up on us. The apartment has a local phone so it is very easy to reach them. The apartment is clean and has everything you need for a comfortable stay.

We had an early flight leaving BA and Gerardo met us at the apartment at 0730 with a cab waiting to take us to the airport. Great hosts!

Fabiana was great and everything with the apartment was as promised.  Centrally located, clean and the building was secure and safe. "Checking in" went smoothly and we were very happy with the apartment. We would rent from Fabiana again!

Passamos 10 dias maravilhosos nesse pequeno apartamento. O studio é bastante iluminado e tem tudo o que precisamos para o dia-a-dia.
A cama é bem confortável e o chuveiro superpotente. Usamos bastante a cozinha para preparar nossas refeições. Não sentimos falta de nada!
O apartamento fica bem localizado, perto de mercados e farmácia, ponto de ônibus bem na frente, uma padaria com medialunas ótimas quase na esquina. Todos os dias passávamos em uma das heladerias próximas (Volta, Persicco e Freddo) e trazíamos um pote de sorvete!
Fabiana desde o início se mostrou bastante simpática e atenciosa pelos e-mails, nos dando algumas dicas de passeio. Com certeza recomendamos.

Great place in a great location.  Fabiana is an amazing host.  Apartment is exactly as described on a very safe clean street in one of the best BA locations.  This way my 1st AirBnB experience and we will defiantly do it again.

As a first time visitor to Buenos Aires, there was a lot to learn about the City and I felt that more time than 6 days would have been preferred.
That said, the apartment of Fabiana's was in a very nice section of Recoleta and was very comfortable and convenient.
It is not a big place, but that is to be expected in a City like Buenos Aires.
Overall, my wife and I were very pleased with the accommodations, and would stay again.

As Recoleta is my favourite place in BA - this apartment is just in the heart of it!

Want to run? - start down the Ayacucho street - through Alvear - near the Cementario Recoleta - and all the way further: Libertador is the best place to run in Buenos Aires!

Want to walk and shoot photos? - don't forget - your are in the heart of the most beautifull and flashy district of BA!
It's not just beautiful (won't break your neck!) - it's safe, tons of coffee shops and restos.
Won't be disappointed whatever direction you choose to walk,
start your trip from this place - don't hesitate!

The app is small - but there is a kitchen to cook your stakes and stuff (That is important really - I've stayed ones in the app without it.);
And finally - the view!
Buenos Aires should be observed from the higher floor -
so you can see how the wealthiest class live here.

Faviana and Gerardo makes my stay really fluent - I feel like a local here! You can always call them in case you need some help or advice - that's really priceless if you visit BA for the first time!

One of the best airbnb experiences I've ever had.

Flor is so lovely; she made us feel so welcome from the minute we arrived. She shared helpful information, made recommendations, helped us with questions we had about transportation. She was great.

The apartment is wonderful. It's obvious how much though Flor and her husband put into creating a cozy, welcoming, and comfortable space. It felt like home away from home. The kitchen is equipped with everything you could need. the whole place is very clean. the bathroom felt like new.

The location is great; we walked everywhere that we wanted to go, the neighborhood is lively but not loud. Just two blocks away we had some of the best empanadas of our entire trip.

If/when I return to Buenos Aires, I will stay here again!

Florencia was a wonderful host - she was very responsive to messages, enthusiastic about her city and extremely helpful in answering our myriad questions. The apartment is sunny and spacious in a convenient location between Palermo and Recoleta. We walked everywhere. The bed is comfortable and the shower is great. I highly recommend this apartment. Thank you Flor and Damien for a wonderful stay!

Wow! Flor and her husband, Demian, really know how to make you feel at home! My husband and I arrived to Buenos Aires around 5 am exhausted, but excited to explore this wonderful city...after a nap! Demian was at the apartment to greet us and made sure to answer every question and give us plenty of information before he left. There were books about the area left for us, and even a map that they had personalized with all the best things to do, places to eat, etc. circled. Flor was always available whenever we had questions or needed help with anything, right down to detailed emails about what to do the minute you get off the plane, to which restaurants are great, their price points, and the kind of food they serve.

The apartment is located in Recoleta on a great street with easy access to anything you need. Not far from the subway (which we used quite a bit), in a busy neighborhood with plenty of cafes, shops, and restaurants. We never felt uncomfortable walking at night, and the building is very secure.

And the apartment itself was absolutely adorable and wonderfully decorated, the little details were super cute. It was easy to feel right at home there. It is a great studio apartment, exactly what my husband and I needed for our few days in Buenos Aires. It was very clean, the bed is super comfortable, the wifi worked very well, and the tv had Netflix so we could settle in at night after a long day of exploring. Flor had left us some water, juice, and a few little snacks as well.

Lastly- Flor set up a Remis shuttle (flat rate, which was nice) for us to get back to the airport on our leave date. It was so comforting to know that we wouldn't have to deal with taxis or worry about a language barrier when trying to schedule that. She also came to the apartment to meet us and say goodbye the day we left (around 5:30 am!), which I thought was a lovely and personal thing to do. She is very sweet!

Overall we had a wonderful experience in Argentina, and it was in large part because of Flor and Demian for taking the time to make us feel comfortable, excited about the city, and right at home in their charming apartment. Definitely stay here if you are looking to travel to Buenos Aires!
Griselda es muy amable. Muy buena comunicación.

La ubicación del apartamento es su sexta estrella. Pleno Microcentro, a pasos de las dos principales peatonales, a metros del Obelisco, de Puerto Madero, Plaza de Mayo. La entrada del Subte está pegada a la entrada del edificio, lo que facilita la movilidad. El apartamento es cómodo. Pensando en pasear durante el día y volver a la noche a descansar es ideal. La zona es ruidosa por su naturaleza céntrica, pero el apto. está en un 6to piso, lo que amortigua el ruido de la calle. Súper recomendable. Griselda nos dio una gran mano ya que tuvimos algunos problemas con nuestro traslado a Bs.As. y cambiamos a último momento la hora de check-in. Siempre atenta y nos dio un montón de datos útiles para movernos en la ciudad.
Vía la página airbnb

Griselda foi muito gentil e atenciosa, nos deixou ficar depois do horário de checkout pois nosso voo era mais tarde. O apartamento é bem equipado, ao lado da estação de metrô e com lojas 24 hrs perto.

El lugar es muy bonito y cuenta con todo lo necesario para hacer una estadía agradable: buen internet, aire acondicionado e incluso adaptadores para la toma de la corriente.
Griselda estuvo atenta a nuestras necesidades y facilitó nuestra entrada y salida. Muy recomendado.
Es la 2da. vez que me hospedo con Griselda, ahora con toda mi familia, la ubicación es excelente para hacer turismo, el lugar es limpio y cómodo y Griselda es una gran anfitriona
Muy buena ubicación, limpio, ordenado y cómodo. Excelente trato con la anfitriona.

I had a wonderful experience staying in this apartment. I was in Buenos Aires for one month, on a work trip. The apartment was perfectly located a few blocks from the D line Subway, which takes you to the center in a few minutes, and its a lovely neighborhood with all amenities, great restaurants, etc.

These hosts were attentive, friendly and very helpful in answering questions before the trip. I cannot think of a single thing that would have made the trip better. Perfect stay, excellent apartment.

Adoramos nossa estadia! Fabiana e Gerardo foram sempre muito atenciosos. O studio é muito bem localizado, perto de um Carrefour, vários restaurantes, padarias, heladerias, farmácia... É como na foto, compacto, mas um tamanho ótimo para duas pessoas. Esperamos voltar!

The apartment was quaint with old school charm. Very nice quiet neighborhood. Very helpful and kind hosts. Cooking might be a bit difficult because of the collection of pots and pans and there is a machine to remove water from clothes which dried overnight. Recoleta mall and cemetery are three blocks away and you can also catch the hop on and off bus by the cemetery.

Hi Fabana and  her husband are perfectly wonderful people helped me get settled even when I had a plane change and my schedule got all changed . They met me and set me up.The apartment is just what they said a nice small studio,in a very nice section of town. Very Safe and the bed was very comfortable.It was just what I needed to beat jet lag and relax for a couple of days and then get on with my journey.  I  highly recommend  them and there place.Jim Dnohue

Fabiana's apartment was in easy walking distance of the Cemetery and museums in Recoleta. The area felt very secure and safe at any time of day or night. There were small groceries and panaderias within one block which made it easy to make breakfast in the kitchen. There were many restaurants in easy walking distance and buses passed near by which we used to visit the rest of the city. I would suggesting getting a SUBE pass that can preloaded and then used on all of the mass transit, including the regular train to Tigre. Fabiana was very friendly and provided us with answers to all of our questions about the city, as did the congenial concierge for the building.
We really enjoyed the walkablity of the city and large number of outdoor cafes. Late March is a great time to visit Buenos Aires.

This was my first time booking a space through Airbnb, and it went wonderfully. Fabiana and Gerardo were friendly, reliable, and helpful. The apartment is represented accurately in the listing--it's a bright, comfortable room in a charming neighborhood. I recommend it if you're looking for a nice, safe place to hang your hat after a fun day exploring Buenos Aires. Many thanks to Fabiana and Gerardo!

Griselda was so pleasant and accommodating.  She is an amazing host.  The apartment was clean and the bed was comfortable.  The cable television didn't work during our stay and the wi-fi was sporadic.  The toilet seat and the shower door needed to be fixed.  Griselda definitely made up for the downsides of the apartment.
El departamento es super práctico para estar en el centro de buenos aires y conectar a todos los lugares que quieras visitar! Es chiquito, pero lo más valorable es la ubicación
Griselda was a great host and her place was lovely! She explained everything about the apartment and gave us an idea of where things where! Would recommend and we would stay again!!!

REALMENTE UNA UBICACIÓN EXTRAORDINARIA EL DEPARTAMENTO. IMPECABLE EN TODOS LOS ASPECTOS Y RECOMENDABLE PARA UNA ESTANCIA PERFECTA EN EL MICRO CENTRO DE BUENOS AIRES. TODOS LOS SERVICIOS AL ALCANCE DE UNO Y UNA SEGURIDAD LOABLE DE DESTACAR. LA PASAMOS ESPLENDIDO Y MUY BIEN ATENDIDOS POR NUESTRA ANFITRIONA GRISELDA. TODO DE MARAVILLA, GRACIAS A DIOS, HABRA QUE VOLVER
Excelente zona cerquita de todo, Griselda se porto 10 puntos con nosotros, muy amable , seguro volveremos!

Griselda was a great host!  Amazing hospitality and a super clean apartment in downtown BA.  Apartment building has 24 hour security at the door which is nice.  A comfy bed, wifi, a clean hot shower, and a quiet building made this a  perfect place to spend the night while touring BA, and Griselda was very accomodating to our requests.  Would stay here again!
Todo perfecto. Muy buena atención por parte de Gricelda, muy buena ubicación. Es tal cual la descripción de la página. Muy recomendable

Departamento super céntrico, a una cuadra del Obelisco rodeado de pizzerias, bares y con una tienda de productos ecológicos a pie de calle!
Alojamiento tranquilo con aire acondicionado, limpio y con lo necesario. ideal para parejas y para aquellos que su prioridad sea estar en el centro de buenos aires.
Todo muy correcto y con mucha seguridad.
Foi muito boa a estada em casa de GRISELDA. Ótimo apartamento, possuía tudo que precisávamos. Muito bem localizado. GRISELDA foi muito atenciosa conosco . Super recomendo.
Todo fue perfecto

El departamento esta con una ubicacion excelente, muy facil para llegar al centro, o tomar metro. el cuarto esta limpio, con aire(aun esta saliendo poca agua). en general es bueno para pareja jovenes que haga un viaje corto en la cuidad.

Gostei muito da localização, perto do metro, restaurantes, lojas...o ar condicionado, TV a cabo e Wi-Fi funcionam muito bem, o colchão eh bom e confortável. A Griselda foi muito atenciosa e deu muitas dicas importantes, inclusive fornece um cartão de transporte para utilização. O pessoal da portaria também foi muito receptivo e simpático. O apartamento não eh tão novo quanto parece nas fotos e o elevador não tem ventilação.

Griselda's place is nice and clean, just like on the pictures. Beds are comfortable. The place is walking distance to Obelisco, teatro colon, cafeterias, public transportation. Griselda is a very pleasant lady, easy to communicate to if you speak Spanish. She replies to emails almost immediately. She also has all tourist information and a subs card ready for her guests. The kitchen does not have any condiments, so bring your own, if you are planning to cook. Also, if you are staying for more than a day, bring toilet paper. We also had some issues with air conditioner and shower: water dripping all the time. Besides of that everything worked fine. It is a nice place to stay for a few nights.
Muy central departamento. La anfitriona nos recibe de muu buena forma dándonos todas las indicaciones. Limpio y amplio. Muy recomendable.
老太太非常爱干净，房间很整洁。地段非常好。与描述的完全吻合。
Muy buena anfitriona amable y servicial . Buena ubicación. Todo excelente :)

Griselda é uma anfitriã espetacular! Muito atenciosa, nos aguardou para o check-in e deu todas as instruções para  que tivéssemos a melhor experiência possível. O apartamento fica muito bem localizado e é completo. Recomendamos muito seu apartamento e com certeza será nossa primeira opção de estadia em BsAs numa próxima oportunidade.

La ubicación excelente sobre todo para quienes van por primera vez a Buenos Aires, la anfitriona y la recepción/seguridad de primer nivel en atención y preocupación para que todo este bien. No es parte del departamento pero los dos ascensores tuvieron problemas durante nuestra estadia de hecho nos paso a nosotros de quedarnos encerrados, nada problemático por la pronta intervención del personal del edificio.
La recomiendo 100%
Great apartment,  great location and very safe, would certainly stay again and griselda is lovely.
Nao tenho como descrever o que mais gostei, tudo divini maravilhoso. Griselda uma pessoa muito querida,maravilhosa. sobre o alojamiento muito ,muito bom,perto de tudo.

Griselda es una persona muy amable, la llegada de nosotros al depto fe excelente, te explica todo muy detalladamente y te trata con mucho cariño. En cuanto al Depto, es tal y como esta en la publicación. Es genial que se encuentra a 2 cuadras del obelisco y a lado de la entrada del edificio esta la entrada a una de las lineas de metro de CABA, y cuando digo al lado es al lado. El precio me parece justo. Muchas gracias!!!!

La ubicacion excelente para lo que necesitabamos. Griselda muy buena anfitriona estuvo atenta a nuestras necesidades. El dpto es pequeño con limpieza extrema. Cama y almohadas muy confortables. Muy recomendable.

El departamento de Griselda es muy comodo y bien ubicado para moverse por el microcentro. A dos cuadras del Obelisco y a centimetros del subte. Las fotos y servicios son reales. No duden en alojarse aqui.

Flor y su esposo unas personas muy amables y calidas; ayudan con cualquier duda que se pueda tener. El apartamento tiene muy linda onda y excelente diseño, es cómodo y central a los lugares con mayor movimiento turístico en Buenos Aires. Regresaría sin duda!

Me and my girlfriend had 2 wonderful weeks in Florencias apartment. The apartment is beautiful designed and equipped, very comfortable bed, very clean and the location is just perfect - subway and busses as well as a lot of restaurants, bars etc nearby!
We really enjoyed the Netflix as well and the kitchen was very good equipped for cooking.
Nothing to complain and would be my first selection if I would come back to Buenos Aires in the future.
Thank you!

My stay in Florencia and Damian's apartment was fantastic.  The apartment was incredibly clean, spotless, and well decorated.  Much of the apartment was also recently renovated and everything looked new.  It was also fully equipped with all the amenities one could ask for such as a good heating & air conditioning system, extra bathroom supplies, and a complete kitchen.  It was also an added bonus that the apartment came with Apple TV  and a complimentary Netflix guest account.  The Wifi was also very speedy.  The location of the apartment is very central to everything in Buenos Aires and is in a very beautiful and safe neighborhood.  There are various supermarkets, cafes, and restaurants located nearby.  Florencia and her husband Damian are also some of the nicest people you will ever meet.  They go above and beyond to make sure your stay is pleasant and that you are comfortable.  They provide you with ample tourist advice and materials (map, subway card, restaurant & shopping recommendations, etc.) and pre-stock the apartment with sweets, water, and juice.  They also quickly responded to any messages I sent them as well as helped me get transportation back to the airport after my stay.  This apartment is definitely a great value and will be my first choice of residence next time I am in lovely Buenos Aires!  Highly recommended!

Florencia é muito atenciosa e nos recebeu muito bem. O apartamento é super aconchegante bem decorado e muito limpo. A cozinha é toda equipada assim como o banheiro.
Perfeito 100%

Fomos em lua de mel, mas queríamos algo mais "nosso", então optamos pelo apartamento e a Flor e Damian foram ótimos; super acolhedores.
Foi uma experiência maravilhosa!!!
Wurden im Apartment freundlich empfangen. Die Lage war seh gut und auch die Austattung der Wohnung, sehr liebevoll eingerichtet!

Florencia y su esposo Damián son anfitriones muy amables y con un admirable sentido práctico. Quienes han cuidado pequeños detalles para hacer la estadía más agradable. Se amoldan a situaciones excepcionales de los huéspedes como lo ha sido nuestra llegada a las 22:30 de la noche.
El departamento estaba muy limpio, es funcional y está muy bien ubicado en un lindo barrio: cerca del subte, con muchos restaurantes y bonitos cafés.
Mi esposo y yo lo recomendamos sin ninguna duda.

Apartamento no centro, bem equipado, limpo, confortável para 3 pessoas. Excelente recepção e fácil comunicação! A anfitriã nos deixou super à vontade e nos apresentou várias opções de lazer e gastronomia na cidade.

O apartamento é confortável, limpo, equipado e muito bem localizado. Inclusive, ha uma estação do metrô ao lado da entrada do prédio. Localização excelente, perto de restaurantes, comércio e pontos turísticos. Griselda foi extremamente atenciosa, desde antes de reservarmos até os dias que estivemos em Buenos Aires, e por isso somos muito gratos. Infelizmente não pudemos conhecê-la.

Super indicamos o lugar!
Muy buena ubicación.. y Griselda un amor.. nos dejo hacer más tarde el check out!
Es un departamento pequeño , pero muy bien ubicado, pleno centro, muy buena comunicación con Griselda, los porteros muy simpáticos y amables. muy recomendado!

El dpto es tal como se ve en las fotos, está re bien equipado, los colchones son nuevos, muy cómodos.
La ubicación es perfecta, cerca de todo y arriba del subte linea C.
Griselda super amable, me dio muchos consejos sobre la seguridad y sobre donde hacer turismo y como llegar a los lugares. Muy buena experiencia!
Un departamento muy limpio y ordenado, nos sirvió mucho la ubicación. La atención y contacto con los propietarios también fue excelente! Muy recomendable!
Custo beneficio bom! Localização excelente! 4 pessoas mas indico no max 2 adultos e 2 crianças! 4 adultos fica apertado! Griselda atenciosa demais!
Muy buena ubicación y muy cómodo !

Griselda é uma pessoa muito querida. Antes mesmo da nossa chegada, nos esclareceu algumas dúvidas por email, sempre muito prestativa. Seu apartamento é bem localizado ao centro, próximos de pontos turísticos, de ponto de ônibus e do metrô (subte). Fizemos quase tudo a pé, de ônibus e metrô. O apartamento é uma gracinha e nos atendeu muito bem (somos 1 casal) e é exatamente igual as fotos. E cheirava muito bem também. A cozinha é bem pequenina, porém como nosso propósito foi tomar café da manhã na rua todos os dias, isso não nos atrapalhou. Para quem está procurando um apartamento simples, aconchegante e bem localizado, eu super indico.
Ótimo lugar.

La anfitriona es una persona muy formal que en todo momento esruvo al tanto de nuestra llegada y requerimientos.
Recomendamos mucho el alojamiento en su departamento pues es un recinto cómodo, cercano a la zona centro y seguro.
Saludos Griselda, gracias por sus lindas arenciones.
Excelente departamento en pleno centro de Buenos Aires. Muy bien equipado.
O apto é bem localizado, Griselda nos atendeu prontamente, mas a rua é muito barulhenta, difícil pra dormir.

The apartment is right in the thick of it. In the heart of town close to tourist attractions and transport links. Great location.

Apartment itself was tidy and fit for purpose. Griselda was really lovely, she gave us a rundown of BA when we arrived and was flexible and agreeable with regards to check-in and check-out times.

La atención y comunicación con Griselda fue excelente.
El lugar queda en un buen punto céntrico, pero en la noche no es muy seguro para salir a caminar. La zona se pone bastante fea en la noche.
Es un apartamento cómodo para una persona o una pareja, no más.
La ropa de cama es muy poca. Faltaría abrigo.
La limpieza del lugar, regular.

A dona do apartamento é muito gentil, disponível pra ajudar sempre. O apartamento é aconchegante, próximo a vários pontos turísticos de Buenos Aires. Sem dúvida, um dos melhores lugares pra ficar em BsAs.

O apartamento é super bem localizado no centro de fácil acesso próximo as principais avenidas e muito confortável, camas e travesseiros ótimos.
Além disso, a Griselda é uma excelente anfitriã nos mostrou o mapa da cidade, roteiros, transportes e as opções para os dias hospedados no local.
Muito amável e receptiva!! Obrigada!!
La ubicación es perfecta... el subte está justamente en la puerta del edificio!!! Vigilancia las 24h del día y griselda siempre atenta a todo...
Muy atenta Griselda.
Todo perfecto!
Excelente depto! Flor y su esposo muy atentos y puntuales! Super recomendado y muy bien ubicado!!!
The place was exactly as advertised- clean, comfortable, charming, and in a great location.  Fabiana and Gerardo were friendly, accommodating, responsive--  overall it was a fantastic experience!

Fabiana and Gerardo were amazing hosts. They were extremely accommodating and went above and beyond for us on many occasions. Gerardo gave us amazing tips on where to eat/what to see in Buenos Aires and met us to exchange dollars into pesos. Fabiana let me know when the buses were on strike, something that saved our entire vacation (and went above and beyond what she needed to do for us). And when I left my favorite hat in the cab we took to the airport, Fabiana was able to retrieve it for me. ALSO, her brother opened up his home to us when we needed a place to stay our last night in BA. I cannot say enough how amazing our experience was because we connected with this beautiful couple. Thank you Fabiana and Gerardo, once again!

Fabian and Geraldo are great people and their studio is fantastic.

On our arrival, they were waiting for us even though our plane had been cancelled then delayed. When we left, Geraldo was there to send us off.

The studio was a great find: well situated, cheap, very clean, with everything you need just working flawlessly.

Thanks Fabiana and Geraldo.

Fabiana was great, she reply very fast and give me a lot of tips about the city and the neighborhood.
Unfortunately I missed the flight to Buenos Aires and don't travel.

My stay at Fabiana's was really great!..the apartment has a great location and we could do everything walking distance.
The apartment is small but very cozy!
thanks a lot Fabiana!

We had a great stay in Fabiana's apartment. The apartment is exactly as it is pictured online. It is quaint but perfect for two people. The bathroom is nice with a good shower. The kitchen has supplies for cooking and eating which was nice

Highly recommended!
I loved my time in this apartment. Natural light,good bed, good wifi, good water pressure, and no noise from neighbouring apartments
The position is perfect with easy walking distance to everything you are likely to need...laundry, supermarkets, banks, Recoleta Cemetery, parks, markets,medical centre and the list goes on.
As a solo traveller, the size of the apartment was perfect .It is safe and secure with elevator/lift access and although she was on vacation when i stayed Fabiana was really easy to communicate with and had everything arranged for a smooth check-in.
The people who look after the apartment security etc were also lovely, which is a rarity. They helped me when I arrived and when I left. A great experience overall and didn't want to leave.

Tudo perfeito, conforme o que foi planejado e divulgado. Perto de tudo, tem tudo que precisamos bem ao lado. Lugar central, rua muito movimentada, tem uma estação de metrô anexa ao prédio. ADORAMOS!!
Griselda é uma caso à parte, pessoa MARAVILHOSA, carinhosa acolhedora e muito atenciosa. Foi um prazer conhecê-la. Nos sentimos em casa, recomendo demais o imóvel.
Ótima localização, muitos lugares pra comer em volta, tranquilo. Recomendo

Fabiana's studio couldn't be in a better location!  It has a great view, is very cozy and well-decorated.  It felt like we were living in Buenos Aires for a week.  I'd highly recommend staying here...  Fabiana was a great host, and we had everything we needed--a full kitchen, laundry nearby, every bus you could possibly need to take you anywhere in the city, etc.  Great stay!
