Florencia and her husband were absolutely wonderful hosts and made a huge effort to ensure we had all the information and advice we needed for a brilliant stay. The flat is lovely and close to great restaurants and the subway making it easy to explore the city. Thank you again Florencia!

Florencia was incredible. The place  excellent and Florencia was a very accommodating an helpful host. I have stayed in Buenos Aires many times and will definitely come back next time I'm in town. Thanks Florenencia!

Flor y Demian fueron realmente muy amables con nosotros. Siempre atentos y disponibles a ayudarnos en todo. El apto está muy bien ubicado y es super cómodo.
Fue una linda estadía.

Muy buena atención de flor .
Saludos !

Wonderful hosts. Quiet location. Well equipped. Great value for money. Not much natural light comes in in autumn (May). Not used to the noisey elevator that woke us in the night from time to time. Overall fine.

Agradecemos a incrível prestatividade de Florencia e Demina. Fomos muito bem recebidos e ajudados durante toda a estadia. O local é como descrito, ótimo em localização e internamente. Os anfitriões fizeram muito além de suas obrigações, nos auxiliando durante toda a estadia. De todas as experiências no airbnb, a melhor que já tivemos.
Todo de maravilla el departamento y la atención!!
Excelente departamento! Tal cual las fotos y muy buena predisposición por parte de los dueños. 100% RECOMENDABLE!

The apartment is cozy and homely . It's very clean , well maintained and quiet . We stayed here 6 nights and it felt like home . Florencia is a great host , takes care of her guests and reachable easily

El departamento cuenta con todoo necesario para una muy buena estancia.
Super céntrico y me cercano a las principales zonas turísticas de la ciudad.
A cuadras del departamento hay muchos super mercados, cafeterías, panaderías y restaurantes.

Adorei o apartamento! A localização muito central e num bairro bom, seguro, (tudo o que é preciso para o dia-a-dia está a uma curta distancia) tem tudo impecável, wifi super bom!
Fabiana óptima anfitriã! Sérgio tbm muito simpático. Muito fácil de os contactar.

Vale muuuito a pena e espero voltar!! :)
Fabiana fue muy amable. El departamiento es muy bien ubicado, mui limpio e ordenado. Ademas Fabiana siempre me respondio muy prontamente. Recomendo.

I stayed for one month and greatly enjoyed the experience. The loft is very trendy as can be seen from the pictures, clean and very cozy. On the day of my arrival, I was welcomed by the property manager Guillermo who was very helpful and gave me great advice about Buenos Aires. A few weeks later, I also met with Sebastian who was also very helpful and always quick to respond to any queries that I had.

The property is located in the northern part of Palermo, and it takes about 15 minutes to walk to a lot of popular restaurants and clubs in the Palermo area. There is also a large supermarket very close to the property, which is a big plus. Unfortunately, the nearest subte (Buenos Aires subway) station is quite far (about 20 minutes by foot) so be prepared to take the bus.

Overall, I was very happy with the loft and would definitely recommend it.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Sebastian's apartment. Whilst we didn't meet Sebastian, we were met by Guillermo who was very helpful and responsive to us. The apartment is great for a couple and well contained for cooking etc. The location is also very good, close to the bars and restaurants of Palermo and a 5 minute walk to the metro. Lots of buses go past too. We definitely recommend this apartment!

Communication between Sebastian and Guillermo (his local contact) was superb and they were great about helping arrange paid airport transfer, pointing out some of the local area and resolving issues.

The place: is in a six unit residence. It is *very* spacious and comfortable (especially the bed) and the neighbors are friendly even helping me when I struggled with the keys during my first day. Worth noting - if you're not accustomed to traditional SA keys, this system will take a day or two to get used to. The furnishings could use a bit of a refresh, but I've been told this is underway and is really only an issue if you're making an extended stay as I did.
The location: While not located in the "thick of it", it's about a .5 mile (or 15-20 minute walk) to the action in Palermo Hollywood and Palermo Soho. No significant street noise, but sufficiently busy enough to easily grab cabs. Neighborhood is very safe although some foreign visitors may find it a bit gritty. 10 minute walk to the B subte and a 20 minute walk to the D.

Overall I recommend and would stay there again.

We stayed in Sebastian's loft for a month. We'd been traveling for eight months and it made a great rest for us. We cooked in the well-equipped kitchen, joined a nearby gym (Crossfit Tuluka), and took tango lessons at Fundacion Tango just around the corner. It felt as though we lived in BA rather than hanging out in touristy areas. The neighborhood is between Palermo Hollywood and Villa Crespo, both of which have good restaurants, coffee shops, and the like, but it's not central BA. It's quite far from the normal attractions of the city (Boca, San Telmo, etc.), but they're reachable by bus (1 hour) or taxi (30 min or so).

Things to note:
- The bed is incredibly comfortable and big
- Best washing machine ever
- The street is noisy. We slept just fine, but may not be good for light sleepers, and it makes the patio less pleasant
- Veggie and meat shops down the street if you like to cook
- The apartment wasn't very clean when we arrived, and the bed wasn't made. This may have been a fluke but was disappointing after 46 hours of travel from Tanzania
- The manager, Guillermo, was incredibly friendly and helpful!

We would definitely return. We find ourselves missing the neighborhood. It's walkable, so we walked off all that delicious ice cream from Occo Helados nearby. Plus there's some really cool street art in Villa Crespo - great to stumble on! It was a true BA experience and exactly what we were looking for.
The apartment is great. I stayed there twice. Totally recommend it.

This would be amazing apartment after some cosmetic improvements, as facilities are quite used-up, there are stains here and there, in bathroom there is bit of mold too.

Other than that it's a good stay, apt is spacious, has huge windows and close to the nice neighborhoods. However you would have to do a fair bit of walking to get to the Palermo SOHO. On the other hand Subway station is relatively close, as well as a bus stop, so it would be simple to navigate the rest of the city.

Sebastian is a good host, he managed to check me in, even tho I arrived pretty late. I hadn't had a chance to meet him personally and only interacted with his friends.

I think it just needs a bit of work to be done on it, but after that would be a pretty nice place.

El loft de Sebastián está muy bien, en relación con el precio que tiene es inmejorable, el anfitrión sólo pone interés en que te encuentres a gusto y solucionar cualquier problema si surge, se encuentra situado en un bonito y tranquilo barrio bonaerense muy agradable y cerca del Subte.

El anuncio se ajusta bien a lo que ofrece, la relación calidad precio es muy buens y el anfitrión siempre dispuesto a resolver rápidamente cualquier necesidad o incidente, el apartamento está en un lugar tranquilo y muy agradable y está bien comunicado.
Como pega, los últimos días hizo bastante calor, el aire acondicionado que tiene es insuficiente para todo el apartamento y se convirtió en una sauna.

My girlfriend and I just spent a month at Sebastian's amazing apartment in Buenos Aires and I don't even know where to start in describing how great our stay was. When we arrived at the airport in BA Sebastian's friend was waiting to pick us up and drive us into town. We were warmly welcomed by our host who gave us a nice bottle of wine and left a couple beers in the fridge - a really nice touch.

I really can't explain enough how good of a host Sebastian is. One day we accidentally locked ourselves out of the building and he arranged for a friend to meet us at a coffee shop near the apartment to let us back in. Awesome.

The apartment itself is fantastic. It's bright and open, has excellent WiFi (which was important to us as we both work remotely), is a short walk to all of the excellent restaurants, bars and events in Palermo. Everything in the apartment worked as expected.

We'd definitely stay here again if we return to BA. Thanks for making our time here so great!
Todo bien con el Loft. Sebastian fue atento y respondio rapidamente a todos mis mensajes. Recomendable.

We stayed in this apartment for 4 nights. It was slightly older than what it appeared in the photos however very clean and had everything we needed. The location is ok, there are a few cafes and supermarkets nearby but not a lot of restaurants. We ended up going to Palermo for dinner 3 of the nights! Fabiana was lovely to deal with, very accommodating with out checkin and checkout and helpful with suggestions of things to do.
I had a great time there !!! Everything is clean and safe

Lovely studio apartment in a great location. Everything you need - plus bright, cheery and clean. Fabiana was lovely to deal with.  We really enjoyed our stay here and are planning to come back to this apartment the next time we are in BA.

Fuimos muy bien recibidas por Fabiana, quien estuvo siempre disponible y fue en todo momento muy gentil y eficiente. Llegamos a las doce de la noche a Ezeiza, porque nuestro vuelo había sufrido alteraciones, y Fabiana nos ayudó con el transfer, además de estar de super buen humor para mostrarnos el apartamento, el lugar y hacernos sentir en casa con una charla muy agradable.
El apartamento es muy luminoso, como lo indica el anuncio y está muy, pero muy bien ubicado. El barrio es muy tranquilo, seguro, lindo y cercano a todo. A escasos 200m tienes todos los comercios: farmacia, panadería, kiosco de períodicos y revistas, kioscos 24 horas, un minimercado, restaurante, pizzería, casa de té, etc. Puedes moverte a pie a Patio Bulllrich, a Avenida Santa Fé, al Centro Cultural Recoleta, al Museo de Bellas Artes, al Palais de Glace, etc. Ya para los lugares que quedan un poquito más alejados puedes usar el subte (metro), la entrada de la línea amarilla H queda tan solo a unas cuadras. Fabiana deja en el apartamento una tarjeta “sube”, para uso durante la estadía, que facilita muchísimo la locomoción y te permite economizar con traslados.
El apartamento es pequeño, pero tiene todo lo que necesitas. Fabiana deja algunas cosas como té, azúcar, yerba, champú, entre otras, que a la hora de la llegada (especialmente a la madrugada) pueden ser importantes. Hay también mapas y guías con informaciones turísticas. Todos los electrodomésticos que usamos funcionaron muy bien. La internet también funcionó perfectamente. Resumiendo: consideramos que es una muy buena opción de hospedaje en Buenos Aires. La pasamos muy bien! Pensamos volver!

Top location to discover Buenos Aires. I enjoyed staying here during my vacation in BA, central location, still quiet and residential area in a safe neighbourhood.
The appartment is nicely decorated and makes the stay quite cosy. It offers some books about BA and toiletries. It has everything you need, to stay either at home or to explore the city and it is clean. Some fresh paint would make it an even better place.
Just check-in did not run very smoothly as one would like: the cleaning service did not show up and Fabiana was taking care of it herself last minute. So, I had to wait until I could check in, which was fine given all the cafés and restaurants around the corner and that I could leave my stuff already in the appartment. She did her best, to make my arrival easy despite the circumstances.
Fabiana was a great host making suggestions for sights and restaurants and was available for any questions, like how much to pay the cab driver or how long it would take from the airport. She was available via Whatsapp, whenever necessairy.
I would stay here again.
This is our second time staying with Fabiana and we had a lovely time. Location, apartment and host interaction were great.  A perfect home away from home.
Excelente anfitriona. Sin duda volvería a hospedarme con ella. Muy lindo el departamento, su equipamiento y ubicación.
Fabiana fue muy amable con todo.

We had a very pleasant stay at Fabianas cozy apartment which is located in quiet and beautiful Recoleta. In her small place you find everything you need, exactly as described. It was clean and as nice as you can see in the pictures. Communication with Fabiana was uncomplicated and quick. We would recommend it without any doubts.

Tuvimos una excelente estadía en BA, el apartamento tiene una excelente ubicación, en una área súper segura, cerca de todo, negocios, restaurantes, mini markets, malls, etc.
Fabiana siempre estuvo atenta a nuestros mensajes de whatsapp, siempre pendiente de nosotros.
El lugar bien equipado y limpio.
Pensamos regresar el próximo año y volver al mismo apartamento.
Nos sentimos súper cómodos.
Gracias Fabiana.
Claudia y Edgar marzo 2016

Great place ! Fabiana was friendly and quick to respond to any questions and even sent me information about a few interesting events in Buenos Aires (BA) while I was here. She was flexible with the checkout time (with some advance notice).
The apartment is only 5 blocks from Las Heras subte (metro/subway) station and walking distance from many of the key sites of BA. Fabiana had someone waiting to let me into the apartment on time when I arrived.
The place was clean and tidy and well maintained (looks like it was repainted not too long ago). Everything I used in the kitchen worked well (fridge, toaster over, microwave, heating element). The apartment is well stocked with dish soap, paper towel, hand soap, toilet paper, towels, etc.
You can hear some sounds from other apartment doors and sounds of the city below. If you need complete silence (likely impossible to find in such a great centrally located place) then it may bother you but it is fairly muted since the apartment is on the 7th floor. I didn't find it disturbing and slept well.
Overall this is a great place and very good value. I'd highly recommend it to any person or couple looking to stay in BA.

Hola Fabiana, te agradecemos por tu hospitalidad y buena predisposición.
El depto es tal cual las fotos, muy cómodo y limpio. Una excelente ubicación y cerca de todo.
Fabiana was quick with communication.  Her place was clean and the bed was comfortable.  Next time, I hope she will remember to leave me with some toilet paper.  :)
Lugar muy bien ubicado, el departamento es tal cual indica la descripción original. Fabiana muy amable, siempre en contacto y dispuesta a ayudar.

The apartment was very clean and met all of our needs. The apartment was also in a central, safe part of Buenos Aires (some porteños called it a posh neighborhood). Fabiana was very helpful and easy to contact. Would highly recommend staying here!

Excelente el lugar. Las fotos muestran el departamento tal cual es.
Muy buena ubicación.
El espacio era pequeño pero confortable y limpio. Todo funcionó bien. Esta muy bien ubicado.  Fue una.Estados muy relajada y Fabiana estuvo atenta a los detalles.
El departamento muy limpio y comodo, con todas las cosas que uno puede necesitar. Una ubicación excelente y  sobre todo segura. Fabiana muy amable y predispuesta en todo lo que necesite
Fabiana was very responsive and helpful and the neighborhood is wonderful, full of good restaurants and cafes to work.
Excelente Depto! Muy lindo, limpio y cómodo :) Florencia súper atenta siempre. 100% recomendable!

We stayed for a month, and this apartment is as advertised-- excellent! It had every convenience one could need for a month-long stay, and its great location allowed for easy access to all the best parts of the city. It's super clean, well styled, comfortable, and homey. It's close to the subway, and if you like to walk, it's perfect. Flor and her husband are great hosts. We highly recommend this Airbnb and look forward to returning soon. We have stayed in a lot of great cities (Berlin, Barcelona, etc.), but this stay was one of our favorites!

I stayed in this apartment for almost 2 months and it was a wonderful experience. The location is just a few blocks from the best restaurants in all of Buenos Aires! Palermo Hollywood is an excellent location to base yourself while exploring this magical city.

The wifi works perfectly and if you are planning to do some work from home like I did you will have access to a high-speed internet connection that never failed me once.

There is a large grocery store nearby that has everything you could possibly want!

There is laundry in the apartment, but if you do not want to deal with doing any laundry there is a laundry service just 2 blocks away that will wash and fold 3 loads of laundry for around 100 pesos - it's an incredible deal.

I give my highest recommendation to Sebastian as a host, I have stayed at many AirBnbs around the world and Sebastion is one of the best!

This lovely studio is exactly as described in the listing. Flor and Demian were spot on in their communications, always honest, friendly and very fast to respond to any questions that we had, prior to the trip, and once we arrived in BA. The studio was furnished well, with all of the basics for cooking accounted for. The TV setup was excellent as well, with cable, Netflix and Apple TV all available. The Wi-Fi worked well (10Mbps down) and was stable and available throughout our visit. For those that are cellular roaming, service was good in the apartment with both Claro and Movistar.

The location is excellent, and in very close proximity to attractions in Recoleta and Palermo. Many major attractions are easily within walking distance, if you are used to walking in your everyday life. If you need to get an Uber to reach where you are going, the building is located at a "T" intersection, which makes it very convenient for hopping in and out of the Uber, and setting the pin accurately. Most fares that we incurred were between $3-$8 USD, with the higher end coming during evening surge times. There are groceries, corner stores and bakeries EVERYWHERE surrounding the condo, so you will not hurt for options buying necessities. Expect prices generally on par with US supermarkets.

I cannot emphasize enough just how helpful and friendly that Flor and Demian were. They provided us with (excellent) recommendations for nearby restaurants, and cautioned us about the best way to reach the city from Ezieza airport. They made our first trip to Buenos Aires a successful one. If you book with them, I am certain that you will have the same experience as well.
It's a clean, cute and quite place. Flor and her husband are very helpful hosts. Perfect for a business trip. All has been great!

A excellent place to stay in Buenos Aires! I was shocked at how much more tranquil it was in person. The apartment is well furnished and you cannot ask for more with Netflix, Apple TV, coffee, water and mate provided by Flor!

The neighborhood is friendly and close to anything you desire! Great restaurants are only walking distance and the entire city is at your fingertips! My top pick for when I return to Buenos Aires!

Flor and Damien were AMAZING!!! Damien met me at 2am to let me into the apartment and was great at helping me get settle in those early morning hours. Flor was there for me anything I had a question and suggested the best places to visit and eat! I highly recommend you stay with them! True super hosts!

L'appartement est propre, bien entretenu, bien équipé et idéalement situé pour découvrir Buenos Aires. Parfait pour un séjour de quelques jours! Nous avons également apprécié les conseils et la gentillesse de Florencia et Demian, ainsi que le fait qu'ils s'adaptent à notre emploi du temps pour l'arrivée et le départ. Merci à tous les deux!

Impecável! Foi tão incrível que ao ir embora já tive a impressão de que iria sentir saudade. Que casal atencioso. Que apartamento fofo! Que lugar central! Mercado literalmente ao lado. Cozinhamos em casa vários dias. Foi realmente deliciosa a estadia, a prestatividade da Florencia e de seu marido são daquelas de encantar qualquer um. Eles são extremamente preparados para receber, dão indicações de lugares para comer, dão dicas, mostram tudo no mapa. Sério! Indescritível o carinho e a atenção que recebemos. Foi como ser recebida por amigos de longa data. Voltarei sem dúvida. E recomendo de olhos fechados! Excepcional! Parabéns casal querido, vocês ganharam dois fãs brasileiros.

El departamento es muy comodo y la ubicación es perfecta para recorrer la ciudad. Fabiana es superdisponible, nos ayudó en muchas ocasiones. Respondió a todas nuestras preguntas e incluso nos brindò sugerencias para disfrutar de la ciudad. Realmente una linda experiencia!
Fabiana es una anfitriona excelente. Todo en el departamento estaba en excelentes condiciones y ella se mostró muy predispuesta y siempre disponible. Excelente departamento !

Fabiana es una excelente host, comunicativa, comprensiva con que era la primera vez que usaba airbnb y siempre dispuesta a ayudar, pero no es invasiva si le toca una viajera como yo... de las q le gusta arreglarse sola

El studio es super acogedor, y tenia todo lo que necesitaba para sentirlo mi hogar. El barrio es super lindo y esta cerca de todo, hay un restaurant riquísimo solo a la vuelta dela depa. Todo 5 estrellas.

Definitivamente tengo que volver a Argentina y me quedaría de nuevo allí.

Gracias Fabiana por todo

Fabiana is great, from even before we started our trip to the end of it she was very friendly and helpful. We met right on time of our arrival and of departure, she gave us tips on where to go, and helped us when the internet of the apartment failed. She is friendly, responsive and an amazing host, I can't say enough good words about how willing to help and make our stay the best as it could be. The place is extremely well located. The downside is that the street can be noisy.

Sebastian's place is just as described: spacious (we even fit two bikes in the living room without a problem), fast wi-fi, very comfortable bed, well-equipped kitchen. Sebastian's kind and helpful friend Nicolás checked us in and helped us with any small issues that arose during our stay. Great location in Chacarita, just off the bike lane. There's some street noise during the week, but nothing major. Gracias Sebastian y Nicolás!
Such an amazing place: spacious, central, and very hip. Sebastian is also an amazing host, totally responsive at all hours of the day for any need. Highly recommended!

It's exactly like in the pictures!  Location is great, very chill neighborhood. Sebastian is super helpful and always open to answering any questions you might have. It was truly a pleasure to stay at his place.
Buen lugar para hospedarse, quedan cerca varios restaurantes. El lugar es igual a lo que se ve en fotos.

Really nice location, and can highly recommend the cafe next to the place. Trouble with the a/c the first week, and difficult communication. Promised a refund, but so far nothing.
Apartment is nice and clean, walking distance to most things in Palermo.

We really enjoyed our 2 weeks in Sebastian's loft. While it is a bit far from any central areas (Palermo Hollywood is a 15 minute walk away), it is really close to a bunch of bus stops.

If you'll just be sleeping in the loft, and going out all day and returning at the end, it's brilliant. There's multiple bus stops within a stones through of the loft which will take you to Centro, La Boca, Belgrano, Retiro, pretty much anywhere you want to go. It's super easy.

The loft is on a very noisy street, so the sound of traffic is loud and constant. If you're a light sleeper, this may not be the best place for you. That said, most places we stayed in in BA were very noisy... it's a noisy city. Bring your ear plugs!

We were there in the middle of summer, when the temperature was mid thirties every day... the airconditioning kept us cool, but we did have to crank it all afternoon for it to cool down enough upstairs to sleep there. Lo siento madre tierra!

Sebastian was really responsive and helpful throughout our stay. For example, when the internet broke, he had a technician at the place fixing it within 24 hours - genius. I don't think i could pull that off in Australia.

Overally we really loved staying in the loft. The facilities are all excellent, there's great wifi and cable TV (Which we never turned on) with Netflix, a cool little desk to work at, and a nice sitting area near the kitchen for eating meals.
Fabiana es una excelente anfitriona. La ubicación  y los servicios con los que cuenta el Departamento son de lo mejor. Es la segunda ocasión en la que nos hospedamos y sin dudar volveré una tercera.
No podimos encontrar fabiana porque estaba de viaje, pero era muy disponible para responder a nuestras preguntas. El apartamiento tiene todo lo que es necesario cerca del subte. Gracias Fabiana!

Florencia y su esposo muy hospitalarios y buena onda, el departamento es hermoso, muy bien decorado, muy cómodo, tiene todo y esta perfectamente ubicado. La verdad que es muy recomendable. Todo muy lindo.
perfect place

Easy to get everywhere and close to Palermo where restaurants and bars are,
Close to the subways into the city,
Nice space for a single or a couple I stayed by myself and had plenty of room to unpack

The apartment is perfectly located! Only a couple of mins from bars, cafes and all the great places in Palermo. Sebastian was very easy to deal with, always responded quickly. Thank you for a lovely stay!

I spent a month in Sebastian's apartment and loved coming home to it everyday. The location was perfect for me, near the subte (metro), buses, with shops, beautiful cafes and restaurants all nearby. The apartment had everything I needed to cook, work, wash clothes and relax. A dream spot from which to explore Buenos Aires. I was there in April, so the climate was perfect, no need for aircon or heating. Sebastian was very responsive, friendly and helpful, as was Nico who was there to check me in and out personally. The apartment windows face onto a busy road, so there is a certain amount of road noise during the day and night, however I used earplugs and slept well. Highly recommended, I'll definitely come back to stay next time I'm in CABA! Thank you Sebastian!
This was such a great experience. I lived in this apartment for a month and it felt like home. Such a cool space in a great location. Great host too. Recommend. Thank you!
fantastic stay!
The apartmenti s at a great location to get around to all major spots of the city. It is clean and comfortable and very quiet considering it's in the heart of the City.
El departamento es lindo y muy ubiscado cerca de la caille Santa Fe. Florencia y su marido son muy aimables.

This was such a nice apartment, very clean, bright, and the perfect size for a couple to stay.  Florencia and her husband were amazing hosts, helpful and attentive when we had questions but not invasive. The location was perfect, right in the middle of it all, easy to get anywhere.

A Fabiana é muito prestativa, ficou o tempo todo a disposição para resolver dúvidas, inclusive por WhatsApp. Mesmo assim, quase não foi necessário contata-la porque ela deixa papéis e guias com diversas informações bem visíveis logo na entrada do apartamento. Pequenas coisas que fazem MUITA diferença: ela deixa um cartão de transporte público (SUBE) que pode ser usado para tomar ônibus e metrô, logo acima do guia de linhas da cidade. Isso é muito bom porque, além de não gastar dinheiro para comprar um cartão, quanto mais você viaja, menor o preço da passagem, então se todos os viajantes que passam no apartamento usam o mesmo cartão, mantém sempre o preço mínimo. Itens de higiene à disposição, todos muito bem organizados. Água quente em todas as torneiras. O apartamento é bem ventilado, abrindo a sacada nem precisamos usar o ar condicionado (que também está à disposição, para quem gosta). A TV e a WiFi são otimas, conseguimos até assistir netflix com um chromecast que levamos. A localização do apartamento é excelente, fica a uma quadra de um supermercado com ótimos preços, na mesma quadra de um kiosko onde é possível comprar e recarregar chip 3G (bom para quem quer andar na cidade com Uber e Moovit), a uma quadra de dois pontos de ônibus onde passam várias linhas e a poucas quadras da estação Las Herras do metrô. O bairro Recoleta é ótimo, fica perto do museu de Bellas Artes, que é sensacional, e tem vários restaurantes. Mesmo sendo muito bem localizado e próximo da Las Herras, que é movimentada, o apartamento é silencioso e dá para dormir muito bem à noite.

Great place! WiFi, hot water, etc. works well. Close to supermarkets. Safe. Clean.
Host is nice and responsive.

Cet appartement est idéalement situé pour découvrir Buenos Aires et son hôte très disponible pour répondre à toutes nos questions. La climatisation est un vrai plus pour les journées d'été...! On vous le recommande vivement. Paul et Coline

Amazing experience! The apartment is small and perfect for first time travelers to Buenos Aires and looking for a great place to stay. The apartment has a rustic feeling and trendy which, gives it a cool vibe. The only surprise for me was the full size bed which, made a bit hard for me and my wife to share it (Please keep in mind I'm a 6'2). Awesome place and recommend it to anyone!

Florencia and her husband are the very BEST hosts we have ever had on AirBnB!  We had inconvenient travel delays and Florencia and her husband were beyond responsive and more than accommodating.  They opened their home to us at 3am after a long unrelenting 36 hours of travel.  Their home is clean, quaint, and ideally located.  Florencia has our full endorsement.  She is a PERFECT HOST!

Florencia y Demian fueron unos anfitriones muy amables y cordiales desde el primer momento. El departamento es cómodo y está decorado y equipado con todo lo necesario  como para sentirse en casa. La zona es una de las más activas de Palermo, con muchas opciones de bares, restaurantes y comercios. 100% recomendable!

Estuvimos felices en este apartamento, que es como un pequeño loft. Es lindo, limpio, con linda decoración,  lleno de detalles y la anfitriona super linda, atenta y accesible. Muy bien ubicado. Sin duda volvería!

The hosts went above and beyond to help me out and accommodate my arrival and late check out. They provided a large bottle of water and had a great house manual that explained everything thoroughly. They were very responsive on whatsapp to some questions I had. The location is excellent and the unit is in the back of the building so very safe and quiet. Thank you for a great visit!

In over a decade on Airbnb this was the worst experience I've ever had.

I saw some of the warning signs in old reviews: needs maintenance, issues with the air conditioner, road noise, poor communication with the host.

I should have paid more attention to these warnings.

I messaged Sebastian in advance, and he assured me everything was in good working order.

Limited to 1000 characters so here is the summary:

- "Manager" lives 90 minutes away and would not reply to messages
- A/C unit had not been cleaned in two years
- No hot water in shower
- Metal gate on balcony impossible to open - even by host
- Paid out of pocket for some repairs not not reimbursed
- Had to rent another hotel room just to sleep during a 100F heatwave
- No instructions to leave when key required to open building door

This is not a designer apartment, as suggested by the title. It is uninhabitable.

This will be my last negative review on Airbnb, the next time I leave the platform.

Daniel was a very nice host and the apartment was in very good shape. My only major issue with the apartment was the location. The description said that the apartment was located in Palermo (a very desirable area of Buenos Aires). However, as I came to find out, the apartment was actually in Abasto (a much less desirable, fringe area). I did not have any issues but I was told that it was not a very safe area, especially at night. also, the internet was kind of slow. The apartment itself, however, was as pictured. It was new and well maintained. Aside from the confusion with the location, Daniel was a helpful and gracious host. All in all, if I were to repeat this stay I would have paid the extra money to actually stay in Palermo.

This apartment is great and Flor is an amazing host. She provide me with many local tips and help.

The apartment looks exactly as the pictures. The location is great as the description says.

La verdad que excelente. Todo en excelente estado de limpieza, orden y decoración. Daba gusto estar ahí. Altamente recomendable, tanto Florencia como su esposo muy amables y serviciales, reserve a último momento y se las ingeniaron rápidamente para recibirme.
Everything was good with Fabiana. She is a great host!
Fabiana is a great host! She went above and beyond to make sure I felt welcome and provided with great suggestions of what to see, do, and eat in BA. Highly recommend this place.

Apartamento situado em uma das melhores localizações de Buenos Aires. Há ótimas opções de bares, restaurantes e supermercados a menos de 5 minutos a pé. Fabiana é uma anfitriã muito atenciosa e prestativa. O cartão SUBE deixado por ela no apartamento facilitou muito nossa locomoção pela cidade.
Lindo espacio, con las comodidades necesarias para una estancia agradable. Muy bien ubicado; Recoleta es un barrio acogedor y sumamente céntrico. Fabiana es una buena anfitriona. Gracias!

Muy bonito departamento, me sentí cómodo y bien tratado, se puede llegar caminando a los lugares más importantes de la ciudad.
La zona es residencial, me sentí muy seguro.

Gracias Fabiana, volvere pronto

Muy bien ubicado.
Fabiana genial!!!

The place was much better than what the other reviewers said, I feel. The area with the cafes and posh shops is a short bus ride away...but if you are like myself, used to transportation, then everything was just minutes away.
For any place you will stay you will experience some noise and it seems dust accumulates fast. But, this is everywhere.
Two days the plumbing in the building had some problems but the building manager seemed to be available for questions.
For those who love to cook. There is no ventilation in the kitchenette.
Overall, I was comfortable and one plus is this place has a bathtub! Very good.
I would stay again.
Ines was excellent and her place was lovely. The location was excellent! I would highly recommend renting from her.

Excelente apartamento en relación costo-calidad. Muy bien ubicado, cercano a comercios y zonas turísticas. El vecindario es bastante tranquilo y seguro; además, es muy fácil acceder desde él hacia puntos de transporte público. Fabiana fue una excelente anfitriona desde el primer día, la comunicación con ella es muy buena en general. Recomendable.
The place is well located close to recoleta Mall and close to local attractions. The apartment was clean and Fabiana was very helpful with the checkin and with tips of things to do.
Muy amable todo limpio!

Fabiana ist eine tolle Gastgeberin. Sie hat alles perfekt organisiert und sich um alles gekümmert. Ihr Studio ist auch super. Ich habe drei Wochen dort verbracht. Es gibt alles, was man braucht. Es ist schön, sauber und gemütlich und ist richtig gut gelegen. Manchmal hört man den Lärm von der Straße, aber da es ruhig gelegen ist, stört das nicht sehr. Ich empfehle es auf jeden Fall weiter!
Excelente ubicación!!! Fabiana nos atendió muy bien y está disponible siempre para cualquier asistencia. Muy recomendado.

We LOVED Florencia's apartment! It was extremely comfortable, the apartment building was quiet and we rarely heard outside noise besides the birds. The shower is actually hot with good water pressure. The kitchen is well equipped.. Her apartment is surrounded by amazing restaurants and cafes on every corner. Its about short blocks to the subway and 4 blocks to a big shopping center. Starbucks is 2 blocks away. We are already planning to come back here. PS the bed is very comfortable with good quality sheets. Florencia's apartment is your home away from home while in Buenos Aires!!! We used Uber to get around the city, it is cheap and safer than taxis, the subway system was cheap and easy to use but some of the lines close at around 10 at night, so it good to have a back up plan.

Tudo estava conforme o site. O que não conseguimos ver antes é a espetacular hospitalidade que  a Florencia e o Demian tiveram conosco. Energia boa e todo o cuidado para que tivéssemos uma excelente estadia , o que realmente aconteceu. Podem confiar pois vale a pena!
Excelente piso. Muy bien decorado, cerca de todo. Mucho transporte cerca. Volvería a elegirlo.

Departamento perfectamente ubicado, central, cerca de todo, muy cerca del metro o subte, cómodo, lindo tal como las fotos. El servicio de Florencia y Damian muy bueno, siempre con respuestas rápidas y disponibles para ayudar en la llegada y  en la salida en lo que necesitáramos (guardar maletas, nos pidieron el taxi a la hora que necesitáramos, facilitan una tarjeta del subte para poder moverse en forma mas barata por la ciudad). Nos hicieron sentir muy bien atendidos, super recomendable!!

Flor and her husband are great hosts. Communication was prompt and everything regarding my arrival went just as planned. The space is perfect for a single person or a couple. The location is great and puts you in close proximity to most of the city's main attractions. I really appreciate that Flor checked in on me a few times during my stay and advised me in advance to stay clear of some protests that took place downtown. I also ate at some fantastic restaurants based on Flor's recommendations. If you are a first timer to Buenos Aires as I was, you will be in good hands with Flor.

The pictures of Florencia's apartment are 100% accurate and the reviews are spot on -- this apartment is in an unbeatable location and exactly as described: cute, stylish, functional and super clean. Flor and her husband are super-communicative and provide tons of resources to help you make the most of your stay in BA (including a card for the subway!). The apartment is centrally located, so you can walk to many sights in Recoleta and are just a short cab ride (or longer walk) to Palermo. There's a grocery store within a few blocks of the apartment and a place to have your laundry done if you're on a longer trip like we were. I cannot recommend Flor highly enough -- you will not regret booking this apartment! Thank you, Flor, for sharing your lovely space with us and making our time in BA so wonderful :)

It is an amazing experience! The house is absolutely lovely! They gave me lots of helpful advices about local spots and even helped me booked this wonderful steakhouse! I have to say it totally worth it!
Highly recommend!!

This is a beautiful apartment in a very central location, near to great restaurants in Palermo, the city centre and the main tourist attractions. Flor is a wonderful host, providing helpful advice and recommendations, including on transportation. Following a mix-up on our part, she responded quickly, coming over to the apartment to help sort things out. Flor and her husband could not have done more. Perfect stay in BA!

Flor’s apartment is exactly as advertised :: clean, comfortable, and in a great location! It is super easy to grab a taxi or to walk to Palermo/Recoleta areas. Flor answered all questions quickly and was very helpful in providing restaurant recommendations! Would 100% stay again and recommend to friends. Great studio apartment for a couple or 1 person.

Home is where the heart is and we could feel all the love in this cosy apartment. It was spotlessly clean and every detail thought about. Flor is the most beautiful host and so thoughtful. She made our last minute booking so effortless and she is very kind and caring.  It is easy to see why there are so many amazing reviews.  This is a real authentic place to  experience living in BA and close to everything you need.

Everything about our stay was perfect.  Florencia was very quick to respond to all of our messages, spoke perfect English which was helpful for us, and was kind enough to book remis to and from the airport for us which were on time and reliable.  The apartment was very clean with all the basic amenities included - towels, soap, shampoo, hairdryer.  They had power outlet converters, maps, and coffee/bottled water/juice which was much appreciated after arriving from our over night flight.  The neighborhood was very quiet (in a good way) but was within walking distance of everything we wanted to see. The area felt very safe, we walked home late at night after dinner.  Was perfect for our 24 hour stay, only wish we could have stayed longer!

This was truely the best airbnb we had (and we had a lot). For argentinian standards this little studio is fresh, clean, open, nice. Flor’s attention, friendliness, tips and eye for detail (clean and lots of towels) made our stay in BA even better. Best quality- price airbnb you can find. Highly reccomendable!

florencia's apartment is really nice!  they have provided a really comfortable space with all of the amenities you need.  they were very helpful with checkin and stayed in constant communication throughout the process.  i loved staying here and would definitely consider it again in the future!
Todo perfecto! Volveremos!😊

We had a great stay here. The hosts were great with our many questions and requests. The flat is very stylish with many homely touches. Located in nice neighbourhood with good subway connections.

Would highly recommend the place and the hosts!

Flor’s apartment is perfect for your next visit to Buenos Aires. It’s location is very convenient, as it’s right between the very hip Palermo areas and the up-scale Recoleta, not to mention in striking distance by foot of every major tourist site. We love to walk, so we hoofed it most of the time, but the subway is a couple of blocks away and makes it easy to get wherever you need to be. Flor’s communication is amazing: she was in constant contact and made it very easy for us by explaining the best ways to get around, offering suggestions for restaurants (great advice!) and local conveniences, and managing the check in and out quite smoothly. I highly recommend that you contact Flor for your next visit to BA!
The apartment and the hosts are beyond great!

Excellent apartment and highly recommended! I stayed in this apartment for three months and thoroughly enjoyed it. Flor and Damian are amazing hosts who always respond quickly and are always readily available to help.  The apartment is spotless and flor does an excellent job of cleaning for extended stays! The apartment has all the extra amenities you need such as netflix and fast internet and is also very quiet at night. The location is also centrally located in the city and in a very safe zone with proximity to restaurants, shopping, and public transport. I would definitely stay here again on a return to Buenos Aires!
Um espaço de bom gosto e diferenciado, no meio de tudo! Tudo foi disponibilizado com muito cuidado e carinho! Casal muito gentil, educado e disponível! Voltarei sempre!
This was a great apartment. The location could not have been better, Ines was a great host and I would definitely stay in her apartment again.

Ines was very responsive to my inquiries, and was waiting at the apartment when I arrived.  The apartment's location is outstanding.  Across the street is a large supermarket where you can get everything you need.  Things are just as they appear in the photos.  The place was immaculately clean when I arrived.  It had just about everything you need for a short stay (mine was six nights).  I was there during a heat wave and the air conditioners worked perfectly.  The apartment is at thr back of the building, up one floor.  It is quiet and there is a lot of light from the large windows, but be aware, there is no view.  All in all, a great place at a great price.  I would stay there again.

Ines was very helpful in accomodating my early schedule and she helped me settle in right away. The apartment was tastefuly decorated and comfortable that I felt right at home. The location is ideal for getting around anywhere by foot and is close to many conveniences. It is also in a safe area, which made things easier for a new-comer like myself. I would love to stay at her apartment if I am ever in Buenos  Aires again!

I had a great stay. Very clean and tidy place. Good area.
Would stay again and recommend it highly. Mark

Great apartment in the great location. Ines is the great host and provided us with fresh towels, linens and toiletries. Apartment is big enough with high ceilings and kitchen has all the necessary utensils. 5 metres from the apartment you have big supermarket Carefour for the groceries. And many restaurants around, great ice-cream cafes(Volta, Persico) are only 3 blocks away on the Av. Callao.
Highly recomended!
The place was conveniently located and comfortable.  We had a positive experience and wish we could have stayed longer.
The apt was amazing, located in the best neighborhood of Baires. The pictures don´t represent how cute and beautiful is the apartment.

Gracias Inés, Pasamos unos estupendos d{ias en Buenos porque el departamento es c{omodo y muy bien localizado. Me gust{o especialmente el barrio Recoleta por su arquitectura y estilo de vida de sus alrededores. Existen muchas lugares que conocer y disfrutar.
Ojal{a nos podamos volver a ver.
Saludos
Victor y Cecilia

Florencia and Damien's AirBNB was fantastic .  They were very helpful and responsive.  They went the extra mile and provided information on their favorite restaurants in the area.  They were even so gracious they allowed me to keep my bags at their house after checkout as I had a red eye back to the United States.   This was the best AirBNB experience I have had yet.
Excelente predisposición y muy puntual en todo

It is a nice cute little place. The host is very helpful. She is the best thing about choosing this air bnb. For two people the place is good.
+ host, security, cleanliness
- no view from window instead there is a big wall, walking distance to nearby tourist places are atleast 25/30 min.
Florencia is a super helpful host! The place was really nice as well.

Es un lugar equipado con las cosas que se requiere para sortear un viaje de placer, aventura; queda bien ubicado, con estaciones de subterráneo cerca, con lugares donde desayunar, almorzar y cenar a pocos metros. La anfitriona es muy amable y servicial.
Great place for a couple. Loved it. Flor was very nice and super responsive. Gracias por todo Flor!
Fabiana's place is a lovely, amazing retreat in a quiet, charming part of Buenos Aires. I'd highly recommend it to anyone looking for a charming, sun-lit, home for their stay in the city.
Lovely place, very well located in a nice neighborhood. Fabiana was very welcoming, gave me good tips on where to go and what to do in the area.
O apartamento de Fabiana é simples porém limpo, organizado e bem localizado. Bairro tranquilo e perto de muitos pontos turísticos.

As fotos são fiéis ao apartamento, que é muito aconchegante e também muito bem localizado. Para mim, Recoleta é o bairro mais bonito e tradicional de Buenos Aires e é o melhor lugar para se hospedar.
Fabiana é atenciosa e sempre disposta a ajudar. Fiquei duas semanas e, apesar de a cozinha ser pequena, consegui cozinhar tranquilamente.
Super recomendo!
Fabiana is a great host. This is a great part of the city, close enough to nice food and sights while still remaining quiet. Would stay again.
Muy buena ubicación tranquilidad y seguridad
Awesome place in the best location, central, with everything nearby - but still quiet. The apartment has everything you might need and Fabiana’s a great host. Would definitely stay again.

Fabiana's flat is very good, great location and has everything needed for a good stay. Close to bars, shopping, restaurants and subway, easy access to the best points of Buenos Aires. I definetely recommend.

The stay in my airbnb was great in part because of the place itself- very clean, warm, and has a wonderful view of the street. However, my stay in Buenos Aires was made particularly delightful because I had Fabiana as my host. She gave great suggestions on places to eat and visit and was extremely approachable and responsive when there were issues.
Lugar super bem localizado, apartamento muito bem estruturado e Fabiana super atenciosa.
todo los detalles tal cual las fotos, zona muy segura y una anfitriona de lujo

Fabiana is a great host, very friendly.
The location is amazing.
The apartment very cozy.
This is our second time in this location.

Ótima localização, atendimento da Fabiana
Voltaremos em uma outra oportunidade!!!
Todo ok, las imágenes son reales, Fabiana como anfitriona es muy atenta y responde cualquier tipo de duda
Muy buena ubicación .

A localização é muito boa e o apartamento é seguro. Fabiana é atenciosa. O prédio é muito antigo e o apartamento pequeno e muito simples. Acho que a cozinha e o banheiro precisam de uma limpeza geral. O colchão é novo. Isso é bom. A televisão também é boa. A rua é um pouco barulhenta. Para ficar alguns dias tudo bem, mas definitivamente não recomendo para períodos longos. Por último, certifique-se de que o serviço de fumigacão do prédio esteja em dia caso contrário poderá encontrar pequenas baratas.

Tres bonne emplacement, rue tranquille bien desservie par les transports publiques. Beaucoup de magasins, supermarchés, boulangeries, restaurants etc dans un rayon proche. L'appartement est assez petit mais fonctionnel.
Quelques petits details négatifs. Difficile de prendre une douche sans mettre de l'eau partout. Les equipements dans la cuisine et la salle de bain à renouveler.
Cependant, rien de tres contraignant, cela ne vous empechera pas de passer un bon sejour.

Fabiana's place is at a great location for a first-timer in Buenos Aires and she is a great host in answering all kinds of questions and providing many local tips, including a transportation card that comes with the apartment. The only problem with the apartment is the plumming system - the kitchen sink gets clogged easily. Overall it was a very good experience, the bed is comfortable, the apartment receives direct sunlight and is very central and secure.

O contato com Inês foi muito eficiente, desde nossa reserva até o dia de retorno ao Brasil. O apartamento é muito bonitinho, com internet rápida, chuveiro quente, ar condicionado na sala e no quarto, TV a cabo. Bem perto de dois super mercados, metrô, muitas linhas de ônibus, muitos restaurantes, shopping e de atrativos turísticos como Museus e o Cemitério da Recoleta.
O único problema é que fica nos fundos, não tem vista e nem máquina de lavar. Mas tem uma lavanderia bem pertinho.
Valeu a pena ficar nesse apartamento e vivemos momentos inesquecíveis. :)

Very comfortable apartment, light and airy. Bigger than it looks in the fotos!
Inés was very accommodating to our checkin/checkout schedule which we appreciated.
Inés happily suggested to us her favourite shops in the area. The depto is in a great area for eating close by as well as for places to buy tasty fresh pasta, cheese, icecream, bread and pastries to prepare and eat in the depto.

Ines's one bedroom apartment has a charming feel with ample room for 2. A very comfy bed king size bed, huge amount of storage and well kitted kitchen are ideal for a long term stay. Great location, we walked everywhere. A view is the only thing missing.

Ines was such a wonderful and accomodating host! My best friend and I got into the city half an hour later than expected, and she was still waiting at the apartment and cheerful and understanding. The apartment is beautiful and in such a great area. We always felt safe. Ines even called her daughter who is our age to provide us with restaurant suggestions. She was extremely helpful and made us feel comfortable and at home in Buenos Aires.

The apartment worked out very well.  It is quiet and cozy.  It is in a very good location.  It is easy to catch the public busses from the area, and grocery stores and cute restaurants are all around it.
This is a huge 1 Bedroom apartment well located fully equiped and just 3-4 blocks from Recoletta. Very nice!

We had a very good experience with Ines and highly recommend the apartment. The location is great, nice and safe.
The apartment is just like you see in the pictures and everything works. The kitchen is fully equipped!
The only drawback is that there is no elevator and it is a second floor (primer piso) and we were with a toddler and a stroller but it's only a small inconvenience and Ines was very kind and helpful with our luggage.
She was also very flexible with our check-in/check-out hours.
Overall a great first time experience with Airbnb.
Muy buen departamento

Fabianas apt is a super location in Recoleta! It is a great value and has all you need rest up and enjoy the city. Fabiana was very responsive and on time for my 2 arrivals and made my 2 departures easy!
Fabiana is very responsive and always happy to help out!
Great stay with my daughter!

Appartement bien situé, Fabiana est disponible. L’appartement n’est pas neuf mais propre et assez spacieux.
Merci pour tout Fabiana.

Small studio (hotel room size), well located in Recoleta and with Public transportation close by ....easy for visiting other areas in the city. Kitchen facilities are just basic (heat things up)....In general ok place for few days in Buenos Aires

El lugar es tal cual las fotos, limpio y ordenado. La comunicación con la anfitriona es muy fluida. La ubicación del departamento es genial, tiene comercios prácticamente en la puerta, por lo que nunca te falta nada. Y además la locación cercana a varios puntos interesantes de la ciudad, como así también a los diferentes medios de transporte.
Por último es un lugar y una anfitriona muy recomendables. Esperamos volver pronto.

This comfortable apartment with easy access to the subway is a great location for planning day trips to the different parts of the city. We did experience on night where it seemed someone was moving into an apartment above us, but the rest of the week was fine. We would stay here  again on a return visit.

A great apartment in Palermo close to everything. You're a short walk from the Palermo mall, from Subway stops, multiple restaurants, bars, and grocery stores. The apartment is a great place to unwind at the end of the day, with fast internet, Netflix, and great furnishings. You will enjoy your stay here!
Apartamento lindo cheio de toques especiais! Limpo e adorável! A anfitriã é um amor de pessoa e dá varias dicas da cidade! Adoramos!!!

Increíble! El departamento está precioso, súper acogedor y con todas las necesidades! Hasta con convertidores de corriente, tarjeta del metro, secadora para el cabello y demás! Literalmente está en medio de todo, la ubicación es perfecta, la parada del metro está cerca, supermercados, una avenida principal y todo. La hospitalidad de Flor y su esposo fue maravillosa, nos dieron excelentes recomendaciones y nos explicaron todos los puntos de interés. El último día, como nuestro vuelo salía en la noche, nos permitieron guardar las maletas en su casa. En conclusión, de los mejores Airbnb que he estado y si vuelvo a Buenos Aires no lo pensaría ni dos veces para quedarme ahí otra vez.
É um lugar aconchegante e muito cuidado e mimos (cafá, chá, alfajor, mapas com indicações pessoais). São valores que fazem um diferencial.
The place is in a very nice neighborhood and is very beautifully decorated. Flor is an excelente host.

Flor has been a lovely, sweet host. She has a great eye for styling and decor and made the apartment such a comfortable place for the 4 nights we were there. We loved the Apple TV, pretty bedsheets, extra throw, lounging area and a dining space. It was a great relaxing space for two. Thank you so much Flor!

I booked this flat for my mother but I also had the chance to visit it a few times and communicate with the owner.

The flat is a very large and well equipped one bedroom. It has a large and complete kitchen so (unlike other similar flats) it is perfectly possible to cook at home. Very comfortable for a single person or a couple, and in a great location. It is also very quiet for Buenos Aires. Do note that it is on a first floor without a lift.

Communication with Inés was easy, friendly and efficient. There was an unexpected water leak due to a huge storm and she was extremely quick in arranging for it to be cleaned and then repaired.

A highly recommended place.

We were delighted with the apartment. It was spacious ( with a sitting area/ dining area/ seperate bedroom and seperate kitchen as well as a good bathroom). It was well lit with a very comfortable doube bed, a good shower with plenty of hot water, and a large, well equipped kitchen with plenty of room for food preparation. There was a full stove and lots of cooking pots and pans. There was also a large fridge and freezer.
There was a seperate area for dining with a large table and four chairs.
It was very peaceful and quiet, and the apartment and the area felt
very secure. There were masses of food shops on the doorstep including two large supermarkets. Tthe apartment was close to bus routes, and about 15 minutes walk from the subway station.
Ines was a helpful and gracious host. She was there to meet us at the agreed time, and was ready to help us with any advice we needed.
We happily recommend this apartment to everyone,. and would certainly hope to stay there again ourselves.
Exclente departamento, confortable, silencioso y muy bien ubicado,  mi estadia fue muy satisfactoria!!!  Muchas Gracias!!!!!!

Nos quedamos con mi novio en el departamento y la verdad que la estadia fue increible. El departamento muy cómodo, completo, silencioso, amplio, tal cual muestra las fotos, super recomendable. En cuanto a Ines, se porto genial con nosotros desde el momento que llegamos adaptandose a nuestros horarios en cuanto al check-in y check-out, muy amigable y predispuesta.

We had a good time in Buenos Aires and the apartment was well located for our purposes. Communication with Ines was very easy and she told us everything we needed to know. The apartment was clean and as shown on the pictures. The only thing that bothered us a little was a machine downstairs that makes a lot of noise. I dont think Ines has an influence on that though.

This was my first experience with Airbnb and everything worked out perfectly. The apartment has a great location, in Recoleta - which is probably the safest part of Buenos Aires - you have a supermarket and a fresh market right at the corner, and also loads of banks nearby. The apartment is perfect for a single traveler or a couple. It.s decorated in a classical style, which I very much liked, and has all the necessary utilities. On top of everything, Ines is an amazing host! :)

We enjoyed in staying in Ines' apartment in Recoleta. It was an excellent location -- only a few blocks from the Recoleta Cemetery with many parks nearby to explore. It was a block from the grocery store and there were many markets as well. The building and apartment are older, but we enjoyed having a full kitchen with ample space. Ines was communicative and on time when picking up and dropping off keys.
Cute little studio, great location and perfect for a short stay.
The loft was clean and had all the amenities for a comfortable stay. Also, Florencia was very helpful. She even booked us a cab ride to the airport the morning of our flight.

This is the second time I have stayed at Flor and Demian’s apartment and I cannot say enough wonderful things about it. The location is superb, truly an incredible place from which to head out on adventures in every direction of the city. The neighborhood is filled with everything you need and feels very safe at any time of day or night. You can walk to the Subte, bus, catch a taxi on the street, or simply walk nearly anywhere. And the apartment feels like a home away from home. It is clean, stylish, quiet, comfortable and simply lovely. On top of all of this, Flor and Demian are truly super hosts. From Demian meeting me at the apartment when checking in and orienting me to the neighborhood to Flor letting me keep my bags at their house on my last day and going above and beyond to help me request a remis to return to the airport, I cannot imagine two better people and hosts. If I could rate this with ten stars, I would! Thank you Flor and Demian!!

We stayed in Florencia’s flat for 4 nights and had a great stay. The flat is clean and stylish and had everything you needed. Everything was in close walking distance and there was a subway station not far to get to anything else. Loads of great restaurants in the area, too. Flor and her husband were very kind and gave us loads of great tips. I’d definitely recommend staying here.

The apartment is clean, bright, and as described by other reviewers.  Florencia is warm, prompt and detailed in her communications, and takes active interest in ensuring her guests have a smooth arrival and exit.  We were unable to find a hotel during our stay (the G20 summit was taking place), and Florencia's apartment was a quiet place to sleep.  Given a 10am check out and the value for $, we opted to keep the apartment for a extra night to ensure an easy trip to EZE and back to California (we had a 10pm flight the night prior).

I had a great stay in Flor and Demian's place.  Recoleta is a nice location - very easy getting to and from many places in the city.  Walking to Botanic Garden and Japanese Garden and Palermo and even few organic shops nearby.  Easy metro access. Very quiet inside the apartment. Clean, good wifi, welcoming and friendly. They offered tips for the area and help with car to and from airport.  I highly recommend staying here.  It was perfect!! Enjoy!! Muchas gracias!!
I extended my stay by one night.  Everything was perfect.  Please see my prior review!!  Thank you again!!

Florencia is an excellent host! Communication was fast and the place is amazing! Perfect Location! Close to the subway and buses! We check out very early in the morning and Florencia was there to get the keys! The apartment has beautiful touches and was very clean! A Bargain Apartment in a Great Location My husband and I have spent 22 nights at Inés’ apartment on Avenue Vicente López. We arrived by ship and took a taxi from the port to the apartment where Inés was waiting for us. Inés helped us get our luggage up the flight of stairs. She showed how to light the burners on the stove and the oven. She also gave us each a set of keys and showed us how to open the exterior door to the building and to open the apartment door. She gave us her cell and home phone number and was available by email throughout our stay. Since we were here for three weeks, her cleaning lady came once a week to change the linens and to clean the apartment. This apartment is located on the second floor of a 40 – 50 year old building. The apartment has large windows in the living/dining area, the kitchen, and in the bedroom. These windows let in light, but they do not open and they face interior light wells. The windows in the living area and the bedroom have blackout drapes. The window in the kitchen does not have drapes. It is fairly quiet at night and we slept very well. The bed is very comfortable. There are air conditioners in both the living room and the bedroom. They have remote controls to set the desired temperature and fan speeds. The water from the faucets is very good and we chilled our refillable water bottles; that saved us lots of money. We also saved lots of money by not eating out. There is a Carrefour supermarket less than a block away. There are also lots of fresh produce stalls on the different side streets. The produce there is fresh and tasty! The neighborhood always felt safe. We were always able to catch radio taxis to get to places in the city. It was an easy walk to the Recoleta Cemetery and to two different shopping malls. My favorite shop was a gluten-free bakery on Avenue Juncal called Gout. Another benefit of the apartment is the reliable high-speed internet. We were not streaming movies, but we did post lots of pictures to Facebook and watched Youtube videos. We mostly used the TV to follow CNN news. Buenos Aires Tourism has free, guided walks every day of the week. If you visit their site, you can see that you can reserve a place on the walk. Some guides were better than ever, but we had a chance to visit 7 different areas. It asks you to book, but there is no charge. There are also other very good free walking tours. If you do a search on the computer you will find them. There is no charge, but they suggest you offer a tip for what you think the value of the tour is. There were a few negatives to this apartment. The apartment is as it appears in the pictures. Technically, it's not really a 1 bedroom as the bedroom does not have a door and is separated from the kitchen by a closet.

The building is in a great location just a block away from a Subte station and there's no shortage of buses and taxis 24 hours a day on Avenida Santa Fe. It is in the Recoleta neighborhood, though this particular area is also known as Bario Norte.

Having a dependable, fast internet connection was important to me, and I was not disappointed. It was faster than 3 Mbs, and did not go down in the 2 weeks that I was there. Though, I did need to reset the wifi box once or twice to regain access to the 6 devices that I had using it.

The bathroom is big and has good water pressure. Getting the temperature right in the shower was a little tricky, though.

The bedroom has a window that you can see Avenida Santa Fe, though it is set back about 20 m, so traffic noise was not bad, but you can hear it at times. There is a small safe in the closet, big enough for small items, but not big enough for a laptop. The living room has a nice balcony overlooking the city to the south.

There's a coin laundry in the building, but obtaining enough coins to use it was too much of a challenge. Fortunately, there are places nearby that you can have laundry done in 1-2 days for a very small amount of money.

The building has a security guard on duty 24 hours a day. He will buzz you in and out. There are 3 elevators for the 14 floors, though using the larger elevator was frowned upon if you weren't moving furniture.

There's a roofdeck with about 6 or 8 wooden reclining chairs, a lap pool and a small gym with a treadmill.

And finally, the staff at ba4uapartments are incredibly helpful and responsive. They respond immediately to emails and calls. They have an office in the same building as this apartment. I would definitely rent from them again.

I have mixed feelings about the place. The kitchen is amazing for a long stay. The neighborhood is fantastic with an unbeatable location for tourist or long term stay. I actually became depressed because there was no decoration on the wall and the windows looked out to a wall. It has nothing in terms of personal touches or home-like feel. There are acoustic problems and the neighbor would bang on the wall if I was talking at 8AM. I hope Ines will just add a few touches to make it homier and soften the acoustics. I have stayed in 4 other apartments here in Buenos Aires. The things I've noted are the best and the worst in comparison to what is out there in this price range. I stayed for nearly two months. There was a constant echo in the living room so I just didn't use the room. This is the first time I stayed for nearly two months in an Airbnb. I would have appreciated more than one roll of toilet paper, and more than a sample size of shampoo. I suggest the host leave a few bathroom necessities in regular size containers somewhere in the home along with some basics for the kitchen like soap and trash bags. That said, I cannot complain. It wouldn't be my first choice to return again and I would not want it for a long term stay for myself. But I think many people who just want a place to rest at night and cook would be happy. The host will be great. Everything works. It is one of the better-maintained places. The stairs are a bit of a pain.

We were warmly received by a BA4U staff member who gave us a thorough showing of the apartment and building, including the pool, gym, and laundry room. The description of the living area is accurate and the living room was very comfortable and kitchen fully stocked with all necessities. The apartment was very clean and has great lighting from large windows. Its prime location allows for easy access to several transportation options and easy walking distance to nearby attractions and good restaurants. We appreciated the guidebook put together by Ralf, with dining suggestions and places to visit. All of the BA4U staff members were very accommodating and willing to answer any questions we had. I would highly recommend this apartment for your stay in BA!

The apartment and the building are even better than described, and Ralf and his team were very welcoming and accommodating. They also provide great recommendations to enjoy the area. I would definitely recommend staying at any of their properties, as I would trust they take care of all their guests with the same level of excellence.

Ralf was a great host, he greeted me at the apartment and provided me with all the required paperwork to stay in the apartment. He showed me around and gave me great advise on the area and things to do. I enjoyed meeting Ralf's staff, they were very helpful and provided professional services. All in all great experience.
The apartment was as advertised, very open with lots of natural lighting. We enjoyed the balcony, had our breakfast there and several dinners. There were a few issue that Ralf corrected right away when informed. As I am a tall guy 6'2" (1.88 meters) the bed was short for me, so tall guys take note. I believe Ralf has other apartments with bigger beds. Also the linens need updating, the mattress cover was torn and the sheets were warn thin. All were very clean. I advised Ralf and his team, he advised me he would take care of that. The building is very well maintained and security is good. Very well located in the heart of everything, great supermarkets, drug stores, banks and boutique shopping. Metro is one block away to go anywhere in the city. Very good restaurants are located close by. I really enjoyed staying at Lemon tree. I enjoyed using the kitchen as I am a home chef and like to prepare local foods. The kitchen was supplied well and Ralf was helpful in supplying what ever I asked for. Ralf thanks for the blender. The internet was slow, I had to work from home a few days and became frustrated with how slow the wifi was. Ralf and Andre provide me with access to another wifi which improved the speed by 20%. One problem I had when making the reservation on the Air B&B website was the daily rate vs the weekly rate. As I was staying 10 days, I assumed the website would charge me the weekly rate plus 3 extra days. The site applied the daily rate for the entire stay, when I questions Ralf after the confirmation, he advised me that I needed to contact him before I clicked on the instant purchase button. He could not adjust the rate to give me the better price. So word of advise contact Ralf with questions before clicking the instant purchase button on the Air B&B website. :(
All in All I had a great time and the apartment was as listed and Ralf's team was professional and provided great service.

Host was very generous with help and information. We were given the option to get transportation from the airport. This was helpful for us. However we weren't the only ones so there was a wait involved. We were one of four or five couples and were last to get a car. I'd advise just getting a cab. Upon arrival at our apartment the man was super kind to us. Very soft-spoken but enthusiastic as well. The apartment was at a great location. The doormen were all very nice. Being a block from the SUBTE was super convenient for us. Very spacious.

A few negatives but not deal breakers. If you're coming for the gym it's not in very good condition. The treadmill wasn't working. The equipment isn't up to standards and it is very tiny. We didn't get to use the pool but it didn't look that inviting to begin with. When we did try to use it it was closed because of some broken glass situation. Two views, one of very ugly apartments and residential buildings from the back balcony or two, from the bedroom window which isn't much of a view at all. Not really important but just a tidbit. The only real negative was a foul smell that comes from the kitchen/ kitchen sink area. My only complaints but not deal breakers. Would still stay there again.

Also the host was gracious enough to let us stay an extra day for free because we thought we were leaving at noon turns out our flight was at midnight. For that we are very grateful. Thanks again.

Wonderful place! We spent 2 months here and everything was great. Amazing location 1 block away from the D line, Pueyrredon. Great place to stay. Excellent location, stylish place. Recommended.
Every thing is perfect. location is close to Metro Line  D, and also there is bus to centro. Apartment is clean and convenient. Stuff is also great person to prepare everything is ready.
Great studio space in the middle of Buenos Aires. Clean, well equipped, centrally located. I would definitely consider staying here again--!

Highly recommend this place!  It was located very close to a subway station and central to many of the great sites. Lots of businesses nearby to eat and shop at. Once inside, no street noise. We stayed a month here from mid february 2013. The apartment itself is a bit worn down with this and that not working or missing but it is also all part of the charm of the place. The kitchen is a bit limited wrt. tools and utensils but not in any big way and you can certainly cook most dishes there. We were dissapointed with the cleanliness of mainly the kitchen area when we arrived. Everything in it had this greasy and sticky feel to it like it hadn't been properly cleaned or washed up in a while. So we basically had to wash everything before we felt comfortable using the plates, forks, pots, pans etc.

Other than that it was a great place to stay. We were recieved by Alejandra with a botlle of water and she had left a few converter plugs out which was a nice feature. There was also a cord for connecting our MacBook Airs to the TV so we could watch movies. The bathroom and shower works really well. The windows to the yard are beautiful with foilage partly covering them and a hummingbird frequenting. Eventhough there isn't any wi-fi in the apartment, Alejandra had arranged for us that we could connect to the neighbor's wi-fi. This worked well. There isn't any AC but the temperature in the apartment was very pleasant and the single ceiling fan was more than adequate. The bed was comfortable but the pillows left a bit to be desired.

The main feature of the apartment is the private roof terrasse which was also one of the primary reasons we ended choosing this place. This terrasse is simply amazing. It is more private than it looks and has a very nice layout. The bbq, shower, basic kitchen area and furniture are all very nice and there is even a parasol which was a pleasant surprise.

The last 10-14 days of our stay, a construction project started in the yard. Basically it was two workers with hammers that worked to remove old concrete and facade. The two were (manually) hammering away every weekday for 8 hours straight from 10 in the "morning" and until 6-7 in the evening. Alejandra warned us about it a few days in advance but we would have liked to have known this before we booked as we would then have booked something else. The yard is very small - like a small livingromm and surrounded by only three apartments. So the noise was substantial, esp. since they were hammering directly on the building. So basically we couldn't be in our apartment during the day the last two weeks - and we also couldn't use the roof terrasse. We were fairly upset about this - esp. considering had they used powertools they could have finished in a day what took them more than two weeks with hammers.

Short version: Nice apartment and roof terrasse but dirty kitchen. And good first half but bad second half.

We had several problems, but worse was how they were handled by the host. Mostly it was the shoddy pluming, which became incredibly time consuming for us (washroom flooded, parts needing replacement, leaking heater so bad we had to change the bucket underneath every 8 hours...), but there was also loud construction on the premises.

Upon entrance to the apartment, as always, I ran the water hot/cold from every tap/shower, and flushed the toilet to ensure it was working properly. Upon the first flush, rushing water 'waterfalled' from the wall (flush handles in Argentina are often at chest height) with such exertion that the bathroom floor flooded. I had to clean it and placed rags over the floor so the wood floor in the hallway wouldn't be affected. Luckily there was a resident caretaker doing some work outside, who, after helping me clean and attempting to fix the problem unsuccessfully, ran out to buy a new part and replaced the faulty one in the toilet. This was a frustrating ordeal as it made me late to leave for the airport to pick up my boyfriend who was arriving that afternoon.

The following day, loud construction began right outside our window (on the property), that continued through the weekdays we stayed there. We would have liked at least a warning about this, as tenants usually know when their building will have work done (see Jeppe's review below).

The next day the water heater in the kitchen began leaking so badly that we had to change the bucket under it every 8 hours. Which meant coming home during our days out (no small feat in a huge city like Buenos Aires) and setting an alarm to wake up in time to change it.

Last straw. Though we didn't want to move apartments - we only had a few days left - I wrote Alejandra in the morning, listing the issues of the week. Though we wanted to stay, I thought that we had paid too much considering all the extra work required of us, so I requested 10% of our week's stay back, which we thought was fair.

Alejandra responded with a defensive, snarky and unkind email that she would consider giving me one night's money back, but came up with many excuses why it would be too difficult...

In the meantime, we had been invited to a great event on Monday (we had planned to check out Sunday) so I wrote back suggesting that it might be simpler if we just stayed the extra night free of charge, and we would deal with the water. In her next email she accused me of breaking her toilet and making "threats and extortions" seeking an extra night...

When I checked out I was in a rush and forgot my leather belt and wine-opener. Alejandra didn't respond to any of my 3 emails, though AirBnB contacted her on my behalf.
