Saw a couple of negative reviews of this place but was tempted by the unique terrace and decided to give it a go anyway. I didn't regret the decision! While the terrace itself was perfect for sunbathing, al fresco dining (I don't think we ever ate inside) and added lots of space to the studio apartment to make it feel really spacious, the apartment itself was also cute and really 'homey': a real home from home. It's not a sterile, crisp but soul-less luxury apartment but more a cute, cosy hideaway with real-world charm. One of the best features isn't even shown, which is a window overgrown with vines/leaves in front of the bed, letting through gentle light and very cute/"Mediterranean villa" feeling. The flat is well stocked and in a perfect spot in San Telmo, a slightly run down, rustic area of BA, but one where you feel you're in a real neighbourhood rather than tourist trap. It has a lot of soul/character and is many people's favourite 'barrio'. Originally an affluent area (reflected in the architecture) there was an exodus of the rich after a Cholera outbreak hundreds of years ago. It was then occupied by artists/immigrants which led to its slightly run down but bohemian/artsy feel that it has today and reputation as the original tango district. The flat is perfectly located right opposite San Telmo's main indoor market, just round the corner from Plaza Dorrego (tree-filled square full of outdoor tables where you can eat and usually be entertained by a bit of tango). Cute but a little 'touristy' and with a few exceptions (the Italian) the best restaurants can be found away from this square. But it, and the bustling street market on Sundays all adds the ambiance of the area. The flat is also located a short walk from the affluent Puerto Madero and its nature reserve (most expansive bit of nature you'll find in BA and the best spot for a walk among the trees, fresh air and a sea view (or technically 'river view' - just that you can't see the other side!) as well as the many infamous Chorizo hotdog stalls that line the park. There are ice cream shops dotted all around the apartment, perfect in the summer for buying to take back (close enough for it not to melt) to enjoy on the terrace. All in all Alejandra was a nice host and the apartment, while maybe not for those looking for a sterile posh hotel room feel, is full of natural wood, and certainly not short on either comfort or charm: very cute and homely. The terrace has to be the feature that sets it apart though - giving you your own outdoor (relatively private) space/retreat in heart of the city. As for building / maintenance work / noise, I did hear some nearby, but it amounted to about 3 hours worth in nearly 2 weeks stay. Otherwise it was a quiet little retreat. Couldn't have asked for...

had to put a bedcover on it...We wrote to her about the sofa in the terrace, but got a reply that more or less said "I could perhaps do something in two weeks".

After finding dirty spots on the wall that looked like blood, a cockroach in the bathroom and finally also bed bugs that gave our baby red bite marks (confirmed by a doctor) and the heatwave, we knew that we had to leave.

Luckily, we could move after only a week (Airbnb support took a while as this was over the Christmas holidays) as our baby did not cope with the heatwave, and I can understand that she wanted more rent for this period (we booked a month initially) but she ended taking ca 25-30€ more than her usual weekly price.

Would I recommend this place? NO, definitely not worth the money!

Comunicating and meeting with Alejandra was warmly efficient.
A special thanks for the cake she left us during the week.

Alejandra was a great hostess. She welcomed us with a bottle of wine and was always available whenever we needed something. Now, about her place, it's everything you can in the photos and a lot more. First when you come in from the street, there's this lovely garden that makes you feel like you are entering a whole different world. Then, the terrace is such a lovely and quiet place with this amazing view. And one thing you can not see through the photos is the fact that she has such a good taste in music and books, we couldn't stop listening to her ipod. And, another great thing, whatever you wanna cook, she has this fully equipped kitchen. So, if you are looking for a nice and quiet place in the lovely San Telmo neighbourhood, I highly recommend Alejandra's place.

Wir haben uns in den zwei Wochen sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Lage der Wohnung ist perfekt - mitten in San Telmo in unmittelbarer Nähe des Marktes und trotzdem ruhig. Die Terrasse haben wir besonders geliebt. Alejandra ist liebenswürdig und hilfsbereit. Gerne wieder!
The reservation was canceled 87 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Great experience! I would kill to live here. The place is large and adorable. So much cooking equipment. San Telma market is literally right outside. The best tango in the city is a couple blocks away. Sitting on the roof have a glass of wine and listening to faint tango music is one of my best memories from BA. OH! The hostess is also super nice.

Alejandra ist eine angenehme, wunderbare Gastgeberin. Sie hat uns sehr herzlich begrüßt und uns köstlichen Wein geschenkt. In Alejandras Wohnung haben wir etwas länger als eine Woche gewohnt und uns sehr wohl dort gefühlt. Sobald man das Haus betritt und durch den schönen begrünten Innenhof geht, in dem die Vögel zwitschern, fühlt man sich wir in einer Oase. Die Wohnung ist sauber, hell und sehr gemütlich. Alles hat uns gut gefallen, besonders die herrliche Dachterrasse. Dort verbrachten wir mit Alejandra einen schönen Abschiedsabend und tauschten Reisegeschichten aus. Als Langzeitreisende haben wir uns auch über die Waschmaschine gefreut. Die Gegend ist großartig. Es sind schöne Läden und Restaurants in der Nähe. Der Markt von San Telmo ist direkt gegenüber und man findet dort Käse- und Wurststände und alles, was man braucht. Ein paar Häuser weiter werden frische Nudeln hergestellt und um die Ecke sind Supermärkte. Jeden Sonntag findet rund ums Haus der berühmte Antikmarkt statt. In der Carlos Calvo gibt es viele Tanzräume für Tangotänzer. Zu Fuß erreicht man Puerto Madero, Plaza de Mayo und vieles mehr. In Alejandras schöner Wohnung wohnen zu dürfen ist ein Traum! Wir empfehlen sie und ihre Wohnung von ganzem Herzen.

The apartment was just as beautiful as it appears in the photos. It was very spacious and the big windows provided plenty of natural light. Everything was very clean and the bed was very comfortable (memory foam!!). The terrace was beautiful, a perfect place to sip wine and take in the beautiful views of the city. The apartment had everything to make a traveler feel at home, including a small library (with a few traveler's guides), kitchen equipment, and a variety of electronics (TV, stereo, iPod). The AC was also a very nice feature. There was even a drawer of international power adapters.

The location was excellent, the San Telmo market on Sunday is literally a few steps away. There are also many different restaurants, cafes, and bars within walking distance. It was a truly wonderful experience!!

This is a lovely apartment in a great area of the city. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay and the roof terrace is a real bonus. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this place!

Alejandra's apartment was perfect! she was not able to be there when we were staying, but arranged for her friend to come and let us in and ensured we had everything we needed. The apartment is in a Great location - you're right in the middle of all the action, but you can still relax with some wine and an asado (bbq) on the beautiful rooftop terrace.  The kitchen is great - has everything you will need! We even wanted to stay again upon our return from the south of Argentina, but the apartment was already taken. I would definitely recommend this place and Alejandra has been great at getting back and helping with ideas of places to see. Overall - Great experience!

Alejandra's place is terrific- very centrally located in San Telmo and an excellent space. The rooftop patio is fantastic and Alejandra has taken extensive efforts to make sure guests have everything they might need during their stay.

An earlier review I read suggested that this was an auto listing; I'm not sure what happened there, but this is definitely not one of those. This is very much Alejandra's home and she's a terrifically responsive host.

We had a lovely time staying at alejandras place- the appartment has a great location, so close to placa dorrego and the market plus it  is very clean and cosy. everytime we got there it felt  like entering a little oasis in this buzzy city. The kitchen is perfectly well equipped, the bed is comfortable, everything is working fine and the terrace, of course, is great. Would love to stay there again!

We absolutely loved staying in San Telmo! Alejandra's home was perfectly located and had everything we needed for a wonderful stay. We were met at the door by her friend Vivi on time and with a smile. We felt very welcomed and were able to start exploring the neighborhood immediately. There were instructions in both English and Spanish for the apartment along with fantastic recommendations. We stocked some groceries for our stay from the local store and Alejandra has all the cookware you could need.  San Telmo is a fascinating place. The street art, parillas, markets, antique shops, and tango make this a unique experience for anyone visiting. We never felt unsafe walking around day or night. What a great experience! Thank you.
The reservation was canceled 311 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Everything was great and cosy. Alejandra is a kind host and communication was easy with her.The appartment got it all and the terrace is an absolute must. You really feel like home! The location is great as well, probably the best cuadra in San Telmo.
A super experience, and I´ll be back! Gracias Alejandra !

Alejandra's apartment was a highlight of our trip to Buenos Aires. She was great to work with, communicated quickly with us and even went out of her way to help us from afar when we got stuck in Argentina a few extra days (thank you Alejandra!!). The apartment is cute, cozy, clean and centrally located. It looks just like the pictures and is within waking distance to many historic sights, great restaurants and wonderful street fairs. It was great being able to save some money by cooking in her apartment and we also enjoyed sitting on the roof top patio. If you rent Alejandra's apartment you won't regret it, it was a great experience and we thoroughly enjoyed working with her!

Alejandra's apartment was fantastic! A great location, perfect for 2, very clean, bright and open, and with great written instructions to get you orientated when you arrive. Alejandra was easy to get a hold of if we had any questions and she was a great source for local specific needs that we had. The roof top deck is a perfect escape from the busy streets of BA and the location of the apartment in San Telmo was perfect. Wine shops and choripan across the street! A great way to ease into BA for a first bite and drink! Thank you Alejandra! We'll be looking for your place the next time we are down that way!

We had an amazing time in Alejandra's awesome apartment! The location is tops - everything on your doorstep and the apartment is so well equipped, so much more than the standard stuff you get in a holiday rental. We shopped in the market across the street and cooked asados on the roof which is just the coolest space. I was tossing up between staying in San Telmo or Palermo and I'm so glad we chose Alejandra's place. It's not expensive to take a taxi to Palermo for a night out and San Telmo is such an amazing place. Plus Alejandra's neighbours are really cool. No problems, great recommendations and Alejandra is so speedy replying to messages and answering questions! Can't recommend highly enough, we didn't want to leave!

This was a great flat in a great location! The little extras of fruit, water, and coffee on arrival were greatly appreciated. There was one minor hiccup (not their fault), but they dealt with it in an amazing way regardless. I would definitely recommend it!

O apartamento fica em um localização ótima, segura, com supermercado do outro lado da rua e um comércio muito variado.

Fomos recebidos pelo anfitrião que nos explicou sobre o funcionamento do apartamento e nos mostrou a piscina, a sauna e a academia. O local é extremamente limpo e organizado, o anfitrião nos respondeu prontamente pelo Whatsapp. Tem dois ar condicionados, uma cama muito confortável, uma cozinha completa e um banheiro ótimo.
Mesmo sendo em uma rua movimentada o apartamento é silencioso.

Recomendamos! E quando estivermos em Buenos Aires novamente, nos hospedaremos lá.
Hermoso departamento y una excelente atención de Marcelo. 10/10
excelente estadia, muy amables y siempre disponible, si vas en Invierno, recomiendo solicitar una frazada extra para la cama.
Todo ok. La ubicación es muy buena y el departamento muy funcional y bien mantenido.
Recomendable departamento.  Edificio moderno, muy centrico y sin ruido! Gracias!

Perfect location, very comfortable space, in the best neighbourhood.  I work while travelling and the wifi was strong the whole time.  Be sure to use the rooftop pool area.  A spectacular place with which to discover BA.
Muy bien ubicado y placentero

Good value for the price. Centrally located and steps to the Subway and bus. Bed, linens and towels were all very comfortable.

The only complaint I have is how loud it was. The building itself including elevators, hallways, doors etc… were very loud and seemed to echo. The street noise was also intense despite being on the 13th floor. Unfortunately during our stay, they were demolishing a building next door which made sleeping in impossible due to the sledgehammers and falling brick. Not the fault of the host at all, but still obnoxious.

All in all, I think it was a good place in BA and would recommend to anyone who isn’t bothered by city noise.

Recomendo muito a hospedagem! Ótimos anfitriões, localização espetacular ao lado de cafés, supermercados, restaurantes e metrô. Próximo a tudo!
Checkin/out também super flexível.
Vale a pena!

Great apartment! Very comfortable, sunny, and pleasant. The neighborhood is within walking distance to all the main sights, and has public transportation to the rest of the city. Wonderful restaurants on the same block!
Ruy was a great host, helpful when we needed info about where to go, how to get there, etc.
I highly recommend this lovely apart!

Un fantastico apartamento muy cerca de San Telmo, bien comunicado y con un supermercado justo al lado. Los propietarios nos dieron una calida bienvenida.

Great apartment with a supermaket nearby. The owners were very friendly and the location is perfect near San Telmo.

The apartament was very nice, clean and in good shape. It was located a few blocks from Avenida de Mayo, the center of the city. There were restaurants and a supermarket in the same street of the apartament. We were welcomed form the mother of Ruy (he was out of town) and she was very kind and helpful.
Highly recommended!

The apartment is sunny, with a nice balcony with plants.  Everything we needed was provided, and we were surprised that there were 3 sinks!  Ruy was very helpful in suggesting places to eat and to see tango, and in helping us when we had trouble with our computer We really enjoyed staying in the apartment.  It is surrounded by good restaurants, next to a market and centrally located.  Looking forward to returning in December.  Roberta and Jim-------------U.S.

Ruy and his mother were perfect hosts. They were flexible about our arrival and departure and even let us leave our bags for a few hours after check out.

The apartment was clean and well-appointed - even better than the photos suggest, which is not common. It was outfitted with a basic kitchen including pots and pans, clothes washing machine, etc. Towels and sheets were included, but there was no handsoap in the bathroom, so make sure to bring some of your own.

The only con to this rental was that its not really in San Telmo - its in a neighborhood called Montserrat. Its not far from San Telmo (5-10 very walkable blocks), but it definitely doesn't have the picturesque, touristy vibe of San Telmo proper.

I'd like to thank Ruy and his mother for being generally lovely and conscientious - we had a great visit.
´Muy buena ubicación!!!. Cómodo y agradable invita al descanso al final de un día agitado. Regresaría sin dudarlo.

Hemos tenido una experiencia realmente gratificante, el departamento es muy lindo, limpio, luminoso y bien ubicado. Pudimos hacer todos los trámites a pie gracias a su buena situación.
Ruy y su madre son muy amables, sin duda, vamos a repetir y lo recomendamos.

Beautiful apartment in a central location. We had a very good stay. From there you can move easily in all the city by bus or subways (the closest stop it's about 400m from the apartement). If you love walk you can reach by foot the Casa Rosada (plaza de Mayo), Puerto Madero, Florida and Corriente Streets.....
It's a place where I'll come back for my next trip to Buenos Aires!!

Great apartment with beautiful view.  Our only complaint is that we wished we had booked it longer, unfortunately our flight was delayed and we missed a day in BA.  Ruy was very nice about meeting us at the apartment and instructing us on all the keys.  He is very knowledgeable of the area and speaks perfect English.   He even had maps and books regarding BA in the room, it felt just like a hotel stay.  We found no problems with the neighborhood, only a short walk to the downtown and shopping.  Overall, great for the price.

We had a wonderful time here! The apartment was perfectly clean, spacious, and offered an amazing view over the city. The bed was comfortable and the shower worked well. It was a tranquil place to come back to after exploring the city for hours.

Ruy B. was very accommodating, speaks perfect English, and lives in the building too, which was very helpful. He was accessible, offered good tips, and even let us leave our bags there when we went away for a couple days.

In terms of location, it was very nice not to be right in the center of the tourist zones. We could easily walk about 15 minutes to San Telmo or to the main boulevards and sights like Cafe Tortoni and Casa Rosada, but it was nice to come "home" to a normal neighborhood that was less crowded and without any tourist traps. The subway is also a short walk away and was fast, easy, and cheap. Having a grocery store next door, and laundry across the street was very convenient, and there are good restaurants on the corner and excellent homemade pasta shops, ice cream shops, and a 24 hour internet cafe within a block.

I highly recommend this place -- it is far cheaper than staying in a hotel, and offers privacy and great convenience. We would stay here next time!

La ubicación del Dpto es apropiado para pasear por la ciudad de Buenos Aires.
El mismo Dpto es amplio y luminoso con detalles de estilo
Es muy recomendable para pasar varios días

Location location location
Great duplex in great apartment block next to train station and underground. Marcos and Daniel were very helpful and allowed me to check-out late at no extra charge.
Will def come back!
Excelente el departamento y la ubicación inmejorable, Marcos estuvo al pendiente todo el tiempo. Muy recomendable.
Muy  buena  atención !!!

The apartment is located in an excellent location. There were some issues with the heater the first day, but we were given an additional heater which worked just fine. Marco has been very responsive, I definitively recommend people to book this flat.
Excellent host and fast respond person , very happy and will recommended to friends and family .

This is a top notch option!
The apartment is located in one of the most beautiful and peaceful corners of Palermo. It is surrounded by green, both in the main street and also in the backyard. It is situated at the end of a street without an exit, and thus only neighbors and pedestrians go by, making it extremely quiet as it lacks traffic. Yet it is still very strategically located: it is only 1 block away from Metro station D and two blocks away from most bus lines that go by Palermo (such as 39 and 108).
WIFI was really strong all the time, and coupled with a very generous desk and comfy chairs it is great for working remotely.
The host was also spectacular. Marcos was very attentive and responsive all the time, and even allowed us to check in much earlier as we arrived early in the morning. He also checked in with us a few times to make sure everything was alright.
Finally, the building has 24hrs security guards. I was able to met the guy in the morning and the lady working the night shift, and they were both extremely friendly and attentive.

I'd highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for an affordable yet stylistic, well-located and safe apartment to enjoy the beautiful Palermo Hollywood and the fantastic city of Buenos Aires.
Marcos was a great house guest!! And he responded to all of our needs and questions about where to go to shop, eat and have a good time in the area!!
Súper atento y disponible. Muy atento a los detalles.

We stayed here for almost 5 weeks and felt so at home! Marcos kept in good communication with us online throughout our stay, and the 24-hr doormen was great when we arrived at 3am and made us feel safe the entire time.

The location is so convenient, one block from the subway and just a few more blocks from a main street where a lot of buses pass through. Cafes, bars and restaurants are sprinkled in the neighborhood, but its not as loud or busy as Palermo Soho is (which is a 15min walk away). For us it was the perfect balance, so we can still sleep at night. Highly recommend!

Thank you so much Marcos for having us!
I recommend this place. I stayed there for a month and it was the perfect location, i worked remote also and it was a great place to do so ! ☺️

I cannot say enough wonderful things about this apartment. Absolutely the perfect location to explore Buenos Aires!
Hands down one of the most comfortable places I have ever stayed.
Wifi was one hundred percent solid, overlooking the garden was soothing after a day in the busy city, Marcos and Dani were beyond an excellent hosts. Security was friendly and helpful. Definitely feels like living like a local.

Great stay at Marcos’. Best location in Palermo: quiet and also nearby to best restaurants and bars. Apartment is great with an amazing balcony, high speed internet and comfortable bed. Staff is very amicable and communication went great. Hope to stay there again soon!
Todo impecable! El departamento y la atención de Marcos. Sin duda volveré.

The apartment is WONDERFUL! I will even say it is much better than the pictures. There is so much natural light with a private balcony. The building itself is peaceful and we never had any issues with noise or anything of the sort. There is 24/7 security at the door which made us feel super secure when at the apartment. Anything you could possibly need is in walking distance not to mention some VERY impressive and highly rated restaurants just blocks away. The wifi was great and the AC was very nice to have on the hotter days. Would without a doubt recommend staying here and would return in an instant!
Lindo depto muy bien ubicado. muebles y baño están un poco viejo y gastado pero nada que molesta demasiado...

I just spent a month in this apartment, and everything was excellent. The place is even better in person than in the pictures! The location was perfect, with everything you would need within walking distance. And Marcos was a great host and very responsive to any questions I had. I also worked from the apartment for the month with no issues, so this is a great option if you are working remotely.

I would 100% come back!

Savas has a very comfortable apartment with all the basic amenities you would expect. It's located in one of the most happening neighborhoods in BA; there are several boutiques, cafes, restaurants, and bars within a block of the apartment. It's close to the subway/subte station, so getting around is incredibly easy. The apartment building is very quiet, secure. Savas was also very quick to respond to all our questions/concerns. I highly recommend Savas' apartment for anyone that wants to have a great time in Buenos Aires.

Ruy was a wonderful host.  The apartment was clean and tidy and had essentials like fresh towels, a great shower and comfortable bed and was centrally located. Just make sure you use the Shuttle service from the airport or if you use a taxi, use a registered one and give them the exact fare. Walking the local area is o.k. as long as you are watchful, have good walking shoes and do not have a lot of luggage.

My friend and I, two mid-20s female backpackers from the States, went to Buenos Aires to explore the city for a week and could not have asked for a better lodging experience! The apartment was the perfect size, great location (close to San Telmo and easy access to buses that go all over the city), and it was clean and comfortable. The patio is wonderful and there is a great grocery store downstairs We really felt like we had a "home" during our stay.

To top it all off, Ruy was so accommodating! He gave us amazing recommendations for restaurants, entertainment, and markets, and he offered his own apartment as a safe place for us to keep our luggage while we traveled to Chile and during our last day between the time that we checked out and went to the airport. He arranged for our taxi service and everything too. We chose this place because of the rave reviews and we were not disappointed; in fact, we were beyond impressed!

We had a great stay at Ruy's place. The very nice and large apartment is in a great location with a wonderful balcony. Most noteworthy Ruy is an awesome guy - super friendly, very helpful, he even got up with us at 4 AM so that we could catch our taxi to the airport! 5 Stars and muchas gracias!
A great functional apartment that is exactly as listed. The balcony is beautiful and the location is great. Ruy and his parent's are great hosts and super helpful with maps and things to do.

Ruy was an amazing host--very quick to respond on email and helpful with changing money and giving great recommendations for local tango spots, restaurants, and the like. I'm proud to call him a new friend of ours and look forward to our paths crossing again!

The place is just like advertised, extremely comfortable and localized. It is in a localization in Buenos Aires that makes possible to visit a lot of places easily. There are two markets very near to the building and two or three ATMs. It is also two blocks from the subway.

The hosts were very friendly and helpful (they even arranged the cab back to the airport).

The place was very clean, with good instructions and maps of Buenos Aires. The WiFi works pretty well, and has a good speed. The place is very sunny (which is great).

We had a good time staying there, and we recommend it to everyone going to Buenos Aires.
Ruy Rocks! He was an amazing host, and really helped us learn the city!
Ruy's apartment in Buenos Aires was my first Air b'n'b experience and a great one. It was spacious with all I needed, and Ruy was a great host, eager to make my stay a good one.
Ruy is very friendly and his apartment has wonderful views of the city of Buenos Aires.

Exceptional host! Ruy had great suggestions about the city and was very quick to help us with anything. He is a star host! The apartment is cute and all new kitchen/bath, excellent quality queen bed, lovely balcony and everything you need to cook and rest well. I also liked the location which was quiet but an easy walk to San Telmo, restaurants, groceries etc. We would definitely recommend!
Great size apartment in a good location handy to everything.  Very nice having the balcony.  The kitchen could be decked out a little better e.g. Only one wine glass. And enjoyable stay.

We loved staying at Ruy's apartment. The place itself is very spacious and nicely renovated. The location is in the slightly grittier neighbourhood of Monserrat which has some nice restaurants, and it's still convenient to San Telmo without being too touristy. The terrace was especially relaxing. Highly recommended. Thanks Ruy!

I had a really great time at Alejandra's apartment. It is exactly as shown on the photos. All organized, clean - and specially cozy. Fully functional. Complete kitchen, wifi, nice bathroom, great terrace (that we didn't use, as the time was cold), heating, safety, etc. And, of course, great location. Alejandra, thank you for offering your apartment on AirBnb!
We loved staying at Alejandra's place! The apartment is beautiful and clean, just as the pictures show, and the location is great. Her apartment made our time in Buenos Aires perfect!

Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen. Die Wohnung ist ein Bijou an bester Lage im San Telmo. Kücheneinrichtungen, Fernseher und Musikanlage, Waschmaschine, Wäscheständer wirklich alles vorhanden und im guten Zustand. Die schöne Terrasse konnten wir leider nicht oft benützen weil es einfach zu kalt war (Juli). Verschiedene Läden, Märkte, Restaurants, Bars alles in unmittelbarer Nähe und trotzdem ist die Wohnung sehr ruhig. Ideal für 2 Personen.

The apartment was just like the pictures. Very comfortable and quiet. From the street, you would never know there is an oasis behind the doors. I love San Telmo, it is my neighborhood. The Mercado Bolivar is directly across the street. It's an indoor market with everything you need if you like to cook. And a great street Parrilla ( BBQ) just across the street too. The kitchen has almost everything you need for food prep. Unusual in a vacation rental. I stayed two months and was very happy. Unfortunately, I was there for a very cold wet spring, so I didn't get to use the upstairs patio much. But it is lovely.

A Alejandra foi uma excelente anfitriã. Muito atenciosa do início ao fim da estadia. O studio é realmente lindo! Muito iluminado e aconchegante. O terraço é um ambiente ótimo para descansar e relaxar. Com ótima estrutura, desde o acesso a internet até a cozinha completa.
A vizinhança é muito tranquila e a noite muito silencioso. Há vários bares e restaurantes próximos abertos durante todo o dia. O mercado em frente possui grande variedade de frutas e verduras. Há uma loja na mesma quadra que possui massas frescas e molhos prontos para realizar ótimas refeições em casa por um custo baixíssimo.

Renting this cozy studio put me in the middle of Buenos Aires' best neighborhood, San Telmo. I started my mornings with coffee the rooftop terrace, evenings with a glass (or two) of Malbec purchased from one of the two wine stores within steps of the apartment.

The apartment is clean and comfortable. The hostess's description is accurate: this space is perfect for, at most, two adults.

Aside from the well-frequented wine stores, there is the San Telmo Grand Market across the street for other provisions. This studio has a fully equipped kitchen (Alejandra is a chef) should one want to cook meals for themself.

I will be returning to Buenos Aires in Oct/Nov 2016. I am hoping that this studio will be available by then. This was the perfect AirBnB experience.

This apartment was perfect for our stay in Buenos Aires!  Located in a wonderful area of San Telmo, it's close to so many great bars, restaurants and shops, including the famous San Telmo market on Sundays.  The apartment was clean and perfect for two people.  We enjoyed relaxing on the awesome rooftop as well.  We also felt very safe the entire time.  Alejandra was a wonderful host and great at keeping in touch and making sure we were all set before and during our stay.  We highly recommend this apartment!

We had a very pleasant stay in Buenos Aires and our stay in Alejandra's apartment had a big part in that. Because of the fine weather we could enjoy the rooftop terrace a lot.
Unfortunately Alejandra was not in town but her neighbour Carolina was very friendly and very helpful. We had some problems with the television and the hot water supply but Carolina fixed them both.
Although SanTelmo is a very busy neighbourhood the apartment is pretty quiet.
If you like to stay in San Telmo then I would recommend Alejandra's place
We had a lovely stay at Alejandras place in a great part of town - cute spot with a great rooftop terrace and everything you could need .

Our stay at Alejandras place was very relaxing and good. We enjoyed the rooftop terrace especially for breakfast time and for a cold beer in the evening. The apartement was very clean and you could find everything yoi need. The neighbourhood san telmo is very beautiful and I can recommend this place!

Nous avons passé 3 semaines à Buenos Aires, essentiellement pour danser le tango. Nous avons eu énormément de plaisir tout au long de ce séjour.
Alejandra n'était pas présente lors de notre séjour, mais était toujours disponible si nous avions des questions. Sa voisine Carolina nous a accueillie et s'est montré charmante.
Le studio est très bien aménagé, très fonctionnel et très propre. La terrasse à l'étage est très agréable le soir pour manger ou boire un verre.
Le studio est très bien situé à San Telmo; en face du marché couvert et à 15 min. à pied du métro.
Si nous revenons à Buenos Aires, nous reviendrions dans ce quartier et dans le studio d'Alejandra s'il est disponible.

Handover of the key through a neighbour was fine. The appartment is equal on the pictures. The neighbour Caroline ist very helpful and sympatic. Everything was fine. We lived 4 weeks in january in this appartment. For a PC maybe it is good to take a LAN-cable with you, depending on WIFI-signals of the PC. The appartment is well equiped with TV, Radio, Telefon, FAN, Air-Condition, heating system for hot water as well as a lot of working tools for kitchen use. What we liked very much was the quiet oase midst in the centerl of good restaurants, San Telmo Markt and Center of Antiquities and Tango.  It is a bijoux of appartment and Alejandra is a nice girl looking for the needs of their guests. I would go again.

We had an exceptional time staying in Alejandra's apartment. The communication was great - even though she was traveling at the time her neighbour was there to let us in and show us around, plus we were in constant connection with Alejandra via email. We could not have asked for a better place. The rooftop terrace was the selling feature and is where we spent most of our time when not touring the city. The location was also perfect. We happened to be there for the Sunday San Telmo market, which is literally right around the corner and is probably the biggest market I've ever seen... My wife was in heaven!  It was also an easy walk to all sites downtown. Thanks for s great stay!
Loved our apartment in Buenos Aires.  All photos and amenties were exactly as stated in the description: EXCELLENT! Thank you for a wonderful stay.

This is a great, modern apartment situated in the very chic Palermo, it was great to be able to walk to Plaza Serrano for breakfast, and then hop on the subte (train) to San Telmo, to get acquainted with the markets! We fell in love with Buenos Aires, and the apartment was perfect for our 9 day stay. It was immaculate, with water and juice thoughtfully left in the fridge for us. They have these great blinds that not only provide privacy (note the balcony does face other apartments so you the blinds are very handy for extra privacy!), which, when shut complete block out all light, you get the best night sleep, no matter what the time of day! We were having to much fun we didn't get a chance to enjoy the gym & pool which looked inviting. Fernando, who was the concierge, was friendly and super helpful and an all-round nice guy! Was a great stay, thanks for having us, cheers from Australia, Katerina & Byron.

Hi,
We were first time visitors to Buenes Aires. We are so glad that we stayed with Savas first. He is a first class individual. His apartment was clean, modern and amazing. The lighting was great. Its in a super location in Palermo. The janitor/security guard, Ferdinando, was very helpful and made us feel safe. Savas has done some very nice updates to his apartment. The welcome packet he sent us with a list of great restaurants and things to do was very helpful and thoughtful. I also enjoyed his travel blogs which he should promote more. We will definately look forward to staying here again. Our only regret is that after having so much fun in Palermo that we decided to extend our trip another week and couldn´t reserve his apartment for the next week. We found another location that was not nearly as nice. Savas is kind and honest and attentive with emails. I would highly recommend using him. Thanks so much Savas!

The 2nd space that we stayed at in BsAs was perfect for us. The host, Savas, was available to answer all my questions since the beginning of my booking and throughout the duration of our stay. He offered his advise on restaurants, yoga studios and cool places to check out in the area.

Sava's partner Luciana was welcoming and gave us a quick run down of the unit and the apartment bldg. Waiting for us in the refrigerator was a carton of complimentary orange juice and 2 big bottles of water in the fridge! A very nice, personalized touch indeed!!

Savas was quick to take care of a small issue we had when we arrived, making our stay very comfortable. That was much appreciated!!

The location was fantastic, close to all the restaurants, boutiques, yoga studios, bars and so much more. About a year old, the building is new and the space radiates clean, modern, cool, with a nice color palate of white/gray/orange. Very comfortable beds, clean towels and bedding and shades that block out the sunlight. The shower was great, with strong water pressure pouring out from above. The kitchen had everything necessary for you to cook and a huge veranda with a clothing dry rack in case you decided to wash or to hang your bathing suit to dry. The pool space was gorgeous – one of my fav parts about the bldg! I took advantage of the gym (fewer times than I should have), which had a good amount of new equipment.

We loved BsAs and it was great to be somewhere that we felt at home. We went to and fro, and were greeted by the on site door man, Fernando, was friendly and pleasant.

A few days into our stay, Fernanda stopped by to deliver a wonderful gift, which was a box of Havanna alfajores!!! One of my favorite pastries from Argentina!! We were thrilled and have taken a bit of BsAs home with us to enjoy. It goes without saying, this space is highly recommended to all seeking an amazing stay in Buenos Aires.

The apartment was as described.  The agent met us and was flexible to work around our flight delays. Bed was comfortable, the aircon worked well, and the roof terrace was really relaxing.   A welcome bottle of wine was appreciated!

The place is in a good area in San telmo. A lot of things are in walking distance. The rooms were clean and looked as nice as the pictures. The contact with alejandra was easy and is was not a problem that we arrived really early in the morning. We had a great stay.

Le logement d alejandra est une merveille niché en plein Coeur de san telmo. Les photos sont fidèles a la réalité. L accueil a été effectué par une de ses amies, très aimable. La terrasse est un plus indéniable pour boire un verre le soir. Un site a recommandé!

Alejandra's apartment is wonderful! We loved the unique space, and it is in a great location. It is literally a block from the famous Sunday market and right across the street from a cute little market where you can get coffee, cheese, meat and other items. We loved getting meat from the butcher and cooking it on the terrace grill while the sun set over the city.  It is easy to catch a cab to other neighborhoods, and it is very close to all the San Telmo restaurants, bars and shops. The space is very cute, has great wifi, and was very easy to find. Alejandra was very easy to ahold whenever we had questions. I highly recommend this charming space!

Alejandras apartment was absolutely stunning and the best place we  could wish for. Everything was clean, new and as advertised on the pictures. Even though we did not meet her in person, all information was well prepared and we never felt "left alone". San Telmo itself is a nice, feel-good, quite hipsterish neighbourhood with tons of restaurants and places to go out and have a good time.

We loved our stay at Alejandra's. The apartment was lovely, perfect for two. The location was great and San Telmo ended up being one of our favorite parts of Buenos Aires. Alejandra has thought of everything her guests might need. She also provides a list of local places to eat and has several guidebooks in the bookshelf. We would stay here again for sure!

This flat is corresponding very well to its description. It is very well located in the central part of BA with many shops, market, restaurants and bars around. it is very quiet with a nice decoration, very pleasant terrace on the top. Alejandra is very helpful and responsive. We appreciated that she offers a nice bottle of wine as a welcome present :)  We recommend this place!
This apartment was adorable and perfect. We loved the location and everything we needed was there in a most pleasing setting. Alejandra is a very conscientious host. Many thanks.

The Private Terrace was an ideal location to base ourselves when we explored Buenos Aires. It was an easy walk to the Subte train stations and we were also opposite a mercado with fresh produce which was great when we decided we wanted a home cooked meal for a change (Alejandra's fully equipped kitchen made cooking a lot easier too).

We were there in late April and it was quite cold outside but the apartment was always warm. We loved what she did with the space, especially with the roof top terrace!

Alejandra is responsive and was great with answering all our questions. We are also very grateful for her flexibility with our check in and check out times (we arrived close to 1am due to changes in our flights and there was still someone there to greet us and show us around). Would definitely recommend this apartment for anyone wishing to explore Buenos Aires!

The apartment was great, provissioned with everything I needed, and Alejandra communicated well. I assume that if I'd needed anything, that she would have been on top of it. I'll definitely stay here again.

Our host Alejandra was very clear, thorough and caring with her communication with us.  She was helpful in her instructions at her apartment about places to eat and also about studio.  She was very informative.  She made us feel at home with her emails and messages.

Alejandra appartment is amazing, really confortable and Well decorated. The roof top is really nice. The area is perfect just in front of San Telmo market. Everything is at a walkable distance. We had a really good stay in this lovely flat. The only problem was the Tv which didn't work and a bad wifi connexion.

Apartment is located in the great location of San Telmo, half block of the amazing San Telmo Sunday's fair. With a variety of cafes, restaurants and antique shops. Once you enter the property the ambience changes from city life to a quiet place to relax, enjoy and rest. The apartment is equipped with everything needed to make you feel home. The apartment also has an amazing terrace ready for a good asado, picada and wine. The owner Alejandra is great, the communication with her was excellent. Always prompt on her replies and  positive interaction. The direct host in Buenos Aires, Carolina was great, helpful and very nice. Overall our experience in this apartment was great. I highly recommend it and most likely will be my stay place next time I come here again. Isis DeJesús

Our host was not present but made arrangements for a neighbor to help us get settled in. The apartment is fantastic and right off the main street in San Telmo, close to everything in that district. Highly recommend it!

Cute little place right across the street from the Mercado de San Telmo!

The neighbor was very friendly and helpful, but her dog barked a lot and the walls were kind of thin.

Otherwise, Alejandra's instructions and recommendations lists were very helpful.

Thanks Alejandra!

Great apartment, Ruy was an excellent host, very accommodating, he helped us with car services, change currency, took us to a Milonga and we got some tickets to a wonderful tango concert. Overall we had an amazing stay.
The terrace is great, we enjoyed it very much.
It's nice to have a familiar apartment feel when you arrive in a big new city. And for the apartment owner to be able to speak perfect English is a bonus!
Comfortable apartment, centrally located and near the subway. It was just what we were looking for and Ruy was very reliable and helpful.

I wholeheartedly recommend staying here. It was me and my husband's first airbnb experience and Ruy is really a 5-star host and helped us a lot. His apartment is great, the bed is comfy, we had everything we needed just a few steps outside the building. We felt at home there.

I will definitely pick this place again next time we go to Buenos Aires.

Oh, the terrace is amazing too :)

Monseratt turned out to be a great neighbourhood to be based in while visiting Buenos Aires for the first time. It was safe, quiet (for such a big city!) and close to the city centre, San Telmo and transport. Best of all it isn't a big touristy area and is filled with everyday 'porteños' going about their day which we enjoyed.

Ruy was very friendly and helpful giving us a quick run down on the city and some personal recommendations when we arrived. The apartment itself was great and the view was fantastic. There is a supermarket in the same building which turned out to be very convenient and there are also some nice little restaurants very close.

Savas worked with me to make room for a stay that was less than his normal minimum.  After my arrival, a minor misunderstanding about the length of my stay was resolved quickly and gracefully.  The place was exactly as advertised.  Will definitely check in with Savas again upon my return to Baires.

Savas was a great host! Even though I didn't have a chance to meet with him (as he had to leave before I arrived), I did not feel unattended at any time. He was available via email, and also left another contact for me in case I needed anything. He had also provided the insider's guide to BA, which was very helpful!
The apartment is very nice, as well as the building (brand new, with a nice swimming pool, BBQ porch, gym and sauna), but the best of all is the location - being in the heart of Palermo Soho was just perfect!
If I ever return (or better said - when I return!), staying at Savas' place would be my first choice!

Our stay here was hugely enjoyable.  The hosts were perfectly helpful and the apartment well located and charming.  Best things about it were:  the great interior design, nice and hot (and tall) shower, and the blackout curtains which made it possible to sleep well into the afternoon after a particularly late night.  Tempted to move to BA after this visit.

Staying at Ruy's place felt very cozy, especially waking up in the morning and having breakfast on the balcony.  We truly enjoy the view from the balcony.  The apartment is located in an antique building within walking distance of major attractions and the metro.  Ruy was accommodating, especially to first timers in Buenos Aires.   We highly recommend the place.

We spent 10 days in Buenos Aires and loved the convenient location of this contemporary and chic apartment.  Savas is prompt in responding to any and all questions or concerns.  The complimentary juice, bottled water, and tea were a superb welcome to Argentina after a long flight.  There are two subway stations within easy walking distance, as well as neighborhood markets and internet cafes.  The location is quiet and we felt safe with the keyed front entry.  Oh!  And did I mention it has a bidet?

We loved our stay at Savas' Apartment. Lucas was there to greet us and hand us the keys to the apartment. He had two big bottles of water and orange juice with him... much appreciated.

This uber chic apartment is located in hip Palermo Soho district... few blocks away from night life and awesome restaurants and shopping. If you are planning to use the Subte “subway”, Plaza Italia is only five blocks away. We highly recommend this place for your stay in Buenos Aires.

Savas and the apt are perfect; Soho Palermo is such a charmning neighborhood and the apartment is located right in the middle -- walking distance to the best restaurants, bars and shopping. The apartment was pristine and even had a gym. Savas and his assistant Luciana are extremely receptive and make you not just feel like you are visiting but more like you are living in Buenos Aires for the duration of your trip. Beats any hotel experience we could have had and is extremely affordable. Would definitely come back .

My husband and I spent 10 exciting days in Buenos Aires.  Staying at Savas' made us feel like Portenos.  The location is perfect in lovely Palermo Soho, nestled between the hustle and bustle of Av. Santa Fe and the trendy yet quiet Plaza Sorrano.  The blackout curtain option was great on the mornings when we wanted to sleep in after tangoing all night.  And when we did wake up it was to the laughter of children in the school nearby during their recess.  It was great and made us smile.  The communication with Savas and the apt administrated was prompt and very appreciated.  Book it!

Thank you Savas for having such a cool place available to rent out. It has everything, (besides dishwasher lol). Main things we liked about the place was it felt secure, great location was good, it was quiet and it had wifi This place is very popular so be quick in renting this place for as long as you can otherwise you'll regret you couldn't stay longer.

I recommend this place as a good place to be in Palermo Soho, Buenos Aires. It's close to bars, restaurants, shops, subway (very cheap) and the main Shopping roads.

I had an excellent stay at Savas' apartment for one month. It's an ideal location in Palermo, kind of right in the middle of Palermo soho. It's a quiet street and the apartment does not face the street. The apartment itself is great, exactly how it appears in the photos - the 'blackout' blinds were awesome!
My flight was delayed then cancelled out of Bs.As due to the volcanic ash and Savas was very accommodating in letting me stay longer at the last minute.

We had an incredible stay at Savas' apartment in Palermo Soho! Great location- very close to tons of bars and restaurants but removed enough that it is very quiet. Luciana (his assistant) was very helpful during our stay. We definitely appreciated the heated bathroom floors, as we stayed there during the cold BA winter! There were three of us and there was plenty of us with the sofa bed. The apartment really can't be beat for the price. I'd definitely stay there again.

What can I say about Sava's place? It's just perfect. Very well located, clean, comfortable, safe, nice and cozy. Luciana was very helpful. Thanks for everything it was a great stay, hope to come back soon.
very good apartment. great location

Savas' apartment was perfect. Palermo Soho is a great location and the amount of shops and restaurants in the area make it the perfect spot. It is also closed to many nice spots and public transport. The apartment is super comfortable and clean and Savas' is an awesome host.
Savas has a great apartment in Palermo Soho!  Perfect location. Very cute/modern studio apartment.  Great find!

Savas' place is awesome. It's very cozy and modernist, and the location is unbeatable - only a few blocks from the Subway D line, and a variety of buses that can take you to Boca/San Telmo and other places.
Plus, you are already in the heart of Palermo and within a few blocks from La Cabrera, a great steak place.
Savas is very thoughtful and helpful with advice for what to do in Buenos Aires as well.

Savas has a very nice and up-to-date 1 bedroom in the Palermo Soho district of Buenos Aires. He was very responsive to all my requests. His apartment has all the amenities anyone could expect. What I appreciated most was the help I received in getting the little things taken care of such as ordering a taxi for an early morning flight. His apartment has DSL access so anyone with a laptop can easily stay in touch via the Internet.

Alvin Huie

Ruy was a very helpful host and gave us excellent advice as for where to go/places to see, tourist attractions, tango shows, etc. The apartment is well located, bedroom is very comfortable, however, the apartment in general could do with sprucing up - not as in mucky but with a coat of paint to brighten things up.  Overall we would stay again. Ruy speaks excellent English so communication wasn't a problem and he was there ready to help when we needed.
Spent a great weekend at this apartment- had everything we needed. Ruy was helpful/available when moving in and out. Felt very safe in the apartment. It is located close to San Telmo.
Well I was essentially in BA to work at the University for a couple of weeks, and the apartment of Ruy perfectly fitted that use. Very calm place and comfortable, and Ruy was very discrete and nice.

Estuvimos desde el viernes 18 hasta el lunes 21 de mayo de 2012. Para nosotros fue una experiencia increíble, ya que podíamos llegar caminando hasta el Obelisco, la Plaza de Mayo, el barrio San Telmo y otros lugares de mucho interés. A pesar de estar tan céntrico, es un lugar muy tranquilo, donde pudimos dormir muy cómodamente. La terraza es increíble, especialmente en la noche cuando se ilumina el mural de Evita. Es seguro y silencioso, cómodo para estar y la atención y amabilidad de Ruy lo hacen todo mucho mejor. Totalmente recomendable y de seguro volveremos.
The apartment met all my needs. It was comfortable and well-maintained. Ruy was a fantastic host. He was extremely helpful and friendly. I definitely would stay at the apartment again.

Ruy and his mother were gracious hosts.  On arrival day there were baked treats.  Ruy was attentive and quick to communicate.  The apartment is centrally located for good access to a variety of sites and venues.  It is super safe and super good value.  If you want to party with the hip crowd, though, Palermo may be (for some) far and/or tiring to get to by subway or traffic jam. The apartment  was clean and, thankfully, very quiet for being in the center of such a large city.  We enjoyed the terrace at all times of the day and night, and under different weather conditions.  Solitary doves come perch on the balcony and flocks of birds fly on the horizon.  There are plants on the terrace for a sense of the seasons.  There is a view of the famous Palacio Barolo from the apartment.  Two nights per week,  its dome is lit and  its lighthouse operates.  On those nights you can turn off all the lights in the apartment to observe the light show while sipping Mendoza wine.  There is also a view of the Eva Peron mural.  We happened to be at the apartment on the 60th anniversary of Eva's death and the mural was lit with gyrating lights in the color of the Argentinian flag.  A supermarket is next door.  The laundry lady and her husband are very kind.  She loves contemporary art because her son is a painter who exhibits at some good galleries.  San Telmo is a brisk 15 minute walk from the apartment.  We walked there for breakfasts, lunches and clubs.  There is a selection of restaurants on the street; one that serves grilled Patagonian lamb and also a Cuban dance club.   Overall, 5 stars and I would stay here again.
Ruy's place is lovely, comfortable and so convenient, and he's a great host - I'd definitely stay here again!

The apartment was very comfortable and centrally located-walking distance to many places, including San Telmo. Ruy is an excellent host , very helpful and with some terrific recommendations:try 'La Brigada' for great steaks.

Nossa estadia neste apartamento foi excelente. Ruy é um excelente anfitrião e nos atendeu muito bem estando sempre disponível quando precisamos de sua ajuda ou orientação. O apartamento é muito bom e correspondeu com as expectativas. Tem ótima localização próximo à San Telmo. Muito prático. O mercado no térreo do prédio é tudo de bom. Recomendamos fortemente. Paulo e Cris.

Fuimos muy bien recibidos por Ruy. La ubicación es muy buena y el departamento también es muy lindo, soleado, independiente y tranquilo. Es recomendable.... Es muy recomendable la hospitalidad que brindó.

O apartamento era exatamente como estava no no anúncio e nas fotos. Foi muito fiel. É um apartamento muito agradável e aconchegante, me senti em casa. Possui todos equipamentos e funcionalidades necessárias e tudo realmente funcionou bem, gás, aquecimento, chuveiros. Achei o valor muito bom, um custo x benefício fantástico! Mesmo não estando presente, a Alejandra foi atenciosa o tempo todo. Gostei muito e voltarei! Vale a pena.

We love, love, LOVED staying in Alejandra's gorgeous apartment. Located in the heart of San Telmo (the jewel of Buenos Aires!), the cozy unit is within a few blocks' walking distance of the barrio's most highly recommended cafés, bars, and restaurants--not to mention directly across the street from the famous San Telmo Market! We had the best time strolling around the neighborhood (in fact, we didn't go much futher than 8 blocks or so), and we were genuinely heartbroken when we had to move on to our next destination!

Alejandra was a fantastic host and went out of her way to make our visit more comfortable. Despite traveling elsewhere during our stay, she was quick to respond to our questions via email and left us a super helpful set of tips, instructions, and recommendations on the dining room table. Her neighbor (who checked us in) was a HUGE help as well, especially when the gas went out for a few minutes and we needed to light the pilot light.

Should we ever return to Buenos Aires, Alejandra's place will be the first we'll go!
What a wonderful stay! Great location. San telmo was by far the best neighborhood. Lovely balcony.

Great place! Fully equiped kitchen and a very nice terrasse. Very near to the San Telmo Market. Alejandra left allot of informations about Buenos Aires and was very flexible, since we booked one more night. Carolina, her neighbour was also very helpfull.
Thanx, we had a great time in Buenos Aires and at your place!

We absolutely loved this place and San Telmo. Perfect apartment for a couple. Close to so many bars and restaurants and the metro. The terrace is such a bonus, unfortunately we didn't get to use it as was too cold, but great for summer travellers for sure. Alejandra was the best host, quick to respond and super helpful.
Buenos Aires recommendations - Parilla Food Tour, BA Bike Tour, Tango lesson and show.
The apartment was beautiful, and in a great location right in the heart of San Telmo. Alejandra was very accommodating. Overall a great experience.

I have stayed in three seperate airbnb properties in Buenos Aires and for the combination of location, value and quality of the premises this easily comes first. The small apartment is well appointed and homely with a great small kitchen and everything you need for a stay in the city. The roof terrace is a real winner and I even managed to use the asado for a BBQ with friends.

The location, in the heart of San Telmo, is perfect yet despite being in a bustling precint the apartment is remarkebly quiet. Arrival and departure was seamless and Alejandra was readily available by email.

Alejandra's apartment was the absolute perfect home for us for the week we spent in BA. The most delicious chorizo sandwiches, the Mercado San Telmo, and the street market on Sundays - all within steps. A charming, awesome, unique neighbourhood with lots of great shops and restaurants. The apartment itself was clean, bright, quiet and felt super safe and separated from the street, which was so nice. Lots of space for two people, and the terrace (though it was a little cold when we were there) is adorable. Alejandra was so kind to meet us in person for arrival and departure, and checked in with us during the week to make sure we were enjoying our stay. Would absolutely stay here again!!
Fantastic apartment in a lovely neighborhood with a very accommodating hostess (& a really comfortable bed)!  Would recommend to everyone I know!
Alejandra was amazing! She checked in us during our stay, and helped me make a call when I couldn't get through to a restaurant. This place is an amazing location! The best!
Superb studio apartment in an excellent location and a wonderful host.
Alejandra was an excellent host and the apt was as described. We loved it!

Alejandra made us feel very welcome and was available and friendly if we needed help- though we didn't need much. Th aprtment is great and extremely convenient. Easy walking to the centre of the city, buses at the street corner, and 15 minute walk to the underground at Independencia and 9 de Julio. With this you can go all over the city easily.
The aprtment is right across the street from the Mercado San Telmo where youcan get any food item you need to cook. The french bread shop in this Mercado is outstanding with croissant, pain au chocolat, baguette etc as good as you will find in Paris. 50 yards down the street is a fresh pasta maker and sho- La Leonesa- where the pasta is as good as you will get in Rome or Florence. San Telmo is a delight and a great base from which to visit the city. We felt immediately very much at home.

Le quartier est sans doute est des plus agréables, et l'appartement d'Alejandra a été un vrai paradis pour nous. Elle-même s'est montrée extrêmement agréable et attentionnée. Les photos correspondent parfaitement au charme de l'endroit, tout est bien conçu, et le lit est excellent. C'est avec regret que nous avons du partir !
Excellent apartment!!  Perfect location! Luciana and Fernando were really nice. Definitely we will return. Thank you Savas!
Savas was very helpful, even when my plans changed suddenly due to volcanic ash. Very comfortable place, small, but nice.

Excelente! Eso resume todo! El local ademá de ser muy bién ubicado (muy cerca de plaza serrano) es fantástico, lindo, limpio y muy seguro. La atención tanto de Savas, Luciana o de la gente del predio (Fernando que es el encargado) y Roberto que es seguridad, fue 110%.
Estuve por 5 dias a trabajo en Bs As y mi señora me acompaño. El depto trae todas las comodidades, es muy bién decorado, la cama es muy confortable, los muebles en excelente estado, el baño super bueno. Toda anda muy bié, el local es tranquilo y sin ruidos, perfecto a descansar despues de un dia largo de tarbajo.
Savas deja mapas, dicas de comidas para entregar en casa (ricas empanadas de Cumen-Cumen) y hasta un kit de primeros socorros hay!
Yo seguramente regresaré y indico con 100% de confianza!
Saludos,
Christian

Alejandra clearly cares about her apartment and the comfort of her guests. She went out of her way to accommodate my arrival and she immediately returned my messages both before and during the rental. She is kind, thoughtful and helpful, and seems adamant about ensuring her renters' satisfaction.

The photos of the apartment are entirely accurate; it's a clean, vibrant, lovely place to stay. I, myself, like to cook, and the kitchen has everything one needs. The bed is comfortable, the water is hot (if/when you need it), and the terrace is wonderful.

The apartment's location is remarkable (in the middle of the colorful San Telmo neighborhood). Considering the cacophony of the neighborhood, noise from the street doesn't seep through nearly as much as I thought it would. That said, the building itself can produce a variety of sounds: I was there for a week and on some days it was absolutely silent, while on others I could easily hear the neighbors going about their daily lives. Not a complaint, simply a fact of life.

Kudos to Alejandra for the screens on the windows. I was amazed by the amount of mosquitoes so here are some words of advice:
-the mosquitoes will come at dusk, so if you want to be on the terrace, prepare yourself. There are some repellents in one of the kitchen drawers.
-never, never, leave a door open to the outside. If you want the terrace door open, use the pull-down screen.
-I took huge precautions and I still had mosquitoes buzzing in my ears a few of the nights. In this case, the ceiling fan above the bed will help to blow them away.

It would be difficult for me to imagine not staying here again. Great location, hassle-free rental, perfect host, lovely apartment...all at a decent price.

Alejandra's apartment is the best! The location is perfect, it's clean, bright, the rooftop terrace is beautiful and Alejandra herself is easy to contact and very nice. We lived staying at her place and will definately choose for it again if we come back!

Alejandra is a great host. She is flexible with check in and out time. She is very helpful and has great communication. It is obvious she takes great pride in keeping her place in good shape. Everything is exactly how it looks in the photos. The Terrace is an awesome place to hang out and relax. You can hear the tango music from the restaurants and bars that are in walking distance from the apartment. The location is unbeatable!

El departamento de Alejandra es excelente. Es súper cómodo en todo sentido. Y además la terraza es hermosa, un sueño. Ella está en cualquier momento a disposición no sólo para coordinar la llegada y la partida sino también para todo lo que uno necesite. Está muy bien ubicado y además increíblemente equipado. En síntesis: un lugar muy especial. Recomiendo absolutamente!

Alejandra's apartment was the perfect place to stay for my introduction to Buenos Aires. The apartment is beautiful and spacious, greenery everywhere and the rooftop has a breathtaking view. Alejandra was wonderful to communicate with, she was flexible with my travel schedule and greeted me when I arrived and departed. The neighborhood is also great. Even though San Telmo is filled with tourists, the apartment is in a quieter and more low key part of the area. I would love to come back to Buenos Aires and stay at Alejandra's again!

Alejandra's apartment is located in a beautiful historic part of Buenos Aires. It was easy to get around the city from there with taxis, subway, and buses and there is plenty to do and eat within the neighborhood itself. The apartment was very nice and clean and the upstairs patio was perfect for hanging out and soaking up the sunshine or winding down in the evenings. The apartment has everything you could possibly need and Alejandra made sure we were comfortable and in for a pleasant stay. Would definitely recommend!

This was our first airbnb experience and first BA visit.  We were nervous but pleasantly surprised.  This apartment is exactly as described, but we found some things to be better than we expected: if you're wanting to stay in the San Telmo area, this is the best location.  It's perfectly situated on a quiet, but not remote, street in the very lively area of San Telmo.  We loved the host and felt she welcomed us well and provided more amenities than we expected. (It may seem small, but having things like a hairdryer on the wall and a small mirror and umbrella to use were nice details that this place provided.) The bed was comfortable. I was very wary about the mosquitoes that were mentioned in precious posts, but didn't get one in the apartment. Highly recommend!
Lovely apartment and great neighbourhood. The place is well equipped and the terrace is just perfect. Alejandra is a really nice host.
Muchas gracias por todo Alejandra ! Agradable  terraza y buena anfitriona

This is one my favorite Airbnb stays ever. The apartment was outstanding. Adorably furnished, very cozy, awesome amenities, wonderful open windows, and incredibly comfortable. The rooftop deck was a total pleasure. We enjoyed sunsets up there while relaxing on the outdoor sofa and enjoying the great view. I would book this place again just for that great terrace. The location was superb. We visited lots of areas of Buenos Aires but I can definitely San Telmo was by far my favorite. It's near lots of great restaurants and the "older" neighborhood is so hip and fun. It was a great hub for us to explore Buenos Aires. Plus it's within walking distance to a great park that was one of the highlights of our stay. Alejandra is truly a great host: vey communicative, provides lots of helpful info, and organized. I would totally stay at this apartment again if I ever came back to Buenos Aires. I fell in love with both the apartment and the neighborhood.

Authentisch, gemütlich, beste Lage direkt gegenüber des San Telmo Market und gleich um die Ecke der Plaza Dorrego, tolle Dachterrasse zum Relaxen !!! Zur Begrüßung gab's einen Obst Korb und Wein. Vielen Dank. Es ist sehr ruhig, man hört keine Autos! Alejandra war bei Fragen immer für uns da und sehr hilfsbereit. Sehr empfehlenswert !!!

The apartment was clean and very lovely. It is centrally located, with multiple bus,  and underground stations nearby. You can also easily reach some of the main places of interest by foot. Such as the Congreso, Pink House, obelisco. The price is extremely fair for the location and what the apartment offers. Ruy is a really nice and friendly person and the service was to our full satisfaction. If we'll some day come back to Buenos Aires, we'll definitely consider at Ruy's apartment again. For all these reasons we really recommend this apartment at Venezuela street hosted by Ruy.

The first thing I have to say is that the appartment is exactly what we see in the pictures, wich already is a positive point. It is great, well decorated and very comfortable.

I had some communication problem at my arrival, wich made me getting worried about my trip but soon it was solved and I could enjoy all that Buenos Aires, and especially the neighborhood of Palermo, has to offer.

Great bars and restaurants, cultural spots, stores, parks, that all you can find near the apartment.

Thank you Savas and staff (Daniel, Luciana, Fernando and the cleaning lady that I forgot the name) for making our stay very pleasant.

Hope to get back there soon.

On my arrival in Buenos Aires, I was received by Savas's assistant Luciana, who kindly showed me everything, gave me a few tips for my stay and introduced me to Fernando the porter/superintendant. The apartment was stylish, nicely furnished and spotlessly clean. The building was also modern, clean and secure, and contained a small gym and a swimming pool, both of which I used during my stay. It was in a very nice, safe location in Palermo, not in the middle of things, but within a very short walking distance of bars, restaurants and shops.

Unfortunately, my stay was very much marred by late night noise from other people in the building with two apartments causing particular disturbance. Although Savas and Luciana tried their best to help, the situation remained out of hand for the second half of my stay. However, I have been told that action is being taken against one particular offender and hopefully the rest will take note. Ask Savas for the latest update!

Despite these problems, I loved Buenos Aires. It's a fantastic city. I am already plotting my return.

Sava's apartment is perfectly located-- in the heart of Palermo but a street that quiets down at night.  The Apartment is just as in the pictures: pleasant, sunny, modern and clean with efficient use of space. The building itself is casual but has all the amenities including a delightful swimming pool and cabana deck in the back which allows you to drft away form the business of Buenos Aires. Keys and logistics were handled punctually and professionally by his ground contact Luciana. All in all, a good experience.

The apartment was perfect for the week, the neighbourhood is the best in all Buenos Aires, and we used very well the swimming pool. The quality vs price is more than accurate and we felt like at home. Palermo Soho did the rest.

A great place in a great location!  It's  in the middle of a chic and trendy neighborhood (Palermo) where all the great shops, bars, and restaurants are located yet extremely homie and quiet.  I truly enjoyed my stay and would definitely come back.  Savas is very friendly, personable, and accommodating.  I would recommend this place to all my friends.

We absolutely loved our time in BA at Savas's apartment. Couldn't ask for a better location or a more comfortable apartment. There is so much to do in BA but Palermo is somewhere you definately want to spend a lot of your time- the best shopping, bars, restaurants, and a really good vibe.

Savas was really friendly- provided a great insiders guide to BA and even helped me surprise Ben with a tango show and a football match on his 25th birthday.

While savas was out of the country during our stay- he phoned the day of our arrival to make sure everything was in order and was available by email if we needed him. Luciana was also very friendly and happy to help in any way she could.

Thank you Savas for having such a funky apartment in such lively and trendy area. Our experience wouldn't have been the same without your tips and advice.

Great flat, great location for trendy stay, Marais or Shoho style.
The location is perfect is perfect for moderne, charming, trendy restaurant and shops. The building is around 3 years old with a quality fabric, nice pool.
After 4 night I moved to Recoleta, what a disppapoitment, 70' high buildings and stores, i shoud i stay in Palermo.

Just got back from out fabulous trip to Argentina. Savas' apartment was the perfect accommodation for us as it was well located, clean, comfortable and had so many great amenities such as the pool which was nice to return to on a hot sunny day. We felt like real Portenos in our hip apartment in Palermo!

It was absolutely amazing to stay in the beautiful apartment. The location is amazing, and I think it is probably the best place to stay in BA. Plenty of resturants, Bars, Parks around. The Metro isn´t too far away, and there were always plenty of taxis around.

Luciana was very helpful, and met us at the apartment to show us around, and waited for us, even though we turned up a little late.

I would highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to stay in BA.

¡Muchas Gracias!

ESTUPENDO departamento, MUY COMODO y muy practico por su LOCALIZACION en Buenos Aires.
Pasamos 2 semanas EXELENTES, mi familia se las pasó paseando
las dos semanas, yo solo una porque permanecí en un Congreso Medico en LA RURAL (a solo 5 cuadras del Depa) y me desplacé caminando. Aparte de contar con TODAS LAS COMODIDADES, el departamento está situado en uno de los barrios MAS BUENOS de B.Aires (Palermo), con la COMODIDAD de que muchos "colectivos" (CAMIONES) pasan a media cuadra y a 5 cuadras está la estacion de Subte (METRO), por lo que nunca batallamos para desplazarnos a ninguna parte. Visitamos tambien Colonia (Uruguay) en viaje de un dia (EXELENTISIMO).... Asistimos al partido de Boca-Lanús (2-2) que tambien es una experiencia que debes vivir (increible), fuimos a Recoleta, Caminito. San Telmo, Puerto Madero, Sr. Tango (NO es de "lo mejor") Hector Manzi (MUCHO MEJOR) y a otras "milongas"... visitamos el Panteon...(ÚNICO !!), visitamos la casa rosada, plazita de Mayo, el Obelisco, la calle Florida.... y Mataderos... durante mis actividades academicas en LA RURAL (de 8am a 6pm de Lunes a Viernes) mi familia visito El Tigre, Tierra Santa, el Mol Palermo y otros centros comerciales... existen muchas ANTIGUEDADES en venta a buenos precios... LLEVEN POCO EQUIPAJE... porque se van a venir "BIEN CARGADOS"... nosotros compramos DOS MALETAS EXTRAS... pues compramos muchas cositas que en México no existen, o son MUY CARAS.

les recomiendo que PAGUEN todo con tarjeta de credito y que realizen los CAMBIOS DE MONEDA solo en el Banco de Argentina , para evitar que los timen con "billetes falsos" en el centro ... y CUIDEN MUCHO sus cosas (celulares-camaras-carteras, etc) en el Subte (Metro)... a mi hija le "desaparecieron" una camarita portatil y a mi esposa el Celular... y eso que siempre nos estabamos "cuidando"... en ESO hay muchos EXPERTOS... por lo demás, les recomiendo comer-cenar en La Escondida y en La Paila (a 3 cuadras del Depa, por la calle Costa Rica... las pizzas del Kentuky de Santá Fé y Thames estan ESTUPENDAS... y para "salir del apuro", en cuanto a la comida, pueden llegar al TENEDOR LIBRE... un muy economico BUFETT con un muy buen surtido para complacer a los más exigentes (Thames casi esquina con Santa Fé)
Nosotros compramos frutas, verduras y "fiambres" en las tienditas (kioskos) cercanos, muy frescos y muy baratos.

BUENOS AIRES.... VAMOS A REGRESAR PRONTO !!!!

We were friendly received with coffee and our host gave us lots of tips and advice for our trips in BA.
The apartment was very clean and well equiped. Especially the bed was very comfortable. The view from the balcony really is nice, both at breakfasttime and late in the evening.
When you prefer having your 'own house' in a quiet part of BA, we highly recommend Sunny Terrace Apartment.

We had a great time at Ruy's apartment. He and his mom were very friendly and helpful. The main reason that I was interested in the
apartment was the big sunny balcony. There is a big patio door that opens so that the balcony becomes an extension of the living room.
It was great! Lots of fresh air except for the day it was so hot. The location is great, a grocery store just downstairs, lots of restaurants,
walking distance to a ton of places. Probably most people wouldn't walk to the famous cemetery from here. It took us about an hour but we loved walking through all the different neighborhoods. I highly recommend Ruy and his mom as hosts and the apartment was
terrific.

We stayed at Ruy's place for the last two nights of our stay in Buenos Aires and really enjoyed how spacious it was compared to the other few apartments we rented during our trip.  To actually have a bedroom and a bathroom separate from one another was wonderful (the other locations we stayed in turned out to be much smaller than we anticipated).  The location isn't too bad either but does require a bit more taxi cab rides as the apartment isn't right there in the thick of things but this wasn't a big deal to us at all especially because taxi cab rides aren't that expensive.  Overall, we enjoyed this location, especially the balcony and Ruy was very friendly and accommodating.  We would look him up again if we ever make it back to BA!

Our host was extremely welcoming and always quick to respond to any minor query that we had (such as how to lower the outdoor barbecue grill - very easy, we just hadn't thought to look at the outside of the BBQ wall!!).  The apartment was just as described and we immediately felt very at home.  The terrace was a great place to start and finish the day and as a place to socialise.
