The neighbours were very friendly (especially their cat) and helpful and the inner courtyard location made the whole setting feel very serene and secure.  The position of the apartment was perfect - we loved San Telmo - the best barrio in Buenos Aires in our view - full of character and lots to see, do and buy, from street markets to interesting boutiques.  And within walking distance to the centre.  The SUBE card that Alejandra left (along with a bottle of fizz, fruit and real coffee) got us going and we didn't look back - out every day exploring and then back to buy our supper at the wonderful San Telmo market.  We definitely want to come back - thanks for being a great host, Alejandra.

Alejandra was super nice and easy to coordinate with. She let us check-in early and prepared us coffee while waiting! The perfect host. We had an amazing time, the apartment is lovely, clean and very well decorated. We really enjoyed the rooftop and the outdoor shower and would definitely book this place again!
Apartment was lovely and perfect for our visit!  We loved the restaurants and cafes nearby and appreciate all the help provided! Such a great location and beautiful apartment.  Thank you!!

This place has an incredible location! It was so convenient for walking, shopping, museums, tango and more. Very comfortable and Alejandra and Carolina were there to help us at any time. We highly recommend this place.

Alejandra's place was my absolute favorite place to stay during my month in Argentina.  It's gorgeous, well maintained, and surprisingly quiet for being right next to one of the larger BA markets. There's great food and coffee right outside the door. A quick 10 minute walk and you're on the subte. Alejandra is easy to communicate with and the neighbors are super sweet. I cannot wait to go back and stay there again.
Just perfect!
Beautiful apartment in a lovely neighbourhood. We had a great time there! Thank you Alejandra & Caroline.
Pictures do not do this apartment justice. A perfect location in San Telmo. The market is across the street. Great food and cocktails within a ten minute walk.

The studio is amazing and the terrace is stunning! I also loved the location in the Heart of San Telmo, a beautiful and historic neighborhood . We had a wonderful time, thanks Alejandra and Carolina!!

The descriptions were all accurate and honest...wifi always worked excellently... very clean and efficient interior...the patio is a whole other experience...lots of great services close at hand...a very good Buenos Aires experience...
Just about perfect - everything a great airbnb should be.
Everything was wonderful. Can't beat the views !
This apartment is the Best location! Especially on market days! Had a lovely stay.

The place really is as beautiful as the photos. Every morning, we had french pastries from the San Telmo market conveniently just across the street, while enjoying the lovely view. The location made it easy to walk to most places in San Telmo. The space had everything we needed and we would highly recommend it!

This apartment is great for couples, with the best feature the private rooftop terrace.

We also found the location to be perfect: San Telmo Sunday markets were only 1 block away; a short cab ride to La Boca; and short walk to the nearest metro station to get around the city easily.

Carolina managed the apartment and assisted us upon arrival and departure - she was very flexible with our arrangements. Alejandra also reached out to us to ensure our stay was fine.

Highly recommended!

No complaints here!

The host, Savas, was extremely helpful leading up to the visit (we had unrelated complications to our travel plans which he generously accommodated).

The apartment is contemporary and comfortable.
Having a good sauna and well equipped gym was great. The pool looked good but given the autumnal weather we didn't drop a toe in.
Wifi worked well (which can't be said for several other places we stayed around the city and country)

The location is awesome if you like a cool urban environment.
Absolutely amazing!  Ideal location in San Telmo.  If I ever make it back to BA, I can only hope Alejandra's place is available again.

Great area to stay in BA with large choice of restaurants and bars within walking distance. Apartment was surprisingly quiet though, being in the centre of things and the upstairs terrace was an amazing space to hang out in. Carolina was easy to deal with and accommodating on check-out process, also handy that she was right next door.

This is so tastefully decorated and so beautiful.  Alejandra and her co-host leave everything you may need and they are so accommodating in answering your questions in a timely manner.  The location is outstanding, close to everything, including San Telmo markets, public transit and tango!  I highly recommend this place and I will return the next time I am in Buenos Aires.
Ocorreu tudo muito bem, gostamos muito de tudo.

This apartment was amazing! Exactly like the pictures and just a joy to stay in. Alejandra and Carolina were great :) Carolina helped us with everything we needed, I only wish we could have stayed longer!
Muchísimas gracias por todo!

Me gustó mucho este apartamento, aunque chico pero es lo mínimo necesario para una buena estancia. Está limpio, bien iluminado, tiene una terraza. La ubicación está super bien, en el corazón de la Plaza del San Telmo.

Alejandra's flat is perfectly situated in San Telmo, in that it is steps away from great restaurants, wine shops, coffee shops, bakeries, and the Mercado, as well as being very, very quiet. The space is super clean, modern, and comfy. The roof top terrace is private and lovely. Carolina looked after us, gave us great tips, and lucky for us, speaks excellent English. Highest recommendation for these hosts and this flat.

La mejor alternativa si estás de vacaciones en Buenos Aires y quieres un lugar hermoso y con muy buena ubicación.
Este apartamento en San Telmo es una muy grata sorpresa que brinda excelentes servicios y muy buena atención por parte de su propietaria y anfitriona.
Lugar acogedor, con una linda terraza y decoración funcional pero que a su vez brinda una muy buena experiencia.
Gracias Alejandra, gracias Carolina.

This place was great. Loved the terrace, loved the location (so great right in the middle of San Telmo) - the main market right across the street - and lots of stuff near by.

Me and my brother stayed here and it was just what we needed. Alejandra was super easy to get a hold of for check in and check out - no issues at all.

I would recommend for others to stay here.
Alejandra's place was very well equipped. Great location for night life. Would highly recommend. Thanks again :)

O apartamento de Alejandra é otimo! Exatamente como se vê nas fotos! O bairro é um charme e conta com deliciosos  restaurantes e com várias linhas de ônibus perto do apto. Alejandra foi muito solícita desde a reserva, assim como Carolina, que nos recebeu e nos ajudou na hora da partida. Suuuper recomendo :)

Alejandra's apartment is in a great location just opposite the San Telmo market, and on a Sunday the apartment is in the perfect location for the street market! The flat itself is lovely, as in the photos with a comfy bed and well stocked kitchen. We were able to check in very promptly and there was a place for us to store our bags upon check out. I would thoroughly recommend staying at Alejandra's apartment.

I cannot recommend a stay in this pretty apartment enough! This was our first visit to Buenos Aires and we found the San Telmo location perfect. The apartment is surrounded by cute cafes, amazing restaurants, and of course, the amazing San Telmo markets. The apartment is delightful. It's clean, bright, and perfect for a couple. The roof is even prettier in real life. If we find ourselves in Buenos Aires again, we will definitely be staying here!
Ótima estadia! As fotos correspondem perfeitamente ao apartamento! Muito bem acolhidos. Vale a escolha!!
A wonderful place in the middle of charming San Telmo. Can't recommend highly enough. Everything was a breeze.

Excelente lugar en el corazón de San Telmo. Muy lindo apartamento, amplio, cálido. El deck superior con parrilla vale cada centavo y más también. Hay TV digital por aire (TDA) que no funciona bien, aunque en nuestro caso no tenemos nada que reprochar porque no fuimos para mirar televisión. Buen sistema de WI-Fi y un dispositivo Bose que permite escuchar emisoras por Internet. Recomiendo sin dudas este lugar.

This is a wonderful apartment with everything you need in a terrific location.
Carolina was very kind and super helpful and Alejandra always in communication. The market over the road is a great opportunity to enjoy sitdown meals there and buy ham, bread and cheese for home supper.
Walking around there are great places to eat (Gran Parilla on corner Chile St
our favorite and bars to sip a drink and soak up the flow of people
passing by. The rooftop terrace is surreal and such a great feature. Just do it!

We loved staying here! The place is very cute and comfortable, and the private terraza is amazing! We definitely recommend this apartment to others and will stay here again. Alejandra and Carolina were both very accommodating and helpful. Thank you!

We really enjoyed our stay. Ruy allowed us to check out very late because the place happened to be free the next night, which was really nice and made our last day in B.A. more enjoyable. He also made arrangements for an inexpensive ride to the airport using the service he uses personally and was really responsive throughout the trip. The place is in a really good location. We felt safe in the area and it is very convenient to the center. The unit is very nice with the fantastic balcony. It was a little warm without A.C., but we could get really good air flow with the windows and a very good fan. We'd definitely recommend it.

Visitamos Buenos Aires em Novembro / 2012. O apartamento é confortável e Ruy foi um bom anfitrião. Caminhe um pouco e encontrará uma estação de metro.
---
We visited Buenos Aires in November / 2012. The apartment is confortable and Ruy was a good host. Just walk a little and you will find a metro station.

Ruy was a great host and the apartment was perfect for our short stay in Buenos Aires. Ruy was always available to answer our questions and knew the city well. The apartment was clean and everything functioned perfectly. I would definitely recommend the experience to a friend.

Ruy was a good host and the apartment had all these features as dislpayed except for wi-fi. Ruy did his best to overcome this and it was not a big problem for us in the end. The apartment was in a great location and we would stay there again. Many Thanks Ruy!!

We have been to Ruy's apartment for two weeks in january 2013. We really enjoyed staying in Buenos Aires and the apartment. We loved to sit outside the big balcony! The apartment has everything you need and is pretty nice. Also the neighborhood was perfect with a supermarket in the ground floor of the house, lost of restaurants, near by train and bus. Ruy was a very goof host! When there was a problem or a question he was helping us. We can really recommend to stay at Ruy's.

The apartment was fairly much as presented however but was not up to the level of expectations that we have in regard to a self hosted apartment.  The main problem was the lack of air conditioning. The hot weather that was present, and continued for the time we were in Buenos Aires led us to have to vacate the apartment  after one night.  We were able to find a very nice hotel with a kitchenette, air conditioning, 4 star rating and a much better location  for about the same price that we paid for the apartment.  The apartment has no air conditioning and in addition has no screening of the windows so you had to choose between oppressive heat or being eaten up by the mosquitoes.   We actually were unable to escape either.  I would certainly not advise anyone to rent this apartment in the summer months  and to also be aware that you have to provide everything even to the basics of salt and  pepper.  In addition the level of cleanliness was rather poor.  Mr Blanco was a helpful host but, of course,  was unwilling to alter our agreement and return any of our payment.  I understand his position but I can only say "buyer beware." The neighborhood is not the best and the closest recommended restaurant was rather poor.  It does have access to a market right next door.  Look closely between the lines when renting through this company.

If you want to live in the center of Buneos Aires in a lovely and real neighbourhood which is not yet overrun by tourists - the apartments of Ruy are the place to be. He himself is a very nice guy who will help you with all the questions you have. And if you don´t speak castellano, that will not be a problem, because of him speaking perfect english. The apartment itself is spacious and luminoso and has everything you want it to have. Extra highlight: The big terrace with vista of Evita Perons image on a ministrybuilding at nueve de julio. So if you come home in the middle of the night you always want to have a last drink on this terrace and you will just be happy. Honest recommendation!

Savas sempre respondeu rapidamente, quando tive alguma indagação ou dúvida.
É a 1a vez que me hospedo em Palermo, sempre fiquei na Recoleta. Gostei do bairro com muitas opções de restaurantes e cafés, assim como lojas.
O apartamento é bem decorado, fiel às fotos.

We have a great time staying at Savas' s apartment! we did not have chance to see Savas, but Fernando and Luciana helped us a lot.
I would come back to this place if I visit Buenos Aires again! Thanks! Savas!!!

This apartment is great! In the perfect part of Palermo Soho (equal distance between the subte & Plaza Armenia) and nice and quiet as the apartment doesn't face the street. It is well equipped; I stayed there for a month and it was big enough for that length of stay. Recommended.

Muy bien ubicado, en la zona mas linda de Palermo. Luminoso, moderno.
Regresaría sin dudas en un próximo viaje!

Overall great apartment!  The pictures and description of the apartment online were accurate, check-in and check-out were quick and easy, and the location of the apartment was very convenient.  It also had all the amenities we were looking for.  The only downsides I would say was that the bathroom door did not work so that if you closed it it would lock you in - luckily there were two of us so we could let the other out once we realized this and forgot to leave the door slightly ajar.  Also the person who checked us in did not do the best job of describing where everything was, so some of it we ended up finding on our own a few days later when we could have used things earlier.  The only other downside was that I was reminded at least 3 times within 24 hours of checking out to write a review, which was somewhat annoying as I was still on vacation and planned on writing the review once my vacation was done.  All of the downsides, however, are minor and you could find with many stays.  I would recommend this apartment to others and I would stay at it again.

Just perfect!!!!!
O apartamento é delicia.
A localização é ótima, principalmente no fim de tarde com as lojas e o restaurantes.
Tudo o que precisamos foi atendido pelo Savas.
I recomend this place.

Excelente apartamento muy lindo y cómodo, cumple con todo lo que dice en su descripción. Está en una zona muy centrica de Palermo pero las ventanas dan a un patio interior así que no hay nada de ruido y tiene cortinas blackout, en las noches es muy tranquilo.
Yo fui con mi señora y mi hijo de 2 años y nos sentimos muy bien, fue una excelente elección.
Perfecta ubicación en pleno Palermo Soho. El piso es muy comodo, confortable y moderno. Altamente recomendable!!!!

Apartamento bastante confortável, moderno e limpo em uma excelente localização em Palermo SoHo.

Tudo saiu como o combinado! Luciana nos recebeu no prédio, foi muito simpática e atenciosa com tudo.

Não há ressalvas a se fazer: a experiência fui muito positiva e recomendável!
Wonderful stay at Savas' place! The location and apartment are gorgeous. We began missing Buenos Aires as soon as we left the apartment to catch our ferry back.
Great experience! Wonderful place to stay! Great communication with check-in and check-out.

Had a GREAT stay at Savas' apartment. Perfect location, excellent apartment (super clean, good size for two, nice towels and bed linen, a lot of space for unpacking clothes, really nice pool area), and great service from both Savas and his assistant Luciana. We always felt that if we had a question or needed help we could get an answer quickly. Luciana took time to give us the Buenos Aires 101 - what to tip in restaurants, which taxis to take (and not to take!) - that kind of stuff, very helpful. And before we arrived Savas had sent us a comprehensive guide to restaurants etc. in the area, which also proved very helpful. Only minor negative aspects (and this is nice, not need) is that it would be nice if there was dishwashing soap, some detergent and maybe some basic cooking stuff such as salt and oil, so one need not to buy a lot of big packages of something only used a couple of times. And a better instruction for the washing machine (we must have chosen something wrong as our clothes  were still dirty after the washing). But again - these are really only minor details in the big, very happy, picture. Thank you so much, Savas and Luciana!
Bonito apartamento. Limpio y muy espacioso para una pareja. Lo mejor, la ubicación.

Adoramos o apartamento. Bem localizado e equipado incluindo lençóis e toalhas limpos. Assim como nas fotos. Luciana e Savas foram extremamente atenciosos. Fernando, o responsável pelo prédio, também foi super simpático e nos ajudou com as malas e taxi quando fomos embora além de estar sempre a disposição. Recomendo o apartamento a todos!!!!

This was our third trip to BA and we decided to experience life in the
city as a Porteno. Savas's apartment made this a pleasure. Perfectly
located to explore the trendy shops and restaurants of Palermo on foot
as well as close to necessities such as grocery stores and Dulce de
Leche Gelato! Savas provides an "Insider's Guide" which was beyond
helpful.

The apartment is exactly as represented. Comfortable and well
appointed with all the mod cons and immaculate. Savas and his team are
extremely professional and always within contact either by phone or
email and respond immediately.

Excellent experience!

My wife and I spent 4 days in our first time in BA. Beautiful city, lots of places to visit, wonderful food, cheap taxis. If you don`t have much time to explore around by yourself, take the 2 days ticket in buenosairesbus.com, It helps to save time. What about Savas apartment? Everything already said is very true: nice apartment, fully equipped (kitchen, hairdryer, iron, TV, plug adaptors...), safe, clean, nice internet connection, nice pool, hosts care about details, including clean towels. Savas was gone during our stay, but Luciana made a wonderful job from beginning to the end. Fernando was also very helpful and polite. Neighborhood was quite all the time. Explore Palermo on foot, it is safe, with lots of restaurants and bars. Don`t miss La Cabrera!  Coming back to the apartment after walking during hours is like getting home! We definitely recommend and we want to come back!

The apartment is really good perfect for 2 people and well located. We were received by Luciana as previously agreed, she explained how to use everything in the apartment. It was great!
However, maybe because there is no windows in the bathroom I had the impression at times to smell sewerage. Although it was not a big problem and because the service in general was really good I thought I should point it out.

This is a lovely studio in the heart of Palermo Soho--you really can't ask for a better neighborhood.   The apartment was clean and well appointed and the building had a great pool and gym.  Can't recommend this place enough.

Ruys lejlighed er placeret et godt sted centralt i Buenos Aires. San Telmo er i gåafstand fra lejligheden, hvor man finder mange hyggelige cafeer og butikker. Lejligheden er fin indrettet, ren og med en stor dejlig altan, som har sol morgen til aften.
Prisen er god, og lejligheden kan anbefales.

Eine tolle Wohnung, zentral gelegen in einer für uns als sicher empfundenen Umgebung. Gute Ausstattung mit allem Nötigen, die Terrasse ist großzügig und lädt zu einer köstlichen Pizza aus der benachbarten Pizzeria (direkt neben Restaurant  Le Famiglie, Salta 440) mit Rotwein ein. Direkt nebenan ein kleiner, gut sortierter Supermarkt - sehr praktisch! Ruy ist ein sehr netter, fürsorglicher Gastgeber, der bei allen anstehenden Fragen gerne hilft. Unkomplizierte Abwicklung der Übergabe. Wir empfehlen die Wohnung uneingeschränkt; an sehr heißen Tagen wäre allerdings eine Klimaanlage statt des Ventilators wünschenswert.

We spent 4 days in BA in Ruy's apartment. we enjoyed the place very much, it was clean, spacious, and  had a great balcony. Ruy was very helpful and reposponded immediately to any of our needs, polite and respectful of our privacy.

Recomendado al 100% !!! Ruy fue un super anfitrión, nos ayudo en todo lo que le pedimos. El departamento muy bien ubicado, limpio y muy amplio, igual que las fotos. Teníamos todo lo necesario muy cerca y el barrio es un sitio tranquilo. Con mucho gusto volvería a hospedarme con Ruy !!!
Excelente lugar. Muy recomendable.

My wife and I stayed at Ruy's apartment in Monteserrat for 1 week and had a very good experience.

The apartment has a very good location - we had no problems directing the taxi at night and in the day we simply took the subway (within 5min walking distance you will find stations for 2 different lines). There is a supermarket and laundry just below so we had no problems with our daily necessities.

The apartment is kept very neat and tidy by Ruy and the balcony is wonderful to sit, chit chat and have breakfast on.

Ruy was wonderful and offered to give us many tips about the local attractions and even helped us to book a taxi to get to the airport!

Overall, this apartment is very good value for money and we had a wonderful experience here. We will look forward to staying here again if we go back to BA.

A great little apartment outside of the touristy bustle of Buenos Aires. The location is very convenient with busy San Telmo just a short walk away. The apartment is very clean and furnished with everything you could need to be comfortable. Ruy was also very helpful and accomodating. My stay here was very relaxing and I would recommend this space to anyone.
I just want to say that this apartment is amazing ! Don't hesitate ... just book without waiting !
Súper recomendable. Ya estoy pensando en volver. Tiene todo lo necesario y es tal cual se ve en las fotos. Un lugar maravilloso y Carolina una divina.
Apartment was modern and right in the heart of great nightlife and restaurants. Would definitely recommend it!

If you are planning on renting an apartment in Buenos Aires then please look no further. I cannot rate this place highly enough.  The apartment is beautiful, bright and modern, with a/c, wifi and a balcony. The building itself is secure, with a delightful porter named Fernando.  It has a swimming pool, gym and sauna, which are such luxuries in BsAs.  Savas was away when we visited, so the lovely Luciana greeted us, and made us feel welcome and comfortable. Palermo Soho, where the apt is located, is by far the BEST neighbourhood in BsAs.  It is packed full of good restaurants, cafes, bars, boutique shops and feels safe to walk around during the day and night,  Savas sent us an amazing pdf guide of the city before we arrived with restaurant recommendations and other tips, which was so helpful. We loved the city so much and would recommend this flat to anyone visiting.  It is the perfect size for a couple, as the bedroom is not fully closed from the living room, where the sofa bed is located, so if there were more people it would feel squashed.  No negatives at all though - great value for money, perfect area, beautiful modern accommodation - please stay here!

Had such an amazing time in this apartment!! it is beautiful, so neat and just like the pictures. the location was perfect in palermo, there was lots of great boutiques and cafes. thankyou SO much for having us savas!!

Savas place is really a great place to stay if you wanna have a relaxed city trip in Buenos Aires! The Appartement is in a really good condition - exactly as shawn on the photos- you are in the heart of Palermo, which is the best neighbourhood if you wanna have all accomodations nearby! We felt save all the time and can really rekommend Savas place. Good host! Perfect Handling :-)
Fantastic
We had a great time, and the apartment was an ideal location. The pool was an added bonus!

PROS: This apartment was clean and tastefully decorated, located in a very nice and hip area. Restaurants, cafes and shopping are within walking distance. CONS: Hosts are Unaccommodating, Unavailable and Condescending.
I thought it was cultural differences at first with previous emails but when the same behavior continued after we checked in, I start to feel uncomfortable with the approach! Savas was OOCountry during our visit and Luciana was going to check us in. When we arrived, Fernando, (sweetest doorman) told us that Luciana was going to be there in 30 mins. Generally, the host are already waiting for us when we arrive. It was late and we were tired and hungry. In 30 mins came a man who didn't look too happy, telling us that Luciana was out of town and that he was checking us in instead. We were only given one set of keys so I emailed Luciana and Savas that night requesting for another set since my friend and I have different plans and would be inconvenient for us to share one set of keys. Luciana responded, "Jade, I am out of the city until monday, so I cant give you another set of key until then!" We checked in Friday night and checking out Tuesday, meaning that we would have to stress over the key business almost the entire stay. On the next email response from Savas, he said, "For security reasons we do not provide a second set of keys. This is our permanent policy and please try to respect it. So far with more than a 100 different guests from all over the world, hasn' t been a problem. Please try to find a way to manage." Hmmm... this apartment can potentially accommodate 4 people. Unless more than 100 of his previous guests are solo travelers or couples who are join at the hip, it's hard to believe that it hasn't been a problem to have one set of keys to be shared among all parties? And "please try to respect it"? implying that this is an unreasonable request? And "Please try to find a way to manage"! Sounds hospitable enough? On this trip, we have stayed at 4 airbnbs and each of them offered 2 sets of keys without being asked, except for this one. One of them even offered 3 sets. On another email, Luciana told us to make a copy of the key since she cant get someone to get into the office to get the keys for us before Monday and Savas is telling us this. All these just dont add up. Rather than getting into an email war with them, we just "found a way to manage" since by the time we get this resolved we would be checking out. Needless to say, it was a frustrating ordeal. Unless you are willing to put up with the bad attitude and inferior hospitality, and have the patience to coordinate the key business, you are much better off staying elsewhere.
It was marvelous! Clean, near downtown,,, Ruy and his mother were very helpful. It was in June. I will go back to BA in August and I intent to stay there again.

Ruy was helpful, friendly, and he speaks perfect English which is helpful. He was also able to be flexible with me on the check-out time.

The apartment is very nice, there's a beautiful view of the city from the balcony. San Telmo and Palermo are the hip and trendy neighborhoods of Bs As, and this apartment is an easy 5 minute walk from San Telmo. Also walking distance from the Casa Rosada, Obelisk, and even Recoleta Cemetery. Neighborhood seems safe and secure. There is a supermarket downstairs from the apartment that sells everything. Apartment is clean, functional, and cozy. Great value and highly recommended.

Sem palavras para expressar como eu e meu namorado ficamos satisfeitos em nos hospedar na cobertura do Sr. Ruy,
Próximo aos principais pontos turisticos, sem contar com a comodidade que se encontra no apt, a vista é maravilhosa onde o pouco sol que peguei porque fui no inverno adentra a sala.
Ruy, muito receptivo e atencioso.
Valeu Ruy! Adorei com certeza voltarei.
Um abraço de Sueli e Uiliam.

We booked Ruys apartment in the last minute, and Ruy answered very fast, he was really helpful and friendly. The falt is in very good location, and the terrace is wonderful! We spent only 2 nights there, and it was very confortable for us. Ruy was very communicative, and always helped us if we had a question. He gave good recommendations of where to go in the city (eating or tango show). I really reccomend the flat, and Ruy is a great host!
Estuvo super bien, todo deiz puntos. Los anfitriones super amables, y atentos. El apto. es muy lumnoso y còmodo. 100% recomendable.

The apartment was fine and the price was really economical. Our biggest problem was the internet. It was nearly nonexistent. We had to go to a coffee shop in order to use a decent connection. Gostei muito da estadia, ótimo apartamento e esta em boa localização. O Ruy foi muito atencioso. Recomendo!

Excelente ubicación, tal cual lo describe el aviso, práctico y con todas las comodidades para estadías largas. No conocimos a Ruy pero su familia nos atendió de maravillas.
Altamente recomendable.
Literally not one grumble about this apartment. It's great, in an awesome position, easy to get everywhere, safe building, clean and Ruy's sister was very welcoming, helpful and friendly.
Ruy's place is clean, spacious and very well located. A good choice!

Really perfect location in trendy Palermo! We loved staying here- the apartment is modern- has everything you need- easy in and out- great building manager helped us find the laundry room and answered Lur questions. Secure- super clean and nicely appointed. nice building pool too! Host was responsive- sent us great tips -  highly recommend.
Savas and Luciana were wonderful hosts and really helpful. The apartment is lovely and in a fantastic location in Palermo close to bars, restaurants and fantastic shops. Highly recommended!
The place is really nice and comfortable. Perfect for one or two people. The location is great, just two blocks away from the center of Palermo Soho.

The appartment is super nice and place to go! Especially loved the pool to go swimming every Morning. Also the neighbourhood in Palermo is very loveley and Savas self made guide for nice places at Buenos Aires was very helpful.
When you go there you have to eat steak at Don Julio which is just around the corner. Also the many boutiques in Palermo are a shopping paradise whith very unique clothing. We only had 3 days which is defenitely not enough for such a nice city. At least one week is a must.

Ruy was unbelievably friendly and accommodating. He offered us rides to and from the airport for very, very reasonable rates, which was super convenient, especially since we were not fluent in the local language. The apartment was exactly as described. We really enjoyed the balcony area. There is a good view of the Evita mural building, and it provides for a very cooling night-time chilling area.

Ruy even went the extra mile to help us out with local money changers, and gave us excellent recommendations for restaurants and sites to visit. He was very personable, and it was easy to communicate with him since he lives only one floor below us.

The area around the apartment is very safe compared to other parts of the city. We rarely found the need to take public transport or a cab, since the apartment was located just one block away from a major street where most of the sites of interest are within walking distance.

I would highly recommend anyone traveling to Buenos Aires to consider staying at Ruy's apartment offerings.

My stay at the apartment was very pleasant and convenient. Ruy was very professional in his management of my booking and Dolores, his sister was very helpful when I had a major travel issue to deal with.
The apartment is in a great location, very accessible to buses and trains all over the city and many supermarkets and restaurants in the area. The apartment is clean, quiet and comfortable. I would highly recommend staying in the apartment , especially if you want easy access to all of the main tourist sites.
We enjoyed the stay at Ruy's apartment. Ruy is a great host and he gave us many tips about the neighborhood. He was very helpful. The apartment is neat and very convenient.

Très bonne expérience à Buenos Aires. Ruy est très aimable et fait tout pour rendre votre séjour confortable.
Je recommande.
Apartamento muito bem localizado e equipado, o Ruy foi muito amável e se prontificou o tempo todo a nos ajudar, ficamos muito contente com a escolha, eu recomendo sem restrições.

Wygodny, przestronny apartament z łazienką, sypialnią, salonen i połączoną z nim małą kuchenką - wszystko tak jak na zdjęciach. Jedyny mankament to brak klimatyzacji, ale nie odczuwaliśmy nadmiernego gorąca, mimo że było bardzo ciepło na zewnątrz. (Zawsze można otworzyć balkon i okno w kuchni). Polecamy ten apartament i jego gospodarza. Ruy jest sympatyczny, przyjazny i bardzo pomocny. Świetny gość! Niezwykle kontaktowy, zawsze odpowiada na maile. Nie narzuca się, ale służy pomocą, jeśli jej potrzebujesz. Bardzo profesjonalny host i miły człowiek. To już nasza druga wizyta w apartamentach Montserrat (pierwszy raz byliśmy tu w zeszłym roku), co dobrze świadczy o tym miejscu. Jeśli znów przejedziemy do Buenos, na pewno tu zamieszkamy.

Comfortable, spacious apartment with a bathroom, bedroom, livingroom and a small kitchen connected to it - everything just like on the pictures.There is also a fairly large balcony, which gives breath and is an extension of the living room under a sky of Buenos Aires. Area is safe and within easy access to public transport. Buenos Aires is one of the world's greatest cities and staying here can only enhance your overall experience of this wonderful and vibrant city.

Comfortable accommodation that was well located. Ruy was a great host who was unobtrusive yet very helpful on the few occasions I required it. The provision of a BUSE card for public transport was particularly appreciated as it made getting around so easy. Highly recommended.

Ruy nos ayudó en todo lo que pudo y fue extremadamente flexible. El apartamento cuenta con todo lo necesario, es agradable, está ubicado en una zona tranquila y con muchos lugares a dónde se puede ir caminando, como restaurantes, bares o comercios.
No tuvimos ningún tipo de problema, muy recomendable.

El apartemento es muy lindo, tal como muestran las fotos. Ruy un grande! No tuvimos ningún tipo de problema y pudimos contar con sus consejos para saber a donde ir a comer y demás. Ampliamente recomendable!!!!

Absolutely great place to stay. Location and the rooftop area make it pretty much perfect. Really loved it.
The neighbourhood is great, the markets and stores are incredible, walked all over the city and was always happy to get back to our corner of the city. The grill was amazing too!

We stayed in the apartment for an entire week and enjoyed the privacy and tranquility of the place as well as the relaxing atmosphere of the terrace upstairs.  Carolina prepared the place in a superb way and we immediately felt like being at home and ready to discover Buenos Aires.  The location is great.  We love San Telmo and the Market across the street offers incredible breakfasts.  Thank you for preparing our stay in such details!

The apartment is in San Telmo, which is perhaps not as chic or polished an area as Palermo, but we liked it all the better for that, being in a Buenos Aires of narrow lanes and streets and old shops not designed for the modern consumer felt more authentic to us. The apartment was clean and very pleasant and and contained everything we needed, and we were met at the door on arrival by a big smile and a warm welcome.

The roof terrace is very very nice and gives great views whilst being secluded. We would recommend the place without hesitation!

The apartment is great, in a very nice neighborhood! Especially the Mercado San Telmo is a great spot to drink a morning coffee and buy fruits and bread. And of course the terrace is a very nice place to start the day or end it!

Alejandra's studio is delightful, it's very well equipped & we found it had everything we required for our week in Buenos Aires. There are two doors to access the studio, one on the street that leads through a small courtyard to the stairs leading up to the second door & into the apartment; this means it feels very safe as both doors have good locks.
The studio has plenty of natural light &, although it is located in a busy area , it's set back from the street & it's quiet inside ...we had absolutely no problem sleeping.
Alejandra was away when we visited but communication with her was good & her delightful friend Carolina (who lives next door) was available to meet us to let us in & to help with lots of very useful information on what to see and do.
Alejandra recommended we pre book a taxi from EZE airport on line (using www.taxiezeiza.com) to San Telmo; this was a great tip & worked well for us; we used this service both from & to the airport.
We found we could walk from San Telmo to most of the places in Buenos Aires, that we wanted to see; sure we walked a long way on some days but it was very interesting to be among the people & to soak up the street life & the architecture. If you don't feel like walking there are buses & taxis close by.
We were very happy with Alejandra's place and we would certainly stay there again.
Nice space opposite markets for fruit veg and meats. Cafes nearby easy walking. Basics are in kitchen to cook most things. Really nice hosts. Roof terrace is a good space in spring

Die Beschreibung der Wohnung entspricht den Gegebenheiten. Wir haben uns besonders wohl gefühlt und empfehlen Alejandras Appartment ganz besonders!! Elizabeth und Andreas

Ótima localização! Fomos muito bem recepcionados! Obrigada Carol e Alejandra. E adoramos as dicas de passeio. Fizemos nossos passeios todos a pé. Caminhamos de dia e de noite e a arquitetura bucólica com a diversidade de pessoas tornou tudo muito mais belo! We loved our stay in the apartment. It is very clean, comfortable and with all the right functionality to feel at home in an unfamiliar city. The location is superb! We found ourselves across the street at the market each morning for coffee as we determined where the day would take us. Communication was very easy. Highly recommmended!
Great apartment in a wonderful location. Just as advertised. Would definitely stay here again.

This is a gem. One of my new favorites on Airbnb. The obvious highlight is the rooftop, but the indoor living space is charming and cozy too. The kitchen has everything you need. I went to beautiful Mercado San Telmo (right across the street) for cheese, bread and fruit, and down the street to the wine shop, and enjoyed my snacks on the roof for both breakfast and sun down every day.

Do not hesitate to book this amazing apartment. I hope to be back someday! Thank you Carolina and Alejandra for sharing your lovely space and hospitality.

Great apartment right in the center of San Telmo, a really great part of Buenos Aires. The apartment has everything you could need on a trip, a fully equipped kitchen, a washing machine, its comfortable, it’s full of nice personal details. It’s very quiet even so it is in the middle of things happening in San Telmo. And it has the best terrace ever. Carolina was there for us when we needed help and provided lots of information. I will definitely recommend this place to my friends and hope I will be back myself.
Savas has a very nice place - the apartment is super clean, in the middle of the action in Buenos Aires, and makes a great HQ for your stay in the city. Highly recommended!

Aunque este apartamento es bonito y está bien ubicado, nuestra experiencia global fue muy negativa. El último día nos olvidamos en un cajón un sobre con un pasaporte y una cantidad considerable de euros. Nos dimos cuenta enseguida y volvimos al cabo de media hora. El sobre había desaparecido. En el apartamento sólo había entrado la señora de la limpieza y el encargado, a quien le dimos la llave del piso. La señora de la limpieza tuvo enseguida claro que el responsable era el encargado. Fuimos a hablar con él, lo negó todo y cada vez se pue poniendo más violento. Al cabo de un rato, el encargado apareció con el pasaporte pero ni rastro del dinero. No entendíamos nada. Tuvimos que llamar a la polícia ante lo surrealista de la situación. El encargado, en lugar de calmarse, se fue poniendo cada vez más agresivo y nos preguntó si habíamos buscado en las basuras. Ante su insistencia, me acompaño a mirar las basuras de todos los pisos y finalmente el sobre perdido "apareció" misteriosamente entre restos de comida. El encargado se fue dando un portazo. Al rato llegó Luciana, la compañera de Savas, y nos advirtió que era mejor alejarnos de allí porqué el encargado estaba armado. Fue todo muy desagradable.

Aunque el apartamento está bien, no recomendaría a nadie alquilarlo hasta que no estén seguros que el encargado en cuestión no trabaja allí. Todo el mundo tenía claro que era el ladrón y que era una persona agresiba. Lo sorprendente es que fue la persona que nos dio la llave para abrir el piso y la persona a quien tuvimos que devolver la llave ante la imposibilidad del propietario de estar en el apartamento a la hora de nuestra llegada y de nuestra partida.

Simplesmente maravilhoso, decoração linda, e o apartamento é muito quentinho, a localização é ótima, tem cafés, restaurantes e bares para todos os gostos e bolsos, pode se andar a noite tranquilamente, e para conhecer outros bairros sempre tem um taxi passando em frente, e aconselhamos andar muito de taxi, o maior valor que pagamos foi $75,00 (pesos argentinos), muito mais tranquilo que o transito intenso. E a nossa dica de restaurante pertinho é o crepe do Chez, muito recheado, cerveja gelada e um ambiente lindo. Voltamos apaixonados por Buenos Aires e com certeza vamos voltar a cidade.

Many interesting cafes, restaurants, and shops within walking distance. Savas' guest guide has a lot of helpful info. Nice to receive the pdf ahead of the trip. A few blocks away from Plaza Italia/Av Santa Fe, where you find Subte line D and many buses going to many places. The neighbors were pretty quite most of the time during our stay except a Saturday night when an apt across the courtyard had a party and loud music went on till around 4 am.

Apartamento confortável e bem equipado com utensílios de cozinha,secador de cabelos e aquecedor potente para os dias de inverno. Próximo a pontos de interesse no bairro. Fiquei positivamente surpresa quando encontrei vários adaptadores de tomada - fato que não havia me ocorrido antes!
Agradeço a hospitalidade e recomendo!

Apartamento muy funcional tal cual se ve en las fotos. Por ultimo Que puedo contar de la ubicación, sólo hay que ir para poder entenderlo.
Pasamos muy lindo.
Recomendable

Unfortunately we didn't have the opportunity to meet Savas, but his assistant was accommodating. Upon check-in she made sure that we knew where everything was located and how to use it.

The photos of the apartment are true to the appearance of the actual apartment. It was a nice cozy space for me and my boyfriend. The heated bathroom floor is a plus. BsAs can be cold in the winter, so the heating system was much appreciated and worked well.

The apartment is very well located. This is my 3rd visit to BsAs and my first time staying in Palermo. There are plenty of restaurants, boutiques, cafes, independent bookshops, and bars around, along with streets that each have their own character. Staying in Palermo is much more relaxing and enjoyable than staying in the center.

I highly recommend this apartment.
this was a great home base for us in BA. lovely neighborhood and building. beautiful open space that fit my husband and i and our two boys perfectly. thanks again!

This apartment is not only perfectly located and practical with everything needed, it’s also absolutely charming and magical. I can’t think of a better place to be in Buenos Aires and I’m already hoping to go back longer !!!
Thanks for the stay, it was great!!

Alejandra's place is a charming apartment nestled in one of the best areas in San Telmo, right across from the Mercado San Telmo. Overall, I would look to book Alejandra's place again any time I am fortunate enough to be back in Buenos Aires.
A good place with a nice terrace. Very good location in San Temo neighbourhood.
Great, great location.  Fantastic restaurants nearby.  Entryway is stunning.  Roof is special.  Bed is very comfortable.  Market right across the street—empanadas are a must!
Fantastic private space right in the middle of the best neighborhood!  Everything we needed.
this place has amazing vibes and is in the perfect location right across the street from san telmo market. host very communicative and easy to check in etc. loved it. terrace is awesome

This apartment is exactly as advertised and an absolutely perfect location in San Telmo.  I would certainly stay again on another trip to BA.  The apartment is quiet and cool and the rooftop terrace is great.

What a fabulous place to call home for a few days! It is very cozy, is located on a fantastic street in the heart of San Telmo and has the most incredible rooftop. I would definitely stay there again if given the chance.

This is a great location directly opposite San Telmo Market which is a great bonus with it's shops, coffee etc. The neighborhood is inner city and certainly the old part of town but that makes much of it's charm. Unfortunately when I was there it was in the middle of a heatwave so I couldn't enjoy the rooftop as much as I would have liked to. Overall highly recommended as long as you are not looking for modern hotel style feel to the place. Caroline (who was looking after the apartment) was charming and helpful.

This was my first Air B ‘n’ B stay and what a positive experience. Not only did Carolina make herself always available but she even ordered me a cab on my way out that was cheaper than my first.
I’d have to say the best “nice touch” was Lola..the Frenchie!

In summary, this is the perfect place to be if you are visiting Buenos Aires. Rui is very attentive to details and willing to help whenever required. The house is very well located in san telmo close to most touristic attractions. In addition, it has an amazing terrace for morning coffee.
Living in Ruy's flat was wonderful. Nice apartment with nice balcony in nice neighbourhood.

This place is easy access to metro station and most places in the city. It is great deal to have private place with this price. However, the shower didnt work while I stayed for 3 nights which was problem.

Ruy es una persona súper amable, cordial y atento con cualquier cosa que necesites. Esta preparado para todo, e incluso me recogió en el aeropuerto y me aconsejo sobre la ciudad. Es espectacular.

El apartamento es muy bonito en una zona segura. Desde allí quedas a distancias que se pueden caminar de lugares importantes para conocer buenos aires.

El departamento de Ruy es muy eficiente y esta muy bien equipado. Se puede dormir muy bièn en esa parte de la ciudad pese a estar ubicado en el centro de Buenos Aires.
La mamà de Ruy muy simpàtica y acogedora. Los dos, Ruy y su madre muy puntuales y amables.
