Ruy's place was awesome, exactly as described and had everything I needed.  The bed was very comfortable.   Ruy was very helpful and not only helped me with my luggage but got up early in the morning to get me a taxi to the airport.

Ruy is an AirBnB professional! He was always prepared to help and he actually helped us with a lot of things! His flat is really nice and the location is also very good. Thanks Ruy for everything! Olga and Viktor

Ruy was the perfect host, making himself available for us whenever we needed, providing us with suggestions for changing our money (at the better black market rate of 12+pesos/1 USD), and even restaurant recommendations (which were always great). The location, though slightly outside of the city center was only a few blocks away from the subway (C line), and provided a place to get away after a busy day. Trust me, you will be so happy you stayed at this place; the apartment was beautiful! We loved the windows, which fully opened, and the patio provided us with great views of the city. The apartment is high up, so we could keep the windows and patio doors open at night without worrying about any mosquitoes or intruders. There is a grocery store located just outside the front door in case you want to grab fruit or beverages for the night. The fridge is super cold; it froze some of the vegetables we had inside, so be aware of that. There is a USD20/ARS100 deposit for the keys, in case you didn't see that. Hire a car to get to the place, which is right INSIDE the airport before you exit. It is cheaper than a taxi (around 380 pesos). The price for this place is so reasonable. I hope the weather is as great for you as it was for us. Enjoy BA!
Fair

The apartment is very nice and clean, in great location and with a fantastic view. Restaurants, shops and public transportation are just around the corner. Ruy was very responsive and flexible with check-in/out. We would definitely book again with Ruy.

Ruy was very friendly and made us feel very welcome.  Even after we left, he offered to help out if we had any questions or emergencies.  We arrived by plane to BA and got to the apartment around midnight and Ruy came by to check us in, which was really nice.  All around, a great experience.  Ruy also directed us to a wonderful little area where we got a drink and some food (Bar el Federal on Carlos Calvo)

Ruy was a great host, being flexible with check-in and check-outs. He helped us get grounded in the city with a map, and pointed out areas for us to see.

The apartment was in an easy accessible location, with a grocery next door, and close to the main avenue and bus way. Make sure to try local pizza, the cheese is amazing. If you bring USD$100 bills, you can exchange them with 'gandia' exchangers for 13pesos/usdollar.

There are actually 2 apartments, the ones in the photo are the newer upgraded ones, but ours was relaxing as well.

My partner and I had an amazing time at Ruy's apartment. He was exceptionally amicable and allowed us to leave our luggage at the apartment when we arrived before check in. Ruy also assisted us when enquiring a out money exchange; going to such lengths as withdrawing from his own account. This was a great help after an awful flight and an even worse taxi experience from the airport. The apartment itself does what is says on the packet. Its a place to rest and recuperate after a days worth city exploration. Its is reasonably sized with a plush bed, pressured shower and nice balcony space. No complaints from these amigos.
Our host Ruy made us feel very welcome.  The accommodation was as we expected. It had easy access to busses and subway. It was close to the city centre with lots of restaurants nearby.

super appartement. moderne, beau, avec tout le nécessaire! je le recommande vivement. de plus, il est super bien placé !
vraiment top!

O apartamento está muito bem localizado, junto a vários restaurantes, bares, mercados, outlets, Av. Santa Fé.
Muito bem decorado e funcional.
Me hospedei com minha esposa e minha mãe durante uma semana e tudo correu muito bem.
Infelizmente, não pude conhecer Savas, pois estava viajando na Grécia. Mas fui muito bem atendido por Luciana e outro rapaz (não lembro o nome). O encarregado do prédio também sempre foi muito cortês conosco.
Enfim, recomendo fortemente essa hospedagem. Certamente retornarei.
Se alguém quiser maiores informações, disponibilizo meu e-mail: souzalima.advogado@yahoo.com.br
À disposição.

I was not able to meet Savas, but I met his assistant, Luciana, who was lovely. The place was in an amazing location - close to everything in Palermo. When we checked out, Luciana also made sure to ask about every part of the stay, in case there was anything to improve for future guests. It's good knowing that Savas and Luciana actually care and look to improve the unit for guests.

One thing - the place is a bit small - smaller than I expected. It would probably be much more comfortable for two people (I stayed with three total). With three, there is no place to relax in the living room without putting the sofa bed back together every day. Though, of course, you could also relax in one of the many coffee shops in the area. But all in all, a fantastic stay.

Excelente apartamento. As fotos mostram o que se encontra lá. Tranquilo, silencioso, muito limpo e bem iluminado. Internet wifi funcionou bem e foi importante para meu trabalho. Bem localizado em Palermo Soho, perto de tudo de bom que tem o bairro. Recomendo sem dúvidas.

Ruy is the perfect host. He is helpful, he is on time, if you have any question just drop him a line and will answer pretty quickly.

The place is really nice, in good shape, I really enjoyed the view and it is quite close to a lot of places.

The wifi will be a little bit slow, but quite helpful.

Ruy is a lovely host who really tries to make your stay in BA as comfortable as possible. The flat is served by a lift and you have a beautiful view over BA. It is close (10 minutes walk) to more 'touristy' San Telmo but we liked the tree lined streets, the local shops and restaurants of the immediate surroundings. It is a great base for exploring BA.

The apart is quite spacious with a nice balcony and a good quality bed. Aside of towels, it was missing any kind of consumables, e.g toilet paper.
There have been a misunderstanding about the checkout time, but such things can happen. Unfortunately to get back our deposit (for the keys), we had to meet again before leaving, and Ruy refused any form of compromise to find an amicable agreement which turned this experience into a really unpleasant one.

Ruys apartment is great. The terrace is huge and has a great view where you can see the sunset. The bed is very comfortable and in general the apartment has everything you need. There is a supermarket right under the apartment and an ATM just around the corner which is very convenient! Metro station is only five minutes away. Ruy was easy to get in contact with and to communicate with and offered us his help anytime. We can definitely recommend staying at Ruys'.

Ruy was a great host, and I would definitely book this apartment again! As we were flying standby, he let us not only make a last-minute booking, but he also let us check in early and was gracious enough to work out a late check out as well. The view from the apartment is INCREDIBLE and the terrace is perfect for a sunset. It also offers a great vantage point to take some cool photos of the Evita mural on 9 de Julio. If you are looking for a place close to San Telmo for the market on Sunday, La Casa Rosada/Plaza de Mayo, this is perfect. It's also a very easy taxi or bus (#10 or #59 picks you right up on 9 de Julio) to Recoleta or Palermo if you want to go out at night, see the Recoleta Cemetary, or play in Palermo's parks.

The apartment was clean and had both hand and dish soap, so you didn't have to go out and buy those things. The only thing to keep in mind is this apartment does not have air conditioning--only a fan. For a fall/spring night, it was just fine, but I could see the heat being a bit tough in the peak summer. (This information is included in the description of the apartment, so it came as no surprise. We were perfectly happy without the A/C.)

As we were in BsAs for only the weekend, he also helped us exchange a little USD for Pesos (at a very fair rate) to get us started, which was perfect. If you are heading to EZE, it's the same price to use the driver he knows as it is to taxi to Manuel Tienda Leon and bus to the airport. In the future, we'll make sure we have enough pesos at the end of our trip to go through his driver. As I had lived in the city before, I didn't ask for tourist tips, but he has guide books in the apartment and am sure he would have great ideas for how to spend your time in BsAs.
Un très bon endroit dans le centre de Buenos Aires. Ruy est très disponible et vraiment sympa.

Ruy was great and very helpful, the place was in a great location in terms of getting around the city, and we really enjoyed our stay. I would recommend if you're from out of town and trying to explore Buenos Aires!

O apartamento é muito bem localizado. Fica a uma quadra e meia da Avenida 9 de julho. É bem espaçoso e limpo.
TV Led e canal fechado.
Cama bastante confortável.
Apartamento em rua silenciosa (algo muito positivo)
Cozinha completa com microondas, geladeira, fogão e utensílios.
Ruy fui muito atencioso e pontual. Ele me emprestou um cartão do SUBE para que eu pudesse utilizar ônibus e metro.
Fortemente recomendo a todos.

Alejandra's place is absolutely lovely and in an ideal location. We absolutely loved the private terrace for morning coffee and being able to go across the street to the market and grab fresh croissants. San Telmo quickly became our favorite neighborhood with it's mix of old architecture and modern restaurants, shops and bars. It was a the perfect place for us to relax and enjoy Buenos Aires for a couple days. Alejandra and Carolina were so kind and extremely helpful and easy to contact during our stay as well. I would highly recommend a stay at this wonderful apartment in the heart of beautiful San Telmo!

This place is an oasis in the heart of atmospheric San Telmo. It has everything you need plus an unbelievable terrace where we grilled one night and hung out often. Having market right across the street and main square around the corner is fantastic. Carolina the neighbor was very helpful. We stayed for a week. Miss the place already.

It was an absolutely outstanding stay at Alejandra’s apartment.  It’s bigger than it appears in the pictures and we absolutely loved the beautiful and private rooftop deck.  The neighbourhood is cool and hip - many great restaurants, interesting architecture, museums, parks, and bars.  Hernand is the next door neighbour and was always available and helpful for check in and out as well as sharing his recommendations about the area.  Really a great stay and I would highly recommend it to someone looking to spend time in San Telmo.

nuestra estadia fue muy buena, pasamos unos lindos dias en Buenos Aires y en el departamento de Savas, la ubicación esta buenisima! y el departamento en si esta muy bien equipado. Definitivamente me volveria a quedar ahi!

A truly charming studio apartment. The building is well located, secure and very stylish. We were impressed with the apartment's furnishings, its sunny patio, and relaxing atmosphere. The unit faces the interior, so virtually no street noise, which helped for sleeping in on our vacation. The property is well maintained and very clean.  As for the location, superb! Close to hip shops, excellent restaurants and a charming plaza where all the action is. We were thrilled with the variety of food offered by all the restaurants within walking distance. Overall, one of our best experiences with an Airbnb rental.
We gave a right decision to rent this apartment. Location was perfect. The apartment was very comfortable and had all you would need. Savas and Luciana was so helpful during our stay.

Don't hesitate. Book it now! Apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures with comfortable bed, sweet little kitchen with everything you need, great aircon, awesome gym and pool in complex. Bathroom has lovely hot shower with great water pressure. Apartment is located in the best part of Buenos Aires right in Palermo Soho! Cool boutiques and restuarants/bars just around the corner, subway just a few blocks walk. There is also a little Carrefour around the corner for all your grocery needs. Savas provided us with a local's guide to BA which was much appreciated too. We did not meet him but his assistant Luciana was fantastic, answered all our questions and was constantly available on email/phone with rapid almost immediate responses. The apartment is a great base for exploring this most fabulous city. We spent over two weeks in this apartment and it felt like home on the first day. There are also two bikes to rent, but we didn't as we preferred to walk everywhere. Honestly, we were so impressed with this apartment and would recommend it without hesitation. It's literally perfect for two people who want to spend time in BA. Modern, neat, and completely convenient. Thank you Savas and Luciana!

We loved the apartment and its location. The Palermo Soho neighborhood is charming and well located. The apartment fully met out needs: there was nice natural light, the apartment was quiet, the bed was comfortable (if short for a person over 6 feet, though), there was ample space for cooking, the bathroom was nice with a good shower, the gym was nicely appointed and we were very happy to have a laundry room. Be prepared with the necessary coins if you want to do any laundry, though. We went to several stores, banks and change places trying to get the 1 and 2 peso coins needed to operate the machines.

Savas was out of town, but his colleague Luciana was very responsive and very helpful. Although we didn’t meet in person, we spoke on the phone and she immediately answered the few e-mails we sent. She also arranged the taxi that arrived punctually at 6 AM to take us to the airport for our international flight.

The down sides were minor. The sliding glass door on the balcony didn’t lock and we were told that fixing it would require replacing the glass panels. With the aid of a screwdriver that we bought at the local hardware store, we adjusted a few screws on the strike plate and easily fixed the door. I would also have liked a couple more wine glasses and/or glass glasses. The apartment came with only one wineglass and one glass, in addition to coffee mugs and plastic glasses.

In sum, the apartment was great and we would heartily recommend it to anyone visiting Buenos Aires.

Je suis venue à Palermo fin novembre 2013.
L'appartement est situé au meilleur endroit possible, dans une rue au coeur de Palermo. Il est très clean et sympa. On ne voit pas le propriétaire, mais son assistante, Luciana, très sympathique et qui fait le maximum pour rendre service sur les horaires d'arrivée et de départ.
Trois petites restrictions : La chambre n'est pas close. Les lits très bons mais un peu courts (le lit du salon ne convient pas pour une personne de plus d'1m60). Et je m'étonne aussi de l'affichage du prix qui ne correspond pas : en octobre il était affiché à 52 euros,et au moment du paiement il est passé à 61. Je vois qu'il est toujours affiché à 52 en décembre....
Sinon, aucun problème, vous pouvez aller chez Savas, en toute sécurité.
Sylvie, France.

My parents and I had an amazing experience at Savas apartment. We did not get a chance to meet him as he was away, but he was very quick in responding to our emails. We felt very safe as the location is very central and just by walking a few blocks you will be at the nearest train station, Plaza Italia and bus stops on the Ave, Santa Fe. We were greeted by Fernando, who is the doorman during the day, and he was just an amazing person who gave us great advice for places to see and eat among other things. It helps if you are fluent in Spanish or know your basics. The apartment was perfect for just us three. Plenty of light, and these curtains that need a little updating, as you have to be careful to pull or they will get stuck, but when cooperating will give you plenty of privacy. The sofa needs a better upkeep as the mattress would sink you in a bit, but regardless I still slept fine.The ac was great since the time we stayed there was very hot outside, and having access to the pool is also helpful. Kitchen is well stocked, and they also have tour book guides in their library which help, if you need to borrow them and help in getting around BA. We met Luciana on our last day and she was very nice and helpful. Overall amazing place to stay at and was just happy my parents were satisfied. Thank you so much Savas, Fernando and Luciana and hope to come to BA and have more memorable experiences. All the best.

Clean, quiet apartment in neighbourhood filled with many small and delicious restaurants. Never met Savas but were able to communicate electronically with his assistant Luciana. Apartment centrally located (and we enjoy walking) so usually walked to our destinations (and felt comfortable walking even in evening). Apartment is not far from subway (Subte) and on local bus routes, but with no Spanish we never figured out routes or costs. We would have appreciated info (in English) about how to use these services. As other guests mentioned, bed was short for my husband (1.9 meters). We had problems with shower head spraying in all directions, especially as no extra towels or mats for floor and no plug for bathtub.

My husband and I spent our honeymoon in Argentina, spending the last 4 days and 3 nights in Alejandra's San Telmo apartment. We LOVED the apartment, the location, and appreciated the attention to detail of Alejandra and the shared host, Hernan (who we met), to helping make our time in San Telmo extra special. Hernan greeted us upon arrival, kindly spoke to us in English as we have terrible Spanish (sorry, Hernan!), and gave us many recommendations of restaurants, bars, and general activities that might be special for us as honeymooners. The guidebooks, maps and information sheet provided by the host were very welcome and helpful.

The apartment is a great size and both it and the roof terrace are exactly as pictured. The only thing I noticed that was inconsistent with the information sheet is the recommendation/request that we leave the roof terrace door open, along with the apartment windows, to cool down and provide a breeze in the summer. While we would have been happy cooling down via a breeze on the hot days we were there, the screen on the upstairs terrace door was not installed and appears to be broken. To avoid mosquitos coming in to the apartment, we couldn't leave that door open at all. Mosquito repellant was provided and we used it up on the terrace with zero incidences of bites, but did have to use the AC to keep ourselves cool.

Overall, a wonderful experience. The location is prime--right across the street from the fabulous San Telmo Market--and the hosts were very kind and accommodating. Thank you!!
Great apartment with huge terrace, ideally located in the San Telmo area with lots of places to go out in just a few minutes. Hernan is the best ! Highly recommend.

Wir haben uns total wohlgefühlt in Alejandras Appartement.
Die Lage in San Telmo am Markt ist perfekt, gerne wieder !!

If I could clone any apartment it would be this one!! It’s adorable and EXACTLY as pictured. It’s in an amazing neighborhood with a brilliant market right across the street and walking distance to so many of the sites. I will say that I did have to fight with the hot water a bit but finally mastered it. I wish I could’ve stayed there longer than two nights but hopefully will be able to when I go back!!

As most other guests have said. The apartment is ideal in San Telmo. The roof terrace is fantastic the location opposite the San Telmo markets is a great place to shop for snacks, have a glass of wine. And there are many restaurants and options to sightsee within close proximity.

Such a great little apartment in San Telmo just steps to the market and the restaurants of San Telmo. If it’s Sunday enjoy the street fair in all its color. Gorgeous evenings on the rooftop deck for a late afternoon nap. Carolina was welcoming and gracious but also left us total privacy.

Really lovely apartment in an amazing location in San Telmo. We absolutely loved the rooftop and the courtyard is beautiful. The market across the street has great food and you can enjoy a milonga in Plaza Dorrego. Carolina was very helpful and friendly. Thanks for everything!

El departamento es muy lindo, es super acogedor y tal como se ve en la foto, es muy limpio y la entrada forrada de vegetación es una delicia. La cama es cómoda y es super tranquilo. La zona del apto está muy céntrica y cerca de transporte público, además el área es muy movida, hay muchas opciones para comer, tiendas de antiguedades, quiskos, fruterías, una plaza de mercado en la misma calle y un famoso bar de cervecería artesanal a unas pocas cuadras. Recomiendo este departamento ampliamente!

Alejandra was very responsive to the various questions we had before arriving and Carolina was a wonderful host while we were there.  The place was clean, cute, and in the perfect location for us to use as home-base while exploring the city for a week.  There were more shopping, eating, and places of cultural right in San Telmo than we expected so some days we stayed in the neighborhood.  Other days we walked to Recoleta, Palermo, and Monserrat for museums and taking in the street life.  We highly recommend this lovely apartment and location!

Clean and stylish home in the heart of San Telmo. It was just as beautiful as it appears in the photographs. You can walk to innumerable restaurants, bars and tourist locations. Even though it is very close to many excellent sights, it is still quiet and peaceful at night. Host and neighbor were very responsive and friendly. Highly recommend this home!

Alejandra's place was perfect for my final 2 nights in Buenos Aires. It is in a location super easy to walk, within minutes of incredible food! The apartment was clean and comfortable. The roof top deck was perfect for relaxing and reading a book. Alejandra was quick to reply to questions and even let me check out late as I had a night time flight.  I never met Alejandra as she was out of the country but her partner was wonderful! Super friendly, always easy to talk to if I needed anything. I would come back in an instant!
This home is adorable and in a perfect location! The rooftop deck is a perfect respite after a long day of life in Buenos Aires! Thanks so much.
Fabulous apartment in a great location.  Clean, secure, well appointed.  Carolina was a fantastic host, highly recommended.

Tremendous location if you want to experience the San Telmo area of Buenos Aires, one of the oldest parts of the city.  The apartment is as advertised, nice studio with all the essentials, and the rooftop terrace is a great plus for unwinding at the end of the day.

This apartment was very cute and the neighbor who checked us in was very helpful with tips for tourists and throughout our stay.  The location is perfect.  We visited all over BsAs and liked staying in San Telmo best.

We had a great time in the house although it was too cold to enjoy the outdoor terrace and parrilla. Very well located, it was fun to visit the San Telmo market just across the street and the restaurants and bars in the neighborhood. A true Porteño experience!

A nice apartment, central to city and san Telmo. The apartment was darker than we had excepted with not a lot of natural sunlight (we didn’t have great weather the whole time but still felt very dark). Lovely roof terrace to relax on.
Thank you!
This is a lovely apartment with a fantastic terrace. The location is excellent. A great place from which to explore the San Telmo neighbourhood and BA in general.  We would love to stay here again.
Excelente todo! 100% recomendable
Excelente ubicación! El apartamento es tal cual las fotos. La terraza es increíble. La comunicación con Alejandra inmejorable! Repetiré sin duda.

Excepcional el apartamento, lo mejor súper tranquilo y a la ves hay todo al rededor y cerca de todo , los vecinos geniales , el baño súper cómodo con agua espectacular , la distribución del apto es súper cómoda y privada , un lujo y súper cálido . Gracias

This is such a great location in San Telmo if you want an authentic experience and love the San Telmo Market.  Hernan and Alejandra were great hosts and were very attentive with our questions and helpful suggestions.  This is a great home away from home!

Great place in the heart of San Telmo, wonderful terrace and a wine shop directly across the street. Tons of great bars and restaurants right outside your door. Safe and secure. Very nice hosts. Highly recommend.
Great place, Great host, Great Experience

We had a great stay at Alejandra‘s place in BA... The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures, the San Telmo market is just 2min away & you can get fresh bread, fruits and food across the street! Also the kitchen is well equipped, the bed comfy and the stay very relaxed... perfect place to explore the city - we would go again!
Appartement très agréable, conforme à la description. Le quartier est plein de bars et de restaurants, et l'accueil fut des plus chaleureux. Je reviendrais dans hésiter.

We felt very lucky to have stayed in this apartment.
From the moment we arrived in the courtyard it felt like it's own little oasis.
Check in was so easy - Hernan was there to greet us even though we arrived later than expected. He had some great recommendations for food and info on the buses .
The rooftop terrace was great.
The apartment is comfortable and well appointed - great to have a good washing machine.
Wonderful location - only steps away from the San Telmo market. great restaurants (Des Nivel and Saigon were two of our favourites). Great coffee at Coffee Town in the market.

O apartamento é muito bem localizado. Em frente ao mercado de San Telmo , um bairro com muitos antiquários, artesanato e restaurantes. A feira de San Telmo aos domingos fica ao lado do apartamento. Pode-se ir para os principais pontos turísticos a pé. O apartamento é confortável, suficiente para duas pessoas e a recepção de Hernán foi acolhedora, simpática e nos deu excelentes dicas de passeios e restaurantes. Não cheguei a conhecer Alejandra, mas fiquei muito contente com a estadia. Voltaria lá diversas vezes.

One could not ask for a better location in Buenos Aires. The apartment was comfortable and the terrace a faboulous space to relax with some food and wine after a busy day touring.     It was a pleasure to meet Hernan, who assists Alexandra welcoming guests. We loved our stay here!

Alejandra’s place is beautiful as you can see at the pictures.

Located in the San Telo neighboorhood where you can find antiqueshops, nice bars and restaurants and the lovely San Telo market across the street.

Recommended!
Perfect stay in Buenos Aires!

What a wonderful experience here! When we arrived, we were given tonnes of local tips, but passed out for two hours because the bed was so comfortable! There really is so much to do from this location - especially if you're here for the Sunday market - it's right outside! Lots of beautiful restaurants within such a short distance. Safety was never a concern here, which made my wife feel much better. I'd absolutely recommend this place to anyone. Thanks for a great stay!
As San Telmo as it gets. Market across the street, cafes bars and restaurants around and the bbq on the terrace is the icing on the cake
The place is lovely, we liked it so much we would love to come back in the future.
Toatally recommended. Nice people around the apartment :)
great place! love the bbq on the roof!

In Bezug auf das In-Viertel San Telmo absolut einzigartige Lage. Vis-a-vis der Markt San Telmo mit Cafes, Bars, Restaurants, vielen Antik- und Trödelshops und individuellen Geschäften. Einzigartig: Sonntags San Telmo Antiques Fair direkt nebenan. Mitten im Leben und  Dank der Innenhoflage der Wohnung mit wunderbarer Dachterrasse trotzdem sehr ruhige Lage.
Great place to stay, no complaints
You could not ask for a better location.  Alejandra’s patio is amazing and every amenity you could want is a stones throw away from her place.  San Telmo is a gem.
Thanks for a great, clean, and safe place to stay!
Great apartment in a great spot. We would gladly stay there again. Alejandra's neighbour Hernan was a great host and local tip provider too!

The apartment is nice and well located. We loved the upstairs terrace the most. San Telmo is a safe and charming historical suburb which is definitely worth a visit.
Hernan, the neighbor, will be your point of communication when you arrive. He is easily available next door (his terrace is adjacent) and provided us with useful tips to get around.
Este departamento es MÁGICO. Altamente recomendado.

Alejandra’s place was an absolute dream. The location was ideal - located in the heart of San Telmo, right across from the famous San Telmo market. The apartment is decorated beautifully and there’s nothing better than enjoying a glass of wine on the gorgeous private roof terrace. Alejandra was very easy to communicate with and we were able to drop our bags off very early in the morning, allowing us to explore the city before checking in. I couldn’t recommend this place more highly.

The apartment is beautifull, well located, and perfect to discover Buenos Aires on foot from that location. Bars and Restaurant near by are excellent. There is a mall across the street and the street became a flee market on sunday’s.
Also, the private balcony is worth every penny! Merci Alejandra and Hernan

Das Apartment von Alejandra liegt absolut ideal direkt beim San Telmo Market und vielen Restaurants. Wir haben die Gegend als sehr sicher empfunden.
Wir wurden herzlich empfangen und haben viele Tips für unseren 5tägigen Aufenthalt erhalten.
Die Wohnung ist hübsch und zweckmässig eingerichtet. Es hat alles was man braucht, sogar eine Flasche guten Rotwein als Geschenk.
Das beste aber ist die Terrasse! Die gemütliche Lounge lädt zum Lesen und geniessen eine.
Sehr zu empfehlen!

Alejandra is a thoughtful, lovely host and her apartment is wonderful.  Hernan lives next door and is available to answer any questions.  He's delightful. The apartment location is the best in San Telmo.  The Mercado across the street has delicious food options, Coffee Town bread and croissants are perfect.  The apartment is so comfortable, quiet at night, super comfortable bed and every amenity.  The patio is great for a late afternoon glass of wine or for starting the day with coffee and  fresh juice.  Thank you, Alejandra and Hernan, my wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our visit!

We spent several days of our honeymoon based out of Alejandra’s place. We felt very taken care of and loved having this cozy getaway to ourselves. We especially enjoyed the location - we walked across the street for fresh bread, empanadas, and fruit at the San Telmo Market nearly every day. We were also able to easily get taxis and walked to lots of the sights from there.
Beautiful apartment in a great location.  Highly recommended!

What can I say about Alejandra's place that has not been said? I've lived my entire life in Buenos Aires and when I moved abroad and came back for Christmas I decided to stay in San Telmo and it was an amazing experience.
This place is right across the San Telmo market, where you can buy lots of stuff including fresh fruit. There are so many options for dinner and lunch in the same area that you can eat at a different place every day. On Sundays you have the San Telmo feria one block away but you won't get bothered with people on the street where you live, which is nice.
The apartment itself is quite comfortable and has everything you need to cook every day in case you don't want to go out.
The rooftop of course is the icing in the cake.. if you are up to the challenge, you can try your bbq skills or you can just chill in the couch and have some mates.
Communication with the neighbours was fast and comfortable. Thanks for everything!

Ruy, очень гостеприимный и отзывчивый человек.
Говорит на английском языке, а для нас это очень важно. В квартире есть все необходимое, место удобное и тихое.
Отдельная благодарность Ruy за помощь в решении наших вопросов. Рекомендую!

C'est un très bel appartement dans lequel nous avons été hébergé en plein centre de Buenos Aires ! Lumineux et bien aménagé. Idéal pour 2 personnes. Et cerise sur le gâteau, Ruy est un hôte attentionné, de bons conseils et très disponible. Merci !

Joli et lumineux appartement avec une belle terrasse. De plus, Ruy est un hôte particulièrement attentionné qui nous a renseigné sur les bons plans et s'est proposé pour nous chercher/amener à notre départ/arrivée. Une chouette expérience, merci!

This was an excellent place to stay, very close to the obelisco. Owner is very polite and speaks perfect English. Not only was the apartment in fantastic condition, it was nice and quiet. From the balcony there are great views over the capital. I will definitely be staying here again on my next trip to Buenos Aires.
Ruy es un gran anfitrión, Muy atento y siempre dispuesto a colaborar. El apartamento es muy lindo y bien ubicado. Todo muy recomendable

Loved the sunny balcony and big windows! Very secure building. Ruy is very kind and speaks perfect english and spanish. I will definitely stay here again next time I am in the area. Lots of yummy places to eat  nearby and there is a small market just next door for connivence.
Ruy was the perfect host - very reliable and friendly! He gave us good tips for restaurants close to the apartment and anything we needed to know. Very recomended!

Reservei o apartamento do Ruy para meu pai e sua namorada. Eles passaram 4 noites e simplesmente adoraram! Contaram que o Ruy foi super atencioso e que o apartamento é bem o que mostra nas fotos. Eu e o Ruy mantivemos contato o tempo todo por mensagens, e ele me deu um super apoio em organizar esta viagem para os dois. Inclusive indo buscá-los no aeroporto, que infelizmente, devido a uma troca da companhia aérea, foi uma ida perdida. Meu pai e a namorada adoraram a localização e as conveniências perto do apartamento. Espero em breve eu mesma poder ir passar uns dias no ap do Ruy. Muito obrigada pelo carinho e pela atenção. Abraços

Ruy was an exceptional host! His apartment was in a great location easily accessible to many of the main attractions in Buenos Aires. The apartment was a great place to rest after a long day of walking and the balcony view was amazing! As a host Ruy was quick to respond to all of my questions and was very helpful in guiding me to places to visit. I know that if I'm ever in Buenos Aires again I will look to stay here again. Thanks again for everything Ruy!

Ruy nous a très bien reçu. C'est un hôte généreux, sympathique et très cordial. Il a pris le temps de nous suggérer des activités et des restaurants du quartier. L'appartement est central, pas très loin des avenues Belgrano, De Mayo et 9 De Julio. L'appartement n'est pas très grand, mais très ensoleillé et très propre. Nous vous suggérons fortement Ruy! Merci!

The balcony view is spectacular and the apartment was very clean, charming, and well-stocked.   I slept so well in the comfy bed.   Ruy was a fantastic host!  He went out of his way to make sure we had everything we needed and gave some great insider's tips on Buenos Aires.  He even gave us a ride to our ferry!  We hope to stay again someday!

O apartamento está conforme anunciado. Eu e minha esposa fomos atendidos super bem. O Ruy foi prestativo a todo momento e durante nossa estadia manteve contato.
Ele passou algumas dicas da cidade e a localização do apartamento é muito boa.
Por ser um elevador antigo, o mesmo faz muito barulho e o ruído chega até o apartamento quando outros o utilizam.
É a primeira vez na cidade e recomendo.

El apto es muy acogedor y exactamente como fue descrito en el anuncio. Gente muy educada y con muy buena disposición. }
Seguramente vuelva a confiar en ellos para mi próxima visita a Bs As.

We had such a nice time during our visit in Buenos Aires. Our experience with this Funky & Stylish Apartment in Palermo could not have gone any better. We really felt like part of the neighborhood and the check-in and check-out process went very smooth. Savas was very accommodating and the condo was just like it looks in the pictures. It was the perfect place for a couple to stay. We also really enjoyed that there was a beautiful swimming pool area that we could use as it was VERY hot when we were visiting. The area that this condo is in, is truly the best area in Buenos Aires. It was easy to walk around and find restaurants and shops as well as access to the subte. It was also very quiet which was nice when we wanted to go to bed. We wish we could have stayed longer! We highly recommend this condo for anyone who visits Buenos Aires.

We really enjoyed to be in the appartement. everything was clean and the fotos are real. Perfect A/C during the hot time in summer. The location is perfect to go out for dinning and enjoying day and night. We felt always vey secure with the porter on the front office.

Apartment is well located in the right neighborhood.
It is not for 4 persons (extra small coach-bed): 2 is a max and the pictures makes it bigger as it is really. Close neighbor vis-a-vis. Good air conditioning. Safe building.
Main point is that the apartment definitely lacks maintenance : old and spotted linens (towels, sheets, pillows), missing or dis functioning curtains, spotted sofa, dirty bathroom seals...
which doesn't give a good impression of this place.
Low value for money.

Situado apartamento moderno y muy bien en el barrio de Palermo, situación calma, estudio funcional, piscina, sala de fitness y sauna a disposición. Internet wifi O.k. Éramos 2 adultos y un niño, comercios y un restaurante en las cercanías
Acogida muy buena de Lucianna para nuestra llegada, excelente dirección, a recomendar vivamente.

Great location! You will find everything you need just a short walk away including the metro (subte)
The apartment is just as described. The curtains are great!!! No light gets through so sleeping during the day is no problem.
Has a nice pool too.
Check in and check out went very smoothly. All my emails were answered very fast as well.
I would definitely recommend this apartment!

The photos do not lie, Savas has a very nice studio/one-bed, brilliantly presented in a very nice, clean building in the heart of Soho. It was a perfect base for us to enjoy one of our favourite places in the world - so many great bars, restaurants, cafes, shops five minutes from our doorstep. Check in was very easy, with the building's superintendent aware of our arrival and Savas' agent waiting for us outside the building. Check out was equally hassle-free. We would highly recommend a stay here. It's such great value too.
We had a great time and everything was fine. It is a nice and really quiet place in the middle of Palermo. Communication and reception were excellent!

The location is great, not far from the subway. We loved the neighborhood (a lot of nice graffiti), very calm and safe. We feel like home because it dosn't seem very touristic. The restaurant Wasabi's is a must do for the sushis lovers (and it's like 2 minutes walk from the studio). It was clean, and functional. It's good to have a lot of advices books for Buenos Aires.

But it's not a big place (well, it IS a 48m2) and the bed is a bit small when you're tall.

Neighbors were noisy by night and if you do'nt close the curtains, you are seen by the neighbors opposite. Also there is a dog barking on the same floor.

Advice for the host: It would be better to have more than one toilet paper and one trash bag for one week.

Excelente estadía en Bs As! El apto es tal cual las imágenes, equipado con todo, y el edificio es muy seguro. El portero es muy buena onda. Una de las mejores ubicaciones de la ciudad. Savas muy buen anfitrión y su staff nos recibió muy bien. Seguro vamos a volver.

El apartamento es tal cual como en las fotos, esta muy bien equipado y el edificio es muy seguro.
Esta muy bien ubicado todo a la mano.
Tanto Savas como Luciana, son muy buenos anfitriones, recomendado el sitio.
Volvere.

O apartamento é como o anúnciado, é pequeno porém bem mobiliado e tudo funciona corretamente, mas as tomadas são bem diferentes das brasileiras. Tivemos um problema com a luz em um dos dias da viagem, algo que o porteiro poderia ter resolvido mas era final de semana e ele não trabalhava... no entanto quando entramos em contato com o Savas ele foi muito solicito e resolveu rapidamente. Savas é um ótimo anfitrião. O porteiro 24hrs não fica 24hrs. O apartamento é pequeno para 4 adultos, indicaria melhor para uma família com crianças. E os vizinhos tem cachorros, porém não gostam de barulho, e não são receptivos a turmas de jovens. O bairro é seguro, e há muitos restaurantes por perto, também há mercado e quitanda, fica perto do plaza serrano onde há barzinhos a noite e boates, no domingo tem uma feirinha muito bacana, e em tudo isso dá pra ir andando. Amamos a localização.

Fantastic location. Great host. Fab apartment.
All in a wonderful city. What else could you ask for.
Highly recommended.
Fue una buena experiencia. Muy lindo apartamento en general.
Nice clean, modern apt in a great location right in Palermo Soho. Definitely recommend to anyone traveling to BA.

This apartment was clean, cute and cozy. We were met at our arrival and showed around and everything was explained to us. And our host was available to answer any questions we had about the apartment and the city. The apartment had more than enough clean bed sheets, towels and everything was as described. The kitchen was stocked with everything necessary. Fantastic apartment in a great location. THANK YOU Ruy!
Ruy was very responsive and helpful. He's clearly eager to make your experience in the city a special one. Thank you, Ruy.

Staying at Ruy's place was fantastic. It is located in a great area, and it is very easy to get around from here. There is a really nice balcony, an easy to use kitchen and it is generally a great place. Ruy was easy to communicate with and helped make the stay better. I would love to stay here again.
Ruy speaks excellent English and is really very helpful! His apartment is centrally located in the heart of the city and is very clean! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Buenos Aires!

Terrific central location in the friendly local neighbourhood of Monserrat. Spacious character apartment with a roomy balcony offering a unique view of the city just as was described. We were nicely welcomed by the host's mother as the host was overseas at the time.  We would like to stay here again when we next visit Buenos Aires.

Ruy's apartment is just in the right location for a city trip to BA, the private balcony is a charm and his mother who welcomed us is such a lovely person speaking the most amazing English in all BA. Ruy knows everything about South America and is eager to share. Will be back every time we stay in BA!

Ruy was an amazing host during our visit to Buenos Aires.  His home is located within walking distance from San Telmo, as well as the subway which is a great way to access all of BA.  The room was clean and comfortable, and offered an amazing view overlooking the city from a 6th floor balcony.  Thank you Ruy, we couldn't have asked for a better host!

Ruy was waiting at the apartment to welcome us, and quickly ran through the important need to know items.  The apartment was very comfortable with separate bedroom, small kitchen, lounge and balcony which we loved.
One of the best AirBnbs I have ever been to. Phenomenal in so many ways.
We had a really nice time in the apartment. The host was super kind and we enjoyed the market and other recommend places to go. Thank you for having us!
Lo recomendo. Tan cerca del centro y tan agradable.
Kleines Paradies in san telmo- perfekter Ort für Buenos Aires zu erkunden, der alte Markt direkt vor der Haustür. Einfach wunderbar

Wonderful spot in San Telmo! Clean, charming, well-equipped space with an amazing rooftop terrace. Alejandra and Carolina were also very responsive and helpful with info on the unit and neighborhood. Great stay; thanks again!

WOW, This place is absolutely fantastic! Simply Amazing! If we could give it more than 5 stars we would have!

You are going to love, love, love the location! San Telmo is such a great place, and this apartment location couldn’t have been better. Close to mercardo San Telmo and that is a huge plus! Need almost anything, its there?! From morning coffee and medialunas to fresh fruits and vegetables, meats, sandwiches, beer and wine, snacks, flowers, clothing, antiques, etc,etc,etc! Amazing place and right across the street.

Now to the apartment. We have stayed all over the world in Airbnb’s and this is by far our most favorite place ever! The decor is super cool. Bedding and bathroom amenities were five star. The rooftop terrace was what brought us there, and it did not disappoint. Very, very chill place to relax and hang out. Nice view and just a super amenity you don’t see much.

The hosts are so nice and quick to communicate, and were cool to hang out with and talk to! Easy to get there, easy to check in, easy and fun place to stay!

We highly recommend this apartment and are so very much looking forward to coming back again!
Muy lindo lugar. Ubicación ideal, un pequeño oasis de tranquilidad en el corazón de San Telmo.  Muchas gracias
Great location, great host, great apartment - all you can wish for in an airbnb!
Alejandra (and Carolina) are real superhosts. Stunning apartment combined with warm welcoming, regardful attitude of the host are introducing San Telmo at it’s best!

Amazing location, easy check in which was great after long travel... beautiful terrace to take afternoon siestas on. Read the directions about hot water, but besides that, a great stay for a few nights or however long!

We loved this convenient location for all that San Telmo has to offer.  For being in the middle of a very large city, her place was very quiet!  And the rooftop patio was lovely to have snacks and Malbec before going to dinner.  Having a washing machine and clothes drying rack was another plus.  The on site person,  Carolina, spoke English well and was very available for questions and tips.  We would stay here again, for sure😀
Super location! Good host!

Absolutely amazing place! We stayed for a week and loved every minute of it. The terrace is incredible—ideal for enjoying your morning coffee or a glass of wine in the evening. We couldn’t have asked for a better location, across the street from the market, and close to so many great restaurants, shops and bars. We arrived early in the morning and were able to leave our bags at the apartment prior to check in which was so nice. Carolina was so helpful during our stay  too. Highly recommend!

San Telmo is an attractive city with pop art, with an antique market open every Sunday. Also, there are many bars that are open until late, and there are also many theaters where you can enjoy tango shows. The house is located in the center of San Telmo, with a very quiet and amazing beautiful relaxing space. The rooftop is another attraction of this house. Host response is quick and super friendly. Recommended for those who want a meaningful stay in San Telmo.
EXCELLENT
Nice place, great location, wonderful hostess, good value!

Beautiful an apartment in one of the oldest neighborhoods of Buenos Aires! Apartment was sparkling clean with everything you need. It has beautiful deck exactly as described, and even more beautiful in person! We will definitely be back again.

Alejandra's place has a cool vibe with a nice terrace view of the city skyline at night. You're close by local pubs and the famous San Telmo market. It's a nice little place that is simple for the average minimalist. I had no problems at all and would recommend it.
Absolutely stunning flat with an amazing rooftop balcony in San Telmo! The perfect location right next to the market and close to public transit. Would highly recommend and will definitely come back!

Savas was very welcoming and was flexible with our awkward arrival time. Everything was as described in the listing, and the building manager made us feel equally welcome whenever we would greet him. We felt very cared for throughout our stay as we had an open line of communication with our host, and a very thorough neighborhood, city, and building guidebook were provided at the apartment.
The location is also terrific for this apartment. So walkable to the city's best dining, nightlife, shopping, and parks, and very central for taxis or public transit. Would highly recommend this space to any traveler or pair!
Great apartment in a lovely neighborhood. Sava's offers a clean and calm refugee in the busy Palermo area, including sauna, gym and a pool. Would definitely stay there again.

A great apartment in a fantastic location. The building is also very nice and has good amenities. I'd definitely stay at this apartment again. Additionally, the host's been great, very accommodating and helpful. Really nice people. Highly recommendable.

It was perfect. The flat is great: airy, sunny, clean and fresh, with everything you need inside (more kitchen utensils than I have at home..). The location really can't get any better -plus totally safe and full of nice places, a plus as I was travelling on my own.
The host even took care of my health and recommended a clinic to check a skin infection!
Luciana and Fernando took care of all the details, arranged for taxis (Julian, very nice local driver) and gave advice on where to go.
Thanks Sava/ Cleo and team!

The apartment is great and in a wonderful location. The area is totally safe and has a ton of fun things to do within walking distance - bars , restaurants, park, etc.
There is also a modest work out area and a pool.
Luciana who works with Savas, met us the day we arrived and was very helpful in showing us everything.
One thing I'd recommend is saving 2 peso coins to do your laundry with - sometimes they are tough to find but we had no problems asking cabs and supermarkets for them.

This flat ROCKS if you are looking for a place that is smack dab in the middle of Palermo Soho!

Savas is a wonderful host.
The place is definitely snug for 4 guests, but perfect for 2.

;)

The description was accurate and the apartment was well-kept. Convenient location to the hip area of Palermo with lots of restaurants and bars nearby. Ms. Luciana was readily available to address any concerns!

Wonderful apartment! Had everything that we could have wanted to make our time in Argentina as pleasurable as possible. We were greeted as we arrived and was given a full rundown of the Palermo neighborhood and Buenos Aires as a whole. This was extremely helpful and got us started on the right foot. We could not have had a better time!

We were welcomed by Luciana who was very helpful to explain the apartment, building and neighbourhood. The apartment was as described, lots of light, comfortable and clean.

It is small..studio like so the bedroom is not totally private, ideal for one person or a couple. The couch in the living room makes into a bed if you don't sleep together but that makes it a bit cramped. The kitchen is equipped with the basics. Stores are very close and the location is great..

Apartment is really central in de Palermo barrio. Easy to get around with Subte (Plaza Italia) and the collectivos (busses). Apartment is cozy and suitable for 2 persons. It fits all important needs (including gym and pool). Two things that could be improved. 1. Sound: You can hear your neighbours. We had to reach out and ask to lower the volume. 2. Bed: Matress seems a bit old and used. Overall we had an OK experience. Savas and his assistent are really approachable and returned to our messages within the hour. And we have been welcomed by the assistent of Savas, which is also important.

Savas' appartment is the greatest thing ever in Palermo. Perfect size, well stocked with everything you need and there was great communication with him and his adequate assistant. Would recommend this place to everyone!

We loved our stay at Savas's apartment! The location is perfect - a walkable distance from many of the best restaurants/activities/bars BA has to offer. The building was modern, beautiful, safe, and had plenty of accommodations to make our stay even better. The apartment was comfortable and had everything one could need for an enjoyable time. We would recommend it to anyone!

Savas's assistant Luciana made us feel right at home and was always available if we needed anything! They did everything to accommodate us when our flight to Buenos Aires arrived late. The apartment looked exactly like the pictures - very clean, spacious and comfortable. The building was very also very nice, modern, and safe. The location was absolutely perfect, located in the heart of the lively neighborhood of Palermo Soho and walking distance to amazing restaurants, cafes, and shops! We would recommend this apartment to anyone!
Tivemos uma ótima estadia!! Fomos recebidos pela Luciana, que foi super simpática e solícita. O apartamento é lindo, limpo e muito bem localizado. Super indico!!!

Somos una familia de Mendoza, Argentina, estuvimos cinco días alojados y verdaderamente nos vamos muy conformes con el depto. Tenía todo lo necesario para pasar unos días geniales, tiene todo lo que se ve en las imágenes y todavía un poco más.
El lugar está estratégicamente ubicado para moverse por Buenos Aires en transporte público, caminando o en auto. También en los alrededores hay mucho para visitar, comprar y pasear con mucha seguridad.

Somos una familia de Cordoba y estuvimos 7 días en el departamento. y la experiencia fue excelente en todo sentido.

Savas y Luciana se encargaron de toda la comunicación inicial via mail y después tuvimos contacto directo con Natalia y Fernando (el portero), todos fueron muy amables y siempre dispuestos a ayudarnos a que la pasemos bien.

El departamento es exactamente como se lo describe y como se ve en las fotos, resulta quizás un poco chico para una familia como nosotros con dos niños, pero los ambientes son muy prácticos y bien pensados. Todo en la habitación y en el edificio en general es de gran calidad.

La ubicación es inmejorable porque es una zona muy tranquila de bares y restaurantes con gente normal caminando por las calles hasta muy tarde. En un radio de 5 manzanas hay gran cantidad de restaurantes muy buenos que pudimos disfrutar con mi familia para cenar yendo y volviendo a pie. Actualmente en esas cuadras hay casi un policía en cada esquina así que la zona se siente y es muy segura.

Nosotros fuimos en auto y hay varios estacionamientos para dejarlo por las noches, al menos 2 que vi en un radio de dos cuadras, uno por Thames a 1 cuadra del depto y otro por Costa Rica a 2 cuadras.

Muchas gracias por todo y seguramente volveríamos a usar este departamento si tuviéramos que volver a Buenos Aires.

I surely recommend Savas' place. The apartment is like in the pictures and Palermo is definitely the place to stay.
Savas and Luciana were very easy to communicate with and everything was fine, plus Fernando the janitor of the building is super helpful. We had only one minor problem with the safe that could not be fixed, but it was not a big deal at all. Bring earplugs because the neighbours can be noisy.
Alejandra’s place was the perfect location for my first visit to Buenos Aires.  I enjoyed the hospitality, neighbourhood and amazing community and would absolutely visit again!

Muy atractivo departamento, amplio, con lindos muebles y buenas instalaciones, todo como en la descripción y las fotos. La terraza una verdadera joya, lamentablemente no la pudimos disfrutar mucho por el tiempo. La ubicación re agradable en medio de San Telmo, además tranquila, con vecinos muy amables. Carolina la co-anfitriona es muy buena onda, re amable, muchas gracias por todo Carolina! 100% recomendable!
Ale apartment is cozy, clean and super well located, Carolina was a great host, I highly recommend this place with a such enthusiasm, thanks for everything girls, and see you next time!

Alejandra's place is charming. Very beautiful on the inside, minimal, clean, and comfortable. The deck up top is as nice as the pictures, and even the walkway coming into the apartment is covered in greenery. I recommend it if you'll be in the area.

Great place to stay, super clean and tidy, with a lovely terrace and quite close to a lot of beautiful places. Ideal to relax and get to know a bit about lovely San Telmo. The hosts are great and willing to help at all times. We certainly had a pleasant experience and we plan to come back sometime. Totally recommended!
Lovely place with nice outdoor space in great neighborhood. Carolina next door was very responsive and super helpful with tips, recommendations, etc. Definitely recommend.
Beautiful place in a wonderful location in the heart of San Telmo. The rooftop terrace is a unique bonus. Alejandra's place was fabulous, and would definitely consider staying again!
Great location ,Personable host ,best equipped kitchen in any Airbnb we have been in.

Alejandra's place was really wonderfully located across the street from the San Telmo market and around the corner from the Sunday street feria. We loved spending a couple of days exploring Buenos Aires from this location. Her neighbor, Caroline, was always quick to help with any questions and for check-in. We were grateful for being able to leave our bags before check-in also!

This place was in a perfect location for first time visitors to Buenos Aires..Great restaurants and antique shopping on every corner of the neighborhood.  Kitchen had everything you could possibly want and the views from the rooftop were awesome.  Highly recommend

Precioso apartamento con una inmejorable ubicación en el corazón de San Telmo. La cuadra es muy segura, frente por frente al mercado. El alojamiento es tal cual se describe y se muestra en el anuncio, con una cocina amplia y completa, baño y living muy confortable. En el 2do piso una increíble terraza con parrillero y sillones para tomar sol. La atención de Carolina y Alejandra fue muy buena y la comunicación muy rápida. Lo recomendamos !

A great spot!  I was on a work trip and wanted a couple days in this neighborhood to see another part of the city.  You really can't find a better location to explore San Telmo.  This is across the street from the market, around the corner from Plaza Dorrego.  There is a supermarket nearby, wine shops, tango spots, great restaurants, etc.  I really enjoyed the rooftop patio, where you can have a gorgeous view of the rooftops at sunset.  I was able to cook with the well equipped kitchen.  The bed is comfy and the place was clean.  Thanks for a lovely stay!
Ruy is a very amiable host, thoroughly professional and generally very easy to have to do with. We were pleasantly surprised by the apartment and had a great stay there. Highly recommended!

Ruy was the perfect host. He was very helpful, attentive and he made sure I was fully informed with the workings of the flat and the neighbourhood. The flat is incredible for the price, and I enjoyed my stay a lot. Thanks Ruy!

Ruy was the perfect host. Knowledgable about the city and surroundings and giving me directions and ideas regarding restaurants and bars. The unit was clean with great views of the city. A great stay and wished I stayed longer.
Ruy is a very knowledgable host who gave us a perfect welcome. We couldn't have asked for more.

Ruy was very knowledgeable about the city and had a lot of great suggestions for us during our visit.  He was very welcoming and even offered airport transportation for comparable fare to a cab, which was lovely.  He showed us around the apartment, which had an incredible view of the city from the balcony.  Lots of windows throughout the apartment to let in sunshine and a breeze to make a hot summer night in BA more comfortable.  The apartment is centrally located, just steps away from all of the best neighborhoods in Buenos Aires.
Ruy is the perfect guide and made the plan even for the person like me who could stay only for the 36 hour. He made my stay very special. Hope I can stay in his room and meet up again.

The apartment is sunny, spacious and the terrace is huge. Even though the location is very central, the apartment itself is very quiet, especially at night. All necessary equipment is provided in the kitchen. Ruy is a great, very corteous host. Communication is always pleasant and he is a great source for infos on the city or travelling in Argentina. We had a wonderful time in the apartment. Highly recommended!

Pasamos unos días preciosos en el apartamento de Savas. Luciana nos atendió de forma excelente, permitiéndonos ingresar un poco antes del horario del check in y retirarnos unas horas luego del check out.

El apartamento estaba en buenas condiciones y muy limpio. Tiene las características que se indican en la publicación: aire acondicionado, cable, wifi con muy buen alcance y sobre todo, algo no menor, es que el agua caliente nunca se termina.

Está igual a la fotos. Nosotros eramos 4 personas y para pasar unos días está bien. Si es para más tiempo, quizás resulte más cómo solo para dos personas. Aunque el sillón y la cama marinera eran muy cómodas.

El edificio es muy nuevo, con posibilidad de acceder al gym, sauna y parrilla. Es muy seguro, con varias modalidades de seguridad. Muy tranquilo y sin ruidos.

Barrio tranquilo, cercano a subte y transporte hacia varios lugares turísticos, a 4 cuadras de plaza serrano y 5 de santa fé. Muchas ofertas gastronómicas y de boliches, así como supermercados y tiendas de ropa.

Recomiendo el apto y volvería a ir.

Gracias!
Sds
El departamento está muy bien ubicado, a pasos del centro y de la locomoción. Tiene una linda vista  a la ciudad.

Awesome location, clean, great patio and the apartment had everything we needed. Ruy was a fantastic host, super friendly, gave us some great recommendations for things to check out, and kindly picked us up from the airport. Would recommend for sure. Thanks again!
Perfect location in the city. Nice apartment, with a fantastic terrasse and a great view, which really makes you feel you are there ! Very friendly and arranging host. Perfect !

El departamento fue confortable y acorde con las expectativas. Muy cómodo y con los elementos necesarios para estar. Ruy fue muy amable y ha estado a disposición por cualquier necesidad. Recomendable.

Die wohnung liegt in perfekter Lage zentrumsnah. Die Wohnung an sich ist sauber und hat einen grossen Balkon mit schöner Aussicht. Ruy hatte viele super Empfehlungen für Veranstaltungen und Restaurants in der Stadt.

El departamento es todo lo que el anuncio promociona. Muy cómodo, limpio y en una excelente ubicación.
Ruy es muy amable y presto a ofrecer información y ayuda.
El depto divino, los anfitriones muy amables, la zona perfecta para compras, salir a cenar y cerca de todo.

Con esta es la segunda vez que pasamos unos días en este departamento y sin dudas volveríamos en otra ocasión.
Tanto la atención como el departamento mismo, siguen siendo altamente recomendables.

My husband and I had a great time in BA. Saves' apartment is in a good part of time and is nice and secure. His assistant met us there and was really friendly and showed us how everything worked. Mariano's apartment is in a nicely restored old building with beautiful wood floors, lovely tall French doors opening into a pretty balcony overlooking the street, a nice living room, dining room and loft. It was a brilliant base for exploring San Telmo as well as Plaza de Mayo and a short bus ride away from La Boca. The neighborhood is a bit rough but it's safe during the day and we really enjoyed the vintage atmosphere of San Telmo. While I enjoyed the location and found the apartment spacious and beautiful, I would hesitate to stay here again. First of all It did not feel very clean, the kitchen sink and bathroom had unpleasant odors and there were tiny bugs and a small spider web under the sofa bed in the living room. The apartment, the furniture and other amenities definitely look more "worn" than in the pictures. Second there was no sound proofing in the upstairs loft and I was able to very clearly hear our neighbors' conversations for 2 days in a row. This was in addition to the street noise. Finally when we had any issues, such as with the wifi, the apartment was too hot or when we needed to make a phone call (no phone service in the apartment even though there was a phone), it was hard to find Zuni (Mariano was out of town during our stay).

Elbio es un excelente anfitrión, siempre atento a lo que necesites y dispuesto a hacer de tu estadía perfecta. Totalmente recomendado.

San Telmo is a great neighborhood to feel like a local.

Mitten in San Telmo, gegenüber dem berühmten Markt, liegt diese Wohnung. Man kommt durch einen kühlen, begrünten Innenhof über eine Aussentreppe in die Wohnung und fühlt sich gleich sicher und geborgen. Wir wurden freundlich mit einer Flasche Wein empfangen. Nach anstrengenden Stadttouren ist man dort wie zu Hause. Die Wohnung ist sehr liebevoll eingerichtet, und auf der Dachterasse hat man einen Blick über die Stadt.
Es wäre schön, wenn es zusätzlich zu dem großen, schweren Eisengestell mit Polstern noch eine gemütliche Sonnenliege gäbe, die man in den Schatten rücken könnte.
Der Kontakt war problemlos, Carolina hat uns freundlich empfangen und uns alles erklärt. Es war hilfreich, die Subtekarte für die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel benutzen zu können, die sie uns gab. Die Wohnung war sauber, nach einer Woche gab es neue frische Handtücher. Carolina war jederzeit ansprechbar und gab uns gute Tipps für Veranstaltungen in der Gegend. Von der Straße hörte man nur am Wochenende etwas, wenn es dort etwas lauter und fröhlich zuging. Das hat uns aber nicht so gestört, etwas störend waren manchmal die Geräusche und Gerüche von den direkten Nachbarn. Man lebt sehr eng nebeneinander und bei geöffneten Fenstern nimmt man so am Leben der Nachbarn teil, die aber sehr rücksichtsvoll waren. Wir würden gerne wieder kommen und empfehlen die Wohnung auf jeden Fall.
Amazing. I would absolutely stay here again.

I highly recommend this Airbnb as an alternative to a boutique hotel in another part of the city.

Highly recommended!
