The apartment looks like very similar to the photos but some additional maintenance is desirable (lights in the kitchen are off and you have water in the floor when using the bidet in the bathroom). Service is very kind but unfortunately I had to ask to change linen on arrival ...... Not perfect but nice to stay

to be honest one of the main reasons why I chose this apartment was its host (apart from the great terrace view) - I liked the description I read at Airbnb. And it fully paid off. I'm very grateful to Ruy who met me at the airport and brought me back when it was needed so I did not have any headache at all + I really appreciate everything I learned from him during these trips - that always makes a difference. Additionally Ruy is very responsive so you would never feel yourself abandoned and your questions would be responded very quickly.
Un departamento amplio, con excelente vista y un balcon grande. Bien unicado y su dueño es cordial y responde rápido.

Très agréable appart tout en haut d'un immeuble, pratique, propre, confortable, bon wifi, belle vue, bon emplacement ... tout était absolument parfait !
Ruy est extrêmement sympathique, très réactif aux messages, toujours la pour aider... un hôte parfait !
Le quartier est très sympa et vous êtes à 2 minutes du subte !
Parfait sur tous les plans ! Merci pour tout !

Ruy was a great guide and gave us fantastic recommendations for all of Argentina! He was very welcoming and the apartment was clean and had an awesome view. Not to mention it was close to everything we wanted to do!

Would recommend this place to anyone!
comodo, espacioso, todo perfecto!!
Excelente trato, limpio, ordenado y muy bien ubicado. Repetiria

Review in English followed by Spanish
The apartment is in a good location in Buenos Aires CBD, walking distance to the Subte (Metro) and buses. The apartment is sunny, as advertised, and this is an advantage in winter. However, as the main windows have a NW aspect this would be very hot in summer.
The apartment has no phone line and no entry phone. This means that if you want to meet with family/friends/colleagues you will have to make an appointment and meet them at the building entrance.
For very important chunks of time while we were at the appartment, we had no wifi which was our only access to the rest of the world.
The bedroom had very poor lighting. We were supplied with the world most uncomfortable couch.

El apartamento esta en una buena posicion en el minicentro de Buenos Aires, a corta distancia del Subte (Metro) y omnibuses. El apartamento es soleado, tal como se lo publicita, lo que es una ventaja en invierno. Sin embargo, porque las ventanas principales dan al noroeste, calculo que sera muy caluroso en verano.
El departamento no tiene telefono ni portero electrico, lo que significa que si uno quiere encontrarse con familiares/amigos/colegas uno tiene que hacer una cita en la puerta del departamento.
Por importantes cantidades de tiempo mientras estabamos en el apartamento no teniamos wifi, quedandonos desconectados del resto del mundo.
La iluminacion en el dormitorio era muy pobre, y teniamos el sillon mas incomodo del mundo.

Recién estuve en el apartamento de Elbio, y la experiencia fue muy agradable. Siempre contestó todas mis preguntas rápidamente, y el y Zuni fueron muy agradables en todo.
El apartamento, tal como en las fotos. Un espacio muy acogedor, y bien localizado...en Montserrat, justo al lado de San Telmo. Una de las mejores veces que me he quedado en la ciudad.
Sin duda, si volviera a Buenos Aires, no dudaría en quedarme con ellos.
Altamente recomendado.
Gracias.
Axel

I recently stayed at Elbio's apartment, and it was a very nice experience. He always responded very quickly to all my questions, and he and Zuni were very nice about everything.
The apartment, just like in the photos. A very cozy place, and well situated...in Montserrat, right next to San Telmo. One of my best stays in the city.
No doubt, if I'm back in Buenos Aires, I wouldn't doubt staying with them.
Highly recommended.
Thank you.
Axel

Lugar tranquilo conforme as expectativas, claro que a demolição do prédio ao lado tira um pouco de brilho, mas o apartamento e confortável e corresponde ao oferecido.
Perto da área que nos interessava.
O Elbio Mariano?
Ele atende o interfone, escreve e-mails mas é invisível.... Não encontramos, havia uma senhorita que nos deu as informações necessárias e nos entregou as chaves.
Adoramos a noite que passamos na casa do Ruy. Ele foi solicito e simpático. A casa é bem localizada e tem uma ótima vista.
Muy buena ubicación. Muy cómodo, especial para pasar unos días. Volvería nuevamente sin dudas!
El depto es hermoso, el barrio tranquilo, el anfitrión amable. Cerca de cualquier transporte público y variedad de comercios en la zona. A 10 cuadras del Obelisco. Todo genial!!!

Ruy es una persona y un anfitrión excepcional. Nunca tuvimos ningún problema con la comunicación o la estadía, es más, fue mejor de lo esperado.  El apartamento es tal como en las fotos, impecable y acogedor -aún en invierno-. Excelente todo.

We had a lovely stay in San Telmo at Alejandra's. The space is just as advertised and the roof deck was amazing - the biggest reason why we stayed in the apartment.  The apartment was sparkling clean and very comfortable.  The little complex was charming and Alejandra was very welcoming and helpful and gave us lots of little useful tips.   The apartment is right across the street from the market and steps to a ton of bars and restaurants - excellent location.
Super locatie om een paar nachten te verblijven en het dakterras is een mega pluspunt!

Such a giant place with amazing style!!
I was absolutely blown away by the comfort of this wonderful location. I unexpectedly ran into friends of friends during my stay and was absolutely blown away by the accommodations and responses. The outdoor could not be better for entertaining a few friends for delicious food outdoors. I adore outdoor areas and could not have been more impressed. Indoor had TONS of windows too and lots of local recommendations. Any time I needed a quick fix or help for a minor problem (3xs), I was given EXTREMELY prompt courteous responses with hands on help - as in 2 minutes or less!! Experience could not have been better. I think this was my favorite out of the 5 places I stayed in BA. Personal with amazing food across the street. Great style. 2 wine stores less than 25 footsteps away. Market every Sunday. I can't think of something bad to say. Definitely one of my favorite areas in BA.
Ubicación perfecta muy cerca de todo lo que ofrece el barrio de San Telmo.  Tienes el mercado al lado, y la terraza es el sitio ideal para descansar.  Repetiría sin duda.  ¡Gracias!

Alejandra’s place in the heart of San Telmo is simply a hidden gem. From the first day on we enjoyed every minute spent inside the apartment and on top of it, on the rooftop.
The location couldn’t be better, with San Telmo market literally opposite the apartment and a lot of great restaurants in short walking distance.
What we really liked about the apartment was its lush green plants everywhere - amazing. Further, the rooftop granted a great view of the area and enjoying a drink at sunset up there was mesmerizing.
Don’t hesitate, book this place and enjoy your time in BA.

Literally steps away from the San Telmo market. This apartment has the perfect location and is close to tons of bars and restaurants. Within walking distance La Boca, Puerto Madero and Plaza de Mayo. Wonderful terrace and plenty of space to relax both in the apartment and upstairs.  Recommend 100%.

We absolutely loved Alexandra’s apartment, stylish, wonderful roof terrace and such an amazing location (we particularly enjoyed the food market across the road - steak and churipan!). Cannot recommend it enough. We hope to return
A compact but fully functional accommodation. Light, bright and cosy apartment. Very comfy bed. Well equipped kitchen. Great rooftop terrace. A very enjoyable experience. We would definitely go back.
Gracias Alejandra y Caro! Siempre atentas y comunicativas. La mejor terraza de San Telmo en la mejor cuadra del barrio. Recomiendo 100%
Legar a la casa de Alejandra es como encontrar un respiro en medio a la ciudad. Pequenita y acogedora, llena de detalles y con una terraza de sueño!
Excelente
Excelente alternativa

Estudio cómodo y muy bien equipado, es un poco más amplio que en las fotos. La terraza es hermosa y tiene una buena parrilla, un excelente espacio para relajarse.
Alejandra siempre muy amable y a disposición.

Localização excelente
Apartamento aconchegante limpo e com tudo funcionando perfeitamente
Destaque para o terraço com churrasqueira
ensolarado durante o dia, e com uma vista urbana deslumbrante para o entardecer e anoitecer
Stylishly decorated, well located, great terrace. Very quiet with mosquito netting, i slept very well!. Alejandra is friendly and responsive. It gets my recommendation!

Un lugar muy cómodo, y decorado con mucho estilo. Espacios cálidos e impecables. Para destacar, el equipamiento y la limpieza del lugar.
El barrio es bastante seguro y tranquilo.
Alejandra como anfitriona muy atenta y amable, mantuvimos un contacto fluido y recibí respuestas rápidas cada vez que la contacté. Una estadía inmejorable.
Amazing. Re recomendable.

It is a little cosy place in a great location! Carolina was a super host and she gave us a lot of advices.
Thanks for making our staying in Buenos Aires simply perfect

La mejor! Súper agradable, atenta a que nada te falte, haciendo que en todo momento te sientas cómodo, facilitándote todos los aspectos del check-in y check-out! Una atención amable y predispuesta en todo momento para lo que uno necesite!

Erst einmal das Positive:
Die Lage ist hervorragend. Das ist völlig richtig in der Beschreibung angegeben.
WLAN und Air Condition funktionieren.
Der Innenhof ist sehr gepflegt und geradezu romantisch.
Betreut von der Nachbarin, die auch bezaubernde Ansprechpartnerin für die Wohnung ist.
Sie hat uns auch einen Late-Checkout ermöglicht.
Dafür bedanken wir uns sehr herzlich.
Es könnte so charmant sein. Aber die Einrichtung ist lieblos.
Da ist ein größeres Einzelbett, auf das eine übergroße Matratze gelegt wurde, die es zu einem kleinen Doppelbett macht.
Geht gerade eben. Bis die Matratze verrutscht und sich diese einseitig runterbiegt.
Das Sofa ist so durchgesessen, dass man es meidet.
Es gibt zwar zwei dieser italienischen Kaffeebereiter, aber keine funktioniert, weil die Dichtungen kaputt sind.
Ein Gasherd ist da, aber ein Feuerzeug mussten wir erst kaufen.
Das Schloss zu Terrasse ist kaputt und für umgerechnet 10 € würde ein Schlosser glücklich sein es zu reparieren.
Ein Viertel des Tagespreises. Das kann man doch verlangen, oder?
Weingläser sind da, aber Wassergläser sind das leider übliche Sammelsurium an übriggebliebene Gläsern.
Viele Messer, keines taug was, 1 Korkenzieher. Leider kaputt.
Um die Klospülung zu betätigen, muss man seinen Finger mehrere Zentimeter in eine defekte Mechanik stecken
Ziemlich unangenehm, wäre für 5 € zu beheben. Und diese Unterlassung ist einfach ärgerlich.
Das billigste Hotel würde das nicht wagen.
Eine Terrasse ohne Schatten ist nur begrenzt nutzbar.
Wir wohnen lieber in privaten Wohnungen, nicht gern in Hotels.
Wir gießen die Blumen und behandeln alles wie zu Hause.
Dort leben wir auch nicht zwischen kaputten und lieblosen Dingen.
Um dann noch die überdimensionierte Hausordnung zu lesen,
gefüllt mit Maßregelungen. Fühlt sich nicht wie Gast sein an.
Wenn man den Preis von 40 € pro Tag im November zugrundelegt,
sowie den Western Union Wechselkurs von 1 € gleich 247 Peso,
hätte man ein Doppelzimmer in einigen sehr schönen Boutiquehotels in der Gegend
preiswerter bekommen.
Müssen Gäste aus Europa, die nach einem 24 Stunden Flug dort um ca. 10:30 ankommen
es eigentlich dulden, sich noch bis 12 rumdrücken zu müssen, um die Check-in-Zeiten einzuhalten?
Bei einer 3 Tage Buchung vielleicht. Bei einer 20 Tage-Buchung werde ich dies nicht mehr akzeptieren.
Nur mal so …
Alle Missstände wären mit einem Rundgang des Eigentümers identifiziert und an einem Tag unter 100 € leicht zu beheben.
Dies ist übrigens nach ca. 8 Jahren meine erste negative Airbnb Bewertung.

I couldn’t ask for a better location, right in the heart of San Telmo, right across from the Mercado de San Telmo. Despite its central location, it was quiet at night as there is a small courtyard you enter before going up to the apartment. Alejandra was easy and quick to communicate with and Carolina is so lovely and lives right next door! The apartment is actually much bigger than the photos lead on. It’s also full of thoughtful touches, like international outlets everywhere. The water pressure in the shower is wonderful. The wifi was ok. The terrace is so big and lovely and nice to enjoy coffee during the day and wine at night. I hope to return and stay here again!

El lugar es bastante bueno, hay bares y boliches en la zona, ideal para gente joven, es bastante espacioso, y no está nada mal. Lo único, le falta prestar un poquito de atención a los detalles. Algunas de las luminarias no contaban con focos, la señal de wifi no es de lo mejor,  al departamento le falta un ligero mantenimiento, pero dentro de todo, el lugar es genial, y lo recomendaría. Mariano y Zuni estuvieron atentos en todo momento ante cualquier inconveniente que pudiere presentarse.
todo muy bien,  el lugar es tal cual lo muestran, accesible y en el medio de San telmo

Elbio Mariano is the perfect host, caring and attentive. We also highly recommend booking airport transfers with him, regular BA taxis have no luggage space and it was such a relief to get off a long flight and have someone standing there with a sign. The flat is charming but do be aware there is a narrow spiral staircase to get to the sleeping areas. Travelling with a teenager, she thought this was the coolest thing, but it might not work so well with a toddler or a grandparent. The neighbourhood is shabby chic Bohemia and it's only ten minutes to walk to the centre of the city or the heart of San Telmo.
Excelente atención gran apoyo en la estancia.

Estuvimos 3 días en el alojamiento de Elbio y nos pareció muy bueno. El departamento es cómodo y bien ubicado pudiéndose acceder fácilmente a puerto madero, plaza de mayo y otros puntos de interés. El barrio tiene algunas zonas descuidadas y por la noche parece un poco inseguro, sin embargo, nunca tuvimos problemas. Lo recomendados.

The apartment is OK. My family and I stayed for 8 days. I have some troubles that annoyed our stay. Wifi is really bad inside the apartment. It is hard to use it. But one of the main problems is that the second floor is very dangerous, in particular for kids, since it does not have walls. I didn't realize that before arriving at the place. Do no recommend if traveling with kids (with was my case).

Another issue is that we payed for the cleaning service, but no one showed up to clean the apartment. The couch and the mattress are a kind old and dusty. The apartment is a way more beautiful in the pictures than in reality.

Apartamento legal, localizado no centro da cidade (área um pouco esquisita a noite, no entanto não consideramos perigosa). Elbio sempre estava ajudando via whatsapp e foi bastante atencioso. O apartamento é antigo e não estava tão limpo quanto gostariamos. O banheiro foi o ponto mais negativo com relação a limpeza e layout, pois molhava todo durante o banho.
Un piso muy espacioso, cómodo y acogedor. Buenísima relación calidad/precio.

Já conhecíamos a cidade e por isso escolhemos ficar em San Telmo - tudo perto e bom para sair à noite - ótimo para comer bem. Pode se pegar um ônibus barato diretamente do aeroporto Ezeiza linha 08 ( só demora um pouco, mas vale a economia ). Ficamos em 5 pessoas e tudo correu bem. Nossa família recomenda. Agradecemos a hospitalidade.
El departamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos. Amplio, muy cómodo e iluminado. Con espacios comunes super agradables. Recomendable en relación calidad precio.

Dpto tipo loft, en el medio de San Telmo, en un complejo tranquilo en su interior.
Agradecidos por permitirnos realizar un check in tardío y por facilitarlos elementos no incluídos en la descripcion. Faltaría prestar atención a los detalles, de limpieza sobre todo.
La zona es ruidosa de noche e impresiona poco segura, por suerte no tuvimos incovenientes.
Charming flat in nice house in San Telmo.

A qualidade dos móveis foi um pouco diferente do que está nas fotos, havia um problema no chuveiro, nada que fosse grave, mas havia.

O maior problema foi por conta do ar condicionado, nas últimas duas noites sofremos com o calor, uma vez que o sistema era desligado enquanto dormiamos, o que gerou grande descontentamento.

O bairro é maravilhoso, bem no centro e tudo que você precisa você acha com facilidade.

Alguns móveis deteriorados, carece de um pouco mais de cuidado e até mesmo reforma.

buen lugar, espacio comodo, pero si buscan tranquilidad sonora no asistan a este lugar un fin de semana, si van de fiesta este lugar es ideal, por lo demás la limpieza no es optima, contrario a lo anterior el lugar esta bien ubicado, cercano a muchos lugares turísticos.
barrio ruidoso, camas medianamente cómodas, sábanas manchadas, la chica que nos atendió indiferente, el microondas no funcionaba
Excelente experiencia, muchísimas gracias!
Muy buena ubicación! Hermoso lugar para hospedarse.

El lugar está bien, sencillo, la ubicación es buena, pero de noche la zona es fea, solo estuvimos 2 noches, el precio es caro en relación al duplex y a la ubicación. La heladera chorreaba agua x abajo pero era porque le hacía falta una descongelada.
Super

Cerca a muchos lugares turísticos y a la línea del metro. El depto tiene un estilo único, sus colores y escaleras dan gusto de ver. Es un depto con lo necesario. un punto a mejorar son los colchones y la limpieza de los sillones.
Nossa estadia no apartamento foi ótima. Os anfitriões respondia a nossas mensagens prontamente, a localização é ótima e o apartamento é confortável.
excelente todo! pasamos de maravilla
Otimo lugar para ficar

This place is awesome if you want a home base to explore Buenos Aires. You are right in the middle of everything the Recoletta (5-10 minute walk), Palermo (5-10 minute), Viejo Palermo(10 minute walk), Abasto, etc. If you prefer the Subte it is literally around the corner from this place as is plenty of shopping on Santa Fe. The accommodations and the building are great. Everything you need for a great stay in Buenos Aires and Viviana is fantastic. Extremely helpful and communicates quickly even through email. We decided not to pay for the phone service just because our Spanish is horrible and wouldn't get us far but I thought it was great that there is a phone included you just have to buy the minutes for your stay. Highly recommend staying here and if we ever return we will definitely be back here.
Wonderful place in San Telmo, beautiful terrace right across the street from the market!  Loved staying here.

Can’t imagine a better location in all of BA, we had the best time and absolutely loved having San Telmo as our home base. Alejandra and Carolina were wonderful,  generous hosts. The apartment is exactly as advertised, a studio with a beautiful big terrace perfect for an afternoon glass of wine. It’s not fancy, but it’s well stocked and had everything we needed, and a very good price.
We had a great stay at Alejandra’s. The location is perfect in San Telmo. The building has a beautiful, verdant, interior court yard.

L'appartement d'Alejandra est parfait et tel que vu sur les photos. Carolina est une hôte exemplaire. C'est elle qui nous a accueilli et qui habite l'appartement à côté. Elle est très gentille, bienveillante et très sympathique. Les communications sont faciles. Alejandra répond très rapidement. Les informations sont claires et précises. Aucune problème du début à la fin de notre séjour. L'appartement est très confortable, beau et bien équipé. Il est situé juste en face du Mercado San Telmo. C'est un quartier vivant et très agréable à habiter. L'appartement n'est pas bruyant. On dort très bien. La climatisation fonctionne très bien. C'est un petit nid bien douillet où il fait bon vivre. Nous avons adoré notre séjour et si nous retournons à Buenos Aires nous retournerons chez Alejandra et Carolina. Merci à nos hôtes exemplaires.
this place was Amazing. communication was great and the spot is right in the heart of the city. lota of bars. restaurants and great day/night life. I will definetly recommend thia place in BA.

We had a very nice time in Alejandra’s apartment. It is like the pictures and the private terrasse is very great. Alejandra gave nice recommendations for restaurants and the communication is very clear with her. Also the co-host and neighbour, Carolina, is very kind and helpful.

Also, the location is great. San Telmo is a wonderful place to live during your time in Buenos Aires. It has a bohemian vibe and the Sunday market is great! If you like walking, you can reach the more ‘’turistics’’ parts like Recolata in an hour (taxi, metro and bus are possible too but we did not used it).
We enjoyed ourselves extremely in this apartment and barrio also thanks to the great hosts we had.

Hermoso espacio. Fantástica terraza. Se nota el cuidado en cada detalle y las ganas de crear una bella y cómoda estadía! La comunicación con Ale y con su compañera (vecina del departamento) fue super fluida. La ubicación es perfecta para el/la que quiera quedarse en San Telmo, a 2 pasos de un montón de buenos restaurantes, cafés, y lugares de interés.

This is a perfectly lovely and well-tended flat, an oasis in the busy, bohemian neighborhood of San Telmo. The rooftop garden is wonderful and private. Alejandra and Carolina were both ideal hosts. Thank you! Peter and Elise

My husband and I spent seven nights in this charming place. We plan to return to Buenos Aires and hope to stay here again. The location across from the San Telmo market is terrific, plus the neighborhood has several great places to eat and cool bars (including a great cocktail bar) all in easy walking distance. Because of the apartment's location, it manages to be located in a lively neighborhood and provide a quiet sanctuary from the city. The rooftop patio is the perfect place to chill out with a coffee or glass of wine. This place is clean, cozy, and well-equipped. We loved it!!!!

Fantastic home. Carolina, the host on site, was incredible and very helpful. I had trouble getting a shuttle to the airport and she jumped in to help me and take care of it.

Using the parilla is a must but I would only try it if you or a friend has experience with hit. The rooftop terrace is beautiful and a great place to relax or have a few drinks.

All of the furniture was comfortable and clean. I stayed in several places while in Buenos Aires and this was the very best experience!

The garden and plants add to the beautiful ambience and vibe of the place.

Perfect location in San Telmo

San Telmo was the last area I stayed in during my 3 week visit to Buenos Aires. The neighborhood, and Alejandra's place, did not disappoint! It's a stone's throw from the Mercado San Telmo and Plaza Dorrego alike. There are a ton of bars and restaurants in and around both, as well as a crafts/antiques fair on the weekends. The unit is quite spacious for one and would be very comfortable for two, as well. The rooftop is an incredible bonus; there is plenty of space to sprawl and enjoy the sunshine and clear skies. Alejandra's neighbor, Carolina helped to check me in/out and get me settled. She is lovely; nearly always available, and very communicative and accommodating. She went above and beyond to help me with a little snafu i experienced at the end of my trip and I could not be more appreciative! Thank you Alejandra and Carolina; I hope to be back to your fabulous San Telmo complex soon! :)

Ruy is such a PHENOMENAL host! I had to book an airbnb in BA before beginning my semester studying abroad and he made the experience completely stress-free and enjoyable. He had helpful suggestions about where to (and not to) go in the city and even picked me and my friend (who wasn't even staying in one of his places) up from the airport. He takes such great care of his guests and I could not recommend him more highly. You will not be disappointed.
Great host and place. Ruy was very easy to communicate with and knowledgeable about the city.

Appartement très agréable et bien situé. Conforme aux photos, propre et sécurisé. Nous avons apprécié qu'il soit ouvert sur une vue et avec une terrasse même si la météo ne nous a pas permis d'en profiter. Un peu de bruit dans la chambre avec la rue, mais cela n'est pas gênant, car c'est lointain (6 ème étage avec ascenseur). Tous les commerces et services à deux pas, ainsi que les transports. Ruy était disponible et flexible pour l'arrivée et le départ. Tout s'est bien passé. Nous recommandons cet appartement, suffisamment spacieux pour deux personnes.

Our stay at Ruy's apartment was great. We had been traveling around South America for a few weeks and needed a break from the hostels. The apartment provided us with our own space, a kitchen to use, and a comfortable bed to sleep in. It is located very conveniently, very close to both bus and subway stations. The supermarket downstairs was useful. The best part was the balcony which provided a great view of the city and we caught a few stunning sunsets.

Hands down my best AirBnb experience so far. The apartment is nice, clean and well located but what made the stay fantastic was the host! Ruy is a wonderful and really friendly host. In addition to having plenty of recommendations of things to do and places to eat in the city, he was incredibly accommodating. On our last day we had to leave midday for the airport. To make sure we made the most of the morning, he picked up our suitcases at the apartment and met us in the neighborhood we were visiting, saving us the trip back to the apartment or the inconvenience of lugging our bags all morning!
Will definitely stay there again when I go back to Buenos Aires!
Muy lindo el departamento.- Excelente atención la de Ruy.- Esta atento a cada detalle.- Lo recomiendo 100%
Lugar bien ubicado, cerca de los principales atractivos de Buenos Aires, limpio, cómodo y accesible.
Excelente la ubicación, el dueño bien atento. El dpto en muy buenas condiciones. Recomendable
Limpio el lugar, cómodo, bien ubicado y buena comunicación con Ruy.
Excelente departamento. Muy luminoso. Muchas ventanas. Muy buena vista
La comodidad del Lugar y su proximidad al centro es inmejorable como la excelente atención de Ruy . Súper recomendable !
Ruy fue muy amable con nosotros, recibiéndonos y dándonos informaciones del barrio y acerca de las cosas que nos interesaban. El departamento es buenisimo! Recomiendo!
Ruy fue Súper hospitalario y su departamento es muy limpio y ordenado
Lo recomiendo

This place is just wonderful. Ruy was one of the mosthelp helpful, professional and kind hosts I ever stayed with. He knows a lot, communication is great, you can ask him everything and he even picked us up from the airport. We couldn't ask for anything more. Thanks a lot!

Heerlijke plek om te verblijven, we zijn ruim een week gebleven. Ruy is heel behulpzaam en communicatief. Het appartement werd na enkele dagen netjes schoongemaakt en van schoon linnen voorzien. Ruy stuurde ons hierover vooraf een berichtje, dat vonden wij erg prettig!
De locatie van het appartement is ook top!
Zeker een aanrader voor Buenos Aires.

Appartement bien exposé, lumineux et agréable, toujours venté. La situation n'est pas loin du centre et de l'Avenue de Mayo. Petite alimentation en bas de l'immeuble et petits restaurants sympas autour.

Excelente anfitrião! Nos ajudou muito nas dúvidas antes da reserva e foi super compreensivo ao perceber que talvez o apartamento reservado não fosse acomodar tão bem os dois adultos e dois adolescentes hospedados. Nos ofereceu um apartamento maior no mesmo prédio em troca, sem custos adicionais. Foi muito perfeito! Sua mãe, Eloisa, nos recebeu super bem e nos atendeu em algumas solicitações extras que tivemos (ventilador, mais travesseiros e chave extra). Também nos ajudou com a reserva do transporte para a volta no dia 1° que é difícil em Buenos Aires. Enfim, recomendamos muito o apartamento e a localização e agradecemos muito a hospitalidade do Ruy, sua irmã Dolores e em especial a mãe Eloisa.

The apartment is quite spacious, well located and we certainly made good use of the balcony. It was a pleasure using the kitchen which had everything to prepare a decent home cooked meal!
Ruy was on holidays but we were greeted by his sister Eloisa who spoke English very well. She was very thoughtful and considerate and helped us get oriented when we first arrived. We would definitely recommend this place.

Sunny appartement ou sahel appartement Les plus Bien situé dans le micro centro, 7ème étage avec ascenseur ancien mais assez fonctionnel, appart assez spacieux avec une chambre séparée, salle de bain avec douche et kitchenette, les environs ce n'est pas Recoleta mais la proximité avec Plaza de Mayo, San Telmo est appréciable pour petits marcheurs et la proximité de tout BA en bus est facile et de bonne proximité. Dans la rue et à proximité on trouve tous les commerces: des restaurants de qualité, des épiciers de quartier ouverts tard, une laverie en face, Victoria du nom de sa très sympathique propriétaires, sur le même trottoir en remontant il y a une chapelle où l'on dit la messe en latin, ambiance Saint Pie X. Les moins le bruit de la rue mais on est au micro centre, pas besoin de réveil car le manque d'occultation des fenêtres réveillera les voyageurs très tôt. A l'arrivée ce qui frappe le plus est l'état d'abandon de l'appartement, à l'évidence le propriétaire le laisse allègrement se dégrader: linge de lit et de salle de bain très mal odorant (nous fîmes rapidement connaissance avec la lavandière d'en face car tout le linge y passa), ce qui sert de canapé est défoncé et très salle recouvert d'un espèce de plaid qui n'en a que le nom tentant de cacher la misère, il n'y a pas d'autre nom. La cuisine est faite d'éléments souvent très abîmes et gras, la batterie de cuisine et la vaisselle pour ce qui en reste est en très mauvais état et grasse, sale. Le rideau de la salle de bain est à changer. La terrasse à notre arrivée présentait un état de désolation ahurissant, en effet la table en pvc était noire au dessus de tant d'intempéries reçues, pas de parasol (pour une sunny?), les plantes vertes et autres cactées n'avaient pas connu l'eau depuis un moment, nous dûmes rapidement les arroser et tenter de les sauver; d'ailleurs l'une d'elle, un arbuste, déjà mort nous servit d'étendoir pour le petit linge... car il n'y en avait pas. Lorsque nous vîmes le propriétaire 2 ou 3 jours après nous lui fîmes part d'une manière assez ferme de notre mécontentement, on passe sur les détails des échanges... ça n'a lui a pas plu... Nous lui avons carrément dit que cet appartement convenait pour camper 2 ou 3 jours mais pas du tout pour les 30 jours où nous allions y résider... Nous avons du nous adapter... Il y aurait une demande que nous formulerions auprès des voyageurs chez Airbnb. Ce serait que le point précis des plus et des moins soit méthodique et sans complaisance même si on comprend que les besoins des uns et des autres puissent varier et les ressentis être subjectifs. Il y va de la fiabilité de ce moyen par ailleurs très sympathique. Attention à la gentillesse excessive de l'accueil qui masquerait des défaillances par ailleurs et vous empêcherait d'être objectif dans l'avis que vous donneriez à la fin. Il...

Une seule nuit agréable.
Possibilité de transport à la demande jusqu'aux aéroports ou depuis les aéroports (un peu plus cher que les standards).

Die Lage der Wohnung ist super, hingegen sehen die Fotos schöner aus als der wirkliche Zustand. Die Wohnung verfügt über keine AireCondition und auch über keine Aussenbeschattung. Bei 35 Grad wird die Wohnung zum Treibhaus und macht das schlafen unmöglich.
We had a fantastic stay in Ruy's lovely apartment. The apartment is right in the heart of the city and very clean and spacious. We couldn't recommend Ruy enough - a very kind and considerate host!

Veldig sentral beliggenhet. Stor og solrik terrasse for oss som liker å oppholde oss utendørs. Veldig varmt om nettene når det ikke var vind som gav gjennomtrekk. Rent, og med alt utstyr for enkel matlaging. Stille og rolig I bygården, men selvsagt høres trafikken godt så sentralt. Roy er en super vert på alle måter, pålitelig, hyggelig og fleksibel.
Apartamento muito bem localizado, anfitrião muito prestativo.
Très bien situé, confortable. Très bon accueil.

From the first moment we felt very welcome, the owners are very nice and helpful. Everything regarding the organization went very smoothly. The apartment provides everything you need for a comfortable stay, very clean and bright, definetely enough room for two people.
The apartment is very central, located in a vibrant and safe part of town, very close to the subway, many bus lines and a variety of stores, cafés and supermarkets which to us was very important.
We definetely recommend it!

The apartment is really well located with great neighborhood, great people, close to lovelly bars and restaurants. You can walk to subway station easily. Viviana and her husband are very kind and caring people.

Very nice and central appartment with an awesome terrace and close to numerous restaurants, bars and supermarkets. We loved the tipps that Ruy gave us for sightseeing and eating. He is an extremely nice host!

En medio de San Telmo, el apartamento está muy bien ubicado, cerca de la av 9 de Julio y la av De Mayo, así como de la plaza Dorrego, donde tiene lugar el dominical mercado de pulgas. Un mini mercado justo al lado sirve para cualquier compra básica de alimentos.
El balcón tiene una amplia vista de la ciudad, incluyendo el edificio Bartolo y el ministerio de Salud, adornado con un mural de Evita.
Un detalle es que al no tener aire acondicionado, puede ser un poco caluroso en días de verano.
En cuanto a la atención, Ruy (y su madre que vive en el apartamento de abajo) fueron siempre muy amables y estuvieron dispuestos a ayudarnos. Incluso el día de la partida y mientras caía un diluvio en la ciudad y ningún taxi se detenía, Ruy nos llevó directamente en su auto al terminal de ferris.

El apto de Ruy es pequeño,  pero muy cómodo. Viajamos con un bebé de 8 meses y las instalaciones funcionaron perfecto. Incluso, Ruy nos ofreció una cuna para el bebé. El sol que entra por el balcón es hermoso, ilumina todo y calienta. Lo disfrutamos hasta bien entrada la tarde. Recomendable!
Super recomendo
Muy buen ubicado. El anfitrión es muy atento y amable! Buenísimo departamento, equipado con todo lo necesario.
Ray's apartment is perfectly located in Buenos Aires and exactly as described, all in all a great place to stay. Ruy was also a very helpful and communicative host; would definitely stay again!
Very nice and central apartment, good to explore the city!
a localização do apartamento é excelente para quem deseja se locomover pela centro de Bs As.

Con Ruy mantuvimos muy buena comunicación, amable y precisa. Nos proporcionó servicio de traslado al aeropuerto de llegada y salida, la que agradecemos mucho.
El espacio de Ruy es acogedor, cuenta con los implementos necesarios para la estadía, muy central y con buena conexión de movilización.
Puntuales y responsables. Dpto prolijo.

O espaço do Ruy é encantador! Extremamente limpo e estiloso, nada diferente do que aparece nas fotos. O terraço é um amor e muito bem localizado. É possível conhecer algumas das principais partes da cidade por meio de caminhadas. Super próximo da 9 de Julio e do Teatro Colón.

O apartamento de Ruy é confortável, com uma grande e simpática varanda. A casa tem tudo o que precisávamos, acessórios básicos de cozinha, um bom wi-fi e pouco ruído, com um pequeno supermercado ao lado, muito prático. Apenas a calefação não funcionava tão bem, pois esquentava pouco. Ruy foi simpático e nos deu boas recomendações de restaurantes na área onde estávamos. Muito obrigada, Ruy, nos sentimos em casa!

Viviana and Carlos were wonderful hosts and the apartment is exactly as described.  It is centrally located between Palermo and Ricoleta and just around the corner for the D-line subte.  Everything I needed was within walking distance.  Upon my arrival everything was prepared as agreed and the place very cozy and clean.  I would definitely recommend this apartment and would certainly stay there again.

Viviana and Carlos are very attentive and kind hosts. The apartment, honestly, is better than it looks in the pictures. Everything works and is in great shape and the location is ideal. I would totally recommend them to all my friends and family.

Better than the pictures.

Nice and functional apartment in a perfect location. Well equiped kitchen, a clean bathroom and a cozy balcony. We had absolutely nothing to complain. Everything is very close to the apartment. We would choose Viviana and Carlos as our hosts again!

Eu recomendo bastante esse espaço. Viviana e seu marido foram ótimos anfitriões, muito prestativos. O apartamento é muito bonito e conservado. O espaço do Ruy é bem aconchegante, limpo e organizado. Nos dias em que estive na Cidade o clima estava bem frio para Brasileiros. Ficamos dois dias sem conseguir sair por conta da friagem.
Passamos esses dias tranquilamente dentro do apartamento. Tem um mercado pequeno ao lado e outros dois maiores bem próximos. Também está próximo a uma estação de metrô e ônibus. Além disso é possível ir caminhando ao charmoso bairro de San Telmo e Rua Florida. (cerca de 20 min a pé).

O apartamento do Ruy é perfeito! ótima localização, no centro da cidade e com tudo bem pertinho do predio, inclusive um mercado ao lado. O apartamento em si é super aconchegante e confortavel. O chuveiro é muito gostoso e a varanda tem uma vista muito legal, maravilhoso para tomar um cafe da manha ou almoçar. Inclusive, a varanda fica para o norte, batendo sol o dia inteiro! Melhor hospedagem com certeza! Cheguei com poucas expectativas e me surpreendi muito! alias, o Ruy é muito simpatico e atencioso, está sempre a disposição para ajudar os hospedes! Parabens Ruy!!
Ruy takes hospitality seriously. He was an amazing host and took well care of us. Great neighborhood, lovely balcony, good and clean place to stay. Highly recommended.

Quedé muy conforme y agradecida de la Hospitalidad de Ruy, amable y empático con nuestra llegada y salida de noche, nos orientó y entregó excelentes tips para recorrer la ciudad.El departamento muy vintage y acogedor, bien ubicado, limpio, seguro.

Excelente localização e espaço. Tudo aconteceu de acordo com o que foi acordado. Uma ótima experiência.

Ruy’s place was exactly as described. The balcony was the perfect place to enjoy the sunset and a glass of wine. He also gave great local recommendations. I will definitely book again on my next trip to BA.

Ruy was an awesome host. He gave me some tips about local culture and food. Also he's always available.
The building is very well located in downtown of CABA and the guest can have a lot of options for food, sightseeing and groceries. I would definitely go back again.

Thanks Ruy!

Excelente hospitalidade! Localização perfeita. Fomos super bem recebidos e Ruy facilitou bastante a nossa estadia na cidade. Super recomendo!
Good downtown location and reasonable place to stay.
O apartamento é super bem localizado, tem uma vista bem interessante e é super funcional. O Ruy é muito atencioso e ajuda em tudo que for preciso. Ele da muitas dicas sobre a cidade. Recomendo!!!
Excelente anfitrión!

Clean, stylish, and amazing location. We walked most places- no problem. Ruy in particular was a great host who provided us with several amazing recommendations. Wish we stayed longer.Would definitely recommend to others and absolutely would return!
great location, good tips on everything from eating in and out and transportation
Really great location!! Many stores near by. Would definitely stay here again if I ever find myself in BA again.

Piso muy bien ubicado, para alguien viajando solo o una pareja es ideal, muy buena relación calidad precio y un anfitrión cercano, dispuesto y muy amable. La terracita genial, equipado lo suficiente, luminoso... muy bien, recomendado!

Ruy was great, extremely helpful and informative, With his help our arrival in Buenos Aires went very smoothly.  The apartment is well located for walking around the city centre and we enjoyed having breakfast on the balcony.

Hôte très accueillant et arrangeant.

とても素敵な、温かみのある落ち着くお部屋でした。テラスからの眺めもとても気持ちが良いです。何でも揃っていて居心地良く滞在できました。

このお部屋への滞在で、とても素晴らしい旅になりました。また次回も泊まりたいし、Ruyさんに会いたいと思います。
A localização é boa, perto de restaurante, padaria, mercadinho. O apto é  limpo, tudo conforme anúncio. Fomos muito bem recebidos pela mãe do Ruy e adoramos a estadia. Recomendo.

What an INCREDIBLE place. I’ve stayed in a lot of Airbnbs, and it’s so rare to get both beauty and coziness. We felt right at home with every household need intuitively met. Carolina was such a pleasure to work with. I didn’t want to leave.
fantastic choice. Perfect location & everything you need in one place! The rooftop is such a treat!!

My fiancé & I had the best stay @ Alejandra’s studio. The flat is bright & cozy and surprisingly peaceful given it’s in the heart of San Telmo. The rooftop patio lives up to the hype! Definitely recommend— such a great value.
If you want to be in the center of San Telmo, yet in an envelope of tranquility, then you couldn’t pick a better place.

Loved staying here — it was the perfect location for us. Literally across the street from the San Telmo Market and close enough to everything else. Perfect for a couple and the rooftop is absolutely wonderful. Definitely recommend

Excellent location! Right in front of mercado San Telmo and one minute walk to plaza Dorrego. You can get everything you need in 5min walking distance. Alejandra and Malena are super nice and helpful whenever I have any need. If you want to stay in San Telmo, this is definitely the place.

Lovely place. Check-in and communication were seemless. Great location right across from San Telmo market. Loved having the balcony (even in winter).

Todo ocurrió como combinados, señor Carlos y señora Viviana son muy amables y nos recibieron muy bien. El departamento es muy cómodo y tranquilo, la ubicación es excelente. Recomendamos a todos! Muchas gracias Carlos y Viviana.

Nice, clean apartment where everything worked in a location from which it´s really easy to access all the parts of the city. The kitchenette has a microwave, refrigerator and stove with dishes and utensils if you chose to cook. There are several markets in the area within walking distance, as well as an excellent bakery three doors down on the corner.  The Agüero Subte station is located on the same block on Avenida Santa Fe.  The building is safe and secure and has free washer and dryers available.  I would definitely stay here again.

This studio is in a great location just off Avenida Santa Fe with a subte station (metro) around the corner and walking distance to restaurants, cafes, buses, Recoleta, heladerias and parks.The flat is very clean, sunny and well maintained with a super comfortable bed and a great balcony for drinking mate in the late afternoons! Responsive and kind hosts and hassle free accommodation guaranteed a great stay in Buenos Aires.

Já estamos com saudade da viagem, inclusive do apartamento, quando voltarmos a buenos aires, com certeza esse espaço será nossa primeira escolha.

Acertei na escolha e fui muito feliz na minha hospedagem. Ficamos 7 dias com conforto e bem atendido pela anfitriã. Tivemos toda atenção que precisava e se for a buenos Aires irei novamente ao apartamento da Viviana.

Apartamento maravilhoso, exatamente como descrito. Tudo funcionando e perfeito, limpo e muito seguro. Fora a localização que é perfeita, uma quadra do metrô e de uma das principais avenidas, bairro muito seguro e repleto de restaurantes. Indico muito. Viviana e seu marido muito atenciosos. Vale muito a pena.

Viviana is an excellent host! The apartment is lovely, it has everything you could possibly need for a long or short stay. Location is also excellent, very close to the subte with easy access to the whole city. Viviana responded very quickly to any little queries we might have and was very helpful. She was also accommodating when we asked for a late check out. Would definitely stay there again if I come back to BA and I'd highly recommended it to everyone. Gracias Viviana!

This is a really lovely studio apartment in a very well-located area of Buenos Aires. Everything is as it is in the description, perfect for spending time in the city - the flat had everything I needed for a longer stay of one month. Viviana had thought of lots of very helpful things - like a mobile in the apartment visitors can use, and both she and Carlos were very welcoming. Palermo is a great, relaxed neighborhood with lots of shops, restaurants and things to do - museums like MALBA and MNBA, and the Recoleta cemetery are in walking distance, while the Subte stop (practically on your doorstep) will take you (very quickly!) into the centre. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend!

Fantastic location and neighborhood, with several stores, shops and supermarkets and a subway station right nearby! The apartment offers all the basic things you may need, including an air conditioner and even a hair drier with a diffuser attachment! Maybe street noise could be a problem for light sleepers like myself, so bring earplugs (I always do!) and you will be fine. I recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a genuine BsAs experience in a fantastic location :)

A Viviana e o Carlos nos receberam muito bem. O apartamento é muito bem organizado com tudo o que você precisa para usar, como utensílios de cozinha por exemplo. Tem 3 supermercados perto, além de vários cafés, shopping, lojas e um metrô.

O único ponto negativo é que como a rua é movimentada, a noite tem alguns barulhos de ônibus e caminhões.

Thank you Viviana for an absolutely perfect stay in your studio! I can highly recommend this little gem, right in the best part of BsAs. The apartment was exactly as described, in perfect condition and ideally situated just off the main street of Recoleta. Within seconds of the house there are several cafés and a bakery, a pizza place, a Chinese take-away, a supermarket, a greengrocer, a butcher and a chemist, and I mean within literally 50 meters of leaving the front door. Incredible address!

The host Viviana has been great all along, and communication with her has been smooth and friendly, with a warm welcome from her husband upon my arrival. For a newcomer to BsAs I don't think there is a better option than this apartment. Gracias!

We totally enjoying our stay in Vivianas and Carlos studio. It is a lovely apartment, well equipped, and has a good location in Palermo. Thanks again Viviana and Carlos for making our stay in Buenos Aires so pleasant.

Beautiful calm oasis right across from San Telmo market.  It’s amazing how much is going on outside and how peaceful it remains in the apartment. Wood grill is great for a home cooked asado!  There is also an exchange office next door if looking for a safe and convenient blue dollar exchange at a great rate.  Highly recommended stay!

Everything as described in the pictures and the other recommendations. Perfect location, really cozy apartment and great terrace! Kitchen is very well equipped and communication with Carolina was perfect!

La ubicación muy buena y el lugar muy cómodo, cumple con todo lo que dice y al alcance de todos los transportes públicos para poder recorrer distintas zonas de buenos aires. Para dos personas más que suficiente el hospedaje !

This apartment is full of charm, and located in an ideal area of Buenos Aires — a bit set off from the hyper touristy areas but surrounded by shops, bakeries, produce markets, butchers, cafes and more, with easy access to the subway. The apartment itself, on a top floor of a beautiful neoclassical building, was very functionally equipped and I was able to do a lot of cooking in the small kitchen. Finally, Ruy was quick to respond to any need I had, such as the French press he retrieved when I requested a coffee maker! I could not recommend this place highly enough.

tudo tranquilo, na chegada precisávamos deixar as malas em algum lugar antes do check in e o ruy disponibilizou, na saída também precisávamos ficar até as 18:00 e ele deixou a gente ficar no apartamento. a localização é ótima fica perto de tudo, não tivemos nenhum problema, ótimo.

la pasamos increible, super comodo, tienes todo lo necesario y de verdad es tranquilo, el sector donde queda es perfecto, con restaurantes cerca, lavanderia, supermercados y tienes facilidad de llegar por diferentes medios (subte y colectivo) y asi mismo puedes ir a varias zonas de la ciudad.
la relacion que tienes con el dueño Egle es buenisima, es supremamente cordial, te colabora en todo lo necesario.

Egle is super nice and very very helpful. The area was absolutely fantastic too. Everything in the apartment felt very new too. Bed is comfortable and the A/C worked really well. Also fast wi-fi. My only complain was that the garbage container is quite small. Ended up having a collection of garbage when I left because there was nowhere to put it.

I enjoyed my stay for the week I was there. I wouldn't want to stay more than a week though. Thanks again Egle!

El departamento es buenísimo y muy cómodo. Todo está nuevo y tiene una decoración muy agradable. La localización es también algo muy muy buena. Está cerca del subte y vías de grande circulación de colectivos. Felizmente el departamento no es de frente a la calle y ese ruido no se siente allí.
Es altamente recomendable.

Viviana e seu marido nos receberam muito bem, com um apartamento super bem decorado conforme as fotos. O apto fica muito bem localizado com 2 padarias bem perto, o metro a 2 minutos e o shopping a 10 min. O  bairro é super seguro, pode andar de noite sem problema algum. A estacao de metro esta a 10 min de todos os pontos turisticos da cidade e dos melhores restaurantes. Na minha opiniao o melhor bairro para se ficar.

The studio apartment was neat and  clean. It has big windows, high ceilings, balcony, modern bathroom, nicely equipped kitchen, air conditioning and steady wifi. Zigzag wooden flooring. Bed was comfortable. It is facing the street one block from Avenida Santa Fe. There is a lift to the 4th floor. A washer and dryer on the roof. Very centrally located. Near Disco supermarket, numerous coffee shops, pastry shops. Everything within a few blocks. The subway and buses are one block away and so are cabs. Perfect location. It can be noisy, especially on soccer nights. I would be happy to return.

El departamento en Buenos Aires está ubicadoen un lugar muy bien comunicado por metro e incluso andando a lugares dignos de conocer de la ciudad. Cerca tienes todas las facilidades que te da la gran ciudad. El apartamento está bien dotado de todo lo necesario. Un detalle poco corriente es estrenar estropajo y bayeta, algo digno de agtradecer. Recomandaría este sitio sin dudarlo.

Une excellent séjour dans cet appartement idéalement placé dans le centre de buenos aires. Accès wifi haut debit, literie confortable,  propreté générale satisfaisante.  En été,  agréable petit dejeuner sur le balcon. Bref un excellent choix pour un séjour à buenos aires. Nous recommandons.
Great stay in the apartment. Received some excellent information on arrival, which was fantastic. We will recommend to our friends :)

Foram 07 lindos dias que passamos em Buenos Aires, o studio é exatamente como mostram as fotos, muito aconchegante e próximo a tudo. Recomendo a todos , o local é muito limpo e Viviana e Carlos são excelentes anfitriões !! Voltaremos com certeza!

Can't believe how nice Egle is! She's so flexible, understanding, considerate, patient and easy/fast to communicate with! The neighbourhood is quiet with lots of best restaurants and bars and coffee shops. Close to subtle and bus stations. Would definitely come back again next year!
Great little place in a lovely neighborhood of Buenos Aires ! The patio is lovely.
Great place in a San Telmo, super nice host and co-host! Would stay again! Only the internet is not super fast, but I believe this is a problem in the area and is not an individual problem.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour de 3 jours chez Alejandra. L’appartement est en plein cœur de San Telmo, juste en face du marché. Il donne sur une petite cour verdoyante, au calme. L’appartement était très fidèle à la description et nous nous y sommes sentis comme chez nous. Très propre, avec une bonne literie. Ensoleillé. Avec une terrasse très jolie et agréable avec une vue sur les toits! Un petit havre de paix. Alejandra et Carolina ont été très disponibles et réactives. Nous n’avons manqué de rien! J’ai pu télétravailler de l’appartement ou de la terrasse, avec internet.  Et déjeuner au marché ou bien dans les petits cafés du coin. Nous reviendrons sans hésiter !

A beautiful studio with a nice balcony! It was between Palermo and Recoleta so just a 15 minute walk to palermo center so the location was great! Good communication with Viviana and the doorman met us up with keys! A perfect place for a couple to spend time in a great city! If we go back we would definitely stay here again!

Passei três semanas no apartamento da Viviana e me senti em casa.
O imóvel é confortável e limpo, todos os itens necessários no cotidiano estão disponíveis (microondas, talheres, wi-fi de qualidade e até secador de cabelos) e a localização é excelente, muito próxima da Av. Santa Fe e da linha D do metrô. O único inconveniente é que, justamente por estar localizado tão próximo de uma avenida, há bastante barulho - mas nada que chegue a atrapalhar a estadia.
Fui bem recebida pelo esposo da Viviana e ela me atendeu prontamente quando tive uma dúvida. Da mesma forma, em um dia no qual não havia energia elétrica, o encarregado do edifício me auxiliou tão logo solicitei.
Recomendo o apartamento e certamente me hospedaria nele novamente.

We were warmly greeted at the apartment and both Carlos and Viviana were very helpful as we had many questions they were more than happy to answer.
The flat was perfect! Spotlessly clean, it provided us with everything we needed for a comfortable stay in Buenos Aries. The location for us was perfect. We walked everywhere and when we were too tired to walk, the buses were close by.
We enjoyed the cafe/bakery on the corner and the many food shops.
We recommend this flat to anyone wanting a cozy home to return to after a hot day of touring!!!
Many thanks go out to our hosts Viviana and Carlos.
Ellen and Adrian from Canada

A estadia foi excelente e só tenho elogios, o apartamento é muito agradável e bem localizado. Viviana e Carlos foram muito atenciosos e solícitos, da pra ver que estão acostumados a receber muita gente e colaboram para que tudo ocorra com tranquilidade.

Great stay in Viviana's apartment. Just as described and very clean.  Check-in was easy.  I didn't meet Viviana but she was quick to respond if I had a question.  Location is perfect, with lots of shops and restaurants around and a full grocery store just a few blocks away.  A subway stop is around the corner providing a quick trip downtown, and a nice touch to have a Subte card waiting for guests.  I enjoyed the balcony most days for breakfast. Strong wifi too. It was perfect for one or a couple.
Perfecto. Descripción del anuncio correcta. El barrio muy lindo

Viviana was extremely responsive and helpful with all our questions as we prepared for our visit to Buenos Aires. Her husband helped us check in when we arrived and all went smoothly. The studio is exactly as listed and very clean. We relied a lot on the close proximity of the Aguero metro station to get around and Viviana provides a Subte card which you can load with pesos for your stay which was very nice. WiFi was also excellent which is always important when traveling and staying connected to friends and family back home. We really enjoyed having a home base after a long day exploring the city and having a kitchen to prepare meals when we needed a break from eating out. One thing to note for very light sleepers is that the street can be a bit noisy on weekends which is to be expected in a large city. We felt very safe in this location and had everything we needed nearby such as a grocery store, the metro, and a delicious pastry shop on the corner which you must visit many times! We had a wonderful stay and would return if we visit Buenos Aires in the future! Muchas gracias por todo!

En nombre de mis padres, que ocuparon el depto, les cuento que todo estuvo perfecto. El depto tal cual las fotos, luminoso, limpio y con todo lo necesario. No conocimos a viviana personalmente pero sí a su esposo que fue muy amable, incluso nos llevó en su auto hasta la clinica. Tuvimos un pequeño inconveniente con la calefacción, pero ella estuvo pendiente por telefono y mail para solucionarlo rapidamente, y todo siguió perfecto.
Excelente ubicacion. Muy recomendable. Gracias!

Fui muito bem recebido por Carlos, marido de Viviana, que me deu várias dicas sobre locais e transportes. O apartamento é ótimo, exatamente como mostram as fotografias. A localização é excelente, com estação de metrô, ponto de ônibus e farto comércio muito próximos. Adorei a experiência.

Estivemos por 10 dias nesse ótimo apartamento e ficamos muito satisfeitos com sua localização. O apartamento é bem equipado (exatamente como descrito no anúncio) e bem aconchegante.
Fica próximo a bons restaurantes, padarias, farmácias, supermercados, fruteiras (quitandas) e transporte público.
A anfitriã nos recepcionou super bem e colocou-se a disposição para quaisquer eventualidades.
Gostaria de ressaltar a gentileza da anfitriã em disponibilizar o cartão SUBE e um celular pré-pago para nossa utilização durante a estadia.
Realmente essa experiência superou nossas expectativas. Nota 10!

My friend and I had a great experience at Viviana's studio apartment. Her kind husband greeted us right on time and showed us everything we needed to know about staying there, and the place itself is perfect and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Great location and perfect for two people!

I never saw Viviana but his husband is a very kind guy, he gave us a warm welcome and took time to explain all about the area of the studio. The location is great, you have a lot of things nearby by just walking a few blocks (supermarket, drugstore, mall, etc.).
Definitely would recommend it!!

Absolutely perfect. Everything. Especially Viviana's helpful guidance and instructions. The place is great too. It works both as a refuge and place to rest within the city. And a great base from which to explore everything there.

El departamento tiene una ubicacion perfecta en una zona muy linda y segura, a una cuadra del subte, cerca de supermercados, farmacias y shoppings. Con Viviana la comunicacion fue muy rapida, directa y facil. Su marido Carlos muy atento y amable explicando todo el primer dia. Incluso me ofreció usar un celular y la tarjeta sube. El remis que me recomendó fue pefecto. Me senti como llegar a casa, el departamento muy limpio y tenia todo lo que se necesita, tambien posibilidad de lavar ropa. Estoy muy agradecida y quisiera poder volver. Muchas gacias!!!

The apartment was nicely located in a residential area of Recoleta/Palermo, close to the metro and on a central street. The apartment was clean and the hosts were there to greet us with the keys and also a metro card. Overall a nice experience.

I have been travelling for 3 months and been to many countries in Asia and South America and Buenos Aires was my favourite place and this was my favourite accommodation to stay in. The apartment was in a great area near a really good bakery and great shops. Not a far walk to the Recoleta cemetery too. The place was really clean, wi-fi was great, they met me on time to give me the keys and were very helpful immediately responding to any queries. I cooked some great food there from the supermarket only 2 streets away and have to say had some of the best steak of my life. Thanks very much for the place and I will definitely be back.

Great apartment and great location!
We had wonderful time in BA.
The apartment just like the photos.
As we arrived we got SUBE card which was very good and helpful for the underground train.
Very recommend.

We totally enjoyed our stay in San Telmo at Alejandra’s place. The neighborhood is fun and welcoming and from the apartment it is easy to enjoy BA, moving with the bus to other neighborhoods. Wifi wasn’t very good but with an Argentinian SIM card wasn’t a problem.. A/C was also very good, it was so hot in BA these days and we were happy to sleep with A/C on. The apartment is beautiful and clean. Alejandra and Carolina are responsive and helpful. Thank you very much for having us!

Probably the best place in Buenas Aires to have a great time in perfect location, great neighbourhood and lovely apartment with tremendous care!
We really enjoyed our stay and would love to come back again! Aljendra was very helpful and she helped with finding everything we needed to have an amazing stay!
Will definitely try to book this place again when in Buenas Aires

Egle's apartment was great! The location in town is super cool (barrio Boedo), close to restaurants, bars, squares and theaters. She was super helpful to us with tips, modes of transportation and a map of the area. Egle is a very nice, wonderful host! We appreciated our stay.

Adorei a nossa estadia!! Egle é uma excelente anfitriã e está sempre pronta a ajudar no que for preciso. O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos: muito bem limpo e tudo está novo. Além disso é muito bem localizado e o metrô está próximo. Quando voltar a Buenos Aires, já sei onde irei ficar. Recomendo!!

Viviana's centrally located suite is an economical way to visit Buenos Aires. Subway and bus lines are a block or two away, good security, food shops and restaurants nearby. Carlos (Viviana's husband) met us at suite minutes after we arrived and made us familiar with the suite and the city's attractions of interest to us. We like to use public transit when travelling and Viviana leaves a "Subte" transit card in the suite which simplifies the ticketing process. We were happy with the suite and enjoyed our visit to Buenos Aires. Thanks Viviana!
David & Claire Vancouver Canada

Wonderful apartment!!! Great location, we really felt "in the center of it all", but it was a nice comfortable place to come home to after a long day out. Bed was comfortable, water was hot, wifi was fast, apartment was both safe and very clean. One thing: bring earplugs! Would stay again in a heartbeat..thanks Viviana!

This is a very central  and adequate apartment in a friendly location. Viviana has supplied all you will need, plus there are supermarkets, restaurants and farmacies all very close by. The community  is friendly and helpful, most people can speak some english. We had a great time exploring the city by foot. Of special interest was the Antique markets on Sunday which is rich with music and various artist performances.

El dpto. es exactmente como se ve. Comodo, calido, confortable, limpisimo, funcional. Ha sido una gran eleccion. Muy bien ubicado. Fue un placer pasar unos dias alli. Lo recomiendo !!!!!!! Cuando vuelva a Bs. As., sin dudarlo, lo volveria a elegir
Muito perto do metro, limpo, lindo! A sacada então? Tudo de bom!
Beautiful studio. Perfect location. Everything right.

Viviana was there when I arrived, and she explained briefly the different things I needed to know. The location is superb and I chose it because of that. I am originally from Buenos Aires and know the city well. The place is exactly as described perhaps even better. Great value for your money and would return any time again. I am delighted about this place.

La Av. Santa Fe está a un paso nada más, lo cual permite tener fácil acceso a los puntos turísticos de la ciudad. La zona es tranquila pues se puede caminar sin problema a cualquier hora del día y de la noche. La gente del barrio nos trato muy bien, desde las peluquerías pasando por buenos restaurantes, hasta los pequeños kioskos cercanos.

El departamento ofrece comodidad y se encuentra exactamente como anuncia la publicación. El Sr. José fue muy atento al igual que las personas que nos recibieron.

10 días fueron suficientes para absorber un poco de todo lo que Buenos Aires tiene por ofrecer a ojos turistas. Algún día volveremos a pasar por el sur del continente...

Highly recommended.
Saludos.
The apartment has a great location: very close to the subway, mall, grocerys and restaurants. The photos on the Airbnb is the same of the apartment. Is great for one or two people.
El departamento superó las expectativas. Muy lindo, ordenado, bien ubicado y muy bien equipado.  Recomendado sin dudas.

I had a good experience in Viviana's apartment. It was very clean, the kitchen appliances working well. It is located in a safe neighborhood, near the avenue Santa Fé, metro, supermarket, places to eat and near most of the city's tourists attractions. It has a nice balcony with a beautiful view. Viviana was very helpful and left us a phone and a metro card for us to use. We loved our stay.

Nos alojamos una semana en su departamento. El mismo es muy lindo, muy cuidado y cuenta con todo lo necesario. El sector donde se encuentra el departamento es muy seguro, tanto de día como de noche. Se encuentra a pasos de la avenida Santa Fe, a metros de un shopping, restaurantes, confiterías y demas. Muy recomendable!

El departamento de Viviana cuenta con todas las comodidades que describe y se ven en las imágenes.
El edificio es tranquilo con servicio de portería, muy atento.
La zona y alrededores cuentan con diferentes servicios (supermercados, verdulería, panadería, restaurantes, bares, comercios en general) y la gran ventaja de disponer de la estación de subte en la misma cuadra.
La comunicación con la anfitriona fue muy cordial y fluida, especialmente para coordinar con facilidad el ingreso y egreso del departamento.
Todo está cuidado, incluso hasta en el detalle de dejar a disposición del huésped una tarjeta para uso en el sistema de transporte público (algo muy útil si se es nuevo en la ciudad).

Es un buen apartamento de buen tamaño para 1-2 personas con lindo balcón y buena ubicación. Desventajas son el ruido de la calle que sí se oye bastante igual al del pasillo cuando hablan los vecinos. Ahora que hubo algunos días fríos hizo mucho frío en el depa de noche, a pesar de la calentadora eléctrica y una cobija que hay ahí. Las ventanas no están muy bien aisladas en general.
Excelente apartamento, localização e anfitriões! Recomendo.

O apartamento é exatamente como mostrado nas fotos. Tudo funciona perfeitamente. Wifi, tv a cabo, água quente em todas as torneiras e aquecedor foram primordiais para melhorar ainda mais nossa estadia. A localização é excelente, perto de metrô, ponto de ônibus e com tudo que vc precisa a poucos metros. Recomendo muito. Voltaria com certeza.
Muy buena ubicación y atención! Viviana siempre pendiente y dispuesta a ayudar! Departamento muy lindo y cómodo!

Estuve alojada tres meses en el departamento de Viviana. Fue una experiencia muy buena, la ubicación es excelente, hay un subte a la vuelta y muchas líneas de colectivos que pasan por Av. Santa fe, por lo cual es muy fácil acceder a todos los puntos de la ciudad. El barrio es tranquilo, tiene supermercados y otros comercios cerca. El departamento es muy cómodo, luminoso, muy limpio, y está en buenas condiciones, además de contar con todos los servicios. Viviana y su esposo, quien me recibió al llegar, han sido muy atentos, y siempre mostraron buena predisposición ante cualquier eventualidad.
Sin dudas un lugar para volver. Muy recomendable

O lugar é como na foto. De tamanho ótimo para 1 ou 2 pessoas, limpo, claro e super funcional.
Muito perto do metrô, da Av. Santa Fé (que tem bastante coisa) e de mercados. Mas longe dos pontos mais turísticos de Palermo (dá pra ir andando ou tem opção de pegar ônibus).
A comunicação sempre foi ótima e sempre foram muito prestativos. Voltaria.
Very nice, clean and centric place. It had everything we needed for our stay in Buenos Aires.
Muy buena mí estadía. La ubicación es muy buena y el departamento es como está en las fotos.

Safe place in a great area! Communication very easy with the host.
Definitely, a place to stay!
El alojamiento es tal cual se ve en las fotos, e inclusive mejor. La hospitalidad de Viviana y Carlos es inmejorable. Recomiendo 100%!
El departamento es tan encantador como se ve en las fotos, no le falta nada y la hospitalidad de Viviana y Carlos no puede ser mejor!

Hermoso departamento, fui con mi novia y nos sentimos muy a gusto, estuvimos 8 noches. Buena ubicacion cerca de la estacion de subte, cama muy comoda, muchos libros disponibles para el que le guste leer, barrio tranquilo y agradable.
El vuelo de regreso salia tarde por lo que viviana nos permitio quedarnos en el dpto hasta tarde asi disfrutabamos el ultimo dia sin los bolsos encima,totalmente recomendable muchas gracias esperamos volver pronto.

Ariana's apartment is a fantastic base for exploring Buenos Aires. It is clean, bright, nicely decorated and thougtfully equipped. Location is great: Av. Santa Fe and the subway are a minute away, and you can easily walk around Recoleta or over to the bars and boutiques of Palermo Soho in 15 minutes or so. Check-in and communication have also been top-notch. Highly recommended.
A really well equipped studio flat with great public transport connections, 20 minute walk to the best of Palermo. We had a great stay and would definitely recommend the place!

We had a lovely stay in this studio! The communication was fast and clear. The studio offers everything you need for a stay of two weeks. Location is central, everything is nearby (supermarkets, restaurants, buses and subway). Sometimes a little noisy because the road is quite busy but overall we slept great and we could relax whenever we wanted. There is a charming little terras where you can enjoy the afternoon sun. Hot shower and great WiFi! Always felt safe at night in this neighbourhood. We would definitely recommend! Thanks Viviana for the great stay.

Viviana y Carlos son personas muy amables y atentas, el departamento se encuentra en una zona muy bonita y rodeada de varios sitio agradables. El departamento de Viviana es como sentirse en casa, así se sentía mi hija.
Lo recomiendo totalmente!!!!!!!!
Recomendable por ubicación y estado de conservación del lugar. Todas las consultas fueron respondidas. Se escucha un poco el ruido de  la calle, lo cual es entendible por la buena ubicación. Saludos.
El lugar es muy lindo y confortable, tiene muy buena ubicación, fácil de llegar y cerca de lugares claves, si vas a Buenos Aires no dudes en elegir este lugar.

El departamento es tal cual aparece en las fotos. Es muy lindo y espacioso. Perfecto para ir solo o de a dos. Yo fui con mi madre y nos gustó muchísimo. Desayunamos todos los días en el balcón donde nos llegaba sol.
La ubicación es perfecta, caminamos hacia plaza Francia y también hasta plaza julio Cortazar, muy céntrico.
Viviana siempre estuvo atenta a los mensajes por lo que la comunicación fue muy rápida y fácil.
100% recomendado!

I stayed in this apartment for six weeks.  It was extremely clean and Viviana was very friendly and responsive.  The location is great, right near the Agüero metro/subte station, although it's really more part of the Recoleta neighborhood and not Palermo.  But very easy to get anywhere in the city!
Great place to stay! Easy to move around, perfectly located between Recoleta and Palermo, highly recommend!

El departamento es hermoso, super luminoso. La comunicación con Viviana fue perfecta. Es idéntico a como se ve en las fotos. Limpieza excelente. Muy cómodo en todos los sentidos. Finalizado el día te dan realmente ganas de volver a descansar. Sin dudas volveremos.
muy limpio y ordenado, las fotos son lo que realmente es el departamento.

Muito boa localização e espaço muito bom.
Possui ar-condicionado, bem iluminado e ventilado.
É uma rua bem movimentada a partir das 6~7hs, o que implica em algumas buzinas barulho de trânsito.
No mais, ótimo.

O espaço é do tamanho certo para uma ou duas pessoas. Tem uma cozinha que não usamos tanto porque não passamos muito tempo em casa, pequena mas funcional. Fomos muito bem atendidos por Viviana, que apesar de não termos visto pessoalmente, sempre esteve disposta a sanar todas as dúvidas quanto às instalações e ao que fazer, e deu várias dicas sobre como seria melhor proceder em algumas situações. Tive um voo cancelado com a possibilidade de não chegar no dia e na hora prevista e desde que soube avisei para ela, que se dispôs a resolver comigo da melhor forma possível.
Fomos recebidos por sua filha incrivelmente simpática mesmo com todos os contratempos do meu voo. A janela principal e a sacada são encantadoras, gostaria de ter passado mais tempo em casa só pra poder ficar mais tempo com a vista.
O lugar também é ótimo, fica perto de tudo, e se você gosta de andar, talvez não leve mais de uma hora para chegar até o centro a pé. O caminho não é desgastante, tem muita coisa pra ver, e quando a gente percebe está passando por um ponto mais turístico ou outro. Fica também muito próximo à estações de metrô. Quando tinhamos um horário marcado pegávamos o metrô e chegávamos nos lugares no máximo em meia hora.
Por fim, muito obrigada Viviana, a experiência foi ótima e tenho certeza que você e sua filha tiveram influência nisso, evitando com que nós ficássemos apreensivos ou ansiosos com as coisas do voo e da casa.

Excelente ubicación, zona segura de la ciudad, accesible al transporte publico. el departamento es cómodo y especioso . Buenos puntos de interés y de zona comercial.
Muy atentos en la atención de la llegada y durante la estadía. Don Jose muy amable y correcto.
Gracias por sus atenciones.
Great place. clean, good area, prompt communication!

Pasé cinco meses de la cuarentena Covid en el departamento. Dentro del contexto, fue buena experiencia, el departamento es más que amplio para una persona, está bien equipado y el barrio tiene lo esencial muy a mano.
Mi única sugerencia para los hosts sería que cambien el colchón ya que está viejo y gastado y se nota.

Mono ambiente muy bien ubicado en la frontera entre Recoleta y Palermo lo que lo hace muy accesible. A unos pasos de Av Santa Fe donde se puede encontrar una infinidad de comercios, restaurantes y cafés. Si bien el apartamento es de construcción antigua está muy bien adecuado, es acogedor y sobre todo muy limpio. Sin duda volvería.
Todo muy bien y acorde a lo publicado.
muy buen depto por ubicación y comodidades.Recomendable

En el departamento estuvo todo súper bien!👌 Viviana siempre atenta a todo!
La ubicación nos pareció perfecta. Llegamos más tarde de lo previsto y nos ayudaron a coordinar el check in sin ningún problema 👍.
Muy recomendable 🙌🙌🙌.
El departamento de Viviana es  tranquilo y cómodo. Está muy bien ubicado y con fácil comunicación para todos lados. Lo recomiendo mucho a quien quiera pasar bien y en paz.
Eugenia an her partner were very pleasent and really caring hosts, I can only recommend them. The appartment was nice, in one of Buenos Aires best locations, and had everything I needed.

Egle's apartment is beautiful and was a perfect temporary home for a couple like us looking to explore Buenos Aires. Egle was very helpful with any questions we had and arriving and checking-out was very simple. Thanks again!

Charles & Jeyn

My friend stayed in Eugenia's flat and it was very nice, clean in a perfectly safe new building, probably a hundred meters away from nice restaurants and bars of Las Canitas. The flat looks very new, it's spacious and perfect even for a longer stay in this beautiful town!

Eugenia was also very helpful in directing us to the right restaurants and bars :)

Las Cañitas is a fun neighborhood for restaurants & non-touristy people-watching.  Eugenia's apartment manages to be both slick & comfortable.  I loved the architecture of the roof deck, as well as the view.  When we needed some household items, she had a family member come over within minutes, ready with dining & shopping advice.  Great city, great hosts - all good.  Except maybe that November is not a swimming month, rooftop pool was out of commission.
Wonderfuly located, this apartment is very clean, well equipped and it is bigger than it appears. Highly recommended.

We didn't have the chance to meet Egle but she was really reactive by mail and even by phone. We had a little problem with the wifi and she was really prompt to react. Very professional, she even offers us to change apartment when we told her that the neighbours were noisy at night. The place is ideally located, very clean, with all the furniture needed (we stay more than a month). I recommend.

Great! Egle is an amazing host, very kind and helpful. The apartment is cozy, clean and mod cons. The location is very good, near the subway, supermarket, bank, cafè and "confiterias" (I suggest Cafè Margot!). If I'll be in Baires again, I accommodate in Egle apartment surely.

It was a great time staying in Egle's apartment!
It is a clean and quite place to leave in. The apartment looks exactly like on the photos.
Egle responded quickly and helped us with all the questions we had.
She is really a nice and sunny person!

Would recommend this place to my friends.

Carolina was very accommodating and helpful as well.
Great spot
We will definitely go back
Great hosts
Amazing location, lovely apartment and great, communicative host. The terrace was brilliant too!

The apartment is also close to public transportation (bus lines and fairly close to the subte). The neighborhood isn't a huge nightlife area-- most people seem to end up in Palermo Soho for that--but I liked the more local feel of the area. There are some bars in the area that seem more low key.

The apartment itself is great. If it had been warmer I would have loved using the balcony. The shower was great and the bed comfortable. But, being in the heart of the neighborhood, there is some noise. I slept just fine with the fan on. The blackout curtains are a nice touch too.

Overall, very recommended, especially as a woman traveling alone. Having a doorman always at the door helps with safety & everyone living in the building seemed friendly.

One final note--there is no blow dryer in the apartment, so plan accordingly.

2) Egle and her team are very responsive and will do their best to cater to your needs.

3) In walking distance from the apartment you can find good grocery stores(e.g. COTO), cafés (e.g. flores poreña), and bars; also tube and bus stations are in walking distance.
