I have broken down this review into pros and cons to give others a depiction of my experience.

PROS:
1. Over all it’s an inexpensive option in a decent location for a short stay.

2. The host was professional and courteous during our communications (In my case there was a time difference between argentine local time and the host’s time so responses may not be instant)

3. The bellman was friendly. It is paramount if you or someone in your party speaks Spanish to facilitate communication.

CONS:
1. The propane gas heater, which emits a strong scent for those who are sensitive, did not sufficiently heat the apartment. Heating is especially important during winter in Argentina.

2. I was without hot water for a short while, however, the host eventually addressed the issue.

3. Keep in mind, the shower entrance is extremely small for those requiring larger entry and exit spaces.

4. Ensure a couple of rolls of toilet paper are sufficiently stocked upon check in.

Side note:
If you want to charge your personal devices next to the bed, you may have to unplug the lamp in order to use that socket.

Perto da estação de metrô e ônibus, supermercado, farmácia, comércio, praças, shopping. Volví enamorada con este lugar, espero volver pronto!
La descripción del anuncio era correcta con todo Lo que María ofrecía.
Maria ist eine sehr warmherzige Gastgeberin und hat mich bereits vorab per mail mit ein paar wertvollen Tips versorgt. Die Wohnung ist super schön - sehr empfehlenswert. Ich komme gerne wieder ...

Tuvimos una muy buena experiencia en la casa de María. Ella es súper amable y nos dio muy buenas recomendaciones de cosas para hacer durante nuestra visita a Buenos Aires. La casa también es muy lindo y en un lugar muy bueno para ir a ver otros barrios en la ciudad. También todo es muy limpio y hay una manera bien organizada para las cosas del baño/cocina y todo. fue un placer quedarnos con María y definitivamente me quedaría allá de nuevo sí regreso a buenos aires.

Such a peaceful haven in the mad world of BA. Maria is a wonderful host - friendly, helpful and full of life. She makes you feel very well looked after. Many of her guests stay for long periods and it's easy to see why. The homely communal dining room, living room and reception/bar area are beautifully decorated with antiques and artwork. Rooms at the front have lovely little balconies from which you can watch the world go by below. There are three excellent bars and cafés within a stone's throw and the bohemian delights of Palermo Soho and Palermo Viejo are just round the corner. I stayed 3 nights and it already felt like home and was a wrench to leave. It's also incredible value for money for such a beautiful home. Muchas gracias Maria!
Muy buena experiencia, la casa es hermosa y limpia. Pude realizar mis actividades con absoluta independencia. Recomendable. Aunque sería conveniente que la habitación tuviera aire acondicionado

Maria è stata molto cordiale e disponibile. Mi ha subito fornito tutte le indicazioni necessarie per sfruttare al meglio il mio soggiorno in città, indicandomi posti da visitare e consigliandomi ristoranti. La casa è molto bella, accogliente e pulita; si trova in una zona tranquilla ma con tutte le comodità per arrivare nelle principali zone turistiche senza difficoltà.
Great value! Comfy and luminous.
Casa maravilhosa e bem localizada, anfitriã super atenciosa e educada. Adoramos a experiência.
El departamento es muy cómodo, bonito y con una ubicación excelente, con Egle todo transcurrió según lo acordado, una experiencia para repetir.
Very well located. You can go walking at the sidewalk to have a coffee or take a drink at night. Comfortable and it have a nice reception/host.

A really lovely, clean and spacious apartment. The location was especially great - Boedo feels like a very authentic and relaxed neighbourhood and Avenida Boedo was a lovely street to walk out on to every day. Thank you Egle!

El monoambiente es muy bonito, amplio y acogedor. La cocina cuenta con varios utensilios y vajilla. La ubicación 100 puntos, ya que cerca se tiene verdulerias, supermercados, restaurantes y a cuatro cuadras la estación del Subte, además de varias paradas de buses.
Sin lugar a dudas, volvería a elegir el monoambiente de Egle tanto por el lugar como el trato y atención.

Insalubre! Sucio! Mosquitos aplastados en las paredes! Ropa de cama, mantas, almohadas y colchón con mal olor, humedad, acaros! Tuvimos que cancelar luego de que nos diera un ataque alérgico! Wifi en la cabecera de la cama, ducha pequeña, el boton del vater  no funciona tampoco la lampara que aparece en fotos, la peor respuesta de la anfitriona, no hacerse responsable y acusarme de chantaje!! No solo NO me compenso por su negligencia si no que tampoco me devolvió el dinero de los dias de terror en su departamento! Eviten este lugar!

El departamento tiene todo lo necesario para una estadía tranquila. Linda la decoración del departamento, el que además está cercano a una zona de bares y restaurantes muy familiar. A escasas cuadras de una estación de subte, tiene todo lo necesario para estar en Buenos Aires.

Il manque d'équipements de cuisine, il faisait froid dans l'appartement. Il n'y avait pas une grande quantité d'eau chaude dans la douche pour 2 personnes.
Secteur sécuritaire à côté des transports en commun, des restaurants et des supermarchés.
Me encanto son los mejores no duden con este alojamiento
Excelente ubicación. Todo estaba muy limpio y en orden. Además el wi fi funciona muy bien.
Excelente hospedaje, muy amables y todo claro, el encargado muy atento. Tuvimos una muy grata experiencia, sin duda volveríamos
Was a good apartment, good location

Una excelente estadía! Egle fue muy amable, excelente comunicación, muy flexible y puntual. Ademas que el lugar estuvo excelente (con varios restaurantes y tiendas alrededor nuestro)
El departamento muy limpio, y la cama estuvo muy cómoda

Lo que no me gustó:
-Comunicación poco asertiva, comentarios desafortunados, falta de tacto y escasas habilidades de servicio al cliente. No sabe escuchar al cliente, es inflexible e intolerante en algunos aspectos.
-Cobran por cambiar ropa de cama aunque anuncio dice que está incluido.
-La puerta de vidrio del patio tiene el picaporte quebrado y no quiso arreglarlo.
-Espacio de ducha extremadamente pequeño.
-Hay unas pinturas muy aterradoras y turbias en la pared frente a la cama que dan mala vibra (no aparecían en las fotos del anuncio cuando reservé).
-Falta una mano de pintura en ciertas áreas (ej.cocina), no es "sin manchas" como se anuncia.
-Jardín de niños que colinda con depto y a ratos hay mucha bulla.
-Cortinas translúcidas, mucha luz desde las 6am.
Lo que sí me gustó:
-Barrio seguro.
-Muy buena ubicación y conectividad con transporte.
-Todo tipo de facilidades (restaurantes, supermercados, bancos, heladerías) a pasos.
Muy buen alojamiento !
It was a beautiful experience  to stay in Egle apartment.
Departamento muy cómodo y bien ubicado

Apartamento muy bien ubicado en una de las zonas más bonitas. Muy iluminado y soleado
Excelente tamaño y distribución.
Mobiliario adecuado que puede ser actualizado para más confort de los huéspedes para largas estancias
Tiene todos los servicios
La anfitriona Andrea mantuvo en todo momento un excelente trato y resolvió todas las solicitudes en manera eficaz y efectiva. Es de resaltar su comportamiento
Esta propiedad es muy recomendable

Excelente alojamiento. Cumple con todo lo publicado. Excelente ubicaciónen un barrios muy bonito. De mencionar el trato excelente de  Brenda dispuesta a cualquier hora para dar respuesta a nuestras necesidades. No tenemos quejas de ningún tipo. Alojamiento altamente recomendable

Apto muy bien ubicado, cerca de parques y zonas de ocio. Amplio y muy iluminado. Buenas instalaciones. Han cumplido con todas nuestras sugerencias y han mejorado colocando una lavadora. Especial mención al trato dado por Brenda quien ha estado pendiente todo el tiempo de nuestra estadía para hacerno sentir bien.
Lugar de 5 sobre 5

Es tal cual como se ve en las fotos.
Estuve viviendo 2 meses en el departamento, y me senti muy a gusto.
Es un lugar muy alegre y calido. El tener seguridad 24 hs es un super plus!
Muy completo, no le falta nada, ni en la cocina ni en el cuarto ni en el baño.
Yo ya habia alquilado departamentos amoblados pero este es el mejor por lejos.
Brenda, la anfitriona, excelente !Cada vez que quise consultar algo, siempre atenta y amable, y flexible a la hora de check in y check out.
Lo recomiendo y yo voy a volver cada vez que vaya a Bs As.

Excelent apartment in one of the most beautiful neighbourhoods in Buenos Aires. Very well equiped, although internet was a bit slow.
It has a big balcony with a view.
perfect price perfect location. we will miss this place.
ótima relação custo-beneficio e localização privilegiada

Una muy linda experiencia! La casa de Maria es muy bonita, acogedora, y está en una ubicación ideal. Y ella es una persona muy amable, siempre dispuesta a ayudar y responder consultas. No tengo ningún tipo de queja. Sin duda regresaría!

I had a great time staying at Marias house. Maria is a lovely, lively and caring person. Her house and the beautiful green terass was a unique experience. I highly recommend staying at her place. Gracias y besos Maria!
Very nice and stylish house/room. Enjoyed my stay there very much, good transport connections, clean house.

Estar em BS AS , hospedada na casa de aria, foi uma ótima opção, local muito bem localizado com muitas opções de desgn, restaurantes, transporte público tudo a "dois passos" da casa.

Maria é uma pessoa muito simpática e disposta , sempre colaborativa.

Enfim, uma ótima opção de hospedagem .

Maria est une hôte très sympathique, accueillante et prête à vous aider . Son appartement est atypique et superbe . Ce fut un plaisir de passer quelques moments avec elle . Je me suis sentie chez moi .

Wow. What can I say to do justice to my stay with Maria!? I booked 4 nights after a horrible hostel experience and could not have been more relieved to arrive. The apartment - first of all - is beautiful. Uniquely decorated, you will be in heaven taking pictures. Maria rents out several rooms - mine was the violet room and I could not have get more comfortable. Clean and fully stocked with everything you could want (converters!) and all of the amenities in the apartment work better than at home. Maria herself is amazing. So helpful and hospitable (she gave me home made tiramisu one morning!) - I felt like I was at home with my family. Will come back and stay longer next time 1000%

L'accoglienza di Maria è stata ottima! Mi è venuta ad aprire, mi ha mostrato la stanza e mi ha spiegato tutto quello di cui avevo bisogno; mi ha poi indicato dei luoghi da vedere sulla mappa e come raggiungerli. La stanza è molto carina e confortevole e anche la casa è bella! Il quartiere è bello e tranquillo.
Maria è simpatica, accogliente e disponibile!

I loved staying with Maria! Her home is beautiful, and she is extremely welcoming and helpful. I had been staying in hostels for weeks prior to staying with Maria, and this was such a welcome reprieve. The room was so cozy, everything you could possibly need was supplied (including a super speedy hot water heater and tea bags!). The location, right on the edge of Palermo Soho, is also great and very safe. There is no laundry at the house but there is a very cheap (30 pesos) laundry service on the next corner. Maria asks that the kitchen is not used for cooking, but it is okay to to keep a few items to reheat and such (I made toast, and heated up prepared food). Overall a great experience, highly recommend!

Mi estadía con María fue muy agradable. Ella tiene un departamento muy bonito y la habitación cuenta con todo lo necesario, incluso más! Fue como sentirme en mi propia casa.
María es muy amable y me ayudó mucho con consejos para tener una mejor estadía en Buenos Aires.
El departamento está muy bien ubicado, cerca del subte y a pasos de Palermo Soho.
Lo recomiendo totalmente.

Maria was very kind and I felt welcome in her home. The room was spacious and comfortable, with a nice little balcony. There was even a kettle in the room and Maria gave me coffee and tea bags which was lovely! The bed was comfy, bathroom was clean and the wifi was good for me.

The location was good, a short walk from the nice cafes, parrilladas and shops of Palermo, as well as a short walk to the metro for easy access to areas like San Telmo. Overall a lovely stay!

We loved this airbnb, one of our favorites in Buenos Aires!  The apartment is well laid out with lots of space.  We enjoyed having a kitchen with everything we needed and more.  The area is idyllic with lots of amazing bars and restaurants around.  We enjoyed having many options for things to do, parks to walk to and various shops to visit.  We wish we could have stayed longer!

Excelente todo muy recomendable....el barrio super seguro tranquilo pero con lugares para salir de noche con muchos supermercados tiendas farmacia panaderias cafes...uno de los mejores barrios para disfrutar bs as. El departamento perfectamente equipado....y la comunicacion un plus que se valora mucho...nos facilitaron todo ...sin dudar será nuestra primera opcion en bs as.

Alloggio in un posizioni meravigliosa, c’era tutto vicino non ho avuto bisogno neanche di prendere la macchina perché era vicino a tutto senza parlare che appartamento é dotato di tutto super comodo e luminoso tornerei di sicuro molto soddisfatta.

El departamento es espectacular.
Amplio , cómodo, limpio. El balcón es grande y tiene todo !
Excelente barrio también.
Mariano y Brenda fueron muy atentos y comprensivos con todo. Muchas Gracias!

The apartment is very well located and functional. It has a lot of light and it is very comfortable. Has lots of closet space, too. The shower has great pressure. The neighborhood is trendy and busy, with great restaurants and cafes nearby. All and all a great stay.

I absolutely loved chatting with Maria.  She is sharp, interesting, and very helpful.  Perfect room and location. Met some very respectful travelers cohabitating there.  And did i mention the interior decoration was gorgeous, artsy, very nicely done!  I hope to return to her airbnb again!  Absolutely loved my stay.
Host very welcoming and was a pleasure to stay. Room is like the pictures and has all the other necessities. Close to bars and good restaurants. Thanks a lot Maria!

I stayed at Maria's house for 3 nights and enjoyed a lot. This is my 4th time in BsAs, and walking around Palermo is one of my favorite things to do there, so the location of the house was perfecto for me! Very convenient location.
Unfortunately Maria is not at home during my stay and I couldn't have chance to see her, but I met nice travel fellows here and they helped me a lot.
Thanks for letting me stay!

Es la segunda vez en el año que me quedo en este departamento, ambas veces 1 mes y medio.
Es calido, alegre , lindo y comodo. Es amplio y moderno.
Excelente el tema de seguridad 24 hs.
Es tal cual como se ve en la foto.
Estuve en invieno y en verano, perfecto para ambas epocas del año. En verano la pileta esta buenisima.
Brenda super atenta y dispuesta para resolver cualquier tipo duda.
Es seguro que vuelvo el año que viene y lo recomiendo sin dudarlo
Great place to stay!

After a last-minute cancelation by another agency, I turned to AirBnB and stumbled across Flor's apartment and it had everything I needed; great location, right size and a terrific price. It was a new posting and had no previous reviews, but she was very pleasant and professional via email, so I decided to go for it.

And I'm glad I did! The apartment is just as it appears in the photos. Perfect for one person, but workable for a couple as well. The building it's in is secure and on a side street in a bustling area, though the street itself has plenty of action. Everything you need (Subte, groceries, pizza, you name it) is just a few blocks away.

The apartment is also nice and quiet, save for the occasional outside noise. It's as bright as it is in the photos (which can make sleeping late a bit challenging) and the A/C works just fine. The bathroom is, well, a bathroom; it's certainly clean, but not as bright and shiny as the rest of the apartment (I'm a guy, so I got over it real fast.) The shower is good though–that's always a plus!

Oh, and most importantly, Flor was just as nice in person as she was via email.

Overall, a great experience!

Very nice host! Appartment in the center of BA, close of everything, subway, grocery, resto!
She waited for us until 2am and it was really kind.
Clean place.
Recommanded +++++

Nice studio, great central location and real value for money.
Florentia is a very friendly host.

Buena atención, ubicación, siempre en contacto y atentos, dpto muy completo
Recomendado!
Everything was good! Nice balcony and lots of restaurants near by. About a 20 minute walk to Palermo, and bus stops nearby as well.

This place was perfect! Great location! Close to buses, metro and supermarkets. It was VERY clean, comfortable and cozy. Florencia was very helpful and even left little welcome treats for us! I would defiantly stay here again if I come back to Buenos Aires!

The apartment was an excelent choice to our vacation in Buenos Aires. Very close to the subway , and ,if you like to take a walk, you can easily go to Recoleta, Jardim de Palermo and Abasto.  The apartment was very clean, the sheets and towels were very good and everything was working just fine. A good choice for staying in Buenos Aires.

I have been in Buenos Aires for 3 months and I have lived in 2 other places. Flor's place is the best so far. I echo everything in the previous reviews and would like to add that I appreciated that Flor is not only nice, but organized and flexible too. I have starred this property in my AirBNB account and I would gladly return here for future stays. Thank you Flor for making my short stay so easy. You may see me again in the future :)

We arrived at 11pm and Florencia was there waiting to let us in. She is very sweet and gracious and lives close-by in case of any problems. We unplugged the Internet accidentally and after telling her, she rushed over and fixed it. Very nice! The neighborhood is very safe and centrally-located. Great buses and trains nearby. Gracias Florencia!

Florencia is a very nice person. Everything was well organized. The appartment is a perfect place for two persons, it is safe, close to Subway, a supermarket and has wireless internet. We enjoyed our stay in Buenos Aires and would take Florencias appartment again. Thanks a lot to Florencia and the Airbnb team.

Me encanto la ubicacion del departamento. Teniamos todo muy cerca. Todo lo que un turista necesita. Florencia es muy antenta y cortez. Estamos muy conforme con nuestra estadia y recomendamos a ella como una muy buena opcion a la hora de elegir donde hospedarse en Buenos Aires.
Sergio

Had a wonderful experience in Buenos Aires due in part to the great location of Florencia's apartment. Neighborhood is very safe. Apartment was very comfortable and satisfactory for 2 people.
Esther

Flor's place was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed. Wifi worked without any problems. Flor is incredibly friendly and waited for Mike twice when he was delayed in the airport so that she could give him the key. She even responded swiftly at 2 am when the lock to the apartment broke for some reason. She had it fixed the next day. Flor left a big bottle of water in the fridge and some breakfast teas and cookies, a nice little surprise.

The apartment itself is only 2 blocks from Av. Santa Fe, a major commercial thoroughfare. The closest subte stops are on Line D at Puerreydon and Aguero. Each is only a 7 minute walk or so from the apartment. There is a little supermarket (Carrefour Express) just one block from the apartment and a pharmacy at the street corner.

Overall, Mike's stay was really enjoyable and he will definitely check to see if Flor's apartment is available the next time he (or I) visit Buenos Aires.

Florencia is a sweet and careful host. She was very friendly and supported us very well. The apartment is clean and beautiful, in a very good location in BA. Perfect for a singles and couples. Nothing else to say but to recommend everyone to stay at this place!
Florencia es muy atenta y el apartamento está perfecto. Altamente recomendado. Me quedaría aquí una vez más cuando regrese.

I had a great time. Maria is very friendly and helpful. The appartment is gorgeous and well situated.
Recommended!

Maria is really a wonderful and generous host. I had a pleasant stay at her house in Palermo soho. She made it a point to make sure my stay was comfortable. The house is located in a very nice and trendy neighborhood of Palermo. There are tons of cafes, restaurants and bars within few blocks. She also was very helpful in arranging taxis for the airport. I had a chance to meet her wonderful daughter who was nice enough to make me tea and a sandwich. I highly recommend Maria's place

I just spent the Easter break in Buenos Aires at Maria's and can only recommend soujourning at her elegant duplex apartment, which is located in one of BAs trendiest neighborhoods.

From the beginning, Maria was very responsive to my queries and was there to welcome me personally, despite the fact that I arrived before time. My room was squeaky-clean, tastefully decorated and even had a little balcony with view over the street (always a plus). The little 'extra' attention in the form of an assortment of teas and water boiler available in the room only made it that much more perfect.

Maria is an inspiringly wonderful host and she rents out two (or three) rooms in her stunning apartment to travelers. Upon my arrival, she gave me and another German guest (who was staying in another room and who ended up being an excellent travel partner for the rest of my trip) a very detailed orientation tour of BA on a map. She recommended excellent places to eat out and areas to walk around in and was full of very practical tips and information throughout my stay. I even had the pleasure of having long, insightful discussions with her about Argentinian society, politics and history (which she's extremely passionate about)- all of which contributed towards making my trip a very enriching and true Argentinian experience!

Overall, I couldn't have been more satisfied with my stay at Maria's and will definitely book again for my next trip to BA. Her warm personality, excellent sense of service and traveler-friendly tips along with her gorgeous apartment all make for a very attractive alternative to a hotel stay that you'll not regret!

Maria is straight-forward and very welcoming - a wonderful host! Her house is BEAUTIFUL, clean and well-organised. The location is lovely too, a tree-lined street in a great barrio with a yummy cafe across the street and laundromat down the road. I would have loved to have more time getting to know Maria and the area - i recommend this place to everyone!

This was my second time staying with Maria, and definitely not my last! The space is so cozy and beautifully decorated - the beds were very comfortable and it's a lovely touch to have hot water and tea available at any time in the room. Location is perfect, Maria has great recommendations for activities/restaurants, and she's an all-around dear person.
nice place. Sandra was very helpful

Maria es una excelente anfitriona, fue muy amable y me sentí realmente cómoda en su casa. El barrio es muy pintoresco y tranquilo, las principales atracciones de Palermo se encuentran a pocas cuadras. La descripción del anuncio es correcta en todo lo que informa.
Respuesta rápida. Hablé con ella para preguntar alojamiento para unos amigos... Buena onda todos, hasta la gente nueva que se cruzaron.  Camas cómodas y comfortable. Gracias!!
Impecable! Fue muy facil llegar, y Maria nos recibió muy bien aunque reservamos tarde y sobre el momento. El lugar es muy lindo en una zona privilegiada, volvería sin dudas!
房子位於Palermo Soho治安極佳的地區，附近十分方便。主人把整個環境打理得十分美麗乾淨，可惜房間沒有鎖，浴室也沒有浴缸，且主人比較冷淡保守，我住得不是很習慣。僅管如此，推薦給生活作息正常、西班牙文流利的旅客參考。

Foi uma ótima experiência partilhar um quarto da casa em que vive a Sra. Maria. Ela é muito receptiva e adora uma boa conversa. Nos faz sentirmos em casa. O apartamento é um belo trabalho de restauro, de uma edificação antiga, projetada pela própria Sra. Maria (que é arquiteta aposentada) e tem uma boa localização (Fica a 10' de caminhada da Av. Sta Fé, onde há metro e ônibus para toda a BsAs. O quarto tem aquecimento para os dias frios. Para quem tem algum problema de mobilidade cabe dizer que o apartamento fica no 2o piso e não há elevador.
Muy buena hospitalidad. Me ayudó a acomodarme un día de semana a las 00:00! Y me recomendó el mejor show de BsAs. Saludos
The room was in the middle of an excellent neighbourhood in Buenos Aires. It was clean and spacious. Maria had a very good tip about the best steak restaurant.

Minha estadia na casa da Maria foi muito legal. Ela é muito atenciosa e educada. Tivemos ótimas conversas apesar do meu espanhol ruim. :)

A casa dela está muito bem localizada, muito perto dos bares e restaurantes de Palermo. Está perto de metrô, supermercado e farmácia. Fiquei 10 dias e não tive nenhum tipo de problema. Recomendo muitíssimo a casa dela para quem deseja ter uma experiência cultural porque Maria tem ótimas histórias para contar.

Ela tem grande experiência em receber pessoas na casa dela. Adorei!
Excelente ubicación, muy buena limpieza, comunicación y atención. Muy recomendable.
todo Ok

Tercera vez de estadía larga en este departamento divino ! Es un departamento cálido , con todo lo necesario para pasarla bien . Estuve en invierno y en verano . Perfecto para cualquier época del año
Sandra siempre dispuesta a asistirme en cualquier cosa a cualquier momento del día .
La ubicación es excelente !
Es imposible no volver a alquilarlo cada vez que vengo a Baires .
Recomendadisimo!
tudo ótimo, passamos dias incríveis ✨

O apartamento é ótimo, confortável e bem situado, próximo dos parques, boa internet na sala (nem tanto no quarto) e com ótima calefação.
A recepção foi bem tranquila e a comunicação muito ágil.
Como sugestão: Talvez fosse a hora de trocar o colchão e disponibilizar um aspirador portátil!
Voltaremos certamente!
Gracias!

El departamento es bien localizado, en un edificio con excelente seguridad y es muy luminoso. Mejoraria el aspecto limpieza y la verificación de itens ofrecidos que no funcionaron esta vez ( aire acondicionado y telefono fijo). Pero, apesar de los inconvenientes,  muy fáciles de arreglar con mejor control y verificación, pase unos lindos dias.

Adoro este departamento. Cada vez que vengo a Bs As lo alquilo . Es muy lindo , cálido y tiene de todo para estar cómodo durante estadías largas .
La pileta divina.
La zona perfecta.
Seguridad 24 hs
La co host Sandra tan amorosa y atenta!!!!Gracias totales!!!’
Ya reserve mi próxima estadía 😊
Sandra was a brilliant host always responding quickly and very flexible with check in and out. Place is very clean, spacious and in a great location.
The communication was good. The location is good. If you like having 24 hour security you will enjoy this apartment. It also has a nice swimming pool.
Alloggio spazioso e confortevole non lontano da piazza serrano e dalla metro. Lo consiglio!
It is probably the most interesting/nicest apartment I have ever been. Maria is a very hospitable host and I really enjoyed staying here. Thank you a lot!

The location
Marias Appartement is located in Palermo. There are lots of restaurants, bars, caffees and shops nearby (about 5min walk to Plaza Immigrantes de Armenia). Also there are a lot of taxis around (or ask Maria to call one ;) and it takes about 20min to the national and about 45min (about 500pesos) to the international airport.

The room
The appartement has its own style (as you can see in the pictures). Everything is clean and tidy. The room itsself was quite cosy. It had a big standing fan (it was very hot), a heater and lots of other stuff we didn't use, but which made the room a little bit small if you're two people with a big and a small backpack each. Also there is a small balcony attached with two large glass doors, facing the street.

The host
Maria was a lovely host. She let us check in quite late and let us leave our backpacks beyond checkout time. Also she helped us get our luggage upstairs via material lift, gave us tipps where to eat a good and afordable steak and even called us a taxi for the airport. Superhost. Muchas Gracias, Maria :)

Maria's place is in a lovely area of Buenos Aires, close to nightlife, the best pizza I've ever eaten (do yourself a favour and order Aquelina at San Paolo's pizzeria), and public transport.

Maria was a great host and is well versed in Argentinian politics and tango, which provided me with a richer background on the city than I could've possibly found out by myself during my too-short stay.

Maria was also great at giving me tips on how to best make use of my short time there, which was invaluable.

Thank you Maria for being a great host!

Maria is an excellent host, she's communicative, very friendly and definitely open minded. The flat has a really unique interior design and the room is clean and cosy. I really enjoyed my stay there. Thanks Maria!

Maria é uma excelente host, atenciosa e gentil e me recebeu muito bem.
O quarto é ótimo, confortável, tudo muito limpo, banheiro bom (ótimo chuveiro, o que é algo importante para Brasileiros). A casa é linda, uma decoração A região é uma das melhores de Buenos Aires, super segura, pertinho do "fervo" do Palermo SoHo. E mais importante, dali você consegue ir para qualquer lugar de Buenos Aires. Voltaria a me hospedar com eles caso eu retorne a Buenos Aires.
Maria has a lovely and comfortable home. This is a wonderful place for someone who wants to explore the city while having a secure place to sleep and store belongings. The price is great as well.

O apartamento fica em um prédio antigo, porém todo novinho por dentro, limpo, organizado e fiel às fotos. Maria e sua filha, Cecilia, foram muito simpáticas, amáveis e nos receberam muito bem. Já fiquei em outros lugares de buenos aires, mas Palermo é o melhor. Bons bares, restaurantes, baladas, tudo muito perto do apartamento, sendo seguro ir e voltar a pé a qualquer horário. Alguns pontos turísticos  (Casa rosada, cemitério recoleta, obelisco, jardim japonês) estão um pouco longe para ir caminhando, mas é tranquilo  e barato ir de uber ou taxi. Quando voltar a Buenos Aires não tenho dúvidas, ficarem no mesmo lugar.
It was a great stay. Very clean and organized places. Very beautiful and interesting apartment as well in a perfect location.

Maria's place is just like described in the other reviews. Unique in the interior decorations, very charming and you feel like at home right away. The location is perfect, very closed to Plaza Armenia in Palermo were you can find all shops, Restaurants and bars. Maria is eye helpful and will assist you in any way possible. The room has two beds, a desc and a wardrobe plus a lovely balcony.

Over all I would absolutely recommend this place for a visit to Buenos Aires.
Florencia es muy atenta y el apartamento está perfecto. Altamente recomendado. Me quedaría aquí una vez más cuando regrese.

wonderful time in B.A. enjoyed  the Market & Choripan in San Telmo Also the dinner & Tango show we took in.  We went out for dinner our last two nights in Puerto Madero where we had we went for a nice walk along the canal an incredibly beautiful area with many great restaurants..  .

Very good place, beautiful, confortable and well organized place. Mrs. Florencia was extremely friendly. Apartment furnished and wi-fi had garanteed all i needed. Definitely, i strongly recommend Mrs. Florencia's apartment to the entire Airbnb community.
Muy buena la ubicación del apartamento, muy central a todos los lugares que visitamos, muy organizado y adecuado para pasar unos días de descanso en Buenos Aires. Muy recomendable.
Florencia is a great host!  The apartment is perfect for one or two people.  It's very clean, has everything you need and is very close to many attractions and public transport.
Excelente ubicacion del apartamento,muy confortable y practico,anfitriona muy amable, 100% recomendable.
Great apartment and location. Florence is a very nice person and helpful.

EXCELENTE. Florencia y su esposo son dos personas súper amables y dedicados a hacer que la estadía en su departamento sea de primera. El departamento está en excelente estado, muy bien cuidado y decorado con muy buen gusto. Tiene todas las comodidades que uno puede necesitar. La ubicación es de primera, uno tiene todo a la mano. De ahora en adelante, el depa de Florencia es mi única opción de hospedaje en Argentina, y definitivamente lo recomiendo.
Florencia was a great host, the apartment is definitely a great place to stay in Bs As. I recommend it 100%!

Quedarnos en este estudio ha sido lejos la mejor experiencia de viaje que hemos tenido! Es un lugar hermoso, mantenido de forma impecable y excelentemente ubicado. Además, Flor es un encanto, nos recibió de muy grata forma y a la hora del check out se quedó tranquilamente conversando con de distintas cosas que nos interesaban, pese a que tenía un check in en cuatro horas y debía dejar el lugar listo (pero no dejamos muy desordenado, así que no creo que haya tenido problemas jajaja). Lo recomendamos 100%

O apartamento de Florência, numa localização privilegiada de Buenos Aires - próximo às Avenidas Cordoba e Santa Fé - é apaixonante. Confortável, acolhedor, perfeito para passar lindos dias de descanso. A anfitriã é amabilíssima, o que torna a experiência ainda mais prazerosa. Recomendo imensamente. Não tenho nenhuma reclamação a fazer. Flor, minha querida, obrigado pelo cuidado e atenção. :-) Beijos brasileiros!!!
O apartamento é excelente, exatamente igual as fotos, a Flor é uma pessoa muito atenciosa e prestativa, recomendo 100%!!
Flor was great as was the apartment - I was able to pay a half day to check out late and check in early, the location of the apartment is great and the wifi and cable worked wonderfully.

Flor gave us a very good reception, she is warm and attentive.
During our entire stay in Buenos Aires, we felt at home in that cosy flat. It is very well situated, close to a lot of lovely places (Abasto, Palermo, Recoleta...).

Lovely clean, bright apartment in a nice, safe area. Check in and check out could not have gone smoother. Both Florencia and her husband Demian were most helpful and kind, and v quick to respond in the run up to our stay. They even sent us a list of suggested places to see while we were in Buenos Aires. For location and price -- if you want to have your own apartment -- you really can't beat it. Bed was comfy, and the alfajores on arrival were a nice touch, as was the map of the local area. Subway to the city centre was about 5 minutes walk away.I would recommend Florencia's apartment, as they clearly run it as a v professional operation.

Florencia e seu marido foram muito prestativos e tornaram a nossa viagem ainda mais incrível. Foram muito flexíveis com horário e super atenciosos nas trocas de mensagem. Fora o apartamento em si, que é uma graça e nos deixou muito confortáveis. A localização é ótima, e não temos absolutamente nada para reclamar desta estadia. Recomendadíssimo!
It was like my home after staying there twice.

Foi maravilhoso conhecer Buenos Aires e estar em um apartamento muito gostoso, aconchegante, próximo do metro, num bairro interessante, pudemos caminhar bastante e conhecer bem a cidade nos 9 dias que passamos lá, nos sentimos em casa, e a Florencia, que amor de pessoa, lindinha, sempre bem humorada, sendo muito flexível com horários e nos dando todas as informações que necessitamos, voltamos realmente maravilhados com a cidade e com a Flor, seu marido tb muito simpático e que filhinha linda, a Agostina, tivemos oportunidade de conhecer, só temos a agradecer e recomendar, nota mil

According to our experiences with 4 Airbnb hosts, Flor is number one!

Her place and her services are excellent .if every host is like Flor, Airbnb would be a great place.

Thank you very much Flor and your family. We will not forget your apt and your help. We wish the best for you, your husband, and your beautiful daughter.

John and Carol

Excelente escolha. O apartamento é confortável, seguro e extremamente bem localizado. Acabei optando por só comer na rua, mas a cozinha tem o que for  necessário para o preparo de qualquer refeição e há vários mercados ao redor - restaurantes e cafeterias também. A Avenida Santa Fé está a poucas quadras, assim como o Subte (Metrô), de modo que a gente se desloca para qualquer lugar com muita facilidade e sem a preocupação de se perder, pois as referências para a volta são fáceis. Flor é uma gracinha e foi muita atenciosa em tudo que precisei saber e providenciar em Baires. Recomendo muito.

Nice and bright appartment on 7th floor. When you open the big window you feel like on a balcony.
Two subte stations in 5min walk distance, from where you can get to everywhere.
Supermarket, Pizza etc. close by.
For a coffee break choose the Altenea bookstore on Av. Santa Fee (20min walk). Its an old theatre and there is a cafe on the former stage. The cheesecake is fantastic.
Great host - lovely flatm easy and uncomplicated communication. Highly recommendable!

We felt comfortable from the beginning. the appartement looked exactly like on the picture. Flor is very polite and helpful. The location of the appartement is good. It is in a nice Barrio and also close to the metro.
We just can recommend Flor and her lovely family.
Florencia et son mari ont été très serviables. J'ai passé un agréble séjour dans leur appartement qui est propre et bien situé.

Flor was a magnificent host.  We stayed two nights in her lovely apartment in Recoleta.  I was very impressed with the quality and cleanliness of the room.  She and her husband could not have been more accommodating for us and our luggage.  The location of the apartment was perfect for exploring and we felt very safe.  Would recommend this to any traveller that can find vacancy with Flor!

We had a very nice stay with Flor who went the extra mile to be a great host. That included making arrangements for me to pick up my cell phone after I'd left it at the apartment and allowing us to check in a little early. The apartment is very clean and quiet--we slept really well. The location is quite good: good access to sites and neighborhoods and very safe, although we didn't love love the very immediate areas. I would definitely recommend it.

O apartamento/studio é excelente. Bonito, aconchegante e confortável. Exatamente como as fotos. E fica numa localização espetacular: a Recoleta. Um ótimo bairro para passear a pé. Além de caixas eletrônicos próximos, vários cafés (entre eles, um starbucks), a 3 quadras da Av. Santa Fe e bem próximo de uma rotisseria espetacula'r: Fitos (Mansilla, 2555). Não bastasse tudo isso, a Flor é super atenciosa. Nos ajudou com dicas e indicações de vários lugares. Recomendo a estadia sem dúvida alguma!

We had a great time in BA. Flor and her husband were ultra accommodating -even letting us wake her up at 6am to leave baggage at her own apt so we did not have to lug around heavy bags before checking in.

The apt was cozy and in a safe location. We felt like locals! The bed was comfy and the hot water pressure was adequate. The Internet worked well and was crucial for Internet freaks like us.

This is a reliable apartment managed by a very responsible and super friendly host.

The price of the apartment was also reasonable.

First of all I would say I had the most enjoyable city break I ever had in my life and staying in this apartment made it even better.
The Apartment is so bright, clean, easy access, well furnished and nicely decorated. We cannot do even better than this in terms of location. Right in the centre of everything, close to shops, subway, main attraction and the area is very safe.
We really felt at home. It was like the flat was waiting for us.
The owner is most enjoyable and nicest person I never met. She is so kind and give you so many tips about the area and even Buenos Aires. You can ask her what you want she will help as most as she can. I personally know now when I am going to stay next time !

O apartamento é perfeito para duas pessoas! Está bem equipado, limpo e é muito bem iluminado e ventilado. A cama é confortável e tanto o ar-condicionado quanto o chuveiro funcionam muito bem. A internet wifi é rápida e estável.
A localização é muito boa, pois além de ficar em uma rua tranquila da Recoleta, onde nos sentimos seguros para caminhar em qualquer hora do dia ou da noite, o apartamento fica próximo à duas estações de metrô e de diversos pontos de ônibus, sendo muito fácil chegar a qualquer ponto da cidade. Nas ruas próximas ao apartamento há uma grande variedade de restaurantes, bares, cafés e pizzarias, e na Avenida Santa Fé há diversas lojas e bancos. O Shopping Palermo fica há poucos minutos de caminhada. Além disso, há boas opções de supermercados, tendo um Carrefour Express na mesma rua e a poucos metros de distância do apartamento.
A Flor é exatamente como já descreveram aqui: muito simpática, gentil e atenciosa. Sempre respondeu rapidamente à todas as mensagens que enviamos e no nosso último dia, pudemos deixar nossas bagagens em seu apartamento enquanto aproveitávamos nossas últimas horas na cidade.
A Flor e seu adorável apartamento estão recomendadíssimos!

Florencia and her husband were attentive, kind hosts in a big bustling city like Buenos Aires.  The apartment was perfect and the pictures are entirely representative of the space, light and how cozy the place is.  Thank goodness for air conditioning in BsAs hot hot summer.  I would highly recommend this apartment and neighborhood :)

Mi 5ta vez en ese departamento que es tan lindo ! Cada vez que viajo a Argentina ya se que me voy a hospedar ahi ! Todo impecable, Sandra ( la cohost) siempre está en todo.
Gracias otra vez y seguro nos estamos viendo nuevamente !
Lo súper recomiendo !
Nice and clean
Departamento muy limpio y ordenado. La ubicación en el barrio de las Cañitas es ideal para pasear y conocer lindos restaurantes y bares.

Great location, great place. And Yamila was most helpful in providing orientation tips.

Couldn't ask for more! HIghly recommended.

O apartamento é muito bom para 2 pessoas, tem tudo que precisa para se passar um tempo! É próximo a 2 estações de metrô, tem 1 Carrefour Express muito próximo e outro supermercado na mesma rua. A localização do apartamento é ótima para ir `a pé até os Bairros da Recoleta, Abasto, Palermo. Fizemos todo um trajeto para os pontos turísticos destes bairros tranquilamente `a pé. Florencia foi muito atenciosa desde o começo, muito educada e sempre respondeu aos e-mails com muita rapidez, seu marido nos recepcionou e foi muito atencioso também. Tivemos uma ótima estadia no apartamento de Flor.

Todo muy bien, Florencia fue muy amable al dejarnos entrar antes de la hora de entrada.
Nos proporcionó información y mapas de la ciudad.
El apartamento es tranquilo y está bien ubicado, en un barrio seguro y cerca de todos los barrios del centro (nosotros fuimos caminando a todos los lugares). El WiFi funciona muy bien, y el aire acondicionado también.
Lo recomiendo 100%

Perfect location, close to the subte and in an area that we felt safe walking day or night. My wife and I spent 10 days in BA and Flor's apartment was a perfect home base for exploring the city. We were greeted by Damien, Flor's husband on our arrival who provided us with the keys and explained everything we needed to know. The bed was comfortable and we had everything that we needed in the apartment. There are plenty of small grocery stores, as well as a large grocery store within a few blocks of the apartment. As well there are several laundromats where one can leave one's clothes to be washed at a very reasonable price. Flor and Damien are just a phone call away if you have any questions.

In short, we would highly recommend this apartment.

Jonathan

Great place to stay in Buenos Aires.  Well located to access all parts of the city.  The apartment is comfortable and has all you need.  Florencia is a fantastic host.  She thought of everything and was incredibly kind and helpful.  We would recommend this place wholeheartedly.  This was our first experience of using Airbnb and if they are all like this we will be mega happy!

O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos, bem localizado, próximo de uma estação de metrô,hospital, vários supermercados e vendas.Conseguimos ir para quase todos os lugares de metrô, o esposo da Flora foi quem nos recebeu, e foi muito receptivo, educado, e disposto a dar todo suporte, nos deixou mapas e nos ensinou a fazer ligações.
Quando voltarmos a Buenos Aires ficaremos novamente no apartamento da Flora.

Very charming and welcoming place.
The clean and tidy flat is located in a very nice neighborhood, closed to the city center and the main attractions in town.
Flor and her husband are extraordinary friendly and helpful: We arrived as late as midnight and even at that late time they took their time to give us many useful tips for our stay. They even provided us with a list of their favorite restaurants (list created by themselves for their guests).
We can very much recommend this place to all visitors to Buenos Aires.
Staying at flor's was a fantastic way to experience BA - located in Recoleta it was within walking distance to most things and really safe and secure! We had a wonderful time there.

This was the perfect place for me to stay while visiting Buenos Aires! This cute little studio apartment is bright and sunny, has a nice and comfortable bed, and good water pressure in the shower. Being a solo female traveler, it was important that I stay in a safe and well located area. This apartment is close to 2 subway (Subte) stations, near Santa Fe avenue where there are lots of shops and restaurants, but is on a quiet street away from Santa Fe Av. so you can get a good night's sleep.
As for Florencia, she is the best host! She is very warm and friendly, very communicative before and during my stay, and she even helped me hail a cab when I left. I can tell that she takes pride in this apartment, and it shows in the way it is decorated and prepped for my stay.

I highly recommend this apartment for a couple or solo traveler!

wir waren vom 31.03-5.04.2013.in dem App. Wir wurden von Florencia sehr freundlich begrüsst.Das App.liegt in einem sicheren Stadtteil mit sehr guter Anbindung in andere Stadtteile . Supermarkt , Cafes und Restaurants kann man zu Fuß erreichen . das App. war sehr sauber , die Badewanne fand ich nach einem anstrengenden Tag in BA besonders angenehm. wir würden jeder Zeit wieder dort wohnen .
Flor was a fantastic host! She made sure I had everything I needed and was always available to answer questions! The apartment is in a great area and I would highly recommend staying here :)

Florencia y su marido fueron muy acogedores y nos han dado buenas informationes para orientarse y visitar a Buenos Aires.
El apartamiento es muy confortable y limpio y hay todo lo que se necesito. Lo recomiendamos 100%.
Genial el departamento, la ubicación y la hospitalidad de los dueños. Para repetir.

My first comment to my friend I was visiting in Buenos Aires was that the apartment easily rivaled a 4-star hotel. Everything was clean and comfortable, the location is very central to the main sites, and Flor and her husband were gracious and helpful hosts. Would definitely stay again.
Maria´s house is beautiful, centrally located and very comfortable. I had a great time and I totally recommend it.

A unique environment in a special place. A lovely home; enchanting balconies. Small room but cozy and light with the french doors opened onto a small plant-lived balcony. I found the quiet that I need.

Maria's home is lovely. Cozy and clean, I had a good stay here. Be aware that there is no air conditioning and no amenities, which can be rough in the summers, but there are fans. Overall I had a lovely stay - the highlight is definitely the interior design of the space.
She is a great host. The apartment is very clean. She is also so helpful. The area is nice. I strongly recommend.
Maria sabe como adotar o hóspede e deixa-lo totalmente a vontade. Uma ótima anfitriã, com ótimas dicas! Só tenho a agradecer.

I absolutely don't recommend this place, I spend a stressful and not comfortable time here.
Maria's place is beautiful and well ubicated,I recommend it for lay-overs but not for longer stay as the atmosphere in the house is not really welcoming:
-the flat door has no key , as well as the room doors, so that they were obviously impossible to close anyway (thing that make me feel quite uncomfortable, since i was sharing the house with other unknown people, and there was also another flat in the building);
-cooking is forbidden (there is only a small electric oven with a label like: "3$ to use, but ask in advance anyway", that I found pretty weird);
-although the house is spacious and beautiful, you are not allowed to use the living room so that basically you are only allowed to stay in your room;
-the shower doesn't have a curtain nor a floor-towel so that it easily get wet and you need to use a weird instrument to clean it that I can't even describe
--> i didn't really understand how to use this thing so i left the bathroom wet various time (without asking for explanations I admit, my bad) and I accidentally left some signs of beetroot (the first time i tried to prepare a salad, since it was impossible to cook) in the kitchen, and it resulted in Maria shouting at me and calling me "pork" and mokking me imitating my italian accent. I felt really uncomfortable.
- on the other hand I have to say that I lost my key and Maria reacted pretty well. I just want to the shop to make another one. But again, when I lost it, I tried to call Maria at home and on mobile phone like one hundred times and ringing the bell without anyone never answering. I could finally get in thanks to the neighbors and maria came back after hours without even calling me back.
So, over all, I spent 10 days feeling uncomfortable and quite scared, both for the impossibility of closing any door of the flat, both for the character of Maria.
I also admit I am 23 years old and for sure I am not an example of precision and order, but I also think tiny mistakes happen to anyone and there's always an easy way to talk about it, without making fun of people and screaming with hate in the eyes like Maria did.
Maybe you will be luckier then me, but i rally don't raccomend this guest.

Muy buena la ubicación
Muy buena la atención de María
Muy limpio
me sentí muy cómoda
Maria ha sido muy atenta, se comunico rápidamente. En mi llegada me ha explicado todo y fue muy amable. Muy recomendable.

Una bella casa, con decoraciones muy interesantes. Es cerca de muchas restaurantes, barres, parques y clubs.

Maria es una anfitriona muy amable y crea condiciones perfectos para una estadia tranquila.
Casa hermosa con todo lo necesario y cerca de todo.

I spent almost a month at Maria's place, and had an incredible experience. She was extremely kind and helpful, and the accommodations were wonderful -- very close to great places to walk, eat/drink and visit.
María es una Excelente Anfitriona!!!!!!, lo mas interesante es su gran conocimiento en el arte y la arquitectura.
María es increíble súper atenta y amable . La casa es hermosa muy limpia y acogedora ! Si duda recomiendo alojarse con ella !
Bastante agradable !

María es una mujer increíble. Una anfitriona culta, amable, divertida, educada que puede llegar a hacerte sentir como en casa y con una familia. La habitación es hermosa, cómoda y muy limpia. María siempre da los mejores consejos para pasear, comer e incluso para la vida.

Ahora, tengo una familia en Buenos Aires. Súper recomendada.
Thanks for very nice welcoming with pleasure if I come back to Buenos Aires
Great location and good value. I stayed for a month, primarily using the space to sleep. Maria is always willing to help and is a great resource for navigating the city.
i have been with Maria three times now and it has always been an excellent experience. Well situated, cousy and beautiful place to stay. Above all, Maria.

María siempre estuvo atenta a cómo estaba y cómo me sentía, me dejó dejar el equipaje hasta la hora de irme a pesar de que el check out era a las 10 hs. Muy agradecida con ella! La ubicación es muy buena, un poco oscura la calle pero segura la zona. Lo único que sugeriría es cambiar la cama porque no es muy cómoda, me caía para un lado. Y además el cuarto no tiene llave, por si alguno es muy desconfiado, ni el cuarto ni el departamento estaban cerrados nunca pero bueno no pasó nada, la mía fue una excelente experiencia! Lo recomiendo!!
Es una habitacion muy linda y esta ubicada convenientemente. Maria es muy amable y me ayudo mucho con sus consejos de lo que estaba pasando en la cuidad. Gracias!

Ich habe eine Woche bei Maria gewohnt und war mit der Schnelligkeit der Kommunikation und der individuellen Ausstattung des Hauses sehr zufrieden. Der gesamte Aufenthalt war durch Marias sympathische, korrekte und hilfsbereite Art sehr angenehm.
I really enjoyed staying here. It's the perfect location in the best neighbourhood of BA.
A estadia na casa de Maria e Cecilia foi ótima, excelente localização, perto de todo!!! Tivemos so um problema com o banheiro, por reforma, mas a solução foi rápida... totalmente recomendável.
Excellent place! Maria is loving, friendly, helpful... It is a very nice place where you feel as if it were your home. 100% recommended

La casa de Maria es un encanto! No solo por el estilo, la limpieza, su ubicación estratégica ( muy cerca de los medios de transporte y perfecta si te interesa la movida del Tango !!) y sobretodo por la presencia de Maria, anfitriona maravillosa, disponible y atenta!
Mi estadía en casa de Maria ha sido estupenda y la recomiendo sin dudas a todos lo que buscan un lugar en esa ciudad hermosa!

PROS: Maria is very nice. Her place is a safe, no frills place to store your luggage and rest your head. Convenient to public transportation. The neighborhood feels safe.

AND NEED TO KNOWS: This is not a place for travelers that want a more involved, "in the know" host. Nor is it for someone who wants a little more high-end accommodations (the house is lovely and clean in and of itself). There is a very steep set of stairs, but fortunately, Maria does have a luggage lift. In terms of restaurants and stores there were not too many right around the corner (per se), but there are choices within a 10-15 minute walk.

Maria is a fantastic person and host. Her home is stylish and lovely, and extremely well located. You can walk easily to all the awesome bars in plaza Serrano and all around. Maria hosts with passion, and has excellent food recommendations. My first night there we had delicious parrilla together which was amazing. Would love to come back to stay with her.

La casa de María es muy linda con calor de hogar, muy Segura, limpia, ordenada y cómoda, María esta siempre dispuesta a ofrecer ayuda y guía a todos, personalmente me sentí muy segura dentro de casa. Esta ubicada estratégicamente en la ciudad. No se arrepentirán de optar por la casa de María.

María es súper amable y macanuda! La habitación es tal cual las imágenes. Ningún problema con horarios de llegada y salida y eso que nosotros teníamos vuelos complicados.. Justo nos tocó el fin de semana de tormentas fuertes en Buenos Aires que provocaron algunos inconvenientes pero María siempre predispuesta a solucionarlos!

Maria, Thanks so much for sharing your home and for all of your help on short notice. Staying at your house was a great introduction to Porteno hospitality and and style, I felt like part of your family. I had a wonderful time and hope to be able to return.

Muchisimas gracias, Ken

María is a great host, she will help you and tell you interesting stories about the city.
Her place is beautiful and the location is really good, I enjoyed the place and the company!

Maria es excelente anfitriona.  Me gustó mucho la casa llena de estilo y detalles. Me sentí como en mi casa.  María está pendiente de resolver tus inquietudes y necesidades y además te da sugerencias muy buenas acerca de Buenos Aires.  En la habitación tienes todo lo necesario.  Gracias Maria por tu amabilidad y por compartir historias!  Volveré!

Foi um privilégio ter Maria como anfitriã. Ela é muito simpática, inteligente, receptiva e realmente dedicada a receber bem os hóspedes. Os interiores são estilosos e visualmente ricos. O quarto é limpo, amplo e confortável. Os outros espaços do apartamento também são limpos e agradáveis. É necessário subir escadas, mas até nisso a Maria faz diferença, pois ela oferece uma "máquina" de corda que eleva as malas até a entrada do apartamento, poupando os esforços dos viajantes. O local é muito bem localizado, seguro, com boas opções de transporte público e bem perto do burburinho de Palermo.

La habitación es muy cómoda, la casa se encuentra en una zona muy linda y tranquila, con bares cercanos y a pocas cuadras de la Av. Santa Fe. María es una excelente anfitriona, muy atenta, siempre brindando información y todo lo que uno necesite!

Very nice place to stay, Maria is very friendly and helpful. The apartment is well located in Palermo-Soho, safe neighborhood for Buenos Aires standards. You can make tee in the room, you get a box for your stuff in the fridge, so the kitchen is accessible.
Great stay! This room has everything you need including a water kettle and kitchen basics. Maria was very helpful.
Maria was a wonderful host. It was like visiting your own grandmother. She was very helpful and her place was just amazing! I felt at home and safe. A true experience into BA living.

Stayed 4 nights.  Maria’s house is quirky with great design features.  Maria was super welcoming (English & Spanish) and I felt at home immediately.  Bedroom has tea/coffee facilities which was very welcome.  Bedroom has black out shutters and I slept well.  Location is superb, moments from all that Palermo has to offer.  Area is super safe . I would not hesitate to stay again.  Gracias Maria!

De maneira respeitosa, ressalto que minha experiência nessas instalações não foi a melhor. Senti-me como se não fosse bem vinda no lugar pela anfitriã Maria, que me colocou num quarto sem sistema de calefação. Na noite em que cheguei, ela ligou um aparelho que mal esquentava as minhas mãos. Eu observei que no quarto havia um aquecedor elétrico, do qual precisei fazer uso, tamanho foi o frio que senti na madrugada. Na manhã seguinte, recebi da anfitriã a chave da porta principal, porém, essa chave só abria por dentro! Eu saí durante o dia e descobri essa fatalidade ao retornar, quando precisei entrar e a chave simplesmente não abria a porta por fora! Ora, alguém que se propõe a receber outrem em sua casa precisa estar com tudo pronto. Quando consegui contato com Maria, ela abriu a porta principal e trocou a chave, mas me tratou de forma tão hostil que me senti culpada por estar ali. No dia seguinte, tentei me aproximar ao perceber que ela estava na cozinha. Pedi a indicação de locais para almoçar e ela me indicou alguns restaurantes na redondeza. Ao manusear meu celular e tentar localizar os locais indicados por ela, senti certa dificuldade em ler as informações do Google Maps, porque tenho hipermetropia (não enxergo de perto) e estava sem meus óculos. Entreguei meu aparelho em suas mãos, ela printou a tela para mim e depois perguntou a minha idade, o que eu respondi, mas depois a questionei o motivo daquela pergunta. Maria me tratou com tanto desprezo, me dizendo que eu com 43 anos não sabia lidar com aquela tecnologia... ou seja, ela supôs que eu não soubesse manusear este app. Foi de uma indelicadeza tão grande, de uma hostilidade... pode parecer uma coisa tão pequena para quem está lendo este comentário agora, mas a forma como me senti eu não desejo para ninguém. Ela foi a primeira pessoa com quem tive contato na cidade. Ao total, fiquei 13 dias na Argentina, sendo 07 em Buenos Aires e 06 em Bariloche. Felizmente, por todos os locais onde estive fui tão bem recebida, tão bem tratada! Fiquei os 03 dias iniciais nas instalções de Maria e depois fui para Barilhoche. Ao retornar para Buenos Aires, encontrei outro local no mesmo bairro, Palermo, também pelo Airbnb, e paguei pouca coisa mais caro, mas preferi isso a me sentir desprezada por alguém que não fez questão nenhuma em ser gentil. Ainda bem que ela foi a única pessoa durante toda essa viagem com quem eu tive essa indisposição. No geral, o povo argentino é amável, educado, prestativo e fora esse momento que relatei, os dias nesse país foram incríveis. Fiz uma das melhores viagens da minha vida. Foi mesmo uma pena que não tive acesso a Maria, pois eu gostaria de conhecer suas histórias e compartilhar as minhas com ela, caso lhe interessasse. Agora, a oportunidade já foi...
La casa es hermosa y la habitación es tal cuál lo publicado. Maria es un 10/10, simpática, graciosa y ama tú ciudad, te puede dar los mejores consejos para el viaje y la vida. Súper recomendable!
