As we were interested in dancing tango, the apartment has very convenient location close to a few milongas. Cleaning was arranged without any problems, when we needed. We liked it very much, for sure will stay there next time, 'cos planning to come back!

I had excellent time in this apartment. The location is amazing, close to everything that a visitor needs: metro station, shops, Palermo Soho go-out area, shopping, etc. The building is excellent, featuring a small but nice sky gym on the top floor. The swimming pool is also very good, I was not that lucky with the weather though... Please mind that only 2 people can be in the swimming pool, so you cannot bring your friends who do not stay in the flat. The building is very secure with the 24/7 guard at the entrance. The studio itself is very comfy. You can find anything you need for a comfortable stay there: tv, kitchen utensils, fridge, wifi, of course. It is comfortable to stay in. The host, Eyenit is a super pleasant woman, very helpful. I'm glad I chose this flat. I can recommend anybody to stay there. It's an excellent value for money, and pleasant experience with the host.

We really enjoyed our stay in BsAs. Palermo is a really interesting neighborhood with plenty of restaurants within walking distance. We liked that the apartment had 24 hour security. We felt safer and had better peace of mind. Eyenit was soo welcoming and was very hospitable with us. The apartment was clean, located on the 4th floor and had everything that we could want. We would recommend this place if you are looking to to truly feel what buenos aires has to offer

We had a great stay at the Palermo apartment! It is in a great location, just a  few blocks from the subway and about a 10 minute walk from great restaurants, bars and shopping. There is a secure entry here and the neighborhood is very safe, we always felt comfortable at night. The apartment is equipped with all of the amenities you need: hair dryer, tv with cable, ironing board & iron, a safe, tea (electric kettle) and coffee maker. There is a small balcony great for relaxing in the afternoon. The pool and gym are added benefits. Pool is best in the afternoon when the sun hits between the buildings. The gym is on one of the top floors and offers a great view of the city. We would love to stay here again!

We had a great time in buenos aires last march, and surely staying at Señora Eyenit apartment helped us to achieve it.

For a fraction of what we would pay for a hotel room, we stayed in a lovely studio in a great neighborhood, walking distance to palermo's restaurants, bars and plazas.
The owner is a very welcoming, nice and sweet elder lady, and it was a pleasure to de-rust our spanish talking to her when we arrived.

My wife and I highly recommend staying there. Building and apartment are brand new, amenities are great and location can't be beat.

It was very easy to get in touch with Yamila, both by email and by phone - she responded in a very timely manner. The apartment looked exactly as described, including photos, and was very clean and organized. It was very easy to get to on taxi, the building is secured well with guards 24/7. We were mostly in touch with Yamila, although she was not physically in Buenos Aires. She gave as many useful tips for getting around, finding shops, restaurants and other POIs. I would highly recommending to stay in this apartment!

Foi um prazer esta no apartamentos da Sra. Yamila. Ela é uma excelente anfitriã , disponível a ajudar-nos em tudo que precisamos. O bairro é excelente pois está situado de modo privilegiado e acesso a tudo. O Apto foi super confortável e elegante para 02 pessoas, conforme as fotos.

I loved my stay at Maria’s Airbnb. I was welcomed in immediately and felt very comfortable. Maria is fun to talk to and very friendly. My favorite thing about the stay was having a balcony for fresh air, everything else was great, I recommend this stay to others.

Yamila y su mama son unas excelentes personas, muy amables y cordiales, siempre pendientes de todos los detalles para tener una estadía agradable y placentera, gracias a ellas pudimos disfrutar de la ciudad como estar en casa. En unas próximas vacaciones esperamos tener la suerte de volver a su departamento. Espectacular!

Yamila was very prompt in responding to all my questions and concerns. The description of the apparent was accurate: very comfortable bed( queen size ), big closet with drawers and hangers, a small safe deposit box with a key,cable tv with a lots of channels in English , bathroom clean ,a decent size balcony , wifi worked fast on all our devices.
The building is close to everything , has a well equipped gym on the top floor, secure entrance.
My only suggestion for the host is to have a brief description of how certain things work : for instance how one dial a phone number for a taxi or witch elevator to take to get to the gym or how to get to the laundry room and how to use the machines, I'm sure these things are different in various countries and it would be easier for the foreign guests to adept to Argentina. I was sorry to bother Yamila with these types of questions through e-mails but she was very prompt to clarify everything for us.
All in all my husband and I had a very nice stay in this studio. Thanks again Yamila.

Thanks a lot Yamila!. Your flat is a lovely place to stay and to enjoy Buenos Aires. Its very well located, in a safe neighbourhood, plenty of resto and bars, clothes shops, means of transport, etc. We loved staying there.
The building is nice, it has great ammenities.
Very good taste in decoration and forniture became your place in a place where enjoy magical and romantic moments.
Good electronic equipment.
Thanks for your hospitality, I'm sure we'll be back again in the future, because we live the BEST week end in that property.

We hope you found all in order after we left the place.
By the way... Your mom is GREAT!!.

Hostess, place and attention were EXCELLENT!

Great Building: New Construction, 24 hour security, good size pool, deck, gym and balcony…Great location walking distance to all of Palermo, 2 blocks from subway….Quiet apartment and comfortable bed.
Yamila was great adding a few days to the front end of our stay and late check out was no problem due to no guests coming in behind us,
I would highly recommend this apartment.
John
San Francisco

What a perfect find! Clean, safe, incredibly comfortable and a great host experience. The apartment building is modern and the facilities there (workout room and pool) make this a luxurious accommodation . Close to busses and subway and a 5-7 minute walk to the wondrous shops and restaurants of Palermo. Wifi and a/c, kitchen, etc- the pictures are quite accurate
Super nice apartment, very clean & looks like on the pictures :) amazing view from the fitness over BA. Very safe area!

Good location, nice studio apartment with all you need. The pool was very enjoyable during the hot summer days. Everything was organised to make our arrival and departure very easy. Very good experience.

We had a lovely stay at Yamila & Eyenit's apartment in Palermo. It's just a short walk from Plaza Serrano Plaza Armenia and all of the great shopping, restaurants, cafes and nightlife in the area. It's also a short walk to Plaza Italia which gives you convenient access to transportation (buses/subte). The apartment was neat and clean, tv and wifi worked well and the AC cooled things off very quickly. Eyenit greeted us and helped us get checked in and settled as Yamila lives out of the country. Even though we don't speak Spanish very well,  my husband was able to communicate with Eyenit and understand how everything worked in the apartment without any problems. Communicating with Yamila via airbnb message was easy and I received very quick responses (most times within an hour or less) when I had a question for her from the time we booked until the day we left. One of the GREAT things about staying here: I messaged Yamila the day before we checked out to ask about an option to leave our bags since we had a very late flight the next day (11pm). She very graciously allowed us to stay in the apartment until we needed to leave for the airport the next day since they didn't have anyone checking in. We greatly appreciated the extra time and not needing to find somewhere to store our bags for the whole day, it made our last day much more relaxing and we were so thrilled to have such a flexible host. We didn't use the kitchen much, just a couple of cups for water and spoons for yogurt in the morning, but it seemed to be well stocked for those that need it. Great water pressure and hot water for showers, plenty of towels for both the bathroom and pool. We spent one afternoon lounging at the pool and it was very nice on a hot day. My husband used the gym one day (I forgot my gym clothes so I just went to check out the view), and it was well equipped and the view is AMAZING up there! One thing to note for those that are picky about beds, the apartment has a full/double size mattress and it's quite firm. I always like to know how a mattress is before staying, so I just wanted to share that! All around, we had a wonderful trip and enjoyed our stay here!

This studio was absolutely perfect. It's right near everything. The pool is great for super hot days and everyone in the building is very friendly. The place looked exactly as described and yamilas mom was very lovely. The building is also very very very safe and secure. Would stay here again

I absolutely loved the entire experience.  The apartment itself is beautiful.  The building is very modern and is equipped with a beautiful heated pool, gym overlooking the spectacular skyline of Buenos Aires, and a spa on the top floor.  I felt very safe in the building thanks to its 24-hour doorman security.  On the first day, Yamila's mom let me in and made me feel very welcome.  The location is in the Palermo neighborhood which is full of culture and captures the should of the city.  This was my first trip to South America and it could not have gone better.
Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben, zentral und gemütlich. Eine noch fehlende bodenreinigung wurde nach Aufforderung umgehend nachgeholt. Insgesamt haben wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Nice apartment in a great surrounding and nice and supportive hosts!

I stayed here during my second week of a two-week stay in Buenos Aires.  It is a great location for going to many tango milongas, both the apartment and room feel new (and perhaps are), being close to a big grocery store and the subway was nice, I greatly appreciated the air conditioning (since my previous place didn't have any), and Kicca was very flexible with me for move-in/move-out.  The only drawback was the building dryer isn't functioning yet, although I imagine that over time this will be resolved.

Kicca was a great host. As a new member on this site, I was a little apprehensive and clueless. Kicca was very patient and provided some guidance during the process.

My boyfriend and I stayed here for two weeks and loved it. This apartment is perfect for a single person or couple. It's super cozy and maintened very neatly. What you see in the photos is exactly what you get. The building is quiet and secure. It's located in a great neighborhood. Everything you need is usually at arms reach. I have absolutely no complaints. I was very pleased with my stay.

Sweet little apartment with lots of personality!  Thanks to the wonderful hosts, personal touches made the stay extra special. I would recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in this area. Super convenient to the subway.

Great hosts! We were were warmly welcomed and given a tour of the apartment. The apartment was great - safe, clean, and quiet. The gym and pool were great. One small problem we had was the wifi did not work. The hosts came and tried to fix it but were unable. The repair person came two days later (the next day was a holiday). After the repairman came, the internet worked intermittently throughout our stay. Other than that, it was delightful!

El departamento es tal cual las fotos. Todo muy nuevo, muy prolijo. Muy amplio y luminoso. La zona es muy tranquila y a la vez tiene mucha vida, muchos negocios, está cerca de todo. Nos gustó mucho haber pasado unos días allí, y Eyenit fue muy amable y nos hizo sentir como en casa.
Todo muy bien. La ubicación muy cómoda y los anfitriones espectaculares y muy atentos. 100% recomendable

Accueil en personne et très chaleureux. Disponibilité de tous les instants. Quartier super-agréable de Buenos Aires avec commerces, restos et métro à proximité. Le quartier est animé mais l'appartement est très calme car situé un peu en retrait de la rue.

Awesome stay. I rented Yamila's apartment for a month while I stayed in Buenos Aires.  It is in a great location in the neighborhood of Palermo so it's only a few blocks to tons of restaurants and bars and coffee shops (btw check out Lattente for the best macchiato in the city).  The area is super safe and full of expats so its a good place to come back and unwind for the evening after a long day of touring.  It's also only 2 blocks from the Plaza Italia metro station which makes it super easy to get around and explore other parts of the city.  The apartment itself is clean and comfortable with all the basic essentials you need for an extended stay.  AC is a nice perk and the building comes with a swimming pool and 24 hour security.   I would definitely recommend staying here if you are looking for a place in Buenos Aires.

Eyenit was such a gracious host. She even had beer for us when we arrived. Her apartment was perfect for our week stay. Easy access to the heated pool and to the very cool Soho neighborhood. It was a very short walk to shops, dining, bars and museums. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting BA and would easily stay there again myself.

La Anfitriona una Señora encantadora, nos recibio como con mucha calidez, realmente nos hizo senttir muy comodos.
El apartamiento es esplendido, luminoso, limpio, moderno, con todo lo necesario.
El edificio impecable tal cua la foto, Un gimnasio con una vista increible, La picina de agua templada, una delicia.
El entorno muy bueno,bastante tranquilo con mucha oferta gastronomica.

On arrival I was greeted by Yamila's mother, who was very sweet and friendly. The apartment looks exactly like on the photos, no surprises. It's pretty spacious, had all of the amenities I needed. The wifi was very fast, I recall at least 25mbit, which is impressive for the area. The apartment block has a pool, where you can do some laps (just make sure to go outside of peak hours in the morning and evening). Same applies to the gym, go in the morning or weekends. The location is superb, you have a subway right around the corner, all kind of restaurants and nightlife nearby. I stayed for a month, and the flat was properly cleaned every week, which was a nice bonus.

The only issue I had was with miscommunication. I recommend talking directly to Yamila's mother, as she manages the apartment, but you need to be able to speak Spanish.

My partner and I stayed here for 5 nights in late March 2016 and we had a great time. The apartment has a great location. The gym in the floor 31 (I believe) is great and has a stunning view, even if you don't feel like working out, just go for the view (day and night). Eyenit (Yamila's mom) is awesome! She'd go out of her way to help you. The 24/7 security in the building is a plus.
Walking distance to the main area of Palermo Soho with lots of restaurants and bars. 3 blocks away from the Subway (Plaza Italia).

Yamila and Eyenit's place is perfect for checking out Buenos Aires. Can't ask for a better location, close to everything, awesome pool for swimming, stunning view from the gym (you can see all the way to the Rio de la Plata) two saunas, a hot tub, and super quiet so you can rest and get ready to tackle the day. We were welcomed by the host's mother, who lives nearby, and is totally charming. Check in and check out were a snap. The building is safe, secure and in impeccable condition. Highly recommended.
We had the best stay here. The place was beautiful in a perfect location. They were so friendly and gave a great recommendation for a leather smith in the area! I would highly recommend staying here!

The apartment is in a great neighborhood, close to restaurants, grocery stores and the subway.   The building has excellent security and very nice amenities.  This is the third or fourth time I've rented from Yamila and Eyenit, and they've always been gracious and accommodating.

I was greeted by Eyenit, she was very welcoming, gave us a tour of the room and went over details of the location. The room was exactly as advertised, the gym on the top floor has the essential equipment for a good workout and overlooks the entire city, is a great view.

If you want to be in Palermo Soho, I can't think of a more well located flat. Just two blocks from Plaza Italia station in one direction and close to all the great Palermo Soho shops/cafes in the other. This flat had everything I needed, and it was in the perfect location. Best of all, Yamila was a very kind and accommodating host.

My husband and I had a great stay in Yamila & Eyenit's place. The apartment is very close to cafes, markets, subway and bus lines. Getting around was easy once we got a sube card! The apartment looked like the pictures and the security guards were great! I would recommend this place anytime!!!
Very kindly attention by the host Yamila & Eyenit. They were very nice with my wife and me. The  apartment looks like the photos , and the location was perfect also.

Flor is a sweet and very accommodating host. She was very communicative before and during our stay and was super flexible with our arrival and departure times. Her apartment was perfect for the two of us; it was cozy, in a great location, and very well-kept. I'd recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a nice place in the heart of the city.

Muy lindo apartamento ubicado en una zona linda y con servicios de Buenos Aires. El apartamento es chico pero tiene todo lo necesario para pasar bien en Buenos Aires. Los dueños muy correctos y amables. Muy recomendable.

Very nice and clean appartment, quick and smooth communication. Florencia has been very nice, giving me a subway pass, making my travels around the city a lot easier. Very nice experience and I would definitely go there again!

Florencia is a thoughtful host and the apartment was very bright, cute and cozy. Florencia lent us a Sube card which we used almost every day. The apartment is also in easy walking distance to all kinds of shopping. The guide book and map was also very handy along with a list of phone numbers for taxis etc. Thank you Florencia for making our first trip to Buenos Aires a very memorable one! PS: Il Migliore pizzeria on the corner makes great pizza and the Tandoor restaurant a couple of blocks away was excellent. El Palacio resto, also nearby, has real Argentine steak. In general we found food in BA very good and accessible in every neighbourhood. Just remember to eat after 8pm and make an evening of it!

This was by far my favorite Airbnb experience. The apartment was perfect--clean and comfortable and much larger than a hotel room. The open-plan kitchen was completely outfitted. Although I'm pretty short I hard no trouble using the microwave, which I thought was placed ingeniously on a small shelf above the apartment sized fridge. Flor thoughtfully provided the fixings for coffee and even some yummy "media lunas" (croissants). I  also appreciated th wine rack hanging above the counter. Even the neighbors were friendly when we met in the elevator. One afternoon was pretty warm for me but the a/c cooled the apartment beautifully in just a few minutes. The hosts were accommodating and extremely responsive to my inquiries. Both Flor and her husband gave me excellent recommendations, from an awesome Indian restaurant just a few blocks away to the best place to change money.  With the nearby super mercado I could have comfortably stayed much longer and wish I could have. I cannot recommend this location highly enough for anyone wishing a true BA experience.

El departamento esta impecable y super equipado, tiene todo lo necesario para estar cómodos, sinceramente nos sorprendió gratamente. Florencia es muy amable, puntual y fue muy amable al permitirnos dejar el departamento mas tarde de lo habitual. Altamente recomendable.

Muito bom, adorei o lugar estava num lugar perto de tudo,
entre avenidas principais como Av.Correntes e Av. scalabrini Ortiz com isso pude ir de ônibus para todos os lugares, usei o sube o metro mas, não usar no horário da tarde tem muitos malandrinhos que roubam turistas.
O apartamento tem aquecedor, banheira e uma cozinha ótima, da para cozinhar e tomar um vinho em casa.
Mucho bom...
Gostei do apartamento e do local onde está situado. Porem faltou cobertores e travesseiros limpos.  E a limpeza  do apartamento precisa ser melhorada.

We had a good time in the studio. We enjoyed the location and the fact that it's a very calm area. The apartment was nice and had what we needed. Kicca was a good host and was very easy to communicate with. We hope to rent this studio again in other opportunities, as we come often to Buenos Aires.

The host is kind and helpful to the guests' needs.
The description of the apartment correspond to reality: the apartment is small but has everything you need to enjoy your stay well. We were almost 2 weeks.
The area is not close to "Microcentro", but it is well connected by metro and bus and is still very close to the Palermo district, full of bars and restaurants where you can spend pleasant evenings.
We suggest the apartment to tango lovers, because it is close to many of the best known and most popular milongas, also reachable on foot: a fortune given the extent of Baires.

Excelente ambientación, linda ubicación, lindo edificio. Mejoraría algunos detalles como el tv, la señal del cable q estaba mal, y en el baño no disponíamos de shampoo ni crema de enjuague y tampoco habíamos llevado. En otros lugares de airbnb que alquilé siempre se cuenta con esas cosas. El resto todo muy bien.

Listing was accurate.
Had everything i needed.
Nice location with good security for safety.
Would stay agaun..
O imóvel é amplo mas necessita de melhoria nas instalações, como um sofá confortável e utensílios mais novos. A localização é boa, o prédio também.
I went with my boyfriend for one week. The place was great and the location was perfect,  we had everything close to us. Really nice area. I highly recommend this place!!
Excelente atención. Sin lugar a  dudas volvería, el apartamento es como las fotos y estaba totalmente equipado.

En el corazón de Palermo, un edificio que cuenta con todas las comodidades, a un paso del subte y en un barrio precioso, lleno de tienditas y cafés.

Volveré a quedarme de todas maneras en mi próxima ida a buenos aires

Yamila and Eyenit are very responsive, accommodating and welcoming. This building is extremely nice, safe and located within 15 minutes walking distance of anywhere you would want to go in Palermo. The space is very nice, clean and I would definitely stay here again.

I had a wonderful stay at Yamila & Eyenit's apartment. It definitely felt like home even after a day! Yamila was very communicative and her mother Eyenit was incredibly sweet. They made every possible effort to accommodate my early arrival and the couple of reservation changes I had to make. The location is so close to everything.

Todo estuvo excelente, Yamila siempre estuvo al pendiente de mi llegada y en comunicación conmigo.

Su mamá me recibió en el departamento con una hospitalidad increible! Es una señora divina y muy atenta.

El departamento justo como se muestra en las imagenes y muy limpio regresaria sin dudarlo!

Yamila and Eyenit were excellent hosts. The apartment was fantastic, clean and modern with a very comfortable bed, a great balcony and in a brilliant location! It was approximately 5 mins walk to Plaza Italia metro station and near to many brilliant bars, cafes and restaurants and supermarkets. One of the main reasons I booked this apartment was because of the swimming pool and gymnasium. I can confirm that the gym is well equipped and located on floor 31 with spectacular views. We loved our stay in Yamila and Eyelet's apartment and would highly recommend it to anyone wanting to stay in Palermo BA.
Apartment was clean/ready upon check-in. Good location, Internet, facilities, security, etc. Enjoyed my stay with zero issues, would come back to this unit again.
the host was great, the area too, the building is new & very safe.

Yamila foi uma excelente anfitriã, muito atenciosa. A torre é magnífica: vista incrível da cobertura (academia), localização privilegiada (bares, restaurantes, supermercado, tudo a pouco mais de 100m de distância).
Place was secure and central for tourists with easy access to subway, uber, and great restaurants of Palermo Soho.
This is a spacious studio in a new building in Palermo. It has a well equipped kitchen and reliable internet. The hosts are very responsive and made my stay enjoyable.
Excellent location in Palermo SoHo.
El departamento impecable, el edificio bonito y muy bien ubicado, pero sobre todo la amabilidad y generosidad de Eyelit hacen que valga la pena ir a alojarse en su propiedad

Florencia and her husband were the perfect hosts! They were recommended by a friend of mine who came in December 2012. My parents stayed here twiced and they loved it. The flat is conveniently located near major tourist attractions. The apartment has everything you need (internet, travel guides, a SIM card, a card for using public transport). We can fully recommend this flat!

I stayed for almost two weeks in Florencia's amazing apartment in the Barrio Norte. Could not have been any better! Florencia is a great anfitrona, she was extremely helpful, easy to communicate with and provide me with tips, even before arrival.
The apartment is fantastic and exactly as represented with the photos on Airbnb, a very clean and cozy place where you feel confortable from the first second. The area is excellent and very central to the main districts of Buenos Aires.
I felt very much at home. If I come again to Buenos Aires, I will definitely stay again at Florencia's apartement. Highly recommended!

Florencia a été une très aimable hôte pour nous. L'appartement était très bien aménagé, central et conforme à nos attentes. Avoir pu faire le check in et le check out avec une grande flexibilité nous a beaucoup aidé. Bref, notre première expérience avec Airbnb a été excellente.
Muchissimas gracias por tu amabilidad y tu disponibilidad, Florencia!

Florencia's apartment was perfect, everything we need, located in a nice neighborhood. You have supermarket, coffee shops, metro...
Florencia was very friendly and communicate fast, she even let us a metro card and maps for us to go around!

It was our first day in Argentina and staying in such a nice apartment with great value for money was exactly experience we were looking for. Apartment is very clean with nice decor which makes you feel like at home. Great location - walking distance to many attractions and not far from metro stations. The host is extremely nice and helpful - we got recommendations on the neighboring cafés and shops before our arrival and Florencia also helped us with the taxi reservation on our departure.
Would highly recommend to stay at this apartment!

Florencia is an amazing host. She was easy to communicate with before my stay and was very welcoming when I arrived. The apartment is spacious, clean and comfortable. Excellent location. Close restaurants, cafes, shops and metro. I really enjoyed my stay in Buenos Aires. Highly recommended!

A wonderful clean, well located, well organised young apartment. It makes a stay in BA very pleasurable and offers everything a traveller needs. It is well thought through - from WiFi to travel adapter to bus tickets to travel guides to refreshments in the fridge. Florencia sees her guests as her 'friends' rather then 'clients'. A lovely young lady - I appreciate that I could make her acquaintance. I had to change my travel itinerary quite often, and Florencia supported me greatly in my changed travel plans and made sure all went well for me.

Very comfortable small flat in the perfect location.  Clean and homely.  Florencia has thought of everything and we were very comfortable.  She emailed us a google map with places of interest, restaurants, laundromat, exchange places etc all marked which was awesome.  Good to have her personal recommendations but also to orientate yourself when you first arrive.  The apartment is in the best possible location as it is slap bang in the centre between hotspots like Ricoleta, Palerma Soho and Downtown.  They supply a card for the underground which you only need to top up but we never bothered as everything was in walking distance (although we do enjoy long walks).  I highly recommend staying here if you are going to be in Buenos Aires.

Florencia's apartment was absolutely perfect! Everything you might need is there, and the location is just excellent. The space is clean and bright and Flor thinks of everything -- coffee filters for the coffee maker, Buenos Aires guidebooks, fresh, clean sheets, a sube card, clear telephone instructions, power strip for multiple plug types, etc. I stayed for a full month and at the end, I was sad to leave the apartment. The neighbors were also very sweet. It is also really wonderful to know that Flor and her husband live nearby and if you need anything at all, they are there to help and quick to respond to any communications. I highly recommend this apartment to anyone coming to Buenos Aires!

We loved our stay at Flor's place, which immediately felt like home.  It was very cozy and clean and exactly what we were looking for in Buenos Aires.  Flor also provided us with a great brief introduction to her place so there were no surprises and ensured that we could reach her if we had any questions.  We felt like we had everything we needed.  She had a couple of guidebooks that we could use during our stay - which were very helpful in getting oriented and finding places to go. We also liked that her place had a phone - so family could reach us from overseas (since calls from a cell phone can be so expensive, and they literally cost a few cents from the U.S.).  Overall, we would definitely recommend her place.

This apartment was the perfect way to relax after many weeks hiking through Patagonia. Just the right size for two people. The bed is the most comfortable bed we have slept in during 6 months of traveling. It is in a great area, near the subway station, and within walking distance to most areas. Florencia has thought of everything including a sube card to travel on the bus/subway, different power adaptors and easy instructions for internet/telephone. Thanks for an amazing 4 days Flor.

Florencia é uma excelente anfitriâ ..muito solicita e presente
O apartamento é uma delicia e tenho certeza que retornarei!

Lovely, spacious studio apartment with a balcony. The use of the swimming pool and gym (which has an amazing view) were a real bonus. It's also a great location within easy reach of shops, restaurants and transport. We would definitely recommend staying here.

hola, estuve 4 días con mi novia y la pasamos excelente. El depto es tal cual se ve en las fotos y tiene muy buenas instalaciones , pudimos disfrutar de la pileta y el solarium. La ubicación  es inmejorable está cerca de restaurantes y bares. Saludos

Yamila, and her Mother, were excellent, friendly and very accomodating from the beginning to the end of my stay.  The apartment was as advertised and very comfortable.  It had all the necessities and the location was just what I needed in BA.  Hot water, air conditioning, etc. all worked well and the wifi never had any issues.  The doormen, security guards and other tenants were also very friendly.  Access to the gym was helpful and there are great views from that part of the building while one works out.  Pool area was comfortable and relaxed if you want to spend some time outside by the pool for a short while during the day.  If you want to spend a few days in BA, Yamila's place will meet your needs ... great host!

We loved our stay at Yamila's place. The apartment is as advertised and we were very happy. Our top priorities were cleanliness, security and a great location. We definitely got all 3 and at a good price. Yamila was very responsive and helpful as well!

El apartamento es comodísimo y perfectamente equipado. He pasado casi 2 meses en el y no puedo imaginar ninguna queja.
Eyenit es una anfitriona perfecta y siempre está disponible.
Los servicios del apartamento así como la seguridad del edificio son perfectas también.

You have to get used to the dog shit which is in the streets. You find that everywhere in BA, not only in the area of the apartment. Bakery, Grocery stores are in easy walking distance to the studio, as are some restaurants. Don't mis Cafe Crespin on Vera 699 (5 min walking distance to the apartment). I very much appreciated the fact that the studio is situated in a calm street, so there was little street noise. Of course the walls of those studios are thin and you here every word and every music channel of your neighbors next to you and above you. But that is the case everywhere, so you have to get used to it. Argentines have usually loud voices and go to bed late.  The mornings are beautifully quiet, so you can easily sleep in.  For those who like shopping, the studio is very close to an area of great shopping (lots of Outlet stores). One word in regards to money changing: The official peso rate (which you get at banks, ATM or change places) is at the moment 4.5 pesos to 1 dollar (that changes from day to day). I was introduced to a company www.xoom.com where you can send money from your credit card or bank account to a pick up place in Buenos Aires. There I got an exchange rate of 6.1. Big difference! It worked very well. You just need your passport for identification when you pick up the money. Last not least, Kicca, the land lady, is very kind and I could reach her within hours by phone or email, when I needed her help. Good experience all together!

Estuvo todo muy bien, el departamento es chico pero con todas las comodidades, tiene cerca casi todo. La comunicación fluyó bien. Lo recomiendo.

If you're looking for care and service from the owner, this is not the right place. I answered an add from "Francesca", and immediately one "Sebastian" appeared as a co-renter, had two contacts with me, and "passed me" to a 3rd one called "Luca", and finally, on my way to the place, Luca gives me the n° of a 4th one, "Natalia", who was supposed to wait for me inside. She was not. I had to wait 25 mn with my lugagge, outside at 22H30...
This appartment is a cash machine, which i have nothing against, but the add on airbnb shouldn't sound like it does.
It's not allowed here to post pictures, of the many things i took photos of, and were not right : a sliding bay window that didn't close on the balcony, the toilet flush, the storage cabinet's door that doesn't hold, the extreme dirt on the floor around the oven, the dirty and old bath mat unusable, the dangerous bed side lamp, dirty aeration grids, dirt of the balcony....
Now, the appartment is "ok", but far too expensive for what it is.

We stay at the apartment for a month. Everything was great. The apartment is adequate for a short or long stay. The location is great, 5 min to Palermo, but Villa Crespo is cheaper than Palermo. Check-in and check-out were flexible. We loved.
Accueil effectué par Sebastian. Très gentil, accueillant et donne de bons conseils. L'appartement était super et pas très loin du centre-ville. Très heureux de mon séjour !

Florencia es un encanto, nos recibió con mucha amabilidad y predisposición para ayudarnos en lo que necesitáramos. El dpto. es muy cómodo, esta perfectamente bien ubicado, y esta muy equipado. El barrio es lindo. Sin dudarlo volvería a rentarlo cuando vuelva a Bs. As.

El apartamento de Florencia está muy bien para pasar unos días en Buenos Aires, está limpio, es espacioso y además se puede cocinar y tiene aire acondicionado, imprescindible para el verano porteño.

Además el trato de Florencia y su marido fue tremendamente amable, nos aconsejaron y ayudaron en todo lo que necesitamos.

Everything was almost perfect in the apartment of Florencia. The house is very well located, near the metro station Aguero. It is also very silent, comfortable and really nice!
Florencia and her husband are very helpful and they try to resolve all the problems.
A stay in this place make your vacation in Buenos Aires better!!
Very recommended!!
Thanks Florencia!
Thr apartment was great,, pretty central location....florencia and her husband were really helpful with every thing! Really comfy bed ;)

Florencia and her husband met us at their apartment at the exact time* we agreed on. Florencia's husband was great. He went over some places to visit adding his local knowledge where needed as well as where to eat in the local vicinity. My wife was familiar with the area but was still grateful for the tips. Regarding the time to meet, because we were not sure of our arrival time we corresponded via email a number of times and we were very happy with how quickly Florencia replied. Florencia was also quite flexible on the departure time.

The space is as advertised and we were very pleased with the arrangement (including secure wi-fi). Everything worked and the apartment is well kept up. The apartment is close to the metro as well as to many other forms of public transit ( e.g. bus or taxi). There are restaurants close by which we located using Google maps.

Overall we were very pleased with the hosts and with the apartment. We would recommend this space to our fellow AirBnB travelers.

Florência, parabéns pelo imóvel. Muito agradável e completo. A localização é muito boa e nos sentimos plenamente seguros. A relação custo benefício e bastante razoável. O atendimento, tanto pela atenção quanto pelo material fornecido foi perfeito. Na volta a Buenos Aires com certeza a primeira opção a ser considerada na hospedagem será o seu imóvel.
Mais uma vez parabéns.

Damien e Florencia são adoráveis, impossível maior simpatia. Nos deixaram alfajores e água de boas vindas, cartão de metrô, mil informações entusiasmadas sobre a cidade. Enfim, confirmaram o que todos dizem sobre eles no site! O apartamento é um charme, exatamente como nas fotos. Limpo, organizado, completo, ótima ducha e internet. Gostamos da localização, sentimo-nos um pouco "portenos" pois ficamos afastados da "confusão" turística. Tomamos café no café da esquina, fizemos compras no quarteirão, enfim tudo foi muito bom.

Lugar maravilhoso. O apartamento é ótimo, mas o que se destaca é a cordialidade da Florencia e do Demian. Desde o primeiro segundo Demian nos ajudou a encontrar passeios e já nos deu ótimas dicas e um mapa que foi muito útil. Voltando ao apartamento, tivemos duas noites excelentes de sono e utilizamos os equipamentos para cozinhar, tudo perfeito. A localização do apartamento achamos excelente também. Usaríamos novamente e certamente indicarei para amigos.

We stayed in Buenos Aires for 3 nights. The apartment is great: located in a safe area and fully equipment with everything that you need. Very clean and nicely decorated.
Flo gave us some instructions in advance and a very warm welcome when we met. She is a great host and helped us in many ways.
In summary: PERFECT!!
The apartment was as described. We felt welcome and had a great time in Buenos Aires! Recommended!

Florencia nous a très chaleureusement accueillis pour 3 nuits dans son studio bien clair et incroyablement tranquille. Elle et son mari ont su être à notre écoute et répondre à nos questions avec efficacité et rapidité. Nous les en remercions beaucoup.
L'appartement est idéalement situé, ce qui permet une visite à pieds de Recoleta et Palermo, ainsi que du centre. Il est très bien équipé (avec même les adaptateurs électriques) et est conforme aux photos. Excellente literie et ensemble très propre. Le bar en marbre est sympa. Nous recommandons chaleureusement cet appartement.
Con la mia ragazza sono venuto in questo appartamento e siamo stati bene, bello il posto, è come dalle foto, pulito e ben arredato. Demian, marito di florencia è sempre stato disponibile e gentile.

Florencia and her husband are wonderful hosts. They were easy to communicate with and just genuine lovely people. The flat is sunny, clean and comfortable. It's in a great location with access to most key neighborhoods. Florencia also shared many useful details about BA and let me store my suitcase at her home for a day while I was sightseeing before my flight. Highly recommend it!

Flor's apartment was perfect! We stayed there for a week and it really was our home away from home. It's in a great location- very easy to get to all parts of the incredible city, and Flor was a perfect host giving us great advice and recommendations. The flat itself was very clean, nice and cool and had everything we needed to have nice nights in aswell as nights on the town. Couldn't recommend more!
Excellent room, wonderful bed and superb host. So helpful always sent detailed messages about tips on what to see and do in the city and location is also excellent

I had a great experience at Flor's apartment!  It was very comfortable and welcoming... It felt like it was my own apartment.  Flor adds little touches that go a long way - water, tea, alfajores (yum!), travel books, a map, sube card, shampoo and soap.  She was very friendly, helpful and responsive through the whole process which was great.  Location wise, the apartment is close to grocery stores, fruit markets and a few blocks from the train which is very convenient.  Overall I had a wonderful experience and I wish I could have stayed there longer!  I definitely recommend this apartment for anyone planning to visit Buenos Aires.

I spent a couple nights at Flor's apartment before flying to Patagonia and ended up coming back to Flor's place upon my return to BA.  Another great experience and it was nice to come back to a familiar face!  :)
Just as great as my stay 2 weeks ago and our bus arrived an hour early and we were still able to meet her and get keys a truly excellent host

Florencia was a wonderful host.  She was always available for any questions or help and she even kept our small carry on for two days while we were in Iguazu Falls.  The studio is small but very clean and very well organized and had everything we needed.  The location was good, within walking distance of many sights and near a main avenue with buses that go everywhere.  We enjoyed our stay.

We had a wonderful stay at Florencia's apartment in Buenos Aires! She made the entire experience warm, welcoming, and professional from the very start. Every communication we had was clear and thorough, from when to pick up the keys, to the best ways to get around the city. The guide books and SUBE card she left at the apartment for us were a nice touch! The apartment itself is adorable: clean, comfortable, and the perfect spot for one or two people to call home base while exploring the city. It's close to subway stops that can take you right into the center of town or you can walk over to the different Palermo neighborhoods. Highly recommend!

Flor and Demian were very kind and helpful. Their apartment was lovely inside, is as represented in the listing and was perfectly suited for our four day trip to Buenos Aires. We had a great time exploring the city and would like to thank Flor and Demien for helping to make it so enjoyable.

Tom & Elizabeth

This place was fantastic! Flor went above and beyond to make our stay so easy and painless. The apartment is in a safe area with plenty of cafes and restaurants within walking distance. We truly enjoyed our time staying here!

Florencia fue una gran anfitriona. Nos ayudó con todas las dudas que teníamos y nos recomendó sitios para visitar y comer que estuvieron super buenos. Gran detalle de dejarnos agua, café, té y la tarjeta del subte que nos hizo toda la estadía más sencilla. El departamento súper limpio, y tal como lo mostraba las fotos. Nos encantó nuestra estadía. Súper recomendable.

Very helpful and thorough host! Flor is brilliant :)

The flat is very pretty and clean. We loved it :) the only thing I would say is that it could do with some curtains or blinds on the kitchen window as it gets quite bright in the morning and we were being very lazy!

The location is pretty good but not excellent. It's near the subway and a local Carrefour, and Av Santa Fe has everything you need. But it seemed that most of the best restaurants are over in Palermo so we ended up walking 20-30m most nights to go out for dinner.

Overall we had a great time and I'd definitely recommend it!

Desde o primeiro contato, a Flor nos tratou com muita educação e gentileza. O apartamento é bem localizado, organizado, limpo e cheiroso. A internet é ótima, a cozinha é completa e a cama é muito confortável. Uma graça e exatamente como nas fotos. A Flor é adorável e estava sempre disposta a ajudar no que fosse preciso. Indico com certeza e vamos voltar em breve.

Florencia was really nice and she gaves us a great introduction to the appartment and facts about the city. The appartment was exactly like on the pictures and everything was very clean. The neighborhood Recoletta is a save area in Buenos Aires.
I can recommend the appartment. Really great!

The neighborhood is great, very well located, close to two subway stations (5-10min walk), and if you don't want to spend much eating in more touristy places there are a few restaurent with more affordable prices. Taxis are also easy to find in case you go somewhere hard to reach by subway. Florencia was a great host: she was there waiting for us, showed us a city map with all points of interest, giving us tips of where to go and telling us a few things she likes to do, showed us details of the apartment. Everything listed was there, including a subway card which could be used by more than one person. The only thing negative about the apartment is that, being in a relatively central location, it gets a bit loud sometimes, especially if you want to sleep late.

Mi experiencia en el apartamento de Florencia fue excelente!!! El apartamento es tal cual se muestra en las fotos, muy arreglado, prolijo y limpio. La distribución es muy cómoda y esta ubicado en un barrio bien lindo y facil para trasladarse a todos lados. Florencia nos estaba esperando a la hora que habíamos acordado y nos explico todo sobre el funcionamiento del apartamento y cómo movernos por el barrio y la ciudad. En síntesis: 100% recomendable el alquiler de este apartamento. Volvería con mucho gusto.

Pros: Florencia was a great host! She was very friendly and gave us a lot of useful information for our trip. The neighborhood was nice as well (Recoleta) and it was safe to be out and about even past midnight. Lots of good restaurants and attractions nearby. Subway was a couple of blocks away. The studio was small (it looks bigger in the pics) but very cute and had all the essentials.

Cons: The room was a bit stuffy (we opened the windows a lot during our stay) and the bed was not very comfortable. My back started to hurt after the second night :/

Overall I would recommend staying at Florencia's if you're just looking for bare essentials in a safe neighborhood. She's very helpful and attentive if you have any questions which is a big plus.

La atención de Florencia y su esposo fue en todo momento amable, cordial y dispuesta a resolver todos los aspectos en procura que nuestra estadía en Buenos Aires transcurriese de la mejor manera, y así fue, el departamento es acogedor y grato.

My friend and I visited Buenos Aires together and stayed at Flor's apartment for 4 nights. Everything was absolutely amazing, and Flor and her husband were both so incredibly helpful. They never hesitated to pick up our phone calls or answer any emails with questions we had for getting around town and exchanging money easily. Flor was even so helpful to send tips about saving money in Buenos Aires before I arrived.

The apartment looks exactly as shown in the pictures and is cute and perfectly cozy for two people. I highly recommend staying at Flor's apartment. She was the most helpful hostess!

This apartment is in the perfect location in San Telmo, very secure and felt very safe. Grisel met us on time as arranged and showed us everything we needed to know.  There are guide books for the area and Buenos Aires which helped a lot.  She also took us out to a milonga / tango evening which was great fun. We would stay here again if we come back to Buenos Aires

Very nice stay in this fantastic flat, it has everything you need to live just like at home.  Despite only two days there, I had a rich and varied taste of life in Buenos Aires.  Grisel gave me good info regarding restaurants (she was on key!!) and a local "milonga".  A great thing in this place is that you can walk to main attractions and shopping areas.  I really enjoyed my stay and highly recommend this comfortable place.

Grisel's place was beautiful. It has very high ceilings and is quite spacious. The location is the best in San Telmo - right on Defensa which is where the weekend street market is.

This area also has a lot of nice restaurants and is quite close to Puerto Madero.

I really enjoyed my stay at this apartment. I wanted to extend but unfortunately, it was rented to someone else before I had the chance to officially put this thru.

This apartment is wonderful, we would highly recommend it! Grisel is a very accommodating host, her guide to the city invaluable, the location of the apartment fantastic, beautiful interiors and old elevator, guide books on hand, comfy beds and luxurious linen. Two couples could stay here happily.

El departamento es maravilloso, es tal cual como aparece en las fotografías, muy cómodo para dos parejas. El barrio también es excelente, seguro y con muchos lugares donde ir a comer y entretenerse, con una ubicación privilegiada de la feria de San Telmo. Nuestra anfitriona, muy amablemente nos coordino el traslado desde el aeropuerto al departamento, en donde ella nos estaba esperando, nos paso una guía turística de buenos aires muy practica y nos entrego todos los datos que le fuimos solicitando a lo largo de nuestra estadía. Nos recomendó los barrios que debíamos visitar y nos indico como movilizarnos, nos paso la tarjeta de transporte y otra con una serie de descuento en diversos lugares.

You couldn't possibly ask for a better space or location! The home is gorgeous, spacious, luxurious, and steps from the best of San Telmo. Grisel is extremely communicative and has tons of recommendations for enjoying the city! I would love to stay here again!

My family and I had such a great time at this lovely place. The location of the apartment is great, San Telmo is full of restaurants and bars and the market on Sunday is amazing.
The apartment is wonderful, a really nice place where you feel like home. You can relax from the hectic Buenos Aires.
We really recommend this place and Grisel was such a nice host!! Thank you very much! I hope we can come back some time :)

French Classic in San Telmo was a perfect place for two tango dancing couples. We felt like being at home and safe in a perfectly equiped appartment in the heart of BsAs. Although being in an area with many restaurants and bars we also used the perfectly equiped kitchen p.ex. on the 24th december when no restaurants were open. Supermarkets are nearby, a bakery is just across the street. Grisel has established a guide which helps with all necessary questions and needs. But she is also always reachable in case any questions are open.  Many attractions and milongas are in walking distance. Others you can easily reach by taxi or public transport. We do recommend this place very much and thank Grisel for her hospitaliy. We will definitely come back!

This airbnb experience was fantastic. Grisel is a lovely and accommodating hostess, making sure that we understood the ins and outs of not only the apartment, but also the city at large. The apartment is as luxurious as the pictures make it seem (very clean and comfortable too), and the location is prime. I would recommend this Airbnb again and again!

Grisel was a wonderful host. She met us very early in the morning and was very thorough about the neighborhood, the apartment, and everything else. She supplies you with a book with great recommendations. She was very attentive and available. The space was so beautiful and in a great location. We truly enjoyed our stay.

The apartment is very charming indeed, exactly like the pictures!
Florencia and Pedro were great hosts! They told us everything that was worth seeing in Buenos Aires.
They have even a manual for the guests, with recommendations of restaurants, shopping places, sightseeing, even the best way to get there from the airport!
Thanks to them we had a wonderful stay!
Great place.

Querida Flor e Demian! Se o que vocês desejam é serem ótimos anfitriões e nos ofereceram lugar para nós chamarmos de "nosso lar", você conseguiram! Nossa estadia foi perfeita! O apartamento é muito bem localizado, pertinho na estação de metrô (inclusive da linha D, que é a que para em todos os pontos que nos turistas temos em nosso roteiro!), do starbucks (para quem curte, eu acho mais caro do que gostoso), de mercado, fruteiras, várias lojinhas, pizzaria kentucky, outros cafés/restaurantes. Para chegar na recoleta ou no burburinho do Palermo (plaza Hollywood) apenas  25 minutos que você nem sente passar pois fica apreciando a bela arquitetura desta linda cidade! A flor e o Demian são super simpáticos e solícitos, uns amores que sabem muito bem recepcionar seus convidados. Alfajores, chá, café nos esperavam. O apto tem tudo, até secador, sombrinha e adaptadores de tomada! Ele é bem limpo, tem uma adorável decoração, cama confortável, ótima ducha! Tudo de bom! Super indico e com certeza me hospedaria novamente! Eles também nos der várias dicas! O cartão sube que oferecem É uma mão na roda! Obrigada por todo!!

My partner and I stayed at Flor's apartment for one week earlier this month during our vacation to Buenos Aires. She was a fantastic host who made us feel welcome well before we even arrived! She truly goes above and beyond for her guests, and her hospitality helped make our first visit to the city unforgettable. Flor was so friendly and helpful in answering questions we had about things to do and getting around the city before and during our stay, and she was extremely responsive any time we contacted her. She even booked us a remis (car service) so we could be sure we had a way to get to the airport for a 5am flight we had to Iguazu Falls and let us keep our bags at her home the day we checked out since we had an evening flight. The apartment itself was extremely comfortable, inviting, clean, and well-equipped. It's in a perfect location--just blocks from the  subway, which made exploring the city a breeze, and surrounded by tons of restaurants, cafes, and shops. Being that we're two women, we also felt very safe walking around the neighborhood, even late at night. We highly recommend staying at Flor's place!
Florencias apartment was very nice and had a great location. Florencia and her husband were very helpfull and nice people. I will highly recommend this place!

We had a fantastic experience in Buenos Aires and Flor and her husband were superb hosts. They went our of their way to make us feel at home, they gave us tips on places to go and helped us with transfers to the airport. The apartment was beautiful styled, spotlessly clean and in a great location close to restaurants and the metro. Highly recommend for any one going to Buenos Aires to stay at Flor's, her and her husband are great hosts and great people.
Muy lindo lugar!! Súper recomendable!!! Todo impecable tal cual mostraban las fotos!!! Florencia súper amable!!! 10 puntos todo!!! Saludos!!
Excellent apartment to stay in. Good location. As appears in photographs. Flor provided maps and recommendations. Excellent value.

This was our first time renting through Airbnb and we could not have picked a better host. Florencia was great and was in constant communication to ensure the initial meeting and hand-off of the keys went smoothly. Her warm welcome was like that of meeting old friends. She went through the instructions for the apartment gadgets thoroughly. In fact the typed up instructions manual was great. She also had a map with some of the must see places that matched the time available to us. That became the guiding document for our stay in BA.

The apartment is really cozy and perfectly as described. Very clean which was a must for us. It is central to everything in BA. Most of the time we walked to the various sights and used the subway, which is close by, once. The kitchen is perfect for making a quick snack or breakfast. The bed was very comfortable. This place is a great choice for experiencing life in BA among the regular folks.

Florencia is a wonderful host and went out of her way to make us feel welcome and comfortable. 10+

My experience with Flor was wonderful from beginning to end. She is incredibly responsive, and having never been to Buenos Aires she answered all of my questions and put my mind at ease. Since we arrived early in the morning, Flor's husband let us drop off our luggage before our check in time so we could get a full day of exploring the city without our luggage weighing us down. He also gave us some great suggestions of where to go and where to eat! Throughout the week Flor kept up with us, giving us little suggestions, giving the apartment a quick refresh, and even arranged a car service for us to get back to the airport. The apartment is lovely, central to metro, easy to grab a cab, in a nice neighborhood, and gave us a little haven to retreat to at the end of our tourist days. Definitely check out nearby Rapanui for ice cream and chocolates!
Flor was great at welcoming us. She gave us maps and also booked us taxis and dinner reservations.

We had an fantastic stay at Florencia's apartament!

Location: really central and safe area with everything you could possibly need around.

the apartament: great space with everything you need. Really comfy bed and everything was super clean.

And the best part of the deal: Florencia! Was in touch all the time giving us info, advice and to know if everything was allright. Amazing human being!

You cant go wrong with Florencia as your host, she is the best and the apartament is really good and well located.

Perfect location to visit BA! Safe, secure, and cozy apartment where we felt like home. Great facilities - shower, kitchen, bed, and TV - made the visit comfortable. Very welcoming host that described the area perfectly and gave great tips.

We were very well inspired to book a room over airbnb at Lauras during our stay in Buenos Aires!It made the whole experience so much more enjoyable!The room is beautiful,the bed very comfortable and everything very clean,we even had our own bathroom which was great cause everyone could keep their privacy under the same roof.Laura and Leo were very welcoming,giving us good tips about where to go for dinner etc.The flat is very near by bus and subway stations which made everything very easy.I loved having the breakfast included,it was feeling just like waking up at home.The last night Laura offered us to join them to a Milonga which was a wonderful idea as i was dying to discover this in Buenos Aires..All in all,we were thrilled about our time there and at Lauras and we will from now always look for a room at a private flat while travelling big cities!So much more cosy and give a better feeling about where and what to do!Thanx Laura ;)
I was very happy to stay at Lauras place. Laura was always helpful in all things. Hope I can come again ...some time...Ilona

I stayed in July 2012 in this 2 beds bedroom in Buens Aires.
The hostess is very professional and detail oriented, she provides a very
Clean, warm and comfortable room with wifi and private bath. She also provides assistance with all sort of things related to your travels, and touring.
The location is great in the center of the city and the building is an architect jewel.
If you are looking for a good location, an excellent hostess and a very high quality accommodation with a good bed in a spacious and very private room I recomend you this one.

Este lugar esta muy buen ubicado y fácil para ir a todos lados.
La calidad y el servicio de los anfitriones es espectacular!
El cuarto es muy amplio, súper limpio, calientito en invierno, con internet inalámbrico, muy privado, con cama comodisima y con baño privado, también muy pulcro.
Yo te lo recomiendo si vas a Buenos Aires y buscas las cualidades del hospedaje antes mencionadas. Yo quede muy satisfecha.

Lau and her husband Leo are great hosts! They are friendly people who assisted my friend and me as needed with touristic guidance and wonderful suggestions of places to visit in Buenos Aires. For instance, Lau mentioned Salon Caning as a good place to tango - indeed, it was a fun milonga with great music and dance where local Argentines go. We loved the Porteno experience!!
The apartment is a beautiful spacious residence with big windows and great sunlight. It is conveniently located in Microcentro, very close to Teatro Colon and a walking distance to Casa Rosada, Plaza de Mayo, the Cathedral and other main touristic attractions.
Thanks Lau and Leo!! It was a pleasure to stay at your lovely home.

Grisel was very accommodating, we felt at home away from home. The apartment was spacious, clean and cozy. The neighborhood was close to restaurants, shops and right on the corner of the Mafalda bench.  Which was a recognition to the author.

I arrived on the red eye from Miami. I had given Grisel an estimated arrival time to the apartment of 7am but I calculated the time wrong. My flight arrived at 5am, I sent her an email and text message as soon as I got out of the plane but her response never got to me. I arrived at the apartment around 5:45am, she was gracious enough to let me in and explained everything even at this early hour.
The apartment is comfortable, inviting and it reminded me a lot of paris. I would stay here again for sure and would recommend this place as a base for anyone who is visiting Buenos Aires.

Grisel was, quite simply, an amazing host. She made us feel hugely welcome in her beautiful flat and was extremely generous with her advice on how to get around and what to do in Buenos Aires. She was easily available for us to contact her if we had any problems. Grisel also arranged our taxis to and from the airport, which was very helpful indeed. Myself and my boyfriend loved staying here. Thanks again Grisel!

Grisel is the perfect Airbnb host. Even before ariving to BA we felt taken care of... The flat is perfect for two couples and we really enjoyed the perfect location for 1. time visitors in this great city.
I hope that flat will be available when we return to BA....!

Home was perfect and the photos are on point. I loved the kitched and stayed in the kitchen most of my time in the home. The apartment is quiet and super clean. I didn't need the AC or watch TV. Love having the subte card available. I will stay there again.

Cheers,
Bill

Belíssimo apartamento, muito confortável e espaçoso. Está localizado bem no meio de san Telmo, perto de tudo, numa rua movimentada. Grisel foi muito atenciosa e disposta a ajudar com qualquer detalhe. Muito obrigado!

Grisel provided us with a lot of information prior to and during our stay which was very helpful. San Telmo is a lively part of town with lots of bars and is close to some tourist attractions. BA is HUGE, so it would be impossible to find a place close to everything.
The actual apartment is very nice and charming, but old. We found one of the beds too small for two people. One of the four of us had to sleep on the couch (not a big deal for our family). On a very hot Summer day, one of the AC units did not work very well, so half of the apartment was almost unbearably warm. Luckily for us, that was only one day during our visit. I would still recommend staying here :)

The apartment was spotless when we arrived and the décor of the apartment is excellent. I loved having the two bathrooms, which were both big and well-appointed. The location is excellent, you are right in the heart of San Telmo close to great bars and restaurants. The two balconies over the street are great for having an afternoon drink and watching the world go by.

We had a great week in the Gallery. Grisel was really helpful and easy to reach. The apartment is gorgeous and classic. It was really clean and quiet but still in the heart of it all. The great kitchen made it easy for us to stay there with our children who tire of restaurants. We'd love to come back again!

Not only was this impeccably designed apartment an absolute dream nestled inside an historic building, we could not have been in a better location in San Telmo! Literally right in the heart of this historic neighborhood on Defensa street, we were walking distance to many of BA's best restaurants and a stone's throw from charming, checkered-tiled bars established in the 30s.

Although our host was not the friendliest (we were 45 minutes late checking in the first day with circumstances outside of our control and unable to reach Grisel due to no wifi unfortunately), she did provide an extensive book of all the who, what, where, when, why of BA which was very helpful.

Loved loved loved our experience at The Gallery and highly recommend to anyone visiting BA!

The location was great, with balconies overlooking all the action on La Defensa. We comfortably fit two couples with the luxury of having a bathroom/shower for each. Grisel was professional, punctual and gave us good tips about the neighborhood and city in general. We had a great time.

My friends and i had a great stay in BA. The apartment is located in heart of San Telmo, very spacious for 4 people and well equipped, everthing was spotless. We had smooth check-in and check-out. 100% recommend!

What a restful and beautiful stay. Grisel was so helpful and accommodating when our first flight was cancelled. She even helped arrange airport transportation. The apartment is incredible and was in a perfect location to enjoy both San Telmo, but the entire city of Buenos Aires.
위치가 너무나 좋았다. 부모님과 함께한 여행이라 택시를 많이 이용했지만 혼자 여행이었다면 걸어서 충분히 다녔을 거라 생각한다. 깨끗하고 큰 불편함 없이 지냈다.
Everything was perfect. The apartment is located in the heart of San Telmo area which mean an easy access to antique shops and the beautiful traditional Tango a few blocks from the apartment.

Flor es una gran anfitriona! El departamento se siente verdaderamente como un hogar, cuidado, limpio y con detalles. Todo lo necesario para tu estadía en BA está allí.
Fue mi primer experiencia por airbnb, no podría haberme sentido más cómoda.
Gracias Flor!

If you want to have a fancy experience then San Telmo is not the right place. I loved the aera, it's charming atmosphere and the "smell of Tango"  around the corner ... The flat is spacious and gives you the feeling of living in another century. It's an authentic place.

This apartment in San Telmo is just perfect! Amazing location, right in the heart of a very lively area with plenty of bars and cafes near by (for which Grisel can give fantastic suggestions). It was very large, 2 big bedrooms and bathrooms so very comfortable for 2 couples or family. Grisel was very lovely, easy to communicate with and gave plenty of advice of how to make the best or your time in BA. Stay here!

Grisels place is exactly as shown in the photos. It is beautiful and has a very vintage feel particularly the elevator. Grisel was overall an accomodating host, when she wasn't able to greet us for check in because of work, she got Andrew to sort us out. The beds were comfortable, and the place was nicely furnished.

There was abit of a hiccup with the pick from the airport when arriving in Buenos Aires, but besides that everything else was smooth, Grisel was flexible with check out times and so forth and very informative about what we can do and where to do our laundry.

San telmo is a lovely bohemian, artsy neighborhood. Too bad we weren't there for the weekend when the neighborhood is bustling. We would definitely recommend staying at Grisel's.

When I arrived in San Telmo I was met by Andrew who very carefully and clearly explained everything about the apartment and gave tips on staying in Buenos Aires. Grisel was always very helpful and thoughtful and even had extra heating for the colder weather! The apartment is lovely; old and charming just like San Telmo. It is very comfortable, safe and a pleasant place to relax. I loved the balconies and the view of Calle Defensa.

Grisel was great from booking to the last minute we stayed at the apartment in San Telmo. She could not be present at check in because our flight was delayed and she had other commitments, but sent his sister who was very kind and explained us everything we needed to know about the functioning of the apartment and the building. The apartment was very charming and comfortable, we really felt at home. The experience was very nice and we will come back for sure.

Foi nossa primeira viagem a Buenos Aires e nossa primeira experiência através da Airbnb. Inicialmente estávamos apreensivos, mas tudo correu bem. Grisel foi muito atenciosa, providenciou transporte do aeroporto até o apartamento, bem como estava a nossa espera e nos passou orientações oportunas. O apartamento era o que esperávamos e passamos dias agradáveis nas capital Portenha. Tivemos sorte de estarmos presente nas comemorações dos 200 anos de Independência da Nação Argentina.   Nosso obrigado a anfitriã por tudo.

Grisel was very welcoming when we got to the apartment, she gave us tips on how to get around the city and gave us several adresses of good restaurants.
The apartment is very beautiful and very clean, albeit a bit cold because of the central heat. It is also very well located (walking distance from Placa de Mayo and Av. 9 du Julio, and there is a great market on Calle Defensa on Sundays).
We loved our stay there, and would definitely stay there again.

Fue un viaje hermoso, el departamento es increíble, gracias a su espacio, limpio, ubicación, y comodidades. Las camas super confortables, el departamento super silencioso, algo valiosisimo en esta ciudad!
La cocina super practica, y acogedora, su mesa desayunador, un sueno!
Andrew y Grisel muy amables y dispuestos siempre! Espero volver a este departamento cuando vuelva a Buenos Aires!

We had a wonderful stay here in Buenos Aires for our honeymoon. Flor and Demian were extremely gracious hosts, giving us extensive suggestions on things to see and eat in the city, and even making us reservations at restaurants since our Spanish isn't the greatest. They also helped arrange cabs for us to and from the airport. At the same time they gave us our space to explore the city on our own. Exactly what we want from a host.

The apartment itself is cute and cozy, with a small kitchen that is helpful when you're sick of eating out for every meal. And it really is truly central to everything--it's in a very safe neighborhood and is walking distance or a short cab ride away from Recoleta and Palermo. It is also very close to a grocery store, a cool little park/playground, and some good, inexpensive restaurants as well.

The next time we're in Buenos Aires, we hope we can find a place as good as this again.
Everything was perfect, the flat, the comfortable bed and pillows, the neigbourhood, and the host really helpfull. I spent around 12days and will come back !

This was by far the best experience i had on airbnb! The location and the place were great!!! And the host was amazing!!! Florencia was very helpful with suggestions and recommendations. 10++++ I highly recommend this place!!!

Apartamento impecable, acogedor, cómodo, y como su nombre lo dice: cerca de todo.

Desde un apple tv hasta adaptadores de enchufes, el apartamento tiene de todo, lo único que le falta es la comida y gente para habitarlo.

Excelente experiencia, mejor que un hotel 5 estrellas, espero volver a quedarme en una próxima oportunidad.

Flor es una amfitriona estupenda y encantadora. Nos contó todo lo que podíamos llegar a ver en nuestra corta estancia en Buenos Aires, y nos hizo sentir como en casa. El apartamento es genial. Totalmente equipado y fiel a lo que se ve en las imágenes. Está en el centro de los 3 barrios más visitados de toda la ciudad, así que es perfecto para ir andando a cualquiera de ellos. Fué una estancia estupenda!!

Eu e minha namorada ficamos seis dias nesse adorável apartamento. Nós queríamos viver o dia a dia portenho, por isso optamos pelo apartamento. A decisão foi mais do que acertada. A Florencia e seu esposo são extremamente atenciosos, respondiam prontamente qualquer dúvida antes de irmos e se colocaram à disposição enquanto estivemos por lá.

Precisei colocar crédito no chip adquirido por lá e Demian, seu esposo foi até um kiosko comigo para me auxiliar a fazer a recarga do chip.

O apartamento é super bem localizado e aconchegante. Fica próximo ao metrô e com diversas linhas de ônibus por perto. O comércio ao redor é bem amplo com tudo o que se precisa, inclusive com um supermercado a uma quadra de distância.

Buenos Aires é apaixonante, pretendo voltar. E quando o fizer, certamente me hospedarei novamente nesse agradabilíssimo apartamento.

Florencia and her husband were very nice from the beginning to the end. She provided me with all the info about transport, money exchange and restaurant recommendations.
The place is clean and provided with clean towels, soap and hair dryer.
My husband and i had a lovely stay. Bed is comfortable, the apartment is safe and close to 2 subway stations.
There was nothing to complain about our stay here. Flor is a great host!

Pasamos unas lindas vacaciones en Buenos Aires!! El departamento de Flor es lindisimo y super bien equipado. Flor y Demian te hacen sentir en casa, dan excelentes tips para conocer la ciudad y hacen muy grata la estancia. Fue una experiencia increíble y sin dudarlo los recomendamos. Superan las expectativas, la próxima vez que vayamos a BsAs esperamos quedarnos en el depa!

Flor made us feel really welcome, which was apparent in her reviews :)  I was really blown away by her kindness, cheer, and thoughtfulness. The apartment was adorable, clean - and the pictures were accurate. Centrally located too! She was very quick with her responses, and I had absolutely no worry. Sometimes AirBnB apartments are not as comfortable as hotels in terms of amenities, but with Flor's apartment.. you get the best of both worlds :) A gratuitous water bottle, chocolate cookie with a wide selection of teas, and an Apple TV!! When I come back to Buenos Aires, I will be sure to seek out Florencia's apartment first!

El departamiento es muy lindo y tiene muchas cosas que no encontramos en otros lugares y todo es de calidad ! !! Florencia es muy simpatica tan como una veritable guion !  Recomendamos mucho este lugar  !!

Florencia was a charming hostess, ever ready to help and responded very quickly and in detail to any of our questions.
The flat is ' central to everything ' , in a nice neighbourhood with easy metro access.

This was my first experience using Airbnb and I loved it!  The hosts were especially nice and helpful.  They speak very good English.  The apartment was just like the photos.  The bed was very comfortable and the shower was GREAT! Kitchen perfect for travelers needs. I felt very safe and at home there by myself for 5 days.  I loved coming back to quiet and not dealing with hotel staff.  They respond to any questions very quickly and gave me great restaurant suggestions.  They provided verbal and written info about the apartment and provided a subway card to load and use.  It made the subway super easy.  I can not recommend them enough!  They are honest, nice people.  It was a pleasure to stay there.

Un verdadero placer quedarnos en casa de Florencia! Comodo con todo lo necesario (y más!)
Florencia es atenta y estuvo disponible para nosotros en todo momento. Un gusto y esperamos volver pronto

Flor nos ayudo con todo lo que pudiéramos necesitar desde incluso antes de llegar a Argentina. Nos dio todos lao consejos de lugares, tipo de cambio, restaurantes, etc. Ha sido una delicia quedarnos con ella y la casa es un encanto! Esta súper bien ubicada, es cómoda y lindisima como en las fotos!
Muchísimas gracias Flor por estos días que han sido maravillosos!

Wonderful experience! Flor and her husband could not have been more helpful or sweeter. Apartment was perfect, great location, and they provided us with everything we needed. We would recommend to anyone!

Florencia's flat is in a great location. It is functional and very clean. Florencia and her husband were wonderful hosts: attentive and helpful. It was a pleasure to stay here. I would recommend it. A great base to explore Buenos Aires!

Flor and Demian were excellent hosts! The apartment is in a great and very safe area in Recoleta and is perfect for 1-2 people who want to explore Buenos Aires! Demian met us at the apartment when we arrived and gave us a ton of recommendations of places to see and where to eat! They also loaned us a subway card (which works on all public transportation in BA) which made it very easy for us to get around. Bed was great, shower was hot, and the apartment in general was very comfortable. Would stay again in a heartbeat and highly recommend it!

All prior reviews have been spot on regarding fantastic host and hostess as well as the location.  Flo and her husband went above and beyond aiding us with restaurant reservations and directions to select sites in BA.  If we goback to BA in future we know where we will try to stay!

Flor was very warm and accommodating - she agreed to meet us late at night to let us in which was a life saver. Her apartment is exactly as depicted and was centrally located and totally lovely. Would definitely recommend.

We spent the last week of December in the apartment and had an amazing time. It was our first time visit to Buenos Aires. Florencia was very attentive and easy to communicate with, she thought of everything, even printed out the information for us. Gave us good recommendations and answered all our questions. The apartment is centrally situated, everything is easily accessible. There are several grocery stores, cafes  in the neighborhood, the subway and stations are nearby. We highly recommend Florencia's apartment.

O apartamento da Laura e do Leo é lindo! As fotos que vimos no site não fazem jus à beleza e ao espaço desse lugar. O quarto duplo onde ficamos é realmente privativo e espaçoso.
A localização é perfeita, tudo que você quiser fazer em Buenos Aires poderá fazer a pé, sem problemas, eu e minha esposa pegamos ônibus apenas quando fomos à La Boca, de resto caminhar foi muito melhor, para nosso bolsos e para conhecer melhor essa linda cidade.
