Mas o lugar é perfeito não só por ser um ótimo quarto ou uma localização fantástica, mas porque Laura e Leo fazem dessa experiência algo único.
Laura nos deu mapas e dicas e tudo que precisamos e perguntamos fomos atendidos com uma simpatia fora do comum.
Nos sentimos em casa em todos os momentos e conhecê-los foi uma das melhores coisas de Buenos Aires.
Com certeza recomendamos ficar aqui e quando voltamos a Buenos Aires não perderemos a chance de ficar com Laura e Leo novamente.

The stay at Laura`s apartment was so great! Sehr has a beautiful home that she shares with her guests!.
We had a double room with a bathroom. The rooms were very clean and lovely. We had much space to put all our luggage.
When we arrived Laura took her time to give many helpful advices for our stay in Buenos Aires.
As the apartment is very central it is possible to reach a lot of interesting spots by foot.
We really recommend this accommodation!

Just Fantastic! Spot in the middle of the action, very nice apartment in an old classy building. We got a double room with annexed neat bathroom.
But the story is with Laura and Leo. They are perfect hosts. Sharing house with strangers is not obvious, but here it took only one minute to feel at home. Laura took us around the block to familiarize us with the neighborhood and the city map. Than as both Laura and Leo are tango dancers, we had the privilege to be guest at a very special Milonga event! The stay with Laura made Buenos Aires even better than it really is. Thank you guys for the nice dinner at home and a great week in BA.

Difficile de trouver mieux comme emplacement dans San Telmo avec la rue Defensa qui dévient piétonne le dimanche avec tous les stands d'artisanat.
L'appartement est spacieux, calme, bien équipé et l'arrivée avec l'ascenseur de l'époque ne fait que rendre le lieu encore plus authentique.
L'accueil de Grisel est on ne peut plus sympathique et professionnel. On serait bien rester encore plus longtemps que la semaine déjà super agréable.
Lovely Apartment and we appreciated Giesel arranging transport to and from the Airport.

Just finished a most enjoyable 5 night stay at Grisel's "French Classic" apartment in San Telmo--it was delightful. As others have reviewed, it was just as pictured--neat and clean, spacious and charming with a definite French feel. While the unit is on the 3rd floor, an old-fashioned grilled elevator (which operates fast and efficiently) takes you right to the apartment's front door. The apartment's 2 bedrooms and 2 baths, the well-equipped kitchen, and the large living room and dining room make this place a great choice for a short or long stay. Although there were just two of us, it would definitely be plenty roomy for 2 couples. Grisel was a fine host, very responsive to our advance questions, and provided a wealth of information about the neighborhood, its restaurants, bars, shops, sights, customs and suggestions well before we arrived, giving us lots of time to plan for a great visit to B.A. Grisel's helper, Andrew, actually greeted us upon arrival and provided an excellent orientation to the apartment as well as further specifics about the San Telmo area and answered any questions we might have had. The apartment's location on Defensa puts it right in the heart of San Telmo, which is gentrified enough that it's full of great cafes and shops, a place where visitors won't feel unsafe, but still a very authentic section of B.A., with cobblestone streets, old buildings full of character, and regular people who live there. As active as the area was, the apartment was pleasantly quiet--always nice to return to after a busy day of touring the city.
Thank you, Grisel, for making our first trip to B.A. such a happy and memorable one. We hope it won't be our last and will definitely look forward to staying with you again.

We enjoyed a wonderful home away from home experience at Grisel's beautiful apartment.

We had a lovely warm welcome from Grisel who was very flexible and responsive throughout the trip. We were there for over two weeks so she even arranged for it to be cleaned half way through, which was a lovely touch.

You'll find a very handy and extensive guide to the city which Grisel has carefully compiled, and it was full of great suggestions and non-touristy tips.

The beds were really comfortable with lovely soft sheets! We both slept really well.

The kitchen is pretty basic but as you are in the heart of the action in San Telmo - there is no need/desire to cook much.

We had a fantastic stay and I would absolutely recommend Grisel's apartment to anyone wanting a true Buenos Aires experience.

La comunicación con Grisel fue excelente antes, durante y después del viaje sobre todo a través de whatsapp. Se mostró muy disponible en todo momento y nos ayudó en lo que necesitamos. Nos acompañó incluso a coger el taxi de vuelta al aeropuerto. El amplio apartamento está muy bien situado en el Centro de San Telmo, un barrio especialmente bullicioso por las noches por lo que no hay que temer al ruido. Está muy bien comunicado con el resto de la ciudad y se encuentra de todo lo necesario a pocos pasos. Hay una abundante oferta de restaurantes, tiendas y ocio, sobre todo los domingos, cuando tiene lugar en la calle el animado mercadillo. El bonito mercado de San Telmo está muy cerca por lo que se puede comprar fruta, verdura y carne fresca. No hay que perderse la exquisita panadería francesa que está en el interior. La casa tiene mucho encanto, sobre todo el salón comedor. Es mejorable la calidad de internet y el equipamiento de cocina y baño, pero eso no ha impedido que pasemos una excelente estancia, hasta el punto de que nos hubiéramos quedado más días. Muchas gracias Grisel por todo. Recomendaremos tanto el barrio como el apartamento a nuestros amigos y nos encantaría volver pronto.

O apartamento é realmente o que as fotos demonstram, ótimo para se passar alguns dias e também muito confortável!
A localização é priveligiada, é possível conhecer 80% dos pontos turísticos a pé, sem precisar gastar com táxi ou metro (que também são muito fácies de se conseguir). O bairro é bem bohemio com diversas opções de bares e restaurantes!

We congratulated ourselves on our good fortune in selecting a perfect location in the historic San Telmo neighborhood.  The 100-year-old building overlooked lively Avenida Defensa, but the condo was quiet and as lovely as the photos, which showcase a collection of unique art.  Grisel arrange our transport to and from the airport, and was there to meet us an bid farewell.  She was always ready to help.  We recommend Cafe Rivas on Estado Unidos, also Origen on Humberto Primo, and the modestly priced desayunos of medialunas and cafe dulce [and sometimes fresh OJ which are everywhere and not to be missed. Also the Saturay morning market mention in Grisel's guidebook.  Great peaches!

Flor was incredibly attentive and accommodating; meeting us upon arrival despite our constantly shifting arrival time, providing us with notated maps, travel guides, a reloadable public transportation card, and several suggestions for places to go around the city. On top of that, she even arranged for a car to pick us up and drive us to the airport on our last day.
The apartment was very nice and included all the amenities we could have wanted. It's centrally located and just a couple of blocks from the subway and main bus lines along Santa Fe. In many cases, we were even able to take a healthy walk to the places we needed to go to.
The power adapters and AppleTV were a nice touch.
This was a great place to stay to enjoy a few days visiting the big city.
Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour chez Flor. L'appartement est très confortable, bien placé dans Buenos Aires. Flor s'est montrée très disponible pour nous aider. Je recommande absolument.

Florencia is the best Airbnb host that my friend and I have ever had - and we've had some good hosts! She is beyond helpful and welcoming, so friendly and kind, and did everything possible to ensure we had a comfortable stay. The flat is very well situated; we walked to most sites of interest and it was very clean and safe. Flor has thought of everything - the apartment has everything you need as well as extra unexpected details such as Netflix, coffee and alfajores and guide books, maps and a metro card. You can't find better in BA. Book now!!! Mil gracias Flor.

A estadia no apartamento correu muito bem. Além de ser exatamente como na foto, o apartamento estava em bom estado de conservação e limpeza. Ar condicionado, tv, aquecimento da água e wifi funcionaram perfeitamente. A Florência, muito amável, deixou toalhas limpas, roupa de cama cheirosa, ferro de passar, secador, sabonete, papel higiênico, papel toalha, shampoo e condicionador no apartamento, além de outros agradinhos. Também foi gentil e nos enviar dicas de transporte e alimentação no local. Nos comunicávamos pelo Airbnb sempre que precisávamos. A vizinhança é agradável e segura, próximo ao metrô, pontos de ônibus, bancos, restaurantes, mercearias, farmácias etc. Recomendo bastante! Voltarei quando tiver oportunidade!

Nós tivemos uma experiência maravilhosa no apartamento da Flor e do Demian, eles foram MUITO fofos e receptivos, nos passaram uma lista de restaurantes bem legal e precisa em relação a preços.
O apartamento é extremamente bem localizado e muito lindo! A cozinha é bem preparada, com todos os utensílios que se pode precisar, tudo muito cheiroso e limpinho. Adoramos!
Place close to shopping centers and other interesting sites, safe and clean! Thank you

El departamento de Florencia es estupendo. Es renovado, limpio, luminoso y agradable. Es devorado con muy buen gusto. En la ducha hay agua caliente. La cocina está bien para una corta estadía.

Florencia fue muy buena hostess. Nos envió muchas recomendaciones para lugares, transporte etc. Además te presta una tarjeta sube para que puedas viajar facilmente en la ciudad. Fue muy flexible para la hora del check out, lo que era genial.

Muchisimas gracias por todo Flor!

Flo estuvo preocupada todo el tiempo, incluso antes de nuestra llegada.
El departamento está muy bien equipado y cercano a las principales avenidas.
Nuestra experiencia estuvo increíble y lo recomendaría sin duda.
Gracias por todo Flo.
Very nice host, beautiful apartment in a great location.  All the things you need, and very comfortable bed. Definitely recommend.

We stayed for 5 days in Buenos Aires at Florencia's place. The apartment is in a great location close to the metro, supermarkets and cafés. You can get to almost every part of the city within very short time. The apartment is in a safe and nice area where you don't have to worry about security. The apartment itself has everything you need for a longer stay. Nice kitchen, Apple TV/Netflix (what we didn't use because there is so much to see), books, great decoration, lift, aircon. etc.
After a great introduction with lots of information on activities, restaurants and cafes, Florencia was very helpful during our stay. Whenever you have questions or need recommendations she has valuable tips for you and answers very quickly. She and her husband are absolutely reliable and very attentive and far above expectations.
Therefore if you go go Buenos Aires stay at their place.

Great apartment and even better host. Flor was extremely helpful during our stay in Buenos Aires, full of recommendations and local tips. The apartment is about a 20 minute walk from the heart of the Recoleta or Palermo SoHo, but is central between the two and is not far from Santa Fe which is bustling with shops and cafes.

Flor and her husband were very welcoming, responsive, and helpful during our entire stay - they gave a useful intro to the apartment and city even though we arrived very early in the morning, they helped call us cars to the airport 2 times, and they were nice enough to let us leave our bags with them during our last day of exploring in the city. The apartment itself is indeed well-located and clean, and was a comfortable spot for our ~9 days in BA. Thanks again!

We stayed here for three nights and it was great! Florencia and her husband are great hosts. We came from Madrid and the airline left our suitcases there. They could deliver them the next day but we had already booked an excursion for that time. Florencia offered the suitcases to be delivered to her own apartment and we picked them up after our excursion.
They also made reservation at a restaurant for us and arranged a transfer to the airport.
The apartment is not very big but it's very cosy and has everything you may need. The location is close to a lot of sites and subway station.

This place is great! Exactly how it looked in the photos. Perfect location in a very cool neighborhood, lots of space, and really cool look. Big and updated kitchen so we could make breakfast in the morning then go walk beautiful Buenos Aires. Only issue was spotty/no wifi a couple of days. But Grisel was very accommodating, helping us out with an extra guest and generally being a great host. Definitely recommend!
Best located spot in the area with a real classic and comfortable place to rest from the living streets you can have a good look down to from the balcony.

Estubimos en el departamento de Grisel y todo fue lo mas perfecto. En el corazón de San Telmo yo y mis amigos nos sentimos como en casa todo el tiempo. Ya pienso en volver con mi familia muy pronto. Grisel fue muy amable y nos ayudo cuando precisamos, hizo el checkin tarde porque teniamos um vuelo complicado y estubo siempre en contacto. Super lo recomendo.

She was an amazing host. The place is in a great central location and she gives you the lay out of the area when you get there.  The place was clean and the shower never runs out of hot water. If you stand on the balcony there's a great breeze asy night.

A lovely apartment, close to cafes and restaurants. An easy walk to other areas of Buenos Aires of interest to a tourist. Grisel was available to answer questions or assist when needed, which was appreciated.

Bien ubicada y a buen precio.

El apartamento se ve igual como en las fotos.

The San Telmo apartment was on the famous Defensa St and it had 2 balconies that faced the street. This was great for people watching! The kitchen was very well equipped and the bedrooms were very cosy. The heating was very good and the showers had continuous flow hot water.
Grisel is a professional manager of the property and you can feel reassured that the apartment is pretty much exactly as described on the Airbnb website.

Regards,

Lesley (Melbourne, Australia)
Todo impecables, ubicación, departamento, entorno , etc

Foi maravilhoso ficar no apartamento da Florencia! A localização é muito boa, central aos principais pontos de visitação, próxima de duas estações de metrô e a 3 quadras da Av Santa Fé, onde se pode pegar ônibus para todos os lugares. Há comercio muito próximo.
O apartamento é muito fofo, igual às fotos! Muito cheiroso, lençois e toalhas limpinhos, decorado, a cama é muito confortável e o chuveiro é muito quentinho! Na cozinha há todos os utensilios que se possa precisar, e a Florencia foi fofa de deixar água, café, chá e outras coisas para nossa utilização.
Antes da hospedagem ela já foi superatenciosa, dando o direcional de como chegar, sugerindo o transporte até o apto. e respondendo nossas dúvidas por email, como sugestões de restaurante.
Recomendo 100% ficar neste apartamento. Com certeza recomendarei a meus amigos e numa próxima oportunidade em BsAs pretendo ficar lá novamente!

Gracias por todo, Flor y Demian!!!

Excelente apartamento, exatamente como nas fotos, limpo, muito bem decorado, super agradável, chuveiro quentinho, ar condicionado frio e quente, cozinha muito bem equipada, cama confortável, muito bem localizado, pode-se fazer tudo a pé, de ônibus ou metrô, ou também de táxi que fica super barato para qualquer lugar de Buenos.
Flor e seu marido foram muito receptivos, preocupados desde antes da nossa chegada, deixando água, chá, café e claro uns deliciosos alfajores, depois durante a estadia, recomendando restaurantes e cafés maravilhosos, em todos que fomos nos surpreendemos. E também nos deixou um cartão SUBE para utilizarmos o ônibus e o metrô. E um mapa com os principais pontos turistícos da cidade.
Super recomendo, já estamos com saudade do Ap. e de Buenos. rss
Muchas gracias Flor, e hasta lá próxima.

El apartamento es genial, tal cual se ve en las fotos, tiene todo lo que uno necesita, pensado para que no te falte nada y superrrr limpio.
El barrio muy lindo, cerca de todo.
Florencia es super amable, te da toda la información para moverte por la ciudad y lugares para visitar.

No le falta nada, sin duda me volvería a quedar ahí.

Florencia was very helpful by sending tips from before arrival all the way through my stay. The apartment was very well equipped and was walking distance to everywhere. We had an amazing stay and they were great hosts!

This place is totally recommendable for solo or couple traveler(s) who would like to enjoy Buenos Aires (BA) as much as possible. The owner Flor and her husband are responsible, flexible, kind and punctual. The apartment's neighborhood is safe. Most main sight-seeing spots are (not so much close but) in walking-distance. In addition, there is a metro station only a few blocks away from the place. This Metro makes it more convenient. If I come back to BA for any reasons, I would choose again this place. Thank you Flor!

Flor is truly a Super Host! She welcomed us personally and gave us a rundown of the apartment. Flor gave us plenty of tips on restaurants, where to do laundry, answering all our questions before and during our stay promptly. She booked a Remi/taxi for us to the airport as well. The apartment has all the little things that make it feel like home that other Airbnbs we stayed at lacked (eg. Coat hanger, paper towels, full length mirror, umbrella, not 1 but 2 sets of keys). She also provided us two SUBE cards which we didn't end up using but just goes to show how thorough and thoughtful Flor is!

A very nice and clean apartment in a good location. Laura was very helpful and gave us a lot of good tips for Buenos Aires.

We can absolutely recommend Laura and her apartment and we will come back.

Great place all in all:
Location. Good. Walking distances in the center.
Hosts - Laura and Leo are welcoming and helpful, you feel great near them. A lot of advices about tango;)
Apartment - big, clean and interesting place; description in profile correct. In dinner room there air condition, in our room there was vent.
One notice, our rooms windows opens at noisy street, so at nights it may be little bit noisy.

We spent two nights in transit in Buenos Aires with Laura.
We had some trouble during our transfers with airports and when we arrived, it was just amazing to meet Laura with his smile in a quiet and beautiful place, in good location. Such a good spirit and good atmosphere... You feel like home and the solutions come easily!
Laura does care about their guests and try to help even if it is late in the evening or early in the morning.
I truly recommend!

Stay with Laura and Leo, only if you want to fall in love with Buenos Aires, Tango, Mate tea and Argentina.

They are so welcoming, nice and sweet that you will think all argentinians are like them.

Their home is super nice and it's the best location in the city.

You will love it, and will want to return to argentina... Enjoy! :)

Laura est une hôte remarquable: son accueil était chaleureux tout en mettant au clair les règles de la maison rapidement. L'appartement est très agréable, avec une chambre et une salle de bain proprettes et un peu à part du reste du logement donc l'intimité est parfaite. L'appartement est très central ce qui permet de découvrir la ville à pied. Nous avons eu l'occasion d'échanger à plusieurs reprises et Laura m'a proposé de l'accompagner à une milonga...  Bref, une expérience au top. Un énorme merci, à bientôt à Paris! :D

Strategic location, very clean functional and comfortable accomodation with private bathroom, super kind host who gave me a lot of very useful tips from the first second we met to the last second I was there. One of the best place I have ever been with Airbnb. Strongly recommended! Thank you Laura!

Laura is a perfect hostess. Attentive and careful with their guests.
The room is exactly as described, comfortable and spacious with private bathroom.
She was clear about the house rules and what I could find in the area. In fact the location is great. Close to the theater I wanted to visit and to great restaurants.
Unfortunately my stay was too short and we couldn't chat more. I'd like to learn more about tango.
It's my first option on my next trip to BsAs.
Mi estancia en el departamento de Laura y Leo me ha sido muy c'omoda. Muy buena ubicaci'on con todos los servicions necesarios a mi alcance.

Laura and her husband are absolutely lovely people and made my stay in BA such a memorable one.  I arrived not feeling very well and Laura was so very helpful in giving me advice about what to ask at the pharmacy.  The apartment is lovely and in a great location where everything is in walking distance.  The room and Private WC were perfect for my 6 night stay.  Would highly recommend staying with this beautiful couple!!

Laura was a very good host, friendly and helpful. I had a few questions about Buenos Aires, things to do, places to see, and she had some great suggestions. I had no communication issues as Laura's english is very good.
Very beautiful house, very nice woman! Great!

Laura and Leo were really helpful and nice and I really felt welcomed and comfortable. They are passionate about tango and could help me in this matter. The bedroom is really comfortable with a private bathroom  just next to the room, which is convenient.  The rooms are clean and nicely furnished. The apartment is well situated in the center (which also means noise from the street, but that's part of being in the center), but apart from that I really enjoyed my stay and will definitely come back there.

Excellents hôtes,  très belle chambre et quel bonheur d'être si proche du centre ville. Nous avons été très content de passer quelques jours chez eux durant notre passage à Buenos Aires. Laura nous a donné de supers adresses pour profiter de la ville :)

I enjoyed my stay with Laura and Leo they have a nice apartment in a great location. I like walking and it was no problem to walk to Recoleta or Museo de Belles Artes on one side or San Telmo on the other. All the other sights like Plaza de Mayo and Teatro Colon are in easy reach. There is a huge choice of restaurants nearby and I took Laura's advice all of which were top class. Although she was very busy she did all she could to help me enjoy Buenos Aires and was the crucial link in arranging a trip to a Boca Juniors game. A real highlight. I have no hesitation in recommending Suipacha as a place to stay and if I return will definitely hope to stay there again.

Laura e seu marido fora excelentes anfitriões, nota 10 para eles! Eles deram todas as informações e dicas e, com sua ajuda, pude comemorar meu aniversário em grande estilo! A localização é fantástica, perto de tudo e bem central. Tudo estava de acordo com o que foi anunciado, a casa é muito limpa e tranquila e tem todas as comodidades. Meu marido e eu nos sentimos em casa. O apartamento é silencioso apesar de estar no centro, algo que não esperava. Quando voltar a Buenos Aires, vou torcer para sua casa estar liberada, pois é lá que vou querer estar! Muito obrigada, Laura!

Laura e Leo são um casal muito solícito, sempre procurando ajudar da melhor forma para que pudéssemos nos sentir em casa. Nos deram várias indicações de lugares para visitar, além de ótimos restaurantes.
O apartamento todo é muito limpo, com roupas de cama e banho muito limpas e confortáveis.
A localização é excelente, independente do motivo da viagem, inclusive com ponto de ecobici bem em frente ao prédio, além das estações de ônibus e metrô a uma quadra.
Esperamos retornam numa próxima oportunidade.
Laura y su esposo son excelentes anfitriones te hacen sentir como parte de su familia su casa es muy acogedora y muy bonita. Totalmente recomendado
A lovely place to stay, very quiet and peaceful , beautiful location in a fine apartment , it’s top class .

Ubicación inmejorable, que permite visitar varios lugares turísticos a pie. Cerca de cafeterías, restaurantes, farmacias, etc. Fuimos en pleno invierno, la habitación estuvo bastante cómoda, cálida e impecable.
Laura y su esposo viven en el mismo departamento, ambos excelentes personas. Fueron muy flexibles con el horario de ingres y salida. Muchas gracias 🤗

O apartamento de Laura é tal qual a descricão. É amplo, limpo, muito bem localizado, tem uma excelente vista para uma praça e um chuveiro quentinho (fomos no inverno). Laura e Leo são excelentes anfitriões, nos atenderam em tudo o que precisamos e nos deram excelentes ideias de passeios, exposições e shows. Ótimo custo-benefício! Recomendo!

Sehr schöne zentral gelegene Altbauwohnung in Buenos Aires. Mir hat es an nichts gefehlt. Gastgeber sind ein junges argentinisches Paar, die sehr offen und sympathisch sind.
Ich hatte eine tolle Woche!

Minha filha Heloisa ficou hospedada com Laura e Leo e aqui coloco as suas palavras:
A estadia foi impecável, Leo e Lau foram excepcionais, sempre muito atentos a todos os detalhes, a experiência como um todo é indescritível, sem dúvida alguma pretendo voltar e recomendo a todos.
Além disso a casa é belíssima, sempre muito limpa e aconchegante, os jacarandas de frente a janela fazem com que sintamos como se estivéssemos em um livro.
A convivência com os anfitriões são dignas de boas memórias que ficaram guardadas em minha história em Buenos Aires.
Sou muito grata por esta experiência e a Laura e Leo por terem compartilhado comigo esses dias em sua residência.
Muito Obrigada!!!!!!
The Perfect Apartment. Super-nice and communicative hosts and you can't get any better then this when it comes to the location. Gracias Laura!

Very nice place
Wonderful location and host easy to communicate with !
Gracias !

Um ótimo local para se hospedar em Buenos Aires. Fica perto de tudo e das principais avenidas do centro, 5 minutos de Corrientes e 5 de Galerias Pacífico. Sobre o apartamento, ele é muito aconchegante. A iluminação e o som externo não atrapalharam durante a estadia. Laura e Leo nos receberam muito bem e o check in flexível ajudou muito durante a viagem. Ótimo custo-benefício!
Laura é uma pessoa maravilhosa e super simpática, bastante solicita!!

O apartamento é bem localizado, próximo dos principais pontos turísticos de Buenos Aires, foi possível fazer tudo caminhando! A Laura foi muito solicita, nos deu dicas de lugares, sempre disposta a ajudar! O apartamento extremamente limpo, tudo muito organizado! Foi uma experiência muito boa!

We really enjoyed our stay and we're pleased of all the little helpful efforts en plus. We enjoyed to have a lot of classy space and these two sepearate bathrooms. The location was perfect for us. Close to our conference and just around the corner of our most preferred restaurants.

Flor was a pleasure to deal with, probably one of the best aibnb hosts I've had to date - accommodating on check-in/out/other requests, gave me loads of tips/recommendations and very responsive on communication. The apartment is small but had everything I needed for my trip. Close to transport links/main attractions but the apartment itself was in a quiet area.

A localização do apartamento é fantastica, proximo ao metrô e de facil acesso para todas as regioes da cidade.

Florencia e seu marido foram extremamente dedicados ao disponibilizar este apartamento, além de é claro alguns "mimos" para turistas... Alfajores, sucos...

Recomendo a locação deste apartamento :)
Muy buena atención! Recomendable.
Excelente departamento.

The hosts are really nice people that went out of their way to make sure we have a comfortable stay! We had an early check in and late check out request that they went out of their way to accommodate, and gave us restaurant and sights recommendations. The apartment is just as described, clean and safe! And the hosts even provided a subway card to use.

We were welcomed by Florencia at the apartment. She explained us the highlights of the city (which she pointed out on a very useful map) and gave us a list of her favorite restaurants. She provided us with a card for the subway/bus. Before using it you probably have to put some money on it, which is easy to do at the nearby subway station.

The apartment was very clean and comfortable. The pictures give a very good resemblance of the place. All necessary utilities are available in the apartment and there is a bottle of water and juice in the fridge waiting for you.

During our stay we went to another place for 2 days and we could store our big suitcases at her place (which is very close to the apartment). Both the check in and out times can be discussed with Florencia in advance and she is flexible depending on the arrival of next guests of course.

We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again!

unos anfitriones excelentes. el apartamento tiene todo lo que se necesita tanto para una estadia corta como larga. los chicos pensaron en todo. el lugar esta muy cerca de los principales puntos turísticos y comerciales y tiene muy buena locomoción. seguramente volveremos.

We stayed at Florencia's place for two nights.
Host: Florencia is indeed a super hostess! She explained everything very well, she provided information about transportation nearby, food places for all budgets and personal favorites. We already knew the area but her attention to detail and clarity was exceptional.
Apartment: it's exceptionally well taken care of, beautiful decoration, small but can perfectly accommodate 2-3 people. Perfect for our needs (we have a 4 month old baby).
Bed was very comfortable, appliances are brand new, good water pressure and hot water, TV with Netflix (not that we watched much TV anyways but it's available) and overall a great place. Armored front door adds a layer of security but it's an apartment in a building in a relatively safe area so security isn't a concern there.
The only advice for future renters: disconnect the landline if you don't want to receive 10 telemarketer phone calls in the morning! :)

Eu e minha namorada chegamos enquanto a Flor ainda estava arrumando o apartamento, mas ainda assim ela foi muito solícita. Nos explicou as regras, nos deu um mapa e o cartão do SUBE. Nos esclareceu todas as nossas dúvidas em relação a condução, e disse que qualquer problema poderíamos a contactar pelo telefone. Mais tarde, nos mandou uma mensagem com todos os restaurantes que nos recomendava. Como todos os comentários anteriores, deixou suco, água, alfajores, chá e café. O apartamento idêntico as fotos, chuveiro e torneira com água super quente, apple tv. Apartamento bem limpo e conservado. A Flor foi super pontual na hora do check out também! Tínhamos transfer marcado para às 6h da manhã e ela chegou uns 15 minutinhos antes e ficou nos aguardando descer na portaria. Definitivamente indico para outras pessoas!

El departamento es sumamente acogedor, lleno de comodidades y con una excelente ubicación para moverse por los lugares más importantes de la ciudad sin mayores demoras!
Su decoración es tal como lo muestran las fotos, y el punto a destacar es la limpieza...brillante y perfumado en cada rincón!
Florencia es una anfitriona de lujo, muy atenta y hospitalaria. Recomiendo sin dudar este alojamiento!

A acomodação é muito fiel a descrição e as fotos. Muito limpo e organizado, fica tudo muito claro com placas indicando alguns cuidados que devemos ter para a conservação do local e dos objetos. Além de ser confortável, tamanho bom, com até mais comodidades do que o básico (como a appletv, guarda chuva, itens de primeiros socorros, cartão de transporte da cidade) também havia algumas coisas para cozinharmos e comermos como sal, pimenta, óleo, açúcar, café, alfajores e balas. Na acomodação há lugares suficientes para guardar todos os nossos pertences - guarda roupas, cabides, armários, gavetas de sobra. O aquecimento da água tem um sistema diferente do Brasil (ou pouco usual) chamado termo-tanque, mas com a ajuda da Flor aprendemos rápido o funcionamento. Chuveiro confortável, banheiro espaçoso com banheira, gaveteiro, toalhas a disposição. Cozinha completa (fogão, forno, geladeira e microondas) com todos os utensílios necessários, inclusive panos, esponjas e produtos de limpeza. O prédio apesar de antigo também é bom, com manutenção frequente e bastante seguro.

A anfitriã é um amor, muito querida e atenciosa. Nos recebeu com explicações rápidas sobre o uso dos equipamentos da acomodação, mostrou pra nós um mapa da cidade com muitas dicas de pontos turísticos e deixou tudo a nossa disposição. Nos explicou muitas coisas, e se não bastasse também nos indicou muitos lugares para comer divididos em categorias - comidas típicas, churrascarias, pizzarias, comida italiana, confeitarias, panificadoras, delivery, tudo na região.

No check-out pudemos deixar nossos pertences no apartamento dela (somente a duas quadras) durante todo o dia, ela também nos deixou usar sua wifi, e com certeza se tivessemos tido algum problema a anfitriã teria nos atendido prontamente.

Mas é difícil ter algum problema pois a Flor pensa em tudo, explica tudo na chegada e o que ela não fala você acaba encontrando. Se está chovendo, tem guarda chuva; se seu aparelho eletrônico não encaixa nas tomadas, tem adaptadores de todo tipo; se você sujou alguma coisa, tem produtos de limpeza; se você se machucou, tem primeiros socorros. Ou seja, a anfitriã já pensou em tudo o que pode acontecer e disponibilizou tudo para que você consiga resolver os problemas com tranquilidade.

O cuidado da anfitriã e atenção dela com tudo o que os hóspedes podem precisar é surpreendente. Superou todas as nossas expectativas e fez com que literalmente nos sentíssemos em casa, indico para todos.
Ela é muito atenciosa, simpática e nos recebe muito bem, deixando-nos muito à vontade. O apartamento é muito bem localizado, limpo e com todas as comodidades.

Staying at Flor's place was a really great way to start our holiday. It was in a great location, close to everything and had everything we needed to feel just like home. Flor was also a really great help and gave us some really good tips to make our two nights in Buenos Aires even better!

Flor and her husband were wonderful hosts. They were super friendly and made me feel instantly welcome. Any time I had a question during my stay they would almost immediately reply to my emails with detailed answers, and we're kind enough to provide me with a terrific list of local restaurants to try.

The map they provided was perfect to help me navigate the city on my own, and the apartment is in a great central location to make it easy to explore all the varying neighbourhoods by foot. Flor also provides a Metro card if you want to take the subway instead - you just have to top it up with money.

The apartment is just how it looks in the pictures and is clean and comfortable. There was water and juice in the fridge, which was terrific, and toiletries in the bathroom. Having access to Netflix through Apple TV is also a terrific bonus, as all the cable channels are dubbed into Spanish.

The only negative was that the apartment can be a little noisy on weekends or Thursday nights with people playing music or yelling in the early hours of the morning. But given the way the buildings are designed across Buenos Aires (all crammed next to each other), I'd imagine this would be a problem experienced everywhere. In fact, some neighbourhoods would probably be worse as, at least, the apartment is in a relatively quiet street.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay, felt completely safe the entire time and would definitely recommend the apartment to others.
Fue todo excelente, como sale el anuncio y mejor. Florencia tiene toda la disponibilidad para Ayudarte y solucionar tus dudas

Flor and her husband Demian were very helpful before, during and at checkout of our stay. Flor gave us lots of hints and tips and lots of great restaurant recommendations and Demian went through everything and much more on a map during check in so we knew everything we needed to know! No question was too much for Flor to answer that we had during our stay. The apartment was as described,  it was lovely, clean, had a comfy bed and was in a great location. Highly recommend for anyone or couple staying in Buenos Aires. Thank you Flor (and Demian!) :)

Florensa was a great host and provided great instructions and suggestions of things to do - the house was great and in a really good location for easily accessing all parts of the city

She was easy to contact and stayed back and helped us speak to the taxi company when we realised we had left our wallet inside and arranged for them to return with it

I would highly recommend this as a great place to stay in BA

Tout est parfait chez Florencia! L'accueil tres chaleureux, l'appartement charmant avec tout le necessaire pour cuisiner, tres bien situe, au calme bien que tres central et tout pres d'une station de metro. Florencia a pense a tout pour facilter la vie du visiteur : carte de metro a recharger, telephone a disposition pour les appels sur les telephones fixes a Buenos Aires, informations sur les lieux a visiter etc...Merci beaucoup !
Un apartamento pequeño, cómodo, intimo, limpio y confortable. Ubicación residencial cerca de estación de transporte publico. Los anfitriones muy pendientes y amables.

Flor and her husband are not only great hosts but also great human beings.

They did everything they could to make sure we were comfortable, explained everything step-by-step (quite important to me, since I’m a fresh AirBnB user) and was very flexible regarding schedule.

Way before our travel she helped us with travels information, weather and now to avoid possible problems with taxis.

They are the kind of people that make AirBnB worth it. AirBnB should be proud to have Flor as a customer.

Florencia and her husband were very, very friendly and helpful. They helped us with the airport shuttle, gave us lots of tips for spending time in the city and even made the room ready for us before actual check in time. The room itself is perfectly fine, fully equipped and very clean. Thank you! Definitely a recommendation!

We loved our stay at Florencia's apartment, it was absolutely perfect for two people. The location is good, within easy walking distance to some sights but very close to a subway station for others. It was great to be left a subway card to use! We were able to check in a bit early which was great as we'd come from a long flight. Florencia and her husband were lovely and helpful. We were also able to leave our bags at their apartment after we'd checked out which was great and we were able to use their wifi to order an uber! We thoroughly enjoyed staying in this apartment and would recommend it to anyone visiting Buenos Aires

Flor was fantastic! She readily communicated with us, and did so much to accommodate us! She let us put our bags in the apartment before our check-in, and took the time to explain everything in the apartment. She also spent several minutes going over a city map, and gave us several ideas of what to see, where to go, and what to eat. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and quiet. We had everything we needed! Flor also offered to help us with restaurant reservations and car reservations (for the airport). I can only think Flor must love her city and helping others from how kind and gracious she was!

The apartment is located centrally and it is secure. The size was just nice for a couple and it was clean. Flor and her husband are wonderful hosts who were very helpful in providing us with lots of advice and recommendations.

Our overall experience staying here was great. Florencia sent advice for us prior to arrival and was extremely helpful with any questions we had. Her husband welcomed us when we arrived and the apartment was exactly as we hoped.
Great location with only a short walk to convenience stores, restaurants and the metro.
Florencia was lovely and even printed out tickets for us and personally delivered on a Sunday when all Internet cafes were closed. We were extremely grateful.
We would highly recommend this apartment as we enjoyed our stay very much.

A great apartment, central to transport and walkable to lots of the main sights! Florencia and her husband were amazing hosts, super friendly and helpful and always quick to respond to questions. We would definitely return!
Flor y su esposo fueron excelentes personas con nosotros. El departamento está muy bien ubicado, limpio y con todo lo necesario para unas vacaciones!
Florencia and her husband Demian were both incredibly gracious hosts - flexible with arrival and departure and really great at communicating. Their apartment is in a great spot close to the subte.
Florencia and her husband were great hosts. The apartment was nice, clean and a really close by to public transportation. I would definitely book this apartment again.

Florencia and Damien are excellent hosts! They were really kind and waited for us when we checked in past midnight, and gave a tour of the property, places to see in the city and sent us a list of recommended cafes and restaurants. They even accommodated a late check out.

As for the property itself, it was clean and neat. The apartment was very safe and located in a safe neighborhood. It's a few blocks from Santa Fe and the metro is accessible within a 5 min walk.

I couldn't have asked for more; everything was perfect. Communication was excellent - made it very easy for us.

Lovely apartment in a great location!

Florencia and her husband were very helpful with many local tips.

Excellent price for the stay, even during Christmas.

Para comenzar, debo manifestar mi gratitud a Florencia y familia, por su excelente y afectuoso trato que tuvo con mi familia y su excelente atención y hospitalidad como anfitriona. Sin duda alguna, es una super host. Su apartamento es completamente maravilloso y ajustado a lo que se ofrece, es decir, es completamente real y veraz lo ofrecido. Quien desee alojarse en Buenos Aires, contará con un apartamento seguro, limpio tranquilo y cerca a todo, con un vecindario muy tranquilo. Florencia y su esposo, les brindarán las mejores indicaciones para movilizarse en la ciudad y sus alrededores. Mi esposa y yo, recomendamos en un 100% la estadía con Florencia. Para ser nuestra primera vez en Airbnb, nos satisfizo en plenitud el servicio. Recomendaré a todos mi conocidos y familia, el hospedaje donde Florencia y su lindo apartamento. Nuevamente, gracias por todo Flor.

Sin duda alguna, con Florencia encontrarán un excelente hospedaje en la cuidad de Buenos Aires.

Un lugar seguro, limpio, cómodo y tranquilo, para disfrutar de esta maravillosa cuidad.

Agradecemos por el grandioso trato que nos brindó Flor y su familia.

Recomendado en un 100%.
We enjoyed our stay! Florencia was a great host and we would recommend her place to anyone staying in Buenos Aires!
Florencia y Damián son excelentes anfitriones y el alojamiento acogedor .

Florencia's place has all travelers' needs. The apartment was well secured and very clean. Hot bath, equipped kitchen, small details like city guide books and SUBE card! They even prepared us some pound cake for our breakfast:) Florencia was so helpful with local restaurants information and did promptly replied to my questions. Recommended!:)

Fue mi primera experiencia con Airbnb. Tengo que decir que todo estuve perfecto! El departamento está en el barrio tranquilo y seguro. Flor y Damian son muy agradables. Me recibieron muy bien, dieron la mapa y la carte de Subte, explicaron todas las cosas muy importantes. La habitación es muy limpia, tiene aire acondicionado y todo lo que necesitas. Muchísimas gracias a Flor y Damian otra vez! :)
Great place close to all.  Apple TV  is great when you just want to chill
Florencia and her husband were very helpful and hospitable!
Recomended

Fantastically priced and located apartment! Great central location.

Kitchen is better equipped than most Airbnb kitchens - we even made a lasagna one night, and Wifi is fast and reliable.

Aircon works great, and helped us stay sane during a heatwave.

Definitely planning to stay here again next time we come to Buenos Aires!!

The apartment was compact but that was all we needed as we were out most of the time. It was in a great location - a short walk from one of the main streets and subway.

Florencia was exceptionally helpful both before we arrived and when we were in Buenos Aires. This included information we needed to know and help with booking things. She was also very quick to respond and easy to get hold of and we would very much recommend her to others

O apartamento de Flor é perfeito para uma estadia de casal. Meu namorado e eu nos hospedamos nele para uma semana adorável em Buenos Aires. Fomos muito bem recebidos, o espaço estava muito limpo e organizado, com vários cuidados à nossa espera: água, bolinhos, chá e café, coisinhas de banho, etc. Ganhamos um mapa com diversas sinalizações customizadas por Flor e seu esposo, além de eles nos darem explicações muito úteis sobre transporte, atrações, mercados, etc.
Também nos deixaram um cartão do sistema de tansporte integrado da cidade, que nos facilitou vários passeios. Nossos anfitriões nos deram uma lista dos seus restaurantes favoritos na cidade, dos quais experimentamos uns cinco e adoramos. Enfim, mais do que alugar um excelente apartamento, tivemos uma excelente experiência de viagem graças à hospitalidade incrível de Flor. Com certeza voltaremos a procurá-los em nossa próxima vinda a Buenos Aires e recomendamos fortemente!

Estive em março no apartamento de Flor e posso afirmar que foi uma experiência incrível. Era como se morássemos em Buenos Aires.

O apartamento é como nas fotos e na medida certa para um casal.
A vizinhança é muito gentil e atenciosa.
A Flor nos disponibilizou o cartão do Subte e um mapa da cidade e isso foi ótimo, pois andamos por toda cidade e tivemos experiências inesquecíveis.
Além de toda atenção, a Flor é uma excelente anfitriã.

Com certeza voltarei mais vezes e indicarei para família e amigos.

Our favourite airbnb stay during our big South America trip! Flor and Demian's apartment was perfect! Felt like a second home - clean and cozy, and close to everywhere we wanted to go in Buenos Aires. Super safe area, and was easily for us to find lots of good vegan food nearby. Their communication was wonderful, since the moment of booking with Flor. And when we arrived, Demian gave us a great intro to the apartment and surroundings. Highly recommend!!

Florencia's apartment is exactly as described. It was very comfortable and was the perfect home away from home. The kitchen was fully stocked although we used it only for breakfast. The location was perfect with less than 25 minute walk to the Recoleta Cultural Center and cemetery. It was also close to Palmero and had excellent access to the subway. Flor and her husband are also very responsive and helpful with any questions you may have. I would recommend staying here while traveling in BA. Next time we come, we will be staying here! :)

One of the best experiences I've ever had in Airbnb!

The pictures of the apartment are quite accurate to itself!
Quite beautiful and very functional!

Exceptional location!
Around 20 minutes to the principal points of the city, very easy to access by public/private transportation.

And the best part was the caring and attention of Demian and Flor for all our needs! We can't thank you enough!

Certainly, the best call in B'A's!

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here. Flor was very accommodating and made sure to cross all her T's and to dot all her I's. she even sent me updates regarding things to do during the week. When I arrived to the place, it smelled of a freshly cleaned apartment. She even managed to have different plug converters if you're coming from another country. The access to the subway, restaurants, and other attractions are very easy.  I would 100% recommend staying here.

Florencia is a really impressive host, she helps you with everything she can. The apartment is in a good area and you feel like home.
If we come again to Buenos Aires we will definitely stay here another time.

O apartamento é exatamente como descrito. O local é muito bom, próximo de várias atrações, cafés, restaurantes, supermercados, farmácias.
Florência e seu marido foram muito gentis e prestativos.
Todo excelente! Se preocuparon por todos los detalles! Sin duda regresariamos!

O espaço é totalmente fiel as fotos e descrição.
É um lugar aconchegante, limpo, bem arrumado... muito gostoso mesmo!
O chuveiro é super quentinho e como pegamos dias frios, isso deixou nossa estadia mais confortável.
Eu entendo que o ideal seja apenas para um casal.
Para quem tem o sono leve, o barulho do elevador por vir a incomodar um pouco, mas não foi nenhum problema!
Pegamos inclusive um dia de chuva e ficamos no apartamento, o netflix nos salvou...rsrs
A localização é ótima, tudo o que fizemos usamos transporte público que era de muito fácil acesso. A noite é tranquilo para andar no bairro, tem muitos mercadinhos perto, lugares para desayunos, algumas boas opções de restaurantes e lojas. Tudo o que precisamos encontramos muito facilmente.
Mas eu acho que além de tudo, o que mais se destaca são os anfitriões... Eles são MUITO solícitos, simpáticos, muito fácil lidar com eles. Desde as trocas de mensagens iniciais com a Flor, sempre disposta a atender a qualquer dúvida e ajudar no planejamento da viagem, até a recepção do Demian, com todas as dicas de como ir e vir dos lugares, os lugares que deveríamos conhecer, a paciência em explicar mais de uma vez a mesma coisa.. rsrs
Tenho certeza que o que fez com que nossa experiência tenha se tornado melhor, foi a boa vontade e simpatia dos dois.
Eu gostaria que eles tivessem uma casa em cada lugar que desejo conhecer...hahaha
Eu amei minha experiência!

This place is a gem! Exactly as described and very central, which is touch in BA since it's such a sprawling city. Close to supermarkets and shopping and a Starbucks right around the corner. Flor and her family were fantastic to communicate with and made everything so easy. It was nice knowing that they were easily reachable via whatsapp just in case I needed anything. They made great suggestions for restaurants and things to do. What a lovely family! One of my best Airbnb stays!

Todo fue exactamente como descrito, recomiendo este departamento. Excelente ubicación, limpieza, y atenciones que nos dieron. El departamento cuanta con muchos detalles que harán la estancia mucho más agradable.

Passamos 5 dias no apto da Flor, que por sinal foi muito atenciosa e prestativa , o apto é bem confortável é bem equipado! Sua localização é ótima, próximo a varias estações de metrô, cafeterias , restaurantes .. super recomendo! Obrigado a Flor e ao seu marido pela excelente recepção !!

Good apartment in a good location close to recoleta, downtown and not too far from palermo...Everything was clean and new.....
The host was waiting on time....an excellent experience...

It was one of the best trips of my life with my 5 friends. Booking the apartment with Isabel was so easy, she responded very quickly to all our messages and gave us tips since it was not only our first time booking throe AirBNB but also first time in Buenos Aires. Isabel was able to arrange early check in and late check out. Apartment was clean and cozy. Not very high standard but we were basically spending nights there. Even the windows were coming out on the street side we did not hear much of the noise. Great place for those who do not like to waist time and see the most of Buenos Aires, apartment is in the heart of the city. Taxi rides are cheep, wherever we went we did not pay more than 25 pesos (6 dollars). There are many food stores, banks and coffee shops around, walking distance. Since there is many people leaving in the building noise rules are tough so no parties in the apartment or loud music, but you can find plenty of those in the clubs all over Buenos Aires so even for party animals - great and affordable place to stay after parting hard all night. And it really is all night, do not go out at 11 pm, people start coming to the club at 1 am and leave when sun comes up. We had two set of keys so there was never a problem splitting the group during the day. Price is good for the standard. I would strongly recommend this apartment
Excelente el departamento, muy cómodo, limpio, moderno, muy bien ubicado. Nos recibieron muy amablemente hasta con alfajores, te y café. Volvería a ir al mismo lugar. Lo recomiendo 100%.
Isabel desde un comienzo fue cordial y muy responsable. Una experiencia grata y 100 % recomendable. Fue un gusto. Saludos desde Santiago de Chile. Claudia.-

Fernanda e Isabel son unos anfitriones estupendos! El apartamento es excelente en la estructura y organización, y cerca de todo lo bueno que hay en Buenos Aires! Animamos a todos los que quieran pasar unos días en esta hermosa ciudad! Todavía tenemos un muy buen soporte Heriberto que siempre está en el edificio y es muy amable y servicial!

A group of six of us needed a place to stay in BA for an academic conference, and we found this place. The location was perfect for us, just a few blocks from the conference, and close to a lot of other attractions as well. The place is clean and well-kept, with a friendly doorman to let us in and out. It's nothing fancy, but it was comfortable for a week-long stay.

Isabel was very good at keeping in touch and making sure that everything was OK. She was also flexible about our dates, even letting a few of us add on an extra day when travel plans changed. Overall we definitely enjoyed our experience here.

We had a great time on Isabel’s apartment. It’s located a block from the subway station Callao and near good restaurants, supermarkets, coffee shops etc. Isabel was very responsive by e-mail and the host Fernanda friendly and helpful. I highly recommended if you are going to B.A. with 4+ people and want to stay in downtown.

Isabel e Fernanda muito atenciosas. O apartamento é exatamente como o combinado. Organizado, limpo e de fácil acesso para qualquer lugar de Buenos Aires. Muitas opções de lazer e alimentação muito perto. Sem contar no metrô que é praticamente do lado do apartamento. Super recomendo.

Isabel e Fernanda são muito atenciosas. Tudo ocorreu dentro do combinado. Cumpriram rigorosamente os horários de entrega e devolução das chaves. Durante o processo Isabel respondeu prontamente aos nossos emails. Fomos em 6 pessoas ( família) gostamos do ambiente do prédio ( bem familiar). O zelador e a esposa foram  muito atenciosos conosco. A localização é excelente pois é possível caminhar para a maior parte dos pontos de interesse. Não tivemos problemas com as instalações do apartamento.

Isabel's apartment is clean, cozy, and in a great location - we were very happy with it. Isabel was also incredibly helpful and she made the entire process very easy. I definitely recommend this apartment!

We had a very nice stay at Isabel' place. Her friend Fernanda welcomed us when we arrived very late, Isabel & Fernanda were very helpful.
The apartment was cosy, clean, comfortable & convenient. Everything was perfect!

O local é perfeito! Próximo a ótimos bares, restaurantes, sorveterias, fácil de acessar o transporte público... e o apartamento de Grisel é excelente!!!

The place is near a bakery/restaurant called "la continental" wich you can have breakfest or grab a pizza at night. It is also near café san juan and other nice places. Its near puerto madero and plaza de mayo! The apartment is exactly like the photos. Very clean and comfy

Amazing, everything was like i hope it would be.
The house was clean and very well decorated.
The location its perfect, the neighborhood full of life but not noisy.
Juan, was already waiting to welcome us, he was very professional and explained all the details.
Easy Check-in and check-out.
I would recommended to everyone without hesitation.
Thanks Grisel and Juan for recieve us and allow us to have this amazing experience in the beautiful city of Buenos Aires.

Grisel was very helpful with our check-in and check-out times. The place is very clean and is just like the pictures but better! Really enjoyed staying there and the location is perfect. There is a nice market on Sunday's and we got a very nice view of it from the balcony.

Despite a welcome which was cold because of a delay of (only) 15min (the arrival was planned between 4 and 4.30 pm, we arrived at 4.45...oups) of ourself (with no internet connection it was difficult to aware the host), the flat is very nice: cosy and spacious, the emplacement will let you discover BA without any issues. Perfect for two couples.
I definitively recommend this flat!!!
Es un departamento amplio y cómodo, muy bien equipado. Ubicado en el corazón de San Telmo desde donde se camina buena parte del casco histórico de la ciudad. La anfitriona atenta y amable.

This was our second stay at Grisel's fantastic apartment, which has now become our home away from home. Grisel is the most organised and efficient host, she made us feel so welcome and even greeted us with little medialunas upon arrival. Such a lovely thought after a long journey. We come to Buenos Aires for a year for a work trip and we would never look any further than Grisel's home. If you are looking for an authentic Argentine experience then this is the place for you. Thank you for a wonderful stay. We will see you next year!
Ps. Don't forget to stand on the balcony on Sunday morning and watch the market traders setting up, it's a magical sight.

Grisel's apartment is well-located in beautiful San Telmo. She was very prompt and helpful with recommendations about what to check out in Buenos Aires. Her apartment is comfortable and stylishly decorated. We really enjoyed our stay there and highly recommend it!
Great apartment with AC! Very convenient location. Very clean. Location was safe as well! Thank you, Isabel!

Isabel is a great host, she responded to our request right away (we were kind of last minute) and was available in no time. She's very nice and smiling. She was really helpfull for everything. The apartment is well located (2 minute walk from the closest subway station, grocery, café and mini supermarket near the building). We stayed 4 nights at 4 people and everything was ok.

Isabel est une excellente hôte, elle nous a répondu très rapidement (nous étions un peu à la der pour notre réservation) et a été disponible de suite. C'est une personne très aimable et souriante, elle nous a accueilli parfaitement. L'appartement est très bien situé (2 minutes à pied de la station de métro la plus proche. Estivemos na apartamento da Isabel durante quatro dias. Não tivemos problemas. Consideramos a localização boa. Como gostamos de caminhar, fomos para vários pontos da cidade caminhando. Isabel é uma pessoa prestativa e o apt está super bem localizado, a descrição do anfitrião correspondeu a expectativa!

Tivemos uma ótima experiência. Fomos bem recebidos e o apartamento estava limpo, contando com toalhas de banho e rosto e cobertores.
O bairro é tranquilo e bem servido, muitos comércios próximos, estação do metrô. É bem localizada.
Os aquecedores funcionaram corretamente e água sempre estava boa.
Recomendo esse apartamento. Acomoda muito bem cinco pessoas.

Realmente fue una muy grata experiencia. El Aviso es exactamente lo que se vio en el departamento, muy cómodo, luminoso. La ubicación es muy buena, las instalaciones son optimas para una buena estadía en el lugar. La atención de Isabel es excelente, en todo momento se preocupo porque nuestra estadía fuera como ella lo platea en el objetivo de su anuncio. En el departamento esta toda la información de lo que uno puede adquirir en la zona para una buena estadía. La locomoción en ese lugar es muy buena.

El apartamento es precioso y tiene una localización perfecta, en una de las esquinas más notables de San Telmo. La comunicación con Grisel fue muy ágil y nos mandó una guía con info muy útil para la llegada y la estancia. Lo recomendaría sin dudarlo!

Our Host Grisel was very responsive during our booking phase, and met us upon arrival at her wonderful place.  She filled us in on many local restaurants, shops, and transportation tips.  The apartment is clean, with modern amenities, but in a vintage building giving you that "old world feel".  We loved exploring the neighborhood, and venturing out to see the rest of Buenos Aires.  I would highly recommend her place and stay here again.

Great accommodation for 3 people - clean and tidy. Good value for money. Good location close to all bars and restaurants but be aware that it will be noisy!! You can’t have it all....

If I was to be picky a couple of things could be improve:
> not enough kitchen cooking ustensiles and pantry stock
> average bed matressss and pillows

Overall a good stay! No issue at all and good communication with Grisel.

Everything about this place was exactly as expected. We even got to experience the very popular San Telmo Féria (outdoor market). The unit is right in the center of it all and walking distance to everything -- shopping, grocery, coffee shops, and more. Grisel was an excellent host and had mapped out everything we needed in a fantastic "visitors book" with tons of recommendations. I can't speak more highly about Grisel and her unit. We loved it!
Absolutely perfect location. A bottle of wine, some cheese and a porch is all you need :)

Fantastic location!! San Telmo is definitely the place to be in BA and the apartment is right in the heart of it. Great on a Sunday to just sit on the balcony with a wine and watch the markets below. Grisel was a wonderful and help host highly recommend staying here we will be back for sure
Everything was perfect. A really excellent location and nice apartment!
Perfect Location in beautiful San Telmo! Spacious and wonderfully decorated apartment!
The apartment was great and the location was wonderful. Grisel was very helpful and this place is perfect for your stay in Buenos Aires!
Great location, host is very thoughtful with lots of tips, very flexible as well

Grisel was always very quick to respond both before and during our stay.  The apartment was nice and we loved the location. Easy access to public transportation so we could visit many areas of Buenos Aires but right in the heart of such a historic area!
Beautiful apartment in a great location!! We felt at home! Lots of shops and restaurants nearby. Easy to get transportation and felt like a safe neighborhood!
Stylish apartment in an excellent location. We were drawn by the photos but the apartment was even better. Grisel was a highly organised and responsive host. Highly recommended.

Grisel was helpful from the very beginning and one of the nicest perks was that she arranged for a driver to pick us up from the airport.
My friend and I came to Buenos Aires for facelifts- in shopping for an Airbnb, my main priority was finding a place that would be a comfortable and stylist place to stay in pretty much full time for 12 days post surgery.
I made the right choice with this darling apartment. There are several small markets with fresh produce just within blocks. Also, a laundry place, pastry shops, and one amazing restaurant after another- all right outside our front door.
It was winter in Argentina and the first night after our surgeries we were both very cold (it didn’t help that we were both a bit weak)- and Grisel brought over space heaters for us.
We had everything we needed.
On Sunday morning, all you have to do is ride the elevator down and step out the front door and you are right in the heart of the famous San Telmo market.
I can highly recommend this charming Airbnb. Carol
The best place we have stayed in San Telmo. Grisel is a great host who helped us feel settled and cared for. Best location and vibe in this thriving neighbourhood. We will definitely be back.
Isabel was very quick to respond and very helpful. Her apartment is in a great central location and we were able to walk and take the subway everywhere. We felt safe and secure.

Resultó tal cual lo ofrecido. Las fotos corresponden fielmente a lo que recibes. El departamento es luminoso y cómodo, el edificio tranquilo y el recibimiento y entrega de llaves muy agradable. No tuvimos inconveniente alguno, Isabel siempre estuvo disponible pero no lo necesitamos. La ubicación fantástica, caminado llegas a muchos lugares de interes como teatros, librerías, bares y la locomoción buenisima!
Para nosotros fue un lindo paseo a Buenos Aires, con base en el departamento de Isabel.

Isabel's apartment caught my eye when I was looking for lodging in Buenos Aires for 4 people. Her friendliness and responsiveness blew me away and I was sold. My friends and I did not have one bad experience while in her apartment. The apartment was extremely clean, centrally located, and fit 4 people comfortably. iIsabel was a wealth a valuable information and she made the whole experience easy even!

The next time I make a trip to Buenos Aires I will contact Isabel.

Cheers,
Cooper

Great 2 bedroomapartment in a great neighborhood in BA, Almagro.  The building is safe and extra security as the police station is close by.  We had 5 guys in our group and we were very comfortable.  Isabel had her cousin meet us to give the keys,  he was cordial and prompt. The apartment has good air conditioning,  comfy beds, strong shower, well equipped kitchen.   I can't say anything bad about my experience with Isabel or the apartment.  When in BA this will be my goto place.

Our host waited at the apartment upon arrival patiently despite our delay. She also responded to a water heater problem quite quickly despite it being the christmas season. Toilet was a little cramp but overall, the house was kept neat and clean. The apartment fits the description mentioned.
La casa è semplice, ma funzionale. Il feedback è positivo. Abbiamo avuto solo qualche problema con la caldaia e la lavatrice.

Isabel una anfitriona muy amable y cumplida. En general el apartamento estaba bien.
Bien ubicado

Recepção e check out tranquilos. Apartamento bem localizado, limpo, com camas confortáveis, roupas de cama e toalhas, chuveiro com água aquecida a gás, cozinha com geladeira e fogão. Foi ótimo para minha família. As crianças amaram!
O apartamento era perfeito exatamente como na descrição. A localização é fantástica, bem perto de tudo facilitanto muito a locomoção.

Fue una grata experiencia, es la primera vez que hago uso del sistema y me ha parecido muy bueno. No tuvimos lo oportunidad de conocer personalmente a Isabel, a pesar de ello fue muy agradable la comunicación con ella. Y tuvimos una rápida respuesta cuando la necesitamos. El departamento es exactamente como se ve en las fotos, es muy bonito y acogedor, nos sentimos como en casa.
Excelente experiencia! Flor y su marido super atentos! El dpto. muy bien ubicado, super limpio. Muy bien equipado y cómodo. Más que recomendable! Volveremos!

Uma experiência adorável! Flor e seu esposo são excelentes anfitriões. Eles pensam em tudo, cada detalhe, procuram manter uma boa comunicação com recomendações importantes. São alegres, carinhosos e acolhedores. O apartamento tem cheirinho de casa limpa e uma atmosfera muito agradável. A janela fica na lateral do edifício e tem uma ótima luminosidade solar, cozinha funcional, bom ar-condicionado, wi-fi funcionando rápido e perfeitamente, chuveiro com aquecimento ótimo, cama casal e TV com Netflix pronta para o uso. Fica numa localização excelente, bem perto de mercados, restaurantes, bares, centros culturais e metrô. Nós fomos muito felizes ao escolher este local para nossas férias. Voltaremos, com certeza.
Great location, central to everything, a true Airbnb experience. Clean, complete, good internet and prompt communication. Also great tips, we used a few and they were all great.
Perfect :)

Un departamento en excelentes condiciones, muy cómodo y con muy buena Ubicación. Ha sido uno de los mejores departamentos en los que me quedé durante mi estancia en Buenos Aires. 100% recomendado. Los anfitriones son muy amables y atentos.

Flor's place was perfect for my stay in BA! Exactly as pictured and in an amazing neighborhood - waking distance from many of the things I wanted to visit. Her and her husband were so generous/kind with regards to recommendations for restaurants etc. and answering all of my (many) questions. They also offered to store my bags so I could explore the city before my flight on the last day. Would definitely stay here again!

Florencia's place was clean, immaculate, and very central to many of BA's cool sites. Flor made sure we had everything we needed, right down to the littlest detail. The people in the building are quite friendly too. One of her neighbours even offered me a mate on a cold chilly morning. I wholeheartedly recommend Flor's place; not just for its location and cleanliness, but for the experience of meeting nice people like Flor and her husband.

Flor's place is exactly like advertised.  Everything was clean and tidy and the bed was very comfortable.  Flor went out of her way to help with our check in which did not go as expected due to air travel issues.

Flor's place is lovely and close to the metro station. It's in Recoleta which is quite a lovely area.
The communication was great and the check-in very thorough.

When I left I had a late flight and they could store my bag for me and called a taxi to the airport so I could make the most of my time in Buenos Aires.

Recommended.

La estadía buenísima y el depto impecable.. Tal cual se ve en las fotos.. la limpieza, el equipamiento del depto y la buena onda de los dueños son las cosas que destaco de mi experiencia en este lugar!
I can definitely recommend Grisels Place. Great apartment, great communication. Very easy and convenient. Thanks Grisel!
Grisel’s place was great! Location was amazing and very cute, chic, apartment. She was very helpful with recommendations and tips and also flexible with Check-in and Check-out!

Súper bien recibidos en hora y de acuerdo a lo combinado. Apartamento súper confortable y limpio. Poderia mejorar las toallas de baño y los almohadones. Pero esta todo muy correcto de acuerdo a las fotos. Gracias por todo!!!
Stylish (shabby chic) apartment in great and lively location!

Nel cuore di San Telmo, appartamento stupendo con due terrazze sulla piazza centrale.
Meraviglioso prenderla la domenica per vivere il mercatino di San Telmo anche dall’alto.
Appartamento pulito con due camere e due bagni OTTIMO per 4 persone. Grazie ancora Grisel

Beautiful apartment in a perfect location! Elevator was nice when we were carrying big suitcases (or exhausted from walking lots!) Close to great places to eat, shop and just wander as Buenos Aires is a great city to walk. Grisel was super helpful and arranged for a driver to take us to and from the airport, and she met us when we arrived . Overall we loved our stay and highly recommend San Telmo and Grisel’s place.

Grisel's apartment is excellent and true value for money.

The location is unbeatable, right on Defensa and close by many excellent bars, restaurants, cafes and markets.

Prior to check-in we received detailed information about the apartment, the area & Buenos Aires in general. This was extremely informative to the point of advising how to spot counterfeit notes etc.

Check in was personalised and flexible with timing, on arrival Grisel met us and explained all about the apartment and the area.

The apartment is very charming and decorated nicely with great art and objet.

We would highly recommend Grisel's apartment and will re-book when we return to BA.

Thanks

Very well located and comfortable apartment. We spent 5 days there and everything worked perfectly ok except by the hot water. Grisel was very communicative and gave us alternatives where to have a hot shower. Moreover she actually did a refund of part of the payment, so we appreciated that gesture.
We hope they can fix the problem, because the apt is perfect to enjoy san telmo and buenos aires.

We stayed three nights at Grisel’s flat in San Telmo and it was a great place to call home during our trip to Buenos Aires. The  bedrooms were spacious as were the common areas. The building is safe and secure, and the location is conveniently walkable to many attractions.

We loved this apartment. Grisel greeted us at the apartment, showed us around  and gave us an overview of San Telmo. She provided wonderful recommendations around the city. The apartment is just as advertised. It's in a very cute French style building steps away from the Sunday San Telmo Street fair, which was incredibly lively and fun! The beds were comfortable and the apartment was perfect. We departed for our flight early in the morning only to find out the flight was cancelled with no reschedule once we arrived at the airport. Grisel graciously allowed us to hang out at the apartment for the rest of the day until our flight was rescheduled (14 hours later). Without her, we would have either been stranded at the airport or carrying around 17 days worth of luggage. Thank you so much Grisel for the amazing hospitality!!
The apartment is amazing, very charming decoration, bright, with 2 French balcony. The location is great. Grisel is a wonderful host. Highly recommended

Grisel's place is great - it is in the heart of San Telmo with great restaurants and cafes on your doorstep; make sure you check out the San Telmo food market which is a five minute walk from the apartment.  Grisel was very responsive to our questions, arranged travel from the airport for us and provided us with great recommendations for restaurants.  The apartment was lovely and very cosy.

Lovely apartment! Great location... safe and secure. On the street of the Sunday market which is great don’t let that put you off. Fab location felt safe. Apartment was lovely. The beds were really comfy. Host was lovely too.

This is such a great apartment with 2 comfortable bedrooms and 2 bathrooms and all the facilities you could need (laundry is just down the road). The apartment is in a great position with good walking to most sites. Take up the offer of having a driver pick you up from the airport if you are flying in.

A wonderful place - large and classic, with stylish decor - in a fantastic neighborhood where you hear tango lessons in the evening and have your choice of great restaurants, cafes, and bars all day and evening long. Well worth the cost, and Grisel was a great host. We had everything we needed and felt at home. Can’t wait to go back!
Grisel’s apartment is comfortable, spacious and a great location in the heart of San Telmo. She is quick to respond, professional, and informative. We didn’t want to leave!

The Gallery is really in an ideal spot for exploring San Telmo which must rate as BsAs's coolest neighbourhood - bohemian and a bit scruffy, not fully dolled up but on its way. Lots to see and a host of excellent bars, restaurants and cafés to visit. Perfect for the market on Sundays too and 30 minute walk to Recoleta. We found the apartment clean, comfortable with high ceilings and walls decorated with wonderful art works. Grisel's recommendation were perfect - where to go, what to consider doing, how to get there. Had a great time... heading back soon !

Grisel’s place made our stay in Buenos Aires very memorable and special. It was such a treat to stay in her massive apartment with wonderful views of Defensa from the two balconies. My family really loved our stay.

Everything was just as pictured! The apartment is conveniently located (plenty of cabs available right downstairs, several supermarkets within a two-block radius, and just a short walk to San Telmo Market). Grisel was there to meet us when we checked in and had somebody call us a cab and help us out on our way home.

A super friendly host , on the best location in town. A spacious place, clean and full with art. When you book here you'll get a great up-to-date guide with useful tips and advice. Highly recommended!

La localización del departamento es buenísima. Es una zona segura. Tal como lo ves en las fotos, es el departamento. Es espacioso y cómodo.

Location is great. Is a safe area. It’s a spacious department and very comfortable. Its as beauty as seen on photos.
Awesome place! Awesome host!

L'appartement est top et surtout extrêmement bien placé. Au pied de celui ci vous croiserez la fameuse Mafalda sur son banc ! Dans le cartier san telmo pleins de restos et bars. Nous avons adoré ce quartier. Aussi le guide qui liste les restos, bars, attractions fourni par Grisel est topissime.

Great location in San Telmo, close to all the bars, market etc. The apartment is huge and well suited to two couples and has two bathrooms - a real bonus. We felt safe walking around the area and Grisel met us on arrival, giving us some local tips on where to go etc - loved the tango lesson and milonga around the corner. Would definitely stay again!
Beautiful rooms. Great location

Great space in a fantastic San Telmo location. Large rooms and comfortable beds , on top of a central San Telmo location, makes this a great rental. Checking in and out with Grisel was professional and easy. We traveled from NYC with our two young children, and Grisel was patient with us as we checked in and out (which could have been very difficult with all of our luggage.) Our family appreciated this great stay. Thank you!

A localização facilitou o acesso a lojas, restaurantes, pontos turísticos e também na hora de pegar táxi, ônibus e metrô. Recomendo a todos o apartamento da Defensa 681. Além disso, as acomodações são agradáveis.
The apartment is lovely and Grisel is a good hostess.  Very thoughtful and considerate.  Highly recommend!

A must stay in San Telmo and a great location! Easy walk to  Puerto Madero, Plaza Dorrego, and Plaza de Mayo. Close to amenities (grocery store, kiosk, pizza, and Glück cervecería!, buses). Because the apartment is on a busy street, walking felt safe. Grisel was a super host!!

A pleasure staying at the apartment. It was centrally located so that I could either walk, Uber, or use public transportation. Florencia was responsive and always had great suggestions. My stay was a joy.
El departamento se encuentra muy bien ubicado y es tal cual las fotos. Muy prolijo y limpio.

A great apartment - very well equipped and light and bright. Good location. We could walk to all neighborhoods easily! Great communication with Flo and Demian. Would highly recommend!
