I have read all the other reviews and I can't match the reviews with the apartment my family stayed in.
The main issues we had were cleanliness, poor functioning shower, and non-functional washing machine.
When we arrived the flat was covered in black street dust. This covered the tables, kitchen surfaces, floor and seats. Within a few steps our feet were black and we had to wash our children's feet (after they had showered) and carry them to their beds. After we cleaned for over two hours the place was better. I understand that a flat overlooking the street will get dirty, but the level of dirt was like it had not been cleaned or lived in for weeks.
Isabel did offer to send the cleaner again, but as we had spent our time cleaning it seemed little point.
Generally the whole place was shabby and needed a thorough clean. The kitchen was also dirty with cockroaches and cobwebs in the cupboards. Cockroaches are not unexpected but on top of the general uncleanliness of the place, this just added to the cleaning we had to do (we washed all dishes and cutlery). During our stay the building was sprayed for cockroaches (we were not advised of this). The pans in the kitchen were damaged with the powder coat flaking off inside.
The shower head was broken so just produced a hose jet. The water however was hot and constant.
The inclusion of a washing machine was one of the reasons we choose this apartment and it was non-functional. It was old and had rust inside. When we did a test run with a towel it failed to run twice, and on the third try it leaked water all over the floor. The towel was soaked and no cleaner than before. We had to pay a significant amount of money to have our clothes laundered (we are a family of 4).
On the plus side, the flat is as the pictures, although now tatty. The air-conditioning worked well, good hot water, good location near to shops, bus routes, and metro. A good 15 minute walk to the obelisk.
We had 8 nights in this flat and it was the worst accommodation we have stayed in our 1.5 month stay in Chile and Argentina. I expect it is likely you could find better places for the same cost. Overall the place was ok, once clean, but not recommended.

The house was well located close to the subway, busstops, restaurants, etc. The house looks just like the pictures and Isabel was a great host and easy to contact and ready to help. And there were a lot of unwelcome bugs, we found cockroaches in the kitchen and bathroom. The washing machine didn't work either and would leak water when you put it to work. And the pans in the kitchen were scratched and damaged. Besides all this the air-conditioning did work wel and there was hot water. If there could come a change in the cleanliness and some investment in new pots and pans and a washing machine it would be a good stay.

Das Bad war allgemein sehr schmutzig, der Vorhang dreckig und nicht gut befestigt. Die Tür zum Bad ging nicht zu schließen und war unten verschimmelt. Die Toilettenbürste war so dreckig, dass sie nicht zu gebrauchen war. Das Waschbecken und die Dichtungen/Rand waren ebenfalls verschimmelt (siehe meine Bilder).

Kleiderschrankschienen und Fenster im Schlafzimmer ebenfalls sehr schmutzig. Wolldecken für kalte Tage sehr sehr schmutzig und daher nicht zu gebrauchen.

Ein vorhandene Sessel war ebenfalls nicht zu gebrauchen, dass sofort Staub in alle Richtungen austrat, sobald man sich setze.

Das andere Schlafzimmer war leider nicht wie angegeben durch eine Klimaanlage zu kühlen. Rechte Seite des Kleiderschranks (siehe Bild) war nicht zu gebrauchen. Offene Steckdosen waren ebenfalls sehr dreckig und auch ein Sicherheitsrisiko.

Wohnzimmerfenster war verschlossen und somit eine Lüftung des Zimmers nicht möglich. Sofas waren ebenfalls sehr sehr schmutzig. Telefon war auch sehr sehr siffig.

Kaffeemaschine war auch nicht funktionsfähig. Die Inhaberin teilte mir gleich bei EInzug mit, dass die Waschmaschine nicht funktioniert. Somit war es nicht möglich, diverse Sachen, die dreckig vorgefunden wurden, zu waschen. Zum Beispiel die Bettwäsche mussten wir 3 Wochen lang nutzen, ohne sie waschen zu können. Leider gab es auch keine Ersatzbettwäsche oder ähnliches. Handtücher waren ebenfalls mangelware und diese damit natürlich auch nicht waschbar.

Allgemein befindet sich die Wohnung in einem nicht vermietbaren Zustand. Das Geschirr ist aus Plastik, auch die Gläser und beispielsweise 2 Suppenlöffel für 6 Personen anzubieten ist eine Frechheit.

El departamento es igual que en las fotografías, es amplio y sin problema alojamos 5 personas. Es bastante luminoso, el ruido de la calle apenas se siente. La ubicación es genial. Hay televisión por cable y Smart tv en el living y dormitorio principal, en el dormitorio secundario hay un televisor común y un dvd. Las camas son cómodas. Se nos proporcionaron toallas limpias. Hay aire acondicionado y funciona sin problemas.
La atención por parte del conserje es destacable.

Ahora, cómo punto negativo está la limpieza. A pesar de que se cobra una tarifa de limpieza cuando llegamos y entramos al baño nos encontramos con pelos en el piso y en el tapete, el espejo sucio. Además en el anuncio dice que contaríamos con artículos básicos (jabón, papel higiénico...), sin embargo en el baño nos encontramos solo con dos barras pequeñas de jabón (que claramente no alcanzan para 5-6 personas, si no solo para 1) y no había papel higiénico.
En la cocina nos encontramos con una nueva sorpresa, los platos y vasos son de plástico y en conjunto con los cubiertos, sartenes y cacerolas se encontraban sucios, grasosos... Tuvimos que lavar cada objeto que usamos en la cocina. No había lavavajillas o detergente para platos, solo había la mitad de una botella de lavandina en gel con aroma. Tuvimos que encargarnos nosotros de comprar lavavajillas para poder desengrasar los objetos de la cocina (vajilla, cubiertos, vasos, sartenes y cacerolas). En la cocina no habían utensilios básicos como espátula o espumadera, lo cual dificultaba cocinar hasta un huevo frito. Había solo un paño de cocina, lo cual es poco para los días que estuvimos (9). No había un paño para limpiar las superficies ni tampoco una esponja de repuesto.
El lavadero estaba sucio, lleno de pelos, se nota despreocupación. Cuando llegamos no había un paño limpio para asear el piso tuvimos que lavar el único paño que encontramos y que para variar estaba lleno de pelos, mojado y con suciedad. Todo eso para poder mantener el departamento limpio y en condiciones.

Creo que si uno paga por un alojamiento, lo mínimo que espera es que se encuentre limpio y tener disponibles elementos basicos para limpiar y más aún si están cobrando tarifa de limpieza.

Si tuviera que recomendar este alojamiento sólo por ubicación, por espacio y por comodidad de las camas, sin duda diría que es 100% recomendable.
Sin embargo, la poca preocupación por la limpieza y por mantener condiciones adecuadas en cocina, baño y lavadero hicieron que nuestra estadia allí no fuera lo que esperábamos, no lo recomendaría. No volveríamos a alojarnos allí.

The apartment was beautiful and Flor was very kind. There were unexpected issues with the wifi but she went out of her way to make sure we had internet. We were very sad to leave and we miss that cozy little apartment in Recoleta.
Excelente loft con todo lo necesario, excelente atención de Florencia, comunicación fluida.

Flor, the host, is fantastic. We were welcomed with a warm smile and hug. She constantly went above and beyond in every aspect of hospitality, like leaving us some sweets and showing us the amenities of her place. She keeps a very tidy space, and guided us through the city with a map, and had a bunch of tour books around. We felt safe in the chill neighborhood of Recoleta. The Airbnb is in the center of the tourist attractions in Buenos Aires and it's easy to get to different place from here. We walked pretty much everywhere we went and always found our way back easily. If you're looking to take a break from a super touristy hotel, this is definitely the place for you.
El espacio de Florencia es cuidado en todos los detalles. Todo muy prolijo y limpio. Me encantó haberlo conocido. Lo recomiendo sin dudarlo!
Excelente ubicacion y anfitriona. Ideal para turistas que quieren conocer Buenos Aires.

Lindisimo y cómodo departamento. Bien ubicado, muchos medios de transporte a su alcance.
Muy cálida la atención de Florencia. Lo recomiendo

Muy buena ubicación, se puede andar tranquilo caminando. Hermoso dpto., monoambiente pequeño, muy luminoso, cálido, bien decorado. Una anfitriona excelente, contesta enseguida, está atenta a las necesidades.

Florencia es una gran anfitriona, aunque llegue tarde me espero personalmente al ingreso y fue muy flexible también para el check out. Su espacio es tal cual se ve en las fotos, muy completo,  limpisimo y muy luminoso ya que hay un edificio contiguo que solo se eleva hasta la planta baja. SUPER SILENCIOSO en un barrio seguro, tranquilo casas de comidas rapidas, cefes, panaderias, supermercados a un bloque y a 3solo 00 mts de Avda Sta Fe . LES ENCANTARA!!

Florencia was a wonderful host! My husband and I loved our stay at her place. The apartment is very conveniently located, neat and modern. Florencia stayed on top of all communications, gave a lot of great recommendations, and was very kind to let us check in early.

Cannot recommend her more!
Muy cómodo y bueno y ordenado. Excelente anfitriona, preocupada por cada detalle. Se agradece su calidez y buena predisposición.
El departamento muy lindo, con todo lo necesario, muy buena ubicación, muy limpio, Flor siempre dispuesta a ayudarnos. Lo recomiendo totalmente!!

Pessoa incrível e extremamente prestativa! Uma dama! Foi ótima a estadia e super indico a quem for a Buenos Aires! Super host com certeza... apto charmoso, boa localização e mil a uma dicas com direito a mapas e cartão do metrô! Meu único medo de indicar é não ter vaga para quando eu quiser ir!
Lo mejor que encontramos todo de primer nivel

Florencia is the ultimate hostess. Very friendly and beyond helpful. Her apartment is in a great location for walking or taking the subway. It is a lovely, comfortable place to call home for a few days.
Un espacio excelente, muy bien cuidado y limpio, con muy buena ubicación y una excelente host! Gracias Florencia!!!

El departamento es inmejorable. Limpio, luminoso, cómodo. Está muy bien ubicado, cerca de muchos transportes públicos y en una zona tranquila. Tiene todo lo necesario para una estadía perfecta. Tiene todos los elementos necesarios y en excelente estado. Florencia es muy amable, hizo todo lo posible para facilitarme el check in y el check out.  Además dejó a mi disponibilidad toda la información necesaria sobre la zona y Buenos Aires en general. Definitivamente volveré a alojarme en éste departamento.
Had a wonderful time staying in Sergio's apartment. Great location, very clean and so easy to deal with.

A Flor é extremamente simpática, cuidadosa, atenciosa e cuidou de cada detalhe com muito carinho. Respondeu as mensagens prontamente, nos deu assistência até mesmo após o checkout e a casa é toda cheia de encantos.

Muchas gracias Florencia, se agradece la hospitalidad y buena onda! Pocas palabras tengo para describir lo lindo de tu hospedaje. 100% recomendado por ubicación, limpieza y espacio. No se arrepentirán !
Excelente hospitalidade, muito atenciosa, tirou todas as nossas dúvidas. Indico super....
Un lugar súper cómodo, limpio, acogedor. Florencia dispuesta al 100% en todo momento. Excelente experiencia!
El apartamento de Flor tiene una buena ubicación, el apartamento tiene todo lo necesario para estar a gusto y destacaría la hospitalidad de Flor. Muy recomendable.
침대 진짜 편안하고 좋아요! 마약침대! 치안 좋은 레꼴레타에 있어서 안전하고ㅎㅎ ㅅr진보다 ㅈrㄱㅇr서 다ㅇ황했지만 그거 빼면 괜찮습니다!!! 호스트 엄청 친절하고 BR여행에서 뭐든 도움주려고 노력해요ㅠㅠ Thank you so much, Flor!
Excelente Flo, muy amable!! Agradecemos todo! Mil gracias💜
Nos encanto...totalmente recomendable por calidad, servicio y ubicación...

Excelente alojamiento, cumple con todo lo descrito en el anuncio. Florencia es un 7, siempre preocupada, atenta y muy amable. Nos ayudó con las zonas turísticas, nos coordinó taxis para volver al aeropuerto. Cada vez que tuvimos alguna duda nos respondió enseguida. Muy recomendada. El departamento muy cómodo y con una excelente ubicación muy céntrico. Gracias por la amabilidad. ☺️☺️

Florencia is a great host, she welcomed us when we arrived in midnight and provided everything needed.

The place is very central, 2 blocks away from a Main Street, and Uber is easy to use in the city.
Muy lindo depto y muy bien ubicado

El lugar es exacto como las fotos. Muy cómodo. Florencia es una persona súper accesible y se mantiene en comunicación. Nuestro vuelo llegó temprano en la mañana y a pesar de tener huéspedes el día anterior nos entregó el lugar impecable y antes de la hora del check in.  Sus recomendaciones fueron las mejores. Gracias por todo. Súper recomendado.
Todo perfecto

I really loved my stay at Florencia's space.
The appartment is well located, close to a metro station, and the bed is very comfy.
I really love how the appartment is decorated.
I recommend this place in term of value for the price.

Splended host and really great condo.  The neighborhood was a great point to explore Buenos Aires from and there are convenient cafes and mini stores to get everything you’ll need for your stay.  Unbelievable value, I would most definitely stay at the same place again!!!  The neighborhood felt really safe.  Much safer than a major city in the USA.
Espaço bom para 2 pessoas, bem localizado e extremamente limpo. Florência é uma ótima anfitriã,  nos deu dicas sobre a cidade e nos ajudou em tudo o mais que foi preciso. Nos sentimos em casa.

Flor is amazing and the apartment reflects just that. Great communication, easy check in. Perfect space in the heart of the city . Very secure and close to everything. If need anything , flor is there to help and she also  provided me with excellent recommendations for the best eats in the city. I really hope one day I can stay here again.

J'ai adoré mon séjour dans l'appartement de Florencia. C'est très propre, loft spacieux, air climatisé fonctionne très bien, matelas confortable, bâtiment calme et vieux avec un ascenseur a grillage et porte. Un petit bonus historique. Un bon marcheur atteint le centre en environ 45 minutes pour visiter la vieille ville. Sinon, transports en commun disponible a proximité. Plusieurs bistrots, cafés et restos pour plaire à tous! Avec la gentillesse et dévouement de Florencia, vous ne serez certainement pas déçus. Elle maîtrise l'art des détails pour agrémenter votre séjour.

Florencia is an amazing host, so warm and friendly and very responsive to any messages.
Both the check in process and the check out process were super easy, Florencia was kind enough to allow a late checkout which made it very easy to arrange myself to get to the airport. The place itself is in a fabulous location. It was extremely clean , had a super comfy bed and was very well thought of relating to all the additional touches. Highly recommend!
Muito bom!
O apartamento é charmoso, limpo e em uma ótima localização. Florencia é muito atenciosa. A cama confortável e o chuveiro bem gostoso. Local super indicado!!!
Excelente lugar; ubicación...flor una gran anfitriona
Great stay

Flor’s place is wonderful - stylish, clean, comfortable, and greatly located with supermarkets and restaurants nearby. Flor met with us upon check in, provided us a great overview of the city and a lot of travel tips. Communication was super smooth. I highly recommend this place!
Um apartamento impecável na parte de cuidados, muita atenção conosco explicando certinho todos os detalhes do local e da cidade e muito bem localizado. Perfeito!
Florencia nous a super bien accueillis dans son studio de Recoleta. Tout était très propre, le wifi fonctionnait très bien, et elle a su nous donner de bons conseils pour découvrir la ville. Merci !
Flor was amazing on response time and sharing local tips, restaurants nearby.  Her place is indeed in the center of everything.  A cool and cozy place in the center of BA!

Eu esperava encontrar um bom apartamento, conforme as avaliações anteriores; mas, encontrei muito mais do que isso. Além de Florencia ser uma anfitriã incrível, a localização, segurança, conforto, beleza e limpeza do apartamento são ótimas.
Seguramente é a melhor localização para hospedagem em Bs.As., longe dos riscos do microcentro ou das zonas periféricas, há acesso fácil para qualquer lugar. Apesar das três estações de metrô nas imediações, muitas linhas de ônibus, táxis circulando 24 horas em frente ao edifício e ponto de bikes do Itaú, com alguma disposição é possível ir a pé para diversos pontos de interesse turístico. Na região do edifício estão o Museu Ricardo Rojas (história da língua espanhola), Museu Xu Solar (artes visuais) e o Museu Casa de Carlos Gardel, que valem uma visita. O comércio no entorno é incrível e os preços são melhores que no Centro ou áreas turísticas. Há estacionamento rotativo em frente, supermercados pequenos e grandes, diversos cafés e restaurantes (baratíssimos para os padrões brasileiros), farmácias e conveniências (quiosques) 24 horas.
O edifício é antigo, mas muito bem conservado e com poucos apartamentos. Não possui portaria, como a maioria dos edifícios em Bs.As., mas é muito seguro. Não há qualquer tipo de inconvenientes.
O apartamento é pequeno, mas muito bonito e confortável. Tem absolutamente tudo para que o hóspede sinta-se em casa. Tudo muito limpo e cheiroso, além de decoração de bom gosto.
Parabéns Florencia! Você e seu apartamento fizeram minha viagem a Bs.As. ser melhor que o esperado.
Todo súper bien

The apartment was excellent  located in a very nice neighberhood, really close to everything. It was very clean and very well equipped. You could find everything you needed. Flor was very helpful, gave us useful advise and responded very quickly to our questions.

Apartamento muito limpo, agradável, tem tudo que precisa é muito bem localizado, perto da avenida Santa Fe e Córdoba que são 2 avenidas de fácil acesso a tudo. Ótimo bairro, da pra fazer muita coisa a pé. Supermercados, restaurantes, cafés, e lanchonetes como ( mcdonalds e burg king), estação de metrô, pontos de ônibus, tudo muito perto.
Ótima localização pra Uber tb, sempre em torno de uns 5 minutos.
Florencia é uma anfitriã muito atenciosa e sempre responde rápido pra qualquer necessidade. Amamos tudo.
Un departamento en una buena ubicación.El edificio es antiguo pero el loft está muy bien cuidado y limpio.
Esta es la segunda vez que me alojo con Florencia, la super recomiendo!

Hermoso departamento, super buena ubicación. Cerca de paradas de colectivo y subte. Hay comercios cerca también. Flor es una divina. Super atenta y amable en todo momento. Nos explicó todo y cumplió todo lo que prometía en el anunció y más. Super recomendado.
Great loft, very well located and *extremely* well kept.  The hostess is very attentive, caring and available to help (in english and spanish). 10/10 recomend and would come back. a true bargain.
Great
Flor es una persona maravillosa y el departamento es perfecto y muy comodo!

Das Apartment war super - wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Alles ist genauso wie auf den Fotos, alles sehr wohnlich und sehr sauber. Die Lage ist auch super - man ist gut angebunden & viele Gegenden wie Palermo auch fußläufig erreichbar. Wir können die Unterkunft nur empfehlen und kommen gerne wieder :) Flor ist super lieb, die Kommunikation lief einwandfrei und das Handbuch vor Ort super hilfreich. Dankeschön!!
Florencia muy amable. El apartamento tenía todo lo necesario. La ubicación está muy cómoda.

Florencia has an amazing apartment in what I would say is the perfect location. There was a supermarket and great restaurants nearby if you eat out.

The apartment felt like home. Cool, clean and comfortable. Im a fussy person but this is everything you want in an Airbnb.

Communication was easy and professional.

thanks again!

Ótima experiência. O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos e é bem confortável para um casal. A internet funcionava bem e a água era quente. Somente o chão que estava um pouco sujo mas passando um pano já resolveu. Mas de resto fica numa região bem tranquila e fizemos muita coisa a pé. A Florência sempre nos respondia com rapidez e é uma pessoa gentil e atenciosa. Um ótimo custo benefício.

Sergio's apartment in Palermo Hollywood was incredible. It was just as awesome as it looks in the pictures and super close to a number of great bars / restaurants / clubs in Palermo. Sergio was kind enough to check us in 4 hours early on Christmas Day! I can't recommend this listing enough. Thanks Sergio!

A really nice studio apartment with everything you may need (kitchen, wifi, cable). Especially nice for someone familiar with the city and able to take advantage of the bus system. The neighborhood is nice with some interesting cafes in a non-touristy part of the city. Egle was very responsive with all of my questions and very accommodating.
This apartment is super comfortable.  It has everything you need for a short or long stay!
The apartment was very nice and in a good location. Egle was a lovely host and easy to coordinate with. A good experience! Egle, all the best to you, and to Lidia, too!
Mi estadia en el departamento de Egle fue excelente, el lugar esta en excelente condiciones y queda cerca de muchas cafeterias y restaurantes.

El departamento está en excelentes condiciones, es tal cual como se muestra en las fotografías (limpieza, wi-fi, lencería). Posee buen acceso al transporte público ya que se encuentra ubicado en toda la Av. Boedo la cual está céntrica para conectarse con los barrios concurridos como Palermo, San Telmo, Recoleta, etc. A dos cuadras y medias te queda la estación del Subterráneo. Se encuentran todos los servicios que necesitas a su alrededor.
Muy buena comunicación con la anfitriona Egle, amable, respetuosa y consideraría volverlo a tomar como opción de hospedaje en un próximo viaje por su confort total. Gracias por tus buenas atenciones!!!.

A very adorable little apartment - perfect for a one week stay.  Boedo Ave offered grocery stores, pharmacies, a laundry service/dry cleaner (directly downstairs), public transport, cafes and restaurants.  It took about 30 mins door to "door" to get from the apartment to the city using the train or 15 mins/$7-$8 (without traffic) or to Palermo by taxi - good location.  Good internet connection too.  The only thing to consider is that the road is quite busy and can be a bit noisy so if you are a very light sleeper, it might not be a great choice - however, for the price and convenience of the place, I had no problem with it :)  Recommend!

Very nice apartment in the middle of Boedo with nice restaurants, sermarkets, banks just a few steps away. Very friendly owner !
It's a bit loud if you do not like airconditioning (as we do not like it) - we had to leave the door to the balcony open which leads to the main road Av. Boedo... which has a lot of noisy traffic during most parts of the day
This apartment is very confortable. It is located in a beautiful and security neighbourhood where you can find restaurants, coffee shops, supermarkets.

We enjoyed our stay at Egle's apartment. It was clean, spacious, and Egle was a very attentive and helpful host. We loved people-watching from the balcony, and it was nice to be surrounded by cafes and restaurants. Try Lucinda, around the corner, and Jaimito for awesome brick-oven pizza!

Die WOHNUNG entspricht in allem der Beschreibung. Sie ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet und alles funktioniert. Die LAGE ist verkehrsgünstig. Busse, U-bahn, Cafés, Restaurants, Off-theater gibt es in der unmittelbaren Nähe.
Es gibt von mir keine 5 Sterne wegen des Verkehrslärms, der bis spät direkt in die Wohnung dringt sonst ist alles sehr angenehm.
Elisabeth

El departamento coincide cien por ciento con su descripcion. Esta arreglado con gusto y todo funciona. Se encuentra bien ubicado con buses, subte, supermercado, teatros alternativos, restaurantes y cafes muy cerca.
No doy cinco estrellas por el ruido que entra desde la calle con mucho trafico. Pero igual la estancia ha sido muy agradable.
Elisabeth

Nos quedamos dos semanan en lo de Paola y fue muy buena experiencia, el departamento algo reducido pero muy bien equipado, el barrio seguro, pudimos parquear nuestro auto en la calle, y a solo una cuadra del tren, dos de un Carrefour y tres de colectivos.
Paola y Sergio fueron muy amables y estuvieron prestos a cualquier detalle. Los recomendamos ampliamente.
We spent 2 weeks at paola`s and it was a great experience, the aprtment is kind of narrow but very well equipped, in a safe neighborhood, We park the car on the street, We enjoyed the train at just One block, Twon blocks to the Carrefour Supermarket & 3 blocks to the buses.
Paola & Sergio were very nice, answer real fast to any details and We widely recommend their place.
Great app. Good price in a very quiet street. Thank you!

La descripcion lo dice todo e inclusive más. El dpto. es tal como se describe, cómodo, confortable, cuenta con todo lo necesario (wi-fi, cable, AC, heladera, buen banho y ducha. El vecindario es perfecto, kiosko, farmacia, restaurantes cerca. El bus pasa en la esquina misma y los deja a cuadras del subte. Excelente atencion por parte de Sergio y Paola, el dpto es muy lindo y comodo ademas de tener un muy acorde precio de alquiler. Recomendado como una muy buena opcion para quedarse en belgrano.

Todo estuvo muy bien. El apartamento es muy cómodo y tiene todo lo necesario para pasarla bien. Nos dejaron café, té, azúcar, sal, yerba, yogurt y cerveza, entre otras cosas. Son detalles no menores si tenemos en cuenta que llegamos de un viaje de varias horas. Nos gustó mucho la decoración. El barrio es muy tranquilo, dejamos el auto estacionado enfrente y no hubo necesidad de alquilar cochera. Paola nos recibió y nos explicó como llegar a algunos sitios además de dejarnos folletería que fue de mucha ayuda para armar un itinerario de visitas a lugares turísticos. Gracias a eso fuimos a la feria de San Telmo y después a La Boca para regresar de noche a San Telmo.  Muchas gracias Paola.

El departamento es impecable. Desde el principio todo funcionaba bien. Con estos días de mucho calor teníamos mucho uso de la pileta y la terraza. La zona de Palermo Hollywood está llena de lindos restaurantes y bares, igual, en el departamento no se escucha el ruido de la calle. Sergio nos contestaba directamente con cualquier pregunta que teníamos. Toda la visita ha sido una maravilla.

The apartment is absolutely adorable! It's super clean and situated in a very good part of Buenos Aires! Sergio was very helpful and organized everything perfectly for us! I can only recommend this place!
Fue muy agradable la estancia . Es un departamento amable y silencioso. Bien equipado y en un barrio muy agradable.

Estuvimos varios días y todo excelente, como en CASA. Lindo barrio con todo a la mano.

Los anfitriones muy macanudos y accesibles.

I stayed at Paola's with my 9 year old son.  We had a fantastic time.  I was in BA for business and vacation, and all was easy with the location of the apartment... shopping, restaurant, laundry service, train, taxis... the apartment is one of the quietest I have ever stayed at, which in BA is amazing.  The beds were comfortable, heaters fantastic when necessary, and internet available.  Paola was a lovely host, and brought fresh towels, gave recommendations as needed, and responded to all of our needs.  She even helped me line up a sitter one evening for my son.  I would definitely stay here again.  As I visit BA often, it is a good possibility.

Our party of 3 loved staying at Paola&Sergio's beautiful apartment. They were very accommodating of our late check-in and check-out and extremely thoughtful. The apartment is very well furnished with A/C, WIFI, an entertainment system etc. There were also guidebooks (incl Nat Geo) freely available and other homely things which we really enjoyed. They even provided us with a public transport card and offered us the use of a mobile and sim card.
The apartment is conveniently located near a train station and many bus routes and we had no issues travelling to Palermo, San Telmo and other places of interest. At the bottom of their apartment building there is a restaurant where we had the best meals of our South America trip at, as well as an excellent ice cream store called Lucca which we loved. Paola and Sergio were such great hosts and really made us feel at home. Would highly recommend!!

Egle sempre foi muito atenciosa e rápida ao responder os e-mails, além de me passar diversas dicas de ônibus e linhas de metrô para ir aos lugares turísticos da cidade. O apartamento é belíssimo e todos os móveis são novos, além da localização boa, que fica próximo a um super mercado e duas das linhas principais de metrô.

L'appartement dans un immeuble récent, correspond exactement à ce que nous avions réservé. Propre, agréable, confortable nous sommes ravis de notre long séjour.
La terrasse, qui avait finalisé notre choix, située à l'arrière permet de s'installer sans nuisance, même si l'avenue Boedo est un axe de circulation, la porte fenêtre du balcon est insonorisée.
Une situation dans un quartier très vivant et varié, de nombreux commerces. Les bus et métro ne sont pas loin pour sillonner B-Aires.
Oui, nous aimions bien rentrer à l'appartement bien entretenu que nous avons très vite adopté.

Foi bem tranquila nossa estadia. O apartamento é bem agradável, igual nas fotos. Só fica um pouco longe do agito, mas tem metrô pertinho, a noite tem que tomar um táxi para voltar dos lugares. O Óscar e sua esposa que nos receberam foram bem prestativos e emprestaram adaptadores de tomada. Quem for do Brasil ficar atento com isso e com a voltagem que é 220.
Beijos querida e obrigada.

Ein geschmackvoll eingerichtetes Appartement in ein lebendiges Viertel mit viele Laden und gute Verbindungen. Gastgeber ist sehr gut über E-Mail erreichbar und gibt gute Tipps zur Umgebung und Verbindungen.

Although I didn't meet Egle personally, she was only an email away which she answered promptly.
The apartment is exactly as you see in the pictures. Modern, airy and luminous. The bed is comfortable, everything works in the kitchen and the shower has good pressure. There isn't a washing machine but this is not a problem as there are two laundry service shops, one next to the building, the other opposite it. They do a very good job and are extremely reasonably priced.
On arrival I met Oscar, the building caretaker, who handed over the keys. His wife cleaned the apartment once a week and provided fresh bed linen and clean towels. They are both delightful to deal with.
The neighbourhood is great, with many shops and reasonably priced restaurants within walking distance.
Another great feature is transportation; there are many buses that will take you to almost anywhere in the city and the subte Linea E (underground), is only 3 blocks away. You can be downtown in about 20'.
In short, this is a great little apartment in a lovely neighbourhood and I highly recommend it. Would I consider coming back to it on my next visit to BsAs? Yeah!

L'appartamento è esattamente come si vede nelle foto: perfettamente tenuto, nuovo e pulito. La zona non è proprio in centro però è tranquilla anche di notte e ben fornita di servizi: autobus, la metro è a 3 quadras, ristoranti, negozi, supermercati, lavanderie. Egle è una padrona di casa perfetta, anche se non l'abbiamo conosciuta personalmente perchè vive in Europa ha coordinato tutto in modo rapido ed efficiente rispondendo a qualsiasi nostra richiesta di informazioni. L'empleado che si occupa della gestione del palazzo, anche lui molto gentile e disponibile, si è occupato degli eventuali problemi tecnici locali risolvendo tutto; ci ha aiutati a riparare la valigia, ci ha aperto la porta perchè avevamo dimenticato le chiavi insomma per qualsiasi cosa è a disposizione. L'unico neo dell'appartamento è che si sentono un pò i rumori della strada di notte ma con i tappi il problema si risolve. Sicuramente consiglierei questo appartamento per venire a Buenos Aires.
Muy linda experiencia en este departamento. El departamento es hermoso y muy comodo, tal cual se ve en las fotos. El servicio es muy bueno, son muy atentos.

Sergio's place was nice and just as described. It was close to a lot of restaurants and bars. We didn't have a good time staying at Sergio's place mainly because of the constant power outages. Buenos Aires was experiencing a heat wave the week we were there (Jan 20 - Jan 28). The building didn't have a generator. So when the power goes, so does the A/C. Other neighborhoods weren't affected by the power outages (probably because the buildings had power generators). So although the place was nice, our experience was less than perfect. We had a miserable time because the power would go out for more than 2 hrs each day, with one day the power was out for more than 8 hours. Imagine being tired after a long day exploring and coming home to a place without power or A/C.

Overall because of the power issues and no generator present, I'd recommend staying in Palermo Soho or at a hotel. I only recommend Soho because there are more shops and restaurants in the area. I understand that our experience is different from the other guests. Had we not had power issues, I'd highly recommend Sergio's place.

Sergio's apartment is awesome! Four of us stayed here for four nights - and an amazing time in Buenos Aires - more so thanks to Sergio. He was extremely communicative beforehand, helping us to arrange transport from the airport. He met us at the apartment on arrival and gave us recommendations about local restaurants and bars. The location is brilliant. A very safe, trendy and tree lined neighbourhood with great night spots near by. The apartment itself was perfect - clean, modern but also very homely. The building has a nice rooftop pool and terrace where you can enjoy the stunning sun sets. All in all I have nothing bad whatsoever to say about the apartment or Sergio - perfect place and a perfect host. Highly recommended.

Sergio fue muy amable y siempre estuvo pendiente de nosotros. Siempre disponible para cualquier pregunta o duda.
El depto muy bien localizado... muchos lugares para ir caminando (restaurantes, bares, etc)

Staying at The Boss has been excellent experience for us:
Great communication after the booking
Terrific location in a cool area close to metro
Outstanding welcome by Marcelo with information provided about the neighbourhood, safety, money exchange and lots more.
Lovely apartment, pool area, security guards at entrance, safes in both bedrooms.
Fruit and snack basket as well as a bottle of water were really welcome with the late arrival.
Highly recommended!

Accurate photos. Ralf's team is professional, highly knowledge and friendly. The place has all amities you'd expect, plus some. A bowl of fruit upon arrival was a nice surprise. A+ experience. Would highly recommend this apartment.

I can just say, we have had a wonderful time in Ralf´s appartement. It is bright, sunny, very clean, quiet, modernly furnished and perfectly situated, right in the middle of palermo.
Every room is equipped with airconditioning, which is necessary during summertime:-)
You can cool off in the big pool and do your work out in the gym on the roof top floor.
The cooling system in the gym, did´nt manage to cool off enough though, during the day.
There are always at least 2 doormen watching the entry/ exit doors!
They are very alert and strict, which gives you a comforting and safe feeling, at all times.
Ralf and his team had been extremely caring and supportive, when needed. We would definitly recommend to anyone, to stay at the boss´s!

Ralf met us at the apartment and showed us all of its amenities and gave us contact numbers for himself and the office if we needed anything.  He has a great team and everyone we contacted were extremely helpful in getting us tickets for the Tango show that we wanted to see and making great recommendations for restaurants.  They were all very patient with us when we had to change plans and quickly rebooked our reservations for us.  The apartment is very clean and modern with everything you need for a great stay.  We ate at restaurants for the most part but if you wanted to cook the kitchen is large and fully equipped.  There was even a large bowl of fruit and granola bars waiting upon our arrival. A problem with one of the air conditioners was taken care of immediately and repaired by the time we returned to the apartment.  Ralf is a very personable person and the whole booking process, check in and check out is a smooth process without a whole lot of paper work.  We had a late flight and were able to leave our bags in the apartment after check out so that we could pick them up later in the day for our flight home.  Highly recommend Ralf and his team.  They have several apartments available and took great care of us.  You'll be in good hands.

Perfectly located just a few minutes from the metro and almost every bus. Amazing building with gym, pool and great security guards. Walking distance to multiple supermarkets and delicious restaurants. The apartment is exactly as it was in the pictures. The "check-in" was seamless and the transfers to/from the airport were on time and very efficient. We were three adults and the space was absolutely perfect. The communication and response time for booking and any questions was absolutely wonderful. I would suggest anyone looking to stay in Buenos Aires for a day or for a year, stay at this apartment.

The owner, Sergio, was a great communicator and really did a great job helping us set up for a successful visit to Buenos Aires. The apartment is really lovely and in a fantastic location. The space is actually larger than it seems in the photos, and there’s even a laundry in the building.

Sergio claramente cuenta con las estrellas de un súper anfitrión, porque su espacio es perfecto: detalles que hacen que uno se sienta en casa, limpieza, decoración, camas, ubicación. Lo más de lo más. La ubicación es muy agradable: está rodeado de cafeses y restaurantes divertidos y lindos. Además, es un lugar tranquilo. Fue una estadía magnífica. Gracias y volveremos!
Close to everything. Parks and bars around. Nice places to eat. Good vibes

This was amazing. Email communication was great, the person who met us upon arrival was extremely welcoming and professional. He gave us a tour of the apartment and carefully explained everything. He was very patient and answered all of our questions. The company is available by phone all of the time and it was nice that everyone spoke English since my Spanish is very basic. I called them to reschedule my friend's car to the airport from 7:30 pm to 7 pm and they did so without a problem. My flight was delayed 3 hours and I called the company to book an additional car for me. They not only booked the car but let me stay in the apartment without being charged because no one else was renting the space the next day.

The apartment itself is incredibly relaxing. The decor is nice, the space is sparkling clean, the sunlight is wonderful and the pool area is very nicely maintained and heated. You can even rent a private whirlpool room by the hour.

If I return to Palermo, I will be using Ralf and his company.

Our experience was wonderful here . We arrived very late at night and was met with a very warm welcome. We were given a complete brief of how the apartment worked , maps of where we were staying etc . The apartment felt like a home away from home . The area is perfect to stay in . Great cafes , restaurants , shopping we loved it .  I would recommend this place and if i ever came back i would definitely stay here .

The reviews I'd read were correct-- modern, neat, clean, good area.  From the moment we entered the apartment, a person was there to explain all the details of using the apartment, building security and the amenities, and welcomed us with fruit and some bottled water.   All our questions were quickly answered, and our stay was great.    Safe area, a couple blocks to good restaurants.  Even found a cleaner within a block who washed & folded our clothes the same day.   Well organized owner gives you confidence you made the right choice.

The apartment was everything it said on the site, the pictures perfectly describe its comfort and utilities. It is very well located, you can walk a couple blocks in any direction and youll find supermarkets, restaurants and really, anything you need. On the day we arrived there was already someone waiting for us, gave us tips, maps and answered every question we had. Ralf and his team are extremely professional and gave us their number in case we needed anything. The building security is very friendly and helpful. Definitley would recommend.
Ralf was a perfect host. The apartment is incredible, i love it. Had a great time in his place!

The comments are correct. We stayed three weeks at the apartment with our 3-yo daughter and everything was as announced. The apartment was clean, well equipped and the building safe. Ralf's team is ready to help if you have any problem. We definitely recommend and will stay there again the next time we travel to Bs As. Perfect!

La estadia fue excelente , Marcelo nos recibio en forma muy amable
y se puso a nuestra disposicion.
La ubicacion excelente , el departamento supero nuestras expectativas , muy bonito amplio , muy luminoso , muy confortable
hasta una bandeja de frutas de recepcion y cafe disponible hicieron que esta escapada a Buenos Aires fuera muy placentera
gracias Ralph volveremos
We had a great weekend in buenos aires. The apartment is perfect and its location is great. We could walk to restaurants and cafes. The metro is really close by. Thank you Ralf!

My dad and I had a wonderful stay at the apartment! Ralf and his team quickly responded to my emails before our stay, and when we arrived they met us at the apartment with keys and a lot of information about the surrounding neighborhood (including a map of Buenos Aires) to help us get oriented quickly.

The apartment is a short walk to the subway, which made getting around the city easy. It is also very close to grocery stores, and, most importantly for me because I like to pack light, inexpensive laundry places where I could drop off my laundry in the morning and have it back that evening. Thanks again!

We had a great experience staying in this apartment.  The place looks exactly as the photos describe, and is extremely close to the subway (green line), which gets you to many of the city's popular sites.  The apartment is in a modern building with good security.  It was extremely easy to coordinate the renting of this apartment.  Ralf and his team are quick to respond and very flexible and accommodating.  The apartment is spacious-- we were only two people, but we could certainly have had 4 of us and still had plenty of room.  I would recommend the apartment, and the experience of working with Ralf and his colleagues.  The only downside is that the apartment is not quite in the most desirable part of Palermo-- it's safe and very convenient for the subway, groceries, etc.; however, the more trendy areas with the best restaurants, stores, cafes, etc. is a bit of walk.  It's a trade-off between subway proximity and the "neighborhood cool factor."

El apartamento de Ralf está muy bien ubicado, cerca hay muchos cafés y restaurantes, además de un Carrefour. El equipo de Ralf es muy amable, siempre atentos a cualquier pregunta y ofreciendo un excelente servicio. Es un lindo apartamento, muy organizado y limpio. La vista desde el gym es espectacular. Tuvimos una increíble estadía en Buenos Aires.
Very well run block. Very secure. A very warm welcome by Marcello who  manages the apartment. Very clean. We were extremely happy. I would highly recommend.

This was a great apartment for us in a perfect location.
Everything is exactly as you see it in the pictures - no surprises..
Great security. Great gym.
The best part of vacation was our home away from home.
If you're going to BA this is the only place to stay..
Loved Tonno a black away for breakfast and dinner.
Everyone that worked for Ralf were very helpful and always available to take care of anything.
Ralf was great... He told me I looked nicer than my picture
Ralf met us at the apartment and explained everything and gave us specific information about the City. The apartment was exactly like the pictures indicated, clean and functional.

Great apartment, very spacious and clean. The amenities are fantastic, exactly as they look in the photos. The apartment is situated in a fantastic location, loads to do and safe. Would highly recommend. Ralf and the team were accessible and very helpful on arrival.

We had a great experience staying at the Boss!

Host:
The host was great. They were very responsive to any inquiries and offered to help as able. The person who met us upon arrival gave us a great 101 on the apartment and Buenos Aires that was perfectly detailed yet succinct. She provided a map and marked it with recommendations, described how to use the apartment's phone and answered any and all questions. The host was also willing to be on call at anytime should we have needed a taxi called or reservations made.

Apartment:
The apartment was very secure and clean. We had no issues with the wifi--it worked great! We had four of us staying, and all of us were comfortable.

Location:
While we were initially going to stay in San Telmo, we were happy we stayed in Palermo and the location of the apartment likely had a lot to do with that. It was nice for us to walk to the plazas and local cafes and restaurants (5-15 mins. in any direction). Of note, for steak lovers, key restaurants La Carniceria, Don Julio and La Cabrera are all within walking distance. I would caution that we did do a lot of walking, but we tend to do that when visiting big cities.

An awesome apartment! The guy introducing the apartment and the rest of the building was very friendly and on time. The apartment was very clean and looked as on the pictures. The gym on the 31th floor is breath taking, best view on Buenos Aires possible!

We had a great time at Ralfs place, very good location equipped with everything, felt home immediately. Had good trainings at the well equipped gym with stunning views, hang around hours at the pool, played with the kids at the playground. Ralph and his team pampered us and treated us like friends. Thank you for making us feel good!

We had a great welcome by Ralf's employee and he made us feel like at home. The apartment was exactly as described, and the location is perfect: closed to the subway and to all shops and restaurants of Palermo. We would definitely come back there!

Fantastic apartment, modern and very comfortable, in a great building with gym and pool. It's equipped with everything you need, including even world plug converters. The beds were very comfortable.
Ralf and Marcelo were great hosts, very communicative, flexible and attentive.
We weren't very happy with the extra charge for late check in (past 8pm), but Marcelo did such an excellent job on making sure we had everything that it almost made the charge worth it.
I would definitely stay here again! The service was beyond expectations.
Great apartment, very clean modern and comfy beds. Great service from Ralf and his team. Good location would definitely stay here again.

Ralf and his staff were very responsive during the booking process and Marcelo spent a great deal of time showing the apartment to us upon our arrival. The apartment is exactly as described and is near many shops, restaurants and local transportation. The beds are very comfortable and the kitchen is fully equipped.

I highly recommend staying here.
La comunicación fue perfecta todo el tiempo. El depto está impecable, bien equipado, es cómodo y está ubicado en un barrio hermoso super bien conectado. Muy recomendable.
A beautiful apartment and base to explore Buenos Aires. Sergio and team were great to deal with and I really enjoyed the stay
Great place, host was very nice. Close to cool coffee shops and restaurants too. I'd stay here again.
Excelente departamento ! Sergio muy amable
Todo excelente. El apto muy lindo tal cual las fotos. La zona espectacular, mucha variedad gastronómica y lugares para entretenerse. Sergio fue muy atento y amable siempre. Muy recomendable
Great place to stay if you are visiting the country!

Great place! Clean and spacious, good location, nice bedrooms and bathroom. The location is top notch, right at the centre of Palermo, close to many restaurants, bakeries and places to hang out. And nice and central, a good place to get to know the city.

Amazing apartment in perfect location - great neighborhood, tons of restaurants, bars, etc. in easy walking distance. Subway about a 15 min walk, easy to get to other places in the city. Beautiful very comfortable apartment, and Sergio is a great host. Highly recommended, I'd come back.
Sergio was a great host. Very responsive and had very helpful suggestions. The place was exactly as advertised, chic, and centrally located. Would stay here again when I come back!

Sergio was a fabulous host and his apartments was perfect.

Clean, tidy and attractive with a balcony and fresh succulent garden.

The rooms were well appointed and everything was in great working order.

The neighborhood is lovely and very convenient and walkable. Several cafes and shops nearby.

The checkin process was perfect and stress-free.

Highly recommended. I can’t wait to come back and see the Palermo neighborhood again.

Sergio es un muy buen anfitrión, atento y cordial.
El departamento está muy bien ubicado y es tal cual lo muestran las fotos publicadas.
Lo recomiendo 100%
Perfect apartment, perfect location!
What a great location and unit.  We would highly recommend!!  Sergio was very helpful, a great communicator and made this stay seamless!!! Highly highly recommend
Awesome place - great AC and good layout for two friends both with large bed and two bathrooms. Good location in Palermo Hollywood and the rooftop pool was a nice perk!

My wife and I are from the US and have rented over 55 Airbnb’s around the world. Sergio’s apartment is nothing less than outstanding. It is the high-end, the good stuff. It has everything you need and the location cannot be beat. Stores, restaurants, shopping, safety, not having to worry, etc. It’s modern and in the best part of Palermo.

As for the host, he’s quite cool and very accommodating. It is a well oiled machine. This is the one to pick, with zero hesitation.

The apartment was wonderful. Very spacious very large very modern. Everything was super clean and there are lots of restaurants in walkable areas nearby. Everything works perfectly. The check in the was easy and Sergio, a very responsive, friendly, and welcoming host. I would recommend this place to anyone, especially if you need two bedrooms.

We had a great stay! I would absolutely recommend this spot for a visit to Buenos Aires. The neighborhood is very walkable and vibrant, the apartment is clean and quiet, and the view from the rooftop deck is great! It was the perfect stay for two couples and we’d stay there again.

Had a great time staying at Sergio's place. The apartment is well-sized and clean and the building roof has gorgeous views and is well located in a beautiful, walkable area near restaurants and public transit. Definitely recommend!
love Sergio’s place and neighborhood. Would def book again
Great stay in a clean and comfortable apartment, in an amazing location! Thanks Sergio
Great flat in prime location! Loved our week here! Comfortable beds, great shower, good times!
Amazing apt. Great location. We discovered a very nice restaurant everything home made right under the apt. Will be back !
everything was perfect.  location was nice.  the house is in the centre.  it was a nice holiday.

Located in Recoleta, arguably the most upscale neighborhood in Buenos Aires, the apartment is very spacious and has all the amenities. There is easy access by foot or underground to all major attractions. Chris has been excellent in replying to emails, rental terms etc. and has stuck to his word (which is not always the norm in Argentina, from what I have read). The only (minor) complaint is some street noise in the bedroom in the morning -- it did not bother us, but people more sensitive to it might want to bring earplugs. The apartment is large, and occupies half of a floor in very nice French-style building with a helpful doorman. Check-in and check-out procedures, conducted by the adminstrator, were streamlined and helpful.

Todo bien, excelente atención! súper atentos! Enfrente hay un mercado que tiene de todo y un cafecito al lado, muy cerca de la estación para poder moverse, barrio muy tranquilo para salir de noche. Si van no se pierdan el restaurante de la esquina, Vicente, una maravilla! Muchas gracias Sergio!

Thank you so much for allowing us to stay in your beautiful, well equipped apartment during our visit in Buenos Aries. Marcello's check in was thorough, friendly and so helpful. Apartment was clean and well equipped. Actually better than pictures. Would definitely recommend The Boss to all my family and friends.

Nos sentimos como en casa ya que el departamento es súper acogedor con todas las comodidades que describe. Nos han recibido muy bien y en todo momento teníamos la posibilidad de contactarnos con Ralf. Esta muy buen ubicado con acceso a todos los medios de transporte y la vigilancia las 24 hs es una tranquilidad. El servicio de limpieza es muy bueno. Hemos tenido una estadía excelente, súper recomendable! Estamos seguros que volveremos el próximo año!
Gracias por todo
Silvana y Luis

[ENG] The place was exactly as it was showed in the pictures a very good equipped apartment in an outstanding area of Buenos Aires, very convenient to move everywhere. The team: they were there as we agreed at the time we agreed (late check-in) the place was clean and we received a very clear explanation about everything on the house (TV, ACs, Windows, water heater, heating system, safe boxes, etc.). The place is a very secure place with guards 7x24 so you feel safe all the time. Everything worked perfect and they also have multi contact with US connector so that helped a lot at the time to recharge devices (phones, tablets, etc.). Check-out, we requested a late check-out it was possible and very easy, just leave the keys inside and close the door. Outstanding experience! Thank you!!
[SPA] El lugar es exactamente cómo se muestra en las fotos un muy buen y bien equipado departamento en una zona privilegiada de Buenos Aires con buenos puntos de acceso h transporte para prácticamente todos lados. El tem: ellos estuvieron a la hora y día acordados (entramos tarde al departamento) y nos explicaron claramente cómo funcionaba todo (TVs, Aires Acondicionados, ventanas, Calefon, calefacción central, cajas de seguridad, etc.). El lugar es muy seguro y cuenta con guardias de seguridad 24x7. Todo funcionó perfectamente, el departamento cuenta inclusive con multó contactos con adaptador integrado para el tipo de conector que se usa en US, muy conveniente para poder recargar las baterías de los dispositivos electrónicos (Teléfonos celulares, tabletas, etc). Salida, solicitamos salida tarde y si bien estaba sujeto a disponibilidad, si se pudo hacer y fue muy fácil, dejar las llaves dentro de la casa, cerrar la puerta y salir. Excelente experiencia!!! Muchas Gracias!!!
Ralf was great, and his apartment was great too.  Located in a great street with lots of cool bars and restaurants.  Hope to stay again!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the boss. Marcello walks us through both the apartment, building, and neighborhood upon arrival and was spot on at all recommendations and advice during our week stay. Would highly recommend for an excellent experience in BA!
Ralf and the team were very hospitable and welcoming. The apartment is in a great location and is the perfect place to stay in Buenos Aires. Thanks so much for having us!
A great option for people wanting to be based in Palermo, but requiring access to other locations, underground parking can be organised

The apartment is great! Close to public transportation, restaurants (for which there's a guide book of recommendations), communication with the staff is quick and easy, and the apartment itself is very comfortable. For full transparency, we did have an issue with the AC not working in two rooms but they worked to get things fixed as quickly as possible. I would happily stay here again!

The apartment is great. Spacious, modern with lots of light, with everything a family needs for a comfortable stay. The commom areas of the building are also very nice and clean; great pool and great view from the gym. The place is 2 blocks from the subway, with lots of restaurants, convenience stores and groceries nearby. Marcelo was great in showing us around and giving us tips, and very quick to respond to any questions and a small issue we had with the air con. We had a very pleasant stay and highly recommend this apartment in Bs As.
Ralf's place was really good, well located and very secure. Ralf welcomed us when we arrived and showed us the place, he is a wonderful host!

Great apartment in every way...clean, comfortable, and quiet. Great location - easy to get to all the wonderful things BA has to offer. Ralf and Marcelo were fantastic hosts. We couldn't have asked for better. If this place is available, stop looking and BOOK IT!

The condo was even better than expected.  Ralf and Marcello responded to all emails very promptly.  They arranged to have us picked up at the airport which was worth the money.  Marcello met us at the condo and showed us around the condo as well as the facilities(amazing pool for laps)  of the building.  The building (great security) is in a perfect location close to the subway and buses.  There are tons of shops, restaurants etc all within walking distance of the condo.  There are even three good little restaurants across the street from the condo.  We had never been to Argentina and would now highly recommend this condo and it's location for sight seeing. We felt very safe in the condo as well as walking around the neighbourhood at night.  Thanks to Ralf and Marcello for a great stay in B.A.

Beautiful apartment and great location in Palamero Soho. It was perfect for a week stay. The building is safe and secure and there was someone there to meet us and explain the apartment when we arrived. They even assisted us with an airport transfer! The apartment is located near lots of shops, restaurants and bars and easy accessible to other parts of the city.

Excelente escolha. O apartamento é lindo e super bem localizado, o anfitrião muito atencioso, solicito e e til. Sempre q voltar faço questão de ficar aqui, e recomendo em todos os sentidos. Se forem viajantes q j conheçam palermo, saibam q é possível fazer tudo a pé! Maravilhoso!! Nota 1000!

The apt. is an excellent location just one street away from one of the most exclusive shopping streets in BA, and few mins. walk to the Recoleta cemetery and excellent parks. It also one of the more narrow streets so has little traffic other than taxis and delivery vehicles. I didn’t find street noise to be a problem unless you are bothered by vehicles delivering to the rear entrance of the swanky Hotel Alvear almost opposite, which start at about 7.00am.

Whilst some may not find the walk to the closest subway station or the main Retiro long distance bus station exactly close (15 to 20mins. brisk walk to either), just 3mins. or so away there are many local buses to all the main destination in central BA.

The actual apartment is all you could ask for – spacious, nicely furnished, great ambience, good WiFi connection, well equipped kitchen and two supermarkets less then 2 blocks away. Plus excellent coffee shops and restaurants also within few mins. walk.

But don’t expect any great views from the apt. The windows in the living, kitchen and dining room both face inwards to a central “well” and the windows in the 2 bedrooms look across to other apts. on the opposite side of the street. That said, it is still a very light apartment with high ceilings adding to the spaciousness.
Chris has been excellent with his communication as well.

What a great location and a great apartment.  We really enjoyed staying here, the apartment  is on a quiet tree-lined street (as advertised) and is close to plenty of great restaurants, running paths and parks.  Chris was easy to work with and always available on email.  His manager was timely, friendly and helpful.  We will definitely stay here again the next time we are in Buenos Aires.

Unfortunately I couldn t make it to come, but my friend did and called me almost every day. He really liked Chris place a lot and appreciated a lot as well the very warm welcome.

So for sure for my next trip I ll stay with Chris!

Thanks a lot!

You will not find better value then this apartment! it's stylish, very spacious, clean and is equipped with everything you need from champagne glasses to your mate gourd and thermos.  This apartment was beyond our expectations. Located near by all the main attractions in Recoleta - all within walking distance.   A nice plus was the complimentary laundry facilities located on the roof top patio. The check-in and check-out procedure was smooth and efficient. It is located in a posh area providing one of the safest areas in BA.  Alot of designer shops and boutiques.  Although this area is magnificent, you defiantly need to venture out of it and explore the rest of BA.  The best empenada's a are located in Sanjuanino Restaurant just downstairs.

Our stay was wonderful. It was a beautifully decorated and well secured building. We were close to wonderful restaurants and activities. We lived Ralf and the staff.  Very responsive and truly wonderful hosts!  😄  Highly recommend a stay here!

The apartment is great: a very secure apartment on the fourth floor of a high rise with excellent amenities a couple blocks from Plaza Italia.  We couldn't have been happier with it:  physically in the midst of everything, but between security and the fourth floor view, still secluded and private.  Ralf is a tremendous host: always eager to assist in any way to improve our stay.  Just couldn't have been happier with the experience!

I loved this place, I felt super confortable, Marcelo was any moment I needed  for any question and help, the apartment is beautiful and confortable, and the building is amazing! I recommend it 100 %!!
Apartamento excelente, bem localizado. Atendimento de Ralf e equipe fdoi impecável.
Great space, accurate depiction, good location and very helpful/communicative!

Ralf e toda a sua equipe nos receberam muito bem, explicando todos os detalhes da casa e de Buenos Aires para nós, além de dar algumas dicas. A casa estava impecável, arrumada e muito confortável. Alem disso, deixaram agua e algumas frutas para nós. O bairro de Palermo é o melhor lugar para se ficar em Buenos Aires, com lojas, mercadinhos, bares e restaurantes próximos ao prédio. O prédio é muito seguro e possui tudo. Adoramos nosso tempo na cidade!

Ralf's place has a very convenient location, in a radius of 2-3 blocks you have restaurantes, cafeterias, (grocery) shops, bank, laundry etc. And not to forget the SubTe (Underground). When I am traveling for more than 5 days I prefer to cook myself. That was easy in Ralf's apartment, everything is there and working as it should. Good bed, good interior.
This time of the year you need heating one day and the A/C the next. Both working perfectly. Good Gym, friendly security staff.

A place to come back to.
El departamento muy bien ubicado, el departamento es perfecto para visitar en familia, cuenta con todo y ralf es un excelente anfitrión. Sumamente recomendable
Ralf was very attentive and made us feel welcome. The apartment was very comfortable, easy to get to and well located. A great option to work and enjoy in BA!

This apartment is the perfect place to to stay in Buenos Aires!  The neighborhood Palermo Soho is a great place to stay with plenty of restaurants and shopping, also near the subway and buses.  It has 24 hr security and a nice haven from the bustling city.  Ralf and Marcelo are extremely responsive and excellent hosts.  Their attention to detail in the apartment made the stay that much more wonderful. The apartment is even better than the pictures, one of our favorite Airbnbs!
The place has a fantastic location, close to transportation and places to eat. Ralf is very responsive and drawn to details. The condo is chick and has everything you need. We slept amazingly well!!!

We lived in this apartment for six weeks and loved our stay. The location is excellent - close to parks as well as some of the best restaurants in BA and great nightlife.

The building is lovely, with a great pool and gym. The apartment is as pictured and great for up to four guests (we were normally 2, but had friends visit along the way).

And Ralf and his team are extremely responsive, always answering questions quickly and doing more than necessary to ensure our comfort. Highly recommend!
Bei Ralf ist man perfekt aufgehoben!

Ralf and his team were extremely attentive and did everything in their power to make us as comfortable as possible.  The neighborhood was safe, hip, vibrant and full of wonderful restaurants and places for delicious helado.  We were there for 5 weeks and it truly became home.

Our stay was perfect! Ralf and his team are very responsive and answered all of our questions as first-time visitors to Buenos Aires (even questions that were not about the apartment). The apartment is beautiful, clean, exactly as pictured and had sufficient air conditioning for cold-living Canadians).

The pool is heated, beautiful and we used it everyday (we stayed March 4-17, 2018). We were travelling with our 4-year old and we really appreciated the outdoor property. It’s secure so we didn’t need to worry about roads or vehicles. It had a small play structure and a good patch of grass to chill out with the kids.

The area is great. For folks from Toronto it’s like Queen West and Kensington. For others it’s a good trendy area where you can find most anything you need without being overly posh. We found playgrounds, botanical gardens, so many cafes and great places to eat. If you love steak (and you probably better if you are going to BA) you are a very short walk to Don Julio.

Ralf and his team also provide a number of small touches that will make your stay much easier. We felt so welcome and really appreciated how easy this made our entire vacation.
Wonderful apartment and great location! Highly recommend it. Ralf was on it! Loves being in my home country. Gracias!
Ralph is a great host and the place is excellent, we really enjoyed our trip.

We had a wonderful stay at Ralf’s place in Buenos Aires. Both Marcelo and Ralf were very kind and hospitable, and the apartment was nice and comfortable. We felt right at home. The neighborhood is fantastic and the building itself is incredibly safe (gated, 24-hour security, etc.). I never felt unsafe in Buenos Aires, but Ralf’s place is a safe, quiet oasis in the middle of a bustling neighborhood. Highly recommended.
Everything was perfect! Thanks very much!
Awesome.

A friend and I went to Buenos Aires for an almost 2 week visit, and we chose Chris's apartment in Recoleta!  Initially we were entertaining the idea of staying in a hotel, but we each wanted our own room, and frankly 2 hotel rooms for a 2 week stay can get rather pricey.  I would rather spend the money out on the town on food and drinks.  Our check-in went perfect; the apartment manager met us on time out front and got us our keys, made sure we got a tour of the amenities in the apartment, and then let us go our own way to explore the city.  The apartment building itself is on one of the nicest streets in Recoleta, just down the street from the Four Seasons Hotel, and the Patio Bulnes Mall(They have stores such as Fendi, Ferragamo, among many other high end stores). We were also just a few blocks from the Recoleta Cemetery, one of the main tourist sights in the city(the most expensive cemetery in the world I think?  or close to it.)  All in all everything went perfect, I love Buenos Aires(I lived there in 2010), and after 2 weeks we checked out of the apartment without hassle!  All the pictures of the apartment on airbnb.com are accurate, the kitchen allowed us to cook our own breakfast or lunch on occasion, and the location allowed us to traverse the city with ease.  This was a great decision on our part.  It was also very easy to communicate with both the owner and the apartment manager prior to our visit.  Enjoy Buenos Aires!

The check in process was quick and painless, and left us with a sense of comfort. First let me start with the area of Recoleta. For those of you who have been to Chicago, think of the posh restaurants, stores, and cultural icons of the Gold Coast and River North wrapped up in the comfortable and  relaxing atmosphere of Lincoln Square. For those of you who have not been Chicago, take my word for it, you will have no need to eat at the same world class Argentinian Beef house twice, shop in the same artisan and hand made leather shops twice, or run out of museumss to visit. Whats even better than all of that? Jump in a cab, drive five minutes, and you are in the Heart of Buenos Aires and standing in the shadow of famous buildings such the Colon Theater and Casa Rosata, the place of Eva Perons inspiring speech to the Argentinian people. Now for the apartment. The first approach to the private apartment situated on the third  floor of a beautiful building on the corner of a bustling intersection begins with a beautiful corridor that leads to a spiral staircase, or for those who prefer, a vintage and quite beautiful elevator. When you get to the apartment you are greated with stunning parquete wooden floors and a spacious living space with comfortable furniture and seething for plenty. The kitchen provides all of the necessities from a range, fridge and coffee maker, to scotch tumblers and fresh juice squeezer, coupled with granit countertops. The two bedrooms provide plenty of sleeping spaces, comfortable beds, great beddings, and a quite place to retreat after a long day of journeying. Furthermore, there is a more formal dinning area that was great for collecting the group and preparing for the day. Overall I must say, this entire process was a wonderful experience, and I could not hesitate for one second to recommend to anyone planning a trip to BA to contact Chris and ensure that you be the lucky ones to stay at this wonderful place.
