I was proud to have friend, who is now an Ambassador to Argentina, over for dinner one night. The apartment was clean, comfortably and stylishly furnished. There were even fresh flowers in a vase upon arrival. Towels and linens are ample. The apartment has windows in every room and is well lighted.

The property managers met us upon arrival and were available to help us get oriented, deal with any problems throughout our stay, and check us out. We had some problems understanding how to operate the plumbing to ensure running a hot bath, and it was an interesting learning process for us. Easy but not readily understood by Americans. Be sure and get clear about how to maintain the water temperature you want! The security deposit was refunded with no problems after a quick look at things. This is a good practice because the apartment is maintained beautifully and it gave us an opportunity to make a few suggestions for Chris to consider to improve things for the next guest (clarify operational instructions for the phone in English, not just Spanish). Chris is responsive and welcoming of suggestions and seems very hands-on even though he is an absentee owner.
I high recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Buenos Aires. It is more than a great value. It is a home away from home! Thank you Chris for being a wonderful host. I am glad to share the host/guest experience with you and hope we can meet one of these days!

We had a very good time in Chris apartement. A typical french style building with flair. Enough space for up to 4 people. It is in a very beautiful and safe area in Buenos Aires. Wonderful parks and cafes just around the corner. I would recommend trying the restaurant Fervor next door for very good argentinian food.

The flat is also perfectly located to reach other areas like Palermo and San Telmo quickly by bus or taxi. Raul, the property manager, was very helpful. Thank you very much for your hospitality. Emre

Chris and his property managers, the Fanzinis, were extremely helpful throughout. Check in and out was smooth and punctual. The flat is in a great location and was clean, spacious (there were two of us) and well equipped for our one week stay. I have already recommended this flat to other friends who will be visiting Buenos Aires. All in all a lovely base to have on a visit to Buenos Aires.

We loved this appartment, it had everything we needed (including great a/c system!) and we found it to be in a perfect location for us to explore BA. Being so close to all the great Palermo shops and restaurants was fantastic. Thanks Martin!

Martin was awesome. We were in touch before arriving to BA and he was in constant contact with us. He met all our requests including going out in the heat to bring an extra mattress for our baby to sleep on. The Palermo apartment is comfortable and well located.
Este apartamento es excelente! Es comodo, linda decoracion, limpio, con todo lo que una necesita. Tambien esta muy bien ubicado, definitivamente recomiendo al que se quiera quedar!
El depto divino, amplio y muy comodo. Todo barbaro!

Our stay at the Billinghurst apartment was fantastic. Martin was so prompt in his replies, gave us helpful tips about the city, and set up rides for us to the airport. The apartment was in a great location with restaurants, laundry facilities, grocery stores and internet all within one block. It is also close to two metro stops with a direct line to the center of town.
The apartment was quiet and looked exactly like the photos; clean, modern and homey. We would stay there again in a heartbeat!

Martín nos recebeu muito bem e correu tudo conforme combinamos! O apartamento é muito charmoso e aconchegante.O bairro é delicioso e seguro!! Nos transportamos com muita facilidade de ônibus, metrô ou taxi para qualquer lado da cidade. Ele também nos deu várias dicas que aproveitamos muito! Obrigada, Martín e até a próxima!
Súper contentos, ninguna queja del apartamento. Se encuentra en excelente ubicación y es como lo muestran más fotografías,  es ideal para conocer Buenos Aires.
Uma passagem rápida mas muito agradável em Buenos Aires, ótima hospedagem!

Perfect!
We were the second time guest of Martin and we love this apartment as well.
The location is perfect 2 blocks to the subte, in walking distance you will have all the nice places like Palermo Soho and Recoletta. There are a plenty of restaurants nearby, you have also some grocery stores.
The condo is like the pictures. It is very clean, safe, quiet....and you will love it. We did!
Martin is a awesome host.
Highly recommended !

El departamento es excelente, todo súper bien.
Es mucho mas grande de lo que se ve y esta muy bien ubicado.
Martin un buen anfitrión nos envió todas las recomendaciones del viaje.

Absolutamente recomendable
very few hot water
O apartamento é maravilhoso, super bem localizado,  cheio de estilo. E Jesse é um anfitrião perfeito.  Adoramos td!

Apartamento muito amplo, com uma gostosa área aberta de churrasqueira. A frente do prédio não é muito amigável (levamos um susto ao chegar), mas entrando no apartamento, essa impressão mudou! Localização muito boa, próximo a tudo!
Jesse and Juan are great hosts. I was blown away by how helpful they were and how easy they made the stay.

Jesse's place is very well located in Palermo. Comprising 2 large bedrooms, one upstairs and one downstairs, both with ensuites. Another separate bathroom off the dining area is a great bonus. The apartment is huge and well laid out. A lift to the apartment adds to ease of accessibility.
Big thanks to Jesse for making our stay comfortable and accommodating our requirements. Also to Juan for his beautiful attitude and helpful assistance.

The location at the Penthouse is perfect for walking to restaurants and bars. It appears well maintained, but we did have a few things to mention. There is a metal pole down the middle of the upstairs bed and the kitchen drawers came off and fell on my foot. One shower gets no water through the shower nozzle. These could just be the charm of Buenos Aires. We did have a wonderful time.

Thanks Jesse & Juan, Great location with good security, Small supermarket and bakery around the corner, Lift access, 2 private bedrooms with ensuites on different levels and large living areas made it very enjoyable for a small group.
Check in/out was well organised and helpful.
Very nice place and a good neighborhood. Juan will show you good places to visit and eat. Recommended!!

We were absolutely happy with the appartment. It is an open and modern architecture on two floors with two terrasses, one of them on three sides with complete grill and furbishment for the outside. The area is quiet and safe, walking home at night has never been a problem here. The next Subte station is eight blocks away and there many bus lines within a five block walking distance. The communication with the host was efficient and fast and when we needed something we could contact him anytime and got answers quickly. I will certainly book here next time I go to Buenos Aires.

Great location, spacious, excellent communication and responsiveness for check-in and any needs that come up. Overall, the place is a little rundown, but good value given location and spaciousness, plus outdoor areas.

I used Chris's apartment for a week to round out a 3 month trip to Argentina.  The location, design and communication are all top notch.  Chris was quick to respond to my emails and allowed us to change our stay as needed.  The location of this cant be beat, it is in one of the best parts of the city and the place is very tastefully decorated.  I would recommend staying here anytime.
***** great location,comfortable,good property manager. 5 stars. MK

Great apartment!  Clean and simple but very pretty and has everything you need. Parisian fin de siècle type building with great old fashioned elevator that is very clean and well maintained.  High ceilings beautiful windows. Location very central, tree lined block, near parks for running soccer exercise sight seeing. Great typical argentine cafe on the corner for breakfast lunch coffee or a drink. Very upscale neighborhood that is perfect for walking around. Great grocery store nearby. And Chris and Cecilia were awesome -- clear, helpful, reliable and really nice. Would highly recommend.

Beautiful apartment…great location…

Lots of space….

I would book this again...

O apartamento do Mr. Curtis, foi muito util na nossa viagem. O apartamento é realmente o que aparenta nas fotos, além de ser silencioso e protegido das alterações de tempo. Muito agradavel.
Na parte burocrática, fomos atendidos pelo Sr. Raul Franzine, que nos recebeu, prestou as devidas orientações e fez o check-out com rapidez, tudo nos horários previamente definidos. Recomendo.

The apartment was perfect! Very clean, in an excellent neighborhood and Chris was always available before our trip to answer our questions and guide us. My family and I had a great time. I really recommend his apartment. Thanks a lot!!

Chris y Cecilia absolutamente profesionales y amabilísimos. El departamento exactamente igual a lo ofrecido y el barrio es sencillamente el mejor de Buenos Aires. Esperamos regresar el próximo año y promocionar el departamento entre nuestros amigos.




Mauricio y Beatriz Gazitua
Santiago, Chile

Muy buena experiencia, el departamento es realmente cómodo, y la atención y servicio otorgado por los anfitriones fue de primera, la localización del departamento es perfecta para conocer la bella ciudad de buenos aires , pienso volver pronto.

This was a perfect stay. Chris did not miss one detail in making us feel settled, informed, welcome, and answering questions. The apartment  was even better than advertised,  the local manager was on call and gracious. This was a perfect AirBnB experience. The apartment was amazingly well located, everything worked perfectly, from the initial bottle of wine greeting us to the send off before we left. It was a great experience, and the owner took an extraordinary amount of detailed care to make sure we enjoyed not only the place, but the city as well.

Wonderful experience all around! From the time we booked the apartment to checkout Chris, Cecilia and Raul were very professional and attentive.
The apartment is very clean,comfortable, tastefully furnished and well located.
We highly recommend renting from Chris. We will be back again.
Thank you Chris for all your suggestions. Wishing you all the best.

Chris and Cecilia were amazingly helpful. The whole experience staying in the apartment was wonderful. We all loved it! The area was the best and the service, response and help from Cecilia was second to none. There are two fantastic restaurants 30 meters from the apartment entrance. Though we spent a lot of time exploring BA, different suburbs, shops, tango shows, returning back to "Callao and Posadas" was very comforting experience. Thanks a lot, Chris and Cecilia!

Our stay couldn't have been nicer. The apartment is spacious and elegant. The kitchen is well-equipped, the bed is comfortable and the shower has lots of hot water. The airconditioning is very efficient, too. The neighborhood is perfect and centrally located. But most of all the host Chris and the local managers, Cecilia and Raul, were always incredibly nice, informative and willingly helpful. We give the apartment our warmest recommendation.

Tivemos uma estadia muito agradável no apartamento. Na chegada nosso anfitrião nos brindou com um delicioso vinho ( Obrigada !!! ) Realmente nada temos do que reclamar, somente elogios. Tudo deu certo desde o check-in até o checkout. E o bairro é maravilhoso, assim como a rua Posadas muito bem localizada no bairro e com supermercados, restaurantes  e panificadoras tudo pertinho!Recomendo !

The flat is perfectly located in a beautiful and upscale area. It is very modern, elegant and beautiful. It is extremely clean and spacious. A lot of interesting books in the shells. The handling agents were very attentive and helpful. It was very pleasant to deal with Chris. The only thing I thought was unfortunate was that there is not much daylight coming into the living room, but on the other hand there is much light and windows everywhere else.

My family and I travel to Buenos Aires every year or two as my wife is from there and we visit as often as we can. After years of staying in hotels and apartments in Recoleta, our favourite part of the city, I can without a doubt say that this apartment was one of the best experiences we have had. The location is phenomenal, being just a few blocks from the main park, cathedral and cemetery in Recoleta. The unit was very clean and well kept with more than enough space for myself, my wife and my children. We were warmly greeted when we arrived, which was very nice as we had just gone through a 14 hour flight, and check in was simple and effortless. They even called to check up on us during our stay and were there promptly with a taxi for us when it was time to go. All the amenities you could need are located nearby and the restaurants on the street (Fervor, Sanjuanino) were excellent.

Chris was very easy to deal with from the beginning and very helpful even before we arrived. Cecilia and her team were very well prepared and friendly once we were there and by far it was the best experience we have had when finding a place to stay in BA. I will recommend Chris and his apartment to all of my friends and family when staying in BA and will be back here every time we come to BA from now on.

The apt is located in a very safe and clean neighborhood. Minutes away from a park and the famous Recoleta Cemetery. Cecilia and her daughter were great help when needed. We loved staying here for 10 days. Chris was also very easy to communicate. In a few words, lovely  apartment managed very professionally.

Fantastic apartment, with a great location within an easy walk of Palermo Hollywood and Palermo Soho - each of which has a fantastic selection of places to eat and drink.  The apartment is generously-sized, with plenty of space in both bedrooms, the living area, and on the terrace.  The apartment is on the top floor, with easy access by lift.  Check-in and check-out both ran very smoothly.  I'd highly recommend the bakery around the corner from the apartment on Thames, adjacent to the supermarket.

This is a great spot, and was an amazing home base! I highly recommend this spot if you are looking for a place to stay in Palermo!

Outstanding features:
- This apartment is big and bright, with tons of open space. It is a really welcoming space to come home to, and we really enjoyed spending time there on our first ever visit to Buenos Aires.
- Wifi is strong throughout the house (although perhaps a bit spotty in the upper bedroom). There is also cable with the best that Argentinian TV has to offer - for us that was the Copamerica! :)
- There is a wonderful rooftop terrace with multiple seating areas to enjoy the view and the weather during warm seasons. While we couldn't take much advantage of it during our stay because of the winter weather, we loved the space!
- The entire apartment is clean and well appointed, from the kitchen to the three full bathrooms. It felt like a luxurious amount of room.
- Jesse was a great host and very responsive to all of our questions. He was really flexible with an early check-in and all the questions we had.

A couple of things to be aware of:
- The listing mentions an indoor fireplace, but there isn't one. However, there are wall-mounted heaters for each room of the big spacious apartment, so it stays warm if you are visiting Argentina in the winter like we were, especially the bedrooms. For extra comfort during winter, I would recommend bringing some slippers for the hardwood floors.
- This is a great home base for exploring Palermo. The area is safe and we never once felt uncomfortable walking around at night. It's also extremely secure to get into the apartment. That being said, it is a bit of a walk to get to Palermo Soho or Palermo Hollywood and all of the restaurants and bars there - at least 15 minutes to both. There are two convenient Sube stops on the red line, although they are also about 15 minutes away.

Un buen lugar para quedarse y descansar. Zona segura con almacenes locales, restaurantes de calidad y outlet para shopping. Además le comentamos que nuestro vuelo llegaba antes del horario de check in y no tuvo problemas para recibirnos. Ideal para dos parejas.

We stayed at Martin's Alto Palermo apartment for four nights, and it was perfect. The place is bigger than the pictures show, and the apartment is in a really great location that's close to the Recoleta neighborhood (15 min walking), a bunch of restaurants in Palermo (15 min walking), and two subway stations (10 min walking) that will take you anywhere in Buenos Aires. We were greeted by Eduardo, Martin's father, who gave us a lot of really great information on the city. We walked home after dinner around midnight sometimes and felt completely safe; the extra security precautions don't hurt either! We did have some trouble figuring out how to get hot water, but a quick email exchange with Martin fixed that up quickly. Stay at one of Martin's properties if you're in BA; I know we will when we visit BA again!

Boa tarde à todos! Minha primeira experiência com o "Airbnb" não poderia ter sido melhor. O Apto do Martin Pelitti, em Palermo/Buenos Aires, é exatamente como descrito por seu proprietário e como aparece nas fotos. Fomos super bem recebidos por nosso anfitrião. O apto estava limpíssimo, roupa de cama e de banho super cheirosas, tudo perfeito. Martin nos deixou recomendações para o uso do apartamento, dicas no bairro, de taxis e de passeios. Fizemos bom proveito de tudo que nos foi recomendado. Eu, meu namorado e minha sogra já dissemos que a próxima vez que formos a Buenos Aires, já sabemos onde ficar, no apto do Martin. Obrigada por tudo e até a próxima viagem. Abraços Andrea Maureen, Gibran Varella e Patricia Varella (Curitiba-PR- Brasil).

The apartment is well located, spacious and as pictured. Martin was a great and punctual host. We found the place in impecable conditions and with everything you need for your stay in the city. I highly recommend this property !!

My son and I had the good fortune of choosing Martin's AltoPalermo apartment for 8 nights in October.  Martin was extremely good at answering all our pre-arrival questions as well as helping us to get to know the neighbourhood once we had arrived with well-thought out written recommendations for sites to see and excellent restaurants within walking distance.  The apartment with its beautiful traditional Argentine hardwood floors and updated kitchen was clean and exactly as shown in pictures.  It offered a welcome and comfortable resting place at the end of a long day of exploring the wonderful, frantic, beautiful city of Buenos Aires. The area feels extremely safe with many people walking the neighbourhood well into the night and would be an excellent option for a single woman traveller who wished to be assured of security.  There are sidewalk cafes up and down the streets and we already miss our daily cafe con leches and medialunas.  Hot water was plentiful, internet worked well, a wall safe gave us extra piece of mind, laundry facilities where they actually do your laundry for next to nothing is across the street, and the beds were wonderfully comfortable. Martin was always just a phone call away and we would not hesitate to book his apartment again.  Gracias Martin!

Excellent host - very flexible with check in and check out times, as well as advice pre-arrival. Good tips for places to go and see. Great apartment in good area for exploring Buenos Aires. A great experience.

We had a great second stay at this apartment. The property is extremely well located. Martin is an excellent host and very flexible with check in/out times!! The apartment itself has everything you need for a super comfortable stay, Thanks Martin!!

El departamento está espectacular!
Es mas grande de lo que se ve en las fotos y muy lindo. La cama es sumamente cómoda, el baño es limpio y grande. La cocina está equipada con todo lo necesario para cocinar. Fácilmente se pueden hospedar 4 personas con mucha comodidad.
La ubicación fue perfecta, a dos cuadras del Subte que te lleva a todas partes en Buenos Aires. Los primeros dias caminé por la zona y encontré muchos lugares para desayunar y almorzar. Hay un centro comercial y un cine a dos cuadras. La zona es muy segura.
Martín fue un excelente anfitrión.
Cuando vuelva a Buenos Aires, defninitivamente me quedaría aquí de nuevo.

No tuvimos el placer de encontrarnos con Martín y fue su papá el encargado de brindarnos un cordial recibimiento, junto con toda la información necesaria sobre el departamento y el barrio. El departamento es muy cómodo y está muy bien equipado, tan agradable como aparece en las fotos. Su ubicación es inmejorable! La comunicación con Martín fue excelente desde el primer momento.  En síntesis, una muy muy buena experiencia

O apartamento é muito bem localizado, confortável, agradável e acolhedor, os três ambientes (sala com cozinha americana, quarto e banheiro) são todos amplos e possuíam tudo que necessitamos durante uma semana que passamos nele. O Martin foi super bacana a atencioso. é localizado numa excelente região de Palermo, não muito distante da Recoleta também, possuindo uma estação da linha D do Metro em frente ao Shopping Alto Palermo.
Ótimo apartamento, excelente localização. Melhor ainda o Anfitrião que está sempre disponível para qualquer auxílio. Quando voltarmos a Buenos Aires, certamente estaremos lá!

My friends and I had an amazing time during our stay at Martin's. The apartment is perfect. It looks exactly like in the pictures. We couldn't have gotten a better place. If I ever go back to BA I will definitely stay there again, there is no doubt about that.

While we never met Martin we greatly enjoyed our stay at his apartment. As others have stated, the apartment is large, clean, well located and extremely well stocked for your stay. The air-conditioning works well. Everything you need seems to be within a 2-3 block radius, from the main subway line, to grocery stores, pharmacies, money exchanges, restaurants, shops, you name it. The neighborhood is very active and feels very safe with people out at all hours, yet the apartment remains quite. The subway is easy to manage and there are cheap cabs everywhere, including right outside the building. I don’t think we waited more than a minute anytime we tried hailing a cab. FYI, if you are traveling during the summer, make sure you ask the cab driver if they have air-conditioning!

Our flight was an 25 hours late, which was a whole different story, but when we arrived Martin’s father Edwardo and Teresa were there waiting. Martin has an unbelievably detailed information packet printed for you on arrival, from places eat, thing to do, where to change money, etc. On top of that, Edwardo and Teresa after showing us the ins and outs of the apartment, stuck around and chatted with us, gave advice and answered every question that we could possibly think of. Communication was great prior to and during our stay via email or text.

Bottom line, we enjoyed our stay and our experience reinforced all the other good reviews Martin has. Thanks

Notre séjour a été très agréable ! Martin a répondu à toutes nos questions avant notre départ, et les parents de Martin nous ont très bien reçu. L'appartement est très confortable et très bien situé - métro, commerces et restaurants à proximité.
Nous y retournerons !

If you're planning a trip to BA, I cannot recommend this place highly enough!

We (two coworkers and myself) stayed a fabulous month in Chris' apartment, working remotely and enjoying what we now know to be the most beautiful city in the world.

Recoleta is easily the nicest (and safest) spot in BA, and when we thought about the nightly rate we were paying to stay there, we were almost embarrassed, like a bunch of impoverished orphans who had somehow snuck past the guards. In retrospect, we would have happily paid 3x the price for the chance to stay there alone.

But, it's not just the apartment that's lovely. Chris and his onsite manager Cecilia were the most gracious and responsive hosts I've ever encountered in my Airbnbing. They gave us valuable advice before arrival, arranged our airport transfers, and any question or issue we encountered during our stay was handled immediately.

On our first night, we stumbled across Prado y Neptuno, a cigar and cocktail bar located half a block away, and we ended up dropping by most nights for the best made cocktails we've ever had. Ever.

We left our hearts in BA, and if we're ever lucky enough to return, this is the apartment and neighborhood we'll want to call home.
Very nice and clean apartment. Location is perfect for the neighborhood and access to the metro. Highly recommended.
Excelente ubicación, departamento muy cómodo.
Anfitriones muy atentos y encontramos todo de acuerdo a lo ofrecido. Fue una buena experiencia
Hermosa vista, cercana al metro y calles principales. El espacio en el hogar también muy bueno para compartir.
O espaço interno do apartamento é ótimo, Jesse é um grande anfitrião, com boas dicas de lugares e super simpático.

The apartment was in a wonderful part of town and walkable distance from many restaurants and sites. The host provided helpful tips and written guides to the area before arriving. The apartment itself was roomy, light, and pleasant.

The apartment was great. Spacious, comfortable and centrally located. There are some great restaurants close by - and a wash and fold, same-day laundry is right around he corner. A very convenient place to exchange money is right across the street.

Chris provided a lot of helpful information before we travelled. His agent, Cecilia, was prompt and helpful.

Our family of four loved this Recoleta apartment. After two months of traveling in South America, it was great to unpack our bags for ten days and have a place to relax and serve as a base during our time in Buenos Aires. The owner Chris was very responsive in helping arrange our visit, and Raul and Cecilia were great with communications and getting us settled and checked in and out. The neighborhood was perfectly located, and we were able to walk all over, to Palermo and even San Telmo. We used the travel agency across the street to book a trip to Colonia, great experience with the staff. Changing money on the blue market across the street was easy and we are grateful that Chris recommended it. There are many great bars and restaurants close by, including the best empanadas ever at Sanjuanino a few steps away. We cooked meals often as the kitchen is well stocked. Overal we were very pleased with the entire experience, and would definitely return the next time we are in Buenos Aires.

I lived at this property for a full month and it was a great experience.

NEIGHBORHOOD LOCATION/AMBIANCE: This is a very upscale location - think NYC central park or Upper East Side. Around the corner (literally) is Hermes, Recoletta Cemetary, Four Seasons, Palacio Duhau, Fueguia, Sotto Voce, and countless other fine dining and shops. This area is where the older, moneyed residents of Buenos Aires live. You won't find boliches or many kioskas here. There is a lavandería and a black market money exchange office within a few steps of the apartment. Both of these made life very convenient.

APARTMENT: The place was spacious and clean. The linens and mattress were the most comfortable that I've had in BA and this trip was my seventh longterm stay in BA. The bedrooms were big with more than enough closet space for a large wardrobe. The kitchen and dedicated dining area made it a great place for hosting dinners.

RECOMMENDATIONS: If you stay at this apartment, here are a few must do activities that are close to the apartment:
1) Eat at Sotto Voce. Excellent Italian food with impeccable, almost white-glove service. A wonderful experience that starts off with a complimentary Italian-style spritz of the day and delicious picks.
2) Buy Fragrances at Fueguia. One of the world's most exclusive perfumeries.
3) Eat at Elena: Best steak I've had in BA. In the Four Seasons hotel.
4) Buy Wine at Grand Cru: Fabulous wine shop with great service.

The apartment was just like the pictures - beautiful! The entire experience was excellent. Cecilia arranged for transportation from the airport, which was definitely the way to go. She also had some great restaurant recommendations. The building was very secure and the neighborhood was safe. The apartment had all the amenities we needed: stove, iron, microwave, fast Wifi, etc. The kitchen was nicely stocked. There were even power strips with universal plugs! The living room was very nice for relaxing and listening to music. The mattress in the main bedroom was very comfortable. The apartment is within walking distance of many good restaurants and sights. A wonderful visit - we would definitely stay here again!

This place in Recoleta is a dream house! It's perfectly situated in the middle of everything. Close to parks, markets, shopping, and sites. Charming, comfortable, spacious, secure and well appointed. Chris was great at communicating and his property managers in BA, Cecilia and Raul were professional and welcoming.

Vivimos una experiencia única, en un edificio y departamento de primerísimo nivel, en un barrio hermoso de Buenos Aires, céntrico y elegante. El cuidado de las instalaciones y la permanente atención de la administradora de la propiedad fueron cruciales para tener una buena experiencia. El anfitrión fue particularmente atento y extraordinariamente educado.

We had a fabulous experience in Chris's apartment in Recoleta.  The place was managed by Cecilia and her dad Raul.  Ceclia was traveling when we arrived, but Chris and Raul arranged for a driver to meet us at the airport and bring us to the apartment, where Raul was waiting with instructions and tips.  The apartment itself was lovely--high ceilings, heavy doors, and many well-constructed shelves and other built-ins.  The neighborhood was super-convenient.  There were scores of cafes and restaurants within blocks, a laundry around the corner that would wash, dry and fold within a day at a very reasonable price (and offer neighborhood tips for free).  There is a fancy hotel next door and, perhaps for that reason, we never waited more than two or three minutes for a radio taxi.  We would be very happy to stay there again if we return to Buenos Aires.

The apartment perfectly situated in Recoleta, close to several good cafes and there are amenities nearby. The rooms are spacious and the wooden floors are particularly beautiful. The beds are comfortable too. The main bathroom and kitchen could use a bit of an update, but otherwise it is a great spot to spend your stay in BA. And, a special thumbs up to Cecilia who manages the apartment for Chris -- lovely and very accessible.

Jesse's place is great, the location a dream and Jessie and Juan, his operational support on the ground, are great communicators (Jesse first language English). Juan was there as promised when we arrived, showed us the apartment and was on the end of a rapid response WhatsApp when I needed to know something. He lives locally and has great local knowledge which he will readily share. The neighbourhood mini supermarket, fruit and veg store and hyper-cool bar mean you don't need to stray more than 200m for most basic needs. Juan assured me Bar 878 is in the top 5 bars in the world, so check it out and see if he is right - I had other favourites very close by. You will not find a shortage of great things to do in a 5-minute walking radius. The bus and metro connections are plentiful and to all parts of the city.  Catch a single bus to any of the cities main museums. The place needs a bit of TLC  but it is basically fine and great value. The top bedroom is gorgeous, especially if you like 360 cityscape views and we loved it. The bed upstairs is two singles together so not the best for sharing.  The downstairs bed is fine and this is actually the principle bedroom. Both have ensuite bathrooms. We stayed for 8 nights as part of a work trip and having this great apartment made it easy to relax and enjoy the neighbourhood. We didn't need to go out all the time,  just chillin' on the roof terrace was enough.  Breakfast on the lower terrace catches the early morning sun beautifully. There is a fully functioning Asado grill on the roof so why go out? We got some great sunsets and spectacular skies.  I offer an unreserved recommendation I and I will definitely look to stay again.
100 % recomendable. Muy cómodo y excelente ubicación.

We couldn’t be happier with our stay at Jesse’s Airbnb.  A warm welcome from Juan (property manager) started our two week stay. The apartment had everything from three terraces, a well equipped kitchen, comfortable beds, a washing machine and wi fi.  It felt like a home. We settled into the neighborhood quickly with its quiet streets and nearby grocery/bakery.  Anything else we needed seemed to be no more than 10 minutes away: subway, coffee shops, cafes and restaurants.  Jesse responded immediately to all of our inquiries, everything from our early checkin/late check out requests and minor questions regarding the property’s utilities, fixtures, amenities, etc. In all, the best Airbnb experience we have had - Thank you Jesse!

The apartment is exactly as the photos show but seems more spacious when you are in it. Every thing we needed for 2 friends staying one week in BA was provided, even the sofa bed was comfortable, easy to use and to put away. I particularly enjoyed the powerful shower which is sometimes a disappointment in other places including hotels! Clean, cool and quiet at night time, the apartment is perfectly located for shops, transport and sight seeing. We felt safe at all times of day and night and the local Supermercado was very friendly and well stocked for all our needs!

Our flight arrived earlier than the usual checki in time and Marin was flexible about us dropping our cases off immediately after the other guest left and while the place was being thoroughly cleaned. His info pack is very useful for first timers like us. Martin himself is friendly, helpful even offering to be available by email or phone if we needed any extra help or local tips.

We were delighted with the apartment, location, Martin's engagement with us and the hassle free trip we enjoyed. Our first Airbnb booking has been a great success.

Excellent first experience with Airbnb.  I am Argentinian and was visiting family for two weeks with my husband. Martin and his mom Teresa were really lovely and super attentive. The flat was great, comfortable, with all necessary amenities, stylish and the location could not have been better. There was a small issue with the building but the hosts acted very quick to try to solve it and made sure we were happy. I would defenitely recommend it.

Es un contrafrente bien ubicado.Buen precio.Tranquilo.

Martín y su Mamá nos han atendido muy bien.Cálidos y atentos a lo que hemos necesitado.
The apartment looks just as it does in the photos.  Extremely clean and well-maintained.  The location is ideal.  Perfect for one person or a couple.  Gracias, Martín!

Excelente departamento con todo lo necesario para una estadia en Buenos Aires.  La ubicacion es perfecta. Ampliamente recomendable. Martin es excelente anfitrión y siempre esta disponible para atender cualquier duda. Gracias Martin!

The apartment was amazing, much bigger than expected! Tony was there to greet my partner upon arrival and gave loads of useful info on the surrounding areas, things to see and do etc... The apartment was in the perfect location for all the bars and restaurants in Palermo and had great access to the centre via the subway at the bottom of the street (2 blocks).

My son, daughter and I had a wonderful stay in Martin's apartment. He replied to my emails before we arrived and we were met by a friend of his who showed us everything in the apartment. Martin was very flexible about our check-out time, which was extremely helpful.
The apartment looks exactly as it does in the photos. It was clean, modern and felt airy. The apartment is at the back of the building and is quiet. The bed in the bedroom is very comfortable, and so was the pull-out couch. We felt very safe in the neighborhood, which was extremely convenient to every part of Buenos Aires.
The hot water in the shower was a little finicky, but Martin told us the trick is to run the hot water in the kitchen sink first, and that gets the pilot light working better. Doing that worked. We were very comfortable. Everything in the apartment was of a high quality. I would stay there again and recommend it highly.

Beautiful apartment in Alto Palermo. The apartment was very nice, clean, and with a wonderfully comfortable bed. We stayed there for 5 days in the winter, including a couple of pretty cold nights, and the heat kept the apartment warm and cozy. There was also AC, which we did not get to try. There was fast wifi in the apartment as well, which is nice addition.

The area felt pretty safe and the host, Martin, was excellent. I would highly recommend this apartment.

Martin was responsive, friendly and helpful host. Traveling alone, Martin happily assisted with my enquiries and was able to provide some very helpful suggestions.

The apartment was excellent, clean, comfortable, good location and as described.

I highly recommend Martin as your host in Buenos Aires.

O bairro e um dos melhores da cidade, tem bons transportes e serviços de banco,restaurantes e cafes. O anfitriao e uma pessoa muito gentil e educada,oferece as informaçoes necessarias e fica a disposiçao dos hospedes
Ótimo apartamento, muito bem localizado. Anfitriões solícitos, estadia muito agradável: recomendo!
Espectacular el departamento! Muy cómodo, divino y con una excelente ubicación. Martín un fenómeno, muy dispuesto a ayudar. Voy a volver.
Es todo muy cómodo y espacioso. La ubicación inmejorable. Muchas gracias !!
El apartamento es cómodo, amplio y cumple exactamente con lo ofrecido en la plataforma. Cecilia, la persona encargada esta muy atenta a cualquier requerimiento de los huéspedes.
good choice!

El apartamento está excelentemente ubicado en el corazón de Recoleta, con la cercanía suficiente para disfrutar, pero sin soportar el ruido y el tráfico pesado de la zona.

Esta muy bien equipado y la realidad es tal como se evidencia en las fotos.

Las calles aledañas tienen buena oferta de restaurantes y tiendas.

La movilidad desde allí a cualquier lugar de CABA es muy ágil.

Chris está atento a responder rápidamente cualquier inquietud.

Our family had an excellent stay at Chris's home. Check-in  & check-out was easy. The location is perfect - close to everything you need; grocery, restaurants, parks, playgrounds, sights or a Uber ride away. The condo itself is on the 3rd floor, with elevator, and is extremely spacious. Beds were comfortable, kitchen well equipped for cooking. We were very happy with our choice and would stay at Chris's home again in the future.

This is an amazing place, its big, clean, amazing location, and the perfect host. Gave us all the information we needed to have a good time. We had family in town as as well and hey all agreed this was the best place to hang out and spend memorable times. The host was amazing by allowing us to stay an extra night due to flight changes. I would recommend to get this place when you visit Buenos Aires.

Muy buen depto amplio y cómodo en un edificio tranquilo y una zona segura y exclusiva de la ciudad. Nosotros éramos 4 y el depto fue muy funcional y confortable. Los anfitriones se preocuparon porque todo estuviera bien. Nos sentimos como en casa. Gracias!

The apt was just as advertised. It was clean and the space is large, comfortable for a family. Cecilia (manager) is very attentive and responsive and ensures you have everything you need throughout your stay. The location is great, near cafes and restaurants and in one of the best places in BA.

Cool apartment in the choice area of Recoleta. Close to many shops and excellent restaurants and handy to anywhere in central BA. Chris' property managers are prompt and friendly...very good service for both check-in and out. Overall an excellent value for the location.
Great apartment, good communication with Chris and his team, and especially great service from Cecilia.
Bigger than the pictures. Best neighborhood in Buenos Aires hands down. Don't look any more and book this place before you miss out.

If you've ever been to Buenos Aires you already know Recoleta is the place to be. This flat is located in a privileged spot, quiet but steps away from where you want to go: touristic attractions, restaurants, pubs, shops, cinemas.
The building is a high-quality petit hotel, very well preserved, with extraordinary details in its architecture and materials. The flat is comfortable, well maintained and fully equipped, perfect for a family or a party of four.
The contact person, Cecilia, is a beautiful and charming woman that made sure everything was perfect and it sure was.
Renting this flat was a brilliant decision that made our trip to be even a better one. THANK YOU.

Si alguna vez has ido a Buenos Aires ya sabes que el barrio de la Recoleta es el lugar donde quedarte. Este apartamento tiene una ubicación privilegiada, está en una zona tranquila pero a pasos de donde querrás ir: atracciones turísticas, restaurantes, bares, tiendas, cines.
Un casa francesa de 4 plantas muy bien conservada con extraordinarios detalles arquitectónicos y materiales de calidad. El apartamento es muy cómodo, está bien mantenido y completamente equipado, perfecto para una familia o para un grupo de 4 personas.
La persona de contacto, Cecilia, es una bellísima y encantadora mujer que se aseguró de que todo estuviera perfecto y así fue.
Alquilar este apartamento fue una magnífica decisión que sin duda alguna hizo que nuestro viaje fuera aún mejor. MUCHAS GRACIAS.

The apartment is big and specious with everything you need to have a pleasant stay. It's spotless clean and Cecilia, the property manager is very helpful.

The street is quite busy in the morning and there is some noise from the cars. If you like to get up early this will not be a problem for you. If not, you might need earplugs.

The area has everything you'll need: cafes, restaurants, bars, supermarket and everything not more than 5 minutes away on foot. Access to other parts of the city, like the centre, Palermo etc is 15-30 minutes by bus

Overall we enjoyed it.

Cet appartement est situé dans le plus chic quartier de la ville et tout près du cimetière de la Recoleta. Voisin immédiat de l’hôtel  Meliá, vous n’aurez aucune difficulté à prendre un taxi dès que vous le désirez. L’appartement est grand, silencieux et comprend a/c et une cuisine complète à l’exception d’une laveuse à linge et d’une sécheuse. Cependant, un laundromat se trouve juste au coin de la rue. Il est accessible par un superbe ascenseur. Tout simplement parfait pour 4 personnes.

It’s a wonderful building and apartment to either spend time in or return to at the end of the day. Everything went very smoothly and it’s a great location!! I would definitely stay in the same place or any of the apartments Chris has. He was great and patient. I’m a nervous traveler. Thank you for everything!!!
This is your place to stay in Argentina! You will definitely feel at home by staying here, amazing historical architecture comfy and cozy living area. Don’t think twice! This is the place to be!

O espaço é exatamente o que está descrito no site
A localização é muito boa, próxima ao hotel Alvear
Recomendo para 4 pessoas
Chuveiro quente e apartamento com ótimo aquecimento
Really nice apartment, highly recommended.

I had a great experience at Martin's apartment. It was just like the pictures- clean, up to date, and cozy. Martin was very patient, meeting me late in the day when I was originally supposed to arrive in the morning- and was lovely about letting me stay late the day I left.  The wifi was great! The only thing that was a bit of an issue was the construction happening next door, so it was VERY loud during the day. Most of the time that wasn't an issue because I was out and about, but sometimes it was hard to be in the apartment because of the noise. That is totally not something Martin can control, but it is a good thing to check on. The location was also fantastic. Overall- excellent!

Estamos muy conformes con el departamento, es muy cómodo y tranquilo, y se encuentra en una muy buena ubicación en la ciudad, teniendo oportunidad de hacer muchas cosas en las cercanías. Y la atención de Martin, es excelente, ya que nos proporcionó ayuda desde un principio. Muy muy recomendable. Definitivamente... volveremos pronto.

Excelente o apartamento. Martin e seu pai são ótimos anfitriões. Falam português muito bem. A localização do Ap é ótima. Certamente voltaria a me hospedar neste ou em qualquer outro dos imóveis da família. Recomendo.

The apartment was in a nice and convenient location, very clean and spacious. The bed was very comfortable. The only issue was that there was no extra toilet paper and the hot water in the shower kept going on and off. But Martin had shown how to get the hot water back on when it gets cold so it was fine.

On my day of departure, it was raining hard, and in Buenos Aires, it's difficult to get a taxi on a rainy day, even if you request one by phone. Martin's father was so kind to walk out and help me hail down a taxi in the rain and tell the driver in Spanish where to go.
Foi tudo bem de acordo com o anuncio!

Très joli appartement, bien décoré et propre. Seul regret : le manque de luminosité.
Appart très bien situe dans un quartier agréable.

Lovely and quiet place at a great location near Diaz and Santa Fe. Checkin was smooth and Martin and his family made us (couple from Amsterdam) feel welcome. The fridge broke down, but was replaced by a new one by Martins father straight away. Very nice man by the way, we chatted for half an hour. Stayed here for two weeks while doing our Spanish course. Icecream around the corner is heaven. Subte (metro) nearby and a list of restaurants etc provided by Martin. Would definately stay here again! Thx Martin.

Martin and his family welcomed me very well. I felt like I've already knew each other before. The apartment is really incredible and I had a GREAT time there. It was exactly as described. 5 stars to the bed, which was really nice and comfortable.

The apartment is located on the first floor of a condo building at the back, therefore it was very quiet. Everything was as described. Martin was helpful when the wifi broke down and set up a workable solution as we had to remain in contact with the office. The wifi repair came on our last day and things worked perfectly. Have to compliment Martin on taking the time and his parents were super helpful. We would definitely stay again..thanks Martin. One thing to keep in mind...the telephone system prefixes are unusual and depending on where you come from, you cannot reach the local numbers easily. We found a helpful passer by who called Martin for us..perhaps look up dialing codes when you are still at home and give it a try.

Martín es un excelente anfitrión, muy amable y pendiente de sus huéspedes.

El apartamento es tal y como muestra en la foto, es muy acogedor y tiene todo lo necesario para una agradable estadía. Tiene una habitación y el sofá puede convertirse en cama.

El lugar en el que está ubicado es Palermo, por lo tanto lo hace central para muchas actividades. Hay una línea de subte (metro) muy cerca (Bulnes), además tienes al alcance de la mano todo lo que se necesita: fruterías -verdulerías, panadería, mini supermercados (tienda de abarrotes), lavandería, cafés, peluquería (salón de belleza).

The apt was as described & very clean with all amenities . Unfortunately, the wifi did not work for a couple of days. It did get fixed. Martin paid for my coffee bar bills where I was able to use wifi. He was very apologetic and kind. The apt is a great location & he provides many recommendations & tips. I very much enjoyed my stay.
Excelente el departamento y con la información necesaria para manejarnos por la ciudad. Muy limpio y exactamente igual a como sale en el aviso! Felicitaciones Martín.

El departamento era tal cual como habiamos visualizado en el anuncio (limpio, moderno, con todas las comodidades), eso es importante porque sería una gran decepción como inicio del viaje. La ubicación es muy buena, en una zona rodeada de bares, restaurantes y comercios. No conocimos personalmente a Martín, una amiga nos entregó las llaves y nos contó los detalles necesarios para una buena estadía. La pasamos muy bien, lo elegiriamos de nuevo.

El departamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos. Está muy bien decorado y es muy amplio, y está super limpio. Tiene todo lo que se necesita para una estadía cómoda (vajilla necesaria, plancha, secador de pelo, etc). Tiene mucho lugar de guardado.
El barrio es hermoso, el departamento está muy bien ubicado. La comunicación con Martín fue excelente en todo momento. Ya lo hemos recomendado a amigos y familiares en Córdoba :)
Spacious apartment in Palermo/Crespo , not too far to walk to good restaurants.

The place was cool and well suited for the three of us. Upstairs was quiet from downstairs—major plus. WiFi didn’t work upstairs, though. Not a huge issue. Clean linens. Clean common area. Well-located to Palermo and some great restaurants. Host was super great at communications, and checking in and out was a breeze
Great Location, big spaces. Ideal for two couples

Espace design et très bien meublé ou l’on se sent bien.
La disponibilité de l’hôte et ses conseils ont été très utiles. Appartement bien placé dans un quartier calme, sûr et très agréable avec de bons restaurants à proximité. Roof top absolument génial pour relaxer et manger!
Great Host, recommendations and punctual reception!
Residência exatamente como mostra nas fotos, limpa, bem localizada, proprietário muito hospitaleiro e atencioso! Estadia maravilhosa!

Stylish, large apartment with lots of natural light in great location in Buenos Aires. Good AC and strong WiFi throughout the apartment. *Families with kids under 5 need to be careful with the indoor staircase and the outdoor areas that aren't safely guarded.

We enjoyed our stay at Jesse's apartment in Buenos Aires very much. His place was great for 2 couples and the location was superb for seeing the beautiful city of Buenos Aires.  Taking Uber was very easy. The layout and space provided was exceptional. Enjoyed being able to wash our clothes too. Access to fresh groceries and shopping was appreciated. We would recommend Jesse's place to anyone wishing to visit B.A. !

Thx for the great stay at your apartment, it was awesome!

The neighborhood is really nice, safe, clean - it's a calm street and still pretty close to a lot of the most interesting and popular places.

They even changed pillows while we were there! Superb!

All communication was super fast, everybody was always on time - excellent!

We really enjoyed it and will highly recommend it to anyone ever going to Buenos Aires!
A great location in a wonderful neighbourhood!

A localização é excelente, com vários cafés próximos, uma casa de cambio em frente com a melhor taxa e muito próximo a Recoleta. O espaço é bom para até 4 pessoas. A Chris nos deixou muito a vontade e respondia rápido a quaisquer dúvidas.
Great location! Well serve area. We got great help from Cecilia. Mingo, the driver recommended  was extremely helpful

Classic French style apartment in a quiet street in Recoleta. Very confortable and close to everything! Host was super helpful and attentive. I would definitely consider staying here next time I visit!

Wonderful apartment in a great location, quiet building surrounded by many restaurants, coffee shops, retails stores, etc. The apartment is very spacious with comfortable beds, sheets, smart TVs, fully equipped kitchen. Cecilia the host is the best! Super professional and attentive. Very easy check in and out.  She made sure everything went great. We will book again soon!
wonderful old style French apt bldg with all the modern amenities, in a very convenient location in the city
Beautiful home in a beautiful area! Everything worked really well for us. Close to bus station and subway, as well as lots of fantastic restaurants. Would definitely stay here again!
Outstanding apartment in the nicest area of Buenos Aires. Walking distance of everything you want. Lovely building and lovely apartment. Chris will help you out with anything you need.
Fine location. Friendly and helpful local contact.

My stay overall was very good. The apartment is very well located and comfortable. Chris and Cecilia were very attentive, accommodating and responded fast.

The layout of the apartment is great, but the place is dated, the walls, windows, shutters, and curtains are worn out. At arrival, the place was clean except for the refrigerator, vent and windows in the kitchen and small bathroom (there are pigeons in the interior courtyards) and big bathroom bathtub area, but upon mentioning this to the manager, the housekeeper, Julia, immediately responded and came to clean.

The beds were very comfortable. The internet was good and so were the two TVs and the music center.

Excelente ubicación en lo mejor de Recoleta, limpieza, comodidades, baños y la atención de Cecilia. Departamento antiguo muy bien conservado y decorado, techos altos, fresco, con todas las necesidades incluidas, etc.
Recomendable

Chris e Cecília foram muito atenciosos, localização perfeita..
Apartamento muito confortável e limpo. Obrigado Chris... Obrigado Cecília.

O apartamento é muito bonito, espaçoso e confortável. Sua localização é fantástica! A rua é arborizada com restaurantes e cafés bem próximos, muitos parques e espaços culturais na região. A rua é muito tranquila mas sempre viva. Não há localização melhor em Buenos Aires! Chris sempre muito gentil e atencioso e Cecília sempre muito prestativa e ágil também.  Nossa temporada nesse apartamento foi maravilhosa!

Cameron was a great host and helpful with all our questions. The apartment was in a great location, Recoleta, with easy access to all the sites in Buenos Aires. We enjoyed our stay.
Thanks!
Marcia and Chuck
All good, location is great, building is super stylish, apartment is comfortable and very spacious!

The apartment is much better than the pictures! It has been difficult to quit.

The area is perfect—quiet and yet three blocks from the hustle and bustle of the Palermo neighbourhood.
I do not hesitate to say that it has been the best Airbnb experience in Buenos Aires.

Great place to stay at, specially when you’re with a group.
Jesse and Juan were great hosts, really helpful when dealing with some inconveniences.
The apartment is very beautiful, really modern with a very artistic touch.
The terrace/deck setting is the is great for days you want to stay in and enjoy the foliage covering the architecture.

Stylish and huge Airbnb with a large rooftop terrace!

Local excelente para descansar e para home office. O Juan e o Jesse são muito atenciosos, prestativos e preocupados com a estadia dos hóspedes.

Proximos tem restaurantes e lojas. Fica 6 quadras de Palermo Soho, onde tem uma variedade grande de bares e restaurantes.
Sigam as dicas do Juan para compras e restaurantes. Todas valeram muito a pena!

Excelente lugar para descansar y para home office. Juan y Jesse son muy atentos, serviciales y preocupados por la estancia de los huéspedes.

Cerca hay restaurantes y tiendas. Se encuentra a 6 cuadras de Palermo Soho, donde hay una gran variedad de bares y restaurantes.
Sigue los consejos de Juan para compras y restaurantes. Todos valieron la pena!

Jesse's place is an incredible find! The complex itself is beautiful -- covered in greenery and has a great sunset view from the rooftop. The apartment was even better in person than the photos. It's located between Palermo and Villa Crespo and so easy to walk everywhere. It's a little far from subway stops, but we used uber if we were going out of the neighborhood and had no issue with that. Safe area and there's a locked gate to get into the complex with just a few other apartments. I would stay here again, and also recommend checking out Grano Santo down the street -- a food hall with many options.
Great flat with a lot of of outdoor space, which is rather rare in BA.
great place! Perfect location. Will definitely be back.
Great location with lots of room.   We loved the two level deck, including a Parilla.  Host was responsive and helpful.
100 porciento recomendado

O apartamento é exatamente como da foto. Muito bem localizado, restaurantes, mercado, lojas, metrô. A receptividade de Juan é um show a parte com suas indicações de restaurantes, bares e sua proatividade para resolver quaisquer questões. Com certeza voltaremos!
our stay at Jesse's place was relaxing and comfortable.  the space is cozy and very quiet.  Easy access to everywhere. We are looking forward to come back next year

La comunicación con Juan es perfecta siempre atento a ayudar. El Depto es de dos pisos y es hermoso. Una mezcla de moderno con la calidez  de los pisos de madera. La ubicación me encantó pues tiene todo cerca sin perder la tranquilidad.
apartamento muito bonito e bem localizado .Juan sempre muito gentil e a disposição para qualquer solicitação.
Spacious and gorgeous. apartment at the Heart of the upcoming Villa Crespo Neighborhood. Jesse and Juan, we're very accommodating to our requests. The rooftop Is very cool. Highly recommended.

Incredible place! Floor to Ceiling sliding glass walls in every room! Super deluxe architectural design. Elevated walkways to the apartment from the elevator. Inside: Lots of light and air through the sliding doors. Two floors, both wrapped with terraced balconies complete with furniture and decking. Nice to sit outside and listen to the birds. Ample curtains if you want to take a nap and shut out the sun. And very quiet day and night. Three nice bathrooms with good water and showers. Kitchen was well-stocked and furnished with nice appliances. One bedroom upstairs and one downstairs. Very comfortable beds and nice bedding.
Near many restaurants, especially the famous La Cabrera. Tip: Stand in line at 5 PM to get a number for the "Happy Hour." At 6 they call you for an incredible meal, everything on the menu including top-shelf wine 40% off!!! Also recommend nearby Sarkis, and locals' place Lo de Jimena. Money: get 2X exchange rate at Western Union!!
Juan was great!
Tudo correu de forma perfeita. O Juan (co-anfitrião) é muito simpático e foi muito disponível e solicito. A casa é realmente incrível e superou nossas expectativas. Com certeza voltaremos!
It was an amazing stay. Looking forward to visiting the city in the near future and hopefully can stay here again. Everything about it was incredible!

The apartment has  good natural light and is spacious. The photographs are an accurate reflection. For us the location is excellent, new restaurants with a fresh intake on food within walking distance.  The great advantage of the apartments is Juan, who looks after the apartment, attentive, quick to respond and very helpful. We would stay again and strongly recommend it.
perfect and Juan is the most amazing host

Great apartment in a great location!.. just 1 block from the Subte station, it is a deal! Everything is close, drugstores, restaurants, banks, grocery stores..For those who like sushi, I enjoyed the Sushi Roll fast food restaurant, one block from the apartment, it is a must.

This apartment is big and perfect equipped! It is very central and quiet! Theatres, Malls and Cafes are next to the apartment. The furniture is tasteful and comfortable. There is enough space for four or five people to stay. During our Argentina trip this apartment was the best one! We really enjoyed it! Highly recommend!
Great apartment and location, Ana is a very kind host.
It´s a good apartament, clean and in a good street.
Todo el departamento es tal cual la descripción, todo estuvo perfecto,  muchas gracias Martin. Verdaderamente fue una muy buena experiencia!!!

Excelente. Muy lindo el depto., tal como lo describen las fotos, cómodo, funcional, limpio y tiene todo lo necesario, no falta nada. Muy buena ubicación. Martín muy atento, aunque no lo conocí personalmente estuvo siempre a disposición y envió a una persona muy dispuesta y simpática. Todo genial.

Hello Martin,

I have just one word for the quality of the appartment: Fantastic!!!

No conocimos a Martin, pero Shangai nos recibió y dio las indicaciones en el manejo del departamento.
El departamento es limpio, silencioso, con muy buena ubicación tanto desde el punto de vista de los medios de transporte, centros comerciales, como desde lo que hace a la seguridad. Es como se ve en las fotos.
El único inconveniente que encontramos es que éramos 4 y necesitábamos hacer uso de la cama del living. Si bien la ventana del living cuenta con el mecanismo roller (black-out) como se puede apreciar en las fotos, la cortina no se encontraba, resultando en una gran claridad que imposibilitaba dormir más allá de las 9 de la mañana. Al margen de este faltante, sería conveniente tal vez, que la ventana de la cocina contara con algún mecanismo para restringir la luminosidad.

Everything was great. The location is just one of the best in buenos Aires for Palermo / Recoleta neighborhoods

Martin is a great host and the apartment, despite has no direct sun light, is quite good and neat.

La experiencia fue muy buena. Todo fantástico por la ubicación central respecto de buenos aires y los barrios de recoleta Palermo. Martin un maestro.
Si bien no da luz de sol directa, el Depto es muy agradable y cómodo.

I stayed two months at this tastefully decorated and renovated two- room apartment. You can see the level of care and attention it has been put to it and Martin and her parents go great lengths to make your stay comfortable and make sure you have everything you need.
The bedroom is super quiet and night and the bed amazingly comfortable. The rooms are ample and the general feel of the place is amazing, a home away from home.
I highly recommend this listing!

Very comfortable and modern apartment, perfect location. Four minutes to the subway station, and many bus lines. Plenty of restaurants and stores in the area.

We would book it again without thinking.

We recently rented the apartment from 16 nights. We informed the host that flight would be arriving early in the morning and he said it there was no problem with that and we could do the check in without any problem.Before arrival we confirmed the arrival time would be 5am in the morning. The host  immediately said he would not be able to be there that early.So he made us wait outside with all the luggage in the cold and rain for 45 minutes.Then, when he arrived he did not even apologize and was totally careless!!. Then when I asked him how many times the cleaning would be he said once per week, but the cleaning just happened once in the almost 3 weeks we were there. We felt Martin did not care to host us kindly. We were expecting a high quality service for what we paid which it was quite a lot. Regarding the place, location is convenient and safe, apartment is in good conditions and very comfortable.

Espectacular  todo, Martín estuvo todo el tiempo atento a las necesidades de mis padres, que fueron los que utilizaron el apartamento. El lugar está muy bien ubicado y el diseño es muy cómodo y funcional, además de silencioso. Las fotos reflejan fielmente lo que es el apartamento, de verdad 100% recomendable y seguramente intentaremos hospedarnos nuevamente allí.
Departamento amplio y comodo. Muy bien decorado. Buena calefaccion. Volveria sin lugar a dudas . El anfitrion atento desde el primer momento

Martin has a terrific apartment listing. Very clean, has everything one needs, and located in an amazing neighborhood. Everything was really comfortable, and although Martin could not meet us upon checking-in, he made sure someone was in the apartment waiting for us to explain everything and make sure we were settled.

Desde el primer contacto, Martín se mostró atento y disponible a cualquier modificación. El apartamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos, hasta mas lindo personalmente me atrevería a decir. Super amena y agradable la estadía en el mismo.  Volveríamos sin dudas a elegir a Martín como anfitrión.

El apartamento fue igual a como se ve en las fotos, éramos tres personas y tenía todo lo que era indispensable en nuestra estadía: la cama era cómoda al igual que el sofacama, tenía toallas, cobijas de sobra y varios utensilios para la cocina. La decoración es muy linda, el wifi es bueno y en general el apartamento está equipado con todo lo necesario para la estadía. Queda muy cerca a una avenida principal así que el transporte también es muy bueno. Aunque Martín no nos pudo recibir, siempre estuvo pendiente cuando le escribí y solucionó todas nuestras dudas, además nos envió una guía que fue muy útil en donde nos indicaba los diferentes medios de transporte, restaurantes cerca, etc. En definitiva lo recomiendo totalmente!

Martín! Muchas gracias por todo. Excelente el departamento. Todo impecable y preparado para lo que necesitábamos.
Saludos!
Martin's place is exactly how it looks on the pictures and it is well-located. I will reccomend his place to anyone going to Buenos Aires.
Excelente como siempre! El apartamento súper limpio, cómodo y cerca de todo! Un placer alquilarle siempre a Martín.

I had a great time staying here. The apartment was clean, cute and conveniently located to a lot of fun things to do in Buenos Aires.  Plus, there were some great cafes just mere feet away. I highly recommend staying here!

Gracias MArtin! Mi amiga se fue feliz! Yo conozco la zona y es comodísima y tu departamento es precioso.

Ojala nos podamos ver pronto de nuevo.

Martin met us late at night which was much appreciated and took time to explain not only the mechanics of the apartment but also answered all of our questions about BA. His information sheet was very useful.

Martin's place is very nice.. Just as described in the listing. Only 2 drawbacks.. First the hot water is inconsistent.. The nice lady who let me in showed how you have to run the hot water in the bathroom sink before turning on the shower.. But also when using the kitchen sink sometimes..

Second, all the windows look to the interior so you don't really have a view if that is important..

Otherwise it was a nice modern place... Check out is complicated if Martin or one of his associates is not there to let you out.. In Buenos Aires all of the buildings lock outside and inside, but you need to leave the keys inside the apartment itself.

El departamento estaba en excelentes condiciones, igual o mejor  de como se ve en las fotos, muy bien decorado y pensado para simplificar toda la estadía. Lo recomendamos y sin duda volveríamos en cualquier momento. Muchas gracias a Martin!
We enjoyed our stay at Martin's place! The apartment is spacious, comfortable and quiet. Martin's tips and recommendations were very helpful too! Definitely recommended.
Excelente recepción como siempre!

My stay in Martin's apartment was excellent. Everything was 100%, or as they say in Argentina, "10 puntos". The location is the best in BA, near all the shops and cafes and entertainment, yet the apartment is very quiet and peaceful. It's also very well appointed with anything a guest might need for a short or long stay. Highly recommended.

The appartment of Martin is a very nice place, well design and spacious. The location is excellent (next to good restaurants and close to the shopping streets of Buenos Aires). Martin has been very responsive to any questions or requests we had about the place before and during our stay. This place is excellent for visiting the capital

Todo perfecto!!! si bien no pasamos mucho tiempo en el alojamiento mas que para dormir, Muy buen lugar, es moderno y no hay nada malo, no es un edificio con poca gente y eso nos gusto mucho, no hay ruido, es muy comodo y se respetan los horarios de descanso. Estabamos muy cerca de Av. Santa fe y de nuestro lugar de nuestro Congreso.
Martin was easy to deal with and responsive.
Martin is a great host. He is very helpful with my inquiries and communication was easy. I stayed at 2 of his listings already and both apartments are nice, particularly this one at Alto Palermo.

I booked this apartment for my parents and they loved it! The apartment is spacious and has everything you need. It's well located with lots of cafes and restaurants. Next time they come back to visit they will probably choose to stay here again.
El lugar muy bueno con excelente ubicación, todo funciono perfecto
Great apartment in an excellent location! Host Martin is very nice and was flexible with our late check in and with checking out. We would definitely stay there again.

The apartment is superb. Perfect ratings. It is much prettier and more spacious than the photos show, with an ambience of "home" that it vibrates.  Everyone who visited me commented on how beautiful the apartment was and how comfortable they felt.  I stayed two months and one day later, I already miss it! The bedroom has great storage for clothes, a hair dryer, an iron, a safe for valuables, like passport, a new dresser and cable television. The bed is very comfortable. The bathroom is lurious and always clean. The living area is spacious and homely. The kitchen is well equipped for anything you want to cook. For travellers staying a short time, you will read from other guests that its very handy to everything, restaurants, bars, supermarket, fresh fruit, bakery, the subte and colectivos. If you're like me and interested in dance, its close to all the good dance studios. My personal relationship with Martin was very positive. He always responded quickly to anything I asked, was quick to problem solve, and was also laid back. A top guy. He also has a lovely mother, who I met. Ruth, the cleaner, does an amazing job every week. In summary, I had the very best stay in this apartment, and by staying there, it positively influenced my time in Buenos Aires. I would give it perfect ratings without hesitation. Oh, yes, its VERY quiet, with respectful neighbours. The perfect sleep you will ever get in the most comfortable bed. You will need to set an alarm to make sure to wake up and enjoy Buenos Aires!
Buen alojamiento. Bien ubicado y muy bien acondicionado

A localização do apartamento é excelente, com farto comércio a pouca distância à pé (supermercados, farmácias, cafeterias - tem um Havanna na esquina!, restaurantes, lanchonetes, kioscos, shopping, hortifrutis.... ). É um bairro muito seguro para caminhar inclusive à noite. Possui um deslocamento muito fácil para todos os lugares através de metrô e ônibus ou à pé, pois como a cidade é plana é tranqüilo fazer longas caminhadas. Tanto é que meu noivo e eu ficamos neste apto duas semanas e só utilizamos Taxi para ir e vir de Ezeiza, no mais só transporte público e boa disposição para andar. O apto é de fundos e silencioso, precisa subir um lance de escadas para chegar ao mesmo, o que para nós não foi um problema.
Martin foi muito solícito desde o primeiro contato das negociações, sempre respondendo prontamente às dúvidas. Ele nos emprestou seu cartão sube, o que facilitou a utilização do transporte público e nos enviou dicas e informações de lugares para visitar.
Bem próximo ao apto existem kioscos e lotéricas para recarregar o cartão.
O apto está em bom estado de conservação e fidedigno às fotos do site, nos sentimos realmente em casa com todos os itens básicos para nossas férias. As roupas de cama e banho estavam limpas e perfumadas. Houve uma faxina durante nossa estada, mas por causa dos passeios não tivemos a oportunidade de conhecer a Ruth. Tudo funcionou muito bem. Possui ar quente/frio no quarto e aquecedor central na sala. A cama é muito confortável e a água sempre quente. O guarda roupa é espaçoso com vários cabides e gavetas. Possui um cofre à chave embutido na parede, secador de cabelo, ferro de passar roupa e um aquecedor portátil que foi muito útil no banheiro. Além de wifi, o apto possui também um telefone fixo e guias de viagem para consulta.
Resumindo, passamos dias maravilhosos em BsAs e com certeza o apto contribuiu muito para isso. Certamente indicarei o espaço de Martin e pretendo me hospedar lá novamente quando retornar a esta cidade tão encantadora.

El departamento es muy lindo, còmodo y agradable.
Todo funciona bien. El barrio es tranquilo muy bien comunicado por metro y bus.
Falta un poco de sol pero hay luz suficiente.
todo muy bien cómo se pacto, el departamento muy lindo y bien ubicado.
Se recomienda el departamento de Martin por ubicación y estado del lugar: cómodo y accesible.

This was my second booking with Martin. Unfortunately, due to work commitments, I was not able to stay. My partner and two kids did stay and apparently the children were blowing kisses to the walls of the house as they left, saying "bye house, hope to see you again soon". Now that is a recommendation.
El departamento es muy cómodo y está muy bien ubicado
Great location and Martin is always available to take care of any issue, asap! the apt.  Is exactly as shown.

Martins Wohnung war bemerkenswert sauber, genau wie auf den Fotos und hatte alles was man benötigt, um einen angenehmen, komfortablen Aufenthalt ~auch mit Baby! ~zu geniessen .
Sehr stilvoll eingerichtet, unkomplizierte Schlüsselrückgabe.

Unbedingt zu empfehlen!

The place served the purpose of my business trip. It is simple, quiet, well equipped, functional, ample, no view, lots of storage space for clothing. Also, free local phone calls to landlines, which is a nice added value. The host was very kind in allowing me to check in two hours before official check in time, which helped me a lot considering my flying schedule. Although at first sight the place seemed clean, there was plenty of "invisible" dust over and inside the furniture. In two different occasions and for different reasons I was requested by the host to allow access to the place to two workers (to fumigate and to bring clean towels and bedsheets for the guest that would check in after I would check out) at a moment where I would be out. Overall, it was a very good experience.
Everything perfect, as usual. This was my third booking with Martin.

El lugar cumple con lo ofrecido, tiene buen internet, es un espacio cómodo y limpio y esta bien ubicado. El vecindario es tranquilo y seguro y queda a cuadras del Subte. Martín fue un buen anfitrión, estuvo siempre a disposición y facilitó el proceso de llegada ( que fue a las 23:00 horas) y entrego facilidades para el abandono del departamento. ¡recomiendo el espacio!
Once again a perfect stay in this tidy, clean, well equipped apartment. Martin is very compassionate and accommodating. I would recommend 100% staying here.

Martin ist ein sehr freundlicher und zugewandter Vermieter/Vermittler. Er gab uns Tipps und war stets für Fragen erreichbar. Die Wohung hat ein ausgezeichnetes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.  Ein sehr großer Wohnbereich und ausreichend Platz im Schlafzimmer. Die Küche ist mit den notwendigsten Kochutensilien ausgestattet. Die Wohnung liegt im Innenbereich des Hauses. Dadurch ist es durchgängig sehr ruhig. Die Fenster sind zu den Innenschächten, aber alle Zimmer sind mit dem Tageslicht sehr hell. Die Air Condition im Schlafzimmer ist sehr ruhig, im Wohnbereich etwas lauter. Geschäfte und Restaurants, Waschsalon etc. In den 18 Tagen kam zwei mal eine Putzfrau. Insgesamt haben wir uns in der Wohnung sehr wohlgefühlt.

Martín was a fantastic host. My husband and I stayed in the apartment for a month + and never had any issues. The apartment is clean and has a full kitchen. The air conditioning works well in the main room and bedroom (plus there is a ceiling fan in the bedroom!). The location is great, just be prepared to walk a little if you plan to visit Palermo soho/Hollywood. The wifi is stable and pretty quick. I would definitely recommend Martin's apartment!
The flat was really nice, clean and comfortable. Martin gave us a lot of good and helpfull tips to explore Buenos Aires. Thanks a lot we really enjoyed our time. Martina, Peter, Marie and Hannah
Departamento amplio en muy buena ubicación

A beautiful apartment in a fun, quiet neighborhood. close to restaurants and public transit. spacious and bright space that is great for a few days or a longer stay. The internet went out due to a storm for a couple of days during my stay, but Martin was attentive to the issue and covered any costs I incurred to access the internet at cafes until it was fixed. Highly recommend.
Buena ubicación. Departamento muy lindo.

Great apartment in a fabulous location.  It's a short walk to everything—restaurants, supermarkets, bank machines, metro, shopping.  I've rented different apartments in this neighborhood over many years.  This one is particularly spacious making it comfortable for long stays.  Martin's mother, an architect, designed the remodel making the space very attractive.  The kitchen is very well equipped for a short-term rental with just about everything I have at home.  The apartment is at the back of the building so it's quiet.  There isn't much of a view but plants have been placed strategically outside the windows so you look out on green. Martin is very responsive and very helpful with check in and check out.  Two things to know in advance.  There is no elevator so you will need to haul luggage up a curved staircase.  This wasn't a problem for me but could be, depending on the amount of luggage you have.  The other thing is that the hot water was a bit erratic—sometimes plentiful and sometimes not there.  You might want to check with Martin to know if there is a way to predict it.  It's an old building and I'm guessing that the infrastructure serves the whole building and not individual apartments.

I have stayed in this apartment many times now.  It's always such a great experience, so much so that it has started to feel like home.  From the friendly neighbours and fruit shop owners, to the relaxed atmosphere of the neighbourhood, to the really pretty decorations and cleaniness provided by the staff, to really clear and straight forward communication with Martin. A definite five star experience every time.
Amazing place! Had a problem w the hot water for a day but was quickly fixed, all in all reccomend 100%

Muy lindo departamento, me sorprendió gratamente. Martín es muy colaborador, tuvimos problema con los vuelos y él nos ayudó acomodando los horarios de llegada y encima fue a presentarse y ponerse a disposición personalmente; nos dio recomendaciones de lugares y esas cosas
Hermoso dpto bien ubicado, limpio y muy buena la atención de su  dueño

Todo muy lindo, disfrutamos mucho nuestra estadía, lo único fue que los vecinos tenían unas fiestas ruidosisimas y se escuchaba todo, pero el lugar es hermoso, muy bien amoeblado, con todo lo necesario para una familia con una estadía larga o corta.
