Muy buena ubicación en una zona tranquila pero muy cerca de todo. El apartamento está muy grande y limpio, y posee todo lo necesario para una buena estadia en Buenos Aires.  La comunicación con Martin es muy buena.

Martin's apartment had everything we needed to make ourselves at home during our 2+ week stay in Buenos Aires. The kitchen is well-stocked, the bed is comfortable, and the living room is quite comfortable for lounging. The neighborhood is friendly, with lots of restaurants, cafes, bars, and supermarkets close by.  Several of the neighbors made a point to greet us on the sidewalk whenever they saw us, once they realized we had been around a while. Martin was very responsive whenever we had questions and otherwise unobtrusive. His recommendations for local places to eat and drink were very valuable. We would highly recommend Martin's apartment for a short or extended stay in Buenos Aires.
Exatamente como nas fotos,excelente localização,apartamento super limpo e confortável
Apartamento muito bem organizado e limpo. Localização excelente! A comunicação com o anfitrião também foi muito boa. Super recomendo!
El departamento esta muy completo, la ubicacion es buena  el edificio es viejo y contrafrente. no se ve la luz del dia. pero le da la ventaja de ser silencioso. Martin lo justo y necesario.
o espaço do Martin é excelente, o Martin tem um atendimento excelente, o mais importante é poder contar com ele.
Great place, really enjoyed my stay.

Lugar excelente para una estadía corta o larga para algunas semanas/meses. Hay una gran variedad de parques (8-15 mins a pie), centros comerciales (5 mins) y negocios (incluyendo lavanderías) cerca del departamento. A tan solo 5-8 mins caminando está la estación de metro Bulnes o hacia el otro lado la estación Agüero que conecta con el resto de la ciudad. En frente del edificio pasa también el autobús 92 que conecta con la ciudad. El departamento tiene una excelente distribución de los espacios y el techo es super alto así que deja una sensación de que es aún más grande de lo que ya es. La cocina tiene todos los utensilios necesarios y el sistema tanto de enfriamiento y calefacción del departamento están en excelente estado. Es un edificio antiguo pero en buen estado (ahora están renovando el pasillo y las paredes de las escaleras). La cama es nueva y MUY cómoda con muchas almohadas. El departamento también cuenta con una mesa cómoda para trabajar o estudiar. El departamento también es SUPER luminoso lo que da una gran sensación de frescura. Por último, Martín es bastante amable y está a la orden para lo que necesites. Creo que es probablemente uno de los mejores departamentos en los que he estado desde que uso Airbnb desde el 2010!
Ha sido una estancia estupenda y muy agradable. Recomiendo el lugar.
El lugar es más bonito de lo que se ve en las fotos, muy limpio y bien ubicado. Nuestro check-in fue fácil y Martín siempre estuvo  atento a responder.  Excelente servicio, lo recomiendo mucho :)
Muy lindo apartamento
Thanks Martin you always go above and beyond your duties. You are the best host I ever had. Apartment was nice and clean. Nice location and easy to find public transportation.

We had a wonderful time in Martín's appartment in Palermo, Buenos Aires. We were suprised how quiet the place was during the nights, even with open windows (at night, there is very little trafic on the small street the apartment is located at). Communication with Martín was completely smooth and easy, he gave great recommendations for places to eat (e.g. La Aguada!!), and was very helpful regarding airport transfer. The place was cleaned once a week during our stay with good communication on suitable cleaning times. The bedroom has a very useful locker for valuables. Overall, I can wholeheartedly recommend the apartment and Martín as a host.
Mi estancia en el departamento, fue hermosa, todo lo cumplido con la descripcion del anuncio, muy recomendable.
Un piso amplio,  cómodo y limpio.

El apartamento de Ana es un lugar encantador en Buenos Aires, con varias opciones para la diversión. Es una dirección ideal. Además el apartamento está limpio y ordenado, y Ana es una estupenda anfitrión.

I have spent a good stay but it's not thanks to apartment quality. Rate is very expensive regarding general state of apartment (paints on walls and roof not refreshed since a long time and it is not appearing on pictures in site; doors between kitchen and living room can not be closed (not only this but in general all windows are uneasy to close so the consequence is bad during winter season when you feel the wind going into the apartment), floor and doors very noisy; lack of light in living room because there is no windows so it gives a gloomy feeling; lack of lot of items like knives; aspirator to clean at least the floor doesn't exist. There is no heat conditioner in the second room with balcony.
I will not repeat this experience in the same apartment because the fare suggested and paid is not at all justified regarding all inconveniences. Ana did not take any guaranty and trusted in us what is good.

Ana sempre foi muito atenciosa, desde o primeiro momento. Passa importantes informações para ajudar no nosso deslocamento pela cidade, além de disponibilizar um telefone para contato. Apesar de antigo, o apartamento é confortável e muito bem localizado, bem próximo à Estação Callao (linha vermelha), e próximo a cafés, mercados e restaurantes. Gostei muito da experiência, e certamente me hospedaria neste apartamento de novo.
Excelente el departamente, excelente ubicación y excelente Ana y su marido. El dpto estaba recién pintado por lo que disfrutamos de él como si fuera nuevo. Gracias
Excelente local
Es cómodo el apartamento, limpio y en buen estado. No tuvimos inconvenientes.

Ótimo apartamento e muito bem localizado. Fica próximo a estações das linhas B e D. A Ana e seu marido foram muito atenciosos e não tenho nada a reclamar. Recomendaria o apartamento a qualquer pessoa e voltaria a me hospedar nele.

Ana e seu marido são muitos simpáticos, e nos deixaram muito a vontade no apartamento. O apartamento é bem localizado, a uma quadra da estação de metrô, amplo, e bastante aconchegante. E ainda fomos supreendidos com alfajores de sua terra natal deliciosos...

O apartamento está em ótima localização e com facilidades de deslocamento para demais pontos da cidade. Fui bem recebida e tive dicas de Ana Foix sobre a cidade e cuidados a ter como turista. No geral o apê é muito bom e com certeza, eu voltaria a me hospedar nele.

Disfrutamos mucho nuestra estancia en este departamento. Su ubicación es excelente, pues pudimos desplazarnos a los puntos que nos interesaba conocer, y tiene muchas facilidades cerca: Tiendas de conveniencia, bancos, el subte (metro), librerías, etc. Lo anterior combinado con la amabilidad de Ana y el equipamiento del departamento hizo que nuestra experiencia en Buenos Aires fuera muy placentera. ¡Volveremos!

El apartamento es excelente, tiene mucho más de lo necesario para sentirse cómodo y disfrutar de Buenos Aires: óptima localización, acceso a todos los medios de transporte público, camas cómodas, cocina y baños bien equipados y limpios. El lugar es más lindo que en las fotos.
Ana y su familia son muy simpáticos y amables.
-----
The apartment is awesome. It has all that is necessary for a comfortable and enjoyable stay in Buenos Aires: perfect location, good access to public transport, comfortable beds, well equipped kitchen and bathrooms. The place is better than it looks in the pictures.
Ana and her family are nice and very helpful.
-----
O apartamento é primoroso, tem muito mais do que você precisa para se sentir confortável e curtir Buenos Aires: ótima localização, aceso a todos os meios de transporte público, camas confortáveis, cozinha e banheiros limpos e bem equipados. O lugar é mais lindo que nas fotos.
Ana e sua família são muito simpáticos.
-----
Le appartement est superbe. Il tien tout ce qu'il faut pour avoir un séjour agréable à Buenos Aires: l'arrondissement est plein de cafés et de théâtres, il y a des stations du métro tout près, les lits sont confortables et la cuisine est bien équipée. En plus il est plus charmant que dans les photos.
Ana et sa famille sont très aimables.

The apartment is really good. The beds are comfortable, the comforters are really cozy and warm (we needed them in the cold Winter of Buenos Aires...), the air conditioners work well (although there is no unit in the room with two beds) and there was plenty of hot water in the shower and faucets. Although you are not staying in Recoleta (I stayed there in my last visit to BsAs), I felt safe enough at Avenida Corrientes. Ana and her husband were really responsive and truly nice. I recommend this apartment and would stay there again.

The apartment is nice and big. It's located in a very convenient area that has all the bus and subte stations, restaurants and cafes, theaters and shops. The only thing is that there is a smoking vent in the bathroom and you can smell smoking from it.

El alojamiento es amplio, luminoso y aireado y responde muy bien a las necesidades de una familia de cinco integrantes.  Cómodo y con todos los servicios en funcionamiento, el teléfono de línea fue un extra que no esperábamos. Muy bien la limpieza y el orden, ubicación excelente para moverse en el corazón de Buenos Aires, a una cuadra del subte y a pasos de múltiples líneas de colectivo.  Dos supermercados pequeños en la misma cuadra, panadería, kioscos, restaurantes, lavadero, bancos, cafés. Detalles que destacaron:  alfajores terrabusi de bienvenida y un adaptador para enchufes que nos vino genial. La comunicación fue siempre rápida y efectiva, Ana muy accesible, amable y dispuesta. Realmente nos sentimos como en casa y eso es un diferencial para todos y especialmente para los niños. Altamente recomendable!

Had a great time in this quiet and comfortable apartment. The apartment looks exactly like on the pictures and feels warm and friendly. Basic supplies like tea, coffee and even shampoo were already there. It was really close to the main metro line and just a few minutes walk away from the beautiful Bosques de Palermo, or Palermo Soho on the other side. I haven't met Tomas, but his father and sister helped me with every question. Flexible check-in and check-out was no problem. Pro tip: The Distrito Arcos is just a 2 minutes walk away, great for shopping and reeally good breakfast :) Would, and hopefully will, come back.

This apartment is in an ideal location in Palermo Hollywood and was only a 5 minute walk to neighbouring Soho. It was cosy and stylishly furnished, and had everything I needed in terms of amenities, such as wifi/books etc. Ernesto, Tomas' father who was looking after the apartment, and his wife were massively helpful with anything I needed and was there to offer information about the city. They also offered to keep in touch should I need anything in the future - always nice for someone moving to a new city. All in all I really enjoyed my stay and would recommend this to anyone coming to Buenos Aires.

Perfect apartment in a great location! Tomas's apartment was one of two we stayed in Buenos Aires and this was our favorite by far. The apartment is sooo open and bright and has everything you need. We loved the modern design and decor! The apartment is walking distance to some great restaurants, grocery stores, parks, and shopping. Even though we didn't meet Tomas in person he reached out to coordinate everything via email to make sure check out and check in went smoothly. His father was so kind and helped us get settled - he even introduced us to the neighbors if we needed anything.

The only thing that wasn't absolutely perfect about our stay was a few issues we had with wifi, nothing major, but since we work from home there were a few times that it would cut out or glitch.

Also - there is an awesome HUGE grocery store that is similar to a Walmart, but better called Jumbo. It has everything you need from makeup & toiletry items to international foods. They also have a good deli for a cheap sandwich and an eating area with AC.

All in all we had a great stay and wish weren't leaving so soon! I'd absolutely recommend staying here to anyone. Thanks Tomas for a great stay!

The apartment was very clean, extremely quiet and in a great location. There were plenty of restaurants, coffee shops and ATMS within walking distance. The beds were comfortable and everything in the apartment worked well. Cameron was responsive, happy to answer all of our questions and very flexible about our check-in and check-out times.

After traveling for the past nine months, it was such a relief to have our own space in Buenos Aires. Thanks!

I stayed in Tomas' place with my girlfriend for a week. It offers everything you need and is really cosy! The Palermo neighbourhood is the best in BsAs, really safe and quiet, yet with lots of activities and nice bars/restaurant. It's a 5min walk from Palermo metro station, which directly connects to the city center. We loved our stay!

Great, clean apartment with high ceilings in the perfect location -- both near the major sights and where you'll want to go out for dinner at night. There's also multiple markets nearby if you need one. Martin is also a great host -- super friendly and very easy to get in touch with should you need anything. I would definitely recommend staying here!

Very nice apartment in the center of Recoleta, a few blocks from the cemetary area. Eveything you need close by including a large supermarket and 2 Starbucks.

Apartment was functional, plenty of space for a couple, wifi worked fine, the bed was comfy and kitchen well equipped.

Wold stay again for sure. Martin spoke English well and handled everything fine.

We greatly enjoyed our stay in Martin's Recoleta property.  The apartment is beautiful with impressive large ceilings, very clean an well designed/decorated.  Martin was helpful and kind.  I would recommend this property or any other of his to anyone coming to stay in Buenos Aires be it for a few days, or for a more extended length of time.

Very well located on the border of Barrio Norte and Recoleta. Apt was quiet, spacious and very comfortable. The place was more a tourist apartment than someone's home so it was like being a local while in Buenos Aires without living amongst someone's "stuff". Cameron was very professional and easy to coordinate with.

Wonderfully sized and equipped apartment that was within walking distance to the cemetery as well as museums and the subway. Clean, comfortable and perfect for anyone traveling to BA! Also, Cameron was exceptionally welcoming and helpful and accommodating when our flights were cancelled and changed due to inclement weather!

My wife & I had a great time staying at this apartment.& would gladly
stay there again. It is a very nice apartment with plenty of room.
Apartment is well located for restaurants, coffee shops, grocery stores, ATM's, parks, public transportation & Recoleta Cemetery.
Cameron is an excellent Host & easily accessible.
Thanks again,
Charlie & lue

Cameron was a great host - very easy to get in touch with before the trip and during.  The apartment is perfectly located in a great neighborhood with lots of restaurants, grocery stores, and an easy walk to lots of sights.  Cabs were easy to get at all times.   We had a great stay and miss Buenos Aires already!
This is a very nice location in Barrio Norte/Recoleta and Cameron is an excellent and completely reliable host.

The apartment was in a GREAT location, right on a major street in one of the nicer sections of town, but in the back of the building so that street noise was never a problem. There were numerous restaurants within a few minute walk, and a large grocery store was right around the corner on the same block. Starbucks was one block away, if that matters. We never had any concerns about safety, either in the building or in the neighborhood, although we did heed numerous warnings from many about the threat of pickpockets in Buenos Aires. From the apartment, it was about a 25 minute walk down Santa Fe Avenue (with hundreds of shops and sights to see) to the city center, and we walked it several times with no problem. Other times we took taxis -- readily catchable on our street and throughout the city -- to get everywhere we wanted to go in the city in a few minutes and for about $6 to $8 US dollars or less. Don't bother renting a car.

The apartment itself was small and took some getting used to, but it worked well for my family of four for the week we were there. I think the pictures of the apartment are accurate. The full bath was very small and a challenge for the four of us, and the second bathroom was little more than a closet with a toilet squeezed in. But overall we had a great stay, and we recognized that we were getting a great value for the location. We have nothing to compare it to (it was our first time in Buenos Aires, and our first experience renting an apartment for a vacation), but we certainly weren't sorry we chose this place. Cameron was also very helpful and was there when we needed him and when he said he would be there, both at move in and move out. Thanks for the great stay!

It was a very pleasant stay in BA in Cameron's flat. He is really caring about you to have a pleasent stay. Everything was really great, there's a shop directly next to the apartment and the neighborhood of Recoleta is a really nice part of Buenos Aires. Moreover the apartment has a lot of space. All in all we can really recommend this stay in BA! Thanks :)
Excellent apartment in a prime location. I recommend to everyone. I will book it again when I return to Buenos Aires

Convenient location, we walked pretty much everywhere from the apartment. The restaurants/cafes/gelato shops and the best hospitals in BA are located within walking distance. The big supermarket Coto is around the corner.  We were 2 couples and had no issues sharing one full bath and the spare toilet. Cameron was very prompt in replying to our questions regarding the apartment and Buenos Aires. Highly recommended! We loved it and already miss Buenos Aires.... Thanks! E, R, S & Y

Cameron and his apartment were fantastic. A perfect location for exploring BA. Cameron was very hospitable and helpful, easy to contact and had some great ideas for things to do and eat.
I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone heading to this fantastic city.
O apatamento é muito bom, bem equipado e bem localizado. O Cameron nos recebeu muito bem e esteve a disposição sempre que precisamos.

Cameron's apartment and its location are awesome, I have been very well received by her pleasant friend Julieta.
I suggest it to everyone and I confess that in a future visit to Buenos Aires I would stay there again. The only problem of my travel was my brother, that didn't want to get out of the big king sized bed every morning...

The two bedroom apartment in Recoleta was both charming and an incredible place to call home-base while in Buenos Aires. Cameron was incredibly easy to reach before and during my stay at his apartment and was kind enough to recommend bars, restaurants, and services in the neighborhood. I will definitely recommend Cameron to friends and family in the future.
The apartment is very clean and modern. It seems bigger than in the pictures. Had a great time and the environment is very safe. For sure, i would advise you to take this apartment!

We had i very good stay at Martin´s place. The studio is just like the pictures! Was very clean and have everithing we need. The location is great as well: just some blocks to the tube station and a lot of places to go,by  walking., like Recoleta Cemetery, MALBA and Museo Decororativo. Some coffee places and restaurants very close, just crossing the street is Sette Bacco, the best restaurant we went in Buenos Aires.

Fuimos 3 personas, el departamento resultó muy cómodo y agradable ambiente. Buena ubicación para las compras...y el turismo, quizás nos resultó fácil movernos porque ya hemos ido varias veces a Baires.
Repetiríamos!!!

O studio é excelente! Muito moderno, limpo e funcional. A rede sem fio e o aquecedor funcionam super bem e foram imprescindíveis. Bem localizado e seguro, possui muitos "cafés" e mercadinhos por perto, com destaque para o "goûtcafe", com atendimento excelente e medialunas deliciosas. O Martin foi um excelente anfitrião, dando várias dicas sobre a cidade e sempre muito atencioso. Eu super RECOMENDO!

El lugar es perfecto para disfrutar de los mejores lugares nocturnos de Palermo, cuentas con tiendas, mercadito y lavanderia a la par, así como un supermercado a tan sólo unas cuadras, la estación del subte "Palermo" está muy cerca, perfecto para caminar a cualquier hora.

El departamento es muy acogedor, ideal para parejas, aparte que tiene una ubicación privilegiada.
Ernesto el papá de Tomás, nos recibió muy amable y nos dejó todos los productos necesarios para tener una estadía excelente en Buenos Aires.
Recomendadísimo, definitivamente volvería a hospedarme ahí.
Tomas and his father were very nice! The location of the apartment is fantastic, near to everything you need!

O apartamento de Tomaz fica em uma rua super tranquila e ao mesmo tempo está no centro de Palermo. O apartamento é muito aconchegante e super bem decorado. Gostamos muito da semana que passamos lá. Se você for pra Buenos Aires não deixe de tentar se ospedar na casa de Tomaz, além do apartamento ser muito legal o Tomaz está sempre disposto a ajudar. ;)
Es un hermoso departamento, con todas las comodidades y muy agradable, en un lugar céntrico con todos los servicios de transporte y proveeduría.
Great, central but still quiet place, cute little kitchen, foot distance away from many great places in Palermo and also the botanic garden.

The apartment was absolutely fabulous, nice quiet street within walking distance to plenty of activity in Palermo and Palermo Soho. Stylish, clean and well-equipped. We did have some issues with WiFi (kind of spotty) but nothing that warranted big problems. Would stay here again and recommend it to anyone!
Perfect Apartment with an excellent price quality ratio. We stay there for one month and enjoyed especially the nice neighbourhood. The check in was very smooth and easy going. Recommendation!

I really enjoyed my stay in this apartment. It is recently renovated so it feels new and has been well-decorated. The place is spacious, clean, and comfortable. The kitchen, like all studios, is small but had all the utensils I needed. I could easily work from home due to the built-in study desk and had no issues with wifi. The location is pretty central as you are within walking distance of restaurants and coffee shops as well as a nice supermarket around the corner. Eugenia was an excellent host who went the extra mile and was always available. I would easily rent this place again!

Spent 8 days in Cameron apt. Great location. This apt is about location, location and more location. 2 blocks from the subte and a huge supermarket around the corner. Very safe neighbohood within walking distance from Recoleta market and many restaurants around. I would not hesitate to go back to this apartment.

Recoleta is an awesome area, walking distance to most visit-worthy Buenos Aires sites, and the apt is super comfortable and in a beautiful building in the middle of a bustling community!

Cameron was always available both before arriving and while there to answer questions or offer suggestions and was super helpful and friendly!
Neat apartment in an excellent location. Both Cameron and Julieta were wonderful to deal with. Recommended.

The apartment was in a perfect location, right in between a cafe and Juvenil (a local pasta/empanada shop). It is a short walk to lots of museums and only minutes from the Recoleta cemetery and the Sunday market.

The apartment itself was clean and comfortable for 3 of us and I think with 4 it would've been perfect too. The bathroom was adequate and it was helpful to have two toilets. The elevators are a bit dodgy, but all in all I would say this is a perfect base for your Buenos Aires adventure.

Cameron, our host, was also extremely helpful and very easy to get in touch with as well.

Me and my wife were at Cameron's place for 7 nights and we had a great time. our flight was delayed for 8 hours and we came to BA at 02:30 AM. Cameron waited for us till them and it sure was good to see a friendly face after the long wait and anticipation. Location in Primo and the apartment is big. it was fully equipped we all the things we needed (kitchen, internet and even cable TV after a long day of walking in beautiful BA)
Cameron gave us great recommendation and we will come back to the same apartment in our next visit.
Thanks Cameron

cameron was a very nice person and very helpful        there were some problems with the a/c and elevators at first but they were promptly fixed      good location     only major reservation is the condition of the bathrooms

Jamais' apartment is amazing. It is in a perfect location in Palermo Soho, only two blocks from plaza Armenia and all the nice restaurants and boutique stores. The apartment is beautiful and big. They did an amazing job at decorating it. The building is very old and charming and the apartment is refurnished and it looks brand new. The decoration is very modern and nice. Someone met us at the door as planned, and everything went smoothly with our stay. I really recommend staying here!! We couldn't have asked for a better place to stay in Buenos Aires!!
The place was great and in a great location. Would definitely stay here again. Jamais was responsive and great to work with.

Jamais' apartment was the perfect location for myself and 3 female travellers for our short stay in Buenos Aires.  It is within walking distance to fantastic shopping and dining, conveniently close to the metro if required and overall safe and accessible.  It is tastefully decorated and furnished, very comfortable and provided all the facilities we needed; the in-house folder/scrapbook and guidebooks were of bonus help. She and the property managers were extremely easy to contact and more than helpful prior to and during our stay, particularly during the check-in-and-out processes.  Would definitely stay here again, and for longer!
El departamento está muy bien ubicado y es muy agradable. Martín muy amable. Recomendado!.
Die hochwertige Wohnung ist sehr sauber und gut eingerichtet. Martin hat sich bestens um alles gekümmert und Fragen umgehend beantwortet.

My girlfriend and I have spent almost a week in Buenos Aires and we enjoy it so much. Patrick has exceeded all expectation; he is very attentions, easygoing, helpful and he really enjoys what he is doing.
The apartment is very modern, complete kitchen, quite, clean, secure, well decorated and very well located.
The check-in check-out was easy, even arriving kind of late he was there when we get to the apartment.
If you are going to BA, don’t miss the opportunity to meet this guy and be hosted at this apartment.

This is a very good studio apartment in a great location.  The apartment is very modern, clean, organized and functional.  I absolutely loved the design of this apartment.  Martin was a great host and provided us with lots of invaluable information about Buenos Aires, which we greatly appreciated.  The place is in a safe and interesting part of Buenos Aires, in Recoleta.  Close to the subway and main commercial strip on Santa Fe Ave, and close to an incredible cemetery.  He also let us stay extra late on the last day, which we also really appreciated.

Great apartment in an awesome location! The apartment is basically halfway between the Recoleta tourist spots (market, cemetery, etc.) and the subway. The neighborhood felt lively and safe. The apartment is clean and modern and Martin was a great host, he emailed us many suggestions.

Me hospedé con mi mamá durante 15 días, pudimos organizar el check in y el chek out sin problemas.
El dpto. es tal cual como lo muestran las fotos, super cómodo, la cocina tiene todos los elementos necesarios para preparar alimentos para dos personas, hay agua caliente y aire acondicionado. El Wifi funcionó a la perfección y nos ayudó mucho que el dpto tuviera teléfono así nos podíamos comunicar con familiares y amigos de la ciudad. La ubicación es excelente, se puede ir caminando a la facultad de derecho y sus alrededores, está cerca a la avenida santafé y al subte. Recomendamos este dpto. nos encantó!! Hizo de nuestra estadia en Buenos Aires mucho mas placentera!

This place is fantastic! Exactly like the pictures - clean, modern, very comfortable bed, spacious bathroom, nice shower, clean towels and linens, and plenty of space for a studio. Great alternative to a hostel if you want privacy and security and a place to settle into. Some street noise if you leave the door open (but where isn't that the case in a big city) but with the powerful A/C there is really no need to.

Safe neighborhood, small market across the street, big market 4 blocks up. Right in between Recoleta cemetery (about 15 minute stroll) and Palermo (30 minute walk or $30 peso cab). Close to the Subte (about 8 minute walk) and also all the buses on Santa Fe.

Martin, our host, was wonderful. He met me when he said he would at the place for check-in. He manages a few of these apartments for his mother (who is the talented interior designer) so he has the process down and was readily available to answer questions via email or phone. He has a nice recommendation list he's happy to email, and he also made up a separate email for me with a variety of live music options that were going on during my stay! Above and beyond.

I highly recommend renting this Recoleta studio, or anything from Martin.

The apartment is gorgeous, and Martín goes to great lengths to assure you an impeccable stay. He is extremely accommodating and clearly a perfectionist, which ends up making for a spotless and well-equipped apartment. We comfortably slept 3 and it ended up being barely more than a hostel but infinitely better! Would definitely stay again and recommend him to anyone!

El depto es hermoso, y Martín hace todo para asegurar una linda estadía. Es perfeccionista, que quiere decir que hace todo el depto esté siempre en condiciones perfectas. Dormimos 3 ahí y nos salió poco más que un hostel pero la pasamos infinitamente mejor! Cuando vuelva a Buenos Aires va a ser el primer lugar a que voy y se lo recomendaría a cualquier persona!

Martin was the ultimate host. He had the place in perfect condition and it had everything intended. Very clean, great central area. Cose to a lot of great things. I strongly recommend staying at this location. Martin is also very helpful in providing you with information about th city. It came in handy and saved me A few times. I can't wait to return to Buenos Aires a d will stay at Matrins place no doubt!

Martin's apartment was absolutely lovely.  Clean and well-equipped, and within walking distance of many sights and transportation.  He was the perfect host and gave us a great list of sites and restaurants tailored to your expressed tastes.  I highly recommend the apartment!

Great location in BA. The studio was clean, well-maintained and sunny. The balcony adds to the charm of the place. It is also really accessible:  close to restaurants, supermarkets and the Palermo district. The only downside of the location is that it is on a rather noisy street so for those people who are used to the calm, this may deter you. Martin is a local and has some good recommendations for things to do in BA.
Excellent accommodation - handy for the subte and Recoleta cemetery. Very clean andvery secure apartment and Martinis a very friendly Host.

Martin's apartment is very clean and spacious enough for two or three.  The apartment is close to everything in Ricoletta and is walking distance to Palermo if you are up for it.  There are lots of cute coffee shops and little restaurants in the neighborhood and there is a grocery store just a few blocks away.  I'd go back!

We LOVED this apartment! It was in such a great location and Martin was so great and easy to work with! We would have absolutely stayed there again upon our return to BA the following month had the apartment been available. The apartment was fully stocked with everything we could have needed in terms of cooking equipment, towels, sheets, etc. It felt like we were right at home right away. Thanks Martin for giving us the inside scoop on navigating BA!

Martin estaba de vacaciones cuando nos hospedamos en el apartamento pero sus padres nos atendieron muy bien y nos ayudaron en todo momento!

Se los recomiendo ampliamente!

Si vuelvo a Buenos Aires algún día, me quedo nuevamente allí!

Martin's apartment was beautiful and spacious. Martin' s dad met us and was very gracious and helpful! Apt was close to everything. Perfect place for two or more people! Would definitely stay there again!

This place is exactly as described and perfect for those looking to be fairly central to everything in Buenos Aires and in a very safe area. The place was clean and in perfect condition; it included all the perks of being at home, including dishes, cutlery, towels, etc. I highly recommended this place to any one traveling alone or with someone. Another plus is that the subway is a walkable 5 blocks away.

I can't say enough good things about the host, Martin. He was at the apartment waiting for me to arrive and was very thorough in showing me everything about the place. He went above and beyond by providing me a map and showing me all the neighborhood locations, tourist attractions and his recommended places to eat, drink and take in all there is in Buenos Aires.

I'll certainly be booking my next trip to Buenos Aires with Martin again.

This studio was very clen and in a secure Building. Busy street, lots of late night noise. The location is very central, bus , metro close by.
Kitchen could do with some better equipment, scratched pots and pans..
Guest should be aware of 11pm chech out. Your US flight will be leaving at 10pm. My husband was unwell and although we were willing to pay for an extra night so that we could stay on until 5 pm. It could not be arranged as other guests were arriving. Martin did allow us to store our luggage.We met his charming parents(guests.?) when we came to pick up luggage. we left feeling perplexed!!!!

Martin was an excellent host and the studio he rented to us on Aguero was clean, large and stocked with all sorts of appliances. When we arrived from the airport Martin was waiting for us with two sets of keys and showed us everything we needed to know. I would highly recommend this apartment and him as a host!

First Martin: amazing guy, nice, funny and love to help u with whatever u need. he is a river fan which is great and honestly you cant get a better host then him.
The apart: location perfect. fully equiped, cocina perfect. beds perfect. and the most importent for me the apart was spotless clean.
Thanks alot my friend un abrazo grande y la proxima en salta veni a mi lugar. :)

Muy cómodo y limpio, en una buena zona de Buenos Aires donde tenes de todo. Me gusto mucho y quisiera volver!

Very comfortable and clean, in a good neighborhood of Buenos Aires, where you have everything you need. I liked it very much and hope to return!

Martin was a really helpful and generous host. The flat is well located, in excellent condition, and has everything you could need. He even arranged a taxi for me on the last day (and the driver was a nice guy too). Highly recommended.

El apartamento de Martín está muy bien ubicado, cerca de cafés, restaurantes y de todo lo bueno que hay en la ciudad. Llegué a la hora indicada y me encontré con él que me explicó´del apartamento y de la vida del barrio.
Es un tipo genial que conoce muy bien Buenos Aires, un guía estupendo para consultarle de todo, desde recomendaciones de buena música hasta de empanadas salteñas.
El apartamento es luminoso y espacioso, con una cómoda cama doble, sofá, escritorio, una coqueta cocina y un baño de buen tamaño. Aparte de sábanas y toallas, están todas las 'practicidades' que uno necesita para sentirse como en casa. Altamente recomendado!

I had a great stay! The apartment is a very ample and nicely decorated studio; furthermore, the location is superb. I felt completely at home. Also, Martín is a great host, providing you with lots of useful information and he is very quick to respond to emails and queries. I highly recommend this apartment for a short or extended stay in Buenos Aires.

Martin was an awsome host. He met us on arrival and took some time to talk about where his favourite parts if the city were which was great as it was our first time in B.A. The studio apartment was funky, modern and huge and the location really close to parks, shops and the cemetery. We would definitely recommend a stay here and will definitely be visiting B.A again. Thanks Martin!

Martin was an awsome host. He met us on arrival and took some time to talk about where his favourite parts if the city were which was great as it was our first time in B.A. The studio apartment was funky, modern and huge and the location really close to parks, shops and the cemetery. We would definitely recommend a stay here and will definitely be visiting B.A again. Thanks Martin!

Martin was great! Our flight was late to arrive and he was kindly waiting for us. Martin was really helpful while my friend and I stayed, not only with the apartment but in helping us get to know the area. The apartment is great! Lovely place to stay!

Martin and his apartment was terrific. The place is amazing and just what you need for 1-2 people. It's renovated, very modern, clean and extremely cozy. You come back and immediately feel at home. It's almost hard to leave! Location is great, there's a market right across the street, a delicious breakfast spot on the corner, I ate there every day, and the neighborhood is very safe. Martin himself is very kind and very helpful. From the moment you meet him, you just see what a nice guy he is. He was happy to help, took the time to answer any questions I had both at check in and anytime during my stay. I would highly recommend using him or one of his other apartments, he'll be my first go to next time I'm in BsAs. Thanks again for everything Martin!!!

Apartamento agradable, cómodo y muy bien situado para "patearse" Buenos Aires. Martín es un magnifico anfitrión, que ayuda incondicionalmente. Si volvemos por Buenos Aires al primero que conectariamos seria a él.

Cameron"s apartment is spacious, spotlessly and comfortably furnished, and located on a lovely street in the heart of the best part of Buenos Aires.
Everything was neat & clean, comfortable big beds with nice linen and wonderful duvets
Would definitely recommend and would definitely return.
With the great host and at the great location, I would recommend it to others!
a very nice older apt. in recoleta.

We had a great week at Cameron's apartment. There were three of us and having the half bathroom (even though it is very small) was a big plus. The apartment is perfectly located, close to all the best attractions (walking and/or taking the subway) and the size of it was just fine for the three of us. We had some small problems in the apartment, but Cameron fixed them all promptly. The internet (which is always important for travelers) was fast and reliable. If you don't mind staying in an older apartment (but with good beds and furniture), then this is a great base for enjoying Buenos Aires. It was my first time using airbnb.com and Cameron's professionalism and courtesy certainly will encourage me to use it again. Cameron was a great host and is a great guy. I would certainly rent from him again.

This apartment was nice, but definitely NOT awesome. We arrived to find an apartment that had been very minimally cleaned with leftover food still in the refrigerator and trash in the cans. The bathroom is outdated with a tub that appears to be disintegrating. Little bugs came out at night near the sink. The shower drips constantly and there was no hot water for the first day of our stay.

Cameron was attentive to our needs, but came across more as a businessman than someone that cared about us enjoying our short-term apartment.

The neighborhood is wonderful. We were able to walk to the cemetery and many downtown sights. The park to the north-west was great for morning jogs.

David and I had a long haul to Buenos Aires and Cameron was very kind to wait for us until we arrived.  It was fantastic to be able to have a place to rest after 24 hours of travel.  Cameron's place is very nice as the pictures show.  He was very flexible and helpful with everthing we needed (including changing out checkout time when we realized our plane flight was later than we thought).  Cameron is interested in knowing and understanding his guest's experiences in BA so that he can accurately answer questions for future guests.  I would recommend his place to a friend for sure!

The location is good, with nearby grocery, laundry, shops and restaurants, and a subte (subway) stop 4 blocks away. It is a walkable location to the Recoleta Cemetery, Retiro and Microcenter neighborhoods.

Cameron was very flexible despite issues with the front door key being changed by the building during our stay, making it impossible to get a second key for our use. This has probably been resolved by now. He was also very willing to meet our check-in and check-out needs to accommodate a late departing flight.

The apartment was clean and the king bed was comfortable. The kitchen was very usable. The water pressure was good in the shower. There is a fair amount of street noise despite being on the 9th floor. The hot water drips from the shower and can only be stopped by closing the hot water valve for the bathroom, which was inconvenient for us. The bathtub surface is peeling and needs repair.The half bathroom is very tiny.

Cameron is a very nice person, always reply the emails and questions. It was my first experience in airbnb and I totally recommend this apt. for the newbies at airbnb.

The apt has a nice atmosphere and the beds are very very good. The girl who made my check-in/out was very friendly, patience and pontual. The location is very good, near many touristic points (recoleta cemetery, obelisco, av. corrientes, av. cordoba, hard rock cafe, etc). The subway is near too. There a supermarket, a 24h bank and starbuck in the block. You can walk at night without problem, it's a secure place.

I short, It's a cheap apt for 2 couples, in a great location, with a great host.

The appartment is perfectly located for Buenos Aires because it's located close to everything. You can walk to recoleta or Alto Plaermo or take a taxi to plaermo hollywood, Belgrano o San Telmo from there and it will take only minutes (aside from peak hours).
The appartment is spacious and comfortable, except for the bathroom which needs to be renovated (apr-12).
What is good about this apartment and needs to weightes is Cameron. He's a great host. I requested him to add a password for the wifi and he did it. When I needed extra power plugs for laptop and charging mobile phones he provided it on the following day. Always very helpful with my family and no problems at all with check in and check out. This is not easy to find in Bs As, so I will recommend this apartment and rent it again on my next trip to Bs As.
Apartamento amplo e localização excelente.

Cosy apartment in a great location.For a family of four you couldn't ask for more.there is a massive supermarket around the corner.Restaurants and cafe's abound on every corner. Cameron as a host was very prompt,professional and friendly.
O apto é em um predio antigo, mas muito acolhedor., simples mas não falta nada. O bairro é otimo proximo de tudo.

My colleague and I stayed at Cameron's apartment in Recoleta for two months.  Cameron was a top-notch host.  He was very responsive to our needs (i.e. bringing us more blankets immediately because it was an unusual cold-spell when we first arrived) and very kind.  He was generous with his time when we needed him and had many great recommendations for Buenos Aires.  The apartment itself worked very well for our needs and we LOVED the location, as it was easy to get to the Centro and to Palermo.  Overall our experience was very good and we would stay here again if we came back.

Perfect!
A place to discover BsAs.
The condo are like the picture look, it's all clean and new.
Martin is a nice host and very helpfull!
It's a good neighborhood of BsAs and the Subte is just 3 blocks away. There are some bakerys and grocerystores nearby.
Highlly recommended !

Mi estadía en Buenos Aires fue excelente, una cuidad súper recomendada con una impresionante arquitectura, llena de gente buena, siempre hay una actividad de interés que hacer, en cuanto al  apartamento esta bien ubicado y bonito súper cómodo y excelentemente ambientado, súper recomendado para quien busque tener un viaje de primera, al apartamento esta céntrico tiene todo cerca súper mercados, lugares de comida y todo lo necesario. En cuanto a Martin es un excelente anfitrión, siempre estuvo atento los día previos a nuestro viaje para ponernos de acuerdos y nos ayudo con muchas dudas que teníamos y durante nuestra estadía siempre estuvo pendiente, nos sugirió lugares que visitar además de que nos envió una lista con sugerencia y tips importantes que debíamos tomar en cuenta antes y durante nuestra visita a la cuidad.
The apartment is awesome. Great location, very luminous, clean and confortable. It has everything you need to stay in Buenos Aires. You will not regret!

Primera experiencia excelente, en este caso fue alquilado para mi papa que tuvo una estancia placentera y agradable. Fue muy bien atendido por Martin!!
Saludos
Demian

A princípio fiquei receoso em fazer esse tipo de locação, nunca havia utilizado essa modalidade (locação direta). Mas foi mto melhor que o esperado. No horário marcado fui recepcionando pelo proprietário. O studio é excelente, tudo organizado, limpo e bonito. A localização não podia ser melhor, uma rua residencial, até silenciosa, perto de tudo, mercado, cafeteria, metrô e mtos taxes. Eu recomendo.
La casa perfecta en un sitio en medio de Buenos Aires. Cerca de todo. Es tal cuál sale en las fotos. No hay engaño.

The flat in Recoleta was perfect - location wise, size, and everything you needed for a slightly longer stay. It's a very residential neighbourhood so it has all the shops and amenities you would need (i.e. laundry, takeaways, grocery stores, DVD rental). I would highly recommend this flat - and also Martin was a great host and was very amenable to all my requirements.

It is not often that I write raving reviews but in this case I will. Indeed martin's apartment is so nice and a perfect base to discover buenos aires. It is clean, light spacious, well equipped and overall so comfortable. So many little details are a nice touch and mad us feel at home. I'd go back any time
Martin was a great host, and we loved the apartment! The apartment was very clean, spacious and extremely comfortable. We found it hard to leave. Thanks again Martin
Enjoyed our stay in Recoletta very much.  Nice neighborhood.  Easy access to the cemetery and other things to see. Martin was great host.  Very good value.

Martin was a terrific host. Met us on time and provided great information on how to navigate the city and what the main attractions to see were. He was available by email and responded quickly.

The apartment was beautiful, clean, and in a safe neighbourhood. Walking distance to main streets.

I would highly recommend renting from Martin during your stay in BA.

Thanks Martin :)

Martin's apartment was beautifully set up, with air-conditioning, kitchen stuff and spare towels, everything you could want. It was all immaculate and spotlessly clean, with floors you wanted to walk barefoot on. The bed was comfortable. The apartment is in a great position - walking distance to everything. Martin was out of town when I checked in (late) but he organised a very helpful Lucas to meet me, and set me up with a cab ride to the airport on departure. All very smooth and easy. Thanks Martin for a great stay.

The apartment is in a great location with cafes, laundry, and anything else you might need during your stay within a two block radius. Also, it's never a problem getting a taxi, and the walk to the metro is pleasant and safe. Martin maintains a clean and secure space, with everything you need to cook a dinner, relax and get some work done, or just to let the light in taking a few more minutes to let the steak digest from one of Palermo's great restaurants.

We had great time in Buenos Aires. The studio is very comfortable and the A/C was appreciated in the hot capital. It is in a quiet neighborhood not too far from the Subte and grocery stores. It was easy to walk to Recoleta cemetery.

Martin's place is amazing! Perfect location walkable to metro and various stores/ restaurants and shops. Everything inside is clean, renovated, modern and really spacious for a studio! and it really made us feel like at home! The bed is super comfortable too:)
Martin met us with the keys and to go over everything. He is super nice and friendly and we felt welcomed and taken care of. I would definitely recommend staying at Martin's studio and I would love to stay there again if I visit Buenos Aires again:)

it was a perfect place for 2 people. Nice quiet street. lots of trees, chinese grocery half a block away, cabs going by frequently, 2 block walk to a major shopping and restaurant area. Martin was a perfect
host… there when we needed a little direction, not there when we didn't… in all, a very satisfactory place to stay in a very lovely and interesting city.

Excelente lugar. Bien equipado y muy buena ubicacion, en el tranquilo barrio de Palermo. Los datos de Martin son una buena alternativa para armarse un recorrido de pocos días y para probar la cocina porteña. Recomendable sin dudas.

The apartment is really nice and looks exactly like the pictures. It’s cosy and very nice furnished. The kitchen has a basic equipment in case you want to prepare your dinner yourself. Wifi works very well, Skype or writing/receiving emails is no problem. Near to the flat there are lots of nice cafes and supermarkets where you get everything you need.
Martin is a nice host and quickly reachable in case you have questions. I arrived in the morning and could directly check in what was very comfortable after the long flight. Late check out was not possible because new guests were arriving, but I could store my luggage until midday without problems.
The only problem of the flat is that it is very noisy. The door to the balcony (with direction to the street) is not very strong and even when the door is closed you can hear the whole street noise (and there is noise 24 hours). So if you are sensitive to noise or looking for a calm place, you might get difficulties.
Excelente ubicación, el Depto es tranquilo así que puede llegar a descansar después de un día largó de caminata. Martín súper amable. Me volvería a quedar ahí de nuevo.

Tivemos uma experiência muito bom no apt do Martin. Apartamento bem localizado, estruturado e limpo. Não tenho nada para por defeito. Chuveiro bom, cama super confortável. O Martin foi super simpático e solicito. Adoramos tudo. Espero voltar em breve!
Apartamento otimo, limpo, bem localizado, fomos a pé para o cemiterio da recoleta, rua tranquila, tem um mercadinho em frente para tudo que precisar, internet, telefone.. Recomendo
O apartamento é ótimo, muito bem localizado. A organização e a limpeza são impecáveis. Martin é um ótimo anfitrião! Foi uma ótima experiência.
The apartment was amazing!  Clean and great location as promised!

Palermo Soho 2/2 + Office, WIFI cell. The apartment at 2154 Malabia, in Palermo Soho, Buenos Aires was an absolute pleasure to stay in. It is very attractive and functional, with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and an office where our computer worked perfectly on the WIFI for the week we stayed there. 2 of us were visiting from Vancouver and one from Cape Town.

Our communication with the owners could not have been better - always prompt and clear. We spoke on the phone and used email months before going to Buenos Aires. This was very reassuring as we hadn't used AirBnB before.

A great strength of the whole experience was the property agent. We emailed and spoke with her by phone before arriving. One of our party was an 85 year old, who arrived 2 days before us, so we were anxious about her . The agent, Brigitte, arranged pick-up and transport from the airport, and had bought quite a lot of food supplies for her convenience. She never let us reimburse her for the food! She went above and beyond basic help by helping us with taxis during our visit, and directions and suggestions. You are in exceptionally good hands with Brigitte.

Just before we got to Buenos Aires 2 lots of friends in different areas of town got mugged, which unnerved us a lot. We never felt threatened in Palermo Soho at any time of day or night.

The area has many trees, which provided great shade and made it very pleasant with the breeze on hotter days.

You climb 2 flights of stairs to get to the apartment, and the owners were careful to point our that they are long flights when we mentioned that one of our party was 85. They did not want us to rent if the 85 year old could not manage. (That is just one example of the amazing thoughtfulness of these owners). However we all managed the stairs with no trouble, and in fact came to see them as beneficial to our health ! and attractive ( curved marble ).

The apartment is in a primarily residential area and similar to much of Buenos Aires in its ambience. Just 3 blocks to the west is a hopping, hip, more commercial area full of stylish shops and restaurants. On Saturday there was happy, colorful revelry there. In the other direction Ave Santa Fe with all its transport possibilities is just 3 blocks away. Taxis cruise past the apartment very regularly and often.

I would definitely stay in Ruben and Jamais' apartment on Malabia again.

Jamais is very clear and prompt and our stay was perfect. The building is incredible and the apartment was very clean and even bigger than it looks like in the pictures. There's a Disco supermarket one block away (calle Armenia) and a lot of shops and restaurants. Definitely would stay in Jamais' place again.

The place was very comfortable and conveniently located near lots of shopping and dining places.  It fit all of our needs during our stay in Buenos Aires. The owners were very responsive through email, but the only issue we had was dealing with the local property agent.  We had a terrible experience with her trying to set up tango shows and classes for us. She kept changing the prices on us and ended up having to take it out of our deposit in the end, which was not fair. The fact that you have to bring US dollars for a deposit makes it a little difficult also.  There seemed to be a disconnect with the owners not knowing what the property agent was doing.   Other than that, the place was amazing!  They rectified the situation right away and ensured us it wouldn't happen again.

We had a great time staying at Cameron's!  The location is ideal - really easy to walk to many different places for sightseeing, and really convenient to have the market just around the corner.  Unfortunately the wifi wasn't working while we were there, but Cameron gave us a bit of a refund for the inconvenience, which was very nice.  Overall a great experience and I would stay here again - thanks!

The apartment was great for our needs and the location is convenient for Recoleta and Palermo isn't too far away.  It's about a 15-20 min ride in a cab and $50AR to trendy San Telmo where you will probably want to spend time too.  Cameron was responsive to our questions and was there on time.  The apartment is a little run down and could do with a refurb but it's a good size and very quiet (which is a bonus in BA!).  Would definitely consider staying here again.
Lovely art deco feel apartment. We enjoyed our stay here and Cameron was so helpful in sharing the best places to visit and eat in Buenos Aires.

Apartamento muito amplo, bonito e bem localizado, cozinha bem equipada para cozinhar, cafeteira, torradeira... Cameron foi muito atencioso. Não tinha lido as instruções então foi uma surpresa a necessidade de caução no check-in, mas no fim tudo deu certo.

I had a great experience staying at Cameron's apartment in Recoleta. The location is great  and within walking distance of the famed cemetary and not too far from the other barrias (Palermo, San Telmo, La Boca). It is located in a nice neighborhood full of cafes and bars. The apartment was very clean and can sleep 4 easily and is adequately equipped with wifi and other basic necessities. And Cameron was very professional and helpful starting from being there at the apartment to hand over the keys, to providing helpful tips about the city. I will definitely recommend staying at his apartment if someone were to visit this great city.

Cameron was very gracious as our flight was delayed for over an hour. The apartment is a good size and is in great location. The internet connection was working well. However I would not label the apartment as awesome for the following reasons:
Both bathrooms are in poor condition. The shower curtain was dirty. The toilet in the main bathroom did not flush properly and we could not use it. Cameron was made aware of it the following day but did not manage to have it fixed before our departure. The light in the second toilet was not working.
One day the french door blew open and wind and rain were coming in the living room. Luckily it happened while we were in. We managed to shut the door with difficulty as the bottom latch was not working. Also one morning there was a big paddle of water on the floor under the air conditioning unit. It was obvious that this was not the first occurrence as the hardwood floor in this area was damaged
It would be nice to find some brochures and information on"happenings" in town to help visitors explore and enjoy the beautiful city of BA .

We stayed 4 days in dec. apartment is well located for being central. Ave puereyddon is very busy and despite being high up it is noisy. Cameron was professional and things went smoothly.  The apartment itself needs some renovations. it is a fair value but not luxurious.
Great apartment, the location, security, and size is perfect for 4 people. They were extremely hospitable and even offered tango lessons. Would definitely stay there again.

The apartment is spacious and well situated. It is within 4 blocks from the subway, key buses stop in front of the apartment, supermarket is around the corner and nice cafes abound in the area. It is an easy walk to recoleta cemetery.
Cameron and his associate Julieta were very accommodating on our late hour arrival and departure. Julieta even booked tickets for us for a tango.
The apartment is quiet since it is located on the back of the building. We had no issues with the apartment, good wifi, kitchen adequate, bed comfortable, reasonably clean and ac worked well.
On the downside, the apartment is slightly tatty with some peeling paint, stained chairs, rusty window frames and dated bathrooms and kitchen. All said, the positives outweigh the negatives and we would stay there again.

We had a great stay in Buenos Aires. Cameron was a great host. He kept in constant communication through our travels to BA and me us promptly at the unit when we arrived. The checkout process was equally smooth.

We enjoyed the spacious apartment in Recoleta. The unit was centrally located near public transportation, restaurants and shipping. It was spacious enough to accommodate our family of 4. The unit, however, was a bit dusty.

Our family had an excellent stay in Jamais' apartment. Jamais was very responsive to our request and suggestions and obvioulsly eager that we have the Best stay possible. It was really cold when we arrived and one of the heater didn't work but Jamais and her local team made sure we had a replacement heater by he next day.
The apartment is very pleasant, with a lot of charm. Excellent spot to discover buenos aires !!

Amazing apt. really. we were 4 people (1 couple and 2 singles), coming to BA for a wedding and a few days vacation. Location- Amazing. couldnt be better. quiet beautiful street, close to everything including the green subway line. apt is gorgeous- really beautiful. The managers are experienced and even though they gave us their numbers in case we need something- we really didnt need anything. they have it all- even guide books of BA and a transformer for US plugs such as cellphones computers etc. very generous, they let us stay as a courtesy till our flight, we left the place at 5pm. great apt, we loved it!!!

Jamais's apartment was a great last-minute addition to our trip. Responses were very prompt and Jamais and associates were very friendly and accommodating to our last minute reservation needs. The flat itself was very spacious, fit four of us very comfortable and is in a great location on a quite street in Palermo. If you are considering staying here, be sure to check out the sandwhich / delicacy shop a few blocks down Malabia (we frequented there multiple times on our four day stay). Couldn't be more pleased with our decision to stay in Jamais's Palermo flat. Many thanks.

Awesome apartment and excellent location. With my favorite ice cream store just around the corner and a giant Disco grocery store on the next block you can't lose. The apartment is set up perfectly for two couples and is very comfortable. You can easily use this apartment as a base to explore Buenos Aires or Palermo. If you want to tango it isn't is an easy walk or super quick cab ride up to the Canning or La Viruta.
The property managers were quick and efficient and willing to meet us at odd hours to check us in. The full kitchen made it easy to prepare our own meals at the apartment.

Lovely apartment..
Jamais and her husband are both lovely people and extremely helpful.
I highly recommend this apartment.

Passei um fim de semana no studio do Martin e tudo saiu como esperava! Emilia, namorada de Martin, estava me esperando no horário combinado e foi muito receptiva. O studio é justamente como aparece nas fotos e tudo estava organizado e limpo. A localização do apartamento é excelente, com supermercado, cafés super aconchegantes para tomar café da manhã, metrô e ônibus.
Antes de chegar em Buenos Aires, Martin enviou uma lista de dicas do que fazer na cidade e todas as opções que consegui visitar foram ótimas!
Para um casal é uma excelente opção e permite ter a sensação de ser porteño por alguns dias. Super recomendado!

The newly painted apartment is in a very good location, close to shops, restuarants and transport and although it's on a busy road it's quiet for Buenos Aires as it's at the back of the building.  The apartment has 2 large bedrooms, one with a king size bed and the other queen size, large dining room and lounge area and compact kitchen.  Cameron is a very good host, meeting us on arrival and departure even though we had a very early flight when we left and he was only too happy to ensure we had a comfortable stay and listened to our concerns.  We loved the area, mostly local residents, and very close to transport and would definitely stay again in this apartment.

Great location and host was very attentive and helpful. The apartment was very comfortable and well priced. I agreed with the other review, the apartment needs a bit of maintenance  updating, specifically the bathroom tile and grout, as well as upholstery cleaning. I still enjoyed staying in the apartment and would recommend.

Cameron was very responsive to all our questions and emails and gave us lots of helpful advice.  We found his home spacious and comfortable.  Since Cameron was out of town, he was very thoughtful to arrange for his associate, Julieta to meet us when we arrived.  Julieta was also fantastic - she arranged for our transportation to and from the airport, sat down and discussed fun things to do in Buenos Aires, left us with tour books, and checked on us during our stay.  The location of the home is great and the internet worked very well throughout our entire stay.

Our stay in Cameron's apartment was really great. The apartment was exactly as it is shown in AirBnB profile. Very clean, light and cozy. Beds were so comfortable with very smoothy lining. Furthermore, Cameron was very gentle in waiting us for up one hour, since our flight was delayed. Considering the neighborhood, one could not be better placed. You have absolutely all you need in a walking distance. We will strongly consider stay there in our next visit to Buenos Aires.

O apartamento é muito bom, muito bem localizado, em uma típica "calle porteña", com muito movimento e vida. É silencioso, amplo,  iluminado e ventilado. É todo refrigerado (o ar condicionado de um dos quartos é um tanto barulhento e não refrigera tão bem). As camas e móveis são confortáveis e a cozinha muito bonita. No entanto, não está equipada para a preparação de refeições, mas apenas para café da manhã ou comida congelada. O wifi é muito bom e o Cameron gentil e educado. Com um pequeno investimento adicional na cozinha e alguma decoração o apartamento se transformaria em uma opção de alto nível, mas tal como está é excelente e muito recomendável. Nós estamos voltando a Buenos Aires em dezembro e certamente hospedar-me- ei lá.

Cameron was super helpful during our entire trip and very responsive to our emails. The place was in a perfect location with A/C in both bedrooms and the living room which made a huge difference as we came during a heat wave.
The location is great and size of apartment very comfortable.

Amigos do Air Bnb. É a segunda vez que eu, meu marido e nossos dois filhos nos hospedamos no apartamento de Cameron. Sempre fomos muito bem recebidos, Cameron é solícito, gentil. discreto, nos deixando sempre muito a vontade. O apartamento está muito bem localizado, é silencioso, organizado e limpo. Sua decoração e cômodos são básicos, de bom gosto e agradáveis, o local é muito arejado também, Próximo de tudo, de fácil deslocamento, ruas seguras e movimentadas, supermercado praticamente ao lado. Voltamos ontem, 18 de fevereiro e na despedida já comunicamos a Cameron, que nesta mesma época no ano que vem, voltaremos novamente. Cameron também possui outros apartamentos no Palermo Soho. Abraço, Cameron! Ótimos dias e até o próximo ano. Ana Maria Ferreira Salzano.

As evidenced by other reviewers and true to fact, Cameron was a great host!  He let us check in early (around 10am) and leave late (around 4pm). The apartment is in a great neighborhood, on the edge of Recoleta, with a huge supermarket around the corner and the bus to Palermo (118) stopping right outside the door.  And there were restaurants literally on almost every corner, with the one next door being very good, and incredibly inexpensive.  We ate there like 6 times during out 18 day stay.  The apartment is a nice apartment, but could use a little renovation and TLC, particularly in the bathroom and maid's quarters.  But all in all, it was a very pleasant stay and I would consider this apartment again.

Nossa hospedagem foi maravilhosa! O apartamento tem ótima localização, com vários cafés, restaurantes, supermercado, farmácia, bem próximos! O lugar é bem espaçoso e confortável! Cameron foi super atencioso. E muito profissional! Indico para todos! Buenos aires é uma cidade incrível! Concerteza voltaremos

As first-time visitors to Buenos Aires and first-time users of airbnb, we had a great experience during our stay in this apartment.  The neighborhood is perfect with many shops and restaurants located very conveniently in proximity to the apartment, and Cameron was a great host, with helpful, timely communication prior to the trip.  My family really enjoyed our time there and recommend this rental property to other travelers.

My friends and I had an amazing stay in this apartment. Cameron was very professional and flexible when we wished to extend. He also gave us many recommendations for local restaurants and bars nearby. The apartment is in a great location with a large supermarket on the corner and lots of coffee places very close by. The apartment is also much larger than we thought it would be and found it to be excellent value for money. Highly recommend this apartment for a relaxing stay in BA.

Martin and his girlfriend were very helpful and kind. I don't speak Spanish, so they called some places for me. I like how the room organized. There are place to eat, place to relax, and place to sleep.

Mi esposo y yo tuvimos una muy buena experiencia en este departamento. El departamento esta en uja excelente ubicación y en muy buenas condiciones tal cual se ve en las fotos publicadas en el anuncio. Cerca de todo.
El anfitrión Martín fue amable y nos explico el funcionamiento del mismo.
Excelente depto, por su ubicacion, comodidades y limpieza. Altamente recomendable. Seguro volveré a ir!!!!

El estudio de Martín está muy bien ubicado, en la linda zona de Recoleta, con todos los servicios y medios de transporte a la mano.  El apartamento es como en las fotos, perfecto para 2 personas.  Tanto la cama como el sofá cama son cómodos.  No tuvimos ningún problema en el check-in y check-out, Martín se acomodó a nuestros horarios de vuelos.  Gracias, Martín!
Todo excelente. Muy lindo departamento y excelente ubicación

Passamos 4 dias em Buenos Aires, no studio do Martin. Gostamos muito da hospedagem e do tratamento do anfitrião.
O apartamento, bem equipado e limpo, nos acomodou de forma confortável - um casal e um filho adolescente. Também gostamos muito da localização, das surpresas dos arredores - ali pertinho está a Biblioteca Nacional, com excelente acervo, arquitetura arrojada e uma cafeteria muito simpática! Gostamos também da vizinhança tranquila e da rua silenciosa e segura, que além de tudo fica próxima de muitos pontos de interesse na capital argentina. Não posso deixar de citar uma dica preciosíssima que nos foi dada pelo Martin - La Aguada, um restaurante de comida regional argentina - a melhor experiência gastronômica da nossa viagem! - e que fica bem perto do apartamento.
Obrigada, Martin.
Recomendo a hospedagem.

Muy buena ubicación en Recoleta Buenos Aires.
Estacionamiento cercano para dejar el auto seguro.
Disfrutamos de un fin de semana largo con muy linda temperatura.
El depto es muy lindo! Se encuentra re bien ubicado y la atencion de martin muy buenaa!!!!!
Neighborhood was perfect, location was key and studio was in great shape. Martin was always available and very accommodating  on time to check in/out.  Only problem was unreliable WIFI....

Minha estadia no apartamento do Martin foi muito legal. O apartamento é ótimo, muito limpo e num prédio bem tranquilo. Além disso, fica bem perto da estação de metrô Agüero, o que é bem prático... Há várias opções de supermercados e cafés perto do apartamento e há também uma pizzaria muito boa chamada Espuma - indicação do Martin. Ele foi solícito e muito gentil!

Excelente apartamento, todo reformado e limpo, idêntico ao descrito no anúncio. O prédio é antigo, mas o apartamento está todo reformado e impecável. O chuveiro é ótimo.
A localização é ótima para sair a pé e passear pela Recoleta. Também existem estações de metrô próximas.
Martin foi um ótimo host e indicou alguns lugares bons para conhecermos, principalmente gastronômicos.
Recomendo!
Lovely cosy flat in the nicesest part of Buenos Aires. Martín, my host, was very kind and welcoming and left me very useful information about the area - highly recommended!

Martin is a cool dude. Very help and smart too. He's very well-read, get him talking about the future and dystopian novels and he'll get you thinking!

Very easy to get along with, great at communications!
The apartment is very well located.  Martin was there when we arrived and took car of every thing we needed.  The apartment is spacious and in a well secured building.

The flat is very well located, it's good, everything works. The bed is excellent. Martin was there when we arrived and was available by phone whenever needed. It would be better to have better glasses to drink wine, but this is a minor issue. We would definitely recommend this flat to someone going to Buenos Aires.

Accueil sympathique et efficace. Le logement est très bien situé au 1er étage dans une rue calme. L'appartement correspond à la photo.
On s'y sent chez soi. Qualité à tous les niveaux. Recommandé pour des longs séjours.

The listing was perfectly accurate, it was located in the great area, he house was spotless, And Martin ensured that someone was waiting to check me in. This place is in excellent value for the price. I would highly recommend staying here.

A localização do apartamento é excelente. O apartamento é bom para hospedar duas pessoas. Todos os aparelhos funcionam e a limpeza é adequada. Recomendo pelo excelente custo x benefício. O Martin foi atencioso e ficou à disposição para apoiar, se necessário.

Everything was fine with the flat: the location is great  to visit everything and amenities were good. The flat was clean and cosy. The shower was perfect and I felt very safe. There is lots of space and storage and the internet connection worked perfectly well!

Excelente la atención de Martín y de las personas que con él trabajan. Muy profesionales y serviciales. El apartamento muy bien ubicado, con todos los servicios y transporte accesibles. En mi próxima parada en BA tendré a Martín en cuenta.
The place was very nice, exactly as pictured, very well-located. Our overall experience was great.
Fantastic!! Martin was extremely accommodating, and the apartment is at once chic and comfy (and in a very nice location). I hope I can come back!
Lugar coresponde as fotos. Muito boa localidade deu tudo muito certo. Recomendo!
El apartamento es hermoso y amplio es idéntico a las fotos y martin fue muy amable durante nuestra estadía. Súper recomendable, seguro volveremos pronto! Gracias Martin!

Martin's studio apartment is absolutely wonderful, and perfect for 3 people. Martin also sent us some recommendations ahead of time for things to do while in Buenos Aires, which we found very helpful. Although there was an issue with the Internet/Cable services at the beginning of our stay, Martin stayed in contact with us and worked to get the services back up as quickly as possible. I would recommend this Studio to anyone traveling in Buenos Aires.

This is a wonderful apartment. I stayed there for 3 weeks and really enjoyed it. Great location. The apartment is professionally managed with everything you need for your stay. Nicely decorated. Fairly quiet even though it is at the front of the building. The street is not that noisy for a city street. Highly recommended!
El apartamento muy lindo y súper amplio e iluminado. Muy limpio y con todas las comodidades. Shanghái muy amable y a disposición por cualquier problema. Sin duda volvemos.

Every detail of the listing was 100 percent on target.  The apartment is totally equipped and in a great location to explore all of BA.  Jamais and Ruben are the consummate hosts and made sure we were totally comfortable before leaving.  You can't beat this apartment!

Great Apartment and great location!! The apartment is big and has everything you need. Cameron was very helpful and helped us in a urgency situation (we needed a asap check in due problems with a hotel). I trully reccomend.
Cameron is top notch!  If there's any issue he's responsive and diligent.  He goes out of his way to accommodate.  Great host - definitely recommend!

Hello Everyone,

The apartment is old but very confortable, the air condition works well and the bed is good.
Cameron is friendly and he can help you with a lot of things (places to eat, to drink and to go out ).
The location of apartment is very good, there are supermaket near of apartament, a lot of restaurants and museums.

Cameron was a warm and attentive host who was super quick to respond to any questions I had before and during the trip. He also made himself available for a very early check-out time, which was very appreciated. Plus, he had good tips on getting from the airport to the apartment as well as advice about the city.

The apartment itself is older, but charming. The kitchen is more modern and more stylish than the rest of the apartment, but overall it's is a comfortable spot from which to explore the city or for a longer stay, too. Also, the location is fantastic, just a short walk from the famed Recoleta Cemetery, and with a 24-hour pharmacy right downstairs (which came in handy during a little health scare), and a Freddo's almost across the street. It's a safe, central street from which to explore or re-visit the city.
This was a great neighborhood - very central, safe and accessible. The home was as pictured. The host was very accommodating as to check-in and check out times.

Jamais and Ruben's apartment is perfect for a trip to Buenos Aires. It is really comfortable, bright, and well equipped. Better than our own home, in fact! It is also fantastically located in the heart of Palermo, with everything you'd need nearby, as well as the SUBTE D line and bus routes a short walk away. Jamais and Ruben were great - really helpful in getting us orientated in this wonderful city.

La descripcion del anuncio fue correcta, y aunque no tuvimos la oportunidad de conocer a Martin personalmente, pudimos conocer a su amiga, que nos hizo muy buenas recomendaciones para conocer en Buenos Aires. El departamento muy lindo, de techos altos y acogedor. en una zona de facil acceso. Todo bien!
Muy lindo el departamento , igual como se ve en las fotos, perfecta atención , el barrio agradable , súper recomendable.

O apartamento do Martin é realmente muito bom e confortável. Fica em um otimo bairro, proximo ao metrô e portanto, de facil acesso. Estava limpo e bem equipado.
O Martin foi um otimo anfitrião e compartilhou algumas dicas interessantes culturais e turísticas. Recomendado.

Excelente departamento. Limpio, bien ubicado y con todo lo necesario. Martin es un excelente host, atento a

Volvería sin lugar a dudas.
EXCELENTE APARTAMENTO Y DECORACION . GRAN ESTADIA . BUENA ATENCION POR PARTE EL ANFITRION . MUY RECOMENDABLE

Martin called the company, and told us they were having issues in the area. Aside from that, everything was good.

Adoramos o Studio, muito aconchegante, tudo limpo, organizado e bem cuidado, como nas fotos postadas.

O apartamento é tal qual descrito e apresentado nas fotos. Fica localizado no lindo bairro Recoleta e próximo ao metrô, cafés e mercados. Embora não conhecemos o Martin pessoalmente, sempre tivemos fácil comunicação com ele. Recomendo.

O apartamento possui ótima localização, em área residencial segura, próximo da linha D do metrô e dos pontos turísticos da Recoleta.
