Fica no primeiro andar, a dois lances de escadas do térreo, o que faz com que se ouça ruídos da rua e do movimento do prédio, principalmente mais tarde.

Passamos uma ótima semana em Buenos Aires. Martin estava esperando no check-in, mostrou o apartamento e falou um pouco sobre a cidade.
O apartamento era exatamente como descrito no anúncio. Tudo muito limpo e bem cuidado. A localização é perfeita, com várias opções de restaurantes, mercados, padarias por perto.

El apartamento es precioso, está muy limpio y la cama es cómoda. Está situado en Recoleta muy cerca de el cementerio, del centro cultural y también del metro. El barrio tiene todo lo necesario para los que viajamos: tintorerías, supermercados, cafés, restaurantes, farmacias... Nos recibió puntualmente Shangai, una compañera de Martín, y muy amable nos explicó todo sobre el apartamento. Ya nos alojamos anteriormente en un apartamento de Martín y lo mejor que puedo decir es que cuando vuelva a Buenos Aires volveré a repetir sin dudarlo. Muchas gracias por todo.

Very clean and spacious apartment. Walking distance to the metro and Recoletta cemetery. Across the street from the best empanadas place - a must eat! Wifi didn't work most of the time. Excellent shower and washroom facilities. We didn't use the kitchen but it looked nice.

Martín bien a nivel general por ahí la mucama/empleada uno espera que cuando vaya por lo menos barra el piso. El internet del lugar puede mejorar. Muy lindo y todo perfecto ;-)...el departamento de Martin es super, bien situado, decorado a la perfecciòn ...me quedé tres semamas y no quiero irme!!!!! No tuve el placer de encontrar a Martin, per su amiga estaba presente y siempre contestò a todas mis preguntas ! Muchismas gracias por todo y por la linda estancia!

Buena ubicación. De los mejores lugares en Buenos Aires. Nos encanto el diseño del aparta estudio o monoambiente. Buen espacio y comodidad espacio, iluminación, decoración, pintura en excelente estado. Cocina con toda una buena dotación. Aunque no la usamos todo estaba muy organizado , limpio y de buen gusto. Martin's place was just great. It's one of those places that actually looks like the pictures. The building is nice, the area was safe, really we had no complains and it was a great start to our Buenos Aires trip.

Martín es muy amable y está atento a responder rápidamente requerimientos y dudas.

Martin was very helpful during our stay.  He was flexible with check-in, gave us a nice overview of the city and location of the apartment, and even offered to help us make plans in BA.  The apartment itself was comfortable and as advertised, in a nice area of the city.

Bueno, yo soy un hombre que a viajado bastante y siempre buscos soluciones para los lugares en los que estoy para sentirme como en casa, es la razón por lo que me llamo la atención Airbnb. Escogí un departamento que se veía mucho mejor de lo que era, mi primera mala impresión fue el anfitrión, camelos un ingles simpático pero con pésima presentación personal, con ropas viejas y descuidadas se veía algo sucio. el aseo pobre del departamento y un detalle no menor pésima ropa de cama (en malas condiciones y con machas de sangre) un asco. Por otra parte el dia que me retire llega camelon en una actitud media prepotente, se varias vultas por el departamento y me me pregunta que cuantas personas no estamos quedando yo le respondo que las dos que vio llegar y que el dia de ayer se quedo un colega mío que trabaja con migo ya que viajaba de vuelta acompañándome me dique que ay muchos reclamos y bla bla bla... Y que como utilice 6 toallas en 12 días y dice en comentario en ingles a minparecer ofensivo, algo a si. que nadie Es tan sucio para usar tantas. We had a very pleasant 4-nights stay at Martin's studio. It fits the description of most reviews. Internet worked just fine. The "empanadas" place across the street is both an asset and a must, the best I have ever tried.
El departamento es igual a las fotos, bien distribuido y muy cómodo. El barrio es muy tranquilo. Martín fue muy atento.

The apartment is pretty modern European/French style apartment and cozy, although not very well equipped when it comes to bathroom and kitchen. Located in a old house in Recoleta, you are surrounded by a multitude of coffee shops and restaurants, although if you want bars and clubs you need to take a cab to a nearby neighborhood. The wifi is pretty fast, I was able to get work done. The building where the flat is located is old, and you can hear your neighbors which have the tendency to party late at night. Same problem with the construction site located right in front of the building, which gets noisy around 8:30. So, bring earplugs.
El departamento tal cual las fotos! Muy lindo, bien ubicado cerca de todo y una zona segura! Lo recomiendo!
Cameron had a great attitude and was extremely helpful.

Cameron is a very friendly host, from the first contact till the end of stay everything went excellent. He answered all questions immediately and precise. The location is well situated in a nice, quiet and secure part of Buenos Aires. Taxis, busses and subway are easy to pick in walking distance. A good supermarket has all you need just around the corner. Electricity, warm water, wifi ran all over the time ( which is not self-evident in BA..) The apartment is luminous, partly with a view ( which is also not self-evident in BA), clean, nicely decorated, lots of storage and hangers ;), the kitchen has all you need. I highly recommend the place and would come back anytime.

Cameron was a great host, he arrived promptly at the beginning/end of our stay and was available by phone if we needed anything.  We spent a week in the flat with our daughter who is studying  in Buenos Aires.  The space was perfect for us, spacious, bright,  two bedrooms, with very comfortable beds, and a king in the master. The shower was robust and hot and  the tub provided a nice soak after a full day of sightseeing. We ate out mostly but had cozy breakfasts in the kitchen and cooked dinner two nights.  As mentioned previously,  there is a large grocery store just around the corner, many local bakeries and a lovely gelato shop, Buffala, a few blocks away which we visited frequently. The location is perfect for visiting neighborhoods of interest, excellent transportation, buses, subway, taxis and reliable  wifi.  We highly recommend!

My family and I rented Cameron's Buenos Aires apartment for a week. We had an early arrival (around 8 AM); Cameron was kind enough to accommodate us with a check-in around 9 AM.

The apartment is in a great part of town, Recoleta. It is definitely not a tourist location. However, my family enjoyed this as we were able to see how the citizens of Buenos Aires live and there are still quite a number of places to visit within walking distance such as the Recoleta Cemetery and the Borges Museum. The only issue was that despite the numerous banks around the apartment, absolutely none of them take debit/credit cards from the United States. As a heads up, we found a currency exchange by crossing French, in a hidden store behind the green newspaper stand.

As for the apartment itself, there are two beds that easily fit two people each; however, one of chose to stay on the couch. We also enjoyed the recently remodeled bathrooms! Keep in mind there is only one shower, though.

Cameron himself was very communicative and addressed issues promptly. We would definitely recommend staying at his wonderful apartment in Recoleta!

Gostei muito do apartamento e da localização ! Cameron foi muito receptivo é simpático ! O bairro é ótimo , boa localização e comercio ao redor !
Muito obrigada

Our family of four spent the holidays at Cameron's apartment. It is large, well equipped and simply furnished. The neighbourhood was central and close to shops, restaurants and some attractions. We really walked a lot! BA is a fabulous city. Check in and out with Cameron was easy as well.

Hola, estuve 17 días en el departamento sola. Me parece muy acogedor y práctico! Martín me recibió y me recomendó sitios a los que podía ir, cómo movilizarme, etc. Muy atento. Martín tambien me brindó sus números telefónicos en caso de alguna emergencia y me sugirió taxis para ir al aeropuerto.
Volvería!
Saludos.
Excelente! El departamento es tal cual el anuncio, el anfitrion muy atento y accesible. Seguro volvemos.! Gracias!!

Localizado em um edifício antigo, o apartamento está novo por dentro, com um ótimo chuveiro e calefação, o que fez com que nem sentíssemos o frio de Buenos Aires enquanto estivemos nele. A localização é excelente! Perto das avenidas Pueyrredón, Santa Fé e Las Heras, a apenas três quadras de uma estação de metrô (Las Heras) e quatro de outra (Agüero). A duas quadras, você encontra um Carrefour. Na rua, quase em frente ao apartamento, há uma loja de ótimas empanadas, com preços muito bons. A região é linda e tem estilo europeu, você está perto de tudo, mas não na muvuca do microcentro. Quando estive no microcentro da cidade, tive a certeza de que fiz a escolha certa por este apartamento na Recoleta. Martin nos atendeu sempre que precisamos, respondendo prontamente nossas mensagens no aplicativo do Airbnb. Um ótimo lugar para estar em Buenos Aires.

Martin's place was great, right in the middle of a busy area of Buenos Aires, conveniently close to groceries and metro station. The place was very clean and great to live in!
Martin was a very attentive host, always available for help whenever needed!

No tengo ningún comentario negativo de mi estadía en Bs As.
El departamento es excelente!!! Sin duda alguna, la mejor ubicación. Puedes caminar en poco tiempo y conocer muchos sitios turisticos como el Cementerio de Recoleta, La Biblioteca Nacional, La Floralis Generis Etc.
Agradezco mucho a Martín por la atención, siempre fue muy formal y estuvo atento a lo que necesitaba.
Recomiendo el hospedaje un 100%.
Volveré pronto!!!!
A descrição do anúncio foi adequada e a recepção também. Apenas duas questões: o barulho irregular do ar-condicionado e reparos no banheiro. De qualquer forma, nada que prejudique o local.
Wonderful! Thank you very much.

Gostamos muito da estadia no studio de Martin, na calle Aguero, em Recoleta. Bem localizado, confortável, com muitas lojinhas wue facilitam a vida como um morador da cidade. Os únicos reparos que sugerimos são para o ruído do ar condicionado e a troca da tampa do vaso no banheiro.

We had a great time in Buenos Aires staying at Martin's place! Martin waited for our arrival at the apartment and greeted us to give us the keys. I highly recommend the food from the restaurant "Lo de Rita" which is a block or two away. Martin's place is wonderful if you are looking for a great location in a great neighborhood in the city.  Thanks for a great stay!

Martin foi super atencioso, meu marido passou mal e ele nos atendeu na hora , inclusive facilitando a conversa com a medica! alem disso tudo que perguntavamos ele respondia rapidamente o que me deu muita segurança de que poderiamos confiar em nosso anfitriao.

Excelente opción para alojarte! lugar seguro, tranquilo y bien ubicado, además de cómodo y limpio. Martín en todo momento estuvo al pendiente. Lo recomiendo ampliamente y sin duda volvería a utilizarlo!

Nice apartment in great location. It's well equipped and internet works just fine.

Martín´s apartment is great. It was clean and neat and the building is ok. Close to coffee shops and restaurants and walking distance to Recoleta´s Cemetery, MALBA and some nice parks. It is a cozy and good decorated apartment.  Nice and clean apartment in a beautiful neighbourhood ,close to subway & nice restaurants, Martin is a friendly host. Thanks you for your hospitality and your recommended locations .I would recommend this apartament definitely.  .
It s a very nice apartment in the heart of Bueinas Aires. You ve got everything to feel comfortable during your staying here. Recommended!)
Very nice stay
Excelente ubicación y muy buena atención por parte del anfitrión súper recomendado las sugerencias de los restaurantes
Fue una hermosa estadía! El depto es súper luminoso y está bien ubicado. Lo recomendamos!

Este lindo apartamento cumplio todas nuestras expectativas. Esta muy bien ubicado y en un area muy segura. El apt es amplio, iluminado y limpio, justo lo que necesitabamos.
Gracias Martin por ser tan atento a todas nuestras dudas! Definitivamente es el lugar para quedarse en buenos aires!
Excelente em tudo

Being a rather "playing it safe" traveler I would normally stick to one place to stay at once I have discovered one that works. That is what happened 3 years ago during my first trip to Buenos Aires where Martin was my host. He made the stay so comfortable, enjoyable and great that I broke my habit, and for the next trip I decided to try another apartment but stick to Martin, knowing that it it can't go wrong. The third time is a charm, it is the best apartment with unique architecture and prime location in Recoleta, blocks away from the brand new H line station (and a few more from the D train) - within 15-25 minutes you can arrive at any central location across the city - amazing. Great restaurants around the building, quite a few dry cleaning/laundry places etc. etc. Martin is a considerate, reliable host and great all-around person - friendly, efficient, cultured, punctual and knowledgeable. Absolutely recommend the apartment, as well as Martin as a host should you chose one of the other locations he manages. He meets, greets, coordinates, communicates, resolves things (should there be any to resolve). Thumbs up yet again!

Fui com meu marido e meu filho de um ano. Escolhi o apartamento do Martin pela localização e, principalmente, pela cozinha. A localização realmente é excelente. Muy buen alojamiento, bien ubicado y con diseño. El edificio no cuenta con ascensor, dato por si viajan con bebes.
Fomos muito bem recebidos pelo Martin! Excelente anfitrião!Nos sentimos em casa! O apartamento é bem o que se vê nas fotos e sua localização é excelente!

Muy bien ubicado. a pocas cuadras del subte. El barrio es tranquilo y hay de todo para comprar cerca (supermercados, lavanderías, bares y restaurants). Algunos problemas con el wifi, que se superaron.
Muy buena ubicación y excelente atención de Martín.
Muy buen departamento, comodo y confortable, excelente ubicacion
Very nice, small apartment in great location! Everything was clean and the checkin/checkout was easy!
O apartamento do Martin é ótimo e super bem localizado. Martin também é um ótimo anfitrião, responde rápido e dá dicas da cidade.

Ideal tanto para turistas como para quienes vienen a estudiar

Apartamento excelente. Exatamente como nas fotos, porém ainda maior pessoalmente. Em um ótimo prédio, com uma vizinhaça silenciosa e muito bem localizada em Recoleta. Com certeza voltaria outra vez.
Muy buena ubicacion. El departamento esta bien equipado. En el caso de tener auto hay varios estacionamientos cerca.

o ambiente é lindo e com muita luz. tudo muito limpo e organizado. a roupa de cama e banho são de primeira qualidade! o bairro é ótimo, tem de tudo, próximo do metrô, a rua bem movimentada por carros mas a porta da sacada bloqueia bem o som quando fechada. gratidão!
the place was very cozy. all that was expected and needed. a great base to explore BA. ! txs!

El Loft es muy bonito, inclusive mejor que en las fotos!. Es limpio y con estilo.

Los puntos bajos son:

1. El pasillo desde la puerta de entrada hasta el Loft es tenebroso y está muy descuidado, además no está completamente cubierto.

2. No hay ascensor y tienes que subir 4 pisos caminando @_@

I cannot say enough good things about this apartment! It was a great apartment with lots of space. There was 4 of us staying there and it never felt crowded. The location is good and within walking distance of a lot of great places to eat and drink. I would definitely recommend staying there! Bri was extremely helpful for us, our luggage was lost by TAM and there was a lot of going forward and backwards with the airline (as well as delays with us landing there), and Bri was very helpful throughout the whole process. The mobile phone they leave is a great touch, without it I don't know how we would have kept in touch with the airline. Thanks again for everything!

Great apartment fitted out to a very high standard. We loved the location just a short walk to some of the best shopping in Buenos Aires as well as great restaurants and a park for our 4yo son. This apartment is classy and a step up from the norm.Jamais and her property manager Brigette were also there all the way through from booking through to departure to ensure everything went smoothly. Thanks for the great stay and will definitely book with you again.
La experiencia fue muy buena. El apartamento luce tal cual las fotos y la atención fue rapida y profesional. Lo recomiendo

We loved our stay at Jamais' place in Buenos Aires.  It is in a great neighborhood, a short walk from shopping, cafes and restaurants.  The loft itself is nicely situated in a building with a lot of character.  There are two nicely sized bedrooms and a joined dining and living area with a separate kitchen.  Jamais was also very easy to communicate with and was very responsive.  Check-in and check-out were a breeze.  We really enjoyed our stay, and would stay again!
Had a great experience in this apartment. Reliable wi-fi and seamless check-in and check-out. Not the best ventilation or light, though.
Beautiful home in the heart of Palermo. I can't rate it highly enough. Thanks for a lovely stay in your wonderful city. We will be back.

Jamais was great to work with preparing the stay and during our time there, too.  I'm sure my two year granddaughter has never experienced such swankiness!  Location is perfect for strolling, eating, and accessing all of the city.

We stayed in Cameron's apartment for 5 nights. Overall it's a nice place and we enjoyed our stay, but there were some issues which tainted our impression. The apartment was pretty dirty and needs a serious deep clean rather than just the spot treatment it gets between guests. The kitchen in particular was covered in muck from the fridge to the bin in the cabinet. We just avoided the kitchen and used our own plastic bags as rubbish bins. The towels and sheets were both worn and had stains on them and clearly had not been replaced in a long time. The A/C in one of the bedrooms was broken when we arrived, but Cameron was great about getting it replaced very quickly. A+ on that. However, the A/C in the living room dripped water throughout our stay, causing a puddle on the floor. It needs to be replaced. The WiFi is VERY slow and kept dropping on all of our devices.

Cameron was very easy to communicate with and he was attentive to our concerns, replacing the broken A/C and even offering to bring in the cleaning person during our stay given my comments about the cleanliness. However he was clearly running a business rather than acting as a host. During check in it was all about getting the deposit and during check out he conducted a full check to ensure that everything was still there and not broken. However, Cameron gets props for meeting us at 6am for checkout given that that is when we needed to leave.

I don't intend this review to be overly negative - overall we enjoyed staying here. The location is great, the price is right, and the apartment is spacious, with good water pressure in the bathroom. It just needs a DEEP clean, some new towels/sheets, and a better modem/router for the WiFi. Good option for a budget stay in Recoleta with two big comfy bedrooms.

This is a great place.  We were a bit concerned about its being too small from the description, but it had plenty of room.  Lots of space for eating, using computers, etc.  We had a bad computer cord which blew the fuses, and Cameron was very responsive, extremely understanding and helpful in getting the power back on.  The location is outstanding, being right in the center of Recoleta, between two great subway stops and on a street with many buses and taxis, as well as every kind of shop, restaurant, laundry, spa, coffee place, etc. that you can imagine.  We loved our stay of a month here.

Pontos positivos: Excelente localização, próximo ao metro, restaurantes, supermercado e cemitério da Recoleta. Apartamento muito silencioso (de fundos) e com uma ótima relação custo/benefício, muito espaçoso e acomoda muito bem 4 pessoas.  Pontos negativos: limpeza da sala e cozinha requerem mais cuidado, a cozinha precisa de uma reforma. Os dos quartos são embutidos e muito antigos, apresentando cheiro de mofo. Apesar dos pontos negativos, nossa estadia foi boa. Cameron (host) foi muito atencioso o tempo todo.

Cameron, me recebeu muito bem em seu apartamento e as fotos que aparecem no site descrevem corretamente o que tem no apartamento. A localização é muito boa e tudo correu muito bem, dentro do planejado.
Cameron was an excellent host. The place is very comfortable and in great location.

A localização é excelente. Fica a uma quadra do metrô. Atras tem um supermercado Coto, porém existem vários outros próximos além de dezenas de restaurantes, kyoskos.  Fica muito próximo ao cemitério da recoleta.   Cameron foi bem atento e pontual.  Excelente apartamento para dois casais.
Localização fantástica com todas as comodidades perto (metrô, supermercado, cafés, praças e parques). Apartamento de bom tamanho, ótimas camas.
El departamento es muy cómodo y tiene muy buena ubicación
El espacio de Cameron, es un espacio Perfecto para estar temporadas largas y cortas, ya que el departamento es muy espacioso y está ubicado en una zona muy interesante de la ciudad.

Appartamento in posizione centrale e tranquilla, confortevolmente arredato e pulito. L'ospite ha dimostrato precisione e professionalità, nonché disponibilità nelle fasi di check in e check out.
Cameron s flat is in a great location. The flat s size was really good although it wasn't exactly as in the photos. Cameron was very responsive and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay!

I had the pleasure of staying at Cameron's apartment in Recoleta and I am very glad i made the choice. His apartment is in a great location, very clean and comfortable. Cameron Is very quick to respond and is always very courteous and polite.

Do yourself a favor and book with Cameron.
El departamento está muy bien ubicado, cerca de lugares de interés que se pueden visitar a pie, tiene comidas cafeterías Justo abajo, La ubicación es magnífica,

Great location, great spacious flat with a huge super market just around the corner. Ideal for a city break.
Highly recommended!

Una ubicación fantástica y el depto era muy cómodo. Cameron fue un anfitrión muy agradable con muchas recomendaciones para la ciudad. Ademas, él siempre respondió rápidamente a mis comunicaciones. Recomiendo mucho quedarse aquí!
Perfect location with easy access to many of the sites. Close to a large supermarket which make it convenient to pick up items that we needed.

Our stay in Cameron's place was amazing.  The location was perfect, centrally located in the Recoleta neighborhood near many places to eat. The cafe downstairs was great and very inexpensive. The Coto supermarket around the corner was great and made getting anything we needed super easy. The metro was located a few blocks down the street and the buses were easily accessible.  The apartment was very comfortable for the 3 of us, it had everything we needed. The check in/check out process was easy.
Foi uma excelente estádia, Cameron é super simpático e atencioso. Sem dúvida o espaço é ótimo com uma boa localização. Recomendo o apartamento.

Todo correcto pero la huella del paso del tiempo no se evidencia en las fotos.
La experiencia sería mucho mejor si se renovara la ropa de cama, parte del mobiliario y se hiciera una limpieza en profundidad.

Cameron was great in all communications upfront as well as the check in process. The accommodation was in an ideal location, close to cafes, grocery stores, subway and easy to walk to different areas in BA.
We were however disappointed that it did not reflect the photos promoting it. New bedding, towels and shower curtain would have greatly improved our experience. Good price and location but very different to the photos!

The apartment is great, just like in the pictures, very spacious and comfortable. The building is just amazing, you definitely get a neighborhood feel. The three bedrooms have a lot of privacy so that's nice too. The location is unbeatable, in the heart of Palermo but still 3 blocks from the subway. Communication with the host worked perfectly too. I definitely recommend the place and would stay there again in a heartbeat.

We greatly enjoyed our extended stay at Jamais' condo in Palermo Soho! The two level condo was very spacious and located only a few blocks from some of the best restaurants and entertainment in all of Buenos Aires. Our group flew in from the States on overnight flights, and the owners were able to arrange early checkin and coordinated perfectly with the property manager to meet us at the condo that morning. They were even kind enough to reach out and checkin with us during our stay.

My travel group would certainly stay at one of Jamais' properties again when vacationing in the future!

El departamento esta impecable , y muy bien equipado . Su ubicacion es inmejorable en Palermo , muy cercano a buenos restaurantes y tiendas , en un sector tranquilo y residencial . Jamais no estaba en buenos aires pero estuvo siempre en contacto y preocupado de nosotros .

From my initial contact on, Jamais was extremely helpful and informative! The loft was perfect; great location and it looks exactly as depicted on the website. Overall, a great experience and I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

Communication with Jamais was excellent when booking the flat and queries were promptly dealt with. She also provided many recommendations and tips on how to get the most out of our stay in Palermo - including the all-important money exchange at the 'blue' rate. The flat itself was as described and quite charming in an older building full of character. Of course this meant no lift - which we knew about - but lugging our cases up the pretty wrought iron and marble stairs was not an experience to be repeated in a hurry! We loved the black/white/red decor and modern art in the flat and it was very spacious with 2 pretty bathrooms and plenty of wardrobe space. Security was fine and the area very nice and full of life. We particularly enjoyed strolling down through the tree-lined streets with houses of many different styles squashed up together eg towards Plaza Armenia. Lots of cafes (cool!)and designer shops (expensive!) and all a pleasant change from the hustle and bustle of central BsAs. We especially liked Minga and La Cabrera restaurants and had some good take-away pizza from Romero. We appreciated having a real coffee machine in the flat too. We would certainly stay here again.

martin's apartment was a great place to stay in buenos aires.

it features 2 bathrooms, a nice balcony, fast internet and a really entertaining ascensor.

we were both late in checking in and out (BA's-traffic-disaster)
and he was fine with that. i definitely recommend the place.


P.S: i recommend the "El Establo" round the corner (San Martin/Paraguay) for perfect meat (and less tourists)

Martin's flat was a great place to stay and in a very central location. Close to the main bus station - Retiro. There are plenty of bars and restaurants close by, although these tend to be closed at the weekends so you have to venture further afar. Taxis are plentiful in Plaza San Martin so this is not a problem. Martin was very helpful and made good recommendations. He emailed every few days to check we were enjoying ourselves and to make sure everything was OK in the flat.  I would definitely recommend staying in this apartment, it is great value for money and Martin is a very good host!!

Martin, boa praça que é, nos recebeu muito bem, com recomendações de locais para visitar e eventos para comparecer, e seu apartamento é como nas fotos: limpo, bem mobiliado, em boas condições. Recomendo!

The apartment was very clean, with everything we needed. It's in a great location, close to all the majors Buenos Aires attractions and a metro station.

Martin was very nice, and always available to answer me. His recommendations was great.

I definitely recommend Martin's place!

O apartamento é ótimo. As fotos são muito confiáveis. A cama é bem confortável, o aquecimento funciona muito bem. Na cozinha, há tudo que se possa precisar. Além disso, o Martin nos recebeu muito bem, deu sugestões muito boas sobre museus, restaurantes, bares.
A localização do apartamento também é ótima.
recomendarei a todos os meus amigos que forem para Buenos Aires.

This is a great apartment in a great location.  You're one block away from the top of Florida Street for all you shoppers, and there are so many restaurants in the area that in a month, I rarely ate at the same place twice.  The apartment is quiet with windows on the courtyard side of the building.  I stayed here for a full month, and I look forward to returning to this location in future years.
Foi muito bom, o Martin foi super atencioso e nos orientou muito bem.

Martín is number one! Easy going, helpful, and fair. Quick to respond in the run up to my stay. I am doing a work about the culture of Buenos Aires and he had always gave me valuable tips especially about music. It also sent a lists of suggested great places to see and eat while i were there.
The apartment is in a nice central area, close to subway and Calle Florida, with many markets, good food and stores near. The place was clean, cozy, airy, with many books, hot water and air, the bed comfy, perfect WIFI and had everything i needed.
I definitely recommend the Martín's apartment, as he clearly run it as a professional operation. And a bonus! For those unaware he is musician and a good one, of the "El Limacoco"! See ya Martín.
Nossa estadia foi muito agradável. O apartamento estava em boas condições, e Martin foi bastante solícito.
Excelente estadia em Buenos Aires. O apartamento é muito bom, limpo e bem localizado, próximo a diversos serviços. Recomendo!!

The flat is very well located, one block from the beautiful Plaza San Martín and the famous Kavanagh building. It is also a big one bedroom flat so it can easily fit 3 people. Although it is in the middle of the centro, it is not at all noisy as it faces the interior (this also means no view of the city). The downside is there is not enough cookware available, but Im sure Martín can easily fix that. There are not big or cheap supermarkets in the neighbourhood cause it is not a residencial area, something to consider if you want to cook well and not eat out all the time. Another good thing, the library is amazing.
great host, very informative and easy to get a hold of. the place has a great location and was convenient.  thanks again for a great visit

El departamento de la calle San Martín está muy bien localizado cerca de varios restaurantes de buena calidad; además, por estár en la parte residencial del centro de Buenos Aires está servido por la densa red de transporte público que existe en esta parte de la ciudad.

Martín es una persona muy amable que te escucha y está lista a corregir las deficiencias del departamento, como en este caso, la dotación de la cocina.

Recomiendo ampliamente a Martín para proveer alojamiento en la ciudad de Buenos Aires.

O apartamento está muito bem localizado com muitos comércios por perto, inclusive farmácias e um supermercado. Tem fácil acesso a pontos de ônibus e metrôs.
Está a poucas quadras do cemitério da Recoleta.
Para ouvidos mais sensíveis aconselho levar tampões pois é um pouco barulhento por estar em uma grande avenida e por ter crianças nos andares de cima. A internet não pega muito bem e, em alguns horários, não pega nada, então se você depender da internet vale a pena providenciar um chip 4g.
Todo ha ido muy bien con Cameron y con el departamento, totalmente recomendado!!
Awesome spacious 2br apartment in a great location. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again!

Nice spacious apartment in Recoleta with plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby, easy walk to the cemetery. The area is safe.

The apartment had some character. It had 2 double bedrooms and 1.5 toilets. Kitchen had some basic cooking utensils. Wifi worked best in the living room.
Cameron contesto nuestros mensajes en forma rapida. el departamento espacioso y la ubicacion perfecta. gracias por todo!

Cameron is a great host and responded quickly to all requested that he had. I would highly recommend staying at his place it is nice and spacious as well. The apartment is close to stores and the metro.
This apartment is in a great location.  It needs some freshening up and updating.  But the accessibility to buses and subway, grocery store around the corner, cafes, vegetable shops, all very nearby.

Mariano was a charming and exceedingly helpful host and without his assistance my stay in Argentina would have been difficult. His apartment was clean and pleasantly decorated and had everything I needed, as well as a spot to sit in the sun. I would not hesitate to recommend him as a host to anyone.
Jonathan L

It was our first time using Airbnb and our first time in Buenos Aires. Honestly it was a great experience! The apartment itself was huge and was exactly as you see it in the photos. It was super comfortable and had plenty of space. It should be noted that the apartment is located on the second floor. However, since the apartments themselves are two floors, you're actually walking up 4 flights of stairs to reach the apartment since there are no elevators. If you have any type of mobility issues, you have to take that into consideration. It definitely wasn't an issue for us and it was a good excuse to get more exercise to work off all the great food we were eating.

The location was spot on! We chose the location that would be close to the subway and have access to bars and restaurants. You're in walking distance to all the bars and restaurants around Plaza Armenia and Plaza Serrano and easy access to the subway. The neighborhood was quiet and we felt safe walking around at night.

Check in/check out was easy. We were originally arriving in the morning and they were willing to hold our luggage till check in. Unfortunately, we got bumped from our flight and arrived late in the afternoon. We kept in contact with Jamais and checked in at a later time with no issues. We would definitely rent this apartment again the next time we're in Buenos Aires.

This is a beautiful condo which was restored and furnished beautifully and with great functionality. The beds were extremely comfortable! We truly enjoyed the living space to relax, sleep and prepare breakfast. The apartment is located two floors above ground (with no elevator) and the building could use a facelift but does have a lot of character and charm. The location is extremely good with access to restaurants and shopping at walking distance and easy access to subway etc. Thew wifi worked well and was fast.
The agent we met for check in was prompt and a pleasure to work with. However during our stay there were a few misunderstandings due to less than perfect communication with the owner which could and should have been avoided. Additionally the owner requested we sign an additional "lease" or agreement which is something I have never had to do with AirBNB which I found unnecessary and somewhat unwelcoming.

We were charmed by everything about our stay at Jamais' condo this week. Check-in and check-out were easy and simple, the apartment looks exactly how the pictures represent and the hosts were excellent in communicating with us before and during our stay. The apartment is really big and fully equipped with everything you could want. The water pressure in the showers wasn't the best but given that it is an older building, it was completely acceptable. We just loved staying here and would definitely return in the future. The only warning I might add would be to older travellers with lots of luggage, the apartment is a bit of a climb and there is only stair access. It wasn't a problem for us though. Many thanks Jamais!

Mariano is a very friendly, helpful and reliable host! He always answered e-mails and gave us some tips during our stay.
The maisonette apt. is a very quiet and cosy and a part of a 7-apt. building, all apts. being rented to tourists. The neighborhood has rather past its glory, but the apt. is a calm island in it:)

I enjoyed my stay at the San Telmo Duplex Loft 6. It's a great space for 1-2 people and is clean and quiet. And the roof deck is amazing—especially at night. The apartment is about 8 blocks from the center of San Telmo's square and 3 blocks from the subway, but a pretty good location. There are a lot of great bars within 2 blocks from the apartment too. The block feels a tad sketchy at night—so make sure you walk with someone, but during the day it is feels fine.

Mariano is very accommodating and was always very quick to respond to any questions that I had for him. I would recommend this place to my friends. Hope you enjoy your stay in Buenos Aires as much as I did!
Mariano was great. The apartment was big and clean and whenever I had a question Mariano helped me. Highly recommended if you are in Buenos Aires

Mariano is very helpful, we really enjoyed our stay.  If you want to stay in San Telmo, this is a good location, and good value.  Only negative (small) was that its hard to get the door open (really hard to turn the key all the way) my mom had to wait for someone to help her. All in all we are very glad we stayed there.

Mariano is great and helpful. The loft (#6) is amazing and very  quiet, clean and comfortable.  The neighborhood seems quite safe and is very convenient (laundry, banks, cafés etc.) The roof-top terrace is also a big bonus! We would highly recommend this loft!

Staying in San Telmo at Marianos and Zunis place was a great experience. Both are wonderful people, always helpful and sweet. I felt perfectly "at home" at their beautiful place. My duplex was cozy and tranquil and I had a very nice time there.

Ha sido una muy linda experiencia la estadía con Mariano y Zuni. Los dos son muy simpáticos, siempre ayudaron en todo lo que necesitaba y me sentía muy "en casa". La casa es muy linda, mi dúplex era tranquilo y espacioso y la pasé muy, pero muy bien allí.

Mir hat es sehr gut gefallen in San Telmo bei meinen Gastgebern Mariano und Uni. Beide sind unheimlich sympathische und hilfsbereite Personen und mein Loft war ruhig und gemütlich. Insgesamt eine sehr gute Erfahrung.

I have already written an extensive review about Mariano's other apartment which we stayed in during the same time (there was 8 of us, renting three apartments from Mariano in the same building). As with the other apartment - this apartment was spotless, comfortable and in a convenient location. Perfect for our needs! Mariano was a wonderful host and the stay at his properties was the highlight of our trip. Absolutely wonderful!
Adoramos Buenos Aires! O Loft é muito aconchegante e bem decorado, mesmo estando numa rua aparentemente estranha a noite, vimos que é bem próximo de lugares agradáveis e bastante movimentados.

We had a very good experience in Jamais space. It's a very nice and big flat in the middle of an outstanding neighbourhood.
Everything worked as or better than expected.
The apartment is perfectly situated and in excellent conditions. Sandra welcomed us at the apartment, which is lovely and big enough for a family of 4. Perfect stay!

Martin foi um excelente host, nos passou todas as informações necessárias sobre Buenos Aires, explicou detalhadamente o funcionamento do apartamento, foi realmente incrível! A localização é  excelente, de táxi nos deslocamos sem problemas por toda a cidade, no bairro é possível conhecer um restaurante por dia, sem duvida, uma ótima experiência. obrigada Martin!
Perfect location, very close to Florida street, 10-20 minuts walk to various subway lines, San Telmo and restaurants. If you're up to some night life you should go to Palermo.

Martin and the apartment were both great! The location is excellent and Martin was very accommodating to my checkin and out schedule which was a bit unusual. I only stayed in the apartment a few days, but would definitely stay there again.
todo  muy bien!
La estancia fue excelente: el departamento está bien ubicado, cerca del subte y de todo lo necesario. Es cómodo y acogedor. Martín fue un muy buen anfitrión. Lo recomendamos

Estuvemos, mi amiga Teka y yo, por 09 dias in 1bdr apartment near Pza.San Martin, nos gustó mucho, muy amable Martin, nos atendió en todo que necessitamos. El departamento és muy bien localizado, cerca de la calle Florida,  Galeria Pacífico, buens restaurants, etc. Cuando yo vuelva a Bs. As. espero me quedar allí nuevamente. Muchas Gracias Martin.

The best thing about this apartment is location. It seems like no one likes Microcentro, the neighborhood where apartment is located, but I loved it. Within less than 30 seconds walk from the apartment you will have several very good and interesting bars, restaurants and coffee shops which I keep coming back to to eat, drink, work and take someone on a date even though I live in another area now. It is also very strategically and conveniently located providing easy access to the places of interest and transportation. Although in some areas of Microcentro you may feel insecure, the vicinity of the apartment situated just one block from lively Florida street and a five star hotel is totally safe to walk at night.

The apartment is very modest and it was a little bit cold in there during the last days of autumn however I would say it is one of the best value for money deals in the city.

I was staying in the apartment for one month so I really enjoyed weekly cleaning and the change of bed linen.

The host, Martin is very professional, accommodating and easy to communicated with.

This is a great apartment. I stayed here three months and was very comfortable. Stylish, nice pictures on walls, nice wooden floors and a big bookshelf.

The bed looks a bit small in the photo, but it is a normal queen sized bed. The power points were of varied types, the most common being Argentine style. There's lots of books on the bookshelf in English and Spanish. Kitchen has plenty of plates, bowls, cutlery etc.

It's quite a way from any streets. Most nights it was completely quiet and I couldn't hear anything outside. A few nights I heard partying coming from somewhere, but it wasn't too loud. I also heard one or two car horns, but this was very, very rare. I'm a light sleeper, so if there was noise, I would have noticed.On a related note, the bedroom window is equipped with blind that blacks out just about all light. Great for siestas and at night for those of us who are sensitive to light.

The doorman is helpful and nice, he's there in the morning till around 14:00 and then from 17:00-20:00. Martin was a good host and gave me some good suggestions when I first arrived for stuff to do and where to eat.

I love the location. There are bars nearby. There's a lavandaria a few buildings away. Florida street is a block away. It's about a 30 minute walk to Recoleta or San Telmo in the other direction. Very short walk to Puerto Madero to get some sea breeze (which, being Australian, I needed).

Mariano ist sehr hilfsbereit und immer absprechbar.
Die Appartments sind nett und fast alle zu einem ganz ruhigen Innenhof gelegen.
Es gibt auch eine Dachterrasse.
Für San Telmo super
A tidy apartment in a great location. Safe and secure and has everything you need. Great value also. Thankyou Elbio and Zulma.

i had 2 very nice weeks in the appartment. i enjoyed the peaceful and spirituell atmosphere of the house and the silence there let me stay there sometimes instead of going out at night. mariano girlfriend didn't speak english but mariano answered to all questions i had immediately online. it's very clean and very green in the house and the rooftop terasse is a big + i would definately rent the place again and can recommend it with no doubts!

We spent one month at this nice and friendly place. Mariano is a warm person and very helpfull. We were really surprised by the balanced atmosphere he created. It made us feel at home immediately.
It is a clean, quiet and safe place to be!
Great little place in a great location. Our host was wonderful-- I had a currency mix up with the taxi and he helped out and saved me. I highly recommend staying here.
Mariano was there when we got in late at night and showed us to the place.  The place is as advertised and central.  All around a good experience

The loft was great. Clean, quiet, very well furnished, and in a great location. I arrived a bit early but was allowed to leave my stuff in the apartment to wander around. The neighborhood was great as there are many restaurants, bakeries, and mini markets very close by which is very convenient. I would definitely stay here again.
Just amazing!!

O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos, como uma mini-casa. A decoração é super simpática e com vários toques típicos. A região tem vários restaurantes e bares legais. Me senti bastante à vontade e segura - pelo menos de dia.
O local é um casarão com um belo jardinzinho, e funciona mais como uma pousada que um airbnb. O wi-fi é ótimo e é bem silencioso.
Ponto negativo: os travesseiros não são muito bons, ar condicionado desliga misteriosamente.

El duplex no. 6 es tal cual como la descripción, y una muy cómoda y buena base para una estadía en BA. Aunque no lo conocí personalmente, Elbio fue muy atento a todas mis inquietudes, respondió rápido a los mensajes y ante un cambio de planes imprevisto que tuve yo, fue flexible con las respuestas. Muy recomendable.
Chambre propre, bien située.

It was a really usefull flat for my girlfriend a me. A very good location in San Telmo and we had here all what we expected for a short stay in Buenos Aires.

If there is something to make better, it could be the welcome. When we arrived, it was more like an hotel than an AirBnB contact. But Mariano answer very quickly to all the questions we had by email.

Cute unit in a good location at a good price.  Everything was as advertised, with charming common areas.  Plus, on check-in when my traveling companion was sick, our host took me to a nearby store to buy bottled water and found us extra blankets to keep warm.  He also arranged a taxi for us for the morning of our departure.  Recommended!
Great space with a great location within walking distance of San Telmo (and the Sunday market) as well as the Belgrano metro station.
Elbio was very nice and attentive, we had excellent communication. We are very gratefull for everything. The appartment is nice and great location!
Mariano was very friendly and helpful. Very nice apartment, good location and very quiet. Highly recommendable!

Todo estuvo de acuerdo a lo publicad. Zuni fue muy amable durante nuestra estadía.
La ubicación es muy buena para paseo por el Barrio de San Telmo.

Todo perfecto! El piso es muy grande y el rooftop es hermoso.
Le recomiendo +++

Great location in a quiet part of town. This is a lofted 2 bedroom apartment with one king bed in the open style loft and a queen in the separated bedroom. Comfortable beds with nice pillows. Elbio was very responsive and helpful. The apartment easily fits 4 people with one adequate private bathroom. Tranquil inner courtyard. Rental bikes available.

There is a kitchenette, but the supplies provided were a bit sparse or in poor condition. The shower handle and door handles need replaced as they are prone to falling off. The old refrigerator also needs replaced as it needs a latch to hold it closed. The WiFi worked well. The central AC works well but has no thermostat in the room and must be turned on by the host.

Would have been nice to have use of a washing machine. We did have a short power outage, but Elbio kept us informed.

Overall good choice in Buenos Aires.
buen sitio para ir a descansar.
Perfect location of San Telmo and Mariano is very communicative. The lodge is beautiful but has a disadvantage with the shower room. We enjoyed our stay yet expected higher comfort
Mucha humedad. Olor desagradable. Poca atención
Hermoso dúplex, excelente ubicación. Mariano y Zuni muy atentos y rápidos en las respuestas
Fantastic apartment.  Falling a little behind on maintenance.
Muy limpio y hicimos el check-in sin problema!

El lugar no está limpio del todo, tengo una alergia con el polvo y se me manifestó todo el tiempo en la estancia. En el lugar te piden moderar el ruido, pero las escaleras y el piso de duela hacen montón de ruido con solo pasar por ahí.

El departamento es muy lindo y está muy bien ubicado. Sin embargo, es necesario que se sepa que tiene un dormitorio cerrado y el otro es en un entrepiso. Y que el patio que se ve en las fotos, no es del departamento sino compartido para todos los departamentos y está en el piso inferior. Se podría mejorar la limpieza.
Elbio muy amable y siempre respondiendo rápido.

El edificio es hermoso y bien ubicado, pero la pieza es muy básica y todo lo que hay adentro (sábanas, muebles, colchones, vajilla, heladera, etc.) está muy gastado. The building is beautiful and well located, but the room itself is very basic and everything inside (sheets, furniture, mattresses, plates, minifridge, etc.) is very worn. Por el precio, esperaba más. For the price, I expected more.

It really was a beautiful and new apartment in a Great location near metro and buses. Palermo was a  really nice and safe place to stay. Excellent host that was really easy to contact and very helpful! I would definately recommend :)

Martin was a great host and made me feel very welcome, greeting me personally and showing me tying the flat. The flat was really central which went lots of attractions were in walking distance or you could jump on the Subte nearby. I definitely recommend it for anyone that wants to be in the heart of everything in BA.

We got to Martin's place with no problems. It was very clean and comfortable. It was very centrally located .Everything we needed was nearby. There is a tourist information place nearby where you can get a map, guidebook to the city, tickets to different places as well as tickets to the hop on -off tourist bus..We enjoyed walking on Florida Street as well. Thank you Martin.

I stayed a week there. The apartment is very well-located (in the Microcentro, close to a Metro station), very well-furnished and clean. Martin is also a very good host who gave me lots of information about the city. Highly recommendable!

This apartment has an excellent location, close to many tourist attractions, money exchange places, shopping district, bars and restaurants. We stayed here for a full month and loved the neighborhood vibe it has to it even when in the middle of the city. The price is right. The A/C is a great addition when in summer. Martin is very accessible and helpful. Thanks for everything.

Martín es un buen anfitrión, dispuso de todo para que estuviéramos cómodos en nuestra estadía, nos recomendó lugares para conocer y dejando la libertad de poder disfrutar del lugar.
El departamento es perfecto para 2 personas y además nosotros íbamos con un bebe de 1 año que disfruto de todo el lugar. Además está muy bien ubicado en el microcentro de Buenos Aires y en los alrededores están todos los servicios que se necesitan, mercados, restaurantes, ATM, centros comerciales, centro histórico, subte, etc.
Solo dejar buenos comentarios por la elección de este lugar para nuestras vacaciones.

El apartamento es muy lindo, cómodo, amplio y lo fundamental que esta cerca de todo. Ya sea de buquebus. Florida. La plaza San Martin que pasan muchos taxis, el subte y tienes el transporte enseguida.

Our stay at Martin's was great!

His apartment is in an excellent part of town just a block down from Florida street!

We were a little disappointed by WIFI as it was slow and my husband works remotely as we travel.

The kitchen also is minimally stocked, but we were always able to make do.

Otherwise a great place!

I stayed here for a week in late May. Martin was a good host and met me on arrival to show me the apartment. We had an initial problem with wifi which Martin fixed on the spot with a call to the company, which was very nice. The apartment is as shown in the pictures: except that in winter it's actually very dark and quite cold inside as there is no direct sunlight. There is heating though and I was only there in the evenings, so it didn't matter. Overall, this was a very nice place to stay and it was in a good area close to Florida St and near good places to eat and drink.

Martin's apartment is in an excellent location so we could walk to lots of places. Although we didnt manage to meet in person, there was no problem at all throughout our stay as he replies promptly to any questions. He was really nice and flexible about my late check out as well. Thanks very much!
Tudo nos conformes.

Gracias por todo Martin !! la ubicacion del dpto es perfecta, a pasos de todo y la unidad tal cual las fotos. No quiero olvidarme de la buena disposicion del anfitrión para quitarme las dudas .... Volveremos

Martin was excellent. He responded quickly to all communication. He was where he said he would be when he said he would be there. He gave us good information about Buenos Aires, including the blue market money exchange which every visitor to Argentina would do well to understand before leaving from home. Speaks great English.

Martin was present when I arrived. Explained everything, showed me how things worked....even the gas stove (which I haven't seen since the 1960's)
A very friendly and welcoming host. Helped me out with a few questions I had days later by email.

Martin allowed me to stay a few hours overtime at no charge due to my late afternoon departure schedule. That was very nice of him.
El apartamento está situado perfectamente y muy bien comunicado. Quizás un poco pequeño para cuatro personas. Excelente servicio de portería. Martín nos facilitó datos muy interesantes de la ciudad.

My partner and I stayed at this apartment for 3 months so we had a good amount of time to get a feel for the area.

The apartment is situated on the second floor right at the back of a big apartment building so it feels really secure especially at night when you have to get through three locked doors to get into the apartment. It has a balcony that overlooks a small terrace but is surrounded by other apartment buildings and can be a bit dark at times. The only view you see out the windows is of a concrete wall... That would be a bonus in summer though as it would stay cool. It is roomy and we didn't feel cramped at all during our stay. The doorman David is very friendly.

The area is close to a central business district which means it is very busy during the week but quiet on the weekends although there is some good night life near the apartment all week. The apartment is right next to Plaza San Martin which is a beautiful Plaza and where a walking tour starts from. As it is only a short walk to the transport hub of Retiro it is easy to get anywhere else you want to go. Florida street is only a block away and the theatre district is walking distance.

Martin was quick to respond to any questions we had. We even managed to lock ourselves out of the apartment on the weekend and he met us straight away with the spare keys.

The kitchen was a little under equipped and we had to buy a few things like a chopping knife and cutting board. The kitchen does have a stove with oven, microwave and full size fridge though.

Awesome apartment.
Victoria was so great to rent from and we will definitely stay in her apartment for our next trip.

This was our first time in Buenos Aires and wanted something close to action of Palermo Soho, but "off the beaten path." The apartment is also on the same block as the subway, which is great to get to the center of the city.

5 stars. Couldn't have asked for better experience.

Thanks again Victoria.

VICTORIA fue sorprendente, junto a su novio Ariel, me recibieron en el check in para mostrarme todo el funcionamiento del Studio y del edificio, y explicarme algo de la zona. Esta muy bien ubicado y conectado con los medios de transporte.
La verdad que el Apto es genial, super comodo, el trendy style es lo mas!! hemos disfrutado mucho mucho y no dudamos en recomendarlos a todos los que busquen un sitio genial donde alojarse durante su estadia en BA.
Muchas gracias Victoria y Ariel!

Cariños

Mariano y Adrian

Nice place at a great location, host very responsive. One bedroom is spacious, bright with en-suite bathroom and a large double bed, the other bedroom is smaller, without en-suite bathroom (there is a one at the same level though) and narrower double bed. Host facilitated early check-in and late check-out.

I highly recommend staying at Jamais' place.  The location is right in the heart of Palermo Soho, making it very convenient to walk to the great restaurants and bars in town.  The apartment itself is very modern and well kept.  Couldn't have asked for a better place to stay.

Perfect studio, very nice building, great location. Victoria is very nice.
I want to go back soon and stay at the same place.
Gracias e saludos, Victoria.

It was delightful staying in Victoria's apartment; I would without doubt recommend her place to anyone wanting to see real BA.  Villa Crespo is a real neighborhood with daily bustle of life.  24 hour doorman in a beautiful building was very much appreciated.  Very close to convenient public transport (subte) and an amazing shopping experience (the outlets - trust me!). Victoria went out of her way to welcome me - I couldn't have been happier!

Had a great and welcoming stay at Victoria's studio.
It is a perfect place to spend a week in Buenos Aires.
Brand new building with a friendly doorman, just one block from the Subte and a walking distance from the trendy area of Palermo Soho.
Victoria and boyfriend were very friendly and helpful, and kept in touch via emails.

The apartment is brand new, good A/C which is important for hot days, always hot water.
Really recommend it to my friends who will travel to BA soon
Awesome location in Palermo Soho, walking distance to our favorite restaurants and bars. Nice apartment with high ceiling, light filled.
Wonderful apartment and location

O apartamento é incrível. Muito bem localizado.
Passamos muito bem os 4 dias.
Há várias opções para cafe nas proximidades. Supermercado próximo. Bares e restaurantes...estação de metrô.
Enfim, aproveitamos muito esta viagem e se voltarmos, com certeza será uma opção de hospedagem.

The apartment is in great location, about 5 mins from Plaza Armenia and the main shopping and bar area and about the same from the nearest metro stop. Supermarkets and ATMs nearby. It's an older style building, there is no lift and there are several flights of stairs but that didn't bother us. We had it for 2 people and it was very comfortable. It would also be comfortable for 3-4. It is well set back for the street so very quiet. Damien the apartment manager was also very helpful. We had a great time.
In a very trendy area with lots of great restauants. Lots of young people and night life! Would definately stay here again!
Everything was excellent.
Great neighborhood, and Demian provided lots of dining tips. He also arranged for a ride to the airport, which was very helpful. The apartment was lovely and roomy. Easy walk to the metro.
Get Demian to give you a list of restaurant recommendations. All the ones we tried were excellent. Also, ask him to book you a car to the airport. It was cheap, easy and very comfortable.
Spacious and Stylish apartment in great neighborhood. Would stay here again next time in BA.
Excellent apartment in the best location!

Place was great. It’s in the perfect area. Close to restaurants and bars.  Everything is within walking distance.  It’s winter and the heat worked great. Nice size kitchen so we could Have a nice breakfast in the mornings. Very quiet in the building. Had a small issue the shower head and it was taken care of.  Would stay here again. Highly recommend it.
El departamento de Milly está ubicado de forma excelente. Es muy amplio y luminoso y cuenta con todas las comodidades para tener una estancia muy agradable. Lo recomiendo ampliamente.

Siamo state veramente bene! L'appartamento è bello, spazioso e pulito!
Demian è stato molto accogliente , gentile e con grande disponibilità . Possiamo solo ringraziare per la bella esperienza che abbiamo fatto a Buenos Aires. Grazie!

Muy buena ubicación, cercano a transportes públicos, bares y restaurantes de la zona.
Excelentemente recibidos y atendidos por Demian, persona muy amable y dispuesta.
Gracias Milly y Roberto! hasta pronto.

We had a TERRIFIC stay at your apartment. It was in an ideal location, large, quiet and safe. Demian was very helpful and attentive. Could not have hoped for better!

Thanks for helping us have a great trip to BA!
Very nice apartment, with a lot of space and a lot of light. Well situated in Palermo Soho. Demian was very nice and welcoming :)

Fantastic Location!
Great for 2 couples. Close to groceries, markets, restaurants but still quiet and great for sleeping.

Great home for 4 guests/2 couples; lots of spaces for lounging and use. Demian was a superb facility manager, checking us in around midnight and providing us with some local tips/suggestions. He answered questions and helped to book a ride for us to the airport. Too bad our stay was so short, otherwise, it would've been awesome to stay longer!

We enjoyed our stay at Milly's place as the location / space was ideal for our purpose.
Damian (who is the acting host) was great especially in helping us getting our luggage (lots of them :) up and down the stairs and even helped us walk our luggage to our next airbnb a couple of blocks away.
The apartment is very clean and more or less same as the pictures. There is enough space for 4 people and maybe one other (smaller) person can sleep comfortably on the sofa in the study room. The location is great, in the middle of everything Palermo offers (bars/restaurants) but you don't hear the noise while inside the apartment.
Make sure you don't mind stairs because the building does not have a lift. The only thing that made is a bit uncomfortable is the contract we had to "approve" over email because it was unclear and some terms did not make sense /didn't translate well in English.
Adoramos o apartamento! Exatamente como nas fotos, os anfitriões muito educados e prontos a nos ajudar. A localização do apartamento é incrível, tudo por perto. Com certeza voltaremos em breve.
Excellent host. Very helpful and friendly.

Pasamos unos dias muy lindos en el departamento de Martin, la ubicación es muy buena y a pesar de ser centrico es muy silencioso. Como fuimos por poco tiempo y somos muy andariegas no usamos muchas instalaciones del dpto, pero estaba todo en orden como la descripción decía.

Como siempre excelente. Correctos los check, muy buena predisposicon tanto del anfitrion como del encargado. Impecable el depto. La ubicacin comodisima, a pasos de todo... Por eso volvemos, ya es la 4ta vez y esperamos hacerlo muchas massss. Gracias por todo !!!!
O apartamento é muito espaçoso e bem localizado, Martin se mostrou atencioso e disponível pra ajudar no que precisássemos e o Retiro é charmosíssimo!

We stayed for 11 nights in Martin's apartment. Martin was there to greet us and explain everything about the apartment. He also sent us information about the city in advance of our stay. He was always available to contact.

The apartment was clean and spacious and a great location for exploring the city. It was very safe at night both in the neighbourhood and the apartment building.

it was comfortable, clean and well equipped. we had great time with Martin's apartment. it is close to florida street which is one of the main street in buenos aires. we felt like home in here. I highly recommend his apartment to all the people who would visit Buenos Aires

Great trip in Martin's apartment. It's well located in the center of Buenos Aires. It's located in a clean, secure residence. The apartment is spacious but a bit dark. Furthermore some refurbishment could be implemented, paintings, furniture ... etc. However it was very pleasant to stay here.

My stay in this appt. has been very nice, the place is clean and very well located, the building is nice and quite, the pictures are reflecting perfectly the reality and it is nice and cosy. Victoria is very nice and everything went very smoothly for the booking, the check in and out, she is very willing to help you during your stay, she is nice and fun and man can see she hopes you're having a good time and you feel good there!!!!

Victoria's flat is a wonderful oasis for Buenos Aires travelers in a busy, bustling city.  I stayed here for four nights and used the flat as a great central location for coming and going throughout the day. It's on a good subway line that is easy to connect to other main lines in the city. It's also central enough that you can fairly cost-effectively get around by taxi.  The flat is close to numerous eateries so it's easy to access morning coffee, afternoon snacks and evening dinners. I didn't cook, but it was handy having the refrigerator for drinks and easy to eat snacks/meals.  The people in the building are very friendly and helpful with information about the area, which can somehow serve a bit like a concierge-style source of information.  Corrientes and Malalbia (the cross streets) are busy so you always feel safe/secure. However, it can get noisy at night, especially if you're an early sleeper (like me:). But if you're keeping typical BsAs hours, you should be just fine.  Within the flat everything is brand new, which helped me to truly enjoy the experience even more. I highly recommend staying here if you're looking for convenient, cost-effective, high quality lodging in a central part of a hip area of town.

Ola! Vou escrever em português, assim o mural fica mais multi-cultural. :)
Para começar adoramos a cidade, Buenos Aires é lindo!
O apartamento era muito acolhedor e fomos muito bem recebidos pelo casal. Muito obrigado pela hospitalidade! Queremos muito voltar.
Hasta!!! :)

My first Airbnb apartment went as smoothly as I could have hoped for with Victoria. She was super helpful and accommodating of my arrival and departure schedule. Her cute apartment is meticulously clean and furnished, the bed comfortable and the amenities ample. The location turned out to be perfect—a short walk to the hippest part of Palermo, smack dab on an essential subway artery and the surrounding neighborhood is more authentic than some with a host of cafés and restaurants. A great stay in Buenos Aires.

We were well received by Victoria at the time agreed. The apartment is well located in a beautiful new building. There is a metro station on the corner of Corrientes with Malabia. The apartment is tastefully decorated in yellow tones. Has a great shower, a good wi-fi, the bed is very comfortable. Next there is a bakery where I bought bread for my breakfast. It has a market a few meters. Best location impossible.

Fomos bem recebidos pela Victoria no horário combinado. O apartamento fica bem localizado em um lindo prédio novo. Existe uma estação de metro na esquina da Malabia com Corrientes. O apartamento é muito bem decorado em tons de amarelo. Possuí uma ótima ducha, uma boa conexão wi-fi, a cama é confortável. Próximo existe uma padaria onde comprei pães para os meus cafés da manhã. Tem um mercado a alguns metros. Melhor localização impossível.

Victoria is a wonderful host and her apartment was perfect, exactly as described. We couldn't have asked for a better experience. Villa Crespo is  a working neighborhood, thankfully missing much of the annoying tourist gloss. That said, it is within easy walking distance of Palermo et al, and has good subway service to other parts of the city. Highly recommended!

Spending a month in Buenos Aires at this place was the most unforgettable experience. First of all the apartment is amazing: clean, organized, roomy, and very cozy, offering me everything I could need. It is located only a few meters from Malabia subway station, so getting around the city was never a problem to me. The neighborhood has plenty of restaurants and pubs and I could find many other amenities such as banks, markets, drugstores, etc…
The fellows that work in the building are very friendly and helpful. Victoria, the landlord, was also an extremely nice and agreeable person. I had everything I needed there – the only bad thing is that eventually had to go back home.
The city of Buenos Aires is enchanting for all kind of public. It is very easy to go around and have fun. The food is exquisite, people very receptive, making my experience one of a kind!
Hope to go back soon to BsAs and certainly will stay at Victoria’s place!

This people is really amazing! Besides your lovely reception, she searches for me an awesome photo store. Everything was great. The apartment is really great. Cable TV, wifi, air conditioning, all you need  to stay great and comfortable. You have to walk just 20 mts to get a subte (subway). Everything you need around like drugstore, bakery, supermarket, etc. all the great outlet brands about 4 square. the building has 24 hrs security with proper guards. i really recommend  this place.

The perfect place, with the perfect size. There is no other definition for this apartment.  Ideal for enjoying the city: very well  located, close to subway stations and bus stops,  close to the main avenues of  Palermo. Victoria is an amazing person. She gave all the tips about the city  and gave all the support  for my stay there was perfect. Indeed, this is the final word on that place: "perfect."

A really great apartment in an excellent location. It was close to everything and we could easily move around. Martin answered all our questions immediately and was very helpful. Also, David, the doorman is a friendly and helpful guy! I do recommend the place! Gracias!:)

This is a great flat, with fabulous location! Martin had organised everything for my arrival, and I'm super happy with the fast wi-fi. I can definitely recommend this apartment for a nice stay in lovely Buenos Aires.

Host was accessible and hospitable.  When there was a hiccup (minor) it was fixed in no time - a very nice fellow and the place couldn't be better located.  Has everything you need for a short stay. Having the second toilet made it more convenient for sharing with a friend.  Beds were super comfortable and great water pressure in the shower.  Balcony is nice and private. It is a very quiet flat.
El apartamento de Martin es perfecto, en pleno centro de Buenos Aires, muy silencioso y cerca de casi todo lo mas importante de la ciudad!!! Es recomendable!!!!
This was my second time in the apartment, and it was as good as the first time around. Great location, everything worked well and coming/leaving was super smooth!

El departamento es amplio, la cama esta nueva. Estuvimos un mes ahí y la verdad que es un departamento que volvería a rentar si regresara a Buenos Aires porque la UBICACIÓN ES PERFECTA, todo esta cerca. Nos gusta mucho la experiencia de vivir allí y Martín fue un excelente anfitrión, las dos o tres veces que  tuvimos algún problemita siempre estuvo allí para apoyarnos. Super recomendable.

Everything was spectacular, I extended my stay another week since I  enjoyed the area so much.  A lot of fun and everyone in the neighborhood is so friendly.  Palermo is a very nice area with many shops, restaurants, and parks.  Book this place NOW you won't be disappointed.

Excellent place to stay in Palermo SOHO. The apartment had everything I needed, great WiFi, plenty of space, very quiet and close to many great restaurants and bars.  I am ranking this airbnb as my #1 favorite place. Many thanks again to the hosts for making my stay relaxing and enjoyable.
Nada que criticar, mejor imposible, excelente ubicacion y Victoria muy amable, siempre estuvo dispuesta a ayudarnos en lo que necesitaramos. Recomendado 100% este studio

Victoria is very responsive to questions via e-mail before and during our stay which is always a good thing. The apartment itself is on a sleepy and safe street away from the main tourists drag. We took a taxi (quite cheap) almost all the time so accessibility was not an issue for us. Otherwise, the subway is nearby and convenient for commuting before 11 pm. One thing I would highlight is that Victoria made a claim of USD 100 from our security deposit for "our wet towels" which she claimed "caused damage" to the flooring outside the bathroom. We found out about her claim when were in a middle of our trip in Brazil but still took the time and ensured that we responded to her expeditiously so that she can make her claim within 48 hours ahead of the security deposit refund. We did not dispute her claim because money can always be earned back but it cannot buy integrity. We do not hold a personal grudge against Victoria for the claim as it was all part and parcel of her business. We only found some things odd: (1) The day before we checked out, she sent her cleaner over. Her cleaner was the one who placed those bath mats in front of the toilet door, so her picture to us claiming wet towels was in fact an inaccurate graphic representation. In any case, we did not feel a need to harp on the nitty gritty as it will bear no fruit and especially since we were on holiday at the time of her claim. It would have been a waste of our time going back and forth on e-mails on this matter. (2) Victoria was around during our check out, she could have inspected the apartment and highlight the damage to us face to face. Victoria claimed in her e-mail to us that she did not do so as we were "busy". The truth is on that day we were done packing and killed time by hanging out at a cafe near her apartment for coffee while waiting for her to come by and collect the keys. If she had asked, we would have acceded to her request for an on-site inspection during check out. Instead, she collected the keys from us at the lobby. A case of premeditation? We will never know. We cannot help but thought of the fact that since she had sent someone over the day before, wouldn't the cleaner have highlighted such "damage" if it was indeed in a state of disrepair? Oh well. =) (3) Lastly, any home owner (such as ourselves) would know that wear and tear happens over a period of time so it does raise questions whether we could have just been the victim of "last one out". (4) A contributing factor for the "damage" is actually no fault of us. It could have very well been because there is no skirting at the entrance of the bathroom. In...

Victoria's place is exactly what you need when exploring BA. Great location in a fun local neighbourhood with nearby bakeries, grocery stores, excellent food and fun shopping. Her place is a short walk to Palermo Soho, and a short cab or subway ride to Microcentro, Recoleta and all the other neighbours worth exploring.

The actual suite is a perfect size with a comfy bed, a nice deck, and a pool in the complex.

Victoria was a great host who was easy to contact and ended up giving us great dinner recommendations. If you stay here be sure to check out Salgado Alimentos an amazing pasta place a few blocks from her house that she told us about.

In addition would recommend walking up Garruchaga to Palermo when you arrive to get acquainted with the city.

Great location! Florencia was waiting at the apartment when we arrived, showed us the loft and gave us some tips for the city. I traveled with a friend so it was great to have the the two completely different spaces in the apartment.
Passamos ótimos dias no apartamento de Martin. Localização perfeita e apartamento muito confortável.  Recomendo! Obrigado Martin.

Martin and his partner gave me a warm welcome and were available to me if I had any questions or needs during my visit. The apartment is spacious and clean, and just a short walk from some excellent restaurants (try "Federal") and lost of shops on Florida street just a block away.  If you want to feel like you live in a neighborhood in Buenos Aires this is an excellent choice.
Apartamento super agradável e com uma otima localização. Não conheci o Martin pessoalmente mas ele sempre esteve diaponivel para esclarecer todas as dúvidas. Recomendo.
Comfortable and cozy place, fantastically well located. Martin was very helpful as was his assistant who received us at the planned time. I would recommend it to anyone.

La descripción es bien concordante con la realidad y el barrio formidable en cuanto a la ubicación y seguridad. Todo muy cerca, especialmente el sistema de metro, comercio, supermarket, etc.
El departamento bien equipado, muy seguro y entrega esa importante sensación a los visitantes.

Nos encantó la ubicación; la Plaza San Martín es hermosa, el barrio tranquilo y con buen acceso a locomoción, comercios, bares y restaurantes.
El departamento es muy amplio y luminoso, y en general está bien equipado, y en óptimas condiciones de limpieza. Además, tiene una biblioteca hermosa!
Respecto a las mejoras, el baño necesita manutención en algunos detalles y falta equipamiento de cocina, pero lo demás está muy bien!
Aunque no conocimos personalmente a Martín, siempre fue muy amable y se mantuvo accesible para coordinar detalles de nuestra llegada y salida del departamento.

En definitiva, fue una buena experiencia el alquilar este departamento, ¡muy recomendable!

I didn't meet the guy, as I was here on NYE, but the flat was wonderful. I'm glad there was AC.  We didn't really receive much specific instructions, but I asked about some things and he responded pretty quickly. My friends and I didn't have anywhere to go until 2pm and Martin was very nice about a later check out. I'd definitely stay here again.

Nice neat and comfortable apartment, close to train and bus stations, and centrally located. Our host was relaxed about our arrival and leaving times and answered our different questions. A good stay!
Nice location, clean and enough space. Kind host.
Martin was very helpful in helping me find things to do around the city. The description matches his apartment and is in very safe, fun neighborhood. I'd return to this place.
Fast reply. The room is in the middle of central. Very clean.

As with any onlne shopping the pictures RARELY are exact in my 2 stays..but  this is true of much shopping in unreal situations. Personal issue.  Photo touch up ...tricks of catching the scene ...but again not exactly as close encounters....
Wonderful apartment, centrally located, Martin was a great and helpful host

We had a great 2 weeks in this apartment. It is everything that it is promised to be. Victoria is gracious and helpful. The apartment is bright and clean. The location is good, with excellent access to the subway station and lots of nearby places to eat.
If I have any hesitation it would be that it is on a busy street and could be noisy for some.
That said, we enjoyed it, and would rent it again.

I just spent a few days in the studio and had a great time. The location's good, within 15 minutes of walk to Palermo Soho.
