It's just beside a metro station but I ended up not really using it as that line didn't really go where I wanted and cabs are very cheap. It was also an easy intersection to give as a destination to cabs.
The studio had everything I needed and more, the pool is nice.
The only thing would be if you're very sensitive to noise it may not be the best place for you, as it's just beside a big boulevard and there are many buses passing on the street right in front, until pretty late. But Buenos Aires in general is very noisy!

Great apartment and great host! Victoria was very helpful with getting us quickly acquainted with Palermo and Buenos Aires. Was great to be so close to the subway too. Some great restaurants nearby - I highly recommend the brunch at Malvon - and for parillas, Don Julio was much better than La Cabrera! Thanks again Victoria!

I rented the charming Victoria´s apartment by the second time. This time it was for my parents who had a short stay in Buenos Aires at the carnival. According to the testimony of them, everything was perfect, they loved the apartment. I recommend this beautiful yellow house for everyone.
-------------------------
Essa foi a segunda vez que aluguei o charmoso apartamento da Victoria. Desta vez foi para os meus pais que tiveram uma curta estadia em Buenos Aires no carnaval. Segundo o testemunho deles, tudo foi perfeito, eles adoraram o apartamento. Eu recomendo essa linda casa amarela para todos.

Una estada genial. Nada que decir. El departamento cuenta con todo lo necesario y te hace sentir en casa. El barrio es muy bueno y estás cerca de todo gracias al metro casi en la puerta del edificio. Gracias a Victoria que siempre estuvo dispuesta a ayudarnos. Recomendado 100%!

The apartment is nice and the building is very nice. It is just as in the pictures. The location is ok, but it is is a little far from the restaurant and bar area. Sometimes I walked there and felt the neighborhood safe, but at nights it is a bit lonely and dark so I took a cab which was about 5 dollars from Palermo Soho. The location is a few meters away from Corrientes which is very convinient for the subway, but it can be a little noisy sometimes. Victoria is very nice! Very good tourist guides in the apartment!
La ubicación es muy buena. Cerca del subte, cafés, restaurants, etc. Es un buen lugar para estar y recorrer el centro de Buenos Aires.

The apartment is phantastically centrally located, in walking distance to lots of sights and also the transport hubs we needed (bus stop from the airport, Retiro train and bus station). Lots of restaurants and breakfast cafes virtually at the doorstep. Martin is a very responsive host, and we clarified everything about our arrival up front. We are especially thankful that he flexibly accomodated our check in and out times. The apartment is quite large and had everything we needed. A highly pleasant stay! We highly recommend Martin as a host and staying in his apartment!

We were a bit to early but Martin, make sure that we could use THE appartement
The communication was really good and stay was plesant, location was great for publictransport and also for nice restaurants

We would defenitly book Martin again and recommend THE appartment if people are not sure

Nuestra estadia en el apartamento de Martin y fuè bueno. El apartamento no es nuevo, pero está lleno, agradable, tiene personalidad, es tranquilo y bien dispuesto. Yo personalmente tengo que agradecer a Martin para la buena colección de libros a disposición de los clientes y que he leído y visto todos los momentos de relajación.



Además, el área de la vivienda es muy estratégica tanto para saber BsAs para viajar dentro del país y más a tiro de piedra de la plaza más bella de BsAs: Plaza San Martín
Sin embargo, disfrutamos de nuestra estadia, un saludo a todos

Donatella e Paolo

Estadia foi ótima!
A cozinha é suficientemente equipada para refeições simples - não tem forno, mas não nos fez falta.
O apartamento é espaçoso, e isso foi bacana porque conseguimos passar bons momentos lá dentro (não é só um local pra deixar as coisas e sair, dá pra ficar relaxando na sala, por exemplo, etc).
As camas são confortáveis e são exatamente como na foto.
Um único ponto em relação às fotos: me pareceu que não entra tanto sol como mostram as fotos, por ser voltado para o interior do edifício, mas isso não nos atrapalhou em nada também.
Há armários para guardar seus pertences no quarto e em um dos banheiros; todos os ambientes são muito limpos e bem cuidados; tornando a estadia bem tranquila e confortável.
Não conhecemos o Martin mas ele esteve 100% disponível, nos ajudou em tudo o que precisamos, respondeu às mensagens com rapidez e esteve sempre pronto para ajudar. Contamos também com o porteiro, que nos auxiliou quando precisamos e ainda nos chamou um taxi para a partida.
A localização é excelente: algumas quadras da 9 de Julio e de Puerto Madero, tem vários bares; restaurantes e cafés no entorno para quem não quer se deslocar muito, é também próximo ao metrô, trem, ônibus, e tranquilo para andar a pé. Usamos todos estes meios de transporte com facilidade e andamos bastante a pé - incluindo à noite.
É bem servido de serviços - na mesma rua, por exemplo, tem farmácia, casa de produtos naturais, cafés, pubs, e um carrefour express, que nos foram bem úteis.
Kein Kommentar.

Parfait endroit pour découvrir la ville. Situé à 2min du métro et bus. Martin est un hôte attentionné et très disponible, il  était présent avant, pendant et même après. Nous retournons d'ailleurs 2j avant notre retour en France au même endroit.

Comme au premier séjour de notre début de voyage, Martin a été très prévoyant. On a pu profiter jusqu'au bout de nos vacances. L'endroit est parfait pour visiter. Metro bus 130 pour palermo, bus 152 pour la boca a 2min à pied. Top

Martin's place was great- superbly located for the conference I was attending, spacious, and had all the amenities I needed.  Martin himself, was waiting for me when I arrived, assisted with my bags, and gave me a good orientation to the apartment.  A great stay!

Apartment looks totally different that presented at photos. It’s very dark with unpleasant view at the wall, with no sun at all. Moreover, it stinks with dust – it was hard to breathe (even though I have no allergy). Fridge was very noisy when it turns on (as it was quite old) and in addition freezer looks like it wasn’t cleaned for years.
Kitchen is very bad equipped – there are no wine glass; cups and plates are very old very unpleasant to use.
This apartment is very old and hasn’t been renovated for years (scratched and dirty walls wall, kitchen in very bad condition). Photos unfortunately don’t show the truth.
I was very disappointed as I was expecting totally something different. After one night, I moved out as I couldn’t imagine spending the whole week of my vacations in such a place.
Only good thing I can say about the apartment is the very good location – that’s all.
Muy buen departamento, con una ubicación excelente, cerca de todo! Muy buena disposición de Martín en todo momento
The location is terrific if you want to be in the city centre. It is quiet and clean.
Excelente lugar para disfrutar de esa maravillosa ciudad de Buenos Aires. A una cuadra de la calle Florida, por la que se puede ir a pie a muchos excelentes lugares.

Es bastante céntrico y ese es su plus, junto con el precio. Al ser un edificio antiguo, tiene sus temas pero nada realmente molesto. La cama muy cómoda y la cocina amplia. La ubicación es inmejorable para quien tiene que trabajar en Puerto Madero y busca una opción céntrica y económica.
El departamento está muy bien ubicado, es cómodo y amplio.
simple but very calm and central
The place is as it appears in photos and felt private, spacious and safe. I'd love to return!

El estudio esta bien ubicado, llegué de madrugada y la llave me estaba esperando con el portero. Todo en perfectas condiciones y limpio.
Victoria muy atenta y rápida en contestar todas mis preguntas.
Muy recomendable, pienso tomarlo otras veces cuando vaya a Buenos Aires.

Leiligheten har en helt perfekt beliggenhet i Palermo Soho. Vi kunne ikke ha hatt det bedre vår uke i Buenos Aires. En stor og flott leilighet med alt man trenger, og et utmerket utgangspunkt for å ta seg rundt i byen. Vertskapet kommuniserte raskt hele veien, og vi ble tatt imot av Demian som ga oss masse nyttig informasjon. Vi kan virkelig anbefale denne leiligheten!

This was a very cute apartment in an older building in Palermo Soho. The apartment was nicely renovated, wooden floors, really cute and nice big double sofa, area to work, and coffee in the kitchen which was really great in the morning. The hosts were very responsive to our need to get there early, and we worked out a good system to meet in the morning even though our flight was delayed. We will definitely pass through again and stay there.

Como siempre el apartamento limpio y en perfectas condiciones.
Victoria tuvo la gentileza de dejar habilitado el aire acondicionado para que funcione en modo de calefacción.
Victoria siempre está atenta y solicita con todo lo que le pido.
Un placer volver a ir.
Muchas gracias Victoria!

Victorias Aparment ist ganz so, wie sie es beschreibt, modern, gut ausgestattet und recht günstig gelegen. Die nächste U-Bahn-Station ist wenige Meter entfernt; die Tickets sind billig (Taxis aber ebenfalls bezahlbar). Victoria selbst ist sehr sympathisch und hilfsbereit. Buenos Aires war ein großes Vergnügen!
My first experience with airbnb could not have been better.  Great apartment exactly as advertised in a great location.  I was only sad that I had to go home!

Victoria is a great host. She made us feel like home and loved her beautiful apartment! Very well located and with nice restaurants around.
We really appreciate her hospitality and kindness!

Great apartment in a very safe part of Buenos Aires. Excellent location, just a few steps to the subway and a few minutes away from shops and restaurants. I recommend this one when staying in Buenos Aires.
La estadía en el departamento fue encantadora, cualquier duda que tengan ella contestara casi de inmediato, Victoria es una persona muy agradable,  volveremos a su depto.
Muy buena ubicación, por transportes y zona turística. Departamento antiguo pero cómodo para 3 personas.
Un excelente lugar, muy silencioso y muy cerca de todo.
Apartamento central, rua movimentada com táxis frequentes. Perto de transportes públicos, do centro comercial Galerias Pacífico e muito seguro à noite.

The appartment is very conveniently located in the middle of town, yet amazingly calm. The pictures give a good description of the flat. There is not much view from the balcony or windows, but on the other hand there are no neighbours watching and one can sleep calmly with windows open at night. Internet was very good.
Martin is very responsive, precise and reliable and was very helpful on the questions that I had.
I am very happy and fully enjoyed my stay.

Primero que nada Martin es un excelente anfitrión y te responde tus inquietudes rápidamente. Segundo el lugar está ubicado muy cerca de la Plaza San Martín, una joya de ubicación, bastante céntrico, con varios restaurantes, cafeterías y plazas a los que puedes llegar a pie (walking distance).

El lugar muy limpio, moderno, con todas las facilidades necesarias para hacer de tu viaje (de negocios en mi caso particular) satisfactorio.

Seguramente volvería!

Para un turista es una buena ubicación. El departamento es muy silencioso y el anfitrión tiene buena disposición. El departamento es algo oscuro y, por el estado en que se encuentra, resulta algo lúgubre, sobre todo por la escasa y poco acogedora iluminación. Hay detalles de limpieza (del departamento y de la ropa de cama) que fallaron.
Todo muy bien! Martín es un anfitrión de total confianza y simpático. Estuvo siempre disponible. El piso es muy agradable, bien equipado y esta muy bien ubicado. Lo recomendamos vivamente.
Un muy buen departamento, Ubicado central en la Ciudad de Buenos Aires. Ideal para unas vacaciones en la ciudad.

I have stayed here twice . Very commodious to eateries etc Dada , excellent . FILO great . Establish superb closed Saturdays . Frenchie Bistro at 697 San Martin for taste of French cuisine ...lunch time ONIY Monday through Fridays .  Shopping convenient . Public transportation good access .
Excelente! El dpto es muy cómodo y la ubicación inmejorable. La atención de Martín es de lujo,  recomendadisimo!
Excelente! Por eso me quede una semana más!
Excelente, termine reservando una tercera semana por que estuve muy cómodo. Martin es un genio, súper recomendable. Volvería sin dudarlo!
nice apartment in a good location. very easy check-in and great communication. very responsive.
Todo bien! Como siempre la comunicación con Martín fue sin problemas. El equipamiento del apartamento es bueno y corresponde a las descripciones.

Both the apartment and Martin were great! Martin was very quick to respond and helpful on arrival. The apartment was very clean and spacious in a good location - I would defiantly recommend staying here!
El lugar es tal como se ve, bien ubicado sobre todo, limpio, Martin muy amable
Excelente anfitrión y lugar impecable. 100% recomendable!
Totalmente real, y recomendable
Buena ubicación, silencioso y bien equipado.

La estancia ha sido maravillosa, sin ruidos, la ubicación excelente, y Martín muy amable siempre, dejándonos hacer el checkout más tarde porque nos cambiaron la hora de recogida. Repetiré sin dudarlo. Muchas gracias
Todo perfecto, ya me hospede en este dpto varias veces y seguire volviendo cada vez que pueda, totalmente recomendable!

Todo muy bien! Como siempre la comunicación con Martín fue sin problemas. Yo lo recomiendo como anfitrión.
El equipamiento del apartamento es bueno y corresponde a las descripciones.
El piso es muy agradable y esta perfectamente ubicado para visitar la ciudad.

Muy buena predisposición, atento a nuestras consultas y buena comunicación. Realmente muy satisfechos con la estadía de nuestros empleados en el airbnb de Martin, buena ubicación y moderno departamento. Tal es así que volvimos a elegirlo para que la estadía en Buenos Aires de nuestro segundo empleado sea de las mejores también. Muchas gracias, Martin!

Volvimos a elegir el departamento de Martin para hospedar a otro de nuestros empleados y realmente quedamos muy conformes. Muy buena predisposición y atención a todas nuestras consultas y pedidos, ¡recomendamos mucho la estadía en el departamento! ¡Muchas gracias por todo, Martin!

Como siempre con Martín: todo sin problemas y según lo convenido.
El apartamento corresponde a las descripciones y está bien situado.
Ótima localização com fácil acesso aos transportes públicos.
Victoria y su pareja fueron muy buenos anfitriones :) ! definitivamente me volvería a quedar ahí.
Great location , very cool doormen, and a safe neighborhood to walk around in! Victoria was very nice and responsive to all of our needs. Would definitely stay here again.

Very nice experience, the studio feels like a suite optimally located about 50-meter from the metro Malabia (red line) and in a nice barrio with cafés, shops, banks and at a walking distance from the trendy streets of Palermo. Everything worked (air-conditioning, wifi, fridge, oven, shower) and we were pleased to find plug adaptors, a hair dryer, etc. It was very hot in BA in January so the AC was very useful. The only little negative point would be the noisy street very near the bed. Even with a closed window, you can hear buses and trucks passing and horning sometimes. It did not prevent us from sleeping well but if you are sensitive, beware. The price to pay for being so well located in a busy area...

Great place and Excellent location. Loved the apartment and especially the neighborhood. There is a wealth of cafes and restaurants within walking distance. Location is a 15 minute walk to Palermo and is steps from a Subte station and numerous bus lines. The apartment was flawless and Victoria was a great host. She was always available by phone or email for any questions. Would highly recommend her place to anyone visiting Buenos Aires.
The apartment was super nice and communication with Victoria was great. I definitely recommend staying here!

What a blast! The apartment is great, everything is made to have a nice time in Buenos Aires, the doorman are really friendly and helpful! Victoria was always ready to answer to any questions... I will rent this place again for sure! Subway, buses are really close to make your move easy! Any chances to find better than this one! Thanks again Victoria! :)

The place is really lovely with everything you need for a nice stay. The area is safe and interesting to walk around; Palermo is at 15/20min distance by feet where you can find an array of restaurants and bars. The only thing we didn't enjoy was the disco at the hotel opposite which played very loud music all weekend until little hours. Viviana is a really nice host and provided us with guides and useful info for our stay in BA.

O apartamento de Victoria é exatamente igual às fotos: claro, limpo e muito bem organizado.
Fica super bem localizado: no mesmo quarteirão do metrô e em frente ao melhor chorizo da cidade - LA PARRILITA.
Victoria é doce, atenciosa e de fácil comunicação.
A piscina do prédio é ótima!
Tivemos dificuldades para encontrar moedas na cidade para usarmos a máquina de lavar.
No mais, aproveitei muito o apartamento, cuidei dele como se meu fosse e pretendo voltar!

Lovely studio apartment in a nice area of town. I stayed here for 1 month and found that it had everything i needed for my stay in buenos aires. Wifi and hot water always worked great, which is huge for me. The location was perfect, only a half block from a subway station, and an easy 15 minute walk to palermo. Would definitely stay in this apartment again!

Meu marido e eu estivemos hospedados no apartamento de Victoria por 5 noites e foi uma ótima estadia. Desde o momento da reserva Victoria sempre foi muito amável e rápida nas respostas e tudo correu conforme o combinado.
O prédio tem portaria 24 horas o que proporciona uma segurança a mais, mas o bairro de Villa Crespo é muito tranquilo. Está muito próximo do metrô e de linhas de ônibus, e há vários restaurantes e cafés deliciosos e charmosos muito próximos.
Estivemos durante o carnaval e foi uma ótima experiência ver as "murgas" e a milonga de carnaval do bairro!
Obrigada Victoria por sua atenção e quando voltarmos a Buenos Aires gostaríamos de nos hospedar em seu apartamento novamente!

Meu marido e eu ficamos 5 dias no apartamento de Victoria e não poderia estar mais satisfeita. A estrutura é excelente e ele está equipado com tudo o que precisamos: toalhas, internet, tv, utensílios de cozinha, a cama e a ducha também são ótimas, além dos funcionários do prédio, muito solícitos e cordiais. A localização é perfeita, com metro perto e muitos restaurantes bons pela região, fizemos quase tudo a pé. O bairro é muito tranquilo e seguro, tanto durante o dia quanto a noite.
A Victoria é super atenciosa, tirando todas as nossas dúvidas antes e durante a hospedagem, com respostas rápidas e precisas.
Outra coisa que amei foi ter chegado no apartamento e ter encontrado flores na mesa de centro.
Ficamos encantados com toda a experiência da viagem e quando voltarmos, tenho certeza que ficaremos hospedados aqui novamente.

Camila

Magnifique séjour au sein de cet appartement ! Victoria répond toujours présente à n'importe quelle occasion, que ce soit pour résoudre quelques petits problèmes ou pour donner des conseils. L'appartement est exactement le même que sur les photos. L'immeuble quant à lui est bien situé, à coté de l'avenue Corrientes et très proche des transports en commun et des commerces. ¡Muy buena vivienda!

Muy bueno todo!! Destaco lo expeditivo de la gestión con la Anfitriona.
Gracias por todo!
El apartamento cumple con lo indicado. Muy buena ubicación y cordial atención de la dueña ¡Muchas gracias por una gran estadía!

Para empezar recibi un precioso ramo de flores como bienvenida con una nota de la anfitriona.Todo estava como se describia en el anuncio. El apartamento es muy amplio de un solo ambiente con baño aparte. Muy bien comunicado, subte en la esquina y tiendas de todo tipo.Limpio muy limpio.
It was just as described and we had a wonderful stay. Victoria was easy to communicate with and the apartment is just what we needed: clean, spacious and in a great location. Would stay again

Victoria's place was great. Easy to get to including a doorman. Clean and functional w great internet service. The place is also walking distance to Soho (via Córdoba). Highly recommended.
Thanks for having me. Was fun.
Todo funcionó super. Es tal cual se vé en las fotos ni mas ni menos. Recomiendo le lugar para una estadía sencilla amena y agradable
Conveniently located near to restaurants, subway station, leather goods outlets and drugstore.

No conocimos a la anfitriona en forma directa pero nos contactamos por whatsapp y todo estuvo muy bien a nuestra llegada ya que las llaves estaban disponibles en la seguridad del edificio que 24 horas estan pendientes del edificio.
El barrio es muy bueno, y la ubicación es excelente ya que desde allí se puede ir a todos lados con mucha facilidad, a 30 mts esta la estacion del metro Linea B que te lleva al centro de la ciudad, en la Av. Corrientes pasan muchas lineas de colectivos que llevan a diferentes puntos y que en Buenos Aires son muy buenos para viajar.

Such a beautiful apartment in a nice area, less than a 1 minute walk away from the metro station!  The WiFi was excellent, the shower was hot and the balcony was big enough to sit outside and relax on.  Check in was extremely easy and it was very easy to contact Victoria during my 1 week stay.  Victoria is such a lovely person and I was very happy that I chose to stay there!

El departamento es muy lindo, como muestran las fotos. La única contra es que tiene bastante ruido de la calle. El edificio me resultó muy cómodo por la seguridad de la puerta que me abría siempre y por el espacio interno se la piscina. Victoria es muy amable!
La estadía estuvo perfecta, era justo lo que buscábamos - un lugar cómodo y bien ubicado. Victoria siempre nos contesto rápido y fue muy agradable.

Un departamento localizado en pleno micro-centro de Buenos aires.
Recomendable para pasar unos días en esta fantástica ciudad.
Martín un anfitrión excelente, una comunicación excelente y un departamento excelente.
Una valoración de una escala del 0 al 10, tiene un DIEZ.

I have lived in Martin's apartment for almost nine months because of the Pandemic situation. I can not say enough or express my thanks for the way I have been treated by Martin.
The apartment is now my home away from home. It is located in a very central area with everything you need for life very close. The apartment is old but well taken care of and comfortable.
When I return to BA if Martin will have me I will live again in this flat

Un apartamento bonito, bien equipado y espacioso, y bien situado para visitar la ciudad. Como de costumbre, Martin era un anfitrión muy confiable, dispuesto a ayudar y siempre accesible. Indudablemente recomendable
Hermoso lugar, súper tranquilo y silencioso. Cómodo e ideal para pasar una estadía trabajando. No tuve ningún inconveniente, todo lo que ofrece funciona muy bien !

La estancia en este departamento fue genial. La ubicación es perfecta, justo en el Microcentro, así puedes llegar caminando a los principales puntos de la ciudad. Hay también muchas opciones de transporte público. Es perfecto para estancias largas, pues es bastante grande y cómodo. Lo único q podría decir es que es un poco oscuro, durante el día tienes que dejar las luces prendidas, pero esto no te prejudicas en nada. Seguro me volvería a hospedar muchas veces más

El espacio ideal para una pareja. Te queda cerca de todo, tienes bancos, kioskios, mini mercados, farmacias, restaurantes, las líneas de colectivos y Subtes también quedan super cerca. Puedes caminar hacia cualquier lado. Martin siempre muy amable, buena comunicación. No tuvimos problema para la llegada ni la salida. El departamento es tal como lo muestran las fotos.

El departamento es muy lindo, cómodo y espacioso, la ubicación es buenísima. Algo que para mi resulta muy importante es la presión del  agua en la ducha y es buenísima, un placer usar esa ducha jajaja

Buena ubicación, amplio, limpio.
Con vista hacia una pared. TV sin smart TV.
Excelente ubicación, el apartamento da lo que promete, pequeños detalles en la limpieza, nada del otro mundo, en general muy bien.
Muy buena ubicación, el lugar espacioso tal cual muestran las fotos, súper cómodo y agradable!

El dto es tal cuál las fotos, es antiguo y fresco. La ubicación está genial, la zona me pareció segura, iluminada, tiene negocios y bares cerca. El internet funciona muy bien para trabajar. Shan muy atenta en todo momento.
Apartamento super acochegante, localizacao exepcional, super tranquilo, predio super limpo, zelador muito atencioso, gostei de tudo, agradeco a acolhida.
Muy recomendable, perfecta ubicación para pasar unos días en Buenos Aires.

El lugar es cómodo, tiene una buena ubicación, sin embargo la estufa tenía algunas fallas iniciales, la vista no era la esperada y no hay cable de TV.
Del resto todo estuvo bien, es un lugar agradable para estar.

El depto. Es tal cual se describe en el anuncio. Me mantuve en contacto en todo momento requerido con Shan, una persona muy amable y dispuesta a ayudar. Mi check-in fue tarde por mi horario de llegada y aún así no hubo inconvenientes, una amiga de Shan pudo recibirme sin problemas. El depto está bien cuidado, funcional y seguro por el manejo de puertas cerradas en el edificio. Mi estadía fue corta de 1 semana pero satisfecha de haberme alojado acá, sin duda volveré a hospedarme para mi próximo viaje. Totalmente recomendado, tanto por el sector que es muy accesible a varios sitios, ruidos externos son los mínimos y relación calidad/precio mejor que en otros sitios que busqué.
A hospedagem foi maravilhosa. Seguramente voltaria  me hospedar no apartamento da Shan.

Excelente anfitriona
Una alojamiento sin ningún problema
Recomendado!!

Muy lindo apartamento con mucho estilo y excelente ubicación. Lo único que no me gustó fue que no tiene persianas o cortinas gruesas que bloqueen la luz del día en las habitaciones . Entra muchísima luz apenas sale el sol. El resto todo muy bueno. Gracias

This was the perfect apartment in the perfect location. The apartment itself was roomy, great living areas, comfortable bedrooms and everything you could need. The location was right in the middle of everything. Just a block or two from tons of bars, restaurants and shopping.
Nice stay in a great location in Palermo. Place was nice and spacious

Horrible experience in Buenos Aires the AC broke down I reported this and had to spend the night in 95 degree weather made me sick. No AC in the middle of summer is inhumane at best. Also horrible construction outside the apartment with pile drivers and jackhammers it's like sleeping on a highway due to the noise. Bad experience.

Estuvimos alojados en el departamento de Victoria durante 4 noches. La pasamos muy bien, el lugar es tal como se ve en las fotos. Victoria pensó en muchos detalles para hacerte la estadía placentera y sin problemas (un cesto para la ropa sucia, un paraguas, adaptadores para enchufes, espacio para tu ropa, etc). El lugar dispone de piscina, aunque no es algo que nosotros utilizamos. Si vas en auto, a 10mts tenés un estacionamiento abierto 24h muy cómodo. Recomiendo el lugar sin dudas.
Es un espacio muy sencillo y funcional, bien ubicado en un entorno seguro y gente agradable.
Great place to stay, Victoria is a great host, always ready to answer your questions! Don't hesitate to book for this place!

Spacious, charming, and location, location, location. The apartment was very comfortable for our family and convenient for exploring BA in all directions.  We really appreciated the vibrant restaurant scene in Palermo and then having a short walk "home".
The host was very nice and helpful. The apartment is very nice, big, clean and warm. Location is great also, walking distance from many strategic places. Overall very good experience. Recommended.

Great location, lots of light and sunshine, comfy and spacious living room, loved the terrace! Close to subte station and bustling commercial Santa Fe avenue. Very helpful host, good experience!
lovely home, sweet room mate, and a nice private room and bath for myself!

I totally recommend this place. Walter, who is Rogelio's roommate, is very friendly and made me feel welcome! Location is also prime -- a few blocks from the subway and right off the main street when it comes to buses/taxis.

Great location, in the heart of Villa Crespo, a cute neighborhood with cafes and shops, and close to the other most-frequented parts of the city.  Clean and easy, everything works, and Victoria was super responsive.

departamento muy bien ubicado en una zona muy central muy cerca del metro y frente a una parada de buses, limpio, sencillo,  cama cómoda,  tiene excelentes guias sobre la ciudad y muy buena disposición, le pedi prestada una tarjeta de transporte y me la dejó. bien.
Muy buena ubicación. El apartamento y el edificio son muy cómodos y seguros. Victoria siempre está accesible. Espero poder volver.

it was not my first stay in Buenos Aires. the apartment I really liked.she is like the pictures. ideal for 1-2 people.not had any problems. good Internet, there is always hot water. in the yard there is a swimming pool and sun loungers. the apartment balcony. the house has security 24 hours, even the night guard is always I opened the door. opposite the house there is a nice restaurant where I could eat dinner before 1 am. metro 3 minutes walk. We enjoyed our stay at victoria's place very much. The apartment is comfortable and well designed, the space is luminous and also there's the bonus of the swimming pool downstairs. You should take into consideration that the street below is noisy during most of the day and night, it didn't bother us, but if you have difficulties to sleep you shoukd know that. Victoria's apartment is clean, cosy and well situated. It was just what we were looking for. Checking in/out was easy, and Victoria was quick and helpful to respond to any query. Great stay!

O apartamento é funcional, limpo, confortável e acomoda bem um casal. Buen departamento, cómodo.

Otima localização!! O apartamento é perfeito! Recomendo!
Todo muy bueno, inmejorable ubicación.
Muy lindo depto amplio, cómodo, zona ideal para moverse, cumple con todo lo que enuncia. Recomendable !

The apartment is very comfortable, has 24 hour security and is a few meters away from subway B red line that travels directly to the center. There are also supermarkets very close. The neighborhood is safe and the people are friendly. Palermo Hollywood a very nice area with many bars clubs, restaurants and clothing stores is only 15 blocks away. Communication with Victoria is very good and fast. Check in and check out is flexible. When I arrived I received the keys at the reception of the building. Everything is as indicated in the description and photos of the apartment. On my next trip to Buenos Aires I will stay again in Victoria's apartment.

This apartment is perfectly located to be able to enjoy Buenos Aires without being stuck in the touristy areas of the city. It is well sized, has all the amenities needed, and is very comfortable.  Victoria was a fantastic host - quick with responses and very flexible when the need arose.
El departamento esta muy bien ubicado y posee todos los elementos necesarios. Victoria nos ayudo sin problemas con todas las inquietudes que tuvimos. Recomendable.

Great location. It's ideal. As others have mentioned, the construction across the road makes it a noisy stay. However, the construction is almost done...which will lead to the apartment being what you were looking for.
MUY PERO MUY RECOMENDABLE , POR LA UBICACION Y LA BUENA ATENCION

Disfruté mucho la estancia. Todo estuvo perfecto y Victoria es una excelente anfitriona. La ubicación del departamento es fantástica, hay buenos restaurantes, cafés y tiendas de indumentaria. Sin duda volvería a hospedarme aquí. ¡Gracias totales!

Excelente departamento, muy bien ubicado, a pasos del subte y con acceso a todas las tiendas que uno necesita. Él edificio muy bueno, con seguridad las 24 hs. Tiene todo lo que uno necesita para tener una buena estadía.
Gracias Victoria, siempre atenta y ayudando ante cualquier necesidad.

Nice apartment and good location, close to public transportation. Victoria is a great host and responds quickly and well.

Stayed here for a month.  Great location, love Villa Crespo, filled with cafe's and restaraunts.  Major perks were the balcony, pool, and neighborhood. We were very pleased staying at Alejandro's. The apartment was much better than what we saw in the pictures. The location was perfect as well. Walking distance to metro and bus stops. His parents helped us and provided us with maps and were really sweet.We enjoyed our stay. Thank you Ale!

Apartamento bien situado, céntrico y próximo a dos líneas de metro. Los anfitriones amables y competentes. Dispuestos a ayudar y aconsejar. Además, discretos y respetuosos.

Mención especial y positiva merece la proximidad del apartamento al Centro Comercial El Abasto, que facilita la vida al turista en compras, comida, servicios varios... También en el entorno hay restaurantes de interés a precios razonables.
Gracias a Walter y Rogelio por su hospitalidad.

I had a wonderful time in this apartment! The view is beautiful and the covered patio gives it a great indoor-outdoor feel, perfect for spring. Walter is very friendly and was able to accommodate me at the last minute.

Rogelio was very flexible with my timing. Walter was an easy going (and mainly absent) flatmate. My only complain was the lack of air-conditioning, which in the summer can make sleeping a bit tougher.

I would definitely recommend this room to any solo traveler visiting Buenos Aires who needs a little privacy.  It's in a decent part of town, the room is spacious and Rogelio and Walter were very accomodating.

I had a wonderful time at Rogelio's place. Would happily visit again!

Mi estadia en la casa de Rogelio fue fantastica, me recibió Walter, me ha dejado super a gusto y me senti con en mi propia casa, el depto está siempre muy ordenado y limpio, su ubicación es perfecta, saludos y muchas gracias por todo!

I lived in this flat 2 months in 2013.  I never met Rogelio personally, but Walter, who is living there all the time is a very friendly and open minded person. We had a very good time together. sparkling clean and great location close to bars/restaurants.   will definitely book again. Demian the apartment manger is a great guy, he also helped us get a taxi at 4 am in the morning to get the the airport, since Uber kept on cancelling on us.

The apartment itself feels very high-end. Even the smell was luxurious. Note: the office was a great touch and had fast internet.
Lugar muy lindo y con una excelente ubicación. Todos siempre muy atentos.

The apartment is exactly as described- very generously and spacious. Everything works, the kitchen is well equipped, the neighbors are very friendly and the neighborhood is quite nice especially for food lovers and families. We would love to come back.

A very comfortable, clean, and nicely equipped 3 bedroom apartment in a great location. The host and property manager were all very responsive, providing helpful information before and during our stay while also respecting our privacy. I highly recommend.

I have stayed in this area a handful of times before but this place was absolutely perfect! I absolutely loved the old charm of the building! The location is perfect and Fernando and Damian were absolutely amazing with their communication! They absolutely completed the stay!

This is a well-located and spacious spot. Generally, very comfortable beds, and receives pretty good light throughout the day (if you are planning to work from the location). Of note for folks -- this place does require agreement to a lease, and this information is provided in the listing at the time of writing. The lease is not a long document, and was available to us in English. Not really a big deal.
Muy buena comunicación, excelente atención, y ubicación ideal!!!

This place is absolutely perfect. Very clean. Very comfortable. Amazing location in a sweet neighborhood with great restaurants, shopping, walking, and neighbors.
