This is the cleanest and best apt that I have ever stayed since I am a Airbnb user. The host was amazing, helpful and fun. The apt is located in one of the best neighborhoods of Buenos Aires near to everything. If I come back to BA I will definitely rent the place again.

The apartment is great (pretty and very clean) and the location too. The host was great and received us at 3am after our 4-hour flight delay. I would certainly come back there next time. Highly recommended!

April 2012.
Wonderful apartment, wonderful location, wonderful host. The perfect home base for exploring BA, the apartment has everything you need, and Silvia is endlessly helpful. Highly recommended!

O apartamento é excelente. Bem localizado e com muitos serviços úteis por perto como, por exemplo: mercado, mercado, casa de comida, telefone público, banco e ponto de ônibus.

O apartamento é ótimo, contendo tudo o que é necessário para passar dias agradáveis na cidade.

Além disso, o bairro é muito bonito e agradável. Muito próximo de lugares turísticos e da universidade.

En cuanto al apartamento: Es mejor que en las fotos. Está muy bien cuidado, limpio, acogedor, con todos los servicios a punto, y sobretodo, super bien situado en el barrio de Recoleta. Muy fácil de transporte y taxis.

En cuanto al host: Silvia nos acogió muy bien, dándonos las indicaciones necesarias y precisas sobre el piso y los alrededores del apartamento, con mucho entusiasmo y paciencia. En seguida, nos sentimos como en casa. Fue de agradecer que Silvia nos recibiera y despidiera a las horas que le pedimos: incluso se despertó a las 6.00 AM para que le dieramos las llaves.

Desde luego, un apartamento muy recomendable!!

This 3rd floor appartment is located at a very good location for discovering Buenos Aires. It is about 8 blocks away from the metro-station Pueyrredón, which we used frequently. The kitchen is fully equipped, a supermarket only 3 blocks away. Many restaurants can be found within 3 blocks of distance including a shopping mall with food court. We used the appartment as a base for our trips to La Boca, San Telmo, Teatro Colon, Puerto Madero, Palermo Soho, Palermo Bosque and Belgrano. The host gives a lot of attention, that the department is in perfect conditions. For third day a room service is included. Here is a list of goodies: heating/cooling system works, cold/hot water, cooking with gas, refrigerator, coffee machine, hair dryer, wifi, cable-TV with DVD player (so you can watch your freshly bought DVDs), table for working/eating, cleaning accesories (in case you want to keep it clean yourself), spare towels, nice illumination, motorized jalousy (to keep out sunlight after a long night), some literature (I liked the Tango book), telephone line, hot line - if something is missing or going bad.
I personally had to get used to the noise of a town street, as I live at a very tranquil place. At around 7 o'clock in the morning the trash-collector is doing its duty in the Peña street. This worked like an alarm clock to get out of bed to discover more of BA during the rest of the day. Be aware, that the single-glazing doesn't provide a good street noise reduction.
We enjoyed staying at that place, which is also very secure. One has to pass three locked doors, in order to get to the appartment. I considered the streets of that neighbourhood to be safe as we walked day and night without meeting suspicious people.
The host is fluent in english and spanish (and perhaps some other languages) which will be an advantage for non-spanish-speaking guests. We can warmly recommend this place for a stay in Buenos Aires.

We stayed in Buenos Aires for one week. The apartment was perfect for our purposes: centrally located, but calm (except during rush hour) in a very nice neighborhood; spacious and cosy with all equipment you need; nice small balcony. Silvia was a very friendly and welcoming host, giving us all the support and information that you need as a tourist in a city like Buenos Aires.
Absolutely recommendable.

O apartamento fica a poucas quadras (2 ou3) do cemitério da recoleta, local onde há bares legais, restaurantes... A uma quadra tem o supermercado Disco, bem como restaurantes.
Quanto ao apartamento, tem tudo o que é necessário para uma estadia confortável: otima cama, tv, bom banheiro, mini-cozinha com utensilios, geladeira com congelador, cooktop 2 bocas (otima para um bom cafe da manha), saleta agradavel com mesa para pequenas refeições e um sofá que pode servir de cama de solteiro, caso necessário. Tem uma varanda com muitas plantinhas, o que torna o apartamento bem claro e arejado. O apartamento é de frente, mas como a rua é calma, nao há barulho que chegue a incomodar, ainda mais com a porta da varanda fechada. (tem ar condicionado).
A casa estava muito limpa e bem cuidada. Silvia Diana é muito simpática, tendo nos dado dicas sobre Buenos Aires, restaurantes na vizinhança, transporte e tudo mais, até o taxi para o aeroporto ela fez a gentileza de chamar para a gente; além de nos disponibilizar mapa, guias de restaurantes e locais para visitar em Bs As.
Tudo muito bom, recomendadíssimo!

El departamento es fantástico: muy bien ubicado, cómodo, tal cual está en la foto.  Está cerca de todo, en un barrio seguro y de gran reputación. Silvia es una excelente anfitriona además de una mujer muy interesante y muy conocedora de temas variados.  El recibimiento fue muy cálido y sus instrucciones  y consejos relevantes y necesarios.  El café para pasar, delicioso!!!!  Fue una experiencia inolvidable y recomiendo totalmente este departamento en Buenos Aires.

I would highly recommend this apartment. We stayed for 3 weeks and really enjoyed our time there. The apartment was perfectly clean and regularly cleaned throughout our stay. The space was tastefully decorated, organised and fully equipped, it looks just as it does in the photos. Silvia is a very good host and really understands good hospitality. The shutters kept out any street noise at night and the balcony was nice to sit out on. Bed was comfortable. Great location in a safe area, walking distance to La Recoleta Cemetery and The flower of Recoleta.

A great apartment in an excellent location in Buenos Aires. Silvia was a most gracious host and very accommodating with an early arrival and departure as well as information about the city. Highly recommended!! Valeu Silvia...

Silvia was a wonderful host and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay in her apartment in Recoleta, Buenos Aires. The apartment is clean and secure, in a location that allows easy access to many of the City's attractions. The apartment is tastefully decorated and has a fully equipped small kitchen, modern bathroom and plenty of hot water.  I do not hesitate to recommend the apartment or the host to travellers who wish to experience the city as a resident rather than a traditional tourist.

Silvia is a great and caring landlady to a lovely, super clean apartment. I lived in her flat for half a year and always felt very comfortable. The location is good and safe, close to sights and to major bus stations (between Las Heras and Santa Fe).

Silvia was my first air bnb host and she set the bar extremely high. An absolutely wonderful woman who maintains a perfectly located, clean, fully equipped apartment.  A great part of the enjoyment of our time in BA was due to Silvia. Highest recommendation  from a well seasoned traveler.

Silvia meet me when I arrived at the apartment and gave me a complete tour of my home away from home where I would be staying for the next month. Silvia speaks very good English and was able to give me directions to all the places that I wanted to go such as grocery stores, pharmacys, restaurants and local attractions. And everything is so close to her apartment. There are restaurants everywhere. It is a short walk to the Recoleta Cemetery and the park areas that surround it, taxis are available all the time and easy to get on the street and it is only a few blocks from the Subway (Subte).

Her apartment is exactly like it is shown in the pictures. And I mean exactly. It is spotlessly clean and on the fourth floor of an older European style building with the old style elevator - very charming indeed. The area has a strong European flavour. Most of the buildings in this area are 8-12 stories tall with a lot of the older style buildings. Buenos Aires is a very large city so there is lots of traffic but easy to get around. Recoleta is said to be the safest part of Buenos Aires and I must agree totally. I always felt totally safe. I walked for at least 2 hours daily in all different directions and never saw a problem. And there were a few nights that I walked back to my apartment late at night and the streets were always safe in Recoleta.

Silvia lives just a short distance away so if there are any issues, she is there right away to solve them. I had a tap that loosened on me - nothing serious at all but Silvia had the plumber in right away to have it checked and repaired. She gave me her telephone number so that if I wanted anything at all, she was there to help. She is a charming person and a new friend. I will always remember my month in Buenos Aires at Silvia's apartment. It was truly a wonderful time and Silvia helped to make it that way. I plan on returning to Buenos Aires some day and will definitely stay at Silvia's apartment again.

Gracias Silvia for everything. All the best. Adios - Bernie

We had an unforgetable stay in Buenos Aires in Silvias apartment. The location is perfect and safe. Everything you need is just a few meters around! The apartment itself was exactly as described and very clean! We felt very comfortable. In particular we want to mention how helpful and kind Silvia was! She cared about everything we needed! We would like to come again! Thank you very much!!

Silvia was an excellent host and made us feel welcome from the minute we arrived. During our stay she was always reachable on the phone or via email to answer questions about the apartment as well as the city. She was very flexible with check-in/out time.

The apartment is beautiful (and very clean!) and has all the amenities a guest could hope for - including a brand new refrigerator. The balcony is small and cute. Overall, the apartment is excellent value.

Recoleta is a great area to stay in Buenos Aires - central and with access to all forms of transport. The apartment is within walking distance of numerous great restaurants.

Silvia's place was exactly what we had been looking for! Silvia expected us personally and gave us a very warm welcome. From the first moment we felt at home in her appartment!
Apart from being a great host, Silvia has got a flair for interior design. The flat is well furnished and very cosy. There was everything we needed. We were especially enthousiastic about the balcony: we enjoyed having breakfast there and started every evening with a candlelight aperitif observing the street and our neighbours:)
Recoleta has become our favourite district. It's very lively and safe at the same time. The flat is very centrally located, lots of places of interest as well as shopping opportunities, various grocery stores and nice restaurants are close by.
Silvia lives just around the block and was ready to help us 24 hours a day and suggest what we should see and do. Silvia is a very nice and cordial person, it was great to chat with her. Within a very short time she has become a friend.
We highly recommend to stay in her apartment and definitely want to come back!

Perfeito. O apartamento de Silvia é bonito, bem decorado e limpíssimo. A localização é excelente: próximo ao transporte público da cidade, de lojas e restaurantes. Silvia é uma pessoal muito amável e nos fez sentir à vontade. Recomendo a experiência e vou voltar a me hospedar no apartamento de Silvia quando tiver a oportunidade.

Silvia was amazing!  She was very attentive to our needs both prior to our trip, during our stay and after our departure as we left a bag and this amazing host arranged for a taxi to get this bag to the airport!!!!  She was full of information about touring the city! Her personality wasso welcoming!  The apartment was spotless, beautiful, with a great view and balcony, safe, and VERY central to everything including many restaurants and sight seeing venues! Recoleta is beautiful and full of culture.

My cousin and I stayed for a week in Silvia's cozy apartment in Recoleta. It was centrally located to all the things we wanted to do while we were in Buenos Aires. Silvia was a great hostess, greeting us when we arrived, helping us out with taxi reservations and checking in every so often to make sure we had what we needed. There is a convenience store across the street and a fruit/veggie stand next door, which proved very useful with household goods we needed throughout the week and it was very easy to get around the city by foot and taxi. And there were many things within walking distance that we wanted to see (Recoleta Cemetery, El Ateneo Bookstore, shopping, etc.).
If you're looking for a convenient, clean place, Silvia's is a good bet. Thanks for everything, Silvia!
Best, Nicole & Ari
Nice apartment in a very nice area. Everything worked. Silvia is a very charming woman. I definitely recommend staying there!

Todo estuvo perfecto. Tal como aparece en las fotos.
El departamento precioso, muy bien cuidado, limpio, cómodo y bien ubicado. Nuestra anfitriona, excelente.

Silvia was a great host, allowed us to do an early checkin, and was waiting for us at the apartment to give us the keys and show us everything we needed to know to stay at her apartment. The apartment is just as advertised in the photos, very comfortable for one person or a couple and has everything you need for a comfortable stay in BA. Excellent location in Recoleta, walking distance to the cemetery, Santa Fe, and all the restaurants, bars and shopping. Very safe neighborhood and also close to the others - San Telmo, Palermo, Puerto Madero, Boca etc. Silvia was very helpful with pointing us in the right direction and made our stay in BA a wonderful experience. I highly recommend staying at her place, great value for your $$/Peso

Sunny, open, sophisticated space just as described. We had a wonderful week, often sitting on the balcony enjoying neighborhood life. Silvia is fun, engaging host taking time to welcome and send off guests. The location is stellar, especially with new subway stop a few blocks away to make large city of Buenos Aires accessible. We loved being close enough to cemetery to enjoy its environs. Highly recommend Roux across the street for world class meal.

This was very much a last minute booking and Silvia went out of her way to accommodate me. She answered my enquiries almost immediately, until late in the night, and took the trouble to call me first thing the next morning to assure me that all would be in order. Silvia allowed me to drop off my luggage around 11 am already, although she was still busy getting the apartment ready for my one month stay.
The apartment itself is everything as depicted, and more. After 7 months in South America and numerous AirBnB experiences this was one of the best equipped apartments I have had the pleasure of staying in, most definitely the best equipped in Argentina (I have stayed in apartments where I had to buy kitchen towels, cork screws, bathroom towels etc because these basic items were simply not provided). Not so in Silvia's place - there is enough linen for a regular change of bedding, more than enough towels, soaps, all the possible cleaning material one could ask for, even a small First Aid Kit equipped with plasters, bandages, paracetamols, all the necessary. That was an all time first for me.
The wifi worked perfectly all the time, and there is cable TV if you require the same.
And to crown it all Silvia offers a cleaning service - in my case it was twice a week - which is absolutely fabulous when you have a busy schedule.
Location wise the apartment is in the best part of Recoleta - three blocks from the cemetery (my favourite place in Buenos Aires), a few blocks from Avenida Santa Fe, and within walking distance of the Centro as well as Palermo. There are copious amounts of verdulerias, flower sellers, lavanderias, small supermarkets (and larger ones) and awesome bakeries in the area, as well as a host of fabulous restaurants merely a stone throw away. Everything you could ask for is right at your fingertips. But the street is surprisingly quiet at night (even for me who is a very light sleeper) and the shutters outside the French doors which lead to the quaint balcony block out the day light 100%.
Silvia was always available for queries and chats - she really gave me a feeling of being looked after and gave me a home away from home. Muchas gracias por todos Senorita...................I will be back, in a heartbeat.
Very nice apartment. Clean. Nice interior. Good location. Recommend. Thanks Silvia!
Silvia was very accomodating with our late night arrival and early morning departure.  The apt. was well maintained.  We had no issues and would be glad to rent from her again.

Excelente lugar para recomendar desde donde lo mires! Super acogedor,cálido,impecable en limpieza, comodidad y servicios. La ubicación fantástica,cerca de todo y muy segura. Silvia,la anfitriona, una genia! atenta a las necesidades de uno desde el primer momento, predispuesta para todo, y tiene un "algo especial" que hace sentirte como en tu casa!!! Para recomendar 100 %.

Silvia was an awesome host and she is willing to help any time. we arrived late at night - around 11PM; she was waiting for us in the listing till we arrived. And she came to say bye to us when we checked out.

The check-in and check-out processes are very smooth. Her place is exactly as listed. Great location in great neighborhood; walking distance to bus stops and subway stations. Air conditioning works great, which is very essential in summers. the place is clean and tidy and has everything we need during our five days' stay.

i'll definitely come back here if i revisit BA and i'd recommend this place to everyone.
Excelente apartamento. Muy comodo en un gran sector. La anfitriona excelente.

o prédio é bem localizado, em uma rua tranquila, mas próximo a bons restaurantes e cafés. o apartamento tem bom espaço para acolher três pessoas, é agradável e com boa estrutura. a anfitriã está sempre pronta a ajudar no que for preciso. recomendo.
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! The  apartment was lovely! The area is safe and Silva was an amazing host. We would definitely recommend :)

Excelente departamento, el mejor lugar para estar un viaje a Buenos Aires. Cerca de todo, buena comunicacion de transportes, restaurantes, zona muy segura y la atencion 11 puntos !!. muchas gracias !!

Silvia is overbearing, pedantic and neurotic. We had an incident where she got very angry that my partner and I accidently made a small reap in the sheets. It came from general wear and tear and it was not done on purpose. The sheets are a bit old and thin and had a small reap when we arrived. We apologised to her but she demanded we pay for new sheets. This is completely unreasonable and it is a common understanding that these things happen. In addition, when she came to tidy the room on the third day we were left with a bunch of handwritten notes explaining what we had done wrong, like little children. We were not allowed to use the plastic bucket to put organic waste. Were told to not put used toilet paper in the bin but flush it down (just to name a few things ). This is very neurotic behavior and we were made to feel uncomfortable.  in terms of the actual apartment and the location, we loved it. It's small but practical and close to everything you might need. I will make a suggestion to minimize the contact with the host as much as possible if you do want to stay there.
El Dto muy lindo.. muy agradable y atenta la señora Silvia.. muy limpio el departamento.. ideal para pasear .. muy buena ubicación! Muchas gracias por todo !! Saludos

Alojarme en lo de Silvia fue genial. Por empezar su departamento es sencillamente ...Perfecto!:  Luminoso, silencioso (ambas dos cualidades difíciles de conseguir en una gran ciudad) coqueto, bien equipado y comodísimo!. La ubicación es muy buena cerca del Cementerio de la Recoleta, Mall, Restaurantes (de gran categoría y también económicos) pizzerias, heladerías, cerca de supermercados, verdulerías y fruterías, Cines y centros culturales, etc etc etc. Resumen: Todo a mano y a toda hora  en una zona super tranquila y paqueta. Por añadidura cerca de la estación Bulnes del subterráneo lo que permite moverse por la ciudad con rápidez, cómodidad y mas barato imposible!  ($7,50 Tarjeta sube permite hacer 20 viajes! Único en el mundo!).  Capitulo aparte para la anfitriona: Silvia es muy simpática y servicial y está siempre dispuesta a ayudar en todo. Muchas gracias Silvia!. Realmente todo estuvo perfecto. Ojalá algún día pueda volver!

Excelente departamento, es tal como se ve en la foto, muy bien cuidado y cómodo para tres personas, con un lindo balcón. Un barrio tranquilo, cerca de toda la locomoción y de lugares donde comer y comprar. La anfitriona muy preocupada en todo momento. Muy recomendable!!!
Rogelio meanwhile moved back into his flat, is a very well organized, attentive and funny flatmate and did everything to make my stay comfortable. I will stay for another month:-)

We had a fantastic stay at Alejandro's apartment and we highly recommend it to anyone visiting Buenos Aires.

The apartment is really new and well equipped. Everything inside has high quality and was chosen to make one feel very confortable. The bed is big and confortable, the shower pressure is great, there are many towels, it's well decorated and the kitchen is very functional, with everything one needs to cook easily. And the internet connection is speedy.

The apartment is located in a beautiful place. The street is quiet, really quiet. There are good restaurants near the building, including a good one just across the street. A small supermarket is located 50 meters from the building.

Although it's a quiet area, it's located only three blocks from Cabildo, which is a very commercial street with pretty much anything you might possibly need, including the subway station (D line) and many bus stops.

We didn't have a chance to meet Alejandro in person, but he was very responsive. We exchanged several messages prior to our arrival and everything worked out as planed.

We did meet Alejandro's parents, who came to the building to greet us. They are absolutely lovely. We were extremely pleased to meet them and we hope to see them again in future visits to Buenos Aires.

The Argentinians are always very friendly but Alejandro's parents are way friendlier than we could ever anticipate. We really loved them. :-)

We will definitely staty in this apartment again in the future and we strongly recommend it to anyone who wants to have a pleasant stay in Buenos Aires.

Great apartment in nice part of town with great access. Little resturant across the street and around corner a market for food & wine. Easy access to subte (subway) system and within 15 minutes of everything. Alejandro and his parents are great people and very helpful!

One of my favorite things was that every afternoon a flock of parrots would gather in the surrounding tree's for about an hour or so, just added so much flavor to the stay. Highly recommended and will be staying there again in the future!

Great apartment in a great part of town. This is perfect if you want to get a bit away from the typical tourist spots and get to know Buenos Aires as a whole. Plus downtown is a quick metro ride away.

It is conveniently located next to public transport, markets and restaurants (the parrilla spot across the street is a good bet if you want to stay close). Alejandro's parents are great hosts, too bad we had such little time to chat. :P

Absolutely lovely apartment, very peaceful. With a great parrilla on the corner open until all hours. Alejandro and his parents were very attentative. General cleanliness was a bit of a problem but Alejandro tells us that it hasn't been an issue before.

Thank you Rogelio for being my host, City guide, spanish teacher and friend in Buenos Aires! I wish I can return one day and would appreciate to find "my room" being offered that day:-) It's been my pleasure to contribute some german-style engineering to some renovation measures and I'm sure that future guests will appreciate the freshly applied sun protection, enjoy the latin-american-style decoration and all the other Features of this flat, that will surely keep experiencing lots of sophistication and commitment of its owner.
Excelente Depto. Lindisimo, muy bien ubicado. Silvia super atenta siempre en contacto. Muy recomendable.

I chose this apartment because Diana is an Airbnb-Superhost and I was not disappointed, everything went perfect: fast answers, reliability, cleanliness, on-site assistance, cleaning etc. The apartment is good located and has everything you need, and if you need something, Silvia is ready to assist on any time.

This place is in a great location in the neighborhood of Recoleta, Buenos Aires.  Silvia’s place is in a quaint area, and is located within walking distance to some main attractions; Recoleta Cemetery, a craft fair on weekends near the cemetery, shops and restaurants. Because Recoleta is centrally located within the surrounding neighborhoods of BA, Silvia’s place is good choice for those who are looking explore through BA. The noise level was similar to what you would find in any city at night. The price is great for a studio that was very clean, not cluttered, safe, and quite simple.

I highly recommend Silvia’s place without reservation.
Communication is quick and clear. Location is in the best area of Buenos Aires. It is in the middle of all attractions. We walked to everywhere. It’s in a residential neighbourhood with groceries, cafes, etc. Apartment is exactly as shown in pictures. Well equipped for travellers. Spacious place for 2 - 3 persons.
Silvia is the best hostess I have met. She spent time to talk to us and tells us about the city. What a lovely start of our visit by talking with a local! Her flexible check in/out is a huge bonus. She helped us to call a taxi to airport. Silvia is definitely a part of our memorable trip of Buenos Aires.
Don’t think twice! Just book Silvia’s apartment!
Alice
O apartamento é ótimo, funcional, confortável, seguro, bonito e bem localizado

Silvia is a great host! She met us when we arrived and when we needed to go. She likes to clean every few days, but we were still sleeping, and we only had one day left, so we didn't see a need. It was the exact space advertised and definitely a quiet neighborhood. We loved how close we were to the main places we wanted to see. When we make it back, we would love to stay with Silvia again.
Muy bien ubicado el departamento y Silvia es fabulosa! Con placer me quedaría con ella en el futuro. // Wonderfully located apartment and Silvia is great! I'd gladly stay again with her.
Silvia es una gran anfitriona, el departamento precioso, todo lo necesario en un barrio perfecto en ubicación. La WiFi funciona perfecto también.

Silvia was great. Her place is well located and close to everything you need. She was a great communicator which made things very easy. I had a very early flight and she went out her way to check me out at 4:30am which I thought was quite extraordinary.

The highlight of this place is the extraordinarily nice people who greet you, Ron and Eva (the parents of Alejandro) who are very warm and welcoming.  The apartment is nice looking, but overall we found it lacked total functionality.   We enjoyed sitting on the patio to eat.  The problem was that when we wanted to eat inside (when cold and dark outside for example) there was no kitchen table to sit at inside.  At one point it was cold and I wanted to put on heat - there was a unit on the wall, but no remote control to use it.  The place was advertised as having wifi, but when we got there it wasn't set up.  That was a big problem for us, so we had to spend a hour troubleshooting it and setting it up on the modem ourselves.  The kitchen had lots of pots and pans, but they were all teflon coated (yuck!) and scratched up at that.  And lastly, the bed was ROCK HARD.  We learned from the experience that we always have to ask airbnb hosts how the bed is after not sleeping well for days on this super hard mattress.  The positives were:  nice bathrooms and lots of clean towels, nice and modern building, the kitchen had some oil and basic supplies which is nice when you're traveling, it was a nice and quiet neighborhood, nice neighbors in the building, a great supermarket right across the street.  It was not Belgrano though, as advertised.  The neighborhood is called Núñez.

A bit broken communication at the beginning.
the apartment is as pictured or better, good quality products, clean, smell new, great location. Highly recommended.
Let others in the Airbnb community know about your stay. This will appear on the listing page.
great place, very clean, lots of space and nice area to stay in BA!
Very nice place, well situated, near a subway... in a cozy area. We were well received. I recommend it for sure !

Amazing apartment in a great location near the metro D line. Great amenities nearby...restaurants, laundry, supermarket.  V reasonable compared to B&B's/hostels in the city centre and nice to get some peace and quiet after a day exploring the city.  Would recommend this apartment to everyone!!!  Only slight downside is the pool was out of order when we were there so check before staying that it is working.
The apartment is very nice, it is in a very quiet neighborhood.

We had the most wonderful time in this apartment. It's brigth, tasteful and provides everything you need. Long breakfasts on the bealcony and you will have the pool on the roof mostly to yourselves.
The neighborhood is easygoing, a chinese supermarket around the corner and the subway in reach.

El apartamento de Alejandro es perfecto. Cómodo y con todos los servicios. La cama es grande y cómoda, el balcón es muy disfrutable. La ubicación es lejana al centro, pero el barrio es residencial, tranquilo de noche y con muchos negocios de día. La parada del subte esta a pocas cuadras y pueden ir hasta el centro en unos 20 minutos.
Super location, excellent and very charming apartment, and the best host we have had. Can't recommend enough.

O lugar é incrível, o apartamento com uma energia ótima exatamente como nas fotos. Lugar seguro. Andei sozinha à noite. A Recoleta é uma delicia e Silvia uma anfitriã cinco estrelas. Absolutamente nada a reclamar. Indico e volto com certeza❤️
Silvia es una excelente anfitriona y está dispuesta a ayudarte en todo.

I have visited Buenos Aires more than 15 times, and this is my 3rd AirBnB stay. This one was hands down THE BEST. It's a comfortable apartment that is very well located. (IMHO, *the* best location for tourists is between Callao, Las Heras, Pueyrredon, and Santa Fe. Please don't stay along Florida Street -- too touristy!!!!) The location of the apartment is GREAT, just GREAT! The checkin is super smooth, the communication is outstanding, and (I think) the price at about $50 a day is very worth it. I'm a simple guest. I just need air conditioning in the summer heat, good WIFI, and a fridge. This place has all of this....plus GREAT water pressure in the shower, a nice TV (which I hardly watched), drawers and closet space, and a nice balcony with windows to give LIGHT so you don't feel you're in the more usual darker, closed windows kind of place. Microwave and small gas stove. EVERYTHING IS EXCELLENT about this place!! Sylvia is an outstanding host!!!!
:-) :-) :-)

Silvia’s place is perfect for a stay in Ricoleta.  You can’t beat the location (walking distance to the Ricoleta cemetery with several parks, convenience stores, restaurants and cafes nearby). The place itself is clean and well put together. The shower has great water pressure and never ran out of hot water. Plus there is tons of natural light in the apartment, thanks to the lovely balcony that opens up to peña st. Definitely consider staying at Silvia’s place if you are visiting Buenos Aires.
Apartamento muy céntrico, cómodo y bonito . Silvia es una súper host

Amazing and warm hospitality! Silvia took her time to introduce me her place and neighborhood. If you are traveling solo, you will find a friends with Silvia’s open personality very fast! Great location and apartment is very cozy and clean. Best location for the best price! Old building with fun elevator! I’m going to miss it, Silvia and BA!
Bonito apartamento en el corazón de Recoleta con todo lo necesario para disfrutar de una perfecta estancia en Buenos Aires.

muy recomenfable...
muy buena ubicacion

silvia es muy atenta y amable...y respusta es muy rapida...

super recommendable

This is a VERY nice apartment in what is, in my opinion, THE best area of Buenos Aires to be in -- the Recoleta neighborhood.  Get out your map and look at this square area of these 4 streets: Las Heras, Pueyrredon, Santa Fe, Callao.  Within this area, you'll find lots of restaurants for locals, not tourists.  It's small streets.  Silvia's place is located on a street called Peña.  It's about 3 blocks from Recoleta cemetery, which is just right.  You're near some touristy things, but you are not in the touristy area.  In fact, in my week just now, I heard English in a restaurant maybe once.  I have been to Buenos Aires MANY times, and I always try to stay in this area.  This was my 2nd time at Silvia's place.  I highly recommend it!  It's a regular "big city" apartment in terms of space.  There is one big area that is comprised of a small kitchen (big fridge, microwave, sink, gas stove, lots of cabinets with toaster, dishes, etc.; a living area with a sofa and a small kitchen table; a sleeping area with a comfortable bed, 2 closet areas, several drawers, and a TV; a small bathroom with a sink and a tub and a toilet -- great water pressure!; a balcony.  One of the cool things about this apartment in fact is that it has a balcony overlooking the street, so you can have sunlight in your apartment, in other words, a sunny view.  (Lots of apartments have only interior views, which means you see nothing at all except another wall.)  I like this place.  I'll be back for sure.

The apartment is great, the localization is excellent very close to the subway. Silvia is a lovely person and a very nice hottest that makes everything for your staying be perfect. I absolutely recommend Silvia’s place!

Silvia es una persona cálida y atenta a todas las necesidades de sus huéspedes. Si es tu primera visita en BA, te vas a encontrar en las mejores manos, Silvia te recibirá ella misma y se asegurará de que pases la mejor de las estadías. Un placer poder haber sido su huésped y espero poder volver en otra oportunidad.

Silvia, una persona muy agradable siempre dispuesta a que la estadía sea la mejor experiencia; el departamento tal cual como en las fotos, limpio, impecable; Silvia, su departamento y los alrededores hicieron del viaje todo de mi encanto, 100% recomendado.
Excelente ubicación, cómodo, limpio y bien mantenido. Anfitriona muy atenta.

El departamento es bellísimo, muy agradable, decorado y cuidado con un estilo clásico con excelente gusto y cariño en cada detalle, con gran preocupación de Diana la anfitriona. Ella es muy acogedora y estuvo atenta siempre, además muy adorable y simpática. El barrio maravilloso cerca de buenos restaurantes (el Roux), comida vegana (a la vuelta de la esquina), comercio (supermercados y mall con librería Cúspide) y centros culturales (cementerio, centro cultural Recoleta donde hay una feria de artesanos los sábados). Muy recomendable! volveré.
Apartment was very comfortable well equipped and centrally located. The balcony will be an added bonus in the summer time.

Silvia´s place is fantastic, very well located, and exactly as shown in the pictures.
Silvia herself was super helpful and she accommodated our check-in and check-out crazy times. Thanks, Silvia, and we hope to be back in Buenos Aires soon!

Nohora & Marcos

10000% recomendado!!
el departamento está en una ubicación privilegiada, es muy cómodo, limpio y está muy bien equipado.
Silvia es una anfitriona espectacular. Excelente comunicación, muy preocupada de todos los detalles y sumamente atenta en el trato. Feliz vuelvo!!

El lugar es exactamente como en las fotos. Es un departamento antiguo muy bien mantenido, todo impecable y lindo! La ubicación es excelente, ideal para salir a caminar, y cerca de supermercados, facturitas, pizzas (en un local que se llama Cala), y comercio de todo tipo). Es muy acogedor y cómodo. Silvia estuvo atenta por si necesitábamos algo y la verdad es que no necesitamos nada durante la estadía, tuvimos todo lo necesario. Gracias Silvia por hacer de tu estadía aún más agradable gracias a tu amabilidad.

Silvia was truly a gem, from the conversation to the apt that was perfectly clean, cozy and inviting in a neighborhood that was all I could’ve asked for in my first trip to Buenos Aires and S America.  Everything you could ever want/need was immediately available in proximity, Recoleta truly  is a special neighborhood.  Access to cafes, restaurants, bars, parks, tourist areas, as well as respites from it all in a lovely apt, I can’t really imagine a better experience for a first time solo international traveler .. I felt safe, welcomed and entertained all the same.  I look forward to returning one day.   Muchas Gracias Silvia 🙏🏼
ÓTIMA
Excelente estadía. Silvia es una excelente anfitriona. El apartamento es exactamente como en las fotos.
A Silvia é maravilhosa! O espaço incrível! Me senti muito bem lá!
Volveria una y mil veces, Silvia es un amor y el departamente es SO CUTE! Es tal cual lo muestra en las fotos, esta re bien ubicado, con restaurantes, supermercados y transporte a mano.

A estadia com Silvia foi boa desde o começo.
A descrição correspondeu ao que encontramos, e Silvia foi muito prestativa.
O apartamento estava impecavelmente limpo. O espaço é muito charmoso.
Tinha todas as comodidades.
O ar-condicionado conseguia refrigerar o apartamento todo. Banheiro ótimo, com boa pressão da água no chuveiro. A localização fantástica, com muitos restaurantes nas proximidades.
Silvia foi muito simpática, nos recebeu como uma amiga em sua casa.

Mi estancia  ha sido excelente. Silvia es una persona muy atenta y cordial; y su departamento muy lindo, cómodo y tranquilo. Lo recomiendo ampliamente . Volvería siempre con ella . Muchas gracias silvia espero volver otra vez
Nicely furnished apartment in a trendy convenient location, and Sylvia is especially nice
Everything is very good.  We felt at home.  Big thanks to Silvia.
Silvia’s place was as advertised. Silvia is very friendly & will go out of her way to accommodate. I want to go back soon.

Silvia is an amazing host and lovely person — friendly, kind and responsible. She welcomed me in short notice and makes sure the apartment is spotlessly clean and beautiful. A great pleasure to stay at this studio which is close to everything. It is so nice to wake up in the morning and see greens on your balcony and downstairs … amazing place in general.

El departamento se encuentra en uno de los mejores barrios de Buenos Aires (para mi gusto, el mejor), en una calle arbolada y con poco tránsito, perfectamente comunicado. Es un monoambiente pero amplio y organizado de una manera muy inteligente. Destaca sobre todo el buen gusto de la decoración, que lo hace un lugar íntimo, cómodo y especial. El baño es cómodo, la cocina esencial pero perfecta. La cama me encantó y el balcón amplio le da otro punto agradable, porque roza con las ramas de un árbol. Fueron días de mucho calor y aún así dormí muy bien gracias al ventilador de techo (también hay aire acondicionado, pero yo prefiero no usarlo). Finalmente, Silvia Diana es una persona muy especial e interesante y se nota el parecido entre su personalidad y su inmueble tan especial. Recomendado al 100%
Elegantly appointed, very quiet place in peaceful neighborhood.  I highly recommend the place. Very nice hosts too --Alejandro's parents.

OMG, I loved this Loft. It was extremely confortable.
But the cherry on top was Alejandro's father he is such a fascinanting figure. He was really great, pls pls ask him to take you on a tour through Buenos Aires, he will be delighted to do it and you will learn a lot with him.

I have only kind words to describe my experience at this place, I'll definetly be staying there every time im at Buenos Aires.

Great apartment in a very central and relatively safe part of Buenos Aires.
Is exactly how it looks on the site.

Alejandro's father was waiting for me in the apartment when I initially arrived and was most helpful.

Thoroughly recommend this place to anyone visiting.
Todo perfecto! Muy recomendable!!!
Muy bueno el departamento, cómodo y completo. En una zona tranquila y con servicios cerca.

El depa es tal cual e inclusive mas lindo que las fotos, la ubicación esta muy buena porque está a 3 cuadras de la av. Cabildo y en general la zona es muy tranquila.
Los anfitriones son muy amables y buena onda!
Regresaría a ese depa sin pensarlo 2 veces!

Lovely apartment, in a quite and nice neighborhood at the limit between Belgrano and Nuñez.
Alejandro's parents who took care of us are charming people!
Just one word....AMAZING!!!!!!!

Alejandro's departamento is indeed nicer then on the pictures. It has everything and is well located in the quiet barrio Belgrano. On the fridge you can find discount flyers for the restaurant across the street: La Rinconada. Tip: order first one dish because the portions are hudge!
Eva and Ronnie will welcome you to the appartment and explain everything about the place and the neighboorhood. They are very Argentinian: warm, friendly and there for all your requests. It will be a great first contact if you have never been in Argentina before!
I will recommend this highly to everyone.

Very nice apartment, well equipped, bright and clean. Convenient location near the subte. Hosts (Alejandro's parents) are very friendly  and easy to communicate. I definitely recommend this apartment to anyone.

Daniele is a very friendly host and was thoughtful from beginning to end.
Suite Gardel is very clean, bright, quiet, and well-equipped. The location is great: close to shops, restaurants, a good supermarket, and the subway.
Highly recommended!

Excelente en todo, la verdad q no puedo darle nada negativo. El departamento estaba en perfecto estado, limpio y con todo lo q mostraba en las fotos. La atencion fue perfecta, tanto a la llegada como a la salida del loft. Llegamos un poco tarde por problemas de tránsito, y nos esperaron sin ninguna queja.

I stayed nearly 4 months at Alejandros loft. I highly recommend staying there. It is located in the safe district Belgrano. It is connected to the subway and all buses. And the flat really looks like on the pictures! I felt very comfortable. Alejandro speaks Engish, Spanish and German, so it was very easy to communicate with him. And he gave me lots of advices to have a nice start in Baires. His lovely parents gave me the keys and showed me around the city.
I really enjoyed my time there.
Excelente apartamento!

The stay in Alejandros apartment was excellent. The apartment fitted the description and is located in a quiet street with almost no traffic, although it's in walking distance to the subway station Congreso de Tucuman. The apartment is fully equipped, the reception was extraordinarily warm and friendly. The balcony is great to have breakfast, lunch or dinner, the room is luminous and has both a fan and an air conditioning. There are two bathrooms, a lovely living room and above the comfortable bed. The neighbors are quiet. In the flat next door lives a cat that loves to pay a visit, it is very cute and well-educated. In the neighborhood you can find all kinds of stores. Belgrano is a lovely barrio, only 30 minutes away by subway from Plaza de Mayo and well-connected to other barrios like Almagro, Palermo and Recoleta by bus. You find hardly any tourists in Belgrano which is a better neighborhood of Buenos Aires. I would love to spend much time there, but some day even the nicest vacations have to come to an end...
Grandioso, maravilloso, muy cerca de la subte, un barrio tranquilo, hermoso y lindo. La casa simpatica, el dueño tambien. Nos sentimos si comodos que queriamos volver! Muchisimas gracias para todo!
i stayed at Alejandro's place while staying in Bs As Visiting my parents. everything was superb. very close to Av Cabildo where you have all the buses to connect you to the city. 100% experience!

As soon as we arrived alejandros really adoreable father warmly welcomed us at the appartement. He gave us a quick overwiev like where the subway is located and so on (btw. He speaks english and spanish) the appartement was amazing! Theres a good kitchen and the bathroom was good aswel! And everything was super clean! The appartement is in a good and quite location. There are some restaurants and supermarkets just around the corner. Even the subway which takes you to all the nice places is just a few blocks from the appartement. So all in all we really enjoyed staying at this appartement and we just can highly recommend this appartement and of course alejandro as host who really manages everything at its best!!! Thanks again!

This apartment was totally perfect! Everything about it was comfortable and I felt very much at home. As others have said, your initial welcoming to the flat is very special. The host's parents come to greet you and help you with anything you need. Take some time to talk with Ronnie, he knows a lot about the area and you will definitely learn some new things.

About the place itself - the pictures are a totally accurate representation. I really enjoyed the balcony in the front and spent a lot of time out there. The building was quiet and the neighbors friendly. There are many supermarkets, cafes, and pharmacies near by. The Subte system was easily accessible and simple to use. Staying in this neighborhood made me feel more in touch with the city rather than staying in the touristy areas.

Bottom line, if you are traveling to Buenos Aires and looking for a private place to stay this is the one for you. You will meet fantastic people and have a wonderful time!
Cosy eclectic latin-american style apartment, nice host, comfortable neighbourghood. And a great city! Definitely recommend.
Lovely apartment in a wonderful location. Rogelio is really friendly and communicated everything very well, would definitely stay again!

Rogelio was a very kind and welcoming host. He works long hours, so most of the time, I had the apartment to myself. His apartment is in a very central location in Buenos Aires and conveniently located next to several bus lines and supermarkets. Having fast Wi-Fi, cable TV, and my own bathroom made my stay more enjoyable. The only thing I wish I had was a larger bed, but the room is a good size. I would recommend Rogelio's apartment for people who are planning to visit Buenos Aires on a budget.

Rogelio was a terrific host. I stayed at his apartment for 4 months.  Rogelio was always very helpful and attentive. Although he works and travels a lot, he was always responsive and easy to communicate with. The apartment is great. Central location and a quaint set up with a nice terrace. Overall this was a great experience, and I would highly recommend Rogelio and the apartment.
A very recommendable host (caring & considerate, 'tranqui' & uncomplicated), and so is the accomodation. I enjoyed the stay very much. It felt like (a temporary) home. Always would go for it again.

Once again, a very (very) recommendable place to stay thanks to very (very) pleasant & obliging host. Besides, the accomodation is just as suitable & agreeable for living in Buenos Aires as it's been during my first stay at Rogelio's. Many thanks for everything!
Nothing I could say would add anything to my previous praises of the overall great experience with staying at Rogelio's. Just have a look at my other comments. ;)
Still nothing to complain about. It's been gorgeous. - Also, special thanks and best regards to the cleaning lady who came every week.

I stayed for 2 weeks whilst studying in Buenos Aires and have no complaints. The room is nice and private, basically had my own bathroom, the neighbourhood isn't completely "central" but is in easy walking distance of everything you need (pharmacies, supermarkets, subway etc) and was safe to walk around. Rogelio is a friendly guy who was really helpful during my stay, and I would recommend to other travellers, particularly those that are coming to study for example.

La habitación es tal cual como se publica. Muy parecido a estar en un hotel, vas a estar solo la mayoría del tiempo ya que Rogelio tiene su propia agenda. Sin embargo siempre te responderá a cualquier pregunta o duda que tengas bien sea en persona o por Whatsapp.

Rogelio é um anfitrião gentil e atencioso. O apartamento, e o quarto, são bem espaçosos, e tais como as fotos. O banheiro é privativo, praticamente como se fôsse uma suíte. O apartamento é muito bem localizado, com uma estação de metrô a cerca de 150 mts, e com muitos comércios e restaurantes próximos. Recomendo, com certeza.
Como foi um 2o período de estadia, não tenho a acrescentar ou alterar, em relação à avaliação anterior; e continuo recomendando, com certeza.

El apartamento es tal cual se muestra en las fotografías. Rogelio es una persona muy atenta, colaboradora y respetuosa. Me sentí muy a gusto, es casi como estar en casa. El apartamento siempre se mantiene ordenado y limpio. Algo muy positivo es el acceso a la cocina COMPLETAMENTE equipada. Existe mucha privacidad ya que la habitación cuanta con baño privado. Algo que me sorprendió y debo rescatar es el respeto por el ambiente que tiene Rogelio (la mayoría de los residuos se separan e incluso él mismo los lleva a los lugares de reciclaje). Finalmente, considero que la ubicación del apartamento es estratégica, a dos cuadras se encuentra la estación Córdoba del Subte linea H, lo que permite realizar transborde con todas las demás lineas del Subte para movilizarse a cualquier parte de BuenosAires.

Rogelio es un excelente anfitrión, respetuoso, colaborador ante cualquier consulta. El lugar es muy agradable, la ubicación es estratégica, la línea H del Subte está muy cerca y esta conecta con todas las demás líneas. Es un lugar que le recomendaría a cualquier persona.

Mi estancia en el departamento con Rogelio ha sido simplemente  genial. Ha sido una persona atenta en todo momento y la limpieza es inigualable. Tenía una habitación de un tamaño muy correcto y mi propio baño! Es una casa grande por lo que da total independencia cuando la necesitas. Además de tener una terraza en el departamento y otra común arriba para las personas que les guste estar al aire libre como a mi. Cuenta con absolutamente todos los servicios. La casa tiene de todo! El barrio es muy tranquilo y sobre todo está cerca de todos los barrios, súper accesible a las zonas turísticas , a las zonas de bares y pubs ( microcentro, recoleta , Palermo...). Me alegro mucho de haber tomado la elección de alojarme con Rogelio y volveré a repetir si vuelvo a Buenos Aires. Os lo recomiendo

Me gusto quedarme en el departamento de Rogelio. Muy limpio, bien decorado y muy agradable. Es un lugar con mucho espacio y con mucha luz, plantas y esto cambia todo! Tuve la casa casi para mi mismo y mucha privacidad. También la ubicación es perfecta, hay muchos negocios y un parque muy lindo cerca. Rogelio es respetuoso y comunicador, estaba dispuesto cuando yo necesitaba ayuda. Recomiendo quedarse en su casa!

Rogelio es un excelente arrendador, siempre atento, muy respetuoso de la privacidad, siempre con respuestas y soluciones a las inquietudes de manera inmediata. Una persona con quien se comparte como si fuera un amigo de siempre. El apartamento tiene una cosina completamente equipada y baño privado, esto permite gran independencia. Lo más importante es que, la hospitalidad de Rogelio siempre me hizo sentir como en casa.

Rogelio's apartment is super stylish and based in a very safe, trendy area that is well connected by public transport. He is fluent in English which made it easy to communicate and discuss many interesting topics. I have no hesitation in recommending Rogelio's apartment for your stay in Buenos Aires.
Muy recomendable muy tranquilo el lugar muy bien ubicado muy recomendable muy limpio muy buen internet wifi muy grande el departamento muy amplio lo recomiendo
Todo genial! Mi papá disfruto mucho su estadía y Rogelio fue muy amable en todo momento. Sin duda volveríamos.

Sempre solicito e pronto nas respostas. Apartamento muito gostoso e facil acesso a tudo. Mercado e restaurantes próximos.
Recomendo!
Could not have been better! Felt like home! If I come back to BA - for sure I would love to stay here again! Thank you for everything Rogelio!

Rogelio was easy to communicate with from booking through check out.   He was a nice host and willing to help.  The apartment is cozy, comfortable and spacious.  It is located in a safe neighbourhood.  Restaurants, supermarkets, fruits and vegetables shops are nearby. The location is excellent and perfect for exploring Buenos Aires.  I was able to get around very easily by bus and subway. The bedroom and private bathroom were clean and tidy.  The actual size of the bedroom is bigger than the photo showed.  I like the terrace very much.
Todo salió perfecto! Muchas gracias.

Nice, cozy flat in a safe neighborhood, Almagro, which is mainly residential—not many charming or historical touches such as cafes, restaurants, old buildings or sites of interests, but many little shops for convenience: verdurerias, carnicerias, several organic/health/bio shops, a good, reputable fish market very nearby, a 24-hour pharmacy. One little bio shop is just steps away, on Córdoba. Owner Gaston speaks good English and is also full of helpful tips on the area, BA and Argentina. There is a really nice farmers market on Saturdays in the park right there, where some vendors accept credit cards and debit cards. Maybe ten blocks away there is a cluster of maybe five nice little restaurants. Robesa is one of them. Also, it’s a tango club area; Catedral and others are nearby.

The layout of the flat is really nice, with the bedrooms on opposite sides. I felt like I had my own little sitting area at a table in the enclosed terrace area just outside my bedroom. One nice little feature in the bedroom is a couple of USB device-charger outlets in the wall.

Thank you, Rogelio, for a very pleasant stay, and for some of the extra tips and help you provided.
Great apartment, just as it shows in the pictures. We were welcomed by Alejandro's parents. They are wonderful, warm and helpful people.

Un departamento comodo y agradable  con excelent ubicacion. A tres cuadras del subte y la Avenida Cabildo resulto facilisimo recorrer la maravillosa ciudad de Buenos ASires. Alehandro se comunicaba siempre rapidamente con nosotros, y sus padres nos acogieron con la maxima amabilidad. Altamente recomendado.

El departamento es igual a las fotos y al detalle, MUY BUENO, muy buena ubicación y EXCELENTE el trato con los padres de Alejandro, siempre bien predispuestos. Alejandro siempre responde en el día las consultas, algo que se aprecia mucho. LO RECOMIENDO Y VOLVERIA A IR!!!!!!

I had a wonderful time at Alejandro's place in Buenos Aires.  Everything was as described in the listing. The place totally met my expectations.  Alejandro and his sister Mariana were perfect hosts. I recommend this place, and will definitely go there again next time I am in Buenos Aires.

A apartamento é muito bom, fui bem recebido no primeiro dia, recebi as chaves como combinado.
O bairro é tranquilo, e possui comercio local. Transporte fácil para o centro da cidade.

Mi estadía en el loft de Alejandro fue excelente. Súper cómodo y funcional, el departamento es igual de lindo como se ve en las fotos. El trato de sus padres que nos recibieron y su hermana que nos despidió fue muy bueno. La ubicación es excelente también, barrio tranquilo pero cerca de todo!

The description of the apartment and that of the host fully match the airb&b's website information - the loft was well-kept, nice and ideal for two persons. The host is very warm and professional. All the necessary information like public transport, nearest bakery, supermarket etc. arelisted on a list in the apartment and even asking his loving parents who unfortunately had to come and pick up the keys at very early in the morning cos of us flying out early. A big "gracias") Everything went smoothly - the host's sister was already waiting for us to brief us about the apartment & handing over of keys. The apartment is well located in a quiet and safe area of Belgrano. Highly recommendable
Thanks once again, Alejandro.

We were attended by Alejandro's father, and he received us late night without any problems because our flight was delayed, pretty nice sir, we felt at home. The place is exactly as the pictures and has all the facilities you would need. The location is great, near the subway station and lots of restaurants and grocery stores. 100% recommended.

Todo impecable. El departamento es tal como se describe y la atencion del anfitrión fue excelente. Nos recibieron tal cual lo acordado, nos suministraron todo lo que necesitamos y toda la estadía fue muy amena gracias a la comodidad del lugar y la hospitalidad de los recibida. Volveriamos a ir con mucho gusto.

Alejandro y su familia nos recibieron de forma excelente, siempre estuvieron a disposición. La descripción del apartamento encaja perfecto con la realidad. Pasamos muy bien en Buenos Aires. Muchas gracias

We had a great time at Alejandro's flat. His parents received us, handed out the keys and show us around the place. They were very helpful and lovely. We first stayed for 4 nights and we decided to come back for another 7 days after our trip to Cordoba. The flat is very well located and with all the necessary amenities. Not far from the bars and clubs of Palermo but in a very quiet and lovely neighborhood. Highly recommended!

Hermoso departamento, exactamente como fue descrito en el anuncio, la zona muy linda y tranquila. Alejandro, fue muy cordial y rápido en sus respuestas, nos pusimos de acuerdo rápidamente. Eva y Ronnie, quienes me recibieron, fueron muy amables y lindos conmigo. Como cada viaje, quiero llegar y sentirme como en casa, así fue! Estoy muy agradecida y recomiendo totalmente este depto por el lugar y por las personas.

This was an amazing experience all around, the loft was absolutely gorgeous, better than in the pictures. Alejandro was an amazing host, the neighborhood top notch, quiet and sophisticated in one of the best areas BA has to offer. I will strongly recommend it and I will definitely go back.
All the best to Alejandro and his parents whom I've met on my last day to return the keys, they were really friendly and loving.

This is the second timeI'm at the loft.
Amazing experience all around, will recommend it, will be back.

Thanks!


Fabian
El barrio es muy lindo. Alejandro nos recibió excelente!! Todo estaba según lo acordado. El apartamento es muy bonito. Pasamos brillante.

Alejandro prepared me for my stay in Buenos Aires in the most welcoming way. Even before my arrival I had all the information I needed on busses, the subway, places to eat, ATMs etc. He had asked for my flight information way in advance and I was greeted warmly by his wonderful parents who gave me a tour of the home and made me feel welcome from the first minute.  The place is well kept, nicely designed and furnished and it is functional. It is perfect for a single person or a couple. Its location is quiet enough if you want to do some work during the day and close enough to all the vibe you want and need from Buenos Aires. The place is bright and you will have sun from late midday on on the balcony which is perfect especially in the hot months, as the place does not heat up as much. Of course there is air-condition etc. Highly recommended for those who love living the nice and more quiet Northern parts of Buenos Aires.

El lugar es perfecto, tal cual se ve en las fotos, muy prolijo y limpio. El barrio es muy tranquilo y esta lleno de tiendas en todos lados, desde supermercados grandes hasta almacenes pequeñas, sin duda volvería a alojarme en este apartamento. Los padres de Alejandro son muy simpáticos y se interesaron mucho por nuestra estadia y hacernos sentir como en casa, nos aconsejaron sobre las tiendas que hay en la zona y fueron muy flexibles con los horarios de Check in y Check out, ya que pudimos disfrutar al máximo nuestro último día de estadia ya que nuestro horario de retorno era bastante tarde. Lo recomiendo muchísimo.

We had a great stay for 6 nights here. It's a very nice loft and even nicer when you compare it with the typical apartment in the neighborhood. It's spacious and has everything you need including two bathrooms. The kitchen has everything and the patio/balcony is very nice. The neighborhood is safe and very close to mass transit (bus and subterranean).

Treze dias perfeitos em Buenos Aires!!!!! Apartamneto lindo, super bem localizado, limpo, igualzinho das fotos. A cama é deliciosa, rsrsrsrs. Super recomendado!!! Eu mesma, sempre que for a Baires pretendo ficar na suite gardel.

I had the best time in Buenos Aires, and it's all due to this place. The apartment is clean, bright, cozy and fully equiped. The bathroom works perfectly, there's air conditioning and heating, wardrobe for two and a safe for documents and money. It's located right in the middle of Palermo Soho, halfway between Plaza Serrano and the subway station of Plaza Italia. There are many restaurants, bars and shop really close by (El Preferido is half a block away), but the room is absolutely silent at night. Daniele is also a great host, thoughtful and very sympathetic. 100% recommendable.

Daniele is wonderful to work with and very responsive, and the apartment is every bit as beautiful as the pictures. Plus it's in a very safe and interesting neighborhood that's just a few blocks from a subway station. I'd love to stay here again someday!
Suite Gardel was prefect for our stay. Daniele was helpful, and the location of the apt couldn't be better. If your looking for a place in Palermo, this is it!

We loved the place and our host! Daniele was very helpful and responsive. Place is very stylish, clean and comfortable. It is in the perfect location surounded by shops, restaurants and night life : great neighboorhood! If we come back to Buenos Aires, we'd love to stay there again!

The apartment is very nice, with everything you could need for a short stay or a long one. Daniele is a wonderful host--friendly, helpful, everything one could hope for. I highly recommend staying here.

Excelente lugar!!
Não poderia ter escolhido uma acomodação tão bela, bem localizada e ainda por cima ser muito bem recebida!!
Super indico para quem procura um aconchego e restaurantes lindo e de bom gosto!!

Adorei!

The apartment is exactly as portraied on the pictures, absolutely no desapointments there! The neighbourhood is exactly what I expected: very trendy, with lots of restaurantes, boutiques and bars, and a quiet atmosphere at night. Danielle was very nice in showing me around the apartment. When I go back to Buenos Aires, I am staying at his place again, that's for sure!
Daniele's home was perfect for our stay in Buenos Aires! Located in the heart of trendy Palermo Soho, but on a quiet street, we were happy to call it home for a few days.  Gracias Daniele!

Overall, the experience was exactly as Daniele listed it. Pictures are 100% accurate and the space was nice. Daniele also speaks English, which was a great bonus. Everything you need is there for a short or long stay.
Head to Armenia St/Ave for several amazing bars and restaurants as well as shopping. It's a great calm get away from the other busy areas you will probably be seeing.
About the neighborhood - I read several reviews on the neighborhood of Palermo SoHo, most of which described it to be much like NYC's SoHo, which really is not the case. I would say BA's SoHo is comparable to NYC's West Village. It's really quiet for the most part. A few streets are busy and restaurants/bars are full, but otherwise the tree lined streets are empty and if anything you see mostly locals walking around.

A recepção foi ótima obrigado sr Ronnie e sra Eva por tudo, e nosso amigo Alejandro!!
Bairro oitimo apto otimo !!
PArabens pessoas como voces anima nos continuar viajando pelo mundo!! Dale volta ao mundo!!!
Roberson
El lugar es tal cual muestran la fotos, Alejandro y sus padres siempre a disposicion. Muy bueno

Hermoso el depto. Mas lindo aun que lo que nos imaginabamos. Muy amables los anfitriones, el barrio muy cómodo y cercano a medios de transporte, mi hermana se sintió como en su casa... lo recomiendo totalmente!

Estuvimos mas o menos 10 días en el departamento de Alejandro y fue una gran experiencia. El departamento es muy lindo, espacioso y luminoso. El barrio tranquilo con tiendas y restaurantes cerca y a pasos del metro. Los padres de Alejandro nos recibieron y orientaron muy bien, fue muy lindo compartir con ellos, son personas muy interesantes y cariñosos. Fue muy grato quedarnos en este departamento. Muchas Gracias

Alquile el departamento para mi hija y su novio que llegaba de ESPAÑA.
El mismo es tal cual se muestra en las fotos, super acogedor y bien puesto.
Los papas de ALEJANDRO que son quien nos recibieron son dos personas adorables que nos hicieron sentir super a gusto y nos brindaron toda la informacion del lugar y nos mostraron el funcionamiento del departamento.
Lo super recomiendo!! la zona tiene de todo cerca y es muy segura.

Alejandro fue muy cordial y dispuesto a mejorar la experiencia en todo momento.
Gracias!

Los padres de Alejandro fueron excelentes anfitriones. Son muy amables y cuidadosos. Cumplieron con los horarios de encuentro que acordamos, actitud que valoro mucho.
El departamento es muy lindo, cómodo y está muy bien ubicado con transportes públicos a mano.
El edificio es silencioso y muy nuevo con sus servicios funcionando en perfecto estado.
Muchas gracias Alejandro y familia!

Ich habe eine Woche in Alejandro's Loft übernachtet und mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Alejandro ist ein super Gastgeber, hat von Anfang an alle meine Fragen sehr schnell beantwortet und mir auch nützliche Tipps gegeben. Da ich tagsüber 8 h an einer Veranstaltung teilnahm, brauchte ich abends auch mal Zeit zu Hause und Ruhe, und das war in dem gemütlichen aber auch stylischen Loft perfekt möglich. Danke auch Alejandros Eltern für die herzliche Aufnahme und Schlüsselübergabe!

Alejandro was a great host! He was very accommodating to my needs. The handover was very smooth and the apartment is beautifully decorated and well located. I am a Buenos Aires native and I would recommend the apartment without any doubt to any tourist visiting the city. The area is nice, quiet and well connected through public transportation. Thanks!

El apartamento está divino. Tal cual se muestra en las fotos e incluso mejor. El barrio es súper tranquilo y seguro y muy accesible de llegar. Disfrutamos mucho de nuestra estadía y conocimos a los padres de Alejandro que son dos personas muy calidad y agradables que nos recibieron divinamente. Totalmente recomendable todo.

This was my first experience wth Airbnb and I am now completely hooked on it! Daniele's apartment was perfect for my stay in Buenos Aires. Its location in Palermo Soho is amazing, right in the thick of the nicest part of the city, lots of cares, restaurants, and shopping. Plus also near a couple Subte stops so it was really easy to get around,

The apartment itself is clean, modern, and the perfect size, I felt really comfortable there and would go back again in a heartbeat.

I really can't recommend this enough for 1-2 people looking for a comfortable, central base for exploring Buenos Aires (which I fell in love with!). Enjoy!

Passamos dias maravilhosos no apartamento de Daniele, um anfitrião cinco estrelas interessado no conforto e bem estar de seus hóspedes. A localização é previlegiada para compras e gastronomia. Realmente recomendamos!!!

I stayed here for 5 nights while visiting Buenos Aires. It was extremely comfortable, clean, well-appointed, in a safe building and a great location. The neighborhood offers everything you could want, and you can easily get to anywhere else. Daniele was flexible with meeting me, and easy to get in touch with. His responses prior to checking in were within a few hours, and once I was in the apartment, he sent me an email to ensure everything was fine and to see if I needed anything.

If I were to return, I'd skip the hotels and try to stay here.

Fantastic apartment in really hip part of Palermo. Great access to all the cool bars/restos. The apartment is clean, well-equipped, great natural light. Daneile was super helpful. An excellent place for two to crash for a few nights.

O apartamente é excelente. Tudo estava bem conservado e limpo, exatamente como nas fotos.

Além disso, a localização é fantástica, especialmente para quem quer curtir bares e restaurantes. Também tem um ótimo supermercado perto e vários tipos de comécio, incluindo lojas de vinhos, livrarias, cafés, etc. Dá pra fazer quase tudo a pé.

Quando chegamos, o Daniele já estava lá nos aguardando, no horário combinado, e nos recebeu com muita simpatia.
Foi tudo muito tranquilo com o checkin e checkout!

Enfim, recomendo a todos!

Abraços,

Thiago

My husband and I stayed in Daniele's apartment for 5 nights in September and absolutely loved it. Daniele was very friendly and responsive. When he checked us in he took us through the intricacies of the apartment which even has a safe. He also helped me in answering general questions I had and checked in on us via email during our stay. The apartment is elegantly and comfortably furnished and decorated and felt like a home-away-from-home. As the other reviewers have mentioned it is modern, clean, well equipped, filled with natural light (bedroom has shutters so if you wish to sleep in the light won't wake you up). It is well positioned near restaurants and a large supermarket. I would highly recommend staying here.

I could not be more pleased with this apartment, the location and with Daniele!  I travel to Buenos Aires frequently and have rented several apartments there - Daniele offers an attention to detail, comfort and aesthetics that is VERY rare in BsAs!  We actually rented both of his apartments for 2 weeks - and they are fabulous!  Trust me when I say that you cannon find a better stay in this city!  Not to mention a better host.  I left my passport in the safe only to realize it after arriving at the airport.  Daniele rushed there and sent it with a driver to meet me so that I did not miss my flight.  WOW!  Thank you for everything!  We will be back!  I have the feeling we will need to book in advance, because once the word gets out, these two apartments will be full!

Fue un placer estar en del departamento de Daniele.
La verdad es que la ubicación y el departamento es perfecto para pasar una increíble estadía en Buenos Aire.
Quienes vayan para allá con su pareja, recomiendo 100% hospedarse ahí, no se arrepentirán.
The apartment was well located and comfortable, and Daniele was friendly and a helpful host.  Highly recommended for a stay in Palermo.

Daniele's flat is absolutely fantastic. It is exactly how it looks in the photographs, and is an extremely functional flat (I love the feeling that it seems that every little thing in the flat has a purpose and a place to be). It can be added the fact that it is absolutely stunning, with a lovely warm feeling.

Its location is also very good, being located from walking distance to most of places of interest in Palermo Soho. Awesome restaurants in the immediate vicinity (El Preferido de Palermo and Don Julio, for instance), close to Plaza Serrano, and a few blocks from Plaza Italia subway station. There are supermarkets, gym, trendy clothes shops, awesome cafes, restaurants and bars around.

As a host, Daniele was great too. He was always very responsive to my queries, gave me a few great suggestions on what to do, and made sure I felt comfortable in the flat. He is friendly without imposing himself, which I find great.

In a nutshell, I find the flat was perfect for me and certainly made my trip to Buenos Aires much more enjoyable.

Great apartment in an awesome location! Daniele is a very nice host. He met us at the apartment, walked us through everything and gave us great recommendations for the neighborhood. Would definitely come back!
A nossa estadia foi excelente, muito confortável e aconchegante. A localização é ótima, perto de bons restaurantes, supermercados e metrô. Recomendamos!! Claudia e Kobi

Daniele has a very nice, clean an really good located flat. He is also very helpful if you have any special questions about location or places you want to go. Palermo Soho is full of bars, restaurants and boutiques, the perfect neighbourhood to live in. Don Julios Steak is the best steak we've ever eaten...:). Conclusion: perfect flat, real nice host in interesting and nice neighbourhood, highly recommended

LOVE LOVE LOVED Argentina! Danielle's apartment was amazing, super spacious, brightly lit with natural sunlight and fun pops of colour. We fell in love with Palermo, so much great shopping everywhere, great restaurants, especially across the street at Don Julio's where we had the best beef we have ever tasted! And super nice people all over this neighborhood, it was clean, safe and fun! I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to friends.
Very kind and warm host. Makes sure you feel very welcome in Buenos Aires.
Es un departamento muy simpático y aptó para los que se llevan bien con ambientes fríos
Todo 100 puntos!

Alejandro took a great deal of time to answer all my questions about his apartment in Buenos Aires. The accommodations were very comfortable and well located. We were met at the flat by the charming and welcoming Ronnie and Eva (Alejandro's parents who liv nearby). They walked us around the apartment, pointed out places of interest in the area and made sure we were comfortably settled. Top marks for this team and their property.
