Al igual que el resto de las evaluaciones, coincido en que es tal cual lo muestran las fotos. Es sumamente cómodo contar con un toillet en el nivel principal y un baño en el dormitorio. Los padres de Alejandro siempre dispuestos,  coordinamos la horas para ingresar y dejar el apartamento.  Alejandro ha contestado cada una de las consultas muy rápidamente y siempre con buena disposición. Volvería a ir.

O loft do alejando é exatamente como descrito e mostrado nas fotos. Estive trabalhando e passeando por 4 dias em Buenos Aires. A localização é muito boa, ficando perto do metrô e cercado de comércio como: mercados, lanchonetes e lojas.
Aproveito para agradecer muito aos pais do Alejandro (Eva e Ronnie). São pessoas maravilhosas, me senti sendo recebido por minha família.
Recomendo 100000% o loft do Alejandro.

MUY COMODO DEPARTAMENTO, TAL CUAL SE VE EN LAS FOTOS Y MAS TAMBIEN. PUNTUALES EN DAR Y RETIRAR LAS LLAVES MUY ATENTA LA MAMA DE ALEJANDRO QUE FUE QUIEN SE ENCARGO DE HACERLO. EL BARRIO MUY TRANQUILO. CERCA DE PARADAS DE COLECTIVO Y SUPTE. VOLVERIA A ESTE ALOJAMIENTO CON GUSTO.

Nos sentimos realmente excelente en el depto de Alejandro, 100% igual a lo que mostraban las fotos y aún mejor! Todo de primera calidad! El barrio muy tranquilo y lindo, con lugares cerca para comprar y salir a comer y desayunar. Sin dudas que volveremos!
Todo tal la descripción

Alejandro and his parents were amazing! The communication with all of them was always fluid and effective. We even made a mistake with the booking dates, but they were excellent in accommodating to our needs. The apartment is in a pristine condition and exceeded our expectations; modern, clean and tastefully decorated. Belgrano is, as always, the best place to stay in Bs.As.; clean, close to everything, and distinguishing fine and stylish.

Alejandro y sus padres son excepcionales! La comunicación con todos ellos fue siempre fluida y efectiva. Hasta nos equivocamos en las fechas de la reserva y enseguida se acomodaron a nuestras necesidades. El departamento es impecable y excedió nuestras expectativas: moderno, limpio y decorado con un gusto exquisito. Belgrano, como de costumbre, es el mejor barrio de Bs.As., limpio, cerca de todo, fino y de un estilo distinguido.

Alejandro was an excellent communicator who confirmed his parents would be waiting at the Loft to let me in. Alejandro's parents Ronnie & Eva were fantastic, lovely people who showed genuine concern & care about making my stay a comfortable one.
The loft was comfortable and had everything one could possibly want.
It's also in walking distance to shops, buses and subway.
I LOVED staying here and would definitely return.

I really enjoyed staying at Alejandro's second story Loft Condo. Belgrano is a wonderful neighborhood and everything was available. I especially Love the local feel. Easy access to the Subte D Train. Enjoyed the Balcony, the Parrots and the security of the building.

From the moment I booked Alejandro ' s place he made sure to be in touch and respond to any questions or needs.

The apartment is exactly as shown and described in the ad. It has plenty of light and nice balcony to work or relax. It is located in great quiet and safe neighborhood.

Thank you Alejandro!
Saludos desde Chile

Alejandro fue un excelente host, y el departamento es tanto o más bueno como la descripción indica. Lo alquilé para un conocido que viajaba a BsAs por unos días y se sintió como en casa. Los papás de Alejandro, quienes hacen el check in y el check out, muy simpáticos y siempre al servicio frente a cualquier necesidad. Muy recomendado!

Excelente todo desde cualquier punto que se lo mire.

Realmente será mi primera opcion al elegir algo por Buenos aires para quedarme unos dias.

saludos y gracias!

La descripcion del apto. era exacta, muy comodo y arreglado con muy buen gusto.
Para nosotros tiene muy buena ubicacion.
Comodo para cocinar y bien equipado aunque haria falta una sarten mas grande.
A unos metros hay un pequeno supermercado, una lavadora y otros servicios.
Eva y Ronnie, quienes nos recibieron, muy amables.
Con gusto lo recomendare
Great location and beautiful loft!

If you are traveling to Buenos Aires...LOOK NO FURTHER!!  You will not find a better apartment or a more considerate host than Juan.  Far and away the best host we encountered on our 6 week trip.  Apartment is PERFECT...clean, modern, full of amenities, and centrally located in Palermo.  Juan is incredibly helpful and accessible 24/7, going above and beyond to make us feel welcome.  We even spent an evening with Juan and his girlfriend Gaby, enjoying a traditional Argentine dinner and exploring the city center.  We highly recommend staying here!!

Juan is the kind of host you would like to see: punctual, respectful of privacy and very helpfull. He even provided some drinks and snacks,  shampoo and phone cards in case you would need to call him on his cell using the house phone. The apartment is ideally located in Palermo, one of the most popular neighborhoods of the city. Great restaurants, bars and disco's just around the corner as well as bus and subte (metro) stops at a few minutes from where the apt. is located. Definitely recommend the place!

Great apartment - clean, comfortable and modern - excellent location in the heart of Old Palermo.

All the communal facilities were great (including a great roof terrace, nice swimming pool to cool down in during the hot summer days and a mini-gym for a work out).

Juan added some nice touches to the apartment e.g. plenty of towels and toiletries, and was willing to help with any questions or queries at any time. A perfect host!

We enjoyed our stay very much at the nice and well equipped apartment.
The hospitality of Juan and Gabriella is generous.

Used of the Swimming pool was a welcome refreshment after the warm days.

Juan's place in Polerma is perfect. My girlfriend and I spent five great nights here and wish we could have stayed longer!juan is a great guy, very helpful and speaks great English! We'd come back again in a heartbeat. Enjoy and take advantage of the great selection of shops and restaurants all in walking distance. Close to Subte and very private.
Thanks Juan!

The apartment was clean, cozy and in a great location.  It was really close to shopping, bars and restaurants a couple of streets one way and the super chic part of town with fancy restaurants a couple of blocks the other.  It was also in a safe part of town so you can walk home after a nice night out and not have to worry about a cab ride.  It had absolutely everything we needed, and Juan was nice enough to even leave a couple of calling cards in case we needed to reach him and/or for emergencies.  He was very accommodating, allowing us to check-in and check-out extremely early, so thank you Juan!!!  We were absolutely pleased with the place and highly recommend it.   Next time we know exactly where we are staying in beautiful Buenos Aires!

I stayed at this studio apartment during a two week visit in Buenos Aires and I loved the location, the space and the support offered by Juan. He was available if I needed anything-the wifi worked without a hitch the entire time; there is a pool at the apartment but the weather did not cooperate for me to use it. The apartment is located in the middle of Palermo, near public transportation and near restaurants and cafes.
I was lucky in that my daughter was living in BA for six months so had mastered the public transportation, particularly the buses, which are cheap and serve the whole city.
I give this place a two thumbs up and recommend it for a single person or a couple who want a nice place in a great location for a very reasonable price.
Although I had heard some bad reports about crime in BA, I never felt unsafe and particularly not in the area where the apartment is located.
I had no problems with any security issues.

We stayed in this apartment for 10 days while visiting our daughter who is living nearby.  It was exactly what we needed, a clean, quiet, comfortable place (comfy bed. good shower. kitchenette.) in a great area full of restaurants, shops, coffee shops, clubs, only a few blocks from the beautiful botanical garden, etc.  Juan is a most gracious host.

I came back once more as it is the perfect place to stay in Buenos Aires!
Thank you Alejandro!
El departamento es excelente, muy cómodo y lindo. Los anfitriones son excelentes, muy atentos y agradables.
El departamente es muy lindo y comodo, el barrio es super tranquilo y esta mut bien ubicado.

the department is very nice, is located in a good neighborhood, very quiet , far from the center but near the subway. the owner and his parents  are very kind and attentive . The whole experience was excellent. It is 100% recommended !

Excelente experiencia.  El apartamento esta en muy buena condición y muy bien ubicado.  Los padres de Alejandro son un sol y muy amablemente se adaptaron a nuestro horario un poco incomodo de salida durante la madrugada.   Altamente recomendable.

I just loved the place, very clean, the build is brandnew and the neighborhood is lovely ( realy well located, near to Cabildo avenue, a important avenue on Buenos Aires). I was received by Alejandro parents, they are lovely people,and they took their time to explain me about the neighbor stuff.

Next time, i hope be there again.
El departamento está impecable en todo sentido. Los padres de Alejandro son espectaculares, muy atentos y serviciales, son esas personas con las que uno se quedaría horas hablando.
Great location, clean and spacious appartment. The only downside was the noise of the neighbors. That had a lot of parties with loud music..

De primera. Todo como dice en la publicacion o mejor. Los anfitriones son un lujo, gentiles y serviciales. No suelo calificar pero esta vez decidi hacerlo porque valia la pena.
El barrio es super silencioso. No hay ninguna critica. Todo de 10!
Spacious and well-kept apartment. Quiet neighborhood that's pretty residential but close to the metro and other busier areas. Lovely set up!
Tuve una muy linda estadía. El departamento es muy luminoso, tiene una muy buena ubicación y un punto muy positivo es que tiene dos baños.

el depto esta muy bueno. la cocina muy completa, tiene de todo. el videt del baño no funciona bien. la zona muy linda, pero ruidosa. no la recomiendo para el que va a descansar. el subte a pocas cuadras te ahorra cientos de pesos en viáticos y tiempo. también brinda comodidad ya que al ser la terminal, siempre vas sentado. es decir, te da excepcional acceso a las mejores zonas de buenos aires.

Host was friendly and welcoming.
The location of the apartment is very handy, close to public transport and good shopping. During my stay a construction nearby produced a lot of noise and dust during day time (temporary issue) .
Cleanliness and maintenance of the apartment has room for improvement.

el departamento es tal y cual aparece en las fotos, todo muy limpio y cerca a muchas tiendas, la zona es tranquila y muy bonita. Definitivamente regresaría a este departamento por que tenia todo lo que esperaba y mas.
Magnífica. Idónea ubicación, limpio, equipado, todo en muy buen estado. Muy cómodo. Una semana perfecta, en parte, gracias al magnífico depto. Muy recomendable.

I stayed at Juan & Gaby's apartment in Palermo Soho for five days on late notice after swinging back through BA from Iguazu.  Our bus was delayed two hours and we had no way of getting in touch with Juan, but as soon as we got to the apartment we got some free wi-fi and saw he had sent multiple e-mails with his number, e-mail, home address and work address to make sure we could reach him when we got there - amazing!  Also, he came by in less than 5 minutes after we e-mailed him back (no cell phone) to let us in.  We were so nervous about the whole process and we needn't have worried - Juan was so gracious and it all worked out.  The apartment is wonderfully located and very reasonably priced!  The bed is super comfortable and the kitchen is adequate for making a meal or two while you're there (though you won't want to, the restaurants in the neighborhood are so cute).  When we were there, they were doing some work in the building so it was a bit loud, but it was temporary. Overall, awesome stay and great building!  Book it!

juan's place is exactly what we needed.
cozy, extremely well located and fairly priced.
too bad we didn't have time to enjoy the pool and the gym.
but the balcony was a charm.


juan was as nice as humanly possible, which included adapting to the crazy hours of our trip (checkin at 1am and checkout a 3am!).

definitively recommended.
Excelente onda Juan y el lugar tal cual lo describes. Por supuesto cuento con su departamento cuando vaya nuevamente a BsAs.

Great apartment with everything you need. Clean and tidy. Supermarket near by and short walk to the nearest metro station. Also short walk to some great bars and restaurants.

Daniele met us at the apartment. Explained everything about the apartment and local area. A really nice and helpful guy. We would highly recommend staying here.
The apartment was gorgeous and the perfect size/location for our four days in BA. Daniele was a great host and met us upon arrival to show us around and answer questions.
Great experience! The apartment was well-located and clean and Daniele was very helpful. The neighborhood is fantastic too

Apartamento maravilhoso!

We stayed in Palermo Soho for 2 weeks and this apartment was perfect - great location, very clean, well-equipped, secure and relatively quiet. The fact that it was extremely tastefully decorated added to the ambiance.

Daniele was a great host and couldn't have been more helpful or accommodating.
-A fantastic experience all around.

I really enjoyed my stay at Daniele flat. It has a very good location in Palermo Soho with good distance to everything you may need : tube, buses, supermarket, pubs, clubs, milongas etc.

The flat is very well furnished, the building is very quiet.

Regarding Daniele, everything went very well. He is very fast to answer to any question you may have. He is a very pleasant person and is quite professionnal with everything regarding the flat :)

In short, everything was very good !

We absolutely loved staying here and Daniele's hospitality made it even better.  The apartment is beautifully decorated and is in a great location (be sure to dine at Don Julio across the street, and hang out in Plaza Serrano which is only a 10 min walk away)!  Daniele went above and beyond by waiting for us at the apartment after our initial flight was canceled and forced us to arrive a few hours later on a later flight.  He was such a nice host and despite the late arrival time, he took the time to show us around the apartment and explained everything in detail.  He was also available to answer questions during our stay.  We would highly recommend this apartment for your next trip in BA!

It’s been my very first time in Argentina and Buenos Aires. The choice of Passion Suite gave a relevant contribute to what became an amazing holiday and one of my best trips so far. The apartment is very comfortable, clean, spacious and in a safe building. It is strategically located in the middle of one of the coolest district of BsAs. Within walking distance there are very good restaurants and the funky Plaza Serrano. Just crossing the road there is one the best restaurant in Palermo, Don Julio. I definitely recommend the Passion Suite! Special thanks go to Daniele Perillo who proved to be a professional and very friendly host. He welcomed us with a bottle of good Malbec and made sure we had all the information we needed about the city. During our stay He was always available to quickly provide advices and suggestions on places to visit. I will rely on Daniele next time I will need an accommodation in Buenos Aires. Hasta Siempre!

O apartamento é realmente muito agradável. Aconchegante e que fez nos sentirmos confortáveis durante toda nossa estadia.
Realmente foi a melhor escolha que pudemos fazer. Daniele é um ótimo anfitrião, atendeu todas nossas dúvidas e estava no apartamento no horário combinado.
E a localização é perfeita. Recomendo com certeza!

Un excelente host. El departamento impecable, limpio, ordenado, nuevo, equipado... Pero ante todo con muy buen gusto de diseño y un toque definitivamente personal de Daniele! Daniele, muy atento y dispuesto a ayudar. Altamente recomendable.

My husband and I had a wonderful 3-night stay at Daniele's very comfortable apartment. Daniele was accommodating, prompt, easy to get in touch with and super helpful. He introduced us to the apartment and neighborhood and then continued to answer our questions throughout our stay. The apartment looks identical to the pictures and was as we expected it to be. The area around the apartment is wonderful - a short walk from parks, zoo, restaurants, bars and shops as well as close to BA's very easy to use, safe and inexpensive subway system. We highly recommend Daniele and this apartment!

The experience was just amazing. The apartment is fantastic, very clean and tidy. The location is perfect: very close to bars, restaurants and all kinds of stores and supermarkets. Totally recomended!

Daniele was a perfect host: he was responsive and was great with giving suggestions on places to go in the neighborhood and with any other questions that we had.  The apartment was in a great location and all of the amenities were wonderful.  I booked the reservation for my parents, and they were very happy with everything.  Highly recommended!

The apartment is like pictures, situated in Palermo, a safe and nice area, where you can find all you need : restaurant, shopping, supermarket, laundry. Walking 10 mn, you have a subway station. We meet Gabriela to have the key to get in the apartment and Daniele to get the key back, as our flight was cancelled due to airline strike. Daniele is helpful and friendly.

Endosso tudo o que já foi dito antes. Apartamento impecável, perto do melhor de Palermo e em uma rua calma e arborizada. O anfitrião é extremamente solícito e atencioso. A partir de agora, só me hospedo aqui!

Spotless apartment, walking distance to the best of Palermo yet in a quiet street. The host is a gentleman. I will never stay elsewhere. Simply the best!

realmente me han hecho sentir muy comoda, la descripcion del lugar es tal cual aparece en la pagina, el barrio es muy tranquilo, tiene todo los servicvios cerca, y el departamento es super recomendable por lo comodo, y mas que nada por la calidez humana.

Muy cómodo el departamento. Alejandro se contactó con nosotros al instante. Nos recibieron los padres de él, que por cierto, fueron muy serviciales. Super recomendable el lugar como sus anfitriones. Gracias!
Excelente todo. El estado del depto, la comunicacion. Muy recomendable.
Super bueno el apartamento, esta muy bien ubicado, es perfecto para ir de vacaciones a Buenos Aires. Super recomendado.

The Passion Suite was perfect for us. Daniele & Gabriela's bright and cozy apartment was the perfect landing pad for our first trip to Buenos Aires. You're a ten minute walk from the Subte (subway), beautiful parks, great shopping, incredible food and everything else you'll need in this busy, wonderful city. Between Don Julio's on one corner and Caracas on the other, you're never more than a block away from a great meal or a well-made cocktail.

Daniele was a perfect host -- answering questions, checking on us by email, providing maid service, even helping us find transportation to the airport on our last day. We started each day with breakfast at home in the Passion Suite, then set out to discover the city, knowing everything was safe and sound back at "home" which was just a ride away on the D line.

Needless to say, if we didn't have to go back to work, we would have loved to stay for another week. Gracias Daniele & Gabriela, you helped make this one of our best vacations ever.

Our stay at Daniele and Gabriela's apartment in Palermo, BA was fantastic. Daniele had his friend Marcelo pick us up from the airport and everything went smoothly. The apartment is very safe with double locks on the door and a secure entrance to the complex. It's in a good location within easy walking distance to everything in palermo and not far to the plaza Italia metro station. The air con and wifi work well and it's quiet inside, far enough away from the palermo nightlife scene that it won't keep you awake if you need a good night's sleep. I highly reccomend Don Julio's parilla across the road and the 1810 cocina regional a few blocks away.

We have stayed in over 40 air bnb apartments and homes throughout Europe and the Americas and this was by far out worst experience. We stayed for two weeks at Daniele's apartment and were shocked at the lack of customer service. He wrote to us very politely but was unaccomodating in every request we had. Whilst we were staying we had a power outage for over 24 hours on our last day, in 40 degree weather. We obviously had no aircon or fan, and thus needed to have the windows open that meant we were demolished by Mosquitos. The biggest issue was that there was no running water. Unable to flush the toilet and unable to cool off with a shower. No drinking water. There was nothing supplied to help with this, no torch no bug spray no emergency water. When we left the next day we had no email to ask if we were ok, and when we asked if we could have any discount on this night he referred us to his policy that there may be 'temporary' outages and the we should 'smile and be happy'!!! To not have power and water for over 24 hours is certainly not temporary. He said he would have offered a 'small' discount however I no choice but to use an old tired face towel in the dark to scrub my face without water which left some makeup on the towel. We even went early in the morning to buy bleach and explained to the cleaning lady and she ensured us this was no problem and occurred all the time. His response to this was that we could consider us 'even'. If you could imagine the disastrous night we endured on our honeymoon you understand it wasn't even close to this. After explaining in detail to Daniele how upset we were we got a 2 line reply. 'Im sorry you feel aggrieved with your stay and best wishes'. Hardly an understanding host. I hope others don't have any disagreements here because you can be assured you won't achieve anything. Even before this we were not pleased with the service. Our flight arrived early in the morning and we requested somewhere to place our bags. Now we understand there are check in times and this is what we were referred to, however every other host we have ever dealt with has attempted to be accommodating where possible. We were given a simple no it not possible. When we arrived at the apartment we were informed that the host had been waiting there half an hour early! However nothing was written to us as we waited outside a cafe two doors down. When we asked about local places to eat and drink we were referred to look at 'trip advisor'!! Every host we have ever stayed with has always provided local information. Why else do we stay with air bnb than to have local information?? When we questioned this a little further we...

We found the Passion Suite ideally situated for our needs. Our host was flexible with our check in requirements. Everything that you would need is in the apartment including iron, ironing board, well equipped kitchen and reading material. Access to the building was easy and secure as was the checkout process. We would definitely recommend staying at the Passion Suite.

This location is great and near a lot of areas we wanted to see.  The host was very friendly and always got back to me in a timely manner when I had a question.  I paid $20 for early check in and she was nice enough to let us have a late check out since we had a late flight leaving.  The only issue we had was there were no supplies in the house.  It would be nice if it were stocked with toilet paper, paper towels, basic bathroom supplies (shampoo, conditioner, soap), also no dish detergent to wash the dishes with.

Adoramos ficar neste apartamento em Palermo! Perto de excelentes restaurantes, bares e dá pra ir andando até o metrô. Na verdade, a gente poderia morar aí. rsrs

O bairro é uma gracinha, principalmente para quem gosta da vida boêmia. Tem ar condicionado para o calor e aquecedor para o frio, o que nos foi muito útil quando estivemos lá.

Limpo, bonito e confortável. Recomendo.

The apartment is beautiful, clean, well organized and very comfortable, and Gabriela was a very kind host. Flexible the last day, when she allow as to loose late the apartment!
The zone is well connected and without noise.
Perfect

La ubicación del lugar fue muy cómoda, todas mis opciones estaban cerca.
Fácil acceso a transportes públicos.
Recomendado

El deparatmento esta super comodo, limpio y la ubicacion es perfecta.
Tal como se ve en las fotos!!

Gabriela was awaiting for my girlfriend and I after normal checkout hours, which was very kind. She gave us all the info we needed and more. The apartment is very clean, comfortable. We felt safe and at home. It is also very well located, in a great neighborhood, and close to restaurants, bars, shops, supermarket, subway station and bus stops. The temperature in the city was cold so the heating came in handy.

Everything was as advertised, or better.
Nos atendieron muy bien, nos resolvieron las inquietudes y los inconvenientes que se nos presentaron.

El departamento es tal como en las fotos. Bien ubicado, limpio, seguro, tranquila la zona y silenciosos los vecinos.
Gabriela se mantuvo en contacto y la coordinación fue muy buena.
Todo impecable
The place is as it's published. Full of light, clean, confortable, with everything that you need and in a perfect place of Buenos Aires.

O apartamento é super funcional e perfeito em termos de espaço e acomodações para um casal. O projeto de iluminação é super cool, com diversas luminárias e contra-luz. Internet boa, calefação ok, telefone (útil pra fazer reservas), tv a cabo idem e o aparelho de som é ótimo. Prédio com elevador. A localização é boa porque fica próximo tanto da Praça Itália (estações de bus e metrô) quanto dos atrativos do bairro, fazendo com que a caminhada não seja mto longa nem pra um lado , nem pra outro... Sem falar que tem dois supermercados a 1 quadra e meia de distância (se for altas horas só chegar num kiosco 24hs na Borges). Gabriela é prática, eficiente e prestativa. Além de nos receber com amabilidade, e no horário, foi solicita e nos ajudou em tudo que precisamos. Gracias por todo novamente!

Gabriela estava no apartamento para nos receber no horário marcado e nos deu todas as instruções sobre o local. O imóvel é exatamente como está nas fotos, com exceção da janela do banheiro, que são duas folhas verticais e não horizontais como na foto (mas isso não faz diferença alguma na prática). A localização é perfeita, em um local silencioso mas bastante próximo a restaurantes, cafés e à Praça Itália (cerca de 4 quadras), onde há grande concentração de ônibus e metrô. Recomendamos jantar ao menos uma vez no Don Julio, restaurante que fica na esquina do prédio. Eu comi o bife de lomo (mignon no Brasil) e estava fantástico!

Gabriela was awesome. She was really helpful, thoughtful and kind from the very beginning.

The apartment is way cute and it's located in a beautiful center area. It's exactly as you see it in pictures. Gabriela's apartment has everything you need for your staying, just like home. She even had an outlet adapter for american plugs, which I lost, but I'm pretty sure she will get a replacement for upcoming visits (I'm so so sorry Gabriela).

You have everything you need nearby. If you're looking for a good meat restaurant, right at front of the apartment is one named Don Julio. I tried both La Cabrera and Don Julio and I liked Don Julio way more than La Cabrera.

If I ever get to come back to BsAs I will DEFINITELY stay again in this beautiful apartment.

We stayed for a few days in Gabriela's apartment and the experience was really good. We arrived a bit late due to flight delays and she waited for us. The apartment was really clean and ready for us. The location is great, Palermo Soho is one of my favourite places in BA. Highly recommend
The Apartment is very cozy. It is clean and quiet. Gabriela is a very nice host. She gave us every information we asked for. It was a nice stay in BA. We highly recommend the apartment
I had a great time in Palermo and the flat. The area is really great. I would highly recommend to anyone looking to visit Buenos Aires

Gabriela y Daniele fueron unas excelentes anfitrionas, primero que nada estuvieron puntuales esperándonos. El departamento muy bien ubicado, bella decoración y la limpieza impecable.
Pasamos unos días magníficos en el departamento!

Perfect location, so easy to get to everything in Soho and Plaza Serrano with minimal noise and great security. I had the most incredible stay and Gaby was so helpful I cannot begin to thank her. The bedroom blinds would benefit from a blackout if you intend to sleep in later as the sun really makes it a bright and airy apartment and certainly I preferred the fan instead of aircon in this room as I suffer with a sensitivity which would not have worked for sleeping. The lounge air con is great and drifts through nicely all on its own. Neighbours were non-existent though there is a piano player who plays occasionally but she's very talented so just listen and enjoy when she does every now and again. I will definitely be returning! Gabriella was very helpful when I came to visit Buenos Aires. Place was clean and exactly as advertised. It's in a great location in Palermo with plenty of things to do within walking distance.
Internet was fast which was important to me for what I do. Would definitely stay here again if I get a change to visit again.

Like all the other reviews, the apartment is exactly as per the photos. Location was great and we walked everywhere without the need of public transport. Most importantly, this was our first AirBnB stay. Gabriela's communication via email was always polite and very prompt. Hopefully, other host's follow in this way.

The flat was great, cosy and confortable!
The best part is the location, I cannot think about a better place to be when visiting Buenos Aires.
Gabriella was quick to respond and check in was super easy. She even left us stay until late our day of check out.
I saw on previous comments that there was a problem with the lights/blinds in the bedroom, and was a little worried about it, but I can assure that there are blinds that do not allow light to enter the room.
I would definitely recommend anyone staying there!
Thanks again, see you next time.

The apartment is located in a lovely neighbourhood close to Plaza Italia, perfect to visit BA as well as enjoy the city's food culture (try La Carniceria on Thames St - amazing). Extremely helpful host, available last minute (we initially booked a bad place in BA and luckily could move out to this heaven at very short notice), responsive and caring. The apartment is exactly as described and presented in the ad. Very pleasant to live in. We stayed for 3 nights and there was nothing wrong with it (comfortable bed, modern shower, window blinds, wifi...all fully functional). Absolutely recommended.

This apartment is located in a very desirable neighborhood with numerous restaurants and shopping opportunities.  One of the best steak restaurants is diagonally across the street and there's an upscale wine store next door.  There's even an upscale outlet shopping mall about six blocks away.  The apartment listing is very accurate and representative.  Gabriela was very prompt upon our arrival and she makes checking out very easy, too.  They have done a really nice job on the apartment décor.

This was a fantastic location for exploring Buenos Aries esp Palermo. There is a great selection of great cafés, restaurants, bars & shops nearby and the apt is perfect: clean, safe & cool! Would definitely recommend it for any couple with zero problems in our 7 days stay.

We have had a wonderful month here!  Gabriela answered each of my messages very promptly from the moment we reserved the apartment and she went out of her way to accomodate our needs.  The apartment is very comfortable and the kitchen is set up to prepare simple meals which was important to us because we were here for such a long visit.  What is best about this apartment is its location.  There can be no better place to stay and explore this beautiful city.  Plaza Italia and the Subway are only a few blocks away and the neighborhood is completely safe and friendly with fantastic restaurants, beautiful parks, and fun shops.  This apartment is perfect for anyone wanting to enjoy a visit to Buenos Aires!

El depa es muy lindo, limpio y practico, ubicado en una zona perfecta cerca a varios lugares de interés. Nos recibieron con mucha amabilidad e incluso con un obsequio. Estamos muy agradecidos y contentos de haber elegido quedarnos con ustedes, tengan por seguro que en nuestra próxima visita a Buenos Aires nos veremos, un abrazo

Even though I couldn't arrive at the time we arranged, Gabriela still waited for me luckily. The photos might not give you a clear sense, but it's BIGGER than it seems, really awesome. Super clean and confortable.

Funny fact, there are a lot of light switches. But it helps to set different light environments. Nice touch.

El apartamento estuvo muy agradable, a tal punto de sentirme como en casa, acogedor, limpio y muy bien ubicado. Fácil acceso a diversas líneas de colectivos (buses), así como también al subte (metro). Lo único negativo que más que un tema del dpto, pienso que es del edificio,  es que de a ratos había un olor desagradable en el baño. Días maravillosos en mi segundo hogar, Buenos Aires. Gracias por todo. Recomendado.

Excelente atención y predisposición... Aparte de amables anfitriones nos demostraron su comprensión para ciertos inconvenientes que tuvimos al final de nuestra estadía... Recomendado 100% departamento confortable, bien decorado, completo y excelente ubicación...

Very welcoming by Gabriela and greeted with a bottle of vino. The apartment is in a fantastic location. It is 30m from Buenos Aires' Don Julio which is arguably one of the best restaurants. The nightclub/bar/brunch/markets are all walking distance.

Thank you so much!

El departamento de Gabriela es súper cómodo y muy buen ubicado. La zona es excelente para caminar, encontrar tiendas de ropa y zapatos lindas, cafés, restaurantes y bares. La verdad es que estuve muy satisfecha con todo! Si vuelvo a Buenos Aires, vuelvo donde Gabriela definitivamente!

It would be hard to find better hosts and location in Buenos Aires. Juan and Gaby were great. They were always accessible by phone or email and allowed me total privacy. The Studio is large, modern, clean and it even has a delightful small balcony that looks out over the street. The location is superb, just a few blocks from the subway and a few blocks from the trendy center of Palermo Soho which is full of great restaurants, coffee houses, art galleries and boutiques. Great stay ~ Great hosts!

Clean, bright, apartment with a nice balcony in a newer building.
Location is excellent; close to subway, grocery, laundry, restaurants and night life.

Did not use the pool or the gym since the weather was on the cold side, so can't review.

Had a great time in BA.

Juan is a very nice and trusetable guy! The apartment in one word is: Fantastic!
Well located, big, clean and comfortable. And what a fun Buenos Aires is!
A beautiful flat in the best part of Buenos Aires. The view from the balcony shows a river of green . It was great to have swimming pool to relax in from the heat, sightseeing and Tango.

Great apartment in an excellent location! Juan was the perfect host right from the initial point of contact - super fast in responding to my initial enquiry and any emails I sent through, as well as being available to meet us to check in and check out at the times we needed. There were some challenges with the buildings water supply on our first day (not his fault!)  and Juan went over and above to make sure we would be ok and compensated us for the inconvenience. I truly can't thank him enough. The apartment itself is exactly as the photos show, perfectly clean, quiet and comfortable with the pool an added bonus. The area of Palermo Soho  has so many options for great food, bars and shopping and the apartment is a very convenient few blocks from the subway line to get you to other areas of the city quickly and cheaply. There is a laundromat just around the corner and a full supermarket I think just two blocks away plus the main road towards the subway has everything else you would need. As for the food - can totally recommend Tijuana for mexican and mojhitos, about 100m from the front door! Basically, stay here! Two thumbs up all round!

My wife and I stayed at Juan's apartment for three weeks. We had a fantastic time. Juan was easy to get a hold for when we had questions about the apartment and Buenos Aires.

The pictures of the apartment are accurate. It was spacious, clean and had everything you could need (hairdryer, towels, kitchen supplies, fridge, internet, air-con and TV). The building had a pool, which was nice, and a gym that was basic, but did the trick. Also, the other building residents were very friendly.

The apartment is in a great neighborhood, Palermo Soho. The neighborhood is safe and has a ton of shops and restaurants right around the corner. There are several super markets within a few blocks and a laundromat one block over. The apartment is a few blocks from the D Metro line, which makes it easy to get to all the major sights. Also, since it's a upscale neighborhood, taxis are easy to find.

I'd definitely stay at Juan's place again and recommend it to everyone.

Juan was a great host! Friendly, punctual, and informative, he made us feel at home and had many great tips for where to go and how to do stuff. The apartment has an all new interior and everything works perfectly. We even hit up the sauna on the top floor. Palermo SoHo is also in the heart of the safest and trendiest area in Buenos Aires.

We had a fantastic stay in Juans lovely apartment. It is a big studio with a lovely balcony to sit out on.  The kitchen was fully functioning so we could cook dinner although there are so many nice restaurants in the area we didn't really need to cook. Juan was really helpful and friendly and on hand when we needed him.

My boyfriend and I stayed in this apartment for 3 nights in Jan 2013. The apartment was great and had everything we needed and Juan was an incredible host! He is accommodating and extremely helpful to navigate BA. The apartment was comfortable, spacious and had great amenities. Everything was clean, the bed was comfortable and the location could not have been better. Whenever we return to BA, we will absolutely rent from Juan. If you are looking for a great value with a friendly, helpful host, look no further!

A really good place to stay in Palermo .We feel at home.
Juan is welcoming and friendly... even if our check in and check out hours were crasy.
The neighborhood is great . Thanks for everything Juan!

Juan is a great host and I would have no hesitation in recommending this place in Palermo Soho.  The area is probably one of the nicest and safest in the city.  There are multitudes of restaurants and bars nearby and you are well positioned to use the subway or the local hop-on-hop-off tourist bus.  Enjoy Palermo Soho, you may not want to come home!

We had a wonderful stay at Juan's apartment! Palermo Soho is a great neighborhood - very safe with tons of shopping and restaurants, and the apartment had everything that we needed. From pre-booking up until our stay, Juan was always very quick in responding to all of my questions, and when we arrived he was warm and welcoming. He went out of his way to provide us recommendations around the area and help us make airport transportation arrangements, and was flexible with our crazy check in and check out times. Thanks for everything, Juan!

Excellente!!!! El departamento es muy bien: limpio, practico, con todo lo que se necesita para unos dias en la capital. El balcon da sobre una calle llena de arboles, y la pileta queda en un jardin muy agradable.
Es un departamento perfecto para dos personas en el mejor barrio de Buenos Aires.
Ademas Juan y Gaby son adorables y estan siempre disponibles por cualquier pregunta o duda.
Lo recomiendo muchisimo!!
Excelente huesped  en especial por el horario de llegada!
Super recomendable! Hermoso lugar y divina la atencion de sus dueños! Seguramente vuelva a alquilarlo. Gracias!

Un departamento espectucular para 2 personas. Bien ubicado, el barrio súper tranquilo, súper cómodo, con todo lo necesario (desde vajilla hasta toallas). Luminoso. Excelente balcón. Alejandro un excelente anfitrión, la comunicación desde el primer momento fue genial y super clara. Recomiendo muchísimo este airbnb; sin dudas volvería a elegirlo.

O apartamento é como nas fotos. O prédio fica numa região calma e com muito verde. Com uma pequena caminhada se chega ao metrô. A região possui diversos restaurantes e centenas de comércios. Mas o que interessa são as pessoas, por isso conhecer o sr. Ronnie, pai de Alejandro, foi uma agradável surpresa. Muito atencioso e com um ótimo papo que deu vontade de ficar horas conversando com ele.
Muy cómodo y agradable el depto. Decorado con simplicidad y buen gusto.  Ronnie y Eva son muy amables y atentos. Lo pasamos genial y seguramente volveremos pronto!
Todo perfecto nos recibieron los padres de Alejandro y fueron muy amables. El departamento tan lindo como las fotos lo muestran
Excelente departamento para disfrutar buenos aries ... alejandro muy buen anfitrion !!!!

Todo es tal cual la descripción. Excelente el lugar, el unico problema fue que habia una obra al lado y el sabado a las 8 am empezaron a golpear las paredes con una maza y no se pudo dormir. El domingo estuvo perfecto
El departamento es muy cómodo, tal cual la fotos, cerca del transporte y Alejandro junto a su mamá siempre estuvieron muy atentos.  Muy recomendable

This is an apartment with a loft and living area, small kitchen and two bathrooms.  It has everything you need to be comfortable for your stay.  The apartment was clean and well managed.  The neighborhood is Belgrano, which is 6-7 km. from the center city.  It is relatively quiet for Buenos Aires and completely safe.  There a direct subway which runs every few minutes to take you there or other locations to visit in Buenos Aires.    We were pleased with the apartment and  highly recommend it as a place to stay outside of the hustle and bustle of downtown.
Excelente lugar , muy recordable y cómodo , los anfitriones muy amables y atentos

La estadía ha sido perfecta. Excelente calefacción, agua caliente siempre. El depto es luminoso y grande. Los padres de Alejandro son muy amorosos y nos recibieron como si estuviéramos en nuestra casa. Cerca de la linea D del subte con muchos locales cerca. Todo perfecto y con seguridad volveremos.
Muy buen alojamiento!!! Limpio y confortable!!! Muy recomendado en una hermosa zona de Buenos Aires!!!
Todo bien, apartameno en un Barrio agradable, cerca de trasportes publicos, tiendas y restaurants. Los padres de Alejandro estuvieron perfectos.

El lugar es excelente, el barrio muy tranquilo, cerca de la avenida Cabildo que brinda buen trasporte a toda la ciudad. El alojamiento es tal cual las fotos y todo funciona perfecto. Los anfitriones Eva y Ronnie (padres de Alejandro) fueron muy agradables, muy accesibles para el ingreso y egreso y nos dieron buenas recomendaciones sobre los comercios de la zona

I travelled from South Africa to Buenos Aires for a physiotherapy course and had the most amazing stay in Alejandro's apartment!

The location is perfect and the neighborhood is quiet. The apartment is lovely and spacious with a good view from the balcony - it is even better than the photos!

I can highly recommend staying here, you can't go wrong - I would definitely stay here again.

Thank you, Alejandro!

El departamento es muy lindo,muy bien equipado y la ubicación para mí fue muy buena,desde la zona donde esta ubicado me trasladé sin inconvenientes. El sector del Barrio es muy tranquilo y con varios comercios para realizar todo tipo de compras.
Excelente el departamento, super recomendable,  los anfitriones divinos !! Pase unos dias muy lindos,  gracias!

Juan and Gaby were fantastic hosts during our 4 night stay in Buenos Aires. They were helpful, welcoming, and had some great recommendations on the local area. The apartment was clean, light, modern and had everything we needed. We were a little nervous having not used AirBnb before but we needn't have been. We loved the area, there are so many wonderful restaurants, cafes, shops all close by. We can't recommend this perfect pied-a-terre enough.

Emma & Simi

Juan and Gabby were incredible hosts. The studio was exactly what we needed and perfectly located. They also recommended great places to see and eat at. Highly recommend booking this place for your next trip to BA.

Per gli amici italiani:
I 15 giorni passati a Buenos Aires sono stati piacevoli, rilassanti, divertenti, interessanti. Parte del merito è dovuto al confortevole appartamento di Juan in cui ci siamo sentiti come a casa nostra.
L’appartamento è moderno, spazioso, situato in una zona strategica (Palermo Soho) servita da autobus e metro, vicino ai più importanti parchi della città, comodo a negozi e decine di ristoranti.
Juan è stato gentilissimo e disponibile per ogni nostra necessità. Sarà un piacere utilizzare ancora il suo appartamento se avremo la fortuna di tornare a Buenos Aires.

For English friends:
The fifteen days in Buenos Aires were pleasant, relaxing, fun, interesting. Part of the credit is due to the comfortable apartment of Juan where we felt like at home.
The apartment is modern, spacious, located in a strategic area (Palermo Soho) served by bus and subway, close to the most important city parks, convenient to shops and dozens of restaurants.
Juan was very kind and available for our every need. It will be a pleasure to again use his apartment if we have the good fortune to return to Buenos Aires.

ara los amigos que ablan espagnoles:
Los quince días de estancia en Buenos Aires fueron agradables, relajantes, divertidos, interesantes. Parte del crédito se debe al acogedor apartamento de Juan donde nos sentimos como en casa.
El apartamento es amplio y moderno, situado en una zona estratégica (Palermo Soho) servido por autobús y metro, cerca de los parques más importantes de la ciudad, cerca de las tiendas y docenas de restaurantes.
Juan fue muy amable y atento a todas nuestras necesidades. Será un placer poder seguir utilizando su apartamento si tenemos la suerte de volver a Buenos Aires

Well...the water was too hot, Air Con too cold, Juan was 1/2 inch smaller than I expected, I couldn't fully straighten my legs in the bath (Im 6.4ft) and the TV had too many channels...
Your right...Ive got nothing...
It was perfect. Juan was a star, v helpful, always a phone call away, helped me change my flight and even let me leave my bag in his house for 2 days. He was wicked.
The place was ideal. In a great location, open plan, balcony, pool, sauna, gym ( -apparently...) and couldn't have been a nicer place to go home to after the incredible BA nightlife.
Would happily recommend it to anyone and hope you'll have as much fun staying there as I did.
Thanks Juan.
H

We've had an amazing experience at Juan's flat.
The location is amazing, everything was clean and organized.
Juan's hospitality really makes the difference.

Juan was a great host, real nice guy and always responded to any questions I had very quickly.  Very accommodating to my travel plans as well.  Studio is as advertised, modern clean and comfortable.  I would stay there again.

Juan's apartment is located in the area of Palermo, the city's hot-spot for restaurants, bars and discos. The place itself is well-furnished and clean but what you're going to appreciate most is Juan's and Gaby's courtesy and helpfulness in everything you need, including insider recommendations by a local. Don't miss the great choice of restaurants and bars he will recommend you!

Juan was a very nice guy and super helpful with suggestions of places to go, sites to see, restaurants to eat, etc.  His apartment is very spacious and clean, the best part being that it's less than 5min walk from the heart of Palermo Soho, a chic area I compare to the east village (moreso than Soho even) of New York.  The apartment also has a plethora of guide books you can borrow as a guest.  Being in a popular neighborhood, the is a small amount of street noise so if you are an extremely light sleeper this may impact you.  However, I slept fine and have no complaints for my stay in Juan's apartment.  Thanks, Juan!

We have been using Airbnb quite a lot recently around Canada and Latin America. Juan's place was our best experience. Juan really went above and beyond for us. He arranged our pick up and drop off, was at the apartment to meet us personally and gave us excellent suggestions. He followed up over email as well to make sure we were ok, gave us further information on the neighbourhood as well as Argentina in general. Anything we asked for, he was more than happy to provide it. I can't recommend Juan and his apartment more!

The apartment was more than we could have hoped, it was charming, very clean and had everything we needed. The location was perfect, close to restaurants and great shopping.

We loved everything.

The apartment is in best location in the city, in a beautiful artsy neighborhood with little restaurants and cobbled streets full of trees.  As its name (Modern Studio Palermo Soho) says, the apartment is super modern, spacious, nice and clean with beautiful balcony. I stayed there with my sister in late August and early September. In addition to this, Juan was a great host always available to anything we needed. He had also provided us with great tips and recommendations so I would warmly recommend him to everyone. As for myself, I wish to come back to that place soon.

Juan was a gracious host who provided lots of helpful recommendations and was easy to get in touch with. The apartment is well-located, clean, and comfortable. I'd especially recommend it as a home base for anyone who is visiting Buenos Aires on a short stay, as it's very close to plentiful shops, dining options, grocery stores, cafes, and the subway. So you don't have to worry about finding any of the practical things, and you can focus on enjoying the best of BA.

As all the reviews state, this apartment and the hosts are great!  The apartment looks great in the photos and it is just as comfortable and tasteful in reality as it looks. Everything works.  Great neighborhood. Great value for the money.  And Juan and Gaby's attentiveness make it even greater than it looks. What they provide in invaluable information for those visiting Buenos Aires makes life exponentially easier.  Even though I only stayed two nights, Juan did extensive research online and on the phone on my behalf before my arrival to find a indoor pool where I could pay to do lap swimming.  There are very few in Buenos Aires.  The best pools are in private clubs which require membership.  So it was looking for a needle in a haystack, but Juan found the best pool nearby.  They made check in and check out extremely easy.  I left at 7 AM but they were there for the handover of the keys.  Words alone cannot describe how helpful they are. You must rent the flat and experience their generosity first hand!  It is memorable.

This apartment was perfect! It's located just a few blocks from the heart if Palermo SoHo - close to lots of shops and restaurants. The apartment is ample and is as pictured and described. Juan provided tons of recommendations from laundry to restaurants - great host! He offered a remis to pick me up and/or take me to the airport. Very generous host!
I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone!

L'appartement est très confortable,situé dans un des meilleurs quartiers de buenos aires...
Gabriela a été une hôte agréable, et ses petites adresses étaient très utiles.
À recommander +++
Aurélie et Raphael octobre 2015 clermont France
La estadía ha sido muy buena en un comfortable departamento, sumamente equipado y cerca de todo. Cabe destacar lo silencioso del mismo. Sin dudas volvería.

Cozy retreat in the bustle of Palermo.
Quaint, clean, bright and well maintained with authentic charm. Gabriella was excellent to interact with and very accessible. Highly recommended.

- Fair value! I can recommend to stay at this place!
- Clean, good bed, basic kitchen
- Contact with the host: Fast and helpful answers from Gabriela
- Location: A lot of restaurants, bars and cafes within 10 min walking distance. To the next subte station it is aprox. 10 min walking. There are several supermarkets just round the corner.
- WiFi: Very good

Staying at Gabriela's apartment was a delight! The apartment is in a wonderful area of Palermo Soho and in walking distance to great shops and restaurants. The apartment is very comfortable, clean, and cute - we loved all Gabriela's decorations and homey touches. The apartment has excellent WIFI and is equipped with A/C (which is very helpful for the summer months!) It was the perfect spot for our 5 day vacation in the BA.

I would like to add that Gabriela was extremely helpful and responsive. She was quick to answer all our messages. Our arrival time kept changing due to travel logistics and Gabriela was very flexible and accommodating.

I would definitely recommend staying here!

Excellent welcome and explanation from Alejandro . Accurate description , lovely neighbourhood  central for all amenities, bus, supermarket , metro, park , restaurants , good coffee and ice cream bars. Friendly helpful neighborhood . A v good flat for a few days in BA, recommended  . Well organized system . Nice security with Keys and safe . v quiet , good bed , pillows , plenty towels , and all facilities . We were comfortable and safe. Loved the place and will recommend and come back .
Nuestra experiencia fue realmente muy buena. Todo se cumplió tal cual lo prometido. Él Depto estaba en muy buenas condiciones. Ubicación excelente. Y Gabriela es muy amable y atenta.

My experience with Gabriela & Daniele was great. We met promptly for check in at 2pm and the space was ready. The bed was comfortable, the shower worked perfectly and the location was perfect for my needs!! The tango details made it evident that they tried to personalize it as much as possible :)
This apartment is in a great part of town. It's right opposite a great restaurant too. It is nicely furnished and has everything you need. The hosts are great too. Perfect.
We loved this place. Perfect location, clean with fast wifi. Thanks for being so accommodating!

Gabriela was very responsive to messages.  In person, she is very friendly and hospitable, and we really appreciated her welcome gift.  The apartment is just like in the photos.  Very clean and tidy, and it had everything we needed for our four night stay.  Great wifi, fan in the bedroom kept us nice and cool at night (there is A/C in the living room as well), elevator in the building, and plenty of warm water for showers.  The neighborhood is PRIME.  It is a great area to walk day or night, with endless options for cafes, ice cream & dessert shops, fine restaurants as well as casual dining (try Burger Joint for amazing burgers!), and the best shopping in Buenos Aires.  I would definitely stay here again!

reviewer_name: Hugo M. Pesa Y Cia S.R.L.
comments: La estadía en el dpto fue muy buena . La atención de Gabriela fue excelente . Estuvo esperando mi llegada a tiempo y fue muy cordial y dispuesta a ayudar mis necesidades

The apartment was FANTASTIC - centrally  located across from one of the best steak houses in the city. Although the flight came in a little bit late, our host was waiting for us and very happy to accommodate an early check in. The apartment was ready for us, clean, with fresh towels and linens as well as a bottle of wine waiting for us. Also, it was so nice that there were converters and a sube (like a metrocard) left for us to borrow during our stay. Overall I'd certainly recommend this to anyone traveling to the city and would love to return back to this apartment myself :-)
Una de las mejores vacaciones que hemos tenido. Nos sentimos como en casa, decorado con muy buen gusto, cómodo y agradable.  Ubicación perfecta. Volveremos en agosto, gracias Daniel y Gabriela.

Apartamento excelente, confortável e com ótima localização.

A descrição e fotos conferem com a realidade.

Apesar de eu não encontrado com a Gabriela, todos os questionamentos foram prontamente respondidos, mostrando ser uma boa anfitriã.

Recomendo bastante este imóvel
El depto muy comodo y el barrio muy lindo!

El departamento de Gabriela es muy completo cómodo y ubicado en excelente zona. Tiene todo lo que puedes necesitar para ir de vacaciones. El departamento Está en buenas condiciones todo funcionando y decorado con pequeños detalles de
Muy buen gusto por lo que sientes que es un un lugar acogedor y moderno. Gabriela estuvo pendiente en todo el momento contestando nuestras preguntas e inquietudes es muy amable y nos dio la bienvenida con una botella de vino. Excelente anfitriona.

Local perfeito, próximo a diversos restaurantes e também das principais linhas de transporte público (metrô e ônibus). O apartamento é ótimo e tem tudo que você pode precisar para passar os dias. Recomendo!

I had a wonderful time in this apartment! Well organized, beautifully decorated, and equipped with everything we needed. Excellent location and Gabriela was very attentive. I would definitely stay here again.

The apartment is very nice, comfortable and clean. Location is perfect and very safe, even late at night. It is just a few minutes walk from Plaza Serrano and on the other side a few minutes from Av. Santa Fe where you can get a bus or metro to basically anywhere in the city. If you are by any chance visiting BsAs for tango life, this is also perfect because it is walking distance to Villa Malcolm and La Viruta. :)
Really a great place, when I return to BsAs, I'll try to stay here again.

Tivemos ótimos dias em Buenos Aires.
O apartamento é confortável e muito bem localizado.
Ubicacion perfecta!

A anfitriã foi extremamente prestativa e solícita durante toda a hospedagem. O apartamento é excelente em todos os quesitos: localização, limpeza, comodidade, mobiliário, decoração, tecnologia. Acredito que o apto está localizado no melhor ponto de Palermo, pois está perto de tudo.

Gabriela was an amazing host, I felt I was in the hands of a pro, there was even a complete guidebook about the, keys, check in and out, maps, close restaurants, etc. The apartment was great and had everything I needed too cook, work and even relax in front of the TV very comfortably.  Palermo is the also the best neighborhood – lots of markets with all ranges of prices, restaurants – and it's also very close to the subway. totally recommend it!
Had a great stay here. It's well located and across the street from Don Julio which is one of the best steakhouses in Buenos Aires.

Gabriela fue muy amable y fácil de contactar. El apartamento es cómodo y seguro, con una buena ubicación en un barrio muy activo, con muchos restaurantes y bares cerca. Solo hay un split de aire acondicionado que no alcanza hasta la habitación y en verano puede hacer un poco de calor.
Me senti en casa y Gabriela estuvo siempre atenta desde antes de mi llegada.

Gabriela and Daniele’s beautifully decorated apartment has a great location in the Palermo neighborhood. You can walk to the subway at Plaza Italia in about 10-15 minutes, and many restaurants and cafes are also just a short walk away. Gabriela and Daniele provided a helpful booklet with instructions about the apartment, what to do when checking out, and where to find local services like the supermarket and the laundry. Much appreciated! Gabriela also responded promptly to any questions that we had.

The apartment itself had everything that my husband and I needed for a week's stay. The kitchen had plenty of dishes, pots and pans, a coffee maker, even a mate cup and bombilla (straw). There's an air-conditioning unit in the living room and a ceiling fan in the bedroom; the combination kept us comfortable even on a 33C day. The apartment faces the rear of the building, which helps keep it quiet. There is some construction going on behind the building, but we found that closing the windows kept out any morning construction noise.

We'd definitely recommend this apartment to other travelers. Thanks, Gabriela & Daniele!
La comunicación con Alejandro fue súper fluida, estuvo pendiente todo el tiempo para que todo salga según lo planeado. Súper recomendable!!
Excelente lugar y ubicación. Todo es tal como lo publicado. Los padres de Alejando son super cordiales y predispuestos. Volveria sin dudarlo. 10 puntos!!!
El departamento es divino. Y está ubicado en una esquina muy linda y tranquila que da a una plaza con una buena parrilla. Todo OK. Y va a ser mejor cuando terminen de construir el edificio lindero.

Great area full a anything you want at your doorstep
Safe, clean, friendly area
Highly recommended
Excellent in all respects.
Cálido departamento en muy buen entorno. Muy recomendable.

Excelentes instalações e tudo funciona perfeitamente no apartamento. A localização é excelente em tudo, especialmente para deslocamentos de ônibus e metrô.
A recepção feita pela pai do Alejandro (Seu Ronnie) merece uma capítulo à parte. Simpatia sem tamanho.
Estadia maravilhosa.

We enjoyed staying at Alejandros...we chose Belgrano to be near family who live in Belgrano. It is a secure and safe neighborhood and we felt safe at all times. Great to have the wifi
we found little fruit shops, lovely bakeries, great cafes for good coffee and
We were not far from Cabildo main drag.
The apartment has a comfortable bed & good pillows, a clothes airer for your hand washing and a great balcony we enjoyed to eat breakfast on...
The bedroom has a much needed fan over the bed...it was quite hot when we were in BA and the bedroom is upstairs (only 15 steps)
We stayed from tuesday - friday night....all was quiet at night until friday night.....the music, yelling & whistling from the restaurant over on the corner was unreasonable....it went until 2.30 am.....we needed to rise at 4.00am for a flight to Australia.....perhaps it was a Christmas party but we didnt have sleep!
But we enjoyed Belgrano & ...we would recommend Alejandros apartment
Recomendadisimo, confiable vuelvo de nuevo

El dpto de Alejandro es exactamente como esta descripto. Me recibieron Ronnie y Eva con mucha amabilidad y me explicaron todo lo que necesitaba saber. El lugar es muy cómodo, con mucha luz. Muy recomendable

Location was excellent - safe, and close to lots of great cafes and restaurants. Having air conditioning in the hot summer days was also wonderful. Gabriela is very responsive and friendly and I would definitely recommend her to others!

Awesome location in Polermo soho near restaurants and bars. Very walkable and also close to subway. Bed was somewhat firm but comfortable. Great value. Very nice host and easy check-in/check-out process.

Location:
- 10 min stroll to Palermo Soho, which has great shops, restaurants, bars etc. Very trendy...think Burlingame in California, Itaim in Brazil or Soho in London...in terms of cool/trendy.
- less than a $10 USD cab ride to San Telmo (great neighborhood for tango in the streets and a great little square, antique shops and a more rustic feeling)
- $12 USD to Puerto Madero, which is more modern/new. Travel guides portray it as pricey...I travel tons and find everything in Argentina to be very affordable compared to other amazing cities...so don't be dissuaded
- 6 min walk to my favorite amazing Sushi joint [Osaka Palermo] with Peruvian flair [seriously, flavors will AMAZE you...as I eat sushi 4x/week, and they did me]. **They only take Amex or Cash.

Other Miscellaneous:
1. Go for a HASH RUN [both walkers and runners welcome]. Great people, fun and instant connections into the community.
2. Go to 'Friday Frinking' and tell Liam the Bald American sent you [he is great], as is the group. Combination of expats and locals, who are very welcoming. Every Friday at 9pm [find it on Meetup].
3. Epic Cigar Joint? Puro, at Thames 1920 [4 blocks from flat].
4. Great wine shop? 3 blocks. Corner of Thames and Guatemala. Get the 2008 De Angeles Malbec. AMAZING! Again, tell the owner high.
5. Starbucks is 12 min walk and just 1/2 block off a great square where you can always do something fun.
6. Plaza Serrano is 10 mins, where there are bars and restaurants at night, and on the weekends are converted into craft stalls and home made wonders. :)
7. Boca: the old port area with live Tango in the restaurants on colorful streets. Bring your camera, as the colors, character and picture-ness-esque of it is cool
8. Great, upscale bar: Milion at Paraná 1048. Converted mansion. If the weather is remotely warm, there is a back terrace and courtyard area that is amazing for a book or anything at all. They make crazy, fresh cocktails...or pour a stiff Jack & Coke!
9. Steak Places: everyone has a favorite...you cannot go wrong anywhere.
10. Craving Scrambled Eggs for breakfast: Bar 6, Armenia 1676 [great little coffee shop] ...Great, fresh juices? Right next door.

Hope this was helpful!
