This was my first time in Buenos Aires. Juan made arrangements for a taxi to pick me up at the airport. However, the taxi was not able to make it and called Juan at 4:00 am to notify him. When I arrived at 7:00 am there was Juan standing at the airport waiting for me. I explained that I could have taken a taxi but he did not want me to feel stranded. I felt very comfortable from that day on knowing that I had a friend in Buenos Aires. The apartment was just as described. Very clean and comfortable. Little restaurant just below for breakfast and many great restaurants within a short walk. There was no traffic noise at all. Short walk to the subway and buses. Juan also provided me with a number to call a taxi anytime. Felt very safe walking around the neighborhood. I would definitely stay there again on my next trip.

YOU GET WHAT YOU SEE! One of my/ our best airbnb experiences (I rent about 8 times a year through airbnb). I was in BA for New Year´s Eve with my family (wife and 12yrs. old daughter). First I hesitated to book the loft because I thought it was too pricey but it was worth every Peso. Not to forget to mention that Ralf is a nice guy, very professional and descrete. When we arrived we got comprehensive information of the neighbourhood (Palermo). When I went to the recommended laundry I was expected already. Thank you Ralf.

We had a sensational stay in BsAs, thanks to Ralf and team. The loft was fantastic - exactly as advertised. Incredible view! Comfortable and very well appointed - we had everything we needed. Conveniently located very close to the Plaza Italia Subte stop, and many great attractions and restaurants located within walking distance. Cabs come frequently for everything further away.

Heads-up for the sensitive traveler: the water from nearby units does make some noise, and your neighbors may be showering at 2:30 AM. Otherwise, it's quiet.

Ralf welcomed us and gave us a quick orientation - much appreciated. Equally appreciated were the fruit bowl and beverages stocked in the kitchen.

The team also went above and beyond when we were in town just for the day the week before, allowing us to store our luggage in their office for the day.

Heartily recommended!
Excellent apartment. Excellent host. If I could give another star I would.

We stayed at the Premier Loft for a month, the area became home for a while, our little corner of Palermo. The complex where the apartment is situated has every amenity - the 20metre pool in the grounds is kept immaculately clean, the view from the gym to the River is stunning and there is even a spa if desired. The apt we rented had a view of Palermo Soho with a balcony. Ralf organised everything seemlessly from check-in to check-out. He gave us his recommendations in the area for the basics and was warm and welcoming. The overall sense was relaxed - giving us an easy time if we decided to stay at home by the pool or hangout in Palermo or further. We would recommend staying in one of Ralf´s apts and have already done so to a friend in New York.
The apartment was exactly as described. Fantastic!!   Great Value for the price. Ralf was very attentive and thoughtful.  I really enjoyed my stay and look forward to coming back.

The loft is beautiful, extremely clean, and well presented. Ralf and the entire BA4U team did an exceptional job at making sure that we were comfortable and secure in the loft. They went above and beyond by providing transportation service from the airport and meeting with us once we reached the loft. They also suggested places to visit and answered any questions we had about Buenos Aires. Overall this has been one of my best experiences with airbnb and I would not hesitate to book with BA4U again. The loft helped to complete the wonderful time I had in Buenos Aires!

We had a very late check-in (almost 2 AM) The transportation from the airport was easy and organized. Our check-in host Marcelo spent a lot of time explaining the area and the best of things BA has to offer.  He was very energetic and helpful even at 2 AM.  The apartment has a wonderful view with a great location, clean and a great value. The building is safe and accessible.  The space is well decorated and comfortable. My wife and I spent our anniversary here and couldn't have found a better place.

Juan was wonderful to work with. He was very helpful and accommodating with us, even when our plans changed. The place is very nice, and well equipped for travelers. Located in a great neighborhood and near a subway stop, this is a perfect place to stay in Buenos Aires.

Juan was an awesome host. His place was great and clean. He was very attentive during my stay and helped me out setting up taxis with his friend who drives a remise, exchanging money, and pointing out recommendations in the neighborhood and the best way to get to the places I wanted to go. Would definitely stay with him again!

I wholeheartedly Juan and Gaby's Palermo Soho studio! It is wonderfully located in the lovely Palermo neighborhood, well appointed with anything a traveller might need, and Juan went above and beyond to help make us feel welcome. Before, during, and throughout our stay, Juan was easy to contact and definitely helped us with transportation and getting to know the neighborhood. You can tell he really enjoys hosting folks from all over the world, and his graciousness shows.
We spent a few days in Buenos Aires for business and pleasure, and this studio (and Juan!) made our stay so easy. The apartment is clean, stylish, and comfortable, with a modern bathroom and small kitchen (perfect for leftover pizza from a nearby restaurant). We enjoyed the apartment's amenities--wifi, a lovely deck/patio, and dubbed movies on TV. Moreover, the apartment is a few minutes away from shopping, nightlife, and great restaurants. Thank you, Juan--I only have wonderful things to say about our stay!

Juan's studio is a fantastic place to stay in BA. The studio itself is pretty big and one whole wall is windows out to a cute balcony. Plenty of guide books and adaptors (which was great, since mine didn't work). The location is the BEST -- Palermo Soho is a really fun neighborhood for 20-30 somethings, cute boutiques & restaurants, and the studio is close to all that and the subway but on a very quiet residential street. Juan lives close by and was an extremely helpful and gracious host. Great place & host, you can't go wrong.

Todo tal cual como se publica y muestra en las fotos. La estadía fue perfecta.
Juan es un excelente anfitrión, muy preocupado de cada detalle. Lo mejor, es que es muy flexible con los horarios de check-in y check-out, lo que facilita la conexión con los vuelos.
Totalmente recomendado!

Simply put, I felt at home. Juan and Gaby are lovely and their Studio is too. Juan makes everything easy from the get go with his recommendations. definitely take his suggestions. Markets are in walking distance. I found a local dance studio to take dance classes at ( also in less than 2 blocks walking distance). I was very happy with my first Airbnb experience.
A+++ host and a great place to stay and play. Thanks so much.
Wonderful place, clean, modern and a great location. The hosts were incredibly helpful and provided great information upon my arrival. Staying here was a fantastic experience!

Superbe appartement, bien situé et très agréable. Juan et Gaby sont très accueillants et toujours disponibles pour répondre à nos questions. Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement !
Muy lindo departamento, muy bien ubicado y muy agradable. Juan y Gaby son muy acogedores y siempre disponibles para contestar a nuestras cuestiones. Recomendamos el departamento !

Realmente aconsejable! Desde el primer momento Juan y Gaby estuvieron disponibles para aclarar nuestras dudas, respondieron siempre nuestros mensajes en el instante y el departamento fue perfecto! Impecable, iluminado, bien equipado, buena temperatura y ubicación inmejorable!!!! Nuestro chekout coincidió con el chekin de otros pasajeros y Juan nos guardo las maletas sin problema e incluso nos acompañó a tomar el taxi para el aeropuerto!!! Anfitriones perfectos y si vuelvo a buenos aires, seguro estaré denuevo en el mismo lugar. Muchas gracias por todo!
Juan was amazing at helping us have a great trip - before and during our stay!  Very much recommend it.

The location of the apartment is peefect and Juan's help and recommendations are priceless. We had an excellent time and would recommend his apartment to anyone looking to be in the hip, cool, and safe part of palermo with very easily accesible public transit (subte). The apartment was clean, modern and everything you needed. Again, the host Juan made it the best Airbnb experience we've had to date.

Great location and comfortable studio. Juan and Gaby are so nice and honest couple that make you feel at home. Excellent communication and attention. I'd recommend the studio and I'd go back in the next trip to BA.

Juan is amazing host; he was quick to answer any of our questions and extremely helpful in addressing any concerns we had. The apartment is in a great location in the heart of Palermo Viejo and was clean and bright with a great balcony. I have no hesitation in recommending Juan and his apartment.

Everything was perfect. Great location (close to metro, parks and restaurants), great appartment. Juan was always very helpful and available and could assist us on different matters. Recommend others to stay here!

This was our first airbnb experience and it exceeded our expectations! The apartment was perfectly located (less than a 10 minute walk to all the shops), clean, modern, and spacious. Juan and Gaby were wonderful hosts. We will definitely stay here again when we return to Buenos Aires.

Hemos estado muy a gusto en el piso, esta muy céntrico y el barrio es una maravilla lleno de vida. Juan ha sido muy amable y en la casa tenía todo tipo de comodidades y guías para que el viajero pudiera organizar su estadía en buenos aires. Hemos estado muy cómodos y estamos agradecidos a juan.

Juan was amazing as all the other reviews state! He was there when we arrived around 1:30am and gave us all the directions we needed for our stay. He was available anytime we had a question by phone as well. The neighborhood is so perfect, great shops and food all nearby and felt very safe. The apt is exactly as pictured and described, beautiful and very secure building with yummy and cheap bistro down stairs! Try their homemade alfajores!
Gabriela and Danielle’s apartment is Perfect for anyone staying in Palermo, BA. Situated in the heart of the neighborhood, you will not be at a loss of options for things to do.

I spent 3 months at Gabriela & Daniele's place, and I have a lot to say about it. First, I cannot stress enough how truly perfect the location is. For someone who is looking for a fun, hip, and easily accessible location to public transportation could really not do better than here. This place is in a phenomenal location. You're close to really great bars and restaurants, one of the handful of legitimately great coffee places in the city, and you're close to the Subte as well. It's probably in the best 4 blocks in the city from the standpoint of someone who is coming to visit. If you're a digital nomad and looking for a place to live that also gives you easy access to getting to WeWork or another coworking space ( there are a bunch in walking distance) then this is absolutely unbeatable. The building is well kept and clean, and in great condition. The elevator is old fashioned with the hand-operated sliding doors (though up-down is automatic) so that is something to be aware of as some folks might be uncomfortable with the elevator. It's mostly families in the building, and there is a lovely wine store downstairs that is owned by the gentleman who lives on the 7th floor. It's great! The apartment itself is a cute little one bedroom. Definitely enough space for a couple. The decor is cute and the furniture is okay. I found the bed to be rather uncomfortable. I never did figure out the TV really, but you shouldn't be watching TV here! The dishes are nice the fridge is clean and works well, and the freezer too. There's plenty of closet space for your stuff. The wifi is good, though I occasionally had issues with facetime. There were some issues I had with the apartment. While the bathroom is generally nice with a nice sink and toilet, the shower tub is not and is in desperate need of a refinish or replacement. It appears to have been refinished once before and that finish is peeling and cracking leaving areas that are chipped and what not. It squicked me out. The windows are large, but they are not tight in their tracks so if it is windy, they will rattle back and forth in the tracks. This kept me awake at times as it can be quite windy. The windows rattling can be solved by jamming a folded up index card into the track to keep them from knocking back and forth, but it's annoying. The other wind-related issue cannot, however, be resolved. There are wires running down the outside of the building and when it is windy, they will make a loud slapping noise against the side of the building. This happens only when it's really windy, but there were probably 5 or so days during my 90 day stay where this kept me up at night. My final issue with the apartment was the air conditioning. It's a...
The flat is very central in Palermo, within walking distance to very nice areas. Gabriela was super helpful and reactive. Thank you!
Departamento impecable. Excelente ubicación. Muy recomendable.

El departamento esta impecable de limpio y ordenado, ademas super comodo y la ubicacion es genial.
Mucha Gracias Gabriela y Daniele, seguro volveria!
hermoso el departamento y excelente tanto su ubicación como la comunicación con las anfitrionas.-
Muy buena ubicación  excelentes restaurantes y transporte a un par de cuadras. Muy recomendable

This place is really a great option is you are looking for a great location in the middle of Palermo! There are great bars (and speakeasies) in the area! The appartment has a great size for a couple and everything you need! Gabriela answeres within minutes and is a really helpful person! Cleaniness in details has a bit of room for improvement and in our case the check-in did not work well (obviously due to a misunderstanding)

My girlfriend and I stayed here for a week. Check-in was a breeze,  Gabriela & Daniele were very accommodating and communicative. The apartment is very stylish and in a great neighborhood in Buenos Aires. Would definitely recommend to travelers.

Somos um casal e ficamos no apartamento de 13 a 23/08
Seguem alguns comentários:
- o barulho da obra vizinha realmente é alto exceto no fds. Ocorre todos os dias em horário comercial. Teve um dia que foi até as 23hs. Se vc pretende dormir tranquilamente até mais tarde, esqueça, é impossível. Para nós não foi um problema pois acordamos cedo todos os dias;
- controle remoto da tv com problemas. Já informei a host para substituir;
- lençóis com manchas e pó em alguns móveis no apartamento. Alguns utensílios na cozinha tb estavam sujos. Já solicitei mais atenção a host;
- A host Gabriela foi extremamente prestativa e me atendeu muitíssimo bem antes e durante toda minha estadia. Inclusive permitiu late check out que nos ajudou muito. Saimos 11:30hs da manhã do apartamento;
- o apartamento é bem localizado para quem (como nós) pretende utilizar o metrô e aproveitar os restaurantes e bares das redondezas a noite. Caminhada de 10 min até o metro plaza Itália e 10min até a região dos restaurantes e bares. Mercado grande e pequeno a uma quadra apenas;
- cama confortável, ótimo chuveiro com água quente, geladeira, cook top, microondas e forno elétrico ótimos tb;
- Internet ótima. Funcionou perfeitamente todos os dias com bom sinal e não tive problema nenhum;
- apartamento fica no quarto andar e tem acesso com elevador que funciona muito bem.

Resumindo meu parecer, os pequenos problemas já mencionados não prejudicaram consideravelmente minha estadia. Ficaria novamente no apartamento.

El alojamiento tenía mucho estilo, la ubicación, en buenos aires, una de las mejores donde hemos estado, especialmente porque estaba al lado de don julio, increíble parrilla. Lo único que debería mejorar es la mantención y los elementos de la casa, un poco antiguos, especialmente la ropa de cama y las toallas. Pero sin duda si vas a buenos aires y quieres estar cerca de todo, tienes que alojarte aquí

Great location in Palermo Soho, right in the middle of fun restaurants, cafes and bars. Not to mention, Rapunia is just right around the corner for all your helado cravings! Apartment is perfect and exactly as described. Will definitely be back!

Estive 11 dias no Apartamento da Gabriela. Não nos conhecemos pessoalmente mas ela sempre esteve disponível para nos atender e dar as informações necessárias e também fez a gentileza de nos permitir um check-in e check-out flexíveis em 2 horas (obrigada!). O apartamento está super bem localizado, perto de tudo o que interessa em Palermo. A Praça mais bacana do bairro está a apenas 4 quadras e para a o metrô são também 4 quadras. Aproveitem para fazer um tour gastronômico e conhecer lugares que oferecem degustação de vinhos. Eu ADOREI ficar em Palermo! O Apartamento é silencioso para dormir, colchão, roupa de cama e toalhas, bons. O Edifício é antigo, elevador com porta pantográfica e descalibrado ao parar nos andares (fica um degrau entre o elevador e o piso), apartamento reformado e decorado como mostram as fotografias. Tem um excelente conceito de iluminação que torna os ambientes muito aconchegantes. TV de boa qualidade, com canais a Cabo. Internet ótima. Chuveiro excelente! mas o banho tem que ser rápido. Sistema de aquecimento de água por termotanque, sendo que há água quente por uns 6-7 minutos e depois começa a esfriar. Há panelas de inox Tramontina novas para cozinhar, fogão, micro-ondas e forno elétrico funcionando perfeitamente. A cafeteira estava sem a jarra, o que dificultava passar o café. Como cortesia ela oferece o primeiro rolo de papel higiênico.

We highly recommend this apartment.  It is clean and comfortably furnished, and the neighborhood is outstanding!  Palermo is quiet, beautiful and the apartment is centrally located to so much of what Buenos Aires has to offer.  There are wonderful restaurants and grocery stores within easy walking distance.  In fact, one of the things we enjoyed most was walking around the neighborhood in the evenings.  Subways and busses are also very convenient to the apartment and gave us such quick and easy access to whole city.  Gabriela and Daniele are wonderful hosts -- very client friendly.  They were attentive to our needs and responded quickly to any questions we asked.  If you are looking for a terrific value and and a care-free experience while staying in Buenos Aires, this is the apartment for you!
Ya sin obras enfrente, por tanto tranquilo en cuanto a ruidos  y completo en equipamientos para sentirte como en casa. Zona espectacular para compras y comidas.

O apartamento tem ótima localização: perto de bares, restaurantes, metrô, lojas e comércio, pode-se fazer tudo caminhando. A famosa parrilla Don Julio fica praticamente em frente ao edifício.

O check-in e o check-out foram muito fáceis e flexíveis.
O apartamento parece reformado recentemente e com bom estilo, é exatamente como nas fotos. A internet funcionou perfeitamente durante a minha estadia e os utensílios de cozinha são ótimos.

Recomendo fortemente o apartamento da Gabriela e com certeza me hospedaria novamente nele.

I was underwhelmed with my stay at the apartment. There were a few issues:
1. The air conditioning is only in the living room, so the bedroom can get very hot at night.
2. There were stains on the bedsheets when i arrived.
3. The lock to the front door to the apartment building malfunctioned during the trip, resulting in us getting locked out of the building late at night. We would have had to find another place to stay but were lucky enough for someone else to let us in. Gabriela did not provide urgent help in this situation.
Excelente atencion de Gabriela y siempre respuestas y reacciones muy rápido . La ubicación es perfecta, cerca de todo en pleno corazón del increíble Palermo Soho.
Best area in town by far, location is perfect. Place is comfortable, clean, hit water, ac is good.

You want to stay here!  Location!!  Communication with host!!  Value!  I can’t say enough good things. 2 of us were here for 4 days and couldn’t be happier. Gabby is a great host. So easy to work with. The building is great. There are donuts near by and any food/beverage you can ask for. I don’t have a thing bad to say!
All our hopes and expectations were fulfilled.
Perfecto !!! Gracias!!!!
A great place to stay, great communication, and very clean. The bedroom was a bit too hot since the air conditioning is only in the living room and not in the bedroom.
110% recomendable, inmejorable ubicación, apartamento impecable y por sobre todo detallo la hospitalidad de nuestros anfitriones. Volvería sin dudarlo!!
Amazing place, clean, very safe, convenient, comfortable, warm, and incredibly friendly and helpful hosts!! I will definitely stay here again when I return!!

We stayed here for the full month of April. Apartment was great. The bathroom is very clean and new. The kitchen has everything you need for cooking. Bed is comfortable and the black-out curtains a nice touch.

One of our favorite things about this apartment is the location. Just a few minutes walk from downtown Palermo, and surrounded by lots of restaurants, grocery stores, and local shops.

Would highly recommend if you're looking to stay for just a few days or a longer period of time in Palermo.

Excelente nuestra estadía. El departamento impecable y muy cómodo en inmejorable ubicación.  Zona muy segura. La encargada Marla muy amable y siempre con una respuesta rápida a nuestras consultas. Muy recomendable!

Marla was an excellent host this apartment is very clean all the necessities were provided the location is excellent as well walking distance to all the bars restaurants and shops she also provide a card for the subway as well along with a bottle of wine I highly recommend this apartment if I ever visit Buenos Aires again I will book this apartment again

It was never that easy as this time to give 5 stars review.
this was the best Airbnb in our stay in Argentina.
every detail in the house is well thought with care and style, the check in was super easy and helpful, the communication with the hosts and the caretaker were very fast helpful. and practical. the location is the best in Palermo, and the value of the apartment is super fair.
we couldn't ask for more and we can't wait to come back.

El alojamiento es tal como se lo presenta. La ubicación nos resultó inmejorable. De volver a Buenos Aires, volveríamos allí sin dudarlo. La atención por parte de los anfitriones, Marla y Frederick, fue excelente! Definitivamente les recomendamos alojarse en este apartamento.

Muy bello departamento, totalmente cómodo, con todo lo necesario para una estadía..todo muy bien equipado, todo funciona correctamente, calefacción, agua caliente. Un barrio muy bello y tranquilo, todo cercano. Anfitriones muy amables y siempre al pendiente de cualquier necesidad. Bella experiencia, volveré y por supuesto a este departamento.

Juan was a wonderful host and was very responsive to my numerous questions during my stay (i.e. where is the laundromat, does he have a spare adapter, etc).  He even let us keep our luggage in his condo after we checked out!  I can't recommend him enough.  His place is centrally located in Palermo Soho and within walking distance to Palermo Viejo where all the cool bars and restaurants are.
Nice apartment in an excellent location. Juan was extremely helpful in getting me set up. The pool was especially nice in the Buenos Aires heat.

Great location in Palermo. Juan was very attentive. Clean and modern studio located above a great bistro. Juan emailed a detailed list of attractions and restaurants.  He also arranged a great taxi driver Daniel.

The apartment is amazing! The studio is just as pictured and has a nice little balcony, and the building has a sauna, small gym, pool, and a spacious roof deck where we watched Christmas fireworks. Juan was very responsive and helpful, and went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable with a late checkout (and even offered for us to keep our luggage at his own place until our late flight). His friend's taxi service from Jorge Newbery airport was a little pricy ($180 pesos instead of maybe $80 if you hail a metered cab at the airport), but otherwise everything was awesome!

We loved our stay! The unit was spacious, clean and a short walk from many good bars and restaurants.  We found the Palermo area to be a perfect starting point from which to explore Buenos Aires.  Juan was incredibly helpful before and throughout our stay.  He recommended activities, restaurants, and provided general travel tips prior to our arrival.  During our trip, he helped organize rides to and from the airport and gave us additional tips on Palermo and Buenos Aires.  Our stay was perfect and I highly recommend both Juan and the apartment!

Juan foi muito gentil e cordial, sempre atendendo a qualquer pedido nosso.
Juan nos deu varias dicas sobre a cidade e no apartamento há varios guias super completos de Buenos Aires.
O apartamento é muito bem equipado e exatamente como demonstrado nas fotos. A cama é super confortável e o banheiro conta com uma boa banheira.
O bairro de Palermo Soho é demais, há tudo proximo.
Supermercado, Cafés, Bares, Restaurantes etc.
Na esquina do apartamento, há as melhores medialunas que comemos. É uma padaria bem artesanal, mantida por apenas uma senhora.
Enfim, nossa estadia em Buenos Aires foi otima e Juan e seu apartamento colaboraram para isto.

Juan and Gaby are amazing hosts. They were very communicative but never overbearing and gave me great suggestions via email before I ever arrived in BA. I can't recommend them as hosts highly enough.

The apartment itself is very well located. It's close enough to the best parts of Palermo Soho to walk in a matter of 5-10 minutes but is distant enough that you can enjoy peaceful quiet while sleeping.

If you are looking for a bright, open, quality space in Palermo with kind and helpful hosts, stay here.

We had a relaxed and comfortable stay in this apartment. The neighborhood was wonderful, safe and attractive. We were within walking distance of a couple of lively plazas with shopping and restaurants, as well as the Zoo and Botanical Gardens. Juan, our host, gave us recommendations of things to see and do, and even made arrangements to have us picked up at the airport, and returned there at the end of our trip.

Staying at Juan's place made our stay in BA even more enjoyable. Everything was great and beyond our expectations. Juan is a wonderful host, very helpful and has tons of good recommendation. We would definitely stay here again!

Juan and Gabi are the one of best hosts one can hope for home away home. We were treated more as friends than b&b guests. The place is exactly what it was described like the pictures, very clean, and very accessible to great restaurants, clubs, subte (MTR), and boutiques.

We can't be more happier with Mr. Zuliani!

We stayed in the studio for two nights and very much enjoyed it. It was exactly what we expected and had everything we needed and more, like a comfy bed and a nice balcony. We even used the gym one morning. Definitate plus are Juan and his wife, who gave us very good recommandations on what to do and where to eat in town, arranged a taxi for us from the airport and let us leave our luggage at their place on our last day, where we had coffee before we left. Great service!! We are gonna come back to ba and definately try to book this studio again!
The apartment is gorgeous, exactly like pictured, in a beautiful neighborhood. Gaby and Juan are very nice people and super considerate hosts. Loved it.

Juan foi um anfitrião muito atencioso. A localização do apartamento é excelente, próximo do que há de melhor em Palermo. Juan nos deu dicas, realizou câmbio para nós e solicitou o táxi de retorno ao aeroporto.
Muito obrigada pela hospitalidade Juan! Até breve!
He was there to greet us. He offered to help us exchanging dollars into pesos at a good rate . H e answered all of our questions and had great recommendations for shopping and dining.
Thanks for hosting us this past few days! The place is amazing and the location is great. It is always nice to go back to BA. Definitely using this place again when I get back!

The apartment is exactly as showed in the photos, in a really grateful neighborhood. Juan and Gaby was very nice and helpful with your tips. In a next time in BsAs I'll be one more time with this apartment for sure.

Juan was perfect. My flight arrived very early and he was very friendly. The location of the appartment is perfect in Palermo. the little terrace is very nice to sip a nice glass of wine in the evening.

I highly recommend this place.

We actually rented two apartments from Ralf, this one and the one next door for our friends with whom we were travelling. Both were as nice as the pictures suggest, with views across Buenos Aires from the 25th floor of a 32 story building and lots of space for relaxing. Ralf and his staff (especially Marcelo) were exceptionally friendly and helpful. We will definitely aim to stay here should we find ourselves in BA again.

Todo fantastico, mucho mejor de lo esperado.
Muy recomendable!!

This was really the best appartment, I´ve ever had. You see what you get! The view is fantastic, Palermo Soho is a good place to stay in BA, the appartment is perfect and Ralf a very good host, who was always there when we needed help or information. Thanks!!!

I cannot express how much thankful we are to Ralf and all the team of BA4U! We absolutely recommend them!!! First of all, Ralf was great from the beginning, offered all possible help as a host, and in a given time of the trip, when we needed help after we ran out of cash (credit card issue), he gave us some money without asking anything. We can't thank enough for that. And about the apartment, it's even better then in the pictures! The atmosphere is great, it was VERY clean, incredibly well decorated! We are even thinking about asking Ralf to help us decorate our own place, he has a great taste! haha =) Stay here and you will enjoy the best neighborhood, at the best possible place, with the most breathtaking view that Buenos Aires can have. Thank you Ralf and thank you BA4U! Felipe and Marcella

Excelente departamento, muy buena ubicación y sobretodo la atención tanto de Ralph al contactarme con él, como de todo su equipo. Es igual a lo que se ve en las foto. Lo mejor, obviamente, LA VISTA!!!
Great apartment, excellent location near the heart of Palermo Soho. Ralph and his crew are the best. This place has an amazing view.

We had a perfect stay in the apartment during our honeymoon trip. As already mentioned the loft is in real even better looking as on the pictures.
Location is great. Close to the sub station Plaza Italia and just a 10min walk through Palermo to e.g. Plaza Serrrano.
Next time on BA I will definitely stay at an apartment from BA4U again. Thanks to Ralf and his team.

Our apartment was really fantastic! The view was incredible, it was very clean, nicely decorated - we really couldn't have asked for a better building. We had such an amazing time, and really thank Ralf's crew for it. Marcelo was particularly welcoming and gave us some helpful advice. Definitely stay in this apartment!!

This was the most welcoming experience we have ever had at any AirBNB  OR Hotel! Ralf's staff (he owns dozens of rentals in Buenos Aires) greeted us with an hour of information about the city, including safety, money changing tips, etc. They were there whenever we needed them. The apartment was wonderful: clean and exactly as advertised. We wouldn't hesitate to use Ralf's apartments again.

We had a great time! The apartment was exactly as listed. We opted for the airport pickup service and even though we arrived after 2am it was seamless. Someone had a sign with my name and we were brought to a private driver who drove us 45 mins from the airport to the loft. We were greeted by a BA4U representative and given the low down on the place and surroundings. Great service and fantastic location!

The flat is modern (in line with the pictures), has a beautiful view and is perfectly located in Palermo. Ralf and his team have taken good care of us. The arrival process worked very well - we were picked up from the airport and Florencia was already waiting for us in the flat when we arrived. Check-out was even more straight forward. Ralf is truly committed to his clients.

The stay with Ralf was flawless. I had also booked a transfer from and back to the airport with them and that worked seemlessly.

When I arrived at the apartment, I was welcomed by Marcello (a colleague of Ralf's) and he walked me through the nooks and crannies of the loft - I right away fell in love with the views from this 25th floor flat!

Note: while this is a great place, it doesn't have the typical Airbnb charme that I usually look for. This place is designed as a vacation rental, so you don't find any personal "things" that usually make an airbnb-stay so special. (This was fine by me this time, as I used the apartment during a business trip and just needed a place to crash.)

A great apartment with sensational views. Wonderfully clean and comfortable. Ralf and his crew were very easy to deal with and gave outstanding service. We are SO delighted we chose this place. Great restaurants nearby and only a short walk to transport.
Marcelo was great and gave us extremely good advice.

Ralf's place in Buenos Aires is simply outstanding. The place is in a super location and the building is very secure. I would HIGHLY recommend that you stay here when you come to Buenos Aires! When I come back, we will definitely stay here again.

We spent a week in this lovely apartment and enjoyed every moment. We took advantage of the airport transfer which was well organized and convenient and were greeted by Andres who gave us a thorough tour of the unit and told us about the area and sights to be seen in BA. The apartment was spotlessly clean and equipped with everything one could need, a safe for personal items, coffee, tea, wifi, etc. the gym on the roof level was excellent; however the pool did not appear to be open, being fall and all.

Halfway through our visit, we had an unfortunate run-in with a motorcycle on busy Avenida Sante Fe at about midnight (warning, be careful crossing the streets, traffic signals are not strictly obeyed), our apartment keys were lost, camera broken, etc. and Marcelo kindly met us at the apartment with an extra key. Great service! We were also treated to an apartment cleaning midway during our stay.

We definitely give Ralf and his staff the highest rating and would hope to return and stay again.
May 2014

We had a great experience with this apartment! The apartment itself is modern, clean, and in a great neighborhood. Juan was a fantastic host. He was very nice and welcoming, and also very accommodating. He let us check in very early in the morning on our first day because our flight arrived in the wee hours. We also had a problem with the lock on the door of the apartment, and Juan came over within minutes to fix it. In sum, we were very happy we chose this apartment to rent and recommend it highly.

Juan e Gaby foram anfitriões espetaculares, nos deixando inteiramente à vontade durante nossa estada.
O apartamento estava exatamente como aparece nas fotos e tudo funcionou perfeitamente. A localização é excepcional, realmente próxima de ótimos restaurantes e demais facilidades, como metrô e mercados, por exemplo. A segurança nas ruas de Palermo também merece destaque. Não tivemos qualquer tipo de problema, independente do horário e da quantidade de pessoas nas ruas. Sentimo-nos seguros o tempo todo.
Juan e Gaby ainda nos deram ótimas orientações sobre como se locomover em Buenos Aires e nos ajudaram de todas as formas possíveis nos nossos objetivos, indicando sempre as melhores opções, inclusive no traslado desde o aeroporto de Ezeiza.
Assim, nossa viagem foi extremamente agradável, pois sabíamos que teríamos um porto seguro na cidade.
Recomendo fortemente esse apartamento e pretendo ficar por lá novamente numa próximoa oportunidade em Buenos Aires.
Ah, sim. Eles ainda nos facilitaram no dia da nossa saída, permitindo-nos ficar até um pouco mais tarde, evitando que ficássemos mais horas no aeroporto.
Deixo um grande abraço a Juan e Gaby e espero um dia poder retribuir todas as gentilezas.
Saúde e paz.

El apartamento es hermoso, amplio y muy bien equipado. Juan tiene todos los detalles cubiertos, por lo que una vez que llegas ahí es como estar en tu casa. El barrio es tranquilo y al mismo tiempo cercano a restoranes e interesantes tiendas.

Definitivamente recomendable para tu estadía en Buenos Aires.

Juan es muy amable y estuvo siempre presto a ayudarnos en lo que necesitemos, el departamento es tal como se muestra muy acogedor y con todo lo necesario y el barrio es muy tranquilo, muy cerca hay de todo, tiendas, restaurantes y buses.
Muy lindo el departamento, muy linda la zona y muy predispuesto Juan para ayudarnos que lo que necesitamos. La verdad es un lugar al que volvería si tuviese que volver a Bs.As.

I highly recommend this place and Juan as a host. I stayed at his place for five nights and it was a great experience.

As for the host, Juan speak fluent English and that helped me a lot. He helped me to replace a lost credit card and gave me a lot of advice on the city.

As for the location and apartment: You can't beat this location in Palermo. It's right in the middle of a bunch of cool bars, cafes and shops. The apartment is just as advertised with great heating and air conditioning. One thing to note, there's no laundry service in the building (but there's a laundromat on the block) and the "gym" is only a few pieces of old equipment, so don't expect a Western type gym here. But, you're there to see the city anyways, right?

Overall, I highly recommend this place and the host.

Great host, nice & large flat, good located in a charming neighborhood (few minutes to underground e close to a lot of restaurants, bars and coffes). We felt very well at Jaun place. I'd love to stay there again.

The apartment is beautiful and located in the most perfect part of town walking distance from great restaurants, shopping and clubs.  Juan was the most gracious host, waiting up for us when our plane was late and we were stuck in traffic for 3 hours! He took the time to show us around and provide us with lots of helpful information about the area and all the things we might need during our stay, and later in the week when I was very sick he was so kind and offered me help to get to a doctor etc... We had wonderful time on our trip and when we return to BA we would definitely stay there again! Excellent choice :)
Altamente recomendable el departamento, una ubicacion privilegiada y juan un anfitrion de primera! Estuvo en todos los detalles y nos hizo sentir como en nuestra casa!

Excelente Juan y Gabi!
Fueron muy atentos y agradables con nosotros! Acudieron puntualmente en los horarios coordinados y se ajustaron a nuestra demora. Ademas nos permitieron hacer late Chake out lo que permito estar en el departamento hasta le momento de nuestro vuelo.
RECOMENDABLES 100 % :)

Logement très bien situé dans un quartier agréable et animé. La description du logement est conforme et ce dernier est très confortable.
Mais surtout, Juan fait vraiment le nécessaire pour que votre séjour se déroule bien. Il est disponible en cas de besoin et très facilement joignable.

Je recommande fortement.
Exactly as described. Clean, tidy & Juan was great at welcoming us & providing a lot of helpful information. Water pressure in the shower was awesome.

Juan foi um excelente anfitrião, nos ajudou com várias dicas sobre a cidade, tivemos muita sorte, foi a primeira vez que utilizamos o Airbnb e a experiência não poderia ser melhor, devemos isso ao Juan que é extremamente simpático e prestativo, o apartamento é exatamente como as fotos, muito aconchegante e confortável, e muito bem localizado, o bairro é muito gostoso com diversos parques e próximo de tudo, é muito fácil a locomoção. Recomendamos o Juan para todos, e com certeza voltando para Buenos Aires faremos contato com ele novamente.

Juan & Gaby sont très flexibles concernant les heures de check-in & de check-out. Ils ont été accueillants et disponibles pendant toute la durée du voyage.
L'appartement convient parfaitement pour un séjour de quelques jours à Buenos Aires. Il est totalement conforme à l'annonce. Petit balcon bien exposé. Sauna au dernier étage de l'immeuble très appréciable.
Juan is a great host. He knows Baires really well and had good suggestions. The place was flawless and the location couldn't be better. Will stay at his place again.

Juan totally deserves the title of Super Host. He was so welcoming and eager to help. He went out of his way to help us out with certain situations. I would highly recommend Juan! The apartment is clean and quite. Really enjoyed the stay.

Die Unterkunft befindet sich in einer super Lage. Im Herzen von Buenos Aires. Das Appartement ist großzügig, sauber und hat alles was man benötigt. Juan ist ein super Gastgeber, er sorgt sich, bietet seine Hilfe stehts an und gibt einem viele hilfreich Informationen zur Stadt.
Leider war der Pool während unseres Aufenthaltes ohne Wasser, dennoch bietet die Umgebung so viel zu sehen, dass wir darauf mühelos verzichten konnten.
Wir würden auf jeden Fall gerne wiederkommen.

Spent a week in Juan's apartment. The unit is clean, comfortable and efficient. Especially appreciated the balcony. Location is great...lots of shops, restaurants, bars to explore and easy access to the subway and other parts of the city. Loved the coffee shop on ground floor for a convenient start to the day.

But the unit is only part of the equation. Juan is indeed a Super Host! He helped with transportation, provided excellent recommendations and was just great to interact with in all regards. Highly recommend a stay at Modern Studio Palermo Soho with Juan!
Juan was a perfect host, welcoming us and giving good recommendations. The apartment  very modern, clean and in a good location in Palermo. This is a nice neighborhood with all amenities closed by

Ha sido una experiencia fantástica, Juan es un anfitrión encantador, nos ayudó y nos dio muy buenos consejos e ideas durante la estancia, además se mostró flexible con las horas de entrada y salida. El apartamento tiene una ubicación excelente, cuenta con todo lo necesario y está limpio y ordenado. Un lugar ideal para una estancia en Buenos Aires

Just like all the other reviewers have said, Juan was a terrific host--very friendly and helpful.  He gave great recommendations on places to eat, drink, see and do.  The apartment is clean and well equipped with everything you need.  It is conveniently located in an excellent neighborhood, just a few blocks from all the action in Palermo Soho and easy access to the Subte train and EZE airport via the Tienda Leon bus.  I highly recommend staying here!

We had a wonderful stay in Juan and Gaby's apartment - everything went smoothly, from booking to check-out at 3am! The apartment has everything you need including plenty of towels and an umbrella which was appreciated, and is in a great location, walking distance to lots of restaurants and shops. Juan provided us with plenty of information and was always available to answer any questions. Highly recommended!

Juan was a great host. Not only was the apartment really well equipped and in in a perfect location, but also there were a lot of helpful touches (like guide books and power adaptors). The apartment was clean, safe, and quiet. It was bright and spacious and perfect for 1 or 2 people. My husband and I loved having breakfast every day on the balcony and feeling like locals in Palermo. I would definitely recommend staying here for anyone traveling to Buenos Aires!

Juan was an excellent host!  This was our first time in Buenos Aires so I had a lot of questions and Juan would respond to me instantly.  He had lots of recommendations that really helped.  The apartment is large and clean.  Very accommodating.  It is located in the best part of Palermo.  I would 100% recommend staying here!!!

For me, a person who likes to culture, art, music, food, and to be safe but does not want to be far from the above, the apartment is perfect!!
From accomodating my early arrival, to providing me with subtle cards to top up ( local travel cards which were very handy), to guide books and suggestions left from previous guests my syat here was like a home from home.
I stayed over 3-weeks and there was plenty of linen etc to cover my time there. I cannot write enough of positive things about my hosts and their place, I loved it!!

Excellent location, very clean and comfortable property, with all amenities needed. Safe and secure building, as well as the city (barrio). Awesome restaurants, and nightlife. Very close to all points of interest. I would definitely recommend this property to any traveler for business or pleasure.
El departamento es mucho mas lindo que en fotos, el baño impecable. Nos dejaron una cortesia muy buena! Y todo explicado. Vale la pena parar aca!

Nos encantó el departamento, súper ubicación, súper cómodo, muy lindo.
Los detalles de darnos información sobre Buenos Aires estuvo fabuloso, hasta tarjetas del metro nos prestaron. Extendimos nuestra estancia ahí y estuvo genial. ¡Completamente recomendable!

The apartment was sparkling clean.  Just as it looks in the pictures.  Location is absolutely great !  Nearby restaurants, bars and shops that Palermo has to offer.  Great neighborhood.   I definitely enjoyed my time at this place.
Excelente departamento, limpio, ubicación perfecta y muy buena atención

The apartment is exactly as seen on airbnb. The host Ralf was more than helpful. It was our first time in BA and staying in this location really made it na eease to see the best of Buenos Aires. It had plenty of amazing restaurants and shopping avenues.

Loved it..! What can I say that hasn't already been said?
Great Team making sure everything went smoothly. Loved the neighborhood, the View, it's one sexy apartment you're instantly 1st class once you step inside. Little touches like the two beers in the fridge and the bowl of fruit add a personal touch. I would Highly recommend booking this place and I'm definitely staying here again next time in Beautiful Buenos Aires..!

I have been in Buenos Aires at the Premium Loft from 21.07 - 30.07.2014.
Over all, I can say this place is really fantastic!
Stunning view - spacious loft - nice interior - perfect service starting with Ralfs team, the room service and also the security at the entrance.
Nearby are lots of good restaurants, nice shopping places and supermarkets. The Gym is well equipped and also with an amazing view to Rio de la Plata.
I had a great time and for sure I will come back to this place!

Ralf crew is very professional and makes your stay just more relaxing. Everything was just like the photos and Marcelo was just perfect with the tips we needed to know. They arranged transfer from the airport to the apartment which made our life easier. Definetly i eould go back! Ha a great time eating and drinking some wine!

Ralph is the perfect host! He made as feel home right from the very first minute. The apartment looked exactly as in the pictures, even prettier and comfier. Everything worked perfect, the view was absolutely fantastic, and the location could not be better, in the heart of Palermo. In so many words, it was really hard to pack our bags to get back home. Thanks BA4U for a perfect short stay!

Couldn't be any better, the flat have an amazing location, is beautifully decorated and the view is just outstanding! Walking distance to most of the trendy restaurants and bistros in Palermo. Definitely recommended!
10 puntos!

Everything was perfect. Ralfs place is lovely, great views and decked out to a very high standard. Location wise it was perfect for us, Palermo ist a great place - Close to Plaza Italia: Bus/ Metro
Super friendly and very easy to contact. This place comes Highly Recommended. Thanks for the fresh fruits.

Die wunderschöne Wohnung mit der herrlichen Aussicht vom Balkon auf das nächtliche Buenos Aires: einzigartig und empfehlenswert!

This loft apartment was amazing!  Ralf and his team were outstanding hosts!   The apartment is on the 25th floor and the west view from the balcony, watching the sun set is stunning!  It is in a great location of Palermo and the apartment had everything you could possibly want.  Ralf even supplied fresh fruit, and I appreciated the candles as it made for a nice evening ambience.  I did not want to leave the apartment.  The neighborhood is safe and friendly and convenient to everything, groceries, restaurants, bike paths, public transportation.   Thank you, Ralf (and BA4U team) for your hospitality!   I hope to stay with you again when I return next year :-)

Ralf and his team really understand the traveller's point of view as they are visiting BA for the first time...From the beer, water and snacks provided in the kitchen to the book of local attractions restaurant reviews and a small staff of people willing to help at every move!

We arrived late night and were assisted, very efficiently, by Ralf's staff member and he was very knowledagble and could speak almost perfect English (good for me and my wife).

The Condo is excellent; had everything we needed and more and was in a good location in a neighborhood we really got to know and enjoyed. Very close to the subway/Metro and to several restaurants, coffee shops, pubs and grocery stores. It was perfect for us...!

Although we didn't meet Ralf we were really supported by his team!

Really we liked everything and the entire condo and the check-in/check-out process was really throughout through with contingency plans in place in case of emergencies. These guys know what they are doing!
Excellent location. Super clean and the friendly and informative staff will have us staying here again!

This was a wonderful apartment and much larger than we thought! The view is definitely amazing as others have pointed out, and check-in and out was easy. The pool was key for these warm and humid summer days. Would definitely recommend it and stay there again!

Highly recommended. We have really enjoyed our stay in the apartment and Buenos Aires in general. The apartment is very clean, well equipped (air conditioner,  towels, hairdryer, shampoo, shower gel,  plates, ...) with the excellent location in the safe, friendly, colourful and vivid district - Palermo Soho. The communication with Marla - who is helping to manage the apartment was fantastic. We would definitely stay again here when visiting Buenos Aires.
Ótimas acomodações! Muito limpo e organizado, além de boa localização! Recomendo!

El apartamento es espectacular y muy bien ubicado.
Tiene una vista muy linda sobre la ciudad.
The apartement was really nice, great view. Lot of good restaurants nearby. Internet worked well.

Excellent stay all around. Amazing location, place is clean, safe, and the view can't be beat. Staff was extremely professional and reliable. If my travels ever take me back to BA this will be where I stay. Couldn't have been happier!
Ralf and his team are great hosts. The apartment exceeded my expectations by far! I had the time of my life. Thanks!

Excellent all up. Ralf and his team really deliver a high-quality experience. This kind of service really takes the Airbnb experience to a new level.

Great location & beautiful view.

The apartment was terrific.  It was bright and clean, and the views  of the city were spectacular.  The gym on the penthouse floor was usually empty, well equipped and also afforded fantastic floor-to-ceiling views of the city.  The building is situated conveniently a short walk from Plaza D'Italia, which is a transportation hub, and from the shopping and dining center of Palermo Soho.  An extra perk is that it's around the corner from one of the city's premier parillas, Carneceria, where you can get a great steak and creative cocktails.  Ralf's staff was friendly, professional and helpful.  They arranged for a cab to the airport at the end of the stay, and provided a hand-made book in the apartment of places to go and things to see and do in the area, and where to shop for all manner of things, and where to eat.  The service they provided was extensive and a real help.  I couldn't recommend Ralf's staff more highly.

Our stay at the lofts was lovely. Ralph and his team were great hosts to us.  The apartment is in a great location, Palermo, walkable to many great restaurants.   Our check in experience was awesome and Marcelo provided us with all the info we needed for our 5 night stay in buenos aires.  The apartment has everything you'd want and the balcony view can't be beat.  Would definitely stay here again! Thank you!

Staying in Ralf's lovely home made the entire experience! I felt completely at home. Everything we needed was available in the apartment.  Even down to having the radio station on the perfect Smooth Jazz channel! To be honest I didn't want to leave the apartment, but when we did it was perfect because all the best restaurants, bars, lounges were either on the same street or very close walking or cab distance. If you care to take the metro/subway, that was nearby as well. We went during Bueno's Aires winter, and I can no  longer imagine a life without heated marble floors! The apt was cozy and a perfect temperature.  I miss this little heaven and I highly recommend staying at Ralf's place because where you lay your head at night and where you wakeup in the morning makes all the difference!  Thank you Ralf!!!
Genial la atención y estancia. Recomendable 100%

We had a wonderful stay at the apartment. The pictures are exactly what you get, and the views are incredible from the balcony. The hot tub didn't work which was a shame, but other than that everything was perfect-we didn't want to leave! Marcelo welcomed us and was incredibly helpful and the book of restaurant recommendations was fantastic. Overall I would highly recommend this place!
The apartment was beautiful and it's in the best area in Palermo. Ralf & co. really made it feel like a home away from home and I would have to give a 5/5 to the apartment!

Ralph is a great host , the appartment is perfect, wonderful view, wonderful place, wonderful location!
I am traveling in Argentina, would stay longer, I am already plan to come back again in this appartment
Thanks a lot Ralph for hosting me in a so great way
Ciao
Raffaella

our host was very pleasant. Gave us a tour of the premises and things we could do around the neighborhood. it was great staying here easy to get the subte and plenty of restaurants around the apartment.

Really impressed by the level of detail and service by our host. Very well thought and was able to address all our queries in a timely fashion.

The apartment was amazing. Stunning views and comfortable in every way.
Todo perfecto

My wife and I had wonderful time in this place. The place was very clean and well decorated with amazing view of Buenos Aires. The host was very kind and gave us many useful knowledge about the city. The neighborhood was very cool, trendy with lots of nice restaurants and coffee shops. Banks, laundromat, supermarkets are all near the place. Even though the neighborhood was very safe, the 24 hour security in the building made us feel even more secure. The owner Ralph let us rest in one of his other studio until check in time because we arrived early. And once we checked in our apt, there was a honeymoon gift from Ralph. Kind gesture of him. And Marcelo check us in, gave us further useful tips and infos getting around town. Overall we are impressed with his professional team and the place. We enjoyed very much. Lovely place. Everything was perfect.

amazing location
helpful and efficient hosts
clean and well equipped
great building
can only recommend
Fantastic 1br apartment in an excellent Palermo neighborhood. Highly recommended!

The place was really nice, we had a problem with the air conditioning and it was repaired in the day.
Should be a bit more of cooking pans or plates, but the rest was all good!
Clean, good decoration, good bed, I would recommend it for sure!

We stayed three weeks and had a great time, Marla was super responsive and helpful with all our questions. The place was very clean and had everything we needed, great location. They lend you SUBE cards to use the public transport. Blackout shades were perfect for us since we stayed out late. Very safe neighborhood. There was some construction noise in the nearby apartment the last week we were there which was frustrating but of course not the hosts fault. Otherwise it was quiet. The hot water runs out and takes a while to make more so keep that in mind if you like to take long showers or like us we were two and taking a shower one after the other and it took us a few days to calibrate. The apartment get nice afternoon light and the sky looks beautiful at sunset.

Perfect stay in a great place. Ideal for single travelers or a couple.
Kitchen is well equipped even though I almost never used it. Same with living room. The bathroom is really nice and the shower works well. Nice that the bedroom is separated, the bed is comfortable and you got a couple of closets to store clothes in. Also a safe for passport and money are available.
A metro/bus card is available, you just need to top up. I used it a lot.
Got a lot of helpful recommendations. The area is really nice, lots of bars, restaurants, shops, cafes etc. Definitely the best area in Buenos Aires in my opinion.
They also helped me exchanging money with a decent rate when I ran out of pesos and forgot that it was public holiday.
Highly recommended to stay at this place!

Excelente departamento con una ubicacion privilegiada en la ciudad de Buenos Aires !
Esta propiedad está equipada con TODO lo que vas a necesitar para una gran estadía en el corazón de Palermo Soho, una de las mejores y mas seguras áreas de la ciudad. Literalmente a pasos de todos los medios de trasnportes publicos y grandes atracciones. Area de negocios, restaurants, bares y gimnasios.
Optima relación precio-calidad. El edificio esta en muy buen estado, siempre limpio y con elevador.
Marla y Matias son excelentes anfitriones y han estado en contacto conmigo todo el tiempo necesario, pero sin invadir mi privacidad en ningun momento.

Lo volveria a elegir sin dudarlo en el futuro.
Totalmente recomendable !

I had a great stay -- the apartment could not have been better suited to my needs. It was cheerful, exceptionally clean, quiet, and great value. The location was perfect, central but not on one of the over-trafficked streets that characterize much of Palermo. I would stay there again.
Lovely place, very comfortable and super well equipped!
Nice apartment in a great location. Close to everything, restaurants, bars, public transportation, etc. Would stay here again.

Cet appartement est tout simplement merveilleux. Très propre, son emplacement est parfait. J’ai louer plusieurs appartements, et forcé de constater que celui-ci et le meilleur, et de très loin. Je le recommande vivement.

Yo estoy muy contento con todo lo referente al departamento y con la atención recibida.
Cuándo hubo algún detalle para aclarar, el anfitrión se ocupó enseguida de ello.
El departamento está muy bien equipado y en una zona especialmente hermosa de Buenos Aires, teniendo un fácil acceso a cualquier otra. Yo estoy simplemente agradecido por el hermoso tiempo transcurrido allí
Perfect location and amazing place. Exactly like the pictures and was well equipped for a long term stay. Definitely would recommend.
Stayed four weeks in this apartment. It had everything we needed. Also in a great location. We would definitely stay again.
Muy linda casa con una ubicación única
Muy lindo departamento. Muy cómodo y bien ubicado en una zona muy divertida de Buenos Aires con muchas opciones gastronómicas y de entretenimiento.
Excelente apto e localização… Tinha tudo que precisávamos, além de ser aconchegante e charmoso..
appartement parfait pour séjourner à Buenos Aires. super localisation, propre et hôte accueillant!
El departamento tiene todo lo necesario, la ubicación es muy buena, funciona bien el internet.

Estuve muy conforme en mi estadía en este departamento.
El mismo es como se ve en las fotos. La atención de los anfitriones es muy buena y ellos están siempre cuando se los precisa.
La ubicación del depto. es también genial y hay suficientes medios de transporte para llegar a cualquier punto de la ciudad.
Hermoso depto en una gran zona de palermo. Super recomendable.
Ubicación Ubicación Ubicación y agradable Dpto con todo lo necesario.
Amazing location! Walking distance from loads of great bars, restaurants and shops. Flat was perfect size for the two of us with a really comfortable bed. Would recommend!

Beautiful apartment in a great location in Palermo. I really loved the way the apartment was decorated, and it felt more like a home than an Airbnb (which was great for a longer stay!). Daniele was super responsive and fixed any issues I had quickly

Muy lindo y completo el alojamiento, responde rápidamente a las dudas y me oriento hasta para las casas de cambio
Le dije que me encantaba el café, ya que consulte si había cafetera, y nos dejo una bolsita para pasar.
Además me encanto el folder hecho a mano con las indicaciones del lugar y hasta tarjetas de subte
Súper feliz en mi viaje
Excellent stay. Unbeatable location, clean apartment, helpful host. 5 stars
great place, great host really reccomanded
Genial el dpto, tal cual la descripción. Matias muy atento y respondía rápido a cualquier consulta. La ubicación muy buena.
Unos genios! El lugar hermoso, la atencion perfecta. Siempre atentos. Volveria a alquilar sin pensarlo. Super recomendable !

Danieles Place was amazing - very close to supermarkets, places to eat and drink, kiosks etc. everything you need pretty much.
He was also super responsive whenever there was small issues or questions I had.
He was really accommodating for us having a late checkin and also so kindly allowed us to leave our bags there for a few hours on our last day whilst we waited to go for a later flight.
The space itself is beautifully curated and there’s plenty of room to chill out.
The only small thing that was just a personal preference and situational problem was that the main air conditioning unit is in the living room which is great. However in the bedroom it is just an overhead fan, which didn’t necessarily help to cool us down, but we were in Buenos Aires during extreme heat even by their standards.
Also the kitchen is very well equipped for everything we needed and lots of random k gradients that got left behind overtime that were really useful.
Overall would recommend & great price

the place was as the pics, very clean comfortable and stylish. Daniele was a great host and very helpful.
It was in a quiet street.

Our stay was just perfect. Daniele was a great host - he met us when we arrived with two sets of keys, a map of Buenos Aires and a lot of helpful information. The apartment was lovely. Air conditioning. Towels. Dishes. Everything we needed and beautiful designed. It's on a quiet street just a few blocks from all the restaurants and shops we frequented.

Everything was as shown on pictures, neat and clean, and worked as expected, including hot water, weekly cleaning, wifi or cable tv. The area is very nice, well connected, and the apartment is on a really quiet street.
Daniele was kind and very fast answering to emails. Would surely come back.

Absolutely stunning apartment with the most spectacular views in ba.. Love the building and location is perfect! Ralf and company are always amazing and helpful, making everything a breeze! Will always stay at Ralfs places, they are all the best in buenos Aires!
Great house, super clean, perfect location! I definitely recommend.
We loved the apartment, the location and we definily will come back again. Danielle was an amazing cicerone.
O apartamento é ótimo, muito bem localizado, perto do metrô e a dois passos de uma das partes mais legais de Palermo Soho.O Daniele foi extremamente atencioso, recomendo muito!

My husband and I stayed here for our honeymoon in the beautiful Buenos Aires. The apartment was quite welcoming, with a chic aesthetic and comfortable furniture. The Palermo Viejo neighborhood was just right for us: plenty of great restaurants and amenities a short walk away, and we got to know the neighborhood easily. If you are not interested in taking a taxi, subway or walking for a while to get to a lot of the city, I would recommend maybe Recoleta or Monserrat. San Telmo was quite a distance, even with the subway. We love walking and the subway, but radio taxis were also relatively cheap.

Don't miss Don Julio, a popular and good value parilla just blocks away. It was busy when we went around 8pm on a Monday, but we got a glass of free champagne while we waited and the food and service were more than worth the wait. There's also a nice café off the beaten path at Gurruchaga and Beruti that's cheap, homey and great for breakfast.

Daniele was quick to respond to our messages and overall it was a great experience.

This place is fabulous! The apartment felt luxurious and was spotlessly clean. When I first found this place on airbnb I thought maybe it was too good to be true, but it is the real deal! It felt like affordable luxury. The photos are spot on. Marcello welcomed us warmly and was extremely helpful in showing us things like how the heated floors work, how to switch the TV between Spanish and English, how to reserve the top floor jacuzzi, etc. He also gave us great advice on places to eat. A very helpful booklet with neighborhood information was also provided. The location was perfect for what we wanted. It's very close to the metro so it was easy to get anywhere in the city. There were also several great restaurants within a 2-block radius. We enjoyed wonderful sunsets from the balcony every night. If we had any questions there was someone just a phone call away to help us (and a phone is provided in the apartment). I highly recommend any of the properties that are hosted by Ralf. It was an excellent experience.

My husband and I stayed here for 4 nights and it was perfect! Clean, modern, spacious, walkable.  Ralf was perfect host and easy to connect with. The location is close to subway, great restaurants & shopping, great for running in city park.  We loved the loft. We had breakfast on balcony every morning. Nice having two bathrooms too!  We would definitely recommend to others.

From the  first communication with Ralph, I knew he was an exceptional host -- responsive and super helpful!   I was never disappointed; he answered all my questions, provided great advice and coordinated taxis, etc in advance of our trip.  I felt totally at ease arriving into Buenos Aires.  Upon arrival to the apartment, he greeted us promptly, made us feel comfortable and got us settled quickly!  The apartment is just as the pictures show -- modern, clean and cute!   The piece de resistance is the balcony with the killer view (with AMAZING sunsets).   We had coffee out there in the morning and wine in the evening before heading out for dinner.   Palermo Soho is an excellent location and the building is really lovely, modern and safe with 24 hour security (not to mention a great pool!)     We walked many places from the apartment easily but also could hop on the metro, bus or into a cab in minutes!  There were a ton of bars, restaurants and shops right around us.  We so enjoyed our stay and would not hesitate to return if we're so fortunate to do so.  This apartment really made our first Buenos Aires experience extra special.

Everything about this apartment was excellent and exactly as advertised. Modern, clean, gorgeous views, super-convenient to wandering around Palermo.

Ralf met us upon arrival and told us everything we needed to know.

This place is just the perfect jumping-off point for a legit stay in BA. Highly recommended.

Being in Palermo is a perfect spot to walk around the trendy areas of BA - Palermo and Canitas. Plenty of places to eat, hang out and enjoy the local vibe. Fully recommend the apartment and Ralf's team, they really go the extra mile to make your stay easy and memorable!

We had an AMAZING time in the Premier Loft.  Incredible location and balcony with a beautiful view of the city.  We stayed over NYE and the celebratory display of fireworks was wonderful!  Location was perfect and very accessible to everything we did and it was so nice each day/night to come back to clean, air conditioned apartment!  Check-in was easy and communication was always very responsive.   Rey highly recommend this loft apartment and would not think twice about staying here again!

Such an awesome place. The pictures are accurate, and the place is even better than I expected. The view is really wonderful. Great amenities. Ralf and his team are so helpful. Couldn't have asked for a better experience!!

Amazing views from this clean, modern apartment. 24h security, nice pool, great neighborhood. Everything about the stay was great. Host met us at arrival and arranged for airport transfers each way which was nice and convenient. A nice 5-10 minute walk to the center of Palermo Soho with all the boutiques and restaurants/bars.

Will definitely stay again.
The apartment was as wonderful as per the pictures, great location in a lively area with excellent restaurants and very convenient public transport. Sunset drinks in the terrace hard to beat!

Loved the loft. It's exactly what you see in the photos - clean, open, comfortable. Great balcony and view of the city. In walking distance to many bars, restaurants, shops, and grocery stores.

Ralf and his staff gave us a helpful overview of the neighborhood when we arrived and were very responsive to any questions we had along the way. Would highly recommend and hope to stay there again in the future.

My wife and I had a very nice stay at the loft for 4 nights. Space lived very well for 2 people. Very clean and exactly as shown in pictures. Great walkable location and easy access to transit. Palermo Hollywood neighborhood with great shops and restaurants an easy 15 minute walk. Views and sunsets tough to beat!

Our stay at Ralf's home was PHENOMENAL.
The home: amazing. Very clean, very comfortable. Literally, it had everything we need, and tons of things we didn't. Ralf and his team thought of everything. There was also a really helpful guide that provided tips, places to eat, etc. We read the whole thing from front to back - what a wealth of information!

The are: perfect. You can literally walk to just about anything. We only hopped in a can once, and that was only because we were too tired (and maybe a bit too tipsy) to walk... great location.

Ralf and team - the best. This is by far, the best customer service I've had in all of my Air BnB experiences. There's always a little bit of uneasiness when doing an Air BnB especially in another country... but Ralf and his team made me comfortable and confident from the very first communication. They are so thorough, and thoughtful... I couldn't have asked for a better experience.

Perfect location to stay in Buenos Aires! Palermo is the most recommendable Barrio to stay. Close to the apartment you will find lots of Cafes and Restaurants.
I really enjoyed Claudias hospitality, kindness, professionality and flexibility. The apartment is spacious, light and well equipped. From the rooftop you have an amazing view over the city. Thanks for everything!

Claudia gave a nice review, and the same thoughts are returned.
She is always there to help, she cares for the people who stay in the apartments and if you need anything she will help with this too.
A honest and genuine person and super friendly as well.
Amazing place, spectacular view of the city! I definitely recommend it over staying in a hotel. Ralf and his staff were very accommodating. I'll definitely be back!

Excelente! Muy Buena ubicación. Nos recibió Marcelo, quien fue sumamente amable. Nos dejaron agua y fruta de cortesía. El lugar estaba impecable. Hermosa vista de la ciudad. Edificio super seguro! 100% recomendable.

You really can't beat the view from the 25th floor, just amazing.
add to it a beautiful apartment, a very helpful and knowledgeable always available host, and you got the recipe for the perfect vacation, what else can you ask:)
p.s: thanks for the awesome Champagne.

10/10

I WOULD GIVE RALPH AND HIS APPARTMENT AN 11 OUT OF 10!
I HAVE RENTED MANY AIRBNB'S IN BUENOS AIRES AND THIS IS BY FAR, THE VERY BEST.
RALPH IS A SUPER HOST, THE APARTMENT IS ABSOLUTELY GREAT IN EVERY WAY. THE MOST RECOMMENDED APT IN BUENOS AIRES!
Ralf has been exemplary in his hosting capabilty. And flexible this was a great location and stay. Second time at ralfs keeps getting better.

This Airbnb experience was special in many ways.

First of all, Ralf is the best host I've ever had. He's a very nice and gentle German living in Buenos Aires, and he brings all the care and attention to detail that characterizes his country to make a trip to Buenos Aires exceed your expectations.

The loft at the 25th floor was just amazing with a stunning view, excellent appliances and microscopical cleanliness. When you stay in one of Ralf's apartments, it won't be only about having a place to stay that's comfortable and has a good location: it's about the experience of excellence, which is dangerously attractive, because it makes you want to stay inside in Winter!

Ralf checked us in very late in the night, and welcomed us with a nice tour and everything we could need to make us feel at home from the very first minute, even a great bowl of fresh fruit in the fridge!

The location is one of the best in Buenos Aires, very quiet but at a couple blocks from stores, restaurants and some of the most beautiful parks in the city.

I would recommend you to try one of Ralf's apartments next time you go to Buenos Aires, and I'm sure I'm going to do the same on my next trip!

A true 5 star experience.
Excelente el Dpto. Todo impecable y veraz. Volveremos.
Very nice appartement in a perfect location in palermo Soho. Perfect welcoming by Marcelo.

The apartment is beautiful and clean, with everything you need. The building was new and clean also, and was in a great location close to transportation, convenient to everything. The views from the apartment and the gym were spectacular. Check-in and check-out were easy, and Marcelo and Ralf were friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.

Ralf’s place is fantastic in many ways: great location that makes it easy to explore all the major attractions of the city, the fantastic view over BA, the design of the loft, the amenities readily available, the quick and uncomplicated communication, the cleanliness, etc. It is a ‘home away from home’ that we truly enjoyed for the last 9 days. It won’t be the last time!

I was staying in this apartment for 2 months. And It was one of my best experiences via Airbnb. Everything was perfect starting from communication regarding booking the apartment ending with the check out. Ralf is very flexible, supportive and friendly. If you need an early check-in, a transfer from the airport, some tips about the city, some utensils for the apartment-no problem, you will get an instant response, if Ralf is not available for some days, his team will support you, so you will always have someone to ask or communicate. The apartment is very clean, with a lot of sunlight and a breathtaking view. I really enjoyed every sunset in the apartment just sitting on the balcony and viewing the city from above.
Near the building there are some grosseries, little store, subway 2 streets down the street and many cafes.
I got the recommendation for this apartment from my German colleagues and it met all my expectations!
Thank you Ralf so much for everything!

Excellent service and location, and the loft itself is just beautiful. Couldn't have wished for a better experience.

Ralf and his team have been very responsive from the first point of contact all the way to check out.

Thanks so much.

Reinhold
Excelent stay and great host!

Amazing stay in BA, extremely convenient location at the intersection of Palermo Soho, Palermo Hollywood, and major transportation hub to many other neighborhoods. Ralf greeted us and was very thoughtful and responsive throughout our stay. Would highly recommend!

My partner and I very much enjoyed our recent visit to the beautiful city of Buenos Aires, made all the better by being able to stay in Daniele and Gabriela's apartment. The apartment is comfortable and well-located. We walked from the apartment to very many good restaurants and interesting sights throughout the city, including from the city centre on one occasion, as well as traveling on the underground train system - with at least two close by stations. Daniele was very friendly, staying up to meet us when we arrived from a late plane, and gave us helpful advice about the apartment and the city. We recommend this apartment to any travellers to Buenos Aires.

My boyfriend and I stayed at Daniele and Gabriela's place in late October 2013 for a week. The Palermo Design Suite met all of our expectations and was the perfect place for our stay.

1. Cleanliness & Comfort - we arrived at the apartment and it was well cleaned and kept. Bed was comfortable and apartment had all amenities you could need for a week of stay (i.e. wine openers, wifi, towels, etc.) Neighborhood was relatively quiet.

2. Location & convenience - located in Palermo Soho, the apartment is really close to public transportation and within walking distance to amazing bars and restaurants.

3. Service - Prior to our trip, Daniele answered many of our questions and was able to help us get ready for our excursions in Buenos Aires. When we arrived, Gabriela let us in and showed us around the apartment. She asked if we had plans for the week and said should we have any questions, we could email her/Daniele. We were visiting a friend who showed us around, so we did not rely on their offer.

I stayed at Daniele and Gabriella's apartment for 5 days and the experience was fabulous. Not only are they so helpful (I asked many questions and Daniele responded almost immediately) but their apartment is located in a very nice and quiet area Palermo. The apartment is clean and modern and there is no noise at night or during the day like many downtown residences. I spent time at 9 museums which are on the East side of Buenos Aires, meaning a reasonable cab ride. There are many markets to walk to if you want to buy fresh produce and groceries, if you like to cook in. The apartment is well furnished and there was nothing missing at all.

All in all wonderful people and a great apartment at a reasonable price. I would definitely go back.
