Thanks for making my first airbnb experience a great one!

I found Daniele's and Gabriella's organization to be better than most hotels that I stay at, and I'm on the road for most of the year.

The apartment itself is great! It looks even better than the photos. I stayed for one month and loved every minute of it. It's extremely clean and modern, the internet is more than fast enough, and it's in an awesome part of town.

I highly recommend this place for anyone traveling to BA. Thanks again to Daniele and Gabriela for the hospitality.
The apartment is fantastic. Beautiful views, really well equipped and amazing location. Will definitely come back. And Ralph is a super host.

I can't recommend this apartment enough!! This place is fantastic in terms of location and amenities, but where it really shines is in working with Ralf and Marcelo - they made everything so easy! The apartment itself has everything you could need, including some knock-out views and a great gym/spa situation. The second half bath is totally key. The location is so perfect, and the Sube card was hugely hugely appreciated. We will be back to BA and we will be certain to stay here. Thanks gentlemen!!

A great apartment in a great location. The apartment was as advertised: clean, comfortable, well furnished and a pleasure to stay in. The views are spectacular and you'll find yourself wanting to stay in some nights just to enjoy the apartment. It's very close to great restaurants, the parks and the Subte (subway) so getting around is quite easy.

Ralf and team are very easy to work with and attentive when needed. Communication was perfect and check in/out was flawless.

When back in BA we will gladly stay here again.
Ralf is a great host and went out of his way to be accommodating. The place is great, views are amazing and the neighbourhood very cool.
Great place, just like in the pictures, good location, and very clean. Ralf was very helpful, and always available. I recommend this place.
Die Einrichtung, Ausstattung und Betreuung durch Ralf und Team war sehr gut.
Great apartment with beautiful views. The attention from Ralf's staff was outstanding. Thank you very much!

Ralf and his team were our first contact when starting our new life in Buenos Aires, and they welcomed us in a way that went beyond everything we had expected. We were introduced to the apartment (a spectacular view on the city, a very nice design and a highly convenient location, among other things) but also to the life in the city, the good habits to take, where to find the shops for our daily needs... A special thanks to Marcello who was in charge of our arrival and who is one of the sweetest persons that we have met here (and Argentinian are all pretty sweet ;)). We warmly recommend Ralf's services!

This sophisticated loft handled by Ralf's team BA4U has an incredible panoramic view of Buenos Aires (try to catch at least one sunset from it!), and all the amenities were exactly as described in the post. My expectations were pretty high coming in after reading so many boasting reviews, and they were definitely met. Check-in and check-out were very easy, the loft was flawlessly clean upon arrival, and fresh fruit and water were waiting for me. Despite paying US-level prices for it in a country where everything is currently quite cheap, I feel that it was definitely worth it, and I would want to use their services again if I come back to Buenos Aires.
Excellent professional management and very beautiful apartment.
Gorgeous view and great area. Curtains very effective at blacking out the lights. AC worked great. Would definitely return
Outstanding all around.  Would recommend to all, it’s a great place and a great host.

This apartment is as advertised, GORGEOUS!  One of my best AirBnB experiences.  The apartment is so relaxing, the pool is amazing, the gym is stunning (views from the 31st floor), Carniceria restaurant(best place to eat close by) is just around the corner along with many other places to eat.  I would DEFINITELY come back.

Ralf's place was absolutely perfect for our stay in Buenos Aires! Centrally located, incredibly clean, and has everything you need for your stay. The views from the balcony are incredible and the gym is amazing. The building also has a 24hr security guard at the entrance so we felt even more safe (although the local area is completely fine - never felt threatened even walking back late at night). We didn't have a chance to meet Ralf in person but he's in the building if you need anything, otherwise they let you enjoy the apartment on your own. Marcelo did our check-in and walk through - he couldn't have been nicer or any more helpful - he's the perfect person to help you get acclimated with the unit. We're  very satisfied with our stay at Ralf's place and will definitely stay here again next time we're in Buenos Aires.
Everything  was very convenient - location, access, gym etc. Super confy bad and efficient aircon. Recommended!

Very nice apartment. Marcelo, who was in charge of our check-in, was a really great guy ... very helpful, personable, and kind. Ralf, the manager of the apartment, was outstanding in terms of communicating with us. The place itself, on the 25th floor, has beautiful views of the city. Very well-appointed. Great neighborhood, near parks and restaurants and cultural sites. Highly recommended.

Daniele and Gabriela were the perfect hosts! I received the apartment in great condition. Just as the pictures, it has everything you could want. It was a key component in making my trip awesome. It's near Santa Fe ave, a main artery of the city and host to a number of shops and Alto Palermo shopping center, a very posh mall. Also walking distance to the shops and restaurants of Palermo Soho. Many cafés and restaurant options as well as nightlife in the booming Plaza Serrano are at your disposal. The area where the apartment is located is very safe (walked around many days after 3 am) and is very quiet in the evening. I will be sure to return to BA and stay in this awesome apartment.

Somos Colombianas, vinimos Argentina hacer un posgrado, nos encanta el Depto, es super cómodo, nuevo, lindo, ubicado en un lugar tranquilo y las personas que se encuentran en el son muy agradables. Zona estratégica, restaurantes, transporte y supermercados cerca. Estamos muy contentas con la anfitriona Claudia es una persona muy querida y amable.

Estuve 2 meses el depa es muy bueno para ir en pareja o solo si se busca tranquilidad para estudiar o trabajar, queda a 20 min de plaza serrano ( lugar de boliches ) y muy bien ubicado de shoppping, supermercado.
tiene pequeños detalles de arquitectura en los baño, y un balcon pequeño.
pero totalmente recomendable.
creo que sin duda los encargados del edificio yolanda y victor lejos hacen mas amable la estadia ya que te ayudan con aseo y cualquier problema.
el lugar no tiene telefono fijo, ami me habian dicho que iba a tener pero no habia, por lo cual es complicado y no hay opcion para hacer llamadas, salvo salir a cabinas publicas.

en general bastante bueno, aun si el dinero que se paga merece que se mejoren los problemas de terminaciones del apartamento, pero en general bien.
I was very happy with the location, comfortable room and bed, Well equipped kitchen. Plenty of towels. Helpful small staff. Working air-conditioner. Totally great.
It was very nice!

Great apartment with good location. 6 blocks to Plaza Serrano and to Avenida Santa Fe. I stayed 2 months there and it was very quiet and clean place. Fast Internet and a wide choice of TV channels was great. Claudia is a great host and all over the place if there is any issue. She is a great help and very friendly

I stayed in two of Claudia's apartments over a four month stay in BsAs.  This is an awesome location!  Close to transportation,  shopping and entertainment, but away from the busy noise of the city center.  WiFi worked very well, having laundry in the building is a very nice amenity.  The apartments were bright and fit my needs perfectly.  Victor, Yolanda and Mesias are all terrific, friendly and helpful.  Claudia is quick to respond to your inquiries.  I was very comfortable here and sad to leave!

Claudia's apartment is in a great quiet location of Palermo. Super easy access to the central of Palermo and many good restaurants and bars. The apartment was clean and well-kept with modern appliances. She was also super helpful when I locked myself out of both my room and the safe! I'd highly recommend staying with Claudia.
Fantastic apartment in the heart of Palermo. Stunning view, plenty of space and excellent WIFI and TV options (Netflix, YouTube, etc.)

If you are looking for your home away from home while in Buenos Aires YOU HAVE FOUND IT!!   You honestly don’t need to look any further.  AMAZING view and we didn’t want to leave.  Ralf and his team are some of the best hosts we have ever had.  Helped us check in early and gave us a place to relax before our flight. Great location and you can walk everywhere you need to go and very safe.  The pool and gym were fantastic and even if you don’t want to work out. Go up there for the view.   WiFi worked great as well!  When I come back to the city I won’t stay anywhere else!!
Awesome place, best location to explore the city

The other reviews say it all. Great value at the location and very nice view. Modern design and very relaxing place. A little weird at the check-in process.

性价比很高，很推荐。景色很好。
1. 地点距离最有名的牛排馆DON JUILO 走路十分钟。距离酒吧夜店区和几个主要公园打的也十来分钟的距离，距离老城区和一些老景点就有点远，我会在马蜂窝上写一个攻略供参考。
2. 助理MARCELO人会说英文，很热情特别搞笑。
3. 在公寓里可以直接看日落，还可以到顶楼看BA日升日落全景。
4. 泳池不在顶楼而是在楼下的阴凉处，秋天来就已经太冷用不了了。
5. 设施很完备，洗浴产品都很齐全。
6. 这个区本身很安全，小区的门卫又是特别严格。
7. 装饰风格现代，很干净。
8. 没有洗衣机

我们入住的时候是助理和我们碰面，但是遇到艾彼迎工作人员也入驻，我们还和他攀谈起来，房主以为我们和他一起的，还亲自迎接热情打招呼，但一听说我们只是普通房客，立刻变脸转身自顾和那个人说话了，搞得场面一度很尴尬。你知道的。

总体来说不错，而且你应该也不会那么巧遇到我们这种情况。

I always search for hours on AirBnB before booking. If you are like me, you can stop here. This one was perfect! It is exactly as described (really better). Ralf and his team are super responsive. The location is absolutely perfect for travels around Buenos Aires. It is a very safe property. You get a neighborhood feel, but also very close to transportation and the action of Palermo Soho. Spotlessly clean. Every amenity you can imagine.  And I even have a collection of breathtaking sunsets seen from the balcony. When I come back to BA I will check to see if this is available because this would be my easy first choice.

Very nice, modern accommodation with a wonderful view (25th floor).  Very centrally located near Plaza Italia.  Friendly host.  Fitnesscenter in the house (free of charge), possibility to wash (for a fee).  Very safe (entrance guarded 24h).  Very recommendable.
on 25th floor so great views and convenient location

Really excellent apartment with great hosts. Ralf’s team was always available and super kind. The apartment is better than the pictures portrait with a great glimpse of Buenos Aires just few meter away. We would definitely recommend it and stay again there.

Ralf’s apartment is beautiful. It has gorgeous views of the city, a beautiful balcony to sit and enjoy the view and your morning coffee, and it’s in a great neighborhood close to many restaurants and other sites. The bed is super comfortable, the apartment is very clean and the whole place felt very luxurious. We would absolutely stay here
again and would highly recommend it to others!

The apartment is great, with an spectacular view of the city. It is the the middle of Palermo’s best restaurants and 2 blocks from the subway. Ralf was very easy to get in touch with and extremely helpful. We loved it. It is definitely worth getting back to.
Amazing amazing amazing view! The apt is huge, stylish, modern, clean, comfortable, etc. better than in pics for sure!

I'm always in Buenos Aires for business but never tried Airbnb before. Great first time experience! The loft is very nice well located, lots of places to go around. Ralf was always friendly since the first contact and Marcelo who's in charge of check-in and first orientations during our arrival was excellent. For sure, I'll be back soon ☺️
Perfect location, stunning view, and an extremely helpful host. If it’s your first time in BA stay here! The apartment is exactly as it looks in the pictures.
Ralph and Marcelo were great hosts.  Marcelo helped with the check in process and is very informative.  The apartment was very very clean and modern and I felt very safe there.

I had a lovely time staying at the Premier Loft. It is absolutely stunning, with the best city views of Buenos Aires. The location was ideal, quiet and safe about 7-10 min walk to lots of great cafes, bars restaurants, beautiful parks. The bed is super comfy as well as the kitchen and living room area. Everything that you need for a comfortable stay is provided. I was accommodated with early check in and late check out which was the most convenient. I am so grateful for your hospitality and a beautiful place to explore this amazing city from. Thank you!
Great spot. The place was very clean and Ralf was very helpful.

Ralfs place offer a unique experience of Buenos Aires.  The views are amazing and the sunsets stunning.  The apartment is clean, stylish and very comfortable, located walking distance from great coffee shops and shopping.

Ich wurde sehr freundlich aufgenommen und habe mich immer gut aufgehoben und sicher gefühlt. Die administrativen Interaktionen beschränkten sich auf das absolut notwendige, wenn es ein Problem gab, war aber innerhalb der Woche immer jemand da. Die Einzimmerwohnungen sind gemütlicher, als man das auf den Fotos sehen kann und sehr praktisch eingerichtet. Das ist definitiv ein Ort, an dem man auch längere Zeit gut verbringen kann (ich war 12 Wochen hier.) Alle Wohnungen sind sehr ähnlich und unterscheiden sich nur in Grösse und Anordnung von Bad und Küche. Das Internet funktioniert ausgezeichnet, hier wurde nicht gespart (Ausfälle kommen aber in ganz BsAs vor). Bei meinem nächsten Besuch in Buenos Aires werde ich sicher zuerst wieder hier nach einer Unterkunft suchen.
Die Umgebung ist einigermassen sicher und viele Attraktionen, wenn man Tango tanzt sind ganz in der Nähe. Hier am Rande von Palermo ist man definitiv besser aufgehoben als im traditionellen "Palermo Viejo" oder "Palermo SOHO". Dort findet man fast nur noch Chickey-Mickey-Touristen-Läden aber kaum noch Lebensmittel- oder Gemüsehändler.
Innerhalb von 3 Blocks findet man Busse, die an alle interessanten Orte der Stadt führen.

Mi estadía en el departamento fue genial. Me gustó mucho el barrio, muy bien ubicado, con restaurantes y supermercados cerca. Claudia siempre fue muy clara en todo los detalles sobre el alquiler y estuvo dispuesta a ayudarme ante cualquier inquietud que yo tuviera. Una gran experiencia!

Great place in a great location. I enjoyed staying in this place a lot. You can't imagine the feeling of being able to just walk home from a bar or club. I took mass transit only a few times during my stay, since I could reasonable walk any where.

The place is close to good supermarkets, gyms and excellent tango school.

I took away one star for unstable internet. This can be a bit annoying, especially when you have no connection for a few days. If you want to work remotely from home, this might not be the best place. Or maybe it is the same over the whole city, I don't know.

Los dos meses que estuvimos fueron realmente increíbles. Es un lugar acogedor que te hace sentir como en casa. Además está cerca de todo, por lo tanto, es una ventaja tremenda.
Claudia fue genial, respondió todas nuestras inquietudes y nos ayudó cuando teníamos algún problema. Sin duda volvería, es un lugar tranquilo, donde uno se siente como en su hogar.

Fue muy agradable alojarme en este departamento. Un agradecimiento muy especial para Yolanda y Víctor que me trataron con mucha amabilidad.

Gracias Claudia.
Excelente local. Bem localizado. Apartamento ótimo!

My boyfriend and I stayed for our first visit to Buenos Aires for a few days. We enjoyed our stay very much. The location is very central to different fun parts of the Palermo neighborhood. Gabriela and Danielle were also extremely quick to respond to us before and throughout our stay. They helped us a lot with recommendations and extra advice we asked during our stay. The check in and check out process was extremely easy and very organized. The was spacious and had a nice layout for the two of us. It was nice having a house phone and Wi-Fi access very clearly set up for us. I would recommend booking with them for sure.
Great experience, clean, tidy and well located. Great to stop by and explore the surroundings.

Gabriela and Daniele were great hosts. The apartment was very clean, comfortable and centrally located. We were in walking distance to many great restaurants, grocery stores, and shops. They even made us a custom map on google to show us where we could get groceries and do laundry in walking distance to the apartment. Wifi was also super fast :) I'd stay here again.

I stayed at Gabriela's place for just about a week in BsAs and it was quailty all around. Fantastic location on nice quiet side street with plenty of cool places around. Room is just as advertised and a great place to stay. Will definitely try to stay here again on my next trip.

O apartamento ,é muito bom, exatamente como as fotos.
Sala bem arejada e iluminada, o banheiro muito confortável, e o design muito bonito, banheiro com iluminação cromoterápica, muito reconfortante principalmente no momento do banho.
Localização próxima de transportes, metro , ônibus e táxis.
Na esquina encontra-se o restaurante 1810, excelente as empanadas e a comida regional.
Próximo a supermercados, cafés, sorveterias e comércios de frutas, quiosques também.
Gabriela sempre atenta às questões e muito solicita.
Serviço de limpeza eficiente e de confiança.
Zelador muito educado e o prédio organizado e limpo.
Local seguro.
Com certeza uma estadia tranquila, e recomendável.
This place was perfect. Just as the photos show. Great host.  Excellent location and safe with security guard.  Beautiful place with amazing views. Very clean.  We loved it.

This is a great place to stay in Palermo! Well decorated, comfortable, and spotless apartment near the top of a tower. The view is amazing! I didn’t meet Ralf but with Marcelo check-in and out was super easy. I would definitely stay here again.
we had a Very nice stay. We be back

This was our second time staying in one of Ralf’s apartments.  You can’t beat the location and view plus it is bright and stylish.  We love the neighborhood and ease of getting around plus the building offers wonderful amenities like a cool pool after a long hot day.  Definitely a great place to stay!
Beautiful loft exactly like the pictures show.  Perfect accommodation and great check  in . Love the  neighbourhood and close to the subway. Very clean and comfortable bed. Highly recommended.

My wife and I had a wonderful holiday stay at this apartment. The previous comments we read before our stay set a high expectation, and I am happy to say it Ralf and his team exceeded it. I would give 6 stars if it were possible.

The apartment was excellent (the photos were accurate), the building perfected located, and the building felt very safe and "high-end" with a manned security access gate. We used the gym, sauna, and pool which were great. We were also pleased to find that the surrounding streets were safe and there were no issues with walking to nearby Soho both day and night.

Ralf's team told me they manage 25 units in this building and the professional approach was very evident. For instance, we had a mid-night flight on the day of our departure and the team gave us access to another room to store our luggage after our check out - very much appreciated.

I have no criticisms at all - room was well appointed, clean, and well maintained.

C’ero già stata negli appartamenti di Ralf , sono molto el avanti arredati con buon gusto , pulizia impeccabile , edificio di categoria con ottimi servizi, palestra all’ultimo piano con vista mozzafiato su tutta Buenos Aires , consiglio vivamente di prendere in considerazione questi appartamenti, io ci tornerò di sicuro .

we've been welcomed very well by Marcelo. everything was very clear and explicit.
we loved the place.
just, one little point is that sound insulation between apartments is not so good , you can hear discussion and music with neighbours if your upstairs in the bedroom

This Loft is just as you see in the images. The location is perfectly placed in between many restaurants, bars and attractions. It is a very safe area in Palermo Soho and communication with the host and his help makes everything seamless. One could not ask for more.

Me and my girlfriend had booked the appartement for three days but we liked it so much that we decided to stay one more day and that was no problem. The communication between me and the host was fantastic during the stay. The appartement was very nice spacious and clean. The view from the balcony was breathtaking and the location is perfect in the heart of Palermo. The building has great security and a sauna and hot tub that were very nice as well. We really enjoyed our stay here!

What a wonderful experience! The loft apartment was just beautiful and exceptionally clean and well-appointed. The location (and the views!) were spectacular. Ralf and his team were amazing hosts! I can't rate this stay more highly!
Excellent location and the host had constant communication with us to meet our needs.

Excelente apartamento: amplio, luminoso, hermoso, totalmente equipado, súper bien ubicado, con una vista impresionante.
Personal anfitrión muy atento y rápido en responder.
Altamente recomendable.
A great modern apartment in a lovely location , we had a wonderful stay

It was standard service. Not impressed. It looked a lot cleaner and modern via pictures. The television kept making weird noises and hard to control the volume. The stairs were unstable and there was dust everywhere. You can here people shower and flush the toilet above the bedroom. Hard to sleep.

Our first trip to Buenos Aires and Ralf’s team made it an incredible experience!

The apartment and views of the city were fantastic and we were walking distance from great restaurants!

His team was helpful with recommendations and anything we needed.

10/10 would recommend and we can’t wait to come back!
Beautiful home and great location. Super clean and well stocked and perfect starting point for walking around the city. Would recommend!

Ralf & team could not have been better.  From the bottle of Malbec and 2 glasses waiting for us upon check-in to the fresh fruit basket too.  This was our first visit to Buenos Aires so we had many questions.  All were answered promptly & accurately and provided great help.  Would not hesitate recommending this place or any other of Ralf's locations.

Excelente experiencia. Preguntamos por una cafetera de capsulas y a la llegada tenismos una Nespresso nueva.
Todo muy bien y excelente atencion. Volveria sin dudarlo.

Las fotos no hacen justicia al apartamento. Es mucho más bello limpio y bonito que lo que se ve. Además tienen servicio de vigilancia 24 h. Zona muy segura y los
Anfitriónes siempre están pendientes de resolver cualquier cosa y son súper amables. No dudaría ni 3 segundos en volver repetir y recomendar a cualquiera.
Vale mucho la pena !! Estancia inmejorable !

The place and host are Perfect!! 10/10
Super indico. Vista linda, espaço impecável. Vou voltar mais vezes com certeza e indicar para outros amigos

Séjour mémorable. Bien situé, on a eut accès à l’aeroparc pour vol interieu( Mendoza, Iguazu) proche des ligne de transport en commun. Quartier avec multiples resto tous accesible à pied.
Ralph a été disponible durant toute notre séjour, avec des recommandations pertinentes!

Hortensia was very welcoming and friendly and her apartment is very well situated and within easy walking distance of the main tourist points such as the Casa Rosada. It is on the 10th floor and very quiet with a nice terrace.

Todo muy bien!!! Tranquilo, limpio, bien equipado, ...
Muchas gracias.

Clean, strong wifi, good heaters, enough hot water, good neighborhood, supermarket, laundry, ATM and fruit market very near. We enjoyed our stay in Gabriela's apartment. The communication via message was also great, Gabriela answered very fast. Thank you!
We had a great stay in this lovely apartment. Gabriella was very accommodating with our late arrival and everything was exactly as described. We would stay here again!

Excelente apartamento! Aconchegante, completo e muito bem localizado, próximo a diversos excelentes restaurantes, bares, praças e estação de metrô.
Gabriela manteve contato antes e durante toda estadia tirando todas nossas dúvidas e dando dicas bem uteis sobre translado, e opções nas redondezas. Ela também disponibilizou 2 jogos de chaves, secador de cabelos, ferro e passar e o adaptador universal de tomadas, apesar de que todas as tomadas do apartamento já estão aptas a receber as tomadas redondas sem terra.
Ela também nos enviou links para mapas com coisas na região próxima ao Apartamento.
O quarto contva com diversos travesseiros e jogos de coberta extras, e mais de um edredom.
Eu e minha namorada adoramos e se voltarmos a Buenos Aires, certamente esta suíte estará nos nossos planos!
Good place to stay
Parfait

We stayed in this apartment for four months. We had booked it in advance for the whole time, which was a mistake. The apartment is great for a shorter stay, but i wouldnt spend this long time there if i could choose again. Here are the pros and cons of our stay:

The cons:
- the wifi was super bad. It didn’t work well at any point of our stay. The only place where it worked better was when we were sitting on the floor next to the door. This was the main problem during our stay. It was impossible to watch movies or series and it was difficult to do work for our studies.
- Every time we had to ask for the made to change our towels and sheets, she did not do it without always asking
- The washing machine of the building was very bad
- Only one of the four stoves was working
- The frying pan was so bad that we had to buy a new one
- Various times there was a fire alarm in the building for nothing

The pros:
- the location of the apartment was good, near to palermo soho
- The building and the neighbourhood was safe
- The made, yolanda was very friendly
- Good air conditioning

Suggestions:
- There could be some cleaning detergents/ironing/hairdryer for the guests in the apartment.
- There could be some kind of cleaning service provided, for example weekly.

The place is well organized, the attention is good. The location is really good and I will suggest this apartment to anyone that comes to visit Buenos Aires as it will be a perfect suit for a couple weeks. Yolanda the maid is truly helpful and really careful with the details. She will take good care of you. Finally Claudia (the host) will provide you really good hospitality and various alternatives to enjoy your time at BA. A nice and tidy space overall.
Sinceramente muy por debajo de las expectativas, vecinos ruidosos, falta de inversión en el mobiliario y sin respuesta en los problemas edilicios

La atención de Yolanda y Victor es excelente. Están siempre atentos a cualquier necesidad y la limpieza que hace Yolanda de los departamentos es excelente. El apartamento está bien acondicionado para el frío y todo está en buenas condiciones.
El barrio es un poco más ruidoso de lo que me hubiese gustado para trabajar concentrada desde casa y el gimnasio está en malas condiciones. La mayoría de las máquinas no funcionan.

Don't go here! The host has several apartments and I didn’t get the apartment I booked; she accepted my booking and then told me that the one I booked was not available but that she had another one for me. She also did that to other people. Of course you can say no, but when you’ve just arrived in Buenos Aires with no place to stay, that's hard to do... Moreover: 1) There are construction works right next to the building for at least the coming months, which made it impossible to sleep after 8.30 in the morning, 2) it smells like mould: I had read this in an earlier review and the owner assured me that the problem had been fixed, but that's not the case at all, 3) the cleaning lady was very friendly and did her best I think, but somehow the place stayed dirty, with lots of insects inside (the door couldn't fully close), and my feet became black after walking on the floor for a few minutes, even after she had just mopped the floor, 4) the washing machine ruins your clothes; I hand-washed for a month; 5) worst of all: the owner falsely accused me of breaking the door lock and running around drunk, and in a really rude manner. When I showed her proof that it couldn't have been me (I had taken a trip of a few days to Iguazu falls), she completely ignored that and kept accusing me. I actually left the place a week earlier than planned because I felt so bad there!
Обоятельные хозяева. Мне понравились, чисто, уютно. Есть терасса, где можно загорать, только жаль она в выходные не работает. Спокойный район. Есть спорт зал.

El apartamento está bien situado, la atención es rápida y buena. Hay algunos detalles a tener en cuenta (el wifi no es muy potente), la cocina y el baño no están super equipados, pero la relación calidad-locación-precio es buena.
el departamento es cómodo, Yolanda estuvo atenta cuando lo necesite. edificio muy tranquilo
Todo de acuerdo a lo prometido.

Este lugar es magnífico! Buena ubicación: hay restaurantes, farmacias, parques y supermercados cerca. La atención es inmediata, humana y empática en todo momento. El edificio es moderno y seguro. Los vecinos son muy buenas personas. El apartamento tiene todo para una estadía corta o larga. Lo mejor es la atención de la Sra. Yolanda y de la Sra. Claudia.

The apartment was super well located! Despite some slight issues at the beginning (to be excepted in old buildings), we had a pleasant stay! Hortensia was super responsive, and fixed everything for us! She's a wonder!

El departamento de Hortensia esta muy bien ubicado, cercano a lugares turisticos, lugares para comprar, medios de transporte publico, etc.
La comunicacion fue siempre muy fluida, y Hortensia estuvo dispuesta a ayudarnos en todo lo que necesitamos.
Muy buena experiencia!

Hortensia is a very nice host. She communicated with me directly and always in good time. She met us at the apartment to explain everything, even when it took hours to get through immigration and customs, she waited. We had problems with the internet, which turned out to be neighborhood-wide, but she tried to get it fixed and anything we asked, she was very responsive. We did spend three days without internet, but it wasn't the host's or the house's fault. We were three, coming for a conference, so it was nice to each have a room.

We did find the place to be quite worn and old, and it could have been cleaner. There was quite a bit of dust on the floors and the shower is very weak, even after being cleaned at our request. The woman who came to clean after a few days seemed to pick and choose what to clean. The couch cushions don't actually belong to the couch and it wasn't very comfortable to sit on. Also, there were no liners in two/three of the trashes, no coffee filters (so we had to buy them after three days- fine if you're not super busy with work and it wasn't a Sunday then holiday Monday on arriving). The mattresses were also fairly worn and soft, which might be fine for some but left me uncomfortable. All in all, if you don't mind and need three bedrooms, it was fine.
The host canceled this reservation 65 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Muy amable
muy buena ubicación y la comunicación con hortensia siempre rápida y efectiva muy buena onda!

El apartamento de hortensia es perfecto tiene 3 cuartos muy cómodos es adecuado para familia grandes viajamos 5 y nos fue súper bien.  Tiene todo lo necesario para hacer tu viaje agradable .Esta ubicado en cañitas y alrededor se encuentran supermercados, restaurantes deliciosos heladerías y la estación del subte a 4 cuadras. Totalmente recomendado. Hortensia y su esposo son muy amables.  :) además de ser una zona muy segura
Todo excelente.  muy recomendable.
Nice appartment and great location!

Cool and well equipped apartment in a good neighborhood in Palermo. There are many restaurants and bars within walking distance. The pictures provide a good representation of the place. Gabriela is very nice and helpful and communications with her ran smoothly. Overall a good experience.

The apartment was as pictured.  Everything worked great!  The neighborhood was quiet,  it was centrally located, and appeared to be safe.   It was about a 15 minute walk to the nearest subte and buses and taxis were readily available around the corner. They even let us borrow their sube card! There were quite a few grocery stores and fruit markets nearby and a few restaurants near. To our surprise there was a shower and a phone available in the apartment as well. The only issue I can foresee staying here is when it is hot in the city the air conditioner is located in the living room which works well but the bedroom is a bit far from the living room and may be difficult to get cool.  But I also love to be cold when I sleep so it might just be a personal preference!
A great place to stay. Quiet and cozy. The apartment is very well equipped and meets all needs. Gabriela is very helpful. I will return soon!

Nice place. Great neighborhood. Comfortable and clean. Never met he hosts, but it was probably because it was the night of Christmas Eve and the next four days. Another lady met us there on Christmas Eve night, albeit a few minutes late. Checking in late accrued a 20 dollar late check out fee. I didn't see this policy until after my booking went through. I may have just looked over the fine print.

Really loved BA and especially Palermo. Greta neighborhood and even ran into this cute jazz bar just a few doors down. House was super clean. Building a bit shabby on the outside, but the inside design made up for it.

We walked everywhere, but taxis are quite cheap, and the metro is not too far from the apartment. Overall, I highly recommend this apartment.
Great apt great location. Terrific!
Gracias Gabriela & Daniele. Yá extraño Buenos Aires y la casa azul...Tengo muchas ganas de volver. Tudo foi mucho lindo...besitos...notaa 10

Great apartment in Palermo Soho.  It was clean, in a great location, and everything worked great!  Wifi was solid throughout our stay and being someone that works remotely, I was thankful for this.  Gabriela met me at the apartment at the prearranged time and answered all questions that I had.  Thanks!

Gabriela nos recebeu muito bem. Muito atenciosa nos explicou sobre o funcionamento do apartamento o que nos deixou bastante tranquilos. O apartamento é exatamente como as fotos demonstram, organizado e equipado. A localização é ótima, o que nos permitiu aproveitar muita coisa sem necessitar de qualquer meio de transporte.     Mercados, farmácias, restaurantes, bares, estações de metrô, paradas de ônibus, lavanderias, tudo muito perto. Esperamos voltar.

Everything was just perfect! The apartment is a very nice place located in a great area of Buenos Aires.
Gabriela was very friendly and helpful. When we wanted to extend our stay very spontaneously, she helped us very quickly and we could enjoy one more day in Buenos Aires!
Everytime again!

Me quedé 7 días con mi novio en este apartamento y tuvimos una muy buena experiencia. Gabriela nos recibió muy atentamente y mostró disposición para ayudarnos en todo lo que necesitáramos. El apartamento es tal como aparece en las fotos, muy bien decorado, con buena iluminación y bien equipado, cuenta con buena conexión a Internet, TV por cable, y todo funcionaba perfectamente. Está en una excelente ubicación, cerca del subte, colectivos, supermercados, restaurantes, bares, cafés, tiendas de todo tipo, etc. El barrio es seguro y agradable, grato para caminar. Fuimos a dos de los restaurantes recomendados por Gabriela, 1810 (muy bueno) y La Choza (excelente). No hubo inconvenientes de ninguna especie para hacer el check-in o el check-out. En resumen, estamos felices de habernos hospedado en este apartamento y nos volveríamos a quedar ahí si algún día regresamos a Buenos Aires. Definitivamente muy recomendable.
Fué el mejor departamento que yo prové hasta hora via AirbnB. El barrio, la calle, el edificio... todo muy rico y charmoso.

Una linda experiencia en un departamento muy cómodo, excelente ubicación, fácil acceso a cualquier linea de ómnibus, taxi y subte. lindos lugares alrededor para conocer y salir. Gabriela se porto muy bien con nosotros. Recomiendo 100% este lugar.

I stayed here for 2 weeks with my husband and loved it! There is absolutely nothing that I would change about this apartment.
It was very clean and comfortable. The location is perfect and close to everything. I worked remotely and the WIFI was great. The host was also very accommodating and non-intrusive. I would definitely stay here again!
Apartamento muy bien situado (muchos restaurantes y subte cerca) y muy bien amueblado (tal como se describe). Muy recomendable.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean and looked just as it did in the profile. Gabriela was a lovely host - she welcomed us at the apartment when our flight got in in the evening and was responsive via email before and during our stay. The neighborhood is beautiful and full of fabulous restaurants and bars. Thank you for a great experience in Buenos Aires!

Incredible place, I was very happy to stay in this spacious apartment and even extended the duration of my stay. The apartment is a peaceful haven in the midst of Palermo and all amenties are accesible within short walking distance. Gabriela was an excellent host and super helpful with everything. I would stay here again as well as recommend this place to all. Thank you!!

Fantstic apmt, great location & great views of Buenos Aires.
Hortensia extremely kind and available.
Overall super recommended!

Great location, terrific host, and a great overall value.

We had a super early arrival into Buenos Aires and Gabriella graciously welcomed us into her place. *Make sure to read the house rules if your check-in and check-out times are outside of the allotted times.

My girlfriend and I stayed for 10 days as we explored the city and connected to the internet to work remotely. Wifi was dependable and the location of the apartment is within walking distance to some great restaurants, especially La Choza as was recommended by our host (must try!). The neighborhood is safe and my girlfriend and I didn't feel at all sketched out at any time.

We didn't use the heater or air conditioner as we got lucky with moderate temperatures during our stay, but the apartment is equipped if you need it.

It was nice to have cleaning service in the middle of our stay to get fresh towels and clean living space just like the first day we arrived.

We had a great time and overall, a great value for your money.

We spent 3 nights in that perfectly located and nice apartment and had a great time! The easy access into Palermo with great options for shopping and eating/drinking as well as to the subway to explore BA made the place a perfect hub for our dive into BA. Gabriela made us feel very welcome and communication as well as keys handover was so relaxed and friendly. Thank you again. Sebastian

Gabbi was a lovely host. She waited for us at the apartment to let us in despite us being held up and was always available via Whatsapp if we needed any tips. The apartment is very well located - near the subway, restaurants, bars, jazz clubs - and very comfortable including the bed. A great place to stay!
Very nice apartment in a very nice neighborhood!  A great place to stay to visit and enjoy Buenos Aires!

Lovely flat end warm welcome !
We had an amazing stay in this beautiful flat in the heart of Palermo ! clean, quiet, well located, and furnished with everything we needed. Gabriela welcomed us very warmly, and was very attentive during all our stay.
We highly recommend it !

La decoración de la casa es linda. La ropa de cama, toallas del baño y demás utensilios estaban limpios y en buen estado. En general encontramos el departamento muy ordenado y limpio. La zona es perfecta para quien va de turismo, muy céntrica y con fácil acceso al transporte público. El único inconveniente es el agua, pues tanto en la ducha como en el caño del baño había poco flujo de agua fría. Sin embargo, la experiencia en general fue muy buena!

El departamento es tal cual las fotos: no son fotos bien sacadas, es un dpto bien puesto!.
La zona es inmejorable y nuestra anfitriona súper accesible y dispuesta.

A Gabriela é uma excelente anfitriã e nos recebeu muito bem, mesmo tendo chegado pela madrugada em Buenos Aires, mostrando-se receptiva e atenciosa em todos os contatos que tivemos, além de nos dar ótimas dicas sobre a cidade. O apartamento é ótimo e corresponde totalmente as fotos exibidas no site, com todo o conforto e funcionalidade que esperávamos para uma estadia de 4 semanas na cidade. Além disso, a localização é fantástica, perto de bons restaurantes (com destaque para o La Choza) e cafeterias, de duas estações de metrô (Bulnes e Scalabrini Ortiz), do Shopping Palermo e de diversos parques e praças. Enfim, um apartamento para voltar muitas vezes. Recomendo totalmente.

My boyfriend and I stayed at this lovely place for 9 days and couldn't have been happier. The apartment itself is perfect. It has a very spacious living room and bedroom, the bathroom is very modern and clean, and the kitchen is the perfect size. The highlight of this place however is the location. It is in walking distance of anything you want to do in the Palermo neighborhood, and very close to all public transport to take you around the city. Moreover, Gabriela was a fantastic host who always stayed in contact with us. She even greeted us with a bottle of wine upon arrival. Overall great experience! A must stay for Buenos Aires.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay for 3 nights. Coming directly from Australia it was a great way to get over jet leg with privacy and comfort. The apartment was clean and in a fantastic location with easy accessibility to most places throughout BA as well as being surrounded by fantastic restaurants and cafes. Gabriela was extremely welcoming and helpful. Highly recommended!

It was a very pleasant stay for 1 week. The bed was comfortable. Living room was spacious and homy. Convenient location with interesting shops and restaurants around the neighborhood. Enjoyable stay at good value.
Departamento luminoso,  buena ubicación y la limpieza es buena
La dueña habla inglés y español, y es muy fácil comunicar
Nice place in a beautiful neighborhood. Lots of bars and restaurants closeby but still has a quiet residential feel. Hortensia was prompt and very easy to communicate with.

Great apartment, everything works well, amazing views, nice balcony, close to public transport, really fun neighborhood. Apartment is on a quiet street but literally one block to streets full of cafes, restaurants and nice tranquil bars.

Excelente departamento!
Todo luz! Todo vista!
Maravillosa ubicación. Súper tranquilo, a metros de la actividad.
Viviría aquí!

While Hortensia was great at communicating with us, the apartment was in a great location and the cleaning lady was great, there were a few things that made our stay difficult.  For one, the A/C unit is only in the living room. Another thing that bothered us was that the equipment in the kitchen did not work.  The skillets were unusable, the coffee maker was flawed and the gas stove was extremely difficult to operate.  While this apartment may be okay for a short term stay, we would not recommend it for more than a few days (we stayed a month and had a very hard time).  For the price, you can find something better.
Super cómodo en excelente ubicación!

La ubicacion del departamento es my buena y la anfitriona muy amable y diligente, siempre atenta a nuestras necesidades, pero eso no suple los innumerables inconvenientes que tuvimos con la calefaccion, los enseres de cocina que eran viejos y muchos inusables, las toallas limpias, pero viejas y asperas, las frazadas viejisimas!
el baño toilette no apto para ducharse por tener la mampara rota y suelta.
El wifi muy pobre, sin acceso a las habitaciones.
En resumen nuestra estadia fue muy sufrida y decepcionante, pero siempre tratados con amabilidad y respeto.

La casa está en una zona muy linda , llena de bares restaurantes y tiendas , segura tanto por el día como por la noche. El departamento es re cómodo equipado con todo lo que necesitas para una estancia agradable. Hortensia es muy amable y disponible para cualquier cosa .
exelente estadia
Muy amables y atentos a nuestras necesidades.

The apartment is great! Modern and design, with a beautiful bathroom and a comfortable bed.
Wifi is good. Location is excellent, very close walk to bars and restaurants in Palermo. I enjoyed my stay and wish I could have stayed longer. Unbeatable quality price ratio!!!

O apartamento é bastante confortável, espaçoso, limpo e seguro. Bem localizado, perto de vários restaurantes/ bares de Palermo, excelente para passar a noite. Fácil acesso para os principais pontos turísticos de Buenos Aires. A anfitriã é muito atenciosa, simpática e sempre a disposição. Super recomendado

L'appartement est tres agreable bien placé lumineux !
Par ailleurs, la proprietaire se montre tres disponible, polie et flexible par rapoort aux horaires de check in chec out.

Je recommande !!

We enjoyed our stay in this clean and well equiped appartment ! Gabriela quickly answered all our questions via whatsapp and we could stay a few hours longer.
What we didn't like was the apartment complex, it appeared to us a little bit cheapy and we really missed some nice view from the window (it felt like a box). Also the place was not really alive.
Palermo neigberhood is great!

O apto é excelente e a proprietária Gabriela foi super gentil e atenciosa. Colocou à nossa disposição um cartão de metrô/ônibus e até guarda-chuvas, caso precisássemos. Na minha opinião, isso é mais que gentileza, pois em outros aptos não havia essa atenção toda. O bairro é ótimo, perto do parque 3 de febrero que é lindíssimo e de vários meios de transporte. Adoramos!

Excelente relación calidad precio ,el único detalle sería cambiar las cortinas porque no llegan a cubrir toda las ventanas y entra luz.
En línea generales excelente.

A acomodação proposta por Claudia é muito boa, a localização é perfeita, muito perto de cafés, farmácias, mercados, kioscos (conveniências). Local limpo, arrumado, bem estruturado, perfeito para quem vai viajar para conhecer a cidade de buenos aires sozinho ou com uma companhia. Tanto a Claudia quanto a Sra Yolanda são muito gentis, queridas e solicitas. Não há reclamações, minha viagem foi perfeita e a estadia em palermo também.

La ubicación es óptima.
El departamento cómodo: como para una o dos personas es ideal. El edificio muy seguro.
Las personas que te reciben son muy amables y predispuestas, con una comunicación constante.
Volveré seguramente a alojarme en este lugar

Mi estadía fue super placentera, el apartamento es muy bonito y está excelentemente ubicado! Hortencia fue muy amable y siempre dispuesta a responder cualquier duda! La vista es lo máximo, me encantó!

My friends and I stayed for a month in Hortensia's place. It was a beautiful, clean apartment that had plenty of room for the four of us. Hortensia was quick to respond and come over to help whenever we had minor issues, even once bringing us an extra fan for one of the rooms. The neighborhood that the apartment is in is fantastic - there are many nearby restaurants, cafes and grocery stores, and it is a quick walk to Palermo and other parts of the city. I appreciated having a doorman downstairs, and it also was a nice treat that the apartment was cleaned each week (with new towels and sheets) throughout our visit.

Great apartment in a great neighborhood. My friend and I stayed here for four nights and loved it. The apartment is clean and spacious, and is located within easy walking distance of restaurants, food, museums, etc. Gabriela is a wonderful host -- when our flight got pushed up and we ended up getting to the city hours before expected, she was very gracious and helpful in coordinating a last-minute early check-in. Would definitely return!

O apartamento fica numa localização excelente: há bares e restaurantes a cada quadra; metrô a algumas quadras e bastante ônibus na Av. Scalabrini Ortiz; não há qualquer problema de insegurança. O apartamento em si é espaçoso, estava limpo e organizado, dispõe de eletrodomésticos na cozinha e roupa de cama de qualidade no quarto; ainda fomos presenteados com uma garrafa de vinho. Gabriela (e sua equipe) esteve sempre disposta a nos ajudar, há ainda um pequeno manual das regras da casa para consulta. Gentilmente foi deixado um cartão de transporte para se usar no metrô e nos ônibus. Recomendo bastante o apartamento de Gabriela e a parabenizo pela sua organização e gentileza.

The apartment is in an excellent location: there are bars and restaurants every block; Subway a few blocks and plenty of buses on Av. Scalabrini Ortiz. There is no problem of insecurity. The apartment itself is spacious, clean and organized, it has kitchen appliances and quality linen in the room. We were still presented with a bottle of wine. Gabriela (and her team) has always been willing to help us, there is still a small manual of house rules for consultation. A transport card was kindly left to use on the subway and buses. I highly recommend Gabriela's apartment and congratulate her for her organization and kindness.

El apartamento está en una excelente ubicación: hay bares y restaurantes cada bloque; Metro a unas pocas cuadras y buses en la Av Scalabrini Ortiz. No hay ningún problema de inseguridad. El apartamento en sí es amplio, limpio y organizado, tiene aparatos de cocina y ropa de cama de calidad en la habitación. Todavía fuimos regalados con una botella de vino. Gabriela (y su equipo) siempre ha estado dispuesta a ayudarnos, hay un pequeño manual de reglas de la casa para su consulta. La tarjeta de transporte fue amablemente dejada para se utilizar en el metro y buses. Le recomiendo el apartamento de Gabriela y la felicito por su organización y atencion.

El departamento es amplio, nosotros éramos unicamente 2 pero realmente puede entrar una gran familia sin problemas, tiene un balcón con una vista buena, un gran living comedor con TV y WiFi, la cocina no es enorme pero está espectacular, con todo lo que se necesita para cocinar lo que desees.
Hay dos baños (uno completo y otro pequeño), lo cual es ideal cuando se viaja con más personas porque permite que sea muchísimo más higiénico.
Cuenta con 3 cuartos grandes cómodos todos, una cama grande en el cuarto principal y luego camás de 1 plaza en los demás cuartos.

¡Increíble vista de la ciudad! Nos encantó la estadía acá. Mejor ubicación no podíamos haber tenido. La única queja es que el departamento no tiene aire en los cuartos y hizo bastante calor cuando estuvimos visitando en enero. ¡Lo recomendamos a cualquiera que viene a CABA!

Incredible view of the city! We loved our stay here. You can’t beat this location. Our only complaint was that it didn’t have air conditioning in the bedrooms and it was very hot the days we were visiting at the beginning of January. We recommend this location for anyone visiting Buenos Aires!

Muy lindo departamento, todo muy limpio, cocina muy bien equipada, en excelente ubicación. Hortensia fue muy amigable y respondió muy rápido cuando tuvimos preguntas. Volvería a hospedarme aquí.

Great apartment, very clean, with fully equipped kitchen, in an excellent location. Hortensia was very friendly and promptly replied to our questions. I would stay here again.
excelente ubucacion, un lugar muy comodo, limpio, y una vista muy bonita de la ciudad. Hortencia muy amable y atenta a nuestras necesidades. Sin duda muy recomendable.
La Sra. Hortencia muy amable con buena disposición, el departamento espacioso con buena ubicación, sector tranquilo.

Super satisfechos y felices de nuestra estancia en el departamento, tiene una vista especular, es super luminoso y esta inmerso en una zona llena de cervecerias artesanales, a 50 mts sobre la misma vereda hay una parrilla espectacular... Las Cholas y a la vuelta de la esquina otra mas La Azulada para probar el tipico asado argentino... la verdad que lo disfrutamos mucho... de fijo repetiriamos..... gracias Hortensia!!!

Passei dez dias, com minha família extensa (dois casais, duas crianças) e a estadia foi perfeita. Recomendo a acomodação, que em todos os aspectos foi excelente:

- O bairro nos agrada muito, e dentro do bairro a região onde está o apartamento é excepcional.

- O apartamento corresponde às fotos e à descrição: amplo, arejado, bem iluminado, num andar alto e num trecho sossegado da rua. Tem todos os equipamentos domésticos, tudo bem cuidado e mantido, e nos foi entregue em um estado de limpeza impecável.

- Os anfitriões, Hortensia e Cláudio, são muito acima da média: muito atenciosos, gentis, sempre acessíveis e disponíveis. Merecem, sem dúvida, a qualificação de Superhosts. Agradeço a eles por uma estadia muito feliz com minha família.

Ralf was an excellent host. He greeted us when we arrived at the airport, and gave us all sorts of helpful tips, from the nearest supermarkets and banks to suggestions for great local restaurants and bars. He is very knowledgeable, helpful, and hospitable.

The apartment was an absolute pleasure! It looks exactly as it appears in the pictures. It's located in a luxury high-rise building that's a few blocks from the subway and near lots of great restaurants, shops, and bars. The views from this 20th floor apartment were stunning--my favorite thing about it. The apartment itself is very modern and clean, with nice amenities. I would definitely recommend staying here.

The apt was impeccably clean, charmingly decorated, quiet and in a great location. Gabriela and Daniele were great hosts, charming, communicative and direct. I can only hope they're available next time we are in Buenos Aires.

O apartamento é amplo, bem decorado e possui todos os utensílios básicos (TV a cabo, som, utensílios de cozinha, secador de cabelos) necessários para proporcionar um estadia bastante agradável. A localização é excelente, em uma rua tranquila e próxima de bares, restaurantes e pontos de ônibus e estação de metrô. Recomendo e agradeço à Gabriela a hospedagem que nos ofereceu.

Good location! Safe and fast Wifi. Close to Mart .
Also good restaurants and nice cafes nearby :-)

They are very nice and always fast feedback.
I had a good time:)~

El departamento de Gabriela & Daniele es tal cual las fotos que muestran, tiene todo lo necesario para pasar una estadía agradable y placentera. El edificio es muy tranquilo y la zona también, tienes cerca supermercados y restaurantes.

Gabriela & Daniele were fantastic hosts! They were flexible with check in which was awesome, and even had a bottle of Argentinian wine waiting for us upon arrival!

Their home is adorable! And in an amazing part of town. Walkable to so many attractions! And near a lots of great restaurants. It was nice having the air conditioning, too!

Very reliable WiFi, which was an added bonus!
Good place to start venturing through Bs As. Nice appt, cool neighborhood.

Gabriela & Daniele's place was fantastic. My wife and I stayed for 4 nights and loved every minute. It's perfectly located in Palermo, walking distance to all the restaurants, bars, cafe's and shops you could want and nice and close to the subway which can take you pretty much anywhere else in BA you could want to go. It was in a quieter street which was great for privacy and to escape the hustle bustle if we wanted to.

The apartment itself was spotlessly clean and incredibly comfortable. It had everything we needed and we cooked a couple of meals while we were there as well. Plenty of space for the two of us to be comfortable and spread out. The check in/out process was seamless as we met Tomas on arrival. We didn't get to meet Gabriele in person but her communication was first class and nothing was too much trouble for her!

We can't really find a fault with anything. We would love to stay here again and would strongly recommend it for anyone considering.
Thank you for a wonderful experience!

Great apartment for one or two travelers, everything is as described. Close to where you want to be in Palermo but in a more quiet residential street just a few blocks away. Communication was fantastic, clear instructions at check in and check out. I would def. stay there again.

Lugar limpio, cómodo y acogedor, con buena decoración y mucha luz. Muy céntrico y cerca de todo, fácil para conectarse caminando con los medios de transporte de la ciudad. Lo recomendamos sin ningún reparo.
Sin dudas volvería, realmente cumplió con todas las expectativas

Excellent option for those who want to be near the ample nightlife of Palermo without the noise of the bar/restaurant scene.  Gabriela & Daniele were excellent hosts who accommodated an early check in for me without issue.  Great resources for recommendations around BA.  Would recommend for anyone staying in BA!

Nossa estadia em Buenos Aires foi muito agradável, começando pela hospitalidade e gentileza dos nossos anfitriões. Fomos recebidos pelo Tomas, que nos deu todas as orientações sobre o funcionamento da casa, nos apresentou o apartamento e deu todas as dicas possíveis. O apartamento é muito organizado e a limpeza impecável. Gabriela deixou a nossa disposição um cartão Sube para usarmos no transporte coletivo o que facilitou muito a nossa locomoção. O apartamento está muito bem localizado, próximo a avenida principal, ao metrô, mercados, cafeterias e outros comércios. O bairro é muito tranquilo e próximo a tudo, muito bom para que nós hóspedes possamos realmente nos sentir em casa! Adoramos tudo! Recomendo muito a estadia no apartamento de Gabriela!

O apartamento é tranquilo, confortável e bem localizado e encontra-se conforme a descrição do anúncio.
A Gabriella nos recebeu e explicou as regras da casa, foi um pouco rápida, como se estivesse com pressa, mas simpática e precisa. Disponibilizou duas sombrinhas, um cartão Sube (que você faz uma recarga em dinheiro para utilizar o transporte público da cidade) e um adaptador universal de tomadas que foram muito úteis. Também recebemos de presente um vinho argentino. O apartamento possui ar condicionado, aquecimento e wifi.
Como pontos positivos destaco a localização, a tranquilidade, a rapidez e precisão da comunicação com a Gabriella.
De pontos negativos: o chuveiro precisa de uma pequena revisão pois espirra água para todos os lados. Tinha bastante poeira em algumas partes da decoração e muita no ventilador de teto do quarto (que não usamos pois estava frio). E encontramos vários cabelos compridos na colcha da cama.
No geral, foi uma boa e tranquila primeira experiência no Airbnb.

Nice a apartment in a nice neighbourhood. A friendly check-in by a friend and hand-over to the cleaning lady. About a 15 min walk to the next metro (SUBE) station. Heating works nicely, if you come in a cold season. Bakery and fruit/vegetable stores very close by. Going back to the airport, we suggest to use Uber.
Todo ok

El departamento es cómodo y luminoso. Es amplio para ser un mono ambiente. El baño es espectacular. Todo funcionó perfectamente. La zona en que está ubicado es inmejorable, a seis cuadras del subte y a menos de tres cuadras de las paradas de colectivo. Para caminar y pasear está muy cerca de bares y plazas. Los anfitriones excelentes todo salió tal cual lo pautado.
Ótimo lugar, tranquilo, seguro, proximo de tudo.     Super recomendo a estadia.

Curtimos bastante o apartamento da Claudia. O que mais gostamos foi o banheiro espaçoso, camas muito boas e o bairro, realmente muito tranquilo. Mesi e Yolanda que nos ajudaram no checkin e no checkout são maravilhosos. Foi uma boa experiência 😊
Todo excelente. Altamente recomendable para una estadía económica en una buena zona.
Excelente ubicación, y un departamento muy comodo
Tudo perfeito!
muy lindo el depto , muy amable y atenta en todo Yolanda, excelente persona.
Excelente ubicación y relación calidad precio. Sin duda volveremos.
10/10 el lugar y la atención

Ralf over delivered as a host. Not only was his apartment well decorated, spacious and inviting but he and his team provided with anything I needed. I will strongly recomend staying in this great unit.

As soon as I walked into the Sunset Luxury studio, I was taken aback by the amazing view. It was beautifully decorated and stocked with everything you might need throughout your visit. Couple that with the lovely gentleman (Ralf) that welcomed me at the door and I knew that this was the perfect spot to host my mother, who was visiting from the US.

Ralf was so kind and talked me through all of his favorite spots and eateries around the neighborhood. I'm living in Buenos Aires now and have noted all of the places on his list that I've yet to visit--I'm definitely checking them out while I'm here.

The apartment itself was gorgeous and the view of the sunset over the city was out of this world. I even had a Portena friend, who was born and raised and Buenos Aires, drop by and she was also awestruck by the view and space.

Ralf and his staff were absolutely wonderful..thank you all again!

What an amazing stay! Ralf met us at the building when we arrived and when we entered the Sunset apartment it was even better than it was described. Ralf gave us many helpful tips about Palermo and Buenos Aires, he's just wonderful as a host. We stayed in the apartment for 9 nights and didn't have any issues at all, it was simply wonderful!

Ralf is a great host and made our arrival and stay very easy and comfortable. The apartment itself is terrific, amazing views and is in a very central location, close to shops and restaurants. Looking forward to traveling back to BA and would definitely stay here again.

As soon as we were greeted by Andre and Ralf, they were both very warm and attentive and also remained that way throughout our stay. The studio is exactly as photographed so no surprises there! The location is very handy as its close to all things needed around Palrmero and the districts. The complex also has a very nice pool area to bathe in. Thanks boys you truly came up with the goods! We will keep in touch.

I can't really say enough about this perfect apartment and Ralf's brilliant attention to detail.

The apartment has everything - a breathtaking view of the city, a very comfortable bed (usually THE most important factor, but the view of the city from the balcony might actually trump the bed, in this case), a fantastically equipped kitchen, and a terrific location in Palermo, easy walking distance to restaurants, shops, grocery stores and the subway.

After several visits to Buenos Aires (and having lived there for a year), I can say without hesitation that Ralf provided an ideal experience. Rent from him and the gang at BA4U!

Great place. My first Airbnb experience and it was over the expectations. The pictures of the Studio matches with reality, mainly the breathtaking view of Buenos Aires.

The host was great in explaining everything we need to know about the place and how to enjoy the city.

I certainly recommend this listing and the host service.

My girlfriend and I spent 5 days in Buenos Aires and had a wonderful experience. We were picked up at the airport flawlessly and Marcelo greeted us at the apartment building. Marcelo was very friendly and gave us all of the information we needed to make our stay comfortable. He provided us with maps and excellent pointers about what to do in the city. We were also provided with a phone number that we could contact 24-hours in case of emergency or if we needed any help. I found that to be very comforting. The apartment itself was amazing with a fabulous view of the city, excellent amenities and 24-hour security. We particularly enjoyed it's location near the parks in Palermo and accessibility to all types of public transportation. The apartment was very clean and way better than any hotel. I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Buenos Aires.

Adoramos o tempo que passamos no sunset, o flat é confortável e tem tudo o que precisávamos, a localização é ótima, perto de estação de metro e de pontos de ônibus que te levam direto para o caminito ou para a feira de san Telmo. Nem é preciso ligar para o taxi, pois eles passam na porta durante todo o dia e noite! E você ainda caminha para algunsdeliciosos restaurantes bem próximos, e a gastronia da região também é farta! A vista então é um espetáculo a parte, tivemos a sorte de ter lindos pores do Sol todos os dias, deixando o céu num vermelho intenso!! Experiência maravilhosa que vamos levar da nossa lua de mel, e já estamos fazendo planos para voltarmos!!

EXCELLENT!!! The apartment and the host. Every thing just fine, exactly as one may see in the pictures os the studio. Ralf welcomed us in the lobby, showed the apartment, the rules, etc. there was water and beer in the fridge, coffee, sugar... the bed is excellent, THE VIEW IS AWSOME!!!! Clean, well decorated studio. You will love as we did! thank you Ralf and team.

First of all Claudia is very helpful and at out arrival as well as our departure things worked out perfectly with her.

The apartment is nice and clean. Good place if you are staying a view days to visit the city.

The location is not in the center of Palermo, but its just a 10 minutes walk to it. Nice area, I liked it

Claudia is an impeccable host. She left clear instructions on how to enter the building, which was a major plus after 12+ hours of flying, and was incredibly quick with all correspondance, which was great. Victor, who handles maintenance, was helpful and friendly, and the apartment itself is as pictured in the photos, and located in one of the most convenient neighborhoods in BA. I'll definitely be staying here again.

Enjoyed Gabriele's place a lot! Comfy apartment in excellent location in Palermo, close to the subway, groceries, restaurants, and bars. Check in and check out were smooth and communication was great!

El lugar es excelente. Cómodo, accesible a la zona de Palermo más visitada, se puede ir a pie y disfrutar el lugar. Accesible a avenidas principales, y zona centro la de Baires. Gabriela excelente anfitriona, y siempre disponible para lo que necesiten.  Volvería mis sin dudas.

Buena ubicacion y el departamento es mejor en persona que en fotos. Algunos descuidos en la limpieza que podrian solucionarse. El barrio tranquilo. Tiene termotanque electrico si no se es cuidadosi se acaba el agua caliente.
Lo mejor : el departamento es grande y muy comodo con calefaccion en la pieza y el baño.

Lo que más nos ha gustado del departamento de Daniele y Gabriela es, en conjunto, el confort de su mobiliario, el buen gusto en la decoración y el correcto funcionamiento de todos los electrodomésticos.
Pero también nos ha sorprendido lo céntrico que es y lo bien comunicado que está mediante las principales líneas de subte y colectivos que atraviesan Buenos Aires.
Apto bien ubicado, buena decoración, es acogedor

Todo perfectamente coordinado y excelente comunicación con Gabriela. El departamento muy cómodo y amplio. La libertad que da estar en Palermo en un departamento bien ubicado y equipado es impagable. Muy recomendado!
Nice place!

Gabriela y Daniel, son muy buenos anfitriones, siempre atentos y dispuestos.
muchas gracias por todo.

El departamento está bien ubicado, en una calle tranquila, pero cerca de buenos restaurantes, bares y tiendas. El barrio me pareció muy bueno para caminar tranquilamente durante todo el día y anochecer. Todo el departamento es muy bien cuidado, buena cama, baño también. Tiene todo lo que usted pueda necesitar para preparar una comida. Las dueñas del espacio responden prontamente los mensajes y aún dejan guías turisticas sobre bsas para facilitar la visita. Tiene tarjeta sube que facilita mucho para quien utiliza transporte público. Y aún dejaron un vino de regalo, muy amables, el chico que me recibió también. Super!

I enjoyed staying at Gabriela and Dabiele's place. They apartment is decorated very well and has a nice living room. It's less than 10 min walk from the busy Palermo Soho and even closer to one of the best steak houses in the city! Gabriela was responsive and easy to communicate with. The check in and check out were very smooth. Overall, great place.
El departamento es lindo y bien ubicado. Gabriela fue muy amable y disponible con nosotros y nos permitió hacer el check-in en adelantado.

Gabriela is a great host, and the apartment is perfectly located on a quiet street very close to public transportation on Scalabrini Ortiz avenue. Just don't expect to be able to cook a main meal, as the apartment only has a  2  "burner" electric stove, a small electric oven, and a microwave. That said, there are very good and affordable local restaurants within 3 or 4 blocks, try "La Pharmacie" and "Enfunda la Mandolina" for true authentic Buenos Aires cusine and locals scene (the Osobuco and the Mollejas are to die for at Enfunda la Mandolina).

This is the third time I stay in this apartment. It is amazing, and Gabriela always available to help when needed.
Highly recommended

Ralf was Great! and the apartment was Gorgeous! More than advertised.
The apartment was stylish and comfortable with the best view just about a block from the Subte station on Santa Fe - could not ask for a better location. Almost did not want to leave the apartment to explore BA.
Ralf had thought of everything and made us feel completely at home.
I hope we can go back to BA again and stay at Ralf's place.

The apartment was better than the photo's, great location, would definately stay here again.
Ralf was a great host and helped with everything we needed.
Highly recommended.

The studio looks exactly like in the photos. One of Ralf's associates, Marcello, checked me into the apartment and was really helpful, showing me the apartment, suggesting an itinerary for my visit, giving me a map and probably most helpful of all, giving me tips on avoiding being scammed in BA. The area is really convenient for buses to take you downtown and is within walking distance to a huge gourmet supermarket and nice cafes. Well recommended!
Ralf was a fantastic host and the apartment was beautiful. Great view, clean and modern.

Ralf was a very kind host and the apartment was also fantastic. The apartment was very conveniently located just off from Plaza Italia subte station and a few minute walk from the most bustling blocks of Palermo SoHo. I want to come back to this place in the near future.

We really enjoyed our stay! The location, view and building were fantastic. Close to both the Subte stop Plaza Italia and the great area of Palermo Soho. The apartment was perfectly situated for what we were looking to do in Buenos Aires. We also found everyone we dealt with to be very professional and helpful as well speak perfect English. I would also recommend getting them to organize an airport transfer as it was a lot more relaxing and seemed reasonably priced.

There are also two local shops which are great if you are buying food to eat at home. The Disco Supermarket for the basics (cnr of Armenia and Paraguay) and a great deli a ‘Manger (cnr of Charcas and Malabia). Grab some local wine, cheese and meats and enjoy the view!

We will be back!!

The Sunset apartment was just as it looks in the photos. Stylish, clean & well equipped with a full kitchen & cooking facilities. The apartment is appropriately named, with a great view at sunset!

At the end of each day coming home to this apartment was a treat. The spa & gym in the building were an added bonus.

Ralf was particularly helpful, friendly & responsive.

Would recommend to anyone staying in BA.

Our stay here was lovely! What a great apartment. Especially the view from the 20th floor was amazing, but so was the apartment. Very modern, cosy and had everything you need. The place was very clean, and very well located. Close to the subte (Plaza Italia), and on walking distance of Palermo, with all its nice bars and restaurants (for example La Cabrera).

The check in was smooth, and the host was very friendly and gave us some good tips and advice for Buenos Aires.
Beautiful, elegant apartment with amazing view of Palermo and beyond. Great location. However, thin walls and noisy neighbors on weakend nights.
Goede locatie.  Rustig , comfortabel.

My partner and I stayed at Gabriela and Danielle's place for 8 nights with our 5 month old daughter. The location was exactly what we were looking for and couldn't be closer to great restaurants, bars and cafes. At the same time, the apartment is in a quiet, residential area (despite some minor construction noise) and feels really safe.  Gabriela was very helpful, amazingly responsive and accommodated some extra requests we had and made us feel completely welcome and at home during our stay.  Thanks!

Gostei muito do apartamento, desde do atendimento da Claudia na minha chegada há Buenos Aires e no último dia.
Tirou todas minhas dúvidas que eu tinha.

O apartamento é excelente, literalmente senti em casa com todo conforto para os hóspedes.

Também o local é de fácil acesso ao metro, táxi, ônibus e mercado; além de uma bairro super tranquilo e bacana.

Excelente departamento, dotado con lo básico. Todo muy limpio y en muy buenas condiciones. Esta localizado en una zona cercana a vías principales lo que permite fácil acceso al transporte, (buses, metro, taxis). Cerca se encuentran mercados, kioscos, lavandería ( aunque el edificio tiene facilidades para laundry, si se desea hacerla por uno mismo). Mi esposa y yo pasamos un mes realmente cómodos y como en casa.
Our stay was wonderful and we are not missing anything. Claudia arranged everything right as we asked. The apartment is very nice, cozy, well located and secure. I recommend to everyone! It's worth!

Mein Kumpel und ich haben für einen vierwöchigen BA- Aufenthalt 2 Apartments gebucht und hatten eindeutig die richtige Entscheidung getroffen! Vom organisierten Flughafentransfer in einem Privatfahrzeug über die Qualität der Wohnungen bis hin zur fürsorglichen Betreuung durch Ralf und seine Mitarbeiter war alles perfekt! Die Wohnungen sind durchwegs sehr geschmackvoll und modern eingerichtet, voll ausgestattet mit Küchenequipment, W-LAN, TV, Stereoanlage und Air Condition. Die Betten sind von hoher Qualität. Jede Woche ist eine sehr nette Haushälterin inkludiert, welche sich natürlich über ein Trinkgeld, ( welches wir empfehlen im voraus zu überreichen , sehr freut! Die Wohnungen waren bei Übergabe lupenrein sauber, gefreut hätten wir uns nur über ein kaltes Bier im Kühlschrank nach diesem langen Flug....Nun, dieses kann man aber 5 Meter vom Hauseingang entfernt ebenso wie Softdrinks, Wasser oder Zigaretten in einem kleinem Kiosk mit sehr netten Betreibern erwerben. Hier sei auch noch Susi erwähnt, eine von Ralf empfohlene "Laundry" - Dame, welche um die Ecke eine kleine Wäscherei mit Ihrer Tochter führt und Hemden und Hosen in kürzester Zeit wäscht, bügelt und gerne ins Apartment liefert. Beide sprechen gut Englisch. Das Apartmenthaus ist erst ein paar Jahre jung, verfügt über gesicherte Eingänge mit Wachpersonal, genügend schnelle Aufzüge, einen 20 Meter Pool der zu täglichen Morgenrunden einlädt, sowie im 32. Stock einen Kraftclub mit fantastischem Blick über die Stadt bis rüber nach Uruguay! Unbedingt ansehen! Einen Stock höher befindet sich ein Bereich mit Sauna, Massagestudio und Whirlpool. Wir empfehlen, was die Etagen angeht, grundsätzlich so hoch wie möglich zu buchen, aus 3 Gründen: Aussicht ( hier gilt noch zu überlegen: Morgen,- oder Abendsonne), Luftqualität, Strassenlärm. Palermo ist ein cooler Szenebezirk, archtiektonisch ganz anders als der Rest dieser Großstadt, gemütlich, entspannt, aber mit großartigen neuen Restaurants, Bars, Clubs, Boutiquen, Cafes, vielen Bäumen und doch mitten in der City! Auf jeden Fall " the place to be"!!! Grundsätzlich ist die Gegend auch sehr sicher, so wie Prenzlauer Berg oder Schwabing... Last but not least: Die Lofts haben, jedenfalls momentan, auch ein super Preis - Leistungs - Verhältnis wie wir finden. Also : we will be back!

Maravilhosa estadia. o apartamento é limpo, muito bem situado, com os recursos necessários aos hóspedes. Senti falta de encontra-me com a proprietária ou alguém responsável. Minha única recomendação à Claudia refere-se as instruções enviadas por email para a minha chegada ao entrar na portaria do prédio. O inglês e o espanhol do texto são ruins e dão margens a muitas dúvidas. No entanto uma vez entendido, foi-me fácil descobrir como entrar no prédio. E o sistema escolhido pela proprietária parece-me bastante prático e inteligente.Dale Claudia, que tenga muchos huespedes.

Our visit in Buenos Aires was simply great. The apartment was exactly as Claudia described it. Clean, well renovated etc. We really enjoyed our stay at Claudias apartment.
Claudia as a host was wonderful. Every little request made by me or my friend, she always made sure to fullfil it. She was always reachable through e-mail which was very good. I strongly recommend Claudia as a host.

The area of Palermo was great and also very safe. You had Palermo Soho close by. Palermo Soho is an area where you can find plenty of restaurants and bars. A great area to spend your evening at. I recommend it.
Then you have capital federal. 20-30 minutes with taxi, depending on traffic.

Overall, our stay at Francisco Acuna de Figueroa was great. It is safe and also very well located.

Excellent apartment right in Palermo Soho in a fantastic new highrise building!  The apartment looks identical to the photos, and was very comfortable and perfect for the two of us - would couldn't have been happier with the unit or building.  The views are very impressive, and the sunsets are excellent.  We spent several evening watching the sun set over a glass of wine and some snacks... The furnishings, etc. were in great shape and well appointed.  Ralf and company were also very helpful and friendly.  As for the location - it's tops.  2 mins walk to the subway (subte D - Plaza Itallia stop).  Busses (colectivos) were also all around.  Best of all, taxis pretty much always are in front of the building so it is very easy to walk out and catch one to wherever you want to go (and taxis in BA are very inexpensive).   There are PLENTY of neighborhood amenities around as well - groceries, markets, ATMs, (MANY) restaurants, bars/clubs, etc.  It's a fantastic unit in a fantastic neighborhood.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND.  Thank you Ralph and crew  - when in BA again we will be staying here again.
Excellent séjour, dans un des quartiers très agréables de Buenos Aires.

The apartment was just as good as it looks in the pictures! It had everything we needed. The neighborhood is great. It is residential, but also with lots of places to eat, drink, and shop. Coordinating with Ralf was super straightforward and he was very helpful giving advice once we arrived. I highly recommend staying here.
