We had a great stay at the Sunset Apartment.  Ralf and his team were excellent in terms of communication and especially helping us out with airport transfers.  Marcelo met us when we arrived and was a great source of information about the apartment, the local area and the city in general.  His hints and tips really helped us make the most of our stay.  The apartment is very well decorated, equipped and in a really nice, safe location.  There are many bars and excellent restaurants close to the apartment and a metro station a couple of blocks away.  There are also a variety of small supermarkets and food shops nearby.  We had a great stay and would definitely go back if we were in BA again.

The apartment was great! Ralf and team were there to make sure we had a comfortable experience, including leaving us a nice bottle of champagne for us when we returned from our wedding in Mendoza! Very nice touch =). The location is excellent, the view from the 20th floor is spectacular (only to be topped by the view from the gym on the 32nd floor!). A few times there was some confusion at the guard gate about our names not being on their list, but it always got sorted out. All in all, a great experience and we would definitely rent from Ralf and in this building again.

I had an excellent airbnb experience with Ralf, The apartment was great and Ralf made everything from arranging my stay to checking in and out as easy as could be. If you have any questions, Ralf will get back to you quickly and his knowledge of Palermo restaurants was a added bonus. I now have a new favourite place to eat. Las Pizarras! Thanks Ralf.

This was my first time in South America and in Buenos Aires in particular so having a nice place to stay was important. My good friends stayed with Claudia in 2012 and highly recommended so it was an easy choice for me.

The checkin process was very easy, place was very clean and neat. Claudia was also very accommodating on the changes with the reservation when I decided to stay for another month.

Couple of tips:
1. There's a washing machine in house, but there's also a laundry (lavanderia) right across the street that will wash, dry and fold your laundry (or iron your shirts) for $3-5. Huge timesaver.

2. Get a bike as there's a bike route right next to the building and it makes exploring buenos aires very easy.

Cheers!
Claudia is a fantastic host, highly attentive and welcoming. Her apartments are ideally located in Palermo, really comfortable and the perfect base for a trip to Buenos Aires.
El apartamento es como se ve en la fotos, está bien ubicado, es seguro y limpio. Muy buena atención.
Lots of space. Everything you need for an extended stay is available.
Lugar súper céntrico , cómodo, ubicación excelente, Víctor y Yolanda que son las personas que atienden en el edificio son muy amables y dispuestos siempre a ayudar.

Excelente estadia en Buenos Aires,como asiduo usuario de AIRBNB y viajero frecuente a Buenos Aires (soy tanguero),este apartamento es mucho mas que lo que muestran las fotografías,excelente localización,bien equipado con aparatos de ejercicios,lavadero y pileta;muy limpio y tranquilo,excelente relación costo/beneficio,inmejorable atención tanto de la chica que reside y limpia en el edificio (Yolanda) como de Claudia...sin duda espero sea mi hogar cada vez que venga a Buenos Aires
Good place to stay

Nuestra estadía en Buenos Aires estuvo increíble Gracias a esta habitación, muy amplia, buena iluminación, muy cómoda, locación excelente. Claudia y Yolanda quienes fueron con las que tuvimos comunicación continua, son MUY amables. Muy recomendado el lugar, definitivamente volveríamos a hospedarnos allí. Nos vamos muy felices.

Claudia's apartment is very good.
We used to go sightseeing and
shopping by bus. Location is safe and neighbors are friendly.
Also, there is a big mart nearby.

Yolanda and Victor, who always lived in the apartment, were very kind and friendly. Even though we can't speak Spanish, they always helped us.
The host, Claudia, was also very friendly and answered questions quickly.

We highly recommend this apartment for the first time in Buenos Aires like us. We also want to use it again. Thank you.

Mi estadía estuvo genial, el dpto. está ubicado en una buena zona, hay acceso a buses, taxis, kioscos y lo demás.  Yolanda, quien es la encargada de estar atenta a los requerimientos de los huéspedes, estuvo de 10, un amor de persona y siempre presta a ayudar a la hora que sea.

Perfect Place , Perfect Neighbourhood
the best place that I ever stayed in Buenos Aires
Good place

Ralf's apartment was exactly as described. Cute but with everything you could need and Ralf even left water, fruit etc. The internet and cable TV worked well. It was great having the balcony and yes the sunset views are stunning! The location is also perfect, just 2 minutes from Plaza Italia metro and dozens of buses. Restaurants and bars are less than 10 mins walk away. The check-in / out went very smoothly and I would recommend this apartment to anyone wishing to stay in Buenos Aires.

Excellent apartment, exactly as it is in the pictures. Helpful guide books in the apartment. Bowl of fruit, tea, coffee & crackers provided complimentary. Well organised team. Good transfer from airport offered at a decent price. Would recommend.

The Loft is Amazing ! It's beautiful and cosy. The experience with Ralf and his team is terrific as well. The landscape of this skycap is singular. Sure i will be hosted there on my next trip to Buenos Aires. Thanks for everything !
El departamento esta muy bien decorado y tiene todo lo necesario para vivir unos días en Baires. Gracias a todo el equipo por su atención permanente y su profesionalidad.

Since I was visiting Buenos Aires for the first time I very much appreciated the time Marcelo from Ralf's team spent with me when I arrived.  He gave me invaluable advice on how to make sure I have the best trip.  I felt right at home in the studio and the view was unforgettable.  Ralf and his team covered every detail to ensure my stay went perfectly.  I would definitely book again.  Five star experience.

Our stay was very good. We felt so comfortable and secure. Ralf was very sympathetic and clear in all informations about the apartment which we stayed.the apartment is very functional and well located. Surely we will return many times and recommend it to all who want to visit Buenos Aires.
Best regards, Osny Coradini e Paulo Pinto.

My girlfriend and I visited this apartment during our 4-day stay in BA and I can really recommend everyone to use Ralf and his apartments - especially the "Sunset Luxury 20th floor studio" due to the incredible view!
When we arrived Marcelo (Ralfs co-worker) gave us a 1,5hrs speech about BA about what to do doing our stay, which included many great tricks we wouldn't have got to know without knowing someone from BA ourselves. Extremely good service I think! :)

Talks apartment is AMAZING!!! If you are looking at staying in BA, look no further, stay here!! It's the best location & apartment in BA! Te sunsets are even better then the photos show, Ralf was so attentive and very thorough with the sights, surrounds, bars, restaurants, cafes and the hidden secrets of the local Palermo area (best area in BA). We were there on our honeymoon, which Ralf found out once we met him. We spoke to him for a good 20-30 mins before he left and wished us all the best.... 30 mins later the door bell rang, it was Ralf with a bottle of champagne to wish us a happy honeymoon!! Such a humbling gesture and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay, only negative, we should have stayed longer!!! For any traveller's staying here, you must do the "Argentine Experience" it is a brilliant night out and learn all about argentine food, people & history!

My stay was wonderful.  The building is relatively new and conveniently located in Palermo Soho.  The unit is beautifully decorated and has a balcony with a stunning view of the city.  Ralf was kind and helpful when I first arrived.  He took lots of time answering questions I had about the city, even marking destinations off on a map for me.  Staying in this apartment made my stay unforgettable.  And I'm sure it could do the same for you!

This was my first experience for this type of renting apts. I’m very happy to say that it was a great experience!!!
Very nice apartment in Buenos Aires, clean and comfortable. Нis apartment was great and was really close center!
Eduardo is very friendly and speaks good English he was very helpful answering questions about the city.
If you are going to Buenos and want an affordable place, make sure to stay with Eduardo!

This apartment was very roomy and very lovely.  It is located in a wonderful neighborhood, full of cute shops and wonderful restaurants.   Eduarado was very helpful, providing us with maps and information of local places to shop, eat, and tango as well as some supplies for the Kitchen.  There is a wonderful view of the Buenos Aries from the windows, and has a quiet office where you can work with Wireless Internet.  When I go back, I plan on staying here again!

Ralf's place was in the perfect location for our first visit to BA, was clean, comfy and had everything you could need....the gym and the view from the balcony were a bonus!
The map and tips from Marcelo who met us at the apartment we're really helpful and the check in and check out we're great....we would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting BA...thanks!

Me encanto el departamento,se encuentra muy bien ubicado en Palermo.La visata por la mañana y la tarde son espectaculares ,tiene todo lo necesario para unos buenos días en buenos aires.Es para 2 personas máximo ya que no es muy grande ,pero esta bien.Cuenta por piscina ,lo que lo hace muy bueno para esos días de calor.Los anfitriones se tomaron el tiempo necesario conmigo.Lo recomiendo

Great place, excellent location within walking distance to all the great restaurants/bars in Palermo Soho/Hollywood. Balcony was great for a nightcap. Loved the travel guides, printed book with restaurant recommendations, help from office with making bookings, and excellent briefing when we arrived (on pickpocket tricks, etc)! Forgot my suit in the closet when we left and picked it up on the way back through BA (thanks!).

Ralf had a very nice place and I would say it is better than the pictures especially the views! My husband and I definitely enjoyed evenings with wine on the balcony after a dip in the pool. The apt really feels like you are staying in a hotel.

Everything was also very well organized. We got in touch with Ralf's representative and he prearranged a car service for us from the airport. He also ensured someone was there to greet us and showed us around the apt even though we arrived very late on Sat night!

The neighborhood is excellent. Lots of cafes, bars, restaurants and shops. Also it was close to the metro so very easy to get around.

Highly recommend!
What a great apartment! Perfect location. Would definitely stay here again!

Eduardo e sua companheira nos receberam muito bem, inclusive com boas dicas.
O apartamento estava limpo e arrumado.
Ficamos hospedados no início do inverno, mas o apartamento possui aquecimento, permanecendo sempre aconchegante.
A cozinha está equipada com todos os utensílios, foi bem útil para economizarmos preparando um café da manhã reforçado antes de sair para os passeios.
O bairro é muito bonito, ótimo para caminhadas e possui transporte fácil para outros locais (a cinco quadras tem uma estação do metrô).
O proprietário foi atencioso e no final da estadia pediu sugestões de melhorias.
Recomendo o apartamento para quem deseja renovar os ares na capital argentina!

Eduardo and Giselle are very kiind and friendly! Their help was precious for us, expecially for logistic problems that we found just arrived to Buenos Aires. The appartment is fantastic, well located in Palermo viejo and ... always good cd music there! Thank you for everything!

El departamento está muy bien, es acogedor y muy luminoso. La ubicación es excelente para los amantes de Palermo Viejo. El equipamiento completo y funcional, aunque no tiene lavadora de ropa hay un Lave-Rap muy cerca. La cama es súper cómoda!
Eduardo es un excelente anfitrión. Se adaptó a nuestros horarios al corto plazo, nos obsequió con fruta fresca y atendió de inmediato a nuestros consejos para mejorar los utensilios de cocina. Gracias!

The apartment is great, cosy and full of light. Excellent location in the heart of Palermo Soho. Complete and functional equipment. There is no washing machine, but there is a laundro-mat nearby. The bed is super comfy!
Eduardo is a great host. He adapted to our schedule on short notice, gave us fresh fruit and immediately acted on our advice to improve the kitchen-ware. Thanks!

i have spent 3 nights with my father on Eduardo's lovely apartment and we had a very pleasing experience. The apartment is very comfortable and I would definitely recommend for both short and long stays. There is plenty of sunlight and good space to store your luggage without disturbing the rooms. Both beds are very comfortable and the blinds really keep the early light away (which is very important to me, since I am a very light sleeper. It's also quiet!). The kitchen is equipped with all the essentials (but I hope you just use it to prepare your breakfast, since you really don't want to miss the argentine cuisine) and has enough room for quick meals. Internet is also fast If there is one downside (that hasn't bothered me at all, but is worth mentioning) is the shower. The boiler is a little small, so it is not possible to take long showers or even taking a shower after someone has taken. Besides that, everything was really nice! The location is great, Palermo Soho is filled with nice cafés, restaurants and there is a milonga in walking distance. The street is also known for it's shops and outlets. The subtle (subway) is 15 min walk away and the neighborhood is safe.
Eduardo and his brazilian wife Gisele were really kind and responded to all my emails very quickly. They are tango-enthusiasts and may give you great tips on that matter. Don't miss them!
I would definitely recommend this apartment and would come back on the next opportunity!

The place is great....near the best neighborhood in Buenos Aires, lots of bars, restaurants...the apartment is clean, it has wi-fi......lot's of room. Eduardo is a great host, I got to Buenos Aires on a late night flight and he waited me at the apartment so I could get the keys. Can't recommend it enough.

El dpto de Eduardo es increible, tremenda ubicacion, cerca de muchos bares y restaurants pintorescos. El dpto es bien luminoso y muy alegre y Eduardo esta muy atento en que no falte nada y pases la estadia lo mejor posible.

El Departamento es una maravilla, y Eduardo y Gisele fueron perfectos, hasta nos llevaron a (intentar de) bailar el tango! Si un dia volveremos a Buenos Aires, intentaremos volver a este departamento...
El apartamento esta precioso! muy acogedor y muy buena ubicación.  Eduardo y Gisele super amorosos y atentos a nuestras necesidades.

This was my first experience booking on Air BnB and it was fantastic. Eduardo and Gisele were at the apartment with the keys for our early arrival into BsAs and were available by phone with any questions during our stay. The apartment is walking distance to the subte and a few short blocks from all of the best restaurants, bars and shopping in the hippest neighborhood. We had a wonderful time!! The apartment is the perfect space for 2-4 people.

The hosts Eduardo and Gisele are very nice and helpful, they provide you with all the information and tipps necessary for a perfect stay in Buenos Aires. The flat is lovely and beautyfully equipped. The location in Palermo Soho is great, we really liked the neighbourhood with all the shops, restaurants...

Very nice neighbourhood, not much traffic, apartment on 4th floor, quiet, not facing street, liked the view.
Cosy, tasteful apartment, good value for price.
Be careful not to slam the elevator doors, if you do you will get a reminder :)

Excelente el departamento de Gabriela. Todo fue tal cual estaba publicado en las fotos y la decripción.
Gabriela respondió rápidamente a todas nuestras consultas. Super recomendado.
Excelente estadía en Bs. As la ubicación es inmejorable. Ellos son muy atentos.  El departamento es hermoso. Muchas gracias. Volveremos

El departamento de Gabriela cumplió completamente con mis expectativas y es tal cual se lo describe. Muy cómodo, luminoso y limpio y con una ubicación inmejorable para poder recorrer Buenos Aires sin contratiempos. Muy buena experiencia de alojamiento, enteramente recomendable.

One of the most comfortable and well equipped apartments I had in the 12 years I’ve been coming to Buenos Aires.  It is comfortable with a lot of thought put into making it inviting for guests.  The owners were very quick to respond to questions and issues that arose.  On of the problems with this apartment is the construction going on close by.  Work started each morning at 8., Monday thru Saturday and I was unable to sleep with the noise of construction.  This is difficult if you want to go to the milongas and want to sleep in.  Charging $20 for a late check in is a bit much since most of us have no choice in what hour our plane arrives .  For me it was once a day and that happened to be at night.  Also when I asked to extend my stay for one night since check out was 10 am and my plan didn’t leave till 9 pm, I was told it would cost me US$196 I felt that that was not fair at all since the advertised amount for one night was much less.  I certainly would not have minded paying the advertised price but  almost $200 for one night ( and I would not have even stayed overnight—only an extra 5 or 6 hours) was grossly unfair.
Casa totalmente hermosa, bien ubicada con accesibilidad a todos lados y súper prolija

Great apartment. Well laid out. Nice building. Very secure. Good location. Excellent check-in process and property management. Fantastic balcony and views! A/C works great - even during heat waves.

We can't really think of anything to complain about after spending a week there. Thanks Raif!

We had a great time in Palermo. Thanks to Ralf for his friendly, attentive and professional hosting. Very nicely and comfortably designed appartments with breathtaking sunset view over Buenos Aires, also perfectly located for city trip close to bars, restaurants, shopping, park and city exploring.

Muchas gracias and hasta luego,
Victoria and Martin

Sunset Palermo was actually amazing, Ralf and the team should be proud of this apartment. They are very professional, gave lots of useful tips for staying in BA and Argentina in general, and were extremely welcoming.

We were running hours late as LAN lost my bag, and the host who welcomed us was happy to wait around for us to arrive and welcome us in!

The property was as advertised: convenient, spotless, with spectacular views in a great location - it was definitely a great base for a short stay in Buenos Aires and would definitely recommend it - actually I'll book the same place when I'm back in BA... Communication with Ralf and his staff was super smooth and they proved really helpful with tips on the city and arranging a ride to the airport.

Eduardo & Gisele's apartment is simply gorgeous! My friends and I were beaming from the moment we walked in. The amenities are clean, comfortable and well maintained. We loved every detail in the apartment - from the plants, the little library of books and music, hanging art pieces and brewed coffee. These perfect little touches give the apartment real character and warmth...It was all a welcome change from the hotels and hostels we stayed at during our trip in South America. We needed something that felt like home and we found it in this apartment.
Eduardo was very helpful and friendly from the beginning to the end of our stay, and was also kind enough to give us a brief walking tour of the neighbourhood so we could familiarize ourselves with the bars, eateries and shops. We appreciate his patience and his hospitality so much, especially because my group had issues with flight delays before arriving to the apartment..and we also encountered an embarrassing problem regarding unlocking the apartment door - something that is seemingly easy to do but proved difficult for us at the start. Fortunately, Eduardo came to our rescue and we had a laugh about it!
I would gladly stay here a second time if I visit Buenos Aires again and would also recommend it to everyone else.
Thanks to Eduardo & Gisele for hosting a wonderful stay!
From Lan, Dee, Louise & Ani x

Eduardo and Gisele were really great hosts. We loved the flat! From the first moment we felt like at home...The apartment is very cosy, perfect for a couple and has lots of natural daylight, which I love ( and nice views over BA). The area turned out to be our favorite neighborhood in BA. Palermo Soho is really a wonderful area. Eduardo and Gisele also had great advise for us and answered all questions we had ... We also got a little welcome bottle of Malbec which was really nice!
A highlight was the Tango Milonga they took us to... Highly recommend this place in Buenos Aires, wouldn't want to stay anywhere else. And we definitely come back! Thank you Eduardo and Gisele for the great time!

This apartment is a gem and an incredible bargain! We stayed here twice (with a one-week Patagonia trip in between) for a total of 6 days. We were three adults it was just perfect. Every room is very bright and cozy. The beds are comfortable, and the bathroom and kitchen both work well. Eduardo recommended waiting 15 minutes between showers for the hot water to heat up, but in practice we found 5 minutes was enough. This was never an issue.

The location of the apartment can't be better. We thoroughly enjoyed Palermo. Food and wine are incredible, and the neighbourhood is so vibrant and green. The subway is a 10-minute walk away along tree-lined streets. Cabs are abundant as well.

Eduardo always responded to my emails quickly did everything to make our stay easy. He even bought us empanadas and beer since we were arriving very late at night. We are very grateful! Thank you again!

Perfect location, wonderful hosts, had everything we needed, and more!

As three mature women traveling together, we required three separate beds, and sought a Palermo Soho location. Upon arrival, Eduardo was there to greet us. He provided a thorough tour not only of the apartment, and how things worked, but of the neighborhood as well. He actually took time to take us around and point out his favorite cafes, markets, etc., which we relied on throughout out stay.

Communication commenced well prior to our arrival, with quick responses to questions, needs, not to mention for the original booking, and Eduardo proceeded to give us information about transfers from the airport to the city, and even booked our return taxi for us. We cannot say enough about the effort he extended to ensure we had a perfect stay.

And a perfect stay it was. The apartment is clean, light, and charming. It was furnished with everything we could have needed: iron, hair dryer, coffee maker, coffee, fridge, guidebooks, plenty of pillows and blankets, etc.. There was also plenty of hot water for showers, elevator to the 4th floor, security building, close to public transportation and affordable, safe taxis.

Palermo Soho itself is filled with cafes, restaurants, boutiques, wine bars, bookstores, and it's cobble-stoned, tree-lined streets are strikingly beautiful. It is the best part of town to stay and play, and is central to the rest of town.

Eduardo and Gisele are great hosts! Their apartment is excellent, exactly as the pictures show! The location is as good as it gets, and they even leave tips about cool places to go, restaurants, bakeries, supermarkets in the neighborhood!
All messages were promptly answered, from the very beginning till the last day.
The apartment made our porteña experience even better!
E&G are great hosts!! The apartment lived up to its billing for its feeling and location in my favorite barrio of BA, Palermo Viejo. Highly recommended!!
Super appartement, très agréable dans un très bon quartier de BA. Nous avons passé une semaine avec deux enfants, c'était parfait. Ne pas hésiter.

Thank you soo much to Both Eduardo and Gisele for sharing their amazing apartment with us! The place is exactly as depicted in the images and description. So much thought and effort has gone into the beautiful decorations creating such a homely and spanish feel!

The apartment is fully equipped with everything you could need and extremely clean! The view at night from the balcony window is beautiful.

The apartment is in a fantastic location within very close walking distance to beautiful cafes, restaurants and shops. You really feel like you are experiencing BA like a local when you stay in this lovely apartment,

Both Eduardo and Gisele were so helpful, offering many fantastic suggestions and promptly replying to all emails.

We could not have loved our stay any more. Thank you so much to both Eduardo and Gisele. We will definatly be recommending yourselves and your apartment and we hope to be back one day!

Courtney and Cam

Excelente fin de semana, el deapartamento es ideal está muy ben equipado, aseado y es muy acogedor: Se ubica en un muy buen entorno que te permita vistar caminando muchos lugares en palermo Soho.
Tenemos muchas ganas de volver y tomar calses de tango con Gisele y Eduardo.
Saludos

Eduardo & Gisele were fantastic -- very communicative and very helpful.  They provided us with great suggestions for things to do in the neighborhood, and also for the city as a whole...things we NEVER would have found in a travel book.  The apartment is lovely and charming, and I'd stay there again in a heartbeat!  Highly recommended.

A estadia na casa foi maravilhosa!! Descobri uma nova Buenos Aires e me perdi andando pelas ruas de Palermo, os café, restaurantes e bares fazem a viagem perfeita. Adoramos a recepção da Gisele e Eduardo e já estamos programando as próximas visitas :o)
Até breve!!

Bjs

Great apartment just as the photos suggested, in a really good palermo location. Felt very at home, with a big comfy bed and good shower. Fantastic view from the balcony. Great welcome from the host, who clearly explained everything about the apartment and the building facilities. He also provided good recommendations and tips. Would definitely stay here again.

Ralf and his team have excelled as hosts! From the welcome fresh fruit basket to the hairdryer, they covered it all. Marcelo, who is a character and greeted us at the apartment, spent nearly an hour explaining us all the details about the apartment and the building, giving us tips on how to stay safe in BsAs (including the identification of fake money) and suggestions on what to do and where to go. The apartment is exactly as pictured, extremely well kept and was impeccably clean.
I definitely recommend Ralf as a host and will for sure stay in one of his properties in my next visit to BsAs.

Great checkin experience (I would certainly use the provided airport drivers if you're not familiar with BA). The apartment matches the photos quite well and is in a prime location. I hope to repeat this stay and I'd enthusiastically recommend this property and host.
Thanks to Ralf for comfortable and pleasant stay in Palermo. Special appreciation for the service at check-out: temporary room for use, luggage storage and transfer.

Nous avons été extremement bien reçus par Ralf et son équipe.
Le studio est situé dans le quartier très sympatique de Palermo Soho, à 5 minutes à pieds de la station de métro Plaza Italia, permettant d'aller facilement dans le centre ville en une vingtaine de minutes.
Nombreux restaurants, bars et petits magasins aux alentours.

Nous avons particulièrement apprécié le confort du studio et de l'immeuble, très sécurisé, avec accès gratuit à la salle de sport, au sauna, et au jacuzzi situés aux derniers étages de l'immeuble !

We were very pleased with our apartment.  The view was wonderful and we were within walking distance to all the bars and restaurants, etc that Palermo has to offer.  They helped us arrange rides to and from the airport and provided us with a place to leave our luggage the day we checked out.  Communication was responded to quickly and the hosts were friendly and reliable.

My wife, daughter and I stayed in two of Ralf's apartments (Sunset and Marylin).
