Eduardo and Gisele were very accommodating and even set up leaving out bags with the building manager since we had to be out by noon but our flight out was leaving late. The location of their apartment is great and we felt very safe where we were. Highly recommend!

What a beautiful apartment! It's in a wonderful location, and is super cute. There are also a ton of books and cds for your enjoyment. Eduardo was very helpful with recommended various tango locations in the city, even though I got to cheat with my previous knowledge ;)

This is was an excellent place to stay in Buenos Aires. It is walking distance to so much in the Palermo neighborhood. The place was tidy and comfortable and fit two of my friends and myself quite nicely. Eduardo was present to receive us and answered all our questions and had plenty of suggestions on what to do in the city. I would most definitely stay here again when I am back in the city.

Très bon accueil avec plein d'explications sur le quartier, la ville. Et tout ça en Français !
Appartement absolument conforme à la description.
Idéal avec notre fille de 5 ans qui avait sa chambre à elle.
Appartement très bien situé.
Un très bon séjour.

Eduardo was a terrific host -- he met us to show us the apartment even though our arrival was very late, and couldn't have been more helpful! He even arranged our taxis to the airport since we had to leave very early.  The apartment is lovely! Just as in the pictures, and amazingly situated right in the heart of palermo soho, just steps to don Julio and all the great bars and nightlife. I highly recommend the apartment!

Eduardo was extremely helpful both before we arrived and also while we were in Buenos Aires. He helped us to arrange a taxi from and back to the airport and even invited us to go for tango lessons (we were too tired!) The apartment was exactly as described and perfect for our needs.  From our point of view, the location could not have been better- close to many beautiful parks, great restaurants, public transportation (Eduardo even lent us a transportation card, which we never needed because we walked everywhere!) and in an interesting part of Buenos Aires.  Eduardo was available in case of emergency - thankfully we had none. We enjoyed our stay immensely in his and Gisele's home.

This apartment definitely did feel like home for the 4 days I spent here at the start of my holiday. My trip began with the airline loosing my luggage and Eduardo was super helpful in ensuring that my suitcase got safely returned to me, even offering to have it delivered to his home so that I didn't have to wait around for it. This was my first time in Buenos Aires and I absolutely fell in love with this gorgeous leafy neighbourhood. It has so many great places to eat and cute independent shops and boutiques. It's well located with great transport links, although I loved exploring on foot. Eduardo has lots of great tips on things to do. My only regrets are not hiring a bicycle and missing seeing Eduardo and Gisele dancing the tango in San Telmo. I hope to stay again soon.

Eduardo and Gisele's apartment was wonderful! Great location, and very comfortable. Eduardo was very kind and accommodating and even brought flowers for the apartment. I'd highly recommend that you rent their place when you visit BA!

Emplacement on adore, décoration existante et de bon goût, super superficie, spacieux et lumineux, au calme, Emilio le gardien très sympa. Eduardo sympathique mais doit faire de GROS efforts sur la propreté.

El apartamento de Eduardo & Gisele es comodísimo y muy agradable, buena conexión wifi, información para moverse por la ciudad con un toque personal para descubrir el barrio, cocina, enchufes, café, ducha muy caliente, sábanas y toallas impecables..., es muy luminoso y con vistas sobre tejados y terrazas bonarenses. El barrio de Palermo Soho tiene un par de plazas, una de día con mercadito de frutas, verduras y artesanía, y otra de noche rodeada de bares, y en las calles librerías-café, teatros-café, milongas, bares, restaurantes, tiendas modernísimas... calles con esquitas emparradas para la sombra y callejones con graffitis muy chulos. Eduardo estuvo pendiente de nuestra estancia todo el fin de semana, ¡gracias!! ha sido un placer.

El departamento impecable en una ubicación inmejorable! Y la atención y el contacto con Eduardo excelentes, nos recibió y explicó todo a la perfección y además estuvimos en contacto por whatsapp para cualquier duda que nos fuera surgiendo. Un 10!

J'ai séjourné une semaine dans cet appartement avec mon épouse et mes deux enfants de 5 et 2 ans. L'appartement nous a plu: il est décoré avec du goût et a un charme d'appartement vécu, avec son âme. Le principal atout de l'appartement est son emplacement: en plein Palermo Soho, à 5 min à pieds des bars, restaurants et boutiques typiques de ce quartier vivant. Malgré cela, la nuit on est calmes, y compris le weekend. Eduardo nous a donné des indications intéressantes sur Buenos Aires. Il nous a loué un lit parapluie pour le petit, qu'il m'a fait choisir auparavant sur un site internet de location de matériel pour enfants. L'appartement dispose d'une bonne connection internet via câble avec Wifi, et d'un téléphone fixe qu'Eduardo invite à "utiliser avec modération". Il y a aussi plusieurs guides de Buenos Aires à disposition des visiteurs, et une carte du métro qui simplifie l'utilisation des transports publiques. Coté améliorations possibles, il manque une machine à laver, ou une machine lave-vaisselle, mais ceci n'est pas une surprise puisque elles ne figurent pas dans la description de l'appartement non plus.
Conclusion: je recommande et j'y reviendrai si j'aurai l'opportunité

Espectacular apartamento en una inmejorable ubicación.
En el centro de Palermo Soho con una gran actividad nocturna pero justo en una cuadra tranquila para poder descansar.
Cuando vuelva a Buenos Aires ya sé dónde me voy a quedar!
Espero que sea pronto.

The apartment was great!  The pictures and description matched the apartment perfectly.  Eduardo and Gisele were very nice and accommodating.  They allowed us to check in early after an overnight flight and were very helpful when we accidentally locked ourselves out of the apartment.  I would definitely recommend the apartment and the hosts!

My friends and I had a great time staying at Eduardo & Gisele's place! The apartment had all we needed, was super well located and Eduardo was very friendly and extremely helpful all along. We recommend it!

Everything was perfect!
Good Place
Great Spot
Loved the neigborhood

Fuimos dos días con unos amigos y pasamos muy bien. El departamento está excelentemente ubicado, a pocas cuadras de bares, restoranes y la Plaza Serrano. Buena vida nocturna y fácil de llegar. Eduardo fue sumamente servicial, dejándonos varios mapas y dándonos recomendaciones de lugares para visitar. Sin dudas lo tendremos en cuenta si volvemos!
Muy buena experiencia, todo como lo pactado.

We had a great experience! Eduardo was extremely helpful and set up a driver to pick us up from the airport. He also gave us tips on restaurants and other activities to check out. The location is perfect, right in the middle of Palermo, the most charming neighborhood in B.A.!  The apartment was just as described and everything worked. We would definitely stay here again and would recommend to anyone visiting. Thanks again Eduardo!

El apartamento muy lindo, tal cual lo ofrecido. Eduardo muy hospitalario. La verdad que lo recomiendo, me volvería a quedar en el.
El apto esta muy bien ubicado y cumple con todo.
Muy cómodo el departamento. Muy lindo barrio. Todo funcionó muy bien.

We had a great time at this lovely apartment in Palermo Soho- clean, well-appointed and perfectly located in the heart of a very cosmopolitan and sophisticated neighborhood. Eduardo was very kind and helpful and quick to respond to queries.

Realmente nos sentimos recebidas em casa. A primeira vez de minha filha em B Aires foi premiada por uma recepção carinhosa, no simpático e super bem localizado apartamento de Giselle e Eduardo. E uma deliciosa noitada na Maldita Milonga foi um inesperado bônus! Valeu,Eduardo e Gilberto, muchas gracias!

A smooth well-oiled experience without any hiccups or stress -- reserving the place, staying there, leaving the place. Eduardo readily followed up with me soon after the reservation, providing all the requisite details, and providing help/suggestions for other things I'd asked: babysitter services, tango show, taxi, etc.

The place was just as advertised. Great location in a safe trendy neighborhood with lots of things to walk to (the zoo, plaza italia, the metro/subte, restaurants/bars) and a park/playground for toddlers and up.

I'm glad we stayed here.
The space was great and perfectly located.  Everything was clean, and Eduardo was so helpful. I would definitely stay here again!
fantastic place and amazing management, I would really recommend it

Ivan was an awesome host!  Super cute apartment! He was kind enough and patient enough to wait for me and my friend who arrived late.  Ivan immediately lent us a local cell phone making it super easy to connect with friends in town.    The apartment for the price is the perfect home base in Buenos Aires.   The apartment was situated in the perfect artsy/bohemian neighborhood.  We were able to grab the cross town buses directly across the street from the apt making it super easy to get around.  Don't forget to check out the street vendors on Sunday  just one block over.  There's also a food market for great fish and meats and veggies and fruit on Saturday's half a block from the apt.  My friend left his credit cards and other important documents accidentally in the apt.  Ivan was kind enough to DHL those documents back to us in NY within days.  Thanks Ivan for a lovely experience in BA.

Paseo Colon ist eine sehr laute befahrene Straße, dafür aber sehr central.Die Wohnung auf dem 1.Stock ist sehr nett, kein Luxus.(Sauber)
Für BA. nicht immer selbstverständlich.
Ansonsten kein Problem.

Ivan was a really great host!

Listening to frank Sinatra records in the evening in his Clean, stylish newly renovated apartment was very relaxing. Great location and internet. Ivan was also very lenient and let us extend our stay at the last Minuit (twice!).

I would recommend this place to everyone!
Great apartment, nice stay. The air con is working well, a lot of different lights very utile to change atmosphere. Ivan is a great and professional host. I'll come back one day.

Ivan was a great host, giving us a lot of information about all the places to go, practical information, and most important where to eat the best steaks. The apartment is really nice, with 2 big bedrooms and a somewhat smaller living. The apartment is really close to San Telmo, in a couple of minuten you'll be on the street market on Sundays and in the heart of San Telmo on other days. We extended our stay two times, which was not a problem at all. We would stay here again if we go back to Buenos Aires.

Thanks to Ivan, we had a great (even better than great) stay in Buenos Aires.
The place is lovely and there is enough space for 4 people.
I particularly thank Ivan for the cleanliness of the place, the clean sheets on the beds, the towels for each person (lovely attention) and the useful kitchen supplies : a perfect host!
Everything was perfect! :)
I just recommend people straying at Ivan's to bring earplugs, the streets of Buenos Aires can be sometimes noisy.

Great apartment in a great location! Very clean and equipped with everything you need. Downstairs is some of the best coffee, Indie is a cool local bar, and Gran Parrilla del Plata has the best lomo in town! Ivan was incredibly helpful and made our stay exceptional.

Can't say enough good things about this apartment. Location was fantastic right next to Plaza Italia, and we loved being in Palermo Soho neighborhood. Wish we could have stayed here more than a week, and will be staying again when we return to Buenos Aires!

Perfection! Such a lovely place equipped with everything you'll need during your stay! Ralf and assistants (especially Marcelo) were very responsive and helpful at all times. They were very accommodating to my late departure, allowing me to stay at the apartment next door. Super secure place and great location. 100% recommend!
El apartamento muy bien, muy funcional todo. Muy práctico. Recomendable.

Tres bel endroit et accueil chaleureux
Tres flexible et disponible
Bref je conseille aux prochains voyageurs de profiter de cette location merveilleusement situee

The house was exactly as described in a really good and safe location. There are plenty of restaurants and markets nearby as well. The subte (metro) is down the street.

Ralf and his team were great. Our flight was delayed from 930am arrival to 0130am the next day and they accommodated us easily. They had someone wait at the apartment for us to show us the details of the apartment. They also provide a car to/from the airport for $45 USD (recommended).

Lastly, we unfortunately had to return home for a family emergency with multiple days left on our reservation and they were more than willing to alter our reservation on no notice to help us out. We can't say enough about how nice they were.

Ivan is an excellent host! We had a really great time in Buenos Aires and he gave us lots of tips and recommendations about different places to go and activities we could do. He was disposed to answer all of our questions, and was really attentive (thanks for the towels, fruit and wine ;)!!). The apartment is perfect for 4 people. Comfortable, very clean and really well equipped. Bedrooms are big and everything works good. The location... nothing to say, perfect!! in 5 minutes you are literally everywhere (San Telmo itself, Puerto Madero, casa rosada, center, subway stations...) and you have taxis and buses stopping right outside the apartment. Maybe a little bit noisy at night, but nothing that some earplugs can't fix.
Totally recommendable! We would definitely stay here again.

Excelente sitio para hospedarse, super cómodo! limpio, con todo lo necesario para estar bien! Muy bien ubicado, Ivan atento, al pendiente de tus necesidades, recomienda sitios que se adapte a tus gusto ya sea para comer, pasear etc.
SIn duda un sitio para volver... Gracias por todo ivan!

To those visiting Buenos Aires and especially for those visiting San Telmo this is the perfect spot! We were never had any issues with the street noise. We always sleep with a "white noise" app playing anyway :) The apartment layout is perfect and the kitchen is big enough to enjoy and actually use. We loved the antique dressers, china cabinet, vinyl record player, phone, etc... The strong wifi, super clean linens and rooms was a big plus for us.
Ivan is a great host. He welcomed us to his apartment with beverages, fruit, two sets of keys, and a cell phone & land-line to use. He was very hands off (unobtrusive) yet always an email message or phone call away. I would definitely use his apartment again and would most definitely recommend it to anyone :)
Iván es un gran anfitrión. Puntual, preocupado, cumplidor y muy honesto. Lo recomiendo completamente. Todo lo que prometió, se cumplió 100%.

Ivan é um cara muito querido, o apto é maravilhoso, tudo limpo e de muito bom gosto, as camas são confortáveis, tudo funciona bem direitinho, o astral daquele lugar é um convite para passar bem.
A localização é estratégica, San Telmo, é um bairro incrível, cheio de surpresas. Além disso, muitos dos lugares que o turista quer ver e conhecer ficam perto (da para ir caminhando) e o deslocamento para outros lugares é fácil, já que tem varias rotas de ônibus na frente do prédio e estação do metrô por perto.
Ivan nos recebeu com vinho, deixou refri na geladeira, além de frutas, agua, bolachas e café. Ele é muito gente fina, muito disposto a colaborar em tudo. A comunicação é fluida e responde as duvidas pacientemente e com muita rapidez.
Certamente quando eu voltar a Buenos Aires, vou procurar este lugar, para me hospedar de novo. Grande abraço Ivan.

¡El apartamento de Ivan es perfecto! Estaba impecable, nos dejó toallas, jabón, una botella de vino y mapas de la ciudad. ¿Qué más se puede pedir para viajar y ver una ciudad? Iván es un tipo fiable, respetuoso y responsable, que claramente sabe como abrirte las puertas a un lugar que sientas como tuyo. ¡No dudéis en reservarlo!

Ivan's apartment is the perfect mix of cool and comfortable; we really enjoyed listening to records and sipping tea in the mornings while planning our days in BA. The location is good too; right around the corner from Defensa St, the spine of San Telmo. And Ivan was a perfect host: he stayed really late to greet us the night of our arrival when our flight was delayed, was helpful with recommendations in the area, and was laid back about checkout.

Travelers not used to older buildings in big cities should know that this is an older building in a big city. For us that meant pure charm and convenience, but others might be more sensitive to street noise and slightly unpredictable hot water, etc.

We would gladly return and recommend!

Ivan's apartment is really nice, good equipped and furnished in a great vintage style. We loved to be there. The location of the flat is really good to get around. It is nearly in the middle of everything. Ivan himself is an incredible host, who cares about his guests. We asked him a lot of questions and in just some minutes we got answers. His recommendations are great and useful. So if you wish to stay in Buenos Aires - go to Ivan's place!
Iván nos recibió en el apto y nos explicó el funcionamiento de todo. Dejo frutas y algunos alimentos básicos que facilitaron nuestra estadía en BsAs!

Nuestra estadía fue muy cómoda. El apartamento estaba en pleno centro, muy cerca de la Casa Rosada y también del barrio San Telmo. El departamento muy limpio, ordenado y con mucho estilo, tal y como se ve en las fotos. Ivan fue muy amable, nos dio un celular, comunicación óptima. Gracias, esperamos algún día regresar.

Ivan's place is located in the lovely barrio of San Telmo, a short walk to the Sunday antique street market. The apartment has what you need for a short stay, and is nicely decorated with a vintage flair. Ivan isa great and helpful host!

Eduardo was an excellent host.  He made sure that everything was in place for us to have an enjoyable time in Buenos Aires, even though he was out of town during our 3 day visit.  He was very responsive to all emails before we arrived, and his daughter was at the apartment to welcome and orient us in person.  The apartment is very nice, and the kitchen was well-equipped, so that my family and I could easily prepare meals there when not enjoying the nice restaurants in the neighborhood.  I highly recommend this place and its host, as have all others who have stayed there.
Cómo siempre! todo espectacular! ya es mi casa en Palermo Soho!

We were warmly greeted by Eduardo into the apartment. The apartment itself was just as advertise, very confortable, and the neighborhood was great! Eduardo gave us excellent recommendations of restaurants and sightseeing at walking distance from the apartment. I really recommend this place!

Eduardo was at the apartment when I arrived and made me feel very welcome as he showed me everything I needed to know. In later days, if I had any query, Eduardo was extremely responsive.
The apartment situated on the edge of the trendy, hip Plaza Serrano in Palermo Soho, was clean and comfortable with many good restaurants and plentiful good shopping.
And if you are a Tanguero, Eduardo and Gisele will guide you well as to Milongas and classes. La Viruta is very close by.
I would be happy to stay there again the next time I am in Buenos Aires.

The apartment is small but with everything needed,it's based in a very nice neighborhood you can find many restaurants and shops,very easy to move.Eduardo is a good host,he came to meet us and introduce how to use the apartment and the city also.There is some small problem but he fixed very quickly,and he arranged taxi for us when leaving,we appreciate it.

This is a great little apartment right in the middle of all that is great about Palermo... but with a quiet and pleasant outlook. We never got to meet Eduardo or Gisele but we did meet their daughter who was lovely and showed us everything. If you want a great base for Bs As - this is it.

This was an absolutely perfect 2 bedroom apartment in one of my favorite neighborhoods in BA.  Eduardo and Gisele were more than accommodating, including letting us in 2 hours early while they were still cleaning, because it was pouring rain and we had all of our luggage.  They let us drop our stuff off and come back when the place was ready for us to check in.  The entire process was easy and smooth, and the place was great for 3 or 4 people to sleep and socialize.

Eduardo nous a chaleureusement accueillis. Nous nous sommes vraiment sentis "comme à la maison". Nous avons apprécié l'équipement et l'aménagement. Le quartier de Palermo Soho est très sympa, branché et agréable. Nous avons rencontré des gens très accueillants, très chaleureux chez les commerçants et  dans les restaurants des alentours. Si nous devions vivre à Buenos Aires, nous aimerions habité dans ce quartier!

I stayed at Eduardo's place with two friends. The three of us fit comfortably and the apartment was what we were expecting. Great location in Palermo, especially on the weekend we were close to two markets, great restaurants, lots of shopping and cafes. We were also able to walk past the zoo and the botanic gardens. Eduardo was very accommodating and helped us set up a tour using his discount code when we arrived. He has a ton of travel books, maps, and suggestions for things to do. I highly recommend staying here.
Great location and the best guidance from the host to move around. Will rent again in the future.

El dpto superaba ampliamente con las expectativas que teníamos del mismo. Realmente nos sentimos como en casa.
La atención que recibimos por parte de Eduardo fue excelente. Siempre se mostró muy predispuesto a responder a nuestras consulta se inquietudes.
La ubicación de dpto es excelente.

My wife and I had a delightful stay in Eduardo and Gisele's lovely Palermo apartment. We were met by their daughter Eugenia, who made us feel very welcome and explained everything we needed to know about the apartment and neighborhood. We were grateful that they have a SUBE card for guests that we were able to use on the subway and buses. Eugenia showed us a bird that was nesting with two baby chicks in the planter in one of the windows, and we got to watch the chicks grow over the course of the week we were there. They were great company for us.
When we arrived there was an issue with the air conditioner, but they had it serviced for us promptly and it worked perfectly for the rest of our stay. It was very easy to communicate with Eduardo and Eugenia (through WhatsApp and the phone in the apartment), and we appreciated their thorough and helpful responses to all our questions. We highly recommend this comfortable and homey apartment for anyone interested in staying in Palermo. Muchas gracias Eduardo, Gisele, and Eugenia!

We totally appreciate Eduardo's house. It was very clean, comfortable, well located and Eduardo helped me through the process very carefully. When i returned to Sao Paulo, i asked to stay again, but the place was already booked unfortunately. You can stay here without any question mark

Eduardo was traveling so his son, Sebastian, assisted me with my stay. He was welcoming and extremely helpful when I had to book an early morning taxi to EZE - given I knew little Spanish. Thanks Sebastian. Also, I really loved the neighborhood.
I loved this apartment, communication was excellent, the apartment had a great vibe to it and the neighbourhood was great! Highly recommend this place.

Eduardo était absent à notre arrivée mais son fils était à l'appartement pour nous accueillir et ça été sympathique ! L'appartement était tel que montré sur les photos  mais un peu plus petit qu'il paraissait. Idéal pour 2 ou 3 personnes, ou 2 adultes et 2 enfants mais pas plus selon moi.

Eduardo was a fantastic host. We were between accommodation on the day of check-in, and he allowed us to drop our bags early in the morning. He also suggested places for us to hang out and eat while he readied the apartment for us. Throughout our stay he checked in and inquired as to how we were enjoying the city. He also suggested things for us to do, and made it clear that he was at our disposal. The accommodation description was totally accurate. A great little place in the heart of Palermo.

Apartamento muito bom tanto na limpeza, infraestrutura, vista, como na localização.
Fomos muito bem orientados pelo Marcelo que nos deu algumas dicas.
Serviço de auto funcionou perfeitamente.
Recomendo!
What a great apartment over looking at the city! Clean,good location and the perfect size, exactly what I was looking for to stay in Buenos Aires!
My stay was very enjoyable and was exactly as described and expected. The host was very helpful in answering any questions for travelers.

Great apartment with awesome location. Near ATM, attractions, restaurants, bars, cafes, dance clubs and supermarkets. Palermo has so many great restaurants that we where able to have lunch and dinner in a different one every day of our 7 day stay.
The staff was great especially Marcelo. The apartment looks just like the pictures and has everything you need to have a great stay. We recommend you use their airport transfering service. It worked great for us. The building where the apartment is located is very safe with private security( the guards were very polite) and a basic gym on the 31st floor that has an amazing view of the city.
We will definitely booked this apartment again when we returned to Buenos Aires.
Another trip and another excellent stay in the building. I love this building and the neighborhood. Thanks for another great trip!
I always love staying at Ralf's.  Beautiful units and the best location in BA.
Ralph's place is great. The location is really convenient (in San Palermo, a few minutes away from the subway), the apartment is well furnished and the view is amazing.

Ralf and his team were very accommodating . The apartment is just like The pictures and it is spectacular. The building is very well located and maintained.
By far the best value apartment I've stayed in. Highly recommended.

Ralf was really nice and great host.
The flat is really modern and well furnished. Quiet place.
The gym on the roof is just perfect!
Highly recommended.
Ralf nos recebeu muito bem, super pontual, ajudou nas localizações básicas.

This apartment was absolutley perfect for our trip! It was clean, comfortable and came with a view that took our breath away. We were welcomed at the apartment by Andres after a delayed flight and late arrival which we very much appreciated! He was able to walk us through everything we needed to know about the unit and all things Buenos Aires. The building is in a great location in Palermo Soho, so we were able to walk to many places or jump on the green line of the Sube to get to everywhere we wanted to go. We also felt safe in the buidling with the security features. I would highly recommend staying here if you are traveling to Buenos Aires.

The apartment was really great, the neighbourhood of Palermo is perfect to find restaurants, milongas, parties at night, and yet it is very quiet, close to big parks very well adapted to run.
And Ralf was very helpful, very professional, all the good advices were written in a booklet !
Great location, very professional service, everything corresponds to the photos. We had a lovely weekend with our 18 months baby boy.
We enjoyed our stay in Buenos Aires and we felt that Eduardo was attentive to our needs.  His daughter even met my children at the apartment at 5:30--much appreciation!
Eduardo & Gisele have been great hosts. The communication was very easy and fast and they provided all information required. The apartment is located perfectly in a great neighborhoud.
Eduardo was the most helpful and caring host! We would love to go back anytime.
Eduardo was very kind and helpful and the apartment in charming, cozy and very well located near all the attractions of Palermo. Highly recommended!

The apartment was great and Eduardo was very nice and helpful. The location is perfect, conveniently located in the center of Palermo near so many great restaurants, cafes, bars and shops. It is also a short walk to the subway so getting around the city was easy.

Eduardo é um anfitrião excelente. Nos recebeu com muito carinho e atenção. Foi muito além de apenas alugar um apartamento para nós. Ele nos deu dicas preciosas sobre os restaurantes, livrarias e cafés do bairro e estava sempre disponível para qualquer dúvida. O apartamento é muito bem localizado, próximo a restaurantes, bares e lojas e ao transporte público. Muito confortável, tem uma boa estrutura para quem quer cozinhar. Recomendo muito, inclusive para quem tem filhos. Fui com meu bebê de 11 meses e adorei a experiência.

The apartment was fantastic!! JUST like the photos. Gisele met me with the keys and got me up to speed on how thugs worked. I stayed there with my two year old and the neighborhood felt safe. There's a big plaza around the corner and we had fun seeing the other families and kids playing on the play equipment. I can't wait to stay there again! A home away from home for us now.

Our stay was just as great as the first if not better because we knew the neighborhood and could really get around like locals. The area is VERY quiet and I felt safe with my two year old walking even at late at 9:30 pm. It was winter and yet the heating was very good and we were very comfortable. Eduardo was sure to leave us umbrellas which came in handy more than once. Honestly, I hope this is where I call home when visiting Buenos Aires!

La casa hermosa, la ubicación increíble! Cerquita de todo! Eduardo me atendió muy bien, tuve solamente un problema con el wifi pero no dependió de el, era problema de la compañía. Pasamos muy lindo! Espero poder volver pronto! :)
La ubicación es excelente. El departamento es muy cómodo. Eduardo es muy gentil y estuvo en contacto con nosotros permanentemente. Nos sentimos como en casa, lo recomendamos.

Adoramos o apartamento! Acolhedor!Muito bem localizado em relação aos nossos interesses, amplo, decoração sóbria, bem equipado, limpo.
Nossos anfitriões, desde os primeiros contatos, foram bastante atenciosos e dedicaram especial atenção no dia da chegada para mostrar tudo e promover uma ambientação tranquila.
Recomendamos fortemente a experiência a quem interesse viver Palermo/Buenos Aires como um local.
AMAZING!

Spacious and ideally located this apartment provided quiet rest and access to any Buenos Aires activity. Ricardo's attention to detail and willingness to make our stay a happy one is of the highest level.  He accommodated our late arrival seamlessly and left more than the basics so that we truly felt at home! As well Eduardo and Giselle are experts in tango so this would be an ideal place for a group interested in experiencing/learning tango. If this is your first trip to Bs As Eduardo would be the perfect host to provide all the support needed. Location is 10/10 just one block from 50 Best Restaurants in the World San Pellegrino 2016 winner Don Julio Parrilla and all other Palermo restaurants, shops and attractions.  The building is a short walk from Plaza Italia subway station that connects quickly to all other locations. Emilio, the building's encargado, was also very helpful. The neighbourhood is safe and alive at all hours of day and night. Eduardo provides already set up taxi numbers, SUBE cards and discount cards for supermarkets. The apartment is stocked with reading material, music, and travel guides. Water in shower is good and beds are very comfortable. The kitchen is stocked above average with all necessities. Buenos Aires is a mecca destination that has won the 2017 best gastronomic destination in Latinamerica and this is a great place to visit if you are not sure and would like to have support. Will definitely recommend Eduardo and Giselle! Muchas gracias! Missing it already.

We were two friends traveling through Buenos Aires for a couple nights en route to Chile. Eduardo and Gisele were incredibly responsive and helpful in planning our stay. There was one example in particular - they were able to help us obtain pesos at a much more favourable rate than in our home countries. The place is just as advertised and positively reviewed by many others.
Su hospitalidad
We enjoyed our stay at Eduardo's place! Communication was very good, the place was exactly was pictured and the place was cozy and in an excellent location. Would definitely recommend!

Eduardo was very considerate. The apartment is cute and in a great area for shops, restaurants, safety, etc.
There is a school nearby and it seems the children are always on recess so during the day with windows open there is that noise. Although the listing stresses the need to be quiet to not disturb the neighbors, one neighbor on the 3rd floor played loud electric rock guitar music every afternoon. Another neighbor had a fairly noisy party Friday evening but it was over by 12 which is ok. Then another one (I think on the first floor) had a loud party that was still going strong when I got up the next day. I had resorted to sleeping pill and earplugs to be able to sleep at all. If you are a night owl and not around during the day, these things wont matter and certainly aren't the owner's fault. I would plan to go again if I were there for partying,which wasn't the case this visit. Another weird thing was that all the electricity for our block went out one night for about 3 hours. I don't know if that is a common occurrence. I went to a bar and watched news until bedtime, and lights came on shortly after I got back. I have a travel flashlight or I would have been stumbling around blind. Eduardo might want to invest in some candles just in case it happens again.

ivan was very helpful and the cleaning service was perfect! the location of the apartment was very convenient for our needs and the place was designed very well. the bedroom does have some traffic noise because the apartment is against a main road; however, that was not a problem for us at all. might be a problem for very light or sensitive sleepers. other than that, the apartment is fantastic!

Ivan is a great host, he responds immediately to answers, problems etc. The aparatment is really nice, clean and very well situated. Unfortunately we had a mosquito plague, since we didnt ask Ivan for help, we had to suffer through it.

Ótima experiência! Ivan nos recebeu com roupas de cama e banho impecavelmente limpas, foi muito atencioso na comunicação. O apartamento tem uma localização excelente. Perto de Puerto Madero, da Plaza de Mayo (onde pegamos metrô para todos os lados), dos ótimos bares de San Telmo. Pra quem tem problema de sono leve, o barulho da Avenida pela manhã (é super movimentada) pode incomodar. Fora isso, apt bem decorado, bem agradável. Recomendadíssimo!

Appartement super. Très bien équipé. Situation excellente près du coeur de San Telmo. Ivan est un hôte très sympathique et il s'est même débrouillé pour trouver un petit lit pour loger notre fille! Je recommande vivement !

Departamento super. Muy bien equipado. Ubicuacion ideal muy cerca del centro de San Telmo. Ivan es muy simpatico, muy disponible, hasta nos encontro una camita para nuestra hija ! Aconsejo este alojamiento a todos.

The apt is just like You see IT on photos! Good location, good transport possibilities close to the apt. Very good contact with Ivan. It was very nice of him to leave us some fruits and wine on our arrival. The location was very good, walking distance to San telmo, centre and puerto madero. I would recommend it to my friends! The apt is really nice, vintage style, we listened to vinyls-awesome! One small drawback is that it is quite noisy in bedrooms as windows face the Main Street. However, as I notice if you want to leave in centre it is almost impossible to find quiet place. Nonetheless, I would stay again in the apt! Ivan was very helpful with tips about the city! Thank you!
Muy recomendable!!

Ivan's apartment was perfect - in location, decor, and cleanliness. It was situated in the heart of San Telmo - so close to many restaurants and bars on Av. Chile and the arts and crafts fair on Defensa on Sundays. Ivan greeted us downstairs and walked us to our apartment - which was very clean, very uniquely designed with a combination of modern and antigue ambiance. He had a record player and very fun lights in the living room.

Ivan is a wonderful and responsive host - we had many questions for him and he responds very promptly. Definitely recommend his place if anyone wants to base themselves in San Telmo - so convenient!

Ivan se portó muy bien, atento a todas nuestras necesidades. En general el apartamento está muy bien ubicado, limpio y en buen estado. Se debería cuidar mucho el ruido insonorizando las ventanas, pues el ruido es insoportable. El colchón de una de las camas es muy incómodo.

Ivan is a great host, very kind and welcoming! We stayed in his beautifully decorated apartment in the historic San Telmo neighborhood, equipped with stylish appliances. We had a great time in the apartment, located on a busy street, and only 2 blocks from fun bars and delicious restaurants. Highly recommended!
The apartment was very nice and comfortable. We loved the view and the heated floor. The bed and linen were a delight.

Beautiful apartment with a gorgeous view of the city. We loved getting some wine and cheese and relaxing on the balcony in the evening. We dealt with Andres and he was super friendly and helpful. He let us know where everything we needed was in the area and gave us a map. The location was perfect for us. Only a 5 minute walk to the subway which will get you everywhere you need to go around Buenos Aires. The apartment itself was very close to quite a few nice restaurants. I recommend Don Julio for the best steak you'll have in your life! We had an issue with the toilet blocking up on our 3rd day and they quickly resolved the issue while we were out exploring the city. Very efficient! I highly recommend this apartment. The neighbourhood is nice and we felt completely safe walking around into the early hours of the morning.

We used Ralf's arranged car service from EZE (much less stressful than all the other options available) and were taken straight to the apartment.  Marcelo gave us a thorough rundown of all the apt features and of Buenos Aires (with a map for us to keep even).  We probably kept him for an entire hour just asking questions about Argentina and BsAs, and he was so helpful in getting us oriented.  The apartment is very nice, and the team leaves you with a basket of fresh fruit (perfect for breakfast on the patio).  The view and amenities were wonderful!

Ralf and Marcelo were both very welcoming, helpful, and responsive to our questions while visiting BA for our first time. The apartment was perfect with a great view and a balcony to enjoy sunset from. The location was awesome. Only two blocks from the subway station (very easy and convenient to use - did not realize what a resource that would be) and a short stroll to the bars and restaurants in Palermo SoHo. Ralf's book of recommendations was helpful and the complimentary fruit was a nice touch. This was our first AirBnB experience and it was awesome. I would love to come back to BA and stay here again!

well located and very safe place to be in bs. the view is amazing!!! gym in the 31 floor is included and also spa area on 32 floor wich is a nice benefit to this appartment. next stay will be definitly with this hosts again.

Ivan's apartment is perfectly located at the edge of San Telmo and Montserrat. We found plenty of great restaurants, cafés, etc within easy walking distance.  The apartment is comfortable, though there's a lot of street noise - the price you pay for a fantastic location in the heart of the city.

O apartamento é perfeito! Super lindo, organizado e limpinho. Amei! O Ivan é um ótimo anfitrião, e me deu toda assistência necessária, foi ótimo. Amamos a decoração!
A localização é simplesmente perfeita! 2 quadras de Puerto Madero e perto da Casa Rosada também. Dá pra ir na Rua Florida à pé.
Muito bom mesmo, recomendo.

Iván es excelente anfitrión. El lugar es cómodo y cálido. La ambientación del departamento es tal cual se muestra en las imágenes. Lo que hace grata la estadía es esa mezcla entre tango y jazz, lo antiguo y lo moderno se funden en el lugar. El vecindario es ideal, San Telmo es bello. Se puede ir caminando a varios lugares o tomar algún transporte público.  El subte esta cerca. Hay cocheras accesibles y cercanas al departamento. Muy recomendable. No se lo pierdan. Saludos
It's a great apartment, clean, comfy. Be aware of the significant street noise, though it was never much of an issue for us. Ivan was super-responsive, kind and helpful!
We had a great stay at the apartment. We had everything we needed and the location is perfect for discovering Palermo. Flat is spacious and equipped for cooking in.

Eduardo and Gisele were incredible hosts. They were flexible with us on check in and check out times and they made sure we were well positioned to take advantage of all that Palermo and Buenos Aires has to offer.

The apartment is well kept and spacious.

I highly recommend this airbnb location to anyone!

Gisele speaks Portuguese English and Spanish. Eduardo speaks English and Spanish.

Great apartment! Definitely recommend staying here.

Eduardo and Eugenia were great hosts - good communication, welcoming and very helpful. The apartment is large and spacious, and it's located in a great area of Palermo - close to bars and restaurants and about 15min walk to the Plaza Italia subte station (the underground).

Totalmente recomendado. Esta muy bien ubicado, la zona es divertida con buenos restaurantes y bares, cerca a 2 paradas del bus turistico y del subte. Eduardo estuvo muy atento y muy pendiente de nosotros.

A perfect flat for hanging out in one of the best neighbourhoods in Buenos Aires! Comfortable and with lovely decor, it is incredibly well situated near endless bars, cafes and shops, and yet is extremely quiet. Easy walking distance to lots of interesting sights and museums, galleries etc as well. Eduardo is a wonderful host - very attentive and full of very useful suggestions. We fell in love with Buenos Aires staying here!
Eduardo and Gisele were excellent hosts and the apartment was well set up, very comfortable and situated in an amazing neighborhood. Highly recommended.
Appartamento gradevole e funzionale situato in una zona residenziale interessante per i servizi e la gran quantità di locali. Vicino alla metropolitana che si trova in piazza Italia.

Localização excelente. Mercado, bares, o agito da Plaza Serrano.
Muito próximo a Av Santa Fé, de onde é possível conseguir transporte publico para toda cidade.
Da pra ir caminhando para o Jardim Botânico.
Gisele e Edu são super atenciosos e podem dar diversas dicas sobre a cidade.
Recomendo e voltarei!
Great space. Great neighborhood. Great hosts.
Todo Excelente, gran lugar para conocer BsAs, lo mejor es su ubicación, la pasamos increíble y siempre Eduardo muy atento!

If you want to be in the Palermo neighborhood, this is a great place to stay. It has the basics f what you need, plus some wonderful books on Argentina. The host Eduardo is so friendly and does everything possible to make your stay the best. The AC works well ( I have heat allergy) and bed very very comfortable, and good pillows. The neighborhood is very quiet, even though nearby places are lively, and sometimes with live music, the actual building and street is very tranquil. I would definitely stay here again! And I feel I have made new friends with Eduardo and Gisela.

In one word: wonderful!

Wonderful hosts, wonderful flat, wonderful location, wonderful experience. Eduardo & Gisele's place is a gem.

Everything about our stay was lovely. Check-in was super easy and flexible (much appreciated). The flat looks just like the photos, very welcoming and like home. The location is *amazing* -- in the heart of Palermo! Even extra nice touches like transit passes and lesser-known local recommendations.

We loved our stay, hope to visit again soon and would highly recommend to others!
Todo de diez! Gracias! ;)
This room is very good.Nice location & Good Communication!!

Eduardos Appartment kann ich jedem empfehlen. Es ist in Palermo gelegen, welches meiner Meinung nach die schönste Gegend in Buenos Aires ist. Zahlreiche Restaurants, Bars und auch Geschäfte sind zu Fuß erreichbar. Die Wohnung bietet ausreichend Platz für 3 Personen. Es gibt ein Doppelbett und in einem separaten Zimmer sogar ein Einzelbett. Ich glaube, es wäre auch möglich, auf der Couch im Wohnzimmer zu schlafen. Dies haben wir jedoch nicht in Anspruch genommen. Eduardo war sehr unkompliziert und auch auf einen kleinen Fehler meinerseits bezüglich des Check-Out-Zeitpunkes hat er freundlich und zuvorkommend reagiert. Vielen Dank für diesen schönen Aufenthalt!

Excellent location, just a couple of blocks from the heart of Palermo Soho which has a great vibe and loads of great cafes/restaurants.  Also the Buenos Aires Bus that tours the whole city stops just 3 blocks away!  Communication with Eduardo was fantastic and he was very accommodating/flexible.  Would definitely recommend this apartment and host.
Todo muy bien. Eduardo se mostró atento y nos hizo recomendaciones del barrio y BsAs en general. Recomendamos la atención y el lugar para hospedarse.

L'appartamento era molto bello e funzionale, esattamente come nella descrizione e nelle foto dell'annuncio. E' situato nel quartiere Palermo, una zona molto tranquilla e piena di ristoranti e negozi. In pochi minuti in metropolitana puoi raggiungere il microcentro. Dal ventesimo piano dell'appartamento si gode di una vista magnifica. La società di Ralf, che gestisce diversi appartamenti in zona, è molto seria e professionale. Ad accoglierci è stato Marcelo, che è stato molto gentile a darci informazioni utili per vivere al meglio la splendida Buenos Aires. Disponibile è presente per ogni tipo di problema. Una persona davvero eccezionale. Sicuramente torneremo in Argentina e certamente ritorneremo in uno degli appartamenti della società di Ralf. Grazie di tutto

This apartment was great - amazing view and convenient location.  The host was very knowledgeable and helpful.  He had maps and guidebooks waiting for us as well as coffee and fruit.  We had a great stay!

The hosts were great!  Very polite and helpful - they got me on the right track since it was my first time in BA.  The APT is nice; basically what you see - the bed was very comfy!  If you're used to big city US 'high end' apartments, though, it wasn't quite up to par, but I don't think that's this apartment specifically - just a difference in construction between the Americas.  Still a great deal for what you pay.

With an exceptional view the location is perfect to explore Palermo and the subway is a quick convenient few minutes walk. A couple of blocks walk on the same street is a good inexpensive local restaurant called La Lechuza the address is 1980 Uriarte. The pre-arranged airport transfer worked very well I would recommend it.

Ralf and his team have been amazing!  We booked our stay well in advance of our trip to Buenos Aires. They were well prepared from the the first interactions. Great communication and timely responses! 

Andres and Marcelo were our main contracts.  Andres, who helped via email prior to arrival secure a driver from international airport to the apartment for check-in. The driver mainly spoke Spanish but was kind and safe.  

When we arrived, Marcelo was waiting for us at the apartment. Marcelo, took the time to show us all the nice features of the apartment, as well as a map with points of interest marked off.

The apartment look just like the photos!  It's a really great, clean, light filled apartment.  The building has 5 elevators, two security guards on duty at all times, and it's very conveniently located.

We also scheduled a driver to bring us to the domestic airport. At check out Marcelo met us. We had made plans to leave our bags with Marcelo in a secure location before we met the driver becuase we were going to have time between check out and going to the airport.  However, our plane was early. Andres over email helped get the driver sooner than expected!

Ralf and his team are full service. It's a great apartment in a fabulous lication.  Definitely advise others to stay with Ralf!

This was a top-notch apartment in one of the best buildings in Buenos Aires. The views were amazing (especially from the top-floor gym!) and the apartment was clean and quiet. I would definitely return again! The host also did an excellent job of showing the ammenities and making sure everything would go smoothly.

Ralf's studio was amazing, it had everything I needed, including a warm welcome by one of his staff members with free fruit, water, and coffee. They provided me with the option to use their airport pick-up service also which made it convenient after a long flight. His studio was clean and has a great view of the city. The studio is located only two short blocks from the subway and the neigborhood itself felt very safe and they have grocery stores nearby in case you want to eat at home. I do appreciate Ralf staff team with providing me a city map and suggestions on what to do. They also have a universal international plug surcharger which came in handy to charge my phone. I really like that they had a gym onsite and laundry option and a pool. You are in a gated(with security guard) high rise building which makes you feel extra safe as well. The bed is queen size and it felt nice and cozy along with the A/C unit. Cable with direct TV is also available. They were aslo very nice to allow me to check in early and do a late check out(Thank You).

I would highly recommend anyone to stay at his place and I would definitley love to stay here again on my next visit.

Excelente apartamento, exatamente como nas fotos. Anfitrião solícito e muito simpático. Localização excelente, perto de vários restaurantes, cafés e mercados. Próximo também do Metrô e dos Parques de Palermo.  Ficarei no mesmo local, numa futura vinda a Buenos Aires.

Pre stay communication was friendly and efficient. We arrived quite early, but Ralf let us into the apartment way ahead of the check-in time. We got very useful tips for money exchange and restaurants in the area. The apartment is just perfect to explore the bustle of Palermo and conveniently close to the Subte to venture into the city. A great experience...

This sunset luxury apartment was perfect for us during our week in Buenos Aires. Perfect location in fancy palermo, a very nice view from the balcony (which we used a lot), nice poolarea, comfortable bed and bathroom. We felt secure and taken care of. I would recomend this place to everyone!

I travelled with my daughter of 13 and had an excellent stay at Palermo Uno. We've spent a lot of time in Buenos Aires and we stayed both in hotels and apartments and this apartment is by far the best we ever stayed in. We booked transfer from the airport since its a caos at the airport and we were recived by Marcelo at the apartment who explained everything to us. The place is exactly as it looks like in the pictures, but the sunset is even more amazing than in pictures, it's really breathtaking, we couldn't get enough of it! The apartment is very well equipped and has for example towels to use by the pool, a coffee machine, olive oil and balsamic vinager, teabags, mate cocido, kitchen towel and cleanings stuff, things you don't always find at rental apartments.
We loved the pool that we used every day and also the gym that we used several times, the view makes it a lot easier to work out!
Palermo soho is our favorite area in Buenos Aires, it's close to all the nice shops and restaurants and to Bosques de Palermo were ALL porteños are running and exercising. Also very close to metro and all important buslines, taxi is cheap and you easily get one from the street. Highly recommend this amazing apartment!

Absolutely amazing apartment. Clean, comfortable, nice neighborhood, and probably the best views in all of Buenos Aires. Some of the most incredible sunsets I've seen- ever! Ralf was very helpful and professional, really appreciate him coordinating around our travel arrangements. Would definitely stay again!
Our stay was great and everything went smoothly. The location was perfect for exploring Palermo on foot. I would recommend for anyone coming to stay

The Palermo studio was the perfect location for my husband and I to make our home base while we explored Buenos Aires. It is exactly as pictured. We were greeted warmly and provided with a lot of useful information for our stay. We loved the terrace, had breakfast every morning there and also watched the sunset. The pool was amazing. We would stay again and recommend this place to others!

Our stay at Ralf's place in BA was the best we've experienced so far, in South America.  His staff is extremely prompt, knowledgeable, and responsive.  The location was everythin we expected it to be - very comfortable, great views, and an awesome location.  We walked all over Palermo from the apartment, and the easy access to the D line put the city at our fingertips.  Highly recommended!

Simply great experience with Ralf and the team. Is was very akin to staying in a 5* hotel. Ralf arranged a pick up for us from the airport which worked smoothly. Ralf was there to give us a great welcome, not only covering the apartment but also a great intro to Buenos Aries and some fantastic bar and restaurant selections. Also got us a great deal on our Tango Night. The apartment is simply top notch, 20th floor with fantastic views, good quality fittings, bedding, etc etc. Impossible to fault. The "office " was also there to help with laundry, taxis etc, all in all the best Airbnb Experience we have had.

The appartment is in one of the best areas of buenos aires with easy access to the subte (tube). The view is just incredible and the flat very convenient. The gym on the top gives another 360 view of the city which motivated us to exercise! Great experience overall, Marcelo warmly welcomed us, and by the 4th day it felt we were portenos ourselves!
Great apartment, and Eduardo was extremely helpful. Excellent location too. Would highly recommend!
Muy buen alojamiento. Los dueños muy atentos y la ubicación era muy cómoda.

The apartment is in a great location, very close to restaurants, shops and bars as well as public transport, the tourist bus line and bicycle rental.
Eduardo was very helpful, communication was easy and he provided all the information we needed about local and city life.
I would highly recommend this accomodation!

The apartment is great, exactly as it appears in the pictures. Eduardo is a great host, excellent communication, attentive, and very accommodating. I would definitely stay here again! Great place, great location.

Great place and great location. Apartment was exactly as described and seen in pictures. Located in great neighborhood with lots of shops and restaurants around. Eduardo was easy to communicate with and very helpful with all of our needs. Would definitely reccomend to others.

A z
O lugar é perfeito para fazer muitas caminhadas, sair pela noite. Quase Adoramos!!

Eduardo and Gisele have a beautiful apartment in a lovely area of Palermo.
My mother and I were really comfortable and Eduardo took the time to meet us personally, show us around the place, provide us with a subway card as well as emailing us during the stay with tips for where to see the tango in Buenos Aires. Fabulous experience!

This was the best place ever for my trip! 15 minutes walking from the heart of Palermo Soho (Plaza Armenia), and few minutes  from the most beautiful place ever (Paseo el Rosedal). We went to ALL the good places in Recoleta and Palermo for less than 75 pesos! It was the most awesome days ever! The location is perfect and the apartment is great! The kitchen, bed, everything! The view from the gym is PERFECT! Ralf's team gave us 2 easter eggs, such a lovely gift!!! Thanks Marcelo and all the team for everything!

Excellent view and facilities. Convenient location and a great building.
Ralf was also helpful with transportation. Thanks for having us, we had happy days in this flat.
Fantastica experiencia. De los 3 departamentos que use en las pasadas 4 semanas este fue el mejor. Super organizado y con detalles en la llegada que me sorprendieron gratamente.

A nice, nicely decorated apartment within walking distance to several interesting BA neighborhoods. The apartment is roomy, clean, and comfortable - though the noise and pollution from the main road deter any wishes to open the windows (problems common throughout the city). Ivan was a great, communicative, and welcoming host, making everything very simple - it was nice to be met personally after the whirlwind of arriving in BA!
O Ivan nos recebeu muito bem, o apartamento é ótimo e a localização excelente. Perto da Florida, de Puerto Madero, da Casa Rosada. Muito bom!

Ivan was super efficient on communicating with me. The apartment was in a great location but as with other reviews there is some street noise.The flat was clean, spacious and modern/reto sytle. Local bras are very good and the market on (Azopardo) Sunday is great place to wander and buy gifts.

El apartamento es tal cual las imágenes publicadas.
Muy próximo a Puerto Madero y a dos cuadras del centro de San Telmo. La comunicación con Ivan fue impecable, nos espero a la llegada y fue muy facil acceder a comunicarnos.
Recomendable.

Nossa estadia no apartamento de Ivan em Buenos Aires foi muito agradável. Fomos muito bem recebidos, o apartamento é ótimo e nos sentimos bem lá. A localização é ótima como ponto de partida para visitar os arredores da Plaza de Mayo e San Telmo. O unico ponto negativo talvez seja que a Avenida Paseo Colon talvez seja bastante movimentada, mas o que por outro lado facilita para pegar taxi, onibus e para melhorar a segurança ao entrar e sair do prédio.
O apartamento é bem equipado, inclusive nos surpreendemos com a disponibilidade de um secador de cabelo e de um ferro de passar! Ótimo!
Ah, e tomar um vinho ao som de um disco de Frank Sinatra tocado numa vitrola antiga na noite da chegada nao tem preço! Recomendamos!
O apartamento é lindo, como nas fotos. Perto de tudo e esta muito bem cuidado. San Telmo é um bairro maravilhoso. Adoramos!

Ivan was a great host, and everything was listed just as he described in the listing. We found the location to be great if you're interested in exploring San Telmo. It was safe, walking distance to many locations, and had a good feel to it.

Ivan is a great host! you will love this apartment.
Hopefully we'll be back!
The apartment in san telmo was really nice and clean! San telmo is a great neighborhood and we really enjoyed our stay there. It's a bit noisy but nothing you cant live with.
Apartamento charmoso, bem localizado e confortável, ótimo custo benefício. O proprietário Ivan se mostrou sempre muito prestativo e educado, recomendo o apartamento!

Apartamento de excelente localização para quem quer ficar perto de pontos turísticos, bares e restaurantes, fácil também para pegar metrô, ônibus e trem. O lugar é aconchegante, você se sente em casa, a decoração é de muito bom gosto (a geladeira é linda) o anfitrião é muito atencioso.

Excelente experiencia fue la que tuvimos en este departamento. Esta increiblemente bien ubicado, a unos pasos de la casa rosada, puerto madero, el obelisco etc. El host Ivan fue super atento en todos momentos dejandonos adaptadores de corriente, recomendaciones y hasta una botella de vino! Se los recomiendo totalmente!!

The apartment is cute. The street is really noisy so it is best to bring ear plugs. He left water, wine and fruit, which was a nice rich. And there are antiques and an old phonograph that works, with vintage records.
Todo bien . El Depto estaba impecable y muy cómodo. Perfectamente ubicado. Todo se resolvió como había sido arreglado. Recomendable

El apartamento se ve tal cual las fotos, limpio y prolijo. La atención fue muy buena,  cordial y puntual (llegamos 11.15 PM aprox.).  El gimnasio en el piso 31 tiene 1 cinta para correr, 2 bicicletas fijas, 1 escalador, 1 cama de pilates,  con una vista espectacular. Esta a 2 cuadras del metro con muy buen transporte colectivo. A unas 6/7 cuadras de la zona de restaurantes de Palermo Soho. El anfitrion fue muy amable al dejar bebidas frias, frutas y galletitas para nuestro arribo. En resumen una opción muy recomendable.
todo muy bien ,buen anfitrion,lindo dpto, bien cuidado,ubicacion  exelente

El estudio es tal y como aparece en las fotos. Las vistas hacia la ciudad son buenas, pero desde el gimnasio del último piso son espectaculares. El barrio es maravilloso: hermoso, seguro, bien comunicado y con un montón de restaurantes cerca. El aeropuerto Aeroparque está a menos de 15 minutos en taxi. El propietario ha confeccionado una magnífica lista de restaurantes recomendados, probamos tres de ellos y cada cual era mejor. El estudio es muy confortable para una pareja y aunque hay estrictas normas de seguridad para acceder al edificio, están permitidas las visitas sin problema. El chico que nos recibió fue puntual, amable y nos explicó todo lo necesario. Limpieza perfecta. Cocina totalmente equipada.

Always love staying with Ralph in Palermo Uno! I feel right at home and have everything you could possibly need in an apartment. I would never rent from anyone else in Buenos Aires and this is coming from someone who has visited the city dozens of times and stayed just about everywhere. Thanks as always Ralph for being so accommodating.

This apartment is amazing!!!
We met with Ralph he ran through everything about the property and spent a lot of time with us which was great so we had a really good understanding of the apartment and also the city.
I would certainly recommend this amazing apartment to future Airbnb guests the views are incredible the complex is amazing and the location is second to none close to amazing restaurants and bars. It's safe and secure and we had a great time

Marcelo nos recibió muy bien. Nos explicó todo lo concerniente al departamento y hasta nos dejó hacer un late check out, lo cual agradecimos mucho porque estábamos con un bebe. La descripción y fotos coincidían exactamente con el departamento. Una gran sensación de seguridad debido a las medidas del edificio. Muy bueno el detalle de las frutas y el agua. Excelente experiencia.

What a great and easy experience. Ralf was quick with any questions that we had and even let us stay 8 hours past check out because the apartment was vacant after our stay. I cannot stress how helpful and wonderful the whole experience was. Also, the best location in BA with an amazing city view. We will definitely be returning.

El departamento cumplió con todas las expectativas, las fotos corresponden a la realidad, la localización del edificio en relación con el transporte es muy buena y la vista que tiene es maravillosa.
Una excelente estadía.

The place is as advertised and I enjoyed my time stay there.  I interacted both with Ralf and Marcelo and both were great. I would not hesitate to recommend this apartment, which is quite nice and in an excellent location

Ralf's apartment is really nice. a beautiful view of Buenos Aires and the neighborhood is really cool. Ralf or Marcelo are really listening and kind, ready to advise us. I recommend highly the apartment.

This studio apartment was just perfect for our stay in BA.  It looks exactly like the photos and is well stocked with all of the necessary kitchen and bathroom items. Great location, great value - I definitely recommend this listing!

This was one of the best places I ever stayed through Airbnb! Thank you so much Ralf and your entire team for having me! Muchas gracias a todos! Hasta luego!
Top service. From the airport transfer to the check in, the apt was amazing and as advertised. Would highly recommend. Great area, great building and great host!

We really enjoyed our time in this apartment. Ivan was incredibly helpful and hospitable throughout our time in BsAs and was an amazing host for us. We would absolutely recommend this listing to friends and family visiting Buenos Aires.

A beautiful apartment exactly as described on the internet.
Located in the heart of BA, highly recommendable.
Ivan is a top host, doesn't knows problems, only solutions.

In Ebay Worten, gerne wieder.

Gran hospitalidad y disposición de los dueños del apartamento. La ubicación es excelente y resultó muy cómodo para tres personas.

Eduardo's and Giselle's place was great. Mooi appartement met leuk uitzicht. Locatie ook prima, dicht bij de metro en veel restaurants en winkels op loopafstand. Verder erg schoon en Ralf en zijn personeel zijn erg behulpzaam.

Great place! Awesome view of city.  The apartment has great security so is very safe. Walking distance to restaurants, etc.

The apartment is decorated VERY well and looks EXACTLY like the photos.  The view is stunning and I never got sick of waking up to it and watching the sunset from it. Great place to stay. Very central. Ralf is very accessible and easy to communicate with. Amazing sunset and great pool!
Beautiful view, very clean and safe. Well equipped. I would like to come back soon!

El departamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos, impecable y funcional. La vista desde el piso 20 es espectacular. Tiene un balconcito hermoso para sentarse a desayunar o tomar una copa por la noche.

Staff was very kindly help to us. And room condition was perfact location also. We want to stay other Ralf's room if we trip Buenosaires.

The location was just right, very centrally located with many restaurants nearby but at the same time very quiet in the apartment. Not to mention the stunning view, you can enjoy from any angle (including from the bed) of the apartment.

My husband and I had a fantastic stay at Ralf's place. From reservation to check out, it was a seamless process. Great location and view of the city!
Recomiendo a Eduardo, muy predispuesto. Buen alojamiento!
Muy atento Eduardo al momento de llegada y salida. El departamento es tal cual en las fotos, todo funciona perfecto, muy limpio y cómodo. La ubicación es excelente. 100% recomendado.

Ivan was there to meet us and made us very welcome. The flat was just as we expected and really cosy and comfortable. The location is great for seeing San Telmo and we walked to lots of sights from here. At night it got a little noisy from traffic but we got used to it.

Excellent apartment with a perfect location! Both Ivan and his flat were excellent, and just what our family was looking for. The flat is very well situated in San Telmo, just two blocks from a lively street with many outdoor bars and restaurants. This flat and host are highly recommended!

Ivan é muito simpático e prestativo. o único ponto que conviria melhorar seria o das chaves na hora da partida. não descobrimos como abrir a porta do prédio sem chaves, então tivemos que abri-la, um de nós ficou segurando a porta e o outro foi colocar a chave por debaixo da porta do apartamento, para irmos embora. quanto ao mais foi ótima a estadia e o atendimento. The apartment is nice and well located. Ivan was very accomodating and met us earlier to check in. He even checked on us often to ensure we had all you needed. We are definetely going to rent it out again if available on our next visit to Bs As.
Perfect location! It's close to everwhere, comfortable. Ivan was very kind he always asked if we need something. I'll go there again for sure.

Apartment was just as described and pictured. Ralf was very flexible with check in and check out times which helped a lot. Apartment was nothing less than beautiful. It's a great place to stay !

My husband and I LOVED our stay in Buenos Aires and that was all thanks to Ralf and his amazing Airbnb. Acogida simpática y puntual de Yvan.

Yvan redactar algunas fichas y mapas y guías están disponibles para ayudar a sus huéspedes.
El wifi perfectamente functiona.
Volveré ciertamente en el momento de mi llegada próxima.

Ivan's apartment is in a great location. Easy to walk to Plaza De Mayo and the city walk. Easy to walk to the San Telmo Sunday market and easy to get to colourful La Boca. Also you can walk to the ecological reserve.
The apartment is very comfortable, spacious and has good facilities. It is in a secure block. We loved the quirky decor and the large fluffy bathtowels.
It's on a main road so has lots of buses stopping outside which is handy but could be a noise problem if you are a light sleeper.
Ivan was a great host and we enjoyed the wine!
Ivan's apartment is in a great location in San Telmo - close to bars, restaurants, buses, Porto Madero, casa rosada and many other things. Clean, nice and spacious. It was a great stay; thanks again!

Ivan was a great host and waited for even though we arrived later than planned due to high security because of Barack Obama's visit! Great location for seeing San Telmo and walking to the Plaza del Mayo. The place was very clean and tidy and there was a nice bottle of wine waiting for us! The only bad thing was there were lots of road works outside which were a bit noisy. But a great stay nonetheless.

O apartamento é excelente! Muito bem cuidado, limpo, organizado e bem localizado! Excelente opção para uma estadia agradável em Buenos Aires! Os anfritriões deram muita atenção e tiveram cuidado de ajudar no que foi necessário! Recomendado!!!

O apartamento é como apresentado e tem tudo que se possa necessitar, de som, secador, ferro de passar roupa, sombrinhas ate cartao para metro e onibus.

Eduardo me recebeu pessoalmente, de modo muito acolhedor e dando varias dicas de cafes,bares, restaurantes e livrarias ao redor e de como me movimentar na cidade.

Excelente atención de los anfitriones , al igual que la ubicación , limpieza y equipamiento del dpto. todo mejor de lo q se ve en las fotos !!

Eduardo y Gisele's place was the perfect quaint flat located on the steps on everything you need in Palermo.  Both Eduardo and Gisele were very easy to deal with and only provided quick responses!!  Thanks for a lovely stay in one of our favorite cities!!!
Excelente localização. Nas proximidades há muitos bares, lojas e restaurantes.
Eduardo was a wonderful host and the apartment is super nice and perfectly located! I can recommend it for everyone...

Eduardo e Gis lemsao excelentes anfitriões. Nos recebem com atenção e generosidade. Seunapartamwnto tem tudo que seu pode precisar para estadia em Buenos Aires, incluindo dicas locais preciosas, roteiros de exposições atualizados e a melhor localização da cidade.

Excelente el dpto!!! Fuimos con un niño pequeño y una bebe y estuvimos muy comodos! Lo mejor de todo es la ubicación, todo super cerca, a lo sumo 5 o 6 cuadras... Excelente!!!

Eduardo was a very helpful and hospitable host. Despite our flight being delayed he waited for us and gave us some great tips on what to do and the area. Palermo Soho is a Great Place to stay at. Very lively at night and with lots of different restaurants! We stayed in the apartment with three people which was great!

My sister and I stayed in this Airbnb for 10 days over Christmas. It was perfect for playing tourist as it has an AMAZING location in Palermo Soho -- so close to many recommended restaurants. Eduardo and Gisele's house had many thoughtful touches like fresh flowers, local travel books, a few beers in the fridge for us, and maps/local guides. Eduardo was responsive and helpful to our questions. It was a wonderful, cozy apartment and I would absolutely recommend it to anyone else!

The apartment felt like home. It had everything we needed and was incredibly clean. The location is superb - neighborhood is fun and it is also walking distance to most of the places you might like to visit. A quiet space and great for sleeping, too. Thank you!

We were very happy with our stay at Eduardo and Gisele's apartment. It is located in a cool part of Palermo, with many restaurants, coffee shops and boutique shopping - only a short walk from the apartment. The apartment was very comfortable and the neighborhood is very quiet. Eduardo kept in touch with us prior to our arrival and during our stay to answer any questions we had and he was very prompt with his responses. He provided us with loads of information and guide maps of the area. There were chocolates on each bed stand, and fresh flowers in a vase on the dining room table - they were a very nice touch. Thank you, Eduardo, you were the perfect host! We look forward to rent your apartment again the next time we return to visit our son.
Muchas gracias,
Maryann J
Great apartment and awesome location!!!

Great location in Palermo Soho, a very convenient apartment.
