The aparment is in a very good location. Lots of bars? restaurants, shops yet the apartment is quite. The  hosts are lovely people.
Bueno para dos personas, buen sector.

This place is in a perfect location. Very close to many restaurants and shops. It had everything we needed for our 6 nights in BA, including for cooking and cleaning up. The space is a bit small, but that’s to be expected in a city apartment. We never could figure out how to open the bed in the living room.

Nos hospedamos en el departamento de Eduardo y Gisele en un viaje de negocios por motivo de la feria del libro de Buenos Aires. La ubicación es excelente , hay un montón de restaurantes, cervecerías, etc. Una zona muy linda para pasear, etc

Excelente! Recomendo a todos. Roupa de cama e toalhas limpos e muito cheirosos. Anfitrião muito atencioso, nos deu muitas dicas da cidade e ainda nos convidou para um show de milonga em uma escola de dança.
Eduardo denkt mee, geeft goeie tips en suggesties, maar is niet opdringerig. Fijn.

Leiligheten har utsikt og ligger veldig sentralt i en fin del av Buenos Aires, med kort vei til mange opplevelser. Vi som ikke er vant til å bo midt i en by opplevde litt støy siden den ligger «midt i smørøyet».  Veldig bra vertskap, god oppfølging både før og under oppholdet.
great place, great location and great hosts

This is a lovely location in the Palermo location.  Easy to walk to local restaurants and shopping.  The layout of the apartment makes it quite comfortable for a family.  The hosts left us fresh flowers and snacks which made our first days in the country seem that much nicer.  Wifi and a good TV made it easy to just relax "at home."
Apartamento bem localizado, com decoração, limpeza e conforto impecáveis. Recepção da equipe excelente. Obrigado por tudo.

Der Aufenthalt hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Alles ist so wie auf den Bildern, nur die Aussicht ist in Wirklichkeit noch besser ;)
Man merkt, dass die Wohnung aufmerksam eingerichtet ist, so hat es bspw. im Badezimmer Shampoo und Duschbehälter, einen Make-up Sortierer und einen Föhn. Zur Begrüssung hatte es frische Früchte und Wasser bereits im Kühlschrank.
Marcelo hat uns sehr ett empfangen und uns alles erklärt. Wir würden definitiv wieder kommen!

The apartment was beautiful, very clean, and had a lovely view of the city. The walls are a little thin - just something to be aware of if you are a very light sleeper (I am not but my boyfriend is, and you can sometimes hear people walking around on the floor above you). The neighborhood and location is a perfect base for exploring.

Excelente departamento! La mejor ubicación, a pasos del subte (linea D) y cerca de los mejores lugares de Palermo Soho.  Cómodo, limpio y con todo lo necesario para tener una gran estadía. Siempre elijo quedarme en los departamentos de Ralf asi que volveré en la próxima ocasión.  Super recomendable!
Very good place in great location . The apartment has everything you need to enjoy your stay. We would definitely choose to stay there again in future visits.

This was perhaps one the best AirBnBs I have stayed this year. The location is phenomenal and so are Eduardo & Gisele. The house was very comfortable, clean and cute. They also left us little local treats which added a really nice touch. Besides all the nice amenities listed, they also had towel heaters. How fancy! Perfect for the cold weather.
Eduardo was also nice to wait for us to give us the keys and instructions when our flight was delayed by 5 hours. Can't recommend them enough.

Ubicación inmejorable ! Súper recomendable para salidas a comer compras o salidas nocturnas
Apartamento cómodo y bien equipado ! Limpio !
Muchas gracias por todo !!

O apartamento de Eduardo e Gisele é muito agradável. Nossa experiência foi no inverno, entre 15 e 21 de julho de 2018, e só temos elogios a fazer: conforto, cuidado, gentileza, disponibilidade e muitas dicas nos foram proporcionadas nessas férias. Eduardo é um gentleman. A localização é especial, em Palermo Viejo, próxima a tudo o que importa, desde a pracinha onde as crianças se divertem (inclusive com a histórica calesita - carrossel - tão apreciada nessa cidade), até restaurantes, pubs, lojinhas de todos os matizes, supermercados, livrarias, bosques, metrô, ônibus, tudo está ao alcance de alguns passos. Pretendemos voltar, sem dúvidas! Mais uma vez, obrigado a Eduardo e Gisele. Abraços de George, Nági e Laís.

Se quiser se hospedar em Buenos Aires, não hesite em procurar Eduardo e Gisele. Um apartamento aconchegante, com todo o cuidado no que é essencial e um capricho notável nos detalhes charmosos. A localização é excelente, no coração de Palermo. A recepção pelo Eduardo é incrível: anfitrião genuinamente preocupado com o conforto e bem-estar de seus hóspedes. Estivemos em família, com duas crianças pequenas, de 6 anos e 1 ano e meio, que também curtiram muito. Não se preocupe com o frio, todos os ambientes ficam bem quentinhos. Aproveite para comprar na vizinhança mediaslunas, dulce de leche e faça seu desayuno na cozinha super equipada, ao som dos Tribalistas, Ney Matogrosso ou tangos argentinos. Dale!

Eduardo & Gisele have a lovely apartment which is in a fantastic location in Palermo, such close walking distance to bars, restaurants , supermarkets etc!
The place was extremely cosy and comfortable, we felt very much at home during our stay and would highly recommend the place to anyone visiting Buenos Aires! Eduardo was very quick to respond to any questions also.

L'hospitalité et l'attention d'Eduardo est exceptionnelle. c'est un hôte qui connait sa ville et qui peut vous renseigner sur n'importe quel sujet la concernant. L'appartement a du charme et représente bien le quartier où il est inséré.

Palermo Soho est un quartier tranquille avec quelques rues suivant les tendences bobo mondiales (on mange organique, on travaille dans le café du coin en écoutant Ella Fitzgerald et l'architecture ancienne remanescente est mise en valeur par le commerce local. c'est sympa d'y faire un tour la nuit ou la journée. on se sent sûr vis à vis de la sécurité.

c'était un super séjour !

Merci Eduardo.
Eduardo’s flat is nice and very well located. Lots of restaurants, coffee places and bars around the area. The place itself it’s very comfy and Eduardo hospitality it’s remarkable.
Excelente localização ! Super recomendo ! O Eduardo é muito cortês.

Location is pretty good. Good walking distance to local restaurants and bars. Eduardo greeted us right at 1400 and gave us a quick tour and some tips for what to eat and what to do. Our flight left very late our last day and Eduardo extended our checkout time from 1100am which was very helpful since we didn’t have to worry about our bags and got to explore the city! Highly recommend this place.

Lovely little apartment, quiet, clean and aesthetic decoration. Prompt communication with Eduardo, he was very helpful and pendiente. Immediate help with a request, for instance, he organized the sofa-bed, which has temporarily been replaced, on the same say that I arrived. Eduardo and Gisele have great tips for any taste and needs in the hood (library, veggie, yoga, parillada etc).

Eduardo and Gisele made our trip! We were traveling with a six month old, and we were hoping for a cosy place, in a great location, where we might feel at home while exploring BA. This was the perfect spot. They helped us with all the little things to ease our travel like renting a crib and stroller to inviting us to take Tango lessons. The appartment is situated at a perfect place to discover Buenos Aires, and we espacially enjoyed very much the sunny terass that was a perfect brekfast place with a cool view at the city. The appartment was nice and clean and with everything you need for a confortable stay. Next time we will love to be there again!

Terrific location just a block and a half from 9 de Julio and a quick walk to the Moreno Subte - plus a great view with a gigantic Evita benevolently looking down. I found it a good central base to explore the city. It was my first time in BA and Ruy was very helpful in orienting me to the city and suggesting some cultural options for the evening.  As a wayfarer on a budget, this was exactly what I was hoping for.

El departamento tiene una ubicación central. Por la zona pasan muchas lineas de colectivos para ir los lugares más alejados. San Telmo está muy cerca, la zona de Avenida de Mayo y la Av. 9 de Julio también, se puede ir a pie. El apartamento está bien equipado, tiene cocina a gas y micro ondas, nevera, pava eléctrica y hasta una plancha! Tiene utencillos de cocina como para poder preparar tus comidas. Aunque a muy pocos metros hay un restaurante por kilo de calidad y con buen precio :)
Los ambientes son amplios, la cama confortable y tamaño king. La habitación tiene un pequeño escritorio, ventilador , amplios placares y espejo. El living tiene un tv lcd con servicio de direct tv y un amplio sillón. El balcón es amplio, con mesa, sillas y hasta una tumbona, muy bien ambientado con plantas. Ruy es muy amable y buen anfitrión, el departamento lo recibimos limpio y todo según lo acordado.

Ruy is a wonderful host and the apartment is lovely and incredibly well located.  Our experience in Buenos Aires was amazing and we can’t thank Ruy enough.  He guided us as to where to go and what to do.  We highly recommend Ruy’s place!!!

El piso es muy muy luminoso, limpio, silencioso y práctico. Tiene todas las comodidades y está en una calle tranquila. Además, hay un súper justo debajo muy completo que facilita mucho la estancia. Las condiciones de alquiler son muy sencillas y Ruy estuvo pendiente de cualquier cosa que necesitáramos. La terraza tiene buenas vistas y es perfecta para un día soleado. Si volviera a Buenos Aires, me gustaría volver a este apartamento.

We have stayed at Ruy apartment almost three weeks. It is bright apartment with really great balcony. We found everything we need in the
closest neighborhood (my husband even buy a guitar hihihi). And the most important is the host - Ruy keeps helping their guests, it was very pleasant experience.
Pasamos una estancia fenomenal, Ruy es un buen anfitrion, y su apartamento es confortable y esta muy bien ubicado.

Lovely well appointed apartment with balcony views over a great neighbourhood. Ruy is a friendly, knowledgeable and helpful host who pointed us in the right direction for fun and arranged our early morning airport transfer too.

Perfect short stay!

I stayed 4 nights here and had a lovely experience. We arrived late on a Fri night and were greeted, given the keys and told about what we could see and do in the local area. The flat was a perfect location for walking around the city and close to metro stations and main roads. The terrace had a lovely view and it was a joy to eat outside and have a wide open space behind us.

A nice apartment with a very friendly host. Great value for money, excellent location, really close to trains, shops, restaurants. We enjoyed our time there.

Ladny apartament, wlasciciel pomocny przy kazdej okazji. Swietna relacja wartosci do ceny, doskonala lokalizacja, blisko metra, sklepow i restauracji. Udany pobyt.

Ruy was a wonderful host; very attentive. The apartment was excellent value with a lovely balcony. I would definitely recommend it. It was within walking distance of San Telmo (which is a great part of BA) and not far from the centre. There is a little supermarket right underneath the apartment building. The apartment includes free satellite TV and wifi. The only (slight) problem was that several of the electric plugs didn't work.

O apartamento do Ruy é ótimo. Ficamos apenas 1 noite, mas deu para notar que há ali tudo do que se precisa para uma estada perfeita.

As negociações com o Ruy foram rápidas e objetivas. Ele é um anfitrião muito gentil, pontual e nos ajudou muito. Precisávamos de um lugar para passar a noite e ele não só nos aceitou como, ainda, topou colocar uma cama a mais para que ficássemos todos juntos. Só tenho a agradecer.

Ruy is a good host, very kind and available with the guests. His flat is very well located, clead and with a very nice terrace!
I recommend it.

We spent 2 days at Sunny Terrace Apart and could have spent some more! The flat is very nice, fully equipped and the terrace (without vis-à-vis) really appreciable. The communication with Ruy was very fluent, and Ruy was available and helpful for practical infos on the city. Check in and check out were simple and easy. We recommend Sunny Terrace Apart, well located between Centro and San Telmo.

Ruy was a very friendly and helpful host. The apartment is very well located, clean and sunny, with a nice balcony. We spent almost 4 weeks and would be happy to come back. We highly recommend this lovely place. Thank you Ruy! Marianne and Urs

Awesome apartment in a great neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and bars.  Walking distance to most of the major tourist attractions, San Telmo market, and the subway is a few blocks away.  Loved the view from the balcony, and the bed was comfortable.  Probably our best nights of sleep during the 2+ weeks we were in South America.

The place is well located in the hart of Buenos Aires,with acces to trasport,shopping and restaurants,just walking. The Flat cater for all your needs and Ruy have it well maintained, a well stocked kitchen with pot's if you like your own meals and plenty of room in the living and bethdroms,bathroom is  fully renovated, you get sun in the bacony al day, WIFI is fast and the cable on teh TV give  you access to multiple chanels in diferent  languages. In all  a very good  experince, Thanks  Ruy for your  hopitallity

Ruy was a wonderful host. Ruy was responsive to my needs and at the same time I was able to do my own thing without any issues or disruptions. The apartment was perfect--clean, sunny and bright, and it has a beautiful balcony for sunbathing and relaxing! The neighborhood is quiet and safe; it is also close to the subway and all areas are easily accessible. I highly recommend this apartment and Ruy as a host.

Sonya
O apartamento de Ivan é muito bem localizado e tem um clima vintage muito bacana. Ele deixou dicas de passeio e indicações úteis (restaurantes, mercados, transporte, etc). Fomos muito bem recebidos.

The apartment is in a good place. The space was clean, comfortable, and had a unique interior. Ivan is a sincere host so he answered the guest questions carefully. He lives close to the room, so he could be able to react if it had a problem. It is a disadvantage that the noise of a large road outside the window has not been blocked.

This apartment was perfect. It looks exactly like the pictures and the view is even more stunning in person. The apartment is equipped with everything you need for a great stay and it is located in the best part of the city. You can walk to so many great restaurants and bars and also can access the entire city using nearby public transportation. The check in process was incredibly easy and Ralf was responsive to any request, including providing great recommendations for bars and restaurants in the area. Ralf’s associate handled the check in but Ralf also stopped by in person to make sure that my stay was going well. Overall it was a wonderful experience and I would recommend it to anyone traveling to Buenos Aires.

Ralf's apartment was very well kept and maintained, nice kitchen and beautiful view. The location was central and located near the train. The apartment also had great security. The Host and his team was very professional and on-call for any concerns. We would definitley stay here again.

Es un departamento , con exelente vistas , limpieza , calidad , muy practico , todo espectacular, la atencion por parte de Marcelo un diez , muy correcto y confiable , lo recomiendo 100 x 100  , abrazo grande a todos el equipo de Ralf .
Great apartment and great location, it would be hard to find anything better. Ruy has been very helpful throughout out stay here, I would really recommend it

I stayed 7 nights at Ruy's apartment and I really enjoyed the place which was truly clean, sunny, warm and well located. You can find everything you need not only inside the apartment but also around (there's a supermarket and a Pizza club in the same street). Ruy is a great person, interested in making your staying confortable and he will be always available for whatever you need. I highly recommend you to stay here!!! I'm sure you will have good fun and a great time as well.

Ruy was great as was the beautiful apartment! Ruy was helpful in every single way possible and quick and responsive to any of my questions and concerns. I couldn't have asked for a better experience for my first time in Buenos Aires. I would definitely stay here again on a next visit. The apartment is very well kept and clean, and in a central and safe neighborhood. Thanks, Ruy!!!

Ruy was a great host.  I did not have a problem with the apartment.  The apartment was clean and the bed was comfortable.  He was very accommodating and helpful. He provided great insight on the places to go, areas to avoid, and suggested great eateries. The neighborhood was safe, about a 10 min walk from San Telmo, it was never an inconvenience. The Cuban restaurant next door became a favorite of mines during my stay.  When I had a problem, Ruy was more than concerned with my safety and accommodated me immediately. I'd rent from Ruy again.

Ruy est un hôte sérieux et accueillant. Il parle couramment anglais. Il est disponible et il habite à l'étage en dessous. Nous avons passé 2 semaines (avec nos 2 enfants) dans son appartement et c'était parfait pour visiter Buenos Aires (commerces à proximité, métro, bus). Ruy répond à toutes vos questions sur la ville (il la connait parfaitement). L'appartement est grand et lumineux.
Seul regret lors de notre séjour, le four ne fonctionnait pas mais nous avons pu cuisiner autrement. La connexion internet était très rapide la 1ère semaine mais pas la 2ème (Ni Ruy ni nous n'avons compris). Au final, un excellent rapport qualité prix pour Buenos Aires.

Nous avons passé une très agréable semaine dans cet appartement lumineux et confortable. Il est très bien localisé, dans un immeuble ancien, au dernier étage avec une vue panoramique. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié la chambre indépendante du salon avec ses nombreux placards et sa bonne literie. Nous avons pu nous préparer de bons petits plats car la cuisine est bien équipée. Le wifi fonctionnait bien. Bref, un excellent rapport qualité prix.
Quant à notre hôte Ruy, il a été aimable et serviable. Il nous a aidé et renseigné chaque fois que nécessaire. Nous recommendons sans restrictions !

It was very nice. I like the roof terrace a lot. "breakfast included" is however a gross exhaggeration. Pretty misleading if you ask me. Ruy is very friendly and helpful. The wifi worked for a couple of hours, but was out of order or barely useable for the rest of our stay.
Overall very nice, and well worth the money.
Apartamento confortável e aconchegante, além de ter uma vista linda  e ser bem localizado. Recomento!

Estuvimos hospedados 12 dias. El aparamento es excelente, tal cual como se ve en las fotografias. Calefaccion, agua caliente, cocina, internet, tv por cable... La terraza es genial. La ubicacion tambien es muy buena. Tiene cerca muchos bares, restaurantes, abastos, zonas de interes turistico, estacion del metro. Es silencioso y tranquilo a pesar de estar en la zona del centro. En muchas oportunidades anduvimos en los alrededores a la media noche y me parece segura la zona. Ruy fue muy amable y presto a colaborar en todo momento. Cuando vuelva a Buenos Aires, sin duda intentare alojarme alli nuevamente. Por cierto, no hubo desayuno incluido como dice el anuncio.
Everything about this apt is great. Marcelo took the time to explain everything clearly. The view is incredible and the apt was luxe and comfortable.
Loved the place, the view, the small touches that make it an experience rather than just a stay. Very professional, will stay whenever I’m in Palermo.

El lugar es muy tranquilo y cerca de los centros comerciales, Ralph muy buen anfitrión,  muy amable y servicial, dispuesto a ayudar en cada momento y dar las explicaciones justas. El departamento tenía algunos detalles como diferentes cables para cargar celulares, adaptadores. Así también como posee pileta tenía todo el equipo indispensable para concurrir a la misma, sombreros, toallas, pareos.  La cocina estaba muy bien equipada
Amazing stay at this apartment. Everything from check in to check out was amazing. Also the security and location can not be beat. There is no better place in Palermo!

Absolutely perfect place for our week in BA.  It is safe, secure and in the best location for Palermo (soho or Hollywood) and is very close to the metro.  The facilities and support is superb.  If you are in any doubt book it - you won’t be disappointed.

We just cannot  say enough good things about the apt, the location, the organization and kindness of Raif and Marcelo. It was an absolutely fabulous stay: studio and building are fantastic with a great view; close to sunte, bus and lots of shops and restaurants. Fun neighborhood. The communication was easy and efficient and information upon arrival was invaluable assistance on how to enjoy and get around BA! They have overlooked nothing and put hotel concierge service to shame! They made our stay in BA so much easier and enjoyable for us.  Thank you, thank you, thank you. We hated to leave.

Me and my wife had the most wonderful time there. The apartment is gorgeous and the view is outstanding. Location is a plus. Just a few blocks form all hotspots in Palermo and still very quite. I would definitely repeat the experience.
Highly recommend! Awesome views and stylish apartment. Regular booker of this apartment whenever I’m in town for business
El lugar muy lindo, la atencion d los chicos muy buena y la zona espectacular, estuvimos un fin de semana y estuvo todo genial!

Great space, with a nice view, clean, and in a nice location! Ruy was a very attentive host and I was able to find everything that I needed. What else is there to say?

One small detail: the laundromat across the street does next-day service, so if you need to do laundry while you're there, don't wait until the last morning like I did!

We stayed at Ruy's place for one night and we have no complaints. Ruy was extremely knowledgeable of the area and was able to recommend several great places to eat within 5 minutes walking distance. He also keeps some very good BA magazines in English that we used to find some great local spots in San Telmo.

Ruy also never hesitated to make himself available if needed. Would highly recommend Ruy and his apartment for any length of stay in BA.

El departamento de Ruy tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia agradable y una terraza con vista espectacular. Ruy es un excelente anfitrión, muy atento y se ofreció a llevarnos al aeropuerto. Lo recomiendo totalmente.

Ruy was an excellent host and the apartment was exactly as advertised. Ruy was attentive and easy to talk to, and really knowledgeable about Buenos Aires (he's had experience living abroad, knows the local area, and is bilingual); he was helpful and offered great assistance (for instance, changing US dollars to Argentinian pesos, which can be a little hair due to the different exchange rates, and calling a cab to Puerto Madero - I got a really talkative, friendly cab driver who was a joy to speak with).

The apartment itself is cozy, well-furnished, and the noise level is easy to control - the noise of the city life is right outside, but if you want quiet, it's as simple as closing all the windows. Everything worked well, including the wireless internet, which I had no trouble with. A few outlets in the house didn't seem to function, but that was trivial and easy to overcome. Additionally, the location is great - everything you need to, well, live, is pretty much within three blocks, and the view is great!

Overall, my stay at Ruy's apartment was great and I wouldn't hesitate to do it again. I would highly recommend it.

My husband and I were blown away when we walked into the apartment! It's beautiful, large, & bright! Ruy is very friendly and accommodating. He was in constant communication with us and is an excellent host. We even booked another stay with him via another airbnb apartment!
We spent 2 days in Ruy's flat and we really had great time there. The apartment is really nice, comfortable, fully equiped and very sunny. Ruy was very helpful and nice !

First of all, Ruy is a great host! He was helpful in any given way: Changed money for us, brought us to the airport, offered to pick us up and gave a lot of useful and interesting informations about the great city. Thank you so much for everything!
The place itself is absolutely awesome! 7 floors above the city with a great view and a short way to Avenue of July 9th. There are a lot of restaurants very close to the place and a supermarket offering anything you might need in the first floor.
If you want to, you can easily prepare your own food in the kitchen for it has a stove, refrigerator and even a microwave. What more can you ask for? :-)

Ruy, was a fantastic host and the apartment was great. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything we needed. There is a grocery store on the main floor of the building. Location is awesome. We ended up walking to most tourist spots, but hopped on the subway when needed. We spent New Years Eve on the terrace overlooking the city.
Great place to stay. We extended our trip.
Apartamento bom, pena a internet não ter funcionado a partir do segundo dia.
Amazing place!
Great location in Palermo, perfect space for a few days to see the city, unbelievable views and wonderful amenities! Would definitely return 👍🏼
Easy check in, lots of beautiful details in the place and many helpful tips in the accompanying stay binder.

Stylish and spacious studio apartment in the heart of Palermo, which has loads of restaurants, bars and nice pockets of green space. Very secure (24hr security at the entrance gates). Great views across the city from the terrace. Thoughtful additions in the apartment - fruit bowl on arrival, lots of toiletries in the bathroom and plenty of guides/maps. Recommended.

Great views over the city and a great location make this a perfect place for couples wanting either a lively pace, or somewhere to chill out. Ralf was a great host and the apartment was immaculate, plus the bed was extremely comfortable compared to others we've stayed in on our world tour. The shower also has good water pressure, which was a big thumbs up for us. The only downside for us was that the pool is closed after April 15th, which was just after we arrived, but id still recommend this place 100%. Book it now, you won't regret it.
Great space, lovely place.

Local exatamente como descrito, local lipo e arejado, tem um toque vintage de muito bom gosto. Apt extremamente confortável e bom para descansar depois de um dia inteiro de turismo. Se voltar a Buenos Aires ficarei la novamente. Recomendo!
Muy bonito el depto. Cómodo, limpio y bien ubicado. Iván es un 7 como anfitrión. Nos dio consejos y nos ayudó en lo que necesitabamos. 100% recomendado.

Excelente ubicacion para ir a la Feria de San Telmo y alrededores. El departamento impecable e Ivan un excelente anfitrion.  Solo el ruido de los trabajos del metro bus y la calle pueden ser un poco molesto al que no esta acostumbrado al ruido de la ciudad.

Fácil localização no Bairro de San Telmo. Com uma tranquila caminhada pode ir a vários pontos turístico.
A estrutura do apartamento está em conformidade com a descrição. Tudo funcionou normalmente.

Ivan foi um anfitrião muito educado e muito prestativo. Sempre respondia rápido quando precisamos de ajuda. Nos deixou várias dicas da cidade. O apartamento é muito limpo, lindo e agradável! Recomendo! Será uma estadia inesquecível! !

Ivan é um ótimo anfitrião, nos recebeu muito bem, deu várias dicas ótimas e o apartamento fica em uma região privilegiada, perto do porto madero, casa rosada, caminito! Recomendo muito e quando puder retornarei com certeza

Apartamento extremamente limpo e bem localizado, anfitrião muito atencioso e gentil.
Nos chamou atenção a limpeza com as roupas de cama!
Os únicos pontos negativos foram a internet, pois ficamos um dia inteiro sem ela e e achamos o apartamento um tanto barulhento, por estar numa rua extremamente movimentada a qualquer hora do dia.
muy recomendado... Ivan es un muy buen anfitrion y el lugar es muy comodo...

Apartamento fiel a descrição, em ótima localização. O Ivan foi paciente em nos esperar pois tivemos problemas de translado, nos recebeu e foi atencioso ao passar todas as instruções referentes as instalações. O apartamento contém roupas de cama e banho. Destaco a dificuldade de adaptação referente a água quente do chuveiro, mas por falta de conhecimento sobre o funcionamento do aquecedor, o que demandou tempo para quatro pessoas tomarem banho. No mais, fomos recebidos com vinho, frutas e folhetos de serviços locais disponíveis nas proximidades. Excelente!

Tivemos uma estadia ótima, a casa muito boa, aconchegante, com todos os aparelhos funcionando. Casa muito bem localizada, perto de tudo. Área nobre do centro de buenos Aires!! Transporte público na porta e metrô a 10 minutos da residencia! O barulho do trânsito incomoda um pouco, pois a casa fica no primeiro andar, e de frente pra avenida, mas se vai a passeio não tem muito que se preocupar! A internet da casa oscila muito! O único problema que tivemos foi na hora de entrar na casa, pois tivemos que ficar a disposição do dono da casa, contudo, o mesmo compensou no checkout!!
Super indico esta residência!

Perfect place to stay in BA. Easy to find and you get a warm welcome by Ruy. He is very keen to help you in any way to make your stay as best as possible.
Ask him for transport and change of money on the blue market.
The apartment is very clean and has all what you need. Good kitchen facilities and a fine bathroom. Fast wifi and a lot of channels on the TV.
From livingroom and bedroom there is access to a wonderfull terrasse with view to the the big Evita portrait.
Supermarket with fruit and vegs next door and if you want you can walk to city center. Remember to do the Free Walking tours in BA.
If we come back to BA, we will for sure stay here again and can recommend Ruys apartment.
Ruy war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut gelegen und hat eine wunderbare Terrasse mit Blick auf die Stadt.

We had a fantastic stay! Ruy was a great host! Everything was clean and ready for us to use. No problems with arrivals and departures. Ruy was very helpful in everything. All of his recommendations of things to do in the area were superb. Our stay in Buenos Aires was exponentially better. When we came back, we of course stayed in the same place again. And if we ever come back, we will stay again!

Nuestra estadía en el departamento de Ruy fue excelente!. Las fotos muestran exactamente como es el departamento y los ambientes son muy comodos, con todo lo necesario para una estadía confortable. La caracteristica a resaltar de los departamentos que Ruy ofrece, es que la ubicación es magnifica, cerca a todos los puntos turísticos de interés, incluso puedes hacer muchos de ellos caminando si disfrutas de caminar, si lo tuyo no es caminar, estas bien conectado porque tiene muy cerca una estación de Subte, y varias líneas de buses pasan cerca al edificio y por tanto te puedes mover fácilmente. Hay buenos restaurantes y cafeterías cerca e incluso un minimarket en la parte baja del edificio con todo lo que puedas necesitar. Solo me queda agradecer a Ruy por ser un excelente anfitrión siempre dispuesto a ayudar - (gracias por recogernos en la terminal de BuqueBus y dejarnos en el Aeropuerto a pesar que tenía otros huéspedes llegando)- y a brindar buenas recomendaciones, realmente conoce su ciudad y fue un gusto tratar con él. Recomendamos a Ruy a otros miembros de la comunidad.

Ruy was a excellent host, the photos show exactly how is the appartment. Very confortable bed and lots of hot water. Great location to get all the turistic points, close to a subway and well served with many public transport close to the area. Even you have a minisupermarket in the first floor with everything you could need to do simple meals and have a glass of wine after a long day discovering Buenos Aires.
Thanks Ruy for everything!.We recomend his appartments to other members of airbnb

Cecilia
This place is wonderful, with a balcony and a great view. Location is amazing. Really sweet.
Great views and location! Communication and check in were great, would definitely come back!

Great unit in Buenos Aires!  Fantastic views in a secure building in the best part of the city.  Very comfortable bed, great little kitchen, nice flat screen TV,  good internet access  and very nice bathroom. The manager promptly met us there when we arrived, made sure we had everything we needed (had fresh fruit and coffee in the unit when we arrived) and showed us the amenities of the building, like the fantastic gym on the 31st floor with unbelievable views!  Good washer & dryers in the basement but be sure to bring a lot of pesos...  they only take coins.  Absolutely love the unit and if we go back to Buenos Aires, we are definitely going to try and stay there again!  Great value for the price! Thanks Ralf!!

My mom and I really enjoyed Ralf's place. The building is modern and secure, the apartment itself was very stylish and clean, and the location being a short walk to a subway station was great. If we ever get a chance to go back to Bs. As., I'd want to stay at Ralf's again.
Perfectly located in Palermo and far enough away from the noise LOVED with a SUBTE we were off and racing in no time

We stayed at Ralf's insta-worthy condo in Palermo, Buenos Aires and had a fantastic experience. We were welcomed personally by one of the hosts and given a thorough tour and overview of the property and local tips. The condo felt safe and secure and it was thoughtfully supplied and modernly decorated. We enthusiastically recommend Ralf's properties!

Great apartment in a fantastic location. The only downside was that the hot water was not working in the shower. Nevertheless, within hours of contacting the owner this issue was resolved.
Overall i would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking to stay in one of the trendiest areas of Buenos Aires.
Wonderful apartment in a great location near many hip bars and restaurants. Truly amazing view from your balcony. You won’t regret booking this place
Apartamento muito bom, limpo, bem localizado e confortável. O único inconveniente que tivemos foi a falta de internet, que não funcionou nenhum dia que estávamos lá e precisava para trabalhar.
El departamento es muy bueno. Classico y hermoso
Ivan es un excelente anfitrión, muy atento y pendiente siempre. El departamento cerca de importantes puntos de la ciudad. Recomendado!
Apartamento muito bem localizado, limpeza impecável e muito confortável! Se tivermos a oportunidade de voltar a Buenos Aires já sabemos onde ficar novamente! Super recomendo.

L'appartement d'Ivan est très bien situé ! Très bien décoré et très confortable.  Il est très propre et Ivan est très réactifs à la moindre demande. C'est idéal pour découvrir Buenos Aires et particulièrement le quartier de San Telmo. je le recommande !

Apartamento aconchegante, bem localizado mas os quartos são um pouco barulhentos por causa da avenida movimentada que fica o prédio, na primeira noite incomodou bastante, mas depois acostumei, e o wifi definitivamente não funcionou! Ivan é bem atencioso e respondeu rápidamente todas as minhas mensagens!!
Increible depar, estiloso, bien unicado, Iván muy atento.
Todo mas que bien!!!!

This apartment was good for us - 2 couples looking for a quiet weeklong holiday in Buenos Aires. The apartment was comfortable and had lots of character, and Ivan was extremely responsive. Fun neighborhood with bars, cafes, parks, and tango.
Todo muy bien, zona, anfitrión, etc
Ivan es una persona muy amable... recomendadisimo para las personas que quieran visitar Buenos Aires

Foi uma experiência maravilhosa! A casa é muito aconchegante e limpa. Fica próxima aos principais pontos turísticos. Muitos pontos de ônibus em frente ao prédio. A rua em frente é bastante movimentada por ser uma das principais avenidas, porém não incomodou muito. A internet oscila, mas isso não foi um grande problema. Ivan foi muito legal, atento e gentil. Nós atrasamos na chegada e mesmo assim ele foi muito paciente em nos esperar. Recomendo muito!

Расположение практически идеальное - можно быстро добраться до основных достопримечательностей и позавтракать / поужинать без долгих поездок на такси.

В квартире приятно находиться, классный интерьер в ретро стиле

We enjoyed staying in this apartment. It’s budget friendly, centrally located and easily walkable to many shops, restaurants, and landmarks. Public transportation is right across the street or you can easily catch a cab. The street noise that people before us have written about didn’t bother us, because it was more like a white noise. The other residents of the building were friendly, as well.
Muy buena ubicación y excelente departamento, muy recomendable.

Súper recomendado!! Ha sido una gran estadía en Buenos Aires, el apt. Está muy bien ubicado, se tiene cerca markets, restaurantes, bares y el metrobús. Es un lugar súper cómodo y acogedor. Muchas gracias por todo Ivan!

Great location with great hospitality. Ivan is great and very prompt will with response. The apartment is exactly as you see it. Such a good guy. Will definitely stay here the next time am in BA. Thanks Ivan you are such a blessing

Ivans place is a great place in Buenos Aires! Suitable for any traveler. Located 5 minutes walking distance from Plaza De Mayo, with buses and subtes departing whenever you need it close by.

Ivan is the perfect host! He helped us with anything we asked for, and provided clear communication throughout our stay. I have no complaints at all.
